job.title: Associate Producer – ABC News Live (As-Needed) (Expression of Interest)
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Associate Producer – ABC News Live (As-Needed) (Expression of Interest) Job ID 10165027 Location New York, New York, United States Business ABC News Date posted Nov. 11, 2026 Associate Producer – ABC News Live (As-Needed) (Expression of Interest) Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements ABC News Live is seeking expressions of interest from experienced Associate Producers who may be available to support our 24/7 streaming news operation in New York. This is an opportunity to join our as-needed talent pool for future production needs, including breaking news and other coverage requiring additional editorial support. We are interested in journalists who thrive in fast-paced environments, react quickly to breaking news, generate strong story ideas, source compelling video, demonstrate solid news judgment, and work effectively under tight deadlines. This posting is an opportunity to submit your resume for future consideration; this is not a role that is open at this time. We anticipate this role may be open in the future, but we are not actively hiring for the position. If you would like to be considered for this potential role, please submit your resume. If the role becomes available, you may receive an email or call from a recruiter. What You May Do Produce a variety of stories, including writing, editing video, and creating graphics or working with Graphics Team to segment produce. Source video and other editorial elements and help keep coverage fresh as stories develop and editorial needs arise Support production in a high-pressure, fast-paced control room environment. Take initiative while collaborating closely with producers and the broader editorial team. What We’re Looking For At least 3 years of

experience

producing in a digital, streaming, or broadcast environment. Familiarity with Avid and/or other non-linear editing software,

experience

with iNews, and camera shooting

experience

preferred. Ability to take initiative and manage multiple assignments simultaneously. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. Prior video production experience, strong editorial judgment, writing skills, organization, and attention to detail. Flexibility to work a variety of shifts, which may include evenings, overnights, weekends, holidays, and breaking-news coverage.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in TV, film, journalism, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The pay rate for this role in New York, NY is $300.00 per day. Select

benefits

may be provided as part of the compensation package, such as medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. To learn more about our

benefits

visit: https://jobs.disneycareers.com/benefits. This position is with American Broadcasting Companies, Inc., which is part of a business we call ABC News. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. American Broadcasting Companies, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs . We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. job.title: Broadcast Maintenance Technician (Expression of Interest) (As-Needed)
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Broadcast Maintenance Technician (Expression of Interest) (As-Needed) Job ID 10165067 Location Washington, DC, United States Business ABC News Date posted Nov. 11, 2026 Broadcast Maintenance Technician (Expression of Interest) (As-Needed) Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements ABC Network News Engineering Operations has daily hire opportunities in our broadcast maintenance department at our studios in Washington, DC. This role supports a wide variety of broadcast systems that provide television production, transmission, communications, monitoring and various technical support for award-winning ABC News shows and platforms. It is a great opportunity for someone who wants to be an important part of a cutting-edge network level broadcast operation. This posting is an opportunity to submit your resume for future consideration; this is not a role that is open at this time. We anticipate this role may be open in the future, but we are not actively hiring for the position. If you would like to be considered for this potential role, please submit your resume. If the role becomes available, you may receive an email or call from a recruiter. The candidate must possess working knowledge and skills in television technology and engineering. In particular, the candidate should have a good understanding of studio, transmission and editing systems. Three or more years of broadcast maintenance

experience

is preferred. Knowledge in network-based Video and Audio technology such as SMPTE 2110, AES 67 and DANTE would be helpful. As a broadcast maintenance technician, the candidate will work as part of a team to provide ongoing support for a 24/7 television broadcast facility including the installations of new systems. The ABC Washington Bureau has multiple studios, control rooms, editing systems and other broadcast resources that the candidate will assist in building and maintaining including: Sony and Ross Production Switchers SSL and Lawo Audio Consoles Miranda, GV and Evertz Virtual Monitor Walls Sony, Panasonic, Canon Studio Camera Systems RTS and Riedel Intercom Systems NVision routers with NV9000 control systems Evertz routers and Magnum control systems AVID NEXIS editing server and AVID editing clients Grass Valley K2 editing servers and PP editing clients Telemetrics EVS Studio and field Robotics Multi-dish Satellite Earth Station Microwave and Bonded Cellular News Gathering Fiber Optic systems using CWDM and DWDM - Certifications in any of the above systems is a helpful, and ABC can provide additional training. - This role will be covered by the National Association of Broadcast Employees and Technicians – Communication Workers of America - ABC collective bargaining agreement. Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The pay rate for this role in Washington, D.C. is $65.18 per hour. The base pay actually offered may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience, among other factors. Select

job.title: Meteorologist - Off Air - ABC News (As-Needed) (Expression of Interest)
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Meteorologist - Off Air - ABC News (As-Needed) (Expression of Interest) Job ID 10165024 Location New York, New York, United States Business ABC News Date posted Nov. 11, 2026 Meteorologist - Off Air - ABC News (As-Needed) (Expression of Interest) Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements Did you grow up dreaming about weather forecasting, wondering about lake-effect snow, hurricanes, tornadoes and the amazing impact of nature on our environment? ABC News is looking for an extremely motivated Meteorologist Producer to join our best in the business weather team. This posting is an opportunity to submit your resume for future consideration; this is not a role that is open at this time. We anticipate this role may be open in the future, but we are not actively hiring for the position. If you would like to be considered for this potential role, please submit your resume. If the role becomes available, you may receive an email or call from a recruiter.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Our meteorology producers work with our on-air talent and editorial teams to communicate the day’s weather, climate and science stories.

Responsibilities

include: Creating a division-wide weather note focusing on nationally important weather stories Finding, creating, and organizing all ‘weather of the day’ video, facts, figures, stats Brief Anchor talent, Executive and Senior Producers on national weather editorial. Produce on-air meteorologists Create all WSI/IBM weather graphics for on-air usage and playback Assist producers and writers with correspondent’s weather pieces, headlines and other content. Produce Social Media hits and verify weather-related social posts. Work with News Desk to coordinate correspondent placement for breaking weather coverage. Source and clear latest and greatest weather video Research and pitch weather-related climate stories in conjunction with ABC News climate unit. Research and pitch weather, climate and science stories for ABC News.com Applicants must be enthusiastic multi-taskers who are passionate about weather, climate and science, and being a part of a hard-working team. They must be able to handle pressure under extreme deadlines and be flexible in dealing with breaking news emergencies. The successful candidate is able to clearly and succinctly communicate complex concepts with a wide range of people. The Meteorologist must be willing to work flexible hours including nights, weekends, holidays as part of a 24/7 News team.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum 3+ years’

experience

in Broadcast Meteorology Strong Proficiency in WSI/IBM Broadcast Weather Graphics platforms Familiarity with National Weather Service Products, Websites and Chat Basic knowledge of clipping and editing in Adobe Premiere Pro Interest in climate science Preferred Qualification: Basic knowledge of clipping and editing in Adobe Premiere Pro Required

Education

Bachelor's degree in Meteorology or Atmospheric Science Must have completed Synoptic 2 Coursework Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The pay rate for this role in New York, NY is $400.00 per day. Select

benefits

may be provided as part of the compensation package, such as medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. To learn more about our

benefits

visit: https://jobs.disneycareers.com/benefits. This position is with American Broadcasting Companies, Inc., which is part of a business we call ABC News. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. American Broadcasting Companies, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs . We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help. Apply Now Save Job About The Walt Disney Company: The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise that includes three core business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, and Disney Experiences. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. Hiring Process Where Does Your Story Begin? Explore Disney Careers and the Life at Disney blog to learn about all the amazing opportunities waiting to be discovered at The Walt Disney Company. Be Part of the Story There are many different brands and businesses to explore. Once you've found the opportunity that is right for you, take the next step by completing your application. The Next Chapter Once you've applied, you will receive an email allowing you to access your candidate dashboard. Create your login and make sure to check your dashboard often to see your application progress. Explore this Location New York, NY With a globally recognizable skyline and 8.4 million people who call it home, New York City is bursting with diversity and excitement – from iconic attractions to hidden gems waiting to be uncovered. job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Producer – ABC News Live (As-Needed) (Expression of Interest) Job ID 10165030 Location New York, New York, United States Business ABC News Date posted Nov. 11, 2026 Producer – ABC News Live (As-Needed) (Expression of Interest) Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements ABC News Live is seeking expressions of interest from dynamic, editorially strong, innovative Producers who may be interested in future opportunities with our 24/7 streaming news operation in New York. We are looking for skilled newsroom journalists with exceptional editorial judgment, strong video editing abilities, and demonstrated control room

experience

in a fast-paced live news environment. The ideal candidate thrives under deadline pressure, is energized by breaking news, and has a passion for compelling storytelling. Candidates should be comfortable developing segments from concept to air, producing live coverage, collaborating with talent and correspondents, and making sound editorial decisions throughout the day. This posting is an opportunity to submit your resume for future consideration; this is not a role that is open at this time. We anticipate this role may be open in the future, but we are not actively hiring for the position. If you would like to be considered for this potential role, please submit your resume. If the role becomes available, you may receive an email or call from a recruiter. What You May Do Produce live and taped segments for ABC News Live programming. Edit video packages, tape elements, and visual storytelling components using industry-standard editing tools. Write scripts, teases, banners, headlines, and anchor copy while ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, fairness, and journalistic integrity. Exercise strong editorial judgment to identify, develop, and prioritize stories across a fast-moving news cycle and track emerging stories throughout the day. Monitor breaking news and rapidly adjust rundowns and coverage plans as events unfold. Produce live interviews and breaking news events from the control room. Partner with directors, technical teams, and production crews to ensure seamless execution of live broadcasts. Source and evaluate video, graphics, and airworthy approved social content to enhance coverage and storytelling. What We’re Looking For Minimum 5 years of

experience

producing live news in a broadcast, cable, streaming, or digital newsroom environment. Strong control room producing

experience

and demonstrated ability to lead coverage during breaking news. Advanced video editing skills and

experience

producing visual storytelling under tight deadlines. Excellent news judgment and a strong understanding of journalistic standards and ethics. Proven ability to generate story ideas and execute coverage from planning through air. Strong television writing, copyediting, and communication skills. Ability to multitask, problem-solve, and prioritize effectively in a high-pressure live-news environment.

Experience

collaborating with talent, correspondents, and cross-functional newsroom teams. Familiarity with iNews or comparable newsroom systems. Flexibility to work varied hours, including weekends and breaking-news coverage as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience

producing live streaming news programming.

Experience

covering major breaking news and special events. Knowledge of audience trends and digital news consumption habits.

Experience

working across multiple platforms and formats.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Television Production, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The pay rate for this role in New York, NY is $400.00 per day. Select

benefits

may be provided as part of the compensation package, such as medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. To learn more about our

benefits

visit: https://jobs.disneycareers.com/benefits. This position is with American Broadcasting Companies, Inc., which is part of a business we call ABC News. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. American Broadcasting Companies, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs . job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
AccuWeather is seeking an Account Executive to join its growing AccuWeather for Business sales team. AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally. The challenge is to develop new sales through your stellar efforts with new and existing markets, products, and verticals. This position is focused on building the vertical instead of handling a specific region. If you are a metric driven Account Executive who thrives on the responsibility of driving strategic B2B field sales from pipeline development through customer acquisition, then it’s time to apply to this exciting opportunity to join a best in class, growing Sales team!

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

•    Drive strategic B2B field sales from pipeline development and lead cultivation through customer acquisition
•    Develop a solid lead generation strategy that allows for customer retention and referrals
•    Close new business while shortening historical sales cycles
•    Lead and manage multiple accounts and be the single point of contact and expert resource to our customers and foster long term, successful relationships
•    Promote AccuWeather’s industry leading Enterprise Solutions within your vertical and drive engagement at an executive level within target markets segments
•    Develop deep relationships within all your accounts to provide 360-degree coverage from end user through executive
•    Collaborate with members of the AES team to expand our current accounts by introducing the benefits of our new products and services to current customers
•    Maintain effective pipeline management to achieve accuracy in forecasting and quota attainment
•    Work in conjunction with Marketing, Sales Support, Account Management and other internal partners to ensure both campaign delivery objectives and proper competitive positioning for AccuWeather
•    Manage, organize, and update relevant data using applicable sales database applications (Microsoft Dynamic CRM)
•    Follow up on all leads generated by advertising, trade shows, mailings, web sites, other media and both internal/external lead generation sources.
•    Up to 20-30% travel is required at times. 
•    Other duties as assigned as necessary

QUALIFICATIONS 

•    Bachelor’s degree in a related field or the equivalent in education and experience
•    5+ years of experience with Enterprise, large corporate sales environments
•    Expertise in multiple verticals such as Manufacturing, Logistics, Transportation, Healthcare, Insurance or FinTech
•    Demonstrated ability to build customer relationships
•    Proven and demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed quota
•    Excellent client relations and negotiating skills
•    Solid presentation skills (both verbal and written) and the ability to clearly articulate ideas at all levels of the organization
•    Demonstrated ability to simultaneously work on multiple projects and adhere to tight timelines and deadlines
•    Must work well in a team-oriented and collaborative environment 
•    Ability to provide clear and concise justification on how decisions make positive impacts on attaining AccuWeather business objectives
•    Must be willing to travel, including overnight trips, for an average of 20-30 percent of the time
•    While we are considering remote candidates, in the United States, AccuWeather is only able to hire team members in the following states due to taxation purposes: CA, CO, CT, DE, DC, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, MD, MN, MO, NE, NV, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OK, PA, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI and WY.

 

About AccuWeather and Dr. Joel N. Myers

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. Over one billion people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination globally and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 250 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, Samsung, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chair, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs. Dr. Myers was inducted into the Broadcasting+Cable Hall of Fame, Class of 2026, in recognition of his role in revolutionizing weather forecasting through teaching, research, and building AccuWeather into one of the world’s major sources of weather data, forecasts, and warnings.

Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion 

AccuWeather is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.  
 
AccuWeather is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to human.resources@accuweather.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

job.title: Account Manager, Strategic Partnerships
job.description:
AccuWeather’s mission is to save lives, protect property, and help people and companies make the best weather-impacted decisions. We are seeking an enthusiastic, curious, and growth-oriented Account Manager to advance that mission through our technology and media partnerships.

You will manage a portfolio of technology and media partners and work with some of the world’s leading companies. Your work will help partners strengthen their products, serve their audiences, and achieve their business goals—bringing trusted weather intelligence to the platforms people use every day.

As part of the Strategic Account Management team, you will gain exposure to AccuWeather’s top strategic accounts and complex commercial deals, learning how major partnerships are developed, negotiated, and expanded. You will build skills in commercial judgment, data analysis, storytelling, negotiation, and strategic relationship management.

You will understand your partners’ businesses, dig into performance data, and identify how AccuWeather’s Proven Superior Accuracy™, proprietary products, and ongoing innovation can help them achieve more.

Success requires a commitment to partner service and a drive to grow revenue. Business development will focus on expanding existing relationships across technology and media, primarily in the business-to-business-to-consumer (B2B2C) space. External prospecting is outside this role’s scope.

You will be part of a collaborative team, sharing insights, contributing ideas, and working toward shared goals. You will receive direct training, coaching, and mentorship while taking increasing ownership of your accounts. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, follows through independently, welcomes feedback, and helps improve both our partnerships and how we work together.

What you will do

  • Own partner relationships. Manage a portfolio of technology and media accounts, developing a strong understanding of each partner’s goals, products, audiences, and priorities. Build trust through thoughtful engagement, responsive service, and reliable follow-through.
  • Know the data. Analyze revenue, API usage, audience engagement, referral traffic, and other relevant metrics. Investigate changes, recognize opportunities, and turn findings into recommendations that improve performance and support partner goals.
  • Lead business reviews. Prepare and conduct regular partner meetings and quarterly business reviews that demonstrate value, assess performance, and look ahead. Work with partners to identify priorities, explore opportunities, and agree on actions and next steps.
  • Tell the AccuWeather story. Learn how AccuWeather’s forecast accuracy, scientific expertise, and proprietary offerings—including AccuWeather MinuteCast® and RealFeel®—help partners deliver differentiated experiences and enable users to make more confident decisions.
  • Bring fresh opportunities to partners. Gather relevant product updates, innovations, success stories, awards, and achievements from across AccuWeather. Connect them to each partner’s needs to strengthen their offerings and expand the value of the relationship.
  • Grow existing accounts. Identify where additional AccuWeather capabilities can advance partner goals through expanded usage, new products, new applications, and broader partnerships. Develop account plans, advance commercial opportunities, and achieve revenue growth targets.
  • Collaborate and advocate for partners. Bring partner needs, feedback, and ideas into AccuWeather. Work with product, technical account management, forecasting, marketing, finance, legal, and other teams to resolve issues, develop solutions, and advance shared opportunities.
  • Present with clarity and impact. Develop and deliver presentations for partners and internal audiences. Use compelling narratives, clear visuals, and well-presented data to communicate results, explain opportunities, and support decisions.
  • Use AI to increase effectiveness. Apply AI tools to research, analysis, presentation development, and routine workflows to improve efficiency and the quality of your work. Explore emerging capabilities and use judgment to verify outputs and protect confidential information.
  • Maintain account discipline. Keep account plans, CRM records, revenue forecasts, commitments, and follow-up actions accurate and current. Track contractual obligations, renewals, and emerging risks.

What you bring

  • Energy and enthusiasm: You take an active interest in your work, engage thoughtfully with people, and bring momentum to opportunities and challenges.
  • Curiosity and a learning mindset: You ask good questions, seek context, and enjoy building expertise in unfamiliar subjects.
  • Coachability: You listen to feedback, put it into practice, and take responsibility for improving your work.
  • A commitment to partner service: You listen carefully, seek to understand what success means for your partners, and care about helping them achieve it.
  • Commercial motivation: You want to achieve measurable revenue growth by connecting partner needs with valuable business opportunities.
  • An interest in data: You like working with numbers, investigating what drives performance, and explaining what the findings mean.
  • Communication and visual storytelling: You enjoy—or are motivated to develop your ability in—presenting to others and translating complex information into clear conversations, written updates, and visually effective presentations.
  • Self-awareness and ownership: You understand that your actions, communication, and follow-through affect partners and teammates. You take responsibility for your work, acknowledge mistakes, seek help when needed, and act on what you learn.
  • Initiative and independent judgment: You organize your work, solve problems, and move priorities forward while recognizing when to seek guidance.
  • Teamwork and collaboration: You enjoy working within a team, share knowledge and ideas, and support your colleagues. You contribute to shared goals and look for ways to improve how the team works together.
  • AI curiosity and adaptability: You follow emerging AI tools and trends and actively look for ways to use them to improve productivity, strengthen your work, and increase your impact.

Relevant experience and skills

  • Experience in account management, customer success, partnerships, business development, or a related client-facing setting. Relevant experience may come from employment, internships, or substantial academic, volunteer, or leadership responsibilities.
  • Strong organization and the ability to manage multiple relationships, priorities, and commitments.
  • Comfort using spreadsheets to analyze data and presentation tools to communicate findings.
  • Practical familiarity with generative AI tools and a willingness to build proficiency in applying them to business tasks.
  • Experience with technology, digital media, APIs, data licensing, or B2B2C partnerships is helpful.
  • An interest in weather and its impact on people and businesses, along with a desire to learn and communicate AccuWeather’s brand and story.

We welcome early-career candidates and those with transferable experience who can demonstrate the curiosity, analytical ability, initiative, and sense of responsibility this role requires.

What success looks like

Your partners view you as a trusted, proactive resource who understands their business and helps them achieve meaningful results. You have a strong command of account performance, deliver engaging and useful business reviews, and turn insights into action. You achieve revenue growth goals by expanding the value partners receive from AccuWeather.

As you build your expertise, you demonstrate increasing independence, sound judgment, and confidence. You apply feedback, contribute to your teammates’ success, and grow into a capable commercial professional who makes a measurable impact.

job.title: Client Systems Specialist
job.description:
The Client Systems Specialist’s primary responsibility is to provide responsive customer service, technical support, and troubleshooting for approximately 100 AccuWeather TV customers. This role supports the department’s 24/7 customer service coverage, helping customers maintain reliable operation of their AccuWeather software, hardware, and data services. The position requires proactive customer communication, advanced troubleshooting, and coordination with internal teams to resolve issues promptly. Occasional travel is required for product demonstrations, system installations, customer training, and trade shows. 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Serve as a primary technical support resource for AccuWeather TV customers, providing timely, professional assistance by phone, email, and remote support.
• Participate in the department’s 24/7 support coverage and assigned on-call schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
• Monitor customer support calls, emails, and requests; prioritize issues based on urgency, impact on customer operations, and departmental guidelines.
• Troubleshoot and resolve software, hardware, system configuration, and data issues, with particular attention to problems affecting on-air operations.
• Take ownership of assigned support issues from initial response through resolution, keeping customers informed of progress and next steps.
• Document customer issues, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and follow-up actions to support consistent service and knowledge sharing.
• Escalate complex or unresolved issues to management and developers, providing clear details to support timely resolution.
• Communicate with sales and account management teams about ongoing customer issues, support needs, and customer satisfaction.
• Provide proactive customer guidance to help prevent recurring problems and improve system reliability.
• Maintain proficiency and required certifications on all AccuWeather TV graphics systems.
• Maintain a working understanding of AccuWeather and other meteorological data to effectively support customers and meteorologists.
• Test new software versions using current customer configurations and coordinate customer upgrades following release.
• Provide remote customer training on system operation, new features, and troubleshooting procedures.
• Occasionally travel to customer sites to install and configure systems, verify proper operation, and provide training.
• Support sales efforts by demonstrating AccuWeather TV products remotely and, as needed, at customer sites and trade shows.
• Identify customer needs for upgrades, additional systems, or training, and communicate those opportunities to the appropriate sales or account management team.
• Provide technical training, guidance, and mentorship to new staff and sales team members.
• Coordinate support coverage with the team during travel and other scheduled activities.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

BACKGROUND AND QUALIFICATIONS
• At least one year of professional experience supporting PC or Mac computers, software, or hardware required. Relevant education or extensive technical training may be considered in place of employment experience.
• Strong customer service skills, including the ability to remain calm, responsive, and professional when customers experience urgent technical issues.
• Ability to troubleshoot software and hardware problems, prioritize competing requests, and follow issues through to resolution.
• Ability to communicate technical information clearly to customers and colleagues with varying levels of technical knowledge.
• Ability to read and interpret instructions, technical documentation, procedural and policy manuals, and customer communications.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when documenting issues, coordinating follow-up, and maintaining customer records.
• Ability to work independently while collaborating with support staff, sales, management, and developers.
• Availability to participate in assigned 24/7 on-call coverage, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
• Ability and willingness to travel occasionally for demonstrations, installations, training, and trade shows.
• Experience with broadcast systems, graphics systems, or meteorological data preferred.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS
The physical demands described here are representative of those required to perform the job's essential functions. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. The position requires extended periods of work at a computer workstation using a keyboard and mouse, as well as frequent communication by phone and video conference. The employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, and lift or move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds during installations, demonstrations, or training. Specific vision abilities include color vision, close vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those encountered while performing the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. Work is primarily performed in an office or remote support setting, with occasional work at customer stations and trade shows. The role includes responding to time-sensitive technical issues in a live broadcast environment and providing support outside regular business hours as part of the department’s assigned coverage schedule.

job.title: Data Architect I
job.description:
Want to lead the technical design behind modernizing AccuWeather For Business — the platform that delivers AccuWeather’s data and services to more than half of the Fortune 500? We are looking for a Data Architect I who combines strong platform design expertise with the judgment to assess legacy infrastructure and design an implementable, cloud-native architecture; someone who wants to own the technical direction of a critical modernization initiative without compromising the reliability enterprise clients depend on. Reporting directly to the Data Architect II overseeing AccuWeather’s data architecture function, this position will assess the legacy, on-premises infrastructure behind AccuWeather For Business and design the cloud-native architecture that will support its future. You will produce architecture and modernization design documents — including current-state assessments, target-state designs, transition and sequencing plans, and technical specifications — and work alongside engineering teams to implement key components of the architecture, while maintaining the reliability of the backend data systems that support critical data delivery services.

You will demonstrate high-level knowledge across cloud platforms and legacy enterprise systems, independently resolve complex architecture and modernization challenges, and collaborate closely with the Data Architect II and engineering teams. Your work will help modernize the technology foundation behind AccuWeather For Business, creating a more scalable, resilient, and cloud-native platform while maintaining the reliability expected by the Fortune 500 companies that depend on it.

We are open to hiring candidates to work from our global headquarters in State College, PA, USA, or remotely.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Assess the legacy, on-premises infrastructure behind AccuWeather For Business, documenting current-state architecture, system dependencies, data flows, and technical debt to inform modernization priorities.

· Design the cloud-native architecture, producing architecture designs, technical specifications, and other documentation needed to guide implementation.

· Own the architectural direction for the modernization effort, ensuring a cohesive approach across the platform rather than individual services or components.

· Develop a roadmap and sequencing plan that provides a practical path from the current environment to the cloud-native architecture while minimizing disruption to enterprise clients.

· Design backend data systems to maintain continuity of critical data delivery services throughout the transition.

· Partner with engineering and data teams to validate and implement architecture designs, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, performant, and maintainable.

· Contribute hands-on to the implementation of architecture designs, including developing and modifying code, data models, schemas, and supporting data platform components.

· Estimate data consumption, capacity, and infrastructure requirements, incorporating cloud infrastructure costs into architecture decisions and trade-offs.

· Identify and document architectural and operational risks associated with modernizing a customer-facing production platform, and design appropriate mitigation strategies.

· Ensure the cloud-native architecture addresses performance, security, scalability, resiliency, recoverability, compliance, and data residency requirements.

· Understand system scheduling, integrations, and dependencies across the platform and incorporate them into planning and sequencing.

· Serve as a technical point of contact for questions and decisions related to the modernization effort’s architectural direction.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

· Required Qualifications:

o BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, with 5+ years of experience in data or enterprise architecture, or MS with 3+ years of experience.

o High-level knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., Microsoft Azure) and cloud-native architecture.

o Demonstrated experience assessing legacy, on-premises systems and designing modern, cloud-native architectures.

o Demonstrated experience planning or supporting large-scale modernization initiatives for production, customer-facing platforms.

o Experience designing production data platforms for performance, scalability, resiliency, and recoverability.

o Experience analyzing complex system dependencies, integrations, data flows, and scheduling requirements to inform architecture and modernization decisions.

o Demonstrated experience working with PostgreSQL, including relational data modeling, schema design, and query development.

o Advanced proficiency in Python or Go, with experience developing production-quality code for data platforms or backend systems.

· Preferred Qualifications:

o Experience designing backend data platforms that support data delivery to external or enterprise clients.

o Experience evaluating technology and architecture options, including build-versus-buy decisions and alternative modernization approaches.

o Experience evaluating infrastructure requirements and costs to inform cloud architecture decisions and design trade-offs.

o Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and data governance requirements, including SOC 2 and data residency considerations.

· Skills & Competencies:

o Strong systems thinking, with the ability to design architectures that engineering teams can implement and maintain effectively.

o Excellent written communication, with the ability to produce clear, actionable architecture and technical design documentation.

o Sound technical judgment, with the ability to translate business and platform requirements into pragmatic architecture without overengineering or underspecifying solutions.

o Ability to move effectively between architecture and hands-on implementation, translating designs into working solutions in collaboration with engineering teams.

o Ability to mentor team members and help develop the architectural judgment of less experienced engineers.

o Ability to independently lead complex, large-scale architecture initiatives and drive technical decisions through ambiguity.

job.title: Database Administrator III
job.description:
Want to be part of a team that keeps AccuWeather's critical database environments reliable, secure, performant, and available around the clock for a global audience? We are looking for an experienced Database Administrator with deep hands-on expertise in SQL Server and PostgreSQL who can take ownership of the health and reliability of our production database systems while helping modernize our database infrastructure for the future. Reporting directly to the Data Architect II overseeing AccuWeather’s data architecture function, this role will serve as a hands-on database administration expert responsible for the day-to-day operational health and long-term reliability of AccuWeather's database environments. Key responsibilities include performance tuning and optimization, backup and recovery, high availability, security and access management, capacity planning, monitoring and maintenance, and incident and root-cause analysis. The DBA will work closely with the Data Architect and engineering teams to establish strong database standards, improve operational practices, and proactively address reliability and performance concerns. This role will also play an important part in the migration of select backend databases to cloud-based environments, helping assess existing workloads, plan and execute migrations, optimize databases for their target environments, and ensure appropriate performance, security, resiliency, and recoverability throughout the transition. It is an opportunity to combine deep database administration expertise with meaningful involvement in the continued modernization of AccuWeather's data infrastructure.

 

We are open to hiring candidates to work from our global headquarters in State College, PA, USA, or remotely.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Administer SQL Server and PostgreSQL databases end to end — performance tuning, query optimization, indexing strategy, and execution plan analysis.

· Design, implement, and regularly test backup, replication, and disaster recovery procedures for databases, ensuring high availability across production environments.

· Manage database security — roles, permissions, access control, and auditing.

· Monitor and plan for database capacity — storage growth, connection pooling, and resource allocation.

· Manage database version upgrades, patching cycles, and configuration tuning.

· Perform routine database maintenance — index/statistics upkeep, vacuuming, storage optimization, and space reclamation — to sustain performance over time.

· Proactively monitor database health and performance, identifying and resolving issues before they affect production.

· Manage cloud cost optimization and capacity planning, including license reporting and true-ups, resource forecasting, and optimization of Azure compute spend through Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, and related strategies.

· Partner with the Data Architect and engineering teams to establish database standards, improve operational practices, and proactively address reliability and performance concerns.

· Plan and execute database migrations to the cloud, optimizing configurations for target environments, and ensuring performance, security, resiliency, and recoverability throughout the transition.

· Build strong working relationships with engineering teams, communicating database constraints and recommendations in terms they can act on.

· Share database expertise and best practices with less experienced administrators and engineering team members.

· Performs other duties as assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

· Required Qualifications:

o BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, with 5+ years of experience in data operations or database administration, or MS with 3+ years of experience.

o Demonstrated experience as a database administrator with SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL, including performance tuning, backup and recovery, high availability, security and access management, and capacity planning.

o Advanced SQL/T-SQL proficiency, with working knowledge of at least one scripting language (Python or PowerShell) for database automation.

o Ability to design and implement monitoring solutions for database health, performance, and capacity.

o Experience with, or strong working knowledge of, migrating databases to cloud-based environments (e.g., Microsoft Azure).

o Awareness of the monetary costs associated with operational work.

o Demonstrated experience mentoring or coaching less experienced engineers.

· Preferred Qualifications:

o Experience with advanced replication topologies (e.g., multi-region, active-active) for SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL.

o Experience administrating, performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and performing backup/recovery of database systems (e.g. SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Azure SQL or similar systems).

o Familiarity with, or willingness to grow into, modern cloud data platforms, including Databricks and Snowflake. Experience with CI/CD automation.

o Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) for building, orchestrating, and maintaining reliable data ingestion and loading pipelines.

o Experience participating in structured post-mortems and root cause analysis for significant incidents.

o Familiarity with data governance practices (quality checks, lineage documentation, access control).

· Skills & Competencies:

o Strong systems thinking; understands how failure in one system cascades to others across a portfolio.

o Sound judgment balancing database performance, availability, security, and cost trade-offs.

o Excellent written communication; operational health reports are usable by data consumers and leadership without interpretation.

o Sound judgment distinguishing proximate causes from systemic causes when writing postmortems.

o Mentoring and coaching skills; able to develop the operational judgment of less experienced engineers.

o Ability to lead complex incident response and drive systemic reliability improvement independently.

job.title: Digital Content & Engagement Intern – Forecasting and Communications
job.description:
AccuWeather is seeking a highly creative, curious, and deeply collaborative Digital Content & Engagement Intern – Forecasting and Communications, to work directly with AccuWeather forecasters and the Writing Committee to further elevate the detail, clarity, precision, and distinctiveness of the language used to describe forecasts for our users. This role is designed for a graduate student or an individual with equivalent writing experience who brings fresh thinking about how complex weather information can be expressed in ways that are more detailed, precise, clear, engaging, and scientifically sound.

Embedded closely with Forecast Operations, this position will learn from meteorologists, participate in the forecast-writing process, and help develop new approaches, terminology, and descriptive frameworks that make AccuWeather forecasts more informative and better than what is available from any other source. The emphasis is on improving the consumer forecast experience - not traditional public relations - by helping forecasters communicate what the weather will be, what the impact will be, how it will evolve, what it may look like, and what details matter most to people making decisions. This includes a laser focus on developing stronger displays, greater artistry, and more effective visual communications that amplify the advantages of AccuWeather forecasts and content.

The Digital Content & Engagement Intern – Forecasting and Communications will serve as a bridge between meteorological expertise and exceptional consumer-facing writing, helping AccuWeather deliver forecast descriptions with greater depth, nuance, consistency, and usefulness while preserving the scientific accuracy and authority at the core of the AccuWeather brand.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Forecast Language, Detail & Description:

  • Work side-by-side with forecasters to craft and refine accurate, detailed, consumer-focused descriptions of daily weather, changing conditions, major storms, seasonal patterns, and forecast developments.
    • Elevate forecast language beyond basic conditions by identifying the most useful details, nuances, timing, impacts, transitions, and sensory descriptions that help users better understand what to expect. Use bold, catchy and descriptive language.
    • Translate complex meteorological concepts into clearer, more detailed, consumer-friendly language without sacrificing scientific meaning, accuracy, or appropriate expressions of forecast confidence.
    • Develop new descriptive approaches, vocabulary, sentence structures, and frameworks that make AccuWeather forecasts more distinctive, informative, and useful than competing forecast experiences.
    • Help establish consistent terminology for recurring weather patterns while preserving enough flexibility for forecasters to communicate the unique character and details of each forecast.

 

Forecaster & Writing Committee Collaboration:

  • Embed with AccuWeather forecasters to understand how forecasts are created, where language choices can add value, and how writing can better communicate meteorological insight to users.
    • Work closely with the AccuWeather Writing Committee to test, evaluate, and introduce new approaches to forecast writing and description.
    • Bring an outside writing perspective to established forecast workflows, asking thoughtful questions and proposing new ways of thinking, writing, and working.
  • Challenge conventional approaches to forecast description and explore new ways to communicate weather that provide users with greater detail, context, understanding, and value.
    • Gather feedback from meteorologists and other stakeholders, iterate on language, and help turn successful approaches into practical writing guidance and repeatable standards.
    • Support a collaborative environment in which meteorological expertise and strong writing work together to create a richer forecast experience.

 

Consumer Forecast Experience & Innovation:

  • Review forecast descriptions across AccuWeather consumer experiences and identify opportunities to add specificity, context, clarity, and useful detail.
    • Develop and test language that helps users better understand the timing, intensity, duration, variability, uncertainty, and real-world impacts of weather events.
  • Explore new ways to make routine forecasts more useful, engaging, descriptive, and impactful, bringing the same level of creativity and attention to detail to both high-impact weather coverage and everyday conditions such as temperature, wind, precipitation, cloud cover, humidity, visibility, and changing conditions.
    • Help ensure forecast descriptions are clear and effective across digital platforms while retaining the depth and detail that distinguish AccuWeather.
    • Contribute ideas that reinforce AccuWeather’s Superior Accuracy™ through the quality, precision, and usefulness of the forecast language itself.

 

Writing Standards & Continuous Improvement:

  • Help evolve AccuWeather’s authoritative, trustworthy, detailed, and forward-looking forecast voice.
    • Identify new ways to describe weather phenomena that are vivid, memorable, consumer-relevant, and scientifically sound.
    • Contribute to forecast-writing standards, terminology guidelines, examples, and best practices used by forecasters and content teams.
    • Study how forecast language performs in practice and recommend improvements based on clarity, usefulness, consistency, and differentiation.
    • Encourage experimentation and fresh thinking while respecting operational requirements, meteorological accuracy, and established review processes.
    • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Writing, or a closely related writing-intensive field is required.
    • Current graduate student in communications, writing, journalism, English, creative writing, technical writing, or a related discipline, or equivalent advanced or professional writing experience.
    • Exceptional command of written language, including tone, clarity, precision, descriptive detail, structure, and audience awareness.
    • Demonstrated ability to take complex or technical information and make it clear, specific, useful, and engaging for a broad audience.
    • Strong collaborative skills and genuine interest in working closely with meteorologists, subject-matter experts, and a writing committee.
    • Intellectual curiosity and willingness to learn meteorological concepts and forecast workflows.
    • Ability to receive expert feedback, revise quickly, and improve language through an iterative process.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Interest in or familiarity with meteorology, weather forecasting, climate, environmental science, science communication, or technical writing.
    • Experience developing descriptive language, style guidance, editorial standards, or writing frameworks.
    • Experience collaborating directly with technical or scientific subject-matter experts.
    • Portfolio examples demonstrating precise, vivid, explanatory, or detail-rich writing.

 

Skills & Competencies:

  • Creative thinking grounded in accuracy, precision, and credibility.
    • Exceptional descriptive and explanatory writing.
    • Ability to identify and elevate the details that matter most to users.
    • Strong editing, revision, and language-development skills.
    • Curiosity about weather and willingness to learn from forecasters.
    • Collaborative, workshop-oriented approach to writing.
    • Ability to develop practical writing standards while continuing to experiment with new approaches.
    • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
    • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of an embedded team.

 

 

About AccuWeather and Dr. Joel N. Myers

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. Over one billion people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination globally and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 250 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, Samsung, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chair, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs. Dr. Myers was inducted into the Broadcasting+Cable Hall of Fame, Class of 2026, in recognition of his role in revolutionizing weather forecasting through teaching, research, and building AccuWeather into one of the world’s major sources of weather data, forecasts, and warnings.

Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion 

AccuWeather is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.  
 
AccuWeather is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to human.resources@accuweather.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

job.title: Director, Advertising Sales
job.description:
AccuWeather is seeking an accomplished, strategic and results-driven Advertising Sales Director in New York to help build and sell digital advertising solutions. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced sales leader with a proven track record to navigate complex digital media and data targeting solutions, work cross-functionally to develop innovative advertising solutions and build lasting client relationships. You’ll contribute to a high-caliber team in a business that is experiencing rapid and dramatic growth. We are looking for demonstrated performance in a constantly changing, ambiguous environment and problem-solving leadership with limited oversight.

This role will manage Holding Company agency relationships with a focus on the C-Suite, Agency Investment Leads, Brand Teams, Buying Teams, Programmatic Buying Arms and Data Analytics & Strategy Teams. In partnership with senior leadership, this role will develop a strategy specific to assigned holding companies, while driving AccuWeather’s media, data, measurement and analytics revenue. This position requires extensive knowledge of the changing agency & media landscape, the drive to develop industry-transforming strategies and the ability to build relationships with senior agency management and brands direct. The ideal candidate has media agency planning experience, a deep knowledge of measurement & analytics used to evaluate performance, ability to develop and effectively communicate creative ideas and solutions along with a proven ability to influence multiple levels of an organization.

This position will be located onsite at AccuWeather’s New York City office with the expectation of being in office with teammates three days a week.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Achieve and exceed revenue goals set by the company for existing and new accounts. Focus on selling AccuWeather digital advertising products to advertising agency and brand direct partners maintaining and fostering positive relationships across both new and existing clients.
  • Build and elevate relationships at the highest levels within the assigned agencies, C-Suite, Senior Agency Influencers to continuously uncover strategic opportunities to drive AccuWeather revenue on a global, regional, and local level.
  • Serve as internal voice of the agency customer to help shape product and marketing roadmaps. Assess the revenue potential of assigned account list and identify highest value targets.
  • Prospect new business opportunities within territory through regular, thoughtful outreach to new clients/agencies with face-to-face meetings, presentations, events, entertainment and other related efforts.
  • Identify revenue opportunities to grow existing clients/advertising agencies relationships.
  • Client account management including, but not limited to: maintaining contact lists, establishing meeting cadence with (internal and external) key stakeholders, seeking out new relationships/contacts, developing quarterly business reviews, organizing and coordinating agency education initiatives (cross discipline agency days and/or training sessions), fulfilling ad hoc client requests, campaign performance reviews along with client entertaining.
  • Consistent pipeline maintenance, and strong internal communications skills to ensure leadership and cross functional partners are apprise of pipeline updates, progress to goal, territory updates and opportunities, along with challenges
  • Contribute to AccuWeather’s tentpole senior-level events, conferences and activations within assigned agencies.
  • Collaborate with internal specialists (i.e. marketing, strategy, data, operations/analytics) as needed to meet revenue requirements and to continuously identify relevant opportunities for agencies/brands.
  • Contribute to agency holding company partnership level agreements, with opportunity to lead specific initiatives in addition to capturing revenue opportunities at the account level
  • Be a trusted thought leader to both external stakeholders and investment teams by leading consistent customer and prospect education initiatives and events.
  • Operate at the ‘tip of the spear’, immersing in industry shifts (in-housing, rise of independent agencies and consultancies etc.) and competitive offerings, to bring an ‘outside-in’ perspective, framing new sales initiatives and recommendations
  • Demonstrate thought leadership in the industry; act as an ambassador and spokesperson for AccuWeather in the advertising community.
  • Other duties as assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS 

  • BA/BS degree required with 5+ years digital ad sales experience with a focus on digital media, programmatic, first party data and analytics; experience executing large scale brand partnerships across channels ideal.
  • High performer – achieve and exceed revenue targets through effective sales strategies, performance optimization and development of innovative campaign strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically about a particular industry and/or product set to achieve customer goals and KPIs; ability to think creatively to solve problems to maintain and grow revenue, and to break new business
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills along with strong presentation skills in both small and large groups.
  • Familiarity with agency holding companies and strong relationships across the agency and brand direct
  • Ability to work collaboratively amidst cross-functional teams including but not limited to strategy, marketing, ad operations and analytics.
  • Tenacious and driven self-starter who takes a hands-on approach in discovering new business opportunities and proactive outreach with a focus on high-value prospects.
  • Hunter mentality – focus on cold outreach and prospecting to secure meetings with new clients and expanding relationships with existing.
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills. Ability to build internal networks to accomplish goals through collaboration with resources across teams.
  • Driven and solution-oriented and can overcome obstacles to drive projects through completion and can balance the need for quick turnaround with longer-term strategic efforts.
  • Strong writing and copy-editing skills.
  • Comfortable with a fast-paced, always-on, start-up environment
  • Strong belief in AccuWeather's vision and goals

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Demonstrated marketing abilities, programmatic advertising expertise and experience pitching first party data
  • Exhibits a high level of competency in oral and written communication skills
  • Demonstrated expertise in building relationships with senior agency decision makers.

 

Pay Transparency: AccuWeather offers a competitive salary commensurate to experience in the range of $130K - $150K base + commission.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 250 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, Samsung, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

job.title: Director, AFB Technologies
job.description:
AccuWeather is seeking an experienced and highly collaborative Director, AFB Technologies to provide technical leadership for the platforms, applications, services, and data that power AccuWeather for Business (AFB).

This role will be responsible for the technology strategy and evolution of the AFB web, mobile app, API, and data capabilities. The Director will develop a strong understanding of existing systems and business needs, work across Technology, Product, Security, Operations, and other teams to establish a modernization strategy, and lead its execution while continuing to support the needs of AccuWeather's enterprise customers.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth, people leadership, strategic thinking, and a pragmatic approach to modernization. This leader will help simplify and modernize AFB technologies,

strengthen security and operational practices, drive progress toward SOC 2 compliance, expand the use of AI across engineering and product capabilities, and identify opportunities for AFB technology investments to be reused across other AccuWeather platforms.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide technical and organizational leadership for the AFB web portal, mobile applications, APIs, and AFB-specific data capabilities
  • Develop a deep understanding of existing AFB systems, integrations, dependencies, data flows, technical debt, and operational processes to establish a clear baseline for future investment
  • Define and execute a technology strategy and modernization roadmap that balances new capabilities, customer commitments, reliability, security, technical debt, and sustainability
  • Partner closely with Product, Technology, Security, Operations, and business stakeholders to translate AFB business and customer needs into scalable technical solutions and priorities
  • Drive adoption of AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows to improve software development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and overall productivity
  • Identify and lead opportunities to incorporate AI into AFB platforms and workflows where it can create meaningful customer value, improve operational efficiency, simplify complex data, or enable new enterprise capabilities while maintaining appropriate security and governance
  • Modernize applications, services, APIs, and data capabilities using approaches that improve maintainability, scalability, observability, developer productivity, and speed of delivery
  • Identify opportunities to create shared services, APIs, data capabilities, components, and platforms that can be reused across AFB and other AccuWeather products
  • Drive AFB technology toward SOC 2 readiness and compliance, partnering with Security and other teams to establish appropriate controls and practices around access, change management, delivery, monitoring, incident response, data protection, SLA’s, and processes
  • Ensure AFB platforms are reliable, secure, performant, scalable, monitorable, and supportable for AccuWeather's enterprise customers
  • Establish and continuously improve software engineering, testing, API, data, and delivery practices across the AFB technology ecosystem
  • Lead, mentor, and develop engineers and technical contributors, establishing clear ownership, expectations, priorities, and opportunities for professional growth
  • Define and monitor meaningful measures of platform health, engineering effectiveness, reliability, security, modernization progress, and delivery performance

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, technology leadership, enterprise applications, digital platforms, or related disciplines
  • 5+ years of experience leading and developing software engineering or technology teams
  • Demonstrated experience defining technology strategy and leading the modernization of existing applications, services, APIs, or data platforms
  • Strong technical understanding of modern web applications, mobile applications, APIs, cloud technologies, distributed systems, data platforms, and software delivery practices
  • Experience supporting business-critical or enterprise-facing technology platforms with demanding reliability, security, performance, and customer requirements
  • Experience with security, compliance, and technology control frameworks; direct experience supporting SOC 2 readiness or compliance is strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of API design, integration patterns, data architecture, and approaches that enable capabilities to be shared and reused across products
  • Experience applying AI-assisted development tools and a strong understanding of the opportunities, risks, and practical applications of AI within software engineering and digital products
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate legacy systems, technical debt, and competing priorities and develop pragmatic, incremental modernization strategies
  • Ability to operate effectively across organizational boundaries, influence technical direction, and lead complex initiatives involving multiple teams and stakeholders
  • Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to technical, business, and executive audiences
  • Self-driven, adaptable, collaborative, and comfortable taking ownership of complex technology challenges

job.title: Editorial Intern (Spring 2027)
job.description:
AccuWeather’s Digital Team is seeking an Editorial Intern for Spring 2027. Join us in a hands-on newsroom role where you'll help shape daily weather coverage for AccuWeather.com. You’ll collaborate closely with editors and meteorologists to pitch compelling story ideas, research developing weather events, and write digital-first articles that inform and engage our audience. This role offers the opportunity to build real-world newsroom experience, sharpen your writing skills, and learn how data, SEO, and emerging AI tools support modern digital publishing. You’ll also assist with sourcing and clearing user-generated content to help bring impactful weather stories to life across platforms.

This paid internship spans 5 months and requires a commitment of approximately 20 hours per week. Morning and daytime availability is preferred, though some evening hours may be accommodated.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

● Finding and gathering information to pitch timely, weather-related story ideas for AccuWeather.com.

● Writing multiple digital stories per month for publication on AccuWeather.com.

● Conducting source gathering and research to support accurate, compelling weather coverage.

● Using ChatGPT and other AI tools to edit content, test prompts, and optimize stories for digital platforms.

● Sourcing and clearing user-generated content for use in articles and on social platforms.

● Collaborating with editors, meteorologists, and the social team to align coverage across platforms.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

● Pursuing a 4-year Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, Meteorology or a related field that requires experience in writing and research.

● Strong writing, editing, and research skills with attention to accuracy and detail.
