job.title: General Counsel
job.description:
AccuWeather is searching for a dynamic General Counsel to join its leadership team. The General Counsel leads AccuWeather's Legal Services team and serves as chief legal advisor to the CEO and business leaders across a global B2C digital media business, and enterprise B2B weather-data and insights business, and a linear broadcast/OTT network. This role owns the company's legal risk, commercial contracting, IP, privacy, and litigation strategy, and is responsible for modernizing the legal functions, including through the adoption of AI-enabled tools and workflows to deliver faster, leaner, and more scalable legal support to the business.

The position is located on-site at AccuWeather's Headquarters in State College, PA  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Legal Operations & AI-Driven Efficiency

  • Champion the adoption of AI legal tools (contract lifecycle management, legal research, drafting assistance) to cut cycle time, reduce outside counsel spend, and scale the legal team's output.
  • Build and own the company's internal AI governance framework and advise the business on legal and regulatory risk arising from its own use and development of AI.
  • Redesign commercial contracting and other legal workflows for speed, consistency, and measurable efficiency gains.
  • Structure and manage the internal legal team and legal support staff; manage outside counsel relationships and budget for cost-effective coverage.

Commercial & Corporate Transactions

  • Negotiate and draft high-value commercial agreements, including content and technology licensing, strategic partnerships and alliances, and ad-tech platform arrangements.
  • Serve as lead legal advisor on M&A, divestitures, joint ventures, and corporate investment transactions.
  • Advise on financing activity, including business and legal-entity structuring.
  • Advise on content delivery and distribution issues across broadcast, cable, and OTT platforms.

Data Privacy, Cybersecurity & Regulatory

  • Act as subject-matter expert on consumer data privacy for a digital media company with a global user base, and monitor emerging privacy, cybersecurity, and AI regulation for business impact.
  • Partner with Security and IT on cybersecurity risk, vendor data-processing terms, and incident response.
  • Ensure company-wide compliance with applicable domestic and international laws and standards.

Litigation, IP & Risk

  • Direct litigation strategy and outside counsel on matters filed by or against the company; approve settlements.
  • Protect the company's intellectual property portfolio, trademarks, copyrights, patents, and trade secrets — including strategy for complex IP litigation.
  • Oversee contract enforcement and delinquency collections.

Corporate Governance & Board Support

  • Serve as key advisor to the CEO and Board of Directors on corporate governance, risk, and major transactions.
  • Participate in defining corporate policies, procedures, and programs, and advise on their legal implications.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • JD and 15+ years of relevant experience, including service as General Counsel or senior in-house counsel in a corporate environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Working familiarity with employment law and compliance investigations (DOL/OFCCP).
  • Proven ability to negotiate and draft complex, high-value contracts and to quickly analyze agreements from varied origins.
  • Strong executive presence; able to advise and present to senior management, the Board, and international clients and partners.

  • General knowledge of tax laws and standards as they relate to corporate transactions.

  • Experience in digital media, broadcast/OTT, or a comparable data- or platform-driven industry.

job.title: Senior Account Executive - Media
job.description:
AccuWeather | Broadcast & Emerging Media Technology

AccuWeather is seeking a high-performing, strategic Senior Account Executive to lead sales for ImmersiCast™, our revolutionary next-generation weather presentation platform transforming broadcast television through immersive augmented reality. This is not another weather graphics system. ImmersiCast™ is redefining how television stations communicate weather by combining cinematic augmented reality, advanced visualization, and real-time meteorological intelligence into one groundbreaking platform built specifically for live television. Powered by Unreal Engine and AccuWeather’s industry-leading weather data, ImmersiCast™ enables broadcasters to create unforgettable, immersive weather storytelling experiences that dramatically elevate viewer engagement.

The ideal candidate is an experienced media technology sales leader with a proven track record selling enterprise broadcast solutions, developing strategic relationships with television station groups, and introducing innovative technology to the market.

About ImmersiCast™

ImmersiCast™ catapults weather presentations into the AI- and immersive-media era.

The platform combines:

  • Advanced augmented reality visualization
  • Real-time weather intelligence
  • Broadcast-grade rendering technology
  • Fully integrated hardware, software, and data services
  • Flexible deployment as a standalone system or enhancement to existing weather platforms

With ImmersiCast™, meteorologists can step inside storms, interact with weather elements in three-dimensional space, and guide viewers through forecasts in ways traditional presentations simply cannot match.

From hurricanes and tornadoes to lightning, flooding, and severe weather events, ImmersiCast™ makes complex weather easier to understand, more impactful, and visually unforgettable.

Why This Opportunity Matters

Every station presents the weather similarly today. ImmersiCast™ gives broadcasters the ability to differentiate themselves in a highly competitive media environment with immersive storytelling technology their competitors may not yet have access to.

This is an opportunity to:

  • Introduce a category-defining broadcast technology platform
  • Work directly with major television groups and media executives
  • Help shape the future of weather presentation

job.title: Senior Lightning Scientist
job.description:
The Senior Lightning Scientist is a subject-matter expert responsible for advancing AccuWeather’s lightning detection, analysis, and interpretation capabilities. This role combines deep scientific understanding of lightning physics with practical expertise in RF systems, sensor networks, and algorithm development. The Senior Lightning Scientist plays a critical role in improving lightning detection accuracy, developing new methodologies, guiding technical strategy, and collaborating across science, engineering, and product teams to deliver industry-leading lightning intelligence products.

Working closely with data science, hardware, and software engineering teams, this role drives innovation in lightning detection technologies, signal processing, and real-time analysis systems that support AccuWeather’s operational, commercial, and public safety offerings.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as a technical and scientific authority on lightning physics, detection methodologies, and operational interpretation.
  • Lead the development, evaluation, and improvement of lightning detection algorithms using techniques such as TOA, TDOA, interferometry, and hybrid approaches.
  • Analyze RF signals across relevant frequency bands used in lightning detection, including waveform characterization, noise mitigation, and signal classification.
  • Collaborate with hardware and electrical engineering teams on sensor design, RF front-end considerations, antenna design, placement, and calibration strategies.
  • Develop and refine signal processing pipelines for real-time and post-processed lightning data.
  • Design, test, and validate algorithms for lightning geolocation, flash clustering, classification (e.g., CG vs IC), and quality control.
  • Evaluate network performance, detection efficiency, location accuracy, and timing precision using ground truth and statistical methods.
  • Contribute to the integration of lightning data into forecasting, nowcasting, severe weather detection, and machine learning systems.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to scientists and engineers working on lightning-related systems.
  • Document methodologies, assumptions, system limitations, and scientific findings for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with product, operations, and research teams to translate scientific advances into scalable, customer-facing solutions.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Advanced degree (PhD or MS with significant experience) in Atmospheric Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Geophysics, or a related field.
  • Deep understanding of lightning physics, electromagnetic emissions from lightning, and storm electrification processes.
  • Strong background in RF systems, signal processing, and spectral analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience with lightning detection techniques such as TOA, TDOA, interferometry, or related geolocation methods.
  • Proficiency in algorithm development and data analysis using Python, C++, or similar scientific computing environments.
  • Experience working with large-scale, real-time observational data systems.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex scientific and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience designing or working directly with lightning detection hardware, sensors, or ground-based networks.
  • Background in antenna theory, antenna design, and RF propagation effects.
  • Familiarity with FPGA, SDR, or embedded systems used in RF signal acquisition.
  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms and high-throughput data processing pipelines.
  • Published research or patents related to lightning detection, RF sensing, or atmospheric electricity.
  • Experience collaborating with operational forecasting or severe weather teams.
  • Familiarity with machine learning applications applied to lightning or RF signal classification.

job.title: Senior Product Manager
job.description:

job.title: Sr. Manager, DevOps
job.description:
AccuWeather is seeking an experienced Senior Manager, DevOps to lead a small team of engineers responsible for the infrastructure, automation, deployment, reliability, and operational capabilities that support AccuWeather's consumer, enterprise, API, and internal technology platforms.

This role combines people leadership with strong technical depth and cross-functional influence. The Senior Manager will establish priorities and direction for DevOps while remaining close enough to the technology to guide technical decisions, remove roadblocks, respond to operational issues, and partner effectively with Software Engineering, Product, Security, and other teams across AccuWeather. The ideal candidate continually looks for opportunities to improve reliability, simplify operations, increase automation, reduce cost, and enable engineering teams to deliver software more quickly and safely.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead, develop, and support a team of engineers including performance management, goal setting, career development, hiring, and resource planning
  • Define and execute the DevOps roadmap in alignment with Technology and Business priorities
  • Drive adoption of AI across DevOps to improve productivity, delivery, infrastructure management, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency
  • Identify and implement opportunities to use AI and intelligent automation with measurable improvements in speed, quality, or efficiency
  • Provide technical leadership across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, deployment automation, observability, and production operations
  • Ensure AccuWeather’s platforms and services are highly available, scalable, secure, maintainable, and recoverable
  • Continuously improve the SDLC by reducing manual processes, improving deployment safety, and enabling greater developer self-service
  • Establish and evolve standards and best practices for cloud infrastructure, configuration management, containers, automation, and operational tooling
  • Improve monitoring, logging, alerting, application performance visibility, and overall observability across supported platforms
  • Lead and improve incident response, root cause analysis, post-incident reviews, disaster recovery, and operational readiness practices
  • Partner internally to identify and address technical debt, reliability risks, scalability constraints, and operational efficiencies
  • Manage cloud and infrastructure capacity, utilization, and cost; identify opportunities to optimize technology spend without compromising reliability or performance
  • Incorporate security and compliance requirements into infrastructure, deployment, access, secrets management, and operational practices
  • Build strong partnerships across AccuWeather and help drive shared ownership

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, site reliability, software engineering, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience managing and developing technical employees
  • Strong technical understanding of modern cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS and CDN’s such as Akamai or Cloudflare
  • Strong technical understanding of CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automation, networking, containers, observability, and production operations
  • Experience supporting highly available web, mobile, API, data, or other large-scale platforms

  • Demonstrated ability to balance reliability, delivery speed, security, technical debt, and infrastructure cost when making decisions
  • Experience managing cloud or infrastructure spend and identifying cost-optimization opportunities
  • Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks, options, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences

job.title: Storm Warning Meteorologist
job.description:
We are seeking a full-time meteorologist with outstanding forecasting and communication skills to join our family of Storm Warning Meteorologists at the AccuWeather Severe Weather Center in Wichita, Kansas. We are looking for someone who is energetic, driven, team oriented and has a proactive work ethic. This is a fast-paced environment where the goal is to save lives, protect property and help clients maximize weather-related opportunities while minimizing weather-related risks. If you would like to contribute to a highly professional team that also knows how to have fun along the way, then this opening is for you! 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

As a Storm Warning Meteorologist, you will have opportunities to handle all types of hazardous weather forecasting and issue weather warnings for major business, transportation, education, media, and government organizations. These include:  

  • Utilize internal warning software to create your own customized, site-specific hazardous weather warnings (tornado, wind, flash flood, hurricane, etc.) independent of government agencies. 
  • Create hazardous weather forecast graphics and customized text discussions for transportation and other specialized clients across North America. 
  • Daily interaction with clients that need to make immediate operational weather-related decisions. 
  • Use internal computer applications. 
  • Perform other duties as assigned. 

  

QUALIFICATIONS 

  • Bachelor’s in Meteorology or Atmospheric Sciences. 
  • Refined customer service skills. 
  • Ability to meet strict deadlines. 
  • Great attention to detail. 
  • Ability to process meteorological data and make swift, accurate warning decisions. 
  • Ability to interact with and collaborate professionally with other members of the forecasting team. 
  • Must be willing and able to work semi-rotating shifts that include afternoons, evenings, overnights, weekends, and some holidays.

job.title: Weather Graphics Production Artist
job.description:

In this operational role, you’ll support graphics creation for internal stakeholders and external clientele across several medias, including print, television and digital. We are looking for someone who is collaborative, creative, and passionate about creating clear and accurate weather graphics that help people and businesses make the best weather-informed decisions.

· Create weather maps, charts and graphs utilizing several different graphic programs and operating systems, including Baron and Photoshop

· Follow set graphical standards across print, television and digital.

· Communicate effectively with Clients and other departments regarding any service or schedule changes or client requests.

job.title: Accounts Payable Specialist
job.description:
Company Information
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Job Summary

The Accounts Payable Specialist may specialize in a variety of different accounting areas related to company invoicing and payment processing. The AP Specialist will focus on the processing of invoices and the payment of company expenses. Responsibilities may include month end close duties and reporting, and other administrative or ad hoc projects as assigned.

Essential Functions

  • Review invoices, road checks, purchase card transactions, and other expenditures for accuracy, and enter and appropriate code into JD Edwards.
  • Contact vendors to request missing invoices and/or request changes to where invoices are being submitted.
  • Review T&E reports in Concur to ensure expenses are valid and employees are submitting proper receipts and support for all expenditures
  • Assist the accounting department as needed in filling out required forms for Wire Payments, Road Checks and Withholding Tax forms
  • Assist the accounting department with filling out and submitting new or change vendor forms
  • Contact vendors as needed to verbally verify payment information
  • Assist the Accounting Manager with various other duties including administrative office duties and ad hoc accounts payable related requests as needed

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or its equivalency (BA/BS Degree Preferred) Accounting
  • 2-4 years Of related work experience
  • Experience working with JDE and Image Now is preferred
  • Experience with financial reporting and ticketing systems is preferred
  • Music industry experience is preferred

Payscale: $21.79-$31.72

job.description:
Company Information

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience live events across five continents—from global touring, concerts, and festivals to iconic sports and entertainment destinations.

Through our music division, AEG Presents, one of the world’s leading operators of tours, concerts, and music festivals, we help shape the sound of now. We work with artists at every stage of their careers to bring live music to life, connecting artists with fans on stages around the world.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, AEG Presents is driven by creativity, innovation, and purpose, and powered by people who want their work to show up in the real world.

If you’re ready to help create moments that matter, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here.

Job Summary

The Development Security Operations (DevSecOps) Engineer is a technical role responsible for implementing and maintaining secure software development practices across the organization. Working closely with development, operations, and security teams, this position helps ensure that software delivery processes and environments align with industry best practices while maintaining operational efficiency and strong security controls. The DevSecOps Engineer supports the integration of security throughout the software development lifecycle, assists in identifying and mitigating security risks, and contributes to the continuous improvement of security automation, monitoring, and compliance capabilities.

Essential Functions

  • Implement and maintain secure software development practices across the organization by:
    • Performing code reviews and collaborate with development teams to address security vulnerabilities and implement secure coding practices.
    • Providing guidance and support to development teams in implementing secure coding practices and integrating security into the development lifecycle.
    • Work to provide security efforts with DevOps team to secure infrastructure and ensure secure deployment and operation of applications.
    • Work with cross-functional teams to define security requirements, standards, and guidelines for software development projects.
  • Enhance and monitor the tools used within the development and operations process.  This includes:
    • Reviewing and enhancing CI/CD pipelines using Github Actions, Azure DevOps, AWS Code pipeline, and Jenkins.
    • Utilizing tools like Orca Security, Sysdig, Codacy and Azure Log Analytics to monitor and analyze system logs and application code for security vulnerabilities.
    • Staying up to date with the latest security trends, vulnerabilities, and industry best practices, and ensure their integration into our software development processes.
    • Secure Image and Artifact Management: Protect container images, build artifacts, and other software packages used in the CI/CD pipeline. Scan these artifacts for vulnerabilities before deploying them and utilize secure registries for storage and distribution.
  • Work on the implementation as well as help maintain a security program.  This includes:
    • Conducting Risk Assessments using frameworks like the OWASP top 10
    • Developing a Risk Treatment Plan
    • Determining and create needed information Security Policies
    • Determining and create needed information Security Objectives
    • Maintain and help develop Security Reports
    • Help implement Security Controls within each dev group
    • Manage vendor relations
  • Work with internal and external team in working on audits, incident response, and/or compliance processes.
  • Work to define requirements and processes for Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity.  After requirements and processes are determined and approved, assist in the facilitation of a DR test.

Required Qualifications

 

  • BA/BS Degree (4- year)
  • 2-5 years of related work experience
  • Have experience managing vendor relationships and running an implementation from start to finish.
  • Has been a team lead or managed a team of security professionals.
  • Experience with a unified, real-time monitoring and analytics platform, such as Azure Log Analytics, Google Cloud Operations (Stackdriver), AWS CloudWatch, Sentry, Splunk or Datadog
  • Experience in at least one programming language (JavaScript, Ruby, Python, PHP, C#)
  • Experience with cloud environment such as AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform
  • Experience using a CI/CD tool like Github Actions, CircleCI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or AWS CodePipeline
  • Experience with apply frameworks in the Software Development Lifecycle like OWASP top 10, NIST, etc
  • Experience configuring infrastructure and application alerts, alarms, and notifications.
  • Proven experience as a DevSecOps Engineer, Software Security engineer, Security Engineer, or in a similar role
  • Eagerness to work in a highly collaborative team environment
  • Knowledge of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) practices and secure coding principles
  • Strong analytical, decision-making, interpersonal, and conflict resolution skills
  • Great verbal and written communication skills
  • Results driven with reliable follow through
  • Comfortable using Git version control.
  • Familiarity with industry security standards and frameworks such as OWASP top 10, NIST, ISO 27001, or CIS benchmarks

 

Payscale: $80,509- $128,000

Bonus: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

Job Summary

The Director Marketing, Las Vegas will create detailed promotional and advertising plans identifying targeted demographics for each show across multiple venues.   This position will develop new strategies for existing events by analyzing statistics regarding market development; acquiring and analyzing data; consulting with internal and external sources.  The Director Marketing, under guidance of the VP Marketing, will oversee the marketing department including progress and performance to ensure assigned work is completed correctly and on deadlines.

Essential Functions

  • Create detailed marketing and promotional campaigns identifying targeted demographics for each individual show.   Strategize and research new marketing trends and practices to apply to AEG Presents Las Vegas shows, events, residencies and tours.   Purchase and monitor media plans, develop national, regional and local promotions, and strategize with local talent buying team, property and venue partners and public relations team.
  • Under the guidance of VP Marketing, oversee marketing department team members including progress and performance to ensure assigned work is completed correctly and on deadline.  Provide mentorship and guidance to develop marketing staff by providing information, educational opportunities, and experiential growth opportunities.  Manage marketing workflow by completing department operational requirements by scheduling and assigning employees; following up on work results.
  • Serve as the primary local marketing contact for artist marketing representatives regarding show and residency marketing plans and approvals.
  • Develop new strategies for existing events by analyzing statistics regarding market development; acquiring and analyzing audience and artist data; consulting with internal and external sources.
  • Responsible for overseeing the creation and approvals of advertising materials and creative.  Order creative including signage, digital assets, and video content, coordinate with legal on sensitive material and vendor contracts.
  • Collaborate with booking team to create unique artist and venue pitch decks for new business and presentations.

This is a position that requires problem-solving skills, diligent attention to detail and being proactive in resolving issues as they arise.  The loading dock is a 24-hour, 7 day a week operation and involves working directly with delivery drivers, restaurant back of house staff, technical and show support crews, and venue management to ensure all deliveries arrive and are unloaded or loaded on schedule and efficiently. The position involves physical fitness, lifting, operating a forklift, and communicating via email and telephonically. It is responsible for ensuring that all safety procedures are followed by delivery drivers and personnel using the loading dock.

  • Control truck traffic, dock access and movement of supplies, deliveries, and equipment into and out of the Campus loading dock areas. Maintain efficiency of the Campus dock operation through coordination with Campus security, engineering, third party vendors, tenant and hotel management personnel.

Must be proactive in inspecting work areas for damage or inefficiencies and reporting to appropriate Manager.
  • Ensure tenants and vendors operate in accordance with all policies pertaining to the loading dock, as issued by Campus management.
  • Assist the Dock Master with assigned duties.
  • Communicate and problem solve access issues in a professional manner and maintain productive and supportive relationships with Campus tenants, third party vendors, security, engineering and hotel teams.
  • Provide operational support to all departments of Campus Operations. Assist with emergency situations as needed.
  • Ensure that all safety policies and procedures are followed and report any issues to Campus management.
  • Maintain cleanliness in the back of house areas, removing waste materials, pallets, food compost, etc.

  • Proficient in Microsoft products (Outlook, Word, Teams, etc.)
  • Must have two (2) years related work experience.
  • Previous experience in event production and logistics
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English (in person, on-line and by phone)
  • Excellent organizational skills with ability to multi-task
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Must be able to stand for extended periods of time of up to 6 hours with or without accommodations.
  • Must be able to lift/carry/pull/push up to 35lbs.
  • Must be able to work evenings, weekends and/or holidays.

  • Bilingual in Spanish

job.title: Lead DevSecOps Engineer
job.description:
Company Information
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Job Summary

AEG is seeking a Lead DevSecOps Engineer to join its global Information Security organization. Reporting to the Vice President of Information Security, this role provides technical leadership for AEG's DevSecOps and Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) programs, driving the integration of security throughout the software development lifecycle. The Lead DevSecOps Engineer partners closely with Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, and GRC teams to establish secure development standards, strengthen application and cloud security, secure CI/CD pipelines, and advance security automation and continuous compliance capabilities. Serving as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert, this role influences technology strategy, leads cross-functional security initiatives, and helps improve AEG's overall cybersecurity posture across its global technology environment. This position collaborates with teams across North America and Europe and may require flexibility to support initiatives across multiple time zones.

Essential Functions

  • Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) Enablement:
    • Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the organization's Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) program, partnering with Information Security and Engineering leadership to establish enterprise-wide secure development standards and practices.
    • Drive the integration of security-by-design principles and automated security controls across the software development lifecycle, ensuring consistent adoption across development, platform, and DevOps teams in collaboration with other engineers; lead security discussions with Engineering, DevOps, and Infrastructure teams to drive adoption of secure development practices.
  • CI/CD Pipeline Security:
    • Lead the architecture, strategy, and continuous maturation of enterprise CI/CD security capabilities, establishing secure-by-design standards for software delivery pipelines, deployment platforms, and development ecosystems.
    • Define and govern secure build processes, deployment workflows, container images, and third-party dependencies; drive and expand automation for security testing, validation, and policy enforcement; establish, integrate, and maintain security controls into build and deployment pipelines to support continuous compliance.
  • Security Tooling and Monitoring:
    • Lead the architecture, implementation, and governance of enterprise application security tooling establishing standards for SAST, DAST, and other application security tools.
    • Oversee the improvement of security visibility and monitoring across development environments; drive the configuration and maintenance alerts, notifications, and security monitoring capabilities.
  • Risk, Compliance, and Governance Support:
    • Lead enterprise application risk assessments and threat modeling exercises; establish and maintain the organization’s SDLC security requirements, procedures, and supporting documentation.
    • Document and monitor that compliance efforts align with ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and related frameworks.
  • Application Security and Vulnerability Management:
    • Perform secure code reviews and work with development teams to remediate vulnerabilities; manage vulnerability reporting, remediation tracking, and disclosure processes.
    • Lead remediation efforts across engineering and development teams.
  • Security Consulting and Cross-Functional Partnership:
    • Serve as the lead security advisor and strategic partner with Engineering, DevOps, Platform, Infrastructure, and GRC teams to advance security initiatives.
    • Lead cross-functional security initiatives and provide practical security guidance throughout the design, development, and deployment lifecycle.
    • Define and maintain secure development standards and best practices; serve as a trusted security advisor for application and development-related initiatives.
  • Audit and Incident Response Support:
    • Lead the development and execution of security audits and evidence collection related to SDLC and application security controls.
    • Work with stakeholders on investigations and incident response activities involving applications and development environments.
    • Participate in control testing, validation, and compliance assessments.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) (Advanced Degree Preferred) Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. Master's degree or advanced certifications preferred.
  • 5+ years Experience in DevSecOps, Application Security, Security Engineering, or related cybersecurity roles.
  • Proven experience integrating security throughout the software development lifecycle, including CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with application security testing tools, including SAST, DAST, SCA, and container security solutions.
  • Experience performing threat modeling, application risk assessments, vulnerability management, and remediation tracking.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, alerting, and security controls across cloud, application, and infrastructure environments.
  • Strong understanding of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) practices and secure coding principles.
  • Familiarity with modern application development frameworks and technologies, including Laravel and other enterprise web application frameworks.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to build partnerships and align security objectives with business needs.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams and accommodate occasional meetings across multiple time zones.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with programming languages including JavaScript, Python, Ruby, PHP, or C#.
  • Experience with CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI, Azure DevOps, or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of application security testing methodologies including SAST, DAST, SCA, and container security scanning.
  • Experience with OWASP Top 10, NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF), and related security frameworks.
  • Experience configuring application and infrastructure monitoring solutions, alerts, and notifications.
  • Familiarity with container technologies and cloud-native application deployment models.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively within a highly collaborative global environment.
  • Self-motivated with strong ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester (GWAPT), GIAC Cloud Security Automation (GCSA), AWS Security Specialty, Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS), or equivalent certifications.

job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

The Role

AXS is seeking a Lead Software Engineer – Full Stack to lead the design and development of our core ticketing platforms.

You will lead full-stack work across user interfaces, back-end services, APIs, and integrations. The role combines hands-on development with technical leadership, architecture, and team guidance in a complex enterprise environment. You’ll own initiatives end-to-end on front-end and back-end, drive technical direction, and partner with Product, Design, and engineering to ship secure, scalable software for high-demand, global use cases.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design, build, and maintain front-end and back-end features for web applications.
  • Lead full-stack architecture and design reviews; author or review technical design as needed.
  • Set standards for code quality, security, performance, accessibility, and scalability on UI and services.
  • Build APIs, business logic, and integrations that support strong user experiences.
  • Support agile delivery: planning, estimation, backlog breakdown, risk and blocker management.
  • Champion testing, CI/CD, observability, and operational practices for apps and services.
  • Mentor engineers, lead code reviews, and improve documentation and knowledge sharing.

What to Bring

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, including technical leadership.
  • Strong front-end experience: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript; frameworks such as React or Next.js; modern UI architecture, accessibility, and responsive design.
  • Strong back-end experience: Java or C# and .NET Core; building APIs, services, and business logic that power web applications.
  • Demonstrated ability to own work across front-end and back-end, not only one layer.
  • Solid understanding of API design, integrations, and modern application architecture.
  • Experience optimizing UI performance and service performance/reliability.
  • Proven ability to lead engineers, set engineering standards, and drive work from concept through production.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication; strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • AWS; Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes.

job.title: Manager Network Infrastructure
job.description:
Company Information
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Job Summary

The Manager, Network Infrastructure is responsible for deploying, supporting, securing and managing the lifecycle of AEG Global Technology's network infrastructure across US venues and enterprise environments. This role ensures network services, firewalls, routing, switching, wireless platforms and related operational processes meet Global Technology standards, security requirements, governance controls and business priorities. The role also provides on-site event support across multiple venues and requires flexibility to work evenings, weekends and participate in an on-call rota.

Essential Functions

  • Line manage US-based network engineers (and contractors as required) and provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, prioritization and performance support in alignment with Global Technology objectives and ensuring service delivery meets established SLAs.
  • Provide escalation support for critical network incidents, including out-of-hours response for venue, event and enterprise-impacting issues.
  • Ensure existing network infrastructure is effectively managed, supported, patched, monitored and secured, including response to vulnerabilities, threats, audit findings and operational risks.
  • Work with venue technology teams, business stakeholders, information security, operations teams and the Vice President, Network Infrastructure and Venue Technology to plan, budget and prioritize network infrastructure projects and service improvements.
  • Project manage network infrastructure initiatives through the full lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, resource scheduling, implementation planning, change management, handover and documentation.
  • Design and implement scalable, secure and supportable network infrastructure solutions that align with Global Technology architecture, security and operational standards.
  • Maintain accurate design documentation, configuration records, operational runbooks, support models and standard operating procedures for all supported network services.
  • Provide technical input and design review for venue technology, business systems, infrastructure, security, cloud and development initiatives where network architecture or connectivity is a dependency.
  • Maintain current knowledge of network, wireless, firewall, automation, monitoring and security technologies and recommend improvements that improve resilience, performance, security and operational efficiency.
  • Ensure network engineering practices, training, knowledge sharing and development plans support consistent delivery of Global Technology standards across venues and enterprise environments.
  • Understand long-term business, venue and event technology objectives and recommend practical network strategies that support secure, resilient and scalable operations.
  • Provide and promote a high standard of service ownership, stakeholder communication and continuous improvement across network operations and project delivery.
  • Undertake other relevant duties or reasonable requests as required by the Vice President, Network Infrastructure and Venue Technology or senior Global Technology leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) in Information Technology or related area.
  • 4-6 years experience in a similar network infrastructure leadership role, including the design, implementation, support and lifecycle management of large-scale, multi-site and multi-tenant enterprise networks. Experience working with venue, event, corporate or highly available operational environments is preferred.
  • Ability to manage, coach and develop network engineering staff, prioritize work across operational and project demands, and support performance, development and service ownership.
  • Ability to build effective working relationships with venue technology teams, business stakeholders, vendors, information security, infrastructure, service desk and senior Global Technology leadership.
  • Understand how technology enables and supports business objectives.
  • Have significant experience configuring, managing and supporting Cisco and Meraki routing, switching, wireless, security appliance and cloud-managed network platforms.
  • Have significant experience configuring and managing Palo Alto firewalls, Panorama and related security policy, segmentation, logging and operational governance processes.
  • Have strong experience in network security, including segmentation, zero trust principles, access control, layer 2 security, layer 7 inspection, vulnerability response and secure change governance.
  • Experience working across test, pre-production and production environments.
  • Demonstrate strong expertise across core network technologies, including the OSI model; fibre, CWDM and DWDM transmission services; Ethernet and layer 2 switching, including VLANs, STP, MTU and layer 2 security; IPv4 and IPv6; VRF; GRE; routing protocols such as HSRP, VRRP, OSPF, EIGRP and BGP; route-based IPsec VPNs; multicast; QoS; MPLS and EoMPLS; network security and 802.1x; DNS; DHCP; and RADIUS.
  • Troubleshoot complex network, voice and internet connectivity issues, including packet capture and analysis.
  • Provide root cause analysis for major incidents and document findings for Global Technology and key stakeholders.
  • Produce accurate, detailed reports while maintaining strong attention to detail and following agreed standards.
  • Understand and consistently apply Global Technology standards for architecture, security, monitoring, documentation, vendor management, operational support and change control.
  • Maintain high documentation standards, including architecture diagrams, configuration records, operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, change records, service incidents and post-incident reviews.
  • Apply industry best practices to design and implement secure, practical technology systems and infrastructure.
  • Use initiative, work with minimal supervision, manage time effectively and deliver within agreed timescales.
  • Must be able to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation to support venues and live events.
  • Willing and able to travel domestically.
  • Demonstrate a positive, solutions-focused attitude.
  • Collaborate effectively in a high-performing team environment.
  • Maintain a strong commitment to high-quality delivery.
  • Certification for core technologies is highly preferred.

Pay Scale: $155,000.00 - $169,000.00

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements..

Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

job.title: Manager, Payments and Fraud Analytics - AXS
job.description:

Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

 

 

The Role

AXS is seeking a Manager, Payments and Fraud to lead macro-level analytics for AXS payment performance and fraud risk. The role uses advanced SQL, data visualization, and payments expertise to identify opportunities to increase authorization and conversion, reduce processing costs, prevent material fraud and chargeback losses, and improve payment reliability across markets, channels, and providers. Unlike transaction-review roles that make accept-or-decline decisions on individual orders, this position analyzes portfolio trends and converts findings into business, product, routing, and risk recommendations. The manager partners with Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, Stripe, and internal Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, and Fraud Prevention teams. The role initially leads through expertise and cross-functional influence and is expected to assume direct people-management responsibility as the analytics team grows.

 

What Will You Do?

  • Lead deep-dive analysis of payment authorization, decline, conversion, routing, settlement, and processing-cost data; identify material trends and quantify opportunities by market, issuer, network, gateway, payment method, and customer segment.
  • Analyze fraud, chargeback, dispute, and loss data at the portfolio level; identify emerging patterns and control gaps, size financial exposure, and recommend changes to fraud strategies, rules, tools, and operating processes.
  • Build and maintain trusted KPI definitions, SQL analyses, dashboards, and executive reporting for payment performance, fraud, chargebacks, costs, and customer impact; establish data-quality controls and clear measurement methods.
  • Develop business cases and lead cross-functional optimization initiatives, experiments, and post-implementation measurement for payment routing, authorization uplift, fraud controls, payment methods, tokenization, 3DS, and cross-border performance.
  • Monitor high-volume on-sales and material payment or fraud events; perform root-cause analysis, coordinate stakeholders, and translate incidents into corrective actions and longer-term improvements.
  • Partner with Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, Stripe, and other providers to review performance, investigate issues, evaluate capabilities, and hold partners accountable for agreed service and optimization actions.
  • Advise Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Fraud Prevention, and senior leaders on priorities, tradeoffs, and policy or process changes; communicate complex findings and gain support for recommendations with financial and customer impact.
  • Establish the operating model, priorities, documentation, and performance standards for the analytics function; coordinate work across analysts and develop, coach, and manage direct reports as positions are added.

 

What Will You Bring?

  • BA/BS Degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Business, or a related field. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 4-6 years of hands-on advanced SQL analysis using large transaction-level datasets and development of dashboards or data visualizations for business decisions.
  • 4-6 years of progressive experience in payments analytics, fraud analytics, payment operations, risk, or a closely related field.
  • 4-6 years of experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives, coordinating the work of analysts, or managing and developing team members.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including the ability to join, validate, segment, and interpret large payment and fraud datasets.
  • Advanced data visualization and dashboard development skills using Tableau, Looker, or comparable tools; experience working with Snowflake or a similar cloud data platform.
  • Strong knowledge of card payments, authorization and decline behavior, routing, processing economics, interchange and network fees, settlement, chargebacks, disputes, and fraud controls.
  • Working knowledge of payment networks and processors or gateways, including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, and Stripe.
  • Knowledge of tokenization, 3DS, alternative payment methods, cross-border payments, and the customer checkout experience.
  • Ability to frame ambiguous business questions, perform root-cause analysis, quantify financial and customer impact, and recommend practical actions.
  • Ability to communicate complex analysis to technical and nontechnical audiences and influence decisions across Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, vendors, and senior leadership.
  • Leadership skills to set priorities, establish standards, coordinate work, coach analysts, and build a high-performing analytics function as the team grows.

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

  • Attend team, community, and other events for purpose of maximizing sales opportunities.

  • High School Diploma or its equivalency (BA/BS Degree Preferred)

Experience:

A minimum of 2-4 years of related experience

job.title: Operations Manager - United Heritage Hall
job.description:
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

The Manager Operations will oversee operations and perform management functions at venues and events throughout the region. The Manager Operations will be responsible for day-to-day operations; marketing shows, working with the General Manager to ensure all event needs are met, and working with the production team to advance the shows at their assigned venue ensuring the artist contract is properly fulfilled within the show budget. This position will work closely with staff to provide a high-level customer service to ensure a friendly, safe environment at all events, and work with operations team on developing policies and procedures, assist with planning and cost estimates. Additionally, the Manager Operations will handle daily administration, oversee equipment and supplies inventory, and provide input on venue improvements.

  • Responsible for the day-to-day office administrative work including staff schedules, timekeeping, hiring, supervising and monitoring of staff performance. Work with staff to create a friendly, safe environment at all events through proper training.
  • Ensure all events have adequate equipment and supplies to function properly. Work with members of the operations team to procure these items at the most competitive price. Negotiate vendor contracts and maintain good working relationship with vendors.
  • Engage in venue improvements and capital projects by providing recommendations for improvements and working with management team to obtain bids, develop ROI (Return on Investment) analyses, and oversee projects to completion. Ensure venue is ready for opening and reporting any maintenance/supply needs to GM.

job.title: Privacy Analyst - Temp
job.description:
Company Information
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

 

Job Summary

The Privacy Analyst supports AEG’s privacy program by analyzing business activities, systems, products, and proposed uses or disclosures of personal information under applicable privacy laws and regulations. The role gathers and evaluates relevant facts, identifies privacy requirements and risks, and translates that analysis into clear, practical actions for business stakeholders. Responsibilities include conducting privacy impact assessments, supporting data mapping and records of processing, preparing data-sharing arrangements, drafting guidelines and recommendations, supporting consumer-rights compliance, and maintaining accurate privacy-program documentation. The Privacy Analyst partners with Legal, Information Security, Marketing, Global Partnerships, Human Resources, IT, and other business teams and escalates novel or material legal questions as appropriate.

Essential Functions

  • Analyze proposed and existing business activities involving personal information, including products, services, marketing initiatives, employee processes, technologies, vendors, and data-sharing arrangements. Gather relevant facts, identify applicable privacy requirements, assess risks and gaps, document conclusions, and recommend practical actions or escalation.
  • Conduct and document privacy impact, risk, AI and other required assessments under applicable laws. Evaluate issues such as notice, purpose limitation, data minimization, retention, sensitive personal information, consumer rights, targeted advertising, sale or sharing, automated decision-making, AI-enabled processing, profiling, algorithmic decision-making, and contractual requirements.
  • Develop and maintain accurate data maps and inventories by documenting categories of personal information, data subjects, collection sources, business purposes, systems, recipients, disclosures, retention periods, and relevant data flows. Analyze gaps and inconsistencies and work with stakeholders to determine practical solutions.
  • Assess proposed disclosures and transfers of personal information to affiliates, service providers, contractors, and other third parties. Determine whether a data processing, data sharing, confidentiality, or other agreement is required; identify necessary privacy terms and restrictions; document recommendations; and coordinate review or escalation with Legal.
  • Draft and maintain privacy guidelines, assessment templates, standard operating procedures, and playbooks that convert legal and policy requirements into repeatable business practices.
  • Analyze and support data subject requests involving access, deletion, correction, opt-out, limitation, and appeal rights under applicable laws; identify relevant systems and data owners; document exceptions and response decisions.
  • Monitor developments in privacy laws, regulations, enforcement actions, and regulatory guidance; assess their effect on existing business practices, and propose updates to policies, processes, notices, agreements, and training materials.

 

Required Qualifications

  • 2-4 years’ experience in information technology or data privacy and AI governance management, including supporting e-commerce or CRM-focused initiatives.
  • Experience with SaaS privacy platforms such as OneTrust, Ketch, Osano, TrustArc etc.
  • Experience supporting compliance initiatives under North America, APAC, Europe, and LatAm privacy laws.
  • Demonstrated understanding of current data protection and privacy legislation in the United States (must), APAC, Europe, and LatAm (plus).
  • Understanding the role privacy has in supporting business enablement and employee privacy in a global enterprise.  
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytics skills.
  • Detail-oriented and highly motivated.
  • Ability to identify and solve problems quickly.
  • Ability to nurture relationships across large and complex organizations.
  • Comfortable working both independently and in a team setting, in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in the use of Generative AI tools such as Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, etc.
  • Proficiency in the Microsoft Office 365 suite (Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.)
  • CIPP-US, CIPP-EU, or CIPM

Pay Scale: $95,000.00 - $105,000.00

Bonus: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: You will be eligible for medical insurance benefits in accordance with the terms of the Company's benefit plan. Currently, full time employees are eligible for these benefits on the first day of
employment.

job.title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) Administrator & Solutions Engineer
job.description:
Company Information

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience live events across five continents—from global touring, concerts, and festivals to iconic sports and entertainment destinations.

Through our music division, AEG Presents, one of the world’s leading operators of tours, concerts, and music festivals, we help shape the sound of now. We work with artists at every stage of their careers to bring live music to life, connecting artists with fans on stages around the world.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, AEG Presents is driven by creativity, innovation, and purpose, and powered by people who want their work to show up in the real world.

If you’re ready to help create moments that matter, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here.

Job Summary

The Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) Administrator & Solutions Engineer owns the health of AEG Presents' marketing automation platform while designing and building the technical solutions that power it. This role blends the day-to-day discipline of a platform administrator — governance, data hygiene, and deliverability — with the build-it mindset of a solutions engineer, using AMPscript, SQL, and APIs to turn business requirements from the Personalization, CRM, and Analytics teams into scalable, well-documented technical solutions inside SFMC. The SFMC Administrator & Solutions Engineer will act as a trusted advisor, shaping how Salesforce Marketing Cloud is leveraged within the broader Martech ecosystem to drive fan engagement, unlock revenue opportunities, and deliver personalized

Essential Functions

 

  • Administer the Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) platform, including user access, business unit configuration, and security settings.
  • Design and build technical solutions in SFMC (AMPscript, SSJS, SQL, APIs) that translate business requirements from Personalization, CRM, and Marketing stakeholders.
  • Monitor platform health, email deliverability, and compliance with CAN-SPAM, CASL, and GDPR.
  • Maintain and audit Data Extensions, Automations, and Journeys for accuracy, performance, and data hygiene.
  • Build and maintain integrations — REST/SOAP APIs and SFTP automations — connecting SFMC to Salesforce Sales/Service Cloud and other marketing technology systems.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across journeys, automations, and data flows; document processes and configurations.
  • Serve as a technical point of contact for SFMC projects; support QA and testing for new campaigns, features and integrations.

 

Required Qualifications

 

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) Marketing, Information Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2-4 years Hands-on experience administering Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including Data Extensions, Automation Studio, Journey Builder, and Contact Builder.
  • Experience with SFMC REST/SOAP APIs and SFTP-based data integrations.
  • Preferred: experience integrating SFMC with Salesforce Sales/Service Cloud; familiarity with live entertainment, ticketing, or hospitality marketing; experience with GA4 or attribution/personalization platforms; working knowledge of HTML/CSS for responsive email templates.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce Marketing Cloud capabilities (Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Contact Builder, etc.)
  • Proficiency in AMPscript and SQL, with working familiarity with Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS).
  • Solid understanding of email deliverability best practices and data privacy regulations (CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR).
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Salesforce Administration Certification Salesforce Marketing Cloud Email Specialist certification also preferred. Certification may be obtained within the first 6 months of employment if not already held.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Crypto.com Arena has an unrivaled reputation for excellence, having established itself as one of the world’s busiest and most successful venues in the world. As the home of three professional sports franchises – the NBA’s Los Angeles Lakers, the NHL’s LA Kings and the WNBA’s Los Angeles Sparks – Crypto.com Arena has proven to be a home court advantage for the local teams. The AEG owned and operated arena continues to distinguish itself as the host of major, high-profile events of national and international distinction including the 2004, 2011 & 2018 NBA All-Star Games, 2002 & 2017 NHL All-Star Games, 2000 Democratic National Convention, 2009 World Figure Skating Championships and 21 GRAMMY Awards shows. 
 
For a quarter of a century, Crypto.com Arena has been marked with performances and special events that brought international stature to the downtown Los Angeles venue including concerts headlined by Taylor Swift, Drake, Beyoncé, Prince, U2, Paul McCartney, Garth Brooks, Usher, Jay-Z, Keith Urban, Roger Waters, Britney Spears, Katy Perry, Ed Sheeran, Kendrick Lamar, Michael Bublé, Carrie Underwood and Justin Timberlake, as well as world championship boxing, family shows and other live events. 
 
Crypto.com Arena is not only a great venue for sports and entertainment, but it also holds a special place in the hearts of the local community. The arena has witnessed many historic moments, unforgettable performances, and become an iconic landmark in the region for the most popular and important events.

Job Summary:

The Security Supervisor position represents Crypto.com Arena and/or Peacock Theater in an exemplary manner. Reporting to the Security Management Team, the Security Supervisor will supervise Security Officers at Crypto.com Arena and/or Peacock Theater. This is a part-time, non-union, hourly position. 

Essential Functions:

  • Event Security
    • Uphold the Security Department’s Prime Directives, most importantly our mission to take reasonable steps to protect the safety and security of our venues’ guests, team members, and assets with respect towards everyone’s dignity and legal rights.
    • Resolve escalated security situations, providing appropriate warnings and complete ejections/arrests if warranted/necessary.
    • Ensure enforcement and compliance of the venue’s Event Policies at all times.
    • Efficiently manage all incidents encountered during an event.
    • Assist with directional and informational inquiries. Serve as escalation point for complaints/issues.

    • Represent Crypto.com Arena and/or Peacock Theater and the Security Department in an exemplary manner.
    • Apply principles of logical thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems in order to successfully perform and direct varied and complex tasks.
    • Perform a variety of duties often changing from one task to another of a different nature without the loss of efficiency or composure.
  • Staff Supervision
    • Deploy staff for events. Assign appropriate shifts, breaks, and necessary equipment.
    • Train staff in basic guest service and security skills. Actively monitor staff interactions with Crypto.com Arena and/or Peacock Theater venue guests, clients, artists/athletes, and team members at all events to ensure a safe, secure, comfortable entertainment experience for all.
    • Provide leadership and guidance to staff. Serve as mentor/coach to all Security team members.
    • Provide timely, appropriate feedback to staff on performance, both positive and corrective. Effectively communicate escalated team member issues to Security Management Team.
    • Administer appropriate performance reviews, counseling and disciplinary documentations as needed to ensure compliance of Crypto Arena.com/Peacock Theater company/department policies.
    • Accept responsibility for the performance and conduct of the entire security team assigned to the deployment.

  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull up to fifty (50) pounds.

job.title: Senior Data Analyst – Paid Media
job.description:
Company Information

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience live events across five continents—from global touring, concerts, and festivals to iconic sports and entertainment destinations.

Through our music division, AEG Presents, one of the world’s leading operators of tours, concerts, and music festivals, we help shape the sound of now. We work with artists at every stage of their careers to bring live music to life, connecting artists with fans on stages around the world.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, AEG Presents is driven by creativity, innovation, and purpose, and powered by people who want their work to show up in the real world.

If you’re ready to help create moments that matter, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here.

 

The Senior Data Analyst – Paid Media sits on the Data Analytics, Reporting & Strategy team and serves as the analytical partner and lead for the Paid Media team. Paid Media drives company-wide digital media strategy, campaign management, and consultative support across AEG divisions, including AEG Presents, Global Touring, Festivals, Goldenvoice, Bowery Presents, and Global Partnerships. Campaigns run across a broad mix of channels, including Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, and other social, search, and programmatic platforms.

This role is responsible for pulling, transforming, and modeling campaign data from those ad platforms and joining it with other data sources to build a unified view of performance. The analyst will design scalable data models and automated reporting that measure campaign effectiveness and surface opportunities to optimize budget allocation, audience targeting, creative, and customer acquisition. The role also turns findings into clear, practical recommendations that drive ticket sales, event awareness, and brand initiatives.

The Senior Data Analyst will work closely with the Paid Media, Product, and Data Engineering teams on cross-functional projects covering paid media data ingestion, aggregation, mastering, measurement, and visualization. The position will lead the work to make sure tracking and tagging (pixels, conversion APIs, UTMs) capture accurate marketing data. It will also develop and maintain attribution models and set performance benchmarks for key metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rate.

Essential Functions

 

  • Provide analytical support to Paid Media and Marketing teams, compiling performance marketing reports across digital channels using internal BI tools, Google Analytics, native advertising platforms. Communicate results to stakeholders, working with media and strategy teams to demonstrate clear actionable insights for media plans, budget forecasting, targeting/audiences, and creative.
  • Build and maintain comprehensive measurement plans to evaluate paid media performance, calculate benchmarks based on objectives, develop + maintain attribution models to identify trends, testing opportunities, and insights by channel, audience, festival/tour/regional show, and business unit.
  • Partner with Data, Product, Engineering teams to manage data pipelines + ingestion for channel metrics, define data collection requirements and enforce optimal taxonomy for reporting implementations, continual data hygiene + integrity across ad buying and internal platforms.
  • Collaborate with media, marketing, and data teams to inform audience and targeting strategies. Develop tests to evaluate new campaign strategies, ad products, optimization tactics, and targeting features.
  • Manage and lead paid media projects involving data aggregation and measurement tools such as Datorama, Google Analytics / GA4, Tag Manager, DOMO, BigQuery, LiveRamp, server-server integrations with media partners. Ensure appropriate site tracking is in place to capture relevant data points to measure marketing effectiveness.
  • Work closely with data team to develop and maintain reporting dashboards for internal and external use, while providing support for ad hot reporting requests.

 

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree (4-year) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business, Marketing, or a related quantitative field
  • 4–6 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role, with exposure to paid media or digital marketing data on the client, publisher, or agency side; e-commerce experience preferred
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience pulling, transforming, and analyzing large, complex datasets
  • Strong ability to build data models, data flows, and ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL and/or Python, bringing together data from multiple media channels into a scalable, automated insights reporting structure
  • Proficiency in BI and data visualization tools such as DOMO, Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar, with strong dashboard design and data storytelling skills
  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence (formerly Datorama) or similar marketing data integration platforms is a strong plus
  • Working knowledge of paid media data and performance metrics, including impressions, CTR, CPC, CPA, conversion rate, and ROAS, across platforms such as Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok
  • Familiarity with tracking infrastructure such as GA4, Google Tag Manager, pixels, Conversions API, UTMs, and server-side tracking
  • Experience applying statistical methods to performance benchmarking, attribution modeling, and media mix modeling (MMM)
  • Understanding of the ad tech and Martech landscape (programmatic buying, DSP/SSP, audience management, ad serving, social buying platforms), and of privacy regulations’ impact on measurement, including cookie-less tracking and multi-touch customer journeys
  • Ability to clearly communicate insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and manage multiple cross-functional projects at once

Payscale: $82,158.00 -$125,000.00

Bonus:  This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.
