job.title: Sr Product Manager, Resale Platform Experience
job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we've consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today. 

We're passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we're always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment. Together we keep the world cheering. 

 

Position Summary: 

AXS is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end strategy and execution of our Resale platform. This role is responsible for the core marketplace engine that powers secondary ticketing across the AXS ecosystem, including resale listings ingestion and distribution, inventory and pricing services, event and venue data models, partner and marketplace integrations, public-facing APIs, and the platform services that connect fan demand with resale supply across thousands of events each year.  

Success requires balancing platform scalability, data integrity, marketplace health, and delivery velocity while evolving the core engine to support new partners, markets, and fan experiences.  

The ideal candidate combines strong product instincts with a deep technical foundation and a systems-modeling mindset. You are comfortable leading engineering teams through domain and data modeling, API and data contract design, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and platform integrations while translating those capabilities into measurable business and marketplace outcomes. You are execution-focused and thrive on turning ambiguous problems into clear requirements, well-sequenced roadmaps, and shipped software.   

You will work closely with Engineering (including onshore and offshore delivery teams), Architecture, Data, Payments, Partner Experience, and business stakeholders to deliver a scalable, reliable resale platform that grows marketplace liquidity and improves the fan experience across the live event lifecycle. 

Essential Functions: 

As a Senior Product Manager you will be accountable for: 

  • Defining product vision, roadmap, and priorities for the core Resale platform engine across the AXS ecosystem. 
  • Establish platform priorities that balance scalability, reliability, modernization, and marketplace growth.  
  • Own platform capabilities delivered through APIs, data contracts, integrations, event-driven services, and backend systems that power resale listings, inventory, and pricing.  
  • Lead systems and domain modeling for core resale entities, including events, venues, seating, listings, inventory, and transactions, to create a durable and extensible platform foundation. 
  • Serve as the day-to-day product leader for Engineering, driving sprint planning, backlog refinement, technical requirements, and acceptance criteria through delivery. 
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Architecture to define API standards, service-level objectives, reliability goals, and operational readiness standards. 
  • Drive product decisions using marketplace metrics, platform telemetry, observability, and performance data. 
  • Own capacity planning and delivery sequencing with engineering leadership, managing dependencies across onshore and offshore teams. 
  • Partnering with the Partner Experience team to ensure platform capabilities, APIs, and integrations are ready for external partner and developer adoption. 
  • Identifying and prioritizing improvements that reduce technical debt, data quality issues, and integration friction across the resale ecosystem. 
  • Develop a deep understanding of secondary ticketing, marketplace supply and demand dynamics, and resale workflows.  
  • Lead modernization efforts across legacy resale and listing systems while maintaining marketplace continuity.  
  • Define and monitor KPIs related to platform reliability, data quality, listing coverage, performance, and delivery predictability. 
  • Communicate roadmap, risks, priorities, and outcomes clearly across technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leadership. 
  • Build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups and influence decisions through data-driven insights and customer understanding. 

 

We are looking for: 

 

Required Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience delivering complex software products in Agile environments. 
  • Demonstrated success owning technical products, platforms, APIs, SDKs, integrations, or enterprise software solutions. 
  • Experience partnering closely with engineering teams to deliver platform, integration, or infrastructure-adjacent products within modern distributed architectures. 
  • Experience supporting mission-critical workflows where reliability, scalability, performance, and resiliency are essential. 
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures, distributed systems, operational telemetry, observability, and data-driven product decision making. 
  • Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex ecosystems spanning modern platforms, legacy systems, integrations, and operational processes. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to define ambiguous problems, synthesize data, and deliver measurable outcomes. 
  • Proven ability to balance customer needs, business objectives, and technical constraints while driving product strategy and execution. 
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align technical and non-technical stakeholders across organizational boundaries. 
  • Systems thinker with a platform-oriented mindset who can connect business processes, technical systems, operational workflows, and customer experiences to build scalable solutions. 
  • Curious, data-driven, and comfortable operating in complex environments, with a strong bias toward continuous improvement, experimentation, and measurable outcomes. 
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 

 

Preferred Qualifications 

 

  • Background building platform products that enable external partners through APIs, SDKs, integrations, or developer ecosystems. 
  • Track record of modernizing legacy operational systems while balancing migration risk, business continuity, and long-term platform evolution. 
  • Familiarity with software-plus-hardware ecosystems, including mobile applications, hardware integrations, edge devices, or operational technology environments. 
  • Understanding of service reliability, operational readiness, performance objectives, and incident management practices. 
  • Proven ability to design configurable platform capabilities that support regional variation while maintaining a scalable core product. 
  • Exposure to complex global organizations and products serving multiple international markets. 
  • Domain expertise in live entertainment, ticketing, venue operations, access control, identity, payments, transportation, hospitality, logistics, or other operationally intensive industries.

 

 

At AXS, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but can't "check every box" in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles. 

 

Pay Scale: $127.000-$135,000

Bonus:  This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. 

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. Currently, full time employees are eligible for these benefits on the first day of employment.

 *Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position. 

 

What’s in it for You?

  • Extraordinary People – we’re not kidding!
  • Meaningful Mission– Helping revolutionize an industry and deliver better experiences for fans and clients around the world.
  • Development and Learning – Opportunities for learning and leveling up through training and education reimbursement.
  • Community & Belonging – A range of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection, inclusion, and professional growth. Access to meaningful volunteer opportunities and community engagement programs to make a positive impact beyond the workplace.

In each location you’ll find a team of dedicated, diverse employees (we’ve dubbed ourselves “Fanatix”) who create groundbreaking products and services in a fun, fast-paced environment. 

To learn more about our culture and values, visit: https://solutions.axs.com/careers/

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

The Role

The Senior Director of Business Development will drive AXS’s growth across the sports industry by identifying, developing, and closing new partnerships with teams, leagues, venues, and other rights holders. Reporting to the Vice President of Business Development, this role will manage the full business development lifecycle, from market development and prospecting through solution design, financial modeling, negotiation, contracting and transition to implementation.

The Senior Director will build trusted relationships with senior decision makers, develop customized partnership strategies, and clearly communicate AXS’s ticketing capabilities. This individual will work closely with Product, Technology, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Operations to create compelling proposals, structure commercially sound agreements, and ensure organizational alignment through the sales process.

The ideal candidate combines deep sports industry knowledge, strong commercial judgement, and a proven ability to navigate complex, long-term sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.

What Will You Do?

  • Financial Proposals and Negotiations: Manage financial proposals and lead contract negotiations for new partnerships and renewals, ensuring terms that support long-term objectives.
  • Revenue Growth: Contribute to achieving and surpassing revenue targets by identifying key opportunities within all verticals.
  • CRM Leadership: Oversee CRM system use, including account maintenance, report generation, and workflow management. Ensure data integrity and process optimization.
  • Industry Representation: Represent AXS at industry events and tradeshows. Facilitate strategic meetings and events with external partners and prospects.
  • Executive Support: Assist the Business Development leadership team with strategic tasks and ad-hoc initiatives that drive growth.
  • Data Integrity: Ensure CRM data accuracy and advocate for best practices in data management, facilitating smooth handoffs to Customer Success.
  • Partnership Development: Cultivate relationships with potential partners and lead efforts to secure and coordinate meetings that drive business opportunities.
  • Sales Tools and Resources: Evolve sales tools, presentations, and contracts to meet marketplace needs and communicate AXS's value proposition.
  • Messaging and Content: Develop messaging and content that clearly articulate AXS's unique value across products, services, and verticals.

 

What Will You Bring?

  • BA/BS Degree in Business Administration, Marketing or a related field
  • 6+ years' experience in Business Development and ticketing or live entertainment
  • Strong experience with identifying opportunities, developing strategies, and negotiating creative solutions
  • Experience negotiating and executing contracts.
  • Experience in evolving sales tools, presentations, and messaging to align with market trends.
  • Experience representing a company at industry events and tradeshows, with the ability to network and generate leads.
  • Strong understanding of the sports and live entertainment ecosystem, including teams, leagues, venues, promoters, and other rights holders.
  • Knowledge of ticketing technology, primary and secondary distribution, pricing, inventory management, data, marketing, sponsorship, and venue operations.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to evaluate opportunities, develop revenue models, and structure mutually beneficial agreements.
  • Consultative selling skills and the ability to translate a prospective partner’s business objectives into a customized solution
  • Exceptional negotiation, presentation, and executive communication skills
  • Ability to communicate complex technology and commercial concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly for client meetings, industry conferences, events, and internal collaboration

 

At AXS, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but can't "check every box" in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles. 

 

Pay Scale: $160, 000 - $190,000

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. Currently, full time employees are eligible for these benefits on the first day of employment.

 

*Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position.

 

What’s in it for You?

  • Extraordinary People – we’re not kidding!
  • Meaningful Mission– Helping revolutionize an industry and deliver better experiences for fans and clients around the world.
  • Development and Learning – Opportunities for learning and leveling up through training and education reimbursement.
  • Community & Belonging – A range of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection, inclusion, and professional growth. Access to meaningful volunteer opportunities and community engagement programs to make a positive impact beyond the workplace.

 

 More about AXS

AXS, a subsidiary of AEG, sells millions of tickets each year for 1600+ premier venues, sports teams, and event organizers across North America, Europe, Asia, Australia and New Zealand. Headquartered in Downtown Los Angeles, California, AXS employs more than 900 professionals in multiple locations worldwide. In each location you’ll find a team of dedicated, diverse employees (we’ve dubbed ourselves “Fanatix”) who create groundbreaking products and services in a fun, fast-paced environment. 

To learn more about our culture and values, visit: https://solutions.axs.com/careers/

job.description:

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

Position Summary:

The Senior Director of Production serves as AEG's on-site representative providing strategic leadership for the operational and execution of large-scale touring productions. Serving as the senior production representative on assigned tours, this role oversees daily show operations, revenue optimization, and cross-functional coordination to maximize tour performance. The Senior Director partners with artists, promoters, venue personnel, ticketing, and production teams to drive operational excellence while ensuring accurate execution throughout the tour lifecycle.

Essential Functions:

  • Lead the day-to-day operational and financial execution of assigned touring productions, serving as the senior production representative with responsibility for production delivery, show settlements, and operational decision-making.
  • Drive revenue optimization by evaluating venue configurations, production layouts, and ticket inventory opportunities to maximize sellable seating while maintaining production, safety, and guest experience standards.
  • Oversee daily financial settlements, expense management, and accounting activities, ensuring timely reconciliation and compliance with internal financial controls and contractual requirements.
  • Coordinate cross-functional tour operations by partnering with ticketing, venue management, production, catering, temporary staffing, and other internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless show execution.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and operational leadership by developing best practices, mentoring production staff, and supporting organizational initiatives related to tour operations, financial processes, and production standards.

Required Qualifications:

  • Extensive experience managing large-scale touring productions, including live event operations and financial settlements.
  • Strong knowledge of production accounting, revenue management, and ticketing operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to make independent operational decisions in high-pressure, live event environments.
  • Experience with tour settlement systems, ticketing platforms, and production management software.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
  • Experience managing multiple complex projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including advanced Excel skills, and experience using budgeting, project management, and financial systems.
  • Ability to build effective working relationships with clients, venues, and co-workers
  • Excellent written, verbal and listening communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Self-motivated and takes initiative
  • May require heavy travel for long period of time of the road

Payscale: $157,468 - $241,030

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

 

AEG reserves the right to change or modify the employee’s job description whether orally or in writing, at any time during the employment relationship. AEG may require an employee to perform duties outside his/her normal description.

AEG's policy is to hire the most qualified applicants.  We are an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any individual, employee, or application for employment on the basis of race, color, marital status, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other legally protected status recognized by federal, state or local law.

Job Summary

The Sr Manager Marketing is responsible for the development and execution of marketing and promotional plans for shows. This position will execute long-term marketing initiatives and oversee issues and risks that affect the marketing campaign. The Sr Manager Marketing will work with artist managers, agents and marketing teams to develop effective integrated marketing plans that will reach the correct demographic and target customers appropriate for each show. In addition, this position will work with talent buyers, local and central leadership to oversee execution of best practices across email, social, media buying, customer relationship management, reporting, etc.

Essential Functions

  • Responsible for the development and execution of marketing and promotional plans for shows. Develop and execute long-term marketing initiatives. Oversee issues and risks affecting the marketing campaign.
  • Generate marketing budget, book and account for advertising and media ensuring funds are allocated to correct partners. Manage advertising settlements for each show to ensure those are settled accordingly.
  • Work with national tour director, talent buyers, and regional marketing director to plan the marketing spend. Work with central digital media buying, partnerships, CRM and creative teams to develop digital marketing plans for targeted audiences, custom creative and impactful partnership activations.
  • Oversee and evaluate show performance market-by-market, making adjustments to meet marketing strategy in changing market or competitive conditions. Develop digital advertising plans to optimize campaigns for best performance to drive ticket sales.
  • Oversee publicity, advance press interviews, secure and manage artist availability for promotions with management, label and public relations agencies.
  • Collaborate with agencies and vendor partners like Ticketmaster and AXS on marketing opportunities, product development, and improving efficiencies.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) (Advanced Degree Preferred)
    • Marketing/Business Communications or a related field
  • 6-8 years
    • Of related work experience
    • Experience with media buying, executing digital media plans and omni-channel digital marketing
    • Experience working with email, mobile and digital marketing programs
    • Experience sourcing and managing content development and publishing
    • Experience and knowledge of music industry
  • Strong knowledge of data analysis and budgeting
  • Strong knowledge of programmatic media and real time bidding
  • Strong knowledge of social media and online marketing initiatives and strategies
  • Displays in-depth knowledge and understanding of Social Media platforms, their respective participants (Facebook, Twitter, Yelp, Google +Local, YouTube, Instagram, Pinterest etc.) and how each platform can be deployed in different scenarios
  • Computer savvy with knowledge of MS Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Google AdWords, Rubicon, CMS, Photoshop, WordPress
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel); and ability to learn required business systems
  • Strong proficiency in content marketing theory and application
  • Must be detail orientated with a high standard for quality and able to multitask and manage multiple campaigns and projects at once
  • Executes creativity and documented immersion in Social Media
  • Excellent interpersonal, as well as written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to effectively supervise and lead a productive team
  • Ability to switch from the creative side of marketing to analytical side, ability to prove ideas are analytically sound

The stagehand is responsible for performing all setup before, during, and after events which includes, but is not limited to, assembling and disassembling production equipment on stage. In addition, the stagehand will work closely with and assist carpenters with scenery build, installation, video, sound and light production.

Essential Functions

  • Responsible for assembling and setting up at the beginning of the scene (i.e. props, microphones, musical instruments, scenery, etc), disassembling and removing equipment at the end of the scene in addition to cleaning up the stage and backstage area after performances. 

  • Load and unload equipment from trucks and set up equipment according to stage design while ensuring safety requirements are met. 
  • Assist carpenters with scenery build and installation of stage maintenance, construct and paint set pieces, move and rearrange furniture. 
  • Work closely with electricians and lighting assistants with maintenance of video, sound, and light production. Ensure operations of systems are functioning properly. 

Required Qualifications

  • 0-2 years of related work experience
  • Previous experience with manual labor preferred.  
  • Must be able to take direction and execute instructions accurately. 
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 50 pounds.

job.title: Talent Buyer - Southwest
job.description:
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

A Brief Overview
The Talent Buyer is responsible for building relationships, identifying talent and confirming profitable shows. This position will create budgets, map scaling for venues and build offers for artists. Additionally, the Talent Buyer will compile all relevant documents and ensure that all shows are settled accurately. They will also work in conjunction with management to identify and build festivals.

Essential Functions

  • Buy profitable talent by actively reaching out to agents with booking possibilities. Respond to inbound requests from agents and artist management. Follow-up on leads from other talent buyers.
  • Negotiate offer details with music agents for artist performances. Gather all relevant information to build offer and present to artist management.
  • Networking and building relationships with agents, artist management, venue managers and other potential clients. Maintain current client relationships.
  • Oversee the marketing and ticketing of events. Confirm show details and artist requests with marketing and ticketing departments. Ensure that shows go on sale and tickets are being sold.
  • Create show or event budgets. Monitor spending and make sure that event stays in budget.
  • Travel to cover road shows, events, festivals and seek new clients, projects and partners. Handle the settlement of shows when necessary.
  • Work with managers on potential festival projects. Identify potential third party venue and festival sites for events. Assist on festival and concert projects as assigned by manger. Develop creative properties that can be grown into annual events.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) In Marketing, Public Relations, or a related area
  • 4-6 years Of related work experience
  • Previous experience in the music industry with demonstrated ability to assess current music trends
  • Previous experience supervisor, leading, and/or mentoring team
  • Knowledge of general accounting principles
  • General understanding of ticketing systems
  • Computer savvy and skilled in MS Office (Outlook, Word and Excel); knowledge of social media platforms
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Must have an outgoing personality with the ability to build and cultivate relationships.
  • Exceptional negotiation skills with an ability to analyze complex documents
  • Ability to work independently to perform job, as well as in a team environment
  • Must have established contacts and relationships in the music industry
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule which may include nights, weekends and holidays.

Payscale: $82,500.00 - $90,000.00 annually

Bonus:This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

job.title: Talent Buyer Assistant- Rocky Mountains
job.description:
Company Information
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

A Brief Overview The Booking Assistant will support the Talent Buyer with the booking of events and shows. This position will draft offers to be submitted to artists and venues. The Booking Assistant will coordinate availability of both artists and venues to create calendar holds for shows and events. Additionally, they will assist in the maintenance of show files and the settlement of shows.

Job Summary

  • Assist Talent Buyer with the booking of events. Draft offers for artists and venues based on projected ticket sales. Reach out to venues to place calendar holds and coordinate with the availability of an artist.
  • Submit offers to venues and agents. Follow up to ensure that appropriate documents are in order. Assist with ticket pricing, royalties, marketing, budgeting, and catering.
  • Advance shows on the day of an event. Ensure that artist and vendors arrive, parking is available, and show advances on schedule.

job.title: Temporary Service Desk Tech II - AXS
job.description:

Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. The Role

Our Temporary Service Desk Tech II will be responsible for providing technical support to internal customers, responding to service desk requests within defined SLAs. job.title: Ticketing Manager - Special Events
job.description:
Company Information
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Job Summary

The Manager, Ticketing will be responsible for developing scaling plans for venues to build events in ticketing software. This position will also compile and distribute daily ticket counts to various internal departments, offices, and artist management, agents, and record labels. The Manager, Ticketing will collaborate with venues, artist management, and discount vendors to create ticket packages for shows and events. For assigned special events, this position may also be responsible for managing ticketing operations, including event setup, inventory strategy, ticket allocations, and box office execution. The Manager, Ticketing may develop and implement event-specific ticket scaling, inventory management, and promotional initiatives based on market conditions, audience demographics, and event objectives to maximize attendance and revenue. This position may also partner with promoters, venues, artists, and internal stakeholders to ensure accurate ticketing execution, oversee sales reporting, and support a seamless event experience from on-sale through event completion.

Essential Functions

  • Manage the setup and configuration of events within ticketing platforms, partnering with promoters or special events teams to ensure accurate event builds and optimal ticketing strategies.
  • Manage ticket holds for each event/show. Process ticket orders for artist management, record label, and internal buys.
  • Prepare and distribute daily ticket counts for agents, departments and offices at AEG Presents. as needed.
  • Lead and train new team members on box office operations for assigned events, including will call, guest lists, artist and promotional ticket allocations, coordination with venue management, touring personnel, and/or special event clients to ensure seamless event execution.
  • Collaborate with promoters, venues, artists, and special events teams to develop and execute ticketing promotions, discount programs, and group sales initiatives that support attendance and revenue objectives.
  • May be responsible for the creation of pop up box offices at seasonal shows and collaboration with special events groups on event ticketing.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • 4-6 years of related work experience including experience in the entertainment industry
  • Previous supervisory experience
  • Experience in developing start-up box offices and strategies preferred
  • Box Office Experience is a plus
  • Familiarity of basic accounting and budgeting principals
  • Familiarity with AXS, Ticketmaster and other ticketing platforms.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and Adobe Professional
  • Must be organized, detail-oriented and self-motivated
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize and remain calm in a fast paced environment
  • Must be able to work flexible schedule including nights, weekends and some holidays
  • Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

The touring coordinator may also be assign various projects for the touring department including but not limited to the creation of potential tour designs, initial drafting of potential tour offers, coordinating the tour budget development, working on tour routing and execution of venue deals for tour.

Essential Functions:

 

  • Maintains department services & efficiencies by organizing department operations and procedures; controlling correspondence; designing filing systems; processing department supply requests; maintaining department contacts, scheduling meetings, planning and implementing department systems and equipment procurement including repair of machinery and equipment for employees on the road
  • Responsible for building the routing of each assigned tour. Creating a realistic schedule for production crew to follow. Reach out to venues to compare availability to artist availability and submit routing for approval to begin execution of necessary contracts

  • May build financial models for Tour Manager and Tour Director to assess financial risk associated with each venue and the potential revenue of a proposed tour. Prepare potential scaling maps and projected budgets. Work with accounting department for budgeting, expense reports, and various department costs throughout the year with department heads

job.title: Touring Project Manager
job.description:
Company Information
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Position Summary

The primary responsibilities of the Touring Project Manager are to support the successful execution of tours and live events by coordinating logistics, operational planning, and cross-functional communication. This role serves as a key operational partner to Touring Managers, exercising independent judgment and discretion in managing project timelines, prioritizing tasks, coordinating resources, and resolving routine operational challenges. The Touring Project Manager supports advancing activities, event settlements, documentation management, and stakeholder communications to ensure tours are delivered efficiently and in accordance with company standards. Additionally, this role maintains strong relationships with venues, vendors, local partners, and internal departments while proactively identifying operational risks and escalating significant issues when necessary.

Primary Job Responsibilities:

  • Support the day-to-day operational execution of tours, events, and live entertainment engagements.
  • Coordinate tour logistics, schedules, timelines, travel arrangements, and operational deliverables.
  • Manage project timelines and ensure key milestones, deadlines, and deliverables are achieved.
  • Support show advancing activities, including venue coordination, artist requirements, production needs, and operational planning.
  • Assist with day-of-show settlements, event reconciliation, and operational documentation.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for venues, vendors, local partners, and internal departments regarding assigned projects.
  • Maintain regular communication with artists, managers, promoters, venues, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment and project success.
  • Monitor project progress and identify potential operational risks, delays, or challenges.
  • Exercise independent judgment in prioritizing competing operational demands and recommending solutions to support successful event execution.
  • Coordinate internal follow-up activities across Booking, Touring, Production, Marketing, Finance, and Operations teams.
  • Prepare and maintain project documentation, schedules, budgets, reports, settlement materials, and operational records.
  • Support expense tracking, budget monitoring, and financial reconciliation activities.
  • Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, artist riders, venue requirements, and company operational standards.
  • Escalate significant operational issues, financial concerns, or project risks to Touring Managers and leadership when appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements, operational efficiencies, and enhanced event execution.
  • Represent the company professionally during events, site visits, meetings, and business travel.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned that are consistent with the nature and level of the position.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Entertainment Management, Event Management, Communications, Music Business, or a related field; equivalent industry experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of 2-4 years of experience in project management, event operations, concert promotion, venue operations, artist relations, or related live entertainment roles.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple projects, events, tours, or operational initiatives simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of live event operations, touring logistics, event production, and artist relations.
  • Experience supporting show advancing, event execution, settlements, and operational planning.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and discretion in coordinating projects, prioritizing resources, and resolving operational issues.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities with the capacity to manage competing priorities.
  • Experience collaborating across multiple departments and managing external stakeholder relationships.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, CRM platforms, event management software, and project management tools.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team environment.
  • Knowledge of current trends and best practices within the live entertainment and touring industries.
  • Fluency in both English and Spanish (written and verbal) is required.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally and work evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.

 

Payscale: $55,000k-$65,000K

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

  • Coordinate tour logistics, schedules, timelines, travel arrangements, and operational deliverables.
  • Manage project timelines and ensure key milestones, deadlines, and deliverables are achieved.
  • Support show advancing activities, including venue coordination, artist requirements, production needs, and operational planning.
  • Assist with day-of-show settlements, event reconciliation, and operational documentation.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for venues, vendors, local partners, and internal departments regarding assigned projects.
  • Maintain regular communication with artists, managers, promoters, venues, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment and project success.
  • Monitor project progress and identify potential operational risks, delays, or challenges.
  • Exercise independent judgment in prioritizing competing operational demands and recommending solutions to support successful event execution.
  • Coordinate internal follow-up activities across Booking, Touring, Production, Marketing, Finance, and Operations teams.
  • Prepare and maintain project documentation, schedules, budgets, reports, settlement materials, and operational records.
  • Support expense tracking, budget monitoring, and financial reconciliation activities.
  • Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, artist riders, venue requirements, and company operational standards.
  • Escalate significant operational issues, financial concerns, or project risks to Touring Managers and leadership when appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements, operational efficiencies, and enhanced event execution.
  • Represent the company professionally during events, site visits, meetings, and business travel.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned that are consistent with the nature and level of the position.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Entertainment Management, Event Management, Communications, Music Business, or a related field; equivalent industry experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of 2-4 years of experience in project management, event operations, concert promotion, venue operations, artist relations, or related live entertainment roles.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple projects, events, tours, or operational initiatives simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of live event operations, touring logistics, event production, and artist relations.
  • Experience supporting show advancing, event execution, settlements, and operational planning.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and discretion in coordinating projects, prioritizing resources, and resolving operational issues.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities with the capacity to manage competing priorities.
  • Experience collaborating across multiple departments and managing external stakeholder relationships.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, CRM platforms, event management software, and project management tools.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team environment.
  • Knowledge of current trends and best practices within the live entertainment and touring industries.
  • Fluency in both English and Spanish (written and verbal) is required.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally and work evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.

Payscale: $55,000-$65,000

Bonus:This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

job.title: Utility Operator (Crypto.com Arena)
job.description:
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Crypto.com Arena is where the world comes to play, perform, and come together. As one of the most iconic venues in sports and live entertainment, we host unforgettable moments, from championship games and global tours to once in a lifetime events that define the culture of Los Angeles. 

Owned and operated by AEG, our team brings live experiences to life with creativity, precision, and pride. Every role plays a part in creating nights fans remember, powered by people who care about the details and the impact of getting it right. 

If you want your work to show up in real moments, in a venue where history is made every night, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here. 

Job Summary:

The Utility Operator controls and shades cameras during events for Crypto.com Arena.

Essential Functions:

  • Work with the camera operators to prepare the proper connection and operation at the Camera Control Unit (CCU). This includes properly connecting the camera with the camera cable to the assigned port at one of the media panels. This includes running the cable from the panel to the camera location and making sure any points along the run are taped to the ground with non-stick gaffer’s tape at any point that is considered a trip hazard.
  • During the game, will provide support as the handheld camera is requested to move around to get shots. This includes making sure the extra cable staged by the camera is kept organized and fed out and wrapped up neatly as the camera operator moves from their original position.
  • Act as a guide to the camera operator ensuring their safety from their blind side and behind them. May also need to make supply runs back to the control room such as fresh batteries or tape or a replacement headset.
  • Lift and/or carry a handheld camera which can weigh up to 30 lbs.
  • Must be able to spend time on their feet or be seated throughout the shift, including moving from a seated position to standing and moving quickly such as an unexpected time out that requires quick action.

Required Qualifications:

  • A minimum education level of: High School Diploma or its equivalency.
  • A minimum of two years of related work experience.
  • Ability to lift heavy objects, walk, sit and move quickly.
  • Ability to work in a fast paced environment.
  • Must be able to focus on their job in front of very large crowd.
  • Must be able to lift up to 30 pounds either sitting or standing.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ability to perform a proper “over/under” cable wrap a plus.

Pay scale: $70.00

Bonus: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Part-time: This position may be eligible for benefits (ACA qualification).

Description

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

We are looking for an experienced Paid Media Marketing Manager to join our Amazon Music Performance Marketing team. This person will build highly impactful full funnel campaigns from Awareness to Acquisition driving and test into white space opportunities. You will define, execute, and measure Paid Media marketing from strategy to execution to drive scalable growth for the business - including manual campaign execution, testing, and developing scalable processes. An entrepreneurial spirit, a creative mindset for pushing boundaries, and the ability to work effectively with a large number of partners and international stakeholders are some of the key skills we are looking for.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive and develop new Paid Media initiatives across multiple channels to drive customer acquisition and build awareness for Amazon Music
- Embrace a test-and-learn approach, scaling strategies, and exploring expansion opportunities.
- Plan, activate, optimize, and manage search media buys aligned with brief, customer journey, and audience insights
- Establish automated reporting and optimization processes. Provide complete performance reporting and analysis on marketing campaigns and take relevant action on insights gained.
- Manage relationships with key partners in the digital marketing ecosystem (DSPs and Social platforms).
- Audit and update existing data pipelines in collaboration with the Business Intelligence and Tech teams to ensure the highest level of data quality
- Partner with strategic cross-functional teams to support GTM plans and drive transparency and education in insights derived from Paid Media

Basic Qualifications

- 4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building and optimizing multiple, simultaneous marketing campaigns
- Experience managing or working within cross-functional marketing and creative teams
- Experience across affiliate marketing, PPC, SEM and social media advertising

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in multi-territory campaign management
- Experience in digital marketing and content production timelines and process
- Experience delivering paid media campaigns spanning TV, print ads and digital/social channels

job.title: Administrative Assistant
job.description:
Position Summary

The Administrative Assistant reports to the Vice President, Finance and primarily supports the LAist newsroom and the Senior Vice President of News. The role provides day-to-day administrative and operational support to newsroom leadership, including proactive calendar management for the Senior Vice President of News; meeting coordination and follow-up; vendor, database, onboarding and offboarding, safety gear, and documentation management; and other activities that support an effective newsroom. The role also provides as-needed support to Development and Membership and serves as backup to the Senior Executive Assistant to the President & CEO, including assisting with organization-wide internal meetings such as all-staff meetings.

Expected Compensation Range:

$25.60–$32.18 per hour. The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity.

Location:

Hybrid, Pasadena, CA

Application Process:

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Application Deadline:

Open until filled.

Position Responsibilities

Newsroom Administration and Operations

Attends newsroom leadership meetings and assists with follow-up, including coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, building slide decks, and leading research tasks.

Handles action items from reporter meetings and safety committee meetings to support the newsroom.

Provides primary, proactive calendar management and meeting scheduling support for the Senior Vice President of News, with additional scheduling support for other newsroom leaders as needed.

Manages newsroom vendor relations, including Accurint, Lexis, Getty, and LiveScans for press passes, and coordinates the annual press pass renewal process.

Works with newsroom editors to help manage freelance contracts, outreach, and budget tracking.

Maintains newsroom databases, including tracking trainings and debriefs.

Manages newsroom email lists, newsroom accounts in 1Password, and newspaper subscriptions.

Helps oversee effective onboarding and offboarding for newsroom staff and interns and identifies opportunities to improve the process.

Assists with the newsroom library project and ongoing work to streamline and update newsroom documentation.

Oversees updates to the newsroom breaking news toolkit for emergencies and major breaking news events.

Partners with Facilities to manage reporter safety gear inventory and the check-out process.

Assists with onsite and offsite events, including staff gatherings, and supports staff and internal photo needs.

Helps send and gather information for staff updates and other internal communications.

Proactively recommends improvements that support a positive newsroom culture and efficient, effective operations.

Development and Membership Support (As Needed)

  • Retrieves Development Operations mail and remittance envelopes from the secured lobby location as part of regular mail processing.
  • Sorts mail and remittances, routes checks to the Finance safe, and distributes items intended for other departments.
  • Routes correspondence, unusual items, and transactions requiring follow-up to the appropriate Development, Membership, or Finance staff and secures any unprocessed items.
  • Handles and processes PCI-restricted donor payments on a semi-monthly basis, including opening remittances containing credit card or banking information; processing credit card and EFT gifts using the PCI-compliant computer; documenting and routing unsuccessful or incomplete transactions to Member-Audience Services; and redacting and disposing of sensitive material in accordance with PCI procedures.
  • Coordinates donor communications with the Member-Audience Services team.
  • Provides additional administrative support to Membership, Development, and Underwriting as needed, based on organizational priorities.
    Senior Executive Assistant and Organizational Support (As Needed)
  • Supports the Senior Executive Assistant to the President & CEO with organization-wide internal meetings, such as all-staff meetings, including scheduling, logistics, agendas, and materials.
  • Provides backup and as-needed administrative support to the Senior Executive Assistant to the President & CEO.

Organizational Relationships

  • Internal: Newsroom leadership and staff, Development, Membership, Member-Audience Services, Underwriting, Finance, Facilities, and the Office of the President.
  • External: Vendors, freelancers, and donors.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
    Required Education and Experience
  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Three or more years of administrative or operations support experience.
    Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Ability to handle confidential information and sensitive financial data appropriately.
  • Proactive problem-solving skills and initiative to improve processes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace, including building slide decks and maintaining databases.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with staff at all levels and across departments.
Required Education and Experience
  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Three or more years of administrative or operations support experience.
Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Ability to handle confidential information and sensitive financial data appropriately.
  • Proactive problem-solving skills and initiative to improve processes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace, including building slide decks and maintaining databases.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with staff at all levels and across departments.
Preferred Skills and Experience
  • Experience supporting a newsroom or media organization.
  • Experience processing payments in a PCI-compliant environment.
  • Experience with vendor management, contracts, or budget tracking.
  • Event planning experience.
  • Experience working in a nonprofit or public media organization.
Reporting to This Position

None.

job.title: Major Gifts Officer
job.description:
Position Summary:

The Major Gifts Officer is responsible for building relationships with major donors and prospects to secure gifts of over $10,000 for annual operating and program specific projects.

This position will actively qualify and cultivate major donor prospects and make direct solicitations. Responsibilities include conducting prospect research, developing solicitation strategies, and writing gift proposals and reports. The Major Gift Officer will manage a portfolio of approximately 150 donors and spend 50% or more of their time outside of the office in face-to-face or virtual meetings to cultivate and steward donor relationships. Solicitations may also include gala tables/support and planned giving commitments. The major gift officer will have 3 – 5 years of major gift fundraising experience and the proven ability to guide donors to more significant support. This position reports to the Director of Major Gifts and will also work with the Managing Director of Development and Senior Vice President on Development on major solicitations gifts.

Expected Compensation Range: $100,000 -$105,000 per year. The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity.

Location: Hybrid, Pasadena, CA

Application Process: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Application Deadline: Open until filled.

Position Responsibility:

  • Manage a dedicated portfolio of donors and prospects within moves management; meet monthly metric goals.
  • Strategically cultivate and solicit donors and prospects with a focus on deepening donor relationships and identifying the best way to connect them with SCPR and funding opportunities.
  • Develop effective stewardship plans to strengthen the relationship and explore other avenues for support.
  • Develop written plans, proposals, reports, and other donor communications.
  • Qualify new prospects to ensure the growth of the SCPR donor pool.
  • Contribute to the expansion of the planned giving program and Legacy Society.
  • Research and qualify major donor prospects to ensure growth of the SCPR donor pool.
  • Document donor contacts in donor management software following established protocols.
  • Provide regular updates and reports on prospect management and fundraising results.
  • Participate in major donor events locally and throughout southern California.
  • Work collaboratively with the Major Gifts team and Development staff.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience required.
  • 3-5 years of experience and a strong understanding of prospect management, major donor cultivation and solicitation is required.
  • Proven track record in securing major and planned gifts.
  • Knowledge of planned giving vehicles and ability to identify strong prospects.
  • Previous experience working directly with board members, volunteers, and content experts.

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Motivated, creative, and organized self-starter.
  • Enthusiastic and determined fundraiser with a record of meeting / exceeding metrics and revenue targets.
  • Able to develop strategic long-term donor relationships while achieving bottom-line results.
  • Innovative, flexible, and able to prioritize in a rapidly evolving organization and industry.
  • Collaborative and successful at working within a team and across an organization.
  • A persuasive and strategic communicator with excellent interpersonal and written / spoken communication skills.
  • Able to participate in donor events, including occasional evenings and weekends, and travel to donor meetings throughout southern California.
  • Professional appearance and demeanor, and strong computer skills are required.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Master’s Degree.
  • Salesforce and donor database experience a plus.
  • Experience in soliciting and securing 6 and 7-figure gifts.
  • Strong interest in public media and its case for support.
  • Willingness to embrace the organization’s priorities and style.

Reporting To This Position:        

  • N/A

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

  • Must be able to perform the essential duties of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to travel during the day, with occasional overnight travel required. 
  • Must have a personal vehicle available for use to call on clients.  Mileage reimbursement will be provided.
  • Must have a valid, current driver’s license.
  • Must have a clean driving record with no DUIs or excessive amount of traffic violations or accidents.
  • Physical Demands: 
    • Required to move about in an office environment and sit for extended periods of time
    • Frequent use of hands for data entry/keystrokes and simple grasping
  • Working Conditions: 
    • Moderate noise level

job.title: Operations Manager, Events
job.description:
Position Summary:

The Events Operations Manager Serves as a hub for the events team as a core function – manages calendar, event requests and coordinates with other support teams (Media Operations, Facilities, Marketing, Legal, Membership, Brands and Content) to plan, resource and execute events internally and externally. The Events Operations Manager will support via the Events Department, a meaningful, balanced, and effective total set of events to service APM|MPR members, audiences and the greater community.  

Expected Compensation Range: $75,000 - $90,000 per year. The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity.

Location: Hybrid, St. Paul, MN

Application Process: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Application Deadline: Open until filled

Position Responsibility:

  •  Coordinates Events department projects and workflow including the weekly events production meetings, the events Airtable calendar and event planning tools within the MPR Division, Events department, Marketing, Membership, Content Creators/Producers, Underwriting, Operations, Membership, Development, Legal, Finance, Institutional Giving, APMG Division, and external partners to ensure smoothly executed events and projects.
  • Produce events and programs and provide hands-on implementation of event details to execute consistently excellent, strategic and goal conscious events on behalf of MPR/APM.
  • Support cross-divisional revenue success (i.e. membership, philanthropic giving and sponsorship revenue).
  • Manages departmental record keeping and reconciliation procedures. Maintains project budgets and SOPs and communicates them across the organization.
  • Coordinate event production needs and support and participate in production and planning meetings to ensure smoothly executed events and programs. Creates and implements consistent and reliable timelines, communications procedures, project and production schedules, role clarity and project management for Events projects.
  • Work as point of contact for Events Department for ticketing, security and audience services. Ensures registration details are captured, communicated, and entered into Envoy and CRM systems and tools.
  • Identify and implement system and process changes necessary to support new growth and innovation and a culture that supports experimentation.
  • Manage Legacy project allocation when relevant in tandem with Institutional Giving and Finance Departments.
  • Support a creative and productive work environment. 
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Five to six years events, hospitality and/or event administration experience.
  • Event/Project management experience.

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Ability to foster and enrich collaborative work across teams.
  • Ability to coordinate community groups formally and informally.
  • Knowledge of project budget management.
  • Strong customer services skills; ability to communicate with diverse groups at various levels both verbally and in writing (management, staff, audience members, vendors and sponsors).
  • Proficiency in computer technology; Outlook, Excel, Word, Power Point, Airtable, Eventbrite etc.
  • Self-starting, an initiative taker and problem-solver.
  • Demonstrated time-management skills with proven ability to meet deadlines within budget constraints. 
  • Resourcefulness, strong attention-to-detail and ability to multi-task.
  • High degree of energy, enthusiasm, and creativity.
  • Marketing knowledge.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

  • Must be able to perform the essential duties of the position with or without reasonable accommodation
  • Physical Demands: 
    • Required to move about in an office environment and sit for extended periods of time
    • Required to move about in the community

job.title: Associate Director, Creative Membership
job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #

Job overview:

The Associate Director, Creative Membership leverages deep music industry knowledge to cultivate and maintain strong relationships within the London and European creative community and its surrounding areas. In this role, you will serve as a vital bridge to songwriters, publishers, major record labels, entertainment lawyers, managers, and talent agents. A primary emphasis is placed on enhancing ASCAP's local presence through active on-the-ground engagement, which includes attending live shows, hosting industry mixers, and conducting in-person meetings with ASCAP members and local executives.

This position is based in our London office and will report to the VP, Creative Membership located in London. This position currently is subject to ASCAP’s in office policy.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Discovery and development of talent, including songwriters, composers and producers, in the London, European, and surrounding area
  • Perform market research and partner closely with the London Creative Team to identify, attract, recruit and successfully transition local up-and-coming creators to ASCAP, in order to grow the value of the ASCAP repertory.
  • Support and maintain relationships within the London, Europe, and surrounding creative community, including songwriters, composers, publishers, major record labels, entertainment lawyers, managers, and agents.
  • Develop an understanding of ASCAP’s Survey and Distribution System and ASCAP membership policies and procedures, to confidently guide members through membership and distribution related inquiries.
  • Stay informed of, escalating and making viable recommendations to the relevant internal subject matter experts on effectively addressing member needs.
  • Partner with and support the London Creative Membership Team, as well as the Marketing & Communications team, to plan, curate, and host high-impact member events and recognition initiatives.
  • Act as a brand ambassador of ASCAP by attending industry panels, conferences and events.
  • Collaborate seamlessly across the ASCAP Creative Membership team to share best practices, align regional goals, and unify strategies.
  • Other duties and special projects as assigned

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree required in Music Business, Business Administration, Communications, Marketing, or a related field required.
  • 5+ years of experience in the Music Industry.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, navigate ambiguous environments, and communicate with ASCAP leadership.
  • Excellent interpersonal and relationship building skills with the ability to represent ASCAP with poise and professionalism across diverse creator and executive groups.
  • Exceptional judgment.
  • Knowledge of and enthusiasm for the London and European music industry.
  • Ability to juggle priorities and be a team player.
  • Market research skills.
  • Will be required to travel and attend events, including ASCAP’s membership events, outside of office hours and/or overnight.
  • This position requires the incumbent to be in the office 3 days per week.

Occasional travel for in-person meetings may be required.

Job overview:

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented individual with strong Mac devices and Audio Visual skills. This role will be part of our existing team of desktop engineers, primarily focused on Macs and Audio Visual support, with a secondary focus on Windows support.

The Desktop & A/V Support Engineer prioritizes and ensures timely responses and resolutions to requests and incidents for our Mac and conference room users. This role will provide IT support for hardware and business applications while also supporting AV functions such as video conferencing and events with AV components. Additionally, the Desktop & A/V Support Engineer will shift and adjust priorities based on changing business needs in our dynamic environment, while also remaining task-oriented to ensure completion of work from start to finish with appropriate solutions. This role will provide high-touch concierge support for senior ASCAP executives.

The Desktop & A/V Support Engineer within the Global Technology Solutions department is based in our New York office and reports to the Director, Support Services. This position is subject to ASCAP’s in office policy.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve complex Mac/PC hardware and software issues with a focus on device security.
  • Support and continually review enterprise Mac/PC client hardware / software standards and strategy.
  • Support client OS, application, mobile, virus, and hardware issues for users.
  • Design, implement, and maintain both Mac desktop group policy using JAMF and PC desktop group policy using BigFix and Intune.
  • Support and troubleshoot conferencing systems including platforms such as Webex, Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Google Meet, as well as hardware room systems.
  • Support the AV production at internal & external events.
  • Work with vendors to design and maintain hardware and software standards.
  • Develop automated workflows and technologies to efficiently manage Mac endpoints.
  • Maintain an inventory database, assign hardware and software assets, and manage warranty and service agreement information.
  • Assist with root cause analysis as it relates to Apple/PC computers and all peripheral devices.
  • Interact with IT and AV vendors, and management, to ensure solutions are being provided for all escalating tickets.
  • Independently resolve complex, break/fix issues in person or via telephone.
  • Be available as needed and provide high-touch technical support to onsite and remote members of ASCAP Senior Management.
  • Write, maintain and implement systems documentation for incident responses and recurring issues.
  • Other projects and duties as assigned.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in computer science, or a related field preferred.
  • Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP) and/or Apple Certified IT Professional (ACITP) Certifications preferred.
  • 3+ years of relevant working experience, including troubleshooting, diagnosing, and resolving complex Mac/MS and PC hardware and software issues.
  • Ability to communicate seamlessly and work productively with peers and senior management.
  • Experience with Mac endpoint patching platforms and administration procedures using JAMF.
  • Experience supporting Webex, Zoom, MS Teams, and Google Meet.
  • Experience supporting AV production environments and events.
  • Experience with Microsoft desktop imaging and distribution platforms such as Intune and BigFix.
  • Hands-on desktop support experience in a large enterprise environment preferred.
  • Experience working with anti-virus platforms preferred.
  • In-depth understanding of Mac based hardware, software, and peripherals.
  • Experience with Cisco conferencing hardware including room kits, boards, and peripherals.
  • Shell scripting experience is a plus.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, adjusting set shift hours or days when needed.
  • Ability to travel to other satellite offices when needed.
  • Interest in audio engineering and event production is a plus.
  • This position currently requires the incumbent to be in the office three days per week.
