job.title: Consumer Product Strategist
job.description:
The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiased news in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

The Associated Press seeks a Consumer Product Strategist for AP News based in New York City. We are a hybrid environment, with employees on site Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.  

  

About the Role  

As a Consumer Product Strategist, you will help AP News better understand its audience and use those insights to shape the future of our digital products and user experience. You will look beyond the numbers to uncover the story of how users discover, experience and engage across web and app platforms, turning those findings into clear, actionable recommendations that inform product strategy, experimentation and long-term growth.  

 

This role sits at the intersection of consumer insights, product strategy and analytics. The ideal candidate is naturally curious about consumers, comfortable digging into data and skilled at communicating what the data means with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.  

  

What You'll Do: 

  • Analyze how audiences discover, navigate and engage with AP News by building repeatable analyses and dashboards in BigQuery, Looker, Omni and Hex to identify patterns in user behavior, feature adoption, engagement and friction points 

  • Connect behavioral data across journeys, funnels, features and retention to explain not just what is happening, but why 

  • Support tracking implementation in Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager to ensure the right data is captured to answer critical product and business questions  

  • Translate complex product and user data into clear recommendations that inform product priorities, audience growth and monetization decisions  

  • Identify strategic opportunities to improve user journeys, feature design and engagement funnels to deepen loyalty   

  • Development and evaluate product experiments and A/B tests, turning results into actionable product recommendations  

  • Build trusted relationships across product, editorial and technical teams to bring consumer insights into product decisions 

  • Translate business questions into meaningful analysis and clearly communicate what the data means  

  • Collaborate with technical teams to ensure data infrastructure supports critical decisions 

  

Who You Are:  

  • You have 3+ years of professional experience in digital product analytics, product strategy, growth analytics, audience insights, user analytics or a related role  

  • You have a bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as communications, journalism, Data Science, Marketing or equivalent professional experience 

  • You communicate effectively and are a strong storyteller who can take complex or ambiguous data and turn it into a clear narrative about consumers, products and business opportunities 

  • You have demonstrated ability to analyze user behavior, product performance and using those insights to influence product or business decisions 

  • You bring curiosity, consumer empathy and sound judgment to open-ended questions and are comfortable making recommendations  

  • You have strong SQL skills and working knowledge of Python or R for querying large datasets, identifying trends and building repeatable analyses  

  • You have hands-on experience with analytics and visualization tools such as BigQuery, Hex, Omni and Looker

  • You have experience with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager, including event tracking and measurement strategy  

  • You are comfortable collaborating with product managers, engineers, editorial teams and other cross-functional stakeholders 

 

What will set you apart:  

  • Experience using consumer insights to influence the strategy or development of a digital consumer product 

  • Experience in digital publishing, media subscription, marketplace or other content-driven consumer products  

  • Background working with BigQuery or other large-scale data warehousing platforms  

  • Familiarity with content recommendation systems or personalization strategies  

  • Experience with experimental design and A/B testing platforms  

  

  

Why join us:  

  • A mission-driven, inclusive environment focused on both individual and collective success.   

  • Opportunities for professional development to help you reach your career goals.   

  • Access to tools, mentorship, and resources tailored to elevate your proficiency and contributions.      

  

The anticipated salary range for this position is $103,000 – $128,000, based on a candidate’s skills and qualifications. The Associated Press offers comprehensive benefits, which include:      

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage      

  • Retirement benefits      

  • Company paid life insurance      

  • Paid vacation and sick days      

  • Paid parental leave for any new parent      

  • Mental well-being resources      

AP seeks to build an inclusive organization grounded in respect for differences. We support all aspects of diversity and provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, status as a veteran, or other characteristic protected by law.

Job Summary

Job Requirements Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa, is more than an enchanting, family-friendly destination. We’ve combined the spirit of O`ahu with the magic of Disney to create a place where guests and cast members alike can feel the magic, can feel the spirit of the island and can truly feel welcome. Here, you’ll bring the spirit of the islands to life in every part of your role. Are you ready to join this team and make an impact?

About the Role

As the Manager of Learning & Talent, you will provide strategic leadership and play a critical part in cultivating a culture that inspires learners to unlock their learning potential through development and service excellence initiatives at Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa. This role provides daily oversight and direction to the Learning & Development Manager while serving as both the front door for learning requests and a trusted advisor to resort leaders to develop strategies and targeted learning solutions that align with business priorities, operational needs, and the Cast experience. Through strong learning operations, advisory partnerships, and program leadership, this role oversees onboarding, leadership development, service excellence learning, and continuous training solutions influencing resort-wide performance, culture, and results. This full-time, salaried position reports to the Human Resources Director and will be located onsite at Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa. What will you do: Act as the central point of contact (“front door”) for learning and development requests. Lead learning advisory conversations with Operations, Line of Business leaders, and HR partners to assess needs and recommend solutions. Serve as a strategic learning partner who translates business challenges into effective learning solutions. Provide strategic oversight for onboarding, leadership development, service excellence, continuous learning programs across the resort and conduct prioritization analysis in collaboration with leadership to ensure delivery of high-quality work. Support business and HR strategies by designing and deploying Leader and Cast development solutions that improve organizational effectiveness. Partner with Operations Training, Disney University, Safety, Workforce Management, and Line of Business leaders to deliver consistent, high-quality learning experiences. Oversee the scheduling, delivery, and continuous monitoring of Resort Onboarding programs, including Resort Orientation, Line of Business overviews, and regulatory and safety training. Manage learning plans for both Hourly and Salaried Cast, across Operations and Leadership audiences. Lead project management for learning initiatives from planning and analysis through delivery and sustainment. Provide consultation on the recruitment, selection, design, development, and performance expectations of facilitators, trainers, and learning resources. Observe onboarding, leadership, and service excellence sessions to identify opportunities for improvement. Provide system, process, and learner insights back to instructional design and partners. Create, sustain, and continuously evolve a comprehensive service auditing program by assessing guest service standards and refining them in response to operational needs and industry trends. Provide financial leadership and accountability for the learning organization, managing budgets and costs

job.title: AI Fellow
job.description:
The big picture: AI is now central to how Axios builds, operates and innovates. We believe AI is a force multiplier - not a side experiment, not a siloed function, but a capability we are embedding at every level and in every role across the company. We are hiring an AI Fellow to work directly with our co-founders as an in-house AI guide and builder. One seat. Three months. Real impact.

Why you matter: This is a highly selective opportunity for a technically sophisticated builder who lives and breathes AI, and is eager to apply that expertise inside a fast-moving, mission-driven media company. The AI Fellow will work directly with the founders to track and interpret major developments in large language models and emerging AI tools, prototype new product ideas, and pressure-test initiatives that could meaningfully shape how Axios leverages AI across editorial, product, and business functions. 

This is not a traditional internship. You won’t be shadowing someone. You’ll be the person we’re learning from.

The details:
The AI Fellow will work directly with Axios co-founders and senior leaders to accelerate how AI is embedded across the organization. This role will combine research, prototyping, experimentation, and strategic advisory work.

You will:

  • Brief founders and leadership on key developments in LLMs and applied AI
  • Build and test prototypes for internal tools, workflows, and product ideas
  • Pressure-test emerging AI use cases across editorial, revenue, product, and operations
  • Identify high-leverage opportunities where AI can meaningfully increase speed, quality, and impact
  • Help translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical applications for non-technical leaders

About you:

  • You are deeply curious about AI and its real-world applications
  • You think in systems and frameworks, not just prompts
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and experimenting quickly
  • You can clearly explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • You can operate at both the technical and strategic level — building something in the morning and briefing founders in the afternoon
  • Strong preference for a Winter 2026 college graduate
  • Strong preference for candidates located in the DC metro area

Skills:

  • Extensive experience working hands-on with LLMs and generative AI tools
  • Experience building and shipping applied AI projects or prototypes
  • Familiarity with model fine-tuning, embeddings, APIs, or AI orchestration frameworks
  • Strong problem-solving and structured thinking skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Program details:

  • Three-month paid fellowship
  • Full-time, temporary position


The salary for this role is $ $6,000-$7,000 per month (3 month term) and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation or benefits.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

 

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement 

Axios is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. 

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Axios makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

job.title: Associate Director, Client Partnerships (Local Advocacy & Public Affairs)
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We are hiring an Associate Director, Client Partnerships to join our growing Public Affairs advertising team, with a dedicated focus on expanding Axios' state and local advocacy business. This role will report to the Head of Public Affairs, Client Partnerships. 

Why it matters: As policy decisions increasingly play out in state capitols and at the ballot box, organizations need effective ways to reach influential audiences in local markets. In this role, you will drive new revenue by building partnerships with advocacy organizations, political and public affairs agencies, trade associations, coalitions, and other policy-driven entities seeking to influence the conversations shaping state and local communities.

You will play a key role in expanding Axios' presence in the state and local advocacy advertising market, leveraging Axios Local and our broader portfolio of advertising, custom content, and event solutions.

Go Deeper: Ideal candidates will bring an entrepreneurial spirit, a strong hunting mentality, and a passion for Axios' mission. This is a high-energy, business development-focused role requiring an understanding of state and local politics, the advocacy advertising landscape, and the ability to translate client priorities into creative, effective media partnerships.

In this role you'll:

  • Drive new business: Identify, prospect, and secure new advertising partnerships with organizations investing in state-level public affairs, issue advocacy, ballot initiatives, and legislative campaigns.
  • Build strategic relationships: Develop and maintain relationships with political and public affairs agencies, trade associations, advocacy organizations, corporate government affairs teams, coalitions, and other stakeholders managing state and local advocacy budgets.
  • Own the state and local opportunity: Identify priority markets, legislative calendars, ballot initiatives, and emerging policy issues that create opportunities for Axios advertising partnerships.
  • Develop integrated solutions: Work with clients and agencies to build strategic advertising programs leveraging Axios Local newsletters, digital advertising, custom content, and experiential opportunities to reach influential audiences.
  • Grow Axios' market presence: Represent Axios at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to establish the company as a valuable partner for state and local advocacy campaigns.
  • Manage the full sales cycle: Lead prospecting, discovery, proposals, negotiations, and closing, while developing long-term relationships that create repeat business.
  • Collaborate across teams: Partner with Axios Local, integrated marketing, advertising operations, and other internal stakeholders to develop and execute successful client campaigns.
  • Deliver against revenue goals: Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline, identify opportunities for growth, and consistently achieve individual revenue targets.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit and a growth mindset, with a proven ability to build relationships and generate new revenue. This position requires the following:

  • 5+ years of experience in advertising sales, digital media, campaigns, political advertising, public affairs, or agency business development at the state level. 
  • Existing relationships with state-level political and public affairs agencies, advocacy organizations, trade associations, or other entities investing in state and local issue campaigns.
  • Strong understanding of the state legislative landscape, ballot initiative campaigns, and the dynamics of state and local advocacy advertising.
  • Proven experience in outbound sales, new business development, and managing the full sales cycle.
  • Experience developing multi-market advertising campaigns or selling local and regional media.
  • Familiarity with digital advertising, media planning, audience targeting, and integrated marketing solutions.
  • Ability to identify business opportunities around legislative sessions, elections, ballot measures, and other policy-driven moments.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across teams and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to travel to priority markets and attend relevant industry events.
  • Track record of successfully meeting or exceeding revenue targets.

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $66,000 - $87,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation and benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Note that the total compensation offered for this role includes incremental variable compensation based on sales territory, which is contingent upon the successful achievement of predetermined sales targets.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

What Axios brings to the table besides salary:

  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Robust PPO and High Deductible health insurance options on the Blue Cross Blue Shield network
  • Employer Health Savings Account (HSA) contribution for the high deductible health plan option
  • Dental and vision coverage
  • Primary caregiver 12-week paid leave
  • Generous vacation policy, plus holidays
  • One mental health day per quarter
  • Annual learning and development stipend
  • $100 monthly work-from-home stipend
  • Tele-mental health services through Headspace
  • OneMedical membership, including tele-health services
  • Personal health advocacy resources through HealthAdvocate 
  • Inclusive fertility, hormonal health and family forming benefits through Carrot Fertility
  • Access to the Axios Employee Support Fund, which was created to allow employees to request financial support when facing financial hardship or emergencies 
  • Increased work flexibility for parents and caretakers 
  • Virtual company-sponsored social events
  • A strong and positive work environment
  • A commitment to an open, inclusive, and diverse work culture

 Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

Axios is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Axios makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

job.title: Business Development Associate
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We are looking for a Business Development Associate (BDA) to join our growing advertising sales team! 

Why it Matters: Business Development Associates help shape where and how Axios pursues new business. Through industry expertise, account intelligence, and close collaboration with Client Partners, BDAs translate market opportunities into focused prospecting strategies and meaningful conversations with prospective advertisers. Their work strengthens pipeline quality, expands our reach into priority markets, and increases the team’s capacity to develop and grow advertising partnerships.

Go deeper: As a BDA, you will develop and execute business-development initiatives across assigned industries, markets, or products. You will work alongside Client Partners to evaluate opportunities, prioritize accounts, understand prospective advertisers’ business needs, and determine effective approaches to engagement.

  • The role combines research and analysis with direct prospect engagement, performance evaluation, and continuous improvement. 
  • You will exercise judgment in selecting accounts and stakeholders, developing messaging, evaluating advertiser fit, and recommending next steps.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Shape prospecting priorities: Analyze industry trends, buying signals, account potential, and alignment with Axios audiences and products to develop prioritized account recommendations. Explain the rationale, potential value, and trade-offs behind proposed priorities, and reassess them as market conditions and prospect needs change.
  • Partner on account strategy: Develop account briefs that synthesize prospective advertisers’ business priorities, relevant stakeholders, potential needs, and engagement opportunities. Recommend messaging and engagement approaches, and partner with Client Partners to evaluate alternatives and determine next steps aligned with advertiser needs and revenue goals.
  • Develop prospective relationships: Create targeted outreach connecting prospect objectives with Axios audiences, products, and proof points. Adapt engagement based on responses and results.
  • Evaluate early opportunities: Assess advertiser fit, needs, timing, and potential; nurture interest and equip Client Partners with context and recommended next steps.
  • Improve performance: Analyze outreach effectiveness, prospect feedback, and pipeline progression to identify barriers and evaluate alternative approaches. Recommend and implement approved improvements to targeting, messaging, follow-up, and handoffs, and assess whether those changes improve results.
  • Refine tools and workflows: Test AI and automation with leadership, Revenue Operations, and Enablement to improve effectiveness, validate quality, and create capacity.
  • Build shared expertise: Translate successful campaigns, industry insights, and workflow improvements into practical playbooks and resources for the broader team.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit, a passion for Axios’ mission, and the following skills:

  • Experience in business development, advertising, sales, marketing, or a related client-facing role; at least one year preferred.
  • Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to translate market information and performance data into actionable recommendations.
  • Sound commercial judgment and the ability to evaluate opportunities, weigh alternatives, and explain priorities.
  • Experience developing targeted outreach and managing early-stage sales opportunities.
  • Ability to build productive partnerships and contribute ideas to shared account and business-development strategies.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to connect advertiser needs with a relevant value proposition.
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to manage competing priorities with initiative and accountability.
  • Proficiency with CRM and sales-engagement tools, and curiosity about using AI and automation to improve results. 
  • A willingness to test approaches, learn from feedback, and share successful practices with others.

job.title: Executive Assistant
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company dedicated to delivering trustworthy news and information with efficiency, clarity, and Smart Brevity. We’re hiring a Virginia-based Executive Assistant to support our Chief Operating Officer, coordinate group meetings across her teams, and partner with her Chief of Staff on cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives.

Why it matters: As the COO’s internal and external commitments grow, thoughtful scheduling and reliable follow-through help her and her teams spend time where it matters most. Reporting to the Chief of Staff, this role divides its time roughly equally between direct support for the COO and cross-functional coordination and project support. The Chief of Staff sets priorities for strategic initiatives, projects and broader team support.

Go deeper: In this role, you will make an impact at Axios with the following responsibilities:

  • Manage the COO’s calendar strategically, aligning internal and external commitments with her priorities and proactively resolving routine scheduling conflicts.
  • Learn the COO’s priorities and working preferences, use sound judgment to resolve routine scheduling and logistical issues independently, and bring the Chief of Staff clear options when trade-offs or decisions need escalation.
  • Schedule complex group meetings across the COO’s teams, working with executive assistants and participants to bring the right people together.
  • Own meeting logistics, invitations and materials, anticipating preparation needs and coordinating changes so participants know where to be and what to prepare.
  • Coordinate the COO’s business travel end to end, maintain accurate itineraries and calendar details, and proactively manage changes with relevant partners.
  • Organize agreed follow-ups from group meetings, track owners and deadlines, and flag dependencies or outstanding items to the Chief of Staff.
  • Maintain project plans, timelines and status updates; coordinate inputs across teams, follow up with owners, and surface risks, dependencies or decisions that need the Chief of Staff’s attention.
  • Gather and synthesize information, conduct research, and draft concise briefs, presentations and updates to support planning, leadership discussions and decisions.
  • Take ownership of defined workstreams and special projects as assigned by the Chief of Staff, and identify practical ways to improve coordination, documentation and team processes.
  • Draft, edit and coordinate internal and external communications for the COO and Chief of Staff, including team updates, stakeholder correspondence and meeting follow-ups; gather input, coordinate review and approval, and ensure messages are clear, accurate and timely.
  • Handle sensitive information with discretion and keep the COO and Chief of Staff informed of changes that affect their plans.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit, a passion for Axios’ mission, and have the following skills:

  • Experience managing executive calendars and priorities, with strong scheduling and logistics skills in a fast-moving organization.
  • Excellent prioritization, time management and attention to detail, with a proactive approach to anticipating needs and adapting as priorities change.
  • Clear, concise communication and confidence coordinating across multiple executives and teams, keeping colleagues and external contacts informed as plans change.
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with experience preparing internal and external communications, adapting tone and content for different audiences, and capturing an executive’s voice with accuracy, professionalism and discretion.
  • Sound operational judgment: anticipate and solve routine problems, assess urgency, make decisions with limited guidance, and recognize when to escalate, while handling confidential information with discretion.
  • Strong coordination skills: organize meeting preparation and follow-ups, track deadlines, and collaborate with executive assistants and accountable owners.
  • Experience coordinating projects across teams, with the ability to turn broad goals into organized plans, track progress, and follow through without constant direction.
  • Ability to synthesize information and prepare clear written updates and presentations, with curiosity about business priorities and how different teams work together.
  • Comfort using Google calendar, document and collaboration tools to keep schedules and follow-ups organized.

What success looks like

  • A well-managed COO calendar that reflects her priorities and minimizes avoidable conflicts.
  • Group meetings scheduled efficiently, with clear logistics and prepared participants.
  • Accurate travel information and timely communication when plans change.
  • Visible meeting follow-ups, with owners reminded and unresolved items surfaced promptly.
  • Cross-functional projects advance against agreed milestones, with clear ownership, timely updates and risks surfaced early.
  • The Chief of Staff has reliable project support and concise, useful materials to move strategic initiatives forward.
  • Some experience and comfort using AI tools, with curiosity to learn more and apply them thoughtfully to day-to-day work.
  • A trusted partnership with the COO and Chief of Staff, with clear boundaries for broader team support.

job.title: Reporter, News
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a media organization dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news in an audience-first format. We're hiring for a writer-editor to lead the afternoons and evenings on our newsdesk. 

Why it matters: Reporting to our News Editor, the news writer-editor will play a critical role as part of the 24/7 nerve center for the newsroom.

  • We are after people with a “see it, write it” mentality who have a personal passion for news and a fast-twitch set of journalistic reflexes.
  • This is a job for the news junkies who “monitor the situation” for fun and want to do it for a living. 
  • We operate at one cadence - do it right now - and are after people who marry a love of news with the thrill of being busy.  
  • This is the ultimate “safe pair of hands” job — someone we can trust to both edit the work of others and write their own, too. 

Go deeper: The role comes with a range of responsibilities, including:

  • Real-time news surveillance
  • Quick-turn writing of spot news stories
  • Editing a wide variety of national news, from breaking stories across the national file to the occasional enterprise.
  • Monitoring developments on key stories and flagging them to experts

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will have a get-stuff-done attitude, a strong sense of personal responsibility and urgency, and a passion for being on top of the news at all times. Some of the skills include:

  • Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate with a team of journalists.
  • Writing and editing experience in a fast-paced news environment.
  • Demonstrated experience monitoring and activating on news. 
  • A belief in Smart Brevity as the core writing style of Axios.
  • Experience working across teams to produce quality content.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the digital and social media landscape.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Willing to work afternoons/evenings (2pm-10pm ET Sunday-Thursday)

job.title: Salesforce Business Analyst
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a modern media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We are hiring a Salesforce Business Analyst to help build and scale our CRM, reporting, and analytics capabilities, as part of our Revenue Operations team.

Why it matters: This role owns and administers our Salesforce Media Cloud instance, ensuring the platform supports the needs of our revenue organization and serves as a trusted source of data. Beyond day-to-day Salesforce administration, this role will develop reporting, analytics, and insights that turn revenue data into meaningful business intelligence. This role will report to the Senior Director of Revenue Strategy and Operations. 

Go deeper: This is an opportunity for someone early in their Salesforce and Revenue Operations career who wants hands-on ownership while expanding their skills across systems, processes, and analytics. You’ll partner closely with Revenue Enablement, Client Partnerships, Client Experience, and Business Development teams to solve business challenges, improve revenue processes, and help teams use Salesforce and data more effectively. Responsibilities include:

  • Serve as the day-to-day administrator for Salesforce Media Cloud, managing users, permissions, page layouts, flows, reports, dashboards, validation rules, and automation.
  • Partner with Revenue Strategy & Enablement, Revenue Operations, and sales leadership to translate business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions and operational improvements.
  • Build and optimize a Salesforce environment that supports Axios’ evolving revenue organization, sales processes, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and recurring analyses that give executives, sales leadership, and cross-functional partners actionable visibility into business performance, sales metrics, and KPIs.
  • Support data migration and ongoing data management efforts, ensuring data quality, integrity, consistency, and governance across Salesforce.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual workflows, streamline processes, and improve operational efficiency across the revenue organization.
  • Support sales planning and performance management, including sales goals, conversion and segment analysis, Quarterly Business Reviews, and weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting.
  • Troubleshoot user and system issues, recommend scalable solutions, and support testing, deployment, and change management for Salesforce releases and enhancements.
  • Create and maintain documentation, best practices, and training materials while supporting user adoption of Salesforce functionality, reporting tools, and revenue processes.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit, have a passion for the Axios mission, and the following skills and experience:

  • 1–2 years of Salesforce Administrator experience.
  • 1–2 years of experience in sales operations or sales analytics.
  • Salesforce Administrator Certification (ADM-201) or plans to obtain certification within the first year.
  • Experience helping build or significantly expand a Salesforce organization from the ground up, or participating in a major Salesforce implementation.
  • Experience building flows, reports, dashboards, validation rules, and custom objects.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security, profiles, permission sets, and data management best practices.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills and a customer-service mindset when supporting end users.
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements and improve business processes.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with Salesforce Media Cloud.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with third-party applications.
  • Experience supporting a Salesforce data migration from one CRM or Salesforce org to another.
  • Experience working in the media industry.

Within your first year, you'll help establish a scalable Salesforce foundation that supports Axios' revenue organization by:

  • Delivering a stable, well-governed Salesforce environment that users trust.
  • Successfully supporting the migration from our legacy CRM while maintaining data quality.
  • Improving automation and reducing manual administrative work across revenue teams.
  • Increasing Salesforce adoption through thoughtful training, documentation, and user support.
  • Partnering with cross-functional teams to improve how they leverage data and analytics to understand their business.

job.title: Senior Counsel, Commercial
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a digital media company focused on breaking news and invaluable insights across business, technology, politics, and media. We are hiring a Senior Counsel, Commercial to join our collaborative legal team and serve as a key legal partner to our revenue, product, and operations teams. 

Why it matters: This is a high-visibility, broad-scope role. You will independently counsel senior business leaders, own significant commercial matters end-to-end, and help shape practical solutions as Axios develops new products, partnerships, and growth opportunities.

Go deeper: We are looking for a pragmatic, self-directed attorney with strong commercial judgment who will: 

  • Commercial Transactions & Workflow
    • Draft, review, and negotiate a variety of commercial agreements, including advertising sales, sponsorships, events, customer subscriptions, content licensing, vendor, technology, and strategic agreements.
    • Own commercial legal intake and workflow: prioritize and delegate work, improve playbooks and templates, and help implement self-service tools and automation to handle volume efficiently.
  • Commercial, Product, Sales & Marketing Counseling
    • Provide practical, business-focused advice that balances legal risk with commercial objectives and helps teams reach workable solutions.
    • Advise on new products and features, sales and marketing initiatives, advertising and sponsorships, new revenue opportunities, and day-to-day business matters.
    • Identify legal implications across privacy, IP, regulatory, and operational issues.
    • Provide practical privacy and data-use counseling, including DPAs, privacy policy updates, and data-use questions, and exercise judgment about when specialized support is warranted.
    • Handle routine commercial disputes and other business issues and escalate significant or high-risk matters thoughtfully.
  • Legal Team Leadership
    • Scope and manage outside counsel efficiently and translate legal advice into clear, actionable recommendations for business leaders.
    • Stay current on legal developments relevant to digital media and technology 
    • Contribute to cross-functional and Legal team initiatives as needed. 

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit and passion for Axios’ mission. This position requires the following:

  • 6+ years of relevant legal experience, including significant in-house commercial experience; law firm experience a plus.
  • Experience advising on product, sales, marketing, advertising, sponsorships, and digital media matters; digital media experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong contract drafting and negotiation skills, with a track record of independently leading sophisticated commercial transactions.
  • Broad issue-spotting skills and experience to identify and advise on legal and business risks beyond the contract.
  • Pragmatic risk assessment that balances legal protection with business agility and avoids over-lawyering.
  • Proven ability to operate independently, own matters end-to-end, and advise senior business leaders with sound judgment and confidence.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills and a collaborative, solution-oriented approach.
  • Ability to move quickly, prioritize competing demands, and communicate clearly and succinctly.
  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree from an accredited law school and active admission to practice law, in good standing, in at least one U.S. state or the District of Columbia
  • AI aptitude and comfort using AI-enabled tools and workflows to work more effectively.

job.title: Beasley Media Group
job.description:
Thanks for visiting our Career Page. Please review our open positions and apply to the positions that match your qualifications.

Account Executive

Augusta, GA Full Time Mid Level Share Account Executive

Position Summary

As an Account Executive, you will serve as a trusted marketing consultant to local businesses and advertising agencies, helping clients achieve their business goals through innovative advertising and marketing solutions. This role combines prospecting, relationship building, strategic planning, and revenue generation across Beasley Media Group's portfolio of broadcast, digital, streaming, event, and experiential marketing assets.

The ideal candidate is a motivated self-starter with a passion for sales, strong communication skills, and the ability to develop long-term client partnerships while driving new business growth.

Key Qualifications

  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented professional who thrives both independently and in a collaborative team environment.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities with attention to detail.
  • Effective negotiator with a customer-focused, consultative sales approach.
  • Ability to identify client needs, develop strategic recommendations, and deliver impactful marketing solutions.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems and sales pipeline management.
  • Passion for building relationships and creating measurable results for clients.
  • Valid driver's license, proof of insurance, and reliable transportation required.
  • Employment is contingent upon successful completion of an MVR check.

Essential Responsibilities

Business Development & Sales

  • Generate new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, referrals, and outreach efforts.
  • Maintain and grow existing account relationships while increasing revenue and market share.
  • Develop integrated marketing solutions utilizing Beasley Media Group's full suite of advertising platforms.
  • Create and deliver compelling sales presentations and marketing proposals to local businesses and advertising agencies.
  • Identify client business challenges and recommend customized advertising and marketing strategies.
  • Secure sponsorships, promotional partnerships, experiential marketing opportunities, and digital advertising campaigns.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals.

Client Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers, stakeholders, and business owners.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, ensuring exceptional customer service and responsiveness.
  • Regularly communicate with clients regarding campaign performance, marketing initiatives, sponsorships, and business objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to expand partnerships through upselling and cross-selling solutions.

Strategic Planning & Market Research

  • Prepare thoroughly for all client interactions by researching industries, market conditions, business objectives, and competitive trends.
  • Analyze client needs, target audiences, and historical advertising investment to develop effective recommendations.
  • Stay informed on emerging advertising, media, digital marketing, and consumer behavior trends.
  • Utilize market insights and audience data to enhance client outcomes and sales effectiveness.

Product & Industry Expertise

  • Maintain comprehensive knowledge of Beasley Media Group's products, platforms, pricing, audience insights, and marketing capabilities.
  • Continuously expand expertise in radio, digital advertising, streaming audio, video, events, promotions, and experiential marketing.
  • Understand competitive offerings and effectively position Beasley Media Group's advantages in the marketplace.

Administrative & Reporting Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records, activity logs, and sales opportunities within the company CRM.
  • Effectively manage schedules, appointments, account plans, and follow-up activities.
  • Provide timely sales forecasts, pipeline updates, and performance reports as requested by management.
  • Document client interactions and strategic account activities to support business growth and customer retention.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Maintain regular communication with leadership regarding sales activity, pipeline development, client opportunities, and business needs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful execution of advertising campaigns and client initiatives.
  • Support client events, promotions, and experiential marketing activities as needed.
  • Contribute positively to a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently meeting or exceeding revenue goals.
  • Developing strong client relationships that result in long-term partnerships.
  • Generating new business opportunities and expanding existing accounts.
  • Delivering strategic marketing solutions that help clients achieve measurable business results.
  • Serving as a knowledgeable and trusted advisor within the local advertising community.

Beasley Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact at the front desk, greeting and assisting visitors, clients, and vendors in a professional and welcoming manner.

Payment Processing
  • Ensure timely and accurate payment of all vendor invoices in accordance with vendor terms.
  • Maintain payment schedules to optimize cash flow and prevent late fees.
  • Process payment runs and coordinate check distributions, ACH payments, and wire transfers.

Accounting & Reconciliation
  • Code invoices to appropriate general ledger accounts in accordance with company policies and GAAP.

  • Support month-end close activities and assist with account reconciliations.

Vendor Relations
  • Serve as the primary contact for assigned vendors regarding invoice status and payment inquiries.
  • Proactively resolve payment discrepancies and disputes in a professional manner.
  • Build strong vendor relationships to ensure uninterrupted service delivery.

  • Associate degree in Accounting or a related field.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with three-way match processes.
  • Previous experience in media, entertainment, or corporate environments.
 Core Competencies
  • Independent Worker – Manages workload autonomously while balancing multiple responsibilities.
  • Problem Solver – Strong analytical skills; researches issues and develops effective solutions.
  • Team Player – Collaborative mindset with outstanding customer-service orientation.
  • Communicator – Clear, professional written and verbal communication with vendors, visitors, and colleagues.

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

job.title: Market Manager
job.description:
Position Summary

Beasley Media Group is seeking a dynamic, results-oriented Market Manager to lead the strategic, operational, and financial performance of the Augusta market. The Market Manager serves as the senior leader responsible for driving revenue growth, cultivating a high-performance culture, and maximizing the impact of Beasley Media Group's audio, digital, event, and marketing solutions.  This is a confidential leadership opportunity.

The ideal candidate is a strong business leader with a proven track record of revenue generation, team development, and market influence. This individual will inspire cross-functional teams while ensuring alignment with company objectives and delivering exceptional results for advertisers, listeners, and community partners.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Market Strategy

  • Lead all aspects of market operations, including sales, programming, digital, promotions, engineering, and business administration.
  • Develop and execute strategic plans to achieve market revenue, profitability, and audience growth objectives.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Build strong relationships with local business leaders, community organizations, and key stakeholders.
  • Represent Beasley Media Group within the market and at industry events.

Revenue Growth

  • Drive revenue performance across broadcast, digital, event, and integrated marketing platforms.
  • Collaborate with sales leadership to establish and achieve aggressive revenue goals.
  • Identify new business opportunities and emerging revenue streams.
  • Review sales pipelines, forecasting, and market performance metrics to ensure consistent growth.
  • Lead and support key client relationships and strategic account development efforts.

Talent Development

  • Recruit, develop, and retain top-performing leaders and team members.
  • Provide coaching and mentorship to department heads and sales leadership.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and accountability measures.
  • Promote employee engagement and professional development across the organization.

Operational Excellence

  • Ensure efficient market operations and adherence to company policies and procedures.
  • Manage budgets and maintain fiscal responsibility while maximizing business performance.
  • Monitor market KPIs and implement corrective action plans when necessary.
  • Collaborate with corporate leadership to support company initiatives and strategic priorities.

Community Impact

  • Strengthen Beasley Media Group's presence and reputation within the local community.
  • Support local events, charitable initiatives, and public service efforts.
  • Champion diversity, inclusion, and community engagement initiatives.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Media Management, or related field; equivalent experience will be considered.
  • 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in media, advertising, broadcasting, digital marketing, or related industries.
  • Demonstrated success leading revenue-generating teams and achieving business objectives.
  • Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, and P&L management.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain executive-level client relationships.

Preferred

  • Experience managing a media or multi-platform advertising operation.
  • Knowledge of digital marketing products, audience analytics, and integrated advertising solutions.
  • Experience leading multiple departments and cross-functional teams.
  • Familiarity with FCC regulations and media industry best practices.

Why Join Beasley Media Group?

At Beasley Media Group, you'll have the opportunity to lead a talented team, shape the future of local media, and make a meaningful impact in the communities we serve. We offer a collaborative culture, entrepreneurial environment, competitive compensation, and opportunities for professional growth.

The position will remain open until filled.

Beasley Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values diversity in the workplace.

job.title: Morning Show Co-Host / Board Operator - 96.3 KKLZ
job.description:
Position Overview
96.3 KKLZ, Las Vegas' heritage Classic Hits station, is searching for an experienced, creative, and entertaining Morning Show Co-Host to join our established morning team.
We're looking for a dynamic personality with a quick wit, strong conversational instincts, and the ability to connect with listeners through humor, storytelling, and relatable content.
This is a hands-on position requiring a versatile broadcaster who can entertain, create, produce, and execute. The successful candidate will serve as a primary on-air personality while also operating the broadcast console and sharing responsibility for daily show preparation and production.
The ideal candidate brings strong ideas, exceptional chemistry, and a collaborative spirit. We want someone who can lead a conversation, share the spotlight, and help create memorable radio every morning.

Key Responsibilities
On-Air Performance & Content Development
  • Serve as a primary morning show personality, sharing responsibility for the show's entertainment, content, and overall success.
  • Develop and deliver compelling, original content, including topical discussions, humor, storytelling, interviews, and recurring features.
  • Research and prepare relevant daily topics that resonate with the station's adult audience.
  • Demonstrate strong conversational chemistry, improvisational skills, comedic timing, and the ability to engage listeners.
  • Collaborate with fellow hosts to plan show content, develop creative ideas, and maintain a consistent, entertaining presentation.
Broadcast Operations & Production
  • Operate the broadcast console and automation system during live programming.
  • Execute music, commercials, audio elements, contests, and scheduled programming with accuracy and precision.
  • Maintain proper show pacing, timing, and seamless transitions.
  • Share responsibility for producing, editing, and preparing audio elements, including interviews, comedy bits, recurring features, and other show content.
  • Assist with daily show preparation, organization, and execution without reliance on a dedicated producer.
  • Troubleshoot routine technical issues and coordinate with engineering or programming staff as needed.
Station & Audience Engagement
  • Participate in station promotions, live appearances, community events, and special programming.
  • Engage listeners through phone calls, contests, social media, and other interactive platforms.
  • Contribute to the station's digital presence through engaging and brand-appropriate content.
  • Collaborate with programming, promotions, and sales teams to support station initiatives.
  • Represent KKLZ and Beasley Media Group professionally on and off the air.

Required Qualifications
  • Professional on-air radio experience, preferably in a live, multi-host morning show environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to create and deliver compelling, personality-driven radio content.
  • Experience operating a broadcast console and radio automation systems.
  • Proficiency with digital audio editing and production software.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, improvisational, and interviewing skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, self-motivation, and the ability to independently prepare content.
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously during a live broadcast.
  • Strong understanding of radio formatics, show pacing, and audience engagement.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively, accept direction, and contribute to a positive team environment.
  • Willingness to work early morning hours and participate in occasional station events outside regular broadcast hours.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Proven success as a primary morning show personality.
  • Experience developing and producing original comedy bits, recurring features, and entertaining audio content.
  • Familiarity with Classic Hits or other mainstream, adult-targeted radio formats.
  • Experience with social media, video production, and digital audience engagement.
  • Knowledge of the Las Vegas market and local community.

The Ideal Candidate
We're looking for a well-rounded broadcaster who loves creating great radio.
Someone who can generate compelling ideas, deliver a great punchline, tell a memorable story, and make their co-host shine. Someone who understands how to balance spontaneity with preparation and entertainment with the demands of a music-intensive format.
You should be equally comfortable behind the microphone, behind the board, and behind the scenes preparing the content that makes a morning show successful.
Most importantly, we're looking for someone who understands that the best morning shows are built on chemistry, creativity, collaboration, and a genuine connection with the audience.

About 96.3 KKLZ
96.3 KKLZ is a heritage Las Vegas radio station delivering Classic Hits, engaging personalities, and strong community connections. As part of Beasley Media Group, KKLZ is committed to creating compelling local radio that entertains and connects with listeners.
Location: Las Vegas, Nevada
Position: Full-Time Morning Show Co-Host / Board Operator
Schedule: Weekday mornings, with additional station appearances as needed

Beasley Media Group LLC is an equal opportunity employer.

job.title: Director of Engineering - Dome Productions
job.description:
Req Id: 433339

Dome Productions is North America’s leading production and transmission facilities provider, Dome is unique in its business approach and sets itself apart from others with its integration of primary business units of Mobile Production, Host Broadcaster and Media Services, and Transmission services all under its corporate umbrella. Dome Productions’ resume includes work with major worldwide broadcasters, leagues, production companies, government parties and other content creators, with a major emphasis on sports, eSports, and entertainment. 
     
We provide a supportive and inclusive community where all team members can succeed. And through our commitment to environmental, social and governance initiatives, you will feel good about the greater impact you will have – making every day better for people as they connect, work, learn and play. 
 
Join us. You belong at Dome Productions’

Summary

The Director of Engineering is responsible for the strategic leadership, technical direction, operational performance, and ongoing evolution of Dome Productions' engineering organization. This role oversees the maintenance, readiness, and modernization of Dome's mobile production fleet, technical infrastructure, and engineering resources while ensuring the delivery of reliable, industry-leading broadcast solutions.

As a member of the senior leadership team, the Director of Engineering will establish the long-term technology vision for the organization, lead the transition to next-generation IP, cloud, and hybrid production environments, and develop high-performing engineering teams that support North America's most prestigious live sports and entertainment productions.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Technology Innovation

  • Provide strategic and technical leadership for Dome’s engineering organization, establishing the vision and multi-year roadmap for media platforms, mobiles, studios, software, architecture, and infrastructure.
  • Execute Dome's long-term technology strategy and roadmap, ensuring continued leadership in broadcast and production technologies.
  • Lead the evaluation, adoption, and implementation of emerging technologies, including IP-based workflows, cloud-based production, UHD/4K, HDR, and software-defined infrastructure.
  • Provide expert technical guidance to executive leadership, clients, and industry partners regarding technology trends, opportunities, and risks.
  • Collaborate with leaders across Dome Productions, Bell Media and Rogers Media to understand business priorities and future growth plans, translating them into scalable technology strategies and roadmaps.
  • Establish strategic partnerships with technology vendors, service providers, and industry organizations to support current and future business requirements.
  • Represent Dome Productions within industry associations, technology forums, and key vendor partnerships.

Engineering Operations & Infrastructure Management

  • Provide leadership and oversight for Dome's mobile production fleet, studios, control rooms, and supporting technical infrastructure.
  • Guide the evolution of Dome Productions infrastructure and shape the transition to next-generation architectures across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Ensure all systems meet operational, reliability, performance, and broadcast quality standards.
  • Oversee engineering support for major live productions and serve as the senior escalation point for critical operational issues.
  • Lead large-scale engineering projects, system upgrades, equipment acquisitions, and infrastructure enhancements.
  • Ensure effective asset lifecycle management, maintenance planning, and operational readiness across all technical platforms.

Business Partnership & Financial Accountability

  • Partner with division leaders across Dome Productions, Bell Media, Rogers Media, to align technology investments with business objectives.
  • Develop capital plans, operating budgets, forecasts, and business cases that support strategic priorities.
  • Manage/oversee capital projects ensuring adherence to cost, time and quality deliverables. Oversee purchase, delivery, and installation of new equipment. Ensure the smooth integration, training and communication of new equipment or process.
  • Make sound business decisions that balance operational excellence, financial stewardship, and long-term organizational success.

People Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of engineering leaders, technical specialists, and field engineering personnel responsible for building, maintaining, and continually evolving Dome’s technology ecosystem.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive talent acquisition, succession planning, workforce development, performance management, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Establish training and development programs that advance technical expertise and leadership capabilities across the organization.
  • Promote a safe, inclusive, and high-performing work environment for employees and freelance resources.

Industry Leadership & Client Support

  • Maintain strong relationships with clients, vendors, partners, and industry stakeholders.
  • Update and maintain thorough knowledge of the mobile, studio and distribution business including who’s who, trends, technology, changes, relationships, competitive and client landscapes and changes within the industry
  • Support client-facing discussions involving technical strategy, production solutions, and future business opportunities.
  • Ensure exceptional service delivery and client satisfaction across all engineering-supported productions.

Critical Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in broadcast engineering, media technology, or related technical environments.
  • Minimum 5 years in a senior management or director-level role leading technical teams and complex operations.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing technology strategies, infrastructure roadmaps, and large-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Experience leading high-performing engineering teams within live production, broadcast, media, or technology environments.
  • Strong knowledge of live production and broadcast technologies, including video, audio, routing, replay, intercom, transmission, and contribution systems.
  • Significant experience with SMPTE 2110, IP-based workflows, cloud-based media technologies, and hybrid infrastructure environments.
  • Understanding of modern networking, compute, storage, cybersecurity, and software-defined architectures.
  • Knowledge of broadcast industry standards, including SMPTE, ATSC, UHD/4K, HDR, and related emerging technologies.
  • Experience overseeing complex technology implementations while maintaining highly reliable production operations.
  • Strategic thinker with strong business and financial acumen.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and build cross-functional partnerships.
  • Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities in high-pressure environments.
  • Ability to lead through change while maintaining team engagement and operational excellence.
  • Passion for innovation, continuous learning, and delivering exceptional client experiences.
  • Builds trust and credibility across technical, operational, and executive teams.
  • Balances innovation with operational reliability.
  • Develops future-ready engineering capabilities while maintaining exceptional service delivery.
  • Leads confidently in fast-paced, high-stakes live production environments.
  • Creates a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Flexibility to travel domestically and internationally.
  • Degree or diploma in Engineering, Broadcast Technology, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Relevant industry certifications and professional affiliations are considered assets.

 

Adequate knowledge of French is required for positions in Quebec.

Summary

We’re looking for a collaborative, solutions‑focused individual who thrives in a fast‑paced news environment and brings a positive, steady approach to daily challenges. This role plays a key part in coordinating editing workflows, supporting team members, and working closely with Engineering, Operations, and Production teams. The ideal candidate is passionate about storytelling, adaptable to evolving technologies, and committed to keeping daily news operations running smoothly across platforms.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee and execute video edits for CTV Toronto, CP24, CTV News Channel, Power Play, and National News
  • Maintain high editorial standards while adapting to fast‑paced, evolving newsroom demands
  • Ensure all edited content meets broadcast standards for timing, formatting, and video/audio quality
  • Support day‑to‑day coordination of the editing team, including task distribution, workflow prioritization, and peer coaching
  • Act as a point of escalation for editorial, technical, or workflow issues during assigned shifts
  • Collaborate with Production and Operations teams to ensure smooth content delivery
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Project teams when required to ensure smooth and continued operations from an end‑user standpoint
  • Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to Editing and Ingest teams
  • Ingest video and graphical elements into the editing system
  • Operate Avid Media Composer effectively within a production‑managed environment
  • Manage media and project files in a multi‑user, networked setup
  • Export elements for further production work (e.g., AAFs, projects, sequences, and bins in a networked environment)
  • Design, adapt, and refine editing workflows to meet changing production needs and improve efficiency
  • Lead the integration and adoption of new technologies, tools, and workflows as they are introduced
  • Ensure workflows and new methods are documented and communicated to the entire Editing team
  • Maintain awareness of cross‑platform content needs, including broadcast and digital workflows, and support editorial teams as required

Qualifications

  • Post‑secondary education with an emphasis on technical and production standards is preferred, along with strong creativity and organizational skills
  • Minimum 5 years of full‑time experience in non‑linear editing and advanced television production techniques.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with team members and cross‑functional departments
  • Ability to clearly communicate ideas, priorities, and project‑related information
  • Comfortable working independently or collaboratively in a team environment, with flexibility to adapt to changing priorities
  • Proven experience supporting or mentoring peers in newsroom or post‑production environments.
  • Knowledge of Avid Nexis, Interplay, MediaCentral | Cloud UX, and iNews.
  • Basic working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud applications, including Photoshop, After Effects, and Media Encoder
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines while maintaining high editorial and technical standards
  • Ability to train and mentor team members on editing systems, media management, and evolving production processes
  • Experience with stereo and 5.1 audio mixing, including channel mapping, loudness compliance, and broadcast export standards
  • Strong understanding of newsroom workflows, broadcast delivery requirements, and evolving production technologies
  • Detail‑oriented with solid problem‑solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot issues independently or in collaboration with Engineering
  • A demonstrated willingness to learn new tools and techniques and help drive continuous improvement
  • Possess a willingness to share knowledge and contribute positively to the growth and consistency of the Editing team

job.title: Distribution Processor - Foreign Incoming (Hybrid)
job.description:
Every royalty payment starts with accurate information.

As a Distribution Processor at BMI, you’ll help turn music usage information into the accurate, timely royalty distributions that support the songwriters, composers and publishers we represent. You’ll process information from different sources, use specialized systems and tools, and contribute to a team that values accuracy, consistency and meeting deadlines.

Depending on your team, your work may involve processing cue sheets, identifying reported performances, handling music reports or supporting incoming international royalty payments. You’ll learn established processes, build knowledge of the music industry and work closely with colleagues and management to resolve questions and maintain quality.

If you enjoy detail-oriented work, solving practical problems and seeing how your contributions support the people who create music, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

POSITION SUMMARY

Processes information from a variety of sources using systems, tools and resources that support the accurate and timely distribution of royalty payments to BMI affiliates.

FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB

Essential Functions: which may be representative but not all inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.

Processes cue sheets, links performances and performs other necessary tasks to meet team goals and deadlines.

Maintains best practices as learned from continuous training on systems, procedures and decision-making.

Applies policies, procedures and guidelines relevant to this business function.

Communicates with management on a regular basis regarding work-related issues and questions.

Meets established departmental goals for quantity and quality.

Performs all tasks and functions handled by a specific team.

Maintains knowledge of industry and affiliate changes through a variety of sources (industry blogs, BMI360, on-line content, and/or updates shared by co-workers and leaders).

Regular attendance.

Supports BMI Core Values and cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion.

Other duties as assigned.

Specific to Distribution and Administration Services Foreign Incoming Team

Processes Audio and Audio-Visual distribution payments made by foreign Performing Rights Organizations.

Creates manual payments to our affiliates.

Reviews and reconciles quality assurance reports related to resolution and payment of Foreign Incoming royalties.

Physical/Visual Activities or Demands

Physical/visual activities or demands that are commonly associated with the performance functions of this job.

Sitting, talking, hearing, walking.

Concentrated mental and visual attention with normal hand-eye coordination.

Clarity of vision at 20 inches; corrected or uncorrected.

Generally negligible physical effort, but occasional moving of 1 to 10 lb. items.

Environmental/Atmospheric Conditions

Environmental and atmospheric conditions commonly associated with the functions of this job.

Normal office conditions.

POSITION QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

Education: High school diploma or GED. Bachelor’s degree in related field preferred.

Experience: Experience or familiarity with an operational/processing role.

Skills and Abilities: which may be representative but not all inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.

Knowledge of music industry or active participation in the music community highly preferred.

Effective written and verbal communication skills.

Proficient keyboard and PC skills.

Ability to perform well in a fast-paced, ever-changing, detail-oriented work environment.

Effective decision-making skills to determine when and how to escalate problems or questions.

Demonstrate a passion for music.

Foreign language helpful but not required.

Ability to organize and prioritize work.

Ability to interact professionally with others at all levels.

Ability to work in a team or independently with minimal supervision.

Initiative.

Good problem-solving ability.

MACHINES, TOOLS, EQUIPMENT, AND WORK AIDS

Personal computer and associated software. Normal office equipment.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

You process music usage and royalty-related information carefully and accurately.

You meet established quantity and quality goals while keeping deadlines in focus.

You follow established guidelines, ask thoughtful questions and know when to escalate an issue.

You build confidence with the systems, procedures and tools needed for your assigned team.

You stay organized, adapt to changing priorities and contribute positively to team results.

You develop your knowledge of the music industry and understand why getting the details right matters.

WHY JOIN US?

The details behind a music performance matter. At BMI, Distribution Processors help make sure the information needed to pay royalties is handled accurately and on time. Your work supports the process that connects music usage with payments to the people who create it.

You’ll gain hands-on experience with music rights operations, develop specialized skills and join colleagues committed to supporting music creators. If you bring curiosity, care and a passion for music, we’d love to meet you!
