job.title: Principal DevOps Engineer
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Principal DevOps Engineer is the organization’s senior individual contributor for enterprise DevOps and platform engineering. This role defines and evolves cloud, automation, software delivery, and operational reliability patterns that align Architecture and business strategy. The position leads the design of secure, scalable Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS) platforms; establishes reusable infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, GitOps, observability, and governance capabilities; and sets technical standards adopted across Development, Architecture, Security, Network, Infrastructure, and Operations. Azure DevOps is the organization’s standard source-control, build, and deployment platform for application and infrastructure delivery across both cloud environments. The Principal DevOps Engineer serves as a hands-on technical authority, leads complex cross-functional initiatives and proofs of concept, mentors engineers, and uses measurable outcomes to continuously improve developer experience, delivery performance, resiliency, security, and operational efficiency.

FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB

Essential Functions

Own the enterprise technical strategy and reference architecture for DevOps, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, software delivery, and engineering automation, translating business and Architecture direction into actionable standards and roadmaps.

Design, implement, and support secure, resilient, scalable cloud infrastructure and shared platform services across Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS), including Kubernetes, containers, networking, identity, compute, storage, data, and other cloud-native capabilities.

Architect and govern infrastructure as code using Terraform, including reusable modules, versioning, automated validation and testing, remote state management, policy checks, controlled promotion, and lifecycle management.

Define and evolve enterprise CI/CD and software-delivery patterns using Azure DevOps as the organization’s standard source-control, build, and deployment platform, including Azure Repos, Azure Pipelines, quality gates, artifact management, release controls, progressive delivery, rollback, and traceability across Azure and AWS environments.

Lead GitOps architecture and deployment practices using Azure DevOps, Argo CD, Helm, Kubernetes, and related technologies; establish secure, repeatable patterns for containerized and cloud-native workloads across Azure and AWS.

Create automation and platform capabilities using PowerShell, Bash, Python, APIs, SDKs, and event-driven integrations to reduce manual work, improve consistency, and increase engineering throughput.

Establish Git and repository governance, including branching strategies, pull-request and code-review standards, release practices, dependency management, and software supply-chain controls.

Design and enforce multi-cloud governance and security controls across Azure and AWS, including policy as code, identity and access integration, secrets and certificate management, network and workload security requirements, resource organization and tagging, cost governance, compliance evidence, and automated guardrails.

Define the enterprise observability strategy across Azure and AWS using Datadog and OpenTelemetry as cross-platform capabilities, together with cloud-native telemetry services such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Amazon CloudWatch; establish standards for logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, service-level indicators, actionable alerting, and operational telemetry.

Lead reliability engineering practices across Azure and AWS, including service-level objectives, capacity planning, performance engineering, high availability, disaster recovery, operational readiness, incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action follow-through.

Monitor and analyze key delivery, reliability, security, and platform-adoption metrics; identify systemic constraints and lead improvements that produce measurable business and engineering outcomes.

Chair or provide technical authority for architecture reviews, platform design decisions, change-control standards, and quality and testing requirements for software and infrastructure builds and deployments.

Lead complex technology evaluations and proofs of concept; document findings, risks, total-cost and operational trade-offs, and recommendations for leadership.

Create and maintain reference architectures, implementation guides, reusable templates, technical standards, decision records, training materials, and operational procedures for varied technical and executive audiences.

Provide expert consultation, technical leadership, coaching, and mentoring to DevOps, platform, development, and infrastructure engineers without requiring direct people-management responsibility.

Facilitate alignment across Development, Architecture, Security, Network, Infrastructure, and Operations teams; resolve cross-domain technical issues and influence adoption of enterprise standards.

Participate in development, testing, deployment, implementation, and continuous-improvement activities across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

Lead multiple concurrent initiatives of high scope, ambiguity, risk, and organizational impact; communicate status, decisions, dependencies, and risks clearly to leadership and stakeholders.

Ensure completeness, accuracy, accessibility, and currency of required technical documentation.

Support organizational values and cultivate a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, diversity, inclusion, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.

Perform other duties as assigned.

POSITION QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

Education

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant industry experience.

Experience

Ten (10) or more years of progressive experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, software engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a related technical field.

Five (5) or more years designing, implementing, managing, and supporting enterprise cloud infrastructure and cloud-based platforms in Microsoft Azure and/or Amazon Web Services (AWS), with demonstrated ability to design and operate across multi-cloud environments.

Demonstrated experience functioning as a senior technical lead, principal engineer, architect, or equivalent authority for enterprise-scale DevOps or platform engineering initiatives.

Hands-on experience designing and operating distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, containerized workloads, and production services in a large enterprise environment.

Progressive achievement in job history, including successful delivery of complex, cross-functional initiatives with measurable technical or operational outcomes.

Required Technical Expertise

Expert-level infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform, including reusable module design, testing, state and dependency management, upgrade strategy, drift detection, and governed deployment workflows.

Expert-level design and implementation of CI/CD and release-engineering systems using Azure DevOps, including Azure Repos and Azure Pipelines, for application and infrastructure delivery across Azure and AWS.

Advanced Kubernetes and container-platform expertise, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), Helm, GitOps with Argo CD, workload security, cluster operations, upgrades, scaling, networking, storage, and troubleshooting.

Advanced automation and software-development capability using PowerShell, Bash, Python, APIs, SDKs, and Git-based development practices.

Deep understanding of Azure and AWS governance, policy as code, identity and access management, secrets and certificate automation, network security, DevSecOps, software supply-chain security, resource organization, tagging, and cloud cost controls.

Advanced multi-cloud observability and reliability engineering experience using Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Amazon CloudWatch, or comparable tooling, including SLOs, actionable alerting, incident response, and root-cause analysis.

Expert understanding of SDLC automation, Agile delivery, design and development practices, testing standards, change control, continuous integration, continuous delivery, and operational readiness.

Ability to develop reference architectures and technical standards that balance security, reliability, developer experience, cost, maintainability, and speed of delivery.

Leadership and Professional Capabilities

Operates independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and exercises sound judgment when requirements are incomplete or priorities conflict.

Influences technical direction across teams and levels through credibility, facilitation, clear decision frameworks, and evidence-based recommendations.

Communicates complex technical concepts effectively to engineering, security, architecture, operations, business, and executive audiences.

Demonstrates exceptional analytical, systems-thinking, troubleshooting, problem-solving, presentation, and technical-writing skills.

Mentors engineers, promotes knowledge sharing, and raises engineering quality through reviews, standards, pairing, and practical guidance.

Demonstrates strong attention to detail, accountability, collaboration, open communication, and commitment to engineering excellence.

Must be willing to work outside normal business hours, including weekends, when required to support releases, incidents, or critical initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience establishing an internal developer platform, paved-road or golden-path capabilities, self-service infrastructure, or developer portals.

Experience applying FinOps practices, cloud cost allocation, capacity optimization, and unit-cost or consumption metrics to platform decisions.

Experience with enterprise risk, regulatory, audit, or compliance requirements and automated evidence collection.

Relevant professional certification such as Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional, AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate, or comparable credentials.

MACHINES, TOOLS, EQUIPMENT AND WORK AIDS

Personal computer and associated software; Microsoft Azure; Amazon Web Services (AWS); Azure DevOps; Azure Repos; Azure Pipelines; Terraform; Kubernetes; AKS; EKS; Argo CD; Helm; PowerShell; Bash; Python; APIs and SDKs; Datadog; Azure Monitor; Application Insights; Amazon CloudWatch; OpenTelemetry; artifact-management, security, collaboration, and documentation platforms; and standard office equipment.

LICENSE(S) / CERTIFICATIONS REQUIRED

None required. Relevant advanced Azure, AWS, DevOps, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code certifications are preferred.

JOB DESCRIPTION NOTICE

This job description does not state or imply that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees may be required to follow other job-related instructions and perform other job-related duties as requested, subject to all applicable state and federal laws. “Commonly associated” is not intended to mean always or only. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

COMPENSATION

The salary range is $140,000-$160,000 USD per year, depending on experience, qualifications, and skills. This role may also be eligible for incentives, benefits, and other rewards as part of BMI’s total rewards package.

job.title: Sr. Manager, Revenue Accounting
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:   Leads the Licensing Accounting function through a Licensing Accounting Manager and Senior Accountant, owning revenue recognition and technical accounting for the company and ensuring compliance with ASC 606 across all revenue streams. Sets team direction, standards and workflow while remaining directly engaged in the highest-judgmental technical matters, the revenue close, review, reporting, controls and audit processes and keeps revenue accounting diligence-ready to support transactions and builds scalable revenue and billing processes as the company grows. Builds scalable revenue and billing processes as the company grows, identifies and implements process improvements pertaining to area of responsibility and works directly with financial accounting, FP&A, licensing, legal, operations, collections services, IT and other departments to uphold company best practices, ensure proper controls are in place and deliver excellent customer service.

FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB

Essential Functions: representative but not all inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.

Revenue Recognition & Technical Accounting

Owns revenue recognition policies and ensures compliance with ASC 606 across all revenue streams, applying judgment appropriate to the company's size and complexity, and reviews and updates related company policies and procedures.

Reviews customer contracts, including non-standard terms, bundled arrangements, variable consideration, and contract modifications and determines the correct accounting treatment.

Writes clear technical memos documenting key revenue judgments for auditors, investors and future diligence.

Revenue Close, Reporting & Controls

Oversee the monthly revenue close performed by the Manager and staff, personally reviewing and approving the most complex or judgmental entries (deferred revenue, unbilled receivables, contract asset balances), and ensuring successful coordination and completion of the month-end process.

Prepares revenue schedules and footnote disclosures for annual GAAP audited financial statements.

Designs and maintains a practical internal controls framework over the revenue cycle, scaled to the company's stage and ready to mature toward SOX if needed.

Leads the fiscal year-end audit and manages the revenue portion of the annual external audit, including PBC requests and auditor inquiries, maintaining relations during the audit.

Diligence, Transactions & M&A

Keeps revenue accounting "diligence-ready" to support fundraising, debt financing, a potential sale, or IPO, including quality of earnings (QoE) reviews.

Supports M&A activity through due diligence and integration of acquired revenue streams.

Team Leadership & Development

Builds and leads the Licensing Accounting team, setting direction and standards while empowering the Manager to own day-to-day execution; remains directly hands-on engaged with the Senior Accountant on complex technical matters, and available for escalation on staff-level, ensuring proper internal control and delivering excellent customer service.

Ensures the manager provides proper on-boarding, cross training and coaching to staff specific to Licensing Accounting; directly coaches and develops senior accountant and periodically reviews the manager's coaching effectiveness with the staff.

Develops the Licensing Accounting Manager's leadership capability, delegating operational ownership of the team's day-to-day work while providing guidance on complex technical or personnel matters.

Schedules, coordinates and leads broader team meetings and regular 1:1 with manager and senior accountant to ensure successful communication and collaboration; ensures the Manager runs effective staff level meetings and communication.

Cross functional partnership

Works directly with Licensing, Legal, Operations, Collections Services, IT and other departments to review deal terms before signing, flag revenue impacts early, uphold company best practices, ensure proper controls are in place and deliver excellent customer service.

Educates non-finance teams on how contract terms affect revenue.

Systems & Process Improvement

Ensures CRM, ERP and other financial systems function properly (as related to area of responsibility), and lead or support the selection and implementation of new systems, coordinating with Accounting Technology and IT, as needed.

Accesses and analyzes data to answer business questions and improve processes, leveraging available technology tools.

Builds or rebuilds revenue processes, often moving from spreadsheets toward automation as the company scales, researching, recommending and implementing process and procedural improvements by coordinating with management, team members and internal/external customers.

Acts as project manager for Licensing Accounting projects when appropriate

Supervisory Responsibilities: Directly supervises a licensing accounting manager and accountant and indirectly oversees additional team members in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring and training employees; planning, assigning, directing and ensuring reliability of work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining team members; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

POSITION QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

Education:  Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance required.

Experience: Minimum 8–10+ years' progressive accounting experience, with significant hands-on ASC 606 work. Three (3) or more years' people management experience required. Comfort operating in a fast-paced, less-structured environment.

Skills and Abilities: which may be representative but not all inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.

Experience with ERP and revenue/billing systems, plus advanced Excel skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office

Experience with Oracle Financial modules and Salesforce preferred

Familiarity with AI-powered tools for data analysis and process improvement preferred

Ability to write clear technical memos, reports, business correspondence and procedure manuals

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret professional literature and technical procedures. Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP, particularly ASC 606, with the ability to apply technical guidance to non-standard or complex transactions

Effective communication skills, including presenting to executives and effectively responding to questions from groups of managers, vendors, internal and external customers

Must be capable of building, fostering and working in a team environment focused on quality and customer service

Excellent time management, analytical, decision making and organizational skills

Ability to  develop and lead a multi-tiered team, delegating prioritized operational execution to a Manager while maintaining accountability for team output and quality

job.title: Sactown Sports Talk Host
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

 

Who We Are

At Bonneville International, our purpose is to build up, connect, inform, and celebrate communities and families in the markets we serve. As an integrated media company, we provide content, advertising, and digital marketing solutions across 19 radio stations in Denver, Phoenix, Sacramento, Salt Lake City, and Seattle, along with the NBC Affiliate TV station, KSL-TV 5, in Salt Lake. We are responsible for lifting and inspriring with respect and giving voice to the communities and clients we serve.

 

We believe that empowering our employees to share their ideas and experiences will fuel creativity, innovation, and inspiration. A diverse and inclusive workforce is crucial to our ability to create and deliver exceptional content, products, and services that represent our communities. We’re proud of our history and we want talented people to join us as we continue to grow!

 

To learn more about Bonneville, our stations, and how our local media matters, visit: https://bonneville.com/

 

Ready to Make Noise?

If you’re passionate about sports, storytelling, and connecting with your community - we want to hear from you.

 

Sactown Sports is on the hunt for a bold, engaging, and digitally-savvy Talk Show Host who’s ready to energize our audience across radio, web, and social platforms. If you live and breathe sports, know how to connect with listeners, and thrive in a fast-paced media environment, this is your moment.

 

We’re looking for someone who can deliver compelling content with personality and purpose, both over the air and online. You’ll be a key player in shaping our sound, growing our digital footprint, and building a loyal community of fans.

Apply now and bring your voice to Sactown Sports!

 

 

Overview

Sactown Sports is looking for a dynamic personality who can engage with our audiences and support our mission by contributing daily on-air, off-air and online content. A successful candidate will deliver remarkable content in an interesting, compelling and entertaining style that attracts the targeted audience, building ratings and digital users. You will be charged with creating exclusive content and regularly contributing to the various digital platforms including, but not limited to regular blogs, podcasts and/or videos, online listener chats and use of other social media platforms in addition to emerging digital technologies.

 

Note: On-air positions within Bonneville are generally considered onsite roles that require employees to regularly work in our offices/studios with occasional live events and remote broadcasts. Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion. 

 

What You Will Do:

Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:

  • Host and deliver informative, entertaining, and engaging content through a daily talk show that connects with the target audience.
  • Create exclusive digital content – blogs, articles, podcasts, videos, listeners chats, and more.
  • Stay sharp on local and national stories, topics, trends and culture.
  • Represent the brands at live events and promotional appearances. 
  • Operate studio eqipment and manage show elements like call-ins, recorded bits, and live interviews.
  • Attend staff meetings and collaborate with producers and team members to develop fresh show ideas.
  • Build strong relationshiops with listeners, clients, and colleagues.
  • Understand and adhere to FCC regulations and company policies with professionalism and integrity.

 

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of on-air hosting experience (sports format preferred).
  • A standout personality that aligns with our mission to build up, connect, celebrate, and inform.
  • Deep understanding of audience engagement in a PPM-rated market.
  • Technical know-how with studio equipment and audio production tools.
  • Strong sports knowledge and the ability to deliver content that’s both informative and entertaining.
  • Confidence in live settings - interviews, call-ins, and public events.
  • Comfort with using digital platforms and emerging media technologies.
  • A collaborative spirit and openness to coaching and feedback.
  • Able to communicate effectively.
  • Able to build audience by connecting with listeners / users and generating engagement and loyalty.
  • Able to consistently work hours required and flexibility to work outside of regular show hours when needed.

 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Receive, process, and maintain information through oral and/or written communication effectively.
  • Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to operate computer keys, radio console, and general office equipment. Ability to work on a computer for prolonged periods of time.
  • Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time.
  • May require a valid driver license
  • May require occasional lifting of up to 20 lbs.

 

COMPENSATION:

  • $72,400 - $90,000 annually.  Salary will be determined by an evaluation of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant along with internal and external benchmarks.

job.title: AI Engineer
job.description:
Opportunity

Brunswick is on an exciting journey to harness the power of artificial intelligence and data science to enhance the way we work and the advice we provide to clients. As we continue to expand our AI capabilities, we are looking for an AI Engineer to join our growing team.

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining AI-powered applications that deliver real value across the business. Working closely with our existing AI team, you will help build innovative solutions using modern AI technologies, with a particular focus on large language models (LLMs).

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with hands-on experience developing and deploying AI applications who enjoys solving complex problems, working with a high degree of autonomy, and turning emerging technologies into practical, high-quality products.

You will thrive in this role if you are curious, creative, and passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges. You take pride in writing robust, maintainable code and enjoy collaborating with colleagues to continuously improve and expand our AI capabilities.

About the Role

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Support, run, and iterate existing AI applications.
  • Design, develop, deploy, and maintain new AI applications which can be scaled across multiple business use cases, driving operational and commercial outcomes.
  • Trial and test solutions with end users to iterate and optimise them.
  • Research and analyse data sets using a variety of statistical and machine learning techniques.
  • Track and understand the evolving AI landscape.

What We’re Looking For

The successful candidate will be a highly professional, well-rounded individual with strong problem-solving skills, engineering expertise, strategic thinking, and excellent interpersonal skills. They will have a strong academic background complemented by an outstanding career to date. Standout candidates will demonstrate:

  • Experience building solutions with large language models (LLMs) and a deep understanding of the broader generative AI landscape.
  • Experience designing datasets, conducting model evaluations, and fine-tuning foundation models to improve task-specific performance.
  • Strong Python development skills, including experience writing production-quality code.
  • Experience with front-end technologies such as JavaScript, React, HTML, and CSS.
  • A solid understanding of statistics and machine learning fundamentals.
  • An undergraduate degree in a quantitative discipline, such as Mathematics or Computer Science, or equivalent relevant industry experience.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment with changing priorities and an iterative, user-focused approach to development.
  • Curiosity, a strong sense of ownership, and the ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively.
  • Previous experience in professional services would be advantageous.
  • Experience developing cloud applications on Microsoft Azure would be advantageous.
  • Experience with DevOps practices and tools (e.g. CI/CD, Git) would be desirable.
  • Knowledge of, or experience with, secure software development practices would be advantageous.

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. 

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world. 

 

Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Please read our Global Privacy Notice to understand how your data is managed.

job.title: Associate, Financial Situations
job.description:
Opportunity 

Brunswick Group is seeking an Associate to join our Financial practice.

Brunswick was founded in 1987 as a financial communications firm, expertise that continues to differentiate us. For nearly four decades, Brunswick has consistently ranked at the top of our industry’s league tables on a country, regional, and global basis.

Our global Financial practice has unparalleled experience developing and implementing campaigns to advise clients on both long-term positioning to enhance valuation and navigating complex capital markets transactions. Members of our Financial practice are deeply experienced and focus their client work on mergers & acquisitions, shareholder activism, IPOs, strategic investor relations and financial communications, and restructuring. These specialists partner with global colleagues to bring a powerful and complementary combination of perspectives across stakeholders to help clients manage their reputations during critical financial events.

About the Role

Client Contribution & Handling
  • Advise clients on the communications implications of complex financial and corporate situations.
  • Produce and refine press releases, strategic plans, presentations, talking points, Q&As, briefing materials and other client communications with precision, speed and sound judgment.
  • Develop and execute integrated communications strategies that connect business objectives with the needs of investors, financial media, employees, regulators and other influential stakeholders.
  • Translate complex financial, strategic and market developments into clear, compelling narratives, messaging frameworks and recommendations for varied audiences.
  • Contribute to strategic discussions with senior executives and collaborate closely with legal and financial advisors on sensitive, fast-moving matters.
  • Plan and deliver high-stakes announcements and campaigns, including transaction communications, corporate positioning, media engagement and executive preparation.
  • Understand how earned media, digital and owned channels, stakeholder engagement and executive communications work together to advance client objectives.
Team Management
  • Manage day-to-day workstreams and client deliverables across multiple engagements, maintaining quality, responsiveness and attention to detail.
  • Work with Partners and Directors to coordinate integrated account teams, collaborate across Brunswick practices and anticipate evolving client needs.
  • Manage drafting, review and approval processes across client teams and external advisors, often under significant time pressure.
  • Direct research and analysis of companies, sectors, financial developments, media coverage and stakeholder perspectives; convert findings into actionable advice.
  • Mentor junior colleagues, provide constructive feedback and help foster a collaborative, high-performing team.
Networking & Practice Development

  • Build trusted relationships with clients and prospective clients, journalists, financial and legal advisors, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Identify emerging issues and opportunities where integrated financial communications advice can create value for clients.

Firm-sponsored 401(k) Plan with 3% automatic company contribution of base and bonus with an additional 1.5% profit share– immediate vesting. Career training and development opportunities. Employee discounts. 

Office Policy: At Brunswick, our work is a craft that thrives in teaching environments – whether in our offices or on-site with clients – through real-time observation, collaboration, human connection, clear guidance and by challenging one another to keep getting better. Our policy is that our team members are in person – either in the office or on-site with clients – at least four days each week.

job.title: Company Secretary
job.description:
Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced, fully qualified Company Secretary to join our Finance and Tax team and support Brunswick’s international operations.

This is a senior role at the heart of Brunswick’s governance framework, providing trusted advice to the Board of Directors and senior leadership. The Company Secretary will lead our corporate governance and regulatory compliance activities, ensuring Brunswick maintains high standards of governance and meets its obligations under the UK Corporate Governance Code and Companies Act 2006.

Reporting to the Group Head of Tax and Partnership Affairs, the role will work closely with the Group Financial Controller and other senior colleagues across the firm, providing thoughtful, pragmatic guidance on governance and corporate matters.

We are open to considering part-time or flexible working arrangements for the right candidate.

About the Role

Your key responsibilities will include:

Board and governance

  • Support the effective operation of the Board, including preparing agendas and papers, drafting minutes, tracking actions and ensuring appropriate follow-up.
  • Act as a key point of contact for executive and non-executive directors on governance matters.
  • Manage the forward calendar and terms of reference for the Board and its committees.
  • Ensure the Board operates in accordance with the Articles of Association, shareholder arrangements, the Companies Act 2006 and other relevant governance and regulatory requirements.
  • Keep the Board and senior colleagues informed of relevant developments in corporate governance and regulation.

Committee support

  • Provide company secretarial support to the Audit & Risk Committee.
  • Attend committee meetings and prepare accurate and timely minutes.
  • Track actions and support appropriate follow-up.

Shareholder matters

  • Maintain the shareholder register and oversee quarterly updates presented to the Board.
  • Prepare and coordinate communications and documentation for shareholders.
  • Work with the Head of International Tax to support partners on shareholder and share-related matters.

Annual General Meeting

  • Manage the end-to-end delivery of the Annual General Meeting.
  • Prepare notices and supporting documentation.
  • Coordinate communications with shareholders.
  • Manage meeting arrangements and prepare minutes.

Share buy-backs

  • Coordinate the documentation and approvals associated with share buy-backs.
  • Manage relevant filing and record-keeping requirements.

Corporate documentation and records

  • Draft resolutions, letters and other corporate documentation for entities and transactions across the Group.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date statutory books and corporate records for the Group’s subsidiaries using Diligent.
  • Maintain authorised signatory records.
  • Own and maintain the Group structure chart.

Statutory filings and compliance

  • Manage the Group’s Companies House filings, including confirmation statements and other statutory returns.
  • Ensure filings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Maintain oversight of filing deadlines and other company secretarial obligations across the Group.

Corporate transactions

  • Lead the company secretarial and governance aspects of corporate and commercial transactions.
  • Support matters including entity closures, share conversions and Group restructurings.
  • Work closely with Legal, Finance, Tax and other colleagues to ensure transactions are appropriately documented and implemented.

Advice and stakeholder support

  • Provide thoughtful and pragmatic corporate governance advice to directors, Finance, Legal and other senior stakeholders across the firm.
  • Support in-house Legal colleagues on company secretarial and governance matters.
  • Work with and provide guidance to Executive Assistants on Board governance and administration.

KYC

  • Coordinate KYC requests relating to directors and senior management.
  • Ensure relevant information is accurate, current and provided efficiently.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who brings:

  • Significant corporate secretarial experience, typically gained over 6–8 years, with experience working in a UK-listed, highly regulated or complex international environment.
  • Strong knowledge of the UK Corporate Governance Code, Listing Rules and Companies Act 2006, combined with the judgement to apply this expertise thoughtfully and pragmatically.
  • Excellent written and analytical skills, with the ability to listen carefully, identify what matters and capture complex Board and executive discussions in clear, accurate and considered minutes.
  • High emotional intelligence and strong interpersonal skills, with the confidence and judgement to build trusted relationships across executive and non-executive leadership while maintaining discretion and impartiality.
  • Fellowship or Associate status with the Chartered Governance Institute (CGI, formerly ICSA) is required.
  • A legal degree or professional qualification as a solicitor would be an advantage.

job.title: Public Affairs and Communications Junior Consultant
job.description:
Opportunity

Are you a young professional eager to grow your advisory career and work on a variety of high-stakes issues? Brunswick Group is seeking a talented Consultant with 1 to 3 years’ relevant experience to join our Brussels office and help national and international clients navigate complex EU policy, political and stakeholder issues. This is an opportunity to develop in a dynamic, fast-paced advisory environment at the intersection of business, media and politics.

As a Junior Consultant, you will deliver timely across policy, politics and media, while building a strong understanding of our clients’ businesses. You will prepare clear, accurate client materials (documents and presentations), support the effective coordination of projects and work closely with colleagues across teams. You will gain exposure to diverse sectors and international projects, and begin developing your own professional network and advisory skills.

Our Brussels team combines in-depth knowledge of EU and Member State policymaking with experience across a broad range of sectors, including industrials and infrastructure, new technologies, healthcare, energy and transportation, as well as banking and financial services or consumer industries.

About the Role 

As a Junior Consultant at Brunswick, you will support high-quality public affairs and strategic communications advice for our clients. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Keep colleagues informed of project status; develop action plans, engagement trackers, meeting requests and notes.
  • Prepare stakeholder background reports and relevant mapping (political and media).
  • Perform competitive analyses of clients and peer groups; identify and analyse research and media coverage on industry trends.
  • Effectively handle logistics around client meetings and other client events.
  • Identify and assess positioning opportunities for clients.
  • Collaborate with peers and senior colleagues to clarify expectations, manage priorities and deliver work accurately and on time.
  • Build relationships and a professional network outside the firm.

job.title: Account Director, Technology - Burson
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

The stakes in tech storytelling today are higher than ever. Gone are the days of technology simply “saving the world.” The double-edged sword of today’s technologies creates as much reputational risk as opportunity across diverse stakeholder groups.

Want to be on the front lines, shaping the narrative around the innovations and products changing the way people live, work, connect and experience the world?

With nearly a century of behavioral science and state-of-the-art AI helping us understand the changing dynamics of reputation, Burson partners with many of the world’s leading technology companies to develop communications strategies and stories that resonate, inspire and drive real impact. We’re not just about press releases and blogs. We help companies introduce breakthrough products, navigate complex issues and build reputations that stand the test of time.

If you’re obsessed with all things tech, love solving complex communications challenges and want to be part of a growing and collaborative team, Burson’s US Technology practice is the place for you.

As an Account Director on our growing US Technology team, you’ll play a leadership role in developing and delivering integrated communications strategies for leading technology and consumer brands. You’ll serve as a trusted client counselor, lead significant account workstreams, translate complex technologies into compelling stories and guide multidisciplinary teams from strategy through execution.

An initial area of focus will be supporting the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service, providing strategic communications leadership across its product and technology portfolio. You’ll help shape communications around new products, features and innovations, including advancements in AI and personalization, and develop integrated launch strategies encompassing earned media, social, influencer, owned and internal channels.

You’ll work closely with stakeholders across product, marketing, trust and safety, legal and communications, helping teams anticipate opportunities and reputational considerations while bringing complex technology stories to life for consumers.

This is an opportunity for a seasoned communications professional who combines consumer technology expertise, strategic and creative thinking, strong media instincts and confident client counsel with the curiosity and agility required to navigate fast-moving technology and product environments.

What you'll do:

  • Serve as a strategic counselor to clients, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and providing thoughtful communications counsel across product, corporate reputation and integrated communications priorities.
  • Lead significant client relationships and account workstreams, setting priorities, anticipating needs and ensuring teams consistently deliver strategic, creative and high-quality work.
  • Develop and lead integrated communications strategies for technology products, features and innovations, including major product launches, media relations, reputation programs and executive thought leadership.
  • Translate complex technologies into compelling narratives, helping clients explain sophisticated products, including AI-powered and personalized experiences, in ways that resonate with consumers, media and broader stakeholder audiences.
  • Lead product and feature launch communications, guiding strategy from early planning and positioning through launch and post-launch storytelling.
  • Bring a 360-degree communications mindset, ensuring strategies consider earned media, social, influencer, owned, internal and paid channels and bringing together the right specialists to deliver integrated programs.
  • Provide strategic media counsel, developing compelling storylines, overseeing proactive media strategies and maintaining strong relationships with influential technology, business and consumer journalists.
  • Counsel clients on emerging technology and reputational considerations, identifying potential risks or stakeholder concerns and helping teams determine when and how issues should be addressed or escalated.
  • Lead cross-functional planning, partnering effectively with product, marketing, social and influencer, trust and safety, legal, analytics, creative and communications stakeholders to build cohesive strategies.
  • Turn trends and insights into strategic opportunities, using an understanding of technology, media, culture and consumer behavior to help clients anticipate conversations rather than simply react to them.
  • Set the strategic direction and quality standard for client deliverables, providing senior oversight of messaging, media materials, executive content, briefing documents and presentations.
  • Lead client presentations and strategic discussions, confidently articulating recommendations, challenging thinking when appropriate and adapting strategies based on client and stakeholder feedback.
  • Oversee multiple complex workstreams, ensuring teams effectively manage timelines, priorities, budgets and deliverables across fast-moving accounts.
  • Manage and develop junior and mid-level talent, providing coaching, feedback and clear accountability while creating opportunities for team members to grow.
  • Partner with senior account leaders on account health and growth, proactively identifying opportunities to expand existing relationships and introduce new capabilities.
  • Contribute to new business and practice growth, including proposal development, strategic planning, pitch participation and broader initiatives that strengthen Burson’s Technology offering.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 6–8 years of experience in public relations or strategic communications, with significant experience supporting technology and/or consumer technology clients. Agency experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading major account workstreams and serving as a trusted client counselor, with the confidence to independently guide client conversations and strategic recommendations.
  • Strong experience developing and leading integrated communications programs for consumer-facing technology products, services, features or launches.
  • Experience across relevant technology sectors such as consumer technology, AI and emerging technologies, digital platforms and services, consumer electronics, gaming, automotive technology or semiconductors.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technology and product information into clear, compelling and consumer-friendly narratives.
  • Strong experience with product communications and launches, including positioning, messaging, earned media strategy and integrated campaign planning.
  • Deep media relations experience and established relationships with relevant technology, business and consumer journalists, paired with strong news judgment and storytelling instincts.
  • Experience developing integrated, 360-degree communications strategies that extend beyond earned media to social, influencer, owned, internal and paid channels.
  • A strong understanding of AI, personalization and emerging technology trends, including the communications opportunities and potential reputational considerations surrounding these technologies.
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders such as product, marketing, legal, trust and safety, social, influencer and communications teams.
  • Demonstrated experience with issues and reputation management, including the judgment to recognize emerging risks, counsel clients appropriately and determine when concerns should be escalated.
  • Strong strategic and creative problem-solving abilities, with the ability to move fluidly between big-picture strategy and the details required for excellent execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of developing compelling narratives and delivering persuasive presentations to senior audiences.
  • Excellent organizational and project leadership skills, with the ability to oversee multiple complex workstreams, teams and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Proven ability to manage, mentor and develop junior and mid-level team members, delegate effectively and maintain accountability for the overall quality of account work.
  • Experience contributing to account growth or new business, including identifying opportunities, developing scopes or proposals and participating in pitches.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and the confidence to form a point of view, make recommendations and challenge thinking constructively.
  • A genuine passion for technology and curiosity about the platforms, products, innovations and cultural trends shaping how people live and communicate.

job.title: Assistant Account Executive, Technology - Burson
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

The stakes in tech storytelling today are higher than ever. Gone are the days of technology simply “saving the world.” The double-edged sword of today’s technologies creates as much reputational risk as reward across diverse stakeholder groups. 

Want to be on the front lines, shaping the narrative for the large-scale innovations that matter? 

With nearly a century of science and state-of-the-art AI to help us understand the changing dynamics of reputation management, Burson is the partner to leading technology companies, crafting stories that resonate, inspire, and drive real impact. We're not about press releases and blogs; we're about building reputations that stand the test of time. 

If you're obsessed with all things tech, love a good challenge, and want to be part of a growing and collaborative team, Burson's US Technology practice is the place for you! 

As an Assistant Account Executive on our growing US Technology team, you'll play a key role in executing impactful integrated communications strategies and programs for both established brands and disruptive startups. We're looking for a strategic and creative individual with a deep curiosity and understanding of the technology landscape and a passion for media relations. If you're a team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is eager to take ownership of client work, and ready to take a big step in your career, this is the opportunity for you! 

What you'll do:

  • Support day-to-day account management by helping coordinate client projects, track deliverables, and communicate with internal teams and vendors.
  • Assist in the development and execution of integrated communications programs, including media relations, thought leadership, creative campaigns, and product launches.
  • Help build media lists and monitor coverage, while learning how to pitch stories to relevant journalists in the technology space.
  • Conduct research on industry trends and competitors to help identify storytelling opportunities and support strategic recommendations.
  • Draft and edit content such as press releases, media alerts, blog posts, and social media copy, with guidance from senior team members.
  • Participate in team brainstorms and contribute creative ideas to support client programs and campaigns.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Internship or 0-1 year of experience in public relations, communications, or a related field – ideally with exposure to the tech industry.
  • A genuine interest for either/both consumer or enterprise technology and ability to "geek out."
  • Past integrated communications experience working with clients, preferably in the technology space
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a keen eye for detail, allowing you to craft compelling narratives and deliver impactful presentations.
  • A proactive and self-motivated approach, demonstrating confidence and a strong presence when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • A highly collaborative spirit and experience and passion for fostering a positive and supportive team environment.
  • Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.

job.title: Associate Director, Influence, 12 month FTC (mat cover) - Burson
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

Burson is building three global Influence & Social Centres of Excellence in the US, Singapore, and London. As part of our UK Centre of Excellence, which serves as the hub for the EMEA region, we are seeking an Associate Director, Influence to play a pivotal, hands-on role in scaling and evolving our Total Influence offer.

This is an exciting opportunity for a mid-to-senior influencer specialist who combines strategic vision with flawless operational execution. Sitting within our multi-disciplinary capability, you will be the day-to-day strategic engine and trusted advisor across all agency practices. You will plan, oversee, and execute best-in-class influencer-led campaigns that earn cultural relevance, protect reputation, and deliver measurable business impact.

As an Influence Associate Director, you will be a dynamic, commercially astute specialist and creative thinker, leading best-in-class, influencer-led content strategies and programmes across all agency sectors. Viewing "influence" holistically, you will provide strategic and practical counsel to clients and internal teams; from identification, vetting, and contracting to creative co-creation, paid integration, and measurement. Partnering with UK head of Influence, you will elevate Burson’s influencer marketing offer, inspire dedicated specialists, and upskill teams to deliver exceptional, measurable results.

What you'll do:

 

Grow: Commercial & Sector Partnership

  • Strategic Influence Partner: Act as a trusted adviser to sector and practice leads, translating client and business briefs into culturally relevant, influencer-led strategies.
  • Commercial & Organic Growth: Partner with the UK Head of Influence and senior teams to develop winning pitches, shape commercial models and identify opportunities to grow influence across existing and new client accounts.
  • Holistic Influence Strategy: Champion a broader view of influence beyond traditional creators, incorporating thought leaders, B2B voices, subject-matter experts and advocates across owned, earned, shared and paid channels.

Enable: Delivery, Operations & Best Practice

  • Best-in-Class Campaign Delivery: Lead end-to-end influencer programmes, from discovery, vetting and contracting through to creator briefing, co-creation, rights management and live campaign delivery.
  • Creative, Paid & Performance Integration: Work closely with creators to deliver authentic, high-quality content while connecting organic influence with paid amplification, licensing, whitelisting and performance marketing opportunities.
  • Governance, Tools & Team Development: Ensure programmes meet ASA, CMA, IP and Burson compliance standards, while embedding tools such as CreatorIQ and GWI and upskilling teams on influencer best practice, cultural trends and effective ways of working.

Transform: Innovation & Modern Measurement

  • Measurement & Impact: Partner with data and intelligence specialists to evolve how influence is measured, moving beyond vanity metrics to demonstrate sentiment, cultural share of voice, reputation shift and conversion.
  • Platform & Innovation Leadership: Build strong relationships with platforms including TikTok, Meta, YouTube and LinkedIn, while testing and embedding AI and emerging capabilities through Burson's AI suite and WPP Open to improve discovery, reporting and workflow efficiency.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Proven Agency Experience: Substantial influencer marketing experience within an agency, PR, or integrated creative environment, operating at Account Director / Junior Associate Director level.
  • Strategic & Creative Rigour: Ability to plan multi-channel content strategies that are influencer-first, with a strong understanding of how audience mapping and data inform creative platforms and creator selection.
  • Negotiation & Contracting Mastery: Deep practical expertise in creator negotiation, complex scope structuring, multi-platform licensing, exclusivity, and contract management.
  • Tech Fluency: Hands-on proficiency with dedicated influencer tech platforms (specifically CreatorIQ) and consumer research tools (such as GWI).
  • Collaborative Leadership: A natural relationship-builder who can seamlessly partner with cross-functional teams (strategy, creative, earned media, paid, data) and mentor junior talent.
  • Client Advisory Skills: Calm, authoritative client-handling skills with the ability to articulate the strategic value of influencer marketing to both senior brand marketers and communications directors.
  • Commercial Acumen: Experience building accurate scopes of work, production budgets, talent fees, and pitch responses that protect agency margins and client ROI.

Burson UK was named Cannes Lions Agency of the year 2026!

job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

We’re looking for a digital specialist with experience in paid media. 

This existing role will report to our Senior Director, Digital. The Digital Specialist will play a key role in supporting digital research, planning, and paid media solutions for our clients. Based in Toronto, you will work within our Digital team, working closely with our practice teams and consultants across Canada to execute digital paid media across social, programmatic, and search.   

The role is perfect for a digital marketing native, someone who has 2-4 years’ experience working hands-on within the social advertising platforms – including Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Google. They will have a proven ability to manage the end-to-end planning and optimization process. They will be responsible for supporting a range of clients and sectors—such as, Consumer, Health, Tech, Public Affairs, and Energy—with a variety of objectives. Experience in SEO and GEO are a bonus.  

Here’s what you’ll be doing: 

You will be responsible for supporting our sector teams and clients throughout the end-to-end campaign management process, including:   

  • Management and/or QA of paid media campaign creation and set-up process for social and digital paid campaigns
  • On-going monitoring, analysis, and optimization of campaign activity
  • Supporting budget reconciliation and finance management, as required
  • Maintain knowledge of industry best practices and new technologies  
  • Research and supporting the development of paid media plans
  • Performance analysis and reporting for social, content, and digital paid media performance 

What you’ll need to get here: 

  • 2-4 years + of hands-on experience setting up, managing and optimizing digital media campaigns for brands – particularly on paid digital and social platforms
  • Agency-side experience is preferable, but in-house experience is also valuable
  • In-depth experience across social platforms – Facebook/Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, SEM, and YouTube (and Google Ads more widely)
  • Web Analytics capabilities is a plus, especially knowledge of GA4 and unpacking acquisition trends
  • Any experience in other areas of digital media (programmatic, paid search, affiliates, SEO, GEO) is preferable, as is any experience in traditional media channels  
  • High attention to detail
  • Experience delivering client service excellence
  • Capability to problem solve; Have a highly numerical and analytical approach

Burson Creative:

You’ll be joining a creative team that’s been recognized with Cannes Lions, Clios, One Show, New York Festivals, SABER, and PRWeek awards, but more importantly, a team that’s curious, collaborative, and constantly pushing each other to do work that earns attention.

The Creative team works across the full Burson client roster to ideate, develop, and produce earned-first campaigns, building original ideas that cut through culture not just the noise. Our work connects people and brands by digging deeper, imagining more, and creating campaigns and content designed to live anywhere and travel everywhere.

We’ve intentionally brought together a mix of designers, writers, producers, and creators from different backgrounds, cultures, and points of view, because better work comes from diverse voices challenging each other.

We’re looking for people who love what they do, value different perspectives, and are excited to roll up their sleeves to help push our creative even further.

Check out our latest work here. https://www.bursonglobal.com/locations/us/creative-careers-at-burson-us

More about the role:

We are seeking a sharp, multi-talented Copy and Content Executive to join our TWITCH Lab. This hybrid role bridges strategic intelligence and high-impact copywriting, determining where AI can help build quick-turn content solves for real client reputational challenges and writing the critical copy that protects and elevates brand value. 

In this role, you will partner with team members who are analyzing real-time listening data, sentiment trends, and emerging reputational risks to craft and produce tailored messaging across fragmented stakeholder groups (media, employees, investors, regulators, consumers). Utilizing generative AI language models and prompt engineering, you will rapidly generate narrative options and build comprehensive, cross platform content at the speed of reputation. 

What you'll do:

AI-Driven Strategy & Intelligence Integration 

  • Translate Data into Copy: Interpret real-time media monitoring, sentiment analysis, and intelligence inputs to craft compelling copy and content. 
  • Identify AI Use Cases: Proactively identify where AI tools can accelerate strategic analysis, message customization, and audience-targeted content for clients in need of quick-turn solutions. 

Copywriting & Content Development 

  • Content and Copy Writing: Write clear, authoritative, and persuasive copy for largely digital content executions. 
  • Multi-Channel Adaptation: In partnership with account teams, tailor content for specific audiences (investors, internal employees, public media, regulators) while maintaining core brand voice consistency. 
  • AI-Assisted Drafting: Utilize AI writing platforms and customized prompts to rapidly draft, iterate, and create content options within time-challenged environments. 

Collaboration & Quality Control 

  • Accuracy & Tone Ownership: Ensure all written materials adhere to strict brand guidelines, nuance, legal standards, and facts. 
  • Cross-Disciplinary Partnership: Work closely with the Creative Director, designers, and account leads to ensure strategy seamlessly informs visual execution. 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 3-5+ years of experience in corporate copywriting, strategic planning, or PR communications within an agency or corporate environment. 
  • AI Prompting & Writing Mastery: Demonstrated expertise using generative AI text tools (ChatGPT, Claude, WPP Open tools) to accelerate research, brainstorming, and copy generation. Political campaign experience is considered an advantage in this role. 
  • Exceptional Writing and Design Skills: Proven ability to craft flawless, nuanced, and persuasive copy and content under tight deadlines. 
  • Data & Sentiment Savvy: Comfort working with media listening data, sentiment tools, and audience insights to inform creative briefs. 
  • Agile Communicator: Strong presentation skills and the ability to articulate complex strategic rationale clearly to internal and client stakeholders.

job.title: Corporate Communications Intern
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

Ready to skip the typical intern coffee runs and jump straight into work that actually matters? At Burson, we don’t just “do PR” – we shape conversations, influence behaviours, protect reputations, and build campaigns that spark change across social, digital, and traditional channels – in Canada and globally. We're all about smart strategy, real impact, and an international network of thinkers, doers, and game-changers.

This is an existing opportunity to join our team as a Corporate Affairs Intern – someone curious, creative, proactive, and genuinely excited about the intersection of business, reputation and current affairs.

In this paid internship role, you’ll work alongside experienced corporate communications and advisory professionals supporting clients across a variety of industries, including financial and professional services, energy and technology. From monitoring and analysis and media relations to stakeholder engagement and thought leadership, you'll gain hands-on experience helping organizations tell their stories and build trust with their audiences.

This isn’t just an internship – it’s a launchpad into a career in corporate communications.

Annual Compensation: C$38,462, plus applicable vacation pay

What you’ll be doing (and probably have a blast doing):

  • Developing client-ready deliverables including media lists, pitches, stakeholder maps, meeting agendas and summaries, briefing notes, media monitoring and social listening analysis reports
  • Assisting with media relations in support of client announcements focusing on business, news and trade media
  • Conducting research on companies, industries, competitors and current affairs to support client work and new business opportunities
  • Bringing your big ideas to brainstorms and planning meetings
  • Becoming our trend and news spotter – tracking business news, industry developments, emerging issues, and online conversations, and sharing relevant insights with the team and clients

One day you might be supporting a major corporate announcement or helping position a subject-matter expert as an industry voice. The next? You’re tracking a news announcement, pitching journalists or researching an emerging reputational issue. No two days are the same – promise.

What makes you a great fit:

  • You’re a recent graduate in public relations, journalism, business, political science, or a related field
  • You thrive in fast-moving environments and juggle deadlines with ease
  • You have strong writing and research skills and excellent attention to detail (typos tremble in your presence)
  • You’re proactive, curious, and ready to take initiative
  • You’re curious about the world around you – business, current affairs, crisis communications, issues management, corporate reputation
  • You enjoy meeting new people, learning from others, and building your network
  • You’re interested in understanding how organizations communicate with their internal and external audiences to build and manage reputation

Why Burson Is That Internship:

  • Work with leading organizations across a variety of industries
  • Get mentorship from people who are excited to see you flourish, grow, and learn
  • Build a portfolio that makes future-you proud
  • Join a team that’s ambitious, collaborative, and genuinely fun
  • Gain exposure to corporate communications, reputation management, media relations, executive positioning, and integrated communications
  • Be part of a global network of communications experts and learn how strategic communications shape businesses and society

If you’re looking for an opportunity to do great work with great people – and make your mark in the corporate affairs and communications space – we’d love to hear from you.

More about the role:

We are seeking a visionary and agile AI-enabled Creative Director to lead the creative direction for our newly concepted TWITCH LAB—an AI-enabled creative rapid-response capability dedicated to quick turn demands of creative assets requested by our clients. While many of the executions will lean toward digital content and story-telling in the corporate and crisis communication space, the North Star will be able building reputation enhancing content that can move at the speed of machine. Done well, this work will begin to redefine how corporate storytelling can be produced, blending cutting-edge generative AI tools with high-impact human craft. 

As the creative lead of the LAB, you will oversee the conceptualization and execution of quick-turn asset development that could range from ad-like digital content to quick-turn executive videos meant for internal employee campaigns, to infographics to help debunk disinformation in real-time and other multi-channel disciplines. You will partner closely with our senior most account leads, clients, strategic intelligence leads (data and intelligence team members), and extensions of our creative team to create and execute reputation driving content.
