job.title: Data Engineer, Communications Intelligence & Insights
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More About the Role

 

Are you interested in building the systems that underpin how modern communications intelligence is measured, analysed and scaled?

Burson’s EMEA Intelligence & Insights Hub is a centralised production and engineering capability responsible for developing the data infrastructure, pipelines and workflows that power monitoring, measurement and reporting across the region. Bringing together engineers and analysts, the Hub builds scalable platforms, integrates multiple external data sources and develops AI-enabled workflows that enhance both the efficiency and quality of intelligence delivery.

As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in developing, maintaining and optimising the engineering systems that sit at the heart of the Hub’s delivery model. You will work across core platform engineering, client-specific solutions and AI workflow development, helping to evolve The Fount and Burson’s wider Data & Intelligence technology stack.

Our technology ecosystem is built on a modern, highly integrated cloud and relational database architecture. Core data-processing pipelines are developed using object-oriented Python and run through scalable cloud-compute orchestration and enterprise ETL tools. Managed SQL environments provide our relational system of record, while raw and semi-structured assets are maintained within secure cloud object storage.

Advanced language models are integrated directly into our processing pipelines to automate enrichment at scale, with the wider ecosystem managed through GitHub, Azure DevOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.

This is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys solving complex data challenges while building reliable, scalable and reusable systems that support analysts, client teams and global stakeholders.

 

What you'll do:

 

  • Build, develop and maintain Burson’s core data platform and pipelines, supporting scalable ingestion, transformation, storage and delivery of intelligence data across the EMEA Hub.
  • Design and manage robust ingestion pipelines for media monitoring, social listening, APIs, internal datasets and third-party research and analytics sources.
  • Develop transformation and data-modelling layers using SQL and Python, creating both standardised central data models and bespoke client datasets that support downstream reporting, including Power BI.
  • Design and deliver client-specific data engineering solutions, developing custom pipelines, integrations and datasets where off-the-shelf technology does not meet complex or specialist requirements.
  • Optimise the performance, scalability and reliability of data systems, identifying bottlenecks, resolving data-quality issues and continuously improving pipeline efficiency.
  • Develop reusable engineering frameworks, templates and components that enable the Hub to scale solutions consistently across clients, markets and use cases.
  • Contribute to AI-enabled workflows, embedding language models into data pipelines to automate content analysis, classification, tagging, summarisation, relevance, sentiment and other enrichment processes.
  • Develop and refine prompting frameworks and AI-processing workflows, including monitoring and optimising token usage to ensure effective, efficient and commercially sustainable AI enrichment at scale.
  • Partner with analysts, product teams and communications specialists to translate approved business and reporting requirements into clearly defined technical solutions and identify appropriate opportunities for AI and automation.
  • Work within a structured Agile and ticket-driven engineering environment, contributing to sprint planning, daily stand-ups and technical design discussions while delivering against agreed functional specifications and architectural standards.
  • Maintain strong engineering governance and security standards, including consistent code practices, Git workflows, secure credential management, database security and adherence to agreed directory and repository structures.
  • Own high-quality technical documentation, maintaining clear technical guides, markdown documentation, database schemas and system records while contributing to planned refactoring and technical-debt reduction without disrupting production services.

 

 

Experience that contributes to success:

 

  • Strong experience in data engineering, with a track record of designing, building and maintaining reliable production-grade data pipelines and platforms.
  • Advanced SQL skills and strong experience in relational database environments, including data transformation, modelling, optimisation and the creation of data structures for downstream analytics and reporting.
  • Strong Python development capability, including writing clean, readable and object-oriented code, working with pandas and developing concurrent or scalable data-processing workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with APIs, data integrations and ETL/ELT architectures, with the ability to bring together structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources.
  • Experience working within cloud-based data environments, ideally Microsoft Azure, including cloud compute, managed databases, object storage and enterprise data-processing services.
  • Strong software-engineering discipline, including experience designing and writing automated unit, integration and regression tests in Python, ideally using pytest.
  • A strong understanding of secure engineering practices, including database security, firewalls and secure secrets and credential management using tools such as Azure Key Vault.
  • Experience with Git-based engineering workflows and CI/CD environments, ideally including GitHub and Azure DevOps, with an appreciation for structured branching, code governance and multi-developer environments.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code, ideally Terraform or Terragrunt, and the ability to safely manage or update environment variables, configuration and access controls within established infrastructure frameworks.
  • Experience or strong interest in AI-enabled data engineering, including exposure to large language models, prompt-based workflows, automated enrichment or the integration of AI services into production data pipelines.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and technical-planning skills, with the ability to diagnose complex data and performance issues, scope engineering work effectively and build scalable solutions rather than short-term fixes.
  • A collaborative and disciplined approach to engineering, comfortable working across multiple projects with analysts, engineers, product teams and business stakeholders while maintaining strong documentation, continuous improvement and adherence to agreed technical standards.

Burson (daw. Hill & Knowlton) to globalny lider w dziedzinie komunikacji. Opis stanowiska:

Interesujesz się biznesem, gospodarką i tematami, które wpływają na funkcjonowanie firm i całych branż? Śledzisz aktualne wydarzenia, rozumiesz zależności pomiędzy biznesem, regulacjami i opinią publiczną? Chcesz pracować dla firm, które kształtują rynek w obszarach takich jak zdrowie, energetyka, przemysł, technologie czy nowoczesne usługi? Dołącz do nas!

Poszukujemy osoby na stanowisko Junior Account Executive, która będzie wspierać zespół w realizacji działań z zakresu komunikacji korporacyjnej, relacji z mediami, komunikacji eksperckiej oraz budowania reputacji marek i organizacji. To rola dla osoby, która ma już pierwsze doświadczenie w komunikacji lub PR i chce dalej rozwijać się pod opieką bardziej doświadczonego zespołu.

Pracujemy dla klientów reprezentujących różne sektory gospodarki, w tym m.in. finanse, technologie, healthcare, e-commerce.

Więcej informacji o nas znajdziesz na naszej stronie internetowej.

Oferujemy:

  • Pracę w jednej z największych i najbardziej utytułowanych agencji PR w Polsce i na świecie
  • Hybrydowy model pracy
  • Dostęp do pakietu narzędzi generative AI (abonament na najnowsze wersje najpopularniejszych rozwiązań)
  • Medicover
    • W pełni finansowany pakiet medyczny dla pracowników
    • Możliwość odpłatnego rozszerzenia pakietu dla bliskich
  • Platformę benefitową z kafeterią (w tym Medicover Sport)
  • Jasną ścieżkę kariery, możliwość rozwoju w ramach globalnych i lokalnych szkoleń. Więcej na ten temat przeczytasz w zakładce Kariera na naszej stronie.
  • Wsparcie Twojego dobrostanu psychicznego.
    • Bezpłatna infolinia psychologiczna dla pracowników i ich rodzin 24/7
    • 10 konsultacji rocznie u specjalistów: psycholog, psychiatra, psychoterapeuta
  • Pracę w nowoczesnym biurze w tętniącym życiem Centrum Praskim Koneser
  • 6000-6500 PLN brutto / mies.

Zakres obowiązków:

  • Realizacja działań dla klientów agencji (m.in. tworzenie tekstów, monitoring mediów, kontakt z mediami, pomoc przy organizacji wydarzeń, przygotowywanie rekomendacji oraz kontakt z podwykonawcami)
  • Przygotowywanie raportów, zestawień i prostych analiz danych
  • Wsparcie zespołu w przygotowywaniu rekomendacji i strategii komunikacji
  • Wsparcie przy przygotowywaniu ofert przetargowych i działaniach z zakresu business development
  • Budowanie relacji i współpraca z dziennikarzami, liderami opinii oraz influencerami

Nasze wymagania:

  • Minimum rok doświadczenia zawodowego w zakresie komunikacji / public relations / tworzenia treści do mediów (doświadczenie po stronie agencji PR będzie dodatkowym atutem)
  • Wykształcenie wyższe lub w trakcie studiów
  • Dobra znajomość rynku mediów, ze szczególnym uwzględnieniem mediów biznesowych i branżowych
  • Zainteresowanie biznesem, gospodarką i aktualnymi trendami rynkowymi
  • Proaktywna postawa - wychodzenie z inicjatywą do zespołu i gotowość do uczenia się
  • Umiejętność analizowania informacji i wyciągania z nich wniosków
  • Lekkie pióro i posługiwanie się poprawną polszczyzną
  • Bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego (na poziomie min. B2) - warunek konieczny, poziom językowy sprawdzamy podczas rozmowy rekrutacyjnej

Jak wygląda rekrutacja:

  • Do wybranych kandydatów zadzwoni nasza Talent & Culture Managerka
  • Po rozmowie telefonicznej umawiamy się na spotkanie – stacjonarnie w biurze (mamy pyszną kawę!) lub przez Teams
  • Spotkanie odbywa się w gronie kandydat + HR + manager. Chcemy dać Ci możliwość poznania naszej kultury pracy i dowiedzenia się więcej o tym, jak się u nas pracuje. Nie bój się pytać o to, co jest dla Ciebie ważne!
  • Krótkie zadanie rekrutacyjne – nie martw się, nie zajmie dużo czasu, ale pomoże nam lepiej zrozumieć Twoje kompetencje praktyczne
  • Po zakończeniu rozmów, na pewno damy Ci znać o naszej decyzji

#LI-AK1 

Twoja przyszłość jest w Burson:

Naszą wizją jest, aby Burson stał się wiodącą firmą, swoistą „akademią” dla specjalistów od komunikacji kreatywnej i przyszłych liderów. Oferujemy dynamiczne środowisko pracy, w którym ambitni ludzie mogą rozwijać swoje umiejętności, poszerzać sieć kontaktów i tworzyć najlepsze rozwiązania dla czołowych marek. Nasze zaangażowanie w Twój rozwój przejawia się w bogatym pakiecie benefitów i programach rozwoju, obejmujących m.in. szkolenia, programy mentoringowe z liderami branży, a także inkluzywną kulturę organizacyjną, sprzyjającą współpracy i innowacjom. Nasze systemy wynagradzania są zaprojektowane tak, by doceniać najlepsze talenty. Inwestujemy w naszych ludzi, ponieważ wierzymy, że ich sukces jest naszym sukcesem.

W Burson różnorodność, równość i integracja to nie tylko wartości – to strategiczne imperatywy, budujące naszą przyszłość w branży opartej na sztuce rozumienia, współpracy i rozwijania relacji. Wierzymy, że różnorodność talentów gwarantuje odważne pomysły i konstruktywny dialog, wspiera innowacje i kreatywność. To właśnie ona pozwala nam na nieustanny rozwój i świadczenie usług najwyższej jakości. Twój unikalny punkt widzenia – Twój talent – czyni Cię #BursonPerson i pozwala nam razem tworzyć coś wyjątkowego dla naszych klientów.

Po wysłaniu aplikacji, podane przez Ciebie informacje zostaną wysłane do Burson. Zanim to zrobisz, naszym zdaniem warto zapoznać się z naszą Informacją o przetwarzaniu danych osobowych.

Poniżej podajemy orientacyjny zakres wynagrodzenia brutto na tym stanowisku w momencie publikacji ogłoszenia. Przedział ten odzwierciedla ramy wynagrodzeń obowiązujące w całej naszej globalnej grupie, obejmujące różnorodne Agencje i specjalizacje. W przypadku tej konkretnej roli, nasza propozycja wynagrodzenia zostanie ustalona w ramach wskazanego zakresu, w oparciu o nasze wewnętrzne wytyczne oraz z uwzględnieniem specyficznych warunków rynkowych dla naszej specjalizacji. Ostateczna wysokość indywidualnego wynagrodzenia zależy od wielu czynników związanych z danym stanowiskiem, m.in.: bieżących potrzeb biznesowych, posiadanego doświadczenia, poziomu odpowiedzialności oraz kwalifikacji.

 

Oprócz podanego przedziału wynagrodzeń, oferujemy kompleksowy pakiet benefitów, mający na celu dbanie o Wellbeing naszych pracowników jak i ich rozwój zawodowy. W zależności od Agencji mogą występować różnice w zakresie benefitów, lecz typowe świadczenia obejmują: prywatną opiekę medyczną, możliwości rozwoju zawodowego, programy szkoleniowe oraz elastyczne warunki pracy (w stosownych przypadkach / jeśli jest to możliwe). We´re always on the lookout for spectacular talent. Currently at Burson we are looking for a Senior Creative Copywriter to join our Strategy & Creative team in Madrid or Barcelona.

What you’ll do:

  • Come up with earned-first concepts, campaigns, activations and content for clients across different sectors.
  • Write a lot – and well – across formats: copy, claims, manifestos, scripts, presentations and whatever else the idea requires.
  • Partner closely with the Head of Strategy & Creative and our team of makers to bring creative thinking to teams and projects across the agency.
  • Get involved in new business processes from the start, helping shape the creative response from the client brief all the way to the final presentation.
  • Spot and develop proactive opportunities for existing clients, turning ideas into work that can be sold in and brought to life.
  • Bring fresh ideas, references, creative judgment and practical solutions to the agency’s everyday work.
  • Present and defend ideas with energy and conviction, both internally and with clients.
  • Help us build a stronger creative culture and raise the ambition of the work across the agency.

 

What will contribute to your success:

  • 4-6 years of experience in a creative, PR, social or integrated agency. Your exact background matters less than the quality of your thinking, writing and ideas.
  • Excellent spoken and written Spanish and strong level of English.
  • A real command of words combined with visual sensitivity and the ability to think beyond copy.
  • Curiosity about earned media, influence and integrated communications, especially if you come from a more traditional advertising background.

We are looking for an ambitious, commercially minded Senior Marketing Manager to help Burson drive visibility, relevance and connection to the clients and prospects we most want to work with.

Sitting at the heart of the UK Growth Team, this is a high-profile role working closely with the Chief Growth Officer and senior leaders across the business. You will help further Burson’s momentum in the UK having been named Cannes Lions Agency of the year 2026, turning our best thinking, expertise, people and client work into marketing that builds our reputation, creates demand and opens doors.

You will be responsible for growing Burson's reputation and visibility in the market, strengthening engagement with priority audiences and building marketing programmes that support our growth ambitions across all areas of our business.

We are looking for someone with ideas, energy and excellent judgement. Someone who understands what makes senior decision-makers pay attention, knows how to turn complex expertise into compelling stories and can mobilise a busy organisation behind a great idea.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and deliver a focused UK marketing strategy that builds brand awareness, distinctiveness and demand, aligned with business and growth priorities.
  • Strengthen Burson’s profile among priority clients, prospects, industry influencers, business leaders and future talent, positioning us as a modern strategic advisory partner.
  • Build a distinctive thought leadership and editorial programme, turning our expertise, insights, data and senior counsel into timely and compelling content across multiple channels.
  • Identify key moments across the business, media and cultural agenda where Burson can lead the conversation, mobilising experts and building the external profiles of senior leaders.
  • Create an engaging events and experiences programme, including briefings, roundtables, webinars and partnerships that deepen relationships with clients and prospects.
  • Showcase Burson’s best work through case studies, credentials, awards and external storytelling, increasing visibility and recognition for our people, expertise and client impact.
  • Build a modern, high-performing marketing engine, using AI, automation, media intelligence, data and measurement to make marketing faster, smarter and more effective.
  • Partner closely with UK leadership, Growth, practices, capabilities and the EMEA Marketing Team to maximise commercial impact, amplify regional and global programmes, and share the best of Burson UK across the wider network.

Experience that contributes to success:

We're looking for an ambitious marketer who combines the instincts of a marketer, editor and connector, and who likes making things happen.

You'll bring:

  • A strong track record in B2B or professional-services marketing, ideally within strategic communications, consulting, creative, technology or another expertise-led business.
  • Evidence that you have helped build a brand, audience or market position, rather than simply managed marketing activity.
  • Experience developing and delivering high-impact thought leadership, content and integrated marketing programmes.
  • Excellent editorial judgement. You know what makes an interesting point of view, what will engage an external audience and what won't.
  • Outstanding writing and storytelling skills, with an ability to turn complex ideas into clear, engaging narratives.
  • Commercial instinct and an understanding of the relationship between reputation, relationships, marketing and new business.
  • Confidence working with senior leaders, including the ability to advise, influence and challenge constructively.
  • A strong understanding of AI-enabled marketing, together with curiosity about how emerging technology can improve insight, creativity, personalisation, productivity and measurement.
  • Strong knowledge of the communications, marketing and wider business landscape, with a natural curiosity about what's happening in the world.
  • A proactive approach to building external relationships with industry influencers, partners, media stakeholders and senior decision-makers.
  • A bias for action. You spot opportunities, bring ideas and make them happen.
  • High standards and exceptional attention to detail, without allowing perfection to get in the way of momentum.
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to bring people together across Growth, practices, capabilities, creative teams and regional marketing colleagues.

What success looks like

You will help create a Burson UK that feels impossible to ignore: sharper in the market, faster into important conversations and better at turning our expertise into reputation, relationships and growth.

Success will mean:

  • greater visibility and distinctiveness for Burson amongst priority audiences;
  • stronger engagement with the clients and prospects we most want to reach;
  • a recognisable and consistent flow of distinctive Burson attitude, thinking and expertise into the market;
  • greater visibility for our senior experts and our best client work;
  • marketing programmes, content and experiences that create meaningful conversations and support growth; and
  • a faster, smarter and more measurable marketing operation.

This is an opportunity to help shape not simply how Burson markets itself in the UK, but how the market sees Burson and what we are capable of.

Burson Creative:

You’ll be joining a creative team that’s been recognized with Cannes Lions, Clios, One Show, New York Festivals, SABER, and PRWeek awards, but more importantly, a team that’s curious, collaborative, and constantly pushing each other to do work that earns attention.

The Creative team works across the full Burson client roster to ideate, develop, and produce earned-first campaigns, building original ideas that cut through culture not just the noise. Our work connects people and brands by digging deeper, imagining more, and creating campaigns and content designed to live anywhere and travel everywhere.

We’ve intentionally brought together a mix of designers, writers, producers, and creators from different backgrounds, cultures, and points of view, because better work comes from diverse voices challenging each other.

We’re looking for people who love what they do, value different perspectives, and are excited to roll up their sleeves to help push our creative even further.

Check out our latest work here. https://www.bursonglobal.com/locations/us/creative-careers-at-burson-us

More about the role:

We are seeking a highly organized, operational powerhouse to serve as Senior Producer/Editor PM for our TWITCH LAB. In this pivotal role, you will own the business operations, client workflow, resource allocation, and project delivery for our AI-enabled rapid-response studio. 

You will manage the end-to-end client experience—navigating strict hour-0 to hour-24 turnaround windows during reputational threats. By bridging account leads, creative specialists, legal/governance partners, and AI platforms, you will ensure seamless production, accurate scoping, and flawless execution across all studio engagements. 

What you'll do:

Rapid-Response Production & Workflow Management 

  • Spearhead Lab Operations: Manage intake, project scoping, production schedules, and asset delivery pipeline for all Twitch LAB projects. 
  • Full Content Lifecycle Execution: Drive the rapid-response workflow from initial requests to assessment, draft optioning, legal sign-off, and final deployment. 
  • Tool & Platform Management: Oversee project tracking tools (Asana), review platforms (Frame.io, Vimeo), and asset archives, establishing file management and taxonomy standards for the studio. 

Client & Financial Ownership 

  • Account & Client Interface: Serve as the primary operational contact for account leads and clients, clarifying briefs, setting turnaround expectations, and managing scope. 
  • Budgeting & Forecasting: Develop budget estimates, track project utilization, manage out-of-pocket costs, and report financial projections to department leadership. Eventually create best-practice around financial stewardship of this type of creative work and delivery through trial and error across the first 6-8 months of executions. 

Team Leadership & Governance Integration 

  • Resource Optimization: Staff and assign creative and technical talent to incoming briefs, balancing internal core studio resources with shared agency specialists. 
  • Governance Gatekeeper: Ensure legal, IP, security, and synthetic media disclosures are integrated directly into the production workflow without delaying deployment. 
  • Process Evolution: Partner with Creative Operations leads to continually refine studio processes, standard operating procedures, and turnaround benchmarks. 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 8+ years of experience in creative project management, agency production, or studio operations within a fast-paced environment. 
  • Agile Workflow Expertise: Proven ability to manage rapid-turnaround video, design, and copy projects under tight deadlines and crisis conditions. 
  • Technical Proficiency: High command of project management and asset platforms (Asana, Frame.io, Vimeo, Adobe Creative Cloud workflows, Microsoft Office Suite). 
  • Financial & Scoping Acumen: Strong track record of scoping complex projects, building accurate estimates, and tracking financial performance. 
  • Client & Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication skills with the ability to maintain calm, authoritative leadership when dealing with senior stakeholders during high-pressure situations. 
  • Resourceful Problem Solver: Highly detail-oriented, adaptable, and proactive in solving logistical or operational roadblocks.

job.title: Senior Vice President, Corporate Affairs, Health Policy - Burson
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

Burson is seeking a Senior Vice President, Health Policy and Public Affairs, to lead one of the agency's most strategically important global healthcare accounts.

This role serves as the senior strategic counselor to client leadership across a portfolio of marketed and pipeline therapies in neurology and rare disease. The EVP will lead multidisciplinary teams responsible for patient advocacy engagement, access and reimbursement policy, stakeholder mobilization, executive visibility, corporate reputation and issues management.

The successful candidate will possess deep healthcare public affairs expertise, exceptional stakeholder engagement experience, and a strong understanding of the evolving policy, regulatory, reimbursement and market access environment impacting innovative medicines globally.

This leader will work at the intersection of science, policy, patient need and reputation, helping shape conversations among patient organizations, professional societies, policymakers, healthcare providers, caregivers and advocacy stakeholders while ensuring communications and engagement strategies support both long-term corporate reputation objectives and product-related priorities.

The ideal candidate combines the strategic instincts of a public affairs leader, the stakeholder expertise of a patient advocacy professional, and the business acumen of a senior agency executive. They are equally comfortable discussing healthcare policy with government stakeholders, scientific innovation with medical leaders, reputation strategy with the C-suite and patient priorities with advocacy organizations.

Most importantly, they understand how policy, science, access, patient advocacy and reputation intersect, and can help global healthcare organizations navigate that complexity to create meaningful impact for patients, caregivers and society.

This Hybrid role is ideally based in New York and Washington DC. 

What you'll do:

Strategic Client Leadership

  • Serve as senior strategic counselor to global and regional client leadership teams.
  • Lead integrated public affairs, corporate reputation and stakeholder engagement programs across neurology and rare disease portfolios.
  • Shape strategic communications approaches that connect policy, patient advocacy, access and reputation objectives into a cohesive narrative.
  • Develop executive-level recommendations informed by evolving healthcare, political, reimbursement and regulatory environments.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for complex business, reputation and policy challenges.

Public Affairs, Policy & Access Leadership

  • Lead policy and advocacy strategies addressing market access, affordability, reimbursement and healthcare system priorities.
  • Counsel clients on emerging U.S., European and global policy developments affecting innovative medicines.
  • Monitor and advise on pricing, reimbursement and trade-related policy developments, including initiatives such as Most Favored Nation (MFN) pricing models, international reference pricing and healthcare cost-containment efforts.
  • Translate complex policy developments into impactful engagement and communications strategies.
  • Partner with policy experts, economists and scientific leaders to develop evidence-based advocacy initiatives.

Patient Advocacy & Stakeholder Relations

  • Build and strengthen relationships with patient organizations, advocacy coalitions, caregivers, healthcare professional associations and disease community leaders.
  • Design and implement engagement strategies that elevate patient perspectives throughout the disease lifecycle.
  • Identify opportunities for trusted partnerships that advance awareness, access, education and health outcomes.
  • Guide stakeholder mapping and influence strategies across advocacy, policy and medical communities.
  • Ensure patient-centered engagement approaches are integrated across all programs.

Neurology & Rare Disease Expertise

  • Provide strategic counsel across brain health, neuroscience and rare disease areas.
  • Help clients advance a more integrated and holistic view of brain health that addresses patient outcomes, access, caregiver needs, public awareness and policy considerations.
  • Develop reputation and thought leadership platforms supporting both established therapies and future innovation.
  • Counsel clients on scientific milestones, breakthrough therapies, disease awareness efforts and emerging healthcare trends.
  • Support launch readiness and lifecycle communications for pipeline and marketed assets.

Issues & Reputation Management

  • Lead proactive reputation management and complex issues preparedness initiatives.
  • Develop risk assessments, scenario planning exercises and stakeholder response frameworks.

The EVP will lead multidisciplinary teams responsible for patient advocacy engagement, access and reimbursement policy, stakeholder mobilization, executive visibility, corporate reputation and issues management.

The successful candidate will possess deep healthcare public affairs expertise, exceptional stakeholder engagement experience, and a strong understanding of the evolving policy, regulatory, reimbursement and market access environment impacting innovative medicines globally.

This leader will work at the intersection of science, policy, patient need and reputation, helping shape conversations among patient organizations, professional societies, policymakers, healthcare providers, caregivers and advocacy stakeholders while ensuring communications and engagement strategies support both long-term corporate reputation objectives and product-related priorities.

The ideal candidate combines the strategic instincts of a public affairs leader, the stakeholder expertise of a patient advocacy professional, and the business acumen of a senior agency executive. They are equally comfortable discussing healthcare policy with government stakeholders, scientific innovation with medical leaders, reputation strategy with the C-suite and patient priorities with advocacy organizations.

Most importantly, they understand how policy, science, access, patient advocacy and reputation intersect, and can help global healthcare organizations navigate that complexity to create meaningful impact for patients, caregivers and society.

This Hybrid role is ideally based in New York and Washington DC.

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Hoe versterken we de reputatie van één van de grootste werkgevers van Nederland? Welke influencers schakelen we in bij een lancering van een nieuw product? Hoe zorgen we dat de onze klant goed in de media komt? Als jouw hart sneller gaat kloppen van deze vragen, dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen?

Stage lopen bij Burson betekent dat je meteen veel verantwoordelijkheden krijgt. Als stagiair maak je écht onderdeel uit van ons team en word je zoveel mogelijk betrokken bij verschillende activiteiten.

Je werkt nauw samen met je collega’s aan opdrachten voor merken zoals SharkNinja, Jaguar Land Rover en Procter & Gamble (o.a. Gillette, Always en Olay). Afhankelijk van de klanten in jouw portfolio ondersteun je bijvoorbeeld bij andere inhoudelijke taken als het verzamelen van relevante informatie, het maken van media-, concurrentie- of stakeholderanalyses, het meedenken over de invulling van nieuwe social media- of influencer-campagnes en het creëren van content voor verschillende kanalen. Er wordt hard gewerkt in de diverse klantteams, maar de werksfeer is open, informeel en eigen initiatief wordt zeer gewaardeerd!

Wie zijn wij? 

Burson staat voor strategie en communicatie, met adviseurs die door opdrachtgevers worden ingeschakeld als het er echt om gaat. Wij helpen bedrijven en organisaties in de meest uiteenlopende en vaak uitdagende omstandigheden, waarbij wij ze adviseren in hun transities en transformaties. Met het creëren van stakeholderacceptatie als doel. Nooit om de status quo te beschermen, niet om op elke hype in te gaan, maar om ze met een gegronde strategie toekomstbestendig te maken.

Onze adviseurs zijn met hun brede ervaring, vakmanschap en integriteit erkende boardroompartners. Onafhankelijk en kritisch zetten zij de discussie met onze opdrachtgevers op scherp. Burson heeft jarenlange ervaring in het adviseren van bedrijven in complexe situaties, onder meer op het gebied van strategie, stakeholdermanagement en geloofwaardige communicatie.

We zijn onderdeel van Burson Group, een internationaal communicatiebureau bestaande uit een groot netwerk met meer dan 95 kantoren in ruim 40 landen. Samen maken wij onderdeel uit van WPP: het grootste marketing- en communicatiebedrijf ter wereld. Sinds 2019 zijn wij onder één dak gevestigd op onze Amsteldok-campus in Amsterdam. Daarnaast hebben wij in Nederland ook een kantoor in Den Haag.

Wie ben jij?

Heb jij je altijd al afgevraagd hoe het is om stage te lopen bij een internationaal communicatiebureau? Ben je goed op de hoogte van het laatste nieuws? Weet je je weg te vinden in de onlinewereld? Ben je communicatief vaardig, leergierig en stel je altijd de juiste vragen? Dan past deze stage perfect bij jou.

Je staat open voor nieuwe ideeën en opvattingen, bent breed geïnteresseerd en zoekt graag dingen tot op de bodem uit. Bij ons zijn studenten van alle studieachtergronden welkom die geïnteresseerd zijn in communicatie, marketing en media.

Wat bieden wij?

Tijdens je stage ontvang je een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van €650 (gebaseerd op een volledige werkweek) en word je begeleid door twee collega’s. Elke maand heb je een coachingsgesprek over je eigen ambities en wensen. Halverwege je stage is er een tussentijds feedbackgesprek waarin genoeg ruimte is om aan te geven wat je nog meer uit je stage wil halen. Daarnaast kun je altijd terecht bij andere Young Professionals (trainees), consultants en senior-adviseurs met vragen. Tenslotte worden je reiskosten vergoed en is het mogelijk om op vrijdagen  vanuit huis te werken.

Enthousiast?

Solliciteer dan via onderstaande link!

Je kunt solliciteren t/m 1 december. De gesprekken zullen dan in de weken erna plaatsvinden. De startdatum van de stage is flexibel, maar idealiter 1 februari. 

Vragen? Neem contact op met Lauren: lauren.vanriessen@bursonglobal.com

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Stage Public Affairs bij Burson

Wil jij ervaring opdoen op het snijvlak van politiek, media, bestuur en bedrijfsleven?

Burson staat voor strategie en communicatie, met adviseurs die door opdrachtgevers worden ingeschakeld als het er echt om gaat. Met ons ervaren team van specialisten opereren we op hoog strategisch niveau en helpen we bedrijven en organisaties door de meest complexe situaties: van het versterken of beschermen van reputaties tot het inspelen op veranderende wetgeving, het agenderen van politieke thema’s, het begeleiden van fusies en overnames, productintroducties of crisiscommunicatie. We zijn onderdeel van Burson Group, een internationaal communicatiebureau bestaande uit een groot netwerk met meer dan 95 kantoren in ruim 40 landen. Samen maken wij onderdeel uit van WPP: het grootste marketing- en communicatiebedrijf ter wereld. Sinds 2019 zijn wij onder één dak gevestigd op onze Amsteldok-campus in Amsterdam. Daarnaast hebben wij in Nederland ook een kantoor in Den Haag.

Public Affairs bij Burson is veel meer dan lobbyen op het Binnenhof. In de huidige mediacratie wordt beleid steeds vaker beïnvloed door publieke opinie en politieke sentimenten. Hierdoor verschuift de macht: niet alleen overheid en markt bepalen de agenda, maar ook de samenleving zelf.  Onze adviseurs helpen organisaties om in te spelen op deze dynamiek: maatschappelijke trends signaleren, draagvlak creëren bij uiteenlopende stakeholders, en strategieën ontwikkelen die zowel politiek als publiek overtuigen.

Als geïntegreerd communicatieadviesbureau weten wij hoe we Public Affairs versterken met slimme PR en gerichte communicatie, zodat we de juiste doelgroep bereiken, op het juiste moment, via het juiste kanaal, met de juiste boodschap. Daardoor richten ons op het beïnvloeden van relevante stakeholders via een breed scala aan kanalen.

Burson stelt jaarlijks per 1 februari en 1 september een Public Affairs stage beschikbaar aan een talentvolle student.

Wat ga je doen?

Als stagiair Public Affairs werk je mee aan diverse projecten en ondersteun je onze adviseurs. Je maakt kennis met veel aspecten van het werk binnen een Public Affairs kantoor en krijgt een uniek kijkje achter de schermen van de politieke arena. Je leert hoe organisaties hun belangen behartigen richting politiek, overheid en media. Kortom: een veelzijdige stage op het raakvlak van politiek, bestuur, media en bedrijfsleven.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Monitoren van nieuws en politiek:dagelijks kranten, vakbladen en opinietijdschriften scannen op relevant nieuws voor onze klanten.
  • Volgen van parlementaire agenda’s:bijhouden van vergaderingen en debatten in de Tweede en Eerste Kamer, relevante Kamerstukken signaleren en samenvatten.
  • Verslaglegging: live en achteraf rapporteren over politieke debatten en griffieverslagen verzamelen.
  • Research en analyse: informatie verzamelen via databanken en analyses maken voor onze adviseurs.
  • Stakeholdermapping: relevante politieke en ambtelijke contacten in kaart brengen en up-to-date houden.
  • Ondersteuning bij diverse klantprojecten: bijdragen aan presentaties, pitches en strategische adviezen.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je volgt een HBO- of universitaire opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Politicologie, Bestuurskunde, Geschiedenis, Europese Studies of Internationale Betrekkingen (en staat ingeschreven tijdens de stageperiode).
  • Je hebt een grote interesse in en kennis van de Nederlandse politiek en maatschappelijke vraagstukken.
  • Je bent proactief, nieuwsgierig en analytisch sterk.
  • Je kunt complexe informatie helder analyseren en samenvatten en hebt een vlotte pen.
  • Je beheerst de Nederlands en Engels taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
  • Je kunt goed omgaan met deadlines en werkt nauwkeurig, ook onder druk.
  • Je bent minimaal vier dagen per week beschikbaar in de periode van 1 februari tot en met 30 juni.

Wat bieden wij

Tijdens je stage ontvang je een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van €650 (gebaseerd op een volledige werkweek) en word je begeleid door twee collega’s. Elke maand heb je een coachingsgesprek over je eigen ambities en wensen. Halverwege je stage is er een tussentijds feedbackgesprek waarin genoeg ruimte is om aan te geven wat je nog meer uit je stage wil halen. Daarnaast kun je altijd terecht bij andere Young Professionals, consultants en senior-adviseurs met vragen. Tenslotte worden je reiskosten vergoed en is het mogelijk om zo nu en dan eens vanuit huis te werken.

Stage conventionné de 6 mois à compter de Janvier 2027.

Vous intégrerez l’équipe Growth de l’agence et participerez à ses côtés au développement commercial de Burson, à la préparation des appels d’offres et à la valorisation des expertises et réalisations de l’agence.

Vous travaillerez en collaboration avec différentes équipes et bureaux du groupe, ce qui vous permettra de découvrir les enjeux de développement d’une agence de communication et de contribuer à des projets variés.

Vos missions pourront notamment inclure :

  • Identification de nouveaux prospects, veille sectorielle et recherche d’opportunités business
  • Contribution aux réponses aux appels d’offres et à la rédaction des recommandations
  • Préparation des supports de présentation
  • Coordination et suivi des différentes étapes des appels d’offres, en lien avec les équipes et les autres agences du groupe
  • Mise à jour des supports de présentation et de communication de l’agence : biographies des collaborateurs, plaquettes, newsletters…
  • Veille concurrentielle et marketing sur les tendances des secteurs de la communication, des relations publics et de l’influence
  • Valorisation des réalisations de l’agence à travers la rédaction de cas et la préparation de dossiers pour des prix et concours
  • Contribution ponctuelle à des missions clients en social media et influence : veille, identification de créateurs de contenu, contribution aux contenus et suivi des campagnes
  • Contribution à la préparation des reportings d’activité

Ces missions pourront évoluer au cours du stage en fonction des projets de l’équipe et de votre progression.

 

Le profil que nous recherchons :

- Étudiant(e) en école de commerce, de communication ou université, niveau Bac+3 à Bac+5.

- Intérêt marqué pour les relations publiques, le marketing, l’influence et la stratégie de marque.

- Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et esprit d’analyse.

- Expérience en gestion de projet.

- Rigueur, curiosité, créativité et goût pour le travail en équipe.

- Excellent niveau d’anglais (C1 ou C2).

- Bonne maîtrise du pack Office et des outils digitaux (Canva, PowerPoint, réseaux sociaux…).

 

Notre engagement :

Nous vous offrons un stage professionnalisant au sein d’une équipe dynamique et experte. Vous serez pleinement intégré(e) à la vie de l’agence et bénéficierez d’un encadrement personnalisé :

  • Suivi régulier : Points d’étape avec votre tuteur/tutrice pour évaluer votre progression et définir vos objectifs.

  • Culture du feedback : Retours constructifs sur vos missions et vos réalisations.

  • Découverte du métier : Collaboration avec les consultants de l’équipe pour appréhender les différentes facettes de notre activité.

 

Tes avantages chez Burson :

Nous nous engageons à offrir un cadre de stage stimulant et avantageux : 

  • Gratification :750€/mois.  
  • Flexibilité :Possibilité de télétravailler jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine (jours flexibles en accord avec le manager) avec une indemnité de télétravail (10€/mois). 
  • Mobilité :Forfait mensuel de 45,40€ pour tes transports (carte Swile).  
  • Restauration :Prise en charge des repas au restaurant d’entreprise pour un reste à charge de 3,70€ (entrée-plat-dessert). 
  • Temps libre :1 jour de congé par mois. 
  • Avantages CSE :Accès aux offres de notre comité d'entreprise (places de cinéma à 5€, chèques cadeaux culture, remboursements sportifs…). 
  • Prime de cooptation :Une prime de 150€ en chèques cadeaux multi-enseignes pour l'aide au recrutement de tes successeurs.

Prêt.e à relever ce défi et à développer tes compétences ? 

Pour postuler : Envoie-nous ton CV et une lettre de motivation ou quelques lignes expliquant ton intérêt pour ce stage. Nous avons hâte de découvrir ton profil !

Votre place est chez Burson :

Notre vision est de faire de Burson la référence en matière de formation pour les professionnels de la communication créative et les leaders de demain. Nous offrons un environnement de travail stimulant où les collaborateurs motivés et ambitieux peuvent développer leurs compétences, étendre leur réseau et élaborer des stratégies innovantes pour les plus grandes marques. Notre engagement envers le développement de nos talents se traduit par des opportunités de formation, des programmes de mentorat avec des leaders du secteur, et une culture d'entreprise stimulante et inclusive qui encourage la collaboration et l'innovation. Nous avons également mis en place des programmes de reconnaissance et de fidélisation pour nos meilleurs talents. Nous investissons dans nos collaborateurs car nous sommes convaincus que leur réussite est aussi la nôtre.

Chez Burson, nous sommes une agence d'apprenants permanents. Nous savons que l'excellence en créativité et en communication exige une compréhension fine et nuancée. C'est pourquoi nous recherchons des collaborateurs talentueux de tous horizons et de toutes cultures. Ces talents sont essentiels pour concevoir des idées audacieuses, favoriser un dialogue constructif, créer des expériences enrichissantes et stimuler l'innovation pour nos clients. Votre point de vue unique, votre talent, fait de vous une #BursonPerson.

En cliquant sur « Soumettre la candidature », vous nous transmettez les informations saisies. Avant de le faire, veuillez consulter notre politique de confidentialité en matière de recrutement. Les candidats résidant en Californie. sont invités à consulter notre politique de confidentialité californienne pour le recrutement. Ce document détaille l'utilisation de vos données personnelles lors de votre candidature et explique comment les mettre à jour ou les supprimer.

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

job.title: Baseball Account Executive
job.description:
Overview:

The Baseball Account Executive generates new corporate revenue through season tickets, group tickets, and client retention via phone, in-person presentations, and networking events.    

 

Key Responsibilities and Essential Functions: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

  • Generate revenue by driving ticket sales through phone calls, in-person presentations, and networking events. 
  • Consistently achieve daily outreach goals to engage prospects. 
  • Exceed sales appointment goals by scheduling and conducting weekly sales meetings with potential clients. 
  • Meet or surpass yearly sales targets through effective prospecting and closing. 
  • Identify and prioritize high-potential sales opportunities.
  • Manage and grow relationships with current clients to drive renewals and referrals. 
  • Effectively implement and track targeted sales campaigns to meet objectives.  
  • Keep accurate, up-to-date records of clients and prospects in the system. 
  • Assist with customer service initiatives throughout the year to ensure satisfaction. 

 

Required Qualifications: 

  • Sales Skills: Proven ability to initiate phone calls, manage face-to-face appointments, and correspond via email to drive sales. 
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present sales materials to large groups and corporate clients. 
  • Organizational Skills: Exceptional ability to manage tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Customer Service: A creative, positive, friendly, and helpful attitude with a commitment to delivering exceptional client experiences. 
  • Technical Proficiency: Competency in basic computer software for managing records and creating presentations. 
  • Teamwork: A collaborative mindset, with the ability to work effectively as part of a team. 

 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Sports Management, Marketing, Business, ora related field. 
  • Three or more years of proven success in high volume sales, particularly in ticket or corporate sales. 
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and implement creative and innovative sales programs. 
  • Familiarity with CRM software or ticketing systems (e.g., Salesforce, Archtics, or Ticketmaster).
  • Strong public speaking and presentation skills.  
  • Established network within the corporate community or experience in B2B sales. 
  • Passion for sports and knowledge of the Durham Bulls organization and Minor League Baseball. 

Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.  

  • Essential physical requirements include: Seeing, hearing, listening, speaking, hand/finger dexterity, ability to move across distances, and pushing and pulling. 

 

Work Conditions: The work conditions and characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.  

  • Ability to work flexible hours as needed, including evenings, weekends, and holidays. 
  • Ability to remain focused and perform work in noisy and crowded environments with multiple distractions. 
  • This position may require working outdoors in unpredictable weather conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, snow, and wind, necessitating the ability to adapt to changing environmental factors and wear appropriate protective gear as needed. 

 

Benefits: 

  • Competitive salary based on experience. 
  • Benefits package including: 
  • Comprehensive health insurance plan options 
  • Vision and Dental Insurance 
  • Company sponsored life insurance 
  • Numerous voluntary benefit options – legal plans, pet insurance, discounted home and auto and more!
  • 401K with company match
  • Generous paid time off
  • 9 paid company holidays
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Dynamic and inclusive work environment with a supportive team culture.
  • Exciting projects and growth opportunities within a leading organization.
  • Opportunities to attend free local events, such as sporting events, concerts, shows, and more.

 

Pre-Employment Information:

  • A pre-employment drug screening isrequired. 
  • Capitol Broadcasting Companyparticipatesin E-Verify.

job.title: Baseball CPL General Manager
job.description:
This isn’t just a job running a baseball team. It’s an opportunity to continue to build something special. The Holly Springs Salamanders are looking for a dynamic, creative, and driven leader to take the reins as General Manager. We want someone who thinks big, challenges the status quo, and knows how to turn a summer night at the ballpark into an experience fans can’t wait to repeat.

You’ll lead the team on and off the field – driving ticket sales, creating unforgettable promotions, building a winning culture, and finding new ways to connect with our community. You’ll be the face of the Salamanders, the energy behind our organization, and the person responsible for making our ballpark one of the best places to be all summer.


Responsibilities Include:

  • Oversee all business operations of the Coastal Plain League club including development of annual budget, organizational charts, goals and objectives for each department.
  • Effectively communicate with Vice President – CBC Sports regarding status of clubs’ business affairs.
  • Develop and implement a plan for increasing tickets, sponsorship and special event revenue. Identify local businesses to engage and commit to strengthening relationships with community business leaders.
  • Work with Vice President to develop a creative marketing campaign that includes print ads, television ads, radio ads, a vigorous website, and unique marketing tactics.
  • Develop innovative promotional campaigns that strategically integrate with marketing, business communications, corporate sponsorship, group sales, in-game entertainment, and community relations to drive ticket sales and expand media reach. Design promotions that provide fun, affordable, family-friendly in-game entertainment.
  • Maintain ongoing management of game/event entertainment in the ballpark to deliver a consistently superior, innovative and fresh approach and to ensure maximum enjoyment by our fans.
  • Manage the Club's brand by ensuring compliance with logo usage specifications for all merchandise used by the organization or approved usage by outside parties (e.g. corporate partners, group outings, etc.).
  • Oversee the daily editing of the Club's website and make suggestions for the ongoing improvement of its content.
  • Provide leadership, guidance and training to sales team staff. Work with staff to develop sustainable ticket campaigns, group ticket plans and pricing strategy.
  • Recruit and hire outstanding personnel to fill all available positions. Develop job descriptions for each full-time staffer and requirements for each job, including priority task lists.
  • Maintain strong and positive relationships with full-time, part-time and seasonal staff. Conduct annual performance reviews with each full-time staff member.
  • Oversee relations between the Club and its concessionaire. Evaluate the concessionaire/concession sales on an annual basis and provide suggestions for improvement.
  • Be the liaison between the Club and the Town of Holly Springs.
  • Will oversee all full-time and seasonal staff members of the Holly Springs Salamanders.

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 4 years’ experience working as either general manager, assistant general managers, or sales manager.
  • Experience working with ticket systems, with Ticketmaster being the preferred vendor.

A pre-employment drug screening is required. EOE, M/F. All Capitol Broadcasting Company properties are tobacco free. Capitol Broadcasting Company participates in E-Verify.

job.title: Baseball Internships
job.description:
Position Overview

Are you passionate about sports and interested in gaining hands-on experience in the exciting world of professional baseball? The Durham Bulls Baseball Club is seeking enthusiastic, motivated, and hardworking interns to join our team.

As an intern with the Durham Bulls, you'll have the opportunity to experience the business side of Minor League Baseball while contributing to the day-to-day operations of one of the most recognized franchises in professional baseball.

Internship opportunities may be available in Marketing, Sales, Stadium Operations, Ticketing, and Retail. Interns will work alongside experienced professionals, develop valuable skills, and gain exposure to multiple aspects of the sports and entertainment industry.

Key Responsibilities

Depending on departmental assignment, responsibilities may include:

  • Marketing & Promotions: Assist with promotional campaigns, social media initiatives, community engagement, special events, and in-game entertainment.

  • Sales & Partnerships: Support ticket sales initiatives, corporate partnerships, sponsorship activation, customer outreach, and sales-related projects.

  • Stadium & Game Day Operations: Assist with stadium preparation, event coordination, game day logistics, guest services, and ensuring a positive fan experience.

  • Ticketing: Support box office operations, ticket sales, customer service, ticket distribution, and fan engagement initiatives.

  • Retail & Merchandise: Assist with team store operations, merchandise displays, inventory management, sales transactions, and customer service.

  • Collaborate with team members across departments to support organizational goals and special projects.

  • Represent the Durham Bulls professionally while interacting with fans, sponsors, community partners, and fellow employees.

  • Perform additional duties and participate in learning opportunities as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a college or university, preferably pursuing a degree in Sports Management, Business, Marketing, Communications, Hospitality, or a related field.

  • Strong interest in professional sports, entertainment, or business operations.

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.

  • Positive attitude, strong work ethic, and willingness to learn.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

  • Strong customer service skills and attention to detail.

  • Willingness to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, particularly during the baseball season.

  • Previous experience in sports, retail, hospitality, sales, or customer service is a plus but not required.

What You'll Gain

  • Hands-on experience working within a professional baseball organization.

  • Exposure to multiple areas of sports business and stadium operations.

  • Opportunities to network with experienced professionals in the sports and entertainment industry.

  • Development of practical skills in communication, teamwork, problem-solving, customer service, and business operations.

  • A behind-the-scenes look at what it takes to deliver an exceptional Minor League Baseball experience.

About the Durham Bulls

The Durham Bulls are the Triple-A affiliate of the Tampa Bay Rays and one of the most recognizable teams in Minor League Baseball. Playing at the iconic Durham Bulls Athletic Park in downtown Durham, North Carolina, the Bulls are known for their rich history, passionate fan base, and commitment to delivering outstanding entertainment and memorable experiences.

As part of Capitol Broadcasting Company, the Durham Bulls offer interns the opportunity to learn within a dynamic organization that values teamwork, innovation, community involvement, and professional development.


Pre-Employment Information:

  • A pre-employment drug screening is required. 
  • Capitol Broadcasting Company participates in E-Verify. 
  • Capitol Broadcasting Company participates in the Work Opportunity Tax Credit (WOTC) program. However, completing the WOTC questionnaire is completely voluntary. Your decision will have absolutely no impact on your hiring chances, and your application WILL be accepted regardless of whether you choose to provide this information or not.

job.title: Creative Director
job.description:
OVERVIEW

The Durham Bulls are hiring a Creative Director to lead the look, feel, and voice of one of the most recognizable brands in Minor League Baseball. From the snorting bull at the DBAP to Wool E. Bull to the legacy of Bull Durham, few teams have a brand this rich. We want someone who will protect it, sharpen it, and keep it fresh for the next generation of fans. Even better, 2027 is the Bulls’ 125th anniversary, and you will shape how fans see and remember it. 

The Creative Director leads a small in-house team of two graphic designers and a video producer. You will be a hands-on leader who still makes work, not just approves it. You will also act as the hub for every creative request in the building, working with ticketing, partnerships, promotions, merchandise, community relations, events and food & beverage to make sure projects get prioritized, scheduled, and delivered on time. 

Working with senior leadership, you will help set the brand and visual direction for the club and make sure it shows up consistently everywhere fans see us: in the ballpark, on social, on the web, in email, on merchandise, and around the Triangle.

 
KEY RESPONSIBILITY AREAS

Brand and creative direction

  • Partner with senior leadership to define and evolve the Bulls' brand, visual identity, and messaging.
  • Own brand standards and make sure logos, colors, typography, and tone are used consistently across every touchpoint.
  • Lead creative for season campaigns, theme nights, promotions, in game content and special events from concept through delivery.
  • Stay hands-on: design, art direct, write concepts, and pitch in on shoots and edits when the team needs it.
  • Give clear, constructive feedback that raises the quality of everything that goes out the door.

 
Team leadership

  • Manage, coach, and develop a small team of graphic designers and a video producer.
  • Set clear expectations, priorities, and goals, and hold regular check-ins and reviews.
  • Build a positive, collaborative team culture that can handle the pace of a 75-game home schedule in addition to a full slate of special events.

Project management and creative traffic

  • Serve as the single point of intake for creative requests from every department.
  • Prioritize, schedule, and assign work so the team stays on deadline without burning out.
  • Build and maintain a simple, reliable request and approval process (forms, project board, timelines).
  • Push back or reset expectations when requests come in late or out of scope, and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Manage the creative budget, plus freelancers, printers, and outside vendors as needed.

 
Collaboration

  • Work closely with ticketing, corporate partnerships, promotions, merchandise, community relations, and game day operations.
  • Bring partner activations to life with creative that meets sponsor needs and still feels like the Bulls.

 
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of professional design or creative experience, including at least 2 years leading or supervising other creatives.
  • A strong portfolio showing brand, campaign, and social work across print, digital, and video.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign; Premiere or After Effects a plus).
  • Proven project management skills: you can juggle many requests, set priorities, and hit deadlines.
  • Clear, confident communication with both creative teams and non-creative stakeholders.
  • Ability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays during the season, including home games and events.
  • Bachelor's degree in graphic design, marketing, communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

 
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

  • Experience in sports, entertainment, live events, or hospitality.
  • Familiarity with project management tools such as Asana, Monday, or Trello.
  • Photography and Videography skills preferred.
  • Experience with in-venue video boards, motion graphics, or photography.
  • Strong concept and copywriting skills
  • A maker and a leader: you are just as comfortable in the design file as in the meeting.
  • Organized and calm under pressure, especially on a busy game day.
  • A low-ego collaborator who builds trust across departments and can say "not yet" diplomatically.
  • Passionate about baseball, the fan experience, and the Durham community.
  • Tuned in to design trends, social platforms, and what makes content connect.
  • Curious and coachable, and eager to help your team grow.

job.title: Entertainment & Promotions Team Member
job.description:
Overview 

The Durham Bulls are looking for outgoing, high-energy people who want to join the most iconic brand in Minor League Baseball and gain experience in the sports industry. These positions support the Promotions Team through game day entertainment to help put on the best show in Minor League Baseball.

This posting includes two roles. Please select the role(s) you’re interested in when you apply. Both positions are part-time, seasonal, game day roles.

Entertainment and Promotions Assistant
Supports on-field entertainment before the game, between innings, and after the game. This role is a great fit for someone who is outgoing, upbeat, and detail-oriented.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Finding contestants for between-inning contests
  • Running between-inning contests
  • Helping with crowd cams and giveaway tosses
  • Following the itinerary from the Director of Promotions and carrying out the planned run-of-show for each event
  • Helping oversee mascots and performers and keep them safe
  • Taking part in skits and other activities that build the atmosphere and entertain fans

Applicants should be willing to go the extra mile to create a memorable experience for every fan who enters the ballpark.

Mascot Handler
Joins the Mascot Team to support Wool E. Bull, the Blue Monster, and other costumed characters on game days and at assigned special events. This role is a great fit for someone who is high-energy, organized, and people-oriented.

Responsibilities include:

  • Making sure all in-game activations in the game day script are completed
  • Making sure mascots meet all scheduled commitments, including skits, activations, sponsorship and ticketing requests, autograph sessions, and appearances
  • Helping set up, run, and clean up all mascot skits and needs
  • Serving as the main point of contact between the mascots and other Durham Bulls staff
  • Interacting with fans to create a positive game day and mascot experience

Performing opportunities may be available for interested candidates who fit the characters needed

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in promotions, entertainment, or customer service is preferred but not required
  • Knowledge of baseball or the Durham Bulls organization is preferred but not required

Physical Demands: 

  • Must be able to stand, walk, and move briskly throughout all areas of the stadium for extended periods (often 4-8 hours) during events. Requires the ability to maintain high energy, enthusiasm, and vocal projection throughout the duration of games and promotions

Work Conditions: 

  • Must be available for all Durham Bulls home games, which include evenings, weekends, and holidays. Flexibility is required for extended hours to assist with pre-game setup, in-game execution, and post-game teardown of promotional elements
  • This role operates in a fast-paced, high-energy, and noisy stadium environment, both indoors and outdoors. You will be exposed to all types of outdoor weather conditions, including sun, heat, humidity, and rain, with limited access to climate-controlled areas
  • Work involves constant interaction with fans, sponsors, and team staff in a lively, crowded, and dynamic event setting. The ability to perform enthusiastically and think quickly under pressure is essential

Benefits: 

  • Exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic sports environment.
  • Complimentary Durham Bulls branded polo shirt

Pre-Employment Information:

  • A pre-employment drug screening is required
  • Capitol Broadcasting Company participates in E-Verify

job.title: Food & Beverage Staffing Coordinator
job.description:
Overview:

The Food & Beverage Staffing Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting game day operations by recruiting, scheduling, and managing nonprofit group staffing for concession stands and food service areas throughout the ballpark. This position is responsible for coordinating both hourly staff and nonprofit fundraising groups to ensure proper coverage and a high-quality guest experience. This role also supports payroll processes, training, and operational communication between staff and leadership.

Key Responsibilities and Essential Functions:

  • Aids in the execution of a successful nonprofit fundraising group program.
  • Trains nonprofit group members in operation of a concession stand, food sanitation, alcohol and customer service.
  • Performs payroll functions for hourly staff including but not limited to tip data collection and time card checks
  • Calculates nonprofit group commissions.
  • Schedules gameday staff for all events
  • Checks gameday staff in for their shift and distribute/maintain uniforms
  • Listen to internal and external guest concerns and issues, resolve those that can be and inform the appropriate supervisor. 
  • Maintaining compliance with local, state and federal regulations. 
  • Perform other related duties, tasks and responsibilities as required from time to time.

Required Qualifications: 

  • 1 year experience in recruiting associates
  • 1 year experience as a trainer
  • Must be proficient using Microsoft Office program. 
  • Ability to communicate in writing or verbally and receive the same. 
  • Ability to understand and implement written and verbal instructions 
  • Must work well in a team environment 
  • Ability to work independently and in a high stress, fast paced environment 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in food & beverage, hospitality, or event operations.
  • Experience working with nonprofit groups or volunteer organizations.
  • Familiarity with payroll systems or workforce management tools.
  • Knowledge of food safety and alcohol service regulations. 

Physical Demands: 

  • Ability to stand and move throughout the stadium for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift and carry items up to 25 pounds occasionally.
  • Frequent use of hands and arms for administrative and operational tasks.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in a loud, fast-paced environment.

Work Conditions: 

  • Work is performed in a stadium environment with exposure to varying weather conditions.
  • Schedule includes nights, weekends, and holidays based on game and event schedules.
  • Extended or irregular hours may be required during peak season.

Pre-Employment Information:

  • A pre-employment drug screening is required. 
  • Capitol Broadcasting Company participates in E-Verify. 
  • Capitol Broadcasting Company participates in the Work Opportunity Tax Credit (WOTC) program. However, completing the WOTC questionnaire is completely voluntary. Your decision will have absolutely no impact on your hiring chances, and your application WILL be accepted regardless of whether you choose to provide this information or not.
