job.title: Game Day Production Team Member
job.description:
Overview
The Durham Bulls are looking for production-focused people who want to join the most iconic brand in Minor League Baseball and gain experience in the sports industry. These positions support the Game Operations team through in-park game production to help create the best show in Minor League Baseball.

This posting includes four roles. Please select the role(s) you’re interested in when you apply. All positions are part-time, seasonal, game day roles.

What All Roles Require

  • Solid knowledge of the game of baseball
  • Ability to stay engaged and focused for the entire game
  • Availability for home games, plus additional hours for preparation, rehearsals, and special events

Xpressions Operator
Operates the Ross XPression graphics system on game days and at assigned special events.

  • Experience in a live sports control room or event production is preferred
  • Light programming knowledge and basic graphic creation skills are preferred

Switcher
Operates the Ross Carbonite switcher and directs camera operators for live shots throughout the event.

  • Works closely with the Replay Operator and Xpressions Operator to keep transitions smooth across all systems
  • Calls replays and replay timing
  • Works with the Post 50 team while taking direction from the Game Operations Director
  • Basic knowledge of how to direct camera operators is required

Replay Operator
Operates the 3Play replay system during baseball events at Durham Bulls Athletic Park.

  • Clips and plays back all legal plays and entertainment moments throughout the event
  • Creates highlight packages
  • Must be highly detail-oriented, attentive to the game, and able to keep up with its pace
  • Previous video editing experience is preferred

Music Operator
Selects and plays all music and audio during events at Durham Bulls Athletic Park and controls levels for PA announcements, in-stadium videos, and microphones throughout the ballpark.

  • Creates an impactful sound experience for every fan who enters the ballpark. This is one of the most important game day roles.
  • The ideal candidate is available for all 75 home games of the season

Physical Demands

  • Ability to stay seated or stationed at a console for extended periods while operating technical equipment
  • Frequent use of hands for keyboards, controllers, switchers, and graphics equipment
  • High level of visual attention to monitor multiple screens, feeds, and live action for accuracy and quality
  • Ability to maintain concentration and performance quality throughout games, which may last 3–4 hours or longer

Work Conditions

  • Roles are performed in the production control room and press box. Operators are exposed to stadium noise, crowd energy, and varying weather conditions.
  • Work is entirely event-driven
  • Fast-paced, high-pressure live production environment that requires continuous focus, adaptability, and teamwork

Benefits

  • Complimentary Durham Bulls branded polo shirt
  • An exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic sports environment

Pre-Employment Information

  • A pre-employment drug screening is required
  • Capitol Broadcasting Company participates in E-Verify

job.title: Manager, Creative Video
job.description:
Overview:

The Durham Bulls are seeking a talented, driven, and visually minded individual to lead the concept, production, and delivery of all video content across the Durham Bulls organization. From high-energy promotional hype reels to in-game videoboard packages to sponsor deliverables and social media content, this role owns every frame of video that represents the Bulls brand.


This role sits at the intersection of creativity and execution, collaborating with marketing, corporate partnerships, community relations, and game presentation to ensure every video asset, whether a 15-second social clip or a four-minute opening day hype film, is delivered on time, on brand, and at the highest possible standard.

 

Key Responsibilities and Essential Functions:


Video Production & Creative Development

  • Lead the creative vision, planning, production, editing, and delivery of all Durham Bulls video content. 
  • Produce high-quality promotional videos, hype reels, player features, season recaps, theme night content, organizational messaging, and in-game entertainment packages. 
  • Develop compelling visual storytelling that strengthens the Durham Bulls brand and enhances the fan experience. 
  • Shoot and edit video content for baseball games, special events, community appearances, player features, and organizational initiatives. 
  • Create engaging short-form video content optimized for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and other digital platforms.




Project & Production Management

  • Manage the organization's video production calendar, balancing multiple concurrent projects while ensuring deadlines are consistently met. 
  • Coordinate video requests from internal departments, establish production timelines, and communicate project status with stakeholders. 
  • Organize and maintain all raw footage, project files, and completed video assets for future use. 
  • Maintain video production equipment, cameras, lighting, audio equipment, and media storage while ensuring all equipment remains production-ready.


Ticket Sales & Marketing Support

  • Produce video assets supporting season ticket campaigns, group sales initiatives, suite sales, mini plans, and promotional campaigns. 
  • Create video content for digital advertising, email marketing, website promotions, and organizational communications. 
  • Collaborate with the Marketing Department to develop campaigns that drive attendance, engagement, and brand awareness.

Corporate Partnerships

  • Produce sponsor fulfillment videos, commercial spots, branded content, and partnership deliverables in accordance with contractual obligations. 
  • Collaborate with Corporate Partnerships to develop creative concepts that maximize sponsor visibility and value.


Game Presentation

  • Produce and deliver videoboard content, player introductions, walk-up videos, countdowns, transitions, entertainment features, and promotional elements. 
  • Work closely with the Game Presentation team to ensure all content is properly formatted, tested, and integrated into the live game presentation. 
  • Build and maintain a library of evergreen video assets for use throughout the season. 



Required Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Video Production, Film, Digital Media, Communications, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3–5 years of professional video production experience within sports, entertainment, media, or an agency environment.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro with demonstrated experience editing high-quality content under tight deadlines.
  • Experience operating DSLR and/or mirrorless camera systems for both studio and field production.
  • Experience with lighting, audio recording, and on-location production techniques.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple departments.
  • Passion for storytelling, sports, and creating engaging fan experiences.
  •  

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Adobe After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Photoshop, Illustrator, or other creative software.
  • Motion graphics and animation experience.
  • Experience producing content for MiLB, MLB, collegiate athletics, or professional sports organizations.
  • Familiarity with videoboard production workflows and live event presentation.
  • Experience creating sponsor-branded content and commercial deliverables.
  • Knowledge of current social media trends and platform best practices.

 

Physical Demands: 


  • Seeing, hearing, listening, touching, ability to move across distances, climbing, pushing, and pulling, and hand/finger dexterity. 
  • Capacity for intermediate reading and writing, basic clerical and math skills, advanced analysis and comprehension skills, advanced judgment, and decision-making skills. 
  • Able to occasionally lift up to 15 pounds. 

 

Work Conditions: 


  • Ability to work flexible hours as needed, including evenings, weekends, and holidays. 
  • Ability to remain focused and perform work in noisy and crowded environments with multiple distractions. 
  • This position may occasionally require working outdoors in unpredictable weather conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, snow, and wind, necessitating the ability to adapt to changing environmental factors and wear appropriate protective gear as needed.

job.title: Manager, Social Media & Digital Content
job.description:
Why This Role Matters

The Durham Bulls are one of the best-known brands in minor league baseball, and most people meet us on a phone screen before they ever walk through the gates at the DBAP. Your work is often the first reason someone buys a ticket.

We are more than what happens on the field. A sunset over the Blue Monster, a kid catching their first foul ball, or the energy of a Friday night fireworks crowd can tell a stronger story than any box score. Our content should make people feel something and make them wish they were here.

Position Overview

The Manager, Social Media & Digital Content owns the day-to-day voice of the Durham Bulls online: social channels and the team website. You will help plan, create, publish, and measure content that grows our audience and drives real business results, including ticket sales, partner value, and community reach.

You will work closely with the Marketing Leadership, our graphics and video teams, ticketing, corporate partnerships, and community relations. You start by executing an agreed calendar and brand direction, and you earn more creative ownership as you show strong judgment and results.

Key Responsibilities

Social Media Execution

  • Run daily posting and community engagement across all Bulls social platforms, YouTube and LinkedIn. Work closely with mascot coordinator on Wool E. Bull’s accounts.
  • Cover games live: in-game posts, highlights, promotions, and moments in the stands, published fast and on-brand.
  • Respond to fans in comments and messages and flag service issues or negative trends to the right department quickly.
  • Watch platform trends and act on the ones that fit the Bulls brand.

Content & Storytelling

  • Plan and deliver content with our graphics and video teams, and with photographers and creators as needed.
  • Shoot and edit quick-turn photo and mobile video, especially during games and events.
  • Write clear, creative captions and copy in the Bulls’ voice.
  • Tell stories beyond baseball: the ballpark, fans, staff, community, and the full Bulls experience.
  • Build relationships with local creators and influencers who can bring new fans to the DBAP.

Revenue & Partnerships

  • Create content that sells: tickets, group outings, theme nights, and merchandise, in coordination with ticketing and marketing.
  • Deliver and document social and web assets promised to corporate partners and help develop new sponsorable content ideas.
  • Support paid social campaigns, including creative, targeting input, and performance tracking.

Calendar, Planning & Collaboration

  • Build and maintain the content calendar with leadership, covering the season, offseason, and special events.
  • Coordinate content around promotions, partnerships, community initiatives, the Tampa Bay Rays and MiLB where applicable.
  • Bring new ideas to the table, take feedback well, and follow through on agreed priorities.

Website Management

  • Own routine updates to the Bulls website so schedules, promotions, news, and fan information are accurate and current.
  • Gather timely content from other departments and recommend improvements to the online fan experience.
  • Monitor and respond to fan inquiries through the email tied to the website.

Measurement & Reporting

  • Track performance across channels and the website and share a regular report with clear learnings and recommendations.
  • Use results to adjust the content mix, posting times, and formats.
How Success Is Measured

Targets will be set with the leadership in your first 90 days. In year one, success looks like:

  • Steady growth in engagement, impressions and followers on our priority platforms.
  • Measurable traffic from social to ticketing and promotion pages.
  • Every partner social and web deliverable completed on time and documented for renewal.
  • A content calendar that is always current, with no missed game days or major promotions.
  • A website fans can trust to be accurate.
What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 3+ years of experience in social media, digital content, or a related field. Sports or entertainment experience helps but is not required.
  • A portfolio or accounts you can show us that prove you can make content people stop for.
  • Strong instincts for what makes content emotional, timely, and worth sharing.
  • Comfort shooting and editing mobile photo and video and writing original social copy.
  • Working knowledge of the major social platforms and their native analytics.
  • Basic experience updating a website or content management system.
  • Strong organization and follow-through during busy calendars and live events.
  • Good judgment and an understanding of what it means to represent a public brand.
Schedule & Work Environment

This is an on-site, event-driven role. Evening, weekend, and holiday work is required during the season and at other events, often in busy, noisy, outdoor conditions. The offseason is for planning, building content libraries, special event content and setting up the next season.

Our goal is simple: show people what makes the Durham Bulls special, not just what happened at the game, but why being here matters.

job.title: Part-Time Promotions Assistant (On-Call)
job.description:
Overview: 

The On-Call Radio Promotions Assistant serves as an energetic ambassador for MIX 101.5, 99.9 The Fan, and 95.7 That Station’s events and promotions. This role supports the setup, execution, and breakdown of live broadcasts and station events, while also engaging with listeners, clients, and the community in a professional and enthusiastic manner. Success in the role means reliably representing the station’s brand, ensuring smooth event operations, and creating positive experiences for the public. This role is key to building the station’s presence and strengthening Capitol Broadcasting Company’s community connections. Please note, this is not a regularly scheduled position, and hours are only available as needed. 

 Key Responsibilities and Essential Functions: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. 

  • Serve as a brand ambassador at station events, live broadcasts, and community activities.
  • Assist with event preparation, including load up, set-up, breakdown, and transportation of promotional materials. 
  • Operate basic broadcasting equipment and provide on-site support during live promotions. 
  • Engage with the public, clients, and listeners in a professional and enthusiastic manner. 
  • Support promotional efforts through clerical tasks, photography, and updating social media accounts.
  • Performs other duties as required or assigned, provided they are reasonably related to the responsibilities outlined in this job description.

 Required Qualifications:  

  • Must have a valid driver’s license with a clean driving record and reliable transportation.
  • Ability to lift equipment and boxes weighing more than 25 pounds.
  • Availability to work on call, including evenings and weekends.

 Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Prior experience in radio promotions, events, or broadcasting.
  • Outgoing and enthusiastic personality with strong interpersonal skills.
  • Familiarity with social media platforms for promotional use.
  • Strong interest in the media and entertainment industry.

 Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.  

  • Ability to stand for extended periods during events.
  • Regular lifting, carrying, and transporting of equipment weighing 25+ pounds.
  • Frequent bending, stooping, pushing, and pulling during event set-up and breakdown.
  • Use of hands and vision for operating broadcasting equipment, photography, and handling promotional materials.

 Work Conditions: The work conditions and characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.  

  • Work performed in varied environments, including outdoor community events, indoor venues, and live broadcast sites.

job.title: Senior Designer
job.description:
OVERVIEW

The Durham Bulls are hiring a Senior Designer to help bring one of Minor League Baseball's most iconic brands to life. You will report to the Creative Director and work alongside a small team to create the graphics, content, and photography fans see every day. Will also help create the imagery that defines the Bulls' 125th anniversary season in 2027.

Photography is a core part of this job, as important as graphic design. With no staff photographer on our team, you will be the club's primary photographer, capturing everything from retail and merchandise to in-game action and styled campaign shoots. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing at a desk and shooting from the field level, and is excited to tell the Bulls' story through both.
 
KEY RESPONSIBILITY AREAS

Design

  • Create graphics for social media, web, email, video boards, in-ballpark signage, print, advertising, and merchandise.
  • Design campaigns for theme nights, promotions, giveaways, and special events from concept through final files.
  • Build partner and sponsor creative that meets their goals and still looks like the Bulls.
  • Apply and help maintain brand standards so every piece looks consistent.
  • Prepare production-ready files for printers and vendors.


Photography

  • Own photography for the club, including:
  • In-game action, fans, and ballpark atmosphere
  • Retail and merchandise product shots for the team store and e-commerce
  • Stylized and studio-style shoots for campaigns, promotions, and social content
  • Community events, partner activations, and behind-the-scenes moments
  • Plan shoots, including shot lists, locations, props, and talent coordination.
  • Edit, retouch, organize, and archive photos so the team can find them fast.
  • Turn around game-day photos quickly for social and media use.

 
Motion and content

  • Create animated graphics and short-form motion content for social and video boards.
  • Partner with the video producer on graphics packages, lower thirds, and in-game elements.
  • Pitch content ideas that fit current trends and platforms.

 
Team and collaboration

  • Take direction from the Creative Director and help manage your own project load.
  • Work with ticketing, partnerships, promotions, merchandise, and community relations on their creative needs.

 
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years of professional graphic design experience, in-house or agency.
  • 3+ years of professional photography experience, including live events and sports.
  • A portfolio that shows both design and photography work, including brand, campaign, and social.
  • Hands-on photography skills: camera operation, lighting, composition, and shooting in fast-moving live settings.
  • Strong photo editing and retouching skills in Lightroom and Photoshop.
  • Expert in Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
  • Strong typography, layout, and color skills, with sharp attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines at once.
  • Availability for nights, weekends, and holidays during the season, including home games and events.

 
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

  • Motion graphics experience in After Effects or similar tools.
  • Experience in sports, entertainment, or live events.
  • Video shooting or editing experience (Premiere Pro).
  • Product or e-commerce photography experience.
  • A team player who takes feedback well and enjoys helping a junior designer grow.
  • Organized, reliable, and proud of the details.

Work Conditions: 

  • Work is performed in a stadium environment with exposure to varying weather conditions.
  • Schedule includes nights, weekends, and holidays based on game and event schedules.
  • Extended or irregular hours may be required during peak season.

Pre-Employment Information:

  • A pre-employment drug screening is required.

Job Description Summary


We are seeking an Adviser, Internal Communications to join the Corporate Communications team. Your primary focus in this role will be on creating and leading internal communication strategies and employee engagement initiatives centered on Equity, Diversity & Inclusion (EDI), Accessibility, and Accommodation. Additionally, you will deliver internal communications support for the Indigenous Office and key corporate priorities, such as the environmental plan.

The employee experience is central to our strategy, and we strive to achieve this by:


  • Making equity, diversity, inclusion and accessibility a priority.
  • Creating agile, customizable programs that focus on the needs of the business.
  • Providing integrated, high-impact service offerings.
  • Deploying technology that contributes to building a modern, agile and safe workplace.
  • Providing an engaging, ethical work environment that reflects the public broadcaster’s values.

Reporting to the Director, Internal Communications, you are a skilled communicator, strategist  and content creator who excels at advising corporate leaders and navigating complex internal messaging. You also possess a strong cultural and emotional intelligence, passionate about building an accessible, equitable, and inclusive workplace.


Your Responsibilities:


  • Develop and execute comprehensive corporate-wide internal communications strategies and plans to support and position CBC/Radio-Canada’s initiatives in Equity, Diversity & Inclusion (EDI), Accessibility, Accommodation and other related areas.
  • Support internal communications and engagement strategies for Indigenous files and projects, ensuring respectful, culturally grounded messaging aligned with organizational commitments and Indigenous initiatives.
  • Create and produce engaging, high-impact internal communications plans and content, including key messages, intranet stories, leadership messaging, employee newsletters, presentations, town halls, and FAQs.
  • Advise senior leaders, managers, and working groups on internal communications best practices within an inclusive, multicultural environment, helping them navigate complex change messaging and sensitivity considerations.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and consistent messaging across English Services, French Services and other parts of the organization.
  • Ensure representation, accessibility standards, accommodation best practices, and inclusive language are integrated into all communications channels and projects, amplifying a diversity of voices across the public broadcaster.
  • Manage internal communications projects end-to-end, including content development, presentation design, and coordination with internal production teams (design, web, translation, accessibility services).
  • Measure the reach and impact of internal comms initiatives regarding EDI and accessibility, using feedback and analytics to continually refine strategies.

What We’re Looking For:


  • University degree in communications, journalism, public relations, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Five to seven years of relevant internal or corporate communications experience in a large, complex, or multi-site organization.
  • Considerable knowledge and demonstrated experience managing projects and communication strategies involving Equity, Diversity & Inclusion (EDI), Accessibility, and Accommodation.
  • Experience with Indigenous files, projects, or cultural engagement initiatives is considered a significant asset.
  • Excellent written, reading, and oral communication skills in both official languages (English and French).
  • Strong writing and editing skills with a proven ability to translate complex policies, frameworks, and cultural topics into engaging employee messaging.
  • Strong interpersonal, stakeholder management and critical thinking abilities, paired with high emotional and cultural intelligence, an open mindset, and a demonstrated aptitude for influencing key stakeholders.
  • Solid project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced environment.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

If you share our passion for Canadian storytelling, and you wish to help us engage with individuals and communities across our various digital platforms, this is where you’ll want to be!

When you join our mission, you are not only shaping the vision of CBC/Radio-Canada, but the future of our country.

This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Why is this role important?

 

You will be an important element of our over-the-top platform team. As such, working closely with the product owners, architects and technical managers, your role is to ensure the smooth execution of product front-end development and coordinate the technical work required to deliver requested features, while adhering to the standards and practices agreed to by the development management team.

 

The team you will be part of is in charge of an harmonized product, powering CBC Gem and ICI TOU.TV.


Perks you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work schedules, allowing you to prioritize yourself, your family and your work.
  • Work from home opportunities.
  • Competitive total rewards package.
  • Opportunities to work with cutting edge technology.
  • Opportunities for continued learning and professional development.
  • Opportunities to become a member of our Employee Resource Groups.
  • Pair programming and mentorship opportunities, where you can learn from the best in the industry and help coach new talent.
  • A creative and dynamic work environment, where your ideas and contributions can be heard, valued and respected.
  • A supportive management team committed to upholding the highest standards of diversity and inclusivity.
  • An environment which favours experimentation and an iterative approach in order to achieve the highest form of technical innovation.

 

Your responsibilities:

  • Design and/or modify reusable components for Radio-Canada's digital platforms; such as the audio/video player.
  • Ensure compliance with standards and control the quality of the product throughout the project's execution.
  • Stay informed of new trends in the various fields of digital development.
  • By being proactive, propose solutions to the challenges encountered.
  • Participate in Agile Scrum activities designed to review ongoing production projects in order to make necessary corrections and adjustments, or completed projects to measure their results.
  • Participate in the development of user stories for our various products.
  • Ensure the good performance of developed applications to handle high loads.
  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and application deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews and solution deployments.

We are looking for a candidate matching the following profile:

  • University degree or equivalent experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience in software development.
  • Experience in developing complex and high-performance mobile applications.
  • Proficiency in Android Studio, Git, and the Kotlin language.
  • Experience in developing an application published on Google Play.
  • Experience in developing within code review context (pull request).
  • Knowledge of programming patterns (such as MVP or MVVM).
  • Knowledge of SOLID architecture principles is an asset.
  • Ability to read, produce, and adhere to software architecture diagrams (UML, sequence diagram, etc.).
  • Interest in working on an application available on multiple form factors (mobile/tablet/TV).
  • Knowledge of Jetpack Compose, Exoplayer, Kotlin Multiplatform is an asset.
  • Knowledge of the libraries Dagger, Hilt, Koin is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Google architecture components is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Maven (including the design/maintenance of internal libraries) is an asset.
  • Knowledge of audio-video broadcasting on the web (streaming) is an asset.
  • Knowledge of other programming languages is an asset.
  • Knowledge of design patterns is an asset.
  • Good general knowledge and strong intellectual curiosity (to acquire and develop new knowledge and skills).
  • Critical thinking (to question and propose new ideas).
  • A keen interest in the major trends and challenges of the digital world.
  • Meticulousness, independence, and resourcefulness.
  • Excellent stress management and priority setting.
  • Analytical and conceptual thinking skills.
  • Flexibility, initiative, and dynamism.
  • Ability to work in a team, excellent communicator.
  • Bilingualism (English and French) spoken and written is mandatory.

 

Please note that due to the nature of the mandates and responsibilities of this role, all candidates will be required to work in a multilingual environment, where business will be conducted in both official languages (English and French). Therefore, employees working in this role will be expected to make the required efforts and adjustments to navigate this multilingual environment in a respectful manner for all.

Radio-Canada Québec is seeking an Assignment Editor to lead its daily and breaking news coverage. You will report to the Senior Manager, News and Programming. 


We are looking for a candidate with sharp editorial judgment, keen news instincts and in-depth knowledge of the greater Quebec City area, its key players and its newsmakers.


In this role, you bring a deep understanding of our audience and the stories that matter to them, the agility to clear roadblocks in real time, and a commitment to championing a culture of continuous improvement through constructive feedback.


Working as part of a three-person editorial leadership hub, you will help set priorities, drive advance planning and co-ordinate multiplatform coverage. 


You will also collaborate closely with colleagues across the wider network to co-ordinate and fulfil regional coverage requests wherever possible.


This strategic role is central to our daily newsroom operations.


Role:

Assign and co-ordinate the daily work of journalists and camera operators assigned to regional coverage, in keeping with corporate standards and policies.


Key Tasks:

  • Keep up with regional, national and international news stories through various sources.

  • Choose which events will be covered during the day. Draw up the assignment schedule.
  • Attend planning meetings for day-to-day, upcoming and special-event coverage. Discuss the various events to be covered, express your opinions and consider those of the team.
  • Inform the National Assignment Editor of local stories having a national angle or liable to take on national importance.
  • Assign stories to journalists and co-ordinate their work. Discuss with reporters which angles they should take and direct them accordingly. Supply reporters with additional documentation if necessary. Inform them of what audio and video clips are available.
  • Assign camera operators to shoots.
  • If necessary, arrange reporters’ and camera operators’ schedules to meet coverage needs (this is a strategic role within our team).
  • Co-ordinate the work of a Research Journalist or Assignment Assistant as needed.
  • Co-ordinate requests for collaboration on regional and national news and current affairs programs. Ensure that the required production resources are available to journalists.
  • Closely follow events as they unfold. Be prepared to reassign journalists at any time. Plan and chase medium- and long-term assignments and create a bank of story ideas.
  • May revise the form and content of the story. May suggest or demand corrections. May refuse to allow a story to be broadcast. Follow up with journalists after the broadcast.
  • Write intros as needed.
  • Occasionally set up interviews for reporters.
  • Ensure that the items under your responsibility are ready on time for the various newscasts per the lineups (digital layouts). Also ensure that adequate human, budgetary and technical resources are available.
  • Perform the duties of a Journalist or Regional Lineup Editor as required.
  • Carry out all other related tasks as needed.

This role requires full-time on-site presence.

  • Five (5) years’ journalism experience or equivalent.

Skills:

  • Fluency in French (working language).

  • In-depth knowledge of newsroom logistics.
  • Very good knowledge of storytelling techniques specific to each platform.
  • Knowledge of production techniques.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills.

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we all have a story to tell. What’s yours?

 

If you share our passion for Canadian storytelling, and you wish to help us engage with individuals and communities across our various digital platforms, this is where you’ll want to be!

 

Every day, you will have an opportunity to shape the way in which Canadians see themselves reflected in our digital services. Your work will have a direct impact on how millions of Canadians from various communities connect with our products, with one another, and with the diverse voices that make our country so unique.

 

You will have the opportunity to play a part in enlightening and entertaining Canadians through our innovative work in building the mediums that deliver our content. We are an innovative hub, where the talented professionals we work with are respected and valued for their contributions. Our product teams are vibrant and our work culture strives to achieve the highest standards of diversity and inclusion. We believe that hiring people with different career paths and backgrounds is fundamental in our shared success and in building healthy and highly performant teams.

 

When you join our mission, you are not only shaping the vision of CBC/Radio-Canada, but the future of our country.

 

We know that commitment to equity, inclusion and diversity is essential to creating content that mirrors and resonates with the rich and evolving makeup of our country.  We’re also committed to reaching out and connecting with our audience on multiple platforms this includes creating virtual places where communities can come together.

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Why is this role important?

 

You will be an important element of our over-the-top platform team. As such, working closely with the product owners, architects and technical managers, your role is to ensure the smooth execution of product front-end development and coordinate the technical work required to deliver requested features, while adhering to the standards and practices agreed to by the development management team.

 

The team you will be part of is in charge of an harmonized product, powering CBC Gem and ICI TOU.TV.

 

Perks you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work schedules, allowing you to prioritize yourself, your family and your work
  • Work from home opportunities
  • Competitive total rewards package
  • Opportunities to work with cutting edge technology
  • Opportunities for continued learning and professional development
  • Opportunities to become a member of our Employee Resource Groups
  • Pair programming and mentorship opportunities, where you can learn from the best in the industry and help coach new talent
  • A creative and dynamic work environment, where your ideas and contributions can be heard, valued and respected
  • A supportive management team committed to upholding the highest standards of diversity and inclusivity
  • An environment which favours experimentation and an iterative approach in order to achieve the highest form of technical innovation.

 

Your responsibilities:

  • Design and/or modify reusable components for Radio-Canada's digital platforms; such as the audio/video player.
  • Ensure compliance with standards and control the quality of the product throughout the project's execution.
  • Stay informed of new trends in the various fields of digital development.
  • By being proactive, propose solutions to the challenges encountered.
  • Participate in Agile Scrum activities designed to review ongoing production projects in order to make necessary corrections and adjustments, or completed projects to measure their results.
  • Participate in the development of user stories for our various products.
  • Ensure the good performance of developed applications to handle high loads.
  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and application deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews and solution deployments.

We are looking for a candidate matching the following profile:

  • University degree or equivalent experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience in software development.
  • Proficiency in C#, ASP.NET Core and WebAPI.
  • Excellent grasp of REST API principles.
  • Knowledge of Git.
  • Knowledge of SQL Server, Entity Framework.
  • Knowledge of Redis is an asset.
  • Knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Azure Data Lake is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure cloud is an asset.
  • Knowledge of audio-video broadcasting on the web (streaming) is an asset.
  • Knowledge of other programming languages is an asset.
  • Knowledge of design patterns is an asset.
  • Good general knowledge and strong intellectual curiosity (to acquire and develop new knowledge and skills).
  • Critical thinking (to question and propose new ideas).
  • A keen interest in the major trends and challenges of the digital world.
  • Meticulousness, independence, and resourcefulness.
  • Excellent stress management and priority setting.
  • Analytical and conceptual thinking skills.
  • Flexibility, initiative, and dynamism.
  • Ability to work in a team, excellent communicator.
  • Bilingualism (English and French) spoken and written is mandatory.

 

Please note that due to the nature of the mandates and responsibilities of this role, all candidates will be required to work in a multilingual environment, where business will be conducted in both official languages (English and French). Therefore, employees working in this role will be expected to make the required efforts and adjustments to navigate this multilingual environment in a respectful manner for all.

 

Please note this is a 12-month contract position, renewable annually. This regular position is not a consulting assignment but a long-term opportunity with competitive CBC/Radio-Canada employee benefits.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

This is a 1-year temporary role.


As the Client Sales Support you will build proposals and help the Integrated Account Lead (IAL) negotiate and close sales opportunities with existing and potential clients to help build revenue. This involves managing client campaigns from inception to completion through the sales cycle and being accountable for all aspects of clients’ business in collaboration with the IAL. 

 

You are also responsible for creating and managing sales plans and tactics while providing required weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting and forecasting.


Key Tasks:


  • Support the day-to-day activities that are required to prepare, pitch, and close a sale:
  • Analyse the advertising activity of customers and their potential for bringing in revenue;
  • Develop strategic plans for accessing this additional revenue;
  • Assist in developing and maintaining client profiles, contact updates, historical buying;
  • Create tracking systems for reporting, trending analysis and identifying potential sales opportunities. 
  • Prepare sales presentations that cover several markets to be directed at advertisers or advertising agencies. 
  • Research potential customers, including their market, activities, and competition and compare the effectiveness of alternate advertising sources whether in broadcast, digital, OTT,  audio or other forms 
  • Present revenue-building opportunities found through research to the Integrated Account Lead. 
  • Oversee sales contracts through to the end, modifying or renegotiating, as required.
  • Initiate post-analysis to determine if contract commitments have been met and review results with the Integrated Account Lead (IAL).
  • Stay on top of all Canadian markets likely to be of interest to your clients.
  • Coordinate and assist the IALs in managing daily administration issues.
  • Maintain client account detail and advertising plans on all CBC/Radio-Canada platforms.
  • Proactively monitor and resolve potential performance issues with client marketing campaigns. 
  • Help coordinate external client events. 
  • Build various tracking systems and reports.
  • Obtain required credit approvals, traffic schedules and delivery of creative, as needed.

We are looking for a candidate with the following: 


  • Post-secondary degree/diploma with emphasis on business and/or marketing and sales or the equivalent.
  • 3 to 5 years of progressive and relevant experience in sales. 
  • Demonstrated understanding of media-related advertising and strategic marketing.
  • Ability to develop and maintain excellent relationships with new and existing clients.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and Powerpoint) and Google Workspace (aka G Suite).
  • Ability to exercise tact and diplomacy when interacting with clients and co-workers.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to think “outside of the box”.
  • Value diverse perspectives and ideas, and differing points of view.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to juggle multiple priorities within a short period of time with frequent interruptions and multiple deadlines.
  • Experience in a multi-platform sales environment is preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Knowledge of the following programs is an asset: Salesforce, OnAir, Google Ad Manager, Advendio, Prisma for Sellers, Triton.
  • English/French proficiency is an asset.

JOB SUMMARY / SOMMAIRE DE L’EMPLOI:


Reporting directly to the Heads of both Digital Originals & CBC Films in the Scripted Department, you will plan, organize, coordinate and control all administrative procedures, activities and documentation for both offices.


You are someone who thrives in a fast-paced, creative environment. There is no job too big or too small for you and you are looking to contribute in every way you can.


Responsibilities include:

  • Maintaining multiple active tracker documents for the Digital Originals & CBC Films content slates, both development and production, ensuring information is up to date and accurate
  • Managing the intake of all Digital Originals & CBC Films content proposals and ensuring timely responses are given to inquiries.
  • Organizing day-to-day operations for each department, establishing priorities, managing schedules, at times with minimal direction:
  • Effectively manage the calendar and daily schedule according to priorities, and ensure that the Heads of each department have necessary background material and are properly briefed prior to appointments and meetings.
  • Ensure information and inquiries are directed and processed quickly and efficiently.
  • Establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with other CBC departments and various external stakeholders.
  • Coordinating sensitive and confidential information across various departments. Including assisting with maintaining and updating confidential departmental records and databases.
  • Organizing and coordinating meetings with internal and external stakeholders, briefing sessions and other appointments and ensuring preparation and distribution of related agendas, documentation, minutes and follow up material.
  • Investigate and resolve problems related to departmental administrative matters.
  • Coordinate asset and master delivery of completed series, working closely with third-party producers
  • Some Social Media management around festival premieres and CBC Films launch on GEM
  • Coordinate asset production for CBC Gem (i.e. key art, thumbnails), acting as a liaison between independent producers and our in-house marketing team
  • Proactively monitoring the status of deliverables for all active projects and acting as the main point of contact for marketing teams regarding availability of program materials.
  • Managing and coordinating travel, festivals, conferences and attendance.
  • Providing all manner of administrative support.

  • Post-secondary education.
  • At least two to five years’ experience performing similar administrative or coordination duties and/or relevant experience (includes internships, job shadowing and learning spaces - e.g. BIPOC workshops).
  • Proficiency in G-Suite (Gmail, Docs, Drive, etc.) is required.
  • Excellent knowledge of and experience with computer applications, specifically Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Google Business Applications and a variety of social media platforms. 
  • Ability to manage financial tracking and reporting and assist in administration of Management projects.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.
  • Accuracy and attention to detail are essential.

  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
  • Ability to work independently and take initiative.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in an efficient manner.
  • Discretion, diplomacy and tact in communications with staff and/or managers at all levels of the organization.
  • An understanding of digital content trends and feature film trends an asset

Helping Canadians make sense of our world is our mission. Trade wars and talk of Canada becoming the 51st American state have made this mission more important than ever. And covering an unpredictable administration in Washington, DC brings new challenges as well.


We’re looking for an experienced correspondent who is keen to dive in and help us tell stories about this pivotal time in Canada’s history – as we work to tell these stories in new ways to grow new audiences.


We are hiring a correspondent for our Washington DC bureau. The successful candidate will be an exceptional journalist who thrives on breaking news, building contacts and working in a team to turn political stories that can feel hard to grasp into creative stories that connect. They bring a broad range of storytelling skills and are excited to produce strong social media-first content, aimed at mobile and streaming audiences. 


You thrive in a demanding daily news environment meeting multiple deadlines. You understand how to hook an audience on TikTok, write comprehensive analysis pieces and can go live when news breaks. You build a list of trusted sources and work to break news about the Canada - U.S. relationship. You are a storyteller who can navigate a variety of audio and video formats.  All of your journalism adheres to the CBC News Journalistic Standards and Practices. 


In this position, you will be supported by the Senior Producer in Washington DC who will assign American coverage, and supported by the World News teams in Toronto.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Cover the news in the United States: join the team of journalists reporting on news there, and other locations, as assigned. Working with the assignment team and other reporters in Washington, DC  the correspondent will generate and produce journalism guided by our audience news needs, across our platforms. 
  • Go live on any platform whenever a story requires it.
  • Produce original content while also responding to breaking news and emerging stories in a fast-paced environment.
  • Pitch and cover stories that resonate with our national audience, with an ability to find the significance in world events for a Canadian audience.
  • Research and analyze complex issues using specialized sources to ensure our audience gets a deep, nuanced understanding of important topics.
  • Develop and maintain a strong network of contacts with a wide range of sources.

What is required: 

  • You are a journalist with a minimum of 7 years of comparable experience, including significant reporting experience at a network/national level
  • Exceptional storytelling skills, with a proven ability to produce memorable social, written, audio and visual content
  • Demonstrated ability to produce compelling vertical visuals and social media content
  • Strong on-air presence and skill with live reporting.
  • Exceptional critical thinking skills, with an ability to breakdown complex issues and explain them clearly to audiences
  • Your extensive experience demonstrates that you can pivot quickly when a story changes, you remain respectful to colleagues when there are competing deadlines and content demands, and be open to social-centric presenting / hosting.
  • Extensive knowledge of world news and current affairs issues
  • A collaborative team player with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and willingness to work long and flexible hours, including overtime, evenings and weekends as needed.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills combined with a successful track record of working as part of a small team
  • Strong grasp of CBC News Journalistic Standards and Practices, with an ability to understand how they apply in your daily storytelling.
  • A university degree in journalism or an equivalent combination of education and experience is preferred.

Your application will be evaluated on your experience, as well as your portfolio of work. 


Please include at least two examples of: 

  • Digital / social stories you produced and shot
  • Packaged daily news video content you shot and edited 
  • A cover letter that tells us why you want this role, and how you will use your experience to support the bureau

Please, do not use Generative AI in your work samples or cover letter unless, of course, your work example is a story about AI. Consult these guidelines for helpful tips on how to apply, know what’s the process, and how to put your best foot forward.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

This role requires full-time on-site presence.

Role

In this role, working independently or coordinating the work of assigned technicians, you will perform all duties required to maintain transmission and broadcasting systems/equipment in a cross-functional environment spanning networking, electronics and computer systems.
 

Description of duties:

  • Perform all duties required to maintain transmission and broadcasting systems/equipment and remote monitoring equipment (including function-testing, configuring, installing, inspecting, diagnosing, troubleshooting, modifying, repairing and refurbishing).
  • Serve as a collaborative technical lead, taking responsibility for the technical quality of work performed by other technicians.
  • Co-ordinate, review and guide the work of other technicians.
  • Resolve latent or intermittent technical issues to maintain reliable transmission and broadcasting services.
  • Perform testing and complex adjustments to optimize technical facility performance.
  • Source required parts and technical materials, contacting vendors for information and sharing details with relevant stakeholders.
  • Maintain workplace safety for all site personnel, contractors and visitors in compliance with operating standards.
  • Keep plans, schematics and operating procedures up to date, creating new diagrams or sketches as needed.
  • Oversee jobsites and co-ordinate subcontractor activities as needed to ensure all work meets project specifications.
  • Maintain current technical knowledge to fulfil assigned responsibilities and keep pace with evolving technology.
  • Perform preventive maintenance and assist in developing methods and procedures that optimize equipment usage and simplify servicing.
  • Advise personnel on the installation, commissioning and operation of production and broadcasting systems/equipment.
  • Perform routine general building maintenance at remote transmission sites.
  • Operate any vehicle necessary for travel or job-related tasks, requiring that you possess the appropriate valid driver’s licence; clean and perform routine maintenance on vehicles; maintain the vehicle logbook; comply with all applicable national or provincial driver licensing requirements and regulations.
  • Complete the appropriate forms and documents; share information verbally or in writing to ensure proper followup and to keep others informed.
  • Familiarize other employees with their duties and the work environment.
  • Carry out, as needed, all or part of the duties of another job classification within an equivalent or lower salary group, as well as other related duties.

What you Bring

  • Community college diploma (DSC) in electronics technology (telecommunications or computer systems option) or a related field.
  • Five years’ experience required to perform duties satisfactorily, given the cross-functional environment and variety of equipment.
  • Working knowledge of English an asset.
  • Flexibility to work evening and weekend shifts.
  • Availability to travel around Quebec and occasionally the Far North.

Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete the following:

  • Interview.

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we all have a story to tell. What’s yours?

 

If you share our passion for Canadian storytelling, and you wish to help us engage with individuals and communities across our various digital platforms, this is where you’ll want to be!

 

Every day, you will have an opportunity to shape the way in which Canadians see themselves reflected in our digital services. Your work will have a direct impact on how millions of Canadians from various communities  connect with our products, with one another, and with the diverse voices that make our country so unique.

 

You will have the opportunity to play a part in enlightening and entertaining Canadians through our innovative work in building the mediums that deliver our content. We are an innovative hub, where the talented professionals we work with are respected and valued for their contributions. Our product teams are vibrant and our work culture strives to achieve the highest standards of diversity and inclusion. We believe that hiring people with different career paths and backgrounds is fundamental in our shared success and in building healthy and highly performant teams.

 

When you join our mission, you are not only shaping the vision of CBC/Radio-Canada, but the future of our country.

 

We know that commitment to equity, inclusion and diversity is essential to creating content that mirrors and resonates with the rich and evolving makeup of our country.  We’re also committed to reaching out and connecting with our audience on multiple platforms this includes creating virtual places where communities can come together.

This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Why is this role important?

 

You will be an important element of the team. As such, working closely with the product owners, project managers, architects and technical manager, your role is to ensure the smooth execution of product front-end development and coordinate the technical work required to deliver requested features, while adhering to the standards and practices agreed to by the development management team.

 

The team you will be part of is in charge of a harmonized product, powering ICI TOU.TV and CBC Gem.

 

Perks you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work schedules, allowing you to prioritize yourself, your family and your work.
  • Work from home opportunities.
  • Competitive total rewards package.
  • Opportunities to work with cutting edge technology.
  • Opportunities for continued learning and professional development.
  • Opportunities to become a member of our Employee Resource Groups.
  • Pair programming and mentorship opportunities, where you can learn from the best in the industry and help coach new talent.
  • A creative and dynamic work environment, where your ideas and contributions can be heard, valued and respected.
  • A supportive management team committed to upholding the highest standards of diversity and inclusivity.
  • An environment which favours experimentation and an iterative approach in order to achieve the highest form of technical innovation.

 

Your responsibilities:

  • Design and modify reusable components for Radio-Canada's digital platforms.
  • Ensure compliance with standards and control the quality of the product throughout the project's execution.
  • Stay informed of new trends in the various fields of digital development.
  • By being proactive, propose solutions to the challenges encountered.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum meetings to track deliverables in production, oversee necessary fixes, and assess the impact of completed projects.
  • Participate in the technical implementation of user stories for our various products.
  • Ensure the good performance of developed applications to handle high loads.
  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, code reviews, and application deployments.

 

We are looking for a candidate matching the following profile:

  • University degree or equivalent experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience developing complex, high-performance native iOS applications.
  • Excellent command of the Swift language and advanced concepts in object-oriented, functional, and reactive programming.
  • Hands-on experience developing user interfaces with SwiftUI and UIKit.
  • Solid understanding of modern iOS architectures (MVVM, MVI) and common software design patterns (Design Patterns, SOLID principles).
  • Proficiency in state management, local persistence (Core Data, SwiftData), and consuming REST/GraphQL APIs using modern concurrency (Swift Concurrency, Combine).
  • Experience with the full deployment and release cycle of applications on the App Store (App Store Connect, TestFlight).
  • Proficiency in iOS performance optimization techniques (app launch time, rendering smoothness, memory management, leak prevention, and energy efficiency).
  • Excellent command of Xcode and its advanced diagnostic tools (Instruments, Memory Graph, debugging).
  • Proficiency in Git and collaborative workflows (code reviews, branching).
  • Ability to read, produce, and adhere to software architecture diagrams (UML, sequence diagrams, etc.).
  • Experience developing for tvOS / Apple TV, an asset.
  • Experience creating, versioning, and distributing internal libraries (Swift Package Manager / SPM or CocoaPods), an asset.
  • Experience implementing authentication systems, session management, or multi-profile environments, an asset.
  • Experience writing automated unit and UI tests, an asset.
  • Awareness of and experience with mobile accessibility principles (VoiceOver, Dynamic Type), an asset.
  • Knowledge of other programming languages, an asset.
  • Technical rigor, attention to detail, and a constant focus on software performance.
  • Autonomy, initiative, and a demonstrated ability to prioritize in a dynamic environment.
  • Team spirit, intellectual curiosity, and ease in communicating technical decisions.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Functional knowledge of written and spoken French is considered a strong asset.

 

Please note that due to the nature of the mandates and responsibilities of this role, all candidates will be required to work in a multilingual environment, where business will be conducted in both official languages (English and French). Therefore, employees working in this role will be expected to make the required efforts and adjustments to navigate this multilingual environment in a respectful manner for all.

 

Please note this is a 12-month contract position, renewable annually. This regular position is not a consulting assignment but a long-term opportunity with attractive CBC/Radio-Canada employee benefits.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

step will be asked to complete a background check. This includes:  

  • A mandatory Criminal record check. 

  • Other background checks may be conducted based on the operational requirements of the position.

If you share our passion for Canadian storytelling, and you wish to help us engage with individuals and communities across our various digital platforms, this is where you’ll want to be!

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

Your Role


CBC/Radio-Canada is seeking a Lead Analyst, Continuous AI Risk Management Expert, to design, build and lead the enterprise-wide governance, security and continuous risk management program for artificial intelligence (covering both traditional AI and generative AI) across the Corporation.

In this role, you will design and deploy an enterprise AI risk assessment framework and conduct continuous evaluations of AI systems throughout the AI life cycle (from design to production). You will collaborate closely with data protection analysts, as well as the legal, compliance and enterprise architecture teams, to identify, measure and mitigate cybersecurity risks associated with AI technologies.

This position can be based in Montreal or Toronto.

What’s in It for You

Challenges. We spend our days solving problems of all kinds. Media files are highly nuanced and incredibly complicated; updating, installing and supporting technologies that are organization-wide and that impact broadcasting content is a time-sensitive, complex technical feat. And that’s just the beginning. You’ll be working with leading-edge data management, cloud, IP broadcasting, AI, security and reliability technologies.

As Lead Analyst, you will:

  • Design and deploy the AI risk assessment framework: Develop, formalize and implement a standardized risk assessment methodology tailored to AI systems, including ethical impact matrices, model criticality criteria, bias analysis, algorithmic vulnerability assessments and data exposure risks.
  • Support enterprise AI governance architecture: Collaborate closely with architecture teams and governance committees to design, integrate and evolve the security foundation for AI technologies across the Corporation.
  • Maintain the AI inventory and classification: Build and manage a centralized registry of all AI systems, models (internal, SaaS, open-source) and AI agents deployed across the organization, classified by risk level.
  • Conduct continuous model risk assessments: Perform technical risk evaluations on new AI use cases, analyzing training data security, prompt/query confidentiality, algorithmic bias and intellectual property risks.
  • Perform AI security testing: Define and execute specialized security and adversarial testing for AI and large language models (LLMs).
  • Assess third-party AI and SaaS solutions: Partner with the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Analyst to evaluate the security posture, privacy controls and model-training policies of external vendors. Provide specialized AI expertise to analyze contractual data-use terms (e.g., ensuring corporate data is not used for model training), evaluate SaaS API security and verify privacy guarantees in third-party environments.
  • Manage the AI risk register: Document, maintain and map AI-specific model vulnerabilities, technical debt and approved exceptions in the risk register.
  • Assess program maturity: Conduct periodic evaluations of AI governance maturity, developing dashboards and tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) for executive and governance committees.
  • Maintain industry expertise: Stay current on information security best practices and industry trends.

What You Bring

  • University degree in computer science, IT or information security.
  • Minimum five years' applied experience in IT security, data governance or technology risk management.
  • Demonstrated experience in designing or implementing risk assessment methodologies and evaluating AI models.
  • Proven ability to translate complex AI concepts into structured risk frameworks for project teams, with a deep understanding of AI architectures and AI-specific attack vectors.
  • Extensive knowledge of security technology and risk assessment methodologies, policies and processes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical decision-makers (e.g., governance committees, business units, legal teams).
  • Excellent analytical, evaluative and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience with compliance programs as well as their technical and security requirements.
  • Technical expertise across key domains:
    • Standards and Frameworks: Strong command of industry standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, 27002, 27005, NIST SP 800-53 / 800-161, COBIT and ITIL.
    • Cloud and Web Architecture Security: Solid understanding of web infrastructure and cloud environment security.
    • Network and Security Technologies: Thorough understanding of network architectures (LAN/WAN, routers), network security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, DNS, web filtering) and cryptographic principles (encryption at rest and in transit).
    • Architecture and Data Security: Working knowledge of database architecture concepts and secure software development best practices.
    • Operational Resilience and Physical Security: Solid understanding of business continuity and disaster recovery planning (BCP/DRP), operational resilience and physical security controls.
  • Relevant professional security certifications a definite asset (e.g., CISSP, CRISC, CBCP, CISA, CISM or equivalent).
  • Bilingualism (English and French) essential.

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. 
 
Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2026-11-19 11:59 PM

To be Canada’s most trusted news source, we must meet our audience in the moments that matter 24/7, helping them make sense of their world in real time. CBC News is looking for an innovative leader to serve as Managing Editor, guiding our live and breaking weekend programming.


You’re an exceptional leader who can manage complex operations independently; navigate ethical and legal considerations to tight deadlines; and support assignment and programming teams in an unrelenting news environment. You are a decisive leader who can act independently under pressure. At the same time, you prioritize deep collaboration with colleagues in the Toronto Broadcast Centre and across the country to deliver relevant stories and compelling formats urgently and efficiently.


In this role, you’ll be on the ground with weekend programming teams, driving live and daily news coverage, co-ordination and distribution across CBC News Network, digital, streaming, social, and CBC Radio One newscasts and national call-in programs.


You know how to build a respectful culture where teams are motivated to support each other, producing impactful journalism that prioritizes live and breaking news that resonates with all Canadians. You are a collaborator who can wear many hats, equally adept at pivoting for live programming as you are at evolving workflows and supporting staff under pressure. You expertly navigate daily digital, streaming, broadcast and social platforms, and help to prioritize
the relentless demands for teams who deliver the highest quality audio, video and text coverage. You’ll work with colleagues across the CBC News division, sharing both content and expertise across platforms and programs..


In this role, you are the first stop for teams around legal issues and questions involving the CBC's Journalistic Standards and Practices, ensuring they’re providing fair, balanced, accurate, thoughtful and immediate coverage.


You support executive producers, senior producers and assignment leaders in managing budgets, resource allocation and ensuring the mental and physical well-being of your teams is front-and-centre.

You work closely with other managing editors to ensure CBC News delivers on its mission to provide seamless live, breaking and daily coverage 24/7.

What you'll be doing:


As a top-tier leader, you'll be front and centre in fulfilling the CBC News mission by driving journalism, innovation and connection. In this role, you’ll:


● Lead with Impact: Bring your A-game everyday, guiding and inspiring a talented team of journalists and directing editorial and audience growth strategy on all platforms. In collaboration with the Head of Live and Daily News, Managing Editors, Executive and Senior Producers, you oversee the weekend news strategy for live and daily coverage of national and international stories and major events.


● Champion Audience Growth: Focus editorial decisions on expanding our reach, particularly to new and younger news consumers, and to deepen our engagement with all Canadians. You understand the pulse of Canadian audiences and their habits, and translate insights and data into actionable content strategies for all platforms.


● Mentor & Develop: Provide strong editorial leadership, offering clear direction,
constructive feedback, and growth opportunities to a large team of journalists. You cultivate a high-performing, collaborative, and respectful work culture where everyone feels empowered to contribute. You ensure your team has the skills, tools and training to adapt quickly, and provide ongoing coaching and mentorship to support them through rapid change.


● Foster Authentic Storytelling: Champion content that truly reflects the richness and diversity of perspectives, ideas, and experiences in Canada. You inspire your team to think inclusively, always asking whose voice is missing and you work diligently to close that gap. You collaborate with journalistic leaders across CBC News, ensuring our daily coverage is reflective of the stories and issues that help Canadians make sense of their world.


● Uphold Journalistic Excellence: Ensure all content adheres to CBC's rigorous Journalistic Standards and Practices, navigating complex ethical and legal considerations with grace and precision.


● Resource Management: Manage budgets, allocate resources effectively, and co-ordinate technical and production requirements for coverage.


● Innovate & Strategize: Demonstrate daily the role of a public broadcaster in a media landscape proliferated with misinformation, disinformation and rapidly evolving technologies. Verification is a core value. You lean into data, and use it to drive audience-focused strategies for your team. You translate big ideas into tangible actions.

We're looking for someone who:


● Has at least eight to 10 years of recent, significant leadership experience in a fast-paced news environment, particularly in roles involving breaking news, live programming and overseeing large teams in a unionized environment.

● Experience with risk assessment and management is a requirement.


● Demonstrates exceptional critical thinking, news judgement and a deep knowledge of the legal and ethical issues in journalism.


● Has demonstrated experience in implementing live and breaking news coverage plans across streaming, digital and broadcast platforms, from the initial alert to sustained coverage as the story evolves.


● Is an astute strategist, capable of translating audience insights and data into effective content decisions and programming results that meet the evolving needs of Canadian news consumers.


● Possesses proven ability to find solutions to a variety of technical, resource and operational issues, to make decisions to tight deadlines; and to handle multiple priorities while juggling tasks and/or projects.


● Has strong coaching and mentorship skills, with a track record of recruiting and developing talent and fostering a positive, inclusive, and equitable work environment.

● Is comfortable navigating rapid change, troubleshooting complex situations, and making swift decisions under pressure.


● Brings a deep and nuanced understanding of national and international politics, world events, geography, and history, coupled with strong cultural awareness and sensitivity.


● Exhibits stellar communication and collaboration skills, essential for working across diverse teams and regions.


● Has a university degree or equivalent professional experience.


● Is flexible to work varying hours on short notice, including early mornings, nights and holidays to respond to the demands of a live programming cycle.
