job.description:
Location: FL-Jacksonville

Job Title:  Media Consultant - Jacksonville Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is looking for Media Consultants (MCs) for outside sales roles focused on acquiring new clients and managing existing accounts. We’re seeking talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who are self-starters and excel in a fast-paced work environment.

 

As a Media Consultant, you will acquire new clients and strengthen relationships with existing ones to become a marketing solution provider that understands each customer’s unique business goals and helps them achieve those goals through your media assets. In this field-based role, you will regularly collaborate with a team of sales professionals and use industry-leading tools and resources to create integrated marketing solutions that help clients achieve their business objectives.

 

This role focuses on generating new and incremental radio and digital revenue. The main job is to prospect for new business, develop innovative cross-platform advertising solutions, run effective marketing campaigns, and build strong relationships and business partnerships within the community. The Media Consultant is also responsible for retaining and expanding their existing accounts through insight-driven proposals, performance metrics, and by maximizing all radio station and digital assets.

 

To succeed, you’ll need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and a problem-solver. You also must have effective communication skills and the ability to build both new and lasting client relationships. The ideal candidate should have strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you face a challenging mission, have access to world-class tools to help you succeed, and can realize your full potential as a sales professional. This position provides an opportunity to increase your income through a rewarding commission structure.

 

You’ll also join a team dedicated to making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and applies resources and strategies appropriately
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling
  • Consistently manages target accounts within the pipeline
  • Generates revenue by developing new accounts and expanding existing ones
  • Prepares proposals to present to Sales leaders, along with existing and potential clients
  • Consults clients on all CMG solutions and offerings, demonstrating a deep understanding of product capabilities, measurement, attribution, and KPIs
  • Responsible for learning and selling fully integrated advertising solutions using our complete range of audio and digital products
  • Responsible for meeting and surpassing all sales targets as outlined by the General Sales Manager and/or Director of Sales
  • Performs a needs analysis and account review to identify the customer’s most important needs
  • Creates effective marketing strategies to satisfy each client’s needs and goals
  • Creates engaging and convincing presentations that generate new or additional business
  • Successfully negotiates advertising rates
  • Showcases product knowledge and its value to customers
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients, then persuasively presents and sells those sponsorships
  • Collaborates with internal departments to oversee account stewardship throughout the process
  • Uses CRM (HubSpot) to track and manage daily activities, build a pipeline, ensure execution, and generate weekly projections and revenue reports
  • Upsells existing customers by sharing performance metrics, research insights, and proven results
  • Collaborates with account management to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions, conduct account maintenance, including make-goods, and collect on aging receivables
  • Attend sales meetings, training sessions, and remote client meetings

Minimum Qualifications

  • Two years of experience in new business development and prospecting within media sales or a related sales role
  • Demonstrated track record of increasing revenue through effective campaigns
  • Proven success in working with people (i.e., career, school, organizations, sports, etc.)
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, interpersonal skills, and business acumen
  • Ability to multitask and work in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment with tight deadlines
  • Excellent marketing, presentation, and closing abilities
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Capable of successfully negotiating with customers to achieve a strong return on investment
  • Experience in prospecting for new clients, selling services to them, and maintaining and upselling to existing clients
  • Proﬁcient in Microsoft Oﬃce, PowerPoint, and CRM tools like HubSpot
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree
  • Three years of experience in media sales, account management, or media buying
  • Proven track record of success in digital and radio sales within a local media environment

job.title: Media Consultant - Long Island Radio
job.description:
Location: NY-Long Island

Job Title:  Media Consultant - Long Island Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is looking for Media Consultants (MCs) for outside sales roles focused on acquiring new clients and managing existing accounts. We’re seeking talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who are self-starters and excel in a fast-paced work environment.

 

As a Media Consultant, you will acquire new clients and strengthen relationships with existing ones to become a marketing solution provider that understands each customer’s unique business goals and helps them achieve those goals through your media assets. In this field-based role, you will regularly collaborate with a team of sales professionals and use industry-leading tools and resources to create integrated marketing solutions that help clients achieve their business objectives.

 

This role focuses on generating new and incremental radio and digital revenue. The main job is to prospect for new business, develop innovative cross-platform advertising solutions, run effective marketing campaigns, and build strong relationships and business partnerships within the community. The Media Consultant is also responsible for retaining and expanding their existing accounts through insight-driven proposals, performance metrics, and by maximizing all radio station and digital assets.

 

To succeed, you’ll need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and a problem-solver. You also must have effective communication skills and the ability to build both new and lasting client relationships. The ideal candidate should have strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you face a challenging mission, have access to world-class tools to help you succeed, and can realize your full potential as a sales professional. This position provides an opportunity to increase your income through a rewarding commission structure.

 

You’ll also join a team dedicated to making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and applies resources and strategies appropriately.
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling.
  • Consistently manages target accounts within the pipeline.
  • Generates revenue by developing new accounts and expanding existing ones.
  • Prepares proposals to present to Sales leaders, along with existing and potential clients.
  • Consults clients on all CMG solutions and offerings, demonstrating a deep understanding of product capabilities, measurement, attribution, and KPIs.
  • Responsible for learning and selling fully integrated advertising solutions using our complete range of audio and digital products.
  • Responsible for meeting and surpassing all sales targets as outlined by the General Sales Manager and/or Director of Sales.
  • Performs a needs analysis and account review to identify the customer’s most important needs.
  • Creates effective marketing strategies to satisfy each client’s needs and goals.
  • Creates engaging and convincing presentations that generate new or additional business.
  • Successfully negotiates advertising rates.
  • Showcases product knowledge and its value to customers.
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients, then persuasively presents and sells those sponsorships.
  • Collaborates with internal departments to oversee account stewardship throughout the process.
  • Uses CRM (HubSpot) to track and manage daily activities, build a pipeline, ensure execution, and generate weekly projections and revenue reports.
  • Upsells existing customers by sharing performance metrics, research insights, and proven results.
  • Collaborates with account management to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions, conduct account maintenance, including make-goods, and collect on aging receivables.
  • Attend sales meetings, training sessions, and remote client meetings.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Two years of experience in new business development and prospecting within media sales or a related sales role.
  • Demonstrated track record of increasing revenue through effective campaigns.
  • Proven success in working with people (i.e., career, school, organizations, sports, etc.)
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, interpersonal skills, and business acumen.
  • Ability to multitask and work in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment with tight deadlines.
  • Excellent marketing, presentation, and closing abilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • Capable of successfully negotiating with customers to achieve a strong return on investment.
  • Experience in prospecting for new clients, selling services to them, and maintaining and upselling to existing clients.
  • Proﬁcient in Microsoft Oﬃce, PowerPoint, and CRM tools like HubSpot.
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree
  • Three years of experience in media sales, account management, or media buying.
  • Proven track record of success in digital and radio sales within a local media environment.

 

This position is 100% commission based. Final compensation for the role will be determined by a variety of factors such as skills, certifications, and relevant work experience. 

 

Benefits for this role include:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance available to the employee and employee’s family (i.e. child, spouse, domestic partner)
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (healthcare and dependent care) and Health Savings Accounts
  • Short-term and long-term disability and life insurance (supplemental and accidental, death, and dismemberment)
  • Participation in CMG’s 401(k) plan with generous company match and both pre-tax and Roth options
  • Paid flexible vacation and up to four weeks (160 hours) of paid wellness time, inclusive of paid sick and safe time under applicable law
  • Up to eight (8) paid holidays throughout calendar year 2025
  • Up to two (2) weeks of paid parental leave
  • Employee assistance program
  • All other benefits required by applicable law

Job Title:  Meteorologist - WSB TV

 

Position Overview

WSB-TV in Atlanta is seeking a Meteorologist to join Severe Weather Team 2. The Atlanta area experiences all four seasons, making forecasting a central part of our coverage. Severe weather is a major focus, and we’re seeking a candidate with strong on-air delivery who can provide breaking weather coverage with a clear, authoritative presence.

 

The ideal candidate is creative and clear in their presentation and graphic support, has a digital-first mindset and connects authentically with viewers both on-air and online. This Meteorologist will also contribute to daily editorial meetings and turn stories.

 

Please submit your resume, link to demo reel (including breaking weather coverage), and examples of digital/social content in your application.

  • Deliver clear, accurate, and engaging forecasts across multiple newscasts
  • Provide confident, in-depth coverage during severe and breaking weather events
  • Contribute to storm tracking and team coverage during high-impact weather
  • Create and publish timely, compelling content for digital, app, streaming, and social platforms
  • Produce weather explainers and enterprise content that enhances viewer understanding
  • Utilize The Weather Company and Baron Lynx weather systems to build visually compelling graphics and presentations
  • Collaborate with newsroom leadership to integrate weather coverage across all platforms
  • Represent the station at community events and public appearances

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Meteorology or Atmospheric Science
  • Minimum 3–5 years of on-air broadcast meteorology experience (major or competitive mid-major market preferred)
  • Proven experience covering severe weather and extended storm events
  • Strong working knowledge of The Weather Company system
  • Excellent live presentation, ad-libbing, and storytelling skills
  • Demonstrated digital-first approach, including social media and app engagement
  • Flexible scheduling, including weekends and holidays, is required, along with participation in an on-call rotation
  • This is an on-site, in-station role in the WSB-TV Newsroom
  • Must have a valid driver's license and clean driving record

Position Overview

WNGC Radio is seeking a dynamic, personality-driven Morning Show Co-Host to join North Georgia's heritage Country radio station. This role is one of the primary on-air voices of the morning show and helps build audience loyalty, grow ratings and digital engagement, create compelling multiplatform content, and represent WNGC in the community.

The ideal candidate understands how to maintain forward momentum through effective teasing, pacing, and content execution while connecting naturally with listeners on-air, online, and in person.

 

Please include your Air Check Package with application!

  • Develop and execute daily content plans, recurring features, story arcs, and digital content across social, video, web, and podcast platforms.

  • Execute station strategy while supporting ratings growth, digital engagement, FCC compliance, and ongoing professional development.

  • Maintain reliable attendance, punctuality, and professional judgment in a live, deadline-driven environment.

  • Demonstrated on-air radio experience with strong storytelling, audience engagement, and personality-driven content skills.
  • Strong on-air presence with a relatable, topical, and occasionally humorous point of view.
  • Understanding of audience retention, content pacing, teasing, show momentum, and the Country radio audience.
  • Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and vocal delivery skills.
  • Experience with audio editing software, such as Adobe Audition, and radio automation systems, such as WideOrbit.
  • Proficiency creating social media and video content across multiple digital platforms.
  • Creative, prepared, coachable, and able to collaborate effectively within a morning show and across Programming, Promotions, Digital, and Sales with a strong work ethic and team-first mindset.
  • Availability for early mornings, local or regional travel, and occasional evenings, weekends, holidays, events, and remote broadcasts.

Job Title:  Multi-Platform Editor/Videographer - WFXT TV

 

Position Overview

WFXT TV is seeking a Multi-Platform Editor/Videographer to join the Boston 25 News team.

 

We’re looking for a skilled video editor and/or videographer with strong visual composition and sound judgment. In this role, you’ll work with producers and reporters to shoot and edit video for 14.5 hours of daily on-air news coverage, while also creating content for streaming channels, the website, news and weather apps, and social media platforms.

 

The ideal candidate is organized, self-motivated, deadline-focused, and brings strong people skills, a solid work ethic, and a positive attitude. This role requires availability to work nights, overnights, weekends, and holidays.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Shoot and edit clear, compelling local news stories.
  • Work well under pressure and make quick decisions in the field.
  • Operate and maintain professional video cameras and news gathering equipment, including laptops, iPhones, LiveU units, and drones.
  • Use non-linear editing techniques to meet deadlines and produce high-impact stories.
  • Respond effectively during crises and breaking news and handle last-minute changes professionally.
  • Create digital content, edit social videos, and post to social media.
  • Come prepared for editorial and other meetings, contribute daily story ideas, and bring creative energy to the team.
  • Collaborate with reporters to create strong visual stories and active live shots or teases while meeting daily deadlines in high-pressure situations.
  • Independently gather VO, VO-SOT, and natural sound packages.
  • Work in all weather conditions and carry up to 50 pounds of equipment.

  • Represent the station and news department professionally, courteously, and with a neat, presentable appearance.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 1–2 years of non-linear TV news editing and/or TV news photography experience required.
  • Reliable and able to work additional hours and travel as needed.
  • Strong news judgment, a solid understanding of daily news content, and knowledge of journalistic ethics and libel laws required.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
  • Able to stand for extended periods and walk long distances.
  • Able to lift and carry 25 to 50 pounds.

job.title: New Business and Sports Sales Manager - WSOC TV
job.description:
Location: NC-Charlotte

Job Title:  New Business and Sports Sales Manager - WSOC TV

 

Position Overview

Join WSOC-TV, a leading local media brand within Cox Media Group, as our New Business and Sports Sales Manager. In this role, you’ll lead new-client acquisition, grow sports sponsorship and advertising revenue, and accelerate growth across television, streaming, and digital marketing platforms.

 

This player-coach role is built for an accomplished media sales leader who thrives on building a disciplined new-business engine, expanding digital and sports revenue, and developing a high-performing sales team. You’ll bring strong leadership along with expertise in linear television, sports programming and sponsorships, connected TV (CTV)/OTT, streaming video, audience-based advertising, and the broader digital marketing ecosystem.

 

You’ll guide Account Executives through the full sales cycle—from target-account identification and prospecting through discovery, solution design, presentation, negotiation, close, renewal, and expansion. You’ll set clear activity and pipeline expectations, strengthen the team’s digital and sports selling skills, package and sell sports programming, sponsorships, and events, and collaborate across WSOC-TV and Cox Media Group to deliver integrated, measurable marketing solutions for local and regional advertisers.

 

If you’re a competitive, collaborative sales leader ready to shape the future of local media sales in Charlotte while helping clients achieve meaningful business results, we’d love to hear from you.

 

At WSOC-TV, you’ll combine the strength of a trusted local media brand with the resources of Cox Media Group to help Charlotte-area businesses grow. This is a chance to lead with impact, build something meaningful, and grow your career with a team that values results, collaboration, and community.

  • Sell with powerful assets. Bring clients trusted local news, sports programming, streaming, and digital solutions that reach audiences across the region.
  • Own the strategy. Shape the new-business and sports sales approach, build your team, and see the direct impact of your leadership on revenue growth.
  • Be part of a dynamic market. Work in Charlotte’s growing business community and passionate sports culture, with opportunities to connect brands with the fans and communities they want to reach.
  • Collaborate with talented teams. Partner with News, Sports, Creative Services, Digital Operations, and Traffic to deliver creative, high-impact solutions.
  • Grow your career. Develop as a leader within Cox Media Group, with opportunities to expand your expertise across television, streaming, and digital media.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Build a focused, accountable sales team that consistently generates qualified new business opportunities and advances them through the pipeline.
  • Achieve or exceed new-business, digital revenue, total revenue, client retention, and market-share goals.
  • Achieve or exceed sports revenue and sponsorship goals by securing new sports advertisers, renewing, and expanding sponsor partnerships, maximizing sell-through of sports inventory, and delivering on all sponsor commitments.
  • Improve key performance indicators, including prospecting activity, pipeline coverage, conversion rates, average deal size, forecast accuracy, and digital revenue mix.
  • Help advertisers achieve measurable business outcomes through integrated, insight-led solutions and effective campaign optimization.
  • Build productive partnerships across Sales, News, Creative Services, Digital Operations, and Traffic to deliver a seamless client experience.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Sales Leadership

  • Lead and develop Account Executives focused on new clients, digital growth, retention, and account expansion.
  • Build a high-performance culture grounded in prospecting, consultative selling, digital expertise, and accountability.
  • Set clear expectations for sales activity, pipeline coverage, conversion, forecasting, and revenue performance.
  • Coach sellers through one-on-ones, pipeline reviews, call preparation, field support, and deal strategy.
  • Support priority presentations, negotiations, and closes while removing barriers to growth.

 

New Business Development

  • Execute a market-level new-business strategy focused on priority categories, target accounts, and prospecting campaigns.
  • Coach sellers to generate qualified opportunities through research, outreach, networking, referrals, and insight-led conversations.
  • Build relationships with businesses, agencies, and key decision-makers across the market.
  • Turn advertiser objectives into integrated strategies using WSOC-TV and Cox Media Group assets.

 

Sports Sales and Sponsorships

  • Lead sports sales strategy across sponsorships, programming, special events, and multi-platform sports packages.
  • Identify and develop new advertisers and categories for local, regional, high school, college, and professional sports opportunities.
  • Build integrated sports packages across broadcast, streaming, digital, social, and on-site activations.
  • Cultivate relationships with teams, leagues, schools, venues, and sports organizations to create new revenue opportunities.
  • Manage sports inventory, pricing, and sponsor fulfillment to maximize revenue and deliver on every client commitment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Multi-Platform Advertising Solutions

  • Champion integrated solutions across television, CTV/OTT, streaming, display, search, social, digital audio, email, and audience targeting.
  • Coach sellers on discovery, positioning, audience strategy, measurement, and outcome-based selling.
  • Ensure proposals are strategic, accurately priced, executable, and aligned with client objectives.
  • Use campaign results to optimize performance, demonstrate value, renew business, and uncover growth opportunities.

 

Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Partner with WSOC-TV News and Sports on sponsorships, content integrations, and community-focused revenue opportunities.
  • Work with Creative Services to develop compelling, differentiated advertising solutions.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Digital Operations, Traffic, and other teams to execute multi-platform campaigns.
  • Create revenue opportunities around station initiatives, partnerships, special projects, and events.

 

Client Success and Retention

  • Build lasting client relationships through strategic guidance, responsiveness, and service.
  • Turn campaign results into persuasive renewal stories, case studies, and recommendations that drive renewals, upsells, and cross-platform growth.
  • Position WSOC-TV as a trusted business-growth partner.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Five or more years of media, sports, or digital advertising sales experience, with a demonstrated record of acquiring new clients, growing digital revenue, and expanding existing accounts.
  • Experience leading, coaching, and developing sales professionals, including setting expectations, managing performance, and driving accountability.
  • Proven ability to build and execute new-business strategies, manage prospecting and sales pipelines, use CRM tools, forecast accurately, and deliver revenue results.
  • Working knowledge of linear television, CTV/OTT, streaming video, audience targeting, digital advertising, campaign measurement, and integrated marketing solutions.
  • Experience translating client objectives into multi-platform advertising solutions and using campaign results to drive optimization, renewals, upselling, and retention.
  • Experience selling sports programming, sponsorships, or event-based marketing, including developing packages, and managing sponsor fulfillment.
  • Effective communication, presentation, negotiation, organizational, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to engage clients and support sellers on priority opportunities.
  • Ability to analyze audience, market, and campaign data and collaborate across Sales, News, Creative Services, Digital Operations, and Traffic to deliver effective client solutions.
  • Must have a valid driver's license and clean driving record.
Tools and Technology
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms, such as HubSpot, to track prospecting activity, manage pipeline health, and support accurate forecasting.
  • Working knowledge of WideOrbit Media Sales and Traffic or comparable broadcast sales and traffic systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Familiarity with advertising analytics, reporting, audience insights, and campaign management platforms.
  • Comfort using company-approved AI tools to support prospecting, planning, productivity, and campaign development.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, or a related field.
  • Prior sales leadership experience in a local broadcast, media, advertising, or digital sales organization.
  • Established relationships with sports teams, leagues, schools, venues, or sports marketing organizations in the Charlotte region.

This role is ideal for a strong storyteller who thrives in a live newsroom, makes sound editorial decisions under pressure, and brings urgency, context, and clarity to every story. Job Title:  News Technology Coordinator - WPXI TV

 

Position Overview

WPXI TV Pittsburgh has an exciting opportunity for a News Technical Coordinator. The role is responsible for resolving time-sensitive technical requests, maintaining the gear used to present and preserve media, maintaining tech supply inventory, and working alongside journalists to capture aerial video of news assignments.

 

This role will work closely with the news photographers, reporters, and video editors of the newsroom.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Consistently demonstrate a customer service approach to technical support
  • Effectively resolve as a front-line technical problems for field crews
  • Communicate technology updates and workflow changes to relevant employees
  • Assist with technical onboarding of new employees
  • Construct how-to guides on media workflows and best practices
  • Provide ongoing documentation of news technology hardware and software
  • Perform scheduled maintenance on photographer’s gear
  • Identify opportunities to improve newsroom workflows
  • Research new technology for capital projects
  • Assist with delivering and retrieving vehicles for maintenance
  • Follow up on reported discrepancies and make appropriate referrals
  • Work occasional weekends and holidays as needed to support coverage

Minimum Qualifications

  • Lift and carry 50lbs

Preferred Qualifications

  • Broadcast newsroom experience preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in broadcasting or video production preferred
  • FAA Part 107 preferred
  • Avid media management experience preferred

job.description:
Location: FL-Jacksonville

Job Title:  Producer - WOKV Jacksonville Radio

 

Position Overview

Reporting to the News Director, the WOKV News Producer develops, writes, and delivers timely local and national news content for 104.5 FM, as well as WOKV’s digital and social platforms. This role requires strong news judgment, urgency, accuracy, and the ability to respond quickly to breaking news, severe weather, and developing stories.

 

The News Producer is responsible for creating factual, compelling, and relatable news content that informs and engages the audience. This person will also develop trusted sources, conduct interviews, support reporting needs, and be prepared to anchor newscasts as needed.

 

This is an 8-hour shift based on newsroom needs and the news/event cycle. The schedule will include one weekend day and may include overnight, early morning, daytime, or evening hours, such as 11 p.m.–7 a.m., 3 a.m.–11 a.m., 7 a.m.–3 p.m., or 12 p.m.–8 p.m.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Produce, write, and edit accurate, compelling local and national news content for radio broadcasts, digital platforms, and social media channels.
  • Monitor breaking news, severe weather, and developing stories; respond quickly and responsibly with timely updates across all platforms.
  • Research, verify, and develop story ideas using reliable sources, sound news judgment, and established editorial standards.
  • Report breaking news, top local stories, and top national stories as assigned.
  • Conduct interviews in studio, in the field, on location, and by phone while maintaining professionalism and journalistic integrity.
  • Prepare to anchor newscasts as needed.
  • Build and maintain trusted sources to support ongoing reporting and story development.
  • Collaborate with reporters, anchors, and newsroom leadership to support daily coverage, breaking news, and special projects.
  • Manage multiple assignments in a fast-paced, deadline-driven newsroom environment.
  • Ensure content follows company policies, legal standards, and digital and social media guidelines.
  • Identify opportunities to improve newsroom workflows, content quality, and audience impact.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the News Director.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience producing, writing, and reporting news content for radio, digital, and social platforms.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to deliver accurate and timely information under deadline pressure.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced breaking-news environment.
  • Sound editorial judgment, strong attention to detail, and the ability to remain composed under pressure.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including nights, early mornings, weekends, and holidays as needed.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively with newsroom colleagues and leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, broadcast journalism, communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • On-air reporting or anchoring experience.
  • Experience conducting interviews in studio, in the field, on location, and by phone.
  • Familiarity with digital publishing tools, social media platforms, and newsroom content systems.

Position Overview

Cox Media Group Atlanta Radio is looking for a Senior Client Performance Manager to help our largest and most strategic advertisers get the most from their media investments.

 

In this senior, client-facing role, you will be a trusted performance partner, turning campaign data, market insights, and advertiser goals into clear recommendations that strengthen relationships, improve outcomes, and support long-term account growth.

 

You will work directly with clients and collaborate closely with Account Executives, sales leaders, digital sales teams, and operations partners to align strategy, execution, reporting, and optimization across radio, digital, and cross-channel campaigns.

 

The right candidate is consultative, analytical, and confident leading performance conversations with senior client stakeholders. You know how to connect campaign results to business priorities, identify meaningful opportunities, and communicate value in a way that builds trust.

 

This is a highly visible role for someone who enjoys using data to tell a compelling performance story, guide optimization decisions, and help clients see the full value of their partnership with CMG Atlanta Radio.

 

Cox Media Group is an integrated company spanning broadcast, publishing, direct marketing, and digital media. We are digital experts – leveraging the best of television, radio, and digital marketing services to create innovative marketing solutions for businesses across the country.

 

At CMG Atlanta Radio, you will have the opportunity to work with well-known brands, influential local advertisers, and high-impact media campaigns in one of the country’s most dynamic markets. This role offers visibility, variety, and the chance to shape how strategic clients understand performance, value, and growth.

job.title: Weekend Anchor - WFTV
job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-South

Job Title:  Weekend Anchor - WFTV

 

Position Overview

WFTV Channel 9 Eyewitness News is seeking a dynamic, credible, and enterprising journalist to serve as our Weekend Anchor/Reporter. This position requires a strong newsroom leader who can confidently anchor weekend newscasts while also producing impactful, original reporting during the week.

 

The successful candidate will anchor Saturday and Sunday newscasts and report in the field three days per week. Reporting is a critical component of this role. We are looking for a journalist who can uncover stories through source development, document research, public records requests, and relentless newsgathering.

 

The ideal candidate is an enterprise-driven journalist who consistently generates original story ideas, develops exclusive content, and turns meaningful enterprise stories on the same day they are pitched, bringing forward investigative and accountability-focused story ideas that matter to Central Florida viewers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Weekend Anchor Responsibilities

  • Anchor live Saturday and Sunday newscasts with authority, credibility, and strong storytelling.
  • Lead breaking news and severe weather coverage during weekend broadcasts.
  • Collaborate with producers, reporters, meteorologists, and newsroom leaders to shape editorial content and presentation.
  • Write, edit, and review scripts to ensure accuracy, fairness, and journalistic excellence.
  • Serve as a newsroom leader who reinforces WFTV's standards of journalism and storytelling.

 

Reporting & Investigative Responsibilities

  • Report in the field three days each week for broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms.
  • Pitch original enterprise story ideas in the morning editorial meeting and execute those stories the same day.
  • Develop and maintain a robust network of sources across government, law enforcement, business, education, and the community.
  • Generate exclusive content through public records requests, database research, source cultivation, and document analysis.
  • Pursue accountability journalism that uncovers information viewers would not otherwise know.
  • Identify investigative angles to daily news stories and develop them into deeper enterprise reports.
  • Deliver compelling live reports from the field, particularly during breaking news and major community events.
  • Write accurate, impactful, and visually compelling stories under daily deadline pressure.
  • Collaborate with photographers, producers, and digital teams to maximize storytelling across all platforms.
  • Produce digital content and supporting materials related to enterprise and investigative stories.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated success developing enterprise stories.
  • Exceptional live reporting and ad-lib skills.
  • Strong on-air presence with the ability to connect with viewers.
  • Excellent writing, storytelling, and interviewing skills.
  • Strong news judgment and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license and maintain an acceptable driving record.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum of three to five years of television news reporting experience; anchoring experience strongly preferred.

job.title: Market Account Executive
job.description:
Company Overview

Cumulus Media is an audio-first media company delivering premium content to a quarter billion people every month — wherever and whenever they want it. Cumulus Media engages listeners with high-quality local programming through 377 owned-and-operated radio stations across 84 markets; delivers nationally-syndicated sports, news, talk, and entertainment programming from iconic brands including the NFL, the NCAA, the Masters, US Soccer, and AP News, across more than 7,800 affiliated stations through Westwood One, a leading national audio network; and inspires listeners through the Cumulus Podcast Network, an established and influential platform for original podcasts that are smart, entertaining, and thought-provoking. Cumulus Media provides advertisers with personal connections, local impact and national reach through broadcast and on-demand digital, mobile, social, and voice-activated platforms, as well as integrated digital marketing services, powerful influencers, full-service audio solutions, industry-leading research and insights, and live event experiences. For more information visit www.cumulusmedia.com.


Position Overview

The Account Executive successfully manages relationships with dozens of local and regional businesses, protects and grows the revenue base, identifies and creates new business opportunities with existing and new clients; provides marketing solutions to help customers achieve their business goals; strategically plans and implements initiatives to meet personal, company and corporate directives, recognizes that achieving budgeted revenue targets is the minimum expectation of performance. The right individual will invest in personal professional development, understanding technology, marketing and the full suite of company products and services.


Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

Key Responsibilities:

  • Able to create and identify client business needs by gaining a deep understanding of their goals, objectives and processes as well as their external environment including key market and consumer trends to proactively develop customized marketing solutions to meet client objectives
  • Deliver and Develop effective and informed marketing solutions via multi-platform, integrated sales presentations identifying Cumulus broadcast, digital, and event tactics to foster brand loyalty and deliver results for the client
  • Ability to negotiate and close business that drives revenue results and fosters long term client relationships, regardless of medium or platform
  • Commitment to having a proficient understanding of the Cumulus Media assets and resources and a desire to constantly learn and grow your product knowledge thus staying relevant and current with industry advertising opportunities for your clients
  • Represent the full suite of products and services as marketing solutions to new and existing clientele. This includes station digital assets, internet-based marketing, social media, streaming, events and specialized programming
  • Ability to appropriately manage time to optimize revenue opportunities, client interaction, implementation and fulfillment of successful sales agreements. Individual must be able to assist in the development of creative messaging, regardless of platform
  • Excel at prospecting and aggressively seeking new clientele by networking, cold calling, canvassing, referrals or other means to maintain a full pipeline of sales prospects at all times
  • Follow all station and corporate procedures for preparing orders, resolving billing issues, submitting regular reports regarding sales, pipeline lists, forecasts and competitive analysis
  • Collaborate, create, and capitalize on opportunities to best represent our brand while working to help your clients achieve success


Qualifications:

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite, social networking platforms and CRM tools

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Passion for developing new business relationships in an outside sales role

  • Enjoy presenting to clients of sales opportunities and post-sale successes

  • Strong understanding of lead generation and ability to connect with viable prospects

  • Comprehension of sales metrics in order to fill a sales funnel and maintain a constant pipeline of new business

  • Self-motivating and entrepreneurial spirit

  • Positive and friendly with a willingness to collaborate

  • High energy and passion for sales

  • Flexible, creative and curious

  • Digitally savvy
  • 3+ years in Media Sales background preferred

Pay Range

USD $3,500.00 - USD $4,000.00 /Mo.
Pay Range

The monthly pay range listed above reflects your guaranteed income during your first year, with additional opportunities to earn commissions
What We Offer

  • Commission-based organization with uncapped earning potential and guaranteed income in year one of employment
  • Focused, responsible and collaborative work environment with the ability to ask, “what if” and try innovative solutions
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance coverage
  • 401K with company match
  • Paid Vacation, Sick & Holiday time off
    Parental leave time off benefits, life insurance, disability insurance, wellness, and an employee referral bonus program

 

For immediate consideration, please visit: https://jobs.cumulusmedia.com/careers

 

For more information about Cumulus Media, visit our website at: https://www.cumulusmedia.com/

job.title: Multimedia Account Executive
job.description:
Company Overview

CUMULUS | Savannah, GA currently has 4 stations in Savannah and surrounding counties along with a robust portfolio on digital products and services.  Our local stations include E93 (93.1 - Urban), Magic 103.9 (Urban AC), Kix 96 (96.5 – Country), and I-95 (95.5 – Classic Rock).  

 

 

Cumulus Media is an audio-first media company delivering premium content to a quarter billion people every month — wherever and whenever they want it. Cumulus Media engages listeners with high-quality local programming through 377 owned-and-operated radio stations across 84 markets; delivers nationally-syndicated sports, news, talk, and entertainment programming from iconic brands including the NFL, the NCAA, the Masters, US Soccer, and AP News, across more than 7,800 affiliated stations through Westwood One, a leading national audio network; and inspires listeners through the Cumulus Podcast Network, an established and influential platform for original podcasts that are smart, entertaining, and thought-provoking. Cumulus Media provides advertisers with personal connections, local impact and national reach through broadcast and on-demand digital, mobile, social, and voice-activated platforms, as well as integrated digital marketing services, powerful influencers, full-service audio solutions, industry-leading research and insights, and live event experiences. For more information visit www.cumulusmedia.com.


Position Overview

 

The audio industry is on fire – from podcasting and streaming to smart speakers and live radio – and it’s never been a more exciting time to join and grow with one of the country’s largest and most sophisticated audio companies!

 

Cumulus Media | Savannah has an immediate opening for a full-time Multimedia Account Executive to join the Sales Team in assisting their clients in our Savannah market – as well as contacts across the US – with multi-media business options that include both traditional media and highly targeted digital products, such as:
•    Radio, Audio Streaming and Podcast Advertising
•    Website Design, Optimization, and Repair
•    Digital Display Advertising
•    Reputation (Online Review) Monitoring & Management
•    DNA Digital (Data Driving Digital Advertising)
•    Call tracking
•    YouTube and Online Video Advertising
•    OTT (App Based & Online Television)
•    Mobile Geofencing
•    Search Engine Optimization
•    Google AdWords
•    Social Media Advertising and Content Creation
•    Political Advertising
•    Event Marketing and Management
•    Recruitment Advertising


Local Cumulus radio stations reach over hundreds of thousands of people weekly in the Savannah metro area; but our reach extends well beyond that, with CUMULUS BROADCASTING’s network of radio stations across the US and our Westwood One Radio Network. We have marketing solutions for unique clients and businesses of all sizes across the US. Cumulus is seeking someone interested in modern, multifaceted media sales – that means selling multiple mediums and solutions. Successful candidates will be able to identify and develop new business opportunities; grow existing client relationships; offer solutions that help clients achieve their business goals; and meet or exceed set digital sales targets.


Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

Key Responsibilities:

  • Able to identify client business needs through a deep understanding of their goals, objectives, and processes; as well as their external environment, including key market and consumer trends to proactively develop solutions to meet client objectives.
  • Deliver effective multi-platform, integrated sales presentations (broadcast, digital, events, etc.)
  • Become a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in both digital assets (e.g., streaming, stations website and social advertising) and digital audience extension products to deliver a complete marketing solution to advertisers.
  • Excel at prospecting and aggressively seeking new clientele by networking, cold calling, canvassing, referrals, or other means to build and maintain a full pipeline of sales prospects.
  • Prepare orders, resolve billing issues, and submit regular sales, reports – pipeline lists, forecasts, and competitive analysis.
  • Stay abreast of the competitive landscape and emerging technologies.
  • Think creatively and generate original ideas.


Qualifications:

  • 1-3 years of sales experience required; with background in broadcast, media or digital advertising sales highly preferred.

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing or related field preferred, but not required.

  • Valid driver's license required. Driving is an essential function of this position because regular travel is required to perform key job duties, including meeting with clients & prospects, as well as attending business-related events.

  • Passion for developing new business relationships in an outside sales role, including preparing and presenting sales opportunities and post-sale successes to clients/potential clients.

  • Strong understanding of lead generation and ability to connect with viable prospects.

  • Comprehension of sales metrics in order to fill a sales funnel and maintain a constant pipeline of new business.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Self-motivating and entrepreneurial spirit; with a positive and friendly attitude and willingness to collaborate.

  • High energy and passion for sales.

  • Flexible, creative and curious.

  • Digitally savvy - proficient in Microsoft Office suite, social networking platforms and CRM tools highly preferred.


Pay Range

USD $3,000.00 - USD $5,000.00 /Mo.
Pay Range

The monthly pay range listed above reflects your guaranteed income during your first year, with additional opportunities to earn commissions
What We Offer

  • Commission-based organization with uncapped earning potential and guaranteed income in year one of employment
  • Focused, responsible and collaborative work environment with the ability to ask, “what if” and try innovative solutions
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance coverage
  • 401K with company match
  • Paid Vacation, Sick & Holiday time off
  • Life insurance, disability insurance, wellness, and an employee referral bonus program

job.title: Account Executive - Curtis Media Group - Career Page
job.description:
Thanks for visiting the Curtis Media Group Career Page. Please review our open positions and apply to the positions that match your qualifications.

Account Executive

Boone, NC Full Time Mid Level Share Account Executive - Boone, NC 
This is the ideal role for a marketing and sales professional who is looking to join a growing digital and radio business. As our Account Executive, you will be responsible for selling digital and radio campaigns across a wide range of digital products and radio stations in Boone, NC. Account Executive to work directly with VP of Sales, Digital Coordinator, Digital Team Leader, and Executive VP of radio stations.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Account Management: Works directly with clients, prospects, and company account executives to support their needs and communicate client expectations.
  • Going on in-field calls with prospective clients utilizing the sales process of creating digital and radio campaigns for prospective clients utilizing the Client Needs Analysis, Client Pitch Presentations to Closing of the Sale.
  • Ability to achieve revenue goals and expectations without hesitation.
  • Responsible for building and maintaining a billing book of business with guidance from VP of Sales.
  • Work directly with our Digital Coordinator in processing requests for proposals, insertion orders, sample spec ads and reporting. (for digital only)
  • Project Management: the ability to track timelines and due dates for deliverables, reviews, and approval for campaign launches.
  • Continuity with graphics team: Ensure all ads are being worked on and deadlines are being achieved so all schedules can run on time.
  • Maintain working knowledge of radio and digital products offered by the company through continuous training.
  • Monitor Campaigns to ensure all campaigns are hitting the promised impressions goals and spots during their flights. Adjust priority levels as appropriate.
  • Campaign Reports: At month end and/or the campaign ends, review performance reports for all digital and radio campaigns and present results to the client.
  • Client communication: Work directly with clients to ensure campaign execution and performance meet their standards.
Qualifications:
  • Organization and follow-through are critical skills for this position.  Logical, process-oriented person, who is effective and strategically contributes to campaigns.
  • Strong work ethic, self-motivated and high achiever with a sales drive.
  • Professional demeanor; comfortable presenting to and interacting directly with clients.
  • Demonstrates the ability to successfully collaborate with various team environments with dynamic priorities and meeting deadlines.
  • Quick-witted, understanding and offering solutions regarding various responsibilities.
  • In-depth knowledge of performance marketing with special focus on radio and digital capabilities.
  • Self-motivated and strategic thinker with a bias towards action while also being a strong team player.
  • Ability to thrive under pressure and ability to work in a fast-paced environment; Comfort dealing with ambiguity.
  • Strong partnership and influencing skills.
  • Comfort working with Senior Management.
  • Ability to uncover new opportunities to acquire customers efficiently and on a scale through well-developed relationships with core channel partners and media agencies.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Communications/Marketing preferred and/or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum experience working in sales: 1-3 years preferred.

job.title: Broadcast Operations Manager - Curtis Media Group - Career Page
job.description:
Thanks for visiting the Curtis Media Group Career Page. Please review our open positions and apply to the positions that match your qualifications.

Broadcast Operations Manager

Raleigh, NC Full Time Manager/Supervisor Share Curtis Media Group is seeking a Broadcast Operations Manager for our multi-market North Carolina radio stations.  The Operations Manager will work closely with the programming, engineering, traffic and IT staff to oversee the day-to-day operations of our FCC licensed radio stations, digital, networks and additional enterprises.  The Operations Manager will work with ownership and senior management in the administration of operational, compliance and administrative activities.
Duties and Responsibilities
  1. Oversees and coordinates the continuous, multifaceted daily operations of radio stations, ensuring compliance with broadcast standards, FCC rules and regulations, and relevant federal and state laws and regulations.
  2. Maintains accurate schedules, records, discrepancy reports, and follow-through communications, and ensures that all on-air broadcast programming complies with FCC rules and regulations.
  3. Participates in the establishment, organization, and implementation of short- and long-range goals, objectives, policies, and operating procedures; monitors and evaluates program effectiveness and effects changes required for improvement.
  4. Directs and administers the provision of day-to-day operation support to the various sub-units of the station, including the non-engineering portions of the station's physical plant, space allocation and utilization, station supplies and inventory, and station safety and security.
  5. Assigns, allocates work, and generally oversees operational and engineering personnel engaged in continuous station operations; performs recruitment, training, scheduling, retention, problem resolution, and performance management.
  6. Develops and implements systems to maintain records on station operations, equipment, and compliance activities; prepares regular and ad-hoc reports.
  7. Provides advice and assistance to senior station management in the planning, implementation, and evaluation of modification to existing operations, systems, and procedures.
  8. Researches and makes recommendations to management pertaining to acquisition of operating equipment; participates in the development and management of annual operating budgets.
  9. Supervises and maintains station FCC Public files including station Political Disclosure Statements, uploading of information to individual station public files including Issues & Ascertainment, EEO and political and issue advertising orders.
  10. May provide services as an on-air host, as required.
  11. Performs miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
Minimum Job Requirements
  • High school diploma or GED; at least 5 years of experience directly related to the duties and responsibilities specified.
  • Completed degree(s) from an accredited institution that are above the minimum education requirement may be substituted for experience on a year for year basis.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required
  • IT and radio automation operations are a must.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to work effectively with a wide range of personnel
  • Records maintenance skills.
  • Skill in the use of personal computers and related software applications.
  • Knowledge of radio principles, procedures, operations, and standards.
  • Knowledge and understanding of radio communications facilities and distribution, and automation systems.
  • Skill in organizing resources and establishing priorities.
  • Knowledge of inventory management practices.
  • Knowledge of radio organizational structures, workflows, systems, and operating procedures.
  • Ability to develop, plan, and implement short- and long-range goals.
  • Knowledge of project management principles, practices, techniques, and tools.
  • Knowledge of FCC and other federal, state and local broadcasting regulations.
  • Ability to supervise and train employees, to include organizing, prioritizing, and scheduling work assignments.
  • Knowledge of budgeting and fiscal management principles and procedures.
  • Knowledge of facilities management, physical plant, safety, and building safety and security procedures.
  • Ability to create, compose, and edit written materials.
  • Supervision of individual station issues and ascertainment for
  • EEO compliance
  • Uploading of Political and Issue orders to FCC public file database
  • Knowledge of on-air and remote broadcasting processes and procedures.
  • Skills in examining and developing station operations and procedures, formulating policy, and implementing organizational strategies and procedures.
  • Ability to oversee, coordinate, and support the execution of continuous broadcast schedules on a 24x7 basis.
  • Knowledge of current and developing trends in radio.
  • Skill in operating radio equipment.

job.title: Broadcast Radio Traffic & Business Manager
job.description:
Curtis Media Group is seeking an organized, dependable, and detail-oriented Business Office & Traffic/Production Manager to oversee essential administrative, business, traffic, and production operations for our three radio stations.

This multifaceted position plays an important role in keeping daily station operations running smoothly. Responsibilities include office administration, vendor coordination, promotional support, commercial scheduling, order entry, production coordination, billing, financial reporting, and maintaining accurate station records.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable managing multiple priorities, possesses strong communication skills, and can work independently while supporting a team-oriented radio broadcasting environment.

Key Responsibilities
Office Management & Business Administration
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for incoming telephone calls, taking messages and directing inquiries to the appropriate personnel.
  • Serve as the primary contact for the station's alarm company, respond to alarm notifications, and coordinate ongoing alarm system maintenance.
  • Coordinate and manage client prize giveaways and station promotions.
  • Prepare, design, and print prize winner sheets for the on-air staff and maintain organized winner records and files.
  • Communicate promotional details and prize giveaway information to on-air personnel.
  • Create social media content and sports graphics to support high school football coverage.
  • Coordinate ticket promotions and giveaways for concerts and events in partnership with Live Nation.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for various vendors and service providers.
  • Retrieve mail from the station's post office box and station mailbox.
  • Process incoming checks, prepare deposits, and forward payments and related information to the appropriate corporate personnel.
Traffic Management & Commercial Operations
  • Enter all new advertising orders into the traffic system and send order confirmations to the appropriate Account Executives.
  • Enter order cancellations and maintain accurate client and advertising records.
  • Prepare and distribute weekly reports, including sales revenue, new orders, and aging reports, each Friday.
  • Upload weekly revenue information into ShareBuilders.
  • Prepare daily commercial logs for all three radio stations and upload logs.
  • Schedule and distribute commercials throughout the broadcast day while ensuring appropriate separation of competing advertisers.
  • Monitor commercial schedules to ensure all client advertising is running correctly and according to approved orders.
  • Distribute production orders (POs) to local talent for commercial recording.
  • Assign cart numbers to new commercial spots and enter all required information into the traffic system.
  • Submit commercial production requests through Just Say Spots and complete additional production work as needed.
  • Load network commercials and prepare required monthly affidavits.
Production Management & Billing
  • Dub commercial spots into production as needed.
  • Process monthly client billing.
  • Print and mail required hard-copy invoices.
  • Prepare and provide notarized affidavits for clients when requested.
  • Forward electronic invoices to clients.
  • Prepare monthly corporate reports and submit them to the appropriate corporate contact by the fifth day of each month.
Qualifications & Skills
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities and meet firm deadlines.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and general computer applications.
  • Ability to learn and navigate radio traffic, scheduling, billing, and production software.
  • Experience with social media platforms and basic graphic design is beneficial.
  • Basic bookkeeping, billing, and administrative experience preferred.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Professionalism when communicating with clients, vendors, co-workers, and the public.
  • Dependable, resourceful, and able to prioritize daily responsibilities.

Interested applicants please send resume to Craig Hahn, chahn@curtismedia.com 

Curtis Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Morning News Host

Raleigh, NC Full Time Experienced Share Morning News Host/Operations Manager – WPTF FM 92.9/AM 680, Raleigh, NC

WPTF is seeking a dynamic and experienced Morning News Anchor/Operations Manager to lead our morning programming and oversee day-to-day station operations. This dual-role position blends the energy and visibility of a live news host with the strategic oversight of a broadcast operations manager.

As the morning news host, you will be the voice that wakes up the Triangle — delivering local, state, and national news in a clear, engaging, and informative way. As operations manager, you’ll also work closely with programming, engineering, and station leadership to ensure seamless technical execution and content delivery.

This is a high-impact role for a broadcast professional who is passionate about news, understands the Raleigh/Durham market, and is ready to lead both behind the mic and behind the scenes.

Responsibilities
On-Air Hosting:
  • Anchor the live weekday morning news broadcast from 5AM to 9AM.
  • Deliver news, weather, traffic, and information updates in a conversational, clear, and unbiased manner.
  • Conduct live and pre-recorded interviews with newsmakers, public officials, experts, and community members.

Operations Management:
  • Oversee daily station operations, including broadcast scheduling, automation systems and technical coordination.
  • Work with programming and engineering to ensure smooth transitions between shows and clean broadcast execution.
  • Manage communication between departments and troubleshoot on-air or backend issues as they arise.
  • Help implement station policies, ensure compliance with FCC regulations and maintain broadcast standards.
  • Assist in onboarding and training part-time staff or interns as needed.
Requirements and Skills
  • Proven experience as a radio host, anchor, or reporter — morning drive experience a plus.
  • Strong understanding of radio operations, scheduling and broadcast automation systems.
  • Broad knowledge of current events, public affairs and local Raleigh-area issues.
  • Confident and professional on-air delivery with strong storytelling ability.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong leadership and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work early mornings and flexible hours as required.
  • Social media savvy with an understanding of how to engage and grow an audience.

Description

***NO PHONE CALLS PLEASE! APPLY THROUGH THIS LINK ONLY***


  

Marketing Consultant — Savannah, GA Market
Dick Broadcasting Company Inc.


FSLA: Exempt


Do you love the thrill of the win — landing a new client, building a campaign that actually moves the needle, and watching a local business grow because of the work you did? If you're a natural relationship-builder who's ready to turn that skill into serious earning potential, we want to talk to you.

· A genuine willingness to learn, adapt, and excel

job.title: Principal Product Software Engineer - Java
job.company: Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Principal Product Software Engineer - Java Job ID 10164971 Location Glendale, California, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Nov. 11, 2026 Principal Product Software Engineer - Java Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements On any given day at Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology, we’re reimagining ways to create magical viewing experiences for the world’s most beloved stories while also transforming Disney’s media business for the future. Whether that’s evolving our streaming and digital products in new and immersive ways, powering worldwide advertising and distribution to maximize flexibility and efficiency, or delivering Disney’s unmatched entertainment and sports content, every day is a moment to make a difference to partners and to hundreds of millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. The Product & Data Engineering team is responsible for end-to-end development for Disney’s world-class consumer-facing products, including streaming platforms Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN+, and digital products & experiences across ESPN, Marvel, Disney Studios, NatGeo, and ABC News. The team drives innovation at scale for millions of consumers around the world across Apple, Android, Smart TVs, game consoles, and the web, with our platforms powering core experiences like personalization, search, messaging and data. The ABC Core Content Technologies engineering team is looking for a Principal Product Software Engineer who is passionate about setting technical direction for high-scale content platforms and multiplying the impact of engineers across the organization. As a Principal Engineer, you are a trusted member of the technical leadership of the organization. You build and set the architectural direction for the systems that provide dynamic content management for many of Disney Entertainment’s brands – including ABC Entertainment, ABC News, ABC OTV, Disney, Marvel, National Geographic, and Studios – as well as content ingestion from many internal and 3rd party sources, publishing pipelines, and complex image services. You operate in highly ambiguous and significantly complex problem spaces that have long-term impact on our brands, products, technology, and architecture. You are recognized as an expert across multiple specialties. You influence business and technology direction, bringing industry context to technical decisions, and setting the standard for engineering excellence across the organization. As a hands-on technical leader, you split your time between coding, design, and architecture based on where your skills will have the greatest impact – personally writing critical-path code, deconstructing architectures so multiple teams can execute independently, and aligning those teams toward simple, coherent designs. On a daily basis you should bring: A track record of driving clarity and simplicity in the face of significant ambiguity and complexity. A force-multiplier mindset – amplifying the impact of teams across the organization through design reviews, mentorship, and technical strategy. Deep ownership of the products and platforms your organization delivers. A pragmatic approach to balancing trade-offs between opportunity and architectural complexity. A passion for keeping abreast of industry trends and benchmarking our technology against the best in the industry. Kindness, pragmatic optimism, and your unique view and experience.

Responsibilities

Lead the design, implementation, and delivery of software in highly ambiguous and significantly complex problem spaces that have long-term impact on our products, technology, and architecture. Heavily influence the design and personally write a significant portion of critical-path code, making the right trade-offs between opportunity and architectural complexity. Deconstruct large architectures into components that can be developed independently by multiple teams, then align those teams toward simple, coherent designs that come together into an integrated whole. Lead strategically important projects that span multiple teams. Acquire a deep understanding of our business processes, dependent systems, and teams, and develop professional relationships with key stakeholders — including business users, product managers, designers, and other Principal Engineers both inside and outside of our organization — to inform technical strategy and drive alignment. Set the standard for engineering excellence across the organization – producing designs, algorithms, and implementations that are exemplary in terms of robustness, scalability, cost-effectiveness, and simplicity – and drive best practices across the organization, including driving the adoption of AI-assisted engineering tooling and demonstrating a strong commitment to the productivity and quality gains these tools and models deliver. Amplify your impact as a force multiplier: lead design reviews for complex projects, probe assumptions, illuminate pitfalls, foster shared understanding, handle escalations, and mitigate complexity risks. Bring business and industry context to technology decisions and influence business and technology direction. Actively develop and mentor engineers across and beyond your organization, keep the engineering community current on trends and technologies, participate in hiring, and perform promotion assessments to support the career growth of others. Additional Expectations: Promote and reinforce engineering best practices — design patterns, code review, and automated testing — and drive their adoption across the organization Mentor engineers within and beyond your squad, and educate the broader engineering community on advanced technical issues, technologies, and trends Lead and reinforce a high level of operational excellence for the systems underpinning applications used by millions of fans every day Solicit differing views, build consensus, and be willing to change your mind as you learn more Participate in hiring and interviewing, and perform promotion assessments to support the career growth of others Champion the adoption of AI-assisted development tools, models, and workflows, demonstrating a personal commitment to them and helping the broader team realize measurable productivity and quality gains Minimum

Qualifications

10+ years of

experience

building large-scale, highly available distributed services. Expert-level programming skills in Java or a similar object-oriented language, with strong computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, databases, etc.). Proven track record designing backend architectures that span multiple teams and driving consensus on them.

Experience

building and operating message-based, distributed systems, including caching strategies.

Experience

mentoring engineers and setting technical direction beyond a single team.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience

working on highly scalable, real-time content or data platforms serving millions of consumers. Extensive

experience

with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or a similar cloud service, including Terraform and infrastructure as code (IaC) practices.

Experience

with event-driven messaging architectures (e.g., SQS, SNS) and both relational and non-relational database technologies (e.g., DynamoDB, OpenSearch). Contributions to intellectual property (e.g., patents), industry conferences, or a broader technical community.
