job.title: Associate Brand Director, BHG Collection at Walmart
job.description:
Job Title

Associate Brand Director, BHG Collection at Walmart

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements

The Associate Brand Director, Walmart will play a key role within People Inc.’s Business Management team supporting the Better Homes & Gardens collection at Walmart (BHGxWalmart), with primary responsibility for the strategy and business management of designated product categories.This role will develop deep expertise across assigned categories, building strong relationships throughout the Walmart merchant organization and serving as a primary BHG business partner to drive category performance and growth. Working within the broader strategy and priorities of the BHGxWalmart business, the Senior Brand Manager will connect business performance, consumer and marketplace insights, product and assortment strategy, and cross-functional partners to translate broader objectives into category-specific strategies and actions.


In-office Expectations: This position is remote and based in Bentonville, Arkansas, with no regular People Inc. in-office requirements. The role is expected to maintain an active presence with Walmart partners in the Bentonville area, including in-person meetings and business activities as needed. Occasional travel to People Inc. offices and other business locations will also be required.


About The Team | The Team and/or Brand.

The BHGxWalmart Business Management team sits within People Inc.’s Brand Development organization and supports the Better Homes & Gardens licensed collection at Walmart. The team partners closely with Walmart, external product development partners, and cross-functional People Inc. teams to drive business growth, strengthen the BHG brand, and identify opportunities across the product portfolio.


About The Positions Contributions:

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results


Category Strategy & Business Management (30%)

  • Lead the strategy and ongoing business management of designated BHGxWalmart categories, developing deep expertise in performance, assortment dynamics, product pipelines and Walmart priorities.
  • Evaluate sales, inventory, distribution, digital performance and assortment productivity to identify key business drivers, risks and opportunities.
  • Translate broader BHGxWalmart strategies and objectives into clear category-specific priorities and action plans.
  • Develop a strong point of view on where assigned categories should grow, evolve or improve based on business performance, consumer insights and marketplace dynamics.
  • Maintain visibility across assortment changes, product launches, distribution shifts and other developments impacting category performance.

Walmart Merchant & Partner Management (25%)

  • Serve as a primary BHG business-management partner for designated categories, building strong relationships throughout the Walmart merchant organization.
  • Lead category-level conversations with Walmart merchant partners, developing a deep understanding of their priorities, strategies, challenges and growth objectives.
  • Build productive relationships with external product development partners, creating connectivity across Walmart, People Inc. and external teams around shared category priorities.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to advance Walmart category goals and the BHG business, elevating significant opportunities, risks and decisions to Business Management leadership.

Product, Assortment & Consumer Strategy (25%)

  • Represent the business and brand perspective throughout the product development lifecycle, partnering with Walmart merchants and external product development teams on category strategies, assortment plans and future opportunities.
  • Develop a deep understanding of consumer needs, competitive activity and marketplace trends within assigned categories.
  • Partner with People Inc. Research & Insights to identify knowledge gaps and translate consumer, competitive, digital and business insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Identify assortment gaps, priority products, whitespace opportunities and areas for innovation or expansion.
  • Help ensure product and assortment decisions support Walmart business objectives and BHG brand positioning.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Brand Stewardship (20%)

  • Lead and influence cross-functional partners around assigned category strategies, opportunities and business priorities.
  • Serve as a central Business Management connector across People Inc. teams, including Research & Insights, Marketing, Creative, Editorial and Digital/PDP.
  • Translate category opportunities into clear business priorities that inform marketing, content, creative, digital and other brand support.
  • Lead category-level preparation for key Walmart meetings, business reviews, development discussions and strategic planning sessions.
  • Partner with the Associate Brand Manager on operational inputs and maintain visibility with Business Management leadership around major category developments, decisions, risks and opportunities.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:


Education:

Bachelor’s degree preferred in Business, Marketing, Merchandising, Retail, or a related field and/or equivalent experience.

Experience:

  • 5–7+ years of experience in brand management, retail merchandising, category management, account management, licensing, consumer products, or a related brand- or retail-focused role.
  • Demonstrated experience building and managing relationships with key retail, brand, and/or external business partners.
  • Experience managing or influencing category strategy, assortment decisions, business performance, and/or growth initiatives.
  • Experience working within or directly supporting a major omnichannel retailer strongly preferred.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Strong commercial and business acumen, with an understanding of retail merchandising, category dynamics, assortment strategy and product development.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to connect category-level details and opportunities to broader brand and business objectives.
  • Strong consumer orientation with the ability to incorporate consumer research, marketplace trends and competitive intelligence into business decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, cross-functional workstreams and influence partners without direct authority.
  • Strong problem-solving and organizational skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and manage multiple categories, initiatives and priorities simultaneously.
  • Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information into a clear business point of view.
  • Collaborative leadership style with the ability to work effectively across internal teams and external organizations.


% Travel Required (Approximate): 5%


It is the policy of People Inc. to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, the Company will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. Accommodation requests can be made by emailing hr@people.inc.

The Company participates in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the identity and employment authorization of all newly hired employees. For further information about the E-Verify program, please click here: https://www.e-verify.gov/employees

Pay Range

The pay range above represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position and may change in the future. Actual pay may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to work location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of People Inc's total compensation package for employees. Other compensation may include annual bonuses, and short- and long-term incentives. In addition, People Inc. provides to employees (and their eligible family members) a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, prescription drug coverage, unlimited paid time off (PTO), adoption or surrogate assistance, donation matching, tuition reimbursement, basic life insurance, basic accidental death & dismemberment, supplemental life insurance, supplemental accident insurance, commuter benefits, short term and long term disability, health savings and flexible spending accounts, family care benefits, a generous 401K savings plan with a company match program, 10-12 paid holidays annually, and generous paid parental leave (birthing and non-birthing parents), all of which may vary depending on the specific nature of your employment with People Inc. and your work location. We also offer voluntary benefits such as pet insurance, accident, critical and hospital indemnity health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance.

job.title: Benefits Manager
job.description:
Job Title

Benefits Manager

Job Description

The Benefits Manager will assist with the design, implementation, administration, and promotion of our employee benefits programs across People Incorporated. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Benefits, this individual will collaborate to ensure that People Incorporated’s benefit offerings remain highly competitive, fully compliant with regulations, and aligned with overall organizational goals. This role requires an experienced professional with vendor management expertise and project management skills to support benefit initiatives, manage partner relationships, and drive program rollouts.


The position is based in the New York City corporate headquarters and is hybrid in-office with the ability to work remotely up to 2 days per week.


About The Position

Benefits Strategy & Administration

  • Manage employee benefits programs across the People Incorporated portfolio, including healthcare, life/disability, 401(k), voluntary benefits, and leave management.
  • Serve as an escalation point for employee benefit questions, policy interpretations, and operational concerns.
  • Evaluate existing benefit vendors and assist with RFPs and implementations as needed.
  • Oversee the annual open enrollment process, including plan design decisions, benefits administration system testing, multi-channel communications, onsite events, and employee education.

Vendor Management & Strategic Partnerships

  • Manage benefit vendor relationships, brokers, consultants, and administration partners to ensure all issues are escalated and resolved quickly and appropriately.
  • Assist with monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs) for benefit vendors, ensuring high-quality execution, accountability, and continuous performance review.
  • Lead benefits billing for multiple vendors including tracking administrative and claims costs and managing the intercompany billing process.

About the Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements

Our CPG team brings our brands into consumers’ everyday lives through new products, beginning with our beverage business. The Executive Assistant, Corporate Governance & Board Operations provides high-level administrative and governance support to the Deputy General Counsel and legal leadership team, focusing on board management and corporate governance. As the central liaison for the Board of Directors, this role ensures seamless communication and meticulous preparation of materials for executive meetings. The ideal candidate is a proactive, highly organized professional who handles competing demands with exceptional judgment, strict confidentiality, and high integrity.

About The Team: 

The People Inc. legal team operates as a trusted strategic partner across the enterprise, safeguarding the company’s assets, reputation, and compliance standards. Job Title

Principal Designer

Job Description


About The Position:


People Inc. is looking for a Principal Designer to take on some of the company’s most varied, visible, and important work.


You’ll work directly with the Chief Communications Officer and Chief Design Officer on the work that most visibly represents People Inc.: our events, our brand identity, our sites, what we put in front of investors, and the spaces we work in. Much of it has no precedent, so not every project starts with a defined brief. You’ll collaborate with leadership to frame the problem, and along with the Senior Creative Director, develop the concept and creative direction and bring it to life.


That means pairing ambitious creative thinking with close attention to the details that make the work successful. For events, you’ll work directly with vendors, production companies, and internal partners to carry the design through production, and stay involved through on-site execution. You’ll bring fresh ideas for what our events can be and the resourcefulness to make the most of the budget, spaces, materials, and time available.


You’ll lead other designers and outside partners project by project while staying hands-on. This is a role for someone highly experienced and influential who loves making the work and seeing it through.


In-office Expectations: At least three days per week at our 225 Liberty Street headquarters in New York City.


About The Team:

_____________________________________________________________________________


The Design Group at People Inc. brings together multiple teams supporting Revenue Design, Brand & Editorial Design, Product & UX Design, Design Systems, Creative Operations, Transactional Creative, and Events.

 

This role will work across corporate, brand, communications, and experiential design, partnering closely with senior leadership and designers across the organization.

Weight %

Bachelor's degree preferred in design, graphic design, visual communication, or related field, and/or equivalent experience.

job.title: Senior Data Scientist
job.description:
Job Title

Senior Data Scientist

Job Description

 

About The Position |

As a Senior Data Scientist for personalization, you will own the science behind the recommendation engine that powers each user’s personalized product feed. Starting from our user-saved product signals and a live catalog ingested from thousands of retailer feeds, you will design, build, evaluate, and continuously improve the models that learn each user’s taste across brand, category, color, price point, and fit.

 

This is a hands-on, full-cycle role. You will take a recommendation problem from raw data all the way to a production model running on our existing MLOps stack — you own the model layer, not the infrastructure. Our platform team already operates the feature store, serving, and autoscaling; your job is to decide what to model, prove it works through rigorous offline and online experimentation, ship it, and iterate as behavioral signals accumulate.

 

A defining challenge of this role is cold-start. We are launching with a small behavioral dataset and a catalog scaling from hundreds of thousands of products toward tens of millions. You will need strong commerce and product-data intuition to produce high-quality recommendations before rich click data exists — and the experimental discipline to keep improving them as it arrives. This is a foundational hire that will shape how millions of users discover products they love.

 

Remote or Hybrid 3x a week NYC

In-office Expectations: This position offers remote work flexibility; however, if you reside within a commutable distance our offices in New York, the expectation is to work from the office three days per week.

 

About The Team: |

_______________________________________________________________________________

Our next-generation product discovery platform connects shoppers with the things they love across thousands of retail partners. Users save, organize, and share products they're excited about — and our platform turns those signals into a deeply personalized shopping experience. We ingest live product feeds from thousands of retailers and use a rich understanding of each user's taste to surface the right product at the right moment.

 

We're building the recommendation engine at the heart of this shopping experience — a system that understands not just what people save, but why they save it. This is a foundational hire that will shape how millions of users discover products they love.

About The Positions Contributions:

  • 35% Recommendation & Personalization Modeling

    Own the design and development of the core recommendation models that turn user-saved product data into a personalized feed. Develop multi-signal models spanning brand affinity, category, color/visual attributes, fit and sizing, price sensitivity, and trend. Select and justify approaches across collaborative filtering, matrix factorization, content-based, and hybrid/neural methods (e.g., two-tower and other embedding models), and know when each applies. Build product and user embeddings that capture semantic similarity across the catalog and power candidate generation and retrieval. Design cold-start strategies that produce high-quality recommendations for new users and newly ingested products with little or no behavioral history.

    25% Experimentation & Measurement

    Define what “good” personalization means and how it is measured. Establish rigorous offline evaluation (ranking and relevance metrics, sound holdout design) and connect it to online outcomes. Design, run, and read out A/B and multivariate experiments, and translate results into clear product and business decisions. Bring statistical discipline — sound experiment design, awareness of bias and confounding, and honest interpretation — so the team can trust which changes actually move engagement.

    20% Data, Signals & Feature Understanding

    Develop deep intuition for Picksy’s product catalog and user signals. Turn implicit behavior (saves, clicks, dwell, shares) and catalog attributes into meaningful model features, writing SQL against BigQuery to pull, join, and shape raw data into training/evaluation datasets. Apply NLP and computer-vision techniques — including modern embedding and LLM-based approaches — to extract structured attributes (category, color, material, fit) from unstructured product descriptions and imagery, and to enrich sparse catalog data. Partner with data engineering on data quality, freshness, and coverage as the catalog scales from hundreds of thousands toward tens of millions of products.

    20% Full-Cycle Ownership & Productionization

    Take models from prototype to production yourself. Write clean, production-quality code and deploy into the existing MLOps pipeline (feature store, training, serving, monitoring) rather than building infrastructure from scratch. Own model performance in production: instrument it, watch for drift and degradation, and iterate as behavioral signals accumulate. Document models, features, and decisions clearly, and collaborate closely with the MLOps, engineering, and product teams to integrate the model layer into the live product.

Education:

Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field; or equivalent practical experience.

Experience:

You combine the modeling depth of an applied/data scientist with the pragmatism to ship end-to-end. You bring:

  • Strong data science fundamentals: statistics, experimental design, and evaluation methodology, with the analytical ability to turn model results into clear product and business decisions.

  • Demonstrated ownership of the full A/B testing lifecycle: designing experiments, running them, reading them out, and deciding; not just reporting offline metrics.

  • Experience designing, training, and deploying embedding models and vector retrieval (e.g., Milvus, Pinecone, or Vertex AI Vector Search) for product or content similarity at catalog scale.

  • Direct experience with cold-start / sparse-signal personalization: building useful recommendations from a new catalog, new users, or both. This is a core, day-one challenge of the role.

  • Strong Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX) plus the standard scientific stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn). You write production-quality code, not just notebooks.

  • Strong SQL: hands-on experience querying large datasets in a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred) to pull, join, and assemble the training and evaluation datasets that feed your models. This is a daily part of the role.

  • Experience deploying and serving models on a cloud ML platform: GCP Vertex AI strongly preferred (SageMaker or equivalent acceptable) and you are comfortable owning the full model lifecycle: training, deployment, versioning, and monitoring.

  • Commerce intuition: you’ve worked with product catalogs and understand merchandising, category, and PM concerns. It shows up in how you talk about catalogs and taste, not just models.

  • Curiosity and pragmatism about emerging AI, particularly LLMs and modern retrieval/ranking, with a track record of bringing new techniques into real production use.

  • Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain technical tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 

Nice to have:

  • Applied NLP and/or computer vision for extracting structured attributes from product text and imagery.

  • Experience with adaptive recommendation and experimentation methods; multi-armed or contextual bandits.

  • Public writing or conference talks on recommendation, personalization, or ranking work.

  • Early-stage or commerce experience where you wore multiple hats and shipped against real business metrics (e.g., commerce SaaS or a vertical commerce startup).

job.description:
Job Title

Senior Enterprise Security Engineer

Job Description

People Inc is looking for a Senior Enterprise Security Engineer with a demonstrated track record of innovative thinking, technical expertise, and execution. You’ll be responsible for maintaining (and raising) the security posture across our infrastructure and end-user SaaS applications and endpoints, designing and implementing enterprise security solutions, and reducing toil through automation.


As a highly visible professional within the Security team, you will be responsible for helping to set technical direction for enterprise security, managing technical projects, and partner with other groups within the organization to deliver tools and services that align with our security roadmaps.


Remote or Hybrid 3x a month 

In-office Expectations: This position offers remote work flexibility; however, if you reside within a commutable distance to one of our offices in New York, Des Moines, Birmingham, Los Angeles, orChicago, the expectation is to work from the office three times per month.


About the Position's Contributions:

Security Engineering

  • Harden systems for cyber resilience including Operating Systems, and Network Devices and SaaS platforms
  • Architect and design log management systems to collect security events across multiple log sources
  • Perform orchestration and automated response (SOAR)
  • Oversee vulnerability remediation

Architecture And Design

  • Provide technical leadership and oversight to security architecture activities and initiatives
  • Define security architecture roadmaps and/or strategy
  • Determine security requirements and security controls
  • Provide design and oversight into identity and access management (IAM)
  • Perform threat modeling and reporting

Data Loss Prevention

  • Provide technical leadership and oversight to data loss prevention activities and initiatives
  • Develop and implement strategies for Data Loss Prevention and architect and design DLP solutions and technologies
  • Perform risk assessments to identify gaps in DLP coverage

Identity And Access Management (IAM)

  • Architect and design IAM solutions and technologies including Single Sign On (SSO), Multi-factor authentication, Password-less authentication
  • Evaluate and inspect current IAM access permissions to verify their ongoing necessity
  • Conduct risk-based analysis of users and groups across the enterprise and cloud infrastructure

Compliance

  • Oversee adherence to internal policies or standards
  • Understanding various compliance standards
  • Interpret standards, requirements and their application to the enterprise environment
  • Provide leadership, guidance and subject matter expertise to compliance and audit teams
  • Recommend, document and monitor the implementation of any prescribed corrective actions resulting from risk assessments

About You:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security with 3+ years of experience as a Security Engineer with a focus on securing end user SaaS applications, user endpoints, and associated infrastructure.
  • Experience with hardening infrastructure including network devices, and operating systems.
  • Experience deploying and customizing security tools.
  • Fluent in one or more modern coding languages (Python, Go, JavaScript, etc.).
  • Experience with one or more infrastructure as code tools (Terraform, Ansible, etc.).
  • Experience with one of the major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with one or more authentication technologies (Okta, Keycloak).
  • Experience with one or more LLM/GCP technologies (ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code, Google Gemini, etc.)

Interpersonal Skills

  • Passion for enterprise security and continuous learning.
  • Able to concisely communicate security risks to both technical and business audiences.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, and as part of a team.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize work effectively.

专业能力

  • 出色的客户沟通与关系管理能力，具备一定策略视角
  • 有KOL / 明星合作经验及资源整合能力者优先

个人特质

  • 持续关注体育行业趋势、品牌动态及消费者文化变化

job.title: Senior Account Executive, Associate Practice (Health)
job.description:
We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging. Consistent with this approach, we hire the best qualified candidates for all positions.

About the Edelman Associate Practice

The Edelman Associate Practice is the foundation of our client service talent and the launchpad for early-career professionals who want to shape the future of communications. Bringing together emerging talent across communications, public affairs, and advisory disciplines, the practice is designed to develop well-rounded, integrated practitioners from day one. Associates contribute meaningfully to client work across industries and sectors—building strong fundamentals in research, writing, project management, and media engagement—while gaining exposure to diverse clients and capabilities. Rather than being confined to a single track at the start of their careers, Associates are empowered to explore, collaborate across teams, and discover where their interests and strengths can make the greatest impact.


Rooted in community and driven by growth, the Associate Practice combines hands-on client experience with structured development, peer connection, and dedicated leadership support. As the industry evolves, so does the role—blending operational excellence with increasing strategic contribution and AI-enabled innovation. Associates learn not only how to execute exceptional work, but how to think critically, solve complex problems, and build the judgment and confidence that define Edelman excellence. This is more than a first step in your career—it’s an opportunity to grow alongside a connected cohort, contribute to transformative client work, and help redefine what modern communications looks like. 


About the Role

Senior Account Executives (SAEs) are strong communicators who serve as trusted connectors between clients, teams, and media or stakeholder networks. They show emerging leadership by anticipating needs, solving problems proactively, and influencing both internal and external stakeholders with clarity and confidence.  SAEs demonstrate supportive ownership of workstreams, contribute to strategic planning and execution, and engage with senior leadership and clients. As they continue to build their expertise, SAEs may begin to specialize in a particular practice area based on their skills, experience, and professional goals. 


In this role, you will primarily support work across Health clients with U.S. and global footprints. These clients are in regulated industries, specifically and such as medical technology, health services, animal health, and more.  Your day-to-day work may include: 

  • Media landscape research, engagement, and materials development
  • Social media campaigns and content creation
  • Executive visibility and thought leadership initiatives
  • Proactively researching and analyzing industry trends
  • Administrative reporting, tracking, and operational management

Key Responsibilities  

Client & Account Support  

  • Actively support senior team members in day-to-day client interactions around assigned projects, helping to manage deliverables and ensure alignment with objectives.  
  • Actively support senior team members in client calls, providing tactical counsel, and proactively flagging issues, risks, or opportunities.  
  • Build strong relationships rooted in reliability, responsiveness, and trust, focused on internal audiences and stakeholders in addition to client interactions

Strategic Planning & Program Management  

  • Support senior leads around client strategy development, message framing, and campaign planning through research, trends analysis, operational activation, presentation creation, etc.
  • Assist with integrated program execution across functions, ensuring alignment with goals, timelines, and budgets.  
  • Collaborate internally and throughout the firm with creative, digital, and analytics partners, for example, to deliver seamless, multi-channel campaigns.  

Content & Storytelling  

  • Write and/or edit high-quality materials such as press releases, op-eds, briefing documents, messaging, talking points, stakeholder materials, or other client-facing content.  
  • Translate complex scientific, technical, and business information into clear, compelling, and accessible narratives that connect to business and reputation outcomes.  
  • Review and refine content to ensure quality and consistency in client deliverables.  
  • Show eagerness, interest, and willingness to learn, as well as developing a strong understanding and/or curiosity to help distill and understand  complex, evolving healthcare topics and issues for varying stakeholder groups
  • Review and refine content with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail, ensuring client deliverables are clear, consistent, polished, and aligned with approved messaging, key stats and facts, and with consideration to overarching operational priorities. 

Media & Stakeholder Relations  

  • Support proactive outreach to journalists, influencers, and conference organizers; secure earned media and stakeholder engagement results; do so under the guidance of senior external engagement team members.  
  • Monitor trends and provide recommendations that shape client strategy, response, and day-to-day real time opportunity potential.  
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships across media, industry, and relevant stakeholder networks.  

Executive Visibility and Thought Leadership

  • Conduct research and provide clear recommendations for conferences, awards, and media engagements for executives.
  • Conduct both company-level and peer-level competitor audits.
  • Draft messaging framework and/or platform development for executives.
  • Manage logistics for media and event engagements, including preparation of talking points, briefing materials, etc.

Leadership & Team Development  

  • Provide and seek guidance and feedback with colleagues both junior and senior to foster their growth and development.  
  • Model professionalism, collaboration, and inclusion; support performance and actively support team performance and development conversations.  
  • Contribute to new business initiatives through research, insights, idea development, or presentation design refinement. 

  

Basic Qualifications:

  • 2 years of professional experience in communications, public relations, or a related discipline. 
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proven ability to manage multiple small or medium-sized projects simultaneously  
  • Clear understanding of the clients’ businesses and their missions, as well as their key stakeholders that could include but are not limited to consumers, patients, clinicians, employees, investors, regulators, media, vendors, partners, other businesses/organizations, etc.
  • Ability to functionally and successfully work in a dedicated time zone, but with day-to-day team members internally who dispersed throughout multiple time zones and office locations.
  • Demonstrated ability to help develop communication programming and plans, implement integrated tactics and impart knowledge to junior account team members and peers.
  • Able to perform well under pressure and be a team player.
  • Strong research, writing and editing skills, as well as the ability to interact with clients professionally and show active engagement internally as well.
  • Demonstrate strong intellectual curiosity and the ability to quickly absorb new information, ask thoughtful questions, and rapidly build an understanding of clients, their businesses, and the broader industry landscape.
  • Operate with a proactive, self-starting mindset and a strong sense of urgency, anticipating needs and moving work forward without requiring significant direction.
  • Thrive in a fast-moving environment, adapting quickly to shifting priorities and balancing speed with sound judgment and attention to detail.

$60,000 - $80,000 a year

job.title: Senior Account Supervisor, Public & Government Affairs (Health)
job.description:
We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging. Consistent with this approach, we hire the best qualified candidates for all positions.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Account Supervisor of Health, to support the growing needs of Edelman’s Public & Government Affairs team. This role will provide day-to-day support to clients and account teams with a focus on health policy and public affairs within the healthcare industry (e.g., pharmaceuticals, biotech, medical devices and medtech, hospitals and health services).


The ideal candidate will bring experience supporting pharmaceutical, hospital or health-system clients in an agency environment, or working in-house within a pharmaceutical company or healthcare organization. They will have a strong understanding of the policy, regulatory and stakeholder dynamics shaping the healthcare industry and experience translating complex issues into actionable public affairs strategies.


While this position will primarily focus on the U.S. health landscape, there is an opportunity to work with other markets and regions.


The Senior Account Supervisor is primarily responsible for creating the first-round deliverables and reports for clients, under the guidance of senior counsel and client leaders. Together with your team, you will support client needs with a variety of tasks including – policy research and analysis, issues monitoring, political risk assessments, stakeholder mapping and campaign strategy development. The role will also support research and issues monitoring for new business and thought leadership development. Success in this role requires exceptional written and verbal communication skills, strong analytical judgment and the ability to convey complex information clearly to clients and internal teams. The ideal candidate will also be highly collaborative, proactive and organized, with the ability to manage competing priorities, coordinate across teams, and consistently deliver high-quality work.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead and oversee day-to-day operations of an account workstream for health clients - anticipating challenges, troubleshooting problems, proposing solutions, monitoring developments in real time through research and networks, overseeing quality, and ensuring deadline and budget adherence.
  • Manage client deliverables in a timely fashion and provide updates to client leaders.
  • Conduct value add research and analysis for client proposals, strategies, and approaches for existing and new clients.
  • Collaborate with staff on deliverables, helping to mentor and motivate team members by providing consistent support and feedback that helps drive efficiency.
  • Contribute to business growth by introducing clients to new capabilities, building a network of industry contacts, and participating in relevant professional organizations.

Basic Qualifications:

  • At least 6+ years demonstrated track record of success within public affairs working in government, pharmaceutical associations, or health related companies.
  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience and knowledge of US healthcare system and health policy environment.
  • Experience developing or supporting public affairs, government affairs, or policy communications strategies within the healthcare sector.
  • Direct experience supporting pharmaceutical companies, hospitals or health systems, either in an agency setting or in-house, with an understanding of the unique policy, regulatory, reputational, and stakeholder challenges facing these organizations. 
  • Familiarity with healthcare stakeholders, including federal and state policymakers, regulatory agencies, patient advocacy organizations, healthcare professional societies, and industry trade associations. 
  • Strong understanding of current political affairs and emerging healthcare policy issues, with the ability to anticipate developments and assess their implications for clients. 
  • Excellent interpersonal and client management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across written, virtual, and in-person settings. 
  • A proactive, intellectually curious and solutions-oriented approach to client service and problem-solving. 
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative, team-based environment, manage competing priorities, and contribute to successful client outcomes. 
  • Exceptional writing, editing and storytelling abilities, with experience developing compelling policy communications and executive-level materials. 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Teams, with the ability to manage project budgets, staffing projections, and client presentations. 
  • Digital literacy and familiarity with social and digital platforms used to support public affairs, advocacy, and stakeholder engagement campaigns.

job.title: Senior Account Supervisor, Special Situations & Investor Relations Communications
job.description:
We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging. Consistent with this approach, we hire the best qualified candidates for all positions.

About Our Team

Edelman Smithfield advises companies when the stakes are highest. We sit at the intersection of capital markets, reputation and strategy, helping leadership teams earn trust, command attention and win support from investors when it matters most.

 

Backed by the scale of the world’s largest independent communications firm, our team brings deep capital markets expertise. We are a team of experienced advisors and former in-house IROs, sell-side analysts and investment bankers who partner directly with Boards and C-suites on IPOs, transformational M&A, activist campaigns, restructurings, earnings inflection points and market-moving moments of change.


The Opportunity

The Senior Account Supervisor, Special Situations & Investor Relations (SSIR), will be responsible for developing and executing IR and financial communications programs of our clients. Ideal candidates will come from former investment and research analyst roles and/or will have direct investor relations experience, either with an agency or in-house IR position. Financial communications experience is preferred. The candidate must be fluent in the capital markets and possess a strong comfort level in counseling senior executives and investor relations teams of publicly traded companies on matters including disclosure, earnings and guidance, governance, marketing, investor targeting and relationship building, M&A, capital raises and crisis situations.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Provide counsel to clients on messaging and positioning across all external investor and financial communications, including: quarterly earnings news releases and conference call scripts, material corporate news, investor presentation and general 1x1 and group communications with the investment community. Manage and participate hands on in team development of messaging and positioning of company business model and corporate developments.
  • Support traditional “retainer” based IR and financial media clients as well as transaction-oriented project work (including M&A, IPOs, shareholder activism, and investor days).
  • Lead the creation of investor communications plans and goals, including development of both tactical and strategic elements; manage against them.
  • Serve as a key day-to-day contact for clients, including CFO, CEO, IRO and other senior leaders.
  • Interact directly with client shareholders and covering sell-side analysts, discussing client business attributes, collecting feedback, supporting bank-sponsored non-deal road shows, and reacting to investment community informational needs.
  • Monitor sell-side valuation models and counsel clients on effectively setting expectations around future performance.
  • Ensure team is proactive and highly responsive to client needs, anticipating upcoming deliverables and taking accountability for proper execution. Ensure junior staff is trained, supportive of team efforts and paying sufficient attention to detail.
  • Participate with senior partners in new business preparation and participate in new business activity to ultimately serve those accounts.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • At least 6 years of relevant experience within the capital markets, including either with a sell-or buy-side firm, investor relations agency or in an IR role at a public company
  • A bachelor’s degree in business, finance, accounting or related discipline or equivalent work experience

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong comfort level in counseling senior executives of publicly traded companies on IR related and financial communications matters.
  • Strong writing skills, including experience writing financially-oriented news releases and presentations.
  • Strong analytical skills; ability to analyze financial data sets and understand businesses across multiple industries.
  • Experience with relevant data platforms, including Bloomberg, Nasdaq IR Insight as well as proficient in MSFT Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Preferred master’s in business administration (MBA) or Charted Financial Analyst (CFA) designation a plus but not required.
  • Specific experience counseling companies through material transaction, including M&A and Initial Public Offerings (IPO) a plus.
  • Organized and detail-oriented; multi-task various responsibilities.
  • Proactive and self-motivated; anticipate upcoming client projects and deliverables.
  • Ability to think critically and demonstrate good judgment.
  • Excellent interpersonal and verbal skills; professional phone and email communications.
  • Innate desire to provide excellent service to clients.

job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum. 

At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.

Edelman Malaysia – Senior Accountant Role

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Senior Accountant to join our Company.  In this role, you will be exposed to the following areas in Finance and Management Accounting: Financial Accounting, Business Law/Contracts, Procurement, Project Accounting, Taxation, and Compliance. 

 

We seek an individual with excellent people skills, numbers’ skills, and beyond all one with a winning attitude to become a successful finance business partner to our core operational team members. Our work environment is fast-paced and not for the faint-hearted. You will be coached and mentored to grow within the organization. We seek only candidates with a long-term aspiration to grow and learn within this organization.

 

Position Summary:

The Senior Accountant is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the company's financial records and delivering timely financial reporting, statutory compliance, audit coordination, and business support. This role plays a key part in managing the month-end and year-end closing processes, maintaining compliance with accounting standards and company policies, and partnering with business stakeholders to support operational and financial objectives.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Revenue Recognition & Project Accounting

  • Perform monthly revenue assessment to ensure project revenue and costs are accurately recognised.
  • Work closely with Client Finance, Client Leaders and Operations to resolve revenue-related issues.
  • Support project profitability analysis and financial performance monitoring.
  • Support in RFQ / RFP submission.

Financial Reporting & Month-End Close

  • Lead and coordinate the monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial close process.
  • Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, prepayments, provisions, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Ensure the completeness and accuracy of the general ledger.
  • Perform monthly financial analysis and explain significant variances.
  • Prepare management reports and support with financial analysis.

Balance Sheet Management

  • Review and reconcile balance sheet accounts, including intercompany balances, fixed assets, receivables, payables, accruals, and provisions.
  • Ensure timely clearance of reconciling items and maintain accurate supporting documentation.

Compliance & Internal Controls

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, accounting standards, and statutory requirements.
  • Support tax compliance, including Sales & Services Tax (SST), withholding tax, and corporate tax reporting.
  • Maintain effective internal controls and ensure timely resolution of audit findings.
  • Identify opportunities to improve finance processes and strengthen operational controls.

Statutory Reporting & Audit

  • Coordinate year-end statutory audit and prepare audit schedules.
  • Liaise with external auditors to resolve audit queries and provide supporting documentation.
  • Coordinate with the Company Secretary on statutory filings, annual returns, and board resolutions.
  • Prepare statutory financial statements in compliance with local accounting standards.

Regional & Global Reporting

  • Prepare supplementary reporting packages for Regional and Global Finance.
  • Coordinate statutory-to-GAAP reporting and ensure reporting timelines are met.
  • Support regional finance requests, reporting submissions, and ad hoc analyses.

 

Qualifications:

  • University degree in Accounting/Finance/Business Studies and/or Professional Accounting qualifications (ACCA, CA, CPA).
  • Minimum 5–7 years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in a multinational or professional services environment.
  • Strong hands-on experience in full-set accounting and month-end/year-end closing.
  • Experience in statutory reporting, balance sheet reconciliations, and external audit coordination.
  • Good knowledge of Malaysian accounting standards, tax regulations, and statutory requirements, including SST, corporate tax, withholding tax (WHT), and stamp duty.

 

Skills & Experience:

  • Proven experience in preparing statutory financial statements and regional/global reporting packages.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and financial reporting skills.
  • Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines.
  • High attention to detail with a strong commitment to accuracy and quality.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, PivotTables, and data analysis.
  • Fluent in spoken and written English.

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Edelman is looking for a Senior Program Director, Project Management to join our Toronto team. Working at the intersection of creativity, strategy, technology, and communications, you'll play a critical role in shaping how ambitious ideas come to life. Who You Are

You're a strategic, solutions-oriented leader who knows how to balance big-picture thinking with the details that make great work happen. You bring deep experience in integrated project management, a strong understanding of technology and digital delivery, and the confidence to guide teams through complex challenges.

You're naturally collaborative, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and motivated by finding smarter ways of working. You lead with curiosity and empathy, build trust across disciplines, and enjoy helping others develop and succeed.

job.title: Senior Vice President, Business Affairs
job.description:
We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging. Consistent with this approach, we hire the best qualified candidates for all positions.

Edelman is seeking a Senior Vice President, Business Affairs to join our global Business Affairs team. This is an opportunity for an experienced entertainment and business affairs professional to help shape complex, high-profile partnerships at the intersection of entertainment, sports, advertising and culture.


Reporting to the Global Head of Business Affairs, you’ll play a key role in structuring and negotiating deals involving celebrities, athletes, musicians, influencers, creators and leading brands. From talent partnerships and sponsorships to content production, licensing and intellectual property, you'll help bring ambitious creative ideas to life while navigating complex commercial and rights considerations.


You'll also help shape how Business Affairs operates across the organization, partnering with senior leaders to strengthen processes, manage risk and develop practical solutions in an evolving media and entertainment landscape.


Who You Are

You're a strategic, commercially minded dealmaker who understands both the business and creative sides of entertainment. You bring deep transactional expertise, sound judgment and the confidence to navigate sophisticated negotiations with high-profile talent representatives, rights holders and business leaders.


You thrive on solving complex challenges, balancing creative ambitions with commercial realities and finding solutions that move business forward. You're comfortable working independently on sensitive matters while building trusted relationships across teams. Above all, you bring curiosity, collaboration and a practical approach to getting deals done.


What You'll Do

  • Lead complex entertainment and talent transactions, including celebrity, athlete, musician, influencer and creator partnerships, sponsorships, licensing and content production agreements.
  • Structure and negotiate sophisticated agreements with talent representatives, agencies, managers, rights holders, production partners and other counterparties, driving negotiations through resolution.
  • Advise on critical deal terms and rights, including compensation, deliverables, usage, exclusivity, intellectual property, approvals, cancellation and termination provisions.
  • Provide strategic Business Affairs guidance across digital, social, broadcast, experiential and emerging content formats, identifying risks and developing commercially practical solutions.
  • Partner with Production, Legal and client teams to navigate intellectual property, music, licensing, publicity rights, union considerations and third-party contracting requirements.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, helping teams navigate sensitive or novel business challenges while balancing creative objectives, commercial priorities and risk.
  • Help shape global Business Affairs practices, collaborating with leadership to improve policies, contracting processes, risk management and production workflows.

Basic Qualifications

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in entertainment Business Affairs, entertainment law, advertising, media, sports, talent, production, licensing or a closely related field.
  • Significant experience independently structuring and negotiating complex entertainment, talent and rights-driven transactions.
  • Strong understanding of intellectual property, licensing, publicity rights and entertainment industry contracting.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. entertainment guilds and performer unions, particularly SAG-AFTRA, and their implications for advertising and content production.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor (JD) and experience practicing entertainment, media, advertising or intellectual property law preferred, but not required. Candidates with substantial Business Affairs experience and equivalent transactional expertise are encouraged to apply.
  • Experience advising on complex content and production matters across digital, social, broadcast, experiential and creator-led campaigns.
  • Strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills, with the ability to navigate competing priorities, complex contract redlines and sensitive business matters.
  • Ability to build credibility and trusted relationships with senior executives, clients, attorneys, talent representatives and cross-functional teams.
  • Strategic leadership and mentoring capabilities, with a collaborative, solutions-oriented approach to managing multiple high-priority matters.

job.title: Senior Vice President, Crisis & Risk Communications - Data, Security, and Privacy
job.description:
We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging. Consistent with this approach, we hire the best qualified candidates for all positions.

The Global Crisis & Reputation Risk practice is one of the most respected and largest in the world, serving clients on complex crises and with 100+ practitioners in more than 60 countries. The capabilities and diversity of talent have also grown to include former management consultants, digital leaders, sector experts, research and analytics specialists, and senior crisis counselors.

 

The Crisis & Reputation Risk team advises leading corporations, governments and institutions and their senior leaders on a broad range of crises including cybersecurity and data security incidents, data privacy matters, physical security risks, corporate malfeasance, societal issues, litigation, ethics and integrity matters, product and service risks, regulatory scrutiny, financial issues and other events that affect trust, reputation and business continuity.  

 

We are currently looking for a senior-level crisis management professional to join our team. In this role as Senior Vice President, Crisis & Reputation Risk you will work on and help grow Data Security & Privacy (DSP) work, which supports clients as they prepare for, manage and recover from cybersecurity, data security and privacy risks and incidents. A successful candidate will have a strong track record developing communications strategies and providing reputational counsel to companies.

 

We are looking for someone with deep experience preparing organizations for cybersecurity/data risks and leading crisis matters involving clients facing cybersecurity incidents – from unauthorized access, data breaches, ransomware incidents, business interruption events, third-party/vendor incidents, sensitive data exposure, data misuse allegations and privacy notification matters. You should be a driven professional who can provide expert, practical and creative client counsel, work effectively alongside legal, forensics, insurance, security and communications stakeholders; and  inspire and lead teams to further evolve, grow and upscale our offering.

 

If this sounds like you, keep reading!

 

Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with the most senior leaders in the company to counsel our clients on complex cybersecurity/data security and privacy crises as well as other issues affecting trust and reputation. This role will involve a strong focus on helping clients prepare for and respond to cybersecurity/data security and data privacy incidents, including ransomware attacks and breaches of personal, financial, health and corporate information. In addition to incident response communications strategy, this role supports client preparedness through playbooks, trainings and tabletops
  • Where needed, support other issues and crisis matters such as product recalls, litigation, labor matters, regulatory investigations and societal issues
  • Work collaboratively with Edelman’s counter-disinformation experts to counsel clients at the intersection of cybersecurity and AI/disinformation
  • Play an active role in strategically driving and developing crisis account work
  • Lead operational and financial performance of account teams, ensuring quality work, effective processes and that client requests are handled in timely and strategic fashion
  • Thoughtfully counsel clients based on cyber communications landscape and business goals; take immediate action on client feedback
  • Work alongside clients’ cyber counsel and forensics partners to develop holistic data security response communications plans and materials
  • Translate complex cybersecurity, data security and privacy issues into clear, credible and audience-appropriate communications for executives, boards, employees, customers, consumers, partners, regulators, policymakers, investors and media.
  • Oversee junior staff by providing clear and consistent feedback, and advancing work
  • product
  • Lead new business development efforts, capitalizing on, and contributing to, the Edelman global network to serve and help grow the firm’s DSP offering, including proactively expanding existing relationships and bridging new relationships with data security attorneys and insurers
  • Demonstrate advanced writing skills and supervise writing of others
  • Set and lead both traditional and social strategic media relations course
  • Host internal trainings on DSP matters
  • Manage billing and budgets

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Have 10 years+ of crisis management experience and experience running integrated account work, managing a team, and growing account work with clients
  • Able to work a hybrid schedule with 3 days a week in the Chicago, NYC, or D.C. office
  • Able to be on site with clients as needed
  • Have a bachelor’s degree in a related field

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Have worked in federal law enforcement, regulatory bodies, or other relevant government entities
  • Experience helping organizations prepare for and respond to cybersecurity, data security and privacy incidents
  • Experience and interest in helping organizations confront the rapidly evolving cybersecurity landscape
  • Strong understanding of the cybersecurity and data privacy incident response ecosystem, including the roles of outside counsel, privacy counsel, forensic investigators, insurers, brokers, regulators, law enforcement and internal security teams
  • Ability to provide sound communications counsel in legally sensitive, fast-moving and high-pressure environments
  • Excellent client relationship skills and experience giving counsel on strategy, approach, and execution
  • Strong organizational, scheduling, and time/project management skills; possess the ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously
  • Able to adapt on the fly, comfortable in a quickly and constantly changing landscape, and able to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Track record of growing profitable programs that have advanced client business goals
  • Media relations and message development skills to lead execution of plans, crisis response messaging and storytelling on behalf of clients
  • Experience in working in new business and driving proposal development and opportunities for the team
  • Sound judgment and proven problem-solving skills
  • Ability to develop and help coach a team, in addition to leading work
  • Ability to secure new business and contribute to and/or lead new business pitches

job.title: Solutions Lead, AI Transformation
job.description:
We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging. Consistent with this approach, we hire the best qualified candidates for all positions.

We're transforming how work gets done across Edelman, redesigning specialty workflows around AI, developing the tools and solutions that support them, and translating these new ways of working into more standardized, scalable services and offerings.

 

As the AI Transformation Solutions Lead, you'll support the SVP of AI Transformation in driving Specialty-Based Transformation across the firm, working closely with subject matter experts, product and engineering teams to rethink how work is performed and bring AI-enabled solutions to life.

 

You'll also help translate these redesigned workflows into clearly defined deliverables, service models and pricing frameworks that shape how Edelman scopes, delivers and goes to market with its services.

 

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of AI transformation, solution design and business transformation. You'll help connect the dots from understanding how people work today, to designing and implementing better ways of working, to defining how those capabilities can be consistently delivered and commercially packaged for clients. 


What you'll do 

  • Support specialty workflow discovery and redesign: Work directly with specialty leaders and subject matter experts to understand how work is currently performed, identify pain points and opportunities for AI, and map current-state and future-state workflows end to end. 
  • Translate workflows into AI-enabled solutions: Turn specialist knowledge and business needs into clear scopes, product requirements and workflow documentation that guide the development of new AI-enabled tools and solutions. 
  • Support solution prototyping and development: Use generative AI tools to create mockups, prototypes and early solution concepts, working with product managers and engineering teams to turn ideas into practical applications. 
  • Bridge business and technical teams: Act as a connector between subject matter experts, transformation leaders and engineers, ensuring that solutions reflect real workflow needs, technical requirements are clearly understood, and stakeholder feedback informs development priorities. 
  • Support testing, rollout and adoption: Coordinate user feedback and testing, help develop onboarding and training resources, and track whether new workflows and tools are being adopted and delivering measurable improvements. 
  • Translate redesigned workflows into standardized deliverables: Help connect new AI-enabled ways of working to Edelman's standardized menu of services and deliverables, identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize or evolve what we deliver and how we deliver it. 
  • Support service definition and commercial modeling: Work with offering leads and operational stakeholders to define deliverables, validate complexity and effort assumptions, and understand the skills, roles, staffing and costs required to deliver services through transformed workflows. Support the development of consistent scoping and pricing frameworks that reflect these new delivery models and inform how services are taken to market. 

What we're looking for 

  • 3-5 years of experience in product management, business analysis, consulting, operations, AI transformation, service design or a related field. 
  • Strong understanding of generative AI tools and their applications in business, with enthusiasm for exploring how AI can fundamentally change workflows and service delivery. 
  • Experience conducting user research, gathering requirements and documenting workflows, processes or solutions. 
  • Ability to translate in both directions: turning complex business needs into clear technical requirements, and explaining technical concepts in practical terms to non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Strong analytical skills, including confidence working with structured data, spreadsheets and models to identify insights and inform decisions. 
  • Excellent written communication and the ability to turn ambiguous or complex information into clear requirements, frameworks, recommendations and documentation. 
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, stakeholders and evolving priorities. 
  • Curiosity about how businesses operate, how services are delivered and how technology can improve efficiency, quality and commercial value. 
  • Confidence working collaboratively across specialty teams, product and engineering, operations and business leadership. 
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail and comfort working in an evolving environment where processes and solutions are still being defined. 

Nice to have:
Experience in PR, communications or professional services; familiarity with AI prototyping, prompt design or product development; exposure to service catalogs, process improvement, workforce planning, commercial modeling or pricing frameworks. 

 

You'll be part of a team fundamentally rethinking how the world's largest global communications firm works and goes to market in an AI-enabled world. 


You'll gain hands-on experience across the full transformation lifecycle, from discovering opportunities and redesigning workflows to developing AI solutions, shaping standardized offerings and supporting new commercial models. 


Working closely with transformation leadership, specialty experts and technical teams, you'll help build tools and ways of working that create real business impact, while contributing to how Edelman defines, delivers and sells its services in the future. 


This is an opportunity to develop expertise at the intersection of AI, product development, business transformation and commercial innovation, helping shape not just how people work, but what the firm is able to offer its clients. 


$90-120K per year

job.title: Sr Analyst, Associate Group
job.description:
Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum. 

At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.

ROLE OVERVIEW

  • The Senior Executive – Integrated Communications (PR & Social) is responsible for supporting the day-to-day execution of integrated communications campaigns, ensuring high-quality delivery across PR, social media, influencer engagement, and digital communications. The role requires strong execution capabilities, proactive project coordination, and the ability to independently manage assigned tasks and workstreams while meeting Edelman Standards and client expectations.
  • S/he demonstrates a solid understanding of integrated Communications Marketing principles, with hands-on experience in media relations, content development, social media communications, influencer engagement, and online community activation. S/he is able to adapt key messages and communications content across different channels to ensure consistency and relevance to target audiences.
  • This role requires the ability to translate communications plans into effective execution, proactively identify opportunities and challenges, and collaborate closely with clients, internal teams, and external partners to deliver impactful integrated communications activities that support client objectives.

RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Integrated Communications Execution

  • Demonstrates a solid understanding of integrated Communications Marketing principles and how PR, social media, influencer engagement, and digital communications work together to achieve client objectives.
  • Supports the implementation of integrated communications plans, translating approved strategies and directions into actionable activities across relevant channels.
  • Coordinates the execution of communications activities across PR and social channels, ensuring consistent messaging, quality, and timely delivery.
  • Contributes ideas, relevant trends, and tactical recommendations to enhance campaign execution and audience engagement.
  • Proactively identifies execution challenges and opportunities, recommending practical solutions to the account team.

2. PR & Media Relations

  • Executes day-to-day PR activities, including media outreach, press release distribution, media pitching, interviews, press events, and other earned media initiatives.
  • Develops, edits, and proofreads high-quality PR materials, including press releases, media pitches, key messages, briefing documents, and feature stories.
  • Builds and maintains working relationships with journalists, editors, publishers, and relevant media contacts.
  • Identifies relevant media angles and opportunities to secure earned media coverage aligned with approved communications objectives.
  • Coordinates media engagement activities, including interviews, press conferences, media events, and other outreach programs.
  • Monitors media coverage and supports the evaluation of PR activities, identifying key highlights and areas for improvement.

3. Social Media & Influencer Communications

  • Executes social communications activities in line with approved campaign directions, ensuring content relevance, consistency, and alignment with brand objectives.
  • Develops social content angles, editorial calendars, content briefs, captions, and other channel-appropriate communications materials.
  • Demonstrates a good understanding of social media platforms, audience behaviors, content formats, and emerging trends within the Vietnamese digital landscape.
  • Coordinates influencer/KOL/KOC and online community engagement activities, including influencer research, selection recommendations, briefing, content review, and execution follow-up.
  • Works closely with creative, content, digital, and external production teams to ensure the quality and timely delivery of social communications materials.
  • Monitors social conversations, content performance, and audience engagement to identify relevant insights and tactical optimization opportunities.

4. Account & Project Management

  • Independently manages assigned tasks and workstreams, ensuring timely delivery, attention to detail, and adherence to client requirements and Edelman Standards.
  • Supports day-to-day client communications, including status updates, meeting notes, activity reports, and follow-ups on assigned deliverables.
  • Coordinates effectively with internal teams, media, influencers, vendors, and external partners to ensure smooth campaign execution.
  • Maintains project timelines, tracks deliverables, and proactively flags potential risks or issues to the account manager.
  • Supports the preparation of client presentations, campaign proposals, status reports, and other account-related materials.
  • Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and a solution-oriented approach in managing daily responsibilities.

5. Research, Monitoring & Reporting

  • Conducts desk research on industry developments, competitors, consumer trends, media landscapes, and social conversations to support communications activities.
  • Monitors media coverage, social conversations, and campaign performance across relevant channels.
  • Collects, consolidates, and analyzes campaign results using relevant PR and social performance metrics.
  • Prepares activity reports and post-campaign reports with accurate data, key observations, and actionable learnings.
  • Identifies relevant insights and provides recommendations to improve ongoing campaign execution.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field.
  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in PR, social media, or integrated communications, including a minimum of 1 year in a Senior Executive or equivalent role.
  • Previous experience in PR, communications, digital, or integrated marketing agency is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience in both PR and social communications, with the ability to independently execute activities across media relations, social media, influencer engagement, and online community activation.
  • Solid understanding of the Vietnamese media landscape, social media ecosystem, influencer landscape, and evolving digital communications trends.
  • Strong writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to develop compelling, channel-appropriate content for both PR and social media platforms.
  • Experience working with journalists, publishers, influencers, content creators, and online communities, with the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships.
  • Good understanding of integrated communications execution, including media outreach, social content development, influencer coordination, and campaign performance measurement.
  • Strong project coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to independently manage assigned workstreams, prioritize tasks, and meet multiple deadlines.
  • Good research and analytical skills, with the ability to identify relevant insights, monitor campaign performance, and recommend tactical improvements.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, internal teams, and external partners.
  • Excellent Vietnamese writing and editing skills, with good working proficiency in English.
  • A proactive, detail-oriented, collaborative, and solution-oriented mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

  • Integrated & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Experience independently managing senior-level client relationships, leading strategic conversations and navigating complex stakeholder dynamics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience managing managers and developing emerging leaders, including succession planning and building high-performing teams.
  • Strong understanding of agency business operations, including financial forecasting, profitability, staffing models and commercial decision-making.
