Our Product & Tech teams drive us forward in an ever-evolving digital landscape, delivering cutting-edge products to over one million digital subscribers daily. Our growth relies on a diverse, dedicated and dynamic group of product, tech, delivery and data specialists.

With a supportive culture, entrepreneurial spirit and opportunities at every turn, there are no limits to where your FT career can take you.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

About the role

The FT app is an important part of how subscribers engage with FT journalism, and we believe there is a significant opportunity to go further. We're looking for an experienced Product Manager with a strong background in native and/or cross-platform mobile apps to play a central role in this transformation.

You'll join at a pivotal moment, working alongside our Principal Product Manager, engineering and design colleagues to turn our app strategy into reality, delivering improvements to the app experience and building the capabilities that will support its continued evolution.

This is an opportunity to shape a product used by a highly engaged global audience, while helping establish a stronger mobile product discipline within the FT.

What you'll be doing

Help shape the future of the FT app

  • Work with the Principal Product Manager to translate our long-term app strategy into clear product requirements, priorities and a deliverable roadmap.
  • Bring specialist mobile product knowledge and experience to decisions about the future app experience, challenging assumptions and finding opportunities to make better use of native device capabilities.
  • Develop a deep understanding of our customers, their behaviours and the moments in which they turn to the FT, using research, analytics and experimentation to see opportunities.
  • Champion a mobile-first approach to product development, ensuring we're designing around the needs of app customers and complementing their web experience.
  • Work across product teams to ensure the app delivers a coherent, premium experience that delivers meaningful value for the business, while making effective use of shared FT capabilities.

Deliver a distinctive, premium mobile experience

  • Own and prioritise defined areas of the app roadmap, balancing customer value, strategic impact, technical dependencies and commercial outcomes.
  • Work day-to-day with engineering, design, data and editorial colleagues to take initiatives from discovery through development, release and iteration.
  • Help deliver experiences that make the FT more essential to customers' daily routines, including better navigation, discovery, personalisation, notifications, offline experiences and continuity across devices.
  • Explore opportunities to make FT journalism more engaging and useful through native mobile interactions and seamless experiences across text, audio, video, data and other formats.
  • Collaborate with teams responsible for identity, subscriptions and customer lifecycle to make the app a more effective platform for acquisition, engagement, retention and subscriber growth.
  • Establish clear success measures, use experimentation and customer feedback to inform decisions, and continuously optimise the experience.
  • Ensure that performance, accessibility, reliability and usability are treated as fundamental parts of the product experience.

Build mobile product expertise within the FT

  • Act as a source of specialist mobile product knowledge for colleagues across product, design and engineering.
  • Share best practices in app product management, including platform conventions, app store requirements, release management, mobile analytics and experimentation.
  • Help establish effective ways of working for developing and maintaining high-quality iOS and Android experiences.
  • Stay informed about developments in mobile technology, customer expectations and emerging product capabilities, identifying opportunities relevant to the FT.

About you

Essential experience and skills

  • Proven mobile app product management experience: You have owned and delivered meaningful improvements to consumer-facing iOS and/or Android apps, ideally within products with significant scale, frequent usage or complex customer journeys.
  • Understanding of mobile technologies: You have practical experience working with native and/or cross-platform development teams and understand the differences, opportunities and trade-offs between architectures. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can engage in technical discussions and understand the product implications of architectural decisions.
  • Knowledge of the mobile ecosystem: You're familiar with Apple and Google's platform conventions, app store policies, submission and release processes, in-app purchases, push notifications, device capabilities and the considerations involved in delivering consistently high-quality app experiences.
  • Strong product management fundamentals: You're experienced in customer discovery, defining problems and opportunities, prioritisation, roadmap management, experimentation and measuring product outcomes.
  • Proven delivery experience: You've worked closely with cross-functional engineering and design teams to deliver products iteratively, navigate technical complexity and balance short-term improvements with longer-term investment.
  • Customer and commercial focus: You use qualitative and quantitative evidence to understand customer needs, make decisions and evaluate success. You understand how product experience contributes to engagement, retention and commercial performance.
  • Collaborative and influential: You're comfortable working across organisational boundaries, bringing different disciplines together and influencing decisions without relying on formal authority.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: You can operate effectively while technology choices, team structures and delivery approaches are evolving, helping turn strategic ambition into practical action.

Desirable experience

  • Experience working on subscription-based digital products, particularly in publishing, media, content or other habit-forming consumer services.
  • Experience developing products that combine native and web-based capabilities.
  • Experience with personalisation, content discovery, notifications, offline functionality or other features that drive regular app engagement.
  • Experience working with external development partners while retaining internal product ownership.
  • Experience helping organisations establish or mature their mobile product development practices.

 

 

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location, but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available on the FT Careers website.

We’ve embraced a 50% hybrid working model (averaging two to three days onsite) that fosters trust and remote adaptability while encouraging in-person camaraderie and peer learning. Additionally, we are open to accommodating specific flexible working pattern requests for all roles where feasible.

The Role / Position overview

FT Studio is an in-house creative team that produces partner content for the FT. We create editorially driven and visually impactful client-branded content, from animations to immersive and interactive digital experiences, mini-documentaries, and podcasts. Maintaining the FT tone of voice, FT Studio’s content sits naturally within the newspaper’s editorial environment.

As Senior Content Producer at FT Studio, you will have exceptional storytelling and production skills.  You will lead creative projects from ideation to completion, working collaboratively with various teams including writers, editors, video teams, and designers. 

This is a hands-on role for an experienced producer who can confidently represent the business in-market, make independent decisions, develop trusted regional partnerships and establish a scalable production operation across APAC.

This role will be based in Singapore and work closely with FT colleagues in the region. It will report into an EP in London, liaising closely with the core team based there.

  • Work with an Executive Producer to execute the delivery of larger projects that require more oversight
  • Work with clients and the Client Solutions team to develop a content strategy, creative and editorial direction, and establish clear project communication

  • Review, test, and proofread content before sending to clients
  • Stay up-to-date on global business trends and FT trending topics

  • Advise on social media and video analytics strategy where needed to assist in the performance of multimedia content
  • Work with Executive Producers and the Client Solutions team to assist in the ideation and development of content proposals
  • Work with the Global Client Services team to assist in the integration of new ways to serve clients
  • Work with Senior Production Manager to help develop effective workflows and processes

  • Experience working with clients in financial services, professional services, technology or other complex, regulated sectors
  • Expertise leading video teams, designers and developers to create video and digital content
  • Strong understanding of how editorial credibility and commercial objectives can be balanced to create high-quality branded content
  • Proven track record of success working in a fast-moving agency setting or complex multi-stakeholder environment with a tolerance for ambiguity

job.title: Senior Cyber Security Engineer
job.description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide. At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world. In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere. Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

The Role Overview

We’re looking for a Senior Cyber Security Engineer to help mature application and cloud security across the FT’s cloud-native, AWS-hosted technology estate. This role has an approximate 50/50 focus across application security and cloud security, working closely with product, platform and engineering teams to make secure delivery easier by default.

You’ll shape and improve developer-friendly guardrails across GitHub-based CI/CD pipelines, AWS environments and infrastructure-as-code workflows. This includes improving SAST, software composition analysis, secret scanning, IaC scanning, vulnerability management and AWS misconfiguration management so that findings are actionable, low-noise and owned by the right teams.

Day to day, you’ll run practical threat-modelling sessions, review application and cloud designs, improve security playbooks, support vulnerability and misconfiguration remediation, and build automation that reduces toil. We’re looking for someone who has demonstrably improved security outcomes in real engineering environments, not just someone with theoretical knowledge of tools or frameworks.

Depending on team structure, you may also mentor or line-manage one or two security engineers, while remaining hands-on and close to the technical work.

What you’ll bring to the role

Application and cloud security experience: practical experience across both application security and cloud security, ideally in AWS-hosted, cloud-native environments.

Developer-friendly security mindset: you know how to work with engineers, explain risk clearly and design controls that help teams move securely without unnecessary friction.

Vulnerability management at scale: experience improving how application vulnerabilities, dependency risks, bug bounty findings, penetration test findings and advisories are identified, prioritised, owned and remediated across engineering teams.

Cloud misconfiguration & vulnerability management: experience identifying and reducing infrastructure-as-code and AWS vulnerabilities & misconfigurations at scale through pragmatic guardrails, tooling and clear remediation paths.

Threat modelling: confidence running lightweight, practical threat-modelling sessions that lead to useful engineering decisions and risk reduction.

CI/CD and code security: hands-on experience with security tooling such as SAST, software composition analysis, secret scanning and IaC scanning.

Automation mindset: ability to write scripts or small tools, ideally in Python, to reduce toil, improve visibility and surface meaningful risk.

Security leadership: ability to mentor other security engineers and influence engineers across the wider organisation. Depending on team structure, this may include line management.

AI security awareness: experience of leveraging AI to improve and scale appsec and cloud sec controls would be useful, but is not essential.

Key Responsibilities

Improve application security guardrails
 Tune and evolve SAST, software composition analysis, secret scanning and related controls so they are actionable, low-noise and useful to engineering teams.

Improve cloud and IaC security guardrails
 Help identify, prioritise and reduce AWS and infrastructure-as-code misconfigurations and vulnerabilities at scale.

Drive vulnerability management
 Improve how application vulnerabilities, dependency risks, bug bounty findings, penetration test findings and third-party advisories are triaged, prioritised and remediated.

Drive cloud misconfiguration management
 Help teams understand, own and remediate cloud security issues using pragmatic, developer-friendly workflows.

Run practical threat modelling
 Facilitate lightweight threat-modelling sessions for new products, features, services and architectural changes.

Build automation and tooling
 Create or improve scripts, integrations, dashboards and workflows that reduce manual effort and make risk easier to understand.

Support secure architecture decisions
 Provide application and cloud security input into design reviews, AWS architecture decisions and larger technical changes.

Partner with engineering teams
 Work closely with product, platform and software engineering teams to embed security into design, delivery and operational practices.

Support incidents and lessons learned
 Provide application and cloud security expertise during incidents and feed lessons learned back into patterns, tooling and guidance.

Mentor others
 Coach security engineers and engineering teams on practical security approaches. Depending on team structure, this may include line management of one or two security engineers.

Required Experience, Essential: 

  • Strong practical experience in application security and cloud security, ideally with a balanced focus across both.
  • Hands-on AWS security experience, including common misconfiguration patterns and practical remediation approaches.
  • Experience improving vulnerability management across engineering teams, including prioritisation, ownership, remediation tracking and noise reduction.
  • Experience in improving cloud or IaC misconfiguration management at scale in a developer-friendly way.
  • Experience integrating, tuning or improving security tooling in CI/CD workflows, such as SAST, software composition analysis, secret scanning or IaC scanning.
  • Experience running practical threat-modelling sessions that influence design, delivery or remediation decisions.
  • Ability to write scripts or small tools, ideally in Python, to automate security workflows or improve visibility.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence engineers and technical leaders without relying on gatekeeping.
  • Evidence of improving application security, cloud security or vulnerability management practices in a real engineering environment.
  • Familiarity with Agile or Scrum ways of working.

Desirable

  • Experience with leveraging AI for AppSec and CloudSec.
  • AWS Certified Security – Speciality or equivalent practical AWS security experience.
  • Terraform or CloudFormation expertise.
  • Incident-management or incident-response experience.
  • Experience with Splunk or similar logging/SIEM platforms.
  • Experience with security metrics, dashboards or reporting that helped drive measurable risk reduction.
  • Experience mentoring or line-managing security engineers.

 

What’s in it for You?

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning.  We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams. 

 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

This role involves working on intricate products that directly aid journalism production at the FT. Work often starts without a clear brief or defined project. You will need to be comfortable investigating problems, grasping detailed workflows, and helping decide the appropriate course.

You'll also consider how editorial tools interact with the reader experiences they facilitate across our website and apps, partnering with our Customer Products teams as needed.

AI is increasingly crafting editorial workflows, and you'll have chances to explore how new technologies can assist journalists and editors. These include tools that improve editorial quality and accuracy.

  • Consider how editorial tools connect with customer-facing experiences, collaborating with Customer Products teams to support consistency and shared development patterns.

  • Strong product and systems thinking, with an ability to understand how interconnected tools, workflows and technologies work together.
  • A thoughtful and analytical approach to problem-solving, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and explore alternative solutions.
  • Experience planning and conducting proportionate user research, combining qualitative and quantitative insights to inform development decisions.
  • Sufficient technical understanding to collaborate effectively with engineers and navigate complex systems, data and technical constraints.
  • Strong Figma and prototyping skills, with practical experience applying accessibility principles.
  • Experience using AI-assisted prototyping or development tools, with the judgement to assess their opportunities and limitations.
  • Excellent communication and collaborator management skills, with the ability to build positive relationships across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Confidence working through ambiguity, crafting requirements and helping teams move towards clear, considered solutions.

Desirable

  • Experience crafting content management systems, editorial platforms or newsroom tools.
  • A grasp of digital publishing workflows, including the creation and management of multimedia content.
  • Experience working on products that connect complex internal systems with customer-facing digital experiences.

job.title: Director of Engineering
job.description:
KTBC FOX 7 Austin is seeking an experienced Director of Engineering to lead the Station’s Engineering Team. This position is responsible for the maintenance, reliability, security, technical compliance, and strategic development of the infrastructure and systems that support the station’s broadcast, production, transmission, and digital platforms. Applying strong Project Management Institute (PMI) principles, the Director of Engineering will provide strategic leadership to the engineering team while partnering with Broadcast Operations, IT, station leadership, and TVHO Engineering on major technology initiatives, capital projects, and infrastructure lifecycle planning.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Human Resource Management

  • Lead, mentor, and supervise the Engineering team, applying PMI team building, stakeholder engagement, and resource optimization techniques to foster a culture of safety, accountability, continuous improvement, and technical excellence.
  • Manage resource allocations, technical schedules, and performance management across all engineering initiatives.

Project & Operations Management

  • Direct the end-to-end lifecycle of technical operations—from initiating and planning through executing, monitoring, controlling, and closing complex broadcast and facility initiatives.
  • Develop and manage comprehensive preventive maintenance programs, risk mitigation strategies, equipment lifecycle management plans, and technical baseline documentation.
  • Identify root causes of technical issues using formal risk management and quality control frameworks, implementing corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to optimize operational reliability.

Compliance, Security, & Quality Control

  • Oversee station transmission facilities and technical quality assurance programs, ensuring strict compliance with FCC regulations, EAS requirements, CALM Act standards, ATSC requirements, and industry benchmarks.
  • Maintain enterprise emergency preparedness programs, business continuity planning, disaster recovery (DR) testing, and emergency management protocols.
  • Partner with IT and cybersecurity teams to ensure all broadcast systems adhere to FOX security protocols, network architecture standards, and governance policies.

Capital Planning, Procurement, & Vendor Management

  • Consult with the VP of Engineering/Operations to develop and manage operational (OPEX) and capital (CAPEX) budgets, leveraging cost management methodologies (earned value, cost baseline, and variance analysis).
  • Lead procurement processes, contract negotiations, service level agreements (SLAs), vendor management, and contract administration for major equipment purchases and third-party services.
  • Oversee critical facility infrastructure scope and lifecycle maintenance, including generators, UPS systems, HVAC supporting technical operations, and specialized building systems.
  • Collaborate with TVHO Engineering and executive leadership on enterprise technology initiatives, standardized engineering governance, and system implementation roadmaps.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated leadership experience in television broadcast engineering, media technology, production systems, information technology, or a related technical domain.
  • Proven track record of applying formal project management principles (PMI framework) to direct complex broadcast, production, transmission, or IT infrastructure projects.
  • Strong knowledge of the PMBOK (Project Management Body of Knowledge) groups: Integration, Scope, Schedule, Cost, Quality, Resource, Communications, Risk, Procurement, and Stakeholder Management.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, risk assessment, organizational, and executive communication skills.
  • Practical knowledge of broadcast, production, high-availability networking, and file-based media technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate high-pressure, live broadcast environments with strong agile problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP® (Project Management Professional), CAPM®, or equivalent PMI certification
  • 5+ years of progressive leadership experience in television broadcast engineering within a local station, network, or major production facility.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Broadcast Technology, Information Technology, Project Management, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
  • Expertise in broadcast transmission systems, FCC regulatory compliance, EAS, ATSC 1.0, ATSC 3.0/NextGen TV, and digital media workflows.
  • Advanced proficiency in IP-based media infrastructure (SMPTE ST 2110), broadcast automation, newsroom systems, cloud workflows, enterprise networking, and cybersecurity.
  • SBE (Society of Broadcast Engineers) certification or other relevant industry technical credentials

job.title: Director, Product Operations & Delivery
job.description:
El Director de Operaciones de Producto y Delivery es el enlace principal entre el negocio de FOX One México y las áreas centralizadas de Producto, Operaciones de Producto, Delivery e Ingeniería.

Este puesto existe por tres razones, en este orden:

  • México está migrando. FOX One México está migrando de extremo a extremo desde sus plataformas de proveedor actuales —aplicaciones, identidad, comercio, derechos de acceso (entitlements), playout y distribución— hacia el stack tecnológico de FOX DTC, con un lanzamiento de primera fase previsto para el 15 de febrero de 2027. El mercado necesita una contraparte operativa dedicada dentro de la organización que lo está construyendo.
  • Después hay que operar México. Tras el lanzamiento, la salud del producto y de la operación debe medirse de forma continua, convertirse en trabajo de producto priorizado y en optimización de procesos de negocio, y llevarse a través de Delivery hasta un resultado validado.
  • América Latina es el siguiente paso. México es la primera instancia de un modelo replicable, no un caso aislado. Este puesto construye el modelo operativo, los procesos y la automatización que hacen que los siguientes mercados sean más rápidos y económicos, y asegura que las necesidades locales se resuelvan configurando una plataforma multi-tenant en lugar de desarrollos específicos por mercado.

La posición está facultada para actuar con autonomía —identificar oportunidades, formarse un criterio propio e iniciar trabajo sin esperar una solicitud formal— acompañada de la colaboración y comunicación necesarias para alinear a los líderes y aplicar las mejores prácticas de la organización DTC en favor de la escala y la eficiencia.

Responsabilidades Principales

Liderazgo de la Operación y del Negocio

  • Ser el responsable operativo del día a día y el punto de contacto único de FOX One México dentro de la organización de tecnología.
  • Investigar incidencias, llegar a conclusiones e impulsar mejoras de forma independiente, presentando una recomendación y no solo un reporte.
  • Construir relaciones de confianza con la dirección del negocio local, merchandising, mercadotecnia, finanzas y atención al cliente, y con sus contrapartes centralizadas en Estados Unidos.
  • Responsabilizarse de la preparación del mercado durante la migración y el lanzamiento: habilitación de merchandising, preparación de atención al cliente, operaciones locales de finanzas y negocio, y operación del día del lanzamiento.
  • Representar la realidad operativa del mercado en la planeación central, incluyendo aquello que no puede posponerse sin impacto al cliente.

Salud del Producto y de la Operación

  • Definir y ser responsable del marco de salud de producto y operación: qué se mide, qué se considera un buen resultado y dónde se ubican los umbrales.
  • Asegurar que existan los dashboards, las alertas y las revisiones recurrentes para que la salud sea visible sin que nadie tenga que solicitarla, en colaboración con los equipos que las construyen.
  • Detectar de forma temprana deterioros y riesgos emergentes, asegurar el diagnóstico de la causa y convertirlo en una corrección operativa o en una mejora de producto definida.
  • Establecer la línea base de medición de cada nuevo mercado de LATAM desde el lanzamiento, en lugar de reconstruirla después.

Gestión de Producto y Mejoras

  • Traducir las necesidades del negocio y de la operación en planteamientos de problema y SOPs que Delivery e Ingeniería puedan ejecutar sin una reunión de aclaración.
  • Facilitar la recepción y priorización de iniciativas del mercado dentro del modelo operativo DTC, y negociar capacidad en el roadmap frente a otros mercados y productos.
  • Validar que las soluciones entregadas cumplieron el objetivo que las justificó, medido contra el marco de salud, y señalarlo con claridad cuando no haya sido así.

Mejora de Procesos y Automatización

  • Tratar el modelo operativo como un producto: identificar dónde los procesos son manuales, lentos, propensos a error o dependientes de una sola persona, y corregirlos.
  • Mejorar la recepción de solicitudes, la priorización, el seguimiento de la ejecución, la gestión de liberaciones, la atención de incidentes y los reportes, alineados a las prácticas de gestión de portafolio de DTC.
  • Automatizar el trabajo operativo y de reporteo recurrente junto con Ingeniería, Analytics y los equipos de herramientas internas. Lo que es aceptable hacer a mano para un mercado resulta inviable con varios.
  • Documentar el modelo operativo para que pueda transferirse a un nuevo mercado, a una nueva persona o a un equipo.

Coordinación de la Entrega (Delivery)

  • Dirigir la ejecución con los equipos centralizados de Delivery y los equipos de Ingeniería distribuidos: requerimientos, dependencias, secuenciación, riesgos y fechas.
  • Mantener la visión de ejecución, dependencias y riesgos como un documento vivo, con una persona responsable y un siguiente paso en cada punto abierto.
  • Administrar la ruta crítica y poder expresar en una sola frase qué está bloqueando el lanzamiento o la liberación.
  • Eliminar bloqueos de forma activa: escalar de manera temprana, convocar a las personas correctas y cerrar el ciclo por escrito el mismo día.
  • Responsabilizarse de la preparación para la liberación y el cutover: criterios de go/no-go, ensayos, operación del día del lanzamiento, plan de reversión (rollback) y comunicación de incidentes.
  • Hacer cumplir la disciplina operativa: decisiones registradas, cambios de alcance documentados y acuerdos verbales asentados por escrito.

Reportes y Comunicación

  • Ser responsable del ritmo operativo del mercado: señal operativa diaria, estatus semanal de ejecución y riesgos, y revisión mensual de negocio y plataforma.
  • Reportar salud de plataforma y producto, desempeño del negocio, riesgos y dependencias, incidentes con impacto al cliente y estado del pipeline — con análisis y recomendación, no volcados de datos.
  • Servir de puente entre Negocio, Producto, Operaciones de Producto, Delivery, Ingeniería, Atención al Cliente, Mercadotecnia y Finanzas, en dos idiomas y entre husos horarios.
  • Gestionar de forma bilingüe la comunicación de escalamientos e incidentes con impacto al cliente. Un retraso debe surgir desde esta posición antes de manifestarse como una fecha incumplida.

Expansión Regional (LATAM)

  • Convertir lo aprendido en México en un manual replicable de lanzamiento de mercados: preparación operativa, línea base de medición, atención al cliente, comercio y habilitación de merchandising.
  • Definir qué es genuinamente específico de cada mercado y qué debe resolverse configurando la plataforma multi-tenant, y cuestionar las propuestas de desarrollos aislados.
  • Responsabilizarse de la preparación operativa de los siguientes mercados de LATAM y hacer crecer la función regional conforme aumente el alcance.

job.title: Engineer Networking
job.description:
Descripción del puesto: Ingeniero de Networking Broadcast

Objetivo del puesto

Diseñar, implementar, operar y mantener la infraestructura de redes que soporta la producción, transmisión y distribución de contenido audiovisual.

La persona será responsable de garantizar la disponibilidad, estabilidad, seguridad y rendimiento de las redes utilizadas en estudios, centros de transmisión, operaciones de producción y plataformas de distribución.

Responsabilidades

  • Diseñar y administrar redes IP para ambientes de broadcast, producción y transmisión.
  • Implementar y mantener soluciones de video sobre IP utilizando estándares como SMPTE ST 2110 y ST 2022-6.
  • Configurar y solucionar problemas relacionados con routing, switching, multicast, QoS, VLAN, OSPF, BGP, IGMP y PIM.
  • Administrar soluciones de sincronización y referencia de tiempo mediante PTP y GPS.
  • Monitorear el rendimiento, disponibilidad, latencia, pérdida de paquetes y calidad de las señales.
  • Atender y resolver incidentes críticos durante transmisiones en vivo y eventos de alta audiencia.
  • Implementar esquemas de redundancia, alta disponibilidad, failover y recuperación ante desastres.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de Ingeniería, Transmisión, Producción, TI, Ciberseguridad y proveedores externos.
  • Participar en proyectos de expansión, modernización y migración de infraestructura broadcast.
  • Documentar arquitecturas, configuraciones, procedimientos operativos y planes de recuperación.
  • Aplicar controles de seguridad, segmentación de red y buenas prácticas de gestión de cambios.
  • Contribuir a la automatización y optimización de procesos operativos de networking.

Requisitos

  • Licenciatura o Ingeniería en Telecomunicaciones, Redes, Sistemas, Electrónica o carrera afín.
  • Experiencia en diseño, operación y soporte de redes empresariales o de broadcast.
  • Conocimientos sólidos de TCP/IP, VLAN, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP y NAT.
  • Conocimiento de protocolos y tecnologías de transmisión, como RTP, UDP y SRT.
  • Experiencia con herramientas de monitoreo y diagnóstico de redes.
  • Conocimiento de infraestructura de centros de datos, fibra óptica y enlaces WAN.
  • Capacidad para analizar incidentes, identificar causas raíz y responder bajo presión.
  • Disponibilidad para atender mantenimientos, eventos especiales e incidentes críticos.
  • Inglés técnico para la lectura de documentación y comunicación con proveedores.
  • Conocimiento de protocolos de contribución y distribución, como RIST, Zixi, NDI y WebRTC.
  • Experiencia en streaming, OTT, CDN y distribución digital de contenido.
  • Conocimientos de audio sobre IP, como Dante y AES67.

Conocimientos deseables

  • Experiencia práctica con SMPTE ST 2110, ST 2022-6 y PTP.
  • Experiencia con cloud networking en AWS, Azure o Google Cloud.
  • Conocimientos de SDN, SD-WAN, virtualización y redes híbridas.
  • Conocimientos de ciberseguridad aplicada a redes y sistemas broadcast.
  • Certificaciones Cisco, Juniper, AWS, Microsoft u otros fabricantes de tecnología broadcast.
  • Experiencia en gestión de incidentes y continuidad operativa.

Competencias

  • Pensamiento analítico y resolución de problemas.
  • Orientación a la disponibilidad y continuidad del servicio.
  • Comunicación efectiva con equipos técnicos y no técnicos.
  • Trabajo colaborativo y coordinación con múltiples áreas.
  • Organización y atención al detalle.
  • Capacidad para trabajar en ambientes críticos y de alta presión.
  • Proactividad y enfoque en la mejora continua.

job.description:
Descripción del perfil: Graphic Operator

Formación académica

Licenciatura en Comunicación, Producción de Televisión, Diseño Digital, Animación o carreras afines.

Experiencia

De 1 a 3 años de experiencia en transmisiones de televisión en vivo, como noticieros, eventos deportivos y programas de espectáculos.

Conocimientos técnicos

  • Dominio avanzado del software Ross XPression, incluyendo XPression Prime, Studio o BlueBox.
  • Manejo de Adobe Creative Cloud, principalmente Photoshop e Illustrator, para realizar ajustes a recursos visuales antes de su transmisión.
  • Conocimientos sobre formatos de video digital y resoluciones HD y 4K.
  • Conocimientos sobre flujos de señal de transmisión broadcast, incluyendo SDI, NDI y otros protocolos relacionados.
  • Conocimientos básicos o intermedios en bases de datos y hojas de cálculo, especialmente Excel, para la automatización de textos y datos.

Misión del puesto

Asegurar la correcta visualización, precisión y sincronía de los gráficos en pantalla —cintillos, marcadores, tercios inferiores, datos estadísticos, animaciones y créditos— durante producciones en vivo o grabadas, optimizando el flujo de trabajo dentro del centro de control de producción.

Responsabilidades

  • Lanzar y retirar de la señal de transmisión los gráficos correspondientes en el momento exacto solicitado por el Director de Cámaras o el Productor.
  • Configurar y actualizar la información de las plantillas gráficas, incluyendo textos, nombres de invitados y marcadores deportivos, antes y durante la emisión.
  • Verificar cuidadosamente la ortografía, sintaxis y formato visual de los textos antes de enviarlos al aire.
  • Vincular y monitorear bases de datos externas, como archivos de Excel, servidores de estadísticas deportivas y redes sociales, para alimentar los gráficos de manera automatizada.
  • Trabajar en conjunto con los equipos de Ingeniería, Producción y Diseño Gráfico para asegurar el correcto funcionamiento de las fuentes de entrada y salida SDI, IP o NDI.
  • Resolver imprevistos y fallas técnicas relacionadas con el software de gráficos durante transmisiones en vivo.
  • Mantener una comunicación constante y efectiva con el equipo de producción dentro del control room.

Competencias y habilidades

  • Capacidad para trabajar bajo presión extrema y en entornos de ritmo acelerado.
  • Máxima atención al detalle y tolerancia cero a errores ortográficos al aire.
  • Alta velocidad de reacción y capacidad para tomar decisiones inmediatas.
  • Comunicación asertiva y excelente trabajo en equipo.
  • Flexibilidad para trabajar en turnos rotativos, nocturnos, fines de semana y días festivos.

job.title: Manager Care Ops (LatAm)
job.description:
El puesto de Gerente, Operaciones de Atención al Cliente - LATAM es una posición de liderazgo clave en la intersección entre la ejecución en primera línea y las operaciones estratégicas. Este rol es responsable de habilitar un soporte al cliente escalable y de alta calidad en toda América Latina, brindando a los agentes la guía, las herramientas y los procesos que necesitan para ofrecer experiencias excepcionales a los clientes.

Serás el socio operativo principal para el equipo de atención al cliente de LATAM, trabajando de forma multifuncional con los equipos de Atención al Cliente, Marketing, Producto y Tecnología para operacionalizar iniciativas, evaluar impactos y mantener comunicaciones de primer nivel con los agentes. Se requiere dominio del español para asegurar una colaboración genuina con los equipos y stakeholders regionales.

Operaciones de Atención al Cliente y Habilitación de Agentes

  • Ser responsable de impulsar comunicaciones claras y consistentes hacia los agentes a través de múltiples productos e iniciativas, asegurando que los equipos de primera línea estén preparados, informados y capacitados para atender las consultas de los clientes.
  • Diseñar, mantener y gobernar el contenido de la intranet, los procedimientos operativos estándar y las herramientas de ventas/soporte que mejoren la preparación, el compromiso y el desempeño de los agentes.
  • Garantizar la calidad, precisión y consistencia de toda la documentación operativa y dirigida a los agentes.
  • Desarrollar y mantener un conocimiento profundo de las operaciones de Atención al Cliente, incluyendo sistemas, flujos de trabajo y particularidades regionales del mercado de LATAM.
  • Crear, actualizar y gestionar documentación operativa dentro de las plataformas de gestión del conocimiento aprobadas.

Liderazgo de Proyectos Operativos

  • Liderar iniciativas y flujos de trabajo operativos que impactan a Atención al Cliente, aplicando las mejores prácticas de gestión de proyectos, actuando como socio operativo integrado más que como una función formal de PMO.
  • Evaluar y comunicar con claridad el impacto operativo y en la experiencia del cliente de nuevas iniciativas, promociones, lanzamientos de herramientas o cambios en los sistemas.
  • Colaborar con equipos multifuncionales para definir requisitos, cronogramas, dependencias y factores de riesgo relacionados con las operaciones de Atención al Cliente.
  • Mantener a los stakeholders informados y alineados sobre el avance de los proyectos, especialmente aquellos que afectan a los agentes y clientes de LATAM.
  • Aplicar resolución de problemas estructurada y disciplina operativa para resolver desafíos de forma rápida y sostenible.

Datos, Insights y Reportes

  • Usar datos para identificar tendencias de desempeño, brechas y oportunidades en las operaciones de atención al cliente y la experiencia de los agentes.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de Analítica, Herramientas y Tecnología, y Marketing para desarrollar y mantener reportes sobre el desempeño de los agentes y los resultados de la experiencia del cliente.
  • Traducir los insights basados en datos en recomendaciones concretas que equilibren la defensa del cliente con las prioridades del negocio.

Colaboración y Liderazgo

  • Ser el socio principal de Operaciones de Atención al Cliente de LATAM, construyendo relaciones multifuncionales sólidas con stakeholders de toda la organización.
  • Defender la experiencia del agente en primera línea y del cliente, alineándose con las metas y prioridades más amplias de la organización.
  • Fomentar una cultura de claridad, responsabilidad y mejora continua dentro de las operaciones de atención al cliente.
  • Promover el intercambio de conocimiento y el desarrollo del equipo dentro de Operaciones de Atención al Cliente.

The ideal candidate will drive operational excellence, ensure strong internal controls, and lead continuous process improvement initiatives. This role requires a hands-on leader with deep expertise in high-volume environments, AP systems, and scalable procure-to-pay operations.

job.title: Manager, Podcast Marketing
job.description:
Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

Red Seat Ventures partners with the world’s top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content through advertising, subscriptions, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our proprietary technology stack, including Supercast for subscriptions and Speakeasy for hosting, distribution, and monetization.

Named after Ted Williams’ longest home run at Fenway Park, Red Seat Ventures was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we are the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Red Seat Ventures is looking for a Manager, Podcast Marketing to lead cross-promotional campaigns across our portfolio of nearly 70 podcasts while building relationships with external shows, creators, and platforms. Reporting to the Senior Director, Podcast Marketing, you will own campaigns from initial planning and creative development through ad operations, measurement, and reporting. You will translate campaign performance into clear insights that help senior leaders understand what worked and what we should do next.

This position sits within a growing Audience Development function with established systems and active campaigns already in place. The work is currently hands-on and high-volume as we continue to improve and automate our processes. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys owning complex systems, maintaining operational precision, and turning campaign data into a compelling and actionable story.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Book and manage in-network and out-of-network cross-promotional campaigns, including launches for new shows and always-on promotional rotations
  • Own campaign execution details, including flight dates, frequency caps, audience targeting, creative trafficking, and delivery
  • Build and deliver weekly and monthly reports on net-new listeners, conversion, and retention for senior leadership
  • Develop clear performance narratives and recommendations based on campaign data
  • Maintain consistent campaign naming conventions across booking, hosting, and measurement platforms so promotional activity can be accurately matched to results
  • Research and pitch podcasts and YouTube channels for promotional swaps, collaborations, and client guest appearances
  • Manage scheduling and promotional materials, including biographies and headshots, in partnership with client teams, host-show contacts, and Creator Partnerships
  • Maintain the programming calendar for editorial pitches to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Amazon Music, iHeart, and YouTube
  • Track upcoming show moments, platform requirements, and submission lead times to support timely and relevant editorial pitches
  • Help improve and automate campaign workflows, reporting processes, and other repetitive operational tasks

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 3–5 years of experience in audience development, marketing operations, campaign management, or ad operations within podcasting, audio, or digital media
  • Hands-on experience booking campaigns in an enterprise podcast hosting and advertising platform
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including experience using pivot tables and lookup functions to create clear reports from raw data exports
  • Familiarity with podcast measurement or attribution platforms such as Magellan AI, Podscribe, or Podtrac
  • Strong written communication skills and the confidence to present performance data, insights, and recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Experience managing outreach or partnerships, including promotional swaps, guest bookings, creator collaborations, or platform relationships
  • Careful and consistent execution, with the judgment to identify incorrect date ranges, mismatched metrics, or other discrepancies before they reach a final report
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and stakeholder relationships in a fast-paced environment
  • A proactive approach to improving systems, solving operational challenges, and identifying opportunities for audience growth

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Day-to-day experience working with podcast attribution tools such as Magellan AI, Podscribe, or Podtrac
  • Previous experience working within a podcast network
  • Listener fluency across podcast genres such as news, true crime, comedy, and sports
  • Working knowledge of SQL or light Python
  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis, reporting, and repetitive workflows, including agentic tools such as Claude Code or Codex

job.title: News Anchor
job.description:
The news team at FOX 26 and FOX Local Houston is transforming how local news is gathered and delivered. We no longer wait for appointed times to deliver content. We're a 24/7 STREAMING FIRST news organization.

As we continue to evolve, we’re hiring a News Anchor for our top-rated morning news block. Our next anchor will bring the passion and skillset to create and deliver live and unscripted content across streaming programs and platforms, digital news sites, social media and on linear TV.

In this role, you’ll anchor 3-hours of morning news from the studio and then transition to anchoring streaming programs from our redesigned newsroom during the remainder of your day. For streaming news shows, you’ll be responsible for operating our Tricaster switcher, while disseminating live and breaking news in a raw, unscripted format with no teleprompter.

Here’s what you’ll need to be successful in this role:

  • A streaming and digital first mindset, that has evolved beyond traditional TV news constructs. You’re as comfortable and skilled delivering unscripted content as you are with a teleprompter. You bring the same enthusiasm to your delivery and on-air performance regardless format, studio environment or platform.
  • You ditched the “anchor voice” long ago and you’ve mastered a more authentic style of delivery that doesn’t rely on a teleprompter. We don’t use teleprompters in our streaming news programs.
  • You have experience and skill anchoring continuous live breaking news events and severe weather such as hurricanes, tornado outbreaks and winter storm coverage. This experience and skill are evident on your reel.
  • You’ve spent a minimum of 3-5 years in the field as a news reporter, covering big news stories, honing your journalism, polishing your on-air performance and proving that the best anchors have built a reputation as aggressive, successful reporters.
  • You have experience field anchoring big news, demonstrating a range of skills from hard news and politics to sports and community events.
  • You are a leader in the newsroom, with a demonstrated track record of mentoring younger reporters, helping them become better storytellers and writers.
  • You are an engaged copy editor, carefully reviewing and signing off on scripts before they go on air. You provide constructive feedback and actively participate in the editorial process.
  • You have impeccable journalistic ethics and integrity. You can spot problematic copy, flag stories that need more vetting, unearth biased narratives and make sound decisions under deadline pressure.
  • You’ve already created a significant social footprint across Instagram, TikTok and Facebook. Your content is rooted in news, not selfies and vacation photos.

You must have significant experience as an anchor, on top of 3-5 year of experience as a reporter in a professional news operation. Candidates who have experience hosting unscripted, live news streaming programs will move up the list. This is not an entry-level position or a position for candidates who do not possess a journalism background.

We’re a 24/7 news operation, so you must be able to work non-traditional hours, weekends and holidays as needed.

job.title: News Photographer
job.description:
The Local Programming Initiatives team at FOX 26 Houston is looking for a Local Programming Initiatives Photographer who is passionate about visual storytelling and willing to create content across live streaming, digital, social media and linear TV.

In this role, you’ll shoot, edit, produce and help direct content for both LPI programming and FOX 26 News, including The Isiah Factor Uncensored, The Nightcap, Chattin’ With Chelsea, FOX Faceoff and FOX NYE Live! You must also be willing to take on general assignment news and help cover severe weather, breaking news, special coverage and other major stories when needed.

Here’s what you’ll need to be successful in this role:

  • A multiplatform mindset. You’re a strong visual storyteller who understands that content is no longer created for just one screen. You can shoot and edit content for streaming, digital, social and linear TV and adapt your storytelling for each platform.
  • Strong photography and editing skills. You understand professional cameras, lighting, audio and visual composition and have experience editing with EDIUS and/or Adobe Premiere Pro.
  • A live and digital mindset. You’re comfortable with live television, bonded cellular technology and evolving digital workflows. You’re ready to be a strong contributor to our live digital news streaming platforms and understand the urgency of getting compelling content to viewers now.
  • The ability to do more. You’re willing to help produce segments or shows, develop ideas and direct live programming as needed. You must also be comfortable and willing to appear on camera when the content or assignment calls for it. Experience with Ross OverDrive and/or TriCaster is preferred, and you’re willing to train and expand your skills.
  • A willingness to evolve. You’re highly adaptable, embrace change and aren’t tied to traditional television workflows. You think outside the box, bring creative ideas to the table and are comfortable using emerging technology and AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to improve workflows, research, ideation and content production.
  • A competitive, winning mindset. You take ownership of your work, thrive in a fast-paced environment and want to help create content that stands out across every platform.

You must have 3–5 years of professional broadcast or multiplatform content production experience, including professional newsroom experience. A high school diploma or equivalent is required; a college degree is preferred. You must have a valid driver’s license with a clean driving record and be able to lift, carry and maneuver up to 50 lbs. of field production equipment.

This position primarily works Monday through Friday, but you must be willing to work weekends, holidays, breaking news, severe weather and special events as needed and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Occasional travel may be required.

job.description:
Descripción del perfil: Operador de vMix

Formación académica

Ingeniería o Licenciatura en Comunicaciones, Producción Audiovisual o carreras afines.

Experiencia

De 1 a 3 años de experiencia en retransmisiones en directo, producción de video o flujos de trabajo de transmisión multimedia (streaming).

Conocimientos técnicos

  • Comprensión de resoluciones de video, tasas de fotogramas (frame rates), tasas de bits (bitrates), enrutamiento de audio y flujos de señal SDI, HDMI y NDI.
  • Experiencia avanzada en la configuración y operación de vMix, incluyendo entradas, disparadores, atajos, creación de títulos y scripting.
  • Conocimientos sobre plataformas de transmisión en vivo y protocolos RTMP, Zoom, Skype y SRT.

Misión del puesto

Alternar entre múltiples entradas de cámara, clips de video y participantes remotos —a través de Zoom, Skype o SRT— en tiempo real, así como activar rótulos inferiores (lower thirds), logotipos en pantalla (bugs), marcadores y animaciones de pantalla completa durante la emisión.

Responsabilidades

  • Gestionar la conmutación de video en vivo, la reproducción de contenido digital, la mezcla de audio y los gráficos en tiempo real mediante el software de producción en vivo vMix.
  • Actuar como Director Técnico principal en transmisiones en vivo, eventos virtuales, partidos deportivos y emisiones web, garantizando una ejecución fluida y una transmisión correcta.
  • Supervisar los niveles de audio, enrutar entradas, ajustar volúmenes y eliminar ruido de fondo o bucles de retroalimentación (feedback).
  • Configurar la codificación, iniciar y detener grabaciones locales, y enviar la señal en vivo a plataformas como YouTube, Facebook o destinos RTMP personalizados.
  • Diagnosticar y solucionar rápidamente problemas de hardware, red o software bajo la presión de una transmisión en vivo.
  • Gestionar simultáneamente diversas tareas de producción en entornos de operador único.
  • Coordinar de manera clara y oportuna con invitados remotos, productores, directores y presentadores antes y durante el programa.

job.title: Platform Ops & Delivery (Sr. SDET)
job.description:
La plataforma directa al consumidor (DTC) de FOX es una iniciativa nueva y visionaria dentro de Tubi Media Group que lleva el incomparable portafolio de contenido de FOX —noticias, deportes y entretenimiento— directamente a los consumidores a través de un innovador servicio de streaming por suscripción.

Impulsado por un equipo de liderazgo altamente experimentado, con trayectorias en la intersección de los medios, la tecnología, el streaming y el contenido, y respaldado plenamente por Fox Corporation, este proyecto combina energía emprendedora con un profundo conocimiento de la industria de los medios.

Nuestra visión es crear una experiencia de visualización unificada y moderna que ponga al consumidor en primer lugar, integrando de forma fluida el contenido en vivo y bajo demanda en todas las plataformas.

En la intersección entre la tecnología de vanguardia y la narrativa de confianza, esta es una oportunidad para dar forma al futuro del streaming en uno de los momentos más decisivos de la industria de los medios. Estamos formando un equipo de clase mundial para cumplir esa visión, y apenas estamos comenzando.

FOX ONE es la aplicación de streaming directa al consumidor de FOX Corporation, ya activa y en operación en Estados Unidos. FOX ONE se está expandiendo ahora a América Latina, y buscamos a un(a) Sr. Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) con base en la Ciudad de México para liderar la ingeniería de calidad de esa expansión. Este es un rol de ingeniería altamente técnico y práctico, para alguien que ve la calidad como una disciplina central de la ingeniería y que pueda definir cómo se construye, prueba, lanza y monitorea la versión de FOX ONE para LATAM.

Como Sr. SDET, colaborarás estrechamente con los equipos de Producto, Ingeniería, Operaciones y Delivery desde las primeras etapas de planeación hasta producción. Te asegurarás de que la calidad se diseñe dentro del trabajo de expansión a LATAM, en lugar de validarse al final. Al comprender el producto actual de FOX ONE, los requisitos del mercado de LATAM y la arquitectura de la plataforma, identificarás riesgos de forma proactiva, definirás estrategias de pruebas y construirás capacidades de automatización en paralelo con el desarrollo de funcionalidades para la región.

Extenderás la plataforma de ingeniería de calidad ya existente de FOX ONE para dar soporte a la expansión en LATAM, adaptando los frameworks y las herramientas construidas para el producto de EE. UU. de modo que funcionen de forma confiable en los distintos idiomas, monedas, dispositivos y entornos regulatorios de México. Este rol requiere un fuerte criterio técnico e implementación práctica, junto con una colaboración cercana con el equipo de plataforma de EE. UU. para decidir qué se debe reutilizar y qué se debe reconstruir para la región.

El candidato o candidata ideal combina sólidas habilidades de ingeniería de software, experiencia consolidada en automatización de pruebas, una mentalidad orientada al producto y un enfoque “AI-first” hacia las pruebas y la ingeniería. Te sientes cómodo(a) cuestionando supuestos, contribuyendo a la dirección técnica y generando resultados de calidad dentro de tu equipo y de los equipos con los que colaboras de cerca, a medida que FOX ONE se expande a un nuevo mercado. job.title: Presentation Designer, Sales Marketing
job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).

Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

POSITION OVERVIEW

Red Seat Ventures is seeking a creative and highly organized Sales Marketing Presentation Designer to support our Sales and Marketing teams. This person will develop compelling, visually engaging presentations and sales materials that help communicate the value of our creators, content, audience, and advertising solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong visual design skills with an understanding of sales storytelling. They will be able to take complex information, data, and ideas and turn them into clear, polished, and persuasive materials for advertisers, agencies, partners, and internal stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and develop high-quality sales presentations, pitch decks, RFP responses, media kits, one-sheets, case studies, and other marketing materials.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Programming teams to understand business objectives and translate them into effective visual stories.
  • Create customized presentations for advertisers, agencies, and strategic partners.
  • Organize complex information, audience data, campaign results, and advertising solutions into clear and compelling presentations.
  • Develop layouts, graphics, charts, infographics, and other visual assets that enhance the sales narrative.
  • Maintain consistency across RSV’s brand, creator, show, and advertising materials.
  • Help build and maintain presentation templates, sales collateral libraries, and design standards.
  • Review materials for accuracy, grammar, formatting, and brand consistency before distribution.
  • Manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Incorporate feedback from multiple stakeholders while maintaining strong design judgment and attention to detail.
  • Stay current on presentation design trends, advertising formats, media industry developments, and emerging tools.
  • Support special projects, events, and other marketing initiatives as needed.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3–5 years of experience in presentation design, graphic design, sales enablement, marketing design, or a related field.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating presentation design, storytelling, information design, and visual communication.
  • Advanced experience with PowerPoint and/or Google Slides.
  • Experience with design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Canva, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of typography, layout, color, composition, and visual hierarchy.
  • Ability to turn complex information and data into simple, understandable visuals.
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities at the same time.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
  • Interest in media, advertising, podcasting, creators, and digital content.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience supporting a media, advertising, sales, entertainment, or technology organization.
  • Experience creating materials for advertisers, agencies, or brand partners.
  • Familiarity with media measurement, audience insights, advertising terminology, and campaign reporting.
  • Experience designing materials for live presentations and executive meetings including senior leadership offsites, financial planning, and revenue operations discussion..
  • Basic knowledge of motion graphics, video editing, or interactive presentation tools.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced start-up or high-growth environment.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Sales teams have polished, persuasive, and on-brand materials that help them win business.
  • Presentations clearly communicate the value of RSV’s creators, content, audiences, and advertising solutions.
  • Materials are delivered accurately and on time, even when priorities shift.
  • Sales and Marketing teams have organized, reusable templates and collateral.
  • Complex information is presented in a way that is easy for clients and partners to understand.
  • The RSV brand is represented consistently across all sales and marketing materials.

LiveNOW delivers relevant, engaging live news coverage from across the country and around the world, moving seamlessly between breaking stories and major events as they happen. Coverage is live and unfiltered, with limited commentary and no opinion.

Based in LiveNOW’s West Coast newsroom at FOX 10 Phoenix and reporting to the Executive Producer, the Producer/Planner will research and plan coverage, book live guests, coordinate incoming content, and produce live coverage of breaking news and important events. We’re looking for a resourceful, dependable, highly organized journalist with strong news judgment who can anticipate coverage needs, build relationships, and thrive in a fast-moving newsroom.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Research, gather, curate, and produce timely original content, including breaking news and live coverage of major events, for digital, social, streaming, and broadcast platforms nationwide.

job.description:
We’re hiring a Regional Digital Content Director to create and optimize content for four FOX-owned and-operated stations in Florida. Based in our FOX 35 Orlando newsroom, you’ll coordinate with teams in Orlando and Tampa to publish stories, videos, live streams, and social content that engage local audiences.

Does This Sound Like You?

You’re smart, driven, quick-thinking, resourceful, full of energy and have a deep passion for what you do. You've got goals. You're (extremely) competitive and want to win. All the time. You know how to tell a story across every digital and social platform—even the ones that haven’t been invented yet. You're a proven, compassionate leader who motivates others to make a real difference. Your journalistic standards are high, and so is the bar you set for your team. You're obsessed with quality and serving the audience in the best possible way. You pivot quickly and keep your cool when things get tough. You can coordinate with different contributors across Central Florida, but there's nothing you love more than supporting your team—and you celebrate their wins in victorious fashion. The powerhouse leader we're looking for is a self-proclaimed news junkie, knows digital platforms inside and out, and has a track record of taking teams to new heights. If that’s you, we can't wait to meet you!

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee team that creates news and event-based content impacting users in all markets, including text stories, photos/graphics, connected TV/live streaming content, breaking news, mobile alerts, and social media elements.
  • Write and produce compelling, consumer-focused content related to news, events, and topics relevant across Central Florida and Tampa, Florida.
  • Create and publish a range of content, including articles, videos, live streams, photos/graphics, breaking news updates, and social media posts
  • Coordinate closely with local teams in Orlando and Tampa to support audience engagement and brand loyalty
  • Optimize content for search engines (SEO) while prioritizing the user experience

job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).

Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Red Seat Ventures is seeking a curious, detail-oriented Research Analyst to help tell the story of our podcast and creator audiences and demonstrate the value of advertising across our portfolio.

Working closely with Research, Sales and Marketing, you will translate audience research and campaign performance data into clear insights that support advertiser proposals, campaign evaluation and renewals. You will gain hands-on experience with podcast audience measurement, brand lift studies and attribution while helping connect advertiser objectives to measurable results.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop audience profiles that highlight listeners’ demographics, interests, purchasing behaviors and relevance to prospective advertisers.
  • Use syndicated research, audience data and marketplace intelligence to support sales proposals, advertiser requests and competitive positioning.
  • Track podcast consumption, creator trends and competitive advertising activity to identify opportunities for our sales teams.
  • Maintain recurring reports, research databases and presentation materials, ensuring accuracy and documenting sources.
  • Support the design and execution of custom surveys and brand lift studies, including questionnaire review, fieldwork tracking and analysis.
  • Help evaluate campaign results against advertiser objectives, including awareness, favorability, consideration, purchase intent and behavioral response.
  • Assist with attribution reporting to understand website visits, conversions and other advertiser outcomes associated with podcast campaigns.
  • Create clear campaign recaps, charts and case studies that explain findings, highlight limitations and identify useful recommendations.
  • Translate research insights, audience behavior and industry trends into compelling sales presentations and marketing initiatives that demonstrate RSV’s value to advertisers.
  • Partner with the research lead in client-facing meetings to present research findings and communicate key insights that inform ad sales strategies and client recommendations.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Approximately 1–2 years of relevant experience in media research, advertising analytics, consumer insights or a related field. Relevant internships may count toward this experience.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with close attention to data quality and accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Excel, including formulas, pivot tables and charts, and the ability to create clear PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain what findings mean for a business question.
  • Foundational understanding of survey research, sample sizes, comparisons and advertising performance metrics.
  • Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to balance recurring assignments and time-sensitive requests.
  • Interest in podcasts, digital creators, audience behavior and advertising effectiveness.
  • Curiosity, resourcefulness and a willingness to learn new tools and methodologies.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Familiarity with podcast audience research and intelligence sources such as Edison Research, Podtrac, Triton Digital, MRI-Simmons, Magellan AI or MediaRadar.
  • Exposure to attribution and campaign measurement platforms such as Podscribe, Spotify Ad Analytics, Claritas or ArtsAI.
  • Experience supporting brand lift studies or working with research partners such as Veritonic, Nielsen, Dynata or YouGov.
  • Familiarity with podcast advertising formats, including host-read sponsorships and dynamically inserted ads.

  • A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience

job.title: Senior Engineer, Commerce
job.description:
Fox Tech desarrolla los productos digitales detrás de las marcas de deportes y entretenimiento de FOX. Nuestras aplicaciones funcionan en web, móvil y dispositivos de sala de estar, y millones de personas las usan, generalmente todas al mismo tiempo cuando comienza un partido. Esos picos de tráfico determinan cómo construimos todo.

Estamos contratando ingenieros para construir la próxima generación de nuestros productos de streaming.

Te unirás al equipo de Comercio, que es responsable de los sistemas que manejan el dinero: pagos, impuestos, facturación y suscripciones en todos nuestros productos directos al consumidor. Un error aquí cuesta dólares reales, y un checkout lento cuesta un suscriptor, por lo que el estándar de corrección y disponibilidad es más alto que en casi cualquier otra parte de la infraestructura.

La mayor parte del trabajo ocurre detrás de la interfaz de checkout: autorización y captura de pagos; reembolsos, disputas y reconciliación; el ciclo de vida de las suscripciones, incluyendo renovaciones, upgrades, downgrades, cancelaciones y todos los estados intermedios; idempotencia y procesamiento de webhooks contra APIs de proveedores que reintentan, llegan fuera de orden y a veces “mienten”; cálculo de impuestos a través de proveedores externos; y el alcance de PCI DSS, manteniendo los datos sensibles de los clientes donde deben estar.

Trabajarás con stakeholders de distintas áreas de negocio de FOX, que no todas venden de la misma forma ni al mismo público. Parte del trabajo consiste en construir capacidades de comercio que puedan reutilizarse entre ellas sin homogeneizar la experiencia de cada una.

El ecosistema de desarrollo ha cambiado drásticamente en los últimos dos años, y nosotros hemos cambiado con él. Nuestros ingenieros usan agentes de código y herramientas de IA generativa como parte de su flujo de trabajo normal, no como un experimento ocasional. Esperamos que llegues con fluidez real: que sepas en qué casos estas herramientas son confiables y en cuáles no lo son, y que ya tengas tus propios hábitos para revisar, probar y proteger lo que producen.

Las herramientas en sí seguirán cambiando. Lo que funcionaba hace seis meses ya está desactualizado, y lo que estandaricemos este trimestre probablemente no será lo que usemos el próximo año. Buscamos ingenieros que vean esto como algo normal y que estén dispuestos a seguir replanteando su propio flujo de trabajo.

Para ser claros sobre el estándar: las herramientas de IA elevan lo que esperamos de ti, no lo reducen. Tú eres responsable del código, de las decisiones de diseño y del comportamiento en producción, sin importar quién (o qué) escribió el primer borrador.

  • Liderar la dirección técnica de las principales capacidades de comercio, desde el diseño hasta la operación en producción.
  • Liderar discusiones de arquitectura y tomar las decisiones de compromiso entre confiabilidad, costo, seguridad y velocidad de entrega.
  • Escribir código de alta calidad con cobertura de pruebas significativa y automatización.
  • Asumir la responsabilidad de producción: respuesta a incidentes, análisis de causa raíz y el trabajo de seguimiento que evita que el mismo incidente vuelva a ocurrir.
  • Mentorear a otros ingenieros y elevar el estándar de ingeniería del equipo.
  • Evaluar tecnologías emergentes de pagos y comercio, y argumentar a favor de cambios que mejoren de forma medible la conversión, la confiabilidad o el costo operativo.
  • Comercio se mantiene estable durante los grandes eventos en vivo, cuando el tráfico llega todo de una vez.
  • Los cambios de pagos y suscripciones se lanzan de forma segura, y puedes señalar la métrica que se movió.
  • Otras áreas de negocio de FOX pueden construir sobre tu trabajo sin heredar el flujo de checkout de otro equipo.
  • Licenciatura en Ciencias de la Computación, o experiencia equivalente.
  • 5+ años de experiencia en ingeniería de software, con enfoque en APIs escalables y seguras, y sistemas basados en eventos.
  • Sólido dominio de Go. Nuestros servicios de comercio están escritos casi en su totalidad en Go, y necesitamos que empieces a escribir código de producción en este lenguaje desde el inicio.
  • Experiencia demostrable usando herramientas de IA generativa en desarrollo de software profesional. Puedes explicar dónde mejoraron tu flujo de trabajo, dónde introdujeron riesgos, y cómo revisas, pruebas y proteges el código asistido por IA.
  • Experiencia en el dominio de comercio. Has trabajado con Stripe, Adyen, Braintree o similares, y entiendes cómo se conectan las piezas entre sí.
  • Bases sólidas de ciencias de la computación e instintos fuertes de resolución de problemas.
  • Experiencia con decisiones de diseño y arquitectura de software a gran escala.
  • Sólida experiencia con SQL y NoSQL, idealmente DynamoDB y Redis.
  • Experiencia profesional con AWS u otro proveedor de nube.
  • Experiencia práctica con contenedores y Kubernetes.
  • Nuestros sistemas dan soporte a eventos en vivo y nuestro equipo está distribuido globalmente, por lo que el puesto implica algo de trabajo fuera del horario habitual: llamadas programadas entre regiones, además de respuesta a incidentes durante eventos importantes.
  • Aplicaciones de streaming, especialmente aquellas que manejan eventos en vivo a gran escala.
  • Comercio electrónico, particularmente tráfico de alta disponibilidad en eventos como Black Friday.
  • Gestión del ciclo de vida de suscripciones: renovaciones, upgrades, downgrades y cancelaciones.
  • Idempotencia, procesamiento de webhooks, reintentos y consistencia eventual.
  • Comercio integrado directamente en una experiencia de streaming de video. Si has explorado esto, nos gustaría saberlo.
