job.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Backend ( PNR )
job.description:
Senior Software Development Engineer – Backend (PNR API Platform)

OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation is home to industry-leading brands including FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations, Tubi Media Group, and FOX One, our recently launched direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform. Across our portfolio, we build and operate large-scale digital platforms that serve millions of users globally. Our teams combine innovative technology, deep data insights, and world-class content to deliver highly personalized, reliable, and scalable consumer experiences across web, mobile, and connected TV platforms.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on the Personalization & Recommendations (PNR) API Platform team, you will build and operate the backend systems that power personalized content discovery and recommendation experiences across FOX's digital products. The PNR API platform serves real-time personalized recommendations at scale, combining user behavioral signals, content metadata, vector similarity search, and ML model inference to deliver individualized experiences to millions of users.

You will work at the intersection of backend engineering and ML infrastructure - building recommendation engines, reranking services, user profile systems, and model serving pipelines. This role requires engineers who take end-to-end ownership - from understanding the problem and designing systems to implementing, deploying, and operating them in production.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, build, and operate high-throughput, low-latency backend microservices for real-time personalization and content recommendations
  • Take complete ownership of assigned problem areas, from system design to production rollout and ongoing operations
  • Build and evolve distributed systems that are resilient, fault-tolerant, and observable in production
  • Work with multiple data stores including relational databases, vector databases, search engines, key-value stores, and caching systems to build efficient data access patterns
  • Integrate ML models into real-time serving pipelines, working closely with ML Engineers and Data Scientists
  • Perform high-level and low-level system design, clearly articulating trade-offs and architectural decisions
  • Optimize systems for performance, latency, scalability, and cost at scale
  • Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, and Platform Engineering teams to deliver recommendation capabilities across Web, Mobile, and Connected TV
  • Participate in on-call rotation and drive production reliability and operational excellence
  • Contribute to engineering best practices around architecture, testing, CI/CD, observability, and security

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field
  • 5+ years of experience building backend software systems in production environments
  • Strong programming skills in one or more backend languages, preferably Golang
  • Experience designing and building distributed systems with a focus on scalability, availability, and reliability
  • Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL/Aurora) including query optimization and data modeling
  • Experience with caching systems (Redis/ElastiCache) and cache invalidation strategies
  • Experience working with NoSQL databases (DynamoDB) and understanding of access patterns and cost trade-offs
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-based systems on AWS
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and their application in backend and distributed systems
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership, and deliver systems end-to-end with minimal guidance

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with vector databases (Milvus, Zilliz, Pinecone) and similarity search systems
  • Experience with search engines (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch)
  • Experience with ML model serving and real-time inference systems (Triton, KServe, SageMaker)
  • Experience building recommendation engines, personalization platforms, or content ranking services
  • Experience with event-driven architectures (SNS/SQS, Kafka)
  • Kubernetes and container orchestration (EKS, pod tuning, HPA)
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
  • Observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)
  • Service mesh experience (Istio)
  • Experience with experimentation / A/B testing platforms
  • Experience with streaming platforms, digital media, or consumer-facing applications

job.title: Senior Systems Design Engineer
job.description:

This role will establish engineering standards, produce and review technical documentation, and ensure that system designs are accurately implemented in our in house NDOX documentation tool.

The ideal candidate has strong broadcast engineering experience, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to translate operational requirements into clear, scalable, and supportable systems designs.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design broadcast systems for studios, control rooms, production spaces, technical facilities, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Define and maintain systems design standards, engineering guidelines, documentation requirements, drawing conventions, and design workflows.
  • Develop system architectures, signal-flow diagrams, block diagrams, equipment lists, rack elevations, wiring documentation, network requirements, and technical specifications.
  • Implement and maintain systems designs in NDOX, ensuring that design data, equipment information, system relationships, and documentation remain accurate and current.
  • Review engineering drawings, system designs, technical specifications, bills of materials, vendor submittals, and installation documentation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established standards.

  • Maintain accurate as-built documentation and update NDOX records following system modifications, upgrades, migrations, and commissioning activities.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Broadcast Engineering, or a related field.
  • At least five years of experience designing, integrating, or supporting complex broadcast, media, audiovisual, or technical infrastructure systems.
  • Strong knowledge of broadcast system architecture, signal flow, routing, synchronization, monitoring, control, and facility infrastructure.

  • Experience designing baseband, IP, and hybrid broadcast environments.
  • Working knowledge of broadcast control systems, media asset management, storage, automation, monitoring, and cloud-based media workflows.
  • Proficiency with technical design and documentation tools such as AutoCAD, Visio, Lucidchart, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of networking, VLANs, routing, switching, storage, cybersecurity principles, and system interoperability.
  • Experience reviewing vendor designs, submittals, installation drawings, test documentation, and as-built records.

job.title: Senior Union Benefits Analyst
job.description:
We are looking for a Senior Union Benefits Analyst to join our team! This position performs various tasks involved in administering union negotiated benefits in accordance with the collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) and plan documents, in a fast-paced environment with a large volume of union benefit plans.

The Senior Union Benefit Analyst will serve as the in-house union benefit Subject Matter Expert (SME) and is responsible for ensuring that all union benefit employer contributions and employee deductions are setup, maintained, paid, and reported in accordance with applicable collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) and in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

A SNAPSHOT OF RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Successfully manage a high-volume portfolio of 300+ union benefit plans, overseeing all associated reporting and serving as the primary point of contact for external stakeholder inquiries
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for Payroll Shared Services through a deep understanding of union benefit rules outlined in collective bargaining agreements (CBAs)
  • Collaborate with Labor Relations to ensure the correct interpretation of CBA union benefit rules. Document and maintain the rules, collecting and retaining approvals from Labor Relations
  • Collaborate with the IT team to ensure union benefit rules and rates are set up timely and accurately based on the approved interpretations by Labor Relations
  • Audit weekly, monthly, and quarterly union benefit invoices and validate invoice calculations against applicable rates, eligibility requirements, and Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) provisions and reconcile the contributions/deductions to the payroll register prior to approving the invoices for payment to benefit funds. Address any discrepancies in a timely manner
  • Perform union benefit audit reviews timely to avoid penalties and interest; and to obtain credits if due. Research and document audit findings and coordinate corrective actions with appropriate internal departments and external union benefit funds
  • Maintain detailed audit records, supporting documentation, reconciliation schedules, and resolution tracking
  • Ensure all union benefit discrepancy notices are addressed in a timely manner
  • Assist with union-related inquiries by researching employee records, eligibility, contributions, and benefit discrepancies
  • Develop Excel-based reconciliation tools, audit schedules, and variance reports
  • Recommend process improvements to strengthen data accuracy, reduce errors, improve reconciliation efficiency, and minimize financial risk
  • Maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive employee information, payroll, benefits, and financial information
  • Perform union benefit retro calculations as needed in support of collective bargaining agreement changes

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 4+ years of hands-on union benefit experience, preferably with IBEW, IATSE, AFTRA, and/or NABET collective bargaining agreements
  • Experience with Workday payroll
  • Experience using software, including but not limited to PowerPoint and Word, with advanced proficiency in Excel, including lookups, pivot tables, complex formulas, and data reconciliation
  • Experience with initiating and leading standardization and process improvement initiatives
  • Ability to interpret collective bargaining agreements for union benefit rules
  • Working knowledge of defined benefit and defined contribution plans and related laws and regulations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail and comfortable working with large volumes of employee and financial data
  • Strong interpersonal skills – you are approachable, responsive, and team-focused
  • High degree of professionalism and solid ability to deliver high-quality customer service and establishing/maintaining effective and collaborative working relationships
  • Self-motivated and calm under pressure
  • Professional communicator, written and verbal, through any channel

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC) or Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) designation

job.title: Sr. Manager, Legal and Business Affairs LATAM
job.description:
Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Legal & Business Affairs will provide strategic legal counsel and business-oriented support to the company's operations across Latin America, with a particular focus on Mexico and Central America.

This role will serve as a trusted legal advisor to business leaders and cross-functional teams, providing practical, commercially focused guidance on a broad range of legal, contractual, regulatory, and corporate matters.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience navigating complex legal and business environments within multinational organizations, demonstrating the ability to assess legal risks, develop effective solutions, and support business objectives while ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

The position requires strong commercial awareness, sound legal judgment, excellent stakeholder management skills, and fluency in both English and Spanish.

Key Responsibilities

1. Legal Advisory & Business Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted legal and business advisor to regional leadership and cross-functional teams across Latin America, particularly Mexico and Central America.
  • Provide strategic, practical, and timely legal guidance on commercial, operational, regulatory, and corporate matters.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to evaluate legal implications, identify potential risks, and develop solutions that support business priorities and commercial objectives.
  • Provide legal support for business initiatives, transactions, and operational projects, ensuring alignment with corporate policies and applicable legal requirements.

2. Commercial Contracts & Negotiations

  • Draft, review, negotiate, and manage a broad range of commercial agreements, including marketing, vendor, licensing, service, and other business-related contracts.
  • Advise internal stakeholders on contractual terms, obligations, liabilities, and potential legal or commercial risks.
  • Support contract negotiations with external partners, suppliers, and service providers, balancing legal protections with business needs.
  • Ensure contractual arrangements comply with applicable laws, internal policies, and corporate standards.

3. Corporate Governance & Regulatory Compliance

  • Support corporate governance activities, including legal entity management, corporate documentation, regulatory filings, and coordination with external legal advisors.
  • Provide legal guidance on regulatory requirements affecting business operations across relevant Latin American jurisdictions.
  • Collaborate with internal compliance teams to identify, assess, and address legal and regulatory risks.
  • Monitor relevant legislative and regulatory developments and proactively communicate potential implications for business operations.
  • Support the implementation of appropriate legal and compliance practices in coordination with relevant internal stakeholders.

4. Legal Risk Management & External Counsel

  • Identify, evaluate, and mitigate legal risks associated with commercial activities, contractual relationships, and regional operations.
  • Develop practical, risk-based recommendations that support informed business decisions.
  • Coordinate and oversee external legal counsel across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring consistent, high-quality, and cost-effective legal support.
  • Manage legal matters requiring specialized external advice and facilitate coordination between internal stakeholders and external advisors.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategic Initiatives

  • Collaborate closely with business, finance, compliance, and operations teams to support regional business objectives.
  • Provide legal guidance on cross-functional projects and initiatives involving multiple business units or jurisdictions.
  • Facilitate effective communication between legal and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on legal requirements, commercial priorities, and operational needs.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing legal processes, operational efficiency, and risk management practices.

Qualifications & Experience

Education

  • Law degree from an accredited university or institution.
  • Admission to practice law in at least one jurisdiction.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant legal experience, either as in-house counsel or at a reputable law firm, preferably within a multinational or regional business environment.
  • Demonstrated experience advising on commercial contracts, corporate matters, and business operations.
  • Experience supporting legal and commercial activities across Latin America, particularly Mexico and Central America, is strongly preferred.
  • Previous experience in the media, entertainment, advertising, technology, or other fast-paced industries is considered an advantage.
  • Proven ability to provide practical legal advice while balancing regulatory requirements, risk management, and business objectives.

Languages

  • Fluency in Spanish and English, both written and spoken, is required.
  • Ability to draft, review, and negotiate legal documents and communicate effectively with stakeholders in both languages.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Business Acumen: Strong understanding of commercial operations and the ability to align legal recommendations with business objectives.
  • Legal Analysis & Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and address legal and regulatory risks while providing practical, solution-oriented guidance.
  • Contract Drafting & Negotiation: Excellent legal drafting, contract review, and negotiation skills.
  • Stakeholder Management: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build effective relationships with business leaders, cross-functional teams, and external advisors.
  • Strategic Thinking & Problem-Solving: Ability to evaluate complex legal matters, anticipate potential challenges, and recommend commercially viable solutions.
  • Organization & Prioritization: Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex legal concepts clearly to non-legal stakeholders.
  • Professional Integrity & Judgment: High ethical standards, discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment when handling sensitive or confidential matters.

job.title: Streaming Associate Producer
job.description:
WOFL FOX 35 Orlando is seeking a Streaming Associate Producer to support daily streaming coverage and help maintain a consistent, engaging viewer experience across FOX LOCAL and our digital platforms. This role will help produce weekend streaming coverage alongside the weekend host while spending the remaining weekdays supporting live coverage, identifying and booking timely newsmakers, preparing interviews, and helping the streaming team respond quickly to breaking news and developing stories across Central Florida.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the development and production of live and on-demand streaming content for FOX 35 Orlando and FOX LOCAL.
  • Help produce weekend streaming programming, including rundowns, segments, interviews, video, graphics, and other production elements.
  • Identify timely Central Florida stories, newsmakers, and guests who can add context and perspective to live coverage.
  • Research, pitch, and book guests for live interviews and streaming segments.
  • Prepare interview research, questions, background materials, and supporting visual elements.
  • Monitor breaking news and developing stories and help the streaming team quickly build and update live coverage.
  • Write clear, compelling, and accurate copy for streaming, digital, social, and linear platforms.
  • Select and organize video, soundbites, graphics, maps, user-generated content, and other visual elements for assigned stories and segments.
  • Write copy that effectively complements video, sound, and other visual elements.
  • Proofread and edit streaming, broadcast, and digital copy for accuracy, grammar, spelling, and editorial standards.
  • Track developing stories and provide timely updates as new information becomes available.
  • Proactively research and gather the information, video, graphics, and other materials needed to complete assigned stories.
  • Work with reporters, photographers, editors, producers, and field teams to coordinate video, graphics, logistics, and other production needs.
  • Assist with live-streaming production and help ensure streams run smoothly and accurately.
  • Organize, write, and edit stories for streaming, newscasts, digital, and social platforms as assigned by Producers and/or the Executive Producer.
  • Contribute ideas for conversational segments, interviews, and new streaming formats.
  • Build productive relationships with newsroom leadership and colleagues to strengthen content development and production.
  • Maintain a strong commitment to journalistic ethics, accuracy, fairness, and community service.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • A Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, broadcasting, digital media, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in news production, digital journalism, streaming, or a related newsroom role.
  • Strong writing, editing, research, and storytelling skills.
  • Strong news judgment and a commitment to factual accuracy.
  • Experience writing and producing content for digital, streaming, broadcast, or social platforms.
  • Ability to identify compelling stories, guests, and angles for live and on-demand coverage.
  • Ability to work quickly and accurately during breaking news and developing stories.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments under tight deadlines.
  • Familiarity with video, graphics, digital publishing, and social media workflows.
  • Ability to quickly learn and effectively use newsroom, editing, publishing, and production software systems.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with producers, anchors, reporters, photographers, editors, and digital teams.
  • Ability to respond well to direction, feedback, and changing editorial priorities.
  • Dependability, professionalism, and a willingness to work a flexible schedule.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced newsroom and live-production environment.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEAL BREAKER

  • Experience producing or assisting with live newscasts, streams, or digital programming.
  • Experience researching and booking guests or newsmakers for live interviews.
  • Experience preparing interview questions, research, and supporting materials.
  • Experience with FOX LOCAL, CTV, OTT, or other digital video platforms.
  • Experience creating graphics, maps, and other visual elements for news coverage.
  • Experience with newsroom rundown, content-management, video-editing, graphics, and social-publishing tools.
  • Experience producing short-form or vertical video for social platforms.
  • Experience monitoring audience engagement or content-performance analytics.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced local newsroom.
  • Knowledge of Central Florida / Orlando news, communities, weather, politics, public safety, culture, and other issues important to local audiences.

Working conditions (IF APPLICABLE)

Flexibility to work weekends, holidays and varied hours required.

Physical requirements (IF APPLICABLE)

Regularly stand; walk; sit; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear.  Occasionally required to climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.  Regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.  Vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

job.title: Systems Engineer
job.description:
The Systems Engineer is an individual contributor on the Digital Newsroom (DNR) Systems Administration team responsible for the engineering, automation, and operational reliability of the Dalet media-asset-management platform and related production systems in New York and Washington, DC. This backfill position replaces a retiring engineer and restores capacity for scripting, proactive monitoring, data migration, and frontline production support across NY and DC.

The Systems Engineer works closely with editorial, media desk, library, and operations teams, partners with Dalet support and internal engineering groups on Mimir, Pyramid, and Project Fresh Start initiatives, and contributes to the team's transition from reactive ticket handling to automated detection and remediation. Success requires strong Dalet platform knowledge, disciplined scripting in PowerShell and Bash, and dependable ownership through completion — including weekends and live production windows.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES:

  • Dalet Platform Engineering & Administration
    • Administer and troubleshoot the Dalet MAM environment in NY and DC — including Dalet Admin Tool configuration, BPM workflows, proxy generation, WebSpace, Wowza load balancers, workflow servers, and ingest/recording components (Brio).
    • Resolve escalated production issues: proxy-not-generating failures, media sync problems, ZID-to-DCID transfer errors, mount failures, TRINT workflow disruption, and slug/metadata special-character recording failures.
    • Configure Dalet Admin Tool settings and BPM rules to prevent recurring operational failures (e.g., illegal-character handling, recording-stuck conditions).
    • Support restricted-folder lifecycle, asset restore/purge requests, and media-desk coordination for NY and DC editorial workflows.
    • Partner with Dalet iCare/support on complex escalations; document root cause and remediation in ServiceNow (DNRNYD) and Confluence.
  • Monitoring, Scripting & Automation
    • Develop, maintain, and extend production monitoring and remediation scripts (PowerShell and Bash) covering recurring Dalet failure modes — Brio recording stuck, MDS/MDD agent health, AuditTrail freshness, BPM thresholds, NetXchange agents, WebSpace/Wowza restarts, send-to-NEXIO catchers, EDL agent errors, and DST offset checks.
    • Tie monitoring automation to tracked DNRNYD tickets with documented thresholds, alert logic, and remediation steps.
    • Contribute to the team's proactive monitoring posture and eventual integration with broader observability initiatives (e.g., Grafana).
    • Apply Python and modern tooling to extend operational automation where practical.
  • Mimir, Migrations & Platform Programs
    • Support Object Store-to-Mimir image and metadata migration work — including XML mappings, JSON watch-folder definitions, VOS re-tagging, shared-asset import logic, and batch validation.
    • Execute and validate large-scale content and metadata migrations (e.g., transcript backfill, person/non-person image regeneration) with minimal production impact.
    • Participate in Mimir Phase 2 and Pyramid platform testing — TestRail case authoring, post-upgrade retesting in DEV and PROD, and permissions/workflow validation with platform owners.
    • Support Project Fresh Start and Dalet upgrade activities (MFP testing, MS-SQL maintenance, version upgrades) as assigned.
  • Production Pipelines & Linux Administration
    • Own or support recurring production delivery workflows — including the Fox News Sunday Hulu unified-delivery package (format updates, captioning conversions, container changes, illegal-character handling, and external QA coordination).
    • Administer Linux systems supporting Dalet and related DNR infrastructure in NY and DC.
    • Perform MS-SQL queries and data tasks tied to Dalet metadata, migration, and reporting workflows.
    • Transform and validate XML metadata for ingest, migration, and platform-integration use cases.
  • Operations, Documentation & Collaboration
    • Provide frontline and weekend production support for NY and DC Dalet users — editors, media desk, library, and operations teams.
    • Respond to ServiceNow incidents and requests; maintain clear written documentation in Confluence for systems, scripts, and troubleshooting procedures.
    • Collaborate with peer DNR engineers (Mimir, Pyramid, ingest, editing platform) and BMT teams on cross-platform initiatives.
    • Participate in on-call and weekend coverage rotation aligned to live news production schedules.
    • Work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and maintenance windows as required.

job.title: VP, Media Technology Engineering
job.description:
FOX Corporation is seeking a high-impact Vice President, Media Technology Engineering to lead the engineering, implementation, and operational reliability of the technology environment supporting FOX News Media and Fox Television Stations.

This leader will oversee the teams responsible for operating and continuously improving the critical infrastructure that supports news gathering, live broadcast, production, post-production, playout, master control, transmission, and digital media distribution.

The role will lead a high-performing engineering organization responsible for network, compute, storage, virtualization, cloud infrastructure, broadcast systems, disaster recovery, and platform resiliency. The successful candidate will have deep experience operating highly available media environments and implementing complex broadcast technology transformations, including SMPTE ST 2110 video-over-IP systems.

Reporting to the SVP, Media Technology & Engineering, this role will partner closely with the VP, Media Technology Architecture and other technology leaders. The VP of Architecture will establish future-state architecture, standards, and technical direction. This role will own engineering execution, implementation, operational readiness, reliability, lifecycle management, and incident response.

Role Scope

The major areas of responsibility include:

  • Broadcast technology engineering and operations
  • SMPTE ST 2110 implementation and operational reliability
  • Network, compute, storage, and virtualization engineering
  • Hybrid cloud infrastructure operations
  • Station automation and delivery platforms
  • OTT, streaming, and OTA technology support
  • News and local production support
  • Media technology and transmission
  • Disaster recovery and platform resiliency
  • 24/7 technical operations and incident response

Responsibilities

Engineering Operations and Reliability

  • Lead the day-to-day engineering and operational support of mission-critical broadcast and media technology environments.
  • Ensure 24/7/365 availability, reliability, and operational readiness across broadcast, production, distribution, and transmission platforms.
  • Establish operating procedures, escalation paths, service expectations, and incident response practices.
  • Partner with Critical Response and Operations teams to manage major incidents, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
  • Monitor system health and ensure timely resolution of reliability, performance, and availability issues.

Broadcast Systems Implementation and Support

  • Lead the engineering implementation, integration, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management of broadcast technology platforms.
  • Support live news gathering, contribution, production, post-production, playout, master control, station automation, and transmission workflows.
  • Implement and operate SMPTE ST 2110 video-over-IP environments, including routing, timing, packet integrity, latency, and system interoperability.
  • Support the transition from SDI-based workflows to synchronized, software-defined IP media facilities in partnership with the Media Architecture team.
  • Maintain operational compatibility across existing systems while implementing new technology platforms.

Network and Infrastructure Engineering

  • Lead engineering execution across WAN, LAN, contribution networks, routing, switching, QoS, multicast, and high-capacity media connectivity.
  • Operate and optimize on-premise data centers, hybrid cloud infrastructure, enterprise virtualization, containerized environments, compute, storage, and related platforms.
  • Manage infrastructure lifecycle activities, including upgrades, capacity planning, patching, migrations, integrations, and technology refreshes.
  • Implement approved architecture and security standards in partnership with Media Architecture, Network Engineering, and Information Security.
  • Ensure infrastructure supports high-throughput, low-latency media workflows and enterprise data distribution.

Resiliency and Disaster Recovery

  • Implement and maintain disaster recovery, business continuity, redundancy, failover, and resiliency capabilities.
  • Conduct readiness testing and ensure recovery procedures are documented, current, and operationally viable.
  • Identify single points of failure and lead remediation efforts.
  • Partner with architecture and security teams to ensure resiliency requirements are incorporated into new implementations and major upgrades.

Project and Program Delivery

  • Partner with the PMO and Critical Response teams to deliver technology upgrades, expansions, migrations, integrations, and operational improvements.
  • Translate approved architecture and technical requirements into executable engineering plans.
  • Manage dependencies, technical risks, resource requirements, milestones, and operational readiness.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and with appropriate testing, documentation, training, and support plans.
  • Coordinate production cutovers and post-implementation support.

Performance Management and Optimization

  • Establish operational KPIs and service-level measures for availability, reliability, capacity, latency, incident response, and recovery.
  • Optimize monitoring, alerting, and alarming systems to reduce noise and improve response effectiveness.
  • Use performance data and operational trends to identify risks, capacity needs, and improvement opportunities.
  • Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, tools, and support models.

Vendor and Service Management

  • Manage operational relationships with key technology vendors and service providers.
  • Monitor vendor performance against service-level expectations.
  • Coordinate escalations, technical support, maintenance, and issue resolution.
  • Partner with Architecture and Procurement teams to validate technical requirements and support vendor evaluations.

Documentation and Compliance

  • Maintain accurate documentation for network, infrastructure, broadcast, transmission, security, and recovery environments.
  • Ensure engineering procedures align with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, security policies, and internal controls.
  • Maintain current system diagrams, runbooks, asset information, configuration records, recovery procedures, and support documentation.
  • Support operational audits, compliance reviews, and risk assessments.

Leadership and Talent Development

  • Lead and develop a high-performing engineering organization supporting complex, highly available media environments.
  • Establish clear team structures, accountabilities, operating rhythms, and performance expectations.
  • Mentor engineering leaders and technical talent.
  • Build a culture of operational excellence, accountability, collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to define requirements, manage expectations, and deliver reliable solutions.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner closely with the VP, Media Technology Architecture to execute approved technical strategies and standards.
  • Collaborate with Network Engineering, Information Security, Broadcast Operations, Media Services, Digital Platforms, News, Local Production, and Transmission teams.
  • Provide engineering input into architecture decisions based on operational requirements, reliability, supportability, and total cost of ownership.
  • Serve as the engineering voice during technology planning, implementation, and operational readiness reviews.

Continuous Improvement and Innovation

  • Evaluate emerging technologies for operational value, reliability, supportability, and compatibility with the FOX media environment.
  • Drive adoption of tools, frameworks, and methodologies that improve engineering effectiveness and standardize deployment procedures.
  • Maintain backward compatibility while modernizing technology platforms and operating practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve automation, observability, resiliency, and engineering productivity.

What You Will Need

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox News Media

FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX News Media is looking for an Associate Marketing Manager, CRM to help build and deepen relationships with our news audience across FOX News Digital and related products. You will help run personalized, Braze-powered programs across email, push, and in-app messaging, using first-party behavioral data to make every touchpoint more relevant and timely.

You will work with Product, Data, Editorial, and Growth, with guidance from senior CRM leadership, and your work will show up in audience engagement, loyalty, and the health of our owned channels.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES

  • Our audience and first-party data give you room to test fast and act on what you learn.
  • You build and launch real campaigns and journeys, from segmentation through analysis, with exposure to senior leadership.
  • Braze as our enterprise engagement platform, with a dedicated Data and Analytics partnership.
  • You learn alongside Product, Editorial, and Engineering and see how customer experiences are shaped, not just the messages.
  • Contribute to engagement strategy across onboarding, habit formation, re-engagement, and loyalty for our news audience.
  • Help track and drive progress against engagement targets, such as click-through, return visits, and content consumption driven by owned channels.
  • Build, QA, and launch multi-channel campaigns, newsletters, and automated journeys in Braze (Canvas, Segments, Connected Content, Liquid, Catalogs, Content Cards) across email, push, and in-app.
  • Help develop and maintain segments from demographic, behavioral, and first-party data, and work with Data and Engineering to power personalization.
  • Set up and run A/B and multivariate tests, and summarize results and learnings, including flagging tactics that are not working.
  • Build reporting and analysis that shows what is working, what is not, and what to try next.
  • Support campaigns tied to product launches and editorial priorities, working with Product, Editorial, Growth, Design, and Analytics.
  • Help manage send volume and frequency across channels, including breaking news alerts, to protect engagement and limit opt-outs and fatigue.
  • Use automation and AI responsibly to scale personalization, content variation, and workflow efficiency, with human review wherever editorial judgment or brand standards are involved.
  • Ensure every campaign meets brand, legal, and privacy requirements.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 2+ years of CRM, email, lifecycle, or engagement marketing experience; news, media, or other high-frequency digital product experience is a plus
  • Hands-on experience building and managing campaigns or journeys in Braze or a comparable platform (Iterable, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Klaviyo, etc.)
  • Working knowledge of segmentation, personalization, and lifecycle marketing
  • Familiarity with marketing automation and AI-enabled tools, with sound judgment about where human oversight is needed
  • Ability to interpret performance data and turn it into optimization recommendations focused on engagement and audience growth
  • Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple tasks at once
  • Clear communicator who works well with both technical and non-technical partners
  • Braze experience specifically, including Connected Content and Liquid
  • Experience in news, media, publishing, or streaming, ideally in a fast-paced newsroom environment
  • Working knowledge of SQL or BI tools (Looker, Tableau, etc.) and analytics platforms (GA4, Adobe Analytics)
  • Familiarity with CDPs and first-party data concepts
  • Exposure to applying AI to CRM, such as generative tools for message variants or the predictive and optimization features in Braze
  • Familiarity with privacy regulations such as CCPA and CAN-SPAM

La compañía transmite más de 2,000 eventos deportivos al año y cuenta con un equipo conformado por algunos de los talentos, periodistas y analistas deportivos más reconocidos de la región. La amplia oferta de contenido deportivo de FOX Latinoamérica está disponible a través de FOX y FOX+ en televisión lineal, del servicio de streaming directo al consumidor FOX One y del canal FOX en Tubi, la plataforma gratuita de streaming con publicidad (AVOD).

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Coordinator, Program Scheduling and Live Operations supports the day-to-day operations of the FOX Deportes Programming Department across linear and streaming platforms, including FOX One exclusive content and the Tubi Fast Channel.


This position is responsible for programming the Tubi Fast Channel from inception through coding, scheduling exclusive live content on FOX One through VPS, managing blackout information and event details, and supporting long-term scheduling, potential acquisition models and budget planning.


Essential Functions

  • Keep all departments updated with the latest program schedules, coding reports, league information and event fixtures.
  • Prepare, proofread and distribute weekly programming schedules for the Tubi channel, the FOX One app and emerging networks.
  • Navigate VPS and other scheduling systems to ensure accurate titling and coding information.
  • Generate VPS programming grids and inventory reports as needed.
  • Work closely with Latin American counterparts to track program and event schedule updates that may affect FOX Deportes.
  • Support long-term scheduling and the development of reliable scheduling models for potential acquisition opportunities.
  • Participate in programming meetings with FOX Sports Mexico and other departments to provide relevant updates regarding programming schedules.
  • Generate weekly blackout reports for geo-blocking purposes.
  • Support the Programming Manager in distributing schedule and fixture updates during their absence.
  • Assist the Programming Manager with updating the events calendar and revenue driver counts as needed.
  • Communicate daily with departments and stakeholders regarding updates to codes, programs, fixtures and program delivery.
  • Collaborate with Programming, Production, Finance, Legal, Marketing, On-Air Promotions, Commercial Administration, Live Operations and FNG Standards & Practices.
  • Coordinate with internal teams regarding event updates, blackout territories, program delivery, coding, ratings and commercial requirements.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Three or more years of experience, or equivalent experience, in television programming or scheduling.
  • Strong understanding of sports programming, including live and taped content.
  • Experience with coding, scheduling and organizational processes.
  • College degree strongly preferred.

Language and Communication

  • Fluent in English and Spanish, both written and spoken.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with creative, business and technical teams.
  • Excellent attention to detail.

Mathematical and Reasoning Skills

  • Basic math skills.
  • Ability to solve problems and navigate technical and organizational challenges.
  • Ability to act quickly and efficiently under tight deadlines.

Computer Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.
  • Experience with scheduling software, such as Visual Programming Software (VPS), preferred.
  • Basic understanding of the Nielsen ratings process is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence and its practical application is a plus.

Other Skills and Abilities

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Resourcefulness and quick-thinking abilities.
  • Basic understanding of cable television, the streaming industry and target demographics.
  • Ability to multitask and work effectively in a fast-paced live television environment.
  • Availability to work weekends and/or late nights when required.

Work Environment

This is a remote position that primarily involves sedentary work, prolonged sitting and frequent use of computers and telephones. The role requires close visual focus and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and tight deadlines.

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Director is a senior sales executive responsible for driving revenue and maximizing client investment across TMZ's portfolio of content, platforms, and distribution partners. This role develops strategic relationships with advertisers and agencies, delivering innovative marketing solutions that connect brands with TMZ's highly engaged audiences while demonstrating measurable business results. The ideal candidate is a collaborative leader with extensive media sales experience, strong business acumen, and a passion for building lasting client partnerships.

Strategic Thinking

Communication

Performance & Insights

Team Leadership & Culture

  • Foster a collaborative and high-performing team environment by encouraging knowledge sharing, promoting innovative thinking, and contributing to the continued growth and development of colleagues

Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats.

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Fox Television Stations (FTS) HR team is seeking a business-minded, hands-on HR Business Partner to support our Sales Team, Finance and other corporate functions. This role is for an experienced HR professional who pairs strategic thinking with strong day-to-day execution and thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven broadcast and streaming environment.


Reporting to the Senior Regional HR Director, the HRBP will own day-to-day HR support across the full employee lifecycle while acting as a trusted advisor to department leadership. The ideal candidate brings sound judgment, credibility, and the ability to translate business needs into practical people solutions. This individual will be comfortable navigating change and balancing competing priorities.


The HRBP will partner closely with HR Centers of Excellence, including Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Benefits, HR Operations, and Learning & Development, to deliver a consistent and effective employee experience across stations.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as a strategic HR partner and advisor to station leadership, providing guidance on employee relations, performance management, staffing models, and people priorities
  • Serve as the primary HR resource for employees and managers, providing guidance on policies, procedures, benefits, and employment practices and resolving issues directly
  • Develop a deep understanding of sales, finance and corporate function, and proactively identify people needs and opportunities
  • Lead talent management and performance processes, including talent reviews, succession planning for key roles, development planning, and performance management
  • Drive employee engagement and retention initiatives that strengthen performance, collaboration, and team culture
  • Manage offboarding and exit interview processes, analyzing themes and trends to inform retention strategies and recommendations to department leadership
  • Provide solutions-oriented counsel on employee relations matters, conducting or coordinating investigations and partnering with Employment Legal and HR leadership as appropriate
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and Compensation on hiring strategies, recruitment, and competitive offer development
  • Own the new hire experience, including onboarding, orientation, and Form I-9 completion and compliance, and continuously improve onboarding practices in partnership with Talent Acquisition and HR Operations
  • Coach and advise managers on employee development, performance, scheduling challenges, team effectiveness, and management practices
  • Use workforce data, including headcount, turnover, and leave trends, to identify issues, influence decisions, and recommend actions to leadership
  • Ensure accurate and timely employee data in Workday, including new hires, job changes, transfers, promotions, and terminations, and regularly audit station data for accuracy
  • Partner across HR functions to ensure programs and policies are effectively implemented and aligned with department needs
  • Support HR initiatives and special projects that advance FTS and FOX's broader people and business strategies
  • Maintain a strong understanding of employment law, company policies, and applicable regulatory requirements across the markets supported
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local requirements, including Form I-9, required postings, mandatory trainings, and record keeping, and identify and address compliance risks

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years of progressive Human Resources experience supporting complex, fast-paced, or multi-location organizations
  • Experience in broadcast, local media, news, or another 24/7, deadline-driven operating environment strongly preferred
  • Broad HR expertise across the employee lifecycle, including talent management, employee relations, performance management, organizational design, and workforce planning
  • Hands-on experience with core HR operations, including onboarding, Form I-9 compliance, and HRIS transactions, with the ability to both execute directly and improve processes
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to understand business priorities and translate them into effective people strategies
  • Excellent judgment and demonstrated ability to handle sensitive employee matters with discretion
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to adapt to executive, management, and employee audiences
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with a hands-on, execution-oriented approach
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to inform recommendations; experience with Workday or a comparable HRIS preferred

job.title: Manager Care Ops (LatAm)
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX LATAM

FOX Latinoamérica inició operaciones en junio de 2025 y se ha posicionado como uno de los líderes en la programación deportiva en México y Centroamérica, ofreciendo un sólido portafolio de contenidos deportivos y derechos de transmisión de algunas de las ligas y torneos más prestigiosos del mundo, incluyendo la Liga MX, la Copa de Campeones de la Concacaf, la MLB y una selección de partidos de la NFL. La compañía transmite más de 2,000 eventos deportivos al año y cuenta con un equipo conformado por algunos de los talentos, periodistas y analistas deportivos más reconocidos de la región. La amplia oferta de contenido deportivo de FOX Latinoamérica está disponible a través de FOX y FOX+ en televisión lineal, del servicio de streaming directo al consumidor FOX One y del canal FOX en Tubi, la plataforma gratuita de streaming con publicidad (AVOD).

JOB DESCRIPTION

SOBRE EL PUESTO

El puesto de Gerente, Operaciones de Atención al Cliente - LATAM es una posición de liderazgo clave en la intersección entre la ejecución en primera línea y las operaciones estratégicas. Este rol es responsable de habilitar un soporte al cliente escalable y de alta calidad en toda América Latina, brindando a los agentes la guía, las herramientas y los procesos que necesitan para ofrecer experiencias excepcionales a los clientes.

Serás el socio operativo principal para el equipo de atención al cliente de LATAM, trabajando de forma multifuncional con los equipos de Atención al Cliente, Marketing, Producto y Tecnología para operacionalizar iniciativas, evaluar impactos y mantener comunicaciones de primer nivel con los agentes. Se requiere dominio del español para asegurar una colaboración genuina con los equipos y stakeholders regionales.


QUÉ HARÁS

Operaciones de Atención al Cliente y Habilitación de Agentes

  • Ser responsable de impulsar comunicaciones claras y consistentes hacia los agentes a través de múltiples productos e iniciativas, asegurando que los equipos de primera línea estén preparados, informados y capacitados para atender las consultas de los clientes.
  • Diseñar, mantener y gobernar el contenido de la intranet, los procedimientos operativos estándar y las herramientas de ventas/soporte que mejoren la preparación, el compromiso y el desempeño de los agentes.
  • Garantizar la calidad, precisión y consistencia de toda la documentación operativa y dirigida a los agentes.
  • Desarrollar y mantener un conocimiento profundo de las operaciones de Atención al Cliente, incluyendo sistemas, flujos de trabajo y particularidades regionales del mercado de LATAM.
  • Crear, actualizar y gestionar documentación operativa dentro de las plataformas de gestión del conocimiento aprobadas.

Liderazgo de Proyectos Operativos

  • Liderar iniciativas y flujos de trabajo operativos que impactan a Atención al Cliente, aplicando las mejores prácticas de gestión de proyectos, actuando como socio operativo integrado más que como una función formal de PMO.
  • Evaluar y comunicar con claridad el impacto operativo y en la experiencia del cliente de nuevas iniciativas, promociones, lanzamientos de herramientas o cambios en los sistemas.
  • Colaborar con equipos multifuncionales para definir requisitos, cronogramas, dependencias y factores de riesgo relacionados con las operaciones de Atención al Cliente.
  • Mantener a los stakeholders informados y alineados sobre el avance de los proyectos, especialmente aquellos que afectan a los agentes y clientes de LATAM.
  • Aplicar resolución de problemas estructurada y disciplina operativa para resolver desafíos de forma rápida y sostenible.

Datos, Insights y Reportes

  • Usar datos para identificar tendencias de desempeño, brechas y oportunidades en las operaciones de atención al cliente y la experiencia de los agentes.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de Analítica, Herramientas y Tecnología, y Marketing para desarrollar y mantener reportes sobre el desempeño de los agentes y los resultados de la experiencia del cliente.
  • Traducir los insights basados en datos en recomendaciones concretas que equilibren la defensa del cliente con las prioridades del negocio.

Colaboración y Liderazgo

  • Ser el socio principal de Operaciones de Atención al Cliente de LATAM, construyendo relaciones multifuncionales sólidas con stakeholders de toda la organización.
  • Defender la experiencia del agente en primera línea y del cliente, alineándose con las metas y prioridades más amplias de la organización.
  • Fomentar una cultura de claridad, responsabilidad y mejora continua dentro de las operaciones de atención al cliente.
  • Promover el intercambio de conocimiento y el desarrollo del equipo dentro de Operaciones de Atención al Cliente.

SOBRE TI

Eres un(a) profesional experimentado(a) en operaciones de atención al cliente que se desenvuelve con soltura en la intersección entre ejecución y estrategia. Sabes traducir situaciones complejas y ambiguas en acciones operativas claras, y te importa tanto la gente que hace el trabajo como los resultados que genera.

  • Tienes experiencia de liderazgo en entornos de atención al cliente y entiendes lo que se necesita para mantener a los equipos de primera línea capacitados y efectivos.
  • Navegas la ambigüedad con confianza, transformando la complejidad en indicaciones claras y accionables.
  • Equilibras la defensa del cliente con las prioridades del negocio sin perder de vista ninguna de las dos.
  • Eres una persona muy organizada, detallista y proactiva, que anticipa necesidades antes de que se conviertan en problemas.
  • Comunicas con claridad y confianza tanto a audiencias técnicas como no técnicas, desde agentes hasta ejecutivos.
  • Te motiva mejorar la forma en que trabajan los equipos, no solo gestionar tareas, sino construir sistemas y hábitos que escalen.

CALIFICACIONES

  • 5-7 años de experiencia en Operaciones de Atención al Cliente, Gestión de Programas o Liderazgo Operativo.

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Accounts Payable Manager to lead a high-volume Accounts Payable shared services function. This role is responsible for overseeing large-scale invoice processing and company-wide payment operations across multiple business units.


The ideal candidate will drive operational excellence, ensure strong internal controls, and lead continuous process improvement initiatives. This role requires a hands-on leader with deep expertise in high-volume environments, AP systems, and scalable procure-to-pay operations.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing AP team in a shared services environment
  • Lead automation initiatives (OCR, touchless processing, AI-driven capture tools)
  • Set clear goals, provide ongoing feedback, and conduct performance evaluations
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and results-driven culture
  • Oversee end-to-end processing of high-volume invoice intake and payment execution across multiple payment methods
  • Oversee AP account reconciliations, return payments, and ensure timely resolution of discrepancies
  • Oversee company-wide payment and settlement processes, ensuring accuracy and timeliness
  • Manage throughput, backlog, and workload distribution to maintain operational efficiency
  • Drive cycle time reduction and improve processing accuracy
  • Increase straight-through processing (STP) and reduce manual intervention
  • Identify and implement scalable process improvements across the procure-to-pay lifecycle
  • Ensure SLA adherence for invoice processing, approvals, and payment cycles
  • Ensure strong internal controls over invoice processing and payment execution (e.g., duplicate detection, segregation of duties, fraud prevention)
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements
  • Maintain audit readiness and support SOX compliance and internal/external audits
  • Maintain strong vendor relationships and resolve escalated invoice and payment issues
  • Partner with Procurement, Finance, and business stakeholders to optimize P2P processes
  • Drive supplier adoption of digital tools (e.g., Coupa Supplier Portal)
  • Define and track KPIs such as invoice cycle time, first-pass yield, exception rates, cost per invoice, and on-time payment performance
  • Provide data-driven insights and reporting to leadership
  • Monitor payment runs and ensure proper controls and approvals are in place

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
  • 7+ years of progressive Accounts Payable Manager experience
  • Experience driving process transformation and automation initiatives
  • Proven experience managing high-volume Accounts Payable operations in a shared services environment
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, Accounts Payable processes, and financial controls
  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Advanced Excel skills (e.g., pivot tables, data analysis)
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience with Coupa / Workday

job.title: News Anchor
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The news team at FOX 26 and FOX Local Houston is transforming how local news is gathered and delivered. We no longer wait for appointed times to deliver content. We're a 24/7 STREAMING FIRST news organization.

As we continue to evolve, we’re hiring a News Anchor for our top-rated morning news block. Our next anchor will bring the passion and skillset to create and deliver live and unscripted content across streaming programs and platforms, digital news sites, social media and on linear TV.

In this role, you’ll anchor 3-hours of morning news from the studio and then transition to anchoring streaming programs from our redesigned newsroom during the remainder of your day. For streaming news shows, you’ll be responsible for operating our Tricaster switcher, while disseminating live and breaking news in a raw, unscripted format with no teleprompter.


Here’s what you’ll need to be successful in this role:

  • A streaming and digital first mindset, that has evolved beyond traditional TV news constructs. You’re as comfortable and skilled delivering unscripted content as you are with a teleprompter. You bring the same enthusiasm to your delivery and on-air performance regardless format, studio environment or platform.
  • You ditched the “anchor voice” long ago and you’ve mastered a more authentic style of delivery that doesn’t rely on a teleprompter. We don’t use teleprompters in our streaming news programs.
  • You have experience and skill anchoring continuous live breaking news events and severe weather such as hurricanes, tornado outbreaks and winter storm coverage. This experience and skill are evident on your reel.
  • You’ve spent a minimum of 3-5 years in the field as a news reporter, covering big news stories, honing your journalism, polishing your on-air performance and proving that the best anchors have built a reputation as aggressive, successful reporters.
  • You have experience field anchoring big news, demonstrating a range of skills from hard news and politics to sports and community events.
  • You are a leader in the newsroom, with a demonstrated track record of mentoring younger reporters, helping them become better storytellers and writers.
  • You are an engaged copy editor, carefully reviewing and signing off on scripts before they go on air. You provide constructive feedback and actively participate in the editorial process.
  • You have impeccable journalistic ethics and integrity. You can spot problematic copy, flag stories that need more vetting, unearth biased narratives and make sound decisions under deadline pressure.
  • You’ve already created a significant social footprint across Instagram, TikTok and Facebook. Your content is rooted in news, not selfies and vacation photos.

You must have significant experience as an anchor, on top of 3-5 year of experience as a reporter in a professional news operation. Candidates who have experience hosting unscripted, live news streaming programs will move up the list. This is not an entry-level position or a position for candidates who do not possess a journalism background.

We’re a 24/7 news operation, so you must be able to work non-traditional hours, weekends and holidays as needed.

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. JOB DESCRIPTION

The Local Programming Initiatives team at FOX 26 Houston is looking for a Local Programming Initiatives Photographer who is passionate about visual storytelling and willing to create content across live streaming, digital, social media and linear TV.


In this role, you’ll shoot, edit, produce and help direct content for both LPI programming and FOX 26 News, including The Isiah Factor Uncensored, The Nightcap, Chattin’ With Chelsea, FOX Faceoff and FOX NYE Live! You must also be willing to take on general assignment news and help cover severe weather, breaking news, special coverage and other major stories when needed.


Here’s what you’ll need to be successful in this role:

  • A multiplatform mindset. You’re a strong visual storyteller who understands that content is no longer created for just one screen. You can shoot and edit content for streaming, digital, social and linear TV and adapt your storytelling for each platform.
  • Strong photography and editing skills. You understand professional cameras, lighting, audio and visual composition and have experience editing with EDIUS and/or Adobe Premiere Pro.
  • A live and digital mindset. You’re comfortable with live television, bonded cellular technology and evolving digital workflows. You’re ready to be a strong contributor to our live digital news streaming platforms and understand the urgency of getting compelling content to viewers now.
  • The ability to do more. You’re willing to help produce segments or shows, develop ideas and direct live programming as needed. You must also be comfortable and willing to appear on camera when the content or assignment calls for it. Experience with Ross OverDrive and/or TriCaster is preferred, and you’re willing to train and expand your skills.
  • A willingness to evolve. You’re highly adaptable, embrace change and aren’t tied to traditional television workflows. You think outside the box, bring creative ideas to the table and are comfortable using emerging technology and AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to improve workflows, research, ideation and content production.
  • A competitive, winning mindset. You take ownership of your work, thrive in a fast-paced environment and want to help create content that stands out across every platform.

You must have 3–5 years of professional broadcast or multiplatform content production experience, including professional newsroom experience. A high school diploma or equivalent is required; a college degree is preferred. You must have a valid driver’s license with a clean driving record and be able to lift, carry and maneuver up to 50 lbs. of field production equipment.


This position primarily works Monday through Friday, but you must be willing to work weekends, holidays, breaking news, severe weather and special events as needed and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Occasional travel may be required.

job.description:

Fox Sports

FOX Sports, the industry leader in live events, is the umbrella entity representing Fox Corporation’s wide array of multi-platform US-based sports assets. Built with brands capable of reaching more than 100 million viewers in a single weekend, FOX Sports includes the sports television arm of the FOX Network; FS1, FS2, FOX Soccer Plus and FOX Deportes, as well as a joint-venture business in the Big Ten Network and digital properties including http://FOXSports.com and the FOX Sports App. FOX Sports has delivered the most watched television program, NFL’s America’s Game of the Week on FOX, for fourteen consecutive years.

This role works closely with the On-Campus Multiplatform Video Producer/Editors (MVPEs), executing content plans and posting content to various social media platforms throughout the Big Ten athletics calendar.


This is a seasonal freelance position through May, offering roughly 40 hours per week and is a hybrid position in the Los Angeles office.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the creative development, production, and preparation of On-Campus content across Big Ten Network’s social, streaming, and broadcast multiplatform channels
  • Publish content across social platforms (Facebook, Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube) around live events
  • Collaborate with entire digital team to drive daily content, monitor Big Ten news, and align on social media strategies and distribution
  • Ensure video content is optimized for social media consumption
  • Distribute ad sales sponsored social media campaigns driven by the On-Campus team
  • Deliver finished content to key internal stakeholders (Remote, Studio, Originals, Marketing)
  • Ensure all content is aligned with brand standards, quality, and voice
  • Assist with social media analytics reporting to provide insights to the On-Campus team

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 1+ years of experience in social media, communications or marketing
  • Deep knowledge of Big Ten athletics
  • Organized, detail-oriented, proactive and a team player
  • Familiarity with Big Ten Network’s programming, talent, and brand initiatives
  • Detailed platform knowledge and experience posting content to Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok & YouTube
  • Excellent writing skills and attention to detail with grammar, brand voice, and spelling
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a keen editorial sense
  • Excellent writing skills and attention to detail with grammar, brand voice, and spelling
  • Always connected and tuned into the latest Big Ten news
  • Passionate for social media and evolution of technology
  • Outstanding organizational & project management skills
  • Demonstrated ability to provide constructive feedback to others as well as seek out and accept constructive feedback for your individual performance
  • Demonstrated ability to be proactive, take initiative, and meet strategic deadlines in a dynamic environment
  • Able to work flexible hours, which will include nights and weekends
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment on deadline

 

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKDER

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).


Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.


ABOUT THE ROLE
Red Seat Ventures is seeking a highly motivated Sr. Manager, Social Media Strategy & Growth to oversee social media strategy and on-platform growth across its portfolio of clients. You will be responsible for identifying the strengths & weaknesses of each client’s presence across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and X, creating audience & revenue growth strategies, and working closely with key staff members and creator teams to ensure the proper execution of action items.  Our ideal candidate is an expert of each platform’s respective best practices, who understands how to reach a client’s ideal subscriber/follower and is adept at directing content strategy that will resonate with existing and new potential audiences. This role requires a highly detail-oriented, data-driven individual who can operate within a quick-paced environment, with a proven track record of experience and success.  


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop, implement & oversee social media strategy and on-platform monetization for a portfolio of large (1M+ Follower) pages across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and X
  • Activate and optimize on-platform revenue surfaces (Reels Play, in-stream video ads, and other monetizable formats), and incorporate video content produced for TV, podcasting and YouTube into the social strategy to drive new revenue
  • Maintain expert knowledge of each platform’s monetization policies & best practices while building strong relationships with platform representatives at Meta, TikTok and X. 
  • Direct creator and production teams on day-to-day content strategy, posting cadence and platform best practices, while assisting with hands-on page management as needed
  • Set-up, manage, analyze and scale social content campaigns that encourage greater audience participation & growth across owned channels
  • Continuously ideate, implement, and measure results of A/B testing for both creatives and campaign targeting to optimize for engagement, growth and conversions
  • Prepare and deliver regular performance reports across all clients and platforms, conducting deep-dive analysis on what is working, what is underperforming, and where teams should be doubling down
  • Manage the execution of paid social campaigns & promotional campaigns, and support the social sales team on the ad ops execution of branded content integrations 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and on multiple projects & campaigns simultaneously 
  • 5+ years’ experience managing social media strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and X for personalities or businesses
  • A verifiable track record of successfully growing social reach & revenue across multiple platforms
  • Expert-level proficiency with Meta Business Suite, Meta Ads Manager and platform-native analytics, plus working knowledge of cross-platform analytics tools 
  • The ability to edit video and create graphics for social media platforms is a plus
  • Pre-existing relationships with relevant social network connections (e.g. platform representatives and partner managers at Meta, TikTok and X) is a nice to have
  • Excellent copywriting and proofreading skills 
  • An interest in current events and podcast and digital media content
