job.title: Senior Systems Design Engineer
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox News Media

FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Fox News Media is seeking an experienced Senior Systems Design Engineer to develop, maintain, and implement broadcast systems designs across our media facilities. This role will establish engineering standards, produce and review technical documentation, and ensure that system designs are accurately implemented in our in house NDOX documentation tool.


The ideal candidate has strong broadcast engineering experience, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to translate operational requirements into clear, scalable, and supportable systems designs.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design broadcast systems for studios, control rooms, production spaces, technical facilities, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Define and maintain systems design standards, engineering guidelines, documentation requirements, drawing conventions, and design workflows.
  • Develop system architectures, signal-flow diagrams, block diagrams, equipment lists, rack elevations, wiring documentation, network requirements, and technical specifications.
  • Implement and maintain systems designs in NDOX, ensuring that design data, equipment information, system relationships, and documentation remain accurate and current.
  • Review engineering drawings, system designs, technical specifications, bills of materials, vendor submittals, and installation documentation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established standards.
  • Perform design reviews and provide technical feedback to engineering teams, vendors, contractors, and project stakeholders.
  • Ensure that approved designs are implemented consistently during installation, integration, testing, commissioning, and operational handoff.
  • Design and support baseband, IP, and hybrid broadcast systems using current industry practices and technologies.
  • Develop solutions incorporating SMPTE ST 2110, NMOS, PTP, multicast networking, routing, storage, monitoring, control, and facility infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with broadcast engineering, operations, IT, networking, facilities, and vendors to validate requirements and ensure system interoperability.
  • Evaluate proposed technologies and equipment for technical suitability, lifecycle support, scalability, reliability, and alignment with engineering standards.
  • Maintain accurate as-built documentation and update NDOX records following system modifications, upgrades, migrations, and commissioning activities.
  • Participate in system testing, troubleshooting, acceptance reviews, and post-implementation assessments.
  • Support continuous improvement of design processes, documentation quality, and system lifecycle management.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Broadcast Engineering, or a related field.
  • At least five years of experience designing, integrating, or supporting complex broadcast, media, audiovisual, or technical infrastructure systems.
  • Strong knowledge of broadcast system architecture, signal flow, routing, synchronization, monitoring, control, and facility infrastructure.
  • Experience developing and reviewing detailed engineering documentation and technical drawings.
  • Experience defining or applying engineering standards, design criteria, documentation practices, and quality-control processes.
  • Experience working with systems databases, documentation platforms, or facilities engineering management tools; experience with NDOX is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with IP-based broadcast technologies, including SMPTE ST 2110, NMOS, PTP, multicast, and networked media systems.
  • Experience designing baseband, IP, and hybrid broadcast environments.
  • Working knowledge of broadcast control systems, media asset management, storage, automation, monitoring, and cloud-based media workflows.
  • Proficiency with technical design and documentation tools such as AutoCAD, Visio, Lucidchart, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of networking, VLANs, routing, switching, storage, cybersecurity principles, and system interoperability.
  • Experience reviewing vendor designs, submittals, installation drawings, test documentation, and as-built records.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Project coordination experience and PMP certification are preferred but not required.

job.title: Spring 2027 FOX Sports - Big Ten Network - Internship Program - Chicago, IL
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Sports

FOX Sports, the industry leader in live events, is the umbrella entity representing Fox Corporation’s wide array of multi-platform US-based sports assets. Built with brands capable of reaching more than 100 million viewers in a single weekend, FOX Sports includes the sports television arm of the FOX Network; FS1, FS2, FOX Soccer Plus and FOX Deportes, as well as a joint-venture business in the Big Ten Network and digital properties including http://FOXSports.com and the FOX Sports App. FOX Sports has delivered the most watched television program, NFL’s America’s Game of the Week on FOX, for fourteen consecutive years.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Headquartered in Chicago, the Big Ten Network (BTN) is a joint venture between FOX Sports and the Big Ten Conference, dedicated to delivering comprehensive coverage of the nation's premier collegiate conference. As part of the broader FOX Sports portfolio, BTN produces more than 3,100 live events across all platforms, paired with studio shows, game highlights, and original programming across linear and digital platforms. 


FOX is proud to support a culture of creativity, entrepreneurial spirit and community that attracts the industry’s brightest talent. The FOX Internship Program offers an exciting opportunity for you to gain practical experience while interning for one of the biggest sports, media, and entertainment companies in the world. You will have the opportunity to participate in real-world projects, which provides valuable work experience and leadership skills.


Please note that this internship is an on-site opportunity in Chicago, IL.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Studio Production: The Studio Production intern’s responsibilities include helping our studio shows by logging and cutting VO elements, bumps, highlights, and montages. Interns are integral in working closely with producers and announcers on all our shows, including B1G Today, pregames, halftimes, postgames and B1G Shows.
  • Media Management: The Media Management intern will assist the media management department in transferring our library to cloud storage. This will include metadata tagging and understanding nomenclatures within our ecosystem. The role will also assist with day-to-day workflows as needed, including fulling requests from networks, athletic departments, vendors, and other stakeholders.


ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be actively enrolled in an accredited college or university and pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree during the length of the program 
  • Current class standing of sophomore, (second-year college student) or above
  • Strong academic record 
  • Committed and available to work for the entire length of the program
  • Access to own housing and transportation to/from the assigned Internship site
  • Must be able to work on-site in Chicago, IL

STUDENTS SELECTED TO MOVE FORWARD IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS:

  • Must demonstrate knowledge of the company and sports media industry

 

TO APPLY:

  • Submit a 1-page resume (PDF preferred) 
  • Submit a cover letter (PDF Preferred) 
  • Explain why your background and experience make you a good fit for our program
  • Share your top areas of interest 

 

STUDENTS ACCEPTED INTO THE SPRING 2027 PROGRAM:

Are required to provide a copy of an unofficial transcript or letter from the adviser/registrar showing proof of enrollment


AREAS OF PLACEMENT:
Depending on your area of interest, you’ll have an opportunity to participate in one of the following below. Please include one top area in your cover letter. 

  • Media Management
  • Studio Production

SPRING 2027 SCHEDULE:

General Application Deadline: Sunday, November 22, 2026

Program Timeline: Monday, February 8, 2027 - Friday, April 16, 2027

Scheduled Weekly Hours: 16 - 24 hours per week 

NOTE: Schedules vary based on department needs and your availability. We do our best to work around your class schedule.

Successful students have: 

  • Knowledge of current Big Ten Network programming and talent
  • The ability to maintain a professional demeanor when interfacing with talent and executives.
  • Knowledge of software/technical skills applicable to your areas of placement.
  • Knowledge of and passion for a variety of sports
  • A detail-oriented nature with strong organizational skills
  • Self-starter attitude and team player
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to handle a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite

job.title: Sr. Manager, Legal and Business Affairs LATAM
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX LATAM

FOX Latinoamérica inició operaciones en junio de 2025 y se ha posicionado como uno de los líderes en la programación deportiva en México y Centroamérica, ofreciendo un sólido portafolio de contenidos deportivos y derechos de transmisión de algunas de las ligas y torneos más prestigiosos del mundo, incluyendo la Liga MX, la Copa de Campeones de la Concacaf, la MLB y una selección de partidos de la NFL. La compañía transmite más de 2,000 eventos deportivos al año y cuenta con un equipo conformado por algunos de los talentos, periodistas y analistas deportivos más reconocidos de la región. La amplia oferta de contenido deportivo de FOX Latinoamérica está disponible a través de FOX y FOX+ en televisión lineal, del servicio de streaming directo al consumidor FOX One y del canal FOX en Tubi, la plataforma gratuita de streaming con publicidad (AVOD).

JOB DESCRIPTION

Position Summary


The Senior Manager, Legal & Business Affairs will provide strategic legal counsel and business-oriented support to the company's operations across Latin America, with a particular focus on Mexico and Central America.

This role will serve as a trusted legal advisor to business leaders and cross-functional teams, providing practical, commercially focused guidance on a broad range of legal, contractual, regulatory, and corporate matters.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience navigating complex legal and business environments within multinational organizations, demonstrating the ability to assess legal risks, develop effective solutions, and support business objectives while ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

The position requires strong commercial awareness, sound legal judgment, excellent stakeholder management skills, and fluency in both English and Spanish.


Key Responsibilities

1. Legal Advisory & Business Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted legal and business advisor to regional leadership and cross-functional teams across Latin America, particularly Mexico and Central America.
  • Provide strategic, practical, and timely legal guidance on commercial, operational, regulatory, and corporate matters.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to evaluate legal implications, identify potential risks, and develop solutions that support business priorities and commercial objectives.
  • Provide legal support for business initiatives, transactions, and operational projects, ensuring alignment with corporate policies and applicable legal requirements.

2. Commercial Contracts & Negotiations

  • Draft, review, negotiate, and manage a broad range of commercial agreements, including marketing, vendor, licensing, service, and other business-related contracts.
  • Advise internal stakeholders on contractual terms, obligations, liabilities, and potential legal or commercial risks.
  • Support contract negotiations with external partners, suppliers, and service providers, balancing legal protections with business needs.
  • Ensure contractual arrangements comply with applicable laws, internal policies, and corporate standards.

3. Corporate Governance & Regulatory Compliance

  • Support corporate governance activities, including legal entity management, corporate documentation, regulatory filings, and coordination with external legal advisors.
  • Provide legal guidance on regulatory requirements affecting business operations across relevant Latin American jurisdictions.
  • Collaborate with internal compliance teams to identify, assess, and address legal and regulatory risks.
  • Monitor relevant legislative and regulatory developments and proactively communicate potential implications for business operations.
  • Support the implementation of appropriate legal and compliance practices in coordination with relevant internal stakeholders.

4. Legal Risk Management & External Counsel

  • Identify, evaluate, and mitigate legal risks associated with commercial activities, contractual relationships, and regional operations.
  • Develop practical, risk-based recommendations that support informed business decisions.
  • Coordinate and oversee external legal counsel across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring consistent, high-quality, and cost-effective legal support.
  • Manage legal matters requiring specialized external advice and facilitate coordination between internal stakeholders and external advisors.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategic Initiatives

  • Collaborate closely with business, finance, compliance, and operations teams to support regional business objectives.
  • Provide legal guidance on cross-functional projects and initiatives involving multiple business units or jurisdictions.
  • Facilitate effective communication between legal and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on legal requirements, commercial priorities, and operational needs.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing legal processes, operational efficiency, and risk management practices.

Qualifications & Experience

Education

  • Law degree from an accredited university or institution.
  • Admission to practice law in at least one jurisdiction.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant legal experience, either as in-house counsel or at a reputable law firm, preferably within a multinational or regional business environment.
  • Demonstrated experience advising on commercial contracts, corporate matters, and business operations.
  • Experience supporting legal and commercial activities across Latin America, particularly Mexico and Central America, is strongly preferred.
  • Previous experience in the media, entertainment, advertising, technology, or other fast-paced industries is considered an advantage.
  • Proven ability to provide practical legal advice while balancing regulatory requirements, risk management, and business objectives.

Languages

  • Fluency in Spanish and English, both written and spoken, is required.
  • Ability to draft, review, and negotiate legal documents and communicate effectively with stakeholders in both languages.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Business Acumen: Strong understanding of commercial operations and the ability to align legal recommendations with business objectives.
  • Legal Analysis & Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and address legal and regulatory risks while providing practical, solution-oriented guidance.
  • Contract Drafting & Negotiation: Excellent legal drafting, contract review, and negotiation skills.
  • Stakeholder Management: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build effective relationships with business leaders, cross-functional teams, and external advisors.
  • Strategic Thinking & Problem-Solving: Ability to evaluate complex legal matters, anticipate potential challenges, and recommend commercially viable solutions.
  • Organization & Prioritization: Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex legal concepts clearly to non-legal stakeholders.
  • Professional Integrity & Judgment: High ethical standards, discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment when handling sensitive or confidential matters.

job.title: Streaming Host/Reporter
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

STREAMING HOST/PRODUCER:


Are you a dynamic journalist who thrives in live coverage? Are you one in your family or friend group who is always explaining this week’s biggest news? Are you ready to be a news influencer?

We’re seeking a talented Streaming Host & Producer to join our team and help us captivate audiences with engaging content. As a Streaming Host & Producer, you’ll be the face of our digital platform, guiding viewers through live news events together and bringing clarity and focus to the most important news in the region.

What you’ll do:

  • Host Streaming News: Host a continuous live stream on a variety of news topics, from breaking news to politics to business and sports.
  • Produce High-Quality Content: Produce your own content, including explainer videos, longform podcast-style interviews, and live reports.
  • Connect with the Audience: Build a strong connection with our audience and your own unique audience through engaging conversations and social media interactions.
  • Stay Ahead of Trends: Stay informed on current events to identify potential content opportunities.
  • Collaborate with the Team: Work closely with producers and editors to create high-quality content.



What you’ll need:

  • A strong on-camera presence and excellent communication skills.
  • A strong understanding of social media platforms and digital trends. You will be editing and posting content on TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and Instagram both before and after your hosting and producing.
  • A confirmed skill set in streaming video production and editing; you will be operating live streaming technology LIVE as you host. editing and posting content.


If you’re ready to take your career to the next level, shakeup the news and information industry and become a leading voice in streaming media, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: VP, Media Technology Engineering
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX Corporation is seeking a high-impact Vice President, Media Technology Engineering to lead the engineering, implementation, and operational reliability of the technology environment supporting FOX News Media and Fox Television Stations.


This leader will oversee the teams responsible for operating and continuously improving the critical infrastructure that supports news gathering, live broadcast, production, post-production, playout, master control, transmission, and digital media distribution.


The role will lead a high-performing engineering organization responsible for network, compute, storage, virtualization, cloud infrastructure, broadcast systems, disaster recovery, and platform resiliency. The successful candidate will have deep experience operating highly available media environments and implementing complex broadcast technology transformations, including SMPTE ST 2110 video-over-IP systems.


Reporting to the SVP, Media Technology & Engineering, this role will partner closely with the VP, Media Technology Architecture and other technology leaders. The VP of Architecture will establish future-state architecture, standards, and technical direction. This role will own engineering execution, implementation, operational readiness, reliability, lifecycle management, and incident response.


Role Scope


The major areas of responsibility include:

  • Broadcast technology engineering and operations
  • SMPTE ST 2110 implementation and operational reliability
  • Network, compute, storage, and virtualization engineering
  • Hybrid cloud infrastructure operations
  • Station automation and delivery platforms
  • OTT, streaming, and OTA technology support
  • News and local production support
  • Media technology and transmission
  • Disaster recovery and platform resiliency
  • 24/7 technical operations and incident response

Responsibilities


Engineering Operations and Reliability


  • Lead the day-to-day engineering and operational support of mission-critical broadcast and media technology environments.
  • Ensure 24/7/365 availability, reliability, and operational readiness across broadcast, production, distribution, and transmission platforms.
  • Establish operating procedures, escalation paths, service expectations, and incident response practices.
  • Partner with Critical Response and Operations teams to manage major incidents, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
  • Monitor system health and ensure timely resolution of reliability, performance, and availability issues.

Broadcast Systems Implementation and Support


  • Lead the engineering implementation, integration, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management of broadcast technology platforms.
  • Support live news gathering, contribution, production, post-production, playout, master control, station automation, and transmission workflows.
  • Implement and operate SMPTE ST 2110 video-over-IP environments, including routing, timing, packet integrity, latency, and system interoperability.
  • Support the transition from SDI-based workflows to synchronized, software-defined IP media facilities in partnership with the Media Architecture team.
  • Maintain operational compatibility across existing systems while implementing new technology platforms.

Network and Infrastructure Engineering


  • Lead engineering execution across WAN, LAN, contribution networks, routing, switching, QoS, multicast, and high-capacity media connectivity.
  • Operate and optimize on-premise data centers, hybrid cloud infrastructure, enterprise virtualization, containerized environments, compute, storage, and related platforms.
  • Manage infrastructure lifecycle activities, including upgrades, capacity planning, patching, migrations, integrations, and technology refreshes.
  • Implement approved architecture and security standards in partnership with Media Architecture, Network Engineering, and Information Security.
  • Ensure infrastructure supports high-throughput, low-latency media workflows and enterprise data distribution.

Resiliency and Disaster Recovery


  • Implement and maintain disaster recovery, business continuity, redundancy, failover, and resiliency capabilities.
  • Conduct readiness testing and ensure recovery procedures are documented, current, and operationally viable.
  • Identify single points of failure and lead remediation efforts.
  • Partner with architecture and security teams to ensure resiliency requirements are incorporated into new implementations and major upgrades.

Project and Program Delivery


  • Partner with the PMO and Critical Response teams to deliver technology upgrades, expansions, migrations, integrations, and operational improvements.
  • Translate approved architecture and technical requirements into executable engineering plans.
  • Manage dependencies, technical risks, resource requirements, milestones, and operational readiness.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and with appropriate testing, documentation, training, and support plans.
  • Coordinate production cutovers and post-implementation support.

Performance Management and Optimization


  • Establish operational KPIs and service-level measures for availability, reliability, capacity, latency, incident response, and recovery.
  • Optimize monitoring, alerting, and alarming systems to reduce noise and improve response effectiveness.
  • Use performance data and operational trends to identify risks, capacity needs, and improvement opportunities.
  • Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, tools, and support models.

Vendor and Service Management


  • Manage operational relationships with key technology vendors and service providers.
  • Monitor vendor performance against service-level expectations.
  • Coordinate escalations, technical support, maintenance, and issue resolution.
  • Partner with Architecture and Procurement teams to validate technical requirements and support vendor evaluations.

Documentation and Compliance


  • Maintain accurate documentation for network, infrastructure, broadcast, transmission, security, and recovery environments.
  • Ensure engineering procedures align with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, security policies, and internal controls.
  • Maintain current system diagrams, runbooks, asset information, configuration records, recovery procedures, and support documentation.
  • Support operational audits, compliance reviews, and risk assessments.

Leadership and Talent Development


  • Lead and develop a high-performing engineering organization supporting complex, highly available media environments.
  • Establish clear team structures, accountabilities, operating rhythms, and performance expectations.
  • Mentor engineering leaders and technical talent.
  • Build a culture of operational excellence, accountability, collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to define requirements, manage expectations, and deliver reliable solutions.

Cross-Functional Partnership


  • Partner closely with the VP, Media Technology Architecture to execute approved technical strategies and standards.
  • Collaborate with Network Engineering, Information Security, Broadcast Operations, Media Services, Digital Platforms, News, Local Production, and Transmission teams.
  • Provide engineering input into architecture decisions based on operational requirements, reliability, supportability, and total cost of ownership.
  • Serve as the engineering voice during technology planning, implementation, and operational readiness reviews.

Continuous Improvement and Innovation


  • Evaluate emerging technologies for operational value, reliability, supportability, and compatibility with the FOX media environment.
  • Drive adoption of tools, frameworks, and methodologies that improve engineering effectiveness and standardize deployment procedures.
  • Maintain backward compatibility while modernizing technology platforms and operating practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve automation, observability, resiliency, and engineering productivity.

What You Will Need


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field, or equivalent executive experience.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in media technology, broadcast engineering, enterprise infrastructure, or related environments.
  • At least 5 years of senior leadership experience managing engineering or technology operations teams.
  • Proven experience leading engineering implementation and operational support for large-scale broadcast or media technology environments.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing and operating SMPTE ST 2110 uncompressed IP video production systems.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise networking, including routing, switching, QoS, multicast, WAN, LAN, and contribution networks.
  • Strong experience with on-premise data centers, hybrid cloud infrastructure, virtualization, compute, storage, and containerized environments.
  • Experience leading disaster recovery, resiliency, high availability, incident response, and business continuity programs.
  • Experience supporting news gathering, live production, post-production, playout, master control, station automation, transmission, OTT, streaming, or OTA delivery environments.
  • Strong project and program management skills focused on implementation, operational readiness, and reliability.
  • Experience managing technology vendors, service providers, escalations, and service-level performance.
  • Knowledge of DCIM, CMDB, IPAM, monitoring, observability, and infrastructure management systems.
  • Executive presence and the ability to communicate complex technical matters clearly to senior stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams through complex technical transformations while maintaining operational stability.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, 24/7 media environment.
  • Occasional domestic travel, up to 25%.

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

LiveNOW from FOX is looking for a Weekend Host/Producer to join FOX TV Stations’ national live streaming news offering. As the Weekend Host/Producer, you will be part of the team that keeps viewers informed and engaged at all hours of the day! You’ll get the best of both worlds – hosting live, on-air coverage and driving viewer engagement while supporting other hosts behind the scenes. This flexible role is ideal for a dynamic journalist who thrives both in front of the camera and behind the scenes. You’ll balance real-time coverage of what’s happening right now with forward-thinking content presentation and finding innovative ways to help viewers find the live events and latest updates they’re looking for.

LiveNOW brings viewers the most relevant and engaging live news coverage occurring right now across the country and the world. We are a team of passionate journalists and content producers seamlessly moving between the biggest events and stories as they happen to keep our audience informed. LiveNOW is always raw, live, and unfiltered, with limited commentary and no opinion.

**Only applications with a reel will be considered for this position. Reels may be submitted in your application as a link or attachment.

The schedule for this position will be Monday-Tuesday, Friday-Sunday.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Gather, produce, and present live coverage of breaking news and major events across digital, streaming, social, and broadcast platforms.

  • Host live streams, guiding viewers through developing stories in a clear, engaging, and informative manner.

  • Research, plan, and build editorial coverage, including booking guests, coordinating interviews, and preparing for upcoming news events.

  • Manage live video production elements including switching, graphics, and stream execution.

  • Monitor live feeds, wires, social media, and newsgathering tools to identify breaking news and emerging stories.

  • Execute and evolve the editorial plan, maintaining calendars and ensuring coverage is forward-looking and well-coordinated.

  • Collaborate with FOX O&O stations and internal/external partners to source live video, interviews, and content.

  • Pitch story ideas and contribute to editorial decision-making while upholding journalistic standards.

  • Monitor real-time analytics to inform coverage decisions and optimize content performance.

  • Support teammates across roles, including stepping in on-air or behind the scenes as needed.

  • Maintain strong relationships with key contacts and sources to support coverage.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Strong knowledge of current events and a deep understanding of how audiences consume news across digital platforms.

  • Proven ability to communicate clearly and confidently both on-air and behind the scenes in a fast-paced, unscripted breaking news environment.

  • Excellent editorial judgment, research skills, and attention to detail.

  • Experience with digital news production, live streaming workflows, and newsroom technologies (e.g., TriCaster or similar).

  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and think several steps ahead.

  • Ability to thrive under pressure and pivot quickly as news develops.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

  • Proficiency in newsgathering tools, social media, and digital analytics platforms.

  • On-camera hosting or reporting experience required.

  • Flexibility to work varied hours, weekends, and holidays as news demands.

Why Join LiveNOW from FOX?

At LiveNOW, you’ll be part of a team redefining how news is delivered in the digital era. We bring audiences live, unfiltered news and events from around the country in real time—no scripts, no anchors, just the story as it unfolds. With millions of viewers tuning in across multiple platforms, this is your chance to help shape the future of live digital journalism.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $75,000.00-85,000.00 annually. This role is also eligible for various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents. Benefits for Union represented employees will be in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

View more detail about FOX Benefits.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Integrated Media Specialist (Account Executive– Outside Sales)

Territory-Based | Hybrid | Client-Facing Market Role

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network Location: Outside Sales, territory-based role in Nashville, TN | Hybrid (Remote + In-territory + 1 day in-office)

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role

Our Integrated Media Specialist role is a consultative, relationship-driven sales position for someone who loves owning the full sales cycle—from net-new prospecting through long-term account growth—and who thrives in both hunting and managing client relationships.

In this role, you will actively hunt for net-new business, while also managing, growing, and expanding an ongoing book of clients. You’ll create tailored marketing strategies, guide businesses from first conversation through ongoing performance discussions, and continually identify opportunities to deepen partnerships over time. You’ll act as a trusted marketing partner—not a transactional seller—balancing new business development with retention, upsell, and account expansion to drive long-term client value.

Our Integrated Media Specialist role is partnered with a post-sales team that manages campaign performance, optimizes results, and prepares reporting. Additional support resources are available, including the Data and Insights team, Client Strategists, and other product-specific resources.

In your first 90 days, you’ll gain confidence in LocaliQ’s solutions, tools, and sales approach while building meaningful prospecting and discovery habits. By the end of this period, you’ll be owning your territory and sales cycle end-to-end, with the support and coaching needed to set you up for long-term success.

Why This Role Stands Out:

Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and strong earning potential

Contests, and recognition programs for top performers

Consultative, full-cycle sales role with ownership from first conversation through long-term account growth

Hybrid flexibility with autonomy to manage your schedule and territory

Strong onboarding, coaching, and sales enablement to support a successful ramp

Access to an extensive mix of digital and traditional marketing solutions, enabling consultative, end-to-end strategies tailored to each client’s growth objectives

Career progression into senior sales and leadership roles

Backed by marketing expertise, post-sale specialists, and industry-leading tools

What You Will Do

Build a consistent prospecting cadence using cold calls, email, social outreach, networking, and in-person or virtual meetings to develop a strong pipeline.

Manage and grow a territory by balancing new business development, client retention, and account expansion.

Lead thoughtful discovery conversations to understand business goals, marketing challenges, and growth opportunities.

Build and present data-informed digital and traditional marketing proposals that connect strategy, tactics, and budget to client goals.

Own the full sales cycle—from initial outreach through close—while maintaining accurate CRM activity, pipeline management, and forecasting.

Partner with internal account management, creative, and strategy teams to support strong client outcomes.

Stay engaged post-sale through reporting, optimization, and performance conversations that support renewals and continued growth.

Qualifications

3+ years of B2B sales experience with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles (experience level may vary by market and role level; Recruiter to update).

Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, networking, and relationship-based outreach.

Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.

Comfort learning and discussing digital marketing solutions such as search, social, display, and video (direct experience is a plus, not required).

Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders, influencing decisions through clear data-driven recommendations.

Proficiency with CRM, Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Perplexity.

Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance

Who Thrives Here

High performers in this role are resilient, self-motivated, strategic and creative minded and competitive, with a strong drive to outperform and continuously take on greater impact. They are coachable and highly self-directed, comfortable initiating outreach, staying organized, asking thoughtful questions, and using data and tools to work efficiently. Energized by real-time results, they handle rejection well and maintain full ownership of their performance and trajectory.

Benefits

We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills.

Competitive base salary + Uncapped commission opportunity

401(k) with company match

Career progression opportunities

Flexibility and autonomy in a hybrid/remote work environment

High-performance culture with recognition, incentives

Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more

Unlimited MTO time off, including paid holidays

Structured onboarding to get you ramped fast

Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders

Access to industry-leading tools, resources, and marketing expertise

Step into a territory where you can own the full sales cycle, bring smart marketing solutions to the table, and be recognized for the results you deliver. If you’re ready to grow your career and be part of a high-performing team, we encourage you to apply.

#LI-AM #LI-Hybrid

job.title: Account Manager - Local Markets
job.description:
Are you passionate about building strong client relationships and helping businesses get better results from their marketing?

As an Account Manager, you’ll serve as a trusted partner to our clients, helping them get the most from their digital and traditional marketing strategies. You’ll manage relationships after the sale, collaborate with Sales and campaign optimization teams, and use performance insights to help clients achieve their business goals.

You’ll work across solutions including paid search, programmatic display, social media, email, digital and print advertising, turning campaign performance into clear recommendations and opportunities for growth.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, analyzing results, and working in a fast-paced digital marketing environment.

What You’ll Do

Own and grow client relationships, serving as a primary point of contact and trusted marketing partner.

Partner closely with Sales and campaign optimization teams to develop strategies aligned with each client’s goals.

Monitor campaign performance, identify trends, and turn data into actionable recommendations that improve results and ROI.

Lead regular client performance conversations and clearly communicate campaign results, successes, opportunities, and next steps.

Advise clients on digital marketing strategies across paid search, display, social, email, and other digital channels.

Identify opportunities to strengthen client strategies, improve campaign performance, and expand the value of our partnership.

Coordinate with internal teams, including digital solutions and ad operations, to ensure campaigns are executed effectively.

Proactively address client questions or concerns while keeping internal partners aligned.

Stay current on evolving digital marketing trends, technologies, and best practices.

Look for ways to improve processes and create a seamless experience for both clients and internal teams.

What You Bring

3+ years of client-facing account management or customer success experience.

2+ years of experience with digital advertising or marketing campaigns.

Strong understanding of digital marketing channels such as Google Ads, paid search/PPC, programmatic display, social advertising, email marketing, and web analytics/GA4.

Proven ability to build strong client relationships and communicate effectively with a variety of stakeholders.

Ability to analyze campaign performance and translate data into clear, meaningful recommendations for clients.

Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.

Comfort working in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where priorities and strategies can evolve.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint.

Google Ads and/or Google Analytics certification preferred.

What Will Help You Thrive

You’ll be successful in this role if you are:

Client-focused: You genuinely enjoy helping clients succeed and building long-term partnerships.

Strategic and analytical: You can connect campaign performance to broader business goals.

Proactive: You look for opportunities and solutions before being asked.

Collaborative: You enjoy working across Sales, campaign optimization, operations, and other teams.

Adaptable: You’re comfortable navigating change and the evolving digital marketing landscape.

A strong communicator: You can make complex marketing concepts understandable and relevant to clients.

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, our mission is to help businesses connect with more customers and achieve meaningful growth through powerful marketing solutions.

We believe great work happens when people feel supported, valued, and empowered to make an impact. You’ll join a collaborative team of digital marketing professionals who are passionate about helping businesses succeed while continuing to learn, innovate, and grow.

#LI-REMOTE#LOCALiQ #LI-LL

The annualized base salary for this role will be $50,000,00 - $55,000.00.  Variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role may be applicable. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, location, and union representation, if applicable.

job.title: Account Manager - Local Markets
job.description:
The Account Manager role is responsible for building, maintaining, & growing relationships with clients by managing their advertising campaigns across multiple publishers/platforms (ex. search, display, social ads, digital, and print media, etc.). The primary focus is ensuring our clients achieve & exceed their desired marketing goals through strategic campaign planning, and data analysis. As the Account Manager, you will act as the primary point of contact for client concerns and needs post-sales.

Must possess strong expertise in existing & emerging business marketing solutions, coupled with the ability to collaborate with our sales partners, post sales optimizers to identify opportunities, and effectively deliver solutions that maximize a client's ROI; are minimum expectations. In this dynamic role, a change-minded person will be crucial for effectively navigating the ever-evolving landscape of digital and traditional marketing concepts. Seamlessly, the AM will integrate with various teams and adapt to new challenges, ensuring that strategies remain agile and responsive to client needs.

Position Requirements:

Closely partner with sales team(s), in owning the client relationship by: building solid rapport, demonstrating transparency, & delivering results against joint business objectives.

Understand, manage, and anticipate client expectations, gain client alignment, and fully mobilize/engage partner teams against the aligned approach while maintaining a strong communicative relationship.

Create a consistent open line of communication ensuring our value story & service successes are in parallel to a client's needs/goals via performance reviews (Weekly, Monthly, etc.)

Articulate media programs to devise appropriate strategies and campaign implementation plans

Work alongside our sales, and post sales optimization teams to formulate and act upon appropriate digital strategies and executions. These actions will aid in meeting and exceeding our clients' business goals.

Advise our clients on how best to leverage feasible ongoing and impending marketing strategies.

Ensure a highly consistent marketing message across paid search, organic presence, display, social media, and O&O digital/print marketing channels.

Daily proficiency in customer relationship management, online search, and display advertising techniques and LocaliQ proprietary technologies.

Review day to day campaign performance in collaboration with post sales optimization counterparts, assess digital campaign trends, facilitate client advertising performance discussions, & identify proactively creative new advertising techniques to further our client’s digital marketing needs.

Hold primary responsibility for communicating and collaborating with backend support resources including, but not limited to, various digital solutions and ad operations teams, focused on delivering and exceeding client objectives (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, As Needed).

Key Skills:

Ability to quickly master business process, marketing, and technology concepts

Demonstrated expertise in customer relationship management

Mastery of key technologies and systems to review and advise on digital marketing campaigns

Advanced capabilities to effectively understand and speak toward digital advertising campaigns –Search, Display, Marketing Management Systems, traditional marketing endeavors etc.

Strong technical skills to recommend, assess, modify/adjust, & routinely improve marketing campaigns over their lifecycle

Demonstrated expertise with digital marketing publishing systems & processes

Excellent verbal & written communication skills

Demonstrate understanding of how retail/service media, sales, and operations work together to successfully drive a business

Proven track record in relationship building and account management

Works efficiently and is always looking to streamline processes & workflows

Moderate Excel and PowerPoint skills required

Key Competencies:

Marketing Concepts & Digital Marketing Acumen: pay-per-click, programmatic display, social, email marketing, and tracking concepts (Analytics/GA4), Leads, etc.)

Customer Focus

Proactive Creative & Analytical Thinking

Business Process & Technology Acumen

Team Collaboration

Conflict Management

Flexible With Change Management

Proven Success in Implementing Ideas in a Fast- Paced Environment

Attentive To Detail

About You:

Bachelor's degree in general business, economics, finance, marketing, advertising, public relations, journalism, or English

2+ years of hands-on experience managing online/digital advertising campaigns

Must have 3+ years of client-facing service/account management experience

Google Ads & Google Analytics Certified

About Us:

Are you looking for a company that values innovation, passion, and a healthy work/life balance? A job where you feel supported and appreciated? At LocaliQ, we know our employees drive success, and we strive to create a thriving company culture where you will enjoy coming to work every day. Here, you can walk through the halls and bump into our CEO, catch an inter-office ping pong tournament, or support a local cause with your fellow employees. Are you ready to join a company where you can have fun and work with some of brightest people in digital marketing? Our mission is to help local businesses all over the world reach more local customers online. As a leader in powering online marketing for local businesses, LocaliQ has been recognized for outstanding products and exceptional employees, having won Google’s Quality Account Champion in North America and Google’s Innovation Champion Award in Canada. LocaliQ is headquartered in Woodland Hills, CA, & Frisco, TX, with over 35 locations throughout the United States, Canada, India, Australia, New Zealand, and Brazil.LocalIQ is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants for all job openings are welcome and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by state, federal or local law. It is the intent of the Company to comply with all applicable federal, state and local legislation concerning equal opportunity in employment. In this role, you’ll serve as a trusted marketing partner to our clients, helping them get the most from their advertising investment. You’ll oversee campaigns across channels including paid search, programmatic display, social media, digital and print media, using performance insights to recommend strategies that support each client’s business goals.

You’ll collaborate closely with Sales, campaign optimization, digital solutions, and ad operations teams to deliver an exceptional client experience. Partner with Sales and campaign optimization teams to understand client goals and develop strategies designed to maximize performance and ROI.

Recommend new strategies, products, and tactics based on evolving client needs and marketing trends.

Help clients understand not just what their campaigns are doing, but why it matters to their business.

Collaborate with internal digital solutions, optimization, and ad operations teams to resolve challenges and deliver against client objectives.

Ensure clients receive a cohesive marketing experience across multiple channels and solutions.

job.title: AI-Assisted Reporter
job.description:
AI-Assisted Reporter — TODAY Californian

Team: Content AI Location: Remote; candidate must be located in California Schedule: Full-time; flexible hours aligned to news demands

The role:

USA TODAY NETWORK is seeking an AI-Assisted Reporter to support TODAY Californian coverage with fast, accurate, high-volume journalism. This role is built for a reporter who can turn a wide range of source material into useful, publishable coverage for readers across California.

This is not a traditional beat role. You will use approved AI tools and newsroom workflows to accelerate production, identify coverage opportunities, and help turn timely information into strong journalism. At USA TODAY Co., AI serves journalism — never the other way around.

What you’ll do:

Produce and publish high-quality California coverage using AI-assisted workflows.

Convert source material such as advisories, public information, data, press materials, and other structured inputs into articles, explainers, summaries, and service pieces.

Adapt stories for different audience needs, including shorter versions, “what to know” formats, local-to-state framing, and state-to-local framing.

Verify facts, names, dates, locations, and claims; conduct interviews or additional reporting when needed.

Work with editors and cross-functional partners to keep coverage accurate, timely, and reader-focused.

Help improve and document repeatable workflows that can be reused across the newsroom.

What we’re looking for:

Requirements:

Newsroom experience producing accurate journalism under deadline pressure.

Comfort working independently and managing a steady production workload.

Strong verification instincts and accountability for published work.

Experience with service journalism, local news, or high-volume digital production.

Comfort using public data, search tools, and CMS workflows.

Experience adapting stories for different formats and audience needs.

Application Instructions

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, please submit:

Your resume – one to two pages.

A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.

Samples of your work.

Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.   #Newsgnt#LI-NC1#LI-Remote

The hourly rate for this role will range between $24.04 and $28.85.  Base compensation is reflective of many factors, including, but not limited to, the market in which one lives/works, individual education level, skills, certifications and experience.   Note: variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable.

job.title: Apprentice (Press Operator I)
job.description:
Press Operator I - Apprentice

Gannett Publishing ServicesPeoria, ILWE ARE OFFERING A STARTING HOURLY WAGE OF $18 PER HOURThe Apprentice - Press Operator position is assigned to learn & perform printing related tasks that may include, but are not limited to: Newsprint reel set-up & operation; newsprint staging; roll preparation; plate processing; placing printing plates; basic ink setting; equipment maintenance; and specified reporting.The primary objective is to support efficient press operations as needed to achieve & maintain on-time production, product quality standards, low waste, and operational safety. Works as part of a press crew to coordinate press & plate operations during an assigned shift.Must be reliable, report to scheduled shifts on-time and ready to begin work.

Work as a team to achieve & maintain on-time press performance

Work as a team to achieve & maintain product quality standards

Work as a team to meet waste goals

Assist with plate, reel room & press operations as assigned

Requirements:

This position requires a high school education or equivalent.

Experience in web offset printing is desirable, although production experience of any kind may be helpful.

Mechanical ability and familiarity with computers is preferred.

job.title: Breaking News Reporter
job.description:
The Cincinnati Enquirer/cincinnati.com part of the USA TODAY NETWORK, is seeking a digital-first reporter to be part of the Breaking News team.

Job Details:

This reporter will be at the center of the region's biggest stories, from breaking crime and public safety news to severe weather. The reporter understands that breaking news is often the front door to deeper accountability and enterprise reporting.  A great breaking news reporter cuts through official-speak and lets the community know what’s happening clearly and concisely. We’re looking for a reporter who goes beyond standard press releases, digging into how and why things happen. Reporters on this team also pursue explainers, features and other enterprise stories that reflect life in Greater Cincinnati.  The position requires urgency, curiosity, accuracy and a willingness to chase news wherever it leads. It also demands strong news judgment and the ability to find and identify stories with impact and reflect the community through the inclusion of a variety of voices.

About The Enquirer:

The Enquirer, founded in 1851, serves communities in southwest Ohio and Northern Kentucky. With major league sports (go Bengals!), a blossoming food and craft beer scene, hundreds of parks, world-class performing arts and eight Fortune 500 companies, Cincinnati offers the amenities of a big city with the comfort and charm of a small town.

Responsibilities:

Monitor real-time news and sniff out stories that are important to our audiences.

Report quickly, clearly and accurately and deliver news via stories, video, newsletters, Facebook, X, Instagram, TikTok or any other methods available to reach our audience and develop new audiences.

Use metrics to inform story choices and shape beat strategies.

Work a schedule that may include nights, weekends and whenever news demands.

Work with editors to experiment with new ways of informing and engaging audiences on social platforms and through alternate story forms. This includes long-tail (evergreen) content.

Requirements:

Bachelor's or master’s in communications, journalism or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

2 + years of reporting experience, applicants with less experience and strong clips may be considered.

Proven ability to write on deadline.

Exceptional core journalism skills (reporter, producing, editing). Strong command of AP grammar and style.

Familiarity with public records and their use in reporting.

Self-motivation and self-direction.

Photo and video skills.

Effective communicator; able to get along with diverse personalities.

Knows how to use time effectively in a 24-hour news environment.

Works collaboratively within a cross-functional environment.

Must embrace peer-to-peer feedback and training.

Applies innovative, creative thinking to support the company's goals.

Industry knowledge.

Organizational skills.

Command of media law and Principles of Ethical Conduct.

This position sometimes requires employees to work extended hours, evening, weekends and holidays, sometimes unexpectedly.

This role requires a valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and the minimum liability insurance required by state law.

Employment is contingent on passing a post-offer pre-employment background check, motor vehicle record check.

job.title: Chief Product Officer
job.description:
Chief Product Officer (CPO) serves as a core member of the executive team, reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, leading the transformation of our product ecosystem into a growth engine for a modern, digital-first media enterprise. This role is central to transforming USA TODAY Co. into a customer-centric, product-led, digitally scaled media enterprise. The CPO will help unlock new growth pathways, leveraging the diversity of the product portfolio, to modernize the product ecosystem, and ensure the company remains competitive in a rapidly evolving media and technology landscape.

This role will define and execute an integrated product vision, strategy, and roadmap across consumer, advertising, and platform experiences—ensuring alignment with company strategy, changing customer needs, and long-term growth objectives. The CPO will partner closely with the CEO and executive leadership team to drive product-led growth, innovation, and differentiated user experiences across USA TODAY and the broader network. Consistent with enterprise priorities, this leader will combine deep product expertise, media industry knowledge, and technology-driven innovation to accelerate revenue growth, audience engagement, customer expansion and loyalty and platform scalability.

• This role is central to transforming USA TODAY Co. into a product-led, digitally scaled media enterprise

• The CPO will leverage the breadth of the product portfolio and potential to unlock new growth pathways, modernize the product ecosystem, and ensure the company remains competitive in a rapidly evolving media and technology landscape

Key Responsibilities

1. Define and Align Enterprise Product Strategy

• Define and communicate a clear, compelling multi-year product vision and strategy aligned with company growth goals

• Translate strategy into actionable product roadmaps, investment priorities, and measurable outcomes

• Ensure product initiatives directly support revenue growth, customer acquisition, retention, and engagement, purposefully elevating the overall quality and reliability of the experience across channels and platforms, and safeguarding consumer trust across our product portfolio

• Serve as the executive owner of product portfolio performance across consumer, B2B, and platform products

2. Drive and Scale Product-Led Growth & Innovation

• Drive a product-led growth model across all digital products and platforms

• Identify and scale new opportunities across subscriptions, advertising, data products, and emerging revenue streams

• Lead innovation across AI, personalization, content experiences, and platform capabilities

• Ensure rapid experimentation, testing, and data-driven iteration across the product lifecycle

• Build efficient and fast-cycle development and learning as a practice and cultural norm

3. End-to-End Product Lifecycle Ownership

• Oversee the full product lifecycle: discovery, development, launch, optimization, and sunsetting

• Ensure a strong focus on customer needs, user experience, and product-market fit

• Deepen understanding of the customer, championing customer-centricity throughout the entire product lifecycle.

• Establish clear product KPIs, OKRs, and performance management systems tied to business outcomes

• Leverage analytics to continuously optimize product performance and decision-making

4. Cross-Functional Leadership

• Partner with Technology, Data, Content, Revenue, Marketing, and Operations leaders to deliver cohesive product experiences

• Align engineering capabilities, monetization strategies, and go-to-market execution to achieve product strategy

• Act as a key connector across teams to ensure speed, prioritization clarity, and execution discipline

• Collaborate with the executive team on capital allocation, strategic tradeoffs, and transformation priorities

5. Organization Leadership & Talent Development

• Shape and lead a high-performing design and product organizations (product management, UX, product analytics)

• Establish best-in-class product management disciplines, operating rhythms, and governance models

• Attract, develop, and retain top product and digital talent

• Foster a culture of customer-centricity, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement

6. Market Leadership & External Engagement

• Act as a visible leader externally representing USA TODAY Co.’s product vision with partners, investors, and the broader market

• Monitor industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies to inform product strategy

• Bring external perspective from high-growth technology environments to accelerate transformation

Qualifications & Experience

Leadership Experience

• 15+ years of progressive product leadership experience, including senior executive roles

• Proven success leading product organizations in high-growth technology companies

• Demonstrated impact driving product-led growth, digital transformation, and revenue expansion

Industry Expertise

• Strong experience in both:

o Technology-driven product environments (SaaS, platforms, marketplaces, or digital ecosystems)

o Media, content, or digital publishing companies with scaled audiences

Functional Expertise

• Deep expertise across:

o Product strategy and roadmap development

o Customer experience and user-centered design

o Data, analytics, and experimentation frameworks

o Monetization models (subscription, advertising, data-driven products)

• Proven ability to align product, technology, and commercial strategies

Leadership Capabilities

• Strategic thinker with strong business and financial acumen

• Exceptional cross-functional leader with ability to influence at executive and board levels

• Track record of building and scaling high-performing teams and organizations

• Comfort operating in complex, fast-changing environments with competing priorities

Personal Attributes

• Visionary and growth-oriented, with an entrepreneurial mindset

• Customer-obsessed with strong intuition for user needs and product-market fit

• Data-driven decision-maker with bias for action and experimentation

• Highly collaborative, capable of aligning diverse stakeholders

• Resilient, adaptable, and energized by large-scale transformation and change

job.title: Director, Technical Product Management – Audience
job.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and commercially minded Product Director to lead the evolution of our audience, media, and advertising platform capabilities. This leader will define and deliver product strategy across audience solutions, programmatic advertising, and the integration of owned media into a unified commercial experience.

The role will turn audience insights, media assets, and performance data into differentiated products that are easy to sell, plan, activate, measure, and optimize. It is an opportunity to shape a foundational growth platform at the intersection of product, data, advertising technology, and commercial transformation.

What You Will Own

Audience Strategy & Product Development

Define and execute the vision, product strategy, and roadmap for audience capabilities.

Build differentiated products using first-party, behavioral, contextual, geographic, and advertiser-permissioned data.

Create packaging, activation, pricing, measurement, and reporting frameworks.

Advance segmentation, enrichment, identity, insights, and responsible data use.

Owned Media Integration & Unified Workflows

Integrate owned media inventory and audience signals into planning, selling, delivery, and reporting workflows.

Define the target experience across planning, order management, inventory, campaign delivery, optimization, and measurement.

Connect advertising, commercial, data, and reporting capabilities through clear platform boundaries.

Simplify fragmented workflows and reduce manual handoffs.

Programmatic Monetization

Own the strategy for direct and automated media offerings across multiple buying models.

Improve yield and inventory utilization while protecting customer value and premium experiences.

Advance forecasting, pricing, packaging, decisioning, and campaign optimization.

Use performance data and market insights to prioritize investment and validate product-market fit.

Commercialization & Leadership

Build business cases, launch plans, adoption strategies, and success measures.

Lead across Sales, Client Success, Marketing, Data, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Privacy.

Guide roadmap, investment, dependency, and trade-off decisions with senior stakeholders.

Develop product talent and influence matrixed teams across the organization.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of product management experience in digital advertising, advertising technology, media platforms, data products, or related fields.

5+ years leading complex platform products, major integrations, or multi-team transformation initiatives.

Strong understanding of programmatic advertising, digital media monetization, audience products, campaign workflows, and advertising operations.

Experience translating customer and commercial problems into platform strategy, roadmaps, product requirements, and measurable outcomes.

Strong analytical and commercial judgment, executive communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Technical & Domain Expertise

Deep working knowledge of Google Ad Manager or a comparable enterprise ad server, including orders, line items, targeting, pacing, creative trafficking, and reporting integrations.

Experience with advertising order-to-cash ecosystems, including booking, pricing, fulfillment, billing, and revenue-recognition processes to connect with ad-serving and reporting platforms.

Understanding modern cloud data platforms and warehouses, such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks, including audience tables, identity graphs, data marts, and scalable reporting layers.

Expertise in audience and identity architecture, including first-party identity resolution, consumer graphs, segment taxonomies, known and anonymous audiences, and deterministic and probabilistic matching.

Experience defining API and integration patterns, including REST or GraphQL, event-driven contracts, system-of-record boundaries, and data synchronization across commercial, advertising, and reporting systems.

Strong understanding of media monetization and yield concepts, including CPM pricing, rate cards, floor strategies, margin structures, premium and remnant inventory, and cross-channel revenue attribution.

Knowledge of cross-channel audience activation from owned environments into social, video, and demand-side advertising platforms.

Knowledge of data-modeling and SQL, including dimensional models for campaign, impression, audience, and revenue data; sold-versus-delivered reconciliation; complex joins; window functions; and performance optimization on large datasets.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience launching audience-based solutions and enabling commercial teams to bring new capabilities to the market.

Experience integrating advertising, customer-management, order-management, reporting, or revenue platforms.

Familiarity with AI-assisted media planning, campaign optimization, and decision-support products.

Experience integrating customer relationship management and commercial workflow platforms, including campaign planning, quote-to-cash, and opportunity-to-order processes in a media sales environment. Experience with Salesforce or an equivalent platform is beneficial.

Experience with business intelligence and reporting platforms that surface campaign, audience, and revenue insights to commercial teams and customers. Familiarity with tools such as Looker, Tableau, or comparable reporting solutions is beneficial.

Understanding of creative fulfillment workflows, including how creative assets are requested, produced, approved, and routed into advertising delivery systems. Experience with commercial creative workflow platforms is beneficial.

Working knowledge of Python or a similar language for prototyping, data validation, analysis, and workflow automation.

MBA or equivalent experience leading product strategy and commercial transformation.
