job.title: Enterprise Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive - Performance Marketing – Outside Sales

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network Location: USA Remote with some travel

Why This Role Stands Out:

Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and strong earning potential Visibility, recognition, and growth opportunities within a performance‑driven, enterprise sales environment

Access to the full USA TODAY Network + additional partners—860+ markets, trusted media assets, and subscriber‑based audiences at scale

True ownership of enterprise relationships with the autonomy to build and grow a national book of business

Remote flexibility with autonomy to manage your schedule and territory with some travel

Structured onboarding, coaching, and sales support to help you ramp quickly

Career Development – Clear paths to career advancement, mentor programs, and tools to manage your long-term career.

Backed by marketing expertise, post‑sale specialists, and industry‑leading tool

About LocaliQ:

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role:

This is an enterprise-level role focused on C-suite conversations rather than local business owners. PIQ is a performance-based marketing program that converts print advertising space into marketing opportunities on a revenue-share, cost-per-acquisition, or cost-per-lead model. The PIQ Account Executive tells an enterprise story about partnership relationships—not transactional relationships—leveraging USA TODAY’s entire asset base to partner with national and regional clients. The role aligns with national sales efforts and one-to-many programs, focusing on enterprise-level relationships that allow the company to leverage its full scale.

In your first 90 days, you’ll ramp into the PIQ enterprise story—gaining a deep understanding of our performance-based model, how we partner with C-suite leaders, and how our national scale creates value for enterprise clients. As you progress, you’ll begin building and advancing a strong enterprise pipeline while establishing core sales rhythms and collaborating closely with internal strategists. By the end of this period, you’ll be confidently owning enterprise opportunities and leading complex, high-impact deals with support from a seasoned cross-functional team.

What You Will Do:

Generate a sales pipeline through self-directed prospecting using ZoomInfo, LinkedIn, attendance at vertical-specific expos, referrals from existing clients, and AI tools for finding leads and building outreach strategies.

Qualify and pursue enterprise level opportunities—focus on prospects capable of $150,000+ deals selling to C-suite and marketing directors at regional, state, and national level.

Deliver the PIQ value proposition—one-to-one exclusive leads to subscriber-based audience, with high frequency exposure through trusted USA TODAY content, and scale across 860 markets/publications.

Collaborate with strategists on proposals for deals exceeding $150,000; quarterback internal resources to design, build, and deliver campaigns.

Manage and grow existing accounts; maintain weekly client touchpoints to drive retention and expansion.

Lead cross-functional delivery—delegate effectively, maintain quality control, run pod cadences, and own outcomes while leveraging specialist expertise

Track performance data—monitor campaign metrics, set clear expectations, review performance regularly, address issues early, and resolve problems through appropriate specialists.

Maintain client data in Salesforce—log activities, track pipeline, and forecast accurately.

Qualifications:

5+ years’ proven track record of success in B2B sales, with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles, selling to the C-suite or marketing director level on deals that exceed $150K+

Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, networking, and relationship-based outreach.

Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Perplexity.

Digital acumen—understanding of digital marketing landscape and performance-based marketing models.

Data-minded, able to understand tracking, performance metrics for client campaigns and developing strategies from that data.

Experience working with agencies and understanding agency operations and relationships.

Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders.

Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance

Who Thrives Here:

You’ll thrive here as a self‑motivated, competitive, and consultative seller who owns a book of business, creates opportunities, and confidently leads complex deals. Top performers are data‑driven, resilient, and results‑focused—energized by real‑time performance metrics and rankings, motivated by commission upside, and accountable for outcomes. They consistently outperform peers, earn expanded roles or territories, and effectively quarterback internal teams to deliver measurable client impact.

Benefits:

We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills.

Competitive base salary + uncapped commission opportunity

401(k) with company match

Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more

Unlimited MTO time off, including paid holidays

Structured onboarding to get you ramped fast

Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders

Flexibility and Autonomy: remote work environment

Access to industry-leading tools, resources and marketing expertise

Career development opportunities

High-performance culture with recognition, incentives, and contests

#LI-REMOTE#LOCALiQ

If you’re energized by enterprise level selling, motivated by performance and ownership, and ready to build something meaningful at scale, this role was designed for you. Apply now to bring your expertise, ambition, and curiosity to PIQ—and be part of a high‑impact team shaping the future of performance marketing.

job.title: High School Sports Reporter (Wilmington DE Guild)
job.description:
Inform readers, celebrate achievement and demand accountability.

We are seeking a High School Sports Reporter to help lead our coverage of local teams and athletes while becoming a prominent on-camera voice. The reporter will produce frequent field video and authoritative rankings of teams, players, games and performances that keep fans returning throughout the season. The role also includes breaking news, major events and distinctive enterprise reporting.

Video and high-interest rankings are central to the job. The reporter will create mobile-first updates, interviews, analysis and personality-driven features, along with recurring lists of top teams, players, games and performances. Other coverage will include daily stories, investigations, explainers, profiles, newsletters and service journalism—all designed to build readership and subscriptions.

What you’ll do:

Partner with our current high school reporter to own the high school sports beat by developing deep knowledge of local teams, athletes, coaches, athletic directors and governing organizations.

Shoot and edit vertical video, conduct interviews and become a recognizable on-camera personality who can host and analyze high school sports coverage.

Break news with urgency and accuracy, including off-field developments, policy changes and other issues affecting student-athletes and school communities.

Publish a regular cadence of authoritative rankings and compelling lists of teams, players, games, matchups and standout performances, backed by clear reporting and analysis. Add timely previews, profiles, trend and investigative stories, reader polls and postseason honors.

Build and maintain a diverse network of sources and consistently identify distinctive stories that competitors do not have.

Use newsletters, social platforms, audience data, reader feedback and verified real-time reporting to strengthen engagement, reach new readers and convert loyal audiences into subscribers.

Work independently on deadline and collaborate closely with editors, photographers and other journalists to set priorities and coordinate coverage.

Pitch ambitious enterprise and accountability stories that examine trends, decisions and institutions influencing high school sports.

What you’ll need:

A bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

At least two years of journalism experience, with demonstrated reporting and writing ability; sports reporting experience is preferred.

Strong news judgment, high ethical standards and a proven ability to source, report and break news.

Clear, engaging writing and the ability to deliver accurate work on tight deadlines.

Demonstrated video production skills, including shooting and editing, plus the confidence and presence to appear regularly on camera and build a credible, engaging connection with viewers.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance breaking news, daily assignments and longer-term projects.

Experience building and engaging digital audiences, using metrics, emerging tools and responsible applications of artificial intelligence to improve reporting, presentation and reach.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, along with the initiative to work independently.

A commitment to inclusive sourcing and coverage that reflects the breadth of the communities we serve.

Work requirements:

This position requires regular night and weekend work based on the sports calendar, as well as travel to games, practices, interviews and other assignments. Reliable transportation is required. The reporter must be comfortable working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and adjusting coverage plans as news develops.

How to apply:

Applicants should submit a resume and three to five work samples that demonstrate reporting, writing and digital storytelling skills. Video or multimedia work samples are required.

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by combining trusted local media, advanced marketing technology, and expert guidance to deliver measurable results. From digital advertising solutions to the reach of the USA TODAY Network, we help businesses connect with the right customers and grow with confidence.

As an Account Advisor, you'll play an important role in helping local businesses succeed by managing customer relationships, identifying new opportunities, and recommending advertising strategies that drive results. You'll work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where daily activity, consistency, and customer focus are rewarded.

In this role, you'll manage an existing book of business while actively prospecting for new clients. You'll conduct a high volume of outbound outreach, build relationships with business owners, recommend customized advertising solutions, and guide clients through short, transactional sales cycles. Every day brings a blend of prospecting, account management, follow-up, and campaign coordination, making this an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys staying busy and seeing the direct results of their effort.

During your first 90 days, you'll learn LocaliQ's products, sales process, and technology while building strong daily habits around prospecting, client management, and pipeline organization. With ongoing coaching and support, you'll quickly develop the confidence to manage your book of business and consistently achieve your performance goals.

Base salary of $40,000 plus uncapped commission with first-year on-target earnings of $55,000–$60,000

Three-month commission guarantee to support your onboarding and ramp

100% remote work environment with flexibility to work from home

Existing customer base combined with new business opportunities

Recognition programs, contests, and performance incentives

Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, and more

What You Will Do

Execute a high volume of outbound and inbound sales activity, averaging 50+ calls per day.

Manage and grow an existing portfolio of advertising clients while identifying opportunities for retention, upselling, and expansion.

Prospect for new business through consistent outbound outreach and follow-up.

Recommend customized print and digital advertising solutions that align with client goals.

Guide clients through short, transactional sales cycles with urgency and accuracy.

Process advertising orders, campaign updates, and client requests efficiently.

Maintain organized CRM activity, pipeline management, and accurate documentation using Salesforce and other sales tools.

Balance prospecting, customer communication, administrative work, and campaign management throughout each day.

Partner with internal support teams to ensure a positive client experience and successful campaign execution.

Qualifications

Sales experience in inside sales, customer service, retail sales, business development, or another customer-facing environment preferred.

Comfortable making 50+ outbound calls per day in a metrics-driven environment.

Strong communication skills with confidence speaking with business owners over the phone.

Excellent organization, time management, and multitasking abilities.

Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment.

Ability to quickly learn CRM platforms, sales technology, and multiple internal systems.

Coachable mindset with a willingness to learn and continuously improve.

Experience using Salesforce or other CRM platforms is preferred but not required.

Who Thrives Here

High performers in this role are disciplined, resilient, and motivated by activity. They enjoy working in a fast-paced sales environment where consistent effort directly influences results. They stay organized while managing multiple client conversations, maintain a strong sense of urgency, and take ownership of their performance every day.

Successful Marketing Account Advisors are naturally proactive, comfortable making outbound calls, receptive to coaching, and energized by building relationships and uncovering opportunities. They understand that success comes from maintaining consistent daily activity rather than occasional bursts of effort.

Career advancement opportunities

Access to industry-leading marketing solutions and sales technology

Apply now and get started.

job.title: Money, Power & Influence Reporter
job.description:
Money, Power & Influence Reporter, based in Miami and working as part of the state team

South Florida is one of the most consequential regions in the nation, where politics, development, business, wealth, international investment and public policy intersect daily. This position supports Florida's One Team strategy by producing enterprise and accountability journalism that can drive readership across multiple markets while establishing the network as the leading source of reporting on power and influence in Florida.

South Florida is one of the most dynamic, complex and consequential regions in America, where billion-dollar development deals, political power, corporate interests, international investment and cultural influence intersect every day.

We're seeking an ambitious, competitive and deeply curious Money, Power & Influence Reporter to cover the individuals, institutions and networks shaping South Florida's future. This reporter will deliver exclusive accountability journalism, break news, follow the money, explain how decisions are made behind closed doors and reveal the impact on residents, businesses and communities.

The ideal candidate thrives on cultivating high-level sources, uncovering hidden connections and translating complex financial, political and business issues into compelling journalism that resonates with a broad audience. This reporter will produce a mix of breaking news, watchdog reporting, investigations, enterprise features, analysis, video and audience-focused explainers.

This beat spans Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach counties and examines how money and influence flow through politics, business, development, real estate, philanthropy, sports, higher education and major cultural institutions.

Key Responsibilities:

Break exclusive stories involving government, business, development, lobbying, campaign finance, economic power and influential decision-makers.

Track major real estate and development projects, following the money behind transformative projects and public-private partnerships.

Examine how political, business and civic leaders shape public policy, economic growth and community outcomes.

Build and maintain a sophisticated source network that includes elected officials, executives, developers, investors, attorneys, lobbyists, nonprofit leaders and community advocates.

Investigate campaign spending, government contracts, regulatory decisions and influence networks.

Analyze public records, financial disclosures, corporate filings, campaign finance reports and property records.

Produce accountability journalism that reveals who benefits, who is affected and what readers need to know.

Collaborate with reporters across Florida to connect regional stories to statewide and national trends.

Develop video, social and newsletter content that expands the reach and impact of key stories.

Pursue stories from inception through aftermath, tracking consequences and holding institutions accountable over time.

What You'll Cover:

Real estate development and growth

Wealth, philanthropy and influence

Corporate power and economic development

Government transparency and accountability

Sports, entertainment and cultural power centers and people

Housing, affordability and economic opportunity

Emerging industries and innovation

The individuals and institutions driving South Florida's future

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Minimum of 3-5 years of reporting experience, preferably covering business, politics, government, investigations or accountability journalism.

Demonstrated ability to break news and produce exclusive enterprise reporting.

Strong source-building and interviewing skills.

Experience working with public records, databases and financial documents.

Ability to explain complex subjects with clarity and authority.

Strong news judgment and understanding of audience interests.

Experience with data journalism and investigative techniques is preferred.

Ability to collaborate across newsroom teams and contribute to statewide coverage.

Multimedia skills, including video and social storytelling, are a plus.

Application Instructions:

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, put together a single document file that includes the following, in this order:

Your resume – one to two pages.

A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.

Links to 3-6 online samples of your work. Show us what you’ve produced or had a hand in that best reflects what you can do in your desired role.

It is important that these items be assembled into a single document and uploaded in PDF format. Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

job.title: Press Operator I
job.description:
PRESS OPERATOR I

Gannett Publishing Services/USA TODAY CO

Des Moines, IA

This position pays $26 per hour based on background and experience.

We are also offering a sign on bonus of $2,250  paid out in 3 increments of $750 each

The Press Operator I is assigned to perform printing related tasks to support efficient press operations as needed to achieve and maintain on-time production, product quality standards, low waste, and operational safety.

Pressroom Tasks

Reel operations: Request, deliver and stage newsprint rolls, set reels, prepare approved paste patterns for all roll sizes, use web kites/devices as applicable, monitor automatic pasters and/or make hand pasters assist with reel room reports as required.

Unit make-ready: Prepare press configurations, check and prepare units for operation, spot plates, ink make-ready, web-up, conveyor set-up and folder set-up.

Basic press control proficiency to reduce waste and achieve quality standards which may include: Press inch, start and stop, speed adjustments, CMYK ink and water balance, CMYK ink density, registration and compensation, web tension/nip and trolley settings, slitter adjustments, assisting with lost web recovery & press restarts.

Densitometer calibration & operation.

Perform general press maintenance including cleaning and replacing blankets, wiping down press units, installing, checking & adjusting rollers, folder clean out, replacing cutting bars, and other press maintenance as specified.

Platemaking

Ensure timely and accurate execution of platemaking functions.

CTP operations: Request, deliver, and stage plates.

Product make-ready: Prepare digital page queues, check, prepare & operate equipment to image, bend & sort plates.

May assist with plate reports.

Safety

Always work in a safe manner and consistently utilize required safety equipment to promote top-of-mind safety awareness:

Maintain a clean and safe work environment.

Complete required annual OSHA safety training programs.

Ensure all machine safety-guards are installed, functioning properly, and in use.

Immediately report any potential safety hazards, operational concerns and all accidents/injuries and near misses to press management and supervisors.

Communications

Provide timely and accurate reports and information to the operations team and management.

Immediately report equipment issues to management.

Other duties as assigned

job.title: Video Producer
job.description:
USA TODAY Co. is seeking a detail-oriented, platform-native video producer to expand video support for local USA TODAY Network newsrooms. This full-time role will use strong editorial judgment and AI-assisted production workflows to turn local reporting, photos, data and graphics into timely, accurate and engaging short-form video.

The producer will work directly with local reporters, editors and newsroom leaders to identify stories that can reach broader audiences through video. Coverage will span the range of local journalism, including breaking news, public safety, weather, government, education, business, consumer issues, community stories, major local events and other topics important to individual markets. This is a hands-on production and service role focused on helping local newsrooms publish more video efficiently across owned and social platforms.

What you’ll do:

Serve as a dedicated video production resource for local USA TODAY Network newsrooms, supporting market needs and network-wide local coverage priorities.

Use AI-assisted platforms, including Stringr, along with templates, automation and editing tools to produce a high volume of accurate, on-brand video from local reporting, photos, data, graphics, user-generated content and newsroom briefs.

Use Stringr AI UGC production capabilities to help local newsrooms identify and develop relevant user-generated content into publishable video while following verification, sourcing, rights and editorial standards.

Use Stringr Clip Gen to create timely clips and short-form video from press conferences, public meetings, interviews, podcasts and other longer recordings.

Use Stringr Show Stacker and other AI-assisted long-form production tools to assemble structured video from local programs, interviews, recurring shows and extended newsroom content.

Partner with local reporters, editors and newsroom leaders to identify stories with strong visual, audience and distribution potential.

Respond quickly to local breaking news and major developing stories while also supporting planned enterprise, service and community coverage.

Create useful explainers that make complex local topics clear, accessible and relevant to the communities our newsrooms serve.

Turn newsroom briefs and published stories into clear video treatments, selecting effective visuals, scripts, on-screen text, audio, pacing and formats.

Adapt local journalism into platform-native vertical video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook, YouTube Shorts and other platforms.

Repurpose AI-assisted and automated content for owned-and-operated and social platforms, tailoring each version to the audience, market and platform.

Optimize video length, aspect ratio, captions, headlines, thumbnails, metadata and calls to action using platform best practices and performance insights.

Program videos on corresponding local articles and support distribution workflows that increase the reach and value of local journalism.

Manage and prioritize requests from multiple newsrooms, communicate progress and blockers, and balance planned work with urgent coverage needs.

Maintain editorial, legal, brand and visual standards, including accuracy, sourcing, attribution, captions, fonts, colors and overall presentation.

Track core performance metrics, identify successful local formats and topics, and share repeatable lessons with newsroom and video partners.

Test emerging AI and automation capabilities responsibly, helping improve templates, workflows and production standards for local newsroom use.

Review videos produced by others for quality and accuracy and provide feedback

What success looks like:

Local newsrooms receive reliable, timely video support across a broad range of coverage needs.

More high-priority local stories include relevant video on owned and social platforms.

Story-to-video turnaround improves, particularly during breaking news and other time-sensitive coverage.

Produced videos meet high standards for accuracy, clarity, audience value and brand consistency.

Local newsroom partners have clear visibility into priorities, progress and production capacity.

Strong formats and workflows are identified, documented and applied across additional USA TODAY Network markets.

AI-assisted tools and automation improve production efficiency while preserving editorial judgment and quality.

Who you are:

A digital-first journalist or producer who understands the role video can play in extending the reach and impact of local journalism.

A strong editor with sound news judgment, a sharp eye for visuals and the ability to identify the clearest audience takeaway from a story.

Comfortable producing quick-turn, high-volume video without sacrificing accuracy, quality or brand standards.

Able to move between breaking news, service journalism, enterprise reporting and community stories based on newsroom needs.

Highly organized and able to manage requests from multiple markets, changing priorities and deadline pressure in a remote environment.

A clear, responsive and collaborative partner who can work effectively with local reporters, editors, newsroom leaders and centralized video teams.

Curious and adaptable, with a practical interest in AI, automation and new approaches to newsroom production.

Committed to journalistic ethics, accuracy, fairness, transparency and responsible use of emerging technology.

Qualifications:

2-5 years Professional experience in digital journalism, video production, social video or a related field.

Demonstrated video editing experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, mobile editing applications or comparable tools.

Experience creating and publishing video for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube.

Strong writing and editing skills, including the ability to create concise scripts, captions, headlines and on-screen text.

Ability to work independently, make sound editorial decisions on deadline and collaborate across newsrooms and time zones.

Experience working with local newsrooms or producing video from local reporting is preferred.

Experience with AI-assisted production platforms, including Stringr or comparable tools, template-driven workflows, content-management systems or publishing tools is preferred.

job.description:
Operations & Innovation Specialist 

(ESPN Network | Milwaukee, WI)

The ESPN Radio Network and Good Karma Sports are seeking a full-time Operations & Innovation Specialist to join the Home Office Innovation Team, with a dedicated focus on supporting ESPN Network teammates.


This role will help teammates work smarter by identifying opportunities to improve existing workflows, eliminate repetitive tasks, and implement practical solutions using AI, automation, and technology.


The ideal candidate is curious, creative, analytical, and action-oriented. We are looking for someone who enjoys understanding how things work, challenging the status quo, experimenting with new technology, and turning ideas into meaningful operational improvements.


Career responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Build strong relationships with ESPN Network teammates to understand their workflows, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Identify repetitive, inefficient, or manual processes across ESPN Network departments and prioritize opportunities for improvement.
  • Evaluate existing workflows, recommend improvements, and design, build, test, implement, and maintain AI-enaabled solutions and automations that improve operational efficiency and consistency.
  • Partner with ESPN Network leadership and the Home Office Innovation Team to prioritize projects and execute improvements.
  • Experiment with emerging AI tools and technologies to identify new ways to improve productivity and operations.
  • Develop clear processes, documentation, and training materials that help teammates adopt new solutions.
  • Support the successful rollout and ongoing adoption of new tools, systems, and workflows.
  • Measure and communicate the impact of innovation initiatives, including time saved, improved efficiency, and increased operational capacity.
  • Collaborate with the Home Office Innovation Team and other teammates across Good Karma Sports to share successful solutions, improve workflows, and implement best practices.
  • Complete additional responsibilities and projects as assigned.
  • Represent Good Karma Sports by demonstrating our core values: Listen, Be Honest, Work Hard, Over Deliver, Follow Through, and Teamwork.

Preferred knowledge, skills and qualifications:

  • Strong curiosity, analytical thinking, and creative problem-solving abilities.
  • Passion for AI, emerging technology, automation, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to understand complex workflows and translate challenges into practical solutions.
  • Experience with AI platforms, workflow automation, low-code/no-code tools, CRM systems, or reporting tools is a plus.
  • Resourceful, self-directed, and comfortable experimenting with unfamiliar technology.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to influence and support change across teams without direct authority.
  • Ability to balance experimentation, execution, accuracy, and responsible technology use.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-changing environment and managing multiple priorities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and willingness to learn new platforms and systems.

Hours/Salary/Benefits

This is a full-time, in-office, exempt salaried position offering a competitive base salary based on experience and qualifications.

This role is eligible for full benefits including health, dental and vision insurance, Life Insurance, STD, LTD, 401(k) Plan, Dependent Care, paid parental leave, and more, with opportunities for growth as responsibilities and impact expand.

The position may require occasional evenings and weekends depending on project needs and operational priorities.

Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company.

job.title: Developer, Audience Engagement
job.description:
Graham Media Group November 10, 2026 Developer, Audience Engagement Graham Media Group November 10, 2026

Reports to: Director of Transformation

Work location: Detroit, MI (on-site)

Description

We are seeking a developer who puts the audience first. You will join the team that builds the websites and apps for our local news stations in Detroit, Houston, San Antonio, Orlando, Jacksonville and Roanoke. In 2027 our focus is engagement: helping people connect with their local news and with each other and giving them reasons to come back.

You will listen to our audiences through surveys, comments and community spaces, and turn what they tell us into experiences that fit them. You will connect survey answers to real, activated audiences: newsletters, alerts and pages our newsrooms use, and first-party audiences our advertising team offers to local businesses. Then you will help both teams plan how each launch reaches the people it is for.

This is a technical role for someone who wants their work used. You will ship, watch real people use what you built, hear what they think, and make it better. You take pride in using modern tools, including AI coding agents you set up and run yourself, to move fast and build with care.

Responsibilities

  • Own an audience product of your own, live with at least one of our stations within your first 90 days.

  • Turn survey answers into first-party audiences that refresh on their own, with consent recorded, and that our newsroom and advertising teams both put to work.

  • Plan each launch with our editorial and advertising teams: who it serves, how stations use it and how sellers explain it.

  • Grow the number of people who come back: return visitors, email and push subscribers, and contributors.

  • Ship steadily. Take small features from ideas to live in two weeks or less. Set a success metric up front and report the results afterward

  • Actively listen to our users and station partners, translating their real-world feedback into meaningful product changes.

  • Share the AI agent workflows and guidelines that work well, so everyone on the team can use them.

  • Adhere to privacy and security rules with every release; treat both as requirements from the start, not checks at the end.

Requirements

  • Proven track record of shipping production-ready web or mobile app features that real people use.

  • Fluency in TypeScript or JavaScript, React or a similar framework, and Node. Comfort across the stack: interface, APIs, data and deployment.

  • Experience with audience data: SQL, event tracking and survey data, and turning raw responses into segments someone can use.

  • Strong proficiency with modern AI development tools. You have set up and run your own coding agents, and you review and test everything they write.

  • Git, code review, CI/CD, testing and feature flags as everyday habits.

  • A habit of measuring what you ship. You define the metric before you build and read the results honestly, including the misses.

  • Sound privacy judgment and working knowledge of web security: consent, common attacks and how to prevent them, and recently announced exploits and their fixes.

  • An audience-first mindset. You start from the person using the product, seek out feedback after launch and welcome it.

  • A clear bias toward shipping: you would rather release a good v1 and iterate than polish something indefinitely before users ever see it.

  • Ownership. You see a project from idea to production and beyond, and you fix problems before anyone reports them.

  • Clear communication with newsroom, sales and product partners, and a willingness to share what you learn.

  • Experience with survey tools, audience platforms such as Google Ad Manager audiences or Braze, or mobile apps in Flutter or React Native is a plus.

Graham Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. In addition to complying with the requirements of federal law, GMG will comply with applicable state and local laws prohibiting employment discrimination. Any offer of employment is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment drug screening, investigative background check, employment/education verifications and reference checks.

Please submit your resume along with a link to a live web or app feature you have shipped to real users to mnewman@grahammedia.com

job.title: Director of Sales Enablement & Development
job.description:
Graham Media Group November 9, 2026 Director of Sales Enablement & Development Graham Media Group November 9, 2026

Reports to: Sr. Director, of Sales

Work location: Detroit, MI

Description

The Director of Sales Enablement & Development leads Graham Media Group’s enterprise-wide strategy for sales training, onboarding, leadership development, and performance excellence. Serving as the sales organization’s center of excellence for learning and talent development, this role ensures Account Executives, Sales Managers, and emerging leaders have the skills and resources to drive revenue growth and strong client outcomes.

The incumbent owns the full learning ecosystem for sales positions within Graham Media Group including onboarding, manager development, certifications, sales specific LMS strategy, sales playbooks, and go-to-market readiness. They partner with Sales Leadership, Digital, Product, and HR teams to build a culture of continuous learning, accountability, and career growth. They also help advance the company’s multi-platform evolution by equipping sellers to position integrated broadcast, streaming, digital, social, sponsorship, data, and emerging advertising solutions.

Success is measured by onboarding effectiveness, retention, manager readiness, seller productivity, leadership bench strength, training engagement, and adoption of strategic initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Organization Learning & Development Strategy

  • Develop and lead the company’s enterprise sales learning and development strategy to support engagement, retention, and career growth for those in sales positions.

  • In close partnership with HR, develop competency models, career development pathways, and learning frameworks for both independent contributor and manager-level sales roles.

  • Partner with Human Resources and Sales Leadership to identify talent gaps and create development solutions that strengthen organizational capability.

  • Create and maintain succession development programs that cultivate future leaders across the organization.

  • Develop and deliver leadership training programs for sales managers and emerging leaders.

  • Equip sales managers with tools and resources to effectively lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams.

  • Create sales leadership certification pathways that strengthen management effectiveness and organizational leadership capability.

  • Continuously evolve the LMS to support hybrid learning, self-paced education, manager coaching, and performance development initiatives for sales positions.

  • Lead the expansion, maintenance, and governance of a centralized learning library that houses onboarding materials, sales certifications, product training, leadership development programs, best practices, and professional development resources.

  • Develop and execute the strategy for the asynchronous learning & development for sales positions via the learning management system.

  • Develop reporting and analytics to track participation, certifications, completion rates, learning effectiveness, and business impact.

  • Establish sales training standards and certification requirements for sales positions across the organization.

Sales Onboarding & Readiness

  • Responsible for owning and enhancing onboarding programs for sales roles across the company.

  • Design, document, and implement structured 30-, 60-, 90-, and 180-day onboarding and development plans.

  • Create sales certification programs that ensure new hires demonstrate readiness in core sales competencies, products, tools, platforms, and company processes.

  • Partner with market sales leadership to accelerate ramp time and improve new hire retention and long-term success.

  • Design and lead comprehensive sales enablement programs that improve seller effectiveness across prospecting, consultative selling, account growth, client retention, negotiation, presentation skills, pipeline development, forecasting, and strategic account management.

  • Build and maintain sales playbooks, enablement resources, talk tracks, case studies, customer success stories, and best practices.

  • Deliver ongoing sales skills training aligned with evolving market conditions, customer needs, and company priorities.

  • Develop role-based learning journeys that support career progression and continuous improvement.

Multi-Platform Sales Growth & Go-to-Market Enablement

  • Create training and go-to-market programs that strengthen sales capabilities across broadcast television, streaming, CTV, OTT, digital marketing services, social media, sponsorships, audience targeting, data solutions, and emerging products.

  • Partner with various teams in the sales and digital organizations to create launch materials, positioning, competitive intelligence, and sales narratives.

  • Develop executive-level sales presentations, customer-facing materials, and enablement resources supporting new revenue opportunities.

  • Ensure every strategic initiative includes consistent training and adoption plan across all markets.

Sales Performance & Process Excellence

  • Partner with market sales leadership to identify skill gaps and development opportunities.

  • Drive adoption of sales methodologies, CRM best practices, pipeline management disciplines, forecasting standards, and account growth strategies.

  • Measure and communicate the business impact of learning and enablement initiatives.

AI, Technology & Future Readiness

  • Serve as organizational leader for AI-enabled selling, productivity, and learning.

  • Deliver training focused on Spark, AI-assisted prospecting, proposal generation, client research, presentation development, and workflow automation.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and learning solutions that increase productivity and seller performance.

  • Ensure the organization remains at the forefront of modern sales enablement and learning practices.

Qualifications

Required

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in sales leadership, sales enablement, learning and development, organizational development, sales training, or performance coaching.

  • Demonstrated success building enterprise onboarding, training, and enablement programs.

  • Experience leading learning management systems, certification programs, and talent development initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of consultative selling, media sales, digital advertising, and multi-platform revenue strategies.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Copilot, PowerPoint, Excel, Teams, and SharePoint.

  • Strong CRM expertise, including pipeline management, forecasting, reporting, adoption, and sales analytics.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

  • Exceptional facilitation, presentation, communication, and leadership skills.

Preferred

  • Media industry sales leadership experience.

  • Experience supporting multi-market organizations.

  • Sales methodology certifications (Miller Heiman, Challenger, Sandler, Strategic Selling, SPIN, or comparable programs).

  • Experience implementing or managing an LMS platform.

  • Background in organizational development, learning strategy, or talent management.

  • Experience leading large-scale change management and transformation initiatives.

Please send resumes to Shosh Abromovich at sabromovich@grahammedia.com

Graham Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. In addition to complying with the requirements of federal law, GMG will comply with applicable state and local laws prohibiting employment discrimination. Any offer of employment is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment drug screening, investigative background check, employment/education verifications and reference checks.

job.title: ANCHOR/CONSUMER REPORTER - KSLA
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KSLA:

KSLA News 12 is the aggressive, National Edward R. Murrow Award-winning CBS affiliate serving the region known as the ArkLaTex. The station is the market’s leader in timely and accurate reporting of breaking news, investigative journalism, award-winning storytelling, and First Alert Weather. KSLA News 12 serves its community on all on-air, digital, and mobile platforms, embracing the innovation of the industry. In the center of the ArkLaTex is the Shreveport/Bossier City metroplex where the best of Louisiana, Texas, and Arkansas culture is combined to create a vibrant and comfortable lifestyle.

Job Summary/Description:

Are you the person family and friends call for advice if they’ve been ripped off? Do you have an instinct for spotting a scam and a relentless drive to help people who might have fallen victim? KSLA News 12 is looking for an Anchor/Consumer Reporter who isn't just a face behind a desk, but a champion for the ArkLaTex. We need an artful storyteller who thrives on getting answers and knows how to turn a complex consumer complaint into must-watch content—whether it’s a 30-second social clip or a deep-dive long-form investigation.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

What You'll Do: 

• Champion the consumer: Lead our "Getting Answers" brand by investigating local scams, retail rip-offs, and bureaucratic red tape with a sense of urgency that matches the frustration of our audience. 

• Anchor with authority: Command the desk for both digital and broadcast newscasts, delivering impactful news with the credibility our audience expects.
• Master visual storytelling: Use creative, high-impact visuals to break down complex data, crafting stories that are so visually engaging they leave the viewer wanting more.
• Own the digital space: Create daily, platform-specific content for social media and streaming that doesn't just repeat the broadcast but engages our digital audience where they live.
• Tell community stories: Find the human heart in every consumer issue, telling stories that resonate deeply with our local community and drive real change.

Qualifications/Requirements: 

What You Bring:

• A proven track record: 2-3 years of experience in a newsroom (consumer or investigative reporting experience is a massive plus).
• Visual eye: You understand that how a story looks is just as important as what is said; you’re a pro at using visuals to hook an audience and keep them watching.
• Digital fluency: You know how to stop the scroll on social media and understand that "digital-first" isn't just a buzzword—it's how we win.
• Relentless curiosity: You don't take "no comment" for an answer, and you’re comfortable digging through records to find the truth.
• Versatile storytelling: You can write a tight broadcast script, a compelling web article, and an engaging social thread with urgency and ease.
• On-air presence: You’re authentic, energetic, and authoritative, whether you’re in the field, on the anchor desk, or live streaming from your phone.
• Technical savvy: You’re comfortable with the tools of modern journalism, from mobile editing to navigating streaming platforms.

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WTHI:

For more than 70 years, WTHI-TV (CBS/FOX/ION/MeTV/MeTV Toons) has been the most-watched local television station in west central Indiana and east central Illinois, earning a reputation for trusted, award-winning coverage of news, weather, and sports. As a treasured member of the community, WTHI-TV continues to prioritize local storytelling, support community initiatives, and provide a trusted platform for the voices and events that shape daily life across the Wabash Valley.

Job Summary/Description:

WTHI-TV is seeking a hands-on technical professional to help lead the engineering and technology operations of our television station. This role partners directly with the Regional Chief Engineer to maintain, modernize, and future-proof all station systems, from traditional SDI broadcast infrastructure and automation to IT networks, building systems, and vendor relationships. You will support live news production in a Grass Valley hot-punch environment, oversee the health of a hybrid broadcasting plant, and help guide the next wave of technical evolution while ensuring daily broadcasts run reliably.

Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

The Right Fit: This position is designed for a well-rounded engineer who thrives at the intersection of broadcast and IT. You will maintain, improve, and innovate across all technical systems while providing vital support to a fast-paced, live news environment. The ideal candidate is a steady hand, a creative problem solver, and a trusted partner ready to help lead one of the Wabash Valley’s most dynamic television operations.
Core Responsibilities:

Broadcast and Production Systems:
- Maintain, repair, and optimize all studio, control room, and transmission systems
- Support Grass Valley Kayak HD, production switchers, Chyron graphics systems, Grass Valley routers, Imagine ADC master control, and Wheatstone audio consoles
- Manage signal flow across SDI infrastructure, including routing, monitoring, and conversion systems.
- Work closely with production and news teams to resolve live on-air technical issues quickly and effectively
- Create and maintain clear system documentation and standard operating procedures

Information Technology and Networking:
- Work with the Regional IT manager to maintain Information technology and support users locally.
- Oversee VMware virtual machines, Windows servers, user workstations, and system backups in coordination with corporate IT
- Manage Active Directory, LAN/WAN-related hardware, and local network security
- Support newsroom systems, automation interfaces, and shared storage environments
- Maintain alignment with Gray Media corporate IT and broadcast technology initiatives
- Ensure proper cybersecurity practices and software updates across technical systems

Leadership and Collaboration:
- Serve as a key technical leader when the Chief Engineer is unavailable or off-site
- Promote proactive maintenance and continuous improvement within the department
- Communicate effectively with newsroom, production, and corporate personnel
- Maintain a calm, professional demeanor under pressure and during live operations

Qualifications/Requirements:

Desired Qualifications/Requirements:
- Working knowledge of Grass Valley switchers, Evertz, Imagine,& Grass Valley Routers, and ENPS
- Understanding of SDI signal flow, routing, audio distribution, and monitoring systems
- Experience with VMware virtual environments, Windows server, Active Directory, and system backups
- Knowledge of VLANs, routing, and network configuration within a broadcast plant
- Basic understanding of transmitters and RF fundamentals preferred
- Must be available for on-call support, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with a proactive mindset
- Strong organizational and documentation skills with attention to detail
- Effective communication and vendor management skills
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a live production environment
- 5 or more years of experience in broadcast engineering and information technology

Do you thrive on the challenge of bridging the gap between traditional broadcasting and the future of media? We’re looking for a Broadcast/IT Maintenance Technician who isn't just looking for a job, but a chance to be the technical backbone of WLUC. About WSAW:

WSAW is Wausau's first TV station, debuting 71 years ago in 1954. Together, WSAW/WZAW produce more than 30 hours of news each week. We work hard and celebrate our wins. In 2026, the news team was recognized as the Wisconsin Broadcasters Association "News Operation of the Year" and also the small-market "Station of the Year" (for coverage airing in 2025). Also in 2026, WSAW's podcast "Wisconsin Cold Cases: Who Killed Gerald Mork?" was honored with a Regional Edward R. Murrow Award. These are just a few examples of the honors WSAW has received in recent years.

North Central Wisconsin is also known as "Wisconsin's Basecamp." In Wausau, you will live and work where thousands of people come to vacation each year. Whether you're skiing down the slopes of Granite Peak, boating on Lake Du Bay, or enjoying Concerts on the Square or a show at The Grand Theater in downtown Wausau, there's something for everyone, and you will enjoy the community we serve. Wausau is also located within 3 hours or less of Minneapolis, Milwaukee, and Green Bay; and is just a two-hour drive from Madison, the state's capital city.

WSAW's viewing area covers 11 counties, including the cities of Stevens Point, Wisconsin Rapids, Marshfield, Rhinelander, and the summer retreat hotspot of Minocqua. WSAW is dedicated to serving the community and does so through several weeks-long campaigns such as Share Your Holidays and the annual Diaper Drive.

Job Summary/Description:

Have you ever wondered what it's like to be at the heart of a newsroom where digital isn't just an afterthought - it's the priority? WSAW is looking for a Digital Content Creator who can own the story from the first alert to the last update, ensuring our audience stays connected on every screen.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

- Own breaking news: Move with lightning speed to send push notifications and update web stories as news unfolds.
- Craft compelling narratives: Write and produce dynamic digital news content that stops the scroll and keeps our audience informed.
- Drive social engagement: Manage our social media presence by posting timely updates and creating content specifically for our digital communities.
- Manage the hub: Split your time between the assignment desk and content creation, helping decide what we cover and how we share it.
- Create multimedia assets: Produce video, photo galleries, and live streams that add depth and visual punch to our local reporting.
- Collaborate for impact: Work closely with crews and producers to ensure our digital voice is consistent, professional, and approachable.
- Lead the charge on digital-only newscast: WSAW produces 715 Live, the only current digital-only newscast in the market. The chosen applicant will produce and anchor the p.m. version of this show.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- College degree in Marketing, Journalism, Communications, or a related field.
- Previous experience in a professional newsroom environment is preferred, but we are willing to train the right candidate.
- Availability for weekend hours; willingness to work flexible shifts for breaking news, specialized coverage, or covering a colleague's PTO.
- A genuine desire to win, the ability to reflect on your work, and a willingness to apply feedback.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills with solid knowledge of AP Style *and writing conversationally for Broadcast.
- Ability to edit video in digital formats.
- Proficiency with Photoshop, Canva, or comparable software to create and edit graphics.
- Ability to work well under pressure and collaborate effectively with a diverse team.
- Strong understanding of journalistic principles and ethics.
- Ability to balance long- and short-term projects while consistently meeting daily deadlines.
- Proven record of digital and social media success; must maintain a responsible and professional social media presence.
- Strong research skills and the ability to employ critical thinking to dig beyond the press release and verify incoming tips.
- Ability to carry 35+ pounds of equipment.
- Valid driver's license with a clean driving record (Motor Vehicle Records check required).

Job Summary/Description:

WKYT in Lexington, Kentucky, is looking for a part-time weekend digital content producer for its award-winning and innovative digital platforms. This producer will help power both news and sports digital and social coverage on weekends — publishing breaking news fast, supporting game-night highlights/scores/recaps, and creating social-first video for station accounts.

Schedule:

• Demonstrated ability to publish quickly and accurately on digital platforms (web + social).

• Strong communication and collaboration skills; thrives in a fast-paced, team-driven environment. Passion for both news and sports coverage a plus.

KLTV is the dominant station in the Tyler/Longview, TX area of East Texas. We are an ABC affiliate and have been #1 by every ratings measure, uninterrupted in every newscast for 30+ years. We also have a very powerful, dominant digital presence in the market. We are a leader in the industry in digital innovation and digital products--operating and populating 11 different apps and producing an 19-hour a 19-hour-a-day live streaming news service from our newsroom on OTT, desktop, and on our mobile apps.

Modern facility. Top-notch equipment. Experienced News Managers. Positive, encouraging workplace with an emphasis on teaching job skills and journalism. Dominant station preparing for the future in a very powerful company in this industry. We believe we are among the best newsrooms in the country.

Job Summary/Description:

This is a unique position. For the last nine years, KLTV/KTRE has operated a successful, live digital broadcast from our newsroom. Thousands watch each day as our hosts report news as it is breaking, live from our newsroom. East Texas Now is live, local news and talk 19 hours a day and in operation seven days a week. This is an established, mature streaming production that has served as the model for many others in the industry.

The hosts produce, present, and technically direct their shows every day using a special interface developed for and with the input of KLTV/KTRE. East Texas Now is live each day on desktop, mobile devices, in our apps, and on Amazon Fire and Roku OTT devices. East Texas Now even has its own dedicated app with integrated chat that allows viewers to interact with the host. If you can talk, love breaking news, and are technically inclined to multitask while talking in front of one of multiple cameras, this is an exciting, groundbreaking position.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Handle Breaking News
- Talk to reporters and news makers via FaceTime and Skype
- Self-direct the show
- Set up and coordinate guests for in-studio or remote appearances
- Plan content for each day
- Perform "live read" commercials from the East Texas Now desk
- Talk a lot!

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Competence in reporting live, online, and on air
- Reporting on digital platforms, often live via FaceTime or Skype
- Setting up guests and reporters
- Computer skills
- Position generally alternates schedules dayside/nightside weekly
- Experience in talk radio is a plus

Job Summary/Description:

 

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to

Digital Sales Strategy and Revenue Growth:
• Partner with the General Sales Manager, Digital Sales leadership, media executives, and station management to develop and execute digital revenue strategies.
• Help identify opportunities to grow digital revenue among existing and prospective clients.
• Consult with clients and sales staff to understand business objectives, target audiences, budgets, and desired outcomes.
• Recommend integrated digital marketing solutions, including display, video, social media, search, programmatic, streaming, email, audience targeting, retargeting, and other available products.
• Support the development of customized proposals, presentations, media plans, campaign strategies, and performance recommendations.
• Participate in client meetings, sales calls, new-business presentations, and account reviews as needed.
• Help sales teams position digital products as strategic business solutions rather than standalone media offerings.
• Work collaboratively with account executives to increase digital adoption, retention, upselling, and renewal opportunities.
• Monitor market trends, competitive activity, emerging digital products, and changes in consumer behavior to inform sales strategy.
• Provide coaching, guidance, and subject-matter expertise to media executives and other team members.

Campaign Operations and Execution:
• Manage the accurate and timely execution of digital campaigns from order entry through completion.
• Upload, review, and maintain campaign forms, insertion orders, creative assets, targeting information, tags, tracking details, and related documentation in Engage and other designated systems.
• Confirm that campaign specifications, budgets, dates, creative materials, targeting, and billing information are complete and accurate before launch.
• Coordinate campaign setup and implementation with internal teams, Gray Media partners, vendors, agencies, and third-party platforms.
• Monitor campaign pacing, delivery, performance, and quality throughout the campaign lifecycle.
• Identify potential issues early and coordinate timely resolutions.
• Ensure that changes, make-goods, extensions, creative swaps, and campaign adjustments are properly documented and communicated.
• Maintain accurate digital order records, workflow documentation, reporting schedules, and campaign status updates.
• Help establish and maintain consistent digital sales processes and standards across the station.

Reporting, Optimization, and Client Service:
• Review campaign performance and prepare clear, actionable reports for clients and sales teams.
• Translate campaign data into insights, recommendations, and next steps.
• Make optimization recommendations designed to improve performance and deliver against client objectives.
• Support campaign wrap-ups, quarterly business reviews, renewal conversations, and post-campaign analysis.
• Ensure client expectations are clearly established and consistently met.
• Provide responsive, professional service to internal and external stakeholders.
• Escalate concerns appropriately while maintaining ownership through resolution.
• Help develop repeatable reporting templates, sales tools, educational materials, and best practices.

Leadership and Team Development:
• Serve as a digital resource and operational leader for the sales organization.
• Provide training and ongoing support to account executives and other station personnel on digital products, processes, platforms, reporting, and best practices.
• Lead or support digital sales meetings, training sessions, campaign reviews, and process-improvement initiatives.
• Help foster accountability, collaboration, organization, and a client-first culture.
• Mentor team members and share knowledge to strengthen the station’s overall digital capabilities.
• Demonstrate the judgment, communication skills, and ownership expected of an emerging manager.
• Support the General Sales Manager and Digital Sales leadership with special projects and other responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications/Requirements:

Required Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, advertising, business, communications, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
• Relevant experience in digital advertising, media sales, campaign management, marketing operations, account management, or a related field.
• Strong understanding of digital advertising concepts, campaign execution, audience targeting, performance metrics, and optimization.
• Demonstrated ability to work with sales teams and translate client goals into effective digital strategies.
• Excellent organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.
• Strong written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
• Ability to analyze campaign performance and communicate recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, CRM systems, order-entry systems, reporting platforms, and digital advertising tools.
• Ability to learn and effectively use Engage and other Gray Media systems and platforms.
• Demonstrated judgment, initiative, accountability, and problem-solving ability.
• Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience with Gray Media systems, processes, products, or station operations.
• Current or previous experience as a Digital Coordinator, Digital Sales Manager, Account Executive, Digital Specialist, or similar role.
• Experience supporting or leading digital campaign strategy across multiple platforms.
• Experience creating client-facing proposals, presentations, performance reports, or business reviews.
• Experience training, mentoring, or informally leading colleagues.
• Experience working with local businesses, advertising agencies, or media clients.
• Familiarity with digital analytics, campaign-management platforms, CRM tools, ad servers, paid search, social advertising, programmatic advertising, streaming, and/or marketing automation.
• Demonstrated success in improving workflow efficiency, campaign performance, client retention, or digital revenue.

Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WLIO: 

Located in Lima, Ohio, WLIO is proud to bring all four major networks—NBC, CBS, ABC, and FOX—under one roof. As a station serving the Midwest, we enjoy the beauty and variety of all four seasons while staying closely connected to the communities we serve.

WLIO offers applicants the opportunity to be part of a dynamic, collaborative team in a welcoming market where journalists and media professionals can make a meaningful impact.

Job Summary/Description:

WLIO is seeking an experienced, motivated, and strategic Director of Sales to lead WLIO's sales department and drive revenue growth across its broadcast, digital, and emerging media platforms. Reporting directly to the General Manager, the Director of Sales will play a key leadership role in the station's overall business strategy, financial performance, and continued growth in the Lima market.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on sales leader who understands how to recruit, develop, motivate, and retain a high-performing sales team while building strong relationships with local businesses, agencies, and regional advertisers. This individual will bring a proven ability to grow existing business, develop new revenue opportunities, strengthen client partnerships, and deliver effective multi-platform marketing solutions that produce measurable results.

 Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

The Director of Sales is responsible for leading WLIO's sales operation, driving revenue growth, developing client relationships, and supporting the station's overall business objectives. Duties include, but are not limited to:

  • Sales Leadership: Lead and manage the station's multi-platform sales operation, with a focus on growing broadcast, digital, and emerging platform revenue.
  • Revenue Growth: Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve and exceed local, national, new business, digital, and other revenue goals.
  • Business Development: Identify new business opportunities, expand existing accounts, and develop creative marketing solutions that deliver measurable results for clients.
  • Sales Strategy: Establish sales goals, budgets, forecasts, and performance expectations aligned with WLIO's local brand and overall business strategy.
  • Team Development: Recruit, hire, train, coach, and retain a high-performing sales team. Provide ongoing development and opportunities for professional growth.
  • Performance Management: Monitor sales activity, revenue pacing, and individual performance. Hold team members accountable for achieving established goals and objectives.
  • Client Relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with key advertisers, agencies, business owners, and community partners.
  • Multi-Platform Solutions: Champion the integration of broadcast television, digital products, and emerging media opportunities to deliver comprehensive advertising solutions.

An Engineering Supervisor is comfortable with RF broadcast equipment and transmitters, as well as IP-based newsgathering and IT infrastructure. You will be the backbone of our technical operations, ensuring our content reaches our community on every screen, every time.

· Problem-solving DNA: You have a deep understanding of both serial and IP communication and a knack for project management.

The ideal candidate will oversee all aspects of newscast production, manage the daily editorial workflow, and anchor the show. About KSLA:

KSLA News 12 is the aggressive, National Edward R. Murrow Award-winning CBS affiliate serving the region known as the ArkLaTex. The station is the market’s leader in timely and accurate reporting of breaking news, investigative journalism, award-winning storytelling, and First Alert Weather. KSLA News 12 serves its community on all on-air, digital, and mobile platforms, embracing the innovation of the industry. In the center of the ArkLaTex is the Shreveport/Bossier City metroplex where the best of Louisiana, Texas and Arkansas culture is combined to create a vibrant and comfortable lifestyle.

Job Summary/Description:

Even before the sky turns dark in the ArkLaTex, the audience turns to us for the First Alert on timing, clarity, and preparation. KSLA News 12 is searching for a high-energy, digitally savvy Meteorologist who understands that weather doesn't just happen at 5:00 and 6:00 PM. We need a communicator who can convey the next weather event with urgency and impact, ensuring our audience is prepared and informed whether they are watching on a big screen or a smartphone.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

What You'll Do:
• Own the First Alert brand: Deliver accurate, high-impact forecasts during our newscasts and across all digital/social platforms with a relentless focus on the "Next Weather Maker."
• Drive digital urgency: Lead our weather coverage on the digital streaming desk, social media, and the KSLA weather app, providing real-time updates that keep our audience engaged and safe.
• Master severe weather coverage: When severe weather strikes, you are the front line—delivering life-saving information with calm authority and a "digital-first" mindset that reaches people wherever they are.
• Create visually stunning content: Use the latest weather technology to craft compelling, easy-to-understand graphics that make complex atmospheric science accessible and visually compelling.
• Engage the community: Build a loyal following by being active and accessible on social media, answering questions, and providing context that goes beyond a standard seven-day forecast.
• Collaborate for impact: Work seamlessly with the Chief Meteorologist and the First Alert Weather team to ensure a consistent, aggressive weather brand across every screen.

Qualifications/Requirements:

What You Bring:
• A passion for the "Why": You don't just read the models; you understand the science and can explain it with urgency and clarity.
• Digital-first DNA: You’re a pro at going live and crafting weather threads on socials and creating engaging reels that make weather the most talked-about topic in town.
• Visual storytelling chops: You have a keen eye for graphics and understand that a great weather hit is as much about the visuals as it is about the data.
• Severe weather experience: You thrive under pressure and have the field or studio experience to handle high-stakes weather events with confidence.
• Technical expertise: A Bachelor’s degree in Meteorology or a related field is required, along with proficiency in modern weather computer systems (WSI/Baron experience is a plus).
• Team player mentality: You’re ready to jump in whenever the weather demands it, supporting the team during major events and contributing to a winning culture.
• Authentic presence: You’re energetic, relatable, and authoritative—someone the ArkLaTex can trust when it matters most.

opportunities within Gray Media’s network of 113 stations.

Columbia, South Carolina, is a vibrant and growing capital city with a diverse population. WIS is located downtown, just two blocks from the South Carolina Statehouse.

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KBTX:

KBTX Media operates the CBS and CW affiliates in Bryan-College Station, Texas, serving an 18-county area known as the Brazos Valley. For nearly 70 years, we’ve been the dominant choice for local news and entertainment. Our team produces about 40 hours of original content each week across our broadcast and streaming platforms.

KBTX is routinely recognized among the best in the state by organizations including the Associated Press, RTDNA and the Lone Star EMMY Chapter of the National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences.

In 2023, KBTX became the first television station to win the Texas Association of Broadcasters’ Bonner McLane Public Service award three consecutive times. Additionally, our team was honored with a National Edward R. Murrow Award for digital innovation and regional Murrow awards for breaking news, digital innovation, and best newscast. KBTX is also a recent Texas AP Broadcasters/Freedom of Information Foundation of Texas Station of the Year and Texas Associated Press Broadcasters Station of the Year.

Bryan-College Station, Texas is a community of more than 250,000 people and the largest single metro in the Waco-Temple-Bryan DMA. The twin cities have a unique small-town feeling, but offer big-city amenities, including a vibrant arts community, a city-wide, all-terrain trail system and world-class dining and nightlife. Bryan and College Station are routinely recognized as a leader in quality of life and as one of the fastest-growing communities in the country.
College Station is also home to Texas A&M University, the nation’s largest university. Aggie home football games attract more than 100,000 in the stands, with tens of thousands more camped outside celebrating at tailgates during football weekends.
