job.title: VICE PRESIDENT/GENERAL MANAGER - WLOX
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WLOX:

WLOX-TV is the undisputed audience and commercial advertising leader on the Mississippi Gulf Coast. Broadcasting both ABC (WLOX 13.1) and CBS (WLOX 13.2) alongside high-performing multicast networks and dominant digital, mobile, and OTT streaming products, WLOX delivers unprecedented market reach across South Mississippi. With a legacy built on lifesaving severe weather coverage, investigative journalism, and deep community ties, WLOX pairs broadcast dominance with sophisticated, full-funnel digital marketing solutions powered by Gray Digital Media (GDM).

Job Summary/Description:

Gray Media is seeking an aggressive, revenue-focused, and visionary leader to serve as Vice President & General Manager for WLOX-TV (ABC/CBS), the market-dominant media powerhouse serving the Biloxi-Gulfport market and Mississippi Gulf Coast. The VP/GM will lead a fully functioning multi-platform media operation with an uncompromising focus on accelerating top-line revenue growth, maximizing digital and linear sales performance, expanding market share, and leading our championship news and community operations in a highly competitive, success-driven culture.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

* Drive Multi-Platform Revenue Growth: Serve as the chief revenue strategist for the station; partner daily with sales leadership to set pricing, inventory management, packaging, and go-to-market strategies that consistently exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual billing budgets across broadcast, digital, and Gray Digital Media (GDM).
* Drive Audience Retention & Growth: Partner with news leadership to analyze minute-by-minute ratings and digital consumption metrics, refining pacing, teasing, and content flow to hold viewers across key dayparts.
* Champion New Business & Strategic Accounts: Actively participate in high-level sales calls, cultivate deep C-suite relationships with major regional advertisers, and expand agency partnerships beyond traditional spot TV to capture larger digital, OTT, and multi-market shares.
* Lead Multi-Platform Operations: Lead a fully functioning, 24/7 multi-platform operation with a sharp focus on growing commercial revenue, broadcast ratings, and digital/social engagement.
* Support & Elevate Award-Winning News: Partner with newsroom leadership to uphold WLOX’s market-leading news brand, ensure dominant severe weather/crisis readiness, and produce compelling local journalism that delivers ratings and commercial monetization opportunities.
* Champion Relevant, High-Impact News: Foster an aggressive investigative and breaking news culture that delivers urgent, authentic, and locally indispensable content to South Mississippi.
* Modern Cross-Platform Execution: Direct multi-screen content strategies (broadcast, OTT, web, social) to ensure storytelling reaches audiences wherever they consume news, maximizing total brand retention.
* Financial Acumen & P&L Responsibility: Assume full accountability for station P&L, financial statements, monthly pacing/forecasting, capital expense budgets, and operating margins.
* Talent Recruitment & High-Performance Culture: Recruit, mentor, and hold accountable top-tier department heads and sales professionals; build an energetic, competitive, and accountable sales and station culture.
* Governance & Compliance: Strictly enforce all FCC, EEO, SOX, OSHA, and corporate policies, always adhering to the highest ethical and broadcast standards.
* Community Ambassador: Represent WLOX and Gray Media as an engaged, high-profile civic leader across the Mississippi Gulf Coast business and philanthropic community.

Qualifications/Requirements:

* Experience: 5+ years of progressive broadcast/media management experience, with a preferred background as a General Manager, Station Manager, Director of Sales (DOS), or News Director.
* Demonstrated success leading or partnering with newsroom leadership to build strong news brands that grow market share and audience loyalty.
* Strong acumen in ratings analysis, digital audience data, and modern retention techniques (flow, vertical/horizontal tease structures, and active live storytelling).
* Director of Sales (DOS), General Sales Manager (GSM), or News Director with significant commercial business experience.
* Revenue Track Record: Demonstrated history of consistent revenue overperformance, digital sales acceleration, creative non-traditional revenue generation, and effective sales team coaching.
* Strategic Vision: Comprehensive understanding of modern multi-platform media consumption, linear-to-digital transition, advanced audience targeting, and competitive positioning.

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WIS:

WIS is the #1 local media organization in the capital city market of Columbia, South Carolina. It is the market’s top-rated broadcast television station, a digital publisher reaching tens of millions of users each year, and the home of GDM Columbia, a full-service in-house digital advertising agency with national scale. WIS is also the hub for Palmetto Sports & Entertainment, a statewide broadcast sports network, and an affiliate of Telemundo SC.

Serving South Carolina's Midlands since 1953, WIS offers the opportunity to join an award-winning culture for a popular brand built upon decades of market leadership. Named the South Carolina Broadcasters Association's Station of the Year a record 17 times, WIS has earned the Edward R. Murrow Award for Journalism Excellence, the National Association of Broadcasters' Service to America Award, the George Foster Peabody Award, and is an annual attendee of the Southeast Emmy Awards.

Among the many notable former journalists who helped set our standard, NBC Today Show co-host Craig Melvin began his career with WIS as an intern, photographer, reporter, and then anchor.

WIS produces more than 60 hours of local, original programming per week. The station offers a unique variety of multiplatform advertising solutions, sponsored content, and professional creative services for businesses of any size.

Columbia, South Carolina, is a vibrant and growing capital city with a diverse population. It is home to the U.S. Army's largest installation for Basic Combat Training, Fort Jackson, along with the University of South Carolina and multiple other colleges and universities. WIS is located downtown, just two blocks from the South Carolina Statehouse.

Our community combines affordable quality of living with a variety of entertainment and activities to accommodate your lifestyle, whether it's our 50,000-acre Lake Murray, our Columbia Fireflies minor league baseball team, the Riverbanks Zoo & Gardens, nearby Congaree National Park, and so much more.

Job Summary:

WIS offers this exclusive, paid newsroom internship each semester, honoring one of our most notable alumni, NBC TODAY anchor Craig Melvin, who began his journalism career in our Columbia newsroom.

This opportunity places you inside the same award-winning environment that helped launch Craig’s trajectory from WIS intern to NBC network anchor. This internship provides hands-on experience as a valued member of the newsroom team, plus guidance directly from Craig, who will generously share his time and insight.

We’re seeking an intern with Craig’s energy, enthusiasm, and drive. If you’re passionate about informing and serving your community, this internship is your chance to take a meaningful step toward a career in journalism with WIS and Gray Media.

The Internship Program:

As a paid intern, you won’t sit and watch someone else doing their job. Gray’s intern program is an immersive experience where you serve as a valued team member on our award-winning teams.

With 117 television stations across the U.S., Gray Media offers an unprecedented opportunity for students to learn an area of broadcast expertise from seasoned professionals in the business. Whether your interest involves news, production, sales, marketing, or engineering, our stations become a hands-on learning environment for Gray Media interns. If we have an employee doing it, there can be a Gray intern learning and earning.

Not only will you walk away with an expanded resume and portfolio, but Gray’s paid internship also opens doors to begin your full-time career with Gray Media. Many of our current employees started as interns. Our paid internship program puts you at the front of the line for full-time job openings, armed with the training you received from your internship.

Interested in learning more? Check out the program description and apply today!

The intern rate of pay can range from the minimum wage in your state to $15 an hour.

▪️ Be currently enrolled in a college/university (preferred: Junior/Senior)

job.title: 2027 Summer Internship- Creative (Writing/Editorial)
job.description:
ABOUT HALLMARK’S INTERNSHIP PROGRAM  

We're looking for curious, creative, and consumer-focused interns who are passionate about storytelling, trends, culture, creativity, and human connection. 

This posting includes two distinct Creative Internship opportunities within Hallmark Greetings Creative .

 

Writing Studio & Greetings Editorial Intern 

This internship provides hands-on experience in creative writing, content development, editorial planning, trend research, and greeting card product strategy. Interns will partner with writers, editors, and product teams to develop consumer-focused content and concepts that help Hallmark create meaningful connections through greeting cards and related products.  

 

What you'll do 

  • Create original writing for greeting cards and related Hallmark products. 
  • Explore emerging trends, voices, and cultural insights relevant to Gen Z and Gen Alpha consumers. 
  • Learn how Hallmark plans, develops, and curates greeting card programs. 
  • Conduct editorial analysis and consumer research to identify future content opportunities. 
  • Develop concepts and editorial content that authentically connect with consumers. 
  • Partner with writers, editors, designers, and product teams throughout the creative process. 
  • Present recommendations and creative concepts to business and creative leaders. 

               

              BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 

              The following is required to be considered for this role: 

              • Pursuing a bachelor's degree in English, Journalism, Communications, Creative Writing, Advertising, Marketing, Public Relations, or a related field 
              • A graduation date of December 2027, May 2028, December 2028, May 2029, December 2029, or May 2030.  

                 

                PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

                Your resume and application will stand out if you are: 

                • Demonstrated interest in writing, content creation, publishing, media, advertising, or product development 
                • Strong writing and editing skills 
                • Familiarity with social, cultural, and consumer trends relevant to Gen Z and Gen Alpha audiences 
                • Experience through coursework, publications, student organizations, freelance work, or personal creative projects is a plus 

                        

                      ADDITIONAL DETAILS 

                      • A portfolio is required for this position. Your portfolio should be compiled into one PDF document that is no larger than 5 MB. If your portfolio file size is above the 5MB limit, you can submit a one-page overview of your work (see example). You can also submit a link to a personal portfolio website to supplement your uploaded portfolio. Applicants who do not upload a portfolio or one-page overview will not be considered.
                      •  Candidates selected to move forward in the interview process will be asked to complete a few brief exercises later in the process.
                      • Our internship program is 12 weeks long, starting in late May and ending in early August. 
                      • This summer internship is a hybrid position, with the flexibility to work from both our recently renovated headquarters building in Kansas City, MO, and from your summer residence within the KC metro area. 
                      • Some relocation and housing assistance is provided for interns whose permanent address is outside of the KC metro area. Relocation is required for this role. 

                             

                            Interested? Follow the application instructions below to apply. 

                             

                            APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS  

                            Along with your resume and application, please provide up to 10 samples of your own writing that demonstrate:

                            • Your unique voice
                            • A range of content types (academic, creative, journalistic, prose, verse, etc.)
                            • Ability to edit for clarity / conciseness (for example, a piece of writing that shows before and after edits)
                            • Success in writing for a variety of audiences

                             

                            You must show how you meet the basic qualifications in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are Microsoft Word (DOC or DOCX), PDF, HTML, or TXT.  

                             

                            In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment. Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks. 

                             

                            ABOUT HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important  

                             

                            For more than a century, Hallmark has been bringing people together and improving the relationships that matter most. That’s why millions of people all over the world connect with the Hallmark brand. It has always been a mission so much bigger than any one of us who work here. Today, we need empathetic learners, strategic thinkers, and enthusiastic visionaries with diverse experiences and skills to help us create the rest of Hallmark’s second century as we shift to a more digitally savvy, unified approach that combines the best of brick-and-mortar retail with the efficiency of dot-com spaces. Help us imagine what our next hundred years could look like!  

                            When you join Hallmark, we will go out of our way to make you feel like part of the team, even in a remote/hybrid work environment. In the day-to-day, we’ll make the best use of the skills and talents you already have. We’ll also give you leadership opportunities and show you multiple potential pathways to future success.  

                            Our culture of care for our consumers and for one another shows in the way we embrace different backgrounds, identities, and working styles, deliberately seeking out ways to be more inclusive both internally among our work groups and externally through the ings we make and sell to our retail partners and consumers. We believe that a broadly inclusive, equitable approach is also our best path to future success. We’re seeking out those who can bring a fresh perspective to our business and would love your input as someone new to our team! We can only change and grow when we intentionally include new perspectives–like yours.

job.title: Building Services Department Manager
job.description:
HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important 

For over 100 years, Hallmark has helped people connect and strengthen the relationships that matter most. Today, we’re building the next century of connection—blending the warmth of in-store experiences with the ease of digital innovation. We’re looking for empathetic learners, strategic thinkers, and enthusiastic visionaries from all backgrounds to help shape what’s next. If you’re ready to bring fresh ideas and energy, we’d love to have you on the team! As a Building Services Department Manager, you will lead facility operations, infrastructure, and building services at our Lawrence Production Center. You’ll be responsible for ensuring a safe, reliable, and compliant facility environment while overseeing capital improvement projects, contracted services, and emergency response planning. You’ll manage facility resources and budgets, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and support uninterrupted manufacturing operations. You’ll develop talent and align resources to meet the evolving needs of the site. 

The Building Services Department Manager will: 

  • Lead facility operations and building services, ensuring the safety, functionality, and reliability of plant buildings, utilities, HVAC systems, grounds, and site infrastructure.
  • Oversee capital construction, renovation, and facility improvement projects while ensuring projects meet budget, schedule, and quality expectations.
  • Manage vendor relationships and contracted services including janitorial, groundskeeping, pest control, waste management, security, and specialized building trades.
  • Ensure compliance with OSHA, environmental regulations, fire codes, permits, inspections, and corporate facility standards.
  • Serve as the Facility Emergency Coordinator, leading site preparedness and response for emergencies, severe weather, utility outages, and other facility-related incidents.
  • Develop and manage operating and capital budgets while supporting long-term facility planning and asset lifecycle management.
  • Lead and develop Building Specialists and HVAC Specialists while partnering closely with Operations, Engineering, Maintenance, Security, and EHS teams.

The role may require occasional weekend or after-hours work, depending on business needs. 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS The following is required to be considered for this role:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or four years of demonstrated management experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Four years of experience in building operations.
  • Four years of experience managing front-line employees.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Good aptitude for utilizing business applications and systems.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Your resume and application will stand out if you have:

  • DOT, EPA Hazardous Waste, and OSHA-related training.
  • Demonstrated experience managing emergency situations and facility-related incidents.
  • Experience overseeing facility operations in a manufacturing, industrial, or commercial environment.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop individuals and teams.

job.title: Ice Rink Attendant - Crown Center Ice Terrace (Part-time Seasonal)
job.description:
WHAT YOU WILL DO

The Ice Rink Attendant monitors and assists customers, ensures that customers skate in a safe manner according to the posted rules, and serves as the first point of contact in case of injury. The Ice Rink Attendant monitors the surface of the ice, fills in holes, reports problem areas to the Zamboni drivers to ensure a quality skating experience for the customer.  

The Ice Rink Attendant interacts with and welcomes customers to the Pro Shop, issues skates, and advises of proper fit and lacing techniques. The Ice Rink Attendant operates a cash register at the main entrance of the Pro Shop and / or in the concessions area. The incumbent must be knowledgeable of proper food handling techniques and health department regulations for the concessions area. The Ice Rink attendant restocks the concession area, shovels snow and ice around the rink, removes trash and cleans tables.

*The Crown Center Ice Terrace is open to the public 7 days a week.

November thru January

  • Sunday - Thursday: 10:00am - 9:00pm 
  • Friday & Saturday: 10:00am - 11:00pm

 

February & March

  • Monday - Thursday: 11:00am - 9:00pm
  • Friday: 11:00am - 10:00pm
  • Saturday: 10:00am - 10:00pm
  • Sunday: 10:00am - 9:00pm

 

We're looking for Ice Rink Attendants who can work weekends (Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays). All Ice Rink Attendants must be available to work Saturday evenings, 5:00pm – 11:00pm. There are a couple of openings Monday - Friday, 10:00am - 5:00pm. Additionally, Ice Rink Attendants must be flexible and available to work day or evening shifts. Work schedules will vary between the hours of 9:00 am to midnight through the week and on the weekend.

job.title: Materials Movement Specialist - 3rd Shift
job.description:
FIND OUT WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A PART OF HALLMARK SUPPLY CHAIN

The Material Movement Specialist position in Lawrence is on 3rd Shift (11:30pm - 7:30am), Sunday night through Friday morning.

The Materials Movement Specialist reports through the Warehouse Department in the Lawrence Production Center.  Individuals in this department transport stock and recycled material to and from the warehouse to the production areas.   

 

The Materials Movement Specialist in Lawrence transports stock between production departments and warehouse or between shipping and receiving docks.  Loads and unloads incoming and outgoing trucks.  Locates stock in the warehouse and fills orders for manufacturing using a variety of powered equipment.  Responsible for loading and unloading skids onto the vertical lift and using the elevator as necessary.  Responsible for sorting paper or other materials into proper recycling categories to ensure maximum revenue generation.  Acts as a technical resource to support departments on paper grading.  Operates paper, chip and poly balers to compress recyclable materials into bales.  Responsible for all documentation related to stock movement.  Transports hazardous waste material in accordance with Federal, State, and Local regulations.   Positively participates in performance dialogues and other team problem-solving activities.  Identifies potential problems, and shows willingness to proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation.  Flexibility is key as the incumbent will be expected to move to different work assignments as needed.  Incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.

 

The Materials Movement Specialist position may be in several departments, and incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.   

 

In this position you will:

  • Be certified to operate fork lifts and other power equipment as required. 
  • Transport stock between production departments and warehouse or between shipping and receiving docks and load onto trucks.
  • Prepare materials and supplies for shipment using banding equipment, power saws, power drills, film wrapper and string tie as required.  Responsible for all documentation related to stock movement.
  • Coordinate with paper recycling contractor, metal, or other contractors regarding the pick-up and delivery of storage containers and trailers to support manufacturing workloads.  Performs preventive and scheduled maintenance services on balers and power equipment. 
  • Demonstrate the flexibility and teamwork to positively influence how goals are accomplished with shorter periods of time. 
  • Communicate effectively with outside vendors and other departments.
  • Utilize good safety practices.

 

Requirements:

To be considered an applicant for this position you must show how you meet the basic qualifications of the job in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields.  Accepted file types are Microsoft Word (DOC or DOCX), PDF, HTML, or TXT.  Individual file size attachment limit is 10 MB.

 

If additional openings become available within 30 days of the posting coming down and the vacancy is still in an open status, applicants will be selected from the original posting. If interested in this job, please apply now.

  • Ability to frequently move materials weighing 35 pounds and occasionally lift materials weighing up to 50 pounds from the floor

job.title: Press Operator (38) - 3rd Shift
job.description:

This position is Full-time (40 hr) benefits eligible, schedule is Sunday night through Friday morning, 11:30pm - 7:30am.

The Press Operator in Lawrence sets up and operates belt fold machines, page insert machines, double overlay machines, etc. that fold paper, light weight packets, and board stock in multiple ways.  May apply glue to stock during operation.  The machinery is of varying vintages, manufacturers, and types with multiple variables impacting press performance.  Applies acetate, vinyl overlay (materials sensitive to temperature, pressure, ink, etc.) or insert pages to greeting cards.  Performs make-ready duties and prepares press or multiple presses, and types of presses to run a variety of folds, some with severe die cut design.  Maintains and operates glue systems.  Incumbent may also diagnose and perform machinery maintenance repairs and preventive maintenance functions while assisting operators.  Responsible for specified production, quality checks, and TPM’s.  Positively participates in performance dialogues and other team problem-solving activities.

Identifies potential problems, and shows willingness to proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation.  Flexibility is key as the incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.

 

In this position you will:

  • Perform make-ready duties on multiple press types with varying controls and production factors (speed, temperature, pressure, etc.). 
  • Read layout, tickets and have an understanding of downstream processes.  
  • Diagnose and perform machinery maintenance repairs and preventive maintenance functions. 
  • Execute the Quality System including preflights, sampling plan and the removal of salvage/spoilage. 
  • Prepare related paperwork/documentation for shipping accuracy, including completing production data and spoilage.

job.description:
FIND OUT WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A PART OF HALLMARK SUPPLY CHAIN

Come work for Hallmark as a Warehouse Order Selector! This is a 3rd shift position working Sunday night-Friday morning, 11pm-7am. Hallmark offers an exceptional work-life balance, a comfortable environment, a comprehensive benefits package, paid holidays, and great company culture.

This position requires the incumbent to fill retail orders in several different pick mediums within Order Processing that include Single Carton Fill, Multi Carton Fill, and Batch Cart while wearing a headset and using a handheld device. Filling methods and skills will vary according to area. Therefore, flexibility to fill in all work types within this description is required. The incumbent completes customer orders using computer-generated documents to pick 2D and 3D product from bins throughout the warehouse while meeting production expectations. This position requires the highest possible quality and customer service by adhering to standard operating procedures while selecting and packing items in cartons and placing cartons on a conveyor system. 

Teamwork, cooperation and flexibility, along with LEAN principles of problem solving and elimination of waste are expectations of the position. Additionally, every employee is responsible for their personal safety, as well as the safety of their peers. Adherence to established safety policies and procedures, along with the reporting of all injuries and unsafe conditions are also requirements of this position.  Business needs of the department may require additions or changes to the duties of this position.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 18 years of age
  • Able to read, write and understand English
  • Ability to constantly, stand, walk push/pull and reach above shoulder level
  • Ability to push, pull, lift, and carry up to 30 pounds constantly, up to 40 pounds frequently and lift up to 60 pounds occasionally

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma, GED or equivalent 
  • Ability to follow instructions and prioritize tasks
  • Able to work in a variety of conditions with automated equipment
  • Ability to operate a PC in a windows environment
  • Attention to detail

 

Now’s your chance to embrace a future with Hallmark—just follow the instructions below to apply.

You must show how you meet the basic qualifications in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are DOCX and PDF. 

In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment.

Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks.

Hallmark is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, pregnancy, national origin, physical or mental disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other legally-protected status. Principals only please.

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

  • The Order Processor position is located at the Hallmark Liberty Distribution Center located in Liberty, Missouri.
  • Relocation will not be provided.
  • Will be required to work at all Liberty/DC locations.

job.title: EXPERIENCES COORDINATOR
job.description:
Position: (Part Time)

Experiences Coordinator

Reports to:

Experiences Manager

Brand(s)

Cruz, play

Location:

Edmonton, AB

Application Deadline:

November 15, 2026

Only those candidates selected to interview will be contacted and no phone calls please

Do you love being a part of concerts and events? Do you want a job that makes all your friends jealous? Here is your chance to help plan and execute exciting promotions, contests, and activations.

Harvard Media is looking for an Experiences Coordinator to join our Edmonton team and work closely with our Experiences Managers, Program Director and Director of Sales. We need your help executing compelling contests and exciting events that build our brands, engage our listeners, and benefit our clients.

Are you up for the challenge? You’ll work in a fun, fast-paced environment where no two days are the same, with a team and a company that wants to see you learn and grow. Sound good? Send us your resume.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Post promotional content across station websites and social media platforms to support experiences and marketing initiatives.

Track and document station promotions, events, and community initiatives.

Attend and represent brands at all major station events and designated client promotions as needed.

Create and manage giveaways using SPARC, ensuring accuracy and compliance with station policies and ensuring prizing is accounted for.

Manage the distribution of prizes and maintain records of contest winners and prize fulfillment.

Be present at off-site promotional events, including giveaways, live broadcasts, and special appearances.

Preparation of equipment and merchandise for events.

Gather data for experience wrap reports.

Maintain promotional materials and station vehicles by ensuring cleanliness, fueling, and identifying items that need repair or replacement.

Other duties as assigned by the Experiences Manager.

Essential Knowledge and Skills:

Strong computer skills including proficiency in Microsoft systems like Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams, Excel & Word

Canva knowledge and skills considered an asset

Video editing software experience is an asset

Social media editing and posting for a brand

Keen problem-solver with ability to act quickly and accurately

Strong communication and interpersonal skills

Creative, dynamic, energetic, and accountable

Self-motivated, team player with a positive attitude and passion to succeed with an eagerness to learn new skills

Essential Requirements:

Minimum 2 years of experience in marketing, promotions and/or media industry would be a definite asset, or related experience that demonstrates the necessary skills and abilities for this position

Must have high attention to detail with exceptional organizational skills

The skills necessary to update station websites and social media with a willingness to learn

Ability to work well under pressure and handle multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment under minimal supervision

Must be willing to work flexible hours. Weekend and evening hours will be required for station events and promotions

Must hold a valid Class 5 driver's license with a clean driving record and provide a driver’s abstract

Must be eligible for coverage under Harvard’s Insurance Plan

A love for getting out in the community and meeting and greeting our listeners first-hand

job.title: GENERAL REPORTER - SASKATOON, SK
job.description:
Position: (Full Time)

General Reporter

Reports to:

Content Manager

Station(s)

SaskToday

Location:

Saskatoon, SK

Application Deadline:

Until filled

Harvard Media is a leading media company in Western Canada, operating 13 radio stations and several top-tier digital news sites like SaskToday.ca. Our digital footprint includes websites, streaming audio, and social media channels. We reach a vast audience, delivering engaging news, sports, and entertainment content focused on Western Canada.

The General Reporter will be key in our newsroom, responsible for covering diverse events and topics in Saskatoon, including local politics, agriculture, business, and arts and culture. This role demands a passionate journalist with a strong sense of curiosity and the ability to produce accurate and engaging news stories under tight deadlines. The ideal candidate will develop and maintain relationships with key community stakeholders and enhance storytelling through multimedia tools.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Covering diverse events and topics in Saskatoon, including local politics, agriculture, business, arts and culture.

Conducting interviews, research and fact-checking to produce accurate and engaging news stories for online publication.

Developing sources and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders in the community.

Pitching story ideas and collaborating with editors and fellow reporters to ensure comprehensive coverage of local events and issues.

Working as a team player, co-operating with other reporters on projects that have a province-wide value.

Adhering to tight deadlines and editorial standards while producing high-quality journalism.

Utilizing various multimedia tools, including photography and video, to enhance storytelling.

Radio tasks.

Other duties as assigned.

Essential Knowledge and Skills:

Strong understanding of local politics, agriculture, business, arts and culture.

Excellent interviewing, research, and fact-checking skills.

Proven ability to develop and maintain sources within the community.

Proficiency in multimedia tools for storytelling, including photography and video.

Ability to work under tight deadlines while maintaining high editorial standards.

Strong writing and editing skills, with an emphasis on accuracy and clarity.

Effective collaboration and teamwork abilities.

Essential Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, or a related field.

Proven experience as a reporter covering a diverse range of topics, with a strong portfolio of published work.

Excellent writing and communication skills, with a keen eye for detail and accuracy.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced virtual newsroom environment.

Knowledge of local issues, politics and community dynamics in Saskatoon is preferred.

Familiarity with multimedia reporting tools and social media platforms.

Commitment to journalistic ethics and integrity.

Flexibility to work evenings and weekends as needed.

Must have a current driver’s license and reliable vehicle.

We appreciate the interest of all applicants. While we will only be able to contact those selected for interviews, we kindly request to refrain from phone inquiries.

Harvard Media values diversity in its work force and is committed to Employment Equity

job.title: SALES ENABLEMENT & OFFICE SUPPORT
job.description:
Sales Enablement & Office Support

Play 103.7 & 100.5 Cruz FM | Harvard Media

Location: Fort McMurray, AlbertaSchedule: Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:00 PMWork Arrangement: 100% In-OfficeReports to: Market Lead / Sales Manager

YOUR ROLE

We're looking for a highly organized, creative, and proactive individual to join our Fort McMurray team in Sales Enablement & Office Support.

This position plays an important role in supporting our local sales team, ensuring advertising campaigns run smoothly, client commitments are fulfilled, and creative ideas are brought to life.

Working closely with our Sales Manager, Sales Representatives, and internal departments, you'll help turn great ideas into successful advertising campaigns and memorable client experiences.

From preparing sales proposals and coordinating advertising campaigns to supporting sales-driven promotions, events, and daily office operations, you'll be an essential part of keeping our sales team and office organized, efficient, and moving forward.

This is a hands-on, fully in-office position that requires a strong sense of ownership, initiative, and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

We're looking for someone who doesn't wait to be told what needs to be done. You'll anticipate needs, recognize priorities, take responsibility for assigned projects, and follow through to completion.

The ideal candidate thrives in a busy environment, can confidently juggle multiple responsibilities, adapt when priorities shift, and takes pride in being the person the team can count on to keep things running smoothly.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Sales Support & Campaign Coordination

Assist the Sales Manager and Sales Representatives with preparing proposals, presentations, sales materials, and client communications.

Support the coordination and execution of advertising campaigns, promotions, and client commitments.

Maintain accurate sales records, inventory trackers, reports, and internal documents.

Coordinate with internal departments to ensure campaigns and projects are completed accurately and on time.

Follow up on outstanding requests, deadlines, and deliverables to keep projects moving forward.

Creative & Marketing Support

Use Canva to create professional sales presentations, promotional materials, social media graphics, and other marketing assets.

Assist with the development and execution of sales-driven promotions, contests, and special events.

Support the preparation of client proposals and customized advertising packages.

Bring creative ideas and solutions to the team while maintaining brand consistency and professionalism.

Office & Administrative Support

Support daily office operations, ensuring the workplace remains organized, professional, and efficient.

Welcome and assist clients, visitors, and staff in a friendly and professional manner.

Assist with scheduling, correspondence, document preparation, and general administrative duties.

Maintain organized files, supplies, records, and office resources.

Respond to changing office and sales needs while managing multiple tasks and deadlines.

Ownership, Initiative & Accountability

Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and projects from start to finish, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

Proactively identify what needs to be done and take action without waiting for direction.

Anticipate the needs of the Sales Manager, Sales Representatives, and office, staying one step ahead whenever possible.

Confidently multitask in a fast-paced environment, balancing competing deadlines, unexpected requests, and changing priorities.

Manage competing priorities independently, recognizing urgent requests and adjusting accordingly.

Follow up on outstanding tasks, client commitments, and internal requests until they are resolved.

Identify opportunities to improve processes, organization, and efficiency within the sales department and office.

Communicate proactively, providing updates, flagging concerns early, and asking questions when clarification is needed.

Be a reliable, consistent presence in the office who takes pride in supporting the success of the entire team.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Experience with Canva and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) is required. Candidates must be comfortable using these programs independently and confidently.

Strong Canva skills, with the ability to create professional sales presentations, promotional materials, social media graphics, and other marketing assets.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel for tracking and organizing information, Word for document preparation, PowerPoint for presentations, and Outlook for email and scheduling.

Proven ability to multitask and thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing several projects, requests, and deadlines simultaneously without sacrificing accuracy or attention to detail.

Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively as needs change throughout the day.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

High attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, professional work.

Ability to work independently, take initiative, and follow projects through to completion with minimal supervision.

Strong problem-solving skills, resourcefulness, and a willingness to learn new systems and processes.

A positive, team-oriented attitude with the flexibility to jump in and help wherever needed.

Previous experience in sales support, marketing, administration, or a related role is considered an asset.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success in this role means:

The Sales Manager and Sales Representatives can focus more of their time on selling and building client relationships.

Sales orders, campaigns, promotions, and client commitments are completed accurately and on time.

Tasks and projects are managed independently with minimal follow-up required.

Multiple projects and competing priorities are handled efficiently, even during busy periods.

Office needs are anticipated and addressed before they become problems.

Clients, visitors, and colleagues receive friendly, professional, and timely assistance.

Sales resources, inventory trackers, and internal systems are consistently organized and up to date.

Communication between departments is clear, proactive, and efficient.

The team has confidence that when something is assigned, it will be handled from beginning to end.

WORK ENVIRONMENT & EXPECTATIONS

This position is based entirely at our Play 103.7 and 100.5 Cruz FM office in Fort McMurray.

Regular working hours are Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM. This is not a remote or hybrid position.

Being physically present is an essential part of the role, as the position supports daily office operations, walk-in visitors, client needs, staff, and time-sensitive sales activities.

Our office is a busy, fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly. The successful candidate must be comfortable multitasking, adapting to unexpected requests, and maintaining a high level of organization and professionalism throughout the day.

The successful candidate will be expected to work independently, exercise good judgment, maintain confidentiality, and demonstrate a high level of accountability in their daily responsibilities.

Harvard Media values diversity in its work force and is committed to Employment Equity.

job.title: AI Music Research Intern
job.description:
About Hook Hook is a social music platform, backed by top-tier investors, building the next generation of music discovery, fan expression, and creator growth. We turn the songs people love into sounds they can play with, enabling fans and creators to reimagine music through intuitive, remix-friendly experiences with zero learning curve. By partnering directly with artists, labels, and rightsholders, Hook ensures music is discovered, shared, and expressed in ways that respect and reward the people behind it. At Hook, music isn’t just consumed. It’s experienced, expressed, and made personal. Role

Overview

We are looking for a curious and motivated AI Music Research Intern to help us explore and develop AI-powered tools for music creation, transformation, remixing, and creative interaction. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of music, machine learning, and creative technology, experimenting with emerging AI techniques and helping turn research ideas into practical tools for music creators. You’ll have the opportunity to work on real-world challenges involving generative audio, music understanding, and audio modeling, while collaborating with our music technology, engineering, product, and creative teams. Whether you have

experience

through academic research, coursework, or personal projects, this is an opportunity to apply your technical skills to exciting problems in AI music and help shape new ways for people to interact with music. At Hook, we believe AI should expand creative possibilities while respecting the people behind the music. You’ll contribute to developing tools that support musical expression and responsible use of music and data.

Responsibilities

Explore AI music technologies: Research and experiment with machine learning approaches for music generation, transformation, remixing, and audio understanding. Implement and evaluate models: Use Python and modern ML frameworks to build, test, and evaluate AI models and audio processing techniques. Build prototypes: Develop experimental tools and prototypes that explore new ways to make music more interactive, expressive, and accessible. Work with data and experiments: Process audio datasets, run experiments, and evaluate model performance, audio quality, and musicality. Collaborate and share findings: Work with engineers, music technologists, and producers to explore creative use cases, document experiments, and contribute to responsible AI development.

Qualifications

Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Audio Signal Processing, Music Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Foundational knowledge of machine learning, deep learning, and statistical methods. Proficiency in Python and familiarity with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch. Interest in audio, music, generative AI, or creative applications of machine learning. Familiarity with audio processing, digital signal processing, or music-related datasets through coursework, research, or personal projects. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with curiosity and a willingness to experiment with new ideas. Ability to work independently on technical tasks while collaborating effectively with a multidisciplinary team. Genuine interest in music, creative tools, and how technology can expand musical expression. Bonus

Qualifications

Academic projects, research experience, or personal projects involving audio processing, music generation, or machine learning. Familiarity with generative audio models, including diffusion-based, autoregressive, or other neural audio architectures.

Experience

with audio libraries, such as librosa or torchaudio, or tools for audio analysis and manipulation. Familiarity with audio embeddings, neural audio codecs, text-audio models, or multimodal learning.

Experience

with music production software, digital audio workstations (DAWs), audio plugins, or creative coding tools.

Experience

collaborating with musicians, producers, or other creative professionals. Familiarity with evaluating generative models or assessing subjective qualities such as musicality, expressiveness, and controllability. Interest in responsible AI practices, including artist consent, music rights, and ethical dataset development. Contributions to research projects, open-source software, machine learning competitions, or relevant technical communities. Our Approach to Responsible AI Music At Hook, we believe AI should expand what people can do with music while respecting the people who create it. We build with artists and rightsholders in mind, developing tools that support creative expression while recognizing the value of human creativity. This means taking a thoughtful approach to the music and data used in model development, respecting rights and permissions, and considering how our technology affects artists, producers, and the broader music ecosystem. We value interns who combine technical curiosity with a thoughtful approach to building AI responsibly and who are excited to help develop technology that

benefits

both music creators and listeners. What We Offer Hands-on

experience

researching and building AI-powered music tools. The opportunity to work on real-world challenges in generative AI, audio modeling, and music technology. Close collaboration with researchers, engineers, music technologists, and producers. The opportunity to experiment with emerging technologies and contribute ideas to product development. Exposure to the process of turning research prototypes into practical creative tools. Mentorship and support for continued technical learning and professional growth. A chance to help shape the future of music discovery, creation, and expression in a responsible, creative environment.

job.description:

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineering Intern to help design, build, and improve the recommendation systems that power personalized music discovery and social experiences at Hook. experience

Experiment and optimize: Train, benchmark, and evaluate different recommendation approaches to identify opportunities to improve model performance. Build ML prototypes: Translate ideas and algorithms into working prototypes using Python and frameworks such as PyTorch or scikit-learn. Collaborate and contribute: Work closely with engineering and product teams to test new approaches, document findings, and contribute to improving Hook's recommendation systems.

Qualifications

Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field. Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with libraries such as NumPy and pandas. Foundational knowledge of machine learning, statistics, and data analysis. Hands-on

experience

with at least one ML framework, preferably PyTorch. Interest in recommendation systems, information retrieval, ranking, or personalization. Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and willingness to learn and collaborate in a fast-paced engineering environment. Bonus

Qualifications

Experience

building academic or personal projects involving machine learning or recommendation systems. Familiarity with recommendation techniques such as collaborative filtering, content-based filtering, or embeddings.

Experience

working with SQL, real-world datasets, or user interaction data. Familiarity with deep learning frameworks, model evaluation, or experimentation. A personal interest in music, music discovery, or social platforms. What We Offer Hands-on

experience

building and improving real-world recommendation and personalization systems. The opportunity to work on the full ML development lifecycle, from data processing and model development to evaluation and product integration. Exposure to practical engineering challenges involving recommendation algorithms, ranking, retrieval, and personalization. Close collaboration with experienced teammates across engineering, research, and product. Mentorship and opportunities to develop strong machine learning and software engineering skills. The freedom to experiment with new approaches, technologies, and ML architectures. The opportunity to make a direct impact on how millions of people could discover, interact with, and

experience

music.

job.title: Research Scientist, AI Music
job.description:
About Hook Hook is a social music platform, backed by top-tier investors, building the next generation of music discovery, fan expression, and creator growth. We turn the songs people love into sounds they can play with, enabling fans and creators to reimagine music through intuitive, remix-friendly experiences with zero learning curve. By partnering directly with artists, labels, and rightsholders, Hook ensures music is discovered, shared, and expressed in ways that respect and reward the people behind it. At Hook, music isn’t just consumed. It’s experienced, expressed, and made personal. Role

Overview

We are looking for a Research Scientist, AI Music to advance the state of the art in AI-powered music creation, transformation, and interaction. In this role, you will research, develop, and evaluate machine learning models that enable new ways for people to play with music, while translating cutting-edge research into intuitive, high-quality product experiences. You’ll work at the intersection of music, machine learning, and creative technology, collaborating closely with our music technology team, producers, and product and engineering partners to turn creative ideas into powerful AI tools. From exploring generative audio models and music understanding to developing novel ways to remix, transform, and interact with music, you’ll help define how AI can make musical expression more accessible. At Hook, we believe the future of AI music should be built responsibly. We are committed to developing tools that respect artists, their creative work, and the rights of music creators and rightsholders. You’ll help shape this approach by building AI systems that enable creative expression while prioritizing ethical data practices, transparency, and responsible use of music.

Responsibilities

Research and develop AI music models: Design and develop machine learning models for music generation, transformation, remixing, and creative interaction. Explore emerging technologies: Investigate advances in generative audio, music understanding, audio representation learning, and related areas of machine learning. Translate research into products: Turn research ideas and prototypes into practical, high-quality AI capabilities, working closely with engineering and music technology teams. Experiment and evaluate: Design experiments and evaluation frameworks to assess audio quality, musicality, controllability, performance, and creative usefulness. Collaborate with creative teams: Work closely with producers, musicians, and cross-functional teams to understand creative workflows and develop intuitive, musically meaningful tools. Champion responsible AI development: Consider music rights, training data provenance, artist consent, and attribution throughout model development.

Qualifications

Advanced degree (PhD or MS) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Audio Signal Processing, Music Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong foundation in machine learning, deep learning, and statistical methods, with

experience

developing and evaluating ML models.

Experience

with audio or music-related machine learning, such as generative audio, music understanding, audio representation learning, source separation, or signal processing. Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks, such as PyTorch. Familiarity with audio processing libraries, datasets, and evaluation techniques. Ability to conduct independent applied research and translate research insights into working prototypes and real-world applications. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and creative disciplines. Genuine interest in music, creative tools, and the ways technology can expand musical expression. Bonus

Qualifications

Experience

training, fine-tuning, or deploying generative audio or music models, including diffusion-based, autoregressive, or other neural audio architectures.

Experience

with audio codecs, neural vocoders, audio tokenization, text-audio models, or multimodal learning. Familiarity with agent frameworks and workflow orchestration tools for building multi-step AI applications. Familiarity with music production workflows, DAWs, audio plugins, or creative software.

Experience

collaborating directly with producers, musicians, or other creative professionals to develop or evaluate AI-powered tools.

Experience

building low-latency, interactive audio systems or deploying ML models in production environments.

Experience

designing evaluation methods for subjective qualities such as musicality, expressiveness, controllability, and creative utility. Knowledge of responsible AI practices for music, including rights-aware dataset development, artist consent, data provenance, and attribution. Research publications or contributions in machine learning, audio processing, generative AI, or music information retrieval. Our Approach to Responsible AI Music At Hook, we believe AI should expand what people can do with music while respecting the people who create it. We build with artists and rightsholders in mind, and we aim to develop AI tools that support creative expression rather than undermine the value of human creativity. This means taking a thoughtful approach to the music and data used in model development, respecting rights and permissions, and considering how our technology affects artists, producers, and the broader music ecosystem. We value researchers who bring both technical ambition and a strong sense of responsibility to their work, and who see ethical considerations as an integral part of building great products. What We Offer The opportunity to shape the future of AI-powered music creation and expression. Freedom to explore ambitious research ideas and influence technical and product direction. Close collaboration with a multidisciplinary team of researchers, engineers, music technologists, and producers. The opportunity to see your research become real tools used in creative workflows. A mission-driven environment focused on making music more interactive, accessible, and expressive while respecting the people behind it. Support for continued learning, research, and professional growth. Competitive compensation and benefits.

Job Summary:

Hope Media Group is seeking a Head of Music & Streaming Content to lead the overall music and content strategy for the Next Digital Product. This role owns the sound, content direction, playlist philosophy, programming standards, and listener content experience, working closely with product engineering to make sure the platform reflects the intended vision. It directs contractors who execute playlisting, production, and interactive streaming, and it directs the Director of Digital Audio Streams.

  • Build the editorial and programming framework future content roles will execute against day to day.
  • Own the content taxonomy: the mood, genre, and activity attributes that drive curation and personalization.
  • Monitor listening data — skips, completions, saves, repeat listening — to refine programming over time. 

Team Leadership:

  • Direct contract resources supporting playlisting, production, and interactive streaming, and manage the production budget.
  • Lead and develop the Director of Digital Audio Streams, delegating day-to-day streaming operations while retaining ownership of standards.

job.title: Vice President of Donor Engagement
job.description:
Description

 Join a company that truly impacts others!


Hope Media Group is a multi-brand ministry. Every story we share, every event we host, and every song we play is done to engage people to love Jesus, serve others, and spread Hope.

Hope Media Group the home of KSBJ, WayFM, Worship 24/7, Vida Unida, NGEN radio. Way Loud, Way New, Way Back, Gospel 24/7, God Listens Prayer App and Hope Events. 

We invite you to apply and become a part of our growing ministry to Love Jesus, Serve Others, and Spread Hope. Our team describes our environment as fun, encouraging, collaborative, engaging, caring, family-oriented, and friendly. We would love for you to join us and be part of what God is doing in our ministry! 


Summary: 

The Vice President, Donor Engagement provides leadership for Hope Media Group's entire donor engagement and fundraising strategy, ensuring an integrated donor journey from acquisition through transformational giving. The VP leads the strategy and performance of donor care, donor communications, mid-level giving, major and catalyst donor engagement, and other donor-facing initiatives, with accountability for donor retention, revenue growth, stewardship, and long-term donor value. As a senior leader within Donor Engagement, this role develops leaders, drives cross-functional alignment, uses data and analytics to inform investment and strategy, and partners with the Chief of Donor Engagement and organizational leadership to advance HMG's ministry and revenue objectives.  

 

Essential Functions

Strategic Direction: 

  • Develop and lead HMG's comprehensive donor engagement strategy, establishing the vision, priorities, goals, and measures of success for donor acquisition, cultivation, retention, stewardship, and growth across the donor lifecycle. 
  • Use data and analytics to evaluate donor behavior, fundraising performance, and engagement trends, informing strategies across the donor lifecycle and identifying opportunities for growth, retention, and increased donor value. 
  • Establish and maintain clear donor pathways that move individuals from initial engagement through mid-level, major, and catalyst giving. 
  • Provide strategic leadership and input into fundraising campaigns and initiatives that generate resources to expand ministry impact. 
  • Collaborate with ministry and organizational leaders to ensure a cohesive, integrated donor journey across HMG brands and platforms. 
  • Establish key performance indicators and regularly evaluate progress toward donor engagement, retention, and revenue objectives. 

Organizational & Executive Leadership: 

  • Serve as a strategic partner to the Chief of Donor Engagement in establishing fundraising priorities, revenue strategies, and long-term donor engagement goals.
    • Translate organizational strategy into clear priorities and measurable objectives across Donor Engagement teams.
    • Partner with senior leaders across HMG to align donor strategy with programming, marketing, digital, finance, data, and ministry initiatives.
    • Provide executive-level insight into donor trends, fundraising performance, opportunities, and risks.
    • Represent Donor Engagement in organizational planning and cross-functional initiatives.
    • Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing leadership team, equipping directors and managers to effectively lead their functions and teams. 
  • Ensure alignment, accountability, and effective decision-making across Donor Engagement functions while empowering leaders to execute within their areas of responsibility. 

Donor Engagement & Program Oversight 

  • Provide strategic oversight of HMG's donor engagement programs, ensuring alignment and effectiveness across donor care, communications, mid-level, major, catalyst, events, and other donor-facing initiatives. 
  • Oversee the mid-level donor advisor program, ensuring effective portfolio strategy, donor cultivation, stewardship, and pathways to major giving. 
  • Lead Donor Communications strategy, including collaboration with fundraising consultants, ensuring cohesive multi-channel stewardship and solicitation across print, digital, on-air, and other donor touchpoints. 
  • Provide strategic oversight to Donor Care, ensuring donors receive responsive, compassionate, and effective support. 
  • Guide strategies that strengthen donor acquisition, retention, engagement, stewardship, and long-term donor value. 
  • Ensure alignment between fundraising leadership and HMG's overall donor engagement strategy. 

Department Operations & Performance: 

  • Ensure Donor Engagement has effective systems, processes, tools, and resources necessary to achieve departmental objectives. 
  • Establish expectations for operational excellence, accountability, documentation, reporting, and cross-functional collaboration across Donor Engagement. 
  • Identify organizational or departmental barriers to effectiveness and partner with Donor Engagement leaders and cross-functional teams to implement solutions. 
  • Provide executive oversight of key departmental projects and initiatives, ensuring appropriate ownership, prioritization, and accountability. 
  • Partner with Finance, HR, IT, and other organizational functions to ensure Donor Engagement leaders and teams have the resources and support necessary to achieve fundraising and donor engagement objectives. 

Budget Management:

  • Partner with the Chief of Donor Engagement and Finance to develop annual departmental budgets, fundraising revenue goals, and forecasts. 
  • Regularly evaluate departmental spending and fundraising performance against budget and forecast, identifying risks, opportunities, and necessary adjustments. 
  • Ensure departmental resources are strategically allocated toward initiatives that advance donor engagement and fundraising objectives. 
  • Provide FP&A monthly input to accurately forecast costs and revenue. 
  • Ensure departmental spending complies with HMG financial, credit card, travel, and purchasing policies. 

 Demonstrated Faith: 

  • Committed to a personal relationship with Jesus Christ 
  • Grounded spiritually and biblically literate 
  • Comfortable praying for co-workers in team meetings, leading spoken prayer, and participating in ministry prayer meetings and Bible studies 
  • Live Christian principles defined by the Ministry Statement of Faith 
  • Participate in on-air fundraisers and prays for donors as needed 
  • Passion for leveraging the platform of radio for evangelism and discipleship 
  • Exhibit a strong moral character 
  • Active member of a Bible believing local church 

Requirements

 Non-Essential Functions:

  • Perform other duties as requested 

Requirements and Qualifications: 

Education: 

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred 

Experience: 

  • 7–10 years nonprofit fundraising, donor engagement, or donor communications experience.  
  • Demonstrated success in donor program design and execution, including mass, mid, and major stewardship programs.   
  • Experience managing and coaching diverse teams.  
  • Familiarity with direct mail, digital campaigns, and donor care strategies 

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: 

  • Heart for Christian ministry.  
  • Strong moral character and personal relationship with Jesus Christ.  
  • Strategic thinker with ability to use data for decision-making.  
  • Skilled communicator with ability to build rapport and inspire trust.  
  • Excellent written/verbal communication and interpersonal skills.  
  • Ability to lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams.  
  • Knowledge of donor databases, fundraising systems, and Microsoft Office Suite. 

Supervisory Responsibilities: :

  • Immediate supervision over a unit, section, or department. Recommends candidates for hiring, termination; prepares and conducts performance appraisals and salary reviews and applies company policies. 

Working Conditions and Environment 

Travel: 

  • Occasional overnight travel required for donor meetings, events, and organizational gatherings 

Nights/Weekends/Holidays: 

  • May be required occasionally for donor events or fundraisers 

Physical Requirements 

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.  

Physical Activity may include Talking. Expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Those activities in which they must convey detailed or important spoken instructions to other workers accurately, loudly, or quickly. Hearing. Perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Ability to receive detailed information through oral communication, and to make the discriminations in sound. Repetitive motion. Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers including pinching, typing or otherwise working, primarily with fingers rather than the whole hand as in handling.  

Light work. Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. If the use of arm and/or leg controls requires exertion of forces greater than that for sedentary work and the worker sits most of the time, the job is rated for light work. 

The worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading. 


 Full-Time Benefits Offerings:

  • Medical
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Health Savings Account w/employer contribution
  • Flexible Savings Accounts
  • Company Paid Short Term Disability/Long Term Disability
  • EAP (Employee Assistance Program)
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Three (3) Paid Mission Days
  • Twelve (12) Company-Paid Holidays
  • 403B Retirement with Company Match
  • Group Life Insurance
  • Legal Shield/Identity Theft Protection
  • Access to Marketplace Ministry Chaplains

Submissions from third parties will not be considered and may be retained without obligation or payment or fees.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive

#26-1326

Albuquerque, New Mexico, United States

Apply

Business Unit

KOB-TV

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

Mountains, streams, deserts, ancient ruins, world-class art, varied culture and a crazy-good brew and food scene.  That's the New Mexico life KOB 4 employees enjoy every day.  The variety represented in our state drives a news organization that covers a wide range of stories from award-winning investigations and special projects to heart-touching profiles of people and real life issues you won't find anywhere else.  Sound good?  Come live in an amazing state and join the KOB 4 team as we proudly "Stand 4 New Mexico"!

Job Overview

The Account Executive is responsible for selling advertising to clients and developing new business relationships by prospecting, developing and selling new direct-business accounts, making sales presentations, performing collections, maintaining client relations and sales.

Job Responsibilities

Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets including spot, digital, and new direct business. Prospect new businesses on a weekly basis.

Prepare and complete sales presentations with decision makers.

Make presentations to include a customer needs analysis, research and supporting documentation, and creative business solutions.

Follow up and close all pending business in a timely manner.

Update Sales Manager weekly on progress of pending business.

Work closely with other departments in creating effective promotional sales solutions for clients.

Create and make presentations to agency personnel, including selling and pre-selling the station audience attributes.

Provide exceptional customer service to direct and agency accounts. Personally contact each active account regularly- defined as an in-person meeting, including the presentation of pertinent sales information.

Obtain credit approval for new accounts.

Ensure all accounts are paid in a timely manner. Follow up and assist in the collection process for past due accounts.

Utilization of and proficiency with Sales software.

Attend special events, such as remotes and broadcasts, which involve clients. These events may occur after business hours and on weekends.

Complete all written business requirements within established deadlines. These requirements include but are not limited to: forecast reports, pending business updates, written orders and advertising copy.

Attend and participate in weekly sales staff meetings, individual meetings with manager and other necessary meetings and training as required by management.

Have a thorough understanding of rates, promotions, inventory, and personnel. Continue to learn and stay abreast of trends in digital and broadcast advertising industry.

Maintain regular, reliable attendance.

Work cooperatively and collaboratively with others. Build working relationships with co-workers, customers, vendors and the general public.

Complete other duties as requested and needed.

Qualifications

Previous sales, advertising, digital sales, or media experience preferred

Knowledge of, and familiarity with, (or ability to learn) broadcasting and digital terminology and methodology preferred.

Ability to understand the features and benefits of advertising and competitive media.

Familiarity with Microsoft Word for Windows; sales software knowledge helpful.

Excellent written and oral English language communication skills.

Experience developing presentations for the purpose of direct-business selling and ability to effectively present and communicate.

Ability to respond to questions appropriately and think on feet.

Establish and maintain customer relationships; communicate effectively with a wide range of personalities in a professional manner.

High level of initiative and ability to work independently required.

Must have reliable transportation, a valid driver's license and a safe driving history as determined by the Company for the purpose of meeting clients and attending events. (Driving record will be checked.)

Demonstrate effective negotiation and closing techniques.

Strong analytical skills, good judgment, and a "positive can do attitude" are required.

Ability to read, hear and speak clearly and follow both oral and written direction.

Ability to think critically, analytically, creatively and logically; and to articulate information in clear, concise manner to others.

Ability to work evenings and weekends.

Physical Requirements: Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to manipulate computer keys and general office equipment (telephone, copier, etc.). Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time. The Company may make reasonable accommodations to facilitate the ability to perform essential job function.

Additional Information

This position is subject to pre-employment driving record background check. A conviction, violation pending adjudication, or adverse driving record more than 3 years old or does not meet the major violation definition per company policy will not, on its own, disqualify an applicant. The company will use background check information in a confidential, non-discriminatory manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Compensation and Benefits

When extending an offer, the company considers a variety of factors such as (but not limited to) the candidate's work experience, education/training & key skills as well as internal peer equity and other market and business considerations.

For information regarding our benefits, please copy the link below and paste in your browser:

https://hubbardbroadcasting.com/our-company/working-here/

EEO Statement

We are an equal opportunity employer, including disability/vets.

Diversity Statement

Hubbard Broadcasting has been committed to representing the communities we serve since our founding over 100 years ago. The same holds true today. We know the best way to accomplish this is by recruiting and retaining top talent from diverse cultures, life experiences, and world views. With dignity and respect, we value YOU and everything that makes YOU uniquely YOU.
