We do this with a commitment to our community...while growing our people and profits.

OUR VISION

To be an industry leader and set the standard for equality and inclusivity for all races, genders, ages, ethnicities, abilities, sexual orientations and religions by creating and fostering principles that integrate our core values.

OUR MISSION

To be proactive in providing a welcoming, professional environment; free of harassment, discrimination and marginalization with on-going habits that incorporate our unique experiences into the overall success and continuous evolution of this organization.

Job Overview

The Federal Drive anchor must have experience in developing ideas, conducting and managing audio and video interviews is strongly preferred, but will consider the right person with the right background in federal issues. This position holds the primary responsibility for the show’s content and adherence to Federal News Network editorial standards and focus areas. Also responsible for ensuring show is prepared and ready for broadcast each work day, five days per week. Audio and video show segments are posted online and published as podcast segments on major distribution networks, the Federal News Network website and multiple social media platforms. Therefore, anchor must treat Federal Drive as a primary contributor to Federal News Network’s website and as a means of attracting audience via multiple listening and watching formats and digital distribution channels.

PLANNING:

Leading the team to determine which guests and topics should be on the show, with a strong preference for federal executives

Working with news staff for suggestions and referrals

CREATING INTERVIEWS:

Reading, understanding background material

Writing teases, leads, tag

Conducting audio and video interviews, typically 2-to-5 per day

CREATING A SHOW:

Deciding which interviews will run on a given day’s show

With the assistance of producers, editing audio and video

Turning interviews into finished show segments, including the voicing of tags and tracking segment length

Creating show scripts

Creating reporter segments. These consist of voicing lead and tag provided by reporter for his or her taped or pre-produced segment. Also engineering and conducting audio and video interviews with staff reporters as daily show segments.

PROMO:

30-second daily element written, voiced and mixed by anchor, to promote subsequent day’s show.

WRITING:

Write newscast items and other news stories, as appropriate

Write occasional columns

TOOLS:

Familiarity with audio editing tools and newsroom content management systems is preferred, but willing to train the ideal candidate.

#26-1358

Business Unit

About Us

2060 Digital, voted one of Cincinnati's Best Places to Work, is a performance-oriented digital marketing agency specializing in developing and executing advertising campaigns that drive measurable results for local, regional, and national brands. Our passionate team of digital marketing experts takes pride in delivering consistent, measurable results for our diverse group of clients. Our culture values trust, respect, creativity and innovation as top priorities, and we believe that when people matter, our organization thrives. 2060 Digital is a Premier Google Partner and Facebook Marketing partner, housing a team of some of the brightest minds in the business with over 100 platform certifications. If you're obsessed with excellence, passionate about creating positive workplace and client relationships, and thrive in a dynamic team environment, 2060 Digital may be the perfect place to grow your career.

Job Overview

This role designs and implements internal, workflow-heavy applications, along with related tools and automations that support how we sell, deliver, and manage client work. As part of the Innovation Team, the Full Stack Engineer partners with operations, Data Services, and the AI Solutions Architect to deliver reliable systems with clean integrations and a strong user experience.

Job Responsibilities

Build and maintain full-stack applications using TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node.js, and Postgres, including UI, APIs, and data models.

Lead development of internal business applications, with a primary focus on an order management system (OMS), adjacent tools, and AI automations/agents. Oversee product roadmap and additional feature development.

Build end-to-end product functionality: user-facing UI, backend services/APIs, database design, and integrations with other platforms.

Translate operational workflows into clear, maintainable software: roles/permissions, validations, edge cases, and change management readiness.

Design and implement APIs and integration patterns to connect internal tools to systems such as finance/billing, reporting, storage, and other operational platforms.

Own production readiness: automated testing, release discipline, monitoring, performance tuning, and incident-friendly design.

Build and maintain AI-enabled features, tools, agents, and automations to improve systems.; partner with the AI Solutions Architect to align with shared platform standards (identity/access, logging/audit trails, integration contracts, and AI-ready data patterns).

Collaborate with stakeholders to define requirements, manage scope, iterate quickly, and drive adoption through usability and reliability.

Maintain documentation, contribute reusable components/patterns, and improve engineering practices over time.

Identify technical debt and propose pragmatic refactors that improve velocity and reduce operational risk.

Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

5+ years building production web applications with meaningful complexity (workflow systems, internal tools, ERP/OMS/CRM-like systems preferred).

Strong experience building production web apps with TypeScript, React, and Node.js.

Strong relational database skills, including Postgres schema design, query optimization, migrations, and performance tuning.

Ability to work alone and with a reporter.

Job Overview

This person is responsible for producing and operating the board for a live show and syndicated programming.

Job Responsibilities

Responsible for overall content and flow of a live show.

Assist and collaborate with show host on preparations for show on daily basis and for future shows. Make sure all aspects of the talk show are complete before the show airs. Plan ahead and meet deadlines so show can run smoothly for all involved. Important details include booking guests as directed by show host, offering suggestions for guests, confirming guest appearances, daily postings to website on show content, understanding program log, assemble audio clips for daily promo updates and key information.

Notify proper people of any changes or special situations that may come up in a timely manner (i.e. breaking news, cancellations, and technical problems).

Ensure show runs smoothly while on air by following established timelines, handling caller requests, notifying talent of important information, keeping show host on time and on track, interacting with talent, callers and guests when appropriate, following program log, taking breaks, running the board flawlessly, handling changes, monitoring of equipment to ensure it is operating correctly.

Answer phone calls during airtime and screen calls. Make decisions as to which callers go on the air. Must be able to respond and work well in a crisis.

Be able to handle last minute and unexpected changes during regular work shift, during shows and at other times as necessary. Be able to communicate quickly and clearly to show host, guests and others as needed.

Ability to relate and communicate with a variety of people including talent, guests, callers, and other staff.

Assist with daily commercial production including voice-overs and copywriting as directed by Production Department. Ensures that all commercial production is completed as specified and on time.

Develop and write copy for station and show promos.

Working knowledge of radio systems to solve minor, routine problems as needed.

Assess emergency situations for the station, and make decisions on when to call Engineering, ENCO or Programming managers for additional support. When necessary, go on-air to report on life-threatening or emergency situations until further support arrives.

Understands and can articulate station and show's programming directions and philosophies.

One year of professional broadcast experience.

Ability to run the board flawlessly under pressure. Ability to work effectively in a high intensity, environment with on air talent.

Ability to write creative, entertaining and informative copy for commercial production and promos.

Multi-task with a variety of duties while running the show (may have to track down guests and/or talk to listeners while running the technical operation of the show).

Must be flexible and able to deal with unexpected show changes calmly. Able to make decisions and judgments quickly, often in a chaotic environment.

Follows directions well, especially over the phone.

Operating knowledge of ENCO system or similar digital radio automation systems.

Ability to work on short deadlines and in pressure situations.

Ability to make basic programming decisions based on emergency situations.

About Us

WNYT NewsChannel 13 is the award-winning NBC affiliate for New York State's Capital Region. We're a longtime market leader and we're committed to excellence in all we do. Whether it's live coverage of breaking news, investigative stories focused on finding solutions, or -- now more than ever -- top-notch digital content, we reach our viewers and followers across all platforms with the information they need to be informed, stay safe and plan their day.

New York's Capital Region is diverse and unique, offering a range of activities and experiences within reach all year long. Enjoy craft breweries and fine dining, water sports, winter sports, the hustle and bustle of city life -- or the calm, beautiful quiet of the Catskills. Albany sits just three hours from New York City or Boston, making experiences outside of the region just a drive, bus ride or train ride away. Whether you're an avid skier, a fan of farmers markets, enjoy theater, live music, professional sports, history, nature -- or all of the above -- the Capital Region has something for you.

When you work for Hubbard Broadcasting and WNYT, you're part of a team of dedicated and passionate professionals, pushing every day to serve our community. Here, collaboration is at the forefront, good ideas can come from anywhere and our community comes first. We're committed to the health and growth of our station culture and believe in a work environment that includes diverse backgrounds, cultures, and experiences. We strive to tell the stories of our community through the diverse eyes of our staff and provide an unbiased platform for all viewpoints. We push to advance our station culture through training, employee engagement and our everyday investment in each other.

Job Responsibilities

Maintain extensive community contacts and awareness of local, state and national current events.

Collaborate with the News Director and other news managers to choose stories to broadcast considering audience preferences.

Revise scripts and prepare to deliver them on-air.

Organize the news to present the most interesting pieces first, ensure late breaking news is added to newscasts.

Introduce news correspondents reporting on scene and ask relevant questions.

Interview guests and other members involved in particular stories engaging in commentary.

Keep abreast of news developments by studying papers, attending events, and staying in contact with industry professionals.

Write for station's website and maintain an active social media presence.

Make daily promotional community appearances.

Provide newsroom leadership and contribute to overall team effort.

Comply with the moral code of the journalistic profession

Shoot, edit video and stories as needed.

Qualifications

Bachelors in Communication, Speech or related field with at least 1 year of experience as a television news reporter or a combination of education and experience to meet the requirements of the position.

Quick and effective decision making, live ad-libbing and maintaining performance under extreme pressure.

Highly developed public speaking and interpersonal skills along with exceptional communication skills, both oral and written.

Professional, consistent on-air appearance and ability to read Teleprompter.

Advanced abilities in critical thinking.

Broad knowledge of local, national and international affairs (e.g. political, economic, legislative and cultural).

Comfortable yet professional presence on camera with the ability to improvise in a live on-camera setting.

Effective communication and interpersonal skills.

Available to work on a flexible schedule including evenings and weekends.

Ability to work under stressful conditions and strict deadlines.

Maintain appropriate and strict standards regarding wardrobe, hair, cosmetics and grooming.

job.title: WTMX-FM Radio Producer
job.description:
WTMX-FM Radio Producer

#26-1335

Chicago, Illinois, United States

Apply

Business Unit

WTMX-FM

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

At Hubbard Radio Chicago we look for the best people to build dominant brands that connect consumers and advertisers to build better businesses and communities. We succeed by always doing the right thing with focus, urgency, and passion. Our company culture builds connections, careers, and employee growth. How? By creating a workplace that values autonomy and transparency. If that sounds like something you'd like to be part of, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

The Morning Show Producer for WTMX assists with the daily preparation and execution of The Morning Mix, helping create engaging, entertaining content that connects with listeners. This role supports the on-air team through content research, segment coordination and production to keep the show running smoothly.

Job Responsibilities

Responsible for overall content and flow of The Morning MIX.  Assists in producing the show from prep/pre-planning, airing of live elements to final editing, post-show promos and production.

Searches online / on social media for potential topics for show to cover on air.  Ensures hosts have show-prep materials for each day and associated audio.

Creates external relationships with key partners in the market so the show has access to high profile events and talent coming to the area.  This includes being connected with agents, concert venues, promoters, production studios etc.

Manage guest scheduling and logistics

Coordinate live and pre-recorded interviews.

Ensure show runs smoothly by following established timelines and program logs.  Assists in running the board flawlessly, handling changes, and monitoring of equipment to ensure it is operating correctly.

Edit audio, posts to online feeds; create audio highlights for promos and social media and podcast.  Assist in generating social media content for the show as directed.

Assist with on air/off air contest execution

Communicates with listeners via social media, phone, text platforms.

Maintain show archives and prepare segments for show vacations with “best of” shows.

Help with basic video recording and production.

Is able  to handle last minute and unexpected changes during regular work shift, during shows and at other times as necessary. Communicate quickly and clearly.

Work seamlessly with other departments.

Stay updated on industry trends to keep content fresh and competitive

Works cross-functionally across content, digital and sales departments to ensure station goals are met.

Attend and participate in meetings as required. Make public appearances.

Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Three+ years of experience as producer or on-air contributor.

Passion for pop culture, current music and entertainment news.

Experience with all aspects of an on air broadcast studio. Operating the board, automation system, understanding radio clocks, logs, and scheduling.

Demonstrated ability for using social media including, but not limited to, Facebook, YouTube, and Instagram.

Willingness to learn new tools and how they can help content, distribution, or sales.

Willing to work in the office or on location.

Multi-task with a variety of duties.

Ability to ad lib while on air and at appearances in a coherent manner in situations that can change quickly.

Project a professional appearance and demeanor.

Work in compliance with company and FCC policies and procedures.

Work established schedule and other hours as needed. Travel to and attend station promotional appearances including sales appearances.

Must be able to perform the essential functions of the job.  The Company will make reasonable physical accommodations to facilitate the ability to perform essential job functions.

Compensation and Benefits

When extending an offer, the company considers a variety of factors such as (but not limited to) the candidate's work experience, education/training & key skills as well as internal peer equity and other market and business considerations.

Compensation range is $55,000-$65,000 annually

For information regarding our benefits, please copy the link below and paste in your browser: https://hubbardbroadcasting.com/our-company/working-here/

EEO Statement

We are an equal opportunity employer, including disability/vets.

With dignity and respect, we value YOU and everything that makes YOU uniquely YOU.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

Location:

Latham, NY: 1203 Troy/Schenectady Road, 12110

                                                                             

Position Type:                                                                                             

Regular

                                                                             

Time Type:

Full time

                                                                                 

Pay Type:

Salaried

                                                                                 

Benefits:

iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

  • Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options

  • Company provided and supplemental life insurance

  • Paid vacation and sick time

  • Paid company holidays

  • A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community

  • A 401K plan

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving

  • ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!

                                                                             

We are accepting applications for this role on an ongoing basis.

Non-Compete will be required for certain positions and as allowed by law.


Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

What We Need:

At iHeartMedia, we believe in the power of audio to connect, comfort, and inspire. As a Board Operator, you are a critical part of that mission—ensuring our broadcasts run smoothly and sound great, so we can be a trusted friend to millions of listeners anytime, anywhere.

Your precision and professionalism ensure that every show, every ad, and every moment reaches our audience with clarity and impact. You help us fulfill our promise to be there for our listeners—whether they’re commuting, working, or winding down—making you an essential part of the iHeartMedia mission.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Operate broadcast console and studio equipment during live and pre-recorded shows.

  • Monitor on-air programming for quality, timing, and compliance with FCC regulations.

  • Coordinate with talent, producers, and traffic teams to ensure smooth transitions and accurate commercial placement. 

  • Troubleshoot technical issues in real time and escalate as needed.

  • Record, edit, and load audio content for playback using automation systems. 

  • Maintain logs and documentation for regulatory and internal compliance. 

  • Support remote broadcasts and live events as needed. 

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Strong technical aptitude and familiarity with broadcast equipment and automation systems (e.g., NexGen, Adobe Audition). 

  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment. 

  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. 

  • Availability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays. 

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; relevant certifications or coursework a plus.

What We Need:

Looking for a new opportunity? Join us as a Digital Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations including but not limited to Streaming Audio, Podcasting, Connected TV, Email Marketing, Targeted Display and much more.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


 

Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as a Multi-Market Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Multi-Market Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  

Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!

iHeartMedia is seeking a motivated, results-driven Outbound Inside Sales Account Executive to join our growing sales team. This fully remote position focuses on identifying new business opportunities, building relationships with advertisers, and developing customized advertising solutions across iHeartMedia's extensive portfolio of broadcast radio, digital audio, podcasts, and digital advertising products. The ideal candidate is a proactive self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment and is excited about building a successful career in advertising sales.

  • Proactively prospect and develop new business opportunities through outbound calling, email outreach, and other sales strategies.

  • Conduct discovery meetings to understand advertisers' business objectives, marketing challenges, and advertising needs.
  • Develop and present customized advertising solutions utilizing iHeartMedia's broadcast, digital, podcast, and other advertising platforms.
  • Manage the full sales cycle, from initial prospecting and discovery through proposal development, negotiation, and closing.
  • Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline to consistently achieve individual revenue goals.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date prospecting activities, opportunities, and sales forecasts in Salesforce.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop effective advertising campaigns and ensure successful execution.
  • Consistently meet established sales activity expectations, including outbound calls, meetings, and pipeline development.
  • Build strong advertiser relationships that support repeat business and long-term revenue growth.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
  • Confidence and comfort conducting high-volume outbound prospecting and cold calling.
  • A self-motivated, competitive mindset with a strong desire to achieve and exceed sales goals.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple prospects and opportunities simultaneously.
  • Ability to identify advertiser needs and communicate compelling advertising solutions.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Ability to work independently and remain productive in a fully remote environment.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms, Microsoft Office, and virtual communication tools.
  • Willingness to accept coaching, adapt to feedback, and continuously develop sales skills.
  • Previous sales experience preferred; experience in advertising, media, or business-to-business sales is a plus.

job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  
  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.
  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  
  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  
  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.
  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 
  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be
  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live
  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 
  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 
  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.
  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.
  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

At iHeartMedia, events are more than just moments—they’re a core pillar of our brand. As a member of the team, you’ll be at the heart of this mission—bringing our stations, talent, and clients to life through unforgettable experiences.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Support the planning and execution of local events and promotions that align with station branding and client objectives, including concerts, community activations, and live broadcasts.

  • Coordinate logistics such as venue setup, staffing, signage, giveaways, and technical needs. 

  • Collaborate with Sales, Programming, and Marketing teams to develop integrated promotional campaigns that drive listener engagement and revenue. 

  • Serve as on-site lead during events, ensuring smooth execution and representing iHeartMedia with professionalism and positive energy. 

  • Engage with listeners and clients to create memorable brand interactions and gather feedback. 

  • Maintain promotional inventory and ensure all materials are prepped and transported as needed.

job.title: RCS Product Support Specialist
job.description:
iHeartMedia

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The World's Largest Broadcast Software Provider.

 

RCS Worldwide is home to four industry-defining brands: RCS, Media Monitors, Mediabase, and Florical Systems — serving the broadcast, music, and media intelligence markets across 120 countries. Every day, thousands of radio and television stations around the world rely on RCS technology to stay on air, sound great, and compete in a rapidly changing landscape.

 

Here is what makes us different:

 

We are the company behind the scenes of media that billions of people consume every day. When a song plays on your favorite radio station, when a song charts in the music industry, when a TV network stays on air without a second of downtime — there is a good chance RCS technology played a role. Our portfolio touches every corner of the media ecosystem, from playout and music scheduling to international advertising intelligence and airplay analytics.

 

We are a global team passionate about the industry we serve and moving with the speed and ambition to lead it forward.

 

If this opportunity excites you, but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. At RCS Worldwide, we know that great talent comes from many different backgrounds and experiences. We're committed to building an inclusive, collaborative workplace where people can grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact.

                                                                              

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Love solving issues? Join us as a Product Support Specialist and be the primary point of contact with clients. You'll be handling phone calls and emails from customers in the United States and other countries 24x7. You'll provide timely and accurate answers on a wide range of topics. Examples include software clock building, configuring audio devices, network infrastructure, or reviewing a SQL Server database. This is a remote position.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Document interactions with customers; provide answers by identifying problems; research and guide customers through corrective steps. 
  • Troubleshoot problems in software, hardware, networks, and systems.
  • Write up technical documentation that can be used to repair software defects and deliver enhancements. 
  • Work with customers to improve software system performance by identifying problems and recommending changes. 
  • We ask that you keep your skills up to date by participating in educational opportunities and maintaining personal networks. 
  • Handling phone calls, emails, and social interactions from customers in the United States and other countries. 
  • Working with other departments within RCS teams to further extend our product capabilities. 
  • Have fun!

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

The ideal candidate should possess a background in Radio automation software. They should also have excellent customer service skills and a team focus. Attention to detail and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment is necessary. Candidates should have a fundamentally sound knowledge of networking technologies, Microsoft Windows, and  broadcast systems.


  • We are looking for people with experience working in a Radio, IT, or an Engineering environment. Knowledge of broadcast software such as GSelector, Zetta or NexGen is highly desirable.
  • If you have prior Customer Service experience, we want to hear from you. 
  • We need people with a built-in ability to prioritize. Your experience in Radio or TV means you know what to do when the Off-Air call comes in. 
  • Ideally, you already have well-developed troubleshooting and investigative skills.
  • We never close! Alternate schedules may be required.
  • Bilingual English\Spanish abilities are a plus.
  • We need someone with a can-do attitude!

Compensation:


Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.


$23.07 - $28.84

                                                                             

Location:

VIRTUAL MST, NE

                                                                             

Position Type:                                                                                             

Regular

                                                                             

Time Type:

Full time

                                                                             

Pay Type:

Hourly

                                                                             

Benefits:

iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

  • Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options
  • Company provided and supplemental life insurance (pursuant to the collective bargaining agreement if applicable)
  • Paid vacation and sick time
  • Paid company holidays
  • A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community
  • A 401K plan
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving
  • ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!

                                                                             

The Company is an equal opportunity employer and will not tolerate discrimination in employment on the basis of race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, ethnicity, national origin, marital status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected classification or status.

job.description:
iHeartMedia

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

iHeartMedia is looking for a strategic, creative, and highly independent Senior Manager to join our Digital Media Strategy & Planning team. In this role, you’ll help shape innovative digital campaigns that span streaming audio, podcasts, social platforms, and live events positioning iHeartMedia as the leading force in digital audio and entertainment.

You’ll serve as a key strategic partner to the sales organization, leading RFP responses, driving creative ideation, and crafting compelling narratives that bring our capabilities to life. You’ll be expected to work independently, navigate complex internal systems and business rules, and proactively escalate issues when necessary, articulating challenges and solutions with clarity and confidence.

The ideal candidate role will have a strong understanding of the digital landscape including fast growing platforms like social, emerging platforms (i.e. connected devices, OTT) and podcasting. We’re looking for a digital expert that can craft compelling stories for clients as well as determine effective media strategies. They will be self-starters with polished written and oral communication skills to effectively communicate their ideas coupled and analytical skills to accurately translate those ideas into media plans. Collaboration is key as they will be working with Go to Market, Sales, Packaging, Research, Creative Services and Product Teams.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Lead the strategic development of digital media plans in response to RFPs across streaming, podcasting, social, and live experiences
  • Own the creation and writing of presentation decks, translating strategy and insights into clear, persuasive storytelling
  • Collaborate with sales, marketing, research, and inventory teams to bring fully integrated programs to market
  • Bring forward creative, insight-driven ideas that connect advertiser objectives to iHeartMedia’s unique assets
  • Interpret and apply internal business rules to ensure compliant, feasible proposals
  • Operate independently to manage timelines, solve problems, and escalate challenges when needed—clearly articulating complex situations to cross-functional partners
  • Leverage post-sale performance data and insights to inform and enhance future campaign planning
  • Work within planning and inventory systems to confirm campaign viability and availability

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • 4–5 years of experience in digital media planning, integrated strategy, or a related field
  • A strong balance of strategic and creative thinking with a passion for storytelling and campaign ideation
  • Proven ability to manage projects independently, with sound judgment and strong attention to detail
  • Deep understanding of internal processes, pricing structures, and the ability to apply and uphold business rules
  • Excellent communication skills—both written and verbal—with the ability to distill and present complex ideas clearly
  • Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel (or Google Slides/Sheets)
  • Highly organized, deadline-driven, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • A collaborative mindset with professional maturity and the confidence to lead and influence

Compensation:

 

Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.

 

$65,800 - $82,250

                                                                             

Location:

Chicago, IL: 233 N. Michigan Avenue, 30th Floor, 60601

                                                                             

Position Type:                                                                                             

Regular

Full time

                                                                                 

Pay Type:

Salaried

                                                                                 

Benefits:

iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

  • Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options

  • Company provided and supplemental life insurance

  • Paid vacation and sick time

  • Paid company holidays

  • A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community

  • A 401K plan

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving

  • ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!

job.title: Deputy Managing Editor, Limited Term
job.description:
Title: Deputy Managing Editor

Schedule Format - Location:Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: $129,776 - $162,220 Annually



A Deputy Managing Editor at KQED’s primary responsibility is to direct strategy and management of senior editors and reporters on beats across the newsroom, as well as to generate story ideas and execute edits with members of the newsroom. A deputy managing editor at KQED works closely with managing editors to set editorial priorities on coverage across our platforms. A deputy managing editor assists managing editors in shaping coverage, and often manages and directs editors, reporters and producers throughout the newsroom. 

Deputy managing editors work closely with managing editors to work as part of our newsroom leadership to take our editorial priorities and help decide how to greenlight stories and projects with those guiding principles in mind.

Deputy managing editors also provide direction, editing and help to other senior editors as needed, but work as a strong and empathetic leader and manager to senior editors as well.  

California Newsroom Editor Addendum

The California Newsroom, a collaboration of public radio and nonprofit news outlets in the state spearheaded by KQED, is seeking a deputy managing editor to lead statewide content planning and coordination. This position is a six-month, limited-term position with a possibility to be extended.

This position requires a journalist who is skilled in leading collaborations and partnerships across multiple newsrooms. We are seeking an empathetic and human-centered manager who works well with people at all levels of experience, from early-career reporters to seasoned editors. The deputy managing editor will also be a key editorial strategist, working closely with news directors, reporters and editors from multiple outlets to serve the needs of all the partner newsrooms, from major outlets in large markets to smaller stations with limited resources and personnel. 

This editor will work in collaboration with journalists spread across 14 public radio stations and other partners such as the nonprofit news organization CalMatters to ensure coverage of significant issues, assigning and editing daily news and in-depth features and projects. The editor will also be responsible for coordinating California coverage for a national audience in partnership with NPR.

This editor will work closely with the California Newsroom Managing Editor to ensure that content production aligns with larger strategic goals. The Deputy Managing Editor will step in to run the entire California Newsroom operation in the absence of the Managing Editor, so we’re seeking candidates with both impeccable news judgment and advanced managerial skills. This is a remote position, but the editor must reside in California. The Deputy Managing Editor will manage from 1-4 journalists.

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. We value the contributions of marginalized people in society, including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people, and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do. We strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics: https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics
 

The mission that drives us:

KQED provides citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.




Essential Functions:
  • Coordinates with newsroom leaders throughout California on daily news coverage, major breaking news and long-term joint projects.
  • Maintains a running database of assignments and planning.
  • Oversees California Newsroom employees assigned to content production and planning. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Non-Essential Functions:
  • Occasionally fills in for other colleagues.
  • Represents KQED at events.

Knowledge/Experience Required:
  • At least five years of experience in a similar role in a newsroom or news environment.
  • Interest and knowledge in California news.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills; clear communication with colleagues.
  • Excellent news judgment.
  • Thorough command of journalistic principles, ethics and standards.
  • Ability to meet deadlines and goals while working under pressure.
  • Proven collaboration skills, which are essential in working with fellow KQED staffers across departments and with partner organizations.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability to stay focused, organized, communicative and proactive while working with a number of journalists and staffers across the organization and dealing with several different editors.
  • Ability to stay organized and prioritize tasks when working on multiple projects at once.

Knowledge/Experience Desired:
  • Non-English language skills (fluency in Spanish, Mandarin or other widely spoken languages in California).
  • Previous work as a newsroom manager.
  • Proven capacity to identify opportunities for stories of high relevance to audiences.
NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as necessary to meet the ongoing needs of this organization.

job.title: Engagement Producer, Close All Tabs
job.description:
Title: Engagement Producer, Close All Tabs

Schedule Format - Location: Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: $42.00 - $51.00 per hour
 


Close All Tabs, KQED’s tech and internet culture podcast, is looking for a part-time Engagement  Producer specializing in video to join our team. The show breaks down how the digital world impacts our real lives, and we’re bringing that mission to video. 

You’ll create video and social content for our digital platforms. This includes short-form vertical videos like interview highlights, explainers, behind-the-scenes content, and person on the street interviews. You’ll also create image assets, graphics, and caption copy. 

Working closely with the Close All Tabs podcast team, you’ll adapt the show’s audio storytelling into a visual medium and help refine its look and tone. You’ll take each video from idea to publication: pitching, scripting, shooting, editing/post-production, and posting. You’ll also be responsible for helping grow the show’s social presence, expanding to new platforms, and contributing to audience growth. 

This is a hands-on role for an experienced visual storyteller who wants to combine polished video skills with strange, absurd, and compelling stories from the internet. 

This is a part-time, limited term position reporting to the Senior Editor, Close All Tabs.

 

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling. 

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color,  people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics  https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics

The mission that drives us:

KQED provides citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.


Job duties:
  • Pitch, produce, and edit short-form video content for Close All Tabs’ social channels, including Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube shorts.
  • Write scripts, production notes, shot lists, and other planning materials
  • Work with the podcast’s producers on a social media plan to promote new episodes 
  • Run single-person or potentially small-crew video production shoots and field work, maintaining professional standards for video and audio recording
  • Direct performance and delivery of host and other on-camera talent
  • Find and license third-party b-roll, photos, music, and other materials, ensuring appropriate rights and permissions
  • Optimize content to perform on each platform (length, format, captions, hashtags, thumbnails, calls to actions) and keep up to date with algorithm changes and new formats
  • Track performance metrics (views, reach, engagement, follower growth, click-throughs to episodes and subscriptions) and use the results to shape creative strategy
  • Maintain an organized archive of assets and templates, and streamline production workflows
  • Follow KQED editorial standards, journalistic ethics, and standards for accuracy and fairness
  • Meet production and publishing deadlines while managing multiple assignments

Knowledge/Experience Required
  • Three or more years of video production, video journalism, or multimedia experience (podcast, newsroom, or digital media preferred)
  • Fluency in video editing and post-production tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or Final Cut Pro, plus Descript for selecting and editing video.
  • Comfort with static image design (Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva) and motion graphic templates
  • Demonstrated ability to produce compelling short- and long-form video, especially for talk-based or interview-driven formats
  • Strong storytelling instincts: spotting moments that hook viewers, spark emotion, and prompt engagement
  • Experience growing a show’s or brand’s social presence through original, engaging video ideas
  • Strong grasp of how each social platforms works: (Instagram feed, stories, and reels; TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook), including what drives performance and growth
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects at once, prioritize under tight deadlines, and collaborate closely with teammates
  • Solid understanding of journalistic principles, including ethics, accuracy, fairness, attribution, and editorial standards

Knowledge/Experience Desired:
  • Experience working in a public media newsroom or mission-driven journalism organization
  • Familiarity with audio production and sound design
  • Experience with long-form video content, including interviews, video essays, and short documentaries
  • Experience covering technology and the internet, and a real interest in internet culture, online communities, or gaming
  • Experience producing journalism for younger or hard-to-reach digital audiences
  • Experience with professional cameras, lenses, lighting, and audio equipment
  • B.A./B.S. degree in journalism, communications, film, media production, or a related field preferred
  • Love of absurd internet humor a plus

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as necessary to meet the ongoing needs of this organization.

job.title: Content Distribution Coordinator
job.description:
Lee Enterprises is seeking a detail-oriented Content Distribution Coordinator to support content delivery across our network of local news brands. This role helps ensure content reaches the right readers accurately and on schedule across Lee’s websites and distribution platforms.

Working with content, marketing, advertising, and product teams, you’ll coordinate publishing workflows in BLOX CMS, support automated messaging campaigns, and maintain consistent execution across multiple markets. This is a hands-on position suited to someone who enjoys digital tools, organized processes, and working collaboratively to keep projects moving.

What you’ll do:

Messaging & Campaigns

Execute messaging strategies across email, on-site messaging, app push notifications, web push notifications, newsletters, and SMS, so that each message reaches the intended audience at the right time.

Support stakeholders using the messaging platform with campaigns, audience logic, template updates, content placement, scheduling, and quality checks.

Maintain approved ad tags in designated newsletter positions and compile routine campaign and placement reports.

Content Publishing & Syndication

Coordinate the publishing and syndication of approved content across Lee’s local websites and other digital channels using BLOX CMS.

Set up and maintain syndication rules and automated feeds that share content between markets, partners, and platforms.

Verify that syndicated content displays correctly on receiving sites, including bylines, attribution, sections, images, and links.

Maintain content schedules and monitor automated feeds for issues and errors.

Work with local markets and internal stakeholders to resolve routine syndication issues.

Stakeholder Support & Operations

Respond to routine requests from local markets and internal stakeholders.

Maintain campaign calendars and process documentation and identify opportunities to improve accuracy and efficiency.

What you’ll bring:

Hands-on experience with BLOX CMS (required).

Approximately 1–3 years of relevant experience in digital publishing, email marketing, content operations, or campaign coordination.

Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

Experience with an email marketing platform or similar digital publishing tools.

Familiarity with spreadsheets and basic performance reporting.

Clear communication skills and the ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.

Helpful experience

Customer.io or another email automation platform.

Content distribution across multiple brands, publications, or locations.

Basic HTML, email templates, audience segmentation, or tracking links.

Work in local media, publishing, or related industry.

Experience in Google Analytics.

What success looks like:

Content and campaigns delivered accurately and on time. Content issues are identified early and resolved quickly. Local markets and internal stakeholders receive responsive support, and publishing issues are identified and addressed promptly.

job.title: Digital Director-Omaha, NE
job.description:
Digital Director-Omaha, NE

The Omaha World-Herald is seeking a dynamic, hard-charging editor to help shape the newsroom’s digital strategy and lead its next phase of growth.

Leadership experience is preferred. Successful candidates will be based in Omaha or willing to move to the metro area.

Responsibilities include:

Shaping the next phase of digital growth with an emphasis on engaging, differentiated content and subscriber retention

job.title: News Intern - Greensboro, NC
job.description:
NEWSROOM INTERNSHIP IN GREENSBORO, N.C.

The Greensboro News & Record, a Lee Enterprises company, located in Greensboro, NC., is now hiring a creative, motivated student journalist or recent graduate for a 10-week paid internship this summer.

We want our interns to walk away with a rewarding, real-world newsroom experience, a pile of great clips and the skills they need to develop into the next generation of journalists.

Qualified candidates should be inquisitive self-starters capable of producing compelling content for our digital and print platforms. Interns should feel empowered to find and pitch great stories about our increasingly diverse communities. We want multitaskers who can juggle multiple assignments and embrace all facets of multimedia storytelling.

We will provide an atmosphere of collaboration and support for all interns.

For our summer internships, we are seeking a variety of applicants, from news and sports reporters to photographers and videographers, but successful candidates will be innovative, prolific and deadline-driven.

Interns will work alongside professional journalists in our newsroom, who will provide guidance, direction and support. Interns will receive customized training on topics such as how to develop sources, how to build a digital audience and how to pitch a great story. They’ll also have access to Pulitzer Prize-winning journalists who are part of the Lee Enterprises network of 73 news markets across the U.S.

Exceptional interns will be considered for full-time, permanent employment at the conclusion of the program.

Qualified applicants should be enrolled in college or be recent college graduates. They also should have either completed at least one previous internship in a media market, or comparable work for a college news outlet.

Interns should have their own transportation and valid driver license to travel to assignments and must be available to work a flexible schedule, including some nights and weekends.

When applying, please submit the following items: a cover letter; a resume detailing relevant journalism experience; and links to five examples of published journalism work.
