job.title: Omni-Channel Digital Campaign Manager, Remote
job.description:
Omni-Channel Digital Campaign Manager, Remote

Amplified Digital, a division of Lee Enterprises, is seeking a highly skilled and analytical Omni-Channel Digital Campaign Manager to manage, optimize, and scale digital advertising campaigns across multiple platforms, with a primary focus on Google Ads, Meta, and programmatic demand-side platforms (DSPs).

This position will be responsible for the hands-on execution of paid media campaigns, advanced conversion tracking and attribution, and in-depth performance analysis to drive measurable business outcomes for our clients. The ideal candidate combines strong technical platform expertise with a strategic mindset, leveraging data to uncover optimization opportunities, improve campaign performance, and support client retention and upsell opportunities.

This role will work closely with our Client Experience, Sales, Analytics, and Product teams to translate campaign data into actionable insights and strategic recommendations.

Position Responsibilities

Campaign Management & Optimization: Build, launch, manage, and optimize digital advertising campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube), Meta (Facebook and Instagram), and programmatic DSPs.

Performance Analysis: Conduct detailed campaign performance evaluations, identifying trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve cost per acquisition (CPA), return on ad spend (ROAS), conversion rates, and overall advertising effectiveness.

Attribution & Conversion Tracking: Implement, troubleshoot, and maintain conversion tracking and attribution solutions utilizing Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Ads, Meta Pixel, and Conversions API (CAPI).

Advanced Analytics: Perform deep-dive analysis across advertising platforms, website analytics, and customer conversion data to assess the complete customer journey, identify attribution gaps, and recommend data-driven improvements.

Strategic Growth Opportunities: Proactively identify campaign expansion, budget reallocation, cross-channel advertising, and upsell opportunities based on performance data, audience insights, and client business objectives.

Cross-Channel Strategy: Evaluate performance across Google, Meta, and programmatic channels to develop cohesive strategies that maximize advertising effectiveness throughout the customer journey.

Reporting & Insights: Develop actionable performance insights and recommendations utilizing GA4 and other reporting platforms. Translate complex datasets into clear findings for internal teams and client-facing discussions.

Technical Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve tracking discrepancies, conversion reporting issues, campaign delivery challenges, and platform integration problems.

Campaign Quality & Compliance: Ensure campaigns adhere to platform advertising policies, internal best practices, budget pacing requirements, and established quality assurance standards.

Automation & Efficiency: Leverage platform automation, AI-powered bidding strategies, and campaign management technologies to improve operational efficiency and campaign performance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Client Experience, Sales, Product, and technical teams to develop advertising strategies, resolve performance concerns, and deliver recommendations that support client growth.

Platform Expertise: Stay current on changes to advertising platforms, measurement capabilities, privacy regulations, AI-driven optimization, and emerging digital advertising opportunities.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Advanced proficiency in Google Ads, including campaign architecture, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, keyword management, and conversion-based optimization.

Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and programmatic advertising platforms, including The Trade Desk, DV360, or comparable DSPs.

Demonstrated expertise in GA4 and Google Tag Manager, including event configuration, conversion tracking, attribution analysis, and technical troubleshooting.

Understanding of server-side tracking, enhanced conversions, Meta Conversions API, offline conversion imports, and CRM-based attribution.

Ability to interpret complex performance datasets and identify meaningful insights beyond standard platform reporting.

Strong understanding of marketing attribution models, conversion paths, customer acquisition costs, and the limitations of platform-reported performance.

Experience analyzing campaign performance to identify opportunities for budget expansion, incremental investment, and additional advertising products.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently investigate performance discrepancies and recommend solutions.

Ability to communicate technical findings and strategic recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client accounts, competing priorities, and performance deadlines.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced agency environment with an emphasis on accountability, continuous optimization, and measurable client outcomes.

Self-motivated with a proactive approach to identifying performance improvements and growth opportunities.

Certifications:

Google Ads Search Certification required.

Google Analytics Certification required or willingness to obtain within 90 days.

Google Ads Display, Video, and Measurement certifications preferred.

Meta Blueprint and The Trade Desk Edge Academy certifications preferred.

Work Environment: Remote position with collaboration across distributed teams. Occasional travel may be required for team meetings or company events.

Education & Experience

3–5+ years of hands-on experience managing and optimizing paid digital advertising campaigns, preferably within a digital advertising agency.

Demonstrated experience managing Google Ads campaigns across multiple clients, industries, and budget levels.

Minimum 2 years of experience working with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and digital advertising conversion tracking.

Experience managing Meta advertising campaigns and working within at least one programmatic DSP.

Proven ability to analyze advertising performance, troubleshoot attribution discrepancies, and implement optimization strategies that produce measurable results.

Experience identifying strategic growth opportunities through campaign analysis and performance insights.

Familiarity with CRM integrations, offline conversion tracking, and first-party data measurement strategies preferred.

Experience with marketing automation, campaign management platforms, and reporting tools is a plus.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, Analytics, or a related field preferred. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

Preferred Platform & Software Experience:

Google Ads and Google Ads Editor

Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

Google Tag Manager (GTM)

Meta Ads Manager and Events Manager

The Trade Desk, DV360, Madhive, or similar DSPs

Looker Studio, Power BI, or comparable BI platforms

Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets (advanced proficiency)

HubSpot, Salesforce, or comparable CRM platforms

Campaign automation and management platforms

Compensation

Base Salary: $75,000 annually, plus performance-based bonus opportunities.

In addition to a competitive base salary, this position offers opportunities to earn performance-based bonuses tied to individual contributions and measurable business outcomes. Bonus considerations may include:

Achievement of campaign performance and optimization goals.

Client retention and overall account performance.

Identification of strategic upsell and revenue growth opportunities.

Operational efficiencies and improvements in campaign execution.

Contributions to broader team and company performance objectives.

Bonus eligibility and payouts will be determined based on established performance criteria and company guidelines.

Why Join Us?

Lee Enterprises offers competitive wages in a dynamic, interesting work environment with career growth opportunities. We offer an extensive benefit program that can be personalized to your needs. Our benefit program includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, company provided life insurance and supplemental life insurance. In addition, we offer a 401K retirement plan with company match. We also offer generous paid time off to allow flexibility to balance personal life and work. This includes paid parental leave for new parents.

job.title: Press Operator Nights - Tulsa
job.description:

Tulsa World, a Lee Enterprises company, and print and digital media solutions provider for broadcast and traditional news media, is seeking a Press Operator. The Press Operator is a vital role in the production of our newspapers and various other print products. This position is on the night shift, but will have initial training period during the day.

Key Responsibilities

Makes paster patterns and operates paster controls to load pasters and operate splicing sequence.

Spot plates according to job press order, mount plates involving reaching in and mounting plates into the slot lock up accurate

Manually lead webs with different web configurations involving reaching in and over to guide press webs over rollers through press units, across superstructure rollers to press folder based on specific press configuration

Stir ink, check viscosity and monitor ink feed functions to printing units before and during press run.

Clean press, pipe rollers, press cylinder blankets with cleaning solvents and wipes up any ink spills

Responsible for setting up and maintaining the operation of presses before and during press runs.

Expected to handle routine job tasks on a day to day basis, maintaining accuracy while meeting deadlines.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

job.title: Project Manager - BLOX Digital
job.description:
BLOX Digital is looking for a highly adaptable Project Manager to lead complex, custom, and fast-moving client projects across a variety of digital products and services. The ideal candidate for this job has a customer-first mindset, takes ownership of outcomes, is adept at communicating with remote teams, proactive in communication, demonstrates outstanding customer service skills, is calm under pressure, and has a strong attention to detail.

This position will manage the onboarding of new clients, working with our internal design and implementation teams. The Project Manager will act as the internal lead from initial kick off through to final delivery of projects, ensuring projects are completed on time and within the agreed-upon scope. They understand customer goals and advocate for the customer internally.

Responsibilities of the Project Manager include, but are not limited to:

• Simultaneously manage multiple projects in different stages of completion. Prioritize work, not just personally, but for other stakeholders as well, to get needed results.

• Create and manage the project plan, to include timeline, communication plan, and resource management.

• Facilitate ongoing, timely, and accurate communication to internal and client stakeholders on project progress. Take ownership of results and follow through.

• Escalate issues while maintaining ownership and momentum.

• Manage a seamless handoff from project build to ongoing account management.

GENERAL EXPECTATIONS:

• Maintain exceptional interpersonal verbal and written communication skills with remote teams and clients. Explain technical concepts simply, lead meetings confidently, and deliver difficult updates without creating panic.

• Excellent stakeholder management skills, including empathy with client goals and building a strong rapport with internal teams.

• Ability to work independently and make sound decisions under pressure.

• Advocate for project management process and methodology, including continuous improvement.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required:

• 2 or more years of Project Management experience

• Experience managing multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities

•  Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred:

• Experience with CMS, SaaS, publishing, or digital media platforms

• CAPM, PMP, or progress towards formal certification

Pay: $28.00 - $31.00 per hour plus opportunity for bonus

Why Join Us?

BLOX Digital offers competitive wages in a dynamic, interesting work environment with career growth opportunities.  We offer an extensive benefit program that can be personalized to your needs. Our benefit program includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, company provided life insurance and supplemental life insurance. In addition, we offer a 401K retirement plan with company match.  We also offer generous paid time off to allow the flexibility to balance personal life and work.  This includes paid parental leave for new parents.

BLOX Digital partners with local media organizations to transform their business models and flourish in the digital age. Our tools and expertise in digital, video, print, connected TV, and advertising enable forward-thinking media organizations in dynamic markets to efficiently engage their audiences, increase security and grow revenue. More than 2,000 news organizations have benefited from our platform and the tools we have built specifically for the media industry to thrive. BLOX Digital is majority owned by Lee Enterprises.

job.title: Sales Support Specialist
job.description:
Sales Support Specialist - Lincoln, NE

Are you highly organized, detail-oriented and energized by keeping a fast-paced sales organization running smoothly? We're seeking an Advertising Operations Associate who thrives behind the scenes, connecting people, processes and information to help our sales team succeed. In this role, you'll serve as a critical link between sales, finance and internal operations, ensuring accurate revenue reporting, tracking sales performance, resolving billing questions and supporting the day-to-day needs of our advertising business. Based in Lincoln, this position is ideal for a proactive problem-solver who enjoys working with data, managing multiple priorities and making a meaningful impact on business performance.

Your responsibilities will include:

Sales Performance Tracking & Reporting: Monitor and report on sales performance metrics, including revenue to goal, active accounts, sales activity and progress toward individual and team targets. Provide timely, accurate reporting to help drive accountability and revenue growth.

Pre- and Post-Sales Support: Proactively support the sales team throughout the sales cycle, from prospect research and proposal preparation to order entry, billing and follow-up. Streamline administrative processes and remove obstacles so our sales professionals can spend more time selling and less time on paperwork.

Revenue Analysis: Research and resolve invoice questions, billing discrepancies and revenue-related issues, working collaboratively with sales, finance and other internal teams.

Sales Tracking & Project Management: Develop and maintain trackers for advertising initiatives, sales campaigns and special projects, monitoring progress, deadlines and results.

Financial Reporting: Prepare profit and loss (P&L) statements for advertising projects and publications, providing insights into financial performance.

Data Management & Sales Intelligence: Research and compile historical client advertising spend, contract information, campaign tactics and other business intelligence to support sales strategies, client meetings and revenue opportunities.

Advertising Campaign Coordination: Serve as a liaison between the sales team and internal operations to help ensure accurate order processing, timely campaign execution and resolution of operational issues.

Digital Advertising Knowledge: Maintain a working understanding of digital advertising solutions, including Google, Meta/Facebook and programmatic advertising, to effectively support the sales team and internal processes.

The ideal candidate will:

Possess a bachelor’s degree in marketing, business administration, or related field.

Have 2+ years of experience in advertising sales coordination or a similar role.

Demonstrate strong organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail.

Possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Be proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and Hubspot.

Be Able to multitask and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Why Join Us?

Lee Enterprises offers competitive wages in a dynamic, interesting work environment with career growth opportunities.  We offer an extensive benefit program that can be personalized to your needs. Our benefit program includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, company provided life insurance and supplemental life insurance. In addition, we offer a 401K retirement plan with company match.  We also offer generous paid time off to allow flexibility to balance personal life and work.  This includes paid parental leave for new parents.

Lee Enterprises is a leading provider of local news and information and a major subscription and advertising platform, with daily and weekly newspapers and rapidly expanding digital products serving 114 markets across 25 states. Our core commitment is to provide valuable, intensely local news and information to the communities we serve.

Lee Enterprises is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We respect and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

For more information about Lee, check us out at www.lee.net.

job.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
job.description:
Lee Enterprises is seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to help the new products and advertising initiatives created by our Content Monetization team reach their full potential across our network of local news brands, through creative, sustained, organic promotion.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Advertising Product, you'll own organic promotion across video, social, email, and our owned channels, partnering closely with our paid media and subscriptions teams.

You'll partner directly with the Senior Director to shape our promotional strategy, bringing your own ideas to the table, and then bring it to life with real ownership of the work: creating the assets, executing campaigns end to end, and showing your impact through results. If you love turning a plan into results without needing someone looking over your shoulder, this role is for you.

What you'll do:

Bring new products to market

Develop creative assets and launch plans that help new products find their audience.

Build always-on promotion that keeps products growing well beyond launch day.

Own curated social and email promotion for these brands, plus additional organic channels.

Power new advertising products

Create marketing materials and promotional assets for new advertising products, equipping sales teams to sell them with confidence.

Execute our video strategy

Build and maintain the creative playbook that puts our video strategy into action, on and off platform.

Coach editorial teams to bring video into their stories, create their own, and know when original video beats wire content.

Elevate social content

Track the layouts and themes that perform best on social media.

Build new social layouts using our content automation tools.

Help newsrooms grow their social brands and posts across every platform, guided by performance insights.

What you'll bring:

5+ years in product marketing, content marketing, digital marketing, or a similar role, ideally in media or publishing.

A track record of independently executing promotional plans, from concept to results.

Strong working knowledge of video best practices, including vertical and short-form video across platforms.

Experience developing creative concepts and producing promotional assets, including social graphics, email, and short-form video.

Hands-on experience managing social media across multiple platforms.

Confidence using data to measure performance and refine your approach.

Excellent writing, communication, and project management skills.

Helpful experience

Work in local media, publishing, or a related industry.

Content and social automation tools.

Video syndication or video monetization.

B2B or advertising product marketing.

What success looks like

New products and advertising initiatives drive revenue growth and strong adoption. Video inventory, views, and revenue grow, social reach and engagement expand, and newsrooms confidently use video and social best practices.

Portfolio or work samples are optional, but we'd love to see what you've created.

Total compensation for this role starts at $105,000 annually, with flexibility to go higher based on experience and qualifications.

job.title: Cleaning Crew- Citizens Live at The Wylie
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 500 million tickets sold annually and more than 12,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 40,000 shows and 100+ festivals annually for nearly 4,000 artists in over 40 countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect over 1,000 brands with the 98 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

Live Nation’s Concerts Division is where tours are born, artists come to life, and fans get to experience the rush of live music. From our dozens of owned/operated Amphitheaters to our Global Touring team, from Ticketing and Venue Operations to Marketing and Sales... we foster a fun and upbeat work culture with no shortage of opportunities. With perks ranging from free concert tickets to dog-friendly offices, to progressive benefits like student loan reimbursement and adoption/fertility support... it’s no wonder we are certified as a Great Place to Work organization and one of People Magazine’s “50 Companies that Care”. We want everyone to feel like they belong and can thrive in our community, so we strive to help you achieve your career and personal goals. Live music is our passion and where we find our common ground. There has never been a better time to join Live Nation.

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

*Residents of the Greater Hill District and surrounding neighborhoods are encouraged to apply. We will host a hiring event for residents closer to the grand opening. Details will be announced as they become available.

THE JOB

Citizens Live at The Wylie is seeking passionate and hard-working individuals to join our Cleaning Crew.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Perform table maintenance duties according to service standards
  • Respond to guest inquiries and requests in a courteous and polite manner
  • Maintain line of sight/atmosphere control by circulating through work area throughout shift
  • Keep floor neat, clean and free of food, trash and other obstacles throughout shift
  • Clean all spills immediately, use floor signs to caution guests and staff
  • Put all trash and recyclable products in proper receptacles
  • Clean and stock line to par throughout shift
  • Follow housekeeping standards per policy
  • Ensure that trash cans/slim jims are clean, free of odor and lined
  • Keep all dust pans clean and free of stuck on debris/odor
  • Separate glass, cardboard and plastics per local codes
  • Pre-roll and store table paper, per venue specifications
  • Keep current on all standard operating procedures
  • Turn all lost and found items into MOD
  • Attend pre-shift meeting conducted by MOD prior to start of each shift
  • Assist Other Employees as needed
  • Clean and dust all areas of venue
  • Sweep and mop floors
  • Clean and maintains restrooms
  • Refill toilet paper, paper towel, sanitary napkin and soap dispense
  • Clean and polish hardware such as doors, woodwork, door handles, push plates, kick plates, metal handrails, cigarette urns and drinking fountains
  • Vacuum and spot clean rugs
  • Replace burned out light bulbs or report same to supervisor
  • Maintain service rooms and storage areas in a clean orderly manner
  • Maintain adequate supply of cleaning equipment, materials and supplies
  • Use cleaning tools such as mops, brooms, squeegees, cleaning cloths, sponges, pails, brushes, vacuum cleaners, etc.
  • Remove wastepaper baskets and containers, and empties same into trash containers and cleans area after trash has been picked up
  • Report all repairs required and safety and fire hazards to supervisor
  • Observe safety standards and practices
  • Additional general cleaning of venue
  • Perform related duties as required or assigned within job classification

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

Required:

  • preferred experience in cleaning services or related type work
  • Ability to read, write and follow written instruction
  • Detail-oriented and team player with a positive “can-do” attitude 
  • Consistent availability
  • Sense of Urgency
  • Time Management
  • Critical thinking and decision making
  • High School diploma
  • Tolerance of all cultures, music and art forms

Preferred:

  • High volume kitchen operations
  • Food Service as either an Expeditor or Server in a high-volume environment
  • Exceptional communication skills

Physical Demands/Working Environment:

  • Work environment is fast-paced
  • Position requires extended periods of prolonged standing, bending, stooping, reaching, and working on your feet
  • Must be able to lift or move up to 50 lbs using proper lifting techniques
  • Tolerance of loud noises

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion.  You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work.  We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife.  As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.  It’s talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.


Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation. 

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act and consistent with other similar and / or applicable laws in other areas.

We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Live Nation will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, Live Nation also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. Applicants are invited to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made to assist them to perform the essential functions of the position they seek. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions of the job should contact a Human Resources Representative to request the opportunity to participate in a timely interactive process.  Live Nation will also provide reasonable religious accommodations on a case by case basis.

HIRING PRACTICES
The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

Live Nation recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Live Nation may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms.

**Please note that the compensation information provided is a good faith estimate for this position only and is provided pursuant to the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act and Equal Pay Transparency Rules. It is estimated based on what a successful Colorado applicant might be paid. It assumes that the successful candidate will be in Colorado or perform the position from Colorado. Similar positions located outside of

Colorado will not necessarily receive the same compensation. Live Nation takes into consideration a candidate’s education, training, and experience, as well as the position’s work location, expected quality and quantity of work, required travel (if any), external market and internal value, including seniority and merit systems, and internal pay alignment when determining the salary level for potential new employees. In compliance with the CO EPEWA, a potential new employee’s salary history will not be used in compensation decisions.

Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

job.title: Cyber Security Support Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 


THE TEAM

The Cyber Security Solutions Engineering team deploys and manages enterprise SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, vulnerability management, privileged access management, and related integrations. It partners with Security Operations and IT teams to maintain effective detection, response, resilience, and security-control coverage.


THE ROLE

The Cyber Security Solutions Engineer 3 is the highest non-lead individual contributor in the solutions engineering team. This role provides advanced technical ownership across one or more critical security-platform ecosystems, architects complex integrations and automation, leads high-severity technical response and major change, establishes engineering standards, and develops the capability of lower-level engineers.


The engineer must be able to become effective quickly in a complex environment and serve as the senior-most on-duty technical authority during assigned business core working hours, directing response across critical platforms and ensuring timely escalation. The position operates with broad technical discretion.


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Act as technical owner and subject-matter expert for one or more critical security-platform ecosystems, defining reference configurations, lifecycle standards, resilience patterns, capacity requirements, recovery objectives, and measurable service outcomes.
  • Serve as the senior-most on-duty technical authority during assigned business core working hours, directing cross-platform triage and response, assigning technical actions, making time-sensitive decisions within delegated authority, and escalating material risk promptly.
  • Architect and deliver complex multi-platform integrations, telemetry and data pipelines, orchestration and automation frameworks, and connections to cloud, identity, endpoint, network, IT service-management, and enterprise data services.
  • Serve as the final internal escalation point before the Senior Cyber Security Solutions Engineer or vendor product engineering for systemic failures, scale and performance issues, data-quality defects, high-availability problems, and cross-platform dependencies.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and problem remediation for recurring or high-impact failures, ensuring corrective actions address technical, process, monitoring, documentation, and resilience gaps
  • Lead the security engineering workstream during high-severity incidents and readiness exercises, coordinating specialized analysis, emergency tool changes, containment execution, telemetry validation, recovery, and after-action improvement.
  • Define tuning, query, content, detection-support, vulnerability-scan, and telemetry-quality strategies in partnership with Security Operations and control owners; establish measures that demonstrate improvement
  • Lead major upgrades, migrations, platform consolidations, architecture changes, and new capability implementations; own technical design, dependency analysis, risk assessment, test strategy, rollback, readiness, and operational handover.
  • Build and govern reusable automation frameworks and deployment tooling, including code standards, peer review, secrets handling, testing, observability, failure recovery, and maintainability expectations.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and lead proofs of concept, comparative testing, technical due diligence, and recommendation development; provide evidence for the Senior Cyber Security Solutions Engineer's roadmap.
  • Establish engineering standards for configuration validation, documentation, change quality, disaster recovery, access control, auditability, and operational support across the role family.
  • Use service, risk, coverage, performance, and incident data to identify systemic gaps, develop technical and business cases, and present prioritized recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Lead design reviews, mentor Levels 1 and 2, delegate project tasks, assess technical quality, and provide development feedback without assuming formal performance-management authority.
  • Represent Cyber Security Solutions Engineering in architecture, governance, audit, major project, and vendor forums; translate business and control requirements into scalable technical designs.
  • Partner with the Senior Cyber Security Solutions Engineer on roadmap planning, capacity, vendor performance, and operating-model improvement.

Level Scope and Accountability

  • Autonomy: Operates with broad technical discretion and without routine supervision within approved strategy, architecture principles, policy, and governance.
  • Technical scope: Critical platform ecosystems, complex cross-platform dependencies, enterprise integrations, and high-risk engineering change.
  • Decision authority: Sets technical methods and standards within delegated scope, approves complex designs and changes, and directs technical response. Escalates policy exceptions, risk acceptance, budget, resource conflicts, and final roadmap decisions.
  • Escalation: Final internal technical escalation before the Senior Cyber Security Solutions Engineer, vendor product engineering, architecture governance, or executive risk channels.
  • Leadership: Leads major technical workstreams, design reviews, and capability development. No direct reports, compensation decisions, performance reviews, hiring authority, budget ownership, or final portfolio prioritization.
  • Core-hours accountability: Serves as the senior-most on-duty technical authority during assigned business core working hours, directing complex response across critical platform ecosystems and ensuring timely escalation of material risk.

 


WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • At least 8 years of direct, hands-on professional or military cybersecurity engineering experience, including at least 3 years serving as a senior technical owner, subject-matter expert, or escalation point for enterprise security platforms in complex environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Advanced proficiency in multiple security technology domains such as SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, vulnerability management, privileged access management, security orchestration, or comparable platforms, with deep expertise in at least one domain.
  • Deep administration and troubleshooting capability across Linux/Unix, Windows, TCP/IP networking, DNS, PKI and certificates, authentication, APIs, virtualization, public cloud, load balancing, clustering, and high-availability design.
  • Advanced scripting and automation skills using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or comparable languages, including production coding practices, testing, version control, logging, error handling, and secure secrets management
  • Demonstrated success architecting complex integrations, leading major upgrades or migrations, and resolving systemic or high-impact platform failures
  • Experience leading technical response during significant security incidents, performing root-cause analysis, and driving sustained corrective action.
  • Working knowledge of security and control frameworks and statutory/regulatory mandates such as NIST and ISO 27001, GDPR and CCPA, including the ability to translate control requirements into technical standards and auditable evidence.
  • Strong technical leadership, design-review, mentoring, vendor-management, and stakeholder communication skills, including the ability to influence without formal authority.
  • Type A personality and work style: an exceptionally self-directed, decisive, and results-oriented technical leader who acts with disciplined urgency, maintains exacting standards, owns complex outcomes, and drives sustained resolution while remaining measured, collaborative, and risk-aware.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CISSP, CISM, GIAC GCIA or GCIH, advanced cloud security, architecture, or vendor-specific engineering certification.
  • Experience with large-scale data pipelines, orchestration platforms, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, configuration management, or security-content engineering.
  • Experience supporting globally distributed environments, high-volume event platforms, or services with strict availability and response requirements

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave and baby bonuses, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, Live Nation also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. job.title: Depot Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – DEPOT ENGINEER

Division: Ticketmaster US

Line Manager: VP of Operational Services

Contract Terms: Full Time - ON SITE


THE TEAM

The Enterprise Support Technology Services team is part of the Global Support & Operations organization and is responsible for the deployment, management, and support of hardware and software used across client venues and live events. This includes asset lifecycle management, configuration, and logistics to ensure systems operate reliably in both event and day-to-day environments.

The team partners closely with Technology, Event Operations, and Account teams to support client needs and deliver consistent, high-quality execution. As part of a rapidly evolving live entertainment landscape, the team continuously improves processes, adapts to new technologies, and scales operations to meet growing demand.

THE JOB

The Depot Engineer is responsible for executing day-to-day depot operations, including hardware configuration, logistics, repair, and asset management. This role ensures that all equipment is properly prepared, tracked, and deployed to support live events and client operations.

You will operate as a key contributor within the depot, owning critical workflows across the hardware lifecycle—from receiving and configuration to deployment and return. This role requires strong technical aptitude, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, agile, event-driven environment.

The Depot Engineer partners closely with internal teams across Technology, Event Operations, and Account Management to ensure hardware is delivered accurately and on time. You will also play an active role in identifying inefficiencies and improving processes to increase reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.

In addition to execution, you are expected to anticipate operational needs—proactively identifying risks, planning for upcoming demand, and ensuring the depot is prepared to support future events and deployments.

Success in this role means consistently delivering high-quality execution, resolving technical issues effectively, and contributing to the continuous improvement of depot operations.


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Configure, stage, test, and deploy hardware for both permanent and temporary installations
  • Manage day-to-day shipping and receiving operations, including tracking and coordinating equipment movement
  • Maintain accurate inventory and asset tracking across systems, ensuring data integrity and visibility
  • Troubleshoot and repair hardware issues across supported devices (POS, networking equipment, peripherals, mobile devices, printers)
  • Execute hardware replacement and refurbishment workflows to maintain deployment readiness
  • Ensure all equipment meets quality standards and is fully prepared prior to deployment
  • Monitor inventory levels and proactively flag risks related to shortages, delays, or upcoming demand
  • Partner with internal teams to support event timelines, client needs, and deployment schedules
  • Communicate status, issues, and risks clearly to stakeholders
  • Follow established operational processes while proactively identifying opportunities for improvement
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of workflows related to configuration, logistics, and asset management
  • Support vendor interactions related to shipping, repairs, and equipment handling as needed
  • Maintain working knowledge of Ticketmaster and company-supported hardware, systems, cyber security requirements and technologies, including emerging platforms and operational tooling across depot and fulfillment workflow.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (TECHNICAL SKILLS)

  • 3–6 years of experience in IT support, technical operations, hardware deployment, or logistics environments
  • Hands-on experience configuring, troubleshooting, and supporting hardware (POS systems, peripherals, mobile devices, or similar)
  • Working knowledge of Windows, macOS, and mobile operating systems
  • Basic understanding of networking concepts (wired and wireless, routers, switches, connectivity troubleshooting)
  • Experience with inventory, asset management, or ticketing systems
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose issues and drive resolution independently
  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams
  • Comfortable working in a hands-on environment that includes both technical tasks and physical operations (equipment handling, shipping/receiving)
  • Ability to anticipate needs, plan ahead, and adapt to changing priorities in an event-driven environment
  • Flexibility to support nights, weekends, or holidays based on event schedules
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in warehouse or depot environments
  • Forklift certification or experience operating material handling equipment
  • Experience supporting live events or field deployments

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability—follows through on tasks and sees issues through to resolution
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized, with the ability to maintain accuracy in fast-paced operational workflows
  • Effective communicator who can clearly share status, issues, and risks with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Collaborative team player, able to work across functions and support shared goals
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to identify problems early and take action
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a dynamic, event-driven environment with shifting priorities
  • Ability to take direction, prioritize accordingly, and adjust quickly as operational needs evolve
  • Reliable and consistent, especially during high-pressure or time-sensitive situations
  • Positive, solutions-oriented approach to challenges

BENEFITS & PERKS

Through our ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ program, we provide benefits across six key pillars:


  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

 

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

Our mission at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. Ticketmaster is the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the global market leader in live event ticketing products and services. Through official partnerships with thousands of venues, artists, sports teams, festivals, performing arts centers and theaters, Ticketmaster processes 550 million tickets per year across 35+ different countries.

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

 

Our work is guided by our values:

 

Reliability - Fans and clients count on us to power their live event experiences and we rely on each other to make it happen.

Teamwork – While we celebrate individual achievements, we know have more success as a team.

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent.

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive.

As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

job.title: Financial Supervisor
job.description:
Job Summary:

THE JOB

The Financial Supervisor will oversee financial operations, reporting, and controls for Live Nation / Bizarro Peru, ensuring accurate and timely financial information across concerts, events, and local operations. Reporting to the Entertainment Director, this role will lead two direct reports, maintain rigorous oversight of event settlements and ROME, and establish consistent daily controls, follow-up, and accountability. The position partners with local, regional, and corporate teams to protect financial integrity, manage risk, and support sound business decisions.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Supervise, coach, and prioritize the work of two direct reports, establishing clear ownership, daily review routines, deadlines, and timely follow-up on open items and exceptions.
  • Maintain strong control over event settlements and ROME, ensuring complete and accurate entries, supporting documentation, reconciliations, timely updates, issue resolution, and escalation of discrepancies.
  • Oversee event and operating budgets, costs, purchase orders, expense reimbursements, and payment commitments; monitor variances and communicate financial risks and corrective actions.
  • Supervise accounts payable, accounts receivable, treasury, bank reconciliations, cash flow monitoring, and payment forecasts, ensuring appropriate approvals and traceable records.
  • Coordinate financial and accounting close activities, including verification of event costs, liabilities, and supporting documentation, and prepare clear budget and financial control reports for local and regional leadership.
  • Ensure compliance with company financial policies, approval procedures, internal controls, and applicable local requirements; support internal and external audits and recommend process improvements.
  • Partner with Production, Administration, Accounting, Legal, vendors, and regional/corporate Finance teams to resolve issues promptly and sustain disciplined execution across the Peru operation.

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Degree or professional qualification in Accounting, Finance, Auditing, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in finance, accounting, financial control, or operations, including experience coordinating or supervising others; prior live entertainment or event finance experience is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of event or project settlements, budgeting, cost controls, treasury, financial close, and financial reporting; ability to manage detailed reconciliations and follow-up.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills; experience with ERP systems and financial reporting tools preferred. Experience with ROME is preferred, or the ability to learn the platform quickly.
  • Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, ownership, and integrity, with the ability to set priorities, meet deadlines, and reinforce consistent team processes.
  • Effective communication and cross-functional collaboration skills; intermediate to advanced English for coordination with regional and corporate teams.

job.title: Insomniac - Creative Project Manager
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE YOU?

Are you an experienced creative project manager who thrives in a fast-paced, high-volume design environment? Are you skilled at managing team bandwidth, assigning work, setting timelines, and keeping creative projects moving from brief through final delivery?


Do you have experience partnering with executive teams, department leaders, and brand stakeholders to prioritize key creative initiatives? If so, read on.


WHO ARE WE?

Insomniac produces some of the most innovative, immersive music festivals and events in the world. Through world-class music, lighting, pyrotechnics, sound design, art installations, theatrical performers, and special effects, Insomniac creates unforgettable experiences for Headliners around the globe.


THE ROLE

Insomniac Events is seeking a Creative Project Manager to support the Design department in Calabasas. This role reports to the Sr. Director of Media Operations and works closely with the Senior Manager, Art Direction.


The Creative Project Manager will manage the flow of work across the Design team, including project prioritization, team bandwidth, assignments, timelines, stakeholder communication, and delivery. This person will partner with executive teams, department directors, marketing teams, and brand stakeholders to ensure key visuals, key art packages, campaign creative, and priority marketing materials are properly scoped, staffed, and delivered on time.


The ideal candidate has experience managing a high volume of creative work within an agency, entertainment company, live-events organization, or in-house creative department. This is not a remote position.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage the day-to-day workflow, prioritization, scheduling, and delivery of creative projects across the Design department
  • Partner with the Sr Director of Media Operations and Senior Manager, Art Direction to evaluate team bandwidth, assign projects, balance workload, and identify resourcing needs
  • Manage project assignments across both internal designers and outside creative partners, based on workload, skill set, project complexity, and priority
  • Partner with executive teams, department directors, marketing teams, and brand stakeholders to align on creative needs, timelines, priorities, and delivery expectations
  • Lead project intake, kickoff meetings, project planning, workback schedules, task assignments, and stakeholder communication
  • Ensure priority work—including key visuals, key art packages, marketing campaigns, and launch materials—is properly scoped, staffed, and delivered on time
  • Maintain visibility into project status, risks, shifting priorities, dependencies, approvals, and resource constraints
  • Proactively identify issues that could affect timelines, quality, or workload and recommend solutions or adjustments to Design leadership
  • Manage project workflow within Asana, including task creation, ownership, due dates, dependencies, reporting, and project hygiene
  • Coordinate feedback, review rounds, revisions, approvals, and final asset delivery across all relevant stakeholders
  • Maintain accurate project documentation, timelines, briefs, status updates, and final asset archives
  • Support QA and delivery-readiness reviews to ensure creative materials are complete, accurate, and approved before release
  • Improve department processes related to creative intake, prioritization, assignments, feedback, approvals, file organization, and reporting
  • Attend company events and work evenings, weekends, and travel as needed to support business and event deadlines


QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in creative project management, creative operations, integrated production, traffic management, or design operations
  • Experience working at a creative agency, entertainment company, live-events organization, or high-volume in-house creative department
  • Proven experience managing multiple creative projects and a large volume of assets across overlapping timelines
  • Experience managing creative-team workload, staffing, resourcing, project assignments, and delivery schedules
  • Experience working directly with senior leaders, department heads, marketing teams, and brand stakeholders
  • Strong understanding of creative development across design, brand, key art, marketing campaigns, print, digital, social, web, video, and production
  • Advanced experience with Asana or similar project-management platforms.
  • Strong organizational, communication, prioritization, and stakeholder-management skills
  • Ability to remain calm, organized, and solutions-oriented in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Dropbox, Mac, and PC.
  • Passion for music, live events, and culture is strongly preferred

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. job.title: Insomniac - Human Resources Generalist, Production
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE YOU?

Do you enjoy dance music? Are you passionate about supporting people and fostering positive, solutions-driven workplaces? Then you’re in luck! We are looking for a highly motivated, detail-oriented, and people-driven individual who embodies both a love for dance culture and a genuine interest in navigating workplace challenges, coaching managers, and ensuring that concerns are addressed thoughtfully, fairly, and in alignment with our company values and policies. If you thrive in high-energy environments, enjoy problem-solving, and take pride in helping teams grow through clear communication and strong partnerships, this could be the role for you.… 


WHO ARE WE?

Insomniac produces some of the most innovative, immersive music festivals and events in the world. Enhanced by state-of-the-art lighting, pyrotechnics and sound design, large-scale art installations, theatrical performers and next generation special effects, our events captivate the senses and inspire a unique level of fan interaction.  The quality of the Headliner experience is our top priority.

 

Insomniac produces 10,000 concerts, club nights and festivals for seven million attendees annually across the globe. Since its inception, Insomniac's events have taken place in 13 countries across five continents. The company's premiere annual event, Electric Daisy Carnival Las Vegas, is the world’s largest dance music festival and attracts more than 525,000 fans over three days. The company was founded by Pasquale Rotella and has been based in Los Angeles since it was formed in 1993.


THE ROLE

Insomniac Events is seeking an experienced Human Resources Generalist to act as a tactful partner and on-site HR lead for our seasonal production teams and partner ventures. This hands-on role will provide comprehensive field HR support across the full employee lifecycle including recruiting, onboarding, ER, payroll, and offboarding ensuring a compliant, inclusive, and engaging work environment.


The ideal candidate will bring a strong HR foundation and thrive in real-time, field-based environments, such as live events, film and TV productions, theme parks, construction sites, factories, etc.., where adaptability, sound judgment, and people skills are key. This role requires comfort operating independently in the field, building trust with operational teams, and resolving employee relations matters with professionalism and care. This is not a remote position and required to be in office when not on site at various event locations. 


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the primary HR point of contact for assigned production teams and seasonal partner ventures. Act as a trusted advisor to on-site managers during high-pressure show environments, coaching them on performance, conflict resolution, and policy adherence
  • Own assigned events from pre-event readiness through post-show closeout, including documentation, employee-relations follow-up, workers’ compensation coordination, payroll/timekeeping exceptions, and confirmation that outstanding items have a named owner and resolution plan. 
  • Provide guidance on HR policies, procedures, and employment laws to ensure compliance across federal, state, and local levels
  • Manage employee relations issues including advising managers, documenting concerns, and independently conducting investigations into workplace conduct, escalating high-risk matters in collaboration with HRBPs or Legal
  • Support the full employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and offboarding
  • Source, screen, and recommend candidates for seasonal production roles; draft and issue offer letters, and coordinate onboarding processes for a smooth new hire experience
  • Ensure timely and accurate processing of payroll, timekeeping, and employee records; troubleshoot and close assigned payroll exceptions in partnership with Payroll, Production, and the event HR owner. 
  • Respond to employee inquiries related to pay, benefits, onboarding, and HR programs, ensuring timely and professional support
  • Maintain HR documentation, manage reporting and audits, and monitor trends to identify opportunities for improvement
  • Partner with production leadership to foster a positive workplace culture, improve retention, and ensure alignment with company values
  • Partner with Safety, Risk, and Production teams to support compliance with OSHA, workers’ compensation, and injury reporting protocols in fast-paced event environments
  • Coordinate assigned production workers’ compensation claims and incidents, including timely documentation, employee communication, and partnership with Safety, Risk, and the Manager, Production HR on escalated matters. 
  • Facilitate employee leaves of absence (FMLA, CFRA, ADA) and accommodations processes in partnership with Corporate HR, Benefits and Legal, ensuring compliance and timely communication with employees and managers
  • Deliver or coordinate HR related trainings, including new hire orientation, anti-harassment, and compliance programs.
  • Collect and analyze HR data to identify trends in turnover, employee engagement, and workplace issues, providing insights and recommendations to leadership
  • Promote a positive workplace culture by encouraging professionalism, collaboration, and mutual respect among production teams
  • Support special HR projects, audits, and process improvements as needed
  • Available for irregular schedules including evenings, weekends, and holidays during live event periods
  • Domestic travel of up to 40% is expected, with concentrated travel during peak event periods.
  • Support recruiting, hiring and onboarding of various team members
  • Travel as needed to serve as the on-site HR presence for productions and key seasonal events

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
  • 4+ years of human resources experience, with at least 2 years supporting employee relations and HR processes directly
  • Entertainment, live events, or production industry experience strongly preferred
  • Strong knowledge of federal, state, and local employment laws, including California
  • Experience supporting safety compliance, workers’ comp, and/or return-to-work processes in field or production environments
  • Proven ability to work independently in remote or high-volume environments with minimal oversight
  • Experience acting as the sole HR presence on-site during live events, productions, or multi-day field operations, with responsibility for managing employee relations, performance issues, and policy matters independently
  • Ability to facilitate or deliver HR trainings to small and large groups in both field and office settings
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to use HR data to inform decision-making
  • Proficiency in HRIS systems; Workday and ADP Vantage experience preferred
  • Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • High level of discretion, confidentiality, and professionalism
  • Willingness and ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays as event schedules demand
  • Ability to perform the physical requirements of field environments, including standing/walking for extended periods and working in outdoor conditions
  • Must have valid driver’s license

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Must be able to quickly assess and de-escalate employee relations issues in dynamic, high-pressure situations
  • Must be able to tolerate loud noise levels & busy environments
  • May work in drastic temperature climates
  • Must be willing to work during evening and weekend hours, as required, to meet deadlines 
  • Must be able to walk long distances or stand for extended periods during event days

Applicants for employment in the U.S. must possess work authorization, which does not require sponsorship by Insomniac for a visa.

job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE YOU?

Do you thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume operating environment where great HR work directly shapes the employee experience? Are you an experienced people leader who can build strong teams, develop scalable systems, and credibly support employees and leaders in the field? If you are passionate about dance culture, people, and operational Human Resources, read on.


WHO ARE WE?

Insomniac produces some of the most innovative, immersive music festivals and events in the world. Enhanced by state-of-the-art lighting, pyrotechnics and sound design, large-scale art installations, theatrical performers and next generation special effects, our events captivate the senses and inspire a unique level of fan interaction.  The quality of the Headliner experience is our top priority.


Insomniac produces 10,000 concerts, club nights and festivals for seven million attendees annually across the globe. Since its inception, Insomniac's events have taken place in 13 countries across five continents. The company's premiere annual event, Electric Daisy Carnival Las Vegas, is the world’s largest dance music festival and attracts more than 525,000 fans over three days. The company was founded by Pasquale Rotella and has been based in Los Angeles since it was formed in 1993.


THE ROLE

Insomniac Events is seeking an experienced Manager, Production HR to lead the HR team supporting high-volume, seasonal, event-based workforces across festivals, concerts, venues, and assigned adjacent business lines. This role leads the Production HR operating model, from annual workforce planning and event coverage through on-site support, employee relations, payroll readiness, and post-show closeout.


The Manager, Production HR leads and develops a team of four full-time and a few HR seasonals. The team supports approximately 5,000 seasonal employees annually. The Manager is accountable for the quality, consistency, and strategic impact of Production HR partnership across a complex calendar of concurrent festivals, concerts, venues, and related workforce programs. This role translates business priorities into scalable workforce strategies, talent plans, employee relations approaches, and HR operating practices that support organizational effectiveness, legal compliance, and an exceptional employee experience. The Manager serves as a senior advisor to Production and operational leaders while building a collaborative, accountable, and sustainable field-HR model.


This position is based in Las Vegas, with a mix of in-office and on-site event work. Travel is expected to be approximately 20-30% annually, with concentrated on-site support during major event periods.


RESPONSIBILITIES

HR Team Leadership and Development

  • Lead, coach, develop, and manage a team of HRBPs, HR Generalists, Coordinators, and assigned operational support roles supporting event operations, production, and related business functions.
  • Establish clear team priorities, service standards, operating rhythms, and performance expectations; ensure consistent, high-quality HR consultation and execution across client groups.
  • Conduct regular performance discussions, provide actionable feedback, support development planning, and address performance concerns for direct reports.
  • Establish annual Production HR goals and individual development objectives aligned to business priorities; review progress at least quarterly, address gaps, and adjust plans as business needs evolve.
  • Assess Production HR team capacity, capability, and coverage; make recommendations regarding staffing, structure, development, and resource allocation.
  • Support recruiting, selection, onboarding, and development of Production HR team members and seasonal HR personnel.
  • Build a collaborative, accountable, inclusive team culture grounded in sound judgment, partnership, continuous improvement, and exceptional service.

Workforce Planning, Event Coverage, and Strategic Partnership

  • Lead the development and execution of people strategies for operational, production, and event-based workforces in alignment with business plans, event calendars, workforce demand, and organizational priorities.
  • Own the annual Production HR event-coverage strategy, including pod assignments, service tiers, on-site deployment decisions, backup coverage, and capacity planning for concurrent events.
  • Ensure each event has a named accountable HR owner, on-site representative when required, and clear escalation path.
  • Partner with senior business leaders to assess workforce effectiveness, staffing needs, talent risks, succession requirements, and opportunities to strengthen team capability and performance.
  • Guide HRBPs and Generalists in translating business needs into practical workforce plans, staffing models, employee engagement strategies, talent development plans, and retention approaches.
  • Serve as a senior HR advisor for complex, sensitive, or high-impact business matters; provide clear recommendations that balance business objectives, employee experience, consistency, and risk.
  • Use workforce analytics, employee feedback, turnover trends, staffing data, and operational insights to identify risks and recommend strategic action.

Employee Relations, Compliance, and Risk Management

  • Oversee complex employee relations matters managed by the Production HR team, including investigations, performance management, corrective action, workers' compensation, accommodations, and terminations.
  • Coach HRBPs and Generalists through complex employee relations, investigations, workers' compensation, wage-and-hour, and corrective-action matters; personally lead only the most sensitive, high-risk, or enterprise-impacting cases.
  • Partner with HR leadership, Legal, Employee Relations, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, and other stakeholders to ensure timely, consistent, and compliant resolution of sensitive matters.
  • Ensure the Production HR team appropriately interprets and applies applicable federal, state, and local employment laws, company policies, and standards.
  • Identify systemic employee relations, compliance, payroll, timekeeping, classification, or organizational risks and develop proactive mitigation plans.
  • Review and recommend enhancements to policies, practices, documentation, and processes to improve consistency, reduce risk, and support evolving business needs.

Operational Excellence and Event Closeout

  • Oversee HRBP and HR Generalist support for the end-to-end seasonal employee lifecycle.
  • Establish event-readiness and post-show closeout standards for seasonal onboarding, employee relations, workers' compensation, payroll exceptions, and compliance items.
  • Maintain a centralized case and closeout tracking process; ensure open items have clear owners, due dates, escalation paths, and documented resolution.
  • Define when HR support is remote, high-touch remote, on-site, or all-hands based on workforce size, event complexity, market novelty, employee relations risk, and historical issue trends.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, HRIS, and Payroll teams to ensure workforce readiness, reliable processes, data integrity, and a consistent employee experience across events.
  • Establish scalable tools, templates, training, reporting, and operating procedures that improve the Production HR team's effectiveness and reduce administrative burden.
  • Own the Production HR shared-inbox operating model, including intake, triage, routing, service-level expectations, coverage, escalation, and continuous improvement; identify and resolve bottlenecks that create delayed or inconsistent responses.
  • Partner with corporate Training and Development to assess capability needs and design effective learning plans, development programs, and training resources that strengthen manager effectiveness, employee growth, and operational readiness across event-based teams.
  • Build and maintain an operating dashboard and provide regular reporting to the VP, People Operations on workforce readiness, staffing and onboarding progress, shared-inbox performance, payroll exceptions, employee relations and workers' compensation trends, event closeout status, material risks, and decisions requiring leadership support.
  • Oversee HR-related budgets within the scope of the role and identify opportunities to improve service quality, operational efficiency, and cost effectiveness.
  • Lead cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives that advance HR and business priorities.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 7-10+ years of progressively responsible HR experience supporting operational leaders.
  • 3-5+ years of demonstrated experience directly leading, coaching, developing, and managing the performance of HR professionals, including establishing priorities, providing feedback, and supporting growth.
  • Demonstrated experience developing people strategies, workforce plans, talent approaches, and organizational solutions for complex, high-volume, seasonal, distributed, or event-based workforces.
  • Strong experience managing complex employee relations matters, investigations, performance management, corrective action, and terminations in partnership with senior leadership and Legal.
  • Strong working knowledge of federal, state, and local employment laws, HR best practices, risk-management principles, and wage-and-hour considerations.
  • Experience supporting live events, production, entertainment, hospitality, retail, or similarly complex operational environments strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders, navigate ambiguity, and translate workforce data and business needs into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience with Workday or a comparable HRIS platform, ADP or comparable payroll systems, time and attendance systems, HR reporting, and workforce analytics.
  • Strong leadership, consultation, communication, project-management, relationship-building, and problem-solving skills.
  • High degree of integrity, discretion, sound judgment, and accountability.
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically and work nontraditional hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, during event periods.

WORK ENVIRONMENT


  • Must be able to tolerate loud noise levels & busy environments
  • May work in drastic temperature climates when traveling to event locations
  • Must be willing to travel to work during evening and weekend hours, as required, to meet deadlines 

Applicants for employment in the U.S. must possess work authorization, which does not require sponsorship by Insomniac for a visa.

job.title: LN Concerts, Accounting Manager
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship.
