For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

We are seeking an Accounting Manager for the Live Nation Concerts division, a segment of the Live Nation live music business. This position oversees accounting and control in a corporate setting, and interacts with multiple divisions, including the development and implementation of accounting policies and procedures. This person must be a self-motivated individual with the ability to multitask.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Establish, implement, and enforce financial and reporting policies and standards in compliance with GAAP and FASB, Sarbanes-Oxley, SEC and the requirements of other applicable regulatory bodies.
  • Perform and supervise month-end close tasks as assigned including preparation and review of general ledger entries, analysis and completion of corporate Balance Sheet and P&L reports
  • Review period close submissions and assist in  month/quarter end reporting package consolidation
  • Complete various balance sheet schedules to be used by senior management in monthly and quarterly financial statement reviews
  • Complete detail reviews regional and/or divisional balance sheets providing accounting guidance as needed.
  • Assist in managing central accounting team ensuring compliance with company’s policies and objectives. 
  • Ensure timely, accurate and reliable financial statements and reporting, and to ensure that policies and procedures meet other organizational objectives and needs.
  • Ensure compliance with generally accepted accounting principles and company procedures / policies, including Sarbanes-Oxley requirements
  • Interface with company’s external and internal auditors.
  • Foster a culture that encourages the highest level of performance, integrity and ethical behavior and cooperation in all business activities.
  • Undertake special projects and/or general management assignments as requested by senior management

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, CPA preferred. MBA a plus
  • 7-10 years of comparable work experience
  • The successful candidate will have directed an accounting and control organization of relevant size and complexity through a period of sustained growth. First-hand experience in the corporate office of a global, publicly traded company with multi-national locations and revenue greater than $1 billion is strongly preferred.
  • Strong accounting experience, ideally in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial company.
  • ERP experience, preferably Oracle, but equivalent is sufficient
  • Experience and confidence dealing with auditors, senior management and divisional operations.
  • Experience developing and coaching teams to perform at new levels of achievement.
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities that allow projects and goals to be completed on time.
  • Be able to delegate responsibility and authority to the lowest appropriate level yet be willing to participate directly and actively as required.

 

BENEFITS & PERKS

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

The Executive Assistant/Booking Coordinator role will support the President/Lead Booker and other talent team members in all aspects of administrative support to the President, as well as buying responsibilities including preparation and distribution of offer sheets, talent research and prospecting. This role is expected to be in the office Monday through Friday unless stated otherwise.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO


Administrative & Executive Support

  • Provide high-level administrative support to the President, including calendar management, travel arrangements, meeting scheduling, expense reports, and budget tracking.
  • Maintain an accurate, up-to-date Outlook calendar for the President, including all shows, events, meetings, travel, and key deadlines.
  • Schedule and coordinate in-person, virtual, and Zoom meetings, including preparing agendas, materials, and follow-up communications as needed.
  • Partner with the President and booking team on special projects and office initiatives, including newsletters, team outings, volunteer events, holiday celebrations, and internal communications.
  • Process and track artist contracts, venue agreements, certificates of insurance, and related documents in accordance with company guidelines; return completed documents to artist agencies and venue partners in a timely manner.
  • Coordinate and track artist deposit payments in partnership with internal finance and accounting teams.
  • Maintain complete and organized show files, ensuring all required documentation is in place before the day of show, including headliner and support contracts, riders, W-9s, insurance certificates, and other required materials.
  • Assist with industry and guest ticketing requests and serve as an on-site liaison as needed.
  • Complete expense reports and arrange travel for the President and team members as needed.
  • Handle confidential information with sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism.

Booking Support

  • Create, prepare, and maintain accurate deal sheets, offer materials, and booking documentation.
  • Obtain venue holds; place and release holds in Rome; and update the corresponding booking grid promptly and accurately.
  • Gather all required show details from artist representatives and serve as a primary communication liaison between artists, agents, venues, promoters, and internal teams.
  • Coordinate announce dates, on-sale dates, and related timelines with artists, venues, and internal departments.
  • Prepare and distribute Show Confirmations and Event Status Sheets to internal staff, venues, and external partners.
  • Maintain and update offer templates, venue records, artist information, and show data in Rome and other internal systems.
  • Create and distribute reports for internal and external stakeholders as needed.
  • Support the booking team with artist history, performance data, market research, and other special projects.
  • Attend shows and events as needed to provide administrative and operational support to promoters and venue teams.
  • Track deadlines and follow up on outstanding contracts, holds, payments, and show-critical information.

Research & Talent Prospecting

  • Research emerging and developing artists, genres, market trends, and live-performance opportunities.
  • Compile and distribute relevant artist research and recommendations to the Lead Booker and booking team.
  • Participate actively in booking meetings and team discussions, contributing new artist ideas, process improvements, and best practices.
  • Maintain awareness of the live music landscape, including touring activity, venue markets, festivals, and competitive programming.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Five or more years of experience in data analysis, administration, operations, booking support, or a related field.
  • At least two years of administrative or executive assistant experience preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, including complex calendar management and group scheduling.
  • Strong Excel skills and comfort working with databases, reporting tools, and internal sales or administrative systems.
  • Experience working with accounting and finance teams, including expense reporting, budgeting, invoicing, deposits, or payment tracking.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple time-sensitive priorities.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams and with external partners.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle confidential or sensitive information.
  • Ability to quickly learn new systems, processes, and tools.
  • Experience with contracts, agreements, insurance certificates, or legal documentation is a plus.
  • Strong internet research skills and comfort using online tools for communication and talent research.
  • A proactive, resourceful, service-oriented mindset with a strong work ethic and sense of ownership.
  • Passion for live music and the music industry.
  • Flexibility to work nights and weekends as needed for events and show support.

 

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

 

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

job.title: LN Media & Sponsorship || Regional Brand Manager
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.


WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!   

 

THE JOB 

The Regional Brand Manager leads client relationships and the day-to-day delivery of Live Nation’s strategic marketing partnerships with local and national corporate brands within Live Nation's portfolio. 


This New Hampshire-based role manages sponsorship programs at BankNH Pavilion and across the regional, as needed. The role works closely with clients, venue teams, and internal partners to plan and deliver successful programs across multiple sponsorship categories. You will focus on: 


  • Regional Sponsorship Activation & Execution 
  • Venue Deliverables & Market Ownership 
  • Client Service & Relationship Management 
  • Financial Performance, Budget Planning & Reporting 
  • Cross-Functional Team Collaboration 
  • Program Recaps, Optimization & Renewal Support 

The Brand Management team is the get stuff done, turn-problems-into-solutions, make our clients look like the rock stars, driving force within the Live Nation Media & Sponsorship division. We are a collection of resourceful, ambitious, and strategic minded individuals that thrive in an environment full of variables and unknowns. If you like to sit at a desk, write white papers, and theorize on how things should work this is not the team for you. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, we should talk. 

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO 

Client Strategy & Deal Execution 

  • Understand how Live Nation Media & Sponsorship supports the broader business, including sponsor objectives, KPIs, inventory management, business solutions, and package development. 
  • Execute regional and national sponsorship programs in line with client commitments, established timelines, and venue requirements, from planning through measurement, recap, and renewal support. 
  • Serve as the primary contact for assigned accounts, providing responsive service, maintaining regular communication, and following through on requests and commitments. 
  • Coordinate the sponsorship contract process, internal approvals, and related financial documents with Legal, Finance, and account teams. 
  • Manage program budgets and forecasts, monitor spending and financial risks, and partner with Finance to maintain accurate reporting and revenue recognition. 
  • Prepare and help lead client status meetings, campaign reviews, and season recaps, providing recommendations that improve program delivery, client satisfaction, and renewal opportunities. 

Market Leadership & Venue Operations 

  • Develop deep knowledge of the New Hampshire market, including venue operations, sponsorship inventory, existing partner programs, sales opportunities, market dynamics, and operational efficiencies. 
  • Serve as the market contact for sponsorship activation, coordinating venue requirements and internal resources. 
  • Partner with Sales to identify opportunities and support sponsorship package development using available inventory, client needs, and venue capabilities. 
  • Identify improvements to regional processes, activation approaches, and shared tools that strengthen program delivery and create consistent sponsor experiences. 
  • Assist amphitheater teams with on-site preseason preparation and end-of-season winterization of sponsorship assets and activation areas, while supporting ongoing activation needs at the clubs. 

Show Execution & Staffing 

  • Manage schedules and sponsorship coverage across more than 100 shows annually, accounting for overlapping events, activation deadlines, and staffing needs. 
  • Cover assigned shows on site, oversee sponsor activations and venue deliverables, support hospitality and custom events, and resolve execution issues with venue teams. 
  • Coordinate clear, timely client and internal communications for show announcements, presales, day-of-show needs, and post-event follow-up. 
  • Support the scheduling, training, and direction of Season Event Staff (SES), ensuring clear expectations for sponsorship requirements and event responsibilities. 
  • Plan and manage contractor support for select events and alternate show coverage, including activation briefings, execution guidance, and post-event follow-up. 

Team Collaboration, Reporting & Growth 

  • Build strong relationships with venue teams, Sales, Legal, Finance, clients, seasonal staff, senior leadership, and other Live Nation partners to keep programs aligned with client objectives. 
  • Collaborate with Brand Management counterparts across regions to share best practices, resolve challenges, and strengthen consistency across regional and national programs. 
  • Develop client-facing materials, recaps, reports, and presentations that use program KPIs, client feedback, and Net Promoter Scores (NPS) to explain performance and recommend improvements. 
  • Apply relevant audience insights, marketing trends, and emerging technologies to develop new activation ideas and improve sponsorship programs. 
  • Build relationships beyond daily client contacts, identify additional partnership needs, and contribute to sponsorship renewal and growth discussions. 
  • Support additional sponsor-related projects and department priorities as requested by management. 

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING 

  • 2+ years of direct experience in brand or account management, client service, media, entertainment, marketing consulting, sales, advertising, or activation agencies. 
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred. 
  • Strong client service instincts, including diligent follow-up and the ability to build trusted relationships with clients and internal partners. 
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and a calendar of more than 100 shows annually across four venues, balancing overlapping schedules, staffing needs, and client deadlines. 
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and visual storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with clients, venue teams, staff, and contractors. 
  • A proactive, collaborative, and organized working style, with the initiative to anticipate needs and meet deadlines. 
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to adjust priorities, respond to changing business needs, and work effectively under pressure. 
  • Experience coordinating event staff or contractor support to deliver on-site programs. 
  • Familiarity with marketing programs that connect in-person experiences with digital components preferred. 
  • Knowledge of consumer and market research, with the ability to translate insights into client recommendations and performance reporting. 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. 
  • Experience with Salesforce, Asana, Airtable, Slack, Keynote, AI tools, social media tools, or graphic design applications preferred. 
  • Strong financial management skills, including the ability to maintain multiyear budgets, monitor expenses, and prepare reliable forecasts. 
  • Attention to detail when reviewing program and financial results, including the ability to identify errors, explain trends, and highlight opportunities. 
  • Passion for music, live events, branding, and current entertainment trends. 
  • Ability to be based in New Hampshire area, provide regular on-site coverage at assigned venues, and travel within the market and surrounding areas as needed, including availability for night and weekend shows. 
  • Reliable transportation to and from assigned venues and the office. 
  • Ability to lift items weighing up to 50 pounds as needed.

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

THE JOB

The Director of Membership Sales is responsible for the development and growth of the premium membership program at the Brooklyn Paramount.  Additional sales channel responsibilities will include group and hospitality package member sales as well as other revenue-generating programs as added to the product portfolio.  This role will include the development, service, support and maintenance of these members and meeting all pre-determined individual and department sales and service performance goals.   • Responsible for actively developing, nurturing, and maximizing positive relationships with new members by conducting effective sales tactics, make outside sales calls, presentations to potential clients, and conduct site visits and prospecting events

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • This role may require periodic hybrid days throughout the year
  • Perform a variety of financial analytical tasks including: research variances, summarize data, and distribute financial and operating results
  • Use analysis to support and explain deviations from plan, trends and expectations
  • Leverage SQL, Python and AI tools to work with large-scale financial data, build models and automate reporting
  • Identify and take the lead on process improvement projects to automate and streamline
  • Prepare weekly and monthly internal and external management reports
  • Assist with month-end close processes focusing on accruals, allocations, journal entries, and various spend analyses

  • Ad Hoc analysis as needed
  • Other duties as assigned

job.title: Product Manager
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 


You embody our core values of Keep It Simple, Be Inquisitive, Win Together, and Own It. You're naturally curious: you want to learn how things work, from the source systems to the business processes behind the data, so you can find ways to improve them. You're a versatile high performer who makes AI part of how you work. You are skilled in building consensus, making data-driven decisions, and delivering world-class data products, with AI as a force multiplier. You persuasively advocate for an idea, but you stay open-minded and prioritize rigorously. You have a bias toward action. Most of all, you love to dig in and build amazing things with your team, always pushing the envelope.


THE ROLE

Live Nation Core Data Services (CDS) team is looking for a Product Manager to create internal data products, primarily for marketing and operations teams. A major part of this role is helping engineering teams ingest data sources from operations worldwide into a single global data platform on which our data products are built. You'll work with internal customer groups to ideate, define, build, and launch data products that drive outcomes across business functions and markets. This includes onboarding data from new business domain streams, enforcing data contracts, and shaping domain models before the first layer of transformations lands.

 

This is a key role on an entrepreneurial team with the resources, exposure, and customer base of the world's leading live entertainment company. The person we're looking for will combine passionate product management with discipline and a keen attention to detail, and will build trust throughout the business. We need research and iterative validation driving technical solutions. We need someone who manages a roadmap and backlog, often feeding more than one engineering team, and who clearly defines success criteria and post-launch measurement requirements, all of which is found in their documentation. You'll also help us raise the bar on how a product team works with AI, both in your own workflow and in making our data easy for AI tools and agents to use.

 

This role is built for growth: as you establish yourself, you'll take on additional domains and broader responsibility. It's a highly visible role on a high-performing, global team.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Own the roadmap and backlog for one or more data domains, and connect priorities to business outcomes.
  • Get up to speed quickly on in-flight work, producer relationships, and stakeholder commitments.
  • Lead discovery with internal customers and source-system producers; translate business needs into clear technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria in Jira.
  • Work with source-system teams on data contracts, agreeing on shape, grain, and quality before data lands.
  • Partner with data engineers on delivery, from intake and design through launch, adoption, and iteration; manage dependencies and surface risks early.
  • Define and track success metrics for your area: adoption, freshness, data quality, and consumer impact.
  • Investigate data directly: write SQL against production data to validate requirements, profile sources, and confirm that what shipped is correct.
  • Own documentation for your domain (definitions, lineage, tags, and known gaps) so people and AI tools can find and trust the data.
  • Use AI tools daily for discovery, analysis, requirements, and documentation, and share what works with the team.
  • Communicate status, trade-offs, and changes clearly to stakeholders and leadership.

 

AI COMPETENCIES

  • Hands-on AI use: You use AI assistants and coding agents (for example Claude Code, Codex, or Databricks Assistant and Genie) as part of daily work: drafting SQL, synthesizing research, prototyping, and drafting specs.
  • Critical evaluation: You check AI output against source data and real behavior before acting on it or sharing it, and you can explain why an answer is wrong.
  • AI-ready data: You understand what makes data usable by AI, and you build that into your product requirements.
  • Specs that agents can execute: You write requirements and acceptance criteria precise enough for an engineer, or an engineer's AI agent, to build from without guessing.
  • Responsible use: You know the basics of how LLMs work (context, retrieval, hallucination) and apply data privacy and governance rules when data is used with AI tools.

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 3+ years of product management experience, ideally on data, platform, or technical products.
  • A strong data background; experience in BI, analytics, or data engineering is a plus.
  • Experience connecting directly to data sources and writing your own SQL. Familiarity with Python, Spark, or Databricks, enough to read a notebook or pipeline and follow what it does, is a big plus.
  • Working knowledge of how data moves from source to consumption (ingestion, modeling, and delivery) in batch and streaming systems.
  • Demonstrated, practical use of generative AI tools (AI assistants, prompt engineering, agent workflows) to improve your own work, with examples you can walk through.
  • Experience writing requirements that turn business needs into technical requirements, plus Jira and agile story writing.
  • Working knowledge of privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA, including consent and data subject requests, and how they shape data products.
  • Experience with customer or behavioral data is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable facilitating discussions across technical and business teams.
  • Comfortable managing several projects at once and prioritizing between competing stakeholders.
  • Willingness to work across time zones and outside normal hours when needed.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • A passion for live music and events is a plus.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave and baby bonuses, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com. 

 

WHO ARE YOU? 

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!   

 

THE JOB 

The Business Analyst will support data analysis and reporting for the Business Analytics team within Promoted Ads, Ticketmaster’s proprietary advertising platform. Reporting to the Director of Business Analytics, you will maintain accuracy and hygiene across core reporting datasets, collaborate with Business Development to grow the Promoted platform, and coordinate across divisions to build and maintain data pipelines. You’ll apply statistical fundamentals to ground your analysis, while keeping day-to-day work organized through JIRA/kanban and other team tools. This is a foundational role for someone early in their analytics career who is detail-oriented, curious about the “why” behind the numbers, and ready to grow into greater ownership over time. 

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO 

  • Maintain rigorous data hygiene across core performance reporting and financial accounting workflows, proactively flagging both anomalies and upside opportunities 
  • Write and troubleshoot SQL queries to pull, validate, and reconcile data across multiple sources 
  • Serve as point of contact for Business Development, client representatives, and other commercial leaders for ad hoc client analytics needs, insights into media performance, and intake for data investigations 
  • Translate data into clear commercial narratives, surfacing the “so what” behind trends for non-technical stakeholders 
  • Liaise between Promoted Business Analytics and counterpart analytics teams to ensure Promoted team’s data pipelines are being properly ingested and distributed to other divisions of the company 
  • Manage day-to-day tracking in Asana, JIRA, and other project management tools, keeping tickets, priorities, and status updates current for the team 
  • Document recurring processes and interdepartmental functions to help build out best practices for Business Analytics team 
  • Identify and deploy AI opportunities for Business Analytics team to expand scale and scope of operations 
  • Communicate findings clearly in writing and verbally, adjusting detail and framing based on the audience 

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING 

  • 3+ years of analytical experience, ideally in digital media or advertising 
  • Confident with statistical concepts and understanding of the economics of the digital media ecosystem 
  • Strong attention to detail: proven track record of delivering media and financial reporting with a high degree of accuracy and understanding of nuances of data sources 
  • Experience writing and troubleshooting SQL 
  • Iterating on analytic methodology and output with LLMs  
  • Demonstrated ownership of deliverables and communications to client-facing representatives 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to flex communication style across technical, cross-functional, and executive audiences 
  • Comfortable operating with significant autonomy in a fast-moving environment where scope may shift based on evolving business priorities 
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience 
  • Bonus: experience in ticketing, live events, or marketplace/advertising platforms 

 

BENEFITS & PERKS 

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits: 

 

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)  

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days 

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program 

FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

job.title: Promoter's Assistant, Outdoor Shows
job.description:
Job Summary:

Company: Cuffe & Taylor

Department: Outdoor Promoters

Location: Preston, Lancashire or Farringdon, London

Reports to: Executive Assistant to the Outdoor Promoters

Working Hours: Full time, 40 hours per week with extra weekend working throughout festival season onsite. Some travel required.

Job Type: Permanent

 

Role Description

 

Cuffe & Taylor is one of the UK’s leading live music, theatre and entertainment promoters, delivering major concerts, festivals and tours across the UK and internationally.

 

The company has worked with some of the world’s biggest artists, including Diana Ross, Lionel Richie, Britney Spears, Kylie, Lewis Capaldi, Sam Fender, Stevie Wonder, Justin Timberlake, Noah Kahan, Alanis Morissette, Robbie Williams, Richard Ashcroft, Becky Hill, Biffy Clyro and Fatboy Slim.

 

Its extensive outdoor portfolio includes Lytham Festival, Blackweir, Live at Powderham, Scarborough Open Air Theatre, Live at The Piece Hall, Blenheim Palace Festival, Bedford Summer Sessions, Depot Live at Cardiff Castle, Forest Live and Live at Lincoln Castle.

 

Cuffe & Taylor also operates a successful UK and international theatre touring division, programming thousands of performances across live entertainment, podcasts, screen-to-stage adaptations and musical theatre. In 2023, its original production Hey Duggee – The Live Theatre Show won the Olivier Award for Best Family Show.

 

The Promoter Assistant will be a key member of the Outdoor Promoter team, providing support in the programming and delivery of festivals, concerts and tours. The role covers the administrative side of events, from the offer letter stage right through to settlement, which involves working closely with the Operations, Finance, Ticketing, Marketing and Production and Artist Liaison teams.

 

The role will also involve diary management, scheduling and preparation for meetings, travel logistics for the Promoter team and general administration, including filing and coding of expenses.

 

We are looking for someone with excellent organisational, administrative and communication skills and a keen eye for detail, who can manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced live events environment. Experience in artist management, agency and/or promoter administration would be advantageous, particularly within live music and touring. Flexibility and a willingness to travel and work on site during the summer months, including evenings and weekends, will be required

 

What it’s like to work in the Team

 

Cuffe & Taylor is made up of a diverse group of individuals, but we all share the same passion for putting our employees first. We have a fun atmosphere within the team, which helps us maintain an open, approachable department, and build genuinely authentic and valuable relationships with our employees. We are committed to working as a team and so support each other to achieve wins.

 

Who you are

 

Competencies / Skills / Knowledge / Experience

 

Essential

  • Demonstrable experience of live music or events administration
  • Ability to work efficiently under pressure and tight deadlines
  • A self-starter with excellent organisational and administrative skills
  • Excellent IT skills including Microsoft Office and Adobe
  • Excellent formatting skills
  • Exemplary attention to detail
  • Excellent communication skills

 

Desirable

  • Experience with Monday.com, Jotform, Claude

 

Behaviours

 

The following attributes determine how the role will be carried out and are required to be a success


  • Extremely well organised and self-motivated
  • High level of integrity and discretion
  • Flexibility – ability to respond to constantly shifting priorities
  • Sound judgement and level-headedness
  • Proactive approach to problem solving
  • Effective communicator with the ability to interact with staff across all levels of the organisation

What the role includes


  • Work closely with the Executive Assistant to the Outdoor Promoters and the wider Promoter team to deliver events and festivals in collaboration with the Operations, Ticketing, Marketing, Finance and Customer Service teams
  • Diary management for the Promoter team
  • Keep accurate financial records for all confirmed shows
  • Mark up all agency confirmations and contracts in line with Live Nation guidelines
  • Schedule show announcements and coordinate relevant teams to ensure the best on-sale experience for all involved
  • Work on site at events and festivals, including evenings and weekends, when required
  • Liaise with heads of department across Cuffe & Taylor, the wider Live Nation group and high-profile external stakeholders
  • Manage Promoter guest ticketing and accreditation requests
  • Book travel and hotels throughout the year, as required
  • Handle all requirements for VIP guests of the company across outdoor shows during the summer season
  • Keep all documentation organised and filed correctly
  • Relay invoices to the finance team for payment
  • Book and manage promoter reps and freelancers across festivals and theatre tours.
  • Undertake ad hoc tasks as required

 

Equal Opportunities

 

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It’s talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender identity, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

 

The Company

 

Cuffe & Taylor is part of Live Nation Entertainment which is the world’s leading live entertainment company comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, LN Media and Artist Nation Management.


APPLICATION DEADLINE: Wednesday 18th November 2026. We reserve the right to close applications at any time.


#CuffeandTaylor

#LI-SL1

Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

job.title: Senior Director, Vulnerability Management & Penetration Testing
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.


WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!


THE ROLE

We are seeking a Senior Director to lead our Defect Management (Vulnerability Management) and Penetration Testing teams, which span penetration testing, vulnerability management, bug bounty program management, and defect remediation.


Reporting to the Vice President, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) and Operations, you will lead a multi-disciplinary team and partner with cross-functional teams across regions to ensure vulnerabilities are prioritized, remediated, and monitored to protect Live Nation Entertainment’s assets and data. You will clearly communicate the business impact and urgency of security defects while following the defined risk management process, and you will define the outcomes and metrics for Defect Management across the enterprise.


This is a delivery-focused leadership role: you own program plans, roadmap commitments, and remediation service-level agreements (SLAs), and you are accountable for measurable, on-time reductions in enterprise vulnerability exposure.


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Build and lead a high-performing, multi-disciplinary security team across multiple locations
  • Set the team’s strategic direction and development, lead by example, and mentor team members at all levels
  • Research and communicate emerging security threats relevant to the environments we operate
  • Participate in threat modeling, security design reviews, penetration testing, and remediation verification
  • Partner with application teams enterprise-wide to detect, prioritize, and remediate security defects throughout the SDLC, embedding a security mindset from concept through implementation, including hands-on security training for architects and developers
  • Set clear priorities and deadlines and hold the team accountable for timely, high-quality delivery
  • Own budget, headcount planning, and resource allocation for both teams, including tooling, third-party testing, vendor, and bug bounty spend
  • Lead response to zero-day vulnerabilities and urgent exploits: coordinate with Cyber Security Operations, Threat Intelligence, and internal/external business partners, communicate clearly and promptly to leadership and stakeholders, and track each issue to closure. Requires 24/7 availability for urgent matters
  • Partner with Cyber Security Operations and Threat Intelligence on red and purple team exercises to validate detection and response and prioritize remediation of exploitable paths

Program Management & Delivery

  • Own program goals and roadmap commitments; build project plans with milestones, risks, and deadlines; escalate blockers early and deliver on time
  • Drive measurable reduction in vulnerability exposure, including Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) and aged backlog, and remediate all Critical vulnerabilities within regulatory timeframes (ex. PCI DSS)
  • Establish and enforce risk-based remediation SLAs, exception and risk-acceptance criteria, compensating controls, and escalation paths; track exceptions to closure
  • Own scanning and assessment coverage across on-premises, cloud, container, application, and API environments, including authenticated coverage and discovery of unmanaged, shadow, and end-of-life assets
  • Lead the bug bounty program end-to-end, from submission through triage, assignment, remediation, retesting, and closure, with SLA and aging reporting at every stage
  • Lead security testing of AI-enabled products, including LLM-based and agentic applications, incorporating AI-specific threats (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications) into testing methodologies
  • Drive automation and AI-enabled integrations across CMDB, ITSM, scanning, and bug bounty platforms to automate ownership mapping, ticket routing, SLA tracking, and reporting
  • Select, implement, and continuously evaluate security testing tooling (coverage, cost, overlap), including continuous and agentic penetration-testing platforms; own the penetration-testing and scanning infrastructure; and make evidence-based retain/discontinue recommendations with transition plans
  • Align the program to PCI DSS, CIS Controls, SOC 1/SOC 2, CCPA, NIS2, and other applicable requirements; maintain audit evidence and support audits, assessments, and security reviews
  • Establish processes to assign, track, and remediate findings from external security-rating and third-party risk services

Business Stakeholder Management & Executive Reporting

  • Build trust and collaboration across business and technology stakeholders with competing priorities through regular, transparent, data-driven communication, and track stakeholder commitments to completion
  • Lead recurring stakeholder reviews of goals, progress, and blockers, ensuring decisions and actions are documented and followed through
  • Produce executive-ready metrics (coverage, SLA attainment, risk burn-down, exceptions, business impact) and present program status and risks to senior leadership

External Partner & Vendor Management

  • Manage third-party vendors and PCI ASV/QSA engagements, including scoping, quality review, and remediation tracking
  • Hold vendors accountable to contractual SLAs; document failures, pursue service credits, and report on vendor effectiveness



WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Knowledge of Cyber Security standards and regulations, including PCI DSS, CIS Controls, SOC 2, CCPA, and NIS2, and of desktop, server, application, database, and network security principles; experience maintaining audit evidence
  • Experience performing penetration testing and exploitation against applications, APIs, web, mobile, and modern infrastructure (containers, microservices, serverless) in cloud (AWS, Azure) and on-premises environments
  • Track record of building and managing large, diverse teams: attracting, hiring, developing, and retaining top security talent and giving them the vision, support, and culture to deliver impact
  • High ethical standards and discretion with confidential information
  • Technical knowledge of adversary Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs)
  • Understanding of common software security issues and remediation techniques (CISA KEV, OWASP Top 10, SANS 25, MITRE, etc.)
  • Deep knowledge of the threat landscape and emerging security strategies and products
  • Strong program management discipline: builds project plans with milestones, risks, and deadlines, communicates status proactively, and delivers on time
  • Attention to detail and a sense of urgency in prioritizing and responding to time-sensitive security issues
  • Experience operating a bug bounty or vulnerability disclosure program and managing security vendors, third-party penetration-testing firms, SLAs, and reporting
  • Experience managing remediation against compliance-driven SLAs, including PCI DSS requirements, and governing exceptions and risk acceptance

Desirable

  • 10+ years in technical security roles, including penetration testing or security hardening
  • 5+ years driving cyber security initiatives across large, diverse organizations
  • Experience working in global environments spanning multiple time zones
  • Training in Cyber Security-specific disciplines
  • Advanced written and verbal communication skills with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., OSCP, OSCE, GPEN, GWAPT, CISSP, CISM)

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave and baby bonuses, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. job.title: Sr. Director, Social Impact Marketing
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

THE TEAM

Live Nation Entertainment believes live music has the power to bring people together and strengthen communities. Through strategic initiatives, partnerships, and programs, the Social Impact team creates meaningful opportunities that connect fans, artists, crews, and communities through the power of live music. 

THE ROLE

The Senior Director will build, lead, and continuously evolve the marketing function for Live Nation Entertainment’s Social Impact organization, overseeing integrated marketing, digital marketing, brand strategy, communications, and storytelling across On the House, LiveNation.org (as applicable), strategic partnerships, employee engagement initiatives, and future social impact programs. 


This role will translate organizational priorities into marketing strategies and campaigns that build awareness, strengthen engagement, elevate Live Nation’s reputation, and deliver measurable business and community impact. 


Working closely with executive leadership and cross-functional partners across Marketing, Communications, Creative, Legal, Government Affairs, Digital, Concerts, and Sponsorship, this leader will own marketing initiatives from strategy to execution while building the processes, systems, and operational excellence needed to support a growing organization. 


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO 


Marketing Strategy & Campaign Leadership 

  • Own the marketing and communications strategy for Live Nation Entertainment Social Impact. 
  • Develop integrated marketing campaigns and digital marketing strategies from concept through launch, including strategy, planning, creative development, execution, optimization, and performance measurement. 
  • Build annual marketing plans and campaign roadmaps that align with organizational priorities and business objectives. 
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Social Impact marketing team by setting clear priorities, providing ongoing feedback, and creating opportunities for professional growth while fostering a collaborative, high-performing culture. 

Brand, Digital & Audience Engagement 

  • Own brand positioning, messaging, storytelling, and launch communications across all Social Impact initiatives. 
  • Develop compelling narratives that translate programs, partnerships, and impact into meaningful stories for fans, artists, partners, employees, nonprofit organizations, and community stakeholders. 
  • Ensure a consistent, premium, and culturally relevant experience across all marketing channels. 
  • Own the digital marketing strategy across web, email, CRM, social media, and emerging digital platforms, ensuring cohesive audience experiences and measurable engagement. 

Marketing Operations 

  • Establish scalable marketing processes, workflows, approval systems, and planning tools that enable efficient execution within a lean organization. 
  • Lead and develop the Social Impact marketing team by setting clear priorities, providing coaching and feedback, and fostering a collaborative, high-performing culture. 
  • Own the integrated marketing calendar, ensuring visibility, coordination, and alignment across campaigns, launches, partnerships, and organizational communications. 
  • Manage external agencies, creative partners, freelancers, consultants, budgets, and production resources. 
  • Measure campaign effectiveness through defined KPIs and performance reporting, using insights to continuously improve future initiatives. 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING 

  • 12-15 years of progressive leadership experience in integrated marketing, brand strategy, communications, or related disciplines. 
  • Proven success developing and leading integrated marketing campaigns from strategy through execution and measurement. 
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing strategy, audience development, CRM, email marketing, social media, web experiences, content strategy, SEO/SEM fundamentals, campaign analytics, and emerging digital platforms. 
  • Experience leading and developing marketing professionals while fostering accountability, collaboration, and strong execution. 
  • Experience leading and developing high-performing marketing teams while fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. 
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders across multiple teams and leadership levels. 
  • Experience managing agencies, creative partners, consultants, and external vendors.
  • Exceptional strategic thinking, project management, organizational, and problem-solving skills. 
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with experience developing messaging for executive, public, partner, and employee audiences. 
  • Highly self-directed with the ability to independently prioritize work, navigate ambiguity, and drive initiatives forward with minimal oversight. 
  • Passion for live music and entertainment, with a desire to leverage marketing to create meaningful community impact. 
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and travel as needed for events and organizational initiatives. 


WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • You are a strategic marketing leader who thrives at building brands, launching campaigns, and turning ambitious ideas into measurable results. 
  • You understand that great marketing is more than creative ideas – it’s thoughtful planning, disciplined execution, strong cross-functional collaboration, and continuous optimization.
  • You’re equally comfortable developing long-term strategy and rolling up your sleeves to move projects forward
  • You know how to take an initiative from concept to launch, building the strategy, aligning stakeholders, managing timelines, overseeing creative development, navigating approvals, and ensuring flawless execution across every touchpoint.
  • You enjoy creating order in fast-moving environments. Whether building marketing calendars, establishing workflows, or developing scalable processes, you bring clarity, accountability, and momentum to complex organizations
  • You are energized by using marketing to tell meaningful stories that strengthen communities, inspire engagement, and demonstrate the positive impact Live Nation creates through music. 

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave and baby bonuses, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

 

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. job.title: Vice President, IT Service Management
job.description:
Job Summary:

About Live Nation Entertainment

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s largest live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. With 550 million fans and operations in over 40 countries, somewhere in the world every 18 minutes a Live Nation Entertainment event takes place. We manage some of the world’s biggest artists, produce some iconic music festivals, oversee world leading venues and, through Ticketmaster, operate one of the largest ecommerce sites. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com. Our Global IT function is a critical enabler of this operation, delivering technology infrastructure, enterprise services, and innovation across every region we operate in.

Job Purpose

The VP, IT Service Management is a senior global leadership role within Live Nation's Global IT organisation, accountable for the strategy, delivery, governance, and continuous improvement of IT service management across all Live Nation Entertainment businesses globally.

Reporting to the SVP / Global Head of IT Operations, this role owns the global service management operating model supporting approximately 25,000 employees and a diverse portfolio of corporate offices, venues, and business operations.

The role has end-to-end accountability for global Service Desks and Tier 1 / Tier 2 support, ITSM processes and platforms, end-user technology, IT asset management, workplace technology, and the employee technology lifecycle. A key priority is to modernise service delivery through AI, automation, self-service, standardisation, strong operational governance, and a relentless focus on employee experience.

Role Description

Strategic Leadership:

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive global IT Service Management capability improvement roadmap that aligns with Live Nation's business objectives and incorporates disaster recovery & business continuity goals.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to identify and prioritize technology initiatives that drive growth and efficiency.
  • Envision and implement AI-native practices and tools to drive effectiveness and delivery throughput
  • Implement frameworks and ways of working to ensure regulatory compliance across all technology domains.​
  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), service-level agreements (SLAs), and other metrics to track performance.
  • Own budget management for the function, including forecasting, cost optimization, vendor spend, and capital expenditure planning across security, cloud, and third-party contracts

Global IT Service Management Leadership & Service Excellence

  • Own the global IT Service Management strategy, operating model, roadmap, standards, and governance across all Live Nation Entertainment businesses.
  • Lead global Service Desk and Tier 1 / Tier 2 support services, ensuring consistent, high-quality support across regions, businesses, offices, and venues.
  • Define and govern global service levels, KPIs, CSAT, operational performance, service quality, and continuous improvement programmes.
  • Act as the senior escalation point for major service issues and business-impacting support challenges, ensuring clear ownership, communication, and resolution.

ITSM Processes, Governance & Platforms

  • Own and mature core IT Service Management disciplines globally, including Incident, Major Incident, Change, Problem, Request, Knowledge, Service Catalogue, and Configuration Management.
  • Establish consistent global processes, controls, reporting, and governance aligned to ITIL principles and Live Nation standards.
  • Drive adoption, optimisation, and governance of ITSM platforms and tooling, ensuring they enable efficient workflows, accurate reporting, and a strong employee experience.
  • Partner with Cyber Security, Infrastructure, Applications, and business technology teams to ensure service management processes support operational resilience, security, and compliance.

AI, Automation & Service Transformation

  • Lead the strategy and adoption of AI, automation, self-service, and digital support capabilities across IT Service Management and Service Desk operations.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support activity, improve ticket deflection, accelerate resolution, and increase employee self-service.
  • Develop a data-led service improvement roadmap using service analytics, trends, employee feedback, and operational insights.
  • Drive standardisation and simplification across global support services while recognising appropriate business and regional requirements.

End-User Technology & Employee Lifecycle Management

  • Own the global operational service for desktop and end-user technology, including Windows and Mac environments, endpoint support, peripherals, and associated workplace technologies.
  • Ensure effective technology onboarding, offboarding, moves, adds, and changes for employees globally, with clear standards and a consistent employee experience.
  • Partner with engineering and security teams to ensure end-user devices remain secure, current, supportable, and aligned to enterprise technology standards.

IT Asset Management and Workplace Technology

  • Own global IT Asset Management processes covering the lifecycle, inventory, control, deployment, recovery, and disposal of end-user technology assets.
  • Oversee operational technology services within office locations, including office networking, Wi-Fi, meeting room technology, AV/VC, printers, and related workplace services.
  • Lead IT service delivery for office openings, relocations, expansions, moves, and changes, coordinating effectively with Real Estate, Facilities, business teams, and technology partners.
  • Manage office networking technologies, including observability, lifecycle refresh programmes, standards, and compliance, ensuring resilient, secure, and consistently managed services across the global office estate.
  • Drive vendor performance, commercial discipline, asset optimisation, and standardisation across workplace and support services.

Experience & Qualifications

Essential

  • Significant senior IT Service Management and IT Operations leadership experience within a large, complex, multi-site global organisation.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale global Service Desk, Tier 1 / Tier 2, end-user computing, and workplace technology services.
  • Deep knowledge of ITSM and ITIL disciplines, including Incident, Major Incident, Change, Problem, Request, Knowledge, Service Catalogue, and service-level management.
  • Demonstrable experience transforming IT support through AI, automation, self-service, service analytics, and process optimisation.
  • Strong experience of enterprise end-user technology environments, including Windows, Mac, endpoint services, office networking, AV/VC, printers, and workplace technology.
  • Experience owning IT Asset Management and employee technology lifecycle processes at enterprise scale.
  • Strong commercial and vendor management experience, including budget ownership, contract performance, cost optimisation, and outsourced or managed service partners.

Desirable

  • Experience working within a de-centralized IT organization
  • CISSP, CISM, ITIL, PMP, or equivalent professional certifications.
  • MBA or equivalent business qualification.
  • Experience working within a large, publicly listed organization.

Skills & Personal Attributes

  • Exceptional global leadership and stakeholder management skills, able to engage credibly from Service Desk teams through to C-suite executives and business leaders.
  • Strong communicator with the ability to translate service performance, technology issues, and transformation priorities into clear business outcomes.
  • Highly organised and comfortable leading multiple global services, priorities, vendors, and transformation initiatives simultaneously.
  • Collaborative leadership style with the ability to build, develop, and inspire high-performing geographically dispersed teams.
  • Data-driven and commercially minded, with a strong focus on employee experience, value delivery, cost discipline, and measurable operational performance.
  • Resilient and decisive under pressure, particularly during major incidents, service disruptions, and high-profile business escalations.
  • Passionate about simplification, standardisation, automation, and continuous improvement.
  • Genuine passion for technology and service excellence as enablers of employee productivity and business growth.

Live Nation Entertainment is an equal opportunities employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

job.title: Application Support Analyst (D365 F&O)
job.description:
The Application Support Analyst provides administration, technical and functional support, maintenance, and continuous improvement for enterprise business applications, with a primary focus on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O). This role owns the operational processing and validation of financial data within D365 F&O, including billing, payments, revenue, and expenses, to support accuracy, financial integrity, and compliance with applicable requirements.

The Application Support Analyst monitors financial batch jobs, manages application configurations, troubleshoots issues, and supports reliable integrations and workflows across business functions. This position serves as a liaison among business stakeholders, IT, developers, and external vendors to resolve issues, improve application performance, and promote effective system utilization. This is an individual contributor position with no direct reports.

MAIN JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own the operational processing and validation of billing, payments, revenue, and expense data within D365 F&O. Monitor and execute scheduled financial batch jobs, validate timely and accurate completion, troubleshoot failures, and resolve or escalate issues to support financial integrity, business deadlines, and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Serve as the primary contact for application support requests and the primary owner of triaging technical and functional configuration issues across D365 F&O modules and related enterprise applications. Manage incidents through the enterprise ticketing system, investigate root causes, identify recurring issues, and coordinate resolution or escalation of complex application, infrastructure, integration, and code-related problems.

• Configure and maintain application settings, workflows, security roles, user access, and system controls in accordance with approved business requirements and security standards. Coordinate configuration changes across D365 F&O modules and associated upstream and downstream processes to maintain reliable operations and appropriate access.

• Monitor and validate application integrations, interfaces, and related batch jobs to support accurate and reliable data flow. Partner closely with Application Support Engineers, developers, and vendors to maintain, enhance, test, and support custom code, D365 objects, and system integrations.

• Coordinate application upgrades, patches, maintenance, and enhancement deployments to minimize business disruption. Gather requirements, support or lead user acceptance testing, document changes, and assist with implementation and post-deployment stabilization in accordance with IT change management processes.

• Maintain application inventories, architecture diagrams, configuration records, technical specifications, operational runbooks, and knowledge base content. Develop user guides and training materials, and deliver onboarding and ongoing guidance to improve system utilization and adoption of effective practices.

• Partner with business stakeholders to evaluate enhancement requests and identify opportunities to improve workflows, reporting, and operational efficiency. Use approved AI tools, low-code platforms, and automation technologies to support documentation, ticket analysis, and process improvements, and collaborate with technical teams to test and validate solutions.

• Coordinate with business units, IT teams, and external vendors to support service continuity, resolve escalations, and manage support needs, licensing compliance, and supported application versions. Prioritize assigned work independently, communicate service impacts and resolution status.

• Other duties as assigned.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or a related field and at least four years of progressive experience supporting enterprise or business-critical applications; or at least six years of relevant progressive experience in lieu of a degree.

• Hands-on experience providing technical and functional support for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, including financial processing, application configurations, and scheduled batch jobs.

• Working knowledge of financial workflows involving billing, payments, revenue, and expenses, including related data validation and system controls.

• Experience troubleshooting application issues, managing incidents, conducting root cause analysis, and supporting users in a business-critical environment.

• Working knowledge of integrations, APIs, middleware, and interface technologies, including experience investigating data flow issues and coordinating technical resolution.

• Experience creating, maintaining, or supporting reports using Power BI, SQL, or equivalent reporting tools.

• Experience using enterprise ticketing systems, such as ServiceNow, Jira, or Zendesk, to document, prioritize, resolve, and escalate support requests.

• Experience supporting application configuration, user access, security roles, workflows, testing, and change management activities.

• Strong documentation, organization, and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities independently.

• Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users and collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, developers, IT teams, and vendors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience supporting multiple D365 F&O modules and their upstream and downstream integrations.

• Experience partnering with developers to support custom D365 code, objects, extensions, and integrations.

• Experience with middleware, automation, or integration platforms such as Workato, MuleSoft, Boomi, or comparable iPaaS solutions.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform, approved AI tools, or other low-code technologies used for workflow automation and operational improvements.

• Experience supporting media, publishing, manufacturing, or multi-entity business environments.

• Familiarity with cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or AWS, and collaboration tools such as Google Workspace.

• Knowledge of Agile, Scrum, or ITIL service management practices.

• Relevant Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, or ITIL certification.

Times is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We actively work to create an inclusive environment where all of our employees can thrive. job.title: Investigations Editor
job.description:
The Los Angeles Times is looking to hire an experienced, talented editor to work with investigative and accountability reporters across the newsroom.

The investigations editor will work with every department to identify and evaluate short- and long-term reporting opportunities, with a focus on accountability reporting. The work includes guiding projects as well as editing or helping to edit stories.

This editor will collaborate with all newsroom departments, editors and reporters and be a paperwide resource for colleagues pursuing investigative projects from their inception. The responsibilities may include helping to manage relationships and joint projects with outside partners. The editor will also be involved with recruiting and hiring decisions.

Tasks will include:

• Directing and supervising investigative assignments from reporters across all newsroom desks

• Lead writers and editors in evaluating potential investigative projects and guide them through reporting and editing

• Actively develop newsroom talent by setting high standards and pushing writers and editors to produce their most ambitious work

• Partner with newsroom leadership on recruiting and hiring

• Develop partnerships with outside groups and organizations.

• Building on an L.A. Times tradition of strong, award-winning investigative reporting

We are looking for candidates with 15 or more years of reporting and editing experience, superb line-editing skills, excellent news judgment (and judgment generally) and a gift for inspiring some of the newsroom’s most talented reporters. A track record of guiding powerful, high-quality investigative and accountability journalism as well as experience in a digital news environment are essential.

Ideal candidates will have:

• Experience with investigative tools, including data analysis and document research

• A rigorous and meticulous approach to accountability journalism

• A track record of guiding investigations, especially examinations of government and institutional actors

• Ability to generate ideas for projects that are of particular importance to California and West Coast audiences

• A proven ability to edit with speed and accuracy

• The ability to think strategically about what big projects are worth the investment of time and resources

• A gift for developing productive, collegial team cultures

• Experience collaborating across newsroom teams

This management role will be based in El Segundo, Calif. This editor may be asked to appear on TV and radio on behalf of the L.A. Times and represent the organization at conferences, seminars, professional meetings and employer-sponsored events. Occasional night and weekend work is expected.

Please submit a resume, cover letter and applicable clips to Editor at Large Scott Kraft at the Apply link. In your cover letter, include your thoughts on how you would approach the role and your philosophy of investigative reporting.

The L.A. Times is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We actively work to create an inclusive environment where all of our employees can thrive. This Privacy Notice for Los Angeles Times sets forth how we will use the information we obtain when you apply for a position with us. Explore our company history, achievement, values, mission and more on our career site.

The pay scale the Company reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting is $160,000 to $180,000 and takes into account a wide range of factors including but not limited to skill set, experience, training, licenses, certifications, and other business or organizational needs. Compensation will be determined based on the above factors along with the requirements of the position. At the L.A.
