job.title: Chief Engineer
job.description:
Chief Engineer

Chief Engineer

Department: Engineering
Reports To: General Manager / Corporate Director of Engineering
FLSA Status: Exempt
Location: Boise Market (KQXR-FM, KJOT-FM, KTHI-FM, KRVB-FM)

 

POSITION SUMMARY

Lotus Boise Corp is accepting applications for a Full-Time Chief Engineer. This position is responsible for the technical operation, maintenance, and regulatory compliance of all broadcast transmission and studio facilities for the cluster. Working closely with the local GM and Corporate Director of Engineering, this role ensures uninterrupted broadcast operations, maintains FCC compliance, and oversees building and facility maintenance.

Due to the nature of broadcast operations, the Chief Engineer position is considered an on-call role and must be available to respond to technical issues or facility emergencies that may impact broadcast operations at any time, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Technical Operations

  • Oversee the installation, maintenance, and repair of all broadcast equipment including transmitters, antennas, STL systems, automation systems, and studio equipment.
  • Ensure reliable operation of broadcast facilities to maintain continuous on-air operations.
  • Monitor transmitter performance and conduct routine inspections of transmitter sites.
  • Ability to resolve complex problems not covered by existing procedures or practices independently often whilst under pressure.
  • Self-motivated to work independently under timeline to achieve departmental and station goals
  • Maintain broadcast automation systems, audio routing systems, and studio consoles.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues affecting broadcast operations.

Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure full compliance with all applicable FCC regulations and licensing requirements.
  • Maintain and update required FCC documentation and station engineering records.
  • Manage EAS (Emergency Alert System) equipment testing and compliance.
  • Coordinate required FCC filings, inspections, and technical reporting.

 

Building and Facility Maintenance

  • Oversee the maintenance and operational readiness of studio facilities, transmitter buildings, and related infrastructure.
  • Coordinate routine maintenance of building systems including electrical, HVAC, grounding systems, generators, and backup power systems.
  • Monitor and address building maintenance needs to ensure a safe and functional work environment for staff and visitors.
  • Coordinate facility repairs and improvements in collaboration with management.
  • Ensure transmitter sites, towers, and studio spaces remain compliant with safety and operational standards.

Vendor Management and Coordination

  • Serve as the primary liaison with technical vendors, contractors, tower companies, equipment suppliers, and facility maintenance providers.
  • Coordinate vendor scheduling for maintenance, repairs, and equipment installations.
  • Obtain quotes, evaluate service providers, and recommend vendor solutions for engineering and facility needs.
  • Monitor vendor work to ensure quality, compliance with safety standards, and completion of contracted services.

Engineering Leadership

  • Coordinate with General Manager and corporate engineering leadership on capital equipment needs and long-term technical planning.
  • Assist with engineering budgets, equipment procurement, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Provide technical guidance and training to station personnel.

Programming and Promotions Support

  • Support programming operations including studio setup and signal quality management.
  • Provide technical support for remote broadcasts, live events, and promotional activities.
  • Assist in implementation of new broadcast technologies and digital platforms.

On-Call and Emergency Response Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary on-call engineering contact for technical emergencies affecting broadcast operations.
  • Respond to equipment failures, signal disruptions, facility issues, or other operational emergencies in a timely manner.
  • Be available outside of normal business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, when technical issues require immediate attention.
  • Coordinate emergency repairs with vendors or technical staff as necessary to restore broadcast operations.

 

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 5–7 years of broadcast engineering experience.
  • Strong knowledge of FCC broadcast regulations and compliance requirements.
  • Experience with radio transmitters, automation systems, audio consoles, and studio-transmitter links.
  • Working knowledge of IP networking and broadcast automation systems.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues under time-sensitive conditions.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing engineering operations for a multi-station broadcast cluster.
  • Experience overseeing facility maintenance and vendor coordination.

 

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to climb ladders and work at transmitter sites and tower locations.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to work in indoor studios and outdoor transmitter environments.

 

Work Environment

This position works in broadcast studios, office environments, and transmitter facilities. The role requires travel between studio and transmitter sites and may require work during evenings, weekends, or holidays to support station operations, technical maintenance, or emergency response situations.

 

Disclaimer:

Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

ABOUT US:

Lotus Boise Corp. is a subsidiary of Lotus Communications Corp. and is a media, entertainment and digital marketing services company that owns and operates radio properties. Lotus Communications Corp. operates 47 radio stations in the Western United States including stations in Los Angeles, Las Vegas, Sacramento, Boise, Tucson, Fresno and Bakersfield. Lotus Boise Corp ensures there is no discrimination based on the grounds of race, color, religion, gender, age, handicap, veteran status or national origin in respect to recruitment, evaluation, selection, promotion, compensation and training. Lotus Boise Corp. is an equal opportunity employer. If you know anyone who may be qualified to fill this position, please let him or her know about this opportunity. All interested candidates are encouraged to contact Careers@lotusboise.com .

Job Summary

Job Requirements The Senior Counsel will serve as a legal adviser to Marvel Comics and Marvel Studios and will be expected to provide guidance and direction reflecting sound judgment, vision, and legal knowledge. The Senior Counsel with Marvel drafts and negotiates a variety of publishing license agreements, co-promotional, sponsorships, and brand partnerships agreements. This position will be working closely with other attorneys, as well as providing support to, and/or manage, more junior team members. What You Will Do: Support Marvel Comics and Marvel Studios business with a wide variety of transactional legal work. Draft and negotiate publishing license agreements, talent agreements, permission agreements, and vendor/professional services agreements for Marvel Comics. Draft and negotiate co-promotional, sponsorships, and brand partnership agreements with third-party partners for Marvel Studios films and events. Draft and negotiate custom solutions and co-promotional agreements with third-party partners for Marvel Comics and Marvel franchise programs. Support clients in Ad-Sales & Partnerships, Corporate Alliances, and Disney Partnership Marketing on projects involving Marvel Studios IP. Review and clear advertising materials, marketing materials, press releases, sweepstakes/contests/giveaways, & other creative assets. Counsel clients on pre-publication legal clearance questions. Assist with trademark clearance process for Marvel Comics. Independently drafts and negotiates agreements with minimal oversight.

Required Qualifications

& Skills: 5+ years legal experience.

Experience

drafting and negotiating a high volume of entertainment or licensing agreements. Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to work well in a team environment and act as a resource to colleagues. Exceptional organizational, prioritization, and time management skills, with a proven ability to manage multiple high-priority, high-volume projects efficiently. Demonstrated capacity to keep current on emerging business and legal trends in the entertainment industry. A collegial and collaborative lawyer who brings a commitment to the creation of a positive working environment within the legal organization. Ability to work in an environment with a high degree of confidentiality.

Education

J.D. degree or equivalent from an accredited law school. job.title: Category Manager – Books and Calendars
job.description:
Drive the future of retail category management with McClatchy’s Retail Network as our Category Manager – Books and Calendars. We’re looking for a dynamic, data-driven leader ready to shape and grow our books and calendars category through innovation, analytics, and strong supplier partnerships. If you thrive on optimizing performance, leveraging AI-powered insights, and exceeding sales targets, this is your opportunity to make a measurable impact in a fast-evolving retail environment.

In this role, you’ll lead the procurement, development, and management of book and calendar programs, collaborating closely with vendors, publishers, and cross-functional teams. You’ll use advanced analytics and emerging technologies to inform product selection, streamline operations, and ensure our offerings are always relevant and competitive. Your strategic thinking and relationship-building skills will be key to maximizing profitability and driving customer satisfaction.

What you’ll do:

  • Manage and optimize the books and calendars category, from procurement and negotiation to sales performance and product availability
  • Leverage AI, data analytics, and market trends to inform go-to-market strategies, pricing, and promotions
  • Build and maintain strong supplier relationships, using technology to enhance sourcing and forecasting
  • Analyze category performance and P&L, identifying opportunities for profit growth and cost savings
  • Support the retailer partnership team through training, pipeline development, go-to-market tools, and serving as an SME on client calls  
  • Champion continuous improvement, innovation, and alignment with company growth objectives
  • Occasional travel may be required

What sets you apart:

  • Proven expertise in category management, retail dynamics, and supply chain optimization—especially in books/calendars or similar categories
  • Strong analytical skills and experience using AI-driven tools and consumer insights

job.title: DOT Compliance & Field Safety Technician
job.description:
Title: DOT Compliance & Field Safety Technician

Reports to: Director of Safety

 

At Meruelo Enterprises, we’re building more than infrastructure, we’re building communities, careers, and a better tomorrow.

Founded in 1986 and proudly minority-owned, we’ve grown into one of California’s leading construction and engineering firms, serving major utility, transportation, and telecom clients across the West Coast. With a talented team of over 2,500 professionals and a family of top-tier subsidiaries, we deliver innovative, high-impact solutions in gas, electric, water, and more.

From the ground up, we’re committed to safety, quality, and integrity. If you're looking to be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven company making a real difference, welcome to Meruelo Enterprises.

 

About the Role:

The DOT Compliance & Field Safety Technician is a senior individual contributor responsible for owning and continuously improving the company’s transportation compliance and fleet safety programs across all operations. Reporting directly to the Director of Safety, this role serves as the enterprise subject‑matter expert for DOT/CHP compliance, fleet risk reduction, incident investigation, and telematics-driven performance management.

This position has no direct reports but carries company‑wide authority and accountability for transportation safety outcomes, compliance readiness, and fleet risk mitigation.

 

Key Responsibilities:

²  Own all transportation compliance programs, including DOT/FMCSA (as applicable), CHP, DMV pull‑notice, driver qualification files, medical certification tracking, and onboarding controls.

²  Plan, lead, and support internal and external transportation audits and inspections.

²  Interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into practical SOPs, controls, and field‑ready tools.

²  Lead initiatives to reduce preventable incidents, injuries, and claim severity across CDL and non‑CDL fleets.

²  Conduct transportation incident and collision investigations; perform root‑cause analysis and ensure timely corrective and preventive actions.

²  Partner with Risk Management, Insurance, and Legal on claim documentation, trends, and litigation support.

²  Serve as program owner for fleet telematics and safety technology platforms (e.g., Samsara, Geotab, Lytx or similar).

²  Develop and maintain driver scorecards, coaching workflows, compliance alerts, and trend analysis.

²  Produce monthly dashboards and executive summaries for the VP of Safety and leadership team.

²  Develop and deliver transportation safety training, refresher programs, and remedial coaching.

²  Equip field leaders with coaching tools and clear compliance expectations.

²  Perform field observations, yard reviews, and ride‑alongs as needed.

²  Create and maintain standardized SOPs, checklists, and documentation related to transportation compliance and fleet safety.

²  Lead cross‑functional corrective action plans with Operations, Fleet, HR, and Safety.

²  Support contractor and vendor transportation compliance expectations where applicable.

 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

²  Preventable incident frequency and severity trends

²  DOT/CHP audit readiness and outcomes

²  Driver coaching completion and improvement metrics

²  DMV pull‑notice and DQ file accuracy

²  Telematics utilization and leading indicator improvement

²  Timely investigation and corrective action closure

 

Qualifications:

²  5+ years of experience in transportation safety, DOT compliance, fleet risk, or safety roles within construction, utilities, logistics, or similar environments.

²  Demonstrated ownership of compliance programs and audits.

²  Strong incident investigation and corrective action leadership skills.

²  Strong analytical capability; working knowledge of Excel and fleet analytics platforms.

²  Experience supporting utility construction or heavy civil operations. (Preferred)

²  Familiarity with California fleet compliance standards and CHP interactions. (Preferred)

²  Experience with safety management systems and telematics‑driven coaching programs. (Preferred)

²  Safety or compliance certifications (CSP, ASP, CHST, accident investigation, etc.). (Preferred)

²  Bilingual Spanish a plus.

²  Reports directly to: VP of Safety

²  Works closely with: Operations, Fleet Maintenance, Risk/Insurance, HR, and Legal

²  Senior Individual Contributor (no direct reports)

²  Combination of office and field environment.

²  Regular visits to yards and jobsites across Southern California.

²  Occasional after‑hours support during serious incidents.

 

 

At Meruelo, we believe that diverse teams drive innovation and better business outcomes. We are dedicated to fostering a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

job.title: Field Coordinator
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Paving field Coordinator is responsible for planning, posting, documenting, and monitoring temporary "No Parking" restrictions required for street paving, reconstruction, utility restoration, and public works projects throughout the City of Los Angeles. The position ensures compliance with City of Los Angeles permitting requirements, parking restriction regulations, traffic control plans, and project schedules to facilitate successful paving operations while minimizing disruptions to residents and businesses.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinate and implement temporary parking restrictions for paving and roadway construction projects.
  • Install, maintain, and remove temporary "No Parking" signs in accordance with City of Los Angeles permit requirements.
  • Verify signs are posted within required notification timeframes prior to scheduled construction activities.
  • Photograph and document all posted signs, locations, dates, and times for compliance records.
  • Conduct field inspections to ensure parking restrictions remain visible, legible, and properly located.
  • Communicate with residents, business owners, property managers, and stakeholders regarding upcoming restrictions.
  • Coordinate daily with project managers, paving crews, traffic control personnel, inspectors, and City representatives.
  • Maintain accurate records of permits, posting logs, photographs, and project documentation.
  • Verify project addresses, limits of work, and parking restriction boundaries before posting.
  • Assist with lane closures, traffic control coordination, and field logistics as required.
  • Respond to public inquiries and complaints regarding temporary parking restrictions.
  • Ensure compliance with company safety policies and applicable traffic safety regulations.
  • Support emergency and short-notice paving operations when required.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED required.

Experience

  • Minimum two (2) years of experience in construction coordination, traffic control, public works, paving operations, utility construction, or related field.
  • Experience working within the City of Los Angeles permitting environment is preferred.

License Requirements

  • Valid California Driver License.
  • Ability to operate company vehicles throughout Los Angeles County.

KNOWLEDGE OF

  • City of Los Angeles temporary no-parking requirements.
  • Public works and paving operations.
  • Traffic control practices and work zone safety.
  • Street and roadway nomenclature throughout Los Angeles.
  • Permit compliance procedures.
  • Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and mobile field documentation applications.
  • Customer service and public communication techniques.

ABILITY TO

  • Work independently in the field with minimal supervision.
  • Read maps, plans, permits, and work orders.
  • Maintain detailed documentation and photographic records.
  • Communicate professionally with residents, businesses, inspectors, and project personnel.
  • Organize and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Work flexible hours, including nights and weekends, as required by paving schedules.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Walk long distances in residential, commercial, and industrial areas.
  • Frequently lift and carry up to 50 pounds.
  • Install and remove temporary parking signs and signposts.
  • Work outdoors in varying weather and traffic conditions.
  • Stand, bend, climb, and perform field activities for extended periods.

PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS

  • ATSSA Traffic Control Technician (TCT).
  • ATSSA Traffic Control Supervisor (TCS).
  • OSHA 10-Hour or OSHA 30-Hour Construction Safety Certification.
  • CPR/First Aid Certification.

WORKING CONDITIONS

This position requires daily travel throughout the City of Los Angeles and surrounding areas. Work is performed outdoors near active traffic, construction zones, and paving operations during both daytime and nighttime hours.

This version is tailored for contractors performing paving, utility restoration, and street work that require temporary No Parking posting and compliance documentation for City of Los Angeles paving permits.

Herman Weissker, Inc. offers competitive pay and excellent benefits including Medical, Dental, Prescription, Vision, 401(K), etc.  Salary will be commensurate with experience.

Herman Weissker, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer

job.title: Media Sales Executive | Yakima or Tri-Cities, WA
job.description:
Apple Valley News Now (ABC) + Phase 3 Digital

What if your next job let you help local businesses grow—and bring their stories to life on TV, streaming and digital platforms?

At Apple Valley News Now and Phase 3 Digital, you’ll help businesses across the Yakima and Tri-Cities connect with customers through streaming TV, digital advertising, social media and, when it fits, traditional television. One day you might be learning what makes a neighborhood business stand out; the next, you’re brainstorming a campaign that brings its story to life. You’ll have plenty of variety, room to build relationships and the satisfaction of seeing local ideas make it into the world.

You can be based in our Yakima or Kennewick office.

What you’ll do

  • Get to know local businesses, ask smart questions and uncover what they want to achieve.
  • Develop new client relationships and grow existing ones through thoughtful follow-through.
  • Build and present advertising ideas across connected TV/streaming, digital video, display, social and other media solutions that fit each client’s goals.
  • Work with creative, digital and sales colleagues to launch campaigns, review results and find ways to improve them.
  • Keep learning as audiences, platforms and marketing tools change.
  • Own your pipeline and work toward sales goals.

Who could thrive here

You might come from advertising sales—but you don’t have to. If you’ve built trust, won business or helped customers make decisions in another field, we want to hear from you. That could mean business development, hospitality, retail, real estate, recruiting or another relationship-driven role.

You’re curious about how businesses grow, comfortable starting conversations, organized enough to follow through and excited to turn a client’s challenge into a compelling idea. You can explain your thinking clearly and enjoy learning new tools. Experience selling connected TV or digital advertising is valuable, not required to start the conversation. Experience with traditional TV advertising is welcome, not required.

Why media? Why us?

Media keeps changing—and that’s part of the fun. You can pair the reach of an established local ABC brand that has partnerships with the Seattle Kraken and Seattle Mariners along with digital and streaming options, bring creative people into the conversation and help businesses show up where their customers are. It’s a career built on relationships, ideas and learning, with support to grow your media and digital sales skills.

Compensation and benefits

  • Posted compensation range: $45,000–$100,000 per year, including supplemental pay such as commission. Actual earnings vary; commissions are uncapped.
  • Monthly cell phone and gas allowances.
  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance.
  • Paid time off; sick, vacation, holidays and a 401(k) with company match.

Ready to make your mark in a field that’s never boring? Apply to be a Media Sales Executive with Apple Valley News Now and Phase 3 Digital. Tell us about the relationships you’ve built, the goals you’ve helped others reach or the new skills you’re eager to learn—even if your career so far hasn’t been in media.

Apple Valley News Now is an equal opportunity employer.

job.title: Account Director, Performance & Growth (LA)
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The NBCU Account Director, Performance & Growth will focus exclusively on driving demand for performance brands across our suite of linear and digital products including all streaming products, with a focus on driving new and incremental revenue for the full NBCU portfolio (One Platform). This individual will play a critical role within our fast-paced advertising sales team, managing relationships across external clients and independent media agencies. The role requires building relationships with key internal stakeholders and collaborative partners across the NBCU organization. Expertise within the performance and digital landscape is a must. This person must have the ability to operate effectively at the cross-section of performance and digital media as these skills are critical to achieving success in this role. This role will report directly into to the Vice President, Performance & Growth. 

  • Drive linear and digital advertising demand of the NBCU Platform for specific performance brands and agencies in the direct-to-consumer category 
  • Be an expert across NBCU digital and streaming products and convey meaningful and sustainable opportunities to emerging brands 
  • Execute on day-to-day sales strategy; develop target lists, lead client outreach and be in market often with full NBCU opportunities 
  • Leverage prospecting software such as Linkedin Navigator, Media Radar and Zoom Info to identify, research and engage prospective clients and partners 
  • Understand customer needs and provide feedback and market input that will strengthen our NBCU opportunities and value proposition 
  • Field proactive requests: collect, manage, and route RFP requests to key stakeholders to ensure deadlines are met 
  • Track sales revenue and establish a regular cadence for reporting on progress 
  • Partner with internal teams (Digital and Linear sales leads, Client Strategy, Agency Partnerships, Marketing, Legal, Research, etc.) to develop proactive packages and drive creativity throughout the sales process 
  • Develop strong relationships throughout NBCU to ensure a unified and coordinated strategy is presented in the market 
  • Proven ability to prospect and identify new/incremental revenue opportunities beyond servicing an existing book of business
  • Growth-oriented/hunter mindset, with experience developing new opportunities, expanding client investment, and converting whitespace into revenue
  • Strong technical aptitude, including demonstrated experience leveraging AI, automation, data, or emerging technology to improve workflows, prospect more effectively, or solve business problems
  • Demonstrated expertise in performance advertising, with a strong understanding of performance-driven digital media concepts, measurement, attribution, optimization, and the key levers that drive business outcomes.
  • Confidently applies performance principles across the full client lifecycle, from developing data-driven media strategies and communicating measurement frameworks pre-sale to analyzing campaign performance, identifying optimization opportunities, and using results to drive account growth post-sale.
  • Advanced client-facing skills with the ability to articulate value propositions, influence investment, and present integrated marketing solutions
  • Analytical and strategic thinker with a track record of creative problem-solving and driving innovation
  • Self-starter who can operate independently and effectively navigate a large, cross-functional organization
  • 5+ years of relevant experience across advertising sales, business development, account management, programmatic/ad tech, or a related advanced media environment
  • Digital video experience required

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 

Location: This role is open to candidates based in Los Angeles or San Francisco.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $95,000 - $170,000 + sales compensation incentive eligible

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

NBCUniversal will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories, or arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with relevant legal requirements, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative For Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

job.title: Assignment Desk Editor - Multiplatform, Telemundo Arizona (Phoenix/Tucson)
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Telemundo Arizona (KTAZ/KHRR) in Phoenix, AZ, is seeking a Assignment Desk Editor -  Multiplatform who thrives in a fast-paced, rapidly changing newsroom. This position is at the heart of our daily news operation, serving as the nerve center of newsgathering while also playing a key role in digital and multi-platform content production.

The ideal candidate will not only manage traditional desk duties but also adapt to audience trends, help shape coverage with relevant context for younger and digital audiences, and ensure our journalism resonates across broadcast, digital, and social media.

Responsibilities

  • Story Discovery & Logistics
    • Monitor desk phones, scanners, wires, social media, and community contacts for breaking and developing news.
    • Curate and update the Dalet daybook with story ideas, planned coverage, and daily events.
    • Dispatch reporters, MMJs, and photographers, coordinating logistics, live shots, and resources.
    • Lead and participate in editorial meetings, bringing strong editorial judgment and audience-driven ideas.
    • Produce a weekend newscast and serve as a backup producer when needed.
    • Strong criteria in national, local politics, Government, and Law enforcement.
  • Digital & Multiplatform Content
    • Publish and update news content across digital, OTT, and social platforms, ensuring timely and engaging coverage.
    • Create content tailored for vertical video and social platforms, adding “wings” (side context such as temperatures, hashtags, key bullet points, or quick facts) to enhance relevance for younger audiences.
    • Push alerts, headlines, and live streams with accuracy, speed, and clarity.
    • Edit video for broadcast, streaming channels, and social platforms.
    • Fast-paced and under pressure role.
  • Collaboration & Community
    • Work together with producers, anchors, and reporters to maximize resources and coverage.
    • Cultivate community contacts and relationships with PIOs, law enforcement, and officials.
    • Stay informed on local, state, and national news, sharing updates with newsroom staff as needed.
  • Enterprise & Forward Planning
    • Identify enterprise story opportunities aligned with station research and leadership direction.
    • Maintain newsroom calendars and plan coverage for upcoming events, community issues, and special projects.
    • Support special projects and investigative initiatives, including undercover or long-form reports.

Basic Qualifications

  • Fluency in Spanish and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both languages.
  • Minimum 2 years’ experience as an Assignment Editor, Producer, or in a newsroom role.
  • Strong editorial judgment, writing, and research skills.
  • Familiarity with newsroom computer systems (Dalet, iNews, or similar).
  • Ability to thrive under pressure, prioritize quickly, and handle multiple assignments at once.
  • Strong understanding of digital and social publishing tools, analytics, and audience engagement strategies.
  • Knowledge of journalistic ethics, FCC rules, libel/slander laws.
  • Valid driver’s license and good driving record.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV via www.nbcunicareers.com
  • Flexible schedule, willingness to work nights, weekends, holidays, and extended hours.
  • Must be willing to work at the station in Phoenix location.
  • Must have valid driver’s license.
  • Must have ability to work any of a 24x7 shift.

Desired Characteristics

  • Passion for breaking news and being the first to inform the community.
  • Creative thinker comfortable experimenting with new storytelling formats.
  • Familiar with the Arizona news landscape, particularly Phoenix and Tucson.
  • Highly collaborative and able to communicate clearly across all newsroom roles.

Additional Requirements

Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

NBC6 and Telemundo 51, the NBCUniversal Local stations serving South Florida, are looking for a bilingual journalist to serve as an Assignment Editor in our duopoly’s multiplatform newsroom. This position is regularly scheduled for evenings and weekends. You will be responsible for facilitating newsgathering and coordinating comprehensive coverage of breaking and daily news stories.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Strong knowledge of social media, streaming and multiplatform news.

  • Outstanding analytical, communication, and organizational skills, including excellent drafting and negotiation abilities

NBCUniversal est l’une des plus importantes entreprises de médias et de divertissement au monde. Nous créons du contenu de calibre mondial que nous diffusons par l’entremise de notre portefeuille de marques de cinéma, de télévision et de diffusion en continu, et auquel nous donnons vie grâce à nos destinations de parcs thématiques à l’échelle mondiale, à nos produits de consommation et à nos expériences. Nous détenons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de diffusion en continu haut de gamme financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des productions cinématographiques et des émissions de premier plan par l’entremise de nos puissants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi que des quatre studios de télévision mondiaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs thématiques et des expériences de premier plan partout dans le monde par l’entremise d’Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment Universal Orlando Resort, qui abrite Universal Epic Universe, et Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Visitez www.nbcuniversal.com pour en savoir plus.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés où notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics vivent et travaillent. Nous avons une longue tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à offrir à notre personnel la possibilité de s’investir au sein de leurs communautés. Nous favorisons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et d’offrir un vaste éventail de contenus qui reflètent notre monde.

RESPONSIBILTIES 

  • As an Associate Design Director, you will support the Design Director in driving the execution, alignment, and day-to-day coordination of the project’s design vision across pillars and disciplines. You will act as a key operational and creative partner, helping ensure design decisions, priorities, and follow-through remain consistent across the project. 

  • Partner closely with the Design Director to define the architecture of shared systems at the intersection of design and programming, including the creator facing-UGC API through which creators build their own experiences. Strong architectural thinking is central to this role: defining clear systems, reusable capabilities, and consistent interfaces. 

  • Support the execution and communication of the gameplay systems and player experience. 

  • Maintain visibility across multiple pillars, strike teams, and cross-disciplinary initiatives to help ensure alignment and consistency. 

  • Help drive follow-up, coordination, and resolution of cross-team design topics and dependencies. 

  • Support design decision-making on gameplay systems, player experience, workflows, and feature implementation. 

  • Collaborate closely with Production, Engineering, Art, UX, Animation, Audio, and other disciplines to ensure alignment between creative goals and execution realities. 

  • Help identify risks, blockers, communication gaps, and production challenges, and proactively work toward solutions. 

  • Mentor and support designers across the team by providing feedback, guidance, and design oversight. 

  • Ensure documentation, communication, and design intentions remain clear and actionable across teams. 

  • Contribute to reviews, playtests, iteration, and feature evaluations to help maintain quality and consistency across the experience. 

  • Help maintain consistency between long-term vision, short-term priorities, and day-to-day execution. 

RESPONSIBILTÉS 

  • En tant qu’Associate Design Director, vous soutiendrez le Design Director dans l’exécution, l’alignement et la coordination quotidienne de la vision design du projet à travers les différents piliers et disciplines. Vous agirez comme un partenaire créatif et opérationnel clé afin d’assurer la cohérence des décisions, priorités et suivis design à l’échelle du projet. 

  • Collaborer étroitement avec le directeur du design pour définir l’architecture de systèmes partagés à la croisée du design et de la programmation, notamment l’API de création de contenu utilisateur (UGC) permettant aux créateurs de construire leurs propres expériences. La capacité à penser en termes d’architecture est au cœur de ce rôle : définir des systèmes clairs, des fonctionnalités réutilisables et des interfaces cohérentes. 

  • Collaborer étroitement avec le Design Director afin de soutenir l’exécution et la communication de la vision globale du gameplay et de l’expérience joueur. 

  • Maintenir une visibilité sur plusieurs piliers, strike teams et initiatives transversales afin d’assurer l’alignement et la cohérence entre les équipes. 

  • Aider à assurer le suivi, la coordination et la résolution des sujets et dépendances design entre les équipes. 

  • Soutenir la prise de décision design concernant les systèmes de gameplay, l’expérience joueur, les workflows et l’implémentation des fonctionnalités. 

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de Production, Ingénierie, Art, UX, Animation, Audio et les autres disciplines afin d’assurer l’alignement entre les objectifs créatifs et les réalités de production. 

  • Identifier les risques, blocages, problèmes de communication et défis de production, puis contribuer activement à leur résolution. 

  • Encadrer et soutenir les designers de l’équipe en fournissant du feedback, du mentorat et de la supervision design. 

  • Veiller à ce que la documentation, la communication et les intentions design demeurent claires et exploitables pour les équipes. 

  • Participer aux revues, playtests, itérations et évaluations de fonctionnalités afin de maintenir la qualité et la cohérence de l’expérience. 

  • Contribuer à maintenir l’alignement entre la vision long terme, les priorités court terme et l’exécution quotidienne. 

QUALIFICATIONS 

Basic Requirements:  

  • Demonstrated experience defining system architectures at the intersection of design and programming, translating complex needs into clear abstractions, reusable building blocks, and well-defined interfaces. 

  • Strong understanding of modularity, abstraction, and composition, with the ability to explain architectural decisions and their tradeoffs to both designers and engineers. 

  • Strong experience in game design on AAA or high-quality indie productions. 

  • Experience leading or coordinating multidisciplinary teams or large gameplay initiatives. 

  • Strong understanding of gameplay systems, player experience, progression, systemic design, and production realities. 

  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to align multiple teams and stakeholders. 

  • Ability to balance creative vision with practical production constraints and technical feasibility. 

  • Strong knowledge of Unreal Engine 5 and Blueprint scripting workflows. 

  • Comfortable operating across multiple gameplay domains, features, and team structures. 

  • Experience collaborating closely with Design, Production, Engineering, Art, and UX leadership. 

  • Ability to make informed moment-to-moment decisions while maintaining alignment with broader project goals. 

Desired Characteristics:  

  • Experience with UGC systems, sandbox gameplay, live services, or player-driven experiences. 

  • Strong systems design sensibilities and understanding of emergent gameplay. 

  • Experience supporting feature teams, strike teams, or horizontal cross-project initiatives. 

  • Experience designing creator tools, scripting interfaces, APIs, or frameworks used by others to build gameplay experiences. 

  • Experience reviewing implementation quality and ensuring consistency across multiple gameplay features. 

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to navigate ambiguity in fast-moving production environments. 

  • Interest in iterative development, rapid prototyping, and collaborative creative workflows. 

QUALIFICATIONS 

Exigences de base :  

  • Expérience démontrée dans la définition d’architectures de systèmes à la croisée du design et de la programmation, en traduisant des besoins complexes en abstractions claires, en éléments réutilisables et en interfaces bien définies. 

  • Solide compréhension des principes de modularité, d’abstraction et de composition, et capacité à expliquer les décisions d’architecture et leurs compromis aux designers comme aux ingénieurs. 

  • Solide expérience en design de jeux sur des productions AAA ou des productions indépendantes de grande qualité. 

  • Expérience en leadership ou en coordination d’équipes multidisciplinaires ou de grandes initiatives gameplay. 

  • Excellente compréhension des systèmes de gameplay, de l’expérience joueur, de la progression, du design systémique et des réalités de production. 

  • Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et communicationnelles, avec la capacité d’aligner plusieurs équipes et parties prenantes. 

  • Capacité à équilibrer vision créative, contraintes de production et faisabilité technique. 

  • Solide maîtrise d’Unreal Engine 5 et des workflows de scripting Blueprint. 

  • Aisance à travailler sur plusieurs domaines de gameplay, fonctionnalités et structures d’équipe. 

  • Expérience de collaboration étroite avec les directions Design, Production, Ingénierie, Art et UX. 

  • Capacité à prendre des décisions éclairées au quotidien tout en restant aligné avec les objectifs globaux du projet. 

Atouts recherchés :  

  • Expérience avec les systèmes UGC, le gameplay de type bac à sable, les jeux en service continu ou les expériences façonnées par les joueurs. 

  • Forte sensibilité en design systémique et bonne compréhension du gameplay émergent. 

  • Expérience de soutien à des feature teams, strike teams ou initiatives transversales à grande échelle. 

  • Expérience dans la conception d’outils de création, d’interfaces de script, d’API ou de frameworks permettant à d’autres de construire des expériences de gameplay. 

  • Bonne sensibilité technique et capacité à communiquer efficacement avec des ingénieurs et des technical designers. 

  • Expérience dans la révision de la qualité d’implémentation et le maintien de la cohérence entre plusieurs fonctionnalités gameplay. 

  • Solides capacités de résolution de problèmes et aisance à évoluer dans des environnements de production rapides et ambigus. 

  • Intérêt pour le développement itératif, le prototypage rapide et les workflows créatifs collaboratifs.

job.title: Associate Design Engineer
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

We’re looking for a Design Engineer I who thrives at the intersection of interaction design, front-end engineering, and emerging technologies. You are passionate about collaborating on early-stage ideas and bringing them to life as real, tangible, high-fidelity prototypes, proofs-of-concept, and internal tools that help teams learn faster, make better decisions, and automate manual tasks.

In terms of core skill set, you look like a front-end engineer, but you think like a designer. You bring a strong visual and interaction sensibility, paired with pragmatic engineering judgment. You bias toward speed, clarity, and craft, while maintaining a deep respect for usability, performance, and maintainability. You’re eager to learn from senior teammates, building your ability to work independently, and proactively identifying opportunities where prototyping, tooling, or automation can unlock new possibilities.

You’re also excited about how AI is reshaping design and product workflows. You don’t just use AI tools—you experiment with them, integrate them into prototypes and pipelines, and explore how generative and assistive AI can meaningfully improve user experiences, internal workflows, and design quality.

You’ll be joining a small but mighty Design Engineering team within the Viewing Experience, Product and Design organization at Peacock. Our mission is to bring ideas to life and power innovation. Your primary focus will be helping build high-impact prototypes that explore new features and experiences across the Peacock ecosystem, while also contributing to design tools, Figma plugins, and AI-powered utilities that help our teams work faster, smarter, and with greater confidence. You’ll work on specific features and components, with guidance and support from senior members of the team.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner closely with designers, product managers, engineers, and user researchers to build prototypes that support design exploration, usability testing, experimentation, and stakeholder alignment
  • Translate abstract ideas and early concepts into interactive, high-fidelity prototypes for specific features and components across web, mobile, and TV platforms
  • Help design and build internal tools, utilities, and Figma plugins that improve design quality, consistency, speed, and scalability
  • Explore and apply AI-driven approaches to design, prototyping, automation, content exploration, and workflow optimization
  • Integrate live or simulated data into prototypes by building or consuming APIs
  • Improve and evolve initial design concepts through iterative prototyping and feedback
  • Contribute to shared toolkits, frameworks, and codebases that accelerate prototyping across the team
  • Contribute technical and creative ideas to projects, including experimenting with new frameworks, tools, or approaches with guidance from senior team members
  • Stay current with industry trends, emerging interaction patterns, and new technologies, and proactively apply them where they create leverage
  • Continuously look for opportunities to improve how the team prototypes, experiments, and collaborates
  • Regularly present and demo work to the immediate team, seeking feedback and flagging issues early as you grow your craft
  • 1+ years of relevant professional experience in design engineering, front-end engineering, or a related hybrid role
  • Degree in Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Design, or equivalent practical experience
  • Portfolio of relevant work and code samples demonstrating strong interaction design sensibility, technical execution, and polished final outcomes
  • Working proficiency in HTML, CSS, modern JavaScript, and React
  • Experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Augment, Cursor, etc.) to assist with coding and design-related tasks
  • Working knowledge of design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong eye for visual detail and a foundational understanding of interaction design principles, user experience best practices, and modern design workflows
  • Some experience contributing to software projects in a team environment, including peer code reviews, version control, and shared coding standards
  • Familiarity with building and/or consuming APIs and working with live or structured data
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly explain ideas to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience presenting and demoing work to peers and cross-functional partners
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with designers, engineers, product managers, and user researchers
  • Ability to complete assignments on time and without handholding, with comfort asking questions and flagging issues early
  • Curiosity and technical fluency around AI models, APIs, and limitations, with an emphasis on practical application over theory

 

Nice-To-Have:

  • Internship, co-op, or academic project experience in design engineering, front-end development, or a related field
  • Exposure to or experience integrating AI capabilities into prototypes, internal tools, or workflows (e.g., content generation, summarization, analysis, automation)
  • Experience developing Progressive Web Apps (PWA)
  • Experience developing Figma plugins and working with the Figma API
  • Familiarity with modern frameworks and languages such as TypeScript, Next.js, or LightningJS
  • Experience with platforms and tools such as Node.js, GraphQL, GitHub, AWS, Azure, GCP, Cloudflare, Firebase, Mixpanel, Contentful, Vercel, Xcode, and Apache, and with web and cloud infrastructure and deployment workflows
  • Experience developing mobile or cross-platform applications, including React Native, Swift, and SwiftUI
  • Experience with video content, media-rich interfaces, TV-based platforms, or large-scale consumer applications
  • Experience building tools or experiences for international or global audiences
  • Prior experience in experimentation-heavy, innovation-focused, or prototyping-centered teams

 

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

Salary range: $120,000 - $165,000

Universal Destination & Experiences’ Franchise, Products & Partnerships team (UDX FPP) extends NBCUniversal’s iconic brands, characters and stories through global consumer products and games, theme park merchandise and retail, in addition to the UDX enterprise function of franchise management and strategic partnerships. Supporting NBCUniversal’s owned portfolio of properties as well as third-party partners across the theme park business, UDX FPP creates products, experiences and partnerships that deepen fandom and connects audiences around the world with the characters, stories and worlds that define Universal.  www.udxfpp.com

Universal Franchise Products & Partnerships Consumer Products Group is seeking a creative, highly collaborative Toy Product Designer to join our Preschool Boys, Plush, Bluesky Team to develop innovative toy concepts and guide licensed products from early ideation through production.

This role combines hands-on product concepting, toy design, and creative art direction with a strong understanding of consumer needs and play. The designer will identify new and white-space opportunities, translate characters and stories into compelling products and play experiences, and partner closely with toy licensees and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products for consumers.

We are looking for a designer who loves toys, thinks proactively, brings new ideas forward, and can translate creative insights into intuitive, innovative, and commercially compelling products. This role reports to a Sr. Design Manager.

 

Responsibilities

  • Primary focus: Partner closely with toy licensees throughout the full product-development process, from initial concept through production, providing clear, actionable creative direction through draw-overs, visual references, and design notes.
  • Translate characters, stories, and franchise attributes into compelling product features, play patterns, and collectible experiences.
  • Develop toy concepts & presentation through concept sketches, product renderings, mood boards, and visual storytelling that clearly communicate form, function, play pattern, and innovation.
  • Manage product submissions through Universal’s product approval systems, delivering timely, constructive, and solutions-oriented creative feedback to partners.
  • Lead design projects in collaboration with internal and external cross-functional teams, balancing product objectives, consumer needs, and timelines.
  • Co-create design strategies with the Manager and Director, using research, trends, and consumer insights to inform new product opportunities.
  • Partner with Category, Retail, Franchise, and other cross-functional teams to ensure licensees have the creative direction, assets, insights, and information needed to develop compelling products.
  • Identify consumer, category, and portfolio white-space opportunities and translate those insights into new product concepts and emerging opportunities through consumer insights, global toy trends, competitive products and cultural influences.
  • Support the UP&E product development process through clear, timely communication and participation in key development reviews and meetings.
  • Support additional creative initiatives ranging from blue-sky ideation, content exploration to product innovation.
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned to meet the evolving needs of the team and business.
  • Ability to travel as required to support business and operational needs.

 

Portfolio

  • PORTFOLIO SUBMISSION GUIDLINES: Please submit a professional portfolio 
    demonstrating strong product ideation, sketching, creative problem-solving, and design development is highly preferred. Examples of toy, children's product, character-based product, or other three-dimensional product design are strongly preferred. Portfolios must showcase the full product development lifecycle, from concept to shelf, and include examples of sketches, trend research,  pattern and print development, overlays/redlines, technical design packages (tech packs), sampling iterations, and final produced products. All submitted work must be the candidate's original work, with clear examples of their individual design contributions.

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $72,000 - $85,000

  • 3+ years of design and development experience.
  • Bachelor’s or Associate's Degree, preferably in toy design, industrial design, product design, or graphic design
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to provide thoughtful, clear, creative art direction to partners and vendors.
  • Ability to prioritize and multitask in a dynamic, deadline-driven environment that revolves around multiple product development calendars.
  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail
  • Strong inter-personal skills to navigate situations across multi-functional departments
  • Understanding of age-appropriate play patterns, and Experience with but not limited to preschool, plush, playset, action figures, vehicles, role play, collectibles, or related toy categories
  • Demonstrated curiosity about consumer behavior, emerging toy trends, technology, innovation, and new ways to play.
  • Skilled in Photoshop, Illustrator, and all relevant software for product development, including Keynote.

job.title: Development QA Tester | Testeur QA en développement
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal est l’une des plus importantes entreprises de médias et de divertissement au monde. Nous créons du contenu de calibre mondial que nous diffusons par l’intermédiaire de notre portefeuille de marques dans les domaines du cinéma, de la télévision et de la diffusion en continu, et que nous faisons vivre grâce à nos destinations internationales de parcs thématiques, à nos produits de consommation et à nos expériences. Nous possédons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les secteurs du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de diffusion en continu haut de gamme financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des productions cinématographiques et des émissions de premier plan par l’intermédiaire de nos puissants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi que des quatre studios de télévision internationaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs thématiques et des expériences de renommée mondiale par l’intermédiaire d’Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment Universal Orlando Resort, qui accueille Universal Epic Universe, ainsi qu’Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Visitez www.nbcuniversal.com pour en savoir plus.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés où vivent et travaillent les membres de notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics. Nous avons une longue tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à offrir aux membres de notre personnel la possibilité de s’impliquer dans leur communauté. Nous favorisons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et de proposer une vaste gamme de contenus qui reflètent notre monde.

RESPONSIBILTIES

The Development QA Tester partners directly with designers, engineers, and artists to test features throughout the development cycle. You’ll validate functionality, identify issues early, analyze root causes, and help maintain build stability. You will collaborate closely with developers, review requirements, and use tools to perform functional, regression, and performance tests, ensuring software is reliable, secure, and user-friendly.

  • Test new features during development and provide clear, actionable feedback to developers.
  • Identify, reproduce, and document bugs with detailed steps, logs, and supporting evidence.
  • Analyze issues to determine severity, patterns, and potential root causes.
  • Collaborate with engineers and designers to understand feature intentions, edge cases, and technical constraints.
  • Verify bug fixes and ensure regressions are caught early.
  • Create and maintain test plans, test cases, and checklists for ongoing features.
  • Support integration testing when new systems, builds, or content are merged.
  • Participate in daily stand‑ups, feature reviews, and sprint planning to stay aligned with development progress.
  • Use debugging tools, logs, and engine features to investigate issues more deeply.
  • Provide feedback on usability, clarity, and player experience from a QA perspective.
  • Help maintain build stability by identifying blockers quickly and communicating them effectively.

RESPONSABILITÉS

La personne occupant le poste de testeur QA en développement travaille directement avec les équipes de conception, d’ingénierie et d’art afin de tester les fonctionnalités tout au long du cycle de développement. Vous validerez le bon fonctionnement des fonctionnalités, repérerez rapidement les problèmes, analyserez leurs causes profondes et contribuerez à maintenir la stabilité des builds. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes de développement, examinerez les exigences et utiliserez différents outils pour effectuer des tests fonctionnels, de régression et de performance afin de garantir que le logiciel est fiable, sécuritaire et convivial.

  • Tester de nouvelles fonctionnalités pendant leur développement et fournir aux équipes de développement une rétroaction claire et exploitable.
  • Repérer, reproduire et documenter les bogues en fournissant des étapes détaillées, des logs et des éléments probants à l’appui.
  • Analyser les problèmes afin d’en déterminer la gravité, les tendances et les causes profondes potentielles.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes d’ingénierie et de conception afin de comprendre l’intention derrière les fonctionnalités, les cas limites et les contraintes techniques.
  • Vérifier les correctifs de bogues et s’assurer que les régressions sont détectées rapidement.
  • Créer et tenir à jour des plans de test, des cas de test et des listes de vérification pour les fonctionnalités en cours de développement.
  • Soutenir les tests d’intégration lorsque de nouveaux systèmes, builds ou contenus sont intégrés.
  • Participer aux stand-ups quotidiens, aux revues de fonctionnalités et à la planification des sprints afin de rester en phase avec l’avancement du développement.
  • Utiliser des outils de débogage, des logs et les fonctionnalités du moteur afin d’analyser les problèmes plus en profondeur.
  • Fournir une rétroaction sur la convivialité, la clarté et l’expérience des joueurs selon une perspective QA.
  • Contribuer à maintenir la stabilité des builds en repérant rapidement les éléments bloquants et en les communiquant efficacement.

Basic Requirements: 

  • Familiarity with tools such as Selenium, Jira, SQL, or scripting languages.
  • Knowledge of software development lifecycles (SDLC) and debugging tools.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to simulate real-world user scenarios.
  • Strong understanding of game development workflows and common tools (Unity, Unreal, or proprietary engines).
  • Ability to write clear, concise, and reproducible bug reports.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort working directly with developers.
  • Ability to stay organized and detail‑oriented in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Passion for games and curiosity about how systems and features are built.

Exigences de base : 

  • Connaissance d’outils tels que Selenium, Jira et SQL, ou de langages de script.
  • Connaissance des cycles de développement logiciel (SDLC) et des outils de débogage.
  • Grand souci du détail et capacité à simuler des scénarios d’utilisation réels.
  • Solide compréhension des processus de développement de jeux et des outils couramment utilisés (Unity, Unreal ou moteurs propriétaires).
  • Capacité à rédiger des rapports de bogues clairs, concis et reproductibles.
  • Solides compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication et aisance à travailler directement avec les équipes de développement.
  • Capacité à rester organisé et à faire preuve de minutie dans un environnement au rythme rapide.
  • Passion pour les jeux et curiosité quant à la façon dont les systèmes et les fonctionnalités sont conçus.

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Experience with console certification requirements or platform‑specific testing.
  • Knowledge of version control systems (Perforce, Git).
  • Experience in embedded QA, feature‑focused QA, or Dev QA roles.

Caractéristiques souhaitées : 

  • Expérience des exigences de certification des consoles ou des tests propres à une plateforme.
  • Connaissance des systèmes de contrôle de version (Perforce, Git).
  • Expérience dans des rôles de QA intégré, de QA axé sur les fonctionnalités ou de Dev QA.

 Eligibility Requirements:

  • Interested candidates must apply to be considered.
  • Must be willing to work in our Montreal office a minimum of 4 days a week.
  • Must be willing to work overtime when required, in accordance with Quebec labor standards.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada.
  • Must be willing to travel for work related business, if necessary

Conditions d’admissibilité :

  • Les personnes intéressées doivent soumettre leur candidature afin d’être prises en considération.
  • La personne retenue doit être disposée à travailler à notre bureau de Montréal au moins 4 jours par semaine.
  • La personne retenue doit être disposée à faire des heures supplémentaires lorsque requis, conformément aux normes du travail du Québec.
  • La personne retenue doit être légalement autorisée à travailler au Canada.
  • La personne retenue doit être disposée à voyager pour des raisons professionnelles, au besoin.

The Director, Food Services will lead the strategy, operations, vendor partnerships, and employee experience for food service offerings across NBCUniversal’s New York campus, with a primary focus on 30 Rockefeller Plaza. This role sits within the Hospitality team and will be responsible for elevating the quality, consistency, efficiency, and financial performance of food service operations, including cafés, catering, pantry programs, executive dining, employee dining, and special event support.  The Director will report to the VP of Guest Experience. 

The ideal candidate is a strategic hospitality leader with deep food and beverage operations expertise, strong vendor management skills, and a passion for creating high-quality, service-oriented workplace experiences. This individual will partner closely with Guest Experience, Facilities, Business Operations, Finance, Procurement, Sustainability, and key business stakeholders to deliver food services that meet the needs of employees, productions, executives, visitors, and events while supporting broader Rock Center Operations priorities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead day-to-day oversight and long-term strategy for food services across the campus, including cafés, catering, pantry services, executive dining, employee dining, special events, and related hospitality offerings.
  • Establish and maintain high standards for food quality, service consistency, cleanliness, safety, accessibility, and employee experience across all food service touchpoints.
  • Manage and strengthen relationships with food service vendors, catering partners, pantry providers, and other third-party suppliers; hold partners accountable to service levels, contractual obligations, budget expectations, and continuous improvement goals.
  • Develop and execute a food services roadmap that improves quality, expands offerings, enhances the employee and guest experience, and supports evolving workplace expectations.
  • Partner with Hospitality, Guest Experience, Facilities, Events, Production, Retail, Finance, Procurement, Legal, EHS, Security, and Sustainability teams to ensure seamless planning and execution of daily operations, activations, and special events.
  • Oversee food service budgets, forecasts, invoices, P&L performance, vendor spend, and operating metrics; identify opportunities to improve efficiency, cost management, utilization, and revenue performance.
  • Use data, employee feedback, utilization trends, and stakeholder insights to evaluate program performance and recommend service enhancements.
  • Support large-scale events, executive meetings, production needs, and high-visibility activations requiring food and beverage services, ensuring polished execution and alignment with business expectations.
  • Drive operational standards related to food safety, sanitation, regulatory compliance, allergen awareness, sustainability, waste reduction, and responsible sourcing.
  • Develop clear operating procedures, escalation practices, reporting rhythms, and communication plans for food service operations.
  • Lead, coach, and develop internal team members and vendor teams, fostering a culture of accountability, hospitality, collaboration, inclusion, and service excellence.
  • Monitor industry trends and workplace hospitality best practices to introduce innovative, practical, and employee-centered food service solutions.

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in food service, hospitality operations, workplace services, corporate dining, catering, hotel operations, restaurant operations, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience leading teams, vendors, or complex cross-functional operations.

The NBCUniversal State & Local Government Affairs team develops and executes advocacy strategies that advance NBCUniversal’s business priorities and protect the company’s operations at the state and local levels. This Director position will report directly to the Senior Vice President, Head of Public Policy with matrix reporting to Vice President of Government and External Affairs.

  • Develop and maintain relationships with policymakers, industry associations, community organizations, business groups and other key stakeholders in Los Angeles County and the City of Los Angeles.

  • Advise senior leadership on emerging legislative, regulatory, and political developments, providing strategic recommendations regarding potential risks, opportunities, and business impacts

The WNBC/WNJU New York Duopoly is seeking a dynamic, Reporter to join our integrated newsroom. This role is designed to serve audiences across both WNBC and WNJU, delivering original journalism in English and Spanish across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms.

The ideal candidate is an enterprising, multiplatform journalist with strong live reporting skills, excellent news judgment, and the ability to tell compelling stories for both English- and Spanish-language audiences. This reporter will play an important role in our duopoly approach to news coverage, working seamlessly across both stations to maximize original reporting, share content effectively, and serve the diverse communities of the New York Tri-State area.

The reporter must be equally comfortable covering breaking news, developing enterprise and community-driven stories, conducting live interviews, producing content for multiple platforms, and adapting storytelling for the audiences of WNBC and WNJU.

Responsibilities

  • Report, write, and deliver original stories for both WNBC and WNJU across newscasts, streaming platforms, websites, social media, and emerging platforms.
  • Report and present stories in both English and Spanish, adapting content appropriately for each station's audience rather than simply translating material.
  • Cover breaking news and major events from the field through live shots, interviews, digital updates, and packaged reports.
  • Develop distinctive enterprise and community-focused stories that are relevant to audiences throughout the New York Tri-State area.
  • Pitch original story ideas and cultivate a broad and diverse network of sources across communities, beats, and geographic areas.
  • Work collaboratively across the duopoly newsroom to identify opportunities to share and maximize reporting while reducing unnecessary duplication of coverage.

  • Contribute to special projects, major event coverage, investigative or enterprise initiatives, and other duopoly-wide editorial efforts.
  • Represent WNBC and WNJU at community events and public appearances as assigned.
  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of local, national, and international news developments.
  • Uphold NBCUniversal journalistic standards, ethics, and editorial guidelines.
  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, Broadcasting, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of reporting experience in a television news environment.
  • Full proficiency in English and Spanish, including speaking, writing, translating, interviewing, and live reporting.
  • Strong live reporting, interviewing, writing, and storytelling skills.
  • Experience covering breaking news and developing stories under tight deadlines.
  • Excellent writing, storytelling, and editorial judgment.
  • Strong editorial judgment and ability to make sound decisions in fast-moving news situations.
  • Ability to work independently in the field and collaborate effectively within a team environment.
  • Experience creating content for broadcast, digital, streaming, and social media platforms.
  • Valid driver's license with a good driving record.
  • Willingness to work a flexible schedule, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours during major news events.
  • Must be willing to work throughout the New York metropolitan area and surrounding coverage regions.

  • Experience working across English- and Spanish-language news operations or in a bilingual/multicultural newsroom.
