We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager to lead the multidisciplinary team responsible for NBCUniversal’s cloud-native VOD encoding platform and associated media engineering capabilities. This leader will own engineering execution, technical direction, production reliability, and team development across software and media engineering. The role will bring together platform development, codec and quality innovation, and operational excellence to deliver secure, scalable, cost-efficient media-processing capabilities for Peacock and other NBCUniversal streaming services.

What the VOD team does

  • Builds and operates the end-to-end media processing platform powering Peacock and other NBCUniversal streaming services.
  • Develops cloud-native systems for ingest, encoding, packaging, quality validation, and delivery.
  • Advances video, audio, subtitle, caption, and packaging technologies.
  • Researches emerging codecs, HDR formats, AI-assisted workflows, and media innovations.
  • Partners with Product, Operations, Playback, and Media Supply Chain teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and grow a multidisciplinary team of software and media engineers.
  • Own execution of the media processing platform roadmap, translating strategic priorities into clearly scoped initiatives, measurable outcomes, and predictable delivery across software and media engineering workstreams.
  • Provide technical direction and architecture oversight for scalable, resilient, cloud-native media-processing services, while empowering senior engineers to lead design and implementation.
  • Define and evolve engineering standards for architecture, API design, code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, release management, observability, documentation, and production readiness.
  • Establish and maintain service-level objectives, operational metrics, alerting, incident-response practices, capacity planning, and continuous-improvement mechanisms for production media services.
  • Drive adoption of new codecs, HDR formats, packaging standards, and AI-assisted media processing.
  • Mentor engineers through coaching, career development, hiring, and performance management.
  • Foster experimentation through proof-of-concepts, benchmarking, and data-driven engineering decisions.
  • 3+ years of experience managing or formally leading software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and delivery accountability.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate software architecture, APIs, distributed-system designs, operational data, and technical trade-offs; recent hands-on development experience with languages such as Go, Python, or Java is preferred.
  • Experience leading iterative software delivery, dependency management, roadmap planning, and prioritization across multiple technical workstreams.
  • Experience with AWS or similar cloud platforms.
  • Strong understanding of video compression, adaptive bitrate streaming, HLS, DASH, CMAF, and DRM.
  • Experience with FFmpeg or equivalent media frameworks.
  • Understanding of video quality analysis (VMAF, SSIM, PSNR and subjective evaluation).
  • Knowledge of video codecs (H.264, HEVC, AV1, VVC), HDR formats (HDR10, Dolby Vision, HLG), audio codecs (AAC, HE-AAC, Dolby Digital Plus), and subtitle/caption technologies (WebVTT, TTML, IMSC1, CEA-608/708).
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.
  • GPU-accelerated media processing.
  • AI/ML or computer vision for media workflows.
  • Encoding optimization and bitrate reduction.
  • Cloud migration and platform modernization.
  • Open-source or media standards contributions.

Leadership Expectations

  • Build an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture.
  • Recruit, mentor, and retain top engineering talent.
  • Drive engineering excellence through metrics and continuous improvement.
  • Promote collaboration across engineering, product, and operations.

NBCUniversal Advertising Products & Solutions is responsible for the product development, program management, and day-to-day operations of NBCUniversal’s full advertising technology suite. We are currently seeking an Executive Assistant to support senior leadership in the Ad Products & Solutions group. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced executive assistant looking to further their career in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. The Executive Assistant will serve as a proactive operational partner to senior leadership, helping manage executive priorities, coordinate the team’s operating rhythm, and ensure effective preparation, communication, and follow-through across the organization.

Executive & Calendar Support

  • Anticipate scheduling, travel, meeting preparation, and logistical needs, including coordinating across senior executives and their assistants.

  • Proactively manage and strategically prioritize complex executive calendars, resolving conflicts and ensuring time is aligned to business priorities.

  • Coordinate travel arrangements
  • When necessary, be the primary point of contact for client or employee catering, delivery and/or pick up
  • Process and track expense reimbursements
  • Handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion
  • Maintain up-to-date and accurate filing system
  • Provide calendar backup support to other EAs as needed

Leadership Team Operating Rhythm & Support

  • Coordinate recurring leadership meetings and organizational cadences, including agenda, pre-reads, presentations, room and technology requirements, catering, and participant communications.
  • Support preparation and distribution of leadership communications, Teams announcements, organization updates, and event information.
  • Maintain accurate organizational records, distribution lists, contact lists, and other team reference materials.
  • Assist with planning and management of special projects such as onboarding new team members, leadership team retreats and off-sites, and other initiatives and events as needed
  • Help drive projects and initiatives to nurture team culture (social events, team cadence...)
  • Punctual, regular, and consistent attendance

  • 2+ years relevant experience supporting senior-level executives
  • Exceptional communications skills (verbal and written) and strong interpersonal skills
  • Demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and operate proactively with limited direction.
  • Experience coordinating large, hybrid meetings and executive-level events.
  • Solid follow-through, with the ability to track commitments and drive administrative work to completion.
  • Advanced proficiency with MS Office (Outlook/Word/Excel/PowerPoint) and MS Teams
  • Ability to successfully multi-task and meet deadlines
  • Excellent at problem-solving, taking initiative, and being resourceful
  • Approachable, friendly demeanor in dealing with executives, employees, vendors, and customers and skilled at developing relationships and working with a variety of personalities
  • Exceptional organizational skills; ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

NBCUniversal Advertising & Partnerships brings together the power of NBCUniversal’s iconic brands, premium content, innovative technology, and expansive audiences to create meaningful connections between advertisers and consumers. From entertainment and sports to streaming and digital platforms, our teams work across sales, marketing, insights, data, technology, and creative solutions to develop impactful advertising experiences for brands and partners. 

Universal Television Entertainment is responsible for world-class television entertainment. The division programs and markets content across leading entertainment brands Bravo, NBC and Peacock, and produces over 3,000 hours of television annually through Universal Studio Group, the studio business comprised of Universal Television, Universal Global Television and Universal Television Alternative Studio.

NBCU Corporate groups are uniquely positioned at the core of our organization. Employees within these groups use their area of expertise to support all businesses across the company, keeping the heart of each brand at the forefront.

NBCUniversal Local is NBCUniversal’s local media division that delivers English and Spanish-speakers and bilingual audiences in 31 U.S. markets and Puerto Rico the very best in local sports, news, weather, consumer and investigative reporting, and lifestyle entertainment across any platform and screen. NBCUniversal Local is comprised of three individual media groups including the NBC Owned Television Stations, the NBC Sports Regional Networks and the Telemundo Station Group. NBCUniversal Local’s stations and networks serve diverse audiences and communities across linear, streaming, OTT, digital web, mobile and audio, and cable platforms and work together to keep local audiences informed anytime and anywhere.       

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Ad Sales Finance – Digital: The Digital Finance team supports financial planning, reporting, and analysis across NBCUniversal’s streaming and digital advertising business. Interns may assist with revenue reporting, forecasting, pacing analysis, partner deliverables, and month-end activities while gaining exposure to the financial processes that support the advertising business.
  • HQ Controllership, Stage Plays: The intern will gain hands-on exposure to entertainment accounting, quarterly close, account reconciliations and journal-entry procedures. The intern will also contribute to process-improvement efforts involving data automation, responsible use of AI-enabled tools and implementation of scalable accounting solutions, while gaining broader cross-functional exposure to the Stage Plays Finance organization.
  • UTE Finance Programming: Our team has full oversight of the Unscripted Programming & Development budgets for Bravo and Peacock. The role will provide operational support and will work cross-functionally between the Finance, Strategy, Scheduling and Production Operations teams, and provides the unique opportunity to be involved in programming strategy.
  • UTE Media Platforms Marketing Finance: This position is a key member of the UTE Marketing Finance team, partnering with Marketing and Communications leaders to provide strategic financial support, help drive planning and close processes, and provide insights that drive informed business decisions and organizational growth. Interns will support the maintenance and reporting of key marketing metrics, and ad hoc analysis across Peacock, NBC, Bravo, and Sports, get hands-on experience with the monthly budget cycle, including prepping and maintaining budget files and partnering with operating teams, and support monthly consolidation of the Marketing portfolio, including variance analysis.
  • Corporate Strategy: The Intern, Corporate Strategy & Development will have the opportunity to work across multiple businesses within NBCUniversal (Film & Television Studios, Television & Direct-to-Consumer Entertainment, News & Sports, Telemundo, Consumer Products, and Parks). This unique position will provide access to high-level strategic decision-making in the ever-evolving world of media and entertainment. Responsibilities may include but are not limited to: providing financial and strategic support in evaluating mergers & acquisitions, joint venture partnerships, minority investments, and cross-divisional business development initiatives; developing financial models and valuation analyses, including returns analysis and sensitivities; preparing comprehensive business plans for new growth initiatives, including new business opportunities or opportunistic enhancements to internal businesses; and conducting market research and competitive benchmarking to inform leadership on industry trends.
  • International Corporate Finance – Billing Ad Sales: Global Customer Finance Operations (Order to Cash - O2C) builds competitive advantage by accelerating revenue cycles, optimizing cash flow and enhancing customer relationships for NBCU’s Digital and Linear networks and Properties, including Peacock. O2C is responsible for the set of business processes that involve receiving and fulfilling customer requests for goods or services, invoicing and collecting $15B from over 30,000 customers worldwide. Responsibilities of O2C include: Risk management, Billing, Collections, Cash operations, and Finance reporting and analysis. This internship will work with the Billing Ad Sales team, the team responsible for the preparation, analysis, and invoicing our domestic and global media campaigns and licensing fees. 
  • Media Group Controllership: The Intern will play a key role in the general accounting and compliance of NBCUniversal’s Media Group. This role provides an outstanding opportunity to learn about the NBC broadcast network, Peacock, and Bravo, as well as Media HQ. The position will work closely with the Media Group finance team and collaborate with Controllership across the NBCUniversal portfolio. This position will support the monthly close and the overall accounting processes to ensure accurate and timely reporting.  The role will support the (i) standardization of existing processes, (ii) identification of business process efficiencies, and (iii) implementation of best practices.  This position is expected to challenge the status quo and think of more enhanced approaches and methodologies to support Media’s overall close and control structure. 
  • NBCU Local Ad Sales Finance: This intern will work closely with the Ad Sales Finance team, along with partnering with sales leadership and sales support functions, to support the reporting of revenue and expenses across the Local Division. Universal Film consists of the operations to produce, acquire, market and distribute filmed entertainment worldwide in various media formats for theatrical, home entertainment, television and other distribution platforms.  The division operates globally with colleagues spread across 20 countries. We pride ourselves in supporting and amplifying diverse stories told by unique voices. We want to bring in driven, dedicated, and diverse talent into our organization who are just as passionate as we are in continuing to tell stories that reflect our global audience.  

Universal Television Entertainment is responsible for world-class television entertainment. The division programs and markets content across leading entertainment brands Bravo, NBC and Peacock, and produces over 3,000 hours of television annually through Universal Studio Group, the studio business comprised of Universal Television, Universal Global Television and Universal Television Alternative Studio.

Franchise, Products & Partnerships extends NBCUniversal’s iconic brands, characters and stories through global consumer products and games, theme park merchandise and retail, in addition to the UDX enterprise function of franchise management and strategic partnerships. Supporting NBCUniversal’s owned portfolio of properties as well as third-party partners across the theme park business, FPP creates products, experiences and partnerships that deepen fandom and connects audiences around the world with the characters, stories and worlds that define Universal.​

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Controllership, Global HQ & Distribution: This role will be responsible for assisting Global Distribution Accounting, and Reporting with the monthly and quarterly close process, financial audit and SOX compliance, customer audits, and monthly reporting to third parties for whom NBCU serves as the distribution agent.
  • HQ Controllership: The intern will gain hands-on experience with financial reporting systems, contribute to meaningful projects, and have opportunities to present financial insights to Senior Leadership across the Studios business. The intern will also learn how financial reporting helps drive business decisions and how those numbers can help executives rethink future productions and bring the next big hit to life.
  • Film Finance: The Film Finance team is responsible for managing all financial aspects of a film project’s lifecycle—from budgeting and pre-production, through production, to post-production. The Finance Intern will work closely with finance managers to assist in the preparation of film budgets, perform ad hoc financial analyses, and contribute to the overall financial duties of film projects.
  • Ultimates FP&A: The Ultimate FP&A team owns ultimate forecasting for the Film Group – the full lifetime P&L for each Universal and Focus Features film. The team partners with finance teams across 11 film business units to consolidate forecasts, analyze performance drivers, and deliver insights to senior leadership that inform strategic decisions. Interns will gain hands-on exposure to how a major studio evaluates film performance while also supporting live work. 
  • International Finance: The International Finance and UPHE Global Finance interns will be integral parts of the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team. The interns will be involved in sales and revenue forecasting, working directly with the sales organization to develop and review revenue budgets in over 100 territories and will be responsible for creating and maintaining deal analysis/financial models, and providing insights to key trends in the markets.
  • Production Finance: The intern will support NBCU Studio Group, which oversees the development, production, and marketing/distribution of our Film & TV Content. The Studio Group Finance team is responsible for the financial consolidation, reporting, and analysis of the Film & TV studios.
  • USG Finance Content Strategy: This internship will support greenlights through data gathering, validation and variance analysis, along with supporting preparation of weekly leadership reports on series financial performance and new releases and contributing to preparation of bi-annual P&L review.
  • USG FP&A: This intern will work on Monthly Pacings/Forecasts while assisting in pulling reports from our Finance database (BPC SMART) to help in variance analysis for both EBITDA & FCF, such as Content Delivery & Airing Schedule Analysis. This team works regularly with partners across the broader organization including TV Distribution, Home Entertainment, and Studios/Corporate finance, so being proactive, adaptable, and team-minded is key in our day-to-day environment.

Interns partner internally and externally to gain exposure to financial systems, accounts payable, production payroll, budgeting, and cost reporting. Daily ad hoc projects include ledger inquiry research, analysis, forensic accounting, p-card management, invoice processing, and check printing, as well as updating and distributing various weekly production tracking spreadsheets and more.
  • UTE Platforms Marketing FP&A: The internship will provide general support for monthly pacing cycles. Responsibilities may include but are not limited to: pulling reports from SAP’s forecasting system; assisting with EBITDA and FCF variance analysis; completing system checks and supplemental schedules; helping clean, reconcile, and load Centers of Excellence submissions into forecast P&Ls contributing to the maintenance of forecasting models and ensuring their accuracy; and collaborating on enhancement of ancillary revenue and cost tracking.
  • FP&A, Consumer Products: Under the Franchise, Products & Partnerships business group, the FP&A Consumer Products intern will be a key contributor to the Global Consumer Products FP&A team. Their primary role is to be the support function for the FP&A team across various financial processes and other ad hoc tasks, especially during the forecasting cycles. Provides HR counsel and support to salaried leaders and hourly Team Members. Supports the execution of Talent & Culture (T&C) activities including, but not limited to, those related to investigations, accommodations, reporting, communication, placement, and record keeping for assigned client group(s). Serves as the primary coordinator of routine T&C services, ensuring consistent process execution, accurate data and documentation, effective program administration, responsive employee and manager support, and compliance with established requirements. Partners closely with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) across the organization, Centers of Excellence (COEs), Employee Relations/Open Door, Talent Acquisition, vendors, and business leaders, escalating matters that require strategic judgment, risk assessment, specialized expertise, or business-specific consultation.

Major Responsibilities

  • Transaction Services - Provides administrative and operational support for workforce transactions and employee lifecycle activities including transfers, promotions, position and status changes, onboarding, separations, and other employee data updates. Supports hiring and onboarding readiness through intake handoffs, manager preparation, start-date logistics, required documentation, system access requests, and workspace coordination. Administers routine leave, accommodation, workers' compensation, timekeeping, attendance, and return-to-work processes while coordinating paperwork, timelines, compliance documentation, and referrals to designated COEs or vendors. Coordinates contingent workforce and compensation-cycle logistics, including onboarding, assignment and renewal tracking, agency and vendor communication, merit and bonus workflows, approvals, routine materials, and inquiry routing.

  • Employee Support - Serves as a point of contact for employees and leaders, providing guidance on policies, procedures, accommodations, timekeeping, leave processes, and available resources. Supports employee matters by gathering information, maintaining documentation, conducting investigations, handling accommodations requests, tracking cases, coordinating follow-up activities, and connecting employees and leaders with appropriate T&C resources. Supports handoffs to HRBPs, Employee Relations/Open Door, or other COEs as necessary. Assists with crisis response activities, including communications, meeting coordination, documentation, resource distribution, and inquiry management. Identifies and escalates complaints and investigations that involve legal risk, repeated conduct or performance patterns, complex accommodations, sensitive employee impact, safety concerns, and situations requiring business judgment or when coaching involves more strategic guidance on performance, conduct, or potential risk.

  • Enterprise Programs - Supports company-wide talent, performance, engagement, communication, and change initiatives through coordination and administrative support. Assists with logistics for talent reviews, succession planning, internal mobility, and development planning by managing schedules, materials, tracking, and follow-up activities. Supports performance management processes, including goal setting, review cycles, check-ins, calibration meetings, communications, tracking, and documentation. Assists with Team Member Satisfaction (TSAT) surveys and engagement action planning through scheduling, reporting, dashboard updates, and progress tracking. Coordinates communications, training, recognition programs, internships, and change initiatives by supporting materials, meetings, stakeholder communications, enrollment tracking, and ongoing program administration.

  • Operational Excellence - Drives process consistency, governance, reporting, data quality, workflow discipline, and knowledge management across services. Upholds Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and delivers timely responses to inquiries. Administers recurring T&C workflows through process checklists, approval routing, trackers, and compliance records while validating completeness and accuracy. Maintains T&C documentation, knowledge materials, FAQs, resources and distribution lists to support consistent service delivery and audit readiness. Identifies process gaps, data anomalies, compliance concerns, recurring inquiry themes, workforce trends, unresolved stakeholder issues, or operational risks and routes or escalates them for appropriate action.

  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Business Management, or related field preferred.
  • 2+ years Human Resources experience in a large-scale, fast-paced HR environment required; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Requirements
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Sound judgment and decision-making authority within established expectations; ability to identify when escalation is needed
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Solid organizational skills, ability to handle multiple priorities
  • Ability to flex & adapt in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality HR services
  •  Ability to objectively coach Supervisors/Managers and Team Members through difficult and emotional issues
  • Ability to research and analyze various types of data and information
  • Independent, self-starter, requiring minimal day-to-day task supervision
  • Professional, confident demeanor
  • Base knowledge of company policies & practice
  • Thorough knowledge of MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint, experience with an HRIS (i.e., SAP) preferred
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

job.title: Global Security & Intelligence Internships – Summer 2027
job.description:
Your future in media starts here. The NBCUniversal Summer Internship Program is your chance to help shape what’s next in media and entertainment. Whether you’re supporting major news coverage, creating content for iconic brands, or contributing to innovative projects, you’ll bring your ideas, creativity, and perspective to make an impact throughout your internship.

Beyond your day-to-day role, you’ll take part in a thoughtfully designed program focused on career development, building your professional presence, and growing your workplace confidence. Through real-world experience and a community of fellow interns, you’ll explore what’s possible in this ever changing and exciting industry.

In addition to all of our internships being paid, we will also offer the following for our Summer 2027 interns:   

  • Paid company holidays for full-time interns.  
  • Robust networking, learning and development opportunities.
  • Complimentary Peacock subscription during your internship.
  • Free admission to Universal Parks to use during your internship.
  • Access to mental health resources including counseling sessions.
  • Financial assistance to offset expenses for transportation and housing may be available on a needs-based basis for eligible in-person interns. More details about eligibility for this assistance will be provided at the time of offer. 
  • At our Universal City office interns will have access to the NBCUCommutes program, which provides fully subsidized transit passes to full-time lower lot employees, good for unlimited rides on all Metro bus and rail, such as the Metro Red Line.

Summer 2027 Program Details

Program Dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027

Time Commitment: 40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need. 

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from Universal City, CA.

Summer 2027 Recruitment Timeline

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)  

Mid November – Late December: First round video interviews   

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews  

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers  

To Apply:

  • Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year.
  • Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below).
  • Upload a transcript (unofficial transcripts are fine) that confirms your status as an actively enrolled student in a degree-granting program.

Operations & Technology: O&T functions as a global shared service within NBCUniversal performing critical functions including Media, Broadcast and Studio Operations & Production, Content Supply Chain, Information Technology and Engineering, as well as Cyber Security. The group operates from numerous locations around the world, including New York, New Jersey, Los Angeles, Connecticut, and London.

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Global Security, West Coast: NBCUniversal Global Security provides a full suite of security, investigative, and intelligence services aligned to safeguard our people, property, operations, and reputation.  This internship supports the Security Technology and Dispatch Operations for the Studios Security Group.

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program. 
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in Universal City, CA.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Experience with AI and object recognition.
  • Experience with or interest in IOT security.
  • Experience with or an interest in Unmanned Aerial Systems.
  • Experience in Physical Security and/or an interest in Physical Security Technology.
  • Experience with or interest in Geographical Information Systems.
  • Experience with computers and/or networking.

The hourly rate for undergraduate student interns is $22.00.

The hourly rate for graduate student interns is $25.00.

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

NBCUniversal will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories, or arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with relevant legal requirements, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative For Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

job.title: Government Affairs Internships – Summer 2027
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Your future in media starts here. The NBCUniversal Summer Internship Program is your chance to help shape what’s next in media and entertainment. Whether you’re supporting major news coverage, creating content for iconic brands, or contributing to innovative projects, you’ll bring your ideas, creativity, and perspective to make an impact throughout your internship.

Beyond your day-to-day role, you’ll take part in a thoughtfully designed program focused on career development, building your professional presence, and growing your workplace confidence. Through real-world experience and a community of fellow interns, you’ll explore what’s possible in this ever changing and exciting industry.

In addition to all of our internships being paid, we will also offer the following for our Summer 2027 interns:   

  • Paid company holidays for full-time interns.  
  • Robust networking, learning and development opportunities.
  • Complimentary Peacock subscription during your internship.
  • Free admission to Universal Parks to use during your internship.
  • Access to mental health resources including counseling sessions.
  • Financial assistance to offset expenses for transportation and housing may be available on a needs-based basis for eligible in-person interns. More details about eligibility for this assistance will be provided at the time of offer. 

Summer 2027 Program Details

Program Dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027

Time Commitment: 40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need. 

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from New York, NY.

Summer 2027 Recruitment Timeline

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)  

Mid November – Late December: First round video interviews   

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews  

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers  

To Apply:

  • Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year.
  • Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below).
  • Upload a transcript (unofficial transcripts are fine) that confirms your status as an actively enrolled student in a degree-granting program.

NBCU Corporate groups are uniquely positioned at the core of our organization.  Employees within these groups use their area of expertise to support all businesses across the company, keeping the heart of each brand at the forefront.

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Government Affairs, East Coast: The State & Local Government Affairs Team develops and executes advocacy plans which advance NBCUniversal’s business priorities and protect operations at the state and local level. The team advocates directly with state and local elected officials on NBCUniversal’s behalf, as well as manages relationships with trade associations, film commissions, and other third-party associations to build support for our overall policy agenda. We cover all policy matters at the state and local level with a focus on expanding economic development opportunities and preserving production-friendly policies. The State & Local Government Affairs Intern will support the bi-coastal team with end-of session reports and strategy-planning for upcoming legislative sessions.

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program. 
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in New York, NY.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Previous internship or work experience within government, politics, and/or campaign management.     
  • Professional presence, including over the phone, in writing, and in person, with the ability to interact with senior executives, diplomats, and government officials.     
  • An educational background in any of the following areas: Political Science, Government, English, History, Communications, or other related majors.     
  •  Strong interest in the media industry.     
  • Ability to multitask and highly organized.   
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook).     

The hourly rate for student interns is $19.00.

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

As a Hayu Marketing intern, you will have a supporting role in delivering marketing activities across brand, PR, events, influencers and partnerships. You will also work in collaboration with the wider Hayu marketing team functions such as digital and social plus gain exposure to the NBCU business units in the Toronto office. This role will expose you to a broad range of tasks from creating post campaign reports to helping with influencer activities, updating press lists, press releases, presentation creation and most importantly, assisting in event planning and execution.

In this role, you will learn

  • How marketing campaigns go from concept to creation to live in market
  • How SVOD services are data driven and how insights inform decisions
  • How to influence our target audience and drive awareness in market through various channels
  • How to work in a fast paced, entertainment brand that is ambitious and innovative

This internship will give you a deep understanding of our reality dedicated SVOD service, a good exposure to multiple channels and layers of the marketing and PR function plus develop your data analysis skill with a fast-paced digital platform

Key Responsibilities:

  • Helping with influencer activities
  • Managing press lists & releases
  • Presentation and post campaign report creation
  • Assist in Hayu events plus event sponsorships
  • Competitive monitoring
  • Supporting administrative tasks

Desired Competencies:

  • Creative mindset crossed with the ability to be analytical
  • A passion for reality TV and digital media
  • A self-starter with the ability to multi-task, be organized and prioritize
  • A team player attitude and “can do” approach
  • Confident communicator and idea generator

Additional Requirements:

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

NBCUniversal may use AI-based tools to assist in screening and assessing applications for this position. These tools may help us identify candidates whose skills and experiences align with our objectives by analyzing information provided in resumes and applications. Our use of AI does not replace human decision-making.

  • Must be in pursuit of a secondary degree at an Accredited Institution or recent graduate and be able to provide documentation to confirm your degree status
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above
  • Must be authorized to work in Canada without visa sponsorship by NBCUniversal
  • Must be 19 years or older
  • Must be available to work 40 hours a week and commit to a 16-week term from January to April 2027, 4-days a week in office

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. job.title: Jr. Software Engineer
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal’s Intellectual Property Analytics, Operations, and Technology (IPAOT) team supports NBCUniversal’s content globally with four key areas: (1) developing more secure and scalable frameworks for Internet-based video distribution, (2) improving security technologies and processes in content production and distribution, (3) addressing voluminous copyright infringements on websites, apps and protocols, and (4) analyzing data to measure and understand the drivers of unlicensed video consumption on the Internet.

The IPAOT team at NBCUniversal is looking for a passionate and curious Jr. Software Engineer to help design, build, and maintain applications supporting content protection, investigations, analytics, and security. This role will have a particular focus on expanding the use of artificial intelligence and large language models (LLMs) across the team's application portfolio, identifying opportunities to enhance existing workflows and develop new AI-powered capabilities.

Reporting to the Manager, Product and Emerging Technology, the Jr. Software Engineer is a fast-paced role with opportunities to work across traditional software engineering, generative AI, emerging technologies, and content protection.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and enhance AI-powered features across the team’s applications using large language models and other AI technologies.
  • Build LLM-powered applications and agentic workflows using model APIs, retrieval technologies, and supporting frameworks.
  • Integrate AI models and services into existing applications based on defined requirements
  • Develop and refine prompts, system instructions, and model interactions to improve application performance and reliability
  • Build integrations with internal systems, tools, and data sources using APIs, MCPs, and other technologies
  • Support monitoring, testing, and evaluation of AI-powered features.
  • Collaborate with product and business stakeholders to translate requirements into working features and improvements.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 1 + years of professional software development experience, including experience developing and delivering software to production.
  • Programming experience with Python and JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience developing modern web applications and backend APIs using frameworks such as Next.js, FastAPI, or comparable technologies.
  • Hands-on experience developing applications or features using large language models through APIs.
  • Experience integrating APIs, backend services, and third-party systems.
  • Experience working with relational databases and SQL.
  • Familiarity with modern software development practices including source control, testing, debugging, and code review.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM field.
  • Experience building LLM-powered workflows using LangChain or similar frameworks
  • Familiarity with multiple LLM providers and model platforms such as OpenRouter.
  • Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, or semantic search.
  • Experience developing cloud-based applications, preferably using AWS.
  • Familiarity with video technologies, streaming media, content protection, cybersecurity, or digital rights management.
  • Interest in emerging AI technologies and their practical application in software development.

Additional Requirements:

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $62,000 - $80,000.

job.title: Lead Animator - Gameplay / Chef.fe d'équipe de l’animation – Gameplay
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Lead Animator supervises a team of animators in creating and implementing top-tier animation for real time gameplay systems. You will be responsible for managing the creation and delivery of exceptional NPC and player animations while providing clear direction, constructive feedback, and mentorship to your team. You will ensure that production goals are met and that the animation production runs smoothly and efficiently depending on the needs of production.

  • The lead animator guides the animation team in creating expressive, polished, and gameplay‑ready animations that elevate the player experience.
  • This role blends artistic leadership with technical expertise, ensuring that animation quality, style, and performance meet the standards of AAA production.
  • Help design, construct, document and uphold pipeline procedures to deliver competitive, cutting-edge assets.
  • Motivate, mentor and inspire the animation team. Support animators in their career development, while guiding them through various stages of production with clear direction.
  • Coordinate and update the production team on assignments for the animation team.
  • Sync and communicate with other leads and disciplines and help resolve production blockers.  
  • Create, document and communicate guidelines, directories and procedures.
  • Help create gameplay animation content as required, working with mocap data, keyframed animations and facial animations, to set a quality bar for other animators to follow.
  • Create style guides, best‑practice documents, and clear communication channels for the team.

 

Le ou la chef.fe d'équipe de l’animation supervise une équipe d’animateurs et d’animatrices dans la création et l’intégration d’animations de haute qualité pour des usages gameplay en temps réel. Vous serez responsable de gérer la création et la livraison d’animations exceptionnelles pour les PNJ (NPC) et les personnages joueurs, tout en fournissant une direction claire, des commentaires constructifs et du mentorat à votre équipe. Vous veillerez au respect des échéanciers de production et à ce que la production d’animation se déroule de manière fluide et efficace, selon les besoins de la production.

Principales responsabilités :

  • Diriger l’équipe d’animation dans la création d’animations expressives, raffinées et prêtes à être intégrées au gameplay, afin d’enrichir l’expérience des joueurs.
  • Assurer un leadership à la fois artistique et technique pour garantir le respect des standards de qualité, de style et de performance propres aux productions AAA.
  • Contribuer à la conception, à la mise en place, à la documentation et à l’amélioration continue des pipelines d’animation.
  • Mobiliser, encadrer et mentorer les membres de l’équipe, en soutenant leur développement professionnel et en les accompagnant à toutes les étapes de production.
  • Planifier et communiquer les assignations de travail, en assurant un suivi rigoureux avec les équipes de production.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les responsables des autres disciplines afin d’identifier et de résoudre les enjeux de production.
  • Élaborer et maintenir la documentation (procédures, normes, structures de fichiers et lignes directrices).
  • Participer à la création d’animations de gameplay au besoin (capture de mouvement, animation keyframe, animation faciale) afin d’établir et de maintenir un standard de qualité élevé.
  • Mettre en place des guides de style, des bonnes pratiques et des processus de communication clairs au sein de l’équipe.
  • 7+ years of experience as 3D character animator in video game development, having worked on at least two AAA games.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills and the ability to work within cross-disciplinary teams. Experienced in leading others.
  • Expert knowledge of industry-standard animation tools such as Motionbuilder or Maya.
  • Strong understanding of gameplay-systems and in-game engine workflows.
  • Excellent key frame and mocap animation skills with a great understanding of human motion, body mechanics, biped locomotion and animation principles.
  • Experience with Unreal 5 is a strongly desired asset.

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Shipped at least one major title as a senior or lead animator.
  • Experience creating scripted events and cutscenes.
  • Experience in developing first-person and third-person gameplay systems and good understanding of 3C concepts
  • Understanding of animation-graph techniques and workflows
  • Experience working on locomotion, occupation, conversation and traversal systems
  • Understanding of camera animation and creation of a cinematic experience
  • Experience in creating creature-, animal- and combat-animations

Exigences essentielles

  • Minimum de 7 années d’expérience en animation 3D de personnages dans l’industrie du jeu vidéo, dont une participation à au moins deux productions de calibre AAA.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication et en leadership, avec une capacité démontrée à travailler dans des équipes multidisciplinaires et à encadrer du personnel.
  • Maîtrise d’outils d’animation standards de l’industrie (ex. : MotionBuilder, Maya).
  • Bonne compréhension des systèmes de gameplay ainsi que des processus liés aux moteurs de jeu.
  • Solides compétences en animation (keyframe et capture de mouvement), avec une excellente compréhension du mouvement humain, de la mécanique corporelle, de la locomotion bipède et des principes fondamentaux de l’animation.
  • Une expérience avec Unreal Engine 5 constitue un atout important.

Atouts

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Position Overview:

As part of the Peacock Data Science team, the Lead Data Scientist will be responsible for creating recommendation and personalization solutions for one or more verticals of Peacock Video Streaming Service.

You’ll collaborate with an international, cross-functional team of engineers, architects, product managers and analysts to identify and prioritize enhancements to Peacock’s personalization models. Your responsibilities will touch everything from feature creation to model development, evaluation, and deployment, and you’ll have opportunities to work on cutting edge machine learning like foundation models and reinforcement learning.

 

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Work with a group of data scientists in the development of recommendation and personalization models using statistical, machine learning and data mining methodologies.
  • Drive the collection and manipulation of new data and the refinement of existing data sources.
  • Translate complex problems and solutions to all levels of the organization.
  • Collaborate with software and data architects in building real-time and automated batch implementations of data science solutions and integrating them into the streaming service architecture.
  • Drive innovation of the statistical and machine learning methodologies and tools used by the team.

 

 

Additional Requirements: 

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $145,000 - $175,000 (bonus and long-term incentive eligible).

job.description:

We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. Nous possédons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de diffusion en continu haut de gamme financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des films et des émissions de premier plan par l’intermédiaire de nos puissants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi que les quatre studios de télévision mondiaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des collectivités où vivent et travaillent les membres de notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics. Nous avons une riche tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à ce que notre personnel ait l’occasion de contribuer activement à sa communauté. Nous favorisons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et d’offrir un vaste éventail de contenus qui reflètent le monde dans lequel nous vivons.

As Lead Tools Programmer, you are responsible for defining, building, and guiding tools and workflows that empower content creators and developers across the project. This role spans in‑engine tooling, standalone desktop applications, and optional web‑enabled tools, enabling efficient production at scale on an AAA title. You provide technical leadership for tools architecture while collaborating closely with Design, Art, Production, and Engineering to ensure tools are robust, scalable, and production‑ready.

RESPONSIBILTIES

  • Lead the design and implementation of tools supporting content creation, iteration, validation, and debugging.
  • Define and maintain tools architecture spanning Unreal Engine editor tools and standalone applications.
  • Design and oversee standalone desktop tools using frameworks such as Qt, .NET / WPF, WinUI, or similar cross‑platform solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership for tools written in C++, with supporting layers in Python or C# where appropriate.
  • Act as the primary technical partner for artists, designers, and developers, translating workflow needs into effective tools.
  • Mentor and support tools programmers through code reviews, technical guidance, and best‑practice development.
  • Collaborate with Pipeline, Gameplay, UI, and Production teams to integrate tools into daily workflows.
  • Oversee performance, stability, usability, and maintainability of tools used across disciplines.
  • Establish coding standards, documentation practices, and testing strategies for tools development.
  • Identify workflow bottlenecks and drive improvements through tooling, automation, and data‑driven solutions.
  • Guide the evolution of tools toward extensibility, cross‑project reuse, and long‑term scalability.
  • Debug complex tools issues involving engine integration, file I/O, data pipelines, and external services.
  • Stay current with industry trends in tools development, automation, and developer experience.

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

À titre de Programmeur ou programmeuse outils Lead, vous êtes responsable de définir, développer et orienter les outils et les flux de travail qui permettent aux créateurs et créatrices de contenu ainsi qu’aux équipes de développement de travailler efficacement à l’échelle du projet. Ce rôle couvre les outils intégrés au moteur, les applications de bureau autonomes et, au besoin, les outils connectés au web, afin de soutenir une production AAA efficace à grande échelle. Vous assurez le leadership technique de l’architecture des outils tout en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes Design, Art, Production et Ingénierie afin de garantir que les outils sont robustes, évolutifs et prêts pour la production.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Diriger la conception et l’implantation d’outils soutenant la création de contenu, l’itération, la validation et le débogage.
  • Définir et maintenir l’architecture des outils couvrant les outils d’édition d’Unreal Engine et les applications autonomes.
  • Concevoir et superviser des outils de bureau autonomes à l’aide de frameworks tels que Qt, .NET / WPF, WinUI ou d’autres solutions multiplateformes comparables.
  • Fournir un leadership technique pour les outils développés en C++, avec des couches complémentaires en Python ou en C# lorsque pertinent.
  • Agir comme principal partenaire technique des artistes, des concepteurs et conceptrices ainsi que des développeurs et développeuses, en traduisant les besoins liés aux flux de travail en outils efficaces.
  • Encadrer et soutenir les programmeurs et programmeuses outils grâce aux revues de code, à l’orientation technique et aux pratiques exemplaires de développement.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Pipeline, Gameplay, UI et Production afin d’intégrer les outils aux flux de travail quotidiens.
  • Superviser la performance, la stabilité, la convivialité et la maintenabilité des outils utilisés par les différentes disciplines.
  • Établir les normes de codage, les pratiques de documentation et les stratégies de test pour le développement d’outils.
  • Identifier les goulots d’étranglement dans les flux de travail et piloter les améliorations au moyen d’outils, d’automatisation et de solutions fondées sur les données.
  • Orienter l’évolution des outils vers une plus grande extensibilité, la réutilisation entre projets et une évolutivité à long terme.
  • Déboguer des problèmes complexes liés aux outils, notamment l’intégration moteur, les entrées-sorties de fichiers, les pipelines de données et les services externes.
  • Se tenir à jour quant aux tendances de l’industrie en matière de développement d’outils, d’automatisation et d’expérience des développeurs et développeuses.

Basic Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in C++, with extensive experience developing tools or editor‑focused systems.
  • At least 8+ years of professional experience in game programming, with shipped titles or equivalent AAA production experience.
  • Professional experience with Unreal Engine editor tooling and engine integration.
  • Strong understanding of tools architecture, data‑driven systems, and content creation workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, or technically guiding programmers on a production team.
  • Excellent problem‑solving skills and the ability to design robust systems under production constraints.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Perforce or Git.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience building standalone desktop tools using Qt, .NET (WPF/WinForms), or similar frameworks.
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python for tooling, automation, and glue code.
  • Familiarity with web‑enabled tools using technologies such as REST APIs, Electron, or lightweight web dashboards.
  • Strong empathy for end‑users and a focus on usability and iteration speed.
  • A passion for enabling teams through high‑quality tools and workflows.

QUALIFICATIONS

Exigences de base :

  • Solide maîtrise du C++, avec une vaste expérience dans le développement d’outils ou de systèmes axés sur les éditeurs.
  • Au moins 8 ans ou plus d’expérience professionnelle en programmation de jeux vidéo, avec des titres commercialisés ou une expérience équivalente dans des productions AAA.
  • Expérience professionnelle avec les outils d’édition d’Unreal Engine et leur intégration au moteur.
  • Solide compréhension de l’architecture des outils, des systèmes pilotés par les données et des flux de création de contenu.
  • Expérience démontrée de leadership, de mentorat ou d’accompagnement technique de programmeurs et programmeuses au sein d’une équipe de production.
  • Excellentes aptitudes de résolution de problèmes et capacité à concevoir des systèmes robustes dans un contexte de contraintes de production.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et capacité à collaborer efficacement avec diverses disciplines.
  • Expérience avec des systèmes de gestion de versions tels que Perforce ou Git.

Atouts souhaités :

  • Expérience dans le développement d’outils de bureau autonomes à l’aide de Qt, .NET (WPF/WinForms) ou de frameworks comparables.
  • Expérience avec des langages de script tels que Python pour les outils, l’automatisation et le code d’intégration.
  • Connaissance des outils connectés au web utilisant des technologies telles que les API REST, Electron ou des tableaux de bord web légers.
  • Forte sensibilité aux besoins des utilisateurs et utilisatrices et souci de la convivialité ainsi que de la rapidité d’itération.
  • Passion pour soutenir les équipes grâce à des outils et des flux de travail de grande qualité.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés où vivent et travaillent les membres de notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics. Nous avons une longue tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à offrir aux membres de notre personnel la possibilité de s’investir au sein de leurs communautés. Nous favorisons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et de proposer une vaste gamme de contenus à l’image de notre monde.

RESPONSIBILTIES

As a Lead VFX Artist, you will manage and mentor a team of skilled VFX artists, supporting their development and championing a collaborative, inclusive environment. You will work with other Artists, Art Directors, Engineers and Producers, to create visual effects that immerse players in the experience. You will play a key role in driving the high-fidelity effects in our game, while also shaping a team culture grounded in creativity, trust, and respect.
You will play a key role in establishing the VFX pipeline and visual quality bar, while also researching and developing new workflows, tools, and emerging technologies, including AI-assisted solutions, to improve efficiency, iteration, and scalability across production. This role is well suited to someone comfortable experimenting, prototyping, and helping shape pipelines that are still evolving.

  • Design and implement impactful real-time VFX that support a wide range of in-game moments and player experiences.
  • Foster technical excellence and artistic creativity across the VFX pipeline.
  • Research and prototype new workflows, tools, and techniques to push the boundaries of real-time VFX.
  • Ensure all VFX content is performant, optimized, and within technical constraints.
  • Coordinate with Directors and Production to align VFX planning with milestones and timelines.
  • Provide feedback, training, and support to junior VFX artists, fostering growth and maintaining quality standards.
  • Research, prototype, and evaluate new workflows, tools, and AI-assisted approaches that can improve the VFX pipeline and cross-disciplines.
  • Partner with Technical Art and Engineering to develop scalable tools and workflows that reduce repetitive work and support efficient content production.

RESPONSABILITÉS

À titre d’Artiste VFX Lead, vous gérerez et accompagnerez une équipe d’artistes VFX chevronnés, soutiendrez leur développement et favoriserez un environnement collaboratif et inclusif. Vous travaillerez avec d’autres artistes, des directeurs et directrices artistiques, des membres des équipes d’ingénierie et de production afin de créer des effets visuels qui plongent les joueuses et joueurs au cœur de l’expérience. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la création d’effets haute fidélité pour notre jeu, tout en contribuant à façonner une culture d’équipe fondée sur la créativité, la confiance et le respect.
Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l’établissement du pipeline VFX et des standards de qualité visuelle, tout en recherchant et en développant de nouveaux workflows, outils et technologies émergentes, y compris des solutions assistées par l’IA, afin d’améliorer l’efficacité, l’itération et l’évolutivité à l’échelle de la production. Ce rôle convient particulièrement à une personne à l’aise avec l’expérimentation, le prototypage et la contribution à l’évolution de pipelines qui sont encore en cours de développement.

  • Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des VFX temps réel percutants qui soutiennent une grande variété de moments en jeu et d’expériences pour les joueuses et joueurs.
  • Favoriser l’excellence technique et la créativité artistique dans l’ensemble du pipeline VFX.
  • Rechercher et prototyper de nouveaux workflows, outils et techniques afin de repousser les limites des VFX temps réel.
  • Veiller à ce que tout le contenu VFX soit performant, optimisé et conforme aux contraintes techniques.
  • Coordonner la planification des VFX avec la direction et la production afin de l’aligner sur les jalons et les échéanciers.
  • Fournir de la rétroaction, de la formation et du soutien aux artistes VFX juniors afin de favoriser leur développement et de maintenir les standards de qualité.
  • Rechercher, prototyper et évaluer de nouveaux workflows, outils et approches assistées par l’IA susceptibles d’améliorer le pipeline VFX et les processus interdisciplinaires.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes d’art technique et d’ingénierie afin de développer des outils et des workflows évolutifs qui réduisent les tâches répétitives et favorisent une production de contenu efficace.

Basic Requirements: 

  • 8+ years of experience as a VFX Artist in game development.
  • Shipped at least one AAA title as a Lead VFX Artist or in a comparable senior leadership role.
  • Proven track record in a leadership role within a creative environment – someone who has mentored others, influenced project direction, and supported team growth.
  • Deep expertise in Unreal Engine 5 and real-time VFX development.
  • Solid knowledge of VFX tools (Houdini, EmberGen, Photoshop, Maya, Blender).
  • Experience with Unreal engine
  • Strong proficiency in real-time and baked simulations.
  • Understanding PBR workflows, shaders, real-time rendering, and lighting.
  • Advanced skills in performance optimization and debugging.
  • Experience developing or contributing to procedural, automated, or scalable content workflows.
  • Comfort working in an evolving production environment where pipelines and solutions are still being developed.

Exigences de base : 

  • 8 ans ou plus d’expérience à titre d’artiste VFX en développement de jeux.
  • Avoir participé à la livraison d’au moins un titre AAA à titre d’Artiste VFX Lead ou dans un rôle comparable de leadership senior.
  • Expérience reconnue dans un rôle de leadership au sein d’un environnement créatif, notamment en mentorat, en influence sur l’orientation de projets et en soutien au développement de l’équipe.
  • Expertise approfondie d’Unreal Engine 5 et du développement de VFX temps réel.
  • Solide connaissance des outils VFX (Houdini, EmberGen, Photoshop, Maya, Blender).
  • Expérience avec Unreal Engine
  • Solide maîtrise des simulations temps réel et précalculées.
  • Compréhension des workflows PBR, des shaders, du rendu temps réel et de l’éclairage.
  • Compétences avancées en optimisation des performances et en débogage.
  • Expérience dans le développement de workflows de création de contenu procéduraux, automatisés ou évolutifs, ou dans la contribution à de tels workflows.
  • Aisance à travailler dans un environnement de production en évolution, où les pipelines et les solutions sont encore en cours de développement.

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • A strong portfolio showcasing mastery in VFX for games is required.
  • Shipped at least 1 mobile or AAA game title
  • Curious and experimental mindset, with an interest in R&D, AI-assisted workflows, automation, and emerging technologies.
  • Ability to identify repetitive or expensive production processes and collaborate on tools, automation, or procedural solutions to improve scalability.
  • Comfortable prototyping ideas, evaluating results, and determining whether new approaches are production ready.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating mastery of real-time VFX for games.

Caractéristiques souhaitées : 

  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, en présentation et en collaboration interfonctionnelle.
  • Un solide portfolio démontrant une maîtrise des VFX pour les jeux est requis.
  • Avoir participé à la livraison d’au moins 1 titre de jeu mobile ou AAA
  • Esprit curieux et expérimental, avec un intérêt pour la R-D, les workflows assistés par l’IA, l’automatisation et les technologies émergentes.
  • Capacité à repérer les processus de production répétitifs ou coûteux et à collaborer au développement d’outils, de solutions d’automatisation ou d’approches procédurales afin d’améliorer l’évolutivité.
  • Aisance à prototyper des idées, à évaluer les résultats et à déterminer si de nouvelles approches sont prêtes pour la production.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, en présentation et en collaboration interfonctionnelle.
  • Solide portfolio démontrant une maîtrise des VFX temps réel pour les jeux.

Eligibility Requirements 

  • Interested candidates must apply to be considered.
