job.title: Learning Experience Designer
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

As Learning Experience Designer within the Leadership Capability & Learning COE, you are the team’s primary design expert responsible for translating strategic capability priorities into high-quality, engaging, and effective development experiences (e-learning, instructor-led training, etc.). You create solutions that are modern, immersive, and genuinely impactful. Where others see a slide deck, you see an opportunity for a simulation. Where others see a workshop, you see a multi-modal experience that extends into the flow of work. Where others see a leadership program, you see a design challenge. 
You work in close partnership with the Sr. Manager, Leadership Capability, who sets the strategic design direction – diagnosing capability gaps and defining what behavior change needs to happen. Your role is to bring that direction to life with craft, creativity, a deep understanding of how adults learn, and a strong point of view on the tools, technologies, and emerging practices that can make learning more effective. You operate with significant creative autonomy within that partnership, bringing your own ideas, pushing the boundaries of what development experiences can be, and continuously raising the bar for what great looks like. 
Beyond individual experiences, you are also the visual and design standard-bearer for the COE. You own how this function presents itself to leaders, the business, and the broader organization. That means owning the COE's visual design standards and templates so that every deliverable that comes out of this function looks and feels like it belongs to the same world. 

Major Responsibilities
Design & Build Immersive Learning Experiences 

  • Design and build simulations, scenario-based experiences, experiential labs, and immersive learning environments that put leaders in realistic situations and require them to make real decisions. 
  • Develop engaging, high-quality e-learning and digital learning assets that extend development into the flow of work, not just for formal learning moments but for the spaces in between. 
  • Translate the defined capability priorities and design direction into concrete learning experiences, bringing creative solutions to the build. 
  • Prototype rapidly, pilot with real learners, gather feedback, and iterate, always optimizing for behavior change over production polish. 
  • Build a reusable library of design assets, templates, and components that accelerate future work and ensure design consistency across the COE's portfolio. 

Set & Own Visual Design Standards 

  • Establish and maintain visual design standards for the Leadership Capability & Learning COE – defining the look, feel, and quality bar for all deliverables including program materials, participant guides, presentations, and digital assets. 
  • Build a template library that is practical, flexible, and easy for others to use so that design standards get maintained even when you are not the one producing the output. 
  • Bring visual storytelling expertise to the design of leadership experiences, ensuring that the narrative arc of every program, module, and asset is as intentional as its instructional design. 
  • Translate complex leadership concepts, capability frameworks, and development models into visuals that are immediately legible to a theme park operations leader as much as to an HR professional. 
  • Elevate the quality of how the COE communicates its strategy, impact, and value through decks, one-pagers, infographics, and other visual communication formats.

Own Learning Technology & Innovation 

  • Own all internal instructional design and learning production tools – selecting, managing, and maintaining proficiency in the technologies that power the COE's design work. 
  • Actively monitor and experiment with emerging learning technologies including AI-powered development tools, immersive and simulation platforms, adaptive learning technologies, and other innovations reshaping how people develop. 
  • Bring a point of view on what the COE should be doing differently based on what you are seeing in the field – not just executing on existing ideas but challenging the standard. 
  • Partner with Learning Operations on any technology decisions that intersect with leader-facing platforms, ensuring alignment on sustainability, budget, and operational support. 
  • Integrate AI meaningfully into design and delivery – not as a gimmick but as a genuine capability enabler that makes development more personalized, more scalable, and more effective.

Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.

Perform other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibility

  • ​​Individual Contributor​  

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required. 

  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Learning Technology, experience design, or a related field – or equivalent demonstrated experience with a portfolio that proves it. 

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience designing and building learning or development experiences end to end. 
  • Demonstrated proficiency in e-learning authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Articulate Rise, Adobe Captivate, or equivalent. 
  • Strong visual design and visual communication skills with a portfolio that demonstrates high-quality, polished work across multiple formats and modalities. Portfolio submission is required with application. 
  • Working knowledge of adult learning theory and learning science, with the ability to articulate why design choices work and how they connect to how adults actually learn.  
  • Experience designing beyond the classroom (simulations, scenario-based learning, experiential modules, or immersive digital learning assets). 
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint or equivalent presentation design at a genuinely high visual standard. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AI-powered learning tools, immersive learning platforms, or adaptive learning technologies. 
  • Experience establishing or contributing to visual design standards, template systems, or brand guidelines for a team or function. 
  • Background in experience design, interaction design, or UX – even if not in an L&D context. 
  • Experience working in a COE, consulting environment, or complex matrixed organization where strategic direction was often ambiguous and design solutions had to be built without a complete brief. 
  • Experience in a fast-moving, operationally complex industry – hospitality, entertainment, retail, or similar environments where practicality and speed matter as much as craft quality. 
  • Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week.
  • This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $88,000-$114,000

Telemundo Arizona is looking for a driven and results-oriented multiplatform sales leader to join our team.   The successful candidate will oversee local sales for our linear and non-linear product portfolio which provides Spanish and English language marketing solutions for brands and businesses across every industry to reach Hispanic and non-Hispanic audiences in the Phoenix and Tucson DMA and throughout the United States through NBCU OTT Spot On & Peacock.  The Local Sales Manager will be responsible for partnering with local advertising agencies and clients to create innovative, targeted, and unique multi-platform marketing and advertising solutions that deliver results across the portfolio. 

Essential Responsibilities

The Local Sales Manager will be responsible for directing the local sales efforts of Telemundo Arizona and will report to the station’s General Manager/VP of Sales

  • The LSM will work strategically with research, business development, and sales leadership across the division to grow revenue for Telemundo Phoenix and Tucson and NBCUniversal Local linear and non-linear platforms, including Peacock, Spot On and NBC / Telemundo Full Episode Player. 
  • The LSM will be responsible for leading a team of AEs and formulate sales goals and competitive advantage strategies to achieve/surpass revenue targets.
  • The LSM must be willing to carry a sales list, work on avails and stay connected with clients to contribute to the overall success of the station. 
  • The LSM will lead local sales and planning, pricing strategies, inventory management, market growth and revenue forecasting across the station’s sales portfolio, including tentpoles. 
  • The LSM will partner with General Manager/VP of Sales, Research, Traffic and Finance to provide local market insights throughout the budget planning process and presentations. 
  • The LSM will direct the local sales effort through clear communication and detailed planning. Review strategies with clients. Provide quick response and turnaround to the local sales team and deliver on timelines and commitments.
  • The LSM must develop strategies to enhance traditional revenue opportunities as well as identify new revenue streams and lead execution of activation and integration sponsorships.
  • The LSM will work with closely with Research to create presentations and determine estimates on programs.
  • Identify local decision makers impacting local buys.
  • The LSM will develop an understanding of our ad products, leverage tentpole events like the World Cup, Super Bowl, and the Olympics, and have solid consultative selling skills to best develop solutions to meet client needs.
  • New business, revenue closure, account relationship building, customer satisfaction, and product implementation success are key responsibilities.
  • Aggressively meet and develop strong business relationships with all buyers, media planners and brand managers throughout Arizona.
  • Ensure optimal market coverage, professional client engagements, increasing awareness of products, services, and capabilities.
  • Provide continual input and assessments to station and division leadership to drive ongoing improvements in sales strategy and approach.
  • Achieve quarterly linear and non-linear revenue targets and support station’s overall OCF achievement.
  • Manage the opportunity pipeline and revenue forecasting.
  • Identify, coordinate, and attend all appropriate local marketing and advertising association events.
  • Collaborate with NBCU Local's sales teams across the division to share best practices, implement new strategies and utilize expertise to drive results.

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in business development and media sales
  • Minimum 5 years of digital media sales experience.
  • A solid record of attaining or exceeding sales quotas by developing creative solutions that meet customers’ needs across traditional and non-traditional advertising categories.
  • Minimum 5 years of working knowledge with Word, PowerPoint and Excel
  • A demonstrated record of growing market share and outperforming the market
  • Ability to understand the big picture and long-term objectives, positive mental attitude, sense of professionalism, team orientation, resourcefulness, and client focus.
  • Excellent communication skills, initiative, creativity, detail oriented, organizational, analytical and presentation skills required.
  • Strong sense of drive and ambition.
  • Industry contacts, client list including both agencies and client direct contacts.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.

  • Must have access to a vehicle and excellent driving history.
  • Must provide proof current valid U.S. driver's license, vehicle insurance, and registration as requested.
  • Willingness to travel and work overtime, and on weekends with short notice when circumstances warrant.

Desired Qualifications

  • A proven track record of managing a successful sales team
  • Degree in marketing, business, or communications
  • Some level of Spanish language skills (a plus)
  • Experience selling OTT/CTV ad solutions
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to successfully apply sales techniques; creative and analytic ability to use information such as behavioral, demo and geo targeting data plus industry research to make effective and persuasive verbal, written or electronic sales presentations.
  • Good organizational and time management skills.

Universal Destination & Experiences’ Franchise, Products & Partnerships team (UDX FPP) extends NBCUniversal’s iconic brands, characters and stories through global consumer products and games, theme park merchandise and retail, in addition to the UDX enterprise function of franchise management and strategic partnerships. Supporting NBCUniversal’s owned portfolio of properties as well as third-party partners across the theme park business, UDX FPP creates products, experiences and partnerships that deepen fandom and connects audiences around the world with the characters, stories and worlds that define Universal.  www.udxfpp.com

UDX FPP is looking for a creative and strategic Design Manager to guide product design and development from initial concept through final execution. This role combines hands-on design expertise, creative direction, team leadership, brand stewardship, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver products that are innovative, consumer-relevant, commercially viable, and authentic to Universal’s properties.

With the primary focus on the collectibles market, this role requires a deep understanding of the collector consumer and the ability to respond quickly to evolving trends, fandom, nostalgia, emerging aesthetics, new formats, and product innovation. In addition, this role requires a deep understanding of Universal’s properties and franchises including our animated, live action and horror portfolios.

Design & Development

  • Oversee product approvals and provide timely, actionable feedback to licensees through the online product approval process.
  • Embrace coaching and mentoring as opportunities to support individual and team growth.
  • Deliver accurate design direction, draw-overs, and overlays aligned with property guidelines and franchise priorities.
  • Serve as a design expert across assigned categories, materials, technologies, and 2D/3D execution.
  • Create mood boards, concept sketches, visual direction, and assets for presentations.
  • Research trends, innovation, and consumer insights to inspire new product ideas, with a strong focus on collectibles while remaining flexible across categories.
  • Lead the creative vision and design direction across assigned product categories.
  • Maintain a high standard of character, property, and brand integrity throughout development.
  • Communicate effectively and confidently across internal teams, external partners, and leadership.
  • Understand packaging structure, branding elements, legal requirements, and toy functionality.
  • Provide clear meeting recaps, next steps, and action items to management and key stakeholders.
  • Embrace Artificial Intelligence as an evolving creative tool and demonstrate a willingness to learn, experiment, and improve.
  • Demonstrate versatility across design styles and aesthetics to respond to changing consumer and market trends.

Design Strategy

  • Identify emerging trends, consumer behaviors, new play patterns, technologies, and white-space opportunities.
  • Translate business and franchise strategies into compelling product concepts and design solutions.
  • Monitor emerging trends and innovation across collectibles, toys, and adjacent product categories.
  • Understand the competitive landscape, target consumer, and evolving collector mindset.
  • Build clear, polished design strategy presentations for internal and leadership reviews.
  • Plan, develop, and execute visual line plans that communicate cohesive product strategies and storytelling.
  • Present concepts, product strategies, and design recommendations clearly and confidently to leadership.
  • Balance nostalgia, fandom, current trends, and forward-looking innovation to create products that connect with both established and emerging collectors.

Licensing Expertise

  • Understand the licensed entertainment and consumer products landscape.
  • Maintain brand consistency across licensed characters, storytelling, products, assets, and toolkits.
  • Guide product development from show to shelf, translating Universal IP into compelling consumer products.
  • Direct external partners and licensees toward creative solutions that authentically represent Universal properties.
  • Review product submissions and provide clear, actionable design feedback throughout development.
  • Balance partner creativity with franchise authenticity, particularly within the collectibles space, while maintaining Universal’s quality standards.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Communicate strategically and effectively with internal teams, leadership, licensees, and external partners.
  • Lead creative discussions, product reviews, kickoff meetings, and approval conversations.
  • Maintain clear, consistent, and productive communication with licensees throughout development.
  • Collaborate closely with Category, Franchise, Legal, Retail, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Build strong relationships with internal and external partners to drive alignment and successful product execution.
  • Advocate for strong design solutions while working collaboratively toward shared creative and business goals.
  • Can confidently present creative concepts, product designs, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership, clearly articulating how creative solutions support franchise objectives, licensing opportunities, partner needs and broader business goals.
  • Perform other related duties assigned to support the needs of the team.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks.   • 5+ years of experience in licensing, manufacturing, consumer products, toy design, collectibles, or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in industrial design, Toy Design, Illustration, or a related field preferred.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating commercial product development and trend-forward design.
  • Demonstrates openness to giving and receiving constructive feedback, embracing continuous improvement, and adapting approaches and ways of working to meet evolving business needs.
  • Strong traditional and digital sketching skills, with strength in figures, collectibles, character-driven products, and stylized design trends.
  • Strong understanding of the collectibles market, including established, emerging, and upcoming consumer trends.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify trends and translate them into relevant product opportunities.
  • Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to drive projects forward.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and creative-direction skills.
  • Experience developing licensed entertainment products.
  • Strong understanding of product development and manufacturing processes.
  • Excellent illustration, conceptualization, and design skills.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, with working knowledge of InDesign, Keynote, PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.
  • Strong understanding of 2D composition and 3D form.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and adaptable within a fast-paced development environment.
  • Confident advocating for design recommendations while collaborating toward shared solutions.
  • Comfortable experimenting with emerging creative technologies, including AI-assisted ideation and visualization.

Portfolio

  • PORTFOLIO SUBMISSION GUIDLINES: Please submit a professional portfolio 
    demonstrating strong product ideation, sketching, creative problem-solving, and design development is highly preferred. Examples of collectible or other three-dimensional product design are strongly preferred. Portfolios must showcase the full product development lifecycle, from concept to shelf, and include examples of sketches, trend research, pattern and print development, overlays/redlines, technical design packages (tech packs), sampling iterations, and final produced products. All submitted work must be the candidate's original work, with clear examples of their individual design contributions.

Working closely with the Director, HR, this role will help drive HR projects that span: onboarding, rewards and recognition, performance feedback, talent attraction and development, and HR’s business impact.  In the day to day, you will strategize in the areas of: organization design & integration, staffing, compensation planning, manager coaching, employee development, workforce planning and performance management.

  • Deliver consistent, high-quality HR support and ensure alignment across teams

  • Executer – You get things done!  Using strong business acumen, insightful analytical skills, and superior process/project management skills you manage through competing priorities even with a matrixed environment
  • Communicates with ease – You have a way with words; written and verbal
  • Trusted counselor – You quickly gain trust and respect with anyone you come in contact with and can influence as needed, keeping a client-focused mindset

  • Translator – You have vision – see the “big picture” and be able to boil it down to the appropriate HR and business strategy to make it work
  • Self-starter – Motivated and can work with minimal guidance, finding the resources to help you out

job.description:

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Manager, Product role will spearhead the product side of Enterprise Rights Management, including the strategy, roadmap, operating model, and execution of complex technology initiatives. The role combines senior product leadership, technical product management, and direct people management. It will lead and develop Product Managers and related product resources while partnering closely with Engineering, Architecture, Data, Security, Operations, and business stakeholders.

A primary focus will be the successful implementation and evolution of a modern Rights Management System (RMS), supported by integrated data capabilities, workflow automation, and responsible use of AI. The role must be able to translate business and rights-management needs into clear product direction, technically sound solutions, executable roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes.

Responsibilities:

  • Product Strategy and Portfolio Leadership
    • Define and drive the product vision, multi-year roadmap, priorities, and delivery strategy for RMS and the broader Enterprise Rights product portfolio.
    • Translate business objectives, operational pain points, and user needs into product capabilities, investment priorities, and sequenced delivery plans.
    • Provide oversight across multiple concurrent initiatives and workstreams, balancing strategic priorities, delivery dependencies, risks, and available capacity.
    • Establish clear product governance, decision rights, success measures, and communication practices across the portfolio.
    • Partner with senior stakeholders to align product investments with enterprise technology strategy and business outcomes.
  • Technical Product and Solution Leadership
    • Act as the senior product partner to Engineering, Architecture, Data, and platform teams throughout discovery, solution design, implementation, testing, deployment, and adoption.
    • Guide product decisions involving SaaS platforms, enterprise integrations, APIs, data models, workflow orchestration, cloud services, security, and scalability.
    • Ensure business requirements are translated into clear product requirements, capabilities, epics, acceptance criteria, and implementation priorities.
    • Establish and reinforce effective use of Jira and Confluence for backlog management, requirements traceability, product documentation, decision tracking, and cross-functional collaboration.
    • Challenge assumptions, identify technical and process dependencies early, and help teams make informed tradeoffs across scope, value, timing, risk, and maintainability.
    • Provide product leadership for vendor evaluations, implementation partners, and third-party platforms where applicable.
  • RMS Implementation and Transformation
    • Lead the product side of the RMS implementation, including business alignment, capability definition, prioritization, roadmap management, readiness, and adoption.
    • Coordinate product activities across rights, content acquisition, legal, distribution, finance, operations, engineering, data, and other impacted functions.
    • Ensure RMS delivery is connected to the broader Rights ecosystem, including source systems, downstream consumers, reporting, integrations, and the enterprise data layer.
    • Drive transparent reporting of progress, decisions, risks, dependencies, and required leadership actions.
    • Promote sustainable product practices that support implementation delivery as well as long-term platform ownership and continuous improvement.
  • AI, Data, and Intelligent Automation
    • Define and prioritize opportunities to use AI, machine learning, automation, and advanced analytics to improve rights workflows, decision support, data quality, and user experience.
    • Partner with Data, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Security, and business teams to evaluate AI use cases and move appropriate concepts from discovery into delivery.
    • Ensure AI-enabled product capabilities are grounded in reliable data, clearly defined business value, measurable outcomes, and responsible governance.
    • Champion reusable data and AI capabilities that complement RMS and strengthen the future-state Rights platform.
    • Monitor relevant technology trends and recommend practical opportunities for innovation without losing focus on core delivery commitments.
  • People Leadership and Product Operating Model
    • Directly manage, coach, and develop Product Managers and other product resources, setting clear expectations, priorities, and development goals.
    • Create a consistent product management operating model across discovery, planning, requirements, delivery, stakeholder engagement, and outcome measurement.
    • Lead the product delivery operating model across Agile teams, including roadmap planning, release planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, capacity management, sprint execution, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement, adapting the approach to the needs of each initiative.
    • Assign ownership across initiatives and ensure Product Managers have the context, support, and accountability needed to lead their workstreams.
    • Build a collaborative, high-performing culture focused on customer value, technical credibility, transparency, and execution.
    • Assess team capacity and capability needs and recommend appropriate staffing, role design, and external support when required.
  • Stakeholder, Change, and Executive Communication
    • Serve as a primary product leadership contact for Enterprise Rights and represent the portfolio in cross-functional and leadership forums.
    • Facilitate alignment across business and technology teams, resolve competing priorities, and escalate decisions when necessary.
    • Communicate roadmap status, delivery health, risks, options, and recommendations in a concise and decision-oriented manner.
    • Partner with change-management, training, and operational teams to support adoption and successful transition to new capabilities.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in product management, business solutions, technology product leadership, or a related discipline.
  • 2+ years of direct people-management experience, including coaching and developing product professionals.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex enterprise product portfolios or large-scale technology transformations from strategy through implementation.
  • Strong technical fluency and experience partnering with Engineering, Architecture, Data, Security, and enterprise platform teams.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS implementations, systems integration, APIs, data platforms, cloud services, workflow automation, or related technologies.
  • Strong working knowledge of Agile methodologies and product-delivery practices, including roadmap planning, release planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, prioritization, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement.
  • Hands-on experience using Jira and Confluence to manage product backlogs, document requirements and decisions, track delivery, and maintain clear communication across product, engineering, and business teams.
  • Scrum, Agile, or product management certification, such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), SAFe certification, or an equivalent credential, is preferred.
  • Practical understanding of AI-enabled products, automation, analytics, data governance, and responsible AI considerations.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, problem-solving, and organizational-change skills.
  • Experience in media and entertainment, rights management, licensing, content operations, intellectual property, or a similarly complex domain is strongly preferred.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Balances strategic thinking with hands-on delivery leadership.
  • Can move comfortably between business outcomes, product details, and technical discussions.
  • Builds clarity in ambiguous environments and creates structure across complex, interdependent work.
  • Leads through influence while also holding direct accountability for team performance and delivery.
  • Communicates risks early, presents practical options, and drives decisions to closure.
  • Develops talent and creates an environment in which product professionals can operate with ownership and confidence.
  • A clear and aligned RMS and Enterprise Rights product strategy, roadmap, and governance model.
  • Effective leadership and development of the product team, with clear ownership across initiatives.
  • Consistent translation of business needs into technically feasible, prioritized product outcomes.
  • Transparent management of portfolio dependencies, risks, decisions, and delivery commitments.
  • Meaningful adoption of data, automation, and responsible AI capabilities that improve rights operations and decision-making.
  • Strong partnership and trust across business, product, engineering, data, and executive stakeholders.

The Manager, Soundtracks & Marketing, Film Music supports integrated soundtrack, score, artist, social, publicity, awards, and event campaigns across the film slate. Working closely with the SVP, Soundtracks & Marketing, this role supports priority campaigns while independently leading select album, awards, and screening initiatives. The ideal candidate is creative, highly organized, collaborative, and able to manage multiple partners, deliverables, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Soundtrack Marketing & Publicity

  • Develop and manage marketing and publicity strategies for soundtracks, scores, singles, composers, and artists.
  • Partner with the SVP on major soundtrack campaigns while independently leading select releases from planning through execution.
  • Liaise with composers, artists, managers, labels, and internal and external marketing teams to establish rollout plans, timelines, key dates, approvals, and deliverables.
  • Create and distribute campaign strategies, release information, assets, and updates to domestic and international partners.
  • Coordinate major-label soundtrack and album campaigns with outside record labels and distribution partners.
  • Work with publicity teams to secure interviews, features, exclusives, and editorial opportunities for composers, songwriters, and artists.
  • Prepare priorities and action items before and after executive meetings; create and distribute Back Lot Music press releases and campaign communications.
  • Develop and maintain strong music-industry relationships. DSP, editorial, and music-press contacts are a plus.

Social Media & Digital Marketing

  • Manage Back Lot Music social accounts, content calendars, release posts, and music distribution and smart-link destinations.
  • Coordinate copy, creative, timing, approvals, tagging, and collaborative posts with film accounts, artists, composers, labels, and partners.
  • Create, organize, and distribute social assets and identify catalog, anniversary, talent, and film-marketing moments that extend campaign reach.
  • Ensure messaging and creative remain consistent across social channels and partner campaigns.

Awards Strategy & Submissions

  • Support awards strategies for eligible scores, songs, soundtracks, composers, songwriters, and artists.
  • Lead direct submissions, including the GRAMMY Awards, Hollywood Music in Media Awards (HMMA), and Society of Composers & Lyricists (SCL) Awards.
  • Spearhead submission reels and supporting materials, including music assets, credits, and required documentation.
  • Manage awards accounts and profiles; track eligibility, categories, lists, deadlines, submissions, and status.
  • Coordinate with talent representatives, labels, internal awards and publicity teams, and other partners to ensure accurate, timely submissions and communicate action items.

Premieres, Screenings & Events

  • Manage quarterly music department screenings and composer or artist hosted screenings for internal teams and external partners.
  • Manage invitations, guest lists, RSVPs, print requests, security, drive-ons, venue coordination, and guest accommodations.
  • Partner with events, publicity, security, and operations teams to execute screenings smoothly.
  • Staff premieres and support composers, songwriters, artists, and music partners throughout event and red-carpet activity.

Campaign & Project Management

  • Manage concurrent release, social, publicity, awards, and event workstreams from planning through completion.
  • Maintain campaign timelines, release calendars, asset and awards trackers, meeting follow-ups, and status updates.
  • Identify and resolve scheduling, asset, approval, eligibility, and communication issues; serve as a central point of contact across internal and external teams.
  • Track campaign activity and identify opportunities to improve collaboration, efficiency, reach, and engagement.
  • Experience in music or soundtrack marketing, record labels, artist or film marketing, entertainment publicity, awards, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of music release campaigns and how publicity, social, digital platforms, talent, labels, awards organizations, and film marketing work together.
  • Proven ability to independently manage multiple projects, stakeholders, deadlines, detailed submissions, and time-sensitive materials.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, discretion, and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Experience managing social campaigns, content calendars, creative assets, and partner approvals.
  • Ability to work effectively with senior executives, talent representatives, artists, composers, labels, and outside partners in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for film, music, soundtracks, artists, and popular culture. DSP, music-media, or editorial relationships are a plus, but not required.

The Manager, Talent & Culture will collaborate closely with leaders to anticipate needs, design solutions, and ensure employees have the tools, opportunities, and support to thrive.

  • Provide counsel on organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, employee engagement, and change management to leaders and Team Members across a diverse operation where priorities can shift quickly and decisions have an immediate impact on both the employee and guest experience.

  • Hands-on experience through coursework, labs, personal projects, or internships involving technical systems, hardware, software, or networking.

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal est l’une des principales entreprises mondiales dans le domaine des médias et du divertissement. Nous créons du contenu de calibre mondial que nous distribuons par l’intermédiaire de notre portefeuille de films, de télévision et de diffusion en continu, et que nous donnons vie grâce à nos destinations de parcs thématiques à travers le monde, à nos produits de consommation et à nos expériences. Nous possédons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo et Peacock, notre service haut de gamme de diffusion en continu financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des films et des émissions de premier plan par l’intermédiaire de nos puissants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi que des quatre studios de télévision mondiaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs thématiques et des expériences de premier plan partout dans le monde par l’intermédiaire d’Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment Universal Orlando Resort, où se trouve Universal Epic Universe, et Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Visitez www.nbcuniversal.com pour en savoir plus.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés où vivent et travaillent les membres de notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics. Nous avons une longue tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à offrir aux membres de notre personnel la possibilité de s’investir au sein de leurs communautés. Nous favorisons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et de proposer une vaste gamme de contenus à l’image de notre monde.

NBCUniversal is seeking an Modeler (Vegetation & Organic) to create high-quality vegetation and organic assets for an ambitious AAA open-world project set in a contemporary real-life urban environment. This role is responsible for producing trees, plants, and organic elements that support realism, environmental storytelling, and large-scale ecosystem creation. 

Reporting to the Lead Artist (Procedural) and working closely with Senior and Principal artists, the Intermediate Modeler will collaborate with Environment, Procedural, and Technical Art teams to ensure assets are integrated into scalable workflows. The role focuses on reliable production, learning vegetation systems, and contributing to efficient content creation across platforms from high-end to mobile. 

Résumé du poste 

NBCUniversal recherche un·e Modeleur.se (Végétation & Organique) pour créer des assets végétaux et organiques de qualité dans le cadre d’un projet AAA en monde ouvert situé dans un environnement urbain contemporain réel. Ce rôle est responsable de produire arbres, plantes et éléments organiques contribuant au réalisme, au storytelling environnemental et à la création d’écosystèmes à grande échelle. 

Sous la direction du·de la Chef.fe Artiste (Procédural) et en collaboration avec les artistes seniors et principaux, le·la Modeleur.se Intermédiaire travaillera avec les équipes Environnement, Procédural et Tech Art afin d’assurer l’intégration des assets dans des workflows scalables. Le rôle consiste à produire de manière fiable, à apprendre les systèmes végétaux et à contribuer à une production efficace du haut de gamme au mobile. 

Responsibilities 

  • Translate Art Direction into vegetation and organic assets supporting natural environments and ecosystems. 
  • Create trees, plants, ground cover, and organic assets with attention to realism, scale, and variation. 
  • Ensure consistency and quality of vegetation assets within environments. 
  • Work within established vegetation pipelines and contribute to production efficiency. 
  • Support scalable workflows for ecosystem creation and large-scale content generation. 
  • Collaborate closely with Procedural, Environment, Lighting, and Technical Art teams for integration. 
  • Ensure assets meet technical constraints including performance, LODs, and scalability. 
  • Iterate on feedback and refine assets according to quality standards. 
  • Contribute to maintaining consistency across vegetation libraries and ecosystems. 
  • Support team productivity and follow best practices in vegetation production. 

Responsabilités 

  • Traduire la direction artistique en assets végétaux et organiques pour environnements naturels et systèmes d’écosystèmes. 
  • Créer arbres, plantes, couvert végétal et éléments organiques avec attention au réalisme, à l’échelle et à la variation. 
  • Assurer la cohérence et la qualité des assets végétaux dans les environnements. 
  • Travailler dans les pipelines végétation existants et contribuer à l’efficacité de production. 
  • Supporter les workflows scalables pour la création d’écosystèmes et de contenu à grande échelle. 
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Procédural, Environnement, Éclairage et Tech Art pour l’intégration. 
  • Garantir que les assets respectent les contraintes techniques incluant performance, LODs et scalabilité. 
  • Itérer sur les retours et affiner les assets selon les standards du projet. 
  • Contribuer à la cohérence des bibliothèques de végétation et des écosystèmes. 
  • Supporter la productivité de l’équipe et suivre les bonnes pratiques de production. 

Basic Qualifications 

  • Experience in real-time or AAA production with a focus on vegetation, environment, or organic modeling. 
  • Portfolio demonstrating solid vegetation and organic modeling skills. 
  • Good understanding of modeling fundamentals (topology, scale, optimization). 
  • Familiarity with vegetation tools such as SpeedTree or similar. 
  • Basic understanding of real-time pipelines and vegetation workflows. 
  • Understanding of modular asset creation and ecosystem consistency. 
  • Ability to follow artistic and technical direction. 
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills. 

Qualifications de base 

  • Expérience en production temps réel ou AAA avec un focus sur la végétation ou les assets organiques. 
  • Portfolio démontrant des compétences solides en modélisation végétale. 
  • Bonne compréhension des fondamentaux de modélisation (topologie, échelle, optimisation). 
  • Familiarité avec des outils tels que SpeedTree ou équivalents. 
  • Compréhension de base des pipelines temps réel et workflows végétation. 
  • Compréhension de la modularité et de la cohérence des écosystèmes. 
  • Capacité à suivre des directives artistiques et techniques. 
  • Bonnes compétences en communication et collaboration. 

Desired Characteristics 

  • Experience working with Unreal Engine pipelines. 
  • Interest in ecosystem creation and large-scale environments. 
  • Familiarity with procedural workflows (Houdini or similar) is a plus. 
  • Understanding of environmental composition and biodiversity. 
  • Motivation to grow toward senior or specialist roles. 

Atouts souhaités 

  • Expérience avec les pipelines Unreal Engine. 
  • Intérêt pour la création d’écosystèmes et environnements à grande échelle. 
  • Connaissance de workflows procéduraux (Houdini ou équivalent) est un plus. 
  • Compréhension de la composition environnementale et de la biodiversité. 
  • Motivation à évoluer vers des rôles senior ou spécialisés. 

Eligibility Requirements

  • Interested candidates must apply to be considered. 
  • Must be willing to work in our Montreal office a minimum of 4 days a week. 
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada. 
  • Must be willing to travel for work related business, if necessary 

Exigences d’admissibilité 

  • Les personnes intéressées doivent soumettre leur candidature afin d’être considérées.  
  • Doit être disposé·e à travailler dans nos bureaux de Montréal au minimum quatre (4) jours par semaine.

Time Commitment: 40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need.

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews  

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers

  • Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below).

NBCU Corporate groups are uniquely positioned at the core of our organization. Employees within these groups use their area of expertise to support all businesses across the company, keeping the heart of each brand at the forefront.

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Music Business & Legal Affairs (undergrad-level): The Music Business & Legal Affairs team supports various clients across NBCUniversal, including Sports, Late Night, Specials, Telemundo, News/Owned Stations, and Scripted. They are experts in music licensing and administration and help our clients navigate music use within television (everything from research to payments). The role of the Music Business & Legal Affairs intern is to support the overall team – they will gain valuable training and a balanced experience by participating in day-to-day operations. Responsibilities include researching copyright information, creating and updating music cue sheets, databases, tracking grids, and more.   

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program. 
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in New York, NY.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Strong interest in music and/or transactional work.     
  • Strong interest in the media industry.    
  • Self-starter, professional, and ability to adapt.     
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.     
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook).    
  • Knowledge of music-related concepts such as PROs, Cue Sheets, and Clearance terminology a plus. 

The hourly rate for student interns is $19.00.

NBCUniversal Local is NBCUniversal’s local media division that delivers English and Spanish-speakers and bilingual audiences in 31 U.S. markets and Puerto Rico, the very best in local sports, news, weather, consumer and investigative reporting, and lifestyle entertainment across any platform and screen. NBCUniversal Local is comprised of three individual media groups including the NBC Owned Television Stations, the NBC Sports Regional Networks and the Telemundo Station Group. NBCUniversal Local’s stations and networks serve diverse audiences and communities across linear, streaming, OTT, digital web, mobile and audio, and cable platforms and work together to keep local audiences informed anytime and anywhere.       

Operations & Technology (O&T) functions as a global shared service within NBCUniversal performing critical functions including Media, Broadcast and Studio Operations & Production, Content Supply Chain, Information Technology and Engineering, as well as Cyber Security. The group operates from numerous locations around the world, including New York, New Jersey, Los Angeles, Connecticut, and London. 

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:  

  • Skycastle/LXTV: NBCU Skycastle and LXTV are creative divisions of NBCUniversal Local. LXTV produces lifestyle and entertainment content, while Skycastle focuses on marketing and promotional campaigns for both general and Hispanic audiences. Together, they form a full-service production and creative team, delivering localized advertising content in English and Spanish. Interns gain hands-on experience in TV production and post-production. Responsibilities may include: assisting producers with planning, guest booking, and pre-production; assisting crew members on set; editing segments for various platforms; assisting with music cue sheets, talent, and location releases and closed captioning; and engaging and assisting with all social media platforms.
  • Digital Editorial: Our team helps the NBC Local websites from New York to Los Angeles provide a full news report each day. We write and share interesting articles among the websites and post national and international stories and we provide the local television stations with short voice overs for broadcast. Our interns report and write stories, post articles from NBC News and The Associated Press and help with data research.
  • Local HQ Marketing: The NBCU Local HQ Marketing team includes members based in New York, Chicago, Stamford, and Dallas. They specialize in various areas including Brand Management, Streaming Platforms, Regional Sports Networks’ Marketing and Creative Services, Graphic Design, and Syndication. The NBCU Local marketing intern, working alongside the HQ team in New York, will have the opportunity to engage in diverse projects involving NBC and Telemundo marketers from local stations and streaming channels across the country. Internship assignments may encompass tasks such as preparing and distributing briefs and campaign documents for major initiatives and premieres, facilitating product launches, organizing streaming channel special events, providing support for voter registration efforts, collaborating on marketing initiatives, and contributing to the company's broader social responsibility endeavors. 
  • Operations & Technology Production Services, Editing Operations: News Group O&T supports the technology, workflows, and production services that help bring NBCUniversal’s news content to audiences across platforms. Within Production Services, the Editing Operations team supports post-production and editorial workflows, partnering with teams across the organization to help deliver high-quality content efficiently. The team works with industry-standard editing tools, including Avid Media Composer, while supporting a variety of editing projects and initiatives.

  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • A background in any of the following areas: Journalism, Communications, Advertising, Production, Marketing, or related fields.  
  • Strong interest in the media industry.  
  • Interest and experience in video editing using Adobe Premiere and Final Cut Pro X a plus.  
  • For NBCU Local internships: fluency in both English and Spanish preferred.  

The hourly rate for non-O&T student interns is $19.00.

NBCUniversal Local is comprised of three individual media groups including the NBC Owned Television Stations, the NBC Sports Regional Networks and the Telemundo Station Group. NBCUniversal Local’s stations and networks serve diverse audiences and communities across linear, streaming, OTT, digital web, mobile and audio, and cable platforms and work together to keep local audiences informed anytime and anywhere.

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • NBC News Digital Creative Design/UX: As a part of the Product and Design team at NBC News Digital, you’ll join in as we design the future of our products, supporting flexible systems that fuel brands like NBC News, TODAY, Telemundo, and more. Our team of designers are involved from strategy to execution for our mobile apps, OTT platform, web experiences, and the Big Board used on broadcast. You will also have the opportunity to gain exposure to our cross-functional teams and learn from product, engineering, and user insights leaders in addition to being embedded in the design team.
  • NBC News Data/Graphics: This team is responsible for explaining the news through visualizations and data analysis. We build interactives, charts, maps, illustrations, graphics and more to tell the news in a compelling and thoughtful way. The intern should be interested in data visualizations and be an avid news reader. You should have an interest in data journalism and will help find stories that we could be telling in a new and visual way. You will also help create charts, maps and graphics for breaking news stories and for reported features.
  • NBC News Mobile App Development: The team is responsible for designing, developing and testing NBC News’s flagship Android/iOS applications. The intern will be working on native mobile applications across all the NBC News brands and collaborate with developers, product and project management in shipping out features. The intern will be mentored by senior developers in the team and will be guided in their work. The intern will be working on various team initiatives following engineering best practices and writing quality code.
  • NBC News Digital – Software Engineering: As a Software Engineer Intern, you will partner with the Product, Operations, Design, and Editorial teams to bring NBC News Digital content to life. You will be a significant influence on our product roadmap, bringing a technical and strategic perspective. You will work alongside fellow inspired developers in a fast-paced environment using technologies like Sass, React.js and GraphQL to help shape the future of digital news.

job.title: NBC News Product Manager
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

As our NBC News Product Manager, you’ll own the strategy, execution and successful delivery of audience and revenue-driving initiatives, developing features, robust subscriber experiences and insights across our award-winning, market-leading news products. You’ll thrive making impactful decisions for a brand customers know and trust, based on a deep understanding and ability to draw actionable insights from user data and research, and be acknowledged as the company’s expert in the space.

Your passion will be to discover, develop and ship products and features which deliver both meaningful benefit to our users and strategic business growth success for our company.

Day-to-day, you’ll succeed by learning which solutions are simultaneously impactful, usable, valuable, and feasible, through product discovery, clear prioritization of effort and collaborative design thinking. You’ll lead, coach and motivate a dedicated, cross-functional Agile team by communicating your vision, authoring user stories, optimizing team welfare and experience, actively prioritizing the backlog, and coordinating regularly and clearly with partners, external vendors and stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and share a deep understanding of the customer, data, business, and industry
  • Establish, articulate, and advocate product vision, strategy, and what business-facing success looks like
  • Define and build consensus on meaningful metrics for success
  • Prioritize upcoming sprints, features and enhancements in story backlog
  • Build and maintain roadmap (annual and quarterly KPIs and OKRs) to ensure alignment and focus on resourcing, progress and success
  • Create a clear path for defining value for users and business growth
  • Author use cases and user stories and build shared understanding around user needs and the definition of “done”
  • Identify and implement opportunities to reduce technical, business and user experience debt
  • Discover value-driven opportunities via product discovery experiments and methods
  • Identify and map customer goals, values and needs rather than “wants” or “table stakes”
  • Inform decisions with unbiased qualitative and quantitative data
  • Ensure good communication and transparency by partnering with internal teams including editorial, marketing, advertising, business development and others
  • Coordinate and collaborate with product peers and their teams to share learnings, leverage shared effort and ensure quality cross-platform experience
  • Minimum of 5+ years in digital growth experience, combined with domain subject-matter expertise and proven thought leadership. Digital subscription experience is preferred, but not required.
  • Proven ability to deliver successful, valuable customer and business outcomes
  • Strong user experience sensibilities
  • Strong experience with analytics, and using user research to drive decisions
  • Strong experience with Agile methodologies, sprints, prioritization and debt elimination

Desired Characteristics:

  • Human-centered thinking and a strong empathy for solving problems for customers
  • Exceptional written, spoken and visual communication skills
  • Exceptional storytelling skills
  • Exceptional organizational and analytical skills
  • Ability to speak fluently with business people, stakeholders, partners, engineers
  • Experience in the media, news, or technology/internet industries
  • Experience with Product Discovery, Design Thinking, Lean Product a plus

Additional Requirements:

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $130,000 - $160,000 (bonus eligible)

  • TODAY: Work directly with producers on stories/segments, with Production Managers in the control room and green room, log tapes, conduct research on assigned topics.
  • Weekend TODAY: Assist producers with research and gathering content for upcoming segments, compile different news stories to pitch to producers for segments, log and transcribe interviews for producers and record music hit times for music cues.

  • Investigative Unit: Researching, filing records requests, analyzing data, organizing media, and assisting on local shoots.
  • Booking Unit: Assist the team with guest research and upcoming events, manage lists/pitch packets, support the team with in-studio guests/shoots.
  • Business Technology & Innovation Unit: Assist digital, television, and investigative teams with research, newsgathering, and story production, monitor news outlets for breaking news, pitch enterprise news stories.
  • Climate/Weather Unit: Forecast research, WSI Tru Vu Max graphic creation and updating, researching and presenting information on Climate change and Climate solutions.

Assist w/the logistics of sending NBC News teams (correspondents, producers, crews, engineers, etc) to cover the news on location.
  • Audio Unit: Here’s the Scoop is NBC’s flagship daily news podcast. The Intern will get exposure to all aspects of daily audio and video production, from researching and booking, to writing headlines and interview scripts, studio recording to audio/video editing, postproduction for audio/video platforms and social media.

  • NBC Selected: Building articles in our CMS, tracking editorial workflow, helping shape new copy flows and more. You will also have the opportunity to write new e-commerce content for the site, as well as update existing content.

Editorial

The intern will be interviewing experts about medical studies, pitching story ideas, and identifying trends in lifestyle and wellness, including nutrition and women’s and men’s health.
  • Today.com: Assisting editors across TODAY.com’s news/trending and lifestyle teams, and writing for sections including Pop Culture, Health, Food, Parents, Style and TMRW.

Social

  • Social Newsgathering: Using digital platforms to find user-generated content, verify social media-sourced content, interview sources and obtain information for the network's coverage. You will be covering a range of stories from breaking news to investigations and feature topics.
  • NBC News Social, TODAY Social: Helping drive social media production and publication to multiple social media accounts. You will be writing headlines, editing video and graphics, and distributing content across social media platforms.

job.description:

We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. NBC Sports Bay Area & California is a leading regional sports content destination, delivering coverage across linear television, digital, and social platforms. We’re home to the Golden State Warriors, San Francisco Giants, San Francisco 49ers, A’s, San Jose Sharks, and Sacramento Kings, bringing fans closer to their favorite teams through live games, pregame and postgame shows, podcasts, and digital and social content.

Across our two linear networks, websites, and social media platforms, we serve Bay Area and Northern California sports fans with up-to-the-minute sports news, original and exclusive content, and coverage of the teams and stories that matter most to our local communities. Our digital presence includes NBCSportsBayArea.com, NBCSportsCalifornia.com, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, X, TikTok, and more.

The Finance team at NBC Sports Bay Area/California supports the financial planning, reporting, and day-to-day business operations of the networks.

As a Finance Intern, you will gain hands-on experience and partner with departments across the organization to support monthly reporting, forecasting, budgeting, and other ad hoc projects to provide insights that support business decisions.

A snapshot of your responsibilities:

  • Assist the Senior Manager of Finance and the Regional Finance team with the preparation and maintenance of monthly financial reporting, forecasting, and budgeting.
  • Perform variance analyses of actual financial results against estimates and help identify key drivers of variances.
  • Assist with monthly and quarterly closing processes (e.g. calculate required accruals, post journal entries, and ensure all expenses are captured and stated properly)
  • Partner with the Finance team to prepare and provide ad hoc financial analyses and special projects
  • Work with large datasets in Excel to organize, analyze, and summarize financial information.
  • Help maintain accurate and timely financial information and reporting.
  • Gain exposure to the financial operations of a regional sports media business and how Finance partners with departments across the organization.

Basic Qualifications

  • Coursework or demonstrated interest in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and work collaboratively with others.
  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program (June through August).
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 16-24 hours per week from June 7, 2027 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in San Francisco, California.

Desired Characteristics

  • Pursuing a degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in Advanced Microsoft Excel (formulas, PivotTables, lookups), or other data-analysis functionality is a plus.
  • Experience with AI, data visualization or business intelligence tools, such as Power BI, is a plus but not required.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with numbers and large datasets.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.
  • Curiosity and willingness to ask questions and learn new processes.
  • Interest in sports, media, or the business of sports is a plus.
  • Students with a class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above

ABOUT THE ROLE:

NBCUniversal’s Network Engineering group within the Operations & Technology organization has an opening for a Network Engineer based at 30 Rockefeller Plaza, NYC.

The engineer will work within a dedicated team of network and firewall engineers tasked with building reliable and scalable network infrastructure for NBCUniversal’s broadcast and media production facilities. The selected candidate will have experience in the configuration, deployment, and support of Cisco, Arista, and Palo Alto firewalls using vendor and internal automation and monitoring systems.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 3+ years' experience configuring, deploying, and supporting network technology from multiple vendors including Cisco (IOS, NX-OS, XR), Arista, Palo Alto, and F5.

  • Ability to develop and maintain technical documentation and diagrams.
  • Occasional travel for project and remote event support.

    • OSPF, IS-IS, vPC, port-channeling, 10/40/100G optics, IPSEC, QoS, VLAN, Multicast
    • MP-BGP, route-reflection, MPLS (IP and Segment Routing), Traffic Engineering, L3VPN, VRF
  • Ability to analyze network logging and other data sets to troubleshoot and isolate production and design problems.
  • Experience with network automation and version control tools such as Ansible and Git to deploy networks at scale

A key revenue-generator, the division oversees the distribution of NBC, Telemundo, Bravo, Peacock, a variety of free ad supported TV networks, as well as major NBCUniversal tentpoles such as the Olympics.

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Sales: The intern will support the Sales team that negotiates the content distribution rights of NBCUniversal broadcast/cable portfolio and the Peacock app in the United States and the Caribbean. Interns will learn about the media landscape and specifically how NBCU network distribution contracts are managed. The intern will support the strategic opportunity analysis of the distribution of Peacock on various platforms. The Intern will have opportunities to collaborate with other departments including Marketing, Legal and Digital Product. Tasks will include analyzing industry, subscriber, and distributor trends and supporting account management and compliance of contract obligations and entitlements. There will be several opportunities over the course of the internship to pitch and present intern’s own research to Senior Leadership.
  • Strategic Partnerships: Within PD&P, the Strategic Partnerships & BD team drives new business and revenue by building partnerships beyond traditional distribution, with a focus on emerging technology, sports, gaming, immersive media, AI and non-traditional devices. Reporting to the Manager, Strategic Partnerships, the intern will get hands-on exposure to how partnership opportunities are identified, evaluated and brought to market. The intern will collaborate with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Product, Legal and Programming, as well as external partners.
  • Partner Operations: The Partner Operations Intern will be a member of the Platform Distribution & Partnerships (PD&P) Partner Operations team. This role is responsible for supporting the team’s operational processes that support PD&P business strategy. The Intern will support the team in efforts to operationalize deal terms, day-to-day tasks, and assigned projects.  They will have the opportunity to work cross-functionally across NBCU teams.

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program. 
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in Universal City, CA.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Seeking a degree in business, communications, finance, or marketing.
  • Experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Interested in the media landscape and content distribution on various platforms.
  • Naturally curious about emerging markets, technology, trends and business models.
  • Passionate about the media, technology, sports and entertainment industries.
  • Prior internship, coursework or club experience in media, business development, strategy or consulting is a plus.
  • Experience with Copilot or other AI tools is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, operations management, business management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience in media distribution, supply chain, or operations management.
  • Experience within the media industry and ecosystem is a plus.

The hourly rate for student interns is $19.00.
