The Principal Engineer for Digital Workplace Technology is a senior technical leader within NBCUniversal’s Workplace Technology Engineering (WTE) organization, responsible for defining and delivering the next-generation digital workplace platform. This role spans enterprise collaboration, endpoint engineering, and AI platform engineering, including Microsoft 365, Copilot, Power Platform, and enterprise AI solutions. This position plays a critical role in transforming NBCU’s digital workplace into an AI-first productivity platform that powers employee communication, engagement, and innovation.

Responsibilities:

Technology Strategy & Architecture 

  • Define and lead the technical vision, roadmap, and standards for NBCU’s digital
    workplace platforms across collaboration, endpoints, and AI.
  • Own the end-to-end architecture for Workplace Technology Engineering, ensuring
    alignment with enterprise architecture, security, and compliance requirements.
  • Serve as a technical authority for complex system design, scalability, and long-term
     platform evolution.

Digital Workplace Platform Engineering 

  • Lead design and engineering of enterprise workplace services, including:
  • Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online)
  • Identity & security (Entra ID, Purview, Defender)
  • Endpoint engineering (Intune, JAMF, SCCM)
  • Unified communications, telephony, and conferencing solutions
  • Ensure platforms deliver high availability, performance, and security, while reducing operational overhead through automation and standardization. 
  • Drive global consistency across workplace technologies supporting hybrid work environments.

AI & Workplace Intelligence Engineering

  • Architect and deliver enterprise AI capabilities, including:
    • Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio
    • Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate)
    • Enterprise AI and low-code automation solutions
  • Lead the engineering of agentic AI solutions, automation workflows, and knowledge systems that enhance employee productivity and decision-making.
  • Establish standards for:
    • AI governance, security, and responsible use
    • Data protection, privacy, and compliance within AI solutions
  • Partner with business stakeholders to identify and prioritize high-value AI use cases across NBCU.

Engineering Excellence & SRE Practices

  • Apply Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles across workplace platforms:
    • Define and manage SLIs/SLOs
    • Improve observability and monitoring
    • Automate operations to reduce manual toil
  • Drive reliability, resilience, and operational excellence across global services supporting collaboration, endpoints, and AI platforms. 

Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence

  • Act as a senior technical leader and mentor across WTE engineering teams.
  • Lead architecture reviews, engineering design boards, and technical decision-making forums.
  • Partner closely with:
    • Workplace Operations
    • Cybersecurity & Risk
    • Enterprise Architecture
    • Product & Business stakeholders
  • Influence strategic decisions and ensure alignment between technology investments and business outcomes.

Innovation & Transformation

  • Drive modernization initiatives across workplace platforms, including cloud migration, endpoint transformation, and AI adoption.
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging technologies in: 
    • Generative AI and LLM ecosystems
    • Digital employee experience (DEX) platforms
    • Automation and low-code development

Enable continuous improvement of employee experience across NBCU’s global workforce.

 

  • 12+ years of experience in enterprise engineering, platform engineering, or workplace technology
  • Deep expertise in:
    • Microsoft 365 ecosystem (Teams, SharePoint, Exchange, OneDrive)
    • Endpoint engineering and device management platforms (Intune, JAMF, SCCM)
    • Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
  • Strong experience in AI/ML or enterprise AI engineering, including Copilot or similar platforms
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Power Platform
  • Knowledge of MLOps, DevOps, and platform engineering best practices
  • Experience in media, entertainment, or large global enterprise environments
  • Familiarity with NBCU-specific platforms (e.g. Intranet, employee portals, custom digital experiences)
  • Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise platform transformations
  • Strong architectural, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong business acuity, including understanding and practical application of relevant market/industry trends
  • Ability to thrive in an ambiguous and fast-paced environment and to manage multiple simultaneous projects requiring organization and time management.

Additional Requirements:

Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Role Summary 

NBCUniversal is seeking a Principal Lighting Artist to define and drive lighting standards across an ambitious AAA open-world game set in a contemporary real-life urban environment. This role is responsible for ensuring that lighting achieves the highest level of quality, consistency, and realism, while supporting rendering pipelines, global lighting systems, and scalable production from high-end to mobile. 

Reporting to the Lead Lighting Artist, the Principal Lighting Artist will work closely with Technical Art and cross-disciplinary teams to ensure that lighting systems, methodologies, and pipelines support both artistic vision and technical constraints. The role focuses on advancing rendering techniques, defining visual benchmarks, and solving complex lighting challenges as an expert authority. 

Résumé du poste 

NBCUniversal recherche un·e Artiste Principal.e Éclairage pour définir et piloter les standards d’éclairage dans le cadre d’un jeu AAA en monde ouvert situé dans un environnement urbain contemporain réel. Ce rôle est responsable d’assurer un haut niveau de qualité, de cohérence et de réalisme pour l’éclairage, tout en soutenant les pipelines de rendu, les systèmes de global lighting et la production scalable du haut de gamme au mobile. 

Sous la direction du·de la Chef.fe d’équipe Éclairage, l’Artiste Principal.e Éclairage collaborera étroitement avec les équipes Tech Art et les équipes transverses afin de garantir que les systèmes d’éclairage, les méthodologies et les pipelines soutiennent la vision artistique ainsi que les contraintes techniques. Le rôle consiste à faire évoluer les techniques de rendu, définir les benchmarks et résoudre des problématiques complexes en tant que référent expert. 

Responsibilities 

  • Define and maintain high-quality lighting standards across environments and gameplay contexts. 
  • Drive the development and evolution of lighting systems, global illumination solutions, and rendering workflows. 
  • Solve complex artistic and technical challenges related to lighting realism, atmosphere, and performance. 
  • Act as an expert authority in real-time lighting, rendering pipelines, and global lighting systems. 
  • Collaborate closely with Technical Art to ensure robust, scalable rendering and lighting systems. 
  • Contribute to the design and evolution of pipelines, tools, and lighting workflows. 
  • Define benchmarks and ensure consistency of lighting quality across the project. 
  • Ensure lighting solutions scale efficiently across platforms from high-end to mobile. 
  • Support the Lead Lighting Artist and team with high-level expertise and technical guidance. 
  • Review and validate lighting implementation to ensure alignment with artistic vision and technical standards. 

Responsabilités 

  • Définir et maintenir des standards élevés de qualité pour l’éclairage à travers environnements et gameplay. 
  • Piloter le développement et l’évolution des systèmes d’éclairage, de global illumination et des workflows de rendu. 
  • Résoudre des problématiques complexes artistiques et techniques liées au réalisme, à l’atmosphère et à la performance. 
  • Agir comme expert en éclairage temps réel, pipelines de rendu et systèmes de global lighting. 
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Tech Art afin de garantir des systèmes robustes et scalables. 
  • Contribuer à la conception et à l’évolution des pipelines, outils et workflows d’éclairage. 
  • Définir les benchmarks et assurer la cohérence de la qualité d’éclairage sur l’ensemble du projet. 
  • Garantir la scalabilité des solutions d’éclairage du haut de gamme au mobile. 
  • Soutenir du·de la Chef.fe d’équipe Éclairage et l’équipe grâce à une expertise avancée. 
  • Réviser et valider l’implémentation de l’éclairage afin d’assurer l’alignement avec la vision artistique et les standards techniques. 

Basic requirements 

  • Extensive experience in AAA game development with a focus on lighting and rendering. 
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality lighting and atmospheric work. 
  • Advanced understanding of real-time lighting, rendering pipelines, and global illumination. 
  • Strong expertise in lighting for environments, mood, and cinematic storytelling. 
  • Experience working closely with Technical Art teams. 
  • Strong understanding of scalable pipelines and multi-platform constraints. 
  • Ability to solve complex artistic and technical challenges. 
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 

Qualifications de base 

  • Expérience significative en développement de jeux AAA avec un focus sur l’éclairage et le rendu. 
  • Portfolio solide démontrant une expertise en éclairage et atmosphères réalistes. 
  • Excellente compréhension de l’éclairage temps réel, des pipelines de rendu et du global illumination. 
  • Forte expertise en éclairage d’environnements, ambiance et narration visuelle. 
  • Expérience de collaboration étroite avec les équipes Tech Art. 
  • Bonne compréhension des pipelines scalables et des contraintes multi-plateformes. 
  • Capacité à résoudre des problématiques complexes artistiques et techniques. 
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et collaboration. 

Desired Characteristics 

  • Experience working with Unreal Engine 5 (Lumen or similar systems). 
  • Strong technical understanding of scalable systems and multi-platform constraints from high end to mobile. 
  • Positive experience working with outsourcing partners or distributed teams. 
  • Strong artistic sensitivity to mood, atmosphere, and cinematic lighting. 
  • Ability to balance visual quality with performance requirements. 
  • Strong artistic sensitivity to mood, atmosphere, and cinematic lighting. 
  • Desire to think and explore innovative solutions to push visual quality in real-time lighting. 

Atouts souhaités 

  • Expérience de travail avec Unreal Engine 5 (Lumen ou systèmes similaires). 
  • Solide compréhension technique des systèmes évolutifs et des contraintes multiplateformes, du haut de gamme au mobile. 
  • Expérience positive de collaboration avec des partenaires d'externalisation ou des équipes distribuées. 
  • Forte sensibilité artistique pour l'ambiance, l'atmosphère et l'éclairage cinématographique. 
  • Capacité à concilier qualité visuelle et exigences de performance. 
  • Forte sensibilité artistique pour l'ambiance, l'atmosphère et la narration cinématographique. 
  • Volonté de réfléchir et d'explorer des solutions innovantes pour améliorer la qualité visuelle en éclairage temps réel. 

Eligibility Requirements

NBCUniversal is looking for a Principal VFX Artist to help shape the visual and technical quality of real-time effects for an ambitious, large-scale interactive project. As a senior individual contributor and discipline expert, you will create high-quality VFX while helping define the standards, systems, and workflows that support rich, cohesive visual experiences at scale. 

Reporting to the Lead VFX Artist, you will collaborate closely with Art Direction, Technical Art, Engineering, and other disciplines to solve complex artistic and technical challenges. At the intersection of art, technology, and R&D, you will explore generative AI, procedural workflows, and automation to improve creative iteration and production efficiency. You will prototype and evaluate new approaches, helping turn promising experiments into reliable production workflows while preserving artistic control, flexibility, and real-time performance. 

Sommaire du role  

NBCUniversal recherche un·e Artiste Principal·e VFX pour contribuer à façonner la qualité visuelle et technique des effets temps réel d’un projet interactif ambitieux et à grande échelle. En tant que contributeur·rice individuel·le senior et expert·e de la discipline, vous créerez des VFX de haute qualité tout en contribuant à définir les standards, systèmes et workflows permettant de produire des expériences visuelles riches et cohérentes à grande échelle. 

Sous la direction du·de la Lead VFX Artist, vous collaborerez étroitement avec la Direction Artistique, le Tech Art, l’Engineering et les autres disciplines pour résoudre des défis artistiques et techniques complexes. À la rencontre de l’art, de la technologie et de la R&D, vous explorerez l’IA générative, les workflows procéduraux et l’automatisation pour faciliter l’itération créative et améliorer l’efficacité de la production. Vous prototyperez et évaluerez de nouvelles approches afin de transformer les expérimentations prometteuses en workflows de production fiables, tout en préservant le contrôle artistique, la flexibilité et la performance temps réel. 

Responsabilities 

  • Create and implement high-quality real-time VFX for gameplay, environments, and characters in a large-scale open world. 
  • Explore and prototype generative AI workflows for VFX ideation, visual exploration, and the creation of effect source assets. 
  • Evaluate AI-generated outputs for visual quality, consistency, editability, and suitability for real-time integration. 
  • Partner with Technical Art and Engineering to combine generative AI, procedural systems, and automation into repeatable production workflows. 
  • Compare experimental approaches with existing methods to determine where they improve iteration, reduce repetitive work, or support production at scale. 
  • Contribute to visual benchmarks and technical standards with the Lead VFX Artist and Art Direction. 
  • Resolve complex VFX challenges and profiles, debug, and optimize effects within memory, GPU, and CPU budgets. 
  • Document validated workflows and support artists through demonstrations, knowledge sharing, and constructive feedback. 
  • Collaborate across Art, Design, Animation, Lighting, and Audio to ensure effects support gameplay and environmental storytelling. 

Responsabilités 

  • Créer et intégrer des VFX temps réel de haute qualité pour le gameplay, les environnements et les personnages dans un monde ouvert à grande échelle. 
  • Explorer et prototyper des workflows d’IA générative pour l’idéation, l’exploration visuelle et la création d’éléments sources destinés aux VFX. 
  • Évaluer les résultats générés par IA selon leur qualité visuelle, leur cohérence, leur facilité de modification et leur compatibilité avec une intégration temps réel. 
  • Collaborer avec le Tech Art et l’Engineering pour combiner IA générative, systèmes procéduraux et automatisation dans des workflows de production reproductibles. 
  • Comparer les approches expérimentales aux méthodes existantes pour déterminer où elles facilitent l’itération, réduisent les tâches répétitives ou soutiennent la production à grande échelle. 
  • Contribuer aux références de qualité visuelle et aux standards techniques avec le·la Lead VFX Artist et la Direction Artistique. 
  • Résoudre les défis VFX complexes et profiler, déboguer et optimiser les effets dans le respect des budgets mémoire, GPU et CPU. 
  • Documenter les workflows validés et accompagner les artistes par des démonstrations, le partage de connaissances et des retours constructifs. 
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Art, Design, Animation, Lighting et Audio pour que les effets soutiennent le gameplay et la narration environnementale. 

Basic requirements 

  • 8+ years of experience creating VFX for games, including significant experience on AAA or large-scale productions. 
  • Shipped at least one AAA game or large-scale real-time project as a Senior, Principal, Lead, or equivalent VFX artist. 
  • Deep expertise in Unreal Engine 5 and modern real-time VFX workflows, including Niagara or comparable systems. 
  • Strong proficiency with tools such as Houdini, EmberGen, Maya, Blender, Photoshop, or equivalents. 
  • Excellent understanding of shaders, materials, PBR workflows, lighting, and real-time rendering. 
  • Advanced skills in VFX profiling, optimization, and debugging. 

Qualifications de base 

  • Plus de 8 ans d’expérience en VFX pour le jeu vidéo, avec une expérience significative sur des productions AAA ou à grande échelle. Avoir livré au moins un jeu AAA ou un projet temps réel d’envergure dans un rôle Senior, Principal, Lead ou équivalent. 
  • Expertise approfondie d’Unreal Engine 5 et des workflows VFX temps réel, notamment Niagara ou des systèmes comparables. 
  •  Bonne maîtrise d’outils tels que Houdini, EmberGen, Maya, Blender ou Photoshop. 
  •  Excellente compréhension des shaders, matériaux, workflows PBR, éclairage et rendu temps réel. 
  • Connaissance avancée du profiling, de l’optimisation et du débogage des VFX. 

Desired Characteristics 

  • Hands-on experimentation with generative AI for visual content creation, with an interest in connecting these tools to real-time VFX workflows.  
  • Curiosity to test new approaches and the judgment to recognize when generated results need refinement or when another method is more effective. 
  •  A collaborative mindset, a willingness to share practical findings, and a focus on solutions that artists can reliably use in production. 
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
  • A strong portfolio showcasing mastery in VFX for games.  
  • Shipped at least 1 mobile or AAA game title.  

Atouts souhaités 

  • Expérience pratique de l’expérimentation avec l’IA générative pour la création de contenu visuel, et intérêt pour l’intégration de ces outils aux workflows VFX temps réel.  
  • Curiosité pour tester de nouvelles approches et discernement pour reconnaître quand les résultats générés doivent être retravaillés ou qu’une autre méthode serait plus efficace.  
  • Esprit collaboratif, volonté de partager les enseignements tirés des expérimentations et souci de proposer des solutions que les artistes peuvent utiliser de manière fiable en production. 
  • Excellentes compétences en communication, en présentation et en collaboration avec différentes disciplines. 
  • Portfolio solide démontrant une maîtrise des VFX pour le jeu vidéo. 
  • Avoir livré au moins un jeu mobile ou AAA. 

Eligibility Requirements 

  • Interested candidates must apply to be considered. 
  • Must be willing to work in our Montreal office a minimum of 4 days a week. 
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada. 
  • Must be willing to travel for work related business, if necessary 

Exigences d’admissibilité 

  • Les personnes intéressées doivent soumettre leur candidature afin d’être considérées.  
  • Doit être disposé·e à travailler dans nos bureaux de Montréal au minimum quatre (4) jours par semaine.

job.title: Producer, Dateline NBC
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Dateline NBC is seeking an experienced Producer to develop, report, and produce longform investigative and true crime stories for broadcast, streaming, and digital platforms. Working closely with correspondents, senior producers, editors, legal teams, and production staff, the Producer will play a key role in all phases of production—from story development and reporting through scripting, field production, editing, and post-production.

The ideal candidate is a strong journalist and storyteller with exceptional editorial judgment, strong organizational skills, and a passion for investigative reporting and true crime programming.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, research, and produce original longform stories for Dateline NBC.
  • Conduct extensive reporting, including interviews with sources, attorneys, law enforcement officials, experts, and key stakeholders.
  • Identify, cultivate, and maintain relationships with sources and potential interview subjects.
  • Write and edit scripts, teases, and promotional materials.
  • Collaborate with correspondents to shape story structure and editorial direction.
  • Plan and oversee field shoots, including interviews, as well as character and location b-roll.
  • Work closely with editors to craft visually compelling, accurate, and engaging stories.
  • Review court records, legal filings, police reports, and other source materials to verify facts and support reporting.
  • Coordinate with Standards, Legal, and Rights & Clearances teams to ensure compliance with NBC News policies and practices.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting production deadlines.
  • Contribute story ideas and editorial updates as cases develop.
  • Collaborate with digital, streaming, audio and promotional teams to extend storytelling across platforms.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience producing longform news, documentary, investigative, or true crime programming.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated experience reporting, researching, and producing complex stories.
  • Experience managing productions and production budgets from development through post-production.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills.
  • Experience conducting interviews with victims, families, attorneys, and law enforcement personnel, and on sensitive subject matter.
  • Must be willing to travel domestically as needed.
  • Must be willing to work in New York, NY or Los Angeles, CA.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Exceptional editorial judgment and journalistic integrity.
  • Strong knowledge of the criminal justice system, investigative journalism, and current events.
  • Ability to synthesize large volumes of information and identify compelling story angles.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize competing deadlines and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Familiarity with broadcast journalism guidelines, standards and ethics.

Additional Job Requirements:

  • Hybrid: This position requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week when not in the field. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $115,000 - $165,000

KVDA Telemundo San Antonio is seeking a Multiplatform Producer to join our award-winning team. The Multiplatform Producer will be responsible for successful coordination and execution of a newscast, other special programs as needed, content for all platforms including apps, social media accounts and streaming channels. This role will report to the Executive Producer.

We’re looking for someone who’s passionate about news, loves breaking news and has a creative vision for crafting live programs. You’ll work closely with managers to create innovative, up-to-the-minute content that resonates with our audiences. The ideal candidate loves to collaborate, wants to help lead a team, and is ready to take on new challenges to help us continue to grow.

Responsibilities

  • Understand and follow all Telemundo San Antonio News and NBC standards and ethics.
  • Responsible for multiple news cast production, content, and elements of the shows.
  • Responsible for being a strong communicator in the newsroom- talking with key stakeholders who will participate or provide content for that newscast (i.e. VP of News, Executive Producer, Managing Editor, anchors, Digital, MMJ's and production crews).
  • Coordinate Live Shots and Satellite Remotes during live newscasts.
  • Select, assign, write, and organize news stories. Write news scripts, headlines, teases and topicals.
  • Contribute story ideas, participate in daily coverage decisions and editorial meetings.
  • Must select stories, understand all the elements, and design a newscast that achieves the daily goal.
  • Knowledgeable on daily news events, awareness of past news events and know what news in the market.
  • Respond to breaking news with urgency and accuracy.
  • Develop special projects involving community and social content.
  • Work with Multimedia Journalists to improve story and presentation.
  • Work closely with VP. Of News, Executive Producer and Managing Editor on story/sweeps planning and coordination.
  • Complete discrepancy reports with detail and accuracy to help prevent future problems and cue sheet.
  • Support Talent with the creation of original digital content.
  • Contribute to the creation of video series for OTT, FAST and all platforms.
  • Understand newscast mission, station priorities and be familiar with all the platforms.
  • Leadership: take responsibility for own actions and take risks for the team and be a team player.
  • Be detail oriented, organized, and able to handle intense deadline pressure.

Basic Qualifications

  • Fluency in Spanish and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both languages
  • Minimum of 2 years producer experience
  • 1 year experience with writing and/or editing and/or producing daily video
  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism or media communication or equivalent experience products

  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States
  • Must be 18 years or older

  • Must be available to work overtime, evenings, weekends and holidays as needed or required
  • Must have a flexible schedule with ability to work multiple shift and willingness to travel and work long hours and on weekends and holidays with short notice

  • Team player mentality

Time Commitment: 40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need. 

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from New York, NY.

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in New York, NY.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Currently pursuing or recently pursuing studies in product design, human-centered design, interaction design, UX/UI design, or usability research.

  • Experience creating wireframes, interactive prototypes, or other design artifacts.

job.title: Product Manager
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Product Manager, Enterprise Data & AI will be part of our Enterprise Data + AI Product organization and will help turn business problems into products, solutions and experiences that create measurable value across NBCUniversal. 

This is a hands-on product builder role at the intersection of business, product, data and AI. The Product Manager will work directly with business and product teams to understand how they work, uncover meaningful problems and opportunities, connect those needs to our enterprise capabilities, and help move ideas from discovery through validation and adoption. 

The ideal candidate combines strong product judgment with business curiosity, technical fluency and a bias toward action. You should be equally comfortable talking with a business stakeholder, understanding how a data or AI capability works, shaping a use case, building or prototyping a solution with modern tools, developing a clear product story and determining whether the resulting experience is creating value. 

This is not a traditional Product Manager role centered solely on managing a feature backlog. It is a role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, operates with high ownership and uses technology… particularly AI, to shorten the distance between an idea and a meaningful business outcome. 

What you will own (day-to-day): 

  • Business discovery and stakeholder engagement to identify meaningful problems, opportunities and use cases 
  • Translation of business needs into clear product opportunities, hypotheses, outcomes and success measures 
  • Rapid prototyping and experimentation to make ideas tangible and accelerate learning 
  • Product positioning, demos, enablement and other go-to-market motions that drive understanding and adoption 
  • Voice of the Customer and product feedback loops that inform future priorities 
  • Adoption and business-value measurement for priority initiatives 
  • Clear communication between business, Product, Data, Engineering and AI teams 
  • AI-enabled ways of working that increase speed, quality and individual leverage 

Responsibilities: 

  • Business Discovery & Use-Case Development: Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across the enterprise, understand their workflows and proactively uncover problems, opportunities and unmet needs — including needs that may not initially be well articulated. 
  • Product Opportunity Development: Translate stakeholder needs into clear use cases, product opportunities, hypotheses and measurable outcomes; connect those opportunities to existing enterprise products and capabilities whenever possible. 
  • Build, Prototype & Validate: Use modern AI-assisted development, prototyping and workflow tools to rapidly bring ideas to life, test assumptions and create tangible experiences that accelerate learning and decision-making. 
  • Product Adoption & Enablement: Develop the positioning, demonstrations, enablement materials and engagement motions necessary to help stakeholders understand, adopt and successfully use enterprise products and capabilities. 
  • Voice of the Customer & Feedback Loops: Establish structured feedback loops using stakeholder input, qualitative insights, usage signals and business outcomes to identify friction, unmet needs and opportunities for improvement. 
  • Data & Success Measurement: Define and track appropriate measures of adoption, engagement and business value; use quantitative and qualitative data to tell a clear story and drive decisions. 
  • Product Strategy Partnership: Bring business, customer and adoption signal back to Product Managers and product leaders to help inform roadmap priorities, investment decisions and future portfolio direction. 
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner across Product Management, Product Operations, Engineering, Data, AI and business teams to determine the right path from opportunity to scalable solution without relying on formal authority. 
  • Translate Complexity into Clarity: Make sophisticated data, technology and AI capabilities understandable and actionable through clear product narratives, demos, executive-ready materials and reusable enablement assets. 
  • AI-Enabled Ways of Working: Apply AI throughout discovery, research, analysis, prototyping, documentation and workflow automation, while continually identifying new opportunities to increase organizational leverage and self-service. 

Primary Stakeholders: 

  • Product Managers and Product Operations teams across Enterprise Data + AI 
  • Engineering, Data and AI product teams 
  • Business teams that consume enterprise data, technology and AI products, including Marketing, Advertising, Analytics and other enterprise functions 
  • Executive leadership and business partners evaluating new capabilities and opportunities 
  • External technology partners and vendors, where appropriate 

Requirements:  

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. 
  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Strategy, technical Product Marketing, MarTech/AdTech, Solutions, Data/AI products, customer-facing technology or a related product and technology discipline. 
  • Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous customer or business problem from discovery through a clear product opportunity, solution or measurable outcome. 
  • Strong product judgment and customer-discovery skills, including the ability to challenge a stated request and uncover the underlying business need. 
  • Strong data fluency and comfort working with analytics, metrics, data products and technical concepts. 
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development, prototyping or automation tools to turn ideas into working prototypes, workflows or other tangible solutions. 
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling and actionable guidance for both technical and non-technical audiences. 
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership skills with demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority. 
  • Proven ability to operate independently, create structure from ambiguity and drive work from problem through outcome with minimal oversight. 
  • Excellent written, verbal and visual communication skills. 

Desired Characteristics:  

  • Experience with enterprise data platforms, MarTech, AdTech, identity, CRM, analytics, AI platforms or other data-intensive product environments. 
  • Experience with GitHub Copilot strongly preferred; experience with Claude Code, Cursor or similar AI development environments is also valuable. 
  • Experience building prototypes, lightweight applications, automations or agentic workflows without relying exclusively on an Engineering team. 
  • Experience developing product positioning, go-to-market strategies, demonstrations, enablement or adoption programs for technical products. 
  • Experience establishing Voice of the Customer, customer-success, product usage or adoption feedback loops. 
  • Familiarity with modern product and collaboration tools such as GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Figma and analytics/BI platforms. 
  • Builder mentality with a bias toward experimentation, learning and tangible outcomes over process for process’s sake. 
  • Intellectual curiosity and willingness to rapidly learn unfamiliar business and technical domains. 
  • Strong ownership mindset and follow-through; proactive driver who identifies gaps and moves work forward without waiting for perfect clarity. 
  • Ability to move fluidly between strategy and execution — from senior-level business conversations to hands-on building and problem solving. 

Additional Requirements:

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $110,000 - $145,000

  • You thrive working in a collaborative team environment

The NBC News Specials team is seeking a Production Assistant to support breaking news coverage and special programming. We are looking for a production assistant who is passionate about journalism, and thrives in a fast-paced, quickly changing and deadline-driven team environment.

  • Assist with multiple aspects of production including: compiling research for production team and talent, creating graphics and lower thirds during breaking news and special coverage, sourcing and editing video, research and compile visual elements for air
  • Help monitor social media and web for any breaking news or developments in long-term news stories
  • Work closely with other members of News Specials to research, select, and locate required footage for broadcast
  • Support the production team in the control room during live broadcasts
  • Work with automated systems to support shows as needed, including building rundowns, segments and writing intros to packages / other taped elements
  • Collaborate with other members of the Specials team to anticipate resources needed for major event coverage
  • Troubleshoot technical or logistical issues in real time to minimize on-air disruptions
  • Partner with technical, graphics, audio, and talent departments to maintain top-tier production quality
  • Produce live cut-ins, breaking news specials, and additional content as needed
  • Keep a constant eye on show rundowns to make sure all content including video and graphics are up-to-date, accurate and ready for air
  • Help research and fact check stories with speed and accuracy
  • At least 1 year of news production experience or internship-related experience at the network or cable news level
  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, Journalism, English, History or a related field of study
  • Strong news judgment and a keen interest in national and international news
  • Proficiency with automated control room systems and rundown tools–or clear aptitude to learn them quickly
  • Must maintain strong awareness of current events and proactively respond to emerging news stories as needed
  • Adhere to NBC News standards and practices
  • Self-starter who has demonstrated strong knowledge and interest in news and current events
  • Strong interpersonal and organizational skills
  • Experience with NewsConnect, Avid Media Central, Avid Interplay, VizRT graphics, iNews, Slack and/or similar editing and editorial technological systems
  • Proficiency with automated control-room systems and rundown tools–or clear aptitude to learn them quickly Long-term career aspirations to be in the production/editorial space
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Must be willing and able to work in person at 30 Rock five days a week, Monday thru Friday from 3pm-11pmET.

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to handle logistics in a live-news environment
  • Ability to remain calm and resourceful under pressure, with a proactive approach to challenges
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to coordinate across diverse production units
  • Collaborative team player dedicated to supporting editorial excellence

Media Group: The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.   

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Peacock Global Delivery: Playback Experience, Platform, & Advertising: The Global Delivery team works across business, product, design, engineering, data, operations, and quality assurance to support the delivery of product and technology capabilities for Peacock and other global direct-to-consumer applications. In this role, you will support Project and Program Managers working across Playback Experience, Playback Platform, and Advertising. These areas shape how audiences watch live and on-demand content, interact with the video player, experience advertising, and receive reliable playback across devices. You will gain exposure to the software development lifecycle and contribute to initiatives involving streaming, player experiences, accessibility, advertising, platform services, metadata, analytics, and playback performance. You will work with cross-functional teams and learn how technology initiatives progress from early planning through delivery.
  • Global Delivery, Portfolio Operations: The Project Coordinator Intern will provide project coordination and administrative support to the Portfolio Operations team within Global Delivery. The Portfolio Operations team partners closely with cross‑functional groups across the NBCUniversal Global Streaming organization to support the planning, coordination, and execution of new features and platform enhancements. The ideal candidate is a highly motivated self‑starter with strong organizational and time management skills, a willingness to learn, and the ability to adapt quickly to new tools and processes. This role offers hands‑on exposure to project management, administration and implementation of solutions using various SaaS tools, and delivery initiatives within a fast‑paced streaming environment. 
  • Technology Delivery, Project Management: The Project Management Intern, Technology Delivery, will support initiatives that enable content publication, metadata management, and operational tooling across NBCUniversal streaming products and technical systems. The intern will gain hands-on experience working with Content & Metadata Program Leads and cross-functional partners across Editorial, Operations, Product, Development, and QA to support project delivery, metadata quality, and continuous process improvement. This role provides a unique opportunity to learn how content, metadata, and technology platforms come together to power streaming experiences while developing foundational project management and technology delivery skills.

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program. 
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in New York, NY.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Interest in streaming media, digital products, advertising technology, application development, or project and program management.
  • Familiarity with, or willingness to learn, project and collaboration tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Airtable, Slack, and Microsoft 365.
  • Basic familiarity with Agile delivery, project planning, data analysis, or the software development lifecycle is helpful but not required.
  • Familiarity with generative AI or AI-enabled productivity tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, and an interest in using them responsibly.
  • An analytical mindset and willingness to use data and operational information to support problem-solving and decision-making.
  • Interest in project management methodologies and operational delivery models.
  • Familiarity with Atlassian tools (Jira and Confluence) for reporting, documentation, and site administration a plus. 
  • Familiarity with using Chat-based LLM’s for generating code.
  • Experience in a coding language such as Python or SQL is a plus. 
  • Interest in technology delivery, metadata management, content operations, streaming products, and digital experiences.

This position sits within Media Group Decision Sciences, a team with a charter to provide valuable insights that enable decision-making across NBCU’s TV networks, FAST channels, and Peacock. The role will traverse the many distribution avenues that put NBCUniversal’s content on screen in front of audiences. Key areas of focus include strategy for the company’s portfolio of FAST channels, as well as opportunistic partnership evaluation in streaming.

Role Overview

The Project Coordinator is a full-time position in NBCUniversal's Decision Sciences organization and provides administrative support to the SVP, Data Products and Science. The ideal candidate for this position has exemplary planning and time management skills and can organize and manage calendars, keeping scheduling operations running smoothly and efficiently. This individual will also be instrumental in helping to develop and manage team building and engagement activities. This position has visibility to the NBCU Executive Leadership team. Excellent written & verbal communication skills are required.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Calendar & Schedule Management: Proactively manage and coordinate the leader’s daily schedule, calendar, travel, and meetings (internal and external), ensuring flexibility and persistence in rescheduling as needed to meet changing priorities.
  • Communication & Liaison: Serve as the first point of contact for high volumes of communication (phone and email), determining the importance of requests and facilitating smooth, effective communication between the leader and senior management.
  • Meeting & Event Coordination: Lead the preparation and follow-up for meetings and events, including scheduling, AV setup, telepresence logistics, preparing presentations, agendas, materials, and coordinating food and drinks when necessary.
  • Document & File Management: Oversee department files, including electronic document systems, wikis, and project management tools, ensuring organized, accessible, and up-to-date records.
  • Office Administration: They will manage general office tasks, including ordering supplies, managing memberships and subscriptions, photocopying, faxing, and handling deliveries to support the smooth operation of the department.
  • Project Management & Special Assignments: Manage special projects and provide support to other department members as needed, acting as a backup for other assistants and coordinating with global Executive Assistants when required.
  • Confidentiality & Discretion: Handle confidential information with care and discretion, always maintaining trust and professionalism, and proactively managing relationships to ensure the SVP is fully supported.
  • Embody The Team Player Persona: Someone who can handle various personalities and situations effectively while serving as a positive role model for others. Additionally, fostering a fun and engaging workplace.
  • Previous experience (at least 1 year, including internships) in a support role, with a proven track record of managing complex schedules, travel arrangements, expenses, and meetings for senior leadership with precision and minimal error.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle and maintain confidential information with the utmost discretion, ensuring the privacy and trust of the senior stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including advanced skills in Outlook, Word, Excel, and strong PowerPoint capabilities for creating professional presentations and reports.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a professional demeanor, including excellent phone etiquette and in-person presence when interacting with internal and external stakeholders.

Additional Requirements

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.
  • This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. NBCUniversal est l’une des principales entreprises de médias et de divertissement au monde. Nous créons du contenu de calibre mondial que nous distribuons par l’entremise de notre portefeuille de films, de télévision et de services de diffusion en continu, et que nous faisons vivre dans nos destinations internationales de parcs thématiques, nos produits de consommation et nos expériences. Nous possédons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les secteurs du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de diffusion en continu haut de gamme financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des productions cinématographiques et des émissions de premier plan par l’intermédiaire de nos importants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi que des quatre studios de télévision internationaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs thématiques et des expériences de premier plan partout dans le monde par l’intermédiaire d’Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment Universal Orlando Resort, où se trouve Universal Epic Universe, ainsi qu’Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Visitez www.nbcuniversal.com pour obtenir plus d’information.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés où vivent et travaillent les membres de notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics. Nous avons une riche tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à ce que les membres de notre personnel aient l’occasion de contribuer à leurs communautés. Nous favorisons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et d’offrir une vaste gamme de contenus qui reflètent notre monde.

RESPONSIBILTIES

As a Senior AI Programmer, you are responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining advanced AI systems that deliver believable, responsive, and scalable in‑game behaviour. You work closely with designers, animators, and gameplay engineers to ensure AI supports the creative vision while meeting performance and stability requirements of an AAA production. You take ownership of complex AI features, contribute to technical direction, and help raise the overall quality of AI systems across the project.

  • Design and implement AI behaviours using systems such as behaviour trees, state machines, utility systems, and sensory frameworks.
  • Support designers in shaping NPC decision‑making by building flexible, data‑driven AI systems and tools.
  • Maintain, refactor, and improve existing AI code to ensure performance, stability, and memory efficiency.
  • Collaborate with gameplay, animation, and systems programmers to integrate AI seamlessly into gameplay mechanics.
  • Implement and optimize AI navigation, movement, perception, and decision‑making systems.
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and well‑documented code following established team standards.
  • Continuously profile, optimize, and refine AI systems for runtime performance and scalability.
  • Debug and troubleshoot complex AI‑related issues across gameplay, animation, and simulation layers.
  • Participate in playtests and reviews to identify AI behaviour issues, tuning opportunities, and edge cases.
  • Contribute to technical discussions and help guide the evolution of AI architecture and workflows.
  • Mentor junior and associate AI programmers through technical guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
  • Stay current with industry trends and best practices in game AI and apply relevant learnings to the project.

RESPONSABILITÉS

À titre de programmeur en IA senior, vous êtes responsable de la conception, de l’implémentation et de la maintenance de systèmes d’IA avancés permettant d’offrir des comportements en jeu crédibles, réactifs et évolutifs. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de conception, d’animation et de programmation de jouabilité afin de vous assurer que l’IA soutient la vision créative tout en répondant aux exigences de performance et de stabilité d’une production AAA. Vous prenez en charge des fonctionnalités d’IA complexes, contribuez à l’orientation technique et participez à l’amélioration de la qualité globale des systèmes d’IA à l’échelle du projet.

  • Concevoir et implémenter des comportements d’IA à l’aide de systèmes tels que les arbres de comportement, les machines à états, les systèmes d’utilité et les systèmes sensoriels.
  • Soutenir l’équipe de conception dans l’élaboration de la prise de décision des NPC en développant des systèmes et des outils d’IA flexibles et axés sur les données.
  • Maintenir, refactoriser et améliorer le code d’IA existant afin d’en assurer la performance, la stabilité et l’efficacité de l’utilisation de la mémoire.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes de programmation de jouabilité, d’animation et de systèmes afin d’intégrer l’IA de façon fluide aux mécaniques de jeu.
  • Implémenter et optimiser les systèmes de navigation, de mouvement, de perception et de prise de décision de l’IA.
  • Écrire du code efficace, maintenable et bien documenté, conformément aux normes établies par l’équipe.
  • Effectuer continuellement le profilage, l’optimisation et le peaufinage des systèmes d’IA afin d’assurer leur performance à l’exécution et leur évolutivité.
  • Déboguer et résoudre des problèmes complexes liés à l’IA dans les différentes couches de jouabilité, d’animation et de simulation.
  • Participer aux séances de test de jeu et aux revues afin de repérer les problèmes de comportement de l’IA, les possibilités d’ajustement et les cas limites.
  • Contribuer aux discussions techniques et aider à orienter l’évolution de l’architecture et des processus de travail liés à l’IA.
  • Accompagner les programmeurs et programmeuses en IA de niveaux junior et associé en leur offrant des conseils techniques, en effectuant des revues de code et en favorisant le partage des connaissances.
  • Se tenir au fait des tendances de l’industrie et des pratiques exemplaires en matière d’IA pour les jeux, et appliquer au projet les apprentissages pertinents.

QUALIFICATIONS

Basic Requirements:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • At least 6 years of professional experience in game programming, with shipped titles or equivalent production experience.
  • Strong proficiency in C++, with experience developing performance‑critical gameplay or AI systems.
  • Professional experience working with a game engine such as Unity, Unreal Engine, or a proprietary engine.
  • Solid understanding of AI concepts including behaviour trees, state machines, pathfinding, and decision‑making systems.
  • Excellent problem‑solving and debugging skills, with the ability to diagnose complex systemic issues.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Git or Perforce.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Passion for games and a strong understanding of gameplay and design principles.
  • Experience developing AI systems for large‑scale or AAA productions.
  • Experience with multiplayer or networked AI systems.
  • Experience with console game development.
  • Familiarity with performance profiling tools and optimization workflows.
  • A portfolio or examples showcasing completed projects or shipped titles.

QUALIFICATIONS

Exigences de base :

  • Diplôme en informatique, en génie logiciel ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.
  • Au moins 6 ans d’expérience professionnelle en programmation de jeux, notamment sur des titres commercialisés, ou expérience de production équivalente.
  • Excellente maîtrise du C++, avec de l’expérience dans le développement de systèmes de jouabilité ou d’IA où la performance est essentielle.
  • Expérience professionnelle avec un moteur de jeu tel que Unity, Unreal Engine ou un moteur propriétaire.
  • Solide compréhension des concepts d’IA, notamment les arbres de comportement, les machines à états, la recherche de chemin et les systèmes de prise de décision.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en résolution de problèmes et en débogage, avec la capacité de diagnostiquer des problèmes systémiques complexes.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et capacité à collaborer efficacement au sein d’équipes multidisciplinaires.
  • Expérience avec des systèmes de contrôle de version tels que Git ou Perforce.

Caractéristiques souhaitées :

  • Passion pour les jeux et solide compréhension des principes de jouabilité et de conception.
  • Expérience dans le développement de systèmes d’IA pour des productions à grande échelle ou AAA.
  • Expérience avec des systèmes d’IA multijoueur ou en réseau.
  • Expérience en développement de jeux sur console.
  • Connaissance des outils de profilage des performances et des processus d’optimisation.
  • Portfolio ou exemples présentant des projets réalisés ou des titres commercialisés.

Eligibility Requirements:

  • Interested candidates must apply to be considered.
  • Must be willing to work in our Montreal office a minimum of 4 days a week.
  • Must be willing to work overtime when required, in accordance with Quebec labor standards.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada.

Universal Products & Experiences Overview:

At Universal Products & Experiences (UP&E), we don’t just create products—we create a universe that fans can hold in their hands, wear, play, read, and experience every day. From Jurassic World’s roaring adventures to the playful charm of Minions and the timeless wonder of Back to the Future, we transform stories into unforgettable moments that spark joy across the globe.

UP&E has grown rapidly while keeping the energy, agility, and inventive spirit of a start‑up. Our mission is bold: to take imagination beyond the screen and into the real world through innovative products, immersive retail moments, and extraordinary theme park destinations. We bring both Universal-owned and third‑party worlds to life across expansive theme park destinations, e‑commerce platforms, live entertainment venues, and global retail partnerships—fueling fandom everywhere it lives. Whether it's iconic toys, fashion collaborations, books, collectibles, lifestyle products, or cutting‑edge video games, we work with world‑class licensees and creators to make our universe tangible.

Here, creativity meets technology, and strategy meets storytelling. We connect design, commercial excellence, and fan passion to deliver experiences that millions cherish—inside the parks and far beyond them. As part of Universal Destinations & Experiences, you’ll join a global team that thrives on collaboration, imagination, and the power of culture‑shaping ideas. Your work will inspire fans, uplift communities, and leave a lasting mark on entertainment history.

We believe in a workplace where every voice matters, every perspective is valued, and every colleague can shine. That’s how we strive to be an employer of choice for talent and a partner of choice for retailers, licensees, and creators who share our passion for world‑class storytelling. If you’re ready to bring imagination to life and create moments that resonate worldwide—your next adventure starts here.

Join us and help create moments that matter.

https://www.universalproductsexperiences.com/

 

Universal Products & Experiences is committed to attracting and retaining a diverse workforce of the highest caliber. We are committed to fostering equitable and inclusive environments that honor the experiences, perspectives, and uniqueness of each colleague.

It is the policy of NBCUniversal and NBCUniversal's affiliated businesses to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy) sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by applicable law.

 

Role Summary:

The Universal Brand Development Group is looking for a Senior Designer of Product Design Development for the UNIVERSAL PRODUCTS & EXPERIENCES Consumer Products division. As a Senior Designer, you will lead the creative development of apparel and fashion accessories, including bags, headwear, and footwear. Bringing over 4+ years of industry experience, you will enhance world-class IPs such as Jurassic World, Minions, and Shrek into trend-setting products. This role is a key creative position on the team, providing vital support to the Supervisor with technical expertise and ensuring smooth collaboration with licensees and internal stakeholders.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $90,000 - $105,000

Key Responsibilities

  • Fashion-Forward Concepting: Analyze and synthesize current market trends (streetwear, luxury, etc.) to develop innovative product concepts that merge character aesthetics with modern fashion. Pitch these creative directions to the Manager for alignment.
  • Trend Forecasting & Concept Development: Lead the translation of macro and micro fashion trends into cohesive, trend-led storytelling. Provide the technical and aesthetic foundation for apparel and accessory lines, ensuring every collection is anchored in seasonal relevance.
  • Design Direction: Provide detailed feedback to licensees based on fashion expertise—covering textiles, specialty construction, and graphic placement—to strongly support the Manager’s final approvals.
  • Style Guide: Flexibly adapt and expand Universal’s style guides for complex garment and accessory constructions to ensure they serve as high-utility design assets.
  • Licensee Communication & Submission Review: Manage daily creative workflows by reviewing licensee submissions via Lunchpad. Provide clear, actionable design feedback from concept to final sample, ensuring every product achieves a high-level balance between fashion-forward sensibility and IP brand consistency.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration Support: Under the Manager’s direction, partner closely with Category Management, Legal, and Franchise teams. Act as the design-side coordinator to help deliver competitive products to the retail market.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned to support the needs of the team.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • PORTFOLIO SUBMISSION GUIDLINES: Please submit a professional portfolio demonstrating a proven track record of translating fashion trends into compelling, character-driven licensed products with a sophisticated and commercially relevant aesthetic. Portfolios must showcase the full product development lifecycle, from concept to shelf, and include examples of sketches, trend research, graphics/logos, pattern and print development, overlays/redlines, technical design packages (tech packs), sampling iterations, and final produced products. All submitted work must be the candidate's original work, with clear examples of their individual design contributions.
  • Experience: 4+ years of senior-level design experience within the fashion industry (apparel, bags, footwear, etc.).
  • Technical Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Deep understanding of Fashion Tech Packs and a sharp eye for translating 2D graphics into 3D garment constructions.
  • Fashion Expertise: In-depth knowledge of fabric properties, washes, and embellishment techniques (embroidery, patches, screen printing). Exceptional color sense and material sourcing skills.
  • Communication: Ability to articulate design intent logically and professionally to support the Manager and facilitate consensus with external partners.
  • Proactive mindset to drive results.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and adaptable in a fast-paced environment.
  • Confident in advocating design decisions and collaborating toward shared goals.
  • Proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, and working knowledge of InDesign, Keynote, PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.

Additional Requirements:

  • Travel may be required
  • Perform other related duties as assigned to support the needs of the team
  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

We are seeking a Data Scientist with experience manipulating large tabular and user-behavior datasets. This role is centered on bridging the gap between raw data and high-quality machine learning inputs, requiring a blend of technical expertise and cross-functional leadership. 

Nous recherchons un(e) scientifique des données ayant de l’expérience dans l’exploitation de grands ensembles de données tabulaires et comportementales d’utilisateurs. Ce rôle vise à combler l’écart entre les données brutes et les entrées de haute qualité pour les modèles d’apprentissage automatique, en combinant expertise technique et leadership transversal.

Vous jouerez un rôle clé en veillant à ce que les données soient correctement structurées, validées et alignées avec les objectifs produit et d’apprentissage automatique, afin de permettre le développement de modèles robustes et évolutifs.

Responsibilities:

  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Work with partner ML and Product engineers and TPMs to spec out data and training requirements. 
  • Data Strategy & Pipeline Oversight: Ensure that datasets are correctly curated, filtered, and processed to meet the rigorous standards of production-level machine learning. 
  • Requirements Translation: Act as a technical translator, taking high-level project goals and turning them into actionable data specs for engineering and annotation teams. 
  • Quality Assurance & Analysis: Maintain high standards for data integrity, ensuring that the behavioral datasets used for training are representative and accurate. 

Responsabilités principales

  • Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Travailler avec les ingénieurs ML, les équipes Produit et les TPM pour définir les besoins en données et en entraînement.
  • Stratégie des données et supervision des pipelines : S’assurer que les ensembles de données sont correctement sélectionnés, filtrés et traités afin de répondre aux exigences des systèmes d’IA en production.
  • Traduction des besoins : Transformer des objectifs produit de haut niveau en spécifications de données concrètes et exploitables.
  • Assurance qualité et analyse : Maintenir des normes élevées de qualité des données en garantissant leur exactitude, leur représentativité et leur fiabilité.
  • Master's or Bachelor’s Degree or certification in Data Science or related computational sciences field.
  • 3+ years of relevant industry experience in a fast paced, high growth tech environment. Professional Experience: Proven experience as a Data Scientist in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Domain Context: Prior experience in industries with complex multi-disciplinary teams such as robotics, streaming services, game development, search engines, and eCommerce. 

Technical Proficiency 

  • Core Tools: Fluency with Python, Git, and the Unix shell. 
  • Ecosystem: Familiarity with collaborative tools such as Jira/Confluence, Slack, a Git server, and an experiment tracking framework. 
  • Data Visualization: Familiarity with data visualization and inspection tools specifically designed for user behavior. 
  • Fundamentals: Deep understanding of data science fundamentals and a strong mathematical background. 

Attributes 

  • Conscientiousness: High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. 
  • Communication: Ability to collaborate effectively across different engineering disciplines to define and execute technical requirements. 

Qualifications

  • Baccalauréat ou Maîtrise, ou certification en science des données ou dans un domaine connexe des sciences computationnelles.
  • Minimum de 3 ans d’expérience pertinente dans un environnement technologique dynamique et en forte croissance.
  • Expérience démontrée en tant que scientifique des données dans un environnement dynamique et en forte croissance.
  • Une expérience dans des secteurs multidisciplinaires complexes tels que la robotique, les plateformes de streaming, les jeux vidéo, les moteurs de recherche ou le commerce électronique est fortement valorisée.

Compétences techniques

  • Outils principaux : Maîtrise de Python, Git et des environnements Unix.
  • Écosystème : Familiarité avec des outils tels que Jira, Confluence, Slack, les workflows Git et les plateformes de suivi d’expériences.
  • Visualisation des données : Expérience avec des outils dédiés à la visualisation et à l’analyse des comportements utilisateurs.
  • Fondamentaux : Solides connaissances en statistiques, en science des données et en mathématiques.

Qualités recherchées

  • Rigueur : Grande attention aux détails et engagement envers la qualité et la précision des données.
  • Communication : Capacité à collaborer efficacement avec différentes équipes techniques et produit pour définir et exécuter les exigences techniques.

NBCUniversal is looking for a seasoned Senior Producer with experience in external development and publishing to help manage a portfolio of external teams for an ambitious new interactive entertainment initiative.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead production across multiple external development teams, establishing clear plans, milestones, budgets, review gates, and delivery expectations.
  • Serve as the primary production partner for external teams, ensuring strong communication, alignment, and accountability throughout development.
  • Own production workflows from onboarding and development through submission, review, approval, publishing, and post-launch support.
  • Partner with creative, product, engineering, business development, legal, and other teams to ensure external developers have what they need to succeed.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects while maintaining visibility into schedules, risks, dependencies, budgets, and portfolio health.
  • Establish and continuously improve processes for external development, submissions, publishing, and release management.
  • Identify and resolve issues affecting external teams, escalating cross-functional dependencies and critical decisions when necessary.
  • Incorporate feedback from external developers and creators into improvements to tools, workflows, and processes.
  • Help scale production operations to support a growing portfolio of external developers and creators.

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

NBCUniversal est à la recherche d’une personne chevronnée au poste de Producteur senior, possédant de l’expérience en développement externe et en publication, afin de contribuer à la gestion d’un portefeuille d’équipes externes dans le cadre d’une nouvelle initiative ambitieuse en divertissement interactif.

RESPONSABILITÉS 

  • Diriger la production auprès de plusieurs équipes de développement externes, en établissant des plans, des jalons, des budgets, des étapes de révision et des attentes claires en matière de livraison.
  • Agir à titre de principal partenaire de production auprès des équipes externes, en assurant une communication efficace, un bon alignement et une responsabilisation continue tout au long du développement.
  • Prendre en charge les flux de production, de l’intégration et du développement jusqu’à la soumission, la révision, l’approbation, la publication et le soutien après le lancement.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes de création, de produit, d’ingénierie, de développement des affaires, des affaires juridiques et d’autres équipes afin de veiller à ce que les équipes de développement externes disposent de tout ce dont elles ont besoin pour réussir.
  • Gérer plusieurs projets simultanément tout en maintenant une visibilité sur les échéanciers, les risques, les dépendances, les budgets et l’état global du portefeuille.
  • Établir et améliorer continuellement les processus de développement externe, de soumission, de publication et de gestion des mises en production.
  • Cerner et résoudre les problèmes touchant les équipes externes, et faire remonter, au besoin, les dépendances interfonctionnelles et les décisions critiques.
  • Intégrer la rétroaction des équipes de développement externes et des personnes créatrices afin d’améliorer les outils, les flux de travail et les processus.
  • Contribuer à faire évoluer les opérations de production afin de soutenir un portefeuille croissant d’équipes de développement externes et de personnes créatrices.

Basic Requirements:

  • 15+ years of production experience in video games or interactive entertainment.
  • Experience with UGC platforms, creator ecosystems, modding communities, or games with significant user-created content.
  • Significant experience managing external development, co-development, or outsourced game-development teams.
  • Experience taking games or interactive content from development through approval, publishing, launch, and post-launch operations.
  • Strong production-management and communication skills, with experience managing multiple teams, schedules, budgets, risks, and cross-functional dependencies.

Exigences de base

  • 15 ans ou plus d’expérience en production dans le domaine des jeux vidéos ou du divertissement interactif.
  • Expérience avec des plateformes de contenu généré par les utilisateurs (UGC), des écosystèmes de créateurs, des communautés de modding ou des jeux comportant une part importante de contenu créé par les utilisateurs.
  • Expérience significative dans la gestion d’équipes de développement externes, de codéveloppement ou de développement de jeux en sous-traitance.
  • Expérience dans l’accompagnement de jeux ou de contenu interactif, du développement jusqu’à l’approbation, la publication, le lancement et les opérations après le lancement.
  • Solides compétences en gestion de production et en communication, avec de l’expérience dans la gestion de plusieurs équipes, échéanciers, budgets, risques et dépendances interfonctionnelles.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience designing or operating submission, review, approval, publishing, or certification workflows.
  • Experience with live-service games or platforms supporting an evolving portfolio of content.
  • Familiarity with Unreal Engine or other modern game-development environments.
  • Experience building new external-development or publishing processes in a fast-moving environment.
  • A passion for helping external developers and creators deliver high-quality interactive experiences.
  • Great communication, collaboration, and presentation skills.

Caractéristiques souhaitées:

  • Expérience dans la conception ou l’exploitation de flux de travail liés à la soumission, à la révision, à l’approbation, à la publication ou à la certification.
