job.title: Senior Producer, NBC News Specials (Prime)
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The NBC News Breaking News Specials team seeks a seasoned Senior Producer to drive our primetime breaking news coverage and lead seamless live broadcasts during planned and unplanned major news events. You will lead editorial and operational execution when news breaks, ensuring broadcasts are fast, accurate, and compelling and work alongside the Specials team on a variety of news broadcasts and projects.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead live breaking-news coverage during major events
  • Coordinate with control-room staff, on-air talent, and field reporters
  • Make split-second editorial decisions that uphold accuracy and clarity
  • Serve as the primary editorial lead for weeknight coverage
  • Mentor and guide the editorial team
  • Collaborate with the Specials team on event planning and execution
  • Partner with technical, graphics, audio, and talent departments to maintain top-tier production quality
  • Produce live cut-ins, special programs, and additional content as needed for NBC Network and NBC News Now
  • Backfill Overnight team approx. 4-6 weeks a year, as lead editorial watch for breaking news between Nightly and Today
  • Minimum of 8 years in broadcast or cable news production, including 3 years on breaking news or live event teams
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent newsroom experience
  • Proven track record of rapid, accurate editorial judgment under deadline pressure
  • Expertise in control room operations from rundown creation through final sign-off
  • Proficiency with automated control room systems and rundown tools –– or clear aptitude to learn them quickly
  • Flexibility to work overnights, weekends, and be on call for urgent breaking events
  • Willingness and ability to work in person at 30 Rock five nights a week Monday-Friday 3pmET-11pmET

Desired Characteristics:

  • Steady under pressure: A composed and decisive leader who excels in fast-paced, high-stakes breaking news situations
  • Editorial excellence: Brings sharp editorial judgment and can guide a team through fast-moving, unpredictable live events
  • Clear communicator: Articulates direction with clarity and confidence –– both in writing and during live broadcasts
  • Collaborative mentor: Invested in nurturing emerging talent and fostering a culture of growth and teamwork

Additional Requirements:

  • Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $125,000 - $170,000 (bonus eligible)

job.title: Senior Product Manager, SAP GRC
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Senior Product Manager, SAP GRC is an integral part of the Corp Core Innovation & Operations organization, reporting directly to the Director, GRC. This role leads the strategy and execution of complex SAP security and access-governance initiatives across NBCU, using advanced functional and technical expertise to evaluate multiple variables, resolve complex problems, and enhance methods, systems, and tools. The Senior Product Manager serves as a subject matter expert for SAP GRC and security, provides technical guidance and oversight, drives architecture and design decisions, and ensures successful delivery of high-impact initiatives. The role also mentors and coaches associates, advises stakeholders on complex matters, adapts communication to influence audiences across the broader business, and may be accountable through the team for delivery of tactical business targets.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the implementation, configuration, and continuous improvement of SAP GRC Access Control (AC) and Identity and Access Governance (IAG) modules, ensuring successful execution across complex, interdependent workstreams.
  • Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) security concepts, including identity authentication, authorization, role collections, destination security, and integration with enterprise identity providers.
  • Working knowledge of SAP Joule and AI-enabled SAP solutions, with an understanding of security, access governance, data privacy, and responsible AI considerations in SAP environments.
  • Ability to support security design for SAP BTP extensions, Fiori applications, cloud integrations, and AI-driven business processes across SAP S/4HANA and connected systems.
  • Familiarity with securing and governing emerging SAP capabilities such as Joule, generative AI, workflow automation, and cloud application services within SAP’s security and compliance framework.
  • Lead collaboration with architecture, application, engineering, business, and compliance teams to evaluate and implement secure access models for SAP BTP, AI services, and intelligent automation solutions; provide technical guidance and drive architecture and design decisions.
  • Design and implement role-based access controls (RBAC), firefighting, and segregation of duties (SoD) rules to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and company policies.
  • Build and maintain a network of key contacts across and beyond the immediate area of expertise; influence senior stakeholders, adapt communication style, and use persuasion to translate business needs into scalable technical specifications and delivery priorities.
  • Recommend new SAP GRC features and functionality, security technologies, tools, and practices to improve the organization's risk and compliance posture.
  • Own and evolve SAP GRC strategies, policies, roadmaps, standards, and procedures; break down complex problems and identify opportunities to enhance methods, systems, and tools.
  • Serve as the SAP GRC and security subject matter expert, applying deep domain specialization to frequently advise product, engineering, architecture, audit, compliance, and business teams on complex matters.
  • Lead complex projects with multiple variables and dependencies, establish clear delivery outcomes, provide technical oversight, proactively manage risks, and remain accountable through the team for achievement of tactical business targets.
  • Mentor and coach product, security, and technical associates, strengthening domain capability, technical judgment, and consistent application of SAP security and governance standards.
  • Exercise independent judgment on product, architecture, control, and delivery decisions that can affect the broader area of contribution, balancing business value, technical feasibility, compliance, and risk.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., SOX, GDPR) and industry standards.
  • Exposure to other GRC products like SAP IAG, SAP BIS, SAP Audit Management, and Process Controls.       
  • Develop and maintain GRC workflows, including access request, approval, and review processes.
  • SAP GRC integration with SAP Analytics Cloud, Success Factors, SAP BTP, SAP HANA, Fieldglass, AD, etc.
  • Conduct detailed assessments of existing access controls and authorization processes to identify gaps and risks.
  • Designs, develops and maintains the company’s SAP user management and security architecture across multiple SAP environments in addition to providing solution recommendations
  • Analyze & understand the current Roles and Access Restrictions from Audit standpoint and synchronize with existing GRC access management solution to provide a risk-free environment
  • Maintaining, managing and monitoring compliance with the SAP IT Security framework; tracking Internal Security Control (ISC) gaps and exceptions for the global IT control environment
  • Commitment to upholding government and corporate security guidelines including Segregation of Duties (SoD), Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) and Privacy related standards
  • Assist with the development and implementation of SAP security policies, processes, architecture, training, and communications.
  • Identify security solutions, implement standards and best practices, proactively identify and remediate vulnerabilities
  • Responsible for managing Security for SAP ERP, SAP BW, Fiori, Gateway, SAP S/4, SAP HANA Implementation in accordance with SAP Security Strategy and Administration/Troubleshooting the complex SAP Security Issues
  • In partnership with solution architects and the business process owners, translate business requirements into the SAP Security design and maintenance of the SAP Security Roles in SAP Systems

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 10+ years of experience in SAP Security, SAP GRC, Identity and Access Management, or related SAP security disciplines.
  • Strong knowledge of the SAP Authorization Concept, including roles, profiles, authorization objects, user administration, and troubleshooting authorization issues.
  • Hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining SAP security roles and authorizations across SAP S/4HANA, MDG, BW4HANA, SAC, CIS/BTP environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of SAP GRC Access Control, including Access Risk Analysis (ARA), Access Request Management (ARM), Business Role Management (BRM), Emergency Access Management (EAM/Firefighter), and MSMP workflows.
  • Experience performing Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis, security risk assessment, remediation, and mitigation.
  • Experience supporting SAP security implementations, upgrades, migrations, and production environments.
  • Knowledge of application security concepts across ABAP, SAP HANA, Fiori, and related SAP technologies.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills with the ability to resolve complex SAP security and authorization issues.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business, functional, technical, audit, and compliance teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities in a complex enterprise environment.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to learn quickly and adapt to changing technologies and business priorities.

Desired Characteristics:

  • 12+ years of experience as an SAP Security and/or SAP GRC professional, preferably in large, complex enterprise environments.
  • Demonstrated leadership of at least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including architecture and design decisions, cross-functional delivery, risk management, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Preferred experience with 3 to 5 full lifecycle SAP Security/GRC implementations, particularly across SAP S/4HANA, and SAP GRC Access Control/Process Control 12.x.
  • Deep expertise in one or more SAP Security/GRC domains with demonstrated credibility as a Subject Matter Expert (SME).
  • Experience designing SAP security architecture and authorization models for SAP S/4HANA and Fiori, including business roles, catalogs, spaces/pages, OData services, and backend authorization requirements.
  • Experience with SAP HANA security, including database roles, privileges, and integration with application-level security.
  • Experience with SAP cloud security technologies such as SAP BTP, SAP Cloud Identity Services / IAS and IPS, SAP IAG, and SAP Analytics Cloud, where applicable.
  • Experience integrating SAP security with enterprise Identity and Access Management and Privileged Access Management solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentor and coach team members, and establish security standards and best practices across cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to translate complex SAP security, SoD, and compliance issues into business risks and recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Experience partnering with Internal Audit, External Audit, SOX, Compliance, Cybersecurity, and Risk Management teams.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate multiple variables, resolve ambiguous issues, and recommend pragmatic solutions.
  • Strategic thinker capable of aligning SAP Security and GRC architecture with broader cybersecurity, IAM, compliance, and business strategy.
  • SAP Security, SAP GRC, cybersecurity, IAM, or related professional certifications are preferred.

Additional Requirements: 

  • Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $130,000 - $170,000 (bonus eligible)

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. 

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access nbcunicareers.com as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by emailing AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

For LA County and City Residents Only:  NBCUniversal will consider for employment  qualified applicants with criminal histories, or arrest or conviction records, in a manner  consistent with relevant legal requirements, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative For Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable.

job.title: Senior Programmer - Tools | Programmeur senior - Outils
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal est l’une des principales entreprises mondiales dans les secteurs des médias et du divertissement. Nous créons du contenu de calibre mondial que nous distribuons par l’intermédiaire de notre portefeuille de marques de cinéma, de télévision et de diffusion en continu, et auquel nous donnons vie dans nos destinations internationales de parcs thématiques, nos produits de consommation et nos expériences. Nous possédons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo et Peacock, notre service haut de gamme de diffusion en continu financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des productions cinématographiques et des émissions de premier plan par l’intermédiaire de nos importants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi que les quatre studios de télévision internationaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs thématiques et des expériences de premier plan partout dans le monde par l’intermédiaire d’Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment Universal Orlando Resort, où se trouve Universal Epic Universe, et Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Visitez www.nbcuniversal.com pour obtenir plus d’information.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés où vivent et travaillent les membres de notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics. Nous avons une longue tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à offrir aux membres de notre personnel la possibilité de contribuer à leurs communautés. Nous favorisons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et d’offrir une vaste gamme de contenus qui reflètent notre monde.

RESPONSIBILTIES

As a Senior Tools Programmer, you are responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining tools that support efficient content creation and development. Your work spans Unreal Engine editor tools and standalone desktop applications, enabling teams to iterate quickly and safely on an AAA production. You take ownership of complex tools and contribute to the long‑term evolution of tools technology and workflows.

  • Design, implement, and maintain tools, editor extensions, and standalone desktop applications.
  • Build Unreal Engine editor tools using C++, Slate, Editor Utility Widgets, or equivalent systems.
  • Develop standalone tools using frameworks such as Qt, .NET / WPF, or similar technologies.
  • Collaborate closely with end‑users to understand workflow needs and translate them into practical, user‑friendly tools.
  • Integrate tools with engine systems, asset pipelines, data processing, and automation workflows.
  • Build automation and utilities using Python, C#, or command‑line tools where appropriate.
  • Maintain and improve existing tools to ensure performance, stability, and usability.
  • Debug complex tools issues involving editor systems, file I/O, data validation, and external integrations.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well‑documented code following established team standards.
  • Collaborate with other engineers to ensure tools scale with project complexity.
  • Contribute to technical discussions and provide input on tools architecture and workflow improvements.
  • Mentor junior programmers through technical guidance and code reviews.

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

À titre de programmeur senior - Outils, vous êtes responsable de la conception, de l’implémentation et de la maintenance d’outils favorisant une création de contenu et un développement efficaces. Votre travail couvre les outils d’édition d’Unreal Engine ainsi que les applications de bureau autonomes, permettant aux équipes d’itérer rapidement et de façon sécuritaire dans le cadre d’une production AAA. Vous prenez en charge des outils complexes et contribuez à l’évolution à long terme des technologies et des workflows liés aux outils.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Concevoir, implémenter et maintenir des outils, des extensions d’éditeur et des applications de bureau autonomes.
  • Développer des outils d’édition pour Unreal Engine à l’aide de C++, Slate, Editor Utility Widgets ou de systèmes équivalents.
  • Développer des outils autonomes à l’aide de frameworks tels que Qt, .NET / WPF ou des technologies similaires.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les personnes qui utilisent les outils afin de comprendre leurs besoins en matière de workflows et de les traduire en outils pratiques et conviviaux.
  • Intégrer les outils aux systèmes du moteur, aux pipelines d’assets, au traitement des données et aux workflows d’automatisation.
  • Développer des automatisations et des utilitaires à l’aide de Python, C# ou d’outils en ligne de commande, selon les besoins.
  • Maintenir et améliorer les outils existants afin d’en assurer la performance, la stabilité et la convivialité.
  • Déboguer des problèmes complexes liés aux outils, notamment aux systèmes d’édition, aux entrées/sorties de fichiers, à la validation des données et aux intégrations externes.
  • Rédiger du code propre, maintenable et bien documenté, conformément aux normes établies par l’équipe.
  • Collaborer avec les autres membres de l’équipe d’ingénierie afin de veiller à ce que les outils puissent évoluer en fonction de la complexité du projet.
  • Contribuer aux discussions techniques et formuler des recommandations concernant l’architecture des outils et l’amélioration des workflows.
  • Accompagner les programmeurs juniors en leur offrant des conseils techniques et en participant aux revues de code.

Basic Requirements: 

  • Strong proficiency in C++, with experience developing tools or editor‑focused systems.
  • At least 6–8 years of professional experience in game programming, with shipped titles or equivalent production experience.
  • Professional experience with Unreal Engine, including editor and tools development.
  • Strong understanding of tools development, data workflows, and content pipelines.
  • Excellent problem‑solving and debugging skills.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Perforce or Git.

   Exigences de base : 

  • Solide maîtrise du C++, avec une expérience en développement d’outils ou de systèmes axés sur les éditeurs.
  • Au moins de 6 à 8 ans d’expérience professionnelle en programmation de jeux, avec des titres commercialisés ou une expérience de production équivalente.
  • Expérience professionnelle avec Unreal Engine, notamment en développement d’éditeurs et d’outils.
  • Solide compréhension du développement d’outils, des workflows de données et des pipelines de contenu.
  • Excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes et en débogage.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication et capacité à collaborer efficacement avec différentes disciplines.
  • Expérience avec des systèmes de contrôle de version tels que Perforce ou Git.

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Experience building standalone desktop tools using Qt, .NET, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience with Python for scripting, automation, and tooling glue.
  • Exposure to web‑enabled tools (internal dashboards, REST services, Electron‑based apps).
  • Familiarity with asset validation, automation, and build workflows.
  • A passion for improving developer workflows and productivity.

Caractéristiques recherchées : 

  • Expérience dans le développement d’outils de bureau autonomes à l’aide de Qt, .NET ou de frameworks similaires.
  • Expérience avec Python pour le scripting, l’automatisation et l’intégration d’outils.
  • Expérience avec des outils intégrant des technologies Web (tableaux de bord internes, services REST, applications basées sur Electron).
  • Connaissance de la validation des assets, de l’automatisation et des workflows de build.
  • Passion pour l’amélioration des workflows et de la productivité des équipes de développement.

Eligibility Requirements:

  • Interested candidates must apply to be considered.
  • Must be willing to work in our Montreal office a minimum of 4 days a week.
  • Must be willing to work overtime when required, in accordance with Quebec labor standards.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada.
  • Must be willing to travel for work related business, if necessary

Conditions d’admissibilité :

  • Les personnes intéressées doivent soumettre leur candidature afin d’être prises en considération.

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.

As a member of the Global Video Engineering – Live team, you will play a key role in delivering the quality and reliability of the live encoding and packaging space, ensuring consistency and quality against KPI. You will build solutions, test integrations, document workflows, assist in deployments, and monitor performance, working with the technical operations group and other technical teams to ensure consistent 24x7 monitoring. You will work closely with key vendors, developing solutions side by side, and you will embrace diversity as part of an inclusive and flexible workplace.

Primarily you will:

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance software systems and features, primarily using Go, to support large-scale video streaming platforms such as Peacock and NOW/WOW.
  • Build and maintain live and linear video streaming pipelines using in-house and third-party tools, focusing on video encoding, packaging, and content delivery.
  • Support live events and linear channels, helping ensure reliable and high-quality streaming experiences.
  • Collaborate with Engineering Managers and Principal Engineers to develop solutions that improve video delivery and enhance audio and video quality.
  • Work closely with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams to build reliable, scalable, and resilient services across multiple regions.
  • Monitor system performance using metrics, logs, and traces to identify issues, troubleshoot problems, and improve service reliability.
  • Manage and maintain cloud-based services and content delivery systems.
  • Continuously improve code quality, system performance, and development processes.

What’s in it for you?

  • Working for a well-known, globally leading Media Streaming organization
  • Exposure to high-level business professionals in a variety of departments and geographic locations
  • Opportunity to work and grow your career in fast-paced environment
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • 5+ years’ experience in software development and web technologies.
  • Proficiency with languages such as Java, Go, Python, JavaScript
  • Experience in building real-time, large-scale, low latency distributed systems
  • Understands CI/CD pipelines and large-scale deployment
  • Deep understanding of OO Design Principles and Patterns.
  • Embrace open-source technologies
  • Technical experience with cloud-based technologies, specifically within architecture/infrastructure (AWS)
  • Understanding of TDD, ATDD and BDD and approaches
  • Understanding of containerization as it relates to Cloud (Kubernetes, Docker)
  • Key understanding of technology principles and work methods (Agile, Scrum, etc.)

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. Salary range: $105,000 - $145,000

job.title: Software Engineer, Roku
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.

We're looking for a Roku Software Engineer to own and evolve our Roku channel, from the SceneGraph UI layer down to the playback pipeline and the APIs that feed it. Roku is one of the largest surfaces in our streaming footprint, and it's also the most constrained: the same channel has to feel fast on a top-tier Roku Ultra and on a five-year-old Roku Express with a fraction of the memory.

This role is for someone who treats those constraints as the interesting part of the job. You'll be measuring texture memory and node counts, chasing down rebuffer events in HLS manifests, and working with backend teams to shape the microservice responses that make a channel launch in under two seconds instead of six.

  • Design, build, and ship features in BrightScript and SceneGraph, with a strong bias toward maintainable, well-factored component architecture rather than monolithic screens.
  • Own video playback quality end to end: startup time, ABR behavior, seek responsiveness, trick play, DRM handshakes, and graceful failure and recovery.
  • Profile and tune channel performance against real device constraints: memory ceilings on legacy hardware, render thread contention, task node usage, image and texture budgets, and cold-start latency.
  • Instrument and act on QoE telemetry (startup time, rebuffer ratio, exit-before-video-start, bitrate distribution), and drive those numbers down over time.
  • Partner with backend teams to define and refine the microservice and BFF APIs that power the channel: catalog, playback authorization, entitlement, continue-watching, recommendations, and search.
  • Implement and maintain Roku platform integrations: deep linking, Roku Search and content feeds, Continue Watching, Roku Pay / Instant Signup, and the Roku Advertising Framework.
  • Build and maintain internal tooling and automation scripts in JavaScript/TypeScript: build and packaging steps, feed and manifest validators, release utilities, device-farm and smoke-test harnesses, and whatever else removes manual toil from the team's day.
  • Own the channel's CI/CD pipeline: automated builds, test execution, static analysis, artifact packaging, sideloading to test devices, and promotion through environments. You treat pipeline code as real code, with the same review and maintenance standards.
  • Shepherd releases through Roku channel certification, including performance and memory requirements, and manage the beta-to-production promotion process.
  • Establish and uphold engineering standards: code review, automated testing, static analysis, and clear documentation.
  • Debug production issues across the stack using the Roku debug console, profiler, ECP, and network capture, and turn root causes into durable fixes.
  • 3+ years of software engineering experience, including shipping production Roku channels with BrightScript and SceneGraph.
  • Demonstrated experience with performance tuning on constrained devices. You can talk specifically about a time you cut memory usage, reduced startup latency, or eliminated frame drops, and how you measured it.
  • Strong grounding in software engineering best practices: separation of concerns, testability, meaningful abstractions, code review discipline, and refactoring as a habit rather than a project.
  • Hands-on experience with video playback and streaming formats: HLS and/or DASH, adaptive bitrate behavior, manifest structure, buffering strategy, and DRM (Widevine and PlayReady on Roku).
  • Practical experience consuming and integrating with RESTful APIs in a microservice architecture, including pagination, caching, retry and backoff strategies, error contracts, and versioning.
  • Working proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript (Node.js) for internal tooling and build automation. You can write a maintainable CLI or script that other engineers will actually use, not just a one-off.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, CircleCI, or similar), including automated testing, build artifacts, and multi-environment deployment.
  • Comfort with debugging tooling and telemetry: you're at home in a debug console, a profiler, and a dashboard.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, especially when explaining tradeoffs to non-client engineers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with the Node-based Roku toolchain: BrighterScript, Rooibos (or another BrightScript test framework), roku-deploy, and ropm.
  • Experience with reusable workflow patterns, composite actions, or shared pipeline libraries across multiple repositories.

  • Familiarity with SSAI/CSAI, VAST/VMAP, and ad-supported playback flows.

  • Background in another living-room platform (tvOS, Android TV / Fire TV, Vizio, Tizen, or webOS), and an understanding of where Roku differs.

  • Experience with CDNs, edge caching, and manifest manipulation.

  • Familiarity with QoE analytics platforms such as Conviva, Mux, or Datadog RUM.

  • Experience defining backend contracts (REST or GraphQL) alongside server teams rather than just consuming them.

  • Accessibility experience: captions, audio description, and voice navigation on TV platforms.

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $105,000 - $145,000

What the VOD Workflows team does

  • The Video on Demand (VOD) Workflows team is responsible for the automated media pipeline delivering VOD content to NBCUniversal’s streaming platforms
  • Troubleshoots issues arising in the VOD workflow and during VOD Playback.
  • Configures encoding of video, audio, and subtitles for delivery across various platforms/devices.
  • Research new technologies and innovations in the stream media industry for use in our system
  • Collaborates with Operations, Player, and Client teams to drive innovation and improvements in video delivery.

Role Responsibilities

  • Manage and maintain cloud-based content delivery and services, primarily on AWS.
  • Work with vendors and the Media Engineering team to define clear requirements, deploy media-processing changes, and identify and resolve defects.
  • Work independently and collaboratively, with transparency, autonomy, and a commitment to quality in assignments of every size.

  • Proficiency in Go; Python experience is preferred
  • Experience with web technologies, digital video workflows and operations, and video technology development
  • Applied experience designing and building cloud-based systems, particularly on AWS
  • Strong software design skills, including system decomposition, API and data-contract design, scalability, reliability, and maintainability
  • Experience with specification-driven development, translating requirements and technical designs into testable implementation plans
  • Hands-on experience building AI agents and agentic workflows, including tool integration, orchestration, guardrails, observability, and human-in-the-loop controls, is highly preferred.
  • Experience designing agentic workflows, including tool integration, orchestration, guardrails, observability, and human-in-the-loop controls
  • Understanding of Agile and Scrum principles and the ability to contribute effectively within a large development program and rapid delivery cycles
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, problem-solving, debugging, and decision-making skills
  • Ability to work autonomously while maintaining an open, collaborative approach
  • Commitment to quality and attention to detail in assignments of every size
  • Interest in fostering an inclusive team culture in which engineers from diverse backgrounds can grow

job.title: Software Engineering Internships – Summer 2027
job.description:
Your future in media starts here. The NBCUniversal Summer Internship Program is your chance to help shape what’s next in media and entertainment. Whether you’re supporting major news coverage, creating content for iconic brands, or contributing to innovative projects, you’ll bring your ideas, creativity, and perspective to make an impact throughout your internship.

Beyond your day-to-day role, you’ll take part in a thoughtfully designed program focused on career development, building your professional presence, and growing your workplace confidence. Through real-world experience and a community of fellow interns, you’ll explore what’s possible in this ever changing and exciting industry.

In addition to all of our internships being paid, we will also offer the following for our Summer 2027 interns:   

  • Paid company holidays for full-time interns.  
  • Robust networking, learning and development opportunities.
  • Complimentary Peacock subscription during your internship.
  • Free admission to Universal Parks to use during your internship.
  • Access to mental health resources including counseling sessions.
  • Financial assistance to offset expenses for transportation and housing may be available on a needs-based basis for eligible in-person interns. More details about eligibility for this assistance will be provided at the time of offer. 

Summer 2027 Program Details

Program Dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027

Time Commitment: 40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need. 

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from New York, NY.

Summer 2027 Recruitment Timeline

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)  

Mid November – Late December: First round video interviews   

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews  

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers  

To Apply:

  • Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year.
  • Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below).
  • Upload a transcript (unofficial transcripts are fine) that confirms your status as an actively enrolled student in a degree-granting program.

NBC News: More Americans watch NBC News than any news organization in the world. NBC News’ leading and award-winning television news broadcasts include TODAY, NBC Nightly News, Meet the Press, and Dateline NBC. The rapidly-growing NBC News Digital Group – including its streaming news services NBC News NOW and TODAY All Day – and the network’s award-winning original podcast and audio unit provide continuous content to consumers wherever they are, whenever they want it. 

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • NBC News Mobile App Development: The team is responsible for designing, developing and testing NBC News’s flagship Android/iOS applications. The intern will be working on native mobile applications across all the NBC News brands and collaborate with developers, product and project management in shipping out features. The intern will be mentored by senior developers in the team and will be guided in their work. The intern will be working on various team initiatives following engineering best practices and writing quality code.
  • NBC News Digital, Software Engineering: As a Software Engineer Intern, you will partner with the Product, Operations, Design, and Editorial teams to bring NBC News Digital content to life. You will be a significant influence on our product roadmap, bringing a technical and strategic perspective. You will work alongside fellow inspired developers in a fast-paced environment using technologies like Sass, React.js and GraphQL to help shape the future of digital news.

 

Media Group: The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.   

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Global Video Engineering, Video-On-Demand SRE: The Jupiter SRE Team is a SRE Team that is embedded as part of the Video on Demand (VOD) team in the Global Video Engineering Group. The VOD team is a mix of software engineers and video engineers, that define and maintain the VOD workflow (The Path a piece of content follows to get on to the streaming Platform).  The SRE Team is responsible for deploying and maintaining availability of all Infrastructure and applications that are part of this workflow. Currently the VOD team uses a mixture of vendor and in house-built applications to implement this workflow. However, we are in the middle of an exciting transition bringing many of these workflows in-house and therefore this internship is an exciting opportunity to get real world exposure to all the work necessary to get content ready for streaming.
  • Global Delivery, Quality Engineering: Our Global Quality Engineering Team is responsible for broad scale of quality by testing integrated systems and the client applications focused on delivering flawless experience for our customers. Our teams analyse requirements, create test plans and perform feature testing for Peacock & all of its propositions which includes backend integration of components and application front end across all the major device platforms. Our goal is to educate the interns on Software Development Life Cycle and importance of Software Quality Assurance.
  • Video-On-Demand Engineering, Workflows: The VOD Engineering team is hiring a summer intern to join the VOD Workflows team, which builds and supports the automated media pipeline that delivers video-on-demand (VOD) content to NBCUniversal’s streaming platforms. The intern will work with engineers on business-critical video workflows and cloud services. They will gain exposure to how the team troubleshoots VOD workflows and playback and configures encoding for video, audio, and subtitles across platforms. Day to day, the work is scoped and guided: contributing to the pipeline, learning how media-processing and cloud delivery systems are operated, and helping improve them.
  • Peacock, Live, Play, and DAI: Global Video Engineering’s Live, Play, and DAI group builds and runs the systems behind Peacock’s live events, video playback, and direct ad insertion. These are the paths viewers hit when they watch a live game, press play, and see an ad. The work is user-facing and revenue-critical, and it has to stay up while millions of people are watching at once. The group is organized as product engineering teams with embedded Site Reliability Engineers. Live covers event orchestration, encoding, and distribution. Play covers playback, and the services that get a stream to the device. DAI covers ad decisioning and inserting ads into live and on-demand video. SREs sit with those teams and own reliability across the stack: AWS, Kubernetes, networking, the application, and the telemetry that shows whether it is healthy. An intern will work with engineers who ship code and operate what they ship. They see how a live event is prepared and run, how an ad decision becomes a break in the stream, and how playback failures show up in metrics, logs, and traces. They will contribute to real systems with a focus on improving reliability, performance, observability, and automation that removes repetitive operational work.
  • Global Streaming Tech, Live Play & DAI: Our Backend Video Engineering team builds and maintains the technology that powers video content and advertising delivery across NBCUniversal’s digital platforms. The team develops scalable backend services and APIs using Go (Golang), helping ensure reliable and efficient video experiences for audiences. Interns will gain hands-on exposure to backend software engineering while collaborating with experienced engineers and learning how large-scale video systems are designed, developed, tested, and maintained.

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program. 
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in New York, NY.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Infrastructure as Code – Exposure to CloudFormation or Terraform etc.
  • Proficiency with Python and/or Go, JavaScript, Java or related programming languages.
  • Basic AI Knowledge – Exposure to generating Code and Docs with LLMs management tools.
  • Knowledge or experience in testing Mobile applications on both Android and iOS platforms.
  • Knowledge or experience working in an Agile development environment.
  • Knowledge or experience in Automation and GenAI.
  • Exposure to cloud systems, particularly AWS, or to workflow, ETL, or data-pipeline concepts, Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with Git and a CI system, and comfort reading an existing codebase before changing it.
  • Exposure to observability (Prometheus, Grafana, or similar) or to debugging with logs and metrics.
  • Working knowledge of Linux and basic networking (DNS, HTTP, load balancers, TLS).
  • Interest in video streaming, advertising technology, or large-scale distributed systems.
  • Basic understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, and Git.

The hourly rate for student interns is $30.00 for roles within Media Group.

The hourly rate for student interns is $40.00 for roles within News Group.

The role:

  • Supports the Talent & Organizational Development team to build leaders, strengthen teams, AI enablement, and help the Media Group navigate change.
  • Gathers and analyzes workforce, talent, and skills information, then turns it into clear insights for HR partners and business leaders.
  • Works on team-led projects and client-facing initiatives, with some administrative support for the VP.

What you’ll do:

  • Coordinate and assist facilitation for workshops, programs, and learning sessions.
  • Support talent planning and performance processes, such as talent review and calibration.
  • Create participant materials, facilitator guides, and communications that are clear and polished.
  • Work with vendors and subject matter experts on program design and delivery.
  • Track participation and feedback, and keep program records accurate.
  • Stay current on AI tools and bring practical ideas to the team.
  • Help build and test AI-enabled workflows, including reporting and summaries.
  • Pull together external information, such as industry reports, talent trends, and how other companies approach leadership development and talent practices.
  • Combine internal data from surveys, feedback, and processes to spot patterns, gaps, and opportunities.
  • Turn findings into report outs to tell a clear story to non-experts.
  • Update and maintain shared information systems (One Drive, SharePoint, etc.) for team use for current work, archives, research, summaries, reporting, and more.
  • Coordinate the VP’s calendar and prepare and submit expense reports.
  • Handle sensitive information with discretion.

What you’ll bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Organizational Psychology, Human Resources, Social Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in talent development, organizational development, HR, learning, or people analytics.
  • Experience supporting or delivering workshops, program development, or talent processes.
  • Experience creating clear learning or training materials, such as guides, job aids, or presentations.
  • Research and analysis skills, including working with survey data and summarizing findings.
  • Solid skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, and comfort with virtual tools like Teams and Microsoft 365.
  • Clear writing and proofreading skills, and the ability to explain complex ideas simply.
  • Solid project management and the ability to juggle several priorities.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools at work, and curiosity about learning more.
  • Exceptional customer service and communication skills.

Preferred:

  • Master’s degree or higher in Organizational Psychology, Organizational Development, or related field.
  • Experience with survey platforms, qualitative analysis, or dashboards such as Power BI.
  • Experience with simple automations or AI workflows, such as Power Automate or Copilot/Copilot Studio.
  • Experience in media or entertainment.

How you work:

  • Curious, consultative, and collaborative.
  • Able to turn data into simple stories.
  • Discreet with confidential information.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and a fast pace.

We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Summary

This position is responsible for leading the Sourcing and Procurement functions for Universal Studios Hollywood, overseeing daily procurement operations, sourcing strategies, and supplier relationships.  The Sr. Manager will deliver procurement efficiency, beneficial spend economics and savings via utilization of sourcing strategies /best practices, on-time ordering accuracy, supplier compliance, and consistent execution across all Food & Beverage categories.  This role will also oversee sourcing readiness and onboarding for all new ventures, ensuring that new concepts are fully supported through SKU setup, vendor engagement, and procurement readiness.  Additionally, this position will serve as the primary liaison to the Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) for all R&D and New Venture sourcing efforts, ensuring alignment with Universal’s sourcing governance framework and overall corporate strategy. 

This position requires a candidate with proven leadership ability to facilitate, guide, and implement improvements within the sourcing organization and operation of the company. This position will lead a team of sourcing professionals and must have the ability to motivate others to meet the challenges of a face paced, collaborative, and results driven environment. This position will work to ensure Sourcing initiatives are executed efficiently, industry best practices are adopted, and corporate Sourcing policies are adhered to for Universal’s domestic properties; may require global interaction with stakeholders and other UPR Sourcing professionals.  Travel is required.

 

Essential Functions

  • Lead a high performing team in sourcing and procurement execution for Universal Studios Hollywood (USH) Food & Beverage, ensuring daily operational continuity, cost visibility, and vendor compliance.
  • Design and implement sourcing programs, including bid specifications, distributor and manufacturer negotiations, and supplier development strategies.
  • Design and execute RFX Processes- RFI, RFP, RFQ - and negotiate economically beneficial contracts with suppliers to deliver competitive product and service pricing across categories.
  • Responsible for delivery of on-time ordering and accuracy for replenishment levels of warehouse and direct shipment items for responsible site and New Ventures sites
  • Oversee procurement processes within Eatec/S4 to ensure accurate purchase orders, on-time delivery, and full adherence to Universal’s governance model.
  • Serve as the primary liaison to the GPO for all R&D and New Venture sourcing efforts, ensuring project transparency, data accuracy, supplier compliance, and measurable value delivery.
  • Coordinate cross-functional alignment with Culinary, Operations, Shared Services, and IT for USH and all new venue onboarding, including SKU creation, sourcing timelines, and supplier readiness.
  • Partner with the Cost Control team to ensure budget alignment, identify cost-saving opportunities, and support margin expansion initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain procurement policies and sourcing procedures to enhance efficiency, transparency, and alignment with Universal’s national sourcing governance.
  • Design and execute category sourcing strategies that deliver short and long term benefits across pricing, delivery, storage and supplier utilization/management.
  • Design and execute procurement ordering and replenishment strategies and/or playbooks that deliver operational efficiency and cost effectiveness across product portfolio.
  • Analyze procurement data and supplier performance to identify cost reductions, supplier consolidation, and continuous improvement opportunities.
  • Forecast demand and usage patterns to optimize inventory levels and procurement scheduling.
  • Ensure sourcing compliance, sustainability standards, and food safety requirements are met across all vendors.
  • Drive completion of key projects by proactively considering new alternatives and applying critical thinking to achieve optimal results.
  • Provide leadership and mentoring to the USH Sourcing & Procurement team to promote continuous improvement, accountability, and best-in-class performance.
  • Build and foster relationships by collaborating with internal stakeholders, external suppliers, and UDX leadership.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established USH policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Various projects as assigned

Requirements:

  • Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in Food & Beverage sourcing or procurement, including at least 3–5 years in a management or leadership capacity.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; Certified Professional Food Manager (CPFM) preferred.
  • Strong understanding of ERP systems (Eatec/S4) and procurement workflow automation. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio.
  • Deep knowledge of multi-step strategic sourcing, bid management, and category management strategies. Proven success in cost modeling, supplier negotiation, and analytics-driven decision-making.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams in a high-volume, fast-paced environment with multiple competing priorities. Skilled in cross-functional partnership and influencing without direct authority.
  • Strong analytical acumen with the ability to translate data into insights and actions. Capable of balancing strategic vision with executional precision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills at all organizational levels, with a focus on clarity, persuasion, and professionalism.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and results-driven. Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement, accountability, and operational excellence.
  • Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week.

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong leader with the ability to motivate and develop a high-performing team in a collaborative, results-driven environment.
  • Deep understanding of product life cycle, price elasticity, COGS, and program-building concepts.
  • Demonstrated success leading sourcing and onboarding initiatives for new concepts and operational expansions.
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams, including Culinary, Operations, and Shared Services, to deliver enterprise sourcing solutions.
  • Experience working with a GPO or similar sourcing framework to deliver measurable value while maintaining compliance with corporate governance.
  • Strong project management skills, including stakeholder management, forecasting, and cost analysis.
  • Resourceful problem solver with the ability to prioritize, negotiate, and drive outcomes in ambiguous or high-pressure situations.
  • Analytical thinker capable of developing frameworks for planning and implementing organizational change.
  • Passionate, positive, and results-oriented with a continuous improvement mindset.

Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $120,000 - $140,000 (bonus eligible)

NBCUniversal is seeking a Senior Software Engineer with strong expertise in SAP SuccessFactors Core, SAP HCM, ABAP, and SAP BTP Integration Suite (CPI). This is a key role in NBCUniversal's HR technology transformation and is responsible for technical solution design, technical specifications, development leadership, governance, and quality assurance across enterprise HR technology initiatives 

The successful candidate will serve as the technical lead for SuccessFactors and SAP integrations, partnering with Product Managers, Functional Consultants, Architects, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into detailed technical designs. The role will lead ABAP and BTP development teams, review completed builds against approved specifications, validate technical unit test evidence, and coordinate Center of Excellence (COE) review and approval. 

Responsibilities 

  • Lead the technical design and delivery for SAP SuccessFactors Talent modules. 
  • Translate business requirements into solution architecture, technical designs, integrations, and RICEF specifications. 
  • Lead the design, development, and support of integrations using SAP BTP Integration Suite (CPI), APIs, and middleware technologies. 
  • Lead SAP BTP, ABAP, and integration development teams, including vendors and offshore resources. 
  • Facilitate architecture reviews, governance approvals, and design checkpoints. 
  • Coordinate testing, deployments, cutover, production support, and incident resolution. 
  • Mentor engineers and drive SAP SuccessFactors and SAP BTP best practices. 

Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field with 5+ years of relevant experience; or a Master’s degree with 3+ years of relevant experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. 
  • Experience developing technical designs, integration specifications, and RICEF specifications. 
  • Strong technical and functional expertise in SAP SuccessFactors Talent Management, including Recruiting, Onboarding, Learning, Compensation, and Performance & Goals. 
  • Hands-on experience designing, developing, and supporting integrations using SAP BTP Integration Suite (CPI), including API, file-based, and middleware integrations leveraging OData, Compound Employee API, REST, SOAP, XML, JSON, and SFTP. 
  • Experience developing and extending cloud applications using SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP). 
  • Experience conducting technical reviews and ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture, governance, and development standards. 
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 

Desired Characteristics

  • SAP Integration Suite (CPI) certification preferred. 
  • Certification in two or more SAP SuccessFactors Talent modules, including Recruiting, Onboarding, Learning, Compensation, or Performance & Goals. 
  • Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), including Cloud Foundry, API Management, Cloud Connector, Event Mesh, Build, Work Zone, Cloud ALM, SAP Joule, and ABAP Cloud. 
  • Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Signavio, and SAP Fieldglass.   
  • 2+ years of experience integrating SAP SuccessFactors with SAP HCM, Employee Central Payroll (ECP), SAP S/4HANA, SmartRecruiters, Onboarding, and other third-party applications. 
  • Preferred to have experience with at least one SmartRecruiters implementation. 
  • Experience supporting large-scale HR transformation and SAP SuccessFactors implementation programs. 
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive technical decisions in complex enterprise environments 
  • Media and entertainment industry experience is desired. 

Additional Requirements: 

  • Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning the employee is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly the employee’s residence.

The Senior Manager, Financial Contract Administration, will lead the analysis, interpretation, setup, and review of theatrical participation agreements within PARIS. This individual will serve as a subject matter expert in participation contract administration, reporting processes, system controls, and technology-driven transformation initiatives. The role is responsible for driving process optimization, cross-functional collaboration, data-driven decision-making, and the implementation of scalable technology solutions. 

This leader will identify and resolve workflow inefficiencies, strengthen reporting controls, and develop innovative approaches to improve accuracy, processing capacity, and overall team effectiveness. The position requires strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and project management skills, along with the ability to successfully navigate complex business and technical challenges. 

As a key member of the Financial Contract Administration team, this individual will provide leadership, strategic insight, and functional expertise to enhance productivity, maintain high-quality standards, and support continuous improvement initiatives across FCAR. A strong understanding of participation and residual agreements, contract interpretation, and related calculations is preferred. 

Here you can:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of contract analysts and setup professionals, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement as it relates to Theatrical and DWA television participations.  
  • Establish team priorities, workload management strategies, and performance expectations to ensure timely and accurate contract setup and reporting. 
  • Oversee, organize, schedule and expedite statement set-up and review participation reporting system (PARIS). 
  • Manage Risk Assessment Project (RAP), a contract conversion and remediation initiative with the goal of migrating legacy reporting into PARIS.
  • Assist with Special Projects and other release-to-market reporting (e.g. Theatrical, Home Video, Television) as needed.
  • Liaison between Financial Contract Administration and Financial Contract Reporting. 
  • Partner with FCAR leadership to resolve complex reporting issues, implement enhancements, and improve reporting controls.
  • Help to create and communicate metrics to ascertain success of projects as well as analyze department efficiency.
  • Support process improvement directives and ensure new processes are aligned and in compliance with various stakeholders (legal affairs, business affairs, tax, IT, AP, FCAR).

Here you'll need:

  • BS/BA in Accounting, Finance or related field
  • 5+ years of participation, consumer products, accounting, or finance experience in the entertainment industry
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team is essential for success in this fast-paced environment
  • Advanced knowledge of Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  • Advanced knowledge of source systems and participation systems/processes
  • Experience working with IT in developing system enhancements
  • Experience in analyzing large amounts of data (using Pivot Tables/Power BI, Power Query, AI tools) 
  • Proven track record of leadership, implementing and managing change
  • Excellent communication skills with customers as well as internal stakeholders 

What we'll look for:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
  • Exceptional analytical orientation 
  • Solid work ethic 
  • Flexible mindset to be able to take on new challenges outside of the job description as they arise 
  • Innovative orientation 
  • Proactive approach to problem solving

This key position within Peacock’s Creative Marketing Team will execute a high volume of promotional assets for Peacock Original content, with an emphasis on scripted series, but also including unscripted series, documentaries, original movies, and more. The person in this role will work closely with the Creative Director and ACD on high-profile campaigns for Peacock Originals. This role requires a conceptual thinker and leader with a strong editorial and production background, who can turn marketing goals into high-impact 360 creative.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee, produce, and directly edit high-volume creative video content (trailers, sizzle reels, episodic promos, and social videos).
  • Partner closely with the Sr. Creative Director, ACDs, Sr Writer/Producers, W/Ps, APs, design teams, and broader marketing stakeholders (Social, PR, Media, Integrated Marketing, etc) to execute best-in-class launch campaigns for Peacock Originals across all digital, broadcast, and streaming platforms.
  • Collaborate with outside creative agencies, production companies, and editorial vendors to guide the creation of 360 external marketing assets.
  • Develop and execute 360 promotional ideas for critical tentpole launches, including hero AV creative, OOH & marketing stunts, paid media, social, performance, and other varied cross-functional needs.
  • Oversee and manage post-production, including full audio mix sessions, music and footage selection, voiceover (VO) recording, and motion GFX for marketing materials.
  • Supervise on-set content capture at creative marketing shoots. Ability to direct talent (when needed) a plus.
  • Pitch creative to Executive Producers (EPs) and network stakeholders, securing alignment and effectively translating marketing briefs into actionable trailer and promo concepts.

Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Film & Television Production, Communications/Media Studies, Digital Arts or related field, Entertainment Marketing, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 7+ years of experience producing and editing promotional AV content at a network, streaming service, studio, or entertainment marketing agency.

Desired Characteristics

  • Proficiency with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects and DaVinci Resolve
  • Experience leading 360° creative campaigns in television or entertainment. Streaming/direct-to-consumer and scripted experience preferred.
  • A diverse portfolio demonstrating a history of high-profile entertainment promo work, sharp design integration, advanced video editing skills, and clear storytelling.
  • A strong pulse on popular culture, entertainment trends, social media platforms, emerging content platforms, and industry news/developments.
  • Mastery and proficiency editing with Adobe Premiere Pro.
  • Strong technical understanding of digital video file formats; working with source video/material of varying quality and technical specs (frame rate, codecs, etc)
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present creative concepts to senior executives and external stakeholders.
  • Deep understanding of the creative production process – from pre-production (brainstorming, ideation), to shoots and on-set production, to post-production workflows (including editing, finishing, versioning, etc)
  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously under tight deadlines in a quick-moving environment.
  • Experience managing and mentoring junior writer/producers, editors, interns, and pages

  • This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer, Design Systems to help shape the foundations that power experiences across our global streaming portfolio.

You’ll help evolve our global design system, creating the components, patterns, frameworks, and tools that enable teams to build cohesive, accessible, and scalable experiences across TV, web, mobile platforms.

This role is anchored in systems thinking and sits at the intersection of product design and engineering. You'll partner closely with Product Design, Product Management, Engineering, and Brand teams to turn product needs into reusable solutions, strengthen the connection between design and code, and make it easier for teams to build high-quality experiences at scale.

We’re looking for someone who sees patterns beyond individual screens, enjoys solving complex platform challenges, and believes a great design system should empower teams rather than constrain them.

What You'll Do:

  • Build and evolve our design system. Design scalable components, patterns, and foundations, using thoughtful component architecture, variables, modes, and tokens to support experiences across products and platforms.
  • Bridge design and engineering. Partner closely with engineers to translate designs into production-ready components, defining properties, states, behaviors, and specifications while strengthening design-to-development workflows.
  • Solve at the system level. Identify patterns across products, standardize where it creates value, reduce unnecessary complexity, and turn individual product needs into flexible solutions that can scale across experiences.
  • Drive adoption and enable teams. Create clear documentation, usage guidance, and contribution processes. Partner with teams through design reviews, consultation, and office hours to help them effectively use and contribute back to the system.
  • Design with accessibility at the foundation. Incorporate accessibility into components and patterns from the start, applying WCAG standards at the component level and supporting consistent experiences across platforms.
  • Improve how the system works. Explore tooling, automation, and emerging technologies that can improve system maintenance, documentation, QA, and design-to-code workflows.
  • Shape what’s next. Explore how tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows can improve how we build, maintain, document, and use the system.
  • Balance today's needs with long-term system health. Help prioritize system evolution based on product needs, adoption, and system health while balancing near-term delivery with the long-term sustainability of the system.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of product design experience, with at least 2+ years of direct experience building, scaling, or implementing design systems.
  • A portfolio demonstrating design systems work, including your approach to components, patterns, systems thinking, and implementation.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, including component architecture, variants, auto layout, variables, modes, and library management.
  • Hands-on experience with design tokens, theming, and scalable component architecture.
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering to translate design system decisions into production components.
  • Strong systems-thinking skills and the ability to identify patterns, understand tradeoffs, and translate complex product needs into scalable solutions.
  • Strong understanding of interaction design, visual design, and accessibility, including WCAG standards.
  • Experience designing systems that support multiple platforms, products, or devices.
  • Knowledge of and interest in AI-assisted design and development workflows.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions and tradeoffs across Product, Design, and Engineering.
  • Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and move complex initiatives forward across multiple teams.

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.
