The Senior Broadcast Production Engineer is a highly experienced technical contributor responsible for maintaining the reliability of NBC Sports production environments while leading complex troubleshooting, systems design, integration and technology projects. This role serves as a senior escalation point for live productions and provides technical leadership across studios, production control rooms and associated broadcast and IP infrastructure within the Stamford Sports facility.

The Senior Broadcast Production Engineer partners with Production, Operations, Technical Management, IT, Security, vendors and other engineering teams to translate production requirements into reliable and supportable technical solutions. The position combines hands-on day-of-air support with systems engineering, project leadership, operational readiness and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a senior technical escalation point for complex or high-impact issues affecting live and recorded productions.
  • Lead advanced troubleshooting across video, audio, communications, replay, graphics, routing, monitoring, compute, storage and network-connected production systems.
  • Provide senior day-of-air engineering coverage and coordinate technical response during production-impacting incidents.
  • Lead technical projects from requirements definition and design through installation, integration, testing, commissioning and operational handoff.
  • Develop system architecture, signal-flow diagrams, equipment specifications, implementation plans and acceptance criteria.
  • Evaluate existing workflows and recommend improvements that increase reliability, scalability, security and operational efficiency.
  • Lead maintenance windows, system upgrades, capacity expansions and technology refreshes while minimizing production disruption.
  • Work with Network Engineering and IT teams to support IP media environments, including SMPTE ST 2110, multicast transport, synchronization and hybrid SDI/IP workflows.
  • Coordinate technical work performed by system integrators, manufacturers and vendors; validate deliverables and oversee acceptance testing.
  • Perform root-cause analysis following significant incidents and translate findings into corrective actions, documentation or system improvements.
  • Develop and maintain engineering standards, SOPs, as-built drawings, recovery procedures and technical support documentation.
  • Mentor less-experienced engineers and provide technical training and knowledge sharing.
  • Represent Production Engineering in cross-functional project, workflow and technology discussions.
  • Support budgeting, equipment planning and technical lifecycle recommendations for assigned systems.
  • Participate in rotating schedule and on-call coverage, including nights, weekends and holidays as required.

Basic Requirements

  • Minimum five years of progressively responsible experience in broadcast engineering, production engineering, media systems or a comparable live-production technology environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Communications or a related field, or equivalent relevant education and experience.
  • Demonstrated expertise troubleshooting integrated broadcast production systems in high-pressure, time-sensitive environments.
  • Experience leading system installations, upgrades, integration, testing or commissioning.
  • Strong knowledge of video, audio, timing, synchronization, signal transport, monitoring and production control-room workflows.
  • Strong understanding of IP networking and media-over-IP production technologies.
  • Experience creating and maintaining system diagrams, technical specifications and operational documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical workstreams and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience with SMPTE ST 2110, PTP, NMOS, AES67, Dante, NDI and hybrid SDI/IP production environments.
  • Experience with redundant, highly available systems supporting 24/7 media operations.
  • Familiarity with cloud, virtualized or software-defined production platforms.
  • Experience with Sony, EVS, Evertz, Grass Valley, RTS, Calrec, Tektronix, Leader, Avid and Chyron systems.
  • Experience with 1080p, HDR and UHD/4K workflows.
  • Experience using AutoCAD, Visio, Lucidchart or similar tools for systems documentation.
  • Familiarity with scripting, automation, monitoring or configuration-management tools.
  • Experience managing vendor deliverables and formal system acceptance testing.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and improve team support practices.
  • Strong ownership mindset, judgment and composure during production-critical incidents.

Additional Requirements

  • Willingness to work overtime, including nights and weekends.
  • Must be willing to work in Stamford, CT.

job.description:

As the Staff DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for leading our DevOps and platform engineering initiatives, fostering a culture of automation, continuous integration, observability, reliability, and delivery. Your efforts will support consumer data-driven advertising and marketing products, standardized consumer identity solutions, machine learning platforms, and emerging AI-powered applications across NBCUniversal and its brands. 

You will partner with engineering, data, security, and AI teams to design and operate scalable cloud platforms that enable application development, analytics, machine learning, and AI workloads. Your expertise in AWS services, Infrastructure as Code, container orchestration, observability, platform automation, and cloud architecture will be critical in building secure, resilient, and cost-effective environments that accelerate innovation while maintaining enterprise governance and operational excellence. You will operate in an individual contributor capacity, but as a Staff Engineer, you will lead and mentor more junior DevOps Engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, operational excellence, and platform-first thinking. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Develop and lead the implementation of DevOps, Platform Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices to improve the efficiency, scalability, reliability, and security of cloud-based applications and services. 
  • Design, build, and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines that automate software delivery, infrastructure deployment, platform provisioning, and operational workflows. 
  • Architect, deploy, and manage scalable AWS cloud infrastructure supporting applications, data, machine learning, and AI workloads. 
  • Implement and manage containerization and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, EKS) to ensure consistent, secure, and resilient environments across development, testing, and production. 
  • Establish and maintain Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and Git Ops practices to improve platform consistency, governance, and operational efficiency. 
  • Build and support ML Ops and AI platform capabilities, including model deployment automation, inference platform operations, AI workflow orchestration, secure API integration, and lifecycle management for AI-enabled services. 
  • Enable secure integration of AI platforms, LLM-based applications, vector databases, agent frameworks, and machine learning services while ensuring compliance with enterprise security and governance standards. 
  • Develop observability solutions using logging, monitoring, tracing, and operational analytics platforms to proactively detect performance issues, infrastructure anomalies, security risks, and AI workload health concerns. 
  • Design scalable cloud architectures that support high availability, disaster recovery, cost optimization, and AI workload scalability. 
  • Partner with Security, Data, and Architecture teams to implement cloud security controls, identity and access management, secrets management, and compliance requirements across traditional and AI-enabled platforms. 
  • Drive automation of infrastructure operations, environment provisioning, platform governance, and operational processes to reduce manual effort and improve developer productivity. 
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation, operational runbooks, architecture standards, and platform governance processes 
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
  • 6+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering, including experience operating at a senior or technical leadership level. 
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, including building, deploying, and maintaining cloud infrastructure at scale. 
  • Deep experience with AWS and core cloud services such as EC2, EKS, ECS, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch, and VPC networking. 
  • Strong experience with containerization and container orchestration technologies, including Kubernetes, EKS/ECS, and Docker. 
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using technologies such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, AWS CodePipeline, or similar tools. 
  • Experience supporting high-traffic, high-throughput consumer-facing applications or platforms, with demonstrated knowledge of scalability, performance, availability, and production reliability. 
  • Experience implementing observability and monitoring using tools such as Datadog, Splunk, ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or CloudWatch. 
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices, including IAM, secrets management, networking, and secure infrastructure design. 
  • Experience designing scalable platform architectures that balance reliability, performance, governance, and cost optimization. 
  • Ability to provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers while remaining a hands-on individual contributor. 
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across engineering, data, security, and architecture teams. 

Desired / Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience supporting large-scale, high-volume platforms processing 5,000+ transactions per second (TPS). 
  • Experience supporting high-visibility live or tentpole events where traffic can increase significantly and platform availability is business-critical. 
  • Experience working in multi-cloud environments, particularly Microsoft Azure in addition to AWS. 
  • Experience with data pipeline orchestration and supporting data-intensive platforms. 
  • Experience deploying or operating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or similar technologies. 
  • Familiarity with agentic AI architectures, agent workflows, AI skills, and AI-enabled application infrastructure. 
  • Experience supporting LLM-based applications, AI/ML workloads, model-serving infrastructure, inference services, or related AI platform capabilities. 
  • Familiarity with AI platform security, governance, operational monitoring, and secure API integrations.

Nous exploitons également des parcs thématiques et des expériences de premier plan partout dans le monde par l’entremise d’Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment Universal Orlando Resort, où se trouve Universal Epic Universe, ainsi qu’Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Visitez www.nbcuniversal.com pour obtenir plus d’information.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés où notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics vivent et travaillent. Nous avons une longue tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à offrir aux membres de notre personnel la possibilité de s’investir au service de leurs communautés. Nous favorisons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et de proposer une vaste gamme de contenus qui reflètent notre monde.

RESPONSIBILTIES

As a Technical Animator (Rigging) you will be creating rigs for characters and animated objects. You will refine skin-weights, work on cloth simulation, and physical objects. As a rigger, you will improve character setups and game engine workflows to overcome the technical challenges associated with creating animations for our games.

  • Skinning of human character meshes, animated props and interactive objects.
  • Setting up physics for cloth objects, accessories and props.
  • Integrating characters into the game and maintaining rigs for DCC and ingame.
  • Find solutions to animation and rig problems. Keep current with the latest animation technologies and trends.
  • Investigate, diagnose, and resolve animation bugs across tools, pipelines, and in-game setups.
  • Optimize character rigs and animation assets to ensure they meet memory and frame rate performance budgets without compromising visual quality.
  • Sharing knowledge with animators, artists and programmers, and writing technical documents and guidelines.

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

En tant qu’animateur technique (Rigging), vous créerez des rigs pour les personnages et les objets animés. Vous peaufinerez les pondérations de skinning, travaillerez sur la simulation de tissus ainsi que sur les objets physiques. En tant que spécialiste du rigging, vous améliorerez les configurations de personnages et les workflows du moteur de jeu afin de relever les défis techniques liés à la création d’animations pour nos jeux.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Effectuer le skinning des maillages de personnages humains, des accessoires animés et des objets interactifs.
  • Configurer la physique pour les objets en tissu, les accessoires et les props.
  • Intégrer les personnages dans le jeu et assurer la maintenance des rigs pour les DCC et dans le jeu.
  • Trouver des solutions aux problèmes d’animation et de rig. Se tenir au courant des plus récentes technologies et tendances en matière d’animation.
  • Examiner, diagnostiquer et résoudre les bogues d’animation dans les outils, les pipelines et les configurations en jeu.
  • Optimiser les rigs de personnages et les assets d’animation afin de respecter les budgets de mémoire et de fréquence d’images sans compromettre la qualité visuelle.
  • Partager ses connaissances avec les membres des équipes d’animation, d’art et de programmation, et rédiger de la documentation technique et des lignes directrices.

Basic Requirements: 

  • A minimum of 4 years of experience in the field of 3D character animation for video games.
  • Excellent technical skills like rigging and skinning as well as a good understanding of the principles of animation.
  • Expertise working with Unreal Engine, Motionbuilder and Maya.
  • Experience in the creation of animations tools and the development of workflows and asset pipelines.
  • Experience with animation retargeting, physics, IK & control-rig, deformers and cloth setup.
  • Experience in the creation of facial rigs.
  • Experience with modular character setups.
  • Good understanding of optimization strategies for video game performance
  • Strong problem-solving skills

Exigences de base : 

  • Un minimum de 4 ans d’expérience dans le domaine de l’animation de personnages 3D pour les jeux vidéo.
  • Excellentes compétences techniques en rigging et en skinning, ainsi qu’une bonne compréhension des principes de l’animation.
  • Expertise avec Unreal Engine, Motionbuilder et Maya.
  • Expérience dans la création d’outils d’animation et le développement de workflows et de pipelines d’assets.
  • Expérience avec le retargeting d’animation, la physique, l’IK et le control rig, les deformers et la configuration de tissus.
  • Expérience dans la création de rigs faciaux.
  • Expérience avec les configurations de personnages modulaires.
  • Bonne compréhension des stratégies d’optimisation des performances pour les jeux vidéo
  • Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Knowledge of Python script is highly desired.
  • Experience using Metahuman
  • Some experience in writing tools for artists
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within cross-disciplinary teams
  • Experience rigging animals and creature characters as well as interactable objects
  • Basic animation graph knowledge
  • Some character animation skills
  • Some experience working with mocap, scripted events and camera setups

Caractéristiques souhaitées : 

  • La connaissance des scripts Python est fortement souhaitée.
  • Expérience avec Metahuman
  • Une certaine expérience dans la création d’outils pour les artistes
  • Bonnes compétences en communication et capacité à travailler en collaboration au sein d’équipes multidisciplinaires
  • Expérience en rigging d’animaux et de créatures, ainsi que d’objets interactifs
  • Connaissance de base des graphes d’animation
  • Certaines compétences en animation de personnages
  • Une certaine expérience avec la mocap, les événements scriptés et les configurations de caméra

 Eligibility Requirements:

  • Interested candidates must apply to be considered.
  • Must be willing to work in our Montreal office a minimum of 4 days a week.
  • Must be willing to work overtime when required, in accordance with Quebec labor standards.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada.
  • Must be willing to travel for work related business, if necessary

Conditions d’admissibilité :

  • Les personnes intéressées doivent soumettre leur candidature afin d’être prises en considération.
  • La personne retenue doit être disposée à travailler à notre bureau de Montréal au moins 4 jours par semaine.
  • La personne retenue doit être disposée à faire des heures supplémentaires lorsque requis, conformément aux normes du travail du Québec.
  • La personne retenue doit être légalement autorisée à travailler au Canada.
  • La personne retenue doit être disposée à voyager pour des raisons professionnelles, au besoin.

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. job.title: Telemundo 44 DC News Internships – Summer 2027
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Your future in media starts here. The NBCUniversal Summer Internship Program is your chance to help shape what’s next in media and entertainment. Whether you’re supporting major news coverage, creating content for iconic brands, or contributing to innovative projects, you’ll bring your ideas, creativity, and perspective to make an impact throughout your internship.

Beyond your day-to-day role, you’ll take part in a thoughtfully designed program focused on career development, building your professional presence, and growing your workplace confidence. Through real-world experience and a community of fellow interns, you’ll explore what’s possible in this ever changing and exciting industry.

In addition to all of our internships being paid, we will also offer the following for our Summer 2027 interns:   

  • Paid company holidays for full-time interns.  
  • Robust networking, learning and development opportunities.
  • Complimentary Peacock subscription during your internship.
  • Free admission to Universal Parks to use during your internship.
  • Access to mental health resources including counseling sessions.
  • Financial assistance to offset expenses for transportation and housing may be available on a needs-based basis for eligible in-person interns. More details about eligibility for this assistance will be provided at the time of offer. 

Summer 2027 Program Details

Program Dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027

Time Commitment: 40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need. 

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from Washington DC.  

Summer 2027 Recruitment Timeline

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)  

Mid November – Late December: First round video interviews   

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews  

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers  

To Apply:

  • Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year.
  • Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below).
  • Upload a transcript (unofficial transcripts are fine) that confirms your status as an actively enrolled student in a degree-granting program.

NBCUniversal Local is NBCUniversal’s local media division that delivers English and Spanish-speakers and bilingual audiences in 31 U.S. markets and Puerto Rico, the very best in local sports, news, weather, consumer and investigative reporting, and lifestyle entertainment across any platform and screen. NBCUniversal Local is comprised of three individual media groups including the NBC Owned Television Stations, the NBC Sports Regional Networks and the Telemundo Station Group. NBCUniversal Local’s stations and networks serve diverse audiences and communities across linear, streaming, OTT, digital web, mobile and audio, and cable platforms and work together to keep local audiences informed anytime and anywhere.       

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:  

News

  • Participate in daily editorial process: planning, researching, newsgathering, logging, writing and editing 
  • Learn editorial and technical aspects of news gathering 
  • Shadow producers and assignment editors 
  • Produce individual news stories for demo reels and online 
  • Participate in studio anchor session 
  • Research view calls and tips and assist on the assignment desk 

Digital

  • Pitch, report and write news and features 
  • Pitch, shoot and edit packaged video pieces for social media platforms in conjunction with the Digital staff and on-air reporters 
  • Identify opportunities for interaction on social media platforms with live conversations between reporters and story sources 
  • Cut video from linear shows for use on websites, apps and social media 
  • Identify opportunities for graphics and data visualization 
  • Shadow digital editors, TV producers, assignment desk editors and others 

Community Affairs & Brand Marketing

  • Assist with planning community meetings and receptions for 50-100 people 
  • Refresh stations’ partner and influencer lists 
  • Research feature opportunities for community segments and shows 
  • Write engaging solution-focused articles for station websites 
  • Assist with planning and set up of dynamic live shots in the community 
  • Spanish language writing and speaking proficiency a plus 

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program. 
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in Washington DC.  

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Pursuing a degree in Journalism or Broadcast Journalism, Digital/New Media Studies, Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, Production, English, Social Media, or Research.   
  • Bilingual in Spanish and English preferred (written and verbal). 
  • Ability to multitask and highly organized.  
  • Excellent verbal and written communication.  
  • Previous internship experience within a corporate setting.  
  • Experience with Social Media Platforms, Final Cut Pro, Adobe Creative Suite, and SEO tools such as Google Trends a plus.  

The hourly rate for student interns is $19.00.

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBC Sports is looking for an experienced Transmission Operator to support live broadcast operations from our Stamford facility. In this role, you'll coordinate with internal teams, transmission providers, and technology partners to ensure reliable, high-quality content delivery for some of the biggest events in sports, including the Olympics, NFL, NBA, golf, and soccer.

The ideal candidate has experience with broadcast transmission technologies such as fiber, satellite, bonded cellular, IP-based transport, video, and audio systems, along with strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to perform in a fast-paced live production environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinates transmission activities and check-ins for high-profile sporting events using the company-wide scheduling system.
  • Works closely with Operations and Production teams to support transmission and routing needs and ensure high-quality broadcast delivery.
  • Monitors and troubleshoots on-air video, audio, satellite, communications, and multiplexed signals across multiple broadcast streams.
  • Partners with transmission carriers to resolve issues, manage escalations, coordinate maintenance, and maintain reliable service.
  • Establishes standard operation procedures for transmission activities, including remote check-ins, quality control processes, ingest, and outgoing feeds.
  • Provides transmission support and feed coordination for internal partners across the organization.
  • Collaborates with Engineering to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Assists with equipment setup, testing, and configuration as needed.

Basic Requirements

  • 2+ years of broadcast, transmission, media operations, or related live production experience.
  • Knowledge of broadcast transmission and media transport systems, including fiber, satellite, and IP-based workflows.
  • Ability to troubleshoot video, audio, and communications signals.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple live events simultaneously.
  • Ability to assist with critical decision-making in time-sensitive, live broadcast environments
  • Experience working in a 24/7 operational environment.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience supporting live sports or large-scale live event broadcasts.
  • Experience supporting REMI / remote production models.
  • Ability to interpret signal flow documentation (CAD drawings) and perform systems-level troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting matrix communications systems and large-scale routing infrastructures.
  • Familiarity with SMPTE 2110 environments.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based media transport and IP video workflows.
  • Experience working with H.264, HEVC, JPEG2000, ASI, and 4K workflows.

Additional Requirements

  • Interested candidate must submit a resume/CV through www.nbcunicareers.com to be considered
  • Must be willing to work in Stamford, CT
  • Must be able to work holidays, nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) and overtime as necessary
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States
  • Must be 18 years or older
  • Must be willing to submit to a background investigation.
  • It is the policy of NBCUniversal and NBCUniversal’ s affiliated businesses to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy) sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Required On-Site: This position is designated as full-time on-site and must be performed from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $35.00 - $39.00 per hour.

job.title: Vice President, Advanced Advertising Strategy
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Vice President, Advanced Advertising Strategy will shape the long-term vision, strategic direction, and innovation agenda for NBCUniversal’s advanced advertising business, translating market shifts, technology advancements, and evolving client needs into growth opportunities.

The role will take emerging ideas from their earliest stages through validation and toward commercial viability, working with Product and Strategy teams and ad-tech ecosystem partners to develop scalable businesses and capabilities aligned with NBCUniversal’s broader priorities and technology roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the long-term strategy. Set NBCUniversal’s advanced advertising vision, strategic roadmap, and investment priorities across audience intelligence, performance advertising, data collaboration, retail media, identity, measurement and attribution, emerging media channels, and AI-enabled advertising.
  • Incubate and validate new growth opportunities. Take emerging ideas from initial thesis through business-case development, market validation, testing, and commercial readiness. Establish disciplined experimentation frameworks to determine which opportunities merit further investment and scale.
  • Partner deeply with Product and Strategy. Work closely with Product teams to connect market opportunities to technology and capability roadmaps, and with Strategy teams to ensure advanced advertising priorities align with NBCUniversal’s broader strategic direction.
  • Identify and assess market disruption. Evaluate shifts in technology, consumer behavior, regulation, competitive dynamics, and advertising business models to identify where NBCUniversal should invest, partner, build, or experiment.
  • Build connectivity across the ad-tech ecosystem. Develop relationships with operators, entrepreneurs, technology companies, platforms, and other innovators across the advertising ecosystem to surface emerging ideas, capabilities, partnership opportunities, and potential strategic investments.
  • Advise senior leadership. Translate complex market developments and emerging opportunities into clear executive recommendations, strategic narratives, and investment priorities.

  • Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem; experience in advertising technology, programmatic, CTV, audience and identity, performance advertising, data collaboration, measurement, or related areas strongly preferred.

job.title: Account Executive (Chicago-Based)
job.description:
Job Description:


Page Six is one of the most recognized names in celebrity and entertainment news. As the originator of the modern gossip column, we’ve built a brand that keeps audiences in the know, from red carpets and exclusive parties to the biggest headlines in pop culture. Today, Page Six reaches millions across digital, print, social, video, podcast, and TV, meeting our audience wherever they consume content.


We’re looking for a motivated, Chicago-based Account Executive to join our entertainment ad sales team. This role is ideal for an experienced seller with 5+ years of media or advertising sales experience who is ready to take ownership of the full Midwest market and drive meaningful revenue growth. Reporting to the Page Six Ad Sales Director, you’ll develop and manage a regional book of business, building strategic client relationships, identifying new opportunities, and growing advertising partnerships across the territory.


You’ll join a collaborative, high-energy sales team with the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on one of the most recognizable brands in entertainment media. In this role, you’ll have the autonomy to shape and grow the Midwest market while partnering closely with sales leadership and internal teams to develop compelling, multi-platform advertising solutions. You’ll work across digital, social, video, and branded content, bringing Page Six’s extensive reach and cultural relevance to agency and direct clients. This is an opportunity for an entrepreneurial seller to take ownership of a key market, strengthen existing partnerships, and establish new relationships that drive long-term business growth.


Responsibilities:


  • Independently own and grow the Midwest sales territory, developing and executing strategies to drive new business and expand existing partnerships
  • Identify, prospect, and convert new business opportunities, building a strong and sustainable regional pipeline
  • Manage the full sales cycle, including outreach, RFP responses, proposal development, pitching, negotiation, and closing
  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with agency partners and direct clients, serving as a trusted point of contact throughout the partnership
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop compelling, customized advertising solutions that leverage Page Six’s multi-platform reach
  • Deliver polished, persuasive sales presentations tailored to client objectives and business needs
  • Take ownership of regional revenue goals through proactive pipeline management, account development, and consistent follow-through
  • Monitor competitive activity, industry trends, and market opportunities to identify new avenues for growth
  • Provide exceptional client service, ensuring strong communication and long-term partner satisfaction

The ideal candidate will have/be:


  • 5+ years of experience in media sales, advertising sales, sales planning, or a related client-facing role
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage a sales territory, develop client relationships, and drive revenue growth
  • Experience working with agencies and direct clients in a major market
  • Proven experience selling digital advertising solutions, sponsorships, and/or integrated media packages
  • Familiarity with prospecting and research tools such as MediaRadar, Winmo, or similar platforms
  • Online video sales experience is a plus
  • Entrepreneurial and self-directed, with the ability to identify opportunities and build a market with a high degree of autonomy
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to build lasting client relationships
  • Highly organized, accountable, and results-driven, with strong business development and pipeline management skills
  • A genuine interest in entertainment, celebrity news, and pop culture

Please note: this role will work remotely out of the Chicago area with occasional travel as needed.

job.title: Data Engineer
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post is one of America’s most iconic and recognizable news brands — delivering bold headlines, unforgettable scoops, and sharp commentary since 1801. With a legacy built on fearless journalism and a distinctly New York attitude, The Post has evolved far beyond its print roots to become a modern media powerhouse.


Today, the New York Post Digital Network is one of the most influential voices in the industry, reaching over 80 million unique users each month across our expansive, ever-growing portfolio. Anchored by NYPost.com, PageSix.com, and Decider.com, our digital brands deliver must-read breaking news, sports, entertainment, pop culture, and lifestyle coverage with the same wit, edge, and energy that define The Post. With innovation at our core, we’ve built a true multi-platform ecosystem — spanning web, mobile apps, video, audio, social, print, TV, and commerce. From viral headlines and exclusive stories to original series, podcasts, and live events, we’re engaging audiences where they are — and always on the pulse of what’s next.

We’re looking for a Data Engineer to join our technology team and work on the systems that power The Post’s digital future. This is a hands-on engineering role with a focus on infrastructure services, data pipelines, and identity enrichment. Along the way you’ll also participate in the product development of data-dependent systems such as AI answer services, personalization systems, machine learning, and audience services.

You will build and maintain the foundational data services that power analytics and machine learning for our newsroom, and product teams to deliver cutting-edge thoughtful digital experiences at scale. You’ll work alongside senior engineers, product managers, and data teams, contributing to high-performance systems.

Please Note: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. Sponsorship, including employment visa sponsorship or transfer, is not available for this position now or in the future.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and operate cloud-based data pipelines supporting specialized needs of our consumer websites, native mobile apps, and information services.

  • Work daily with compute services, query services, storage services, and big data services with technologies like Vertex AI, Lambdas, DynamoDB, Cloud Functions, S3, Kubernetes, Glue, and BigQuery inside AWS and GCP.

  • Develop and maintain data ETL pipelines for real-time and batch processing of large-scale content and event data.

  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code (Python preferred).

  • Collaborate with product, editorial, and data science teams to deliver infrastructure and services that meet business needs.

  • Monitor, optimize, and improve the reliability, security, and cost efficiency of cloud-based systems.

  • Write and present ideas clearly. Document functional requirements for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and agile sprint ceremonies.

Qualifications:

Must-Haves

  • MS or BS in computer science, or related field.

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience

  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, and PySpark

  • Working knowledge of common AWS and/or GCP services

  • Experience building and deploying data pipelines (e.g., Airflow, Dataflow, Glue, or similar tools)

  • Knowledge of data warehouse technologies (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, etc.)

  • Firm grasp of the tools of the trade including AI tooling, IDEs, Git, JIRA, and agile methodologies.

  • Familiarity with web standards and protocols.

  • Comfort with code reviews, writing unit tests, QA and UAT processes, and exposure to end-to-end testing frameworks.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, thoroughness, and an eagerness to learn.

  • Proactive approach to problem-solving.

  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Great-to-Have Experience

  • Familiarity with content-management systems, media, news, publishing, video technology, ad technology, or other high-traffic consumer-facing industries.

  • Exposure to personalization and recommendation systems.

  • Comfortable with the CLI, Linux administration, shell scripting, ssh, crontabs, etc.

  • Hands-on experience with generative-AI models, LLM prompting, and/or machine learning

  • Experience with monitoring, logging, dashboard, and alarming tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, etc.)

  • Familiarity with REST and GraphQL APIs, authentication/authorization, and API best practices.

  • Scaling techniques in cloud environments.

  • Troubleshooting and debugging experience with internet services.

  • Understanding of CI/CD workflows and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes a plus)

Note: The New York Post follows a hybrid work model. This position would be expected to be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week (subject to change).

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and love turning complex client campaigns into seamless successes, this role is for you.

job.title: Social Media Editor & Community Manager, Virtual Reali-Tea
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority. Over the past 225 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.


About the Role


Page Six is seeking a sharp, reality TV-obsessed social content & community manager to join its fast-paced team, with a dedicated focus on its growing reality TV  vertical, Virtual Reali-Tea. This role is for someone who doesn’t just watch reality TV, they live it! You know the casts, the feuds, the timelines, and the fan theories as they unfold in real time. If your group chats rely on you for every reality TV update, then this is your role. 


Key Responsibilities


Collaborate with the Virtual Reali-Tea social and editorial teams to ideate and execute platform-specific content that drives engagement, fuels growth and leads the conversation.


  • Pitch, conceptualize and produce timely content for maximum reach across social platforms, from breaking news to viral moments and deeper cultural takes
  • Monitor social media platforms (Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, Threads, etc) to identify trending conversations, fan theories, and emerging storylines and rapidly turn breaking moments into social explainers
  • Help build the Virtual Reali-Tea voice and brand across social platforms by responding to comments, direct messages, etc., and engaging with our reality TV community   
  • Work closely with hosts Danny Murphy and Evan Real to identify the most compelling angles from interviews and quickly turn them into multi-media formats and pitch to other outlets for coverage 
  • Prepare questions for and cover red carpets and premieres ensuring we get the most news-worthy and entertaining interviews, stories and video to advance our coverage
  • Appear on camera, when needed, to deliver commentary, explainers or quick-hit reactions to breaking reality TV moments
  • Collaborate with online, video and social teams to ensure content is platform-native and built for shareability
  • Write trending articles and video scripts with clean copy in the VRT voice when needed  

Who You Are


  • Deeply knowledgeable and genuinely obsessed with reality TV across networks and streamers (Bravo, Netflix, Peacock, etc.)
  • Chronically online in the best way, you instinctively know what’s trending and why
  • An exceptionally strong multimedia storyteller and producer who can match VRT’s unique voice, and create viral visuals and commentary that travels across the Page Six network
  • Think about shareability first. You instinctively see the clip, the hook and the moment that drives to the story
  • Quick, accurate, and able to turn around clean copy and scripts on a tight deadline
  • A creative thinker who can spot the headline and trends and stay ahead of the fandoms
  • Collaborative and comfortable working across multiple editorial departments, including news, SEO, video and social teams

Bonus Points


  • Past experience covering entertainment or celebrity news
  • A network of sources and contacts across the reality TV universe including with publicists and talent

Why This Role


This is a chance to help shape the voice and growth of Virtual Reali-Tea, the leading destination for reality TV fans, while working at the most iconic brand in entertainment news.

Note: The New York Post adheres to an on-site work model. This role will be expected to report into the office 5 days per week.

job.title: Vice President, Strategy & Business Transformation
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post is one of America’s most iconic and recognizable news brands — delivering bold headlines, unforgettable scoops, and sharp commentary since 1801. With a legacy built on fearless journalism and a distinctly New York attitude, The Post has evolved far beyond its print roots to become a modern media powerhouse. 


Today, the New York Post Digital Network is one of the most influential voices in the industry, reaching over 80 million unique users each month across our expansive, ever-growing portfolio. Anchored by NYPost.com, PageSix.com, and Decider.com, our digital brands deliver must-read breaking news, sports, entertainment, pop culture, and lifestyle coverage with the same wit, edge, and energy that define The Post. With innovation at our core, we’ve built a true multi-platform ecosystem — spanning web, mobile apps, video, audio, social, print, TV, and commerce. From viral headlines and exclusive stories to original series, podcasts, and live events, we’re engaging audiences where they are — and always on the pulse of what’s next. 


We are seeking an experienced, highly analytical, and execution-oriented Vice President, Strategy & Business Transformation. In this role, the incumbent will work closely with the Chief Technology & Strategy Officer and the senior leadership team to build and operationalize enterprise capabilities. Key responsibilities include translating strategic priorities into actionable business decisions, aligning resources around our highest-value opportunities, and driving measurable results.

 

This is a highly visible, hands-on role for a strategic thinker who can move seamlessly between executive-level problem-solving and practical implementation. The successful candidate will help establish the frameworks, processes, governance, and operating rhythms that enable leaders to make informed decisions, prioritize investments, manage competing resources, and accelerate strategic initiatives.

 

The ideal candidate combines the analytical rigor of a management consultant with the pragmatism of an operator. They are comfortable navigating ambiguity, challenging assumptions, influencing senior stakeholders, and turning complex business questions into clear recommendations and measurable outcomes.


Importantly, this role serves as an enabler and facilitator of enterprise strategy. Business leaders retain accountability for decisions and execution within their respective functions.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 

Enterprise Strategy & Executive Alignment

  • Partner with the Chief Technology & Strategy Officer and executive leadership to translate the enterprise operating model into actionable priorities, processes, and governance.
  • Facilitate executive alignment on strategic priorities, organizational objectives, decision rights, and resource allocation.
  • Help define the Strategy Team’s mandate, operating model, engagement approach, and partnership with business functions.
  • Prepare executive presentations, decision briefs, and recommendations to support critical business decisions.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen cross-functional alignment and accelerate enterprise-wide initiatives.

 

Strategic Portfolio & Initiative Management

  • Establish and maintain a consolidated view of enterprise initiatives, strategic investments, resources, ownership, milestones, and expected business outcomes.
  • Develop consistent evaluation frameworks to assess initiatives based on strategic alignment, financial and operational value, ownership, and execution capacity.
  • Facilitate portfolio reviews and recommend opportunities to accelerate, continue, sequence, redesign, or discontinue initiatives.
  • Identify resource constraints, competing priorities, dependencies, and opportunities to redirect capacity toward higher-value business objectives.
  • Establish transparent portfolio reporting and tracking mechanisms.

 

Business Strategy & Decision Support

  • Lead and support high-priority strategic engagements across the organization, translating complex business questions into actionable recommendations.
  • Develop business cases, financial analyses, scenario models, and strategic assessments to inform investment and resource decisions.
  • Create structured decision-making frameworks that clearly outline business questions, supporting evidence, alternatives, financial implications, risks, and recommendations.
  • Work backward from defined decision milestones to ensure strategic engagements produce timely, actionable outcomes.
  • Challenge assumptions and identify opportunities to improve business performance, operational effectiveness, and organizational alignment.

 

Strategy Operations & Governance

  • Design and implement the Strategy Team’s operating processes, including initiative intake, prioritization, engagement selection, and delivery tracking.
  • Establish and facilitate regular enterprise strategy reviews, portfolio reviews, and executive decision forums.
  • Develop governance tools, templates, decision logs, dashboards, and accountability mechanisms.
  • Clarify roles and responsibilities across executive sponsors, initiative owners, working teams, and decision-makers.
  • Streamline existing reporting and meeting structures to improve decision velocity and reduce unnecessary administrative processes.

 

Enterprise Performance & Organizational Effectiveness

  • Partner with Finance, Human Resources, Technology, Product, Editorial, and Revenue leadership to connect enterprise strategy with financial investment, organizational capacity, and business performance.
  • Develop an enterprise scorecard and key performance indicators to measure strategic progress, financial impact, execution, audience growth, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Monitor initiative performance, identify barriers to execution, and facilitate timely resolution of cross-functional issues.
  • Support change management and organizational adoption of new strategy processes and operating practices.
  • Build the capabilities, tools, and knowledge transfer necessary to establish a sustainable Strategy Operations function.

 

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Strategy, or a related discipline; advanced degree or MBA preferred.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, business operations, enterprise transformation, or strategy execution.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise prioritization, portfolio management, and strategic operating frameworks.
  • Strong financial acumen, including business case development, financial modeling, investment analysis, and resource planning.
  • Proven ability to partner with CEOs, C-suite executives, and senior functional leaders.
  • Experience facilitating complex business discussions, challenging assumptions, and navigating competing priorities and resource tradeoffs.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, executive communication, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to translate complex information and ambiguity into concise insights, options, and actionable recommendations.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders without direct reporting authority.
  • Media, digital publishing, advertising, audience development, subscription, product, or technology experience strongly preferred.

Note: The New York Post follows a hybrid work model. This position would be expected to be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week (subject to change). 


Equal Opportunity Employer

job.title: Digital Media Buyer & Planner
job.description:
General Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Plan, execute, manage, and optimize paid media campaigns across Facebook, Instagram, X, Google, YouTube, and other digital advertising platforms.
  • Develop media plans and buying strategies based on campaign objectives, target audiences, budgets, and performance goals.
  • Develop and manage audience targeting strategies, including demographic, behavioral, interest-based, remarketing, and lookalike audiences.
  • Manage campaign budgets, pacing, bidding strategies, placements, and audience allocation to maximize performance and return on advertising investment.
  • Monitor campaign performance and make ongoing adjustments based on key performance indicators, audience behavior, costs, and campaign objectives.
  • Analyze campaign and audience performance to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for optimization.
  • Evaluate the performance of creative assets, messaging, audiences, and placements and assist with A/B testing strategies.
  • Manage campaign setup, trafficking, tracking, quality assurance, and implementation to ensure accurate campaign launches.
  • Partner with creative, marketing, digital, and other internal teams to coordinate campaign assets, messaging, landing pages, and tracking requirements.
  • Prepare campaign performance reports and translate data and audience insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Track campaign spending and ensuring budgets are appropriately paced and aligned with approved media plans.
  • Leverage AI tools, including ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and other emerging technologies, to support audience research, campaign analysis, reporting, and optimization.
  • Monitor emerging digital platforms, advertising products, audience trends, and technologies and recommend new opportunities when appropriate.
  • Manage multiple campaigns and priorities while meeting campaign launch and reporting deadlines.
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Position Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Business, Analytics, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in digital media buying, media planning, paid social, paid search, performance marketing, or programmatic advertising.
  • Hands-on experience planning, launching, managing, and optimizing paid digital advertising campaigns.
  • Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads required; experience with X Ads, YouTube, and other digital advertising platforms preferred.
  • Experience with programmatic advertising platforms and DSPs such as DV360, The Trade Desk, Yahoo DSP, or similar platforms is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of audience targeting, segmentation, retargeting, campaign optimization, and digital advertising performance metrics.
  • Experience analyzing campaign performance and using data to make media buying and optimization decisions.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with Google Analytics, data visualization, or other reporting tools preferred.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and an interest in applying emerging technologies to digital advertising, analysis, and campaign optimization.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns, budgets, platforms, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

     Compensation & Benefits

    • Competitive salary - $85k -$110k depending on skills and relevant experience.
    • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
    • 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
    • Paid time off and holidays.
    • Professional development and training opportunities.
    • Collaborative and inclusive work environment.

job.title: Director of Talent Management
job.description:
General Duties and Responsibilities: 

  • Serve as a key point of contact for Newsmax on-air talent regarding scheduling, contracts, wardrobe, and other day-to-day talent needs.
  • Coordinate communication between on-air talent, agents and representatives, Legal, Production, Programming, Human Resources, and other internal teams as appropriate.
  • Manage and maintain daily and weekly talent schedules, including regular shifts, schedule changes, substitutions, special programming, and other talent assignments.
  • Communicate schedule changes and talent availability to appropriate production and newsroom teams in a timely manner.
  • Assist with the administration of on-air talent agreements, renewals, amendments, extensions, and other contract-related documentation.
  • Coordinate with Legal and talent representatives to facilitate contract paperwork, signatures, approvals, and required documentation.
  • Maintain organized and accurate records of talent agreements, contract dates, renewal periods, schedules, and other relevant information.
  • Track important contract milestones and proactively communicate upcoming expirations, renewals, or required actions to appropriate leadership.
  • Coordinate wardrobe appointments, fittings, styling schedules, and other appearance-related requirements for on-air talent.
  • Work closely with Production and Programming teams to coordinate talent needs for regular programming, special coverage, breaking news, promotional appearances, and network events.
  • Assist with scheduling and coordinating talent for promotional shoots, network initiatives, special programming, and other assignments as needed.
  • Maintain a high level of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality when handling talent contracts, compensation information, schedules, and other sensitive matters.
  • Maintain accurate calendars, trackers, files, and other administrative systems related to on-air talent.
  • Support onboarding and offboarding logistics for on-air talent in coordination with Legal, Human Resources, Production, IT, and other departments as appropriate.
  • Identify and recruit on-air talent, including anchors, hosts, correspondents, reporters, contributors, analysts, and commentators.
  • Develop the network's talent strategy in consultation with the CEO, president, news director, and programming executives.
  • Continuously scout competitors and emerging media for potential talent, including television, radio, podcasts, streaming, YouTube, social media, and local news.
  • Lead contract discussions and negotiations in coordination with legal, HR, finance, and senior management, including compensation, contract length, exclusivity, outside activities, and renewal terms.
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Position Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Media, Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in television, broadcast media, talent coordination, production coordination, entertainment, or a related environment preferred.
  • Previous experience working with on-air talent, talent representatives, agents, producers, or other high-profile individuals strongly preferred.
  • Experience with scheduling, contract administration, production coordination, or talent operations preferred.
  • Strong organizational and administrative skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage complex schedules, competing priorities, and frequent last-minute changes in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with talent, agents, executives, attorneys, and employees at all levels of the organization.
  • Strong judgment and discretion when handling confidential contracts, compensation, personnel information, and other sensitive matters.
  • Ability to anticipate needs, identify potential scheduling or logistical issues, and proactively develop solutions.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and calendar management tools.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a service-oriented approach and the ability to build effective working relationships.
  • Ability to remain organized and composed during breaking news, schedule changes, and other time-sensitive situations.
  • Knowledge of television production and newsroom operations preferred.
  • Flexibility to work outside regular business hours when necessary to support breaking news, special programming, and talent needs.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Competitive salary - $150k - $175k depending on skills and relevant experience.
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
  • Paid time off and holidays.
  • Professional development and training opportunities.
  • Collaborative and inclusive work environment.

job.description:

job.title: Sr. News & Corporate Researcher
job.description:
Core Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Company research: Prepare profiles of potential partners, customers, acquisition targets, vendors, investors, and other organizations.
    • Financial research: Review public filings, earnings reports, investor presentations, industry data, and other financial information.
    • Strategic research: Support management in evaluating new markets, products, geographic expansion, partnerships, licensing opportunities, and investments.
    • Executive briefings: Produce concise research memos, background reports, talking points, charts, and briefing materials for executives.
    • Market research: Analyze industry size, growth rates, trends, competitive conditions, and emerging opportunities.
    • Data collection and analysis: Gather information from databases, government records, surveys, trade associations, research firms, and credible online sources and turn it into actionable findings.
    • Fact checking: Verify statistics, claims, quotations, company information, and other material before it is used internally or externally.
    • Regulatory and policy research: Track legislation, regulations, government policies, court decisions, and agency actions relevant to the company's operations.
    • Special projects: Conduct rapid research for senior executives on acquisitions, business development opportunities, corporate communications, litigation, presentations, or other priority matters.
    • Cross-department support: Work with finance, legal, business development, marketing, communications, and senior management on research-intensive projects.
    • Recommendations: Go beyond simply collecting information by identifying key findings, risks, opportunities, and recommended next steps.
    • News and developments: Monitor news, government actions, regulatory developments, economic trends, and other events that could affect the company.

    News Research to Include:

    • Conduct in-depth research on breaking news, developing stories, current events, public figures, organizations, government agencies, businesses, and other topics relevant to Newsmax programming.
    • Provide producers, anchors, reporters, and editorial leadership with timely background research, facts, statistics, timelines, and other information needed for news coverage.
    • Monitor news developments throughout the day and identify relevant information, updates, and potential story angles.
    • Research and develop background materials for interviews, guest appearances, breaking-news coverage, and special programming.
    • Prepare concise research briefs, background documents, timelines, fact sheets, and other materials for producers, anchors, and newsroom leadership.
    • Research potential guests, experts, newsmakers, and other individuals relevant to developing stories and planned programming.
    • Review government reports, court records, public filings, studies, polling data, transcripts, news reports, and other primary and secondary sources.
    • Conduct research across multiple sources and evaluate the credibility, accuracy, and relevance of information.
    • Quickly respond to research requests from producers and newsroom leadership during breaking-news situations.
    • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

    Position Requirements:

    • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, Political Science, History, English, Liberal Arts International Relations, Research, or a related field preferred.
    • Previous experience in corporate research, news research, television production, digital media, investigative research, or a related field preferred.
    • Strong knowledge of current events, politics, government, business, international affairs, and the broader news landscape.
    • Exceptional research and fact-checking skills with demonstrated ability to locate and evaluate information from credible sources.
    • Ability to quickly research unfamiliar or complex subjects and summarize findings clearly and accurately.
    • Experience researching public records, government documents, court records, public filings, databases, and other primary sources preferred.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
    • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to accuracy and factual integrity.
    • Ability to clearly organize and present research findings for staff.
    • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, online research tools including artificial intelligence and databases.
    • Flexibility to work outside standard business hours as required by breaking news and major events.

    Compensation & Benefits:

    • Competitive salary - $85k -$105k depending on skills and relevant experience.
    • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
    • 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
    • Paid time off and holidays.
    • Collaborative and inclusive work environment.

job.title: Account Executive
