job.title: Account Executive, Sale
job.description:
Nexstar Media Group is America’s largest local TV and media company, with nearly 200 owned or partner stations in 116 markets and a fast-growing digital business. At CBS 17 (WNCN), we cover what matters across the Triangle and beyond—breaking news, weather, sports, and community storytelling—on-air and across streaming, social, and digital.

We’re looking for a hungry, high-energy Multi-Platform Account Executive who loves building relationships, winning new business, and creating smart marketing campaigns that actually work. If you’re competitive, organized, and want a career path in modern media + marketing, this role is for you.


  • Sell TV + digital marketing solutions that help local and regional businesses grow (broadcast, streaming/CTV, programmatic, paid social, paid search, and more).
  • Build relationships with direct clients and agencies across the Raleigh-Durham-Fayetteville market.
  • Own the full sales cycle: prospect ? pitch ? close ? launch ? optimize ? recap.
  • Create big, creative, results-driven ideas—then work with our digital, marketing, and production teams to bring them to life.
  • Prospect consistently and develop new revenue in non-traditional categories (think: new-to-TV advertisers, digital-first brands, challenger brands, franchise groups).
  • Present campaigns with confidence—using insights, examples, and performance expectations that make sense to clients.
  • Negotiate and structure agreements that hit client goals and station revenue targets.
  • Track your activity and pipeline in CRM, forecast accurately, and manage deadlines like a pro.
  • Stay curious and keep learning as the media world evolves (streaming, creators, measurement, AI tools, etc.).
  • Be a great teammate—collaborate across sales, digital, creative services, traffic, and finance so campaigns launch clean and deliver strong results

What success looks like

    • You’re building a healthy pipeline and consistently bringing in new business.
    • You grow accounts from single-platform buys into integrated TV + digital partnerships.
    • Your clients renew because you deliver great service, strong ideas, and measurable outcomes.

What we’re looking for

    • 1-3 years of experience in sales, advertising, media, marketing, or business development (TV/digital experience is a plus—but if you’re a fast learner, we’ll train).
    • Strong communication skills and comfortable presenting to decision-makers.
    • Competitive, self-motivated, and organized—someone who loves goals and chasing wins.
    • Able to think strategically: you don’t just sell spots—you sell solutions.
    • Comfortable using tools like Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and CRM systems.
    • A team-first attitude with the ability to work independently.
    •  
    • Experience selling CTV/streaming, programmatic, paid social, or paid search.

Nice to have (not required)

    • Agency-side experience or experience managing agency relationships.
    • Local market knowledge in Raleigh/Durham/ChapelHill/Cary/Fayetteville and surrounding counties.

Work style / environment

This is an in-office role with time spent both at your desk and in the field.

    • In-office: proposal building, prospecting calls, presentations, CRM/pipeline updates, internal meetings.
    • In the field: client meetings, agency visits, community events, and station engagements.
    • Occasional lifting of materials for presentations/events may be required.

Why CBS 17

    • A trusted local news brand with major reach across TV + digital.
    • A collaborative team environment with resources to help you win.
    • A role where you can build real marketing skills and a long-term sales career.


#LI-Onsite

job.title: Account Executive/Marketing Consultant
job.description:
A KXAN Marketing Consultant is a strategic sales professional responsible for generating advertising revenue through Broadcast Television, OTT/Streaming, and Digital Marketing solutions. In this role, you will identify and develop new business opportunities, uncover client marketing needs, create customized advertising strategies, and oversee campaign execution and performance.


As a trusted marketing advisor, you will partner with business owners and advertising agencies to deliver innovative campaigns that drive measurable results while building long-term client relationships and generating revenue growth for KXAN.


Why Join KXAN?

  • Represent the most trusted local news brand in Central Texas.
  • Offer clients a full suite of advertising solutions, including broadcast television, streaming, and digital marketing.
  • Work with local businesses and agencies across one of the fastest-growing markets in the country.
  • Receive ongoing training, coaching, and professional development opportunities.
  • Build a rewarding career with one of the nation's leading local media companies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect and develop new business through outbound outreach, networking, referrals, and in-market visits.
  • Conduct discovery meetings to assess client goals, challenges, and marketing needs.
  • Develop and present customized broadcast, streaming, and digital advertising solutions.
  • Launch, manage, and optimize campaigns from proposal through renewal.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships through ongoing communication and performance reviews.
  • Increase revenue through renewals, upselling opportunities, and new campaign initiatives.
  • Collaborate with internal sales support, strategy, creative, and research teams to deliver exceptional client results.
  • Maintain accurate activity, pipeline, and revenue forecasting within CRM systems.
  • Serve as a trusted marketing resource within the local business community.
  • Stay current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in digital advertising and media sales.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Strong understanding of digital marketing, including OTT/Streaming, paid media, and online advertising solutions.
  • Excellent relationship-building skills with the ability to establish long-term client partnerships.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and driven to meet and exceed revenue goals.
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Highly organized with exceptional time-management abilities.
  • Comfortable with prospecting, cold calling, and developing new business opportunities.
  • Collaborative team player with a positive attitude and strong work ethic.
  • Coachable, adaptable, and eager to grow professionally.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience in sales, marketing, or media.
  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
  • Sales, marketing, media, or advertising experience preferred, but not required.

job.title: Accounts Receivable Analyst
job.description:
The Accounts Receivable Analyst will support a minimum of three markets in all aspects of accounts receivable including billing, lockbox reporting and cash application, credit card posting, ACH postings, credit adjustments, aging review.   The role requires high quality customer service in support of their markets.

  • Daily lockbox reporting and research, posting all customer payments in Wide Orbit broken down between payments for invoices due and prepayments.    Ensure mounts received per the Lockbox equal the amounts posted to Wide Orbit for the respective payment forms
  • Daily credit card and ACH reporting and research, posting all customer payments in Wide Orbit broken down between payments for invoices due and prepayments.    Ensure amounts received for credits cards and ACH’s equal the amounts posted to Wide Orbit for the respective payment forms.
  • Significant attention is required to ensure cross market payments are identified and listed separately on each market’s receipts reconciliation for Lockbox, Credit Card, and ACH.
  • For short pay discrepancies, forwards the discrepancies to station Sales to research.  Follow up with Sales is required to ensure resolution including verifying that the station prepares and obtains all required approvals on the Credit Adjustment form.  Upon receipt, processes the Credit Adjustment for revenue adjustments.
  • AR point of contact for monthly collection meetings with the stations.  Prior to the RBM’s distributing the   aging, the AR Analyst is required to review and “clean” the aging of immaterial amounts outstanding, ensure prepayments are applied to open invoices that have billed, and ensure that between station transfers are complete to ensure proper matching of billing and payments to the proper station. 
  • After the monthly collection meeting, the AR Analyst must follow up on the action items from the meeting to ensure that the stations are preparing all the proper Credit Adjustments identified in meeting.  Ensure the timely processing of the Credit Adjustments to ensure no carryover items identified in the prior month’s meeting are carried forward. 
  • Assists station sales staff and customers when questions arise.  Position is required to work closely with and provide first class quality customer service to customers and Sales. 
  • Applies unapplied payments for cash in advance and paid programming accounts.
  • Completes broadcast and calendar month end billings, reconciles accounts receivable module preparing monthly roll forward from beginning of month balance to end of month balance based on sales, credit adjustments, and cash receipts for the month.
  • Processes co-op billing for stations collecting scripts, matching with invoices, and obtaining proper notarization.   Ensure all co-ops are completed within 5 days of close, with a copy of the notarized invoices and scripts scanned and placed in the co-op support folder on the shared drive (by market).
  • Research prior balance issues and provide detailed reconciliations of amounts paid, invoices, and credits to ensure all accounts within the aging are accurate.
  • Work with markets Sales Management, Account Executives, and the Traffic Department on billing issues caused by incorrect rates, improper ISCI codes, and other issues which may require credit and reissue of corrected invoices.
  • Performs other management requests and related duties as required.

Requirements & Skills:

 

  • Degree in Accounting or Management preferred (Associates or Bachelors)
  • Minimum 2 years’ experience in accounts receivable or general accounting a plus
  • Strong Excel skills required  
  • Wide Orbit or OSi experience a plus, but not required
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple projects with competing priorities
  • Self-motivated with strong interpersonal skills
  • Team player with exceptional oral/written communications skills
  • Proactive, high attention to detail, able to operate in a fast-paced environment
  • Highly customer focused

SCAM ALERT:

Please be aware candidates may be at risk of being targeted by scammers seeking personal data or money. Recruiters with Nexstar Media Group and its local stations will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with Nexstar.tv domain or official station email addresses (example:@wreg.com).  Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nexstar or its recruiters via any other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. We will not contact you using a @gmail email address. If you are unsure about the authenticity of a job inquiry or offer, email us at corporaterecruiters@nexstar.tv.

The Sales Coordinator is responsible for entering and coordinating orders, billing requests as well as developing sales proposals and/or plans with their account executive for agency and/or client deals.  Incumbent will work across all media platforms to create proposals, execute, and steward campaigns.  Will focus on both pre and post sales with a customer-first approach.  Will focus on all aspects of both linear and digital to optimize campaigns to ensure delivery.

  • Enter and revise orders

  • Assist Account Execs with creating sales material and developing client pitches.

  • Will create strategic cross-platform plans that maximize the portfolio and meet agency and/or client objectives.

  • Work with marketing team to secure materials and schedules for added value

About you:

  • 1+ years’ experience in media

  • Strong analytical skills
  • Ability to manage client expectation
  • Solutions-oriented customer service focus that emphasizes driving sales

Nexstar offers full time employees a comprehensive benefits package to include medical, life and short-term disability insurance, worker’s compensation, and unemployment insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid holidays, paid vacation, paid sick time, employee assistance program, bereavement leave, jury duty service time off, military leave, and medical/maternity & family leave.


Nexstar is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the industry’s top talent.  In compliance with the provisions of all applicable state and federal civil rights laws, every effort will be made to employ the most qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, disability, age, sex, national origin, citizenship, veteran’s status, sexual orientation, military status, or any other protected personal characteristic. Additionally, it is and shall continue to be our policy to provide promotion and advancement opportunities within the Company in a nondiscriminatory fashion based on merit, qualifications, and ability.

job.title: Anchor, Digital News
job.description:
The Digital Anchor, News produces and anchors segments on local digital trending topics, reports, shoots, writes, voices, edits, and feeds news content for all platforms in a manner that is clear, engaging, and meaningful to news consumers. This person will be the face of our digital breaking news coverage online. We are looking for someone that is actively engaged in all tenets of journalism. The Digital Anchor, News will be asked to anchor in studio and on our digital platform, field anchor, report, break news stories and handle long-form content when necessary. You will be responsible for generating sources, enterprising story ideas, and follow-ups. Having a ‘Digital First’ mentality is a must!

job.title: Anchor/Reporter
job.description:
Job Title:  Anchor/Reporter                                                    

Station:  WREG-TV   / Memphis CBS                                

Reports to:  Assistant News Director

Purpose/reason for this Position:  WREG in Memphis is searching for a seasoned storyteller to join a team of champions.  We’re looking for a digger who can uncover leads in one of the sauciest cities in America.  This place is news heaven, and the journalist good enough to win this job will be aggressive, resourceful and relentless.  If you lead by example… if you care about being fair and accurate… if you are born to connect with others… let us hear from you.    If you love the give and take of social media… let us hear from you.

You must include a link of your work.

Core Job Functions:

* Pitches unique story ideas every day.

* Builds and maintains a list of sources

* Gathers and turns stories on deadline that are fair, accurate, grammatically correct, and engaging to the audience.

* Presents those stories on live television… on set and in the field… in an energetic, conversational and creative style

* Posts and promotes those stories on multiple digital platforms.

* Cultivates curiosity

* Relishes personal responsibility, including learning new things and adapting to change as the world and the industry evolve.

* Works well in a team environment.

* Refuses to give up, even when people aren’t returning telephone calls, e-mails or DM’s.

* Protects the reputation and integrity of self and that of the station.

* Welcomes coaching and constructive criticism without rolling up into a ball or becoming hostile.

Minimum Knowledge Skills & Abilities:

Command of the English language, secondary language such as Spanish, helpful.  Should be able to write in complete sentences with proper spelling, punctuation and format.  Should be able to function under extreme stress and deadline pressures.  Experienced in anchoring,  reporting and news gathering.  Should have working knowledge of the Internet and feel comfortable using computers and electronic newsgathering equipment.

Requirements and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Journalism, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience
  • At least two years work experience
  • Must have current reel showcasing your work
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Valid driver’s license with a good driving record
  • Flexibility to work any shift

Physical Requirements:

The Anchor/Reporter must be able to sit, conduct telephone conversations, use electronic mail, write letters and memos, conduct face-to-face discussions with individuals or groups, make decisions without supervision, make decisions that impact the results of co-workers, work near others, work outdoors occasionally in all weather conditions, and work indoors in environmentally controlled conditions.  In addition, the Anchor/Reporter must be able to lift, set up and operate equipment weighing up to 25 pounds, and be able to handle, control or feel objects, tools or controls.  Repetitive movements are required.  Work may be conducted in extremely bright or inadequate lighting conditions.

Statement about Other Duties:

The foregoing is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all functions essential to the job for which the employee is responsible, nor an exhaustive list of the minimum requirements and specifications necessary to perform the essential functions, including all responsibilities, skills, duties, requirements, efforts, or working conditions associated with the job.  While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, management reserves the right to revise the job or to require that other or different functions be performed when circumstances change or exigencies require it.

job.title: Content Producer
job.description:
ABC4 Utah is seeking a dynamic and motivated Content Producer to help drive content across television, digital, social media, and streaming platforms. This hybrid role combines the responsibilities of a newscast producer, digital news producer, assignment editor, and streaming content creator, making it ideal for a news-driven storyteller who thrives in a fast-paced newsroom environment.

 

The Content Producer will oversee daily news gathering, coordinate coverage with reporters and photojournalists, monitor breaking news, and help generate original content for News4Utah+, ABC4’s streaming platform. They will also be trained as a traditional newscast producer to help back up the production of newscasts. They will also contribute to the creation of compelling, audience-focused content for broadcast, digital, and social media. This position is also responsible for developing and producing original video, podcast, and streaming content from concept to completion.

Key Responsibilities


  • Strive to be #1 on ABC4's television newscasts, digital and streaming platforms 24 hours/day
  • Report news quickly and accurately
  • Be able to craft original content that stands out from competition

job.title: Director of Engineering
job.description:
Are you an innovative, results-driven engineering leader who thrives on solving challenges, developing people, and embracing new technology?

KRQE Media Group is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead our technical operations and help shape the future of local broadcasting in New Mexico.

As part of Nexstar Media Group, America's largest local television broadcasting company, KRQE offers an opportunity to lead technology initiatives across a dynamic, multi-platform media operation.


Reporting directly to the Vice President & General Manager, you will serve as a key member of the station's leadership team, collaborating with News, Production, Digital, Sales, and Operations to advance our technology strategy, improve operational efficiencies, and support exceptional local content.


We're looking for more than a technical expert.   We want a forward-thinking leader who can turn innovation into action, inspire a talented engineering team, and keep KRQE at the forefront of broadcast technology.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Engineering Leadership & Operations

  • Lead, mentor, and develop the station's Engineering and technical support teams, fostering accountability, collaboration, and professional growth.
  • Oversee the maintenance, reliability, and performance of broadcast, production, studio, and technical infrastructure.
  • Support the technical operations of KRQE News 13, CW, My50, streaming, digital platforms, and locally produced programming.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership, troubleshooting, and timely resolution of critical system failures.
  • Collaborate with department leaders to identify technical needs, improve workflows, and support station-wide initiatives.

Technology Innovation & Strategic Planning

  • Develop and execute a multi-year technology roadmap aligned with KRQE's operational objectives and Nexstar's technology strategy.
  • Partner with News, Production, and Digital teams to improve content creation, distribution, and delivery across linear television, streaming, and digital platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to modernize equipment, streamline workflows, improve efficiency, and reduce operating costs.

Broadcast Infrastructure & Compliance

  • Oversee transmitter facilities, translator sites, and remote technical operations, including facilities supporting KRQE's broadcast coverage throughout New Mexico.
  • Maintain reliable broadcast transmission, master control, studio, production control room, and related technical systems.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable FCC regulations, technical operating requirements, and company policies.
  • Maintain appropriate emergency broadcast readiness, technical redundancy, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures.
  • Coordinate preventive maintenance, equipment inspections, technical documentation, and system upgrades.

Budget Management & Cybersecurity

  • Develop and manage engineering operating and capital budgets, including equipment replacement, infrastructure improvements, and major technology investments.
  • Direct technical projects from planning through implementation, ensuring appropriate scheduling, cost management, and accountability.
  • Partner with Nexstar's corporate technology and IT teams to support cybersecurity standards, network security, system access controls, and technical safeguards.
  • Monitor system performance, assess operational risks, and recommend improvements to protect station assets and maintain service continuity.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Experience managing operating budgets, capital expenditures, vendors, and complex technical projects.
  • Knowledge of applicable FCC regulations and broadcast technical compliance requirements.
  • Ideally five years of supervisory or management experience in broadcast engineering, television production technology, or a closely related technical environment.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of modern broadcast RF equipment, IP-based infrastructure, studio systems, transmission systems, and production workflows.
  • Experience with broadcast and production technologies such as Ross, Evertz, Bitcentral, ENPS, vMix, OBS, Florical, Clear-Com, Vinten, Cobalt, or comparable systems.
  • Working knowledge of computer networking, cybersecurity practices, broadcast automation, and digital media distribution.
  • Demonstrated leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize competing demands, respond effectively to technical emergencies, and collaborate across multiple departments.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to the station’s broader leadership objectives.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Engineering degree, Broadcast Technology, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience with cloud-based broadcast solutions, IP migration, streaming infrastructure, and ATSC 3.0 technologies.
  • Experience supporting multi-station operations, remote transmitter facilities, or distributed broadcast infrastructure.
  • Relevant broadcast engineering certifications, including SBE certifications.



Work Environment & Physical Requirements:

This is an on-site leadership position requiring active involvement in station operations, technical facilities, and remote broadcast locations.

Responsibilities may include:

  • Travel to transmitter and remote technical sites, including high-elevation mountain environments where weather and temperatures can vary significantly.
  • Periodic lifting, carrying, or moving equipment weighing approximately 20–50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Occasional strenuous activity associated with equipment installation, maintenance, and technical troubleshooting.
  • Availability outside regular business hours when necessary to address critical technical issues, emergencies, or scheduled maintenance.

Why Join KRQE Media Group?

At KRQE Media Group, engineering is more than maintaining equipment. It's about enabling great journalism, supporting creative content, and bringing new ideas to life.

You'll join a collaborative leadership team, help develop the next generation of broadcast technology, and play a meaningful role in shaping the future of local media in New Mexico.

If you're ready to lead, innovate, and make an impact, we want to hear from you!

job.title: News Producer (Broadcast/Digital)
job.description:
Do you love to write? Are you intrigued by the latest headlines? Do you soak up digital and social trends and have a creative mind? Are you passionate about creating content and working with a great team? We're looking for a creative, empowered, and enthusiastic producer who knows how to be a leader and is willing to learn how to create dynamic content for broadcast and digital worlds. KSN is looking for a producer who loves writing, and thrives on creative, collaborative work. Recent college grads with an enthusiasm for journalism and a drive to learn are asked to apply! Experienced producers will find our newsroom a place to continue to grow. 

JOB SUMMARY: The producer delivers and contributes accurate, visual, news content across all media platforms.


Principal Duties & Responsibilities:
* Responsible for evaluating, writing, illustrating (through video, sound, graphics etc.), and organizing stories into broadcast and digital platforms.

* Oversees writing, production, and timing of broadcast, online or streaming publication.

* Manage broadcast and digital shows, contribute to the editorial process and make solid decisions in breaking news situations.

* Monitor and contribute to post-production and edit processes to ensure accurate completion of details.

* Write, produce and edit material that appeals to target audiences.

* Edit video for multiple platforms

* Research production topics using the internet, video archives, and other information sources.


Specialized Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:
*Must be able to interact well with all broadcast and digital journalists in the newsroom, including anchors, multi-media journalists, videographers, meteorologists, sports, news managers, production, and engineering staff.

*Detail oriented.

*Excellent verbal, written, grammar, and analytical skills.

*Fluency in English, bilingual Spanish a plus.

*Strong news judgment and journalistic integrity.

*Willingness to learn our specific media production, communication and dissemination techniques and methods.

*On-camera appearances possible.


Education/Experience: Bachelor’s Degree in Journalism, Communications, TV/film; may substitute equivalent experience in television or radio broadcast/production for those without degree.


Training/Equipment: Utilize state-of-the-art television technology; MS Outlook, E-mail.


Work Environment/Physical Requirements: High stress environment with deadline pressures. Some travel may be required on an occasional basis. The News Producer must be able to stand, sit, conduct telephone conversations, use email, conduct face-to-face discussions with individuals or groups, make decisions without supervision, make decisions that impact the results of co-workers, work in close proximity to others, regularly work indoors in environmentally controlled conditions, and occasionally work outdoors in all weather conditions. In addition, the News Producer must be able to lift, set up and operate equipment weighing up to 25 pounds, and be able to handle, control or feel objects, tools or controls. Repetitive movements are required. Work may be conducted in extremely bright or inadequate lighting conditions.


NOTE: This job description contains the basic requirements for the position and is NOT intended to be a complete list of responsibilities; other duties may be assigned.

job.title: NewsNation - Broadcast Engineer in Charge - Part-time
job.description:
The Broadcast Engineer in Charge will be responsible for providing front-line broadcast engineering and technical support across multiple studios and control rooms within our production environment. The role involves supporting all broadcast systems and technology for live day-of-air programs, troubleshooting hardware and systems, managing projects that include system design, integration, and commissioning. This position requires a combination of maintenance and project management/system engineering skills. The support spans seven days a week, with certain periods requiring availability as part of a 24x7 schedule.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform system-level troubleshooting of technical facilities, including control rooms, studio equipment, audio equipment, and associated computer systems.
  • Conduct preventative maintenance on studio and control room equipment.
  • Assist Studio Operations with technical setup in control rooms and studios.
  • Collaborate with production and operations teams to implement technical solutions that meet production initiatives.
  • Install and update equipment and systems software.
  • Repair and troubleshoot equipment to the module level using industry-standard test equipment.
  • Manage projects, design systems, and assist with system integration and commissioning.

Qualifications


Basic Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in a television broadcast environment or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • BS degree in Engineering, Communications, or a related field or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Final candidates may be asked to complete a job-related skills assessment related to this position.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Proficiency with broadcast production systems and software, including audio consoles, intercom systems, video switchers, wireless audio, server-based playout, and test and measurement equipment.
  • Understanding of TCP/IP networks.
  • Knowledge of digital TV (HDSDI).
  • Proficiency in software-driven broadcast video equipment.
  • Ability to read and understand system signal flow diagrams for television control room and studio facilities.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to remain calm and focused under the pressures of live television.
  • Strong hands-on problem-solving skills with broadcast-related equipment and systems.
  • Understanding of the urgent needs of on-air sports and the ability to remain productive in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment.
  • Ability to support a 24x7 production environment.
  • Willingness and ability to learn new production technologies.
  • Preferred experience in live production environments.
  • Knowledge of computer server installation and maintenance.
  • Specific experience with:
  • Sony cameras 
  • RTS Intercom
  • Calrec audio consoles
  • Tektronix and Leader test and measurement systems.
  • Knowledge of SMPTE 2110 standards.
  • Experience in system design, AutoCAD, and project management.
  • Understanding of wireless audio and communication technologies.
  • Comms Systems (RTS ADAM/Omneo) knowledge
  • Experience with Comms Systems (RTS ADAM/Omneo)
  • Strong customer focus with a commitment to delivering high-quality technical support.
  • Self-starter with the ability to meet deadlines and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to diplomatically engage with colleagues across various departments.

Compensation: $75.00/hour

job.title: NewsNation - Executive Director of Technology
job.description:
NewsNation is seeking an experienced Executive Director of Technology to lead broadcast and production technology, technical infrastructure, and technology teams across New York, Chicago, and Washington, D.C. Reporting to the Vice President, Operations, this onsite Midtown Manhattan role directly leads the New York and Washington, D.C. teams and provides dotted-line functional leadership to the Chicago team.

The Executive Director will establish a unified technology strategy across NewsNation while maintaining hands-on oversight of the New York technology operation. The role is responsible for technical reliability, team development, infrastructure planning, and ensuring Technology has the skills and readiness required to support a fast-paced national news operation.

Key Responsibilities

·    Lead NewsNation's technology strategy and technical operations across New York, Chicago, and Washington, D.C.

·    Directly lead the New York and Washington technology teams, provide functional leadership to the Chicago team, and maintain hands-on oversight of New York team development, technical readiness, troubleshooting capabilities, and day-to-day performance.

·    Serve as the senior technology partner to the Vice President, Operations and Operations leadership.

·    Establish network-wide standards and priorities for system reliability, technology support, maintenance, documentation, disaster recovery, and technical projects.

·    Ensure technical issues have clear ownership, escalation, communication, and follow-through; drive recurring problems toward sustainable resolution; and lead the technology response during major incidents, breaking news, special events, and other critical production periods.

·    Lead technical planning for studios, control rooms, signal paths, transmission, remote production, and supporting broadcast infrastructure, advancing appropriate cross-market standardization in technology practices, ownership, documentation, and resilience.

·    Develop a network technology roadmap identifying technical risks, lifecycle requirements, infrastructure needs, and investment priorities, and partner with Operations on capital planning, facility projects, system upgrades, and technology investments.

·    Build and maintain structured training, cross-training, mentorship, and professional-development programs, including a skills and certification roadmap and regular opportunities for technology staff to maintain and expand relevant credentials.

·    Strengthen troubleshooting and organizational capability through technical training, knowledge-sharing, documentation, practical development, and cross-training; identify skill gaps and single points of knowledge; and broaden technical capabilities across the organization.

·    Coordinate with NewsNation teams, corporate technology resources, vendors, and other technical partners.

·    Lead represented and non-represented employees while working within applicable collective bargaining agreements and partnering with Human Resources and Labor Relations as appropriate.

 

 

Required Qualifications

·    Minimum 10 years of progressively responsible experience in broadcast technology, broadcast technology, television technology, live-production technology, or a closely related technical field.

·    Demonstrated experience leading technology teams and technical operations in a complex live television or media environment.

·    Strong knowledge of studios, control rooms, broadcast production systems, signal flow, transmission, remote production, and supporting technical infrastructure.

·    Experience leading major technical projects, facility upgrades, infrastructure modernization, and system implementations.

·    Experience leading technical teams across multiple facilities or geographically distributed operations.

·    Demonstrated ability to develop technical talent through training, cross-training, mentorship, knowledge transfer, and skills development.

·    Experience working with represented and non-represented employees.

·    Ability to lead effectively through direct-report, dotted-line, and shared-resource organizational structures.

·    Strong troubleshooting, project-management, vendor-management, organizational, and communication skills.

·    Ability to communicate complex technical issues, risks, and recommendations clearly to operational and executive stakeholders.

·    Ability to provide effective leadership in a fast-paced, 24/7 live-news environment.

Preferred Qualifications

·    Bachelor's degree in technology, broadcast technology, computer science, information technology, or a related field preferred, not required.

·    Relevant technical certifications or specialized training.

·    National network or 24/7 news technology experience.

·    Experience with IP-based broadcast infrastructure, remote production, streaming, and digital production technologies.

·    Experience developing multi-year technical and capital plans.

Schedule and Travel

This is an onsite position based in Midtown Manhattan, New York. Regular travel to Chicago and Washington, D.C. is expected, along with other travel as necessary to support NewsNation operations, projects, facilities, training, vendors, and special productions.

The position requires flexibility outside normal business hours during breaking news, special events, major technical projects, system outages, and other critical operational situations.

Compensation

$200,000-$250,000 annually, commensurate with experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Benefits Statement

Benefits: Our comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees includes, but not limited to, medical (with multiple plan options), dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, a 401(k) with company matching contributions, Paid Parental leave, life insurance and more.

About NewsNation

NewsNation is a national news network owned by Nexstar Media Group and dedicated to delivering fact-based, unbiased journalism for all Americans. Reaching audiences nationwide across cable, digital, and mobile platforms, NewsNation combines a national newsroom with the strength of more than 6,000 journalists in 110 local newsrooms across the country.

Equal Opportunity Employer

NewsNation and Nexstar Media Group are equal opportunity employers committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic under applicable law.

job.title: Political Reporter
job.description:
The Political Reporter produces, reports, shoots, writes, voices, edits and feeds news production content for all platforms in a manner that is clear, engaging and meaningful to news consumers.

  • Minimum 5 years experience required.
  • Arranges interviews with people who can provide information about stories
  • Reviews copy and corrects errors in content, grammar and punctuation, following prescribed editorial style and formatting guidelines
  • Reviews and evaluates notes taken about event aspects to isolate pertinent facts and details
  • Determines a story’s emphasis, length and format, and organizes material accordingly
  • Researches and analyzes background information related to news stories to be able to provide complete and accurate information
  • Gathers information about events through research, interviews, experience or attendance at political, news, sports, artistic, social or other functions
  • Pitches stories to news managers and news producers which are relevant to the local community
  • Receives assignments and evaluates leads and tips to develop story ideas
  • Discusses issues with producers and/or news managers to establish priorities or positions
  • Checks reference materials such as books, news files or public records to obtain relevant facts
  • Revises work to meet editorial approval or to fit time requirements
  • Shoots and edits news events and news reports
  • Produces and presents reports for all platforms

Physical Demands & Work Environment:

The Political Reporter must be able to sit, conduct telephone conversations, use electronic mail, write letters and memos, conduct face-to-face discussions with individuals or groups, make decisions without supervision, make decisions that impact the results of co-workers, work near others, work outdoors occasionally in all weather conditions, and work indoors in environmentally controlled conditions.  In addition, the Political Reporter must be able to lift, set up and operate equipment weighing up to 25 pounds, and be able to handle, control or feel objects, tools or controls.  Repetitive movements are required.  Work may be conducted in extremely bright or inadequate lighting conditions.

job.title: Producer
job.description:
KFOR is seeking an experienced producer who is creative and cares about news.  We are looking for someone with strong communication skills, a love of journalism and a passion for helping the community.    

PRINCIPAL FUNCTIONS ESSENTIAL TO THE JOB:

1.     Writes & produces news stories for daily newscasts, digital and social platforms.

2.     Serves as a control room leader during severe weather and breaking news coverage.

3.     Produces opens and graphics elements for highly produced segments.

4.     Fills in on other newscasts as needed.

5.     Work aggressively to increase traffic on web and social platforms.

6.     Contributes recommendations on daily story coverage and special assignments.

7.     Must be available to work at station promotion events.

8.     Serves as a leader within the newsroom, offering advice & assistance to other employees.

9.     Copy edits news stories by reporters and writers.

10. Produces special news events, shows and coverage outside the daily newscasts.

 

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:

1.     Top notch showcasing skills, superb writing and communication skills.  

2.     Must be extremely flexible to work different shifts throughout the year.

3.     Ability to work under extreme pressure and deadlines.

4.     Must keep up on local, state, national and international events.

5.     Must work well as part of a team.

 

This position requires someone who can exercise discretion, best judgment, and has solid journalistic/ethical skills.  Degree in journalism or equivalent experience preferred.

job.title: Reporter, Breaking News
job.description:
The Hill, a division of Nexstar Media Group, is looking for a journalist who prizes urgency and accuracy to join our team as a breaking news reporter. The Hill's breaking news reporters work as part of a team of journalists who cover DC newsmakers, policy decisions and key national news items through quick updates. The best applicant will show an ability to write clean, concise copy on a tight deadline where every minute counts in beating the competition. A strong interest in politics and national affairs and an ability to recognize news quickly will go a long way in the job. As with any breaking news role, this job may include night and weekend hours. The position is based at our Washington, DC offices.

About The Hill

Established in 1994, The Hill is the country's definitive digital source for non-partisan political news and information. Inside the Beltway, it's known as an essential, agenda-setting read for lawmakers and influencers. Beyond the Capitol, The Hill's trusted content is shared more often on social media than any other political news brand in America.

Our properties include TheHill.com, reaching a monthly audience of 41M; Hill.TV, the largest independent video platform within the Beltway with 1.4B annual views; The Hill's print edition, one of the most influential sources for law and policy makers; Elevate Studios, creating breakthrough branded content offerings for leading marketers; and The Hill Events, which hosted 70 virtual events last year, featuring 92 Members of Congress and 88 industry leaders in meaningful policy discussions.

About Nexstar Media Group

Nexstar Media Group, Inc. is a leading diversified media company that produces and distributes engaging local and national news, sports and entertainment content across its television and digital platforms, including more than 316,000 hours of programming produced annually by its business units. Nexstar owns America’s largest local broadcasting group comprised of top network affiliates, with more than 200 owned or partner stations in 116 U.S. markets reaching 220 million people.

Duties & Responsibilities:

• Write clean, concise copy on a tight deadline with a focus on immediacy and accuracy

• Conduct research and interviews to gather information and verify facts

• Craft articles with an eye towards audience engagement

• Work collaboratively with editors and other journalists to ensure appropriate coverage

• Utilize social media to share stories, interact with audience, and monitor trends

• Cultivate sources and contacts who are go-to sources for news and available for insights and analysis to contextualize breaking news coverage

• Perform other duties as assigned by leadership


Requirements & Skills:

• A bachelor’s degree in journalism or a related field is required

• Previous reporting experience in a metro or national media environment is preferred

• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, MS Office)

• Basic familiarity with Google Trends, SEO skills and real-time analytics are a plus

• Commitment to being a self-starter who proactively seeks out tasks and opportunities for growth

• Excellent knowledge of current events and politics

• Must be detail-oriented and have excellent written and verbal communication

• Must have the ability to work under deadline pressure

• Must have the ability to handle multiple projects or assignments with attention to detail

• Must thrive in a collaborative work environment

•Must be able to work varied shifts: weekends, holidays, nights, overnights, or early mornings.



Compensation Range: $25.48 - $27.88 per hour based upon experience

Benefits: Our comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees includes, but not limited to, medical (with multiple plan options), dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, a 401(k) with company matching contributions, Paid Parental leave, life insurance and more.   Part time employees are eligible for 401(k) and any local/state leave plans.  Union positions are subject to the benefits outlined in their Collective Bargaining Agreement.

job.title: Sales Assistant Project Coordinator
job.description:
WCBD News 2 | Charleston, SC


Apply online at: https://nexstar.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/nexstar


WCBD News 2 is seeking an organized, creative, and detail-oriented Sales Assistant to support our sales department and help coordinate client projects and lifestyle show appearances. This versatile role combines administrative sales support, project coordination, guest booking, research, and occasional video editing using Adobe Premiere Pro.


The ideal candidate communicates clearly, manages competing deadlines, and enjoys working with clients, guests, sales professionals, and production teams.


WCBD TV is an NBC Affiliate Station owned by Nexstar Media Inc.  We are located in the beautiful Lowcountry area of Charleston, SC.  Charleston is known for its warm weather, friendly people, charming downtown, outstanding food, beautiful beaches, and so much history.

Key Responsibilities


Sales Support

  • Assist account executives and sales management with proposals, presentations, sales materials, and client communications.
  • Support the entry, tracking, and maintenance of advertising orders and campaign details.
  • Coordinate creative assets, approvals, and deadlines with clients and internal departments.
  • Help prepare campaign recaps and maintain accurate client records and department reports.

Project Coordination

  • Coordinate assigned sales and sponsorship projects from initial planning through completion.
  • Maintain project calendars, timelines, task lists, and status reports.
  • Track deliverables for television, digital, sponsored content, and lifestyle show integrations.
  • Serve as a central point of contact among sales, clients, production, and other station departments.
  • Follow up on outstanding materials and approvals, communicate changes, and flag potential deadline conflicts.

Lifestyle Show Guest Booking

  • Schedule and confirm guests for lifestyle show segments, including local businesses, community organizations, and sponsored appearances.
  • Coordinate booking details with the sales team and show producers to align client commitments with available airtime.
  • Provide guests with arrival instructions, preparation guidelines, segment expectations, and material deadlines.
  • Collect guest biographies, talking points, business information, photos, videos, and other supporting assets.
  • Maintain an accurate booking calendar and communicate cancellations or scheduling changes promptly.
  • Assist with guest check-in and coordination on production days.

Research Assistance

  • Research prospective advertisers, local businesses, community events, and potential lifestyle show guests.
  • Gather audience, market, industry, and competitive information to support sales presentations and client proposals.
  • Verify facts, organize findings, and turn research into clear summaries and presentation materials.
  • Help identify timely segment ideas and sponsorship opportunities relevant to the Charleston market.

Video Editing

  • Use Adobe Premiere Pro to edit short promotional videos, client clips, lifestyle segment excerpts, and sales presentation content as needed.
  • Perform basic trimming, sequencing, audio adjustments, title and graphic placement, and exporting.
  • Organize footage and project files and deliver finished assets to required specifications and deadlines.
  • Coordinate revisions and approvals with sales and production staff.

Qualifications

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Professional written and verbal communication skills and a customer-service mindset.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro, including the ability to independently complete basic video edits.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Comfort conducting online research, checking information, and preparing clear summaries.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating across departments.
  • Sound judgment when handling client information and confidential materials.
  • Previous experience in sales support, project coordination, television, marketing, guest booking, or administrative support preferred.
  • Familiarity with advertising systems, CRM platforms, and digital media is a plus.
  • A degree in communications, marketing, business, or a related field is preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.

Work Environment

This position involves regular coordination with station staff, clients, and show guests. Scheduling flexibility may occasionally be needed for production, special projects, or station events.


How to Apply

Submit your résumé and a brief cover letter through the WCBD/Nexstar careers portal. Applicants are encouraged to include links to relevant video editing samples or a portfolio.

job.title: Strategic Account Manager
job.description:
KELOLAND Media Group (KELO) is seeking a Strategic Account Manager to join our Sales team in Sioux Falls, SD. This revenue-generating sales position plays a key role in developing new digital advertising business, expanding existing accounts, strengthening advertiser relationships, and delivering strategic marketing solutions that achieve measurable business results.


The Strategic Account Manager serves as the station's digital marketing services sales lead and digital advertising expert. Combining consultative selling, digital marketing expertise, and data-driven insights, this individual drives business development, client acquisition, revenue growth, and advertiser retention. Working collaboratively with Account Executives and other station departments, the Strategic Account Manager leads digital sales opportunities from prospecting and client discovery through solution development, sales presentations, campaign performance evaluation, renewal, and account expansion.

  • Develop and execute consultative digital advertising sales strategies that generate new business, grow existing accounts, and meet or exceed individual and station digital revenue goals.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities, account growth, renewals, upselling, and cross-selling to increase recurring digital advertising revenue.
  • Serve as the station's subject matter expert on digital advertising products, audience targeting, campaign analytics, attribution, and emerging digital marketing technologies.
  • Conduct market research, audience analysis, and account planning to identify prospective clients, evaluate business opportunities, and develop strategic advertising recommendations.
  • Lead and participate in client discovery meetings, sales presentations, and business reviews to identify advertiser needs, present digital marketing solutions, and advance sales opportunities.
  • Develop and present compelling proposals, audience recommendations, and integrated advertising solutions across digital and broadcast platforms, collaborating with Account Executives on shared client opportunities.
  • Analyze advertising campaign performance, interpret key metrics, and translate results into actionable recommendations that improve client outcomes and support revenue growth.
  • Lead strategic performance discussions with advertisers to demonstrate return on investment, address concerns, and identify opportunities for renewal and account expansion.
  • Proactively identify campaign performance issues, client retention risks, and opportunities to improve advertising effectiveness, customer satisfaction, and long-term revenue.
  • Establish, maintain, and grow meaningful relationships with advertisers and key decision-makers through consultative selling, strategic guidance, and recommendations that support long-term business partnerships.
  • Work collaboratively with Sales, Research, Ad Operations, and Digital Services teams to ensure alignment between advertising strategies, campaign execution, and client expectations.
  • Provide training, coaching, and ongoing guidance to Account Executives on digital advertising solutions, consultative selling techniques, and the effective use of research and performance data.
  • Stay informed of industry trends, competitive developments, emerging technologies, and changes in digital advertising to identify new sales opportunities for the station and its advertisers.
  • Contribute directly to station digital revenue growth, advertiser retention, sales conversion, account expansion, and achievement of established sales goals.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements & Skills:

  • Minimum of two years of experience in digital marketing, media sales, strategic account management, advertising strategy, consultative selling, or a related field, or equivalent education and work experience.
  • Strong understanding of digital advertising solutions, audience targeting, campaign optimization, performance marketing, analytics, and attribution.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop, present, and sell strategic marketing solutions that drive measurable business results.
  • Proven ability to generate new business, develop existing accounts, and contribute to meeting or exceeding sales and revenue goals.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex digital advertising concepts to clients and internal teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret campaign performance data and develop actionable business recommendations.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain positive client relationships, identify growth opportunities, and drive customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Strong presentation and consultative selling skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with advertisers, high-level decision-makers, sales professionals, and station leadership.
  • Experience working with customer relationship management (CRM) systems, digital analytics platforms, audience research tools, and performance reporting systems.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and collaborate effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with a proactive approach to identifying opportunities and resolving challenges.
  • Willingness to stay current with emerging digital advertising technologies, industry trends, and evolving marketing strategies.
  • Previous experience in television, broadcast media, digital advertising, advertising agencies, or related media environments preferred.

job.title: Administrative Assistant
job.description:
The Administrative Assistant will primarily provide administrative support to three Senior Vice Presidents. The position will handle a wide range of administrative and executive support-related tasks, including but not limited to calendar management, meeting preparation, travel arrangements and coordination, organizing and submitting expenses, and project management. The Administrative Assistant will operate with the utmost discretion while working with highly confidential information, ensuring impeccable attention to detail, organizational skills, and thoroughness. Additionally, this position will be in constant communication with both internal and external partners and clients.

Responsibilities

  • Manage complex and ever-changing day-to-day schedules of the SVPs via Microsoft Outlook, scheduling and organizing meetings across multiple time zones.
  • Anticipate all needs of the executives by thinking and working proactively with a one-step-ahead mentality throughout the day in terms of meeting prep, arising issues and new developments.
  • Prepare for meetings and appointments by creating agendas and other pertinent materials, preparing conference rooms and audio/visual needs and securing external guests when applicable.
  • Provide high-level administrative support to executives including answering phones, coordinating/preparing for meetings, maintaining calendar, arranging conference calls, arranging complex travel arrangements which include international, etc.
  • Serve as liaison between the SVPs and key stakeholders.
  • Act as a "gatekeeper" by managing the SVPs leadership’s calendars. This involves using discretion in identifying critical items, setting up meetings and making scheduling changes with minimal involvement by the executive. Plans, coordinates and ensures schedules are followed and respected.
  • Make thoughtful, quick and accurate decisions when executive is unavailable.
  • Assist in regularly creating and editing memos and PowerPoint presentations to be presented by the executives.
  • Coordinate travel arrangements; prepare detailed travel itineraries inclusive of flights, hotels, meeting agendas, etc.
  • Screen phone calls and forward calls appropriately, communicating with external and internal partners in a professional manner.

job.title: Associate, Business Operations (External Agency Employee)
job.description:
The NFL Films Commercial Operations and Business Affairs Department oversees business operations, strategy, and deal negotiations for NFL Films. We are seeking a Business Operations Associate who thrives in a creative, collaborative, and fast-paced environment and can provide operational support across key areas of the NFL Films business. This role will manage essential systems and workflows, coordinate employee and business partner initiatives, and work closely with NFL Films leadership, League departments, external vendors, and business partners.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the creation of POGA contracts for production projects and syndication Review incoming requests, manually create new project contracts, and distribute assigned contract numbers to the internal stakeholders who need them to keep projects on track.
  • Facilitate deal-execution workflows and new vendor onboarding through the contract lifecycle management system, partnering with internal teams to move agreements through execution. Create purchase orders and process invoices for Business Operations in line with company policies.
  • Lead the planning and execution of internal employee events and engagement programs, from concept, budgeting, and vendor coordination through day-of execution. Manage timelines, invitations, RSVPs, logistics, and post-event follow-up to deliver a well-organized experience for employees.
  • Track event-related vendors, such as caterers, through the onboarding process and maintain an accurate, up-to-date record of all onboarded vendors.
  • Provide cross-functional operational support for tax credit reporting and analysis.
  • Develop and maintain Airtable systems that support business operations across multiple groups, including project billing readiness and status updates for timely invoice preparation, budget and expenditure tracking, revenue reporting, ACA tracking, and third-party Entertainment Requests for use of NFL intellectual property.
  • Maintain production and footage usage trackers to ensure accurate project information, licensing compliance, and timely reporting across the NFL Films business.
  • Monitor licensing and website inquiries, route requests to the appropriate internal contacts, and maintain accurate client and vendor records to support ongoing business relationships.
  • Manage internal employee communications by drafting, editing, and distributing content for newsletters, the NFL Films Intranet, and informational monitors throughout the building.
  • Facilitate senior leadership business partner visits, including scheduling meetings, developing day-of itineraries, arranging building tours, coordinating internal participation, and providing on-site support to deliver a polished, professional experience.
  • Support additional business operations initiatives, special projects, and other responsibilities as assigned

Required Qualifications

  • 3-5+ years’ experience in a business operations environment.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • General knowledge of the production and media industry

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of Airtable or comparable databases and workflow platforms, as well as contract lifecycle management systems.
  • Proven ability to enhance processes and workflows by implementing solutions that increase efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Familiarity with production and media operations, including production tracking and footage usage compliance.
  • Background planning and executing internal employee events and coordinating business partner visits, including timelines, invitations, RSVPs, vendors, catering, logistics, and day-of execution.
  • Ability to support internal communications, including newsletters, intranet content, and digital signage.
  • Ability to partner across departments on agreements, requisitions, payment processing, and other operational needs.
  • Excellent organizational, prioritization, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Detail-oriented and able to work independently and collaboratively while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

 

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • 40 Hours per week in office.

job.title: Associate, Global Event Operations
job.description:
The NFL Global Event Operations team is seeking a highly motivated individual for a fulltime temporary position who has experience in live event operations, venue/stadium management and logistical planning. The role is focused on NFL tentpole events including Super Bowl and International events, while supporting other events as assigned (eg NFL Draft, Hall of Fame, Combine).  Additionally, the candidate is organized and has strong technical skills to create visually appealing, persuasive and effective presentations. This role is based out of New York City and will require a significant amount of travel.

Responsibilities

  • Support planning and execution of the NFL’s major events including but not limited to, master site planning and execution, venue and facility management, vendor management, production, budgeting, site operations, transportation, wayfinding and logistical planning and execution.
  • Work in operational capacity onsite at tentpole and other events in variety of roles
  • Build long and short-term event timelines, establishing deadlines and managing progress working cross-organizationally
  • Communicate and manage needs of internal NFL departments at Events including but not limited to Sponsorship, Consumer Products, PR/Communications, NFL Security, Football Operations, Broadcast & Media Operations and NFL Creative
  • Handle assigned projects from start to finish ensuring all appropriate parties are kept up to speed on progress and deadlines are met
  • Plan and manage onsite meetings and walkthroughs including planning trip dashboards, hotel/meeting space set-ups, A/V, IT, food and beverage, meeting scheduling & transportation
  • Attend and/or conduct meetings and walkthroughs on behalf of members of the events department
  • Provide administrative support including meeting scheduling, note taking, managing follow ups
  • Work with events team to build effective and clear presentations across events and projects
  • Participate in After Action Reporting process, collect data and turn into outward facing reports
  • Lead teams of people remotely or onsite at events
  • Manage invoicing, billing and contracting for multiple vendors supporting NFL events
  • Conduct research on venues, vendors, logistics and technology, as needed
  • Identify and drive new opportunities & innovation across NFL portfolio of events to increase revenue and evolve event experience
  • Support internal RFP process year-over-year pertaining to third party vendors at tentpole events

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively interact with people of diverse backgrounds and variety of levels inside and outside of the organization
  • Strong work ethic
  • Ability to work long hours, nights/weekends, as needed
  • Excellent organizational, interpersonal, and administrative skills
  • Service oriented style with professional presentations skills
  • Ability to improve the bottom line
  • Clear concise written and verbal communication skills
  • Effective in providing exceptional customer service
  • Ability to oversee and motivate support staff
  • Must be able to travel domestically and internationally
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  • High energy
  • Entrepreneurial spirit

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Creativity
  • Adaptability
  • Self-direction

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in multi-layered, large scale sports and entertainment-related events
  • Vendor/labor/workforce management
  • Knowledge of venue/stadium, media and broadcast operations
  • High-end client servicing experience

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Significant travel required, up to 50%

Physical Demands

This is a live event production role and, at times, will require physicality.  This could involve lifting, moving heavy objects, extended periods outdoors in inclement weather, long hours of physical movement during show production, extensive travel requirements, site builds and adjustment of physical assets.

job.title: Associate, Growth Audiences Marketing (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and culturally minded Associate to support our Growth Audience marketing efforts. This role will support the Global Brand and Consumer Marketing Growth Audience team to execute the youth and Flag Football marketing strategy. The ideal candidate is a strong project manager, detail-oriented, collaborative, and eager to build a career at the intersection of brand, sport, and culture. You’re passionate about culture and have a sharp eye on emerging trends. You understand what’s shaping conversations today, what’s coming next, and use those insights to inspire ideas and drive relevance. 

Responsibilities:

Strategic Support, Planning and Go-To-Market Coordination 

  • Support and document Growth Audience marketing strategies, objectives and performance measures  
  • Translate Growth Audience marketing priorities and tactics into consistent, clear and calendarized plans  
  • Maintain and update centralized planning frameworks and toolkits for cross-functional uses  
  • Produce presentations and communication materials for leadership  
  • Project manage and execute fully integrated marketing campaigns for top initiatives, including NFL FLAG, NFL FLAG Championships  
     

Flag Football Marketing Support & Execution 

  • Execute flag football marketing strategy, working with key internal and external stakeholders, helping to build out support efforts on the ramp up to Flag Football’s debut in the LA28 Olympic Games  
  • Build weekly trackers and dashboards to capture flag support across broadcast integrations, landing page KPIs and club and partner activations  
  • Support amplification efforts across NFL Tentpoles (PBG, Super Bowl, International Games), driving strategy and execution of deliverables across broadcast team, clubs, football development, comms, social and sponsorship  
  • Continuously identify and unlock synergies across broader flag football strategy, stakeholders and partners  

Youth Partner Support 

  • Support and own key youth partner relationships with day-to-day support needs including asset tracking, building Go To Market plans, amplification efforts and internal tracking  
  • Coordinate key meetings and input-gathering processes  
  • Identify emerging trends to help inform strategy  

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years in brand or sports marketing, agency partnerships or other relevant roles 
  • Bachelor’s degree required 
  • Strong project management skills and comfort working with a variety of stakeholders to hit deadlines  
  • Proficiency with PowerPoint and Excel 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills  

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics:

  • Highly collaborative team player 
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized  
  • Resourceful and proactive problem-solver  
  • Passionate about Culture and globally minded  
  • Flexible, self-motivated, and eager to learn

job.title: Associate, Marketing Science & Strategy- (External Agency Employee)
job.description:
The NFL Marketing Strategy & Insights team serves as the voice and advocate of NFL fans, leveraging diverse data sources to generate actionable insights that help inform League-wide business decisions and optimization. The Associate, Marketing Science and Strategy will support research and analysis across media, marketing, and key fan development priorities. This role is ideal for a curious, flexible, and detail-oriented professional who can help design and execute research, analyze syndicated and proprietary data, and translate findings into clear, strategic insights for internal and external stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the planning, execution, analysis, and reporting of primary research projects for the NFL.
  • Manage research initiatives by coordinating with internal stakeholders and third-party vendors to help ensure projects are delivered on time and on budget.
  • Create story-driven reports that translate research findings into strategic insights for teams across NFL Media, Marketing, Sponsorship, Club and other key areas.
  • Serve as a research resource and voice of the fan by supporting study development, methodology selection, survey design, data weighting, and reporting recommendations.
  • Use research tools and platforms, including MarketSight, Sports Poll, YouGov, and AceMetrix, to pull, analyze, and interpret data.
  • Provide support across Consumer Insights projects, including ad hoc analyses and custom research studies throughout the year.
  • Ensure research and insights work reflects best-in-class diversity, equity, and inclusion practices.

Required Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience in market research, consumer insights, analytics, consumer behavior, or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Market Research, Business, or a related discipline.
  • Understanding of quantitative research, including the ability to write surveys aligned to business questions and research objectives.
  • Ability to synthesize quantitative and qualitative data into concise, creative, and insightful reports for a diverse business audience.
  • Strong project management, relationship-building, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Experience with a range of research methods preferred.
  • Understanding of the application of various analytic techniques preferred.
  • Experience with analytical platforms such as Microsoft Excel, SPSS, or Q.

job.title: Associate, Player Relations (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The Player Relations Associate will assist the Sr. Manager, Player Relations and the Sr. Director, Player Relations in building a strong partnership with the entire football community with a focus on marketing and branding opportunities for both players and Legends. The associate will also play a pivotal role in the player procurement process and execution of all player appearances for the League.   

Responsibilities:

  • Player procurement and appearance management
    • Management of all player contracts for 1,000+ annual appearances
    • Liaison between NFL Legal, Finance, players and marketing reps for any contract edits
    • Collaborate with all internal NFL departments that book players to ensure the best players are selected and all contractual elements are executed correctly
    • Management of all appearance tracking documents and reporting including department metrics and fee trackers
    • Management of the Player Procurement System including liaising with NFL IT
  • Cultivate relationships with key stakeholders that support the player partnership
    • Act as the point of contact for the NFLPA Player Services team as it relates to player appearance contracts and creative approvals
    • Management of the quarterly NFL Agents Meeting which disseminates pertinent detail to key marketing representatives
    • Represent the Player Relations team in internal meetings that include player involvement in events or activations
  • Assist with all player brand building and marketing opportunities
    • Assist with league wide NFL marketing initiatives that effect the larger player population including My Cause My Cleats and the NFL Heritage Program
    • Collaborate with the Player Communications and Marketing team on content opportunities involving players or Legends
    • Management of the Player Office Visit program for all players and Legends
    • Manage the process for all group licensing creative approvals across the League to ensure guidelines are followed and player rights are protected
    • Review, track, and route all print, video, online promotions, enhancements and vignettes featuring active NFL players to the NFLPA for necessary approvals
  • Support the overall player experience and event activation
    • Manage the logistics tied to executing player appearances or activations and any support staff or vendors (i.e., Carey Cars, rotational staff, AMEX, etc.)
    • Management of specific groups at tent pole events to ensure they receive a best-in-class experience (i.e. Pro Bowl Roster, NFL Draft Prospects, WPMOY at Super Bowl, etc.)
    • Provides overall support to NFL Legends Community as needed

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Minimum 1-3 years of relevant experience
  • Experience with Microsoft Office
  • Excellent writing and presentation skills
  • Experience working in the sports industry and/or client management preferred

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • General knowledge of football and NFL players/teams
  • Strong ability to multi-task and prioritize effectively
  • Effective interpersonal skills and ability to be a team player
  • Ability to collaborate with internal groups and external partners
  • Ability to manage others with different interests and skill sets
  • Maintain autonomy on select projects and integrate internal parties where necessary
