job.title: Associate, Product Operations (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The NFL Digital Media Technical Operations team is seeking an experienced Product Operations Associate to assist with supporting various platforms at NFL Media including: NFL+, NFL.com, NFL app, and Clubs Sites. This person will be expected to immerse themselves within the details of all digital products and become a communication hub for operational activities. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills and demonstrate confidence in a fast-paced environment. This position communicates with Product Management, Technology, Marketing and Sales departments This role will report directly to the Senior Director of Digital Operations.

This is a temporary benefited role spanning 8+ months, paying $2,200.00 - $2,500.00 weekly.  

Responsibilities

  • Serve as central POC for communication and stakeholder management for all NFL's in-market products from product marketing, in-market operational support, content strategy, product enhancements, engineering, business development and legal.
  • Create concise plans and presentation for cross functional teams not limited to senior leadership from process/product ideation to in-market consumption.
  • Develop, manage, and continuously improve processes for scale that help the Digital Programming and Product teams meet their goals more efficiently and effectively.
  • Develop, manage, and enhance business analytics of in-market performance, not limited to KPI measure of operational performance, foster and maintain new technical partnerships with external and internal clients/vendors.
  • Provide operational support for our digital O&O platforms on all gamedays and around League tentpole events, including reporting and prioritization of issues.
  • Manage operational execution and support of live streaming digital shows on NFL.com.
  • Manage content updates within the CMS for various stakeholders within digital content programming, editorial and the League including active NFL.com webpage.
  • Manage request of access on NFL.com for API portals, databases, and ecommerce platforms services.
  • Oversee all new/existing partner integrations and operational responsibilities for authentication management for NFL O&O products not limited to MVPDs and Broadcast partners.
  • Serve as central POC for Live Broadcast blackout/retrans management & communications.
  • Maintain relationships with partner support teams who operate within and outside NFL.com support instance.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Manage Service Desk Jira board (Kanban) and ensure all tickets are being properly QA’d.
  • Help communicate Club product needs.
  • Ensure Service Desk developers have all the information they need to troubleshoot bug tickets.
  • Have an overall understanding of NFL and Club issues for prioritization.
  • Create runbooks and instructional articles to assist clubs with product updates.
  • Act as liaison between Clubs and the NFL streaming services during Preseason.
  • Quickly triage incidents impacting all Clubs.
  • Send release notes to Clubs and communicate platform updates/outages.

 Required Qualifications

  • BS or BA in business, marketing, communications, computer science, or related field preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years working in either product management, project management, business analysis, and live event support in large scale media environment.
  • Must be passionate about the NFL and its clubs.
  • Ability to supervise employees, handle conflict, manage change, and improve operations.
  • Excellent problem-solving ability; highly motivated to drive positive change.
  • Prior experience with Content Management Systems (CMS).
  • Prior experience in operational support of a web and mobile based applications.
  • Prior experience managing a JIRA board and writing user story tickets.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with markup skills utilizing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is preferred.
  • Proficiency in design via tools such as Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Strong Knowledge of 3rd party authentication work streams.
  • Avid interest and knowledge of NFL football.
  • Demonstrate the ability to create and maintain documentation and runbooks.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Ability to understand and document business rules.
  • Attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.
  • Excels collaborating with teams.
  • Ability to quickly learn new systems and programs.
  • Excellent problem-solving ability; highly motivated to drive positive change.
  • Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Passion for leading in a collaborative, cross functional team environment.
  • Well-organized; able to manage multiple tasks and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.

Travel 

  • Up to 15% travel required.

job.title: Associate, Reporting & Finance System Administration (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
Associate, Reporting & Finance System Administration Specialist

The Associate, Reporting & Finance System Administration Specialist supports the daily administration, reporting, and operational effectiveness of the organization's financial systems. This role assists with system support, report development, data validation, troubleshooting, and user support across Oracle ERP, Oracle EPM, BlackLine, and other finance applications.

Partnering closely with Finance, Accounting, Shared Services, and IT teams, this individual helps ensure data integrity, reporting accuracy, and efficient financial operations while contributing to process improvement and system enhancement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Systems Administration & Support

  • Provide day-to-day support for Oracle ERP, Oracle EPM, BlackLine, and related finance applications.
  • Troubleshoot system and reporting issues, escalating more complex matters as needed.
  • Support user access, security administration, and master data maintenance.
  • Assist with system testing, upgrades, patches, and enhancements.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities by resolving system-related issues.

Reporting & Data Management

  • Develop and maintain, standard and ad hoc financial reports.
  • Validate financial data and investigate reporting discrepancies.
  • Monitor data quality and support reconciliations across systems.
  • Maintain reporting documentation, standards, and data definitions.
  • Assist with data validation during system updates and enhancements.

Process Improvement & Projects

  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, data accuracy, and automation.
  • Support implementation of process improvements and system enhancements.
  • Participate in upgrades, implementations, and finance technology projects.
  • Assist with business requirements gathering, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and issue tracking.
  • Create and maintain process documentation, training materials, and end-user guides.

Collaboration & Customer Support

  • Partner with Finance, Accounting, Shared Services, IT, and business stakeholders.
  • Provide responsive support and clear communication regarding system issues, updates, and process changes.
  • Build strong working relationships with users and cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 1-3 years of experience in finance systems support, accounting operations, financial reporting, business analysis, or a related field.
  • Experience working with ERP systems, financial applications, or reporting tools.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

Preferred

  • Experience with Oracle ERP, Oracle EPM, BlackLine, or similar financial systems.
  • Experience supporting financial reporting, data analysis, or business intelligence initiatives.
  • Familiarity with Power BI or comparable reporting platforms.
  • Exposure to Finance, Accounting, Shared Services, or IT operations.

job.title: Director, Broadcast Engineering
job.description:
The Director, Broadcast Engineering is responsible for leading the strategy, operation, modernization, and reliability of mission-critical broadcast engineering systems that support live production, studio operations, transmission, post-production, digital media, and multi-platform content delivery. This role manages a team of engineers, technicians, specialists, and vendor partners while bridging traditional broadcast workflows with IP-based, virtualized, and cloud-enabled media infrastructure. The Director will provide technical leadership, staff development, operational discipline, and long-range planning to ensure high-quality, resilient, and scalable production services.

Responsibilities

Staff Leadership and Management

  • Lead, manage, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary broadcast engineering team responsible for live production, technical operations, maintenance, system support, and engineering projects.
  • Define team priorities, assign resources, manage schedules, establish performance objectives, and conduct regular performance reviews.
  • Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational readiness, documentation, continuous improvement, and inclusive leadership.
  • Develop career paths, training plans, succession plans, and cross-training programs to strengthen technical depth and leadership bench strength.
  • Partner with production, operations, IT, transmission, digital media, security, procurement, finance, and executive stakeholders to align staffing and engineering priorities with business objectives.

Broadcast Infrastructure and Operations

  • Oversee the design, deployment, maintenance, and lifecycle management of studios, control rooms, routing, intercom, audio, video, replay, graphics, monitoring, transmission, post-production, and media asset systems.
  • Ensure reliable operation of live broadcast environments through preventive maintenance, system monitoring, incident response, disaster recovery planning, and root-cause analysis.
  • Establish engineering standards, documentation practices, escalation procedures, commissioning processes, and operational readiness checklists.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable broadcast, safety, security, accessibility, and regulatory requirements. 

IP, Cloud, and Emerging Technology Strategy

  • Lead the transition from traditional SDI and hardware-centric workflows toward IP-based, software-defined, virtualized, and cloud-connected media infrastructure.
  • Evaluate and implement technologies such as SMPTE ST 2110, PTP timing, NMOS discovery and control, AES67, Dante, JPEG XS, SRT, NDI, bonded contribution, REMI production, virtualization, containerization, cloud playout, cloud production, remote monitoring, and observability platforms.
  • Develop hybrid architectures that connect on-premises broadcast facilities with digital media platforms, OTT distribution, FAST channels, content supply chains, and cloud-based production workflows.
  • Partner with IT, cybersecurity, network engineering, and cloud architecture teams to ensure media systems meet requirements for latency, timing, resiliency, security, scalability, and operational support.
  • Create roadmaps that balance current broadcast reliability requirements with future-facing digital media, automation, AI-assisted workflows, metadata, and cloud-native capabilities.

Project, Budget, and Vendor Management

  • Lead capital and operational engineering projects from concept through design, procurement, implementation, testing, training, handoff, and ongoing support.
  • Develop budgets, forecasts, business cases, technical requirements, scopes of work, risk assessments, and implementation schedules.
  • Manage vendor relationships, integrators, managed service providers, service contracts, support agreements, and equipment lifecycle planning.

Operational Support and Incident Management

  • Provide senior technical leadership during live events, critical outages, major launches, and high-priority production support scenarios.
  • Lead troubleshooting efforts across broadcast, IP network, storage, compute, cloud, audio, video, and application layers.
  • Develop incident reports, postmortems, lessons learned, corrective actions, and preventative controls.
  • Ensure teams are prepared for 24/7 operations, live-event support, escalation coverage, and business continuity requirements.

Communication and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for executive, operational, production, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Facilitate collaboration between engineering, production, digital media, IT, security, facilities, vendors, and business leadership.
  • Represent broadcast engineering in strategic planning, technology evaluation, roadmap development, standards alignment, and operational governance.

 Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, broadcast engineering, computer science, information technology, media technology, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in broadcast engineering, media systems engineering, technical operations, or live production technology, including leadership of complex broadcast facilities or production environments.
  • 5+ years of people-management experience leading engineers, technicians, managers, project teams, vendors, or managed service providers.
  • Demonstrated experience managing live production environments where reliability, speed, operational discipline, and incident response are critical.
  • Strong knowledge of broadcast signal flow, studio systems, production control rooms, intercom, audio, video, routing, replay, graphics, transmission, post-production, monitoring, and media asset workflows.
  • Working knowledge of IP media standards and systems, including SMPTE ST 2110, SMPTE 2022-6/7, PTP/IEEE 1588, NMOS IS-04/IS-05, AES67, Dante, multicast networking, QoS, and media-over-IP troubleshooting.
  • Experience with cloud, virtualization, digital media, or software-defined infrastructure, including hybrid workflows that connect broadcast operations with cloud production, streaming, OTT, FAST, remote production, or digital distribution platforms.
  • Familiarity with compute, storage, networking, cybersecurity, automation, orchestration, APIs, monitoring, observability, and DevOps-style support practices as they apply to media systems.
  • Proven ability to lead technical strategy, capital projects, budgets, vendor negotiations, RFPs, scopes of work, implementation plans, and lifecycle management.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours as needed to support live events, urgent technical issues, launches, maintenance windows, and business-critical operations.

Qualifications

  • Experience with ST 2110 facility design, IP fabric architecture, timing design, boundary clocks, grandmaster redundancy, multicast routing, and vendor interoperability testing.
  • Experience with media supply chain platforms, MAM/DAM systems, storage orchestration, transcoding, cloud-based playout, streaming workflows, and metadata-driven content operations.
  • Experience leading engineering teams through organizational change, facility transformation, SDI-to-IP migration, cloud adoption, or major technology refresh initiatives.
  • Knowledge of AI-assisted media workflows, automation, quality control, captioning, accessibility, rights-aware distribution, and digital content monetization platforms.

Salary / Pay Range

The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

job.title: Executive Assistant
job.description:
The Executive Assistant provides high-level administrative and operational support to two senior executives in a fast-paced, highly visible environment. This role manages complex calendars, meeting preparation, travel, expenses, communications, and projects while anticipating priorities and helping the executives remain organized and focused.   The Executive Assistant serves as a key liaison with internal and external stakeholders and regularly handles highly confidential information. Success requires exceptional judgment, discretion, attention to detail, organization, adaptability, and the ability to anticipate needs and act proactively with limited supervision.

Responsibilities

  • Manage complex, frequently changing executive calendars, coordinating meetings across multiple time zones, resolving scheduling conflicts, and proactively protecting time for critical priorities.
  • Anticipate the executives' day-to-day needs and priorities, proactively identifying scheduling issues, meeting requirements, emerging developments, and matters requiring timely attention or follow-up.
  • Coordinate and prepare executives for meetings and appointments, including agendas, briefing and presentation materials, conference rooms, audio/visual requirements, conference calls, external guests, and related logistics.
  • Plan and coordinate complex domestic and international travel, developing detailed itineraries that integrate transportation, accommodations, meetings, agendas, and other logistical requirements.
  • Serve as a trusted liaison and point of contact among the executives, their direct reports, other Executive Assistants, and internal and external stakeholders, exercising professionalism, diplomacy, tact, and discretion.
  • Manage executive communications and information flow, including reviewing and prioritizing correspondence, drafting and editing communications, memos, reports, and presentations, and ensuring time-sensitive matters receive appropriate attention and follow-through.
  • Exercise sound independent judgment when executives are unavailable, assessing urgency, making appropriate administrative decisions, escalating critical matters, and maintaining confidentiality.
  • Coordinate large and complex meetings and executive activities, ensuring materials, participants, technology, facilities, security, and other logistical requirements are organized and executed effectively.
  • Manage executive and departmental administrative processes, including preparing, reconciling, and submitting invoices and credit card expenses in Concur and maintaining accurate internal and external contact information.
  • Maintain awareness of relevant sports business developments, organizational initiatives, and department priorities, identifying information, deadlines, or developments requiring executive awareness or action.
  • Build strong working partnerships with Executive Assistants, direct reports, facilities, travel, IT, security, and other key stakeholders to facilitate effective executive operations.
  • Provide additional administrative and project support as needed, including document and records management, shipping and mail coordination, and other assignments that support executive and department priorities.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 4+ years of administrative or executive assistant experience supporting a senior-level executive.
  • Significant proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong technology skills, including experience working across PC and Mac environments and mobile devices.
  • Demonstrated experience handling sensitive and confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex calendars, meetings, travel, communications, and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, solve problems independently, and follow through on commitments with limited supervision.
  • Strong attention to detail and demonstrated project-management capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Experience in the digital, entertainment, or sports industry.
  • Fast and accurate typing skills.

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics

  • Proactive and anticipatory: Consistently thinks ahead, identifies needs and potential issues early, and takes appropriate action.
  • Judgment and discretion: Handles confidential and sensitive information appropriately and makes thoughtful decisions in high-pressure situations.
  • Executive presence and diplomacy: Communicates effectively and professionally with senior executives, high-profile individuals, colleagues, and external partners.
  • Organization and execution: Effectively manages multiple priorities, deadlines, details, and changing requirements while maintaining accuracy and follow-through.
  • Composure and adaptability: Remains calm, solution-oriented, and effective in a fluid, fast-paced environment.
  • Resourcefulness and problem solving: Approaches challenges with curiosity, sound judgment, resilience, and a continuous-improvement mindset.
  • Collaboration: Builds trusted relationships across functions and works effectively with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.

Travel

  • Travel to main NFL events with the Executives as needed.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • NFL employees are required to work 40 hours per week in office.
  • FLSA Exempt.

Salary / Pay Range

The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range. job.title: Manager, DTC Product Marketing
job.description:
The Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) Product Marketing team is a group of strategic brand and product marketers responsible for driving campaign development, brand strategy, media planning, and execution across the DTC portfolio – including NFL+, NFL App, and more.  

As DTC Product Marketing Manager, you will support the go-to-market (GTM) strategy development and lead day-to-day marketing execution for the DTC portfolio. Accelerating subscriptions, minimizing churn, deepening engagement, and delivering fan-first campaigns powered by insights and personalization for NFL+ will be your primary focus. You’ll collaborate closely across departments – from Product to Consumer Insights to Media – and work externally with league partners, agencies, and platform partners to bring innovative plans to life.  

Responsibilities

  • Support GTM strategy development and lead execution for NFL+ and related DTC experiences, from planning to launch to optimization
  • Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure strategic campaign alignment and tactical implementation
  • Craft clear and inspiring marketing briefs for internal teams and external agencies that articulate the objective, audience, product value, desired customer action, and measures of success
  • Oversee campaign development across owned and paid channels, including audience targets, messaging, creative assets, approvals, and execution
  • Lead promotional planning and manage creative asset delivery for both on-platform and off-platform touchpoints
  • Analyze and interpret performance across marketing channels and fan journeys to optimize initiatives and tactics
  • Leverage fan insights, campaign outcomes, and market intelligence to support recommendations for product marketing strategy, audience definitions, messaging, and customer journey design
  • Contribute to weekly cross-functional planning meetings to ensure alignment and delivery against business goals, milestones, and dependencies
  • Support executive communication and internal rollout of marketing initiatives through clear updates on plans, performance, risks, and next steps
  • Lead assigned projects and workstreams, escalating key risks and decisions as needed 

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in marketing, preferably in entertainment, sports, tech, or subscription-based products
  • Strong strategic mindset with a track record of translating insights into action
  • Creative instincts and experience managing campaigns from ideation to execution
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills (copywriting experience a plus)
  • Highly organized with a commitment to operational rigor and accuracy
  • Strong time management skills and the ability to juggle multiple high-stakes projects
  • Comfort with managing multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment
  • Team-oriented mindset with a drive for collaboration and accountability

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Passion for sports and an understanding of its role in culture
  • Background in subscription models, streaming, DTC platforms, and/or product marketing
  • Familiarity with the evolving media landscape and digital consumption behaviors
  • Hands-on experience with personalization, testing, measurement, and optimization  
  • Comfort using AI and emerging technologies to drive workflow efficiencies and/or support customer-facing efforts
  • Ability to navigate projects through ambiguity and formulate clear next steps 

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Employees are to work 40 hours per week in the office. 

Salary / Pay Range

This job posting contains a pay range, which represents the range of salaries or hourly rates that the NFL believes, in good faith, at the time of this posting that it might be willing to pay for the posted job in the location(s) specified. The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

 

Salary $110,000—$125,000 USD

job.title: Part-Time Researcher
job.description:
The Researcher helps to drive the development and distribution of research to the NFL Media Group, ensuring editorial consistency and factual accuracy.  

Responsibilities

  • Drives the development of editorial content ensuring that ideas are properly executed as graphics, segments, pieces and more on live studio shows
  • Contributes to daily content distribution plan that pushes targeted research materials to content creators throughout the Media Group
  • Develops original storylines, notes, nuggets and “boards” that provide statistical context around events, news stories and topical issues
  • Recognizes and anticipates league and team trends, applying appropriate statistics to create content
  • Ensures factual accuracy of all content generated
  • Works within our standards for high-quality research content while maintaining tireless work ethic on a consistent basis
  • Works closely with coordinating producers, producers, editors, digital team, talent and writers
  • Makes significant and essential contributions to Weekly Research Notes, breaking news and numerous research-related projects supporting the Media Group
  • Utilizes broad football knowledge and awareness of the NFL Media Group’s platform to anticipate the research needs
  • Helps to identify new and emerging statistical trends and seeks out ways to engage with outside companies who may be generating these trends
  • Collaborate with research team on best practices regarding both dedicated show research and general research support
  • Recommends changes to enhance current research methods and standards
  • Must be able to adhere to strict deadlines and react to breaking news
  • Strong writing and editing skills are required
  • Strong attention to detail skills are required
  • Must be able to communicate information accurately

Required Qualifications

  • 1-3 years professional experience working with statistics or covering or analyzing sports events and news
  • Undergraduate degree
  • Must have strong foundation of knowledge about current and historical football statistics, news, events and milestones
  • Must be technologically savvy, with strong command of Microsoft Word, Outlook and Excel
  • Must have strong familiarity with digital and social platforms

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in sports media
  • Previous work experience working for or covering the NFL
  • Proven track record of success working with high profile broadcasters
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively and on deadline
  • Knowledge of football research databases/resources a plus (i.e. Pro Football Reference, Pro Football Focus, Rotoworld and/or nfl.com)
  • Thorough knowledge of football media landscape, including emerging platforms and competing properties
  • Detailed knowledge of television production processes, including awareness of key editorial roles

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

job.title: Recruiter, Seasonal & Early Careers Associate (External Agency Employee)
job.description:
The Early Careers & Seasonal Recruitment Associate will support full-cycle recruiting efforts across Early Career programs and high-volume Seasonal hiring for various NFL offices. This role is critical to building and sustaining talent pipelines that support both near-term staffing needs and long-term talent development.

The successful candidate will partner closely with hiring managers, senior leaders, Human Resources, Compensation, Finance, and HR Business Partners to deliver efficient, equitable, and high-quality hiring outcomes that align with the NFL’s vision, mission, and values.

Responsibilities

  • Provide full-cycle recruiting support, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, scheduling, and offer management, for:
    • Early career programs (internships, rotational programs, fellowships, entry-level roles)
    • High-volume seasonal and temporary roles across multiple departments and locations
  • Handle 40–50+ requisitions during peak seasonal periods across multiple departments and locations.
  • Partner with hiring managers and HR to understand workforce needs, headcount planning, and role requirements.
  • Build and maintain diverse talent pipelines for early career and recurring seasonal hiring.
  • Provide regular search updates, hiring insights, and pipeline reporting to stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate candidate and requisition data in Greenhouse.
  • Coordinate offer processes and ensure completion of onboarding requirements.
  • Represent the NFL at campus events, job fairs, and virtual or in-person recruiting events as needed.
  • Ensure compliance with EEO, ADA, and applicable federal and state employment laws.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 3 years of recruitment experience (early career, seasonal, or high-volume), or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Demonstrated success managing high-volume requisitions concurrently.
  • Experience with recruitment platforms such as Greenhouse, LinkedIn, and HireVue.
  • Strong working knowledge of federal and state employment laws and corporate recruiting practices.
  • Proven candidate management and stakeholder partnership skills.
  • Excellent project management, organizational, and communication skills.

Other Key Attributes

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Experience supporting large-scale, fast-turnaround hiring initiatives.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to quickly learn operational needs across departments.
  • Detail-oriented with strong follow-through and proactive problem-solving skills.
  • Self-starter who can work independently while collaborating effectively with teams.
  • Creative, resourceful, and solutions-oriented thinker.

Travel

  • Potential travel during peak recruiting seasons.

Terms & Expected Hours of Work

This job posting is for a position with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners that provides services to the NFL. The individual selected for this role will be an employee of that third-party agency and not the NFL. All compensation, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment are handled by the agency. The assignment to provide services to the NFL will be limited in duration but may be extended for an additional period by agreement between the NFL and the agency.

  • Anticipated engagement of up to six months or longer, subject to business needs.
  • 40 hours per week required; overtime and/or weekend hours may be necessary during peak recruiting periods.
  • FLSA non-exempt.
  • This role is with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners providing recruitment services to the NFL.

The Seasonal Associate Producer contributes to editorial and production execution across a range of NFL Films programming. The role supports research, editing, scripting, and post-production workflows while collaborating closely with Producers.

job.title: Seasonal Feature Producer
job.description:

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time TOC Operator
job.description:
The TOC Operator will perform multiple job functions and ensure that all technical facility requests are met.  Works closely with NFL Media Production team, Newsroom personnel, NFL Films Technical Operations, Encompass Atlanta Technical Operation, and members of all 32 NFL Clubs to ensure all video content is received and distributed to broadcast specifications.  Works closely with Engineering to troubleshoot all issues that may occur with feeds or broadcast.  Communicates with NFL Network Master Control during live broadcasts to ensure signal continuity.  Works closely with Remote Operations team for the proper transmission and receipt of feeds for live remote network productions including NFL Network Games, Super Bowl, NFL Combine, NFL Draft, Hall of Fame Enshrinement, and any other NFL Network remote projects.  Works closely with SVG team to provide content with captioning for our streaming platforms on NFL.com, NFL FAST Channel, and NFL +.  The TOC operator is the first point of troubleshooting and escalation if an issue occurs and will be expected to communicate issues to Operations and Production Management in a timely and efficient manner.

Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate knowledge and operation of broadcast routing systems, including split routes as required.
  • Ability to read digital & analog waveform monitors and how to set up test bars.
  • Ability to read audio meters.
  • Must have strong understanding of analog, digital and SMPTE 2110 signal flows.
  • Must be able to perform Sync and Fax checks prior to live shows and events.
  • Ability to perform extensive transmission checks prior to live remote events.
  • Booking and goodnight procedures for The Switch, Lumen & AT&T Fiber and Satellite orders.
  • Strong understanding of common broadcast signal problems and how to rectify them, i.e. audio levels or distortion, sync issues, video issues.
  • Must possess above average writing skills to document on-air issues.
  • Requires strong oral and written skills, including excellent telephone etiquette.
  • Requires strong organizational skills to ensure high broadcast quality on multiple feeds.
  • Must be willing to adapt in a quickly changing environment.
  • Familiarity with EVS IP Director ingest server systems.
  • Responsible for the generation of broadcast reports as required.

Required Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years’ experience in a broadcast operations environment including 2110, HD/SD, ASI, JPEG and MPLS signals and the ability to troubleshoot those signal paths. 
  • Possess a strong work ethic and positive attitude and leadership qualities. 

Expected Hours of Work

  • Up to 29 hours per week up to 7 months based on business needs
  • Must be willing to work flexible schedules including nights, weekends and holidays.  

Salary / Pay Range

The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. job.title: Seasonal Product Designer
job.description:
The NFL is seeking a Seasonal Product Designer to join our Product team. This role is perfect for a passionate and detail-oriented designer who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and is eager to contribute to one of the most iconic brands in sports.

As a Seasonal Product Designer, you will support the design of NFL owned and operated experiences like the NFL App, NFL.com and our Connected TV experience as well as the creation and delivery of digital assets across the NFL’s product portfolio. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams, including Product Design, Marketing, Creative, and Product Management, as well as senior designers and other team members, to craft thoughtful, high-quality design that enhances the fan experience across all platforms and aligns with brand guidelines and project requirements. You will also help design and deliver marketing, e-commerce and promotional assets for various projects and platforms. Responsibilities often include creating app/web/connected TV UI, graphics, mockups, and prototypes, as well as managing and organizing design files. 

This is a unique opportunity to make a real impact on the look and feel of NFL digital products, from concept to execution, throughout the 2026-27 season.

Responsibilities

  • Help design team deliver user experience designs for our portfolio of NFL owned and operated experiences including NFL Connected TV, NFL Mobile App, NFL.com, and more.
    • Some examples of assets UX/UI work you will work on:
      • UX/UI work for app screens on the NFL App, NFL Connected TV App and NFL.com.
      • Improvements, updates and new components.
      • Design system improvements and updates.
  • Asset Design and Delivery: Assisting with asset creation across our product portfolio including NFL Connected TV, NFL Mobile App, NFL.com, and more.
    • Some examples of assets you will create:
      • Artwork for marketing, content, games, events, etc.
      • User Interface assets like icons or illustrations.
      • Processing Image cutouts.
      • UI Mockups with assets for review.
      • Mockups and artwork for presentations.
      • App Store Assets.
      • and more...
  • Follow Design Guidelines: Ensure all the design deliverables adhere to brand guidelines and style guides.
  • Collaborating with teams: Work with designers and other stakeholders to understand project requirements. 
  • Developing design concepts: Contributing to the ideation and development of design solutions. 
  • Managing digital assets: Organizing and maintaining design files and assets.
  • Meeting deadlines: Managing multiple projects and prioritizing work to meet deadlines. 

 Required Qualifications

  • High Proficiency in design software such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), understanding of photo editing, cutouts and manipulation as well as editing PSD/AI assets that are provided.
  • High Proficiency in Figma: All of our product experiences are designed and managed in Figma and this will be the primary space we will be designing, collaborating, reviewing and delivering work from for not just designers but also our entire Product Team including Product Managers, Engineers, Project Managers and Marketing Team.
  • Strong Portfolio of work showing excellent design.
  • Understanding and Experience with Design Systems as you will be frequently designing within the constraints of our components and screens on different platforms.
  • Understanding of web/app asset delivery requirements like file formats, file sizes, image ratios, saving for multiple devices and device breakpoints.
  • Some understanding of Accessibility guidelines to ensure our assets pass accessibility rules.
  • A strong understanding of design principles and visual elements and art direction.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
  • Attention to detail and a strong eye for visual design.
  • May require experience with AI tools for creative purposes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 4-year Bachelor's Degree in Design, UX or Human-Computer Interaction.

job.title: Seasonal Senior Product Designer
job.description:
The NFL is looking for a Senior Product Designer to bring compelling, innovative and user-centered design digital experiences to life across the NFL portfolio. The ideal candidate will be a passionate product designer, adept in balancing the nuances of user flows, product requirements and UX practices with a love of the details that bring thoughtful, well-crafted designs to life. We will look to you for strategic design thinking as well as best in class execution, along with a passion for collaboration, a curious mind, and an enthusiastic approach to making great products.

This role will work closely with Product Management, Project Management, Engineering, UX and User Research across all products and platforms to creatively solve problems and partner with all facets of the NFL organization to help bring those ideas to life for the incredible NFL fan base.

This is an exciting opportunity to have a major impact on all of the products within the NFL portfolio and help shape our process to continuously improve and ship them.

*Please submit a resume and portfolio (pdf or website link) with your application.

Responsibilities

  • Design compelling, informative, and engaging user experiences & flows.
  • Deliver high-fidelity UI and UX specs that clearly communicate requirements.
  • Be an excellent communicator and storyteller both verbally and visually, bringing ideas to life using sketches, workshops, journeys, comps, prototypes, presentations and more to communicate clearly and move the needle within creative teams and with less design-fluent stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with the UX, User Research, Product Managers and Engineering teams to identify needs, determine approaches, create design solutions and iteratively refine ideas through development and launch.
  • Advocate for design and experience priorities within interdisciplinary teams in creating products that consider users, push for innovation, prioritize usability, and balance business objectives from ideation to launch through maintenance on live products.
  • Identify, align, and establish shared user experience patterns across different platform features.
  • Contribute to creating and managing a cohesive design system across the NFL digital portfolio via flexible and reusable components.
  • Be a champion for experience cohesion, helping the expansive NFL digital ecosystem function in one unified voice.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Product Design experience developing user experiences and interface design for digital products.
  • Bachelor’s degree in design, graphic design, fine arts, or equivalent field preferred.
  • Strong portfolio with engaging, diverse designs in the digital space, demonstrating a passion for design.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and shipping end to end products with complicated flows, multiple scenarios and edge cases.
  • A strong understanding of interactivity, accessibility/WCAG, design systems, and the fundamentals of typography, hierarchy, and layout.
  • Motivated, detail oriented, organized, and accountable, with the ability to work both independently and in highly collaborative settings.
  • Strategic problem-solving skills and the capacity to distill complex information into meaningful concepts, ideas, and designs.
  • Strong experience working in Figma, particularly with building and managing component libraries; a comfort with additional tools for design, collaboration & prototyping is a plus.
  • Experience collaborating with other designers, giving and accepting constructive criticism.
  • Experience with the agile development methodology and ability to work in a fast-paced environment, often juggling multiple priorities and successfully balancing immediate short-term needs while maintaining strategic vision for the long-term.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 4-year Bachelors Degree in Design, UX or Human-Computer Interaction.
  • 5-7 years of experience working in with a Product teams, Marketing agencies or Digital Media organizations with relevant experience assisting in the design and delivery of design assets.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Have a positive attitude and work well with others on the team.
  • Have a collaborative mindset and aren’t afraid to ask for help or feedback. You understand that open communication leads to better outcomes and stronger design.
  • Eager to learn new skills and take on challenges.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Up to 7-month employment period, 40 hours/week expected.
  • Flexible schedule required, including weekends, holidays, and occasional late nights.

Our producers also start on the overnight shift, producing the morning news for a passionate television audience before moving on to other shifts. This role is NOT for those who are looking to be on-air. You must have a degree in Broadcasting or Journalism. You must be able to show us how you would approach producing and showcasing content, and how to keep it fresh in different broadcasts. If you want to be part of a dynamic newsroom that thrives on breaking news and creating compelling content every day, we want to see your work. Send a link to your work, along with your news philosophy and what you think makes for great television news product. Candidates MUST have a degree in Journalism or a related field. This is not a remote position. Pay Range: $17.40 – 20.00 per hour. Based on experience. When applying for this position, please note your referral source, and go to KEYT.com under About Us, choose Jobs/Internships. All applicants must apply through the website. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of background and drug screenings. Finalists must furnish evidence of employment authorization and identification. PLEASE NO PHONE CALLS. job.title: Chief Business Editor
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application deadline and instructions :

  • Please complete and submit your application by 11:59 pm EST on Monday, December 7th, 2026
  • Please submit your resume and cover letter. In your cover letter please share your philosophy for leading a Business desk and what you envision the top focus areas should be for the desk in 2027.

Intro to Position

NPR’s Chief Business Editor has overall operational and editorial responsibility for business and economics coverage on all platforms. This editor supervises assignments and provides editorial guidance to a team of business reporters, correspondents and editors across the country. The position also advises NPR shows, including Morning Edition and All Things Considered, and coordinates editorial content closely with the Planet Money podcast team. This includes preparation of material on all platforms, overseeing the editorial integrity and quality of content, monitoring and evaluating staff performance, recommending new hires and providing editorial support to the Executive Editor.  This position will be responsible for a team and report to the Executive Editor.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

Responsibilities

  • Leads NPR’s business coverage through a combination of distinctive stories, daily news, enterprise and scoops
  • Identifies and sharpen areas of coverage across broadcast and digital platforms
  • Supervises assignments and provide editorial guidance to staff, station and freelance reporters, and production staff
  • Works across the newsroom to determine the best approaches to stories, subjects to be discussed and treated, and individuals to be interviewed 
  • Tracks station, freelance and staff submissions and assignments. 
  • Ensures that speculative submissions from stations and freelancers are auditioned to determine suitability for airing. 
  • Regularly has critical discussions about pieces with reporters and editors, and with the Executive Editor, as appropriate.   
  • Makes hiring and salary recommendations for staff members under his or her supervision, in consultation with the Executive Editor. 
  • Responsible for preparing performance reviews for assigned staff members. 
  • Assists in planning and monitoring the business unit’s annual budgets and in monitoring current spending. 
  • Coordinates business unit staff schedules, submits and approves time sheets and maintains other personnel records as needed. 
  • Responsible for tracking overtime and travel expenditures.
  • Ensures that all material aired and published meets the highest journalistic standards and practices, including standards of accuracy, fairness and probity. 

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • A minimum of 15 years’ experience as a news reporter or editor, including demonstrated experience covering business and economics
  • Demonstrated experience overseeing editorial output for social media and digital platforms
  • Demonstrated collaborative approach to newsgathering and story presentation across platforms
  • Considerable skill in both news and feature editing

Preferred Qualifications

  • Broadcast and specifically radio news experience
  • Familiarity with the NPR member station network

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Previous managerial experience

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and work experience 

Work Location & Requirements

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. Some aspects of this role require duties better performed at an NPR facility. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C., New York City, or Culver City location at least 3 days a week.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $190,000-215,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

job.title: Cloud Systems Engineer
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR is seeking a Systems Engineer for its Distribution IT Infrastructure team to manage, test, and maintain our enterprise virtualized infrastructure, including servers, storage, and networking systems. In this role, you will deploy, configure, monitor, and troubleshoot modern virtualization platforms (such as VMware vSphere, HPE Morpheus VM Essentials, or Proxmox) to guarantee high availability, scalability, and security across NPR's core distribution technologies.

This role sits at the intersection of physical and virtual infrastructure: you will help stand up new data center hardware and build NPR's private cloud environment on top of it, from rack and cable to hypervisor and host networking.

Working collaboratively with Infrastructure and Security colleagues, you will analyze business workflows, implement structured change management processes, and support capacity planning initiatives to deliver resilient, mission-critical operations for NPR and our nationwide Member station network.

Responsibilities

  • Physical Infrastructure Build-Out: Partner with Infrastructure colleagues to install, rack, cable, and configure new server, storage, and network hardware, including firmware updates, out-of-band management (e.g., HPE iLO, Dell iDRAC), and RAID/BIOS configuration, to establish the foundation for virtualized workloads.
  • Virtual Infrastructure Deployment & Maintenance: Deploy, configure, and maintain virtualized systems using enterprise tools (e.g., HPE Morpheus VM Essentials, Proxmox, Nutanix, Incus, or VMware) to support operational reliability.
  • Architecture Evaluation & Testing: Evaluate virtual system architecture, compare existing applications, and create metrics to measure response times and availability for test environments.
  • Change Management Implementation: Recommend and execute system enhancements following established organizational change management policies and procedures.
  • Operational & Capacity Support: Assist the Distribution Infrastructure team in executing cloud/virtualization workflows and capacity planning tools focused on return on investment and business value.
  • Security Alignment & Compliance: Partner with Security Engineers to ensure virtual hosts, operating systems, and network configurations comply with organizational security policies.
  • Workflow & Process Analysis: Analyze and document Distribution IT process workflows, identifying areas for continuous improvement and operational efficiency.
  • Technical Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Create comprehensive documentation, procedures, instructions, and training materials for internal colleagues and system users.
  • Incident Escalation & Operational Support: Proactively communicate operational status to management, participate in an on-call rotation, and respond to critical system issues on a 24x7 basis as needed.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience supporting, maintaining, troubleshooting, and administering servers and networking within a data center environment.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in the planning, design, deployment, and management of enterprise virtualized cloud infrastructure (e.g., VMware ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, or open-source hypervisors).
  • Hands-on experience with physical data center hardware, including racking and cabling servers, configuring out-of-band 
  • Competence in DNS administration (BIND preferred).
  • Experience with IP address management (IPAM) and DHCP services.
  • Experience with configuration management (Puppet preferred).
  • Experience creating agentless automation workflows (Ansible preferred).
  • Experience with Mail Transfer Agent administration (Exim).
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server administration (2022+) alongside core directory and networking protocols (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, IIS).
  • Practical experience supporting enterprise storage (NetApp or TrueNAS).
  • Comfortable with networking configuration of hosts, switches, and routers, including VLANs, trunking, and NIC bonding/link aggregation as applied to hypervisor hosts.
  • Proven track record as a key contributor or project leader on complex technical initiatives, including the creation of detailed technical documentation and workflow diagrams.
  • Demonstrated ability to participate effectively in a team environment, handle multiple concurrent projects, and contribute to an on-call rotation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Unix/Linux networking configuration and Cisco switches and routers (Catalyst or Nexus/NX-OS).
  • Familiarity with scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, or JavaScript).
  • Experience with enterprise backup/recovery solutions (e.g., Veeam).
  • Experience with HPE ProLiant or Dell PowerEdge server hardware.
  • Knowledge of Linux operating systems and relevant industry certifications (VMware VCP, Microsoft, or AWS).

Required Skills/Competencies

  • System Troubleshooting & Diagnostics: Ability to systematically isolate, diagnose, and resolve complex issues across hardware, server, storage, network, and virtualized layers.
  • Structured Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills to present technical concepts and write actionable system documentation.
  • Prioritization Under Pressure: Capacity to prioritize tasks effectively during high-urgency system maintenance or operational incidents.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to partner seamlessly with Security, Network, and Distribution engineering teams.
  • Continuous Learning Mindset: Commitment to staying current with emerging virtualization tools, cloud platforms, and data center technologies.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, OR equivalent practical work experience.

Work Location

Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. Some aspects of this role require duties better performed at an NPR facility. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. location at least 2 days a week. The employee must also reside in an NPR-supported location based on the number of on-site days they choose.

Job Type

This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

job.title: Manager, AI Engineering and Vendor Operations
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR's AI Labs team is looking for a Manager of AI Engineering and Vendor Operations. This person will serve on the AI Labs leadership team and help inform NPR's AI technical strategy. We are seeking a player-coach style who understands the complexities of building adaptive and conscientious AI coding teams, and can help us apply rigor and standards to our infrastructure decisions and rollouts. In this role, you will supervise the mid-level engineering staff, provide mentorship and support to NPR's larger engineering teams and own the evaluation and deployment of the team's AI tools and vendors. This role suits someone who can weigh build-versus-buy decisions honestly, explain technical trade-offs to non-technical colleagues, and hold both vendors and our own work to NPR's standards for privacy, security, and accuracy. This is a chance to shape a new team and have a tangible effect on how NPR uses AI responsibly in service of its mission, on a team built on respect, trust, and work-life balance.

Responsibilities

  • People Leadership: Manage and mentor a team of entry and mid-level AI engineers, including hiring, onboarding, and supporting each person's professional growth.
  • Delivery: Lead technical planning, scoping, and sprint execution for AI Labs engineering work, such as NPR's AI-powered metadata service, in partnership with AI Labs leadership and editorial and business stakeholders.
  • Engineering Standards: Work with AI Labs leadership to develop AI coding frameworks, practices, and expectations for the team.
  • Code Quality and Architecture: Review designs and code, and contribute hands-on where it helps the team, keeping systems maintainable, secure, and consistent with NPR's technical standards.
  • Testing and Evaluation: Build and maintain automated testing and model evaluation practices, including regression tests and evaluation checks before release, aligned with quality bars set by the product team.
  • Production Support: Coordinate the team's response to production bugs and infrastructure incidents, and lead follow-up reviews to prevent repeat problems.
  • Vendor Evaluation: Lead technical evaluations of AI vendors, models, and tools, covering architecture, data handling, security, and cost, and recommend whether NPR should build, buy, or partner.
  • NPR-wide AI Tool Review: Participate in AI Labs' review of AI tools requested by teams across NPR, working with IT Security through the vendor risk and security intake processes. AI Labs assesses, and IT and the Office of General Counsel approve.
  • Vendor Relationships: Take over day-to-day management of selected AI vendors and tools, from onboarding and seat provisioning through renewal and offboarding. 
  • Responsible Scaling: Track vendor usage, spend, and renewal dates against budget, and ensure AI systems scale securely and cost-effectively while maintaining strong data privacy protections.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of experience building and shipping production AI or machine learning systems, with deep hands-on knowledge of large language models and the systems built around them.
  • 2+ years of experience managing or mentoring engineers.
  • Experience setting engineering practices for a team, such as code review, testing, or deployment standards.
  • Experience working with technology vendors and managing software tools, including security and data privacy reviews.
  • Experience building automated testing, including methods for evaluating the quality of AI model outputs.
  • Hands-on experience building in a major cloud environment (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Experience setting up automated testing, including methods for evaluating the quality of AI model outputs.
  • Experience working across technical and non-technical teams, including explaining technical and cost trade-offs to people without a technical background and working with product managers to gather requirements from stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a media organization, newsroom, or public service institution.
  • Experience onboarding staff into a new or growing team.
  • Experience designing harnesses for AI coding agents, including permissions, approval steps, and automated checks.
  • Experience working with procurement, legal, or vendor risk teams on technology reviews.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Strong Python skills and working knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and semantic search.
  • Proficiency in design and architecture of AI systems and systems of AI evaluation
  • Proficiency in SQL and cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake.
  • Familiarity with model evaluation methods, prompt engineering, and API integration, including NPR's approved model families such as Claude, Gemini, Gemma, and Llama.
  • Ability to assess vendor security documentation, data processing terms, and seat-based and usage-based pricing.
  • Commitment to data privacy, AI ethics, and identifying and reducing bias.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Work Location & Requirements

The employee will be required to be in the office, preferably at the Washington, DC location, at least 2 days a week. job.title: Overnight/Live Broadcast Supervising Editor, Morning Edition & Up First
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Instructions:

Please submit your resume and cover letter. In your cover letter please share your philosophy for leading a newsroom overnight in order to deliver the most up-to-date morning broadcast possible.

Intro to Position

Morning Edition and Up First are looking for a resilient journalist with strong news judgment, excellent writing skills and a willingness to work overnights as the Overnight/Live Broadcast Supervising Editor, managing  a production team that executes what is needed to get the live radio show to air and the Up First podcast to publication.

Millions of listeners depend on Morning Edition and Up First to set the news agenda to start their day. We deliver the latest national and international news stories paired with analysis to put headlines into context. Morning Edition is a platform for accountability through interviews with government officials and decision makers who make or influence policy that affect people's lives. The show also features culture stories about music, movies and books that bring joy and provoke thoughtful conversations about who we are in this world.

The right candidate for this position is committed to daily news, and is eager to deliver the freshest, most important stories to listeners. They put the needs and wants of audiences first. They believe in the mission of public media.

As the Overnight/Live Broadcast Supervising Editor, you will join a team of managers who collaboratively lead news and editorial coverage of events in the U.S. and around the world for Morning Edition and Up First. You ensure that the show is at the leading edge of the conversation across a range of issues. Most importantly, you work directly with our hosts to edit and make final changes to the show before and while it is live on air to ensure we are broadcasting our best journalism and editorial work.

Duties for this position include assigning stories and segments to hosts, producers and editors; editing show scripts, crafting live coverage and breaking news plans; leading the control room during the live broadcast; finding guests and reporters to feature on the show when needed; monitoring news and responding with show coverage plans as needed; mentoring and editing producers’ and editors’ writing for stories and show segments; managing staff work schedules as emergencies arise; coordinate and collaborate with other newsroom editors, leaders and journalists on show coverage plans, projects; upload editorial standards and ethics as the lead show manager during your shift. As a manager, you will be assigned direct reports and are expected to evaluate and develop staff.

This is an overnight position with a shift scheduled from approximately 11:30pm - 8:30am Eastern Time Sunday-Thursday.

Morning Edition is a 24/6 news operation. Successful candidates can work holidays and may be asked to temporarily change their work schedule to cover other show shifts and special assignments as needed.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff are defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the show production team in bringing the live radio show and podcast to air, including the most listened to segment that airs during the 7a ET hour
  • Manage the editorial operation of the control room during the live broadcast
  • Coordinate with teams for live updates for later news feeds
  • Work directly with show hosts, guests and reporters to prep, record and edit live and taped interviews for the show and podcast on a tight deadline
  • Line edit various scripts for the live show while maintaining NPR’s editorial standards for all parts of the final product
  • Make editorial, programming and news judgment decisions about edits and show coverage plans, especially during breaking news situations
  • Provide written and verbal editorial feedback to staff on work
  • Evaluate, develop, and manage staff performance
  • Collaborate with multiplatform news teams to maximize reach of show content
  • Participate in the hiring of individual staff
  • Cultivate, promote and advance diversity, equity, and inclusion in one’s work and in the workplace.
  • Demonstrated awareness of intersectional identities and ability to collaborate with people from diverse backgrounds
  • Other duties as assigned

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 3  years of experience managing direct reports in a newsroom or operation
  • At least 5  years of experience writing and editing broadcast journalism content
  • At least 5 years of experience producing daily news journalism content for a national or international news organization

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with audio production and mixing techniques
  • Experience working in a live control room
  • Experience being the lead producer or editor for a radio or podcast show 
  • Experience editing news content for various platforms
  • Familiarity in another written language other than English, such as Spanish or Mandarin

EDUCATION REQUIREMENT

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in work experience.

WORK LOCATION

On-site: This is an on-site role based in Washington, DC .

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Mastery in project management such as managing deadlines and time management
  • Expert knowledge and demonstrated skill in news-writing techniques for varied formats such as guest interviews, breaking news,  feature stories
  • Mastery in AP style writing and editing skill for broadcast and digital platforms.

job.title: Senior Editor, Arts and Culture Hub
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Deadline: Please submit your application materials by 11:59 pm EST November 19th, 2026

Intro to Position

This editor brings enthusiasm and fresh ideas to the coverage of cultural insights and deep respect for the curious audience. In collaboration with the Arts & Culture Hub editors and platform leads, this senior editor will be responsive to the news and drive NPR’s cultural insights coverage for broadcast and digital. They will work to identify and explain the values, beliefs, and social dynamics that shape our culture and guide the reporting team to explain and contextualize emerging trends with verve, speed and accuracy. This mandate includes providing insights into current artistic movements and trends, as well as deep dives to explain meaningful cultural change. This editor’s leadership will help the team break news and ideas. Because of the breadth of this beat, this editor will be a key decision-maker on the shape and design of day-to-day news coverage for the entire team. 

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with SAG-AFTRA. 

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff are defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

Responsibilities

Generate story ideas and review story pitches with reporters on the Society & Culture desk, which includes coverage of movies, books, sports, religion and education, among other things.

  • Help develop storytelling approaches and sources, and determine the best platform for coverage.
  • Direct daily news and feature coverage of beat in collaboration with all platform leads, desks and others as appropriate;
  • Ability to fill-in or supplement editing of sports coverage, which may include some weekend work
  • Engage digital and visuals teams at the earliest stage of story and event planning and idea generation;
  • Proactively produce multiplatform coverage plans for major events and stories in collaboration with divisions and teams throughout NPR when necessary;
  • Edit stories for broadcast, digital, social, and newsletters, supporting critics and correspondents in developing and executing stories with speed, voice, and nuance.
  • Ability to advise show programmers and hosts on coverage threads, booking guests and interview questions.
  • Competent at audio production;
  • Competent in SEO, headline writing and other engagement best practices to ensure that all digital stories produced by the team are ready for posting;
  • Participate in, edit, and direct news coverage when needed, including the flexibility to work some evenings or weekends when needed, and also occasional holiday assignments.
  • Ensure that desk content meets NPR’s standards and practices (including accuracy, fairness, honesty, and impartiality). 

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience editing arts, entertainment and culture coverage.
  • Experience editing for radio and/or podcasting.
  • Experience with coverage of arts and culture, including but not limited to: movies, TV, visual arts, and books.
  • Experience in digital media, including editing copy, visuals and coordination with news apps as well as familiarity with content management systems and collaboration tools.
  • A strong record of multi-platform thinking and execution in daily news as well as feature and enterprise coverage.
  • Experience in editorial decision-making, including assigning reporters/correspondents.
  • Ability to handle multiple and complex projects simultaneously under stringent timeframes and changing priorities/conditions.
  • Ability to work quickly and efficiently under deadline pressure.
  • Ability and willingness to work varied shifts.
  • Demonstrated team collaboration and leadership skills.
  • Expertise in writing, with excellence in news, headline and broadcast writing as well as copy editing. 
  • Proven ability to communicate clearly and effectively in challenging situations

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Familiarity with NPR member stations and the public media system.
  • Some experience and understanding of sports and sports journalism 
  • Flexibility, creativity and eagerness to innovate and embrace change.
  • Long-standing relationships and contacts in the entertainment industry are a plus.
