Intro to Position

A Software Architect exemplifies technical expertise and excellence at NPR. Working alongside engineering leadership and cross-functional discipline teams, you will guide strategic technology decisions, design scalable solutions, and build robust pipelines, services, and tools that support NPR and our Member Station Network.

In this role, you will lead technology strategy across our most complex engineering initiatives—those impacting multiple product lines, distributed systems, and mobile platforms simultaneously. Responsible for end-to-end architecture from platform services to client applications and downstream data pipelines, you will balance system performance, developer velocity, data privacy, and cost-efficiency to deliver exceptional public media experiences at scale.

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with NABET-CWA DMU.

Responsibilities

Architectural Strategy & System Design

  1. Architect Unified Mobile & Cross-Platform Systems: Define and implement shared architectural patterns and modular design systems across native iOS and Android codebases and cross-platform integrations to maximize code reuse and development velocity.
  2. Design Scalable Personalization & Delivery Pipelines: Lead platform-to-client architecture for personalized content delivery, supporting high-traffic, localized media experiences across owned digital properties and member station networks.
  3. Drive Technology Standards & Evaluation: Conduct technical evaluations for custom builds versus vendor solutions; introduce modern technologies and establish architectural standards across divisions.

Cross-Team Collaboration & Governance

  1. Lead Multi-Team Engineering Initiatives: Provide technical oversight and direction across cross-divisional product roadmaps, project proposals, and OKR planning cycles for multi-team initiatives.
  2. Establish Quality & Code Governance: Conduct architectural proposals and code reviews, providing substantive feedback on system designs, security protocols, workflows, and peer-written software.
  3. Integrate Compliance & Cost Controls: Architect solutions with explicit focus on privacy compliance (GDPR/CPRA), security standards, CDN caching strategies, and cloud cost optimization frameworks.

Operational Excellence & Mentorship

  1. Support Deployment & Operational Resilience: Participate in automated deployments across QA, UAT, and production environments; join the developer on-call rotation to diagnose and resolve critical incidents.
  2. Contribute High-Quality Code: Author documented, resilient code and reusable core libraries aligned with department standards and sprint commitments.
  3. Foster Technical Mentorship & Team Growth: Assist in onboarding, training, and interviewing software engineering staff, advocating for efficient agile processes and inclusive team practices.

  • Proven track record designing high-traffic, resilient distributed systems, RESTful/GraphQL APIs, and client-server integration patterns.
  • Practical experience architecting media playback, streaming protocols, CDN configurations, and cloud infrastructure ecosystems (e.g., AWS or GCP).
  • Hands-on experience integrating data privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CPRA) alongside cloud cost optimization frameworks in high-availability environments.
  • Demonstrated experience with modern version control systems (Git), continuous integration pipelines, and automated testing frameworks.

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. Intro to Position

NPR is seeking an experienced, technically rigorous Senior IT Systems Engineer to join our IT Systems team. In this role, you will serve as a primary technical lead responsible for the design, deployment, administration, and optimization of NPR’s core virtualized data center infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on expertise in VMware vSphere, enterprise Storage Area Networks (SAN/NAS), and Cisco Unified Computing System (UCS) environments.

You will play a critical role in ensuring the high availability, scalability, performance, and security of our enterprise systems while partnering across Technology to advance infrastructure modernization and automation initiatives in support of our nationwide public media mission.

Responsibilities

Data Center Architecture & Storage Administration

  1. Architect Virtualized Infrastructure: Design, deploy, and manage core virtualized data center infrastructure, leading enterprise VMware vSphere environments, Cisco UCS compute platforms, and SAN/NAS storage arrays.
  2. Administer Enterprise Compute & Storage: Execute routine server builds, security patch management, virtual machine lifecycle administration, and enterprise storage capacity allocation.
  3. Advance Cloud & Hybrid Integration: Evaluate systems architecture and hybrid-cloud strategy, taking operational ownership of the maintenance and integration of cloud infrastructure (AWS or Azure).

Systems Governance & Disaster Recovery

  1. Govern Disaster Recovery Strategies: Design, maintain, and rigorously test business continuity and disaster recovery strategies, including enterprise backups, data replication, and automated site failovers.
  2. Manage Structured Change Processes: Recommend, test, and implement system enhancements in strict adherence to established organizational change management policies and procedures.
  3. Publish System Documentation & SOPs: Author and maintain comprehensive systems architecture diagrams, standard operating procedures (SOPs), runbooks, and technical documentation for IT colleagues and system stakeholders.

Incident Escalation & Operational Automation

  1. Lead Tier-3 Escalations & Root Cause Analysis: Serve as the senior technical escalation point for enterprise technology teams, isolating root causes and resolving complex production incidents.
  2. Automate Infrastructure Operations: Design and execute automation scripts using modern scripting languages to streamline routine administrative tasks, infrastructure provisioning, and systems health reporting.
  3. Maintain Operational Communications: Provide timely status reporting on system health to engineering leadership, manage incident response on a 24x7 rotation, and articulate outage impact clearly to technical and operational partners.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of dedicated experience as a Systems or Infrastructure Engineer supporting, administering, and troubleshooting systems in an enterprise data center environment.
  • Proven, hands-on experience designing and managing complex VMware vSphere environments (clustering, DRS, HA, vMotion).
  • Extensive experience with Cisco UCS Manager, configuring service profiles, templates, and physical hardware deployment.
  • Strong background in configuring and managing enterprise SAN/NAS storage arrays and storage networking protocols.
  • 2+ years of experience planning, designing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure (AWS or Azure).
  • Strong working knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem, including Windows Server (2016+), Active Directory, Azure AD, Office 365, IIS, SQL, DFS, DHCP, and DNS.
  • Experience creating detailed systems documentation and flow charts.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to successfully handle multiple projects in a high-pressure, collaborative environment.
  • Ability to participate in an on-call rotation and a 2-week onsite rotation every two months (or as required).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Infrastructure Automation & Scripting: Experience utilizing configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet) and writing automation scripts (PowerShell, Python, or Bash).
  • Identity, Access & Messaging Services: Practical experience managing enterprise SSO/MFA solutions, Exchange Online/Hybrid environments, or Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI).
  • Industry Certifications: Active professional certifications in VMware (VCP), Cisco (CCNA/CCNP Data Center), Microsoft, or AWS/Azure solutions architecture.

  • Deep understanding of networking concepts (VLANs, routing, switching, LACP, DNS, DHCP) as they relate to virtualization and server infrastructure.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating technical challenges to cross-functional teams and leadership.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to lead infrastructure upgrades and migrations independently.
  • Self-motivated team player with a willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and perform after-hours maintenance.

job.title: Senior Vice President, Audience Development & Content Distribution
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and mission-aligned executive to serve as Senior Vice President (SVP), Audience Development & Content Distribution. Reporting directly to the Chief Content Officer (CCO), this executive will bridge enterprise editorial vision with multi-platform publishing, network syndication, and station distribution strategy. While our newsroom leadership focuses on the stories we tell, you will lead how, when, where, and to whom public media journalism is delivered and experienced across our nationwide network.

The ideal candidate sits at the intersection of executive media leadership, digital strategy, and network operations—scaling quality, editorial integrity, and audience reach by building a collaborative publishing framework that aligns, empowers, and coordinates NPR, Member stations, and affiliate partners. You will oversee enterprise content roadmaps and channel distribution strategies to maximize audience acquisition, reader/listener retention, and civic impact across owned properties, third-party platforms, and member newsrooms.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

Responsibilities

Multi-Platform Distribution & Ecosystem Growth

  • Drive Enterprise Content Planning: Build and manage the enterprise-wide content roadmap, aligning daily news flow, major investigative series, podcasts, newsletters, and special projects across all publishing platforms to optimize newsroom capacity and audience engagement.
  • Execute Channel & Syndication Strategy: Oversee multi-platform distribution across owned digital properties (apps, web, newsletters) and third-party networks (search, social platforms, news aggregators, streaming platforms) while adapting to media consumption trends and algorithm shifts.
  • Lead Ecosystem Relationships: Build, maintain, and expand long-term executive relationships with publishers, digital-native media outlets, radio/TV syndicators, and non-profit journalism networks.
  • Optimize Audience Growth & Impact: Direct cross-functional initiatives with SEO, social media, and newsletter teams to boost discovery, retention, and measurable civic and journalistic impact.

Member Network Strategy

  • Architect Station Network Publishing: Design, govern, and scale the operational framework for network syndication, content sharing, joint reporting initiatives, and affiliate publishing across Member stations and affiliate newsrooms.
  • Cultivate Member Relationships: Serve as the central executive partner to station managers, news directors, and affiliate leaders, establishing partner advisory cadences and service standards that deliver maximum strategic value to Member stations.
  • Establish Impact & Performance Metrics: Partner with data and analytics teams to define network operational KPIs, content adoption metrics, and ROI frameworks, translating audience data into actionable strategic recommendations for editorial leadership.

Enterprise Infrastructure & Strategic Leadership

  • Modernize Publishing Workflows: Architect technology-enabled distribution workflows, enterprise CMS stacks, asset management repositories (DAM/MAM), and ethical AI tools designed for distributed network environments.
  • Manage Budget & Executive Alignment: Oversee the content operations and distribution budget, manage strategic resource allocation, and collaborate with Legal, Product, Tech, and Revenue leadership to preserve brand safety and organizational alignment.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in media strategy, content operations, audience development, or network distribution—ideally within a major newsroom, public broadcasting network, or federated media alliance.
  • Demonstrated expertise managing complex editorial calendars, media partner relationships, and multi-channel digital distribution mechanics (SEO, news aggregators, newsletters, social platforms, and streaming syndication).
  • Proven experience designing, scaling, and managing complex affiliate syndication systems, content-sharing networks, or federated member-station alliances.
  • Executive-level familiarity with enterprise publishing architecture, distributed CMS stacks, media asset management systems (MAM/DAM), and workflow automation.
  • Exceptional executive presence with a track record of building consensus, inspiring collaboration, and aligning independent station partners and cross-functional leaders around shared strategic goals.
  • Strong operational budget management experience with familiarity with network economics, membership models, or syndication structures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep operational understanding of public radio, member-station governance, and federated media fundraising/licensing models.
  • Direct experience evaluating and implementing ethical AI, automated distribution tools, or next-generation media delivery frameworks within distributed media environments.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Strategic Publishing Vision: Ability to bridge high-level editorial vision with operational execution, aligning enterprise storytelling with multi-platform delivery mechanics.
  • Federated Stakeholder Diplomacy: Exceptional interpersonal and negotiation skills to build trust, navigate federated governance structures, and align independent partners.
  • Data-Informed Editorial Judgment: Strong competency in translating quantitative audience analytics and qualitative metrics into strategic publishing decisions.
  • Executive Change Leadership: Proven capacity to guide teams through digital transformation, process modernization, and evolving media landscapes.
  • Mission-Driven Commitment: Passion for public-interest journalism, editorial integrity, and the vital role of news in a healthy democracy.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Media Studies, Business Administration, or a related field, OR equivalent practical work experience demonstrating equivalent executive capability.

Work Location & Requirements

NPR and SAG-AFTRA Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the Washington, D.C. office at least 3 days a week. The employee must also reside in Washington, D.C. / Maryland / Virginia.

Job Type

This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. job.title: Senior Vice President, NPR Content Strategy & Business Development
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

We are seeking a strategic, deal-driven SVP of Content Strategy & Business Development to lead the strategic expansion of our editorial reach and enterprise distribution. Reporting directly to the Chief Content Officer, this executive will serve as the primary architect and operator of our external partnership strategy. You will bridge the gap between our content production and revenue growth—identifying, negotiating, and executing strategic alliances with digital platforms, streaming networks, audio networks, and mission-aligned distribution partners.

In addition to structuring external partnerships, you will collaborate closely with enterprise stakeholders across the organization to standardize operational frameworks, direct the division’s OKR planning, and align resource allocation directly with Content’s overarching strategic objectives.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

Responsibilities

Strategic Business Development & Monetization

  • Drive Partnership Revenue: Pitch, negotiate, and close high-value content distribution, co-production, and IP licensing deals for network content across platforms.
  • Expand Distribution Channels: Identify and secure deal structures with major digital news aggregators, streaming platforms, newsletter networks, and public media systems to scale audience reach and maximize revenue.
  • Innovate Business Models: Work alongside the CCO to design business models (e.g., enterprise member subscriptions, content licensing, revenue-share frameworks) that bring financial sustainability to NPR and the Network.

Partner Management & Strategic Alliances

  • Co-Production & Joint Ventures: Structure operational agreements for collaborative, multi-newsroom reporting initiatives to ensure partner alignment while protecting editorial standards.
  • Cross-Sector Alignment: Collaborate with executive leadership to identify grant-funded or corporate-sponsored distribution initiatives that support the organization's broader mission.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • CCO & Newsroom Partnership: Partner with the Chief Content Officer and network editorial leads to ensure business development strategies protect editorial standards and elevate network priorities.
  • Deal Structuring & IP Oversight: Manage the contract lifecycle, intellectual property rights, licensing terms, and revenue-sharing mechanisms in collaboration with legal counsel.
  • Metrics & Strategy Iteration: Track partnership performance, audience expansion, and net revenue to regularly present actionable pipeline insights to the CCO and executive team.  

  Business Operations

  • Operational Excellence: Refine cross-departmental Content workflows to streamline project delivery and execution.
  • Financial Oversight & Governance: Partner with Finance to direct divisional budgets, track CapEx, and forecast resource needs to maintain fiscal discipline.
  • Workforce Strategy & Resource Allocation: Collaborate with People Team and Content leaders to drive organizational design, headcount planning and resource optimization.
  • Strategy Stewardship: Lead the definition, tracking, and execution of divisional OKRs to align daily operations with overarching company goals.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in media business development, content licensing, distribution, or syndication within news or digital publishing.
  • Proven history of initiating, negotiating, and closing complex, revenue-generating content distribution and licensing partnerships.
  • An active network of media executives, syndicators, platform leads, and distribution decision-makers across digital and legacy media.
  • Deep appreciation for independent journalism and a strong understanding of how to balance revenue goals with editorial integrity.
  • Direct experience structuring IP licensing, copyright agreements, syndication contracts, and revenue-share models.
  • Deep familiarity with IP licensing, copyright frameworks, syndication contracts, and revenue-sharing mechanisms for collective/networked content.
  • Strong negotiation skills, analytical capability, and clear communication style when representing the organization externally.
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating with senior journalists, newsroom leadership, and legal teams to construct commercial partnerships that rigorously protect editorial independence.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Substantive understanding of the public media system, member-supported networks, or federated non-profit distribution models.
  • Direct commercial deal-making experience in episodic audio, podcast network syndication, or connected-car/smart-device audio ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with public media sponsorship rules, non-profit business parameters, and related FCC regulatory environments.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Commercial Deal Structuring & IP Acumen: Master-level ability to structure complex licensing agreements, distribution terms, and multi-party revenue allocations.
  • Strategic Negotiation & Executive Presence: Proven ability to represent NPR persuasively in high-stakes negotiations with global technology platforms and major media conglomerates.
  • Editorial & Commercial Boundary Stewardship: Unwavering ethical judgment to ensure commercial initiatives maintain an uncompromised firewall around newsroom decision-making.
  • Cross-Functional Coalition Building: Demonstrated capability to align diverse cross-functional teams—including legal, product, editorial, finance, and station relations—around complex enterprise transactions.
  • Financial Modeling & Market Analytics: Sophisticated acumen in analyzing audience consumption data, modeling revenue scenarios, and forecasting emerging market distribution opportunities.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Media Studies, Business Administration, or a related field, OR equivalent practical work experience demonstrating equivalent executive capability.

Work Location & Requirements

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the Washington, D.C. office at least 3 days a week. The employee must also reside in the D.C. Metropolitan Area, which includes Washington, D.C., Maryland, or Virginia.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. Intro to Position

NPR’s Marketing team is responsible for building and growing our audience for podcasts, programs, and platforms. The team seeks to grow the reach and impact of everything NPR puts out in the world—from our up-to-the-minute digital and broadcast content to our on-demand podcasts, events, videos, website, and app  The Vice President, Marketing Strategy leads the operational planning and execution of comprehensive marketing strategies across NPR's portfolio. Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer, this role manages a team of marketing professionals to execute targeted initiatives that attract, grow, and retain diverse audiences for NPR while driving brand alignment and engagement across all channels. 

Responsibilities

  • Partner across divisions to identify emerging audience opportunities and propose initiatives and campaigns aligned with NPR’s strategic goals.
  • Directly manage, guide, and mentor a team of marketing professionals overseeing audience development work on NPR products, podcasts, and platforms.
  • Define target audiences, perform competitive landscape analyses, identify market opportunities, establish messaging frameworks, and set KPIs to launch new properties and sustainably grow audiences.
  • Create cohesion and consistency across marketing strategy work by lifting up best practices, strengthening and reimagining workflows, and deepening team collaboration.
  • Maintain and enforce a consistent brand expression, voice, and positioning across all channels and consumer touchpoints.
  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to develop third-party publisher and brand partnerships to grow, diversify, and acquire new audiences.
  • Strengthen the marketing team’s commitment to cultivating meaningful, collaborative partnerships with our network of Member stations.
  • In close collaboration with the CMO, set operational priorities, allocate staff effectively, and manage project workflows.
  • Build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships to ensure Marketing’s capabilities, role, and integration across the organization are clear.
  • Measure project success using industry-standard metrics (Nielsen ratings, Cume, AQH, CTR, downloads, etc.) to evaluate show and podcast campaign performance.
  • Support and optimize NPR’s consumer products marketing strategy to expand brand reach and complement revenue initiatives.
  • Select, manage, and hold accountable external partners, such as digital ad agencies.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

  • Hands-on experience conceptualizing, building, and executing end-to-end integrated marketing campaigns across multiple distribution touchpoints—including broadcast, podcasting, digital display, social media, email lifecycle marketing, and mobile app ecosystems. 
  • Demonstrated proficiency in establishing performance benchmarks and leveraging audience measurement metrics (such as Nielsen ratings, Cume, AQH, CTR, downloads, active users, and conversion rates) to evaluate, optimize, and report on campaign ROI.

  • Demonstrated understanding of the unique dynamics, revenue models, and collaborative touchpoints between national network programming and local station engagement. 
  • Hands-on experience working alongside product development, digital design, and editorial teams to align marketing strategy directly with audience UX and content lifecycle management.

job.title: Vice President, Talent Strategy
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

Reporting directly to the Chief Content Officer (CCO), the Vice President of Talent Strategy serves as the principal architect, relationship builder, and strategic scout for creative, journalistic, and host talent across NPR. In this role, you will work side-by-side with the CCO and editorial leadership to align talent acquisition, career stewardship, and creator partnerships directly with NPR’s long-term multimedia vision.

You will nurture trusted relationships with our established roster of award-winning journalists, hosts, and commentators while proactively identifying, evaluating, and attracting emerging voices from independent media, podcasts, newsletters, and digital platforms. Serving as an executive bridge across Content, People, Legal, and Member station network, you will champion a collaborative environment where exceptional storytellers can thrive and expand public media's reach across platforms.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.

Responsibilities

  • Executive Talent Relationship Management: Serve as the primary executive liaison and trusted advisor to high-profile journalists, hosts, and creative contributors, cultivating sustainable career pathways and retention strategies in close collaboration with the CCO.
  • Talent Scouting & Pipeline Development: Design and lead a comprehensive discovery strategy across traditional broadcast, podcasting, newsletter platforms, social ecosystems, and independent journalism to build an ongoing, diverse pipeline of on-air and digital talent.
  • Cross-Functional Mediation & Advocacy: Act as the central connective tissue between creative talent, talent representatives (agents, managers, attorneys), and internal executive teams (People Team, Legal, Marketing, and Operations) to align individual goals with organizational priorities.
  • Complex Contract Structuring & Negotiations: In close coordination with the CCO, Legal, and People teams, oversee talent agreement frameworks, leading contract renewals, compensation structures, and rights agreements with precision and diplomatic finesse.
  • Editorial Standards & Mission Alignment: Ensure all talent recruitment, onboarding, and partner strategies rigorously reflect NPR’s core mission, journalistic ethics, and commitment to public service.
  • Audience Forecasting & Metric Analysis: Partner with Content Insights and divisional leadership to evaluate audience consumption trends and identify future talent requirements across evolving media such as video, episodic audio, and experiential storytelling.
  • DEI Talent Initiatives: Systematically embed diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into every phase of talent identification, pipeline cultivation, and retention.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 12+ years of progressive executive leadership in talent management, talent relations, media recruiting, or creative talent strategy within news, podcasting, digital media, or broadcast entertainment.
  • Demonstrated, active network of professional relationships with journalists, creators, literary and talent agencies, management firms, and digital-first storytellers.
  • Proven track record of structuring and negotiating complex, multi-party talent contracts, intellectual property rights, and compensation agreements in compliance with organizational policies.
  • Demonstrated success building and sustaining diverse, multi-perspective talent rosters that engage cross-generational and culturally diverse audiences.
  • Substantive experience acting as a trusted mediator in high-stakes creative environments, resolving interpersonal, contractual, or operational friction with discretion and high emotional intelligence.
  • Unwavering commitment to editorial independence, high-integrity journalism, and the civic mission of public media.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience navigating talent relations within a federated, public service, or non-profit media network operating alongside union collective bargaining agreements (e.g., SAG-AFTRA).
  • Proven experience executing creator-led co-productions, live podcast tours, or multi-platform distribution partnerships.
  • Familiarity with the commercial and sponsorship frameworks unique to digital audio, podcast monetization, and multi-market station networks.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Executive Relationship Building: Exceptional diplomatic presence with the proven ability to build trust quickly with high-profile personalities, agents, and senior internal stakeholders.
  • Contractual & Negotiation Acumen: Strong fluency with creative intellectual property rights, talent deal points, non-disclosure terms, and talent contract structuring.
  • Audience & Format Vision: Forward-looking creative perspective capable of identifying how emerging digital storytellers can translate their voices to public radio and multimedia platforms.
  • Strategic Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional alignments involving Legal, Finance, People, and creative stakeholders without friction.
  • Crisis Management & Discretion: Exceptional judgment, confidentiality, and composure when navigating sensitive personnel or creative matters under public or time pressure.

Education Requirements

job.title: Helpdesk Support
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The IT Helpdesk role provides Level 1/2 end-user on-site and remote support to agency end users in a predominantly Mac OS environment in the country. This includes end-user support to VVIP and other senior executives on-site. This role provides audio-visual support as needed for high-visibility meetings on-site, as well as advanced smart-hands support as needed to support other Omnicom IT centralized services. The role requires flexibility and adaptability to supporting multiple agencies in the region and supporting “ad-hoc” or otherwise custom support as needed.

The ideal candidate has 5+ years of IT end-user support experience desktop, mobile device , and audio-visual support.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Provides executive and VVIP support and audio visual (AV) support.
  • Provide quality assurance over any 3rd party IT services provided on-site.
  • Facilitate and coordinate site-specific activities (e.g., office moves, weekend power downs) as needed.
  • Support “ad-hoc” agency IT support as needed and directed by the IT Support Manager.
  • Works directly with internal and external 3rd party resources to ensure that end-user issues are resolved efficiently.
  • Manage the end-user experience delivered to agency end-users on-site and remote in the region.
  • Provide Level 1/2 end-user on-site support to agency end users, including troubleshooting, resolving, and documenting issues with desktop, laptop, mobile device, printer, and peripheral hardware and software.
  • Maintain rapport with agency end-users and be a go-to resource for IT troubleshooting.
  • Provide end-user support to VVIP and other senior executives on-site, including setting up, configuring, and testing devices, applications, and network connectivity.
  • Engage IT Support Manager(s) as needed to identify systemic issues with end-user support.
  • Maintain asset inventory and track IT hardware in the region.
  • Follow Omnicom IT policies, procedures, and standards for end-user support and service delivery. And report any violations of Omnicom security policies to management.
  • Provide attended meeting support for high-visibility internal and external meetings.
  • Provide “ad-hoc” or otherwise custom IT support to agencies, while also documenting the support requirements for review as a consolidation opportunity for Omnicom IT centralized services.
  • Provide advanced smart-hands support on-site, supporting other Omnicom IT centralized services that may not have an on-site presence.
  • Support cross-functional IT processes such as onboarding, offboarding, device replacement, incident resolution and request fulfillment.
  • Use ServiceNow ITSM platform to receive and manage incident and request tickets, maintaining proper ticket management protocols such as detailed comments and close notes.
  • Manage assigned tickets to complete within service level criteria.
  • Participate / provide after-hours support and flexibility to travel as needed.

Individual must also maintain an extreme level of confidentiality in dealing with all information that flows through the office.

EDUCATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • 5+ years of IT end-user support experience desktop, mobile device, and audio-visual support.
  • Strong technical knowledge and skills in Mac OS
  • In-depth knowledge of end-user platforms and services, including but not limited to, MacOS, Office365, Windows OS, Active Directory, etc., current desktop and mobile computing technology, core media business applications and their operation.
  • Familiarity with networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN).
  • Excellent customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Must possess a “can-do” attitude and be ready to roll up their sleeves to get the job done.
  • Ability to function within a group and support other team members to resolve problems.
  • Ability to quickly analyze problems, interpret operational needs, and resolve or escalate problems in a timely manner as well as ability to provide real time support for end-user issues.
  • Ability to work calmly under high pressure situations.
  • Ability to maintain good rapport with agencies being supported.
  • Ability to communicate with executives and their staff.
  • Ability to prioritize and work on multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to train others in the use and support of Omnicom business systems.
  • Understanding of ITIL principles is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Jamf platform is preferred.
  • Knowledge of advertising and media businesses is highly preferred.
  • Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Microsoft, Apple, or Cisco are preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent work experience, is preferred.

job.title: Learning & Development Coordinator
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Learning & Development (L&D) Coordinator supports the planning and day-to-day delivery of learning programs. Working under the guidance of the ONWARD Connected Lead and program managers, this role helps keep timelines, participant communications, enrollment details, logistics, records, and follow-up activities organized and on track.

The L&D Coordinator partners with subject matter experts (SMEs), facilitators, Learning Operations, Learning Communications, Learning Impact, Connected Capabilities Leads, Learning & Performance Business Partners (LPBPs), HR Business Partners (HRBPs), and external vendors. The role is suited to an early-career professional who is organized, service-minded, eager to learn, and ready to build program coordination skills while contributing to a positive participant experience.

This is for UK Shift. 

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Program Planning & Coordination

  • Help maintain program calendars, workplans, schedules, task trackers, and key deadlines; update them as plans change.
  • Gather planning information from program leads, SMEs, facilitators, Learning Operations, and other partners, and keep shared materials current.
  • Coordinate routine details across program activities such as marketing, nominations, preparation, delivery, evaluation, and follow-up.

Nominations & Participant Administration

  • Support nomination and enrollment activities using established criteria, processes, forms, and timelines, in partnership with Learning Business Partners.
  • Maintain participant lists, registration status, waitlists, and alumni records, checking information for accuracy and completeness.
  • Prepare participant rosters and provide enrollment details to Learning Operations and other partners as requested.
  • Track participation changes or gaps and bring them to the program lead's attention for review and follow-up.

Participant Communications & Support

  • Prepare and send routine participant communications using approved templates and guidance, including invitations, welcome information, reminders, logistics, and follow-up resources.
  • Help keep communication plans, templates, FAQs, and send dates organized and up to date.
  • Monitor program inboxes or communication channels; respond to routine questions using approved information and route complex or sensitive issues to the appropriate partner.
  • Provide timely, courteous support and help participants understand where to find program information and materials.

Digital & On-Demand Program Support

  • Responsible for LMS setup and enrollment following established processes.
  • Check that program information such as descriptions, dates, links, prerequisites, and instructions matches the approved source materials.
  • Use available reports to track enrollment, progress, and completion; send reminders according to the program plan and share potential concerns with the program lead.
  • Record access or technical issues and route them to Learning Operations or the appropriate support contact.

Program Logistics & Delivery

  • Use program checklists to help prepare virtual sessions, including meeting links, platform settings, breakout rooms, recordings, and technology checks.
  • Coordinate in-person logistics such as room arrangements, audiovisual needs, materials, and onsite details with the relevant partners.
  • Organize and distribute agendas, participant materials, facilitator resources, and other approved program content.
  • Support session-day operations, maintain attendance records, and share required information with Learning Operations for tracking and reporting.
  • Help identify logistical gaps early and bring them to the program lead's attention.

Evaluation, Reporting & Follow-Up

  • Help prepare and distribute program evaluations, surveys, and pulse checks; monitor responses and send planned reminders.
  • Compile attendance, enrollment, completion, and evaluation information in established trackers or templates.
  • Prepare basic status updates and summaries for review by the program lead; flag notable feedback, recurring questions, or participation issues.
  • Keep follow-up tasks and resource distribution organized after program sessions.

Documentation & Process Support

  • Maintain shared program files, calendars, participant records, and materials so information is current, easy to find, and appropriately organized.
  • Follow established version-control, privacy, data-handling, and governance practices when working with program materials and participant information.
  • Update FAQs, checklists, standard operating procedures, and other program documentation as directed.
  • Share practical ideas with the team for making recurring coordination tasks clearer, more consistent, or more efficient

EDUCATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Minimum 3 years' experience in Learning & Development.
  • Organization & attention to detail: Keeps information accurate and follows through on assigned tasks and deadlines.
  • Clear communication: Writes and speaks courteously, shares updates, and asks questions when expectations are unclear.
  • Service mindset: Responds helpfully to participant and stakeholder needs and knows when to seek support.
  • Teamwork & learning agility: Collaborates well, accepts feedback, and builds knowledge of learning program operations over time.
  • Coordination & prioritization: Tracks multiple tasks, adapts to changing details, and raises capacity or timing concerns early.
  • Problem solving & judgment: Notices issues, gathers relevant details, and escalates appropriately rather than making unsupported decisions.
  • Comfort with digital tools: Willingness to learn collaboration, scheduling, learning-management, and survey tools used by the team.

job.title: Supervisor Tax
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Tax Supervisor is responsible for performing activities related to activities related to Indirect Tax & Statutory compliance procedures for Good and Service tax (GST), Withholding Tax and Corporate Income tax across multiple entities of the Group.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Calculation, filing preparation and remittance - GST, TDS/ Withholding tax
  • Ensuring all Monthly/Annual returns in Form GSTR 1, GSTR 3B, GSTR 6 (ISD) and GSTR 9 and 9C are filed within the due dates
  • Preparation of outward GL and outward report working file. Reconciliation of such working files i.e. Outward report and Output liability GL accounts
  • Preparation of inward GL and inward report working file. Reconciliation of such working files i.e. Inward report and inward GL accounts
  • Discussions with relevant teams in case of differences between outward register and the IRN portal data
  • Review of errors/ observations for outward and inward transactions
  • Co-ordination and discussions with agencies and relevant SSC teams for resolving the errors/ observations
  • Review of ITC matching files which includes the following –
    • Review of split-booking transactions
    • Review of invoices for resolving the transactions with document number mismatch and document date mismatch
  • Preparation of dashboard workings to ensure that the liability is discharged correctly in the monthly return
  • Review of 180 days deferment report shared by EY along with the interest workings
  • Timely payments to tax bank accounts and vendor related TDS payments processing
  • Support team members and Senior team members with audits – GST, client’s audit.
  • Prepare/ Review Vendor and Employee quarterly e-TDS processing and monthly remittances
  • Support Local Finance in Tax compliance documentation as required.
  • Liaise with tax consultant on ongoing matters such as Show Cause Notice, hearings with department, etc.
  • Review Corporate Income Tax calculation.
  • Review documentation prepared for filing of withholding tax
  • Prepare agencies with supporting documentation as per the local tax & statutory requirements
  • Prepare annual financial statements
  • Review Withholding tax calculation and filing preparation
  • Review 26AS Income tax provision, filing, and remittance
  • Income tax assessment and audit
  • Calculate roll forward of deferred income taxes and accrued income taxes payable
  • Estimate annual effective tax rate calculation
  • Ensure timely preparation of Other IPG Tax Reporting Schedules
  • Perform transfer pricing audit and assessment reconciliation
  • Update and send for TL review Month/Quarter end Tax compliance check list.

Other activities:

  • Resolve Agency Local Finance queries within defined timelines by meeting SLAs agreed
  • Assist client and external audit process when necessary
  • Supervising activities within process
  • Assisting Team Leads in productivity and work load management for their respective areas
  • Supporting TLs in Leave and Attendance management for their respective areas
  • Cross training activities
  • Act as Subject matter experts within the team.

EDUCATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

Essential

  • 5-8 years of work experience in a similar role
  • Experience in Advertising and Media industry preferred
  • Minimum Education Qualification – B. com/M. com with Chartered Accountant or other equivalent post qualification
  • Management of a high transaction volumes business, with good knowledge of associated controls and procedures
  • Knowledge of statutory requirements in relation to Tax & Compliance
  • Ability to provide high level of customer service for the R2R process
  • Strong written and oral communications skills in English
  • Strong problem solving, team management and organizational skills
  • Experience in managing people and processes through a sustained period of change
  • Excellent computer skills and competency in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook)
  • Experience in Tax compliance tools, AI and Automation tools, S4 HANA, MS Dynamics or similar ERP systems

A distinct advantage:

  • Experience working in a Shared Services Centre focused on Finance & Accounting activities
  • Experience in document imaging software like SharePoint
  • Good knowledge of working with Government Portal and integrating with ERP.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

THE OPPORTUNITY
This is not a maintenance role. This is a growth role built for a broadcast-experienced seller who can do it all — someone who has spent time in local TV knows how to maximize opportunities, and is hungry to excel as a multi-screen, multi-market powerhouse.
As an Account Executive on the Local Ad Sales team at CBS, you will sell across our full O&O footprint — with the ability to close multi-market broadcast deals that span from coast to coast. Layered on top of that is the opportunity to sell Paramount+ and Pluto TV streaming inventory, giving clients a truly end-to-end screen solution backed by one of the most recognized brands in media.
You will bring new business to the table. You will build client relationships that outlast any single campaign. And you will deliver results.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Hunt — hard. Prospect relentlessly across local, regional, and national categories. New-to-station and non-traditional revenue is your primary mandate. You don't wait for the phone to ring.
  • Sell all screens. Drive revenue across CBS O&O broadcast, Paramount+ and Pluto TV — in a single, integrated pitch.
  • Think multi-market. Leverage the full 17-market CBS O&O footprint to bring advertisers a scaled broadcast solution to reach audiences across any & all markets.
  • Build don't inherit. Develop direct client and agency relationships from the ground up. Own your pipeline and your outcomes.
  • Be a marketer first. Package custom solutions — tentpole programs, sports integrations, streaming packages, sponsorships — tailored to client business goals, not just available inventory.
  • Own your numbers. Manage quarterly and annual account plans, forecast accurately, and hit your monthly and quarterly revenue goals. 
  • Stay ahead of the market. Know the linear and streaming landscape. Understand where categories are investing and why. Bring category intelligence into every client conversation.
  • Collaborate to win. Partner with Integrated Marketing, Account Management, Traffic, and deliver seamless, high-impact campaigns from pre-sale through post-recap.
  • Stay sharp. Keep a pulse on marketplace trends, category dynamics, and the evolving linear and streaming landscape.
  • Represent CBS Pittsburgh at client meetings, presentations, and station events.

 

WHAT YOU BRING

 

Required:

  • 2+ years of local broadcast experience, multi-platform, or local media advertising sales with a verifiable history of hitting or exceeding revenue goals.
  • Real hunger—you prospect, you pitch, you close. You don’t wait for business to come to you.
  • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to build lasting client partnerships.
  • Experience working with both advertising agencies and direct clients.
  • Outstanding presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage a high-volume, fast-paced book of business with professionalism and precision.
  • Valid Drivers License

 

Preferred:

  • Experience selling streaming, digital, or OTT inventory in addition to linear television.
  • Familiarity with Paramount+, Pluto TV, or FAST/AVOD platform sales.
  • Experience selling multi-market or national broadcast packages.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Proficient in Wide Orbit, Strata, Salesforce, and Microsoft Excel.

 

CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.  

 

What We Offer:
  • Attractive compensation and comprehensive benefits packages. Check out our full list of benefits here.
  • Generous paid time off.
  • Complimentary subscriptions to HBO Max, Paramount+, and other Skydance streaming services and digital news products.
  • Robust employee engagement opportunities, including access to exclusive screenings and events, speaker series, volunteer activities and more.

 

Skydance is an equal opportunity employer (EOE) 

 

We embrace the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit. In line with the laws of the country or region in which the role is based, this includes consideration without regard to race, color, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship status, religion or belief, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, physical or mental disability, genetic information, military or protected veteran status, union status or any other category protected by applicable law. 

 

If you are a qualified individual with a disability, you may request a reasonable accommodation during the job application and/or recruitment process. You can request reasonable accommodations by calling 212.846.5500 or by sending an email to paramountaccommodations@paramount.com. Only messages left for this purpose will be returned.

job.title: Account Manager, Programmatic Sales
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Overview:

As part of the Programmatic sales team, the Programmatic Account Manager plays an important role in growing our programmatic advertising revenue. Programmatic Account Managers are in charge of collaborating with the Programmatic and Direct AEs to manage existing business and generate new programmatic revenue from agencies and marketers, with a consultative and technical advertising approach.   This role requires deep knowledge and comprehension of programmatic advertising and the supporting AdTech ecosystem of DSPs and SSPs, and a strategic and analytical approach to troubleshooting, data analytics and client relations.   The Programmatic Account Management team is a central team within the Sales organization tasked with spearheading programmatic revenue and embracing the innovation and ad technology that our programmatic team brings to the marketplace. The Programmatic sales team partners with the convergent sales team and executives working with direct clients, agencies, and third-party partners (e. g. SSPs, DSPs, ATDs, etc).   Located in New York, the Programmatic Account Manager supports our programmatic sales team with planning, executing and monitoring the programmatic ad campaigns. This role works closely with Programmatic clients, the Programmatic and Direct Sales teams and the Programmatic Partnerships team to ensure impeccable campaign planning and execution. This includes diligent campaign management across all steps of the sales process (Pre-sales, Campaign Launch, Post Delivery) while working closely with internal stakeholders, clients and partners to maximize the effectiveness and revenue potential of their programmatic deals and campaigns.    

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Support the education and evangelization of our programmatic strategy, best practices, and offerings both internally and externally. Serving as a key programmatic subject matter expert, evangelist and sales resource to drive programmatic revenue via PMPs and PG.
  • Develop a solid awareness of our Ad Tech stack, integrated partners and the general programmatic ecosystem
  • Become power user of key third-party systems such as Salesforce, Operative and SSP user portals (such as FreeWheel, Magnite and PubMatic) which are utilized for deal set up, management, troubleshooting and forecasting.
  • Serve as the PMP Deal Manager and Client Service Lead for your assigned Hold Co and Accounts with:
  • Pre Campaign Launch/Deal Creation - Lead PMP Deal Set up and Troubleshooting including Creative QA process, Forecasting support
  • Deal Launch - Forward-thinking Deal Monitoring, Continued Troubleshooting to ensure campaigns start on time and without any issues
  • Deal Monitoring - Observant PMP campaign monitoring to maximize spend - including PMP pacing spend/deal health, optimizations/recommendations, Internal and External PMP Reporting from Salesforce/Freewheel, continued forecasting support
  • Client Servicing - Forward-thinking involvement with your Programmatic clients through regular check ins to provide regular PMP reports and insights related to deal health while Instilling PMP Best Practices with buyers
  • Sales Prospecting - Support your assigned Programmatic Account Executives proactive prospecting providing spend reports through indirect opportunities, bid CPM optimization, week over week top spenders across Direct & Indirect businesses
  • Collaborate with the Direct Sales team with Programmatic Guaranteed Deal Management to ensure campaign delivery and troubleshooting.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • A BS/BA degree, or equivalent training and experience

AI Engineering Technical Lead


The Applied Intelligence Data Engineering team is seeking an AI Engineering Technical Lead
to drive the design, development, and productionization of AI-powered data products acrossParamount streaming platforms.

 

This role will lead the development of intelligent systems that leverage real-time and batch data
to power personalization, recommendations, content discovery, and advanced analytics. You will
work at the intersection of data engineering, machine learning, and software engineering,
building scalable AI systems that integrate tightly with our real-time data ingestion platform.
As a technical leader, you will define architecture, guide implementation, mentor engineers, and
ensure production-grade performance, scalability, and reliability of AI-driven systems.


Key Responsibilities
Lead AI System Design & Development
● Develop real-time and batch inference pipelines integrated with streaming data
platforms.
● Design feature engineering pipelines leveraging high-volume behavioral and content
metadata.
● Implement end-to-end ML workflows from data ingestion to model serving.
Build AI-Powered Data Products
● Develop production-grade AI services that power user-facing and internal data products.
● Design APIs and services to expose AI capabilities to downstream applications and platforms.
● Ensure tight integration between AI systems and the core data platform.
Architect Scalable ML Infrastructure
● Define architecture for model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
● Build and optimize feature stores, model registries, and inference services.
● Design systems that support low-latency, high-throughput model serving.
● Establish best practices for reproducibility, versioning, and lifecycle management.
Production Reliability & Model Performance
● Monitor and optimize model performance, latency, and system reliability in production.
● Implement observability for data quality, feature drift, and model degradation.
● Establish automated testing, validation, and deployment pipelines for ML systems.
● Ensure scalability and cost efficiency across AI workloads.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
● Partner with Data Engineers to integrate AI pipelines with real-time and batch data systems.
● Collaborate with Product Managers to define AI-driven product capabilities and roadmap.
● Work with Software Engineers to integrate AI services into user-facing applications.
● Align with analytics and experimentation teams to measure model impact.
Technical Leadership
● Lead architectural decisions for AI/ML systems and data-driven applications.
● Mentor engineers in machine learning engineering, system design, and best practices.
● Establish standards for model development, deployment, and operational excellence.
● Drive innovation in applied AI across streaming and content platforms.

 

Required Technical Skills
Machine Learning & AI Systems
● Strong experience building and deploying machine learning models in production.
● Expertise in recommendation systems, personalization, ranking models, or NLP.
● Experience with model training frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar).
● Understanding of feature engineering, model evaluation, and experimentation frameworks.
Data & Feature Engineering
● Experience designing large-scale feature pipelines using batch and streaming data.
● Strong knowledge of data modeling and transformation for ML use cases.
● Familiarity with feature stores and real-time feature serving architectures.
Streaming & Real-Time Systems
● Experience integrating ML systems with real-time data platforms (e.g., Kafka, Pub/Sub).
● Understanding of event-driven architectures and low-latency processing patterns.
● Ability to design real-time inference and decisioning systems.
Cloud & Distributed Systems
● Strong experience with cloud-native architectures (GCP preferred).
● Experience deploying ML systems in Kubernetes-based environments.
● Understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and fault tolerance.
Software Engineering & APIs
● Proficiency in Python, Java, or similar languages for production systems.
● Experience building microservices and APIs for model serving.
● Strong software engineering fundamentals, including testing, CI/CD, and observability.

Basic Qualifications
● Strong foundation in machine learning engineering, data systems, and distributed
architecture.
● Proven track record of building and scaling AI/ML systems in production environments.
● Experience working with real-time data platforms and high-scale user-facing systems.
● Ability to balance long-term architecture with rapid product delivery.
● Excellent leadership, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
● Self-motivated, quality-driven, and focused on delivering measurable impact through AI.

Preferred Qualifications
● Experience in streaming, media, or consumer-facing platforms.
● Familiarity with experimentation platforms (A/B testing) and metrics-driven optimization.
● Experience building AI-powered data products and platform capabilities

Responsibilities

  • Oversee coordination of graphics in the control room for tentpole events (e.g., Selection Sunday, Super Bowl Sunday, NBA Draft).

  • Write succinct headlines that reflect key storylines, applying strong editorial judgment, critical thinking, and AP Style Guide standards.
  • Build graphics and operate ROSS XPression for live studio productions when needed; update manual game-driven and “evergreen” graphics throughout sports seasons.
  • Work well under pressure in a live control room environment, with strong communication skills and a collaborative approach.

Basic Qualifications

  • 2 or more years of on-air graphics systems playout experience in a major market or at the network level.
  • Deep sports knowledge with college and professional sports beyond CBS Sports properties, including strong familiarity with fantasy and gambling.
  • Ability to work flexible hours — including nights, weekends, and holidays — under tight deadlines, with a proactive work ethic and willingness to take initiative and learn new skills.

Additional Qualifications

    • Comfortable making decisions and finding solutions as a supervisor/leader in prior teams or workplaces; experience delivering feedback and modeling professional behavior.

We are hiring an Audience Acquisition Specialist for our DTC Paramount team. This role is based (5) days on-site in Burbank, CA or New York City, NY. 


As an Audience Acquisition Specialist for MACS, you will own the day-to-day execution of paid mobile app user acquisition campaigns across Paramount+ and PlutoTV. You will manage recurring performance reporting, budget pacing and shifting, creative delivery and trafficking, and end-to-end PlutoTV campaign operations, while serving as the primary point of contact for key acquisition partners (e.g., InMobi, Moloco, Jampp, YouAPPi) and spearheading ongoing CPA optimization and A/B testing. The ideal candidate has prior experience in paid app user acquisition and is looking to grow their career within mobile app marketing, with a well-developed awareness of how to drive business goals and evaluate performance against key metrics (KPIs). Knowledge with the mobile app ecosystem - including app post-back tracking, the iOS ATT measurement framework, SKAN attribution, and MMP technology (e.g., Kochava) - is a strong plus. The candidate shows a robust work ethic and a drive to continually learn and grow their digital marketing skills, and must be organized, punctual, and professional. The role will support the team’s efforts on paid acquisition campaigns, with special focus on mobile app campaign operations and processes.

 

Your Day-to-Day:
●    Build, traffic, and manage paid mobile app user acquisition campaigns across Paramount+ and PlutoTV, working through various ad managers/DSPs and partner platforms (e.g., InMobi, Moloco, Jampp, YouAPPi)
●    Manage budget pacing and shifting across the app portfolio, including twice-weekly pacing checks, IO issuance, and reconciliation against monthly spend and CPA/CPIA targets
●    Own recurring performance reporting, including Monday/Wednesday reporting checks across Paramount+ app campaigns, bi-weekly US insights reporting, and monthly ad hoc reporting for priority titles
●    Coordinate creative delivery and trafficking, including banners, videos, and native creatives for top-tier shows, plus monthly creative selection across app partners
●    Run end-to-end PlutoTV campaign operations, including media planning, creative delivery, and performance reporting
●    Serve as the day-to-day point of contact across key acquisition partners, managing relationships, optimization, and testing roadmaps
●    Drive performance testing initiatives (e.g., carousel/CTA A/B tests) and ongoing CPA optimization across DSP and partner channels
●    Monitor campaign performance and delivery to ensure campaigns deliver in full against agreed flight dates and budgets, proactively taking action if campaigns fall short
●    Collaborate with partners and internal teams to ensure billing accuracy, invoice tracking, and data integrity across internal dashboards
●    Collaborate with the larger MACS team to communicate campaign progress, learnings, and updates in mobile app marketing, and monitor competitor activity and industry trends
●    Execute special projects as needed

Key Projects - 
●    Build and launch mobile app campaigns with accuracy for tags, names, and tracking details
●    Monitor campaign KPIs and pacing to benchmarks
●    Process invoices and ensure timely payment
●    Provide key reports + insights to aid in strategic decision-making across campaigns


What you bring to the team:
●    Bachelor’s Degree preferred
●    1-2+ years of hands-on mobile app user acquisition experience (e.g., Apple Search Ads, Google UAC, InMobi, Moloco, Jampp, YouAPPi, etc.) strongly preferred, ideally gained at a media agency or entertainment/streaming organization
●    Experience with mobile app acquisition platforms, including app DSPs and partner networks (e.g., InMobi, Moloco, Jampp, YouAPPi) and mobile measurement partners/attribution tools (e.g., Kochava, AppsFlyer)
●    Familiarity with the mobile app measurement ecosystem, including iOS ATT, SKAN attribution, app post-back tracking, and mobile measurement partners (e.g., Kochava)
●    Strong computer skills, including advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint
●    Ability to multi-task and adapt to a challenging, dynamic environment of multiple priorities and stakeholders
●    Enthusiastic, passionate and robust work ethic
●    Proactive and self-motivated
●    Able to work autonomously and manage routine campaign operations with general direction, while seeking guidance on new projects or initiatives
●    Flexibility and ability to handle multiple projects at one time
●    Strong verbal and written communication skills, proactively communicating bandwidth and deliverables

May also have -
●    Professional Certification: mobile app marketing or attribution certification (e.g., AppsFlyer, Kochava, Google Ads/App campaigns, etc.) or other equivalent
●    Experience with project management software or platforms such as Asana, Trello, JIRA, Basecamp or equivalent

Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. CBSSports.com is seeking a contract copy editor to support coverage across the full CBS Sports portfolio, including the NFL, college football, college basketball, NBA, MLB, combat sports, golf and more. This editor will play a key role in ensuring stories are accurate, clean, clear, consistent and ready for publication across CBSSports.com and CBS Sports platforms.

The ideal candidate is a sharp, detail-oriented editor with strong sports knowledge, excellent news judgment and the ability to move quickly across a wide range of coverage areas. This role requires schedule flexibility, including the ability to work nights, weekends and holidays as games, news cycles and editorial shifts warrant.

• Broad knowledge of sports, including football, basketball, baseball, golf and combat sports

• Strong headline judgment and understanding of digital story packaging
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills
• Experience with content management systems
• At least three years of professional editorial experience, preferably in sports media
• Schedule flexibility, including the ability to work nights, weekends and holidays as coverage needs warrant


Additional Qualifications:

• Experience editing across multiple sports or coverage verticals
• Familiarity with SEO best practices and digital audience trends
• Experience with live event coverage and breaking news

• Familiarity with CBS Sports coverage areas, including NFL, college sports, fantasy, betting and major championship events

job.description:
