Data Engineer – Data Pipeline & ETL

 

46034

 

Overview and Responsibilities

 

Job Summary

 

The Data Engineering team is hiring a Data Engineer – Data Pipeline & ETL. You will help build and maintain scalable data platforms and ETL/ELT pipelines in a fast-moving environment. In this role, you will build and support batch and real-time data systems powering analytics, ML, and AI applications. You will also grow your expertise in modern data architecture and cloud-native best practices.


Key Responsibilities

 

Build and Maintain Scalable Data Pipelines

Design, develop, and maintain scalable batch and streaming data pipelines for large-scale structured and unstructured datasets.

Build robust ETL/ELT frameworks supporting analytics, BI, experimentation, and machine learning use cases.

Optimize pipelines for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

Implement advanced ingestion patterns including CDC, incremental loads, and event-driven processing.

Data Modeling & Data Warehouse Architecture

Design scalable, dimensional, and hybrid data models optimized for analytics and ML use cases.

Develop reusable transformation layers (semantic layers) that serve BI, ML, and AI applications.

Write optimized, production-grade SQL for large-scale analytics workloads.

Contribute to query optimization, indexing, partitioning, and performance tuning across distributed systems and cloud warehouses.

Modern Data Pipeline Development

Build and maintain modular data components following established framework patterns.

Contribute to architectural decisions across streaming systems, data lakes, and warehouses.

Data Quality, Governance & Observability

Implement automated data validation, anomaly detection, and monitoring frameworks.

Establish data lineage and metadata standards to support reproducibility in ML workflows.

Enforce governance, privacy, and security best practices, particularly for sensitive AI datasets.

Ensure responsible AI data usage and compliance standards.

 

Required Technical Skills

 

Advanced Data Pipeline & ETL/ELT Expertise

2–4+ years of experience building and scaling ETL/ELT pipelines in production environments.

Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Composer, or similar platforms.

Strong understanding of distributed data processing concepts.

SQL & Data Modeling for Analytics & ML

Expert-level SQL skills for large-scale transformation and analytics.

Experience designing scalable warehouse schemas and ML-ready data layers.

Strong experience optimizing complex queries across multi-terabyte datasets.

Programming & ML Data Integration

Proficiency in Python (or similar language) for data processing and ML pipeline integration.

Experience with distributed processing frameworks such as Spark.

Familiarity integrating data pipelines with ML platforms such as Vertex AI (preferred), Databricks ML, or equivalent.

Streaming & Event-Driven Systems

Experience building real-time data pipelines using Kafka, Pub/Sub, or similar technologies.

Understanding of feature streaming, low-latency data processing, and event-driven architectures.

Ability to architect and build real-time dashboards using Superset.

Cloud & Modern AI Data Platforms

Experience designing cloud-native data architectures (GCP preferred).

Experience with Lakehouse architectures and cloud data warehouses.

Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings pipelines, and AI-serving infrastructure is a plus.

 

Basic Qualifications

 

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

2–4+ years of experience in data engineering, data pipeline development, or related fields.

Strong foundation in modern data engineering principles, distributed systems design, and cloud-native architectures.

Demonstrated ability to design and operate large-scale production data systems.

Proven track record of technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration.

Strong problem-solving skills and ability to thrive in complex, fast-paced environments.

Detail-oriented and committed to engineering excellence and continuous improvement.

Understanding of feature streaming, low-latency data processing, and event-driven architectures. Work closely with the streaming team and architect/build Realtime dashboards using Superset. Cloud & Modern AI Data Platforms.

Experience designing cloud-native data architectures (GCP preferred) Experience with Lakehouse architectures and cloud data warehouses. Knowledge with vector databases, embeddings pipelines, and AI-serving infrastructure is a plus.

Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

job.description:

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview:


The Pluto TV Content Operations team intakes, prepares, and publishes every title on our streaming service. We are a global team, based in the US, South America, and Europe. Each year we support twelve regional instances and tens of thousands of assets for hundreds of partners!

 

We are seeking a Director, Content Operations to guide our US content workflows and team. This role is a true team leader! You will be based in the United States. You will build a skilled, accountable team that keeps growing. You will also be our main voice with partners and teams.

 

You will own the US content pipeline: partner onboarding, ingestion, QC, metadata, packaging, and publishing. Every title ships on schedule, to spec, and at the highest quality! You will also scale the team wisely: developing talent, refining processes, and managing capacity. That way we handle more volume at the same quality and speed.

 

Operational excellence is the standard you set and keep. That means a pipeline that runs smoothly at scale, partners who get clear guidance, and a team energized by finding better ways to work. The ideal candidate pairs a talent for growing people with deep technical skill. You love to invent and automate, using cloud tools and data to build operations that scale.

 

You will work closely with Content Partnerships, Programming, Product, Marketing, and Pluto TV Streaming Operations. You will keep improving the Pluto TV viewer experience. You will also align with our International Content Operations leads in Europe and South America. That keeps global standards, best practices, and one way of working.

 

Responsibilities:

 

Content Delivery & Operational Workflow Leadership

 

  • Oversee the U.S. content operations production workflow, including onboarding, asset delivery, QC, metadata, artwork, closed captions, audio, ad-break structure, and final publishing. 
  • Partner with Programming and Content Partnerships to ensure content scheduling, delivery forecasts, and launch timelines are aligned with platform and partner expectations. 
  • Maintain deep expertise in Pluto TV’s evolving deliverable specifications (video, audio, captions, artwork, metadata, UUID’s, ad markers, localization assets etc.). 
  • Support localization pipelines and delivery of multi-language assets across global markets. 
  • Document, maintain, and continuously refine operational workflows, SLAs, SOPs, and cross-functional 
    communication processes. 

 

Team Leadership & Performance Management 

 

  • Coach and grow a skilled team with clear goals.
  • Plan capacity, coverage, and top tasks.
  • Build a good culture that adapts fast.

 

Partner & Vendor Management 

 

  • Manage daily communication with content partners, labs and preferred vendors. 
  • Oversee vendor bidding, cost analysis, rate negotiations, and operational performance reviews. 
  • Ensure partner expectations are met regarding deadlines, technical requirements, and quality standards. 

 

Cross-Regional Collaboration

 

  • Align U.S. Operations with LatAm/Brazil/Canada and European Content Operations leads on standards, tooling, vendor usage, quality baselines, and global workflows. 
  • Drive consistency across regions while supporting local market nuances (content regulations, ratings practices, localization requirements, etc.). 
  • Participate in global operations meetings and task forces supporting Paramount’s shared streaming infrastructure. 

 

Operational Analytics & KPI’s 

 

  • Track KPIs for output, quality, pace, and partner trust.
  • Build forecasts, budget plans, and staffing plans, and help fix supply chain gaps.

Technology, Tooling & Systems Expertise 

 

  • Maintain proficiency with MAM/CMS tools, cloud-based infrastructures and delivery systems, and automated ingestion workflows (S3, FTP, API, JSON/XML/MRSS feed ingestion). 
  • Partner with Content Systems Product and Engineering to define features that enhance Pluto TV’s content supply chain, automation capabilities, and operational observability. 
  • Ensure operational requirements are represented in tooling roadmaps and platform updates.

Compliance & Standards 

 

  • Follow FCC and platform rules for captions, access, and children's content.
  • Keep up with U.S. and global content rules, ad limits, and ratings.

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • 7+ years in streaming operations, or content supply-chain management. 
  • Leadership experience managing a team of 10+ members.
  • Strong understanding of digital video encoding, UHD, HDR Dolby Vision and acceptance workflows.
  • Experience in defining content systems requirements and working within MAM and CMS’s and scheduling systems. 
  • Experience in managing content compliance elements (Closed Captions & Audio Description) and regional regulatory 
    requirements. 
  • Experience with JSON schema’s, XML and Content Metadata formats. 
  • Expertise in operational documentation, workflow design, and project management. 
  • Experience managing vendors, negotiating rates, and evaluating performance. 
  • Proficiency in MS Office, Google Workspace, and industry-standard media operations tools. 
  • Exceptional communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills. 

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in TV/Film, Media Operations, Digital Production, or related field. 
  • Experience in FAST, AVOD, SVOD, or other streaming environments. 
  • Familiarity with global content operations and regional compliance considerations. 
  • Experience in highly matrixed organizations supporting multiple brands or geographies.

 


About Skydance
Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Overview:

We are seeking a top-tier IT Audit Director to join the Paramount team! This person will be tasked with implementing a comprehensive program of Information Technology (IT) internal auditing throughout the Company. They are primarily in charge of defining the scope of audits to identify control deficiencies, security weaknesses, opportunities to streamline and improve operations, and promote best-in-class business practices.
The Director will lead a team of audit professionals. They will assess risks related to technology, operations, and compliance throughout the organization; this includes evaluating applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud environments, and strategic technology initiatives. The Director will also conduct administrative tasks to support an elite internal audit function. They will oversee multiple audits and special projects. They will present findings to management. Additionally, they will build solid partnerships with business and technology leaders across the Company.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Conduct audit planning and risk assessments to establish audit scope, resource allocation, and audit priorities across technology and operational audit engagements
  • Lead audits of highly technical areas within applications and infrastructure, security and vulnerability assessments, third party management, identity and access management, change control, asset management, disaster recovery, data privacy, cybersecurity, cloud services, and other emerging technologies
  • Evaluate the design and performance of internal controls and communicate audit and special project findings to management by clearly articulating risk exposure and providing realistic, cost-effective recommendations to mitigate risk and improve operational efficiency
  • Assess risks and controls associated with system implementations, major technology transformations, and pre- and post-implementation reviews
  • Coordinate audit activities with IT and business management while supervising and critically evaluating the performance of audit staff

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

 

Director, Product Management (CBS Sports Web)
Location: Nashville, TN / New York, NY / Los Angeles, CA Type: Full-Time, On-Site Org: CBS Sports Digital, Product, Design & Engineering


#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We've got the brands, we've got the stars, we've got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet. Now all we're missing is
YOU. Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also
enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together we co-create moments that matter, both for our audiences and our employees, and aim to
leave a positive mark on culture.


Overview
Own the product direction for one of the largest sports sites on the internet. CBSSports.com is the front door to CBS Sports for tens of millions of fans. It is where scores, live gametrackers, news, fantasy, and betting come together during the biggest moments in sports: the NFL, March Madness, The Masters, college football, Champions League, and more. This role owns the product strategy for the full web experience. You will lead a small PM team, work directly with design and engineering leads across squads, and stay close to the work. This is a player-coach role. You set the direction, and you're in the details.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Set product strategy for CBSSports.com and translate it into clear priorities teams can act on. Own the web plan. Decide what we're building, sequence the work, balance risk, track outcomes, and make the hard calls on what to
    continue, change, or stop.
  • Treat web as the reach and discovery engine for CBS Sports. Grow organic and direct traffic, sharpen high-intent surfaces like
    gametrackers and scores, and turn anonymous visitors into registered users.
  • Own the role web plays in the broader portfolio: growing registered users at scale and converting web audiences into sticky products
    like the CBS Sports App.
  • Prototype to think. We build working prototypes to remove ambiguity, test ideas with real fans, and learn before we commit. You'll use
    tools like Claude and Cursor to make concepts tangible, iterate on what you learn, and arrive at a better strategy because you've held
    the thing in your hand.
  • Coach and develop 1 to 2 PMs through structured feedback, calibration, and deliberate growth planning.
  • Partner with design and engineering directors on cross-squad alignment, delivery cadence, and how we evolve our process.
  • Partner with editorial to make web the place where great storytelling and great product meet.
  • Represent product to executive leadership. Turn fan behavior, competitive dynamics, and product performance into a clear narrative that builds trust.

 

How We Build (The Builder Culture)
We've moved past feature factories, PRDs, and slow-motion handoffs. We work in small, cross-functional squads with fixed timeboxes, clear ownership, and a focus on outcomes over output. When we need to figure out whether an idea works, we build a prototype and put
it in front of fans. The goal is not a finished feature. It's removing ambiguity fast enough to make better decisions. AI is how we make this possible. PMs prototype in code using tools like Claude and Cursor. Not to ship production features, but to make
ideas tangible, test them with users, and learn before we commit. Designers do the same. Engineers ship with AI as a pair programmer. We build internal tools with prompts when a workflow can be automated. This is the operating expectation, and as a Director, you'll
model it and push what's possible further. The result is that we move faster than our size suggests. Small teams, short cycles, real signals from real fans, and the autonomy to act on what you learn without waiting for permission. 

 

What success looks like:

  • The web product strategy is coherent.
  • People across the organization understand what we're building, why, and what we're choosing not
    to do. 
  • Web reliably grows reach, grows registered users, and feeds the rest of the portfolio.
  • The funnel from anonymous visitor to registered user to sticky-product user gets measurably stronger.
  • High-intent surfaces like gametrackers and scores get sharper and convert better, especially during tentpole events when traffic peaks. Ideas are tested before they're committed.
  • Teams prototype, learn from fans, and start building with real clarity.
  • Fewer false starts, less rework.
    PMs on your team grow their craft visibly and operate with stronger judgment over time.
  • Prioritization decisions are defensible, tied to measurable fan impact, and adjusted when the signal says so.
  • Stakeholders trust your perspective because you bring receipts, not just opinions.


Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years in product, with meaningful time in a leadership role. Consumer web at scale, ideally high-traffic and real-time. You've owned the strategy, shipped against it, and developed other PMs.


Additional Qualifications

  • Strong prioritization instincts. You can hold site-level strategy and problem-level detail in the same day.
  • Fluency with the levers that move large-scale web: discovery and SEO, performance, identity and authentication, and conversion.
  • Comfort prototyping in code with AI tools. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can use Claude or Cursor to build something testable and learn from it.
  • Fluency with product analytics, experimentation, and outcome accountability.
  • An AI-native working style. You already use LLMs to think through problems and accelerate your own work, and you have a point of view
    on how AI changes what a product team can do.


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR.

Overview:

CBS News is seeking a smart, driven, and organized Editorial Producer with booking and political newsgathering skills. Primary responsibilities include booking political newsmakers, including lawmakers, political candidates, analysts, and internal contributors for CBS News platforms, with a strong focus on CBS News 24/7’s The Takeout with Major Garrett, in addition to CBS Mornings and CBS Evening News.   Candidates must have strong communication and interpersonal skills, have the ability to cultivate sources and maintain relationships with key political contacts, and book high-profile guests. The ideal candidate takes initiative, makes calls, and owns projects that are assigned. This position requires attention to detail, persistence, organization, sound editorial judgment, and a command of the political landscape and the Washington news cycle. This person must have the ability to communicate effectively internally with newsroom managers and shows/teams across the news division, as well as externally with guests, communications directors, and other contacts. Candidates must be flexible with occasional travel requirements and schedule changes as news events warrant. This role will report into the Central Booking team and the schedule is Monday through Friday dayside.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Secure multiple guest bookings for daily and future news coverage, including high-profile political newsmakers, experts, and contributors 
  • Develop, cultivate, and maintain relationships with key political sources, communications teams, and Washington-based contacts to generate booking opportunities
  • Partner with producers, newsroom leadership, and cross-functional teams to identify, pitch, and execute guests that support editorial priorities and breaking news coverage
  • Manage multiple bookings and projects simultaneously, exercising strong editorial judgment, attention to detail, and adaptability in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in a newsroom, with a background in political, Capitol Hill, or Washington news strongly preferred
  • Must have a strong understanding of Congress, the executive branch, campaigns, and the broader political landscape
  • Must have solid news judgment, including the ability to recognize and pitch the right guest for a developing story
  • Strong research skills, including use of public and private records databases such as Lexis Nexis, as well as social media, are preferred
  • Must be an excelled writer with well-developed oral communication skills
  • Must be able to juggle and prioritize multiple projects with different deadlines: short, medium, and long-term
  • Must have the ability to develop and maintain ongoing relationships with external contacts
  • Must be a team player with a positive attitude
 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Thrives in high-pressure, time-critical situations, and works with a sense of urgency
  • Degree in broadcast journalism, political science, or a related field is preferred
  • Passion for news, politics, live events, and journalism is required
  • Must be willing and able to work occasional late/overnight and/or weekend shifts as needed

 


CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. About the Role
Paramount Streaming is investing heavily in personalization, experimentation, and applied AI to shape how millions of viewers begin — and continue — their journey with Paramount+ and Pluto TV. We are seeking an Experimentation Lead to own and scale experimentation across the sign-up and cancellation flows. This is a highly strategic and execution-oriented role focused on identifying, prioritizing, launching, and scaling experiments that directly impact conversion, retention, and lifetime value. Reporting to the Principal Machine Learning Engineer for Sign-Up Optimization, you will act as the connective tissue between product, ML, engineering, data science, design, and growth — ensuring we are running the right experiments, running them well, and learning from them rigorously. This role blends product thinking, scientific rigor, experimentation design, and operational management.

 

What You’ll Do
Experimentation Strategy & Roadmapping

  • Define and own the experimentation roadmap across sign-up, onboarding, and cancellation flows for Paramount+ and Pluto TV.
  • Identify high-impact test opportunities across UX, messaging, offers, personalization, pricing, bundling, and model-driven experiences.
  • Translate business goals (conversion, churn reduction, engagement, LTV) into structured, testable hypotheses.
  • Prioritize experiments using data-driven frameworks balancing impact, risk, and resource constraints.

End-to-End Experiment Ownership

  • Drive experiments from ideation → design → instrumentation → launch → feedback → iteration.
  • Partner with ML engineers and applied scientists to test model-driven experiences (ranking, personalization, content ordering, offer targeting).
  • Ensure experiment configurations are correctly implemented and debug issues in targeting, logging, or exposure.
  • Monitor live experiments for integrity, guardrail breaches, or unintended side effects.
  • Lead post-test readouts and translate results into clear, actionable next steps.


Scientific Rigor & Measurement

  • Design robust A/B, multivariate, and sequential testing frameworks.
  • Define primary metrics, guardrails, and success criteria aligned to long-term value, not just short-term conversion.
  • Improve offline-to-online validation practices in partnership with ML teams.
  • Standardize experimentation best practices across the Applied Intelligence group.
  • Champion causal reasoning and statistical discipline in decision-making.

Cross-Functional Management

  • Partner closely with Product, Growth, Marketing, Design, Data Science, Analytics, and Engineering.
  • Serve as the central point of coordination for experimentation across the lifecycle entry/exit flows.
  • Communicate insights clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Create scalable documentation and experiment tracking processes.


Basic Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of experience in experimentation, growth, product analytics, applied ML, or related quantitative roles.
  • Proven track record designing and executing high-impact A/B tests in high-scale consumer digital products.
  • Deep fluency in experimentation methodology: statistical inference, power analysis, guardrails, sequential testing, causal reasoning.
  • Experience working closely with ML-driven systems (recommendation, ranking, personalization) in production environments.
  • Strong analytical toolkit (SQL required; Python/R preferred).
  • Ability to debug experiment integrity issues (logging, targeting, traffic splits, instrumentation gaps).
  • Strong product intuition and ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured testable frameworks.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills and executive-level communication.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in subscription businesses, streaming media, or lifecycle optimization.
  • Familiarity with experimentation platforms and feature flag systems.
  • Background in growth, pricing optimization, offer testing, or churn reduction strategies.
  • Experience working in ML-first or AI-driven product environments.


Why Join Us

  • Impact: Your work will directly shape how millions of users begin and end their relationship with Paramount’s streaming products.
  • Ownership: You will define the experimentation engine for some of our most critical user journeys.
  • Influence: Work alongside senior ML leaders and help establish how personalization and growth intersect across the company.
  • Scale: Paramount is investing heavily in foundational AI and experimentation infrastructure — this is an opportunity to build systems that operate at global streaming scale.

 

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

job.title: Finance Leadership Development Program (LA)- July 2027 Start
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Two years. Three rotations. One launchpad to lead.

 

The Finance Leadership Development Program turns ambitious, innovative Analysts into Skydance’s next generation of Finance leaders. Starting summer 2027, you’ll join as a full-time employee for a two-year program, rotating through three eight-month assignments across our Finance organization — learning the business from the inside, building real financial and leadership skills, and pitching your own capstone project directly to company leadership. A dedicated mentor is with you every step of the way.

 

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Financial Modeling & Forecasting 

    • Craft and maintain complex financial models that shape real budgeting, forecasting, and expense optimization across the business

    • Turn data into direction — translate KPIs and core business metrics into analyses leadership will use to drive decisions

  • Capstone Innovation Project

  • Identify a real business problem, build a solution, and pitch it directly to company leadership — a chance most analysts don’t get until years into their career

  • On-the-Job Training & Leadership Development

  • Own real, high-impact work from day one — guided by your manager and a dedicated mentor invested in your growth

  • Receive comprehensive AI training, including in-depth sessions on how and when to use finance and other enterprise-wide tools

  • Sharpen your leadership edge through recurring feedback, a day shadowing an executive, and dedicated leadership training

  • Reporting & Close

  • Own critical pieces of the monthly and quarterly close — accruals, reconciliation, and variance analysis that keep the business accurate

  • Dive into the general ledger and turn raw numbers into clear, actionable reports

  • Run the quarterly payment process end-to-end

  • Business Partnership

  • Partner directly with finance, accounting, and business leaders — your insight helps shape how the business plans ahead

  • Take on ad hoc, high-visibility requests that put your problem-solving in front of the people who matter

  • Build a cross-functional network of relationships that will follow you for the rest of your career

 

LEADERSHIP TRAINING | INNOVATION | CAPSTONE PROJECT | DIRECT EXECUTIVE ACCESS 

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Proper work authorization is required to be employed within the United States for the full length of the program (July 2027-July 2029). 

  • Associates or Bachelor’s in finance, accounting, or other related quantitative degrees.  

  • Strong proficiency in Excel (formulas, pivot tables, VLOOKUP’s, macros, etc.) 

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience in finance or accounting

  • Ability to work in a fast paced, high-pressure environment

  • Self-directed, highly developed motivation for accelerated development 

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work well in a team environment

  • Must be detail oriented with organization skills and the ability to prioritize deadlines

  • Strong analytical skills to analyze financial data

  • Works well as a team member with strong interdependency within the team

  • Good written and verbal communication skills

As part of the evaluation process, applicants will be required to play a games-based assessment. This assessment is a mandatory part of the application process and will require approximately 30-45 minutes of your time.

This entry-level role provides essential clerical and technical support to the news production team. Freelance Production Assistants operate the teleprompter during live newscasts, manage and organize archival materials, and assist with daily newsroom communications. Successful candidates show drive, curiosity, and enthusiasm for journalism and local news while upholding high standards of professionalism.

Responsibilities

  • Operate teleprompter and assist technical staff during live or recorded broadcasts
  • Locate, catalogue, and retrieve file video and archival material
  • Answer phones, relay information, and handle general office tasks
  • Run newsroom errands and assist with set logistics as needed

Cross-Training Opportunities
Cross-training and advancement opportunities may be available for freelance Production Assistants who excel but are not guaranteed parts of this position.  Our goal is to help freelance Production Assistants expand their skills and grow into other newsroom roles through cross-training. Those who consistently demonstrate drive, initiative, and enthusiasm will be considered for advancement opportunities as they develop professionally.

  • Writing news copy for broadcast and digital platforms
  • Managing and creating posts for social media accounts

Overview:

The Free Press is looking for a Growth Marketer to help drive subscriber acquisition and retention across our fastest-growing channels. We're looking for a hands-on marketing tactician: someone who can plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across paid and owned channels, while using data to know what's working and why. You'll blend creative instinct with a rigorous, test-and-learn mindset to help scale The Free Press's subscriber base. Our ideal candidate is also passionate about using emerging AI tools to move faster, building campaigns, analyzing performance, exploring agentic tools, and automating repetitive work so the team can experiment more and ship more.

 

Please note submitting a cover letter is required.

 

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Plan, execute, and optimize paid marketing campaigns across channels, including paid social, search, video, and O&O, to drive subscriber acquisition.
  • Manage and grow email and on-platform marketing efforts in support of subscriber growth and engagement.
  • Own campaign performance: monitor results, run tests, and adjust tactics in real time to maximize ROI.
  • Build and execute a testing roadmap for offers, creative, and messaging to improve acquisition and retention.
  • Use audience segmentation and subscriber data to tailor campaigns and messaging to different reader groups.
  • Support paywall, pricing, and promotional strategy by helping design and run experiments.
  • Collaborate with editorial, audio, video, and events teams to bring cohesive, on-brand marketing campaigns to life.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate campaign builds, reporting, and workflow automation across the growth function.
  • Help set and track growth and retention goals.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in performance marketing or growth marketing for a consumer subscription product. In media or at a startup is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience running paid social, search, and video campaigns.
  • Comfortable working in email marketing platforms and CRM/subscription management tools.
  • Strong understanding of the subscriber funnel, from anonymous visitor to registered user to paid subscriber, and what moves people through it.
  • Deep comfort and fluency using AI tools for campaign execution, analysis, and workflow automation, with a proactive mindset toward finding new ways AI can drive growth.

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Data-savvy: comfortable using analytics tools to evaluate campaign performance and translate results into next steps. SQL or Excel fluency is a plus.
  • Creative thinker with a strategic mindset and a results-oriented, test-and-learn approach.

  • Thorough understanding of (or strong interest in) the independent media and news landscape. Interest in and familiarity with The Free Press is a plus.

Purpose of the role: 

 

The Head of Commercial Innovation is responsible for delivering Paramount ANZ’s streaming innovation strategy and roadmap in line with the Commercial Strategy, bridging Paramount’s global capabilities with the local business requirements to mobilise and operationalise new commercial solutions that drive advertising revenue and business growth.  The role owns the advertising innovation narrative, both internally and externally, advocating and influencing stakeholders across the business whilst positioning Paramount ANZ as a recognised authority and leader in emerging trends, to ensure the organisation remains at the forefront of advertising innovation.    

 

Functions will include:  

  

Strategic Leadership 

  • Defining and delivering Paramount ANZs Digital Innovation Strategy and Roadmap, setting and tracking KKPIs to measure success
  • Providing strategic oversight of Innovation Initiatives against the Commercial strategy
  • Collaborating with VP Sales, National Digital Sales Director and Head of Commercial Data to ensure strategic alignment and delivery of the commercial strategy
  • Championing innovation for the Australian business, bridging Paramount’s global capabilities and innovation requirements with the local business and market relevance
  • Acting as an authority on emerging trends and technology across the streaming landscape
  • Owning the strategic direction of vendor and partner relationships
  • Representing the Commercial Innovation agenda at a leadership and forum level 

Cross-functional leadership and delivery 

  • Leading the delivery of strategic initiatives within the Innovation Roadmap, mobilising cross-functional teams to deliver on key requirements
  • Overseeing delivery of the Premium Ads Growth Strategy
  • Leading the development and execution of the Innovation Sales Strategy 

 Commercial performance and governance 

  • Overseeing commercial adoption of innovation solutions and measuring business impact
  • Assessing the success of Innovation Initiatives in line with KPIs
  • Evaluating commercial impact, scalability and alignment with transformation goals
  • Leveraging insights to refine innovation strategy and identify new opportunities 

People management 

  • Leading the Commercial Innovation team fostering a culture of curiosity, experimentation and constant learning
  • Coaching the team to grow capability, setting clear goals and giving them ownership to deliver against them
  • Creating clear pathways for the team to move fast, cutting through complexity, unblocking challenges and supporting new ideas to streamline processes and improve delivery 

 

What are we looking for in the Head of Commercial Innovation?  

  

  • 10+ years of experience working in digital marketing, ad technology, or commercial strategy roles within media or advertising. 
  • Deep understanding of digital media, programmatic, and streaming landscapes including ad technology vendors, emerging technologies, and sales/client environments. 
  • Experience leading and developing teams, including setting performance goals and building team capability.

job.description:

  Overview Paramount’s Platforms & Intelligent Automation team is part of Enterprise Solutions & Technology. They create a shared AI agent infrastructure. This infrastructure supports teams in Finance, Legal & Business Affairs, Content Operations, Rights, People, and Technology. It helps these teams complete their business workflows using AI. As our Lead AI Engineer, you’ll build secure, production AI applications that orchestrate large language models, enterprise APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools and Automation Anywhere bots. Your applications will execute business workflows with human approvals, audit trails and monitoring built in. In this individual contributor role, you will work directly with business stakeholders. You will use a forward deployed model and take responsibility for applications. This means you will discover problems, develop user interfaces, coordinate with multiple agents, test the applications, deploy them, and manage operations. You’ll make application architecture, agent design, tool design and model selection decisions, while collaborating with the hiring manager and architecture review process on platform standards.     Responsibilities
  • Architect and build secure, full stack AI applications using Python, TypeScript, APIs and React or similar user interface frameworks. Integrate LLMs, including Gemini, Claude, GPT and open weight models through Vertex AI and Azure OpenAI, with enterprise systems, MCP tool servers and Automation Anywhere A360 and Agentic Process Automation bots. Support workflows across ERP, HR, ITSM, finance close, electronic signatures and collaboration platforms.
  • Implement coordination across multiple agents using planner and worker, supervisor and handoff patterns with Google Agent Development Kit, Agent Engine, LangGraph or equivalent tools. Build deterministic guardrails, approval gates, role based permissions and complete audit trails so automated actions are explainable, attributable and reversible. Design state management, retries, idempotency and escalation paths for workflows that run over extended periods.
  • Apply enterprise security controls. Use OAuth2/OIDC and ensure service identities have the least privilege access. Manage secrets and implement defenses against prompt injection and data exfiltration, like Model Armor. Also, make sure to administer PII properly and maintain audit evidence that meets SOX requirements. Partner with Information Security, Internal Audit and Legal to define and maintain the security and production readiness checklist for agentic applications across the enterprise.
  • Build automated evaluation suites covering task success, groundedness, safety, latency and cost. Develop regression tests, CI/CD pipelines, OpenTelemetry tracing of agent steps, token and spend telemetry, SLOs and on call runbooks. Lead production readiness reviews and drive improvements following incidents
  • Partner with business process owners to identify valuable workflows, develop rapid prototypes, define success metrics and ROI, and turn pilots into supported production products. Translate requirements for offshore contractors and vendor engineers, and review their deliverables for quality and security.
  • Contribute reusable MCP servers, agent templates, approval interface components and evaluation harnesses to the shared platform. Create reference architectures and documentation. Mentor engineers in Enterprise Solutions & Technology. Help them understand development practices that encourage self-sufficiency.
  • Support ad hoc projects, including proofs of concept for executive stakeholders and evaluation of emerging models, protocols such as MCP and A2A, and vendor capabilities.

 

Basic Qualifications
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 2 years of designing and delivering production LLM applications. The applications should be used by real users on an enterprise scale. They must have features like retrieval augmented generation, tool or function calling, and agents.
  • Expertise in Python or be proficient in TypeScript/JavaScript. Experience in full stack development is required. This means you will create backend services and APIs, like FastAPI or Node. You should also know modern frontend frameworks such as React. It is necessary to have experience with both relational and NoSQL data stores.
  • Extensive functional experience with at least one major cloud platform. Google Cloud experience, including Vertex AI, Cloud Run/GKE, Pub/Sub and IAM, is preferred; AWS or Azure experience is acceptable. Experience must include Docker/Kubernetes, infrastructure as code using Terraform, and CI/CD.
  • Proven experience building agentic systems with orchestration across multiple steps, tool integration including MCP, state management, human approval flows, and systematic evaluation of LLM outputs for correctness, safety and cost.
  • Understand enterprise integration and automation. This includes knowledge of REST and GraphQL APIs. Also, knowledge of event-driven architectures, workflow and business process management concepts, and RPA platforms. Automation Anywhere is preferred; UiPath or Power Automate experience is acceptable.
  • Solid knowledge of application security and compliance. This covers authentication, authorization, secrets management, data privacy, and audit logging. You also need a successful history of passing security and architecture reviews.
  • Great communication skills are important. You need to lead discovery sessions with business partners who might not have technical backgrounds. You should also write clear design documents. Additionally, you will present tradeoffs to senior leaders.
  • Experience coordinating with offshore or globally distributed teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent functional experience.

 

Bonus Skills (Nice-to-Haves)
  • Experience with Automation Anywhere’s agentic capabilities, including AI Agent Studio, Process Reasoning Engine and Control Room/A360 governance, or building AI agents that invoke RPA bots as tools.
  • Experience with Google’s agent stack, including Agent Development Kit (ADK), Agent Engine, Gemini Enterprise and Model Armor, or with Azure OpenAI and Anthropic Claude platforms.
  • Experience authoring MCP servers, working with the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol or contributing to open source agent frameworks.
  • Awareness with LLM evaluation tools such as Vertex AI Evaluation, Ragas, DeepEval and Promptfoo.
  • Prior experience in media and entertainment business operations is preferred. This experience can include rights and royalties, content supply chain, finance procedures, and SOX controls. It can also include legal contract workflows. Alternatively, experience in a consulting role with Fortune 500 clients is acceptable.
  • Experience with token budgeting, caching, model routing and user interface design for enterprise applications.

You'll build and maintain scalable, low-latency infrastructure that powers personalization and engagement across Paramount's streaming platforms. Our workloads include real-time machine-learning inference, event-driven messaging, and high-traffic backend services — so deep Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud-infrastructure expertise is the core of the role, with ML-serving experience as a solid plus.

The ideal candidate has 4+ years of production DevOps / SRE experience, is fluent in Kubernetes and infrastructure as code, and cares deeply about reliability, latency, and developer velocity.

Your Day-to-Day
- Design, implement, and manage scalable and reliable Kubernetes-based infrastructure for personalization services.
- Build and own CI/CD pipelines that ship services (and ML models) to production safely — canary, rollback, progressive delivery.
- Stand up observability and monitoring with Prometheus, New Relic, OpenTelemetry, and Grafana; define SLIs / SLOs and drive error-budget discipline.
- Ensure high availability, security, and performance of production APIs and streaming data pipelines.
- Partner with application, data, and ML engineers to integrate their workloads smoothly into the platform.
- Implement autoscaling strategies (HPA, KEDA, traffic-driven) for variable, bursty traffic patterns.
- Manage Pub/Sub and event-driven architectures for real-time messaging, engagement analytics, and inter-service communication.
- Optimize hot-path services using Redis, Memcached, and other caching strategies.
- Debug and tackle production issues around latency, scaling, and reliability.

Key Projects
- Build and optimize real-time serving infrastructure for personalization and engagement (including ML-inference workloads).
- Develop scalable, secure CI/CD pipelines for deploying services and ML models.
- Implement log aggregation and monitoring solutions for platform-wide observability.
- Optimize Kubernetes-based serving for minimal latency and efficient resource utilization.
- Improve A/B testing infrastructure to track the impact of personalized experiences.
- Enhance streaming data pipelines to support real-time data consumers.

Basic Qualifications
- 4+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Cloud Infrastructure Engineering.
- Solid experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.
- Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and ArgoCD.
- Deep knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, or Azure.
- Expertise in infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform and Helm.
- Experience with message queues and event-driven architectures (Pub/Sub, Kafka, etc.).
- Proficiency in monitoring and logging solutions (New Relic, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).
- Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or Go for automation.
- Track record of owning production reliability — SLIs / SLOs, incident response, postmortems.

Preferred / Additional Qualifications
- Experience deploying and operating ML models in production (TF Serving, Triton, TorchServe, Ray Serve).

- GPU / accelerator scheduling and node-pool management on Kubernetes.
- Knowledge with load balancing, API gateways, and caching strategies at scale.
- Experience with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation infrastructure.
- Experience optimizing low-latency microservices for personalization or recommendation workloads.
- Passion for building and maintaining high-performance infrastructure for real-time applications.

job.title: Lead Engineer, Discovery
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Consumer Platform Engineering owns the API layer that sits between Paramount's client apps (Web, iOS, Android, Roku, CTV, Apple TV, Fire TV, and more) and the downstream content, identity, and commerce systems that power them. The org is organized into three domains — Identity & Commerce, Experiences, and Discovery. Discovery domain engineers build and operate the backend services powering content discovery across search, browse, recommendations, editorial curation, and content metadata. Our systems focus on helping viewers discover content at scale—delivering low-latency, high-concurrency services across millions of devices ranging from legacy TVs to modern streaming boxes. 

 

Role Summary 

We are hiring a Lead Engineer to be the senior technical anchor for a team of backend engineers building the services that power content discovery across Pluto TV and Paramount+. You will drive architecture and design for the domain's most complex initiatives, set the technical bar through hands-on coding and code/design review, and mentor engineers — while partnering with your Engineering Manager, Product, Data Science & Personalization, and adjacent platform domains to ship performant services that drive viewer engagement. 

 

This is a senior individual-contributor role: you lead through technical depth and influence, not through formal people-management authority. 

 

Responsibilities 

  • Technical Leadership & Architecture 

    • Drive the architecture and design for the domain's backend services and APIs (search, browse, recommendations, editorial curation, and content metadata), balancing feature delivery against platform health, scalability, and technical debt.

    • Serve as the hands-on technical authority in design reviews — making the call on service boundaries, caching strategies, and data models for high-throughput systems, and staying close enough to the code to lead by example. 

    • Break large-scale architectural initiatives (such as personalization engine overhauls and new recommendation surfaces) into shippable, measurable phases, and personally lead delivery of the highest-complexity or highest-risk pieces. 

    • Set and uphold engineering standards for the team: code quality, testing practices, API design conventions, and documentation. 

  • Operational Ownership 

    • Ensure backend services meet availability, low-latency, and high-concurrency targets for APIs consumed across Pluto TV and Paramount+ client apps. 

    • Lead on-call engineering practices, incident response, and postmortems for the team's services; be the senior escalation point for the most complex production issues. 

    • Define, track, and optimize operational KPIs (p99 latency, error rates, cache hit ratios, and API adoption), and drive the technical investments needed to keep them healthy.

  • Cross-functional Partnership

    • Partner with Product Management and the Data Science & Personalization teams as the technical voice for the domain, translating engagement goals into concrete technical designs. 

    • Represent the team in cross-functional and cross-domain technical discussions with Identity & Commerce and Experiences, ensuring backend APIs integrate cleanly with entitlement, playback, and UI client layers. 

    • Communicate technical trade-offs, design decisions, and risks clearly to your Engineering Manager, peer leads, and non-technical stakeholders. 

  • Technical Mentorship & Team Enablement

    • Mentor and grow engineers on the team through code review, design pairing, and hands-on guidance — raising the technical level of the team over time.

    • Partner with the Engineering Manager on technical aspects of hiring (interviewing, technical bar-raising) and onboarding new engineers. 

    • Foster a culture of technical ownership and operational accountability, giving engineers context and room to drive their own implementation decisions. Support coordination with distributed or offshore engineering partners on technical execution and design alignment. 

  • Process & Delivery 

    • Contribute to and help run agile workflows (sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives), with a focus on technical sequencing and de-risking dependencies. Own comprehensive documentation for system architecture, API contracts, domain data models, and operational runbooks. 

 

Basic Qualifications and Experience 

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a solid track record as a senior hands-on contributor on backend and distributed systems in streaming, media, e-commerce, or another high-traffic consumer platform. Demonstrated experience owning the design and delivery of high-concurrency APIs or platforms consumed at scale across heterogeneous client surfaces (web, mobile, legacy TVs, and modern streaming devices). Deep familiarity with core discovery domains: search indexing, recommendation pipelines, content metadata, or ranking systems. 

  • Technical Acumen - - - - Deep, current, hands-on expertise in distributed systems, API design, caching strategies, and data modeling for high-throughput, low-latency services. Ability to serve as the technical tie-breaker in architecture reviews — evaluating system trade-offs, service boundaries, and design choices under ambiguity, and defending decisions with data. Hands-on expertise with Java-based backend services, cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred), and modern CI/CD practices. Proven experience operating services under strict SLAs, leveraging metrics (p99 latency, error rates, cache hit ratios, A/B test data) to guide technical and operational decisions. 

  • Leadership & Collaboration - - - - Track record of mentoring and raising the bar for engineers through code review, design guidance, and pairing — without formal management authority. Strong communicator who bridges technical and non-technical partners — translating product visions into scoped, actionable technical designs. Skilled at navigating competing priorities across cross-functional groups, including Product Management, Data Science & Personalization, and adjacent platform teams. Comfortable working alongside geographically distributed engineering teams across time zones, including partner or offshore engineering teams. 

  • Mindset - - - Strong bias toward incremental, measurable delivery over big-bang system launches. Genuine curiosity about how content discovery and personalization drive viewer engagement — you care as much about the "why" (watch time, engagement) as the "how" (systems, APIs). Proactive ownership mindset toward operational health and system reliability, building resilient production services rather than just reacting to incidents. 

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with recommendation systems, ML-adjacent infrastructure, or search technologies (e.g., Elasticsearch, Solr). 

  • Prior experience in multi-brand or multi-app streaming platforms (AVOD, SVOD, FAST).

  • Experience working alongside vendor and offshore engineering resources on technical delivery.

Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

About This Role

Paramount is looking for a hardworking Lead Software Engineer - Android to develop cohesive solutions to content based technical obstacles. The role will be end-to-end from understanding the goals and roadmaps of the product and engineering teams, through design and architecture of any solution and the delivery and maintenance of those platforms once in place.

 

This role sits at the intersection of deep Android platform engineering and AI-native development: daily use of AI agents and coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot) and hands-on collaboration with ML and data science teams on client-facing features.

 

We are seeking someone who will participate in the definition of product requirements, being able to articulate how the engineering effort will align to those requirements and provide accurate estimates of the effort. You will also be involved in platform architectural discussions and initiatives paving the way for optimizations and performance alongside. You will also be working with a team of engineers through the development process, including implementing standards around code, tooling, metrics, progress reporting and interactions with the QE team to ensure a quality first approach to any work.

 

Responsibilities

 

Technical Leadership

  • Drive the architectural direction and design of Android applications
  • Establish best practices for coding, testing, and deployment
  • Evangelize new tools, frameworks, and processes for continued innovation and development efficiency
  • Prepare architectural diagrams and technical specifications for the engineering team to deliver high quality, maintainable software
  • Lead architectural discussions around feature development and software development best practice
  • Involvement in performance and playback optimizations, overall app stability and profiling

 

Application Development

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy new solutions as well as maintaining, integrating and improving existing solutions using modern technologies and industry best practices
  • Ensure robust performance, responsiveness, and quality of applications, troubleshooting and debugging as needed

 

AI-Integrated Development

  • Leverage AI-driven coding assistants like Copilot, Cursor, or Claude as a core component of the daily engineering lifecycle, including architectural design, implementation, and refactoring.
  • Partner with technical leadership to establish and optimize safe, high-impact practices for utilizing AI tools within the development team.
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives to integrate LLM and ML capabilities into product features, such as advanced search, discovery, and personalized content understanding.

 

Mentorship

  • Mentor mid- and senior-level engineers, sharing technical expertise and guiding professional growth
  • Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and consistency across the team

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineering teams to clarify requirements
  • Coordinate with backend services and APIs to ensure seamless integration and feature delivery

 

Process Improvement

  • Enhance software development processes and policies, driving continuous improvement in code quality, development speed, and overall team productivity
  • Stay current with emerging Android technologies, libraries, and trends, recommending their adoption where beneficial

 

Ownership and Accountability

  • Partner closely with the Android Engineering Manager on development strategies
  • Ensure the application is highly responsive and performant
  • Safeguard against production incidents
  • Enable engineers to deliver mission-critical features and enhancements
  • Identify technical risks and potential bottlenecks, proposing solutions to mitigate them

 

Expertise in Android Development

  • Proficient in Kotlin and Java, with a solid understanding of the Android SDK and different Android versions
  • Deep knowledge of Architecture Patterns and Material Design (e.g., MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture, Compose UI)
  • Experience using Gradle and Android Studio
  • Experience following and implementing software design patterns.

 

System Design & Architecture

  • Proven ability to design scalable, high-performing, and secure Android applications
  • Experience integrating complex RESTful APIs and third-party libraries

 

Testing and Quality Assurance

  • Strong experience in writing unit tests, UI tests, and automated tests using frameworks like JUnit, Espresso, and others
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions)

 

Performance Optimization

  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, including memory leaks, slow rendering, and network inefficiencies
  • Skilled in using performance profiling and optimizations (e.g., Android Profiler, Leak Canary)

 

Leadership and Communication

  • Ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to engineers, stakeholders, and executives
  • Strong mentoring skills, with a track record of developing and inspiring high-performing teams

 

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with at least 6 years focused on Android development
  • Demonstrated history of leading and delivering multiple large-scale Android projects in a production environment with multiple scrum teams in an agile process
  • Proven track record of architectural ownership and driving technical decisions
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with ability to facilitate conversations with business partners in project definition, business requirements definition and functional design sessions
  • Eye for quality and user experience
  • Translate business objectives into software requirements

 

Desired Qualifications

  • Hands on software development on the Android/Android TV/Amazon/Amazon Fire TV platform
  • Have shipped one or more apps to the Google Play and/or Amazon app store
  • Experience working remotely with globally distributed and multiple interdisciplinary teams
  • Experience working on Android projects with multi-module architecture
  • Experience with assistive technologies such as JAWS/VoiceOver, ZoomText, and keyboard-only input methods
  • Experience evaluating front-end code against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)
  • Experience developing accessible front-end experiences with techniques such as TalkBack properties used in XML (labelFor, contentDescription), TalkBack announcements, dynamic text scaling, and responsive design

 

AI Literacy

  • Hands-on, daily use of AI coding assistants such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent, with a clear sense of what these tools are good and bad at.
  • Comfort writing effective prompts, structuring context, and evaluating AI-generated diffs critically before they land in the codebase.
  • Working understanding of LLMs, embeddings, retrieval, and prompt engineering, enough to design client integrations and reason about latency, cost, and failure modes.
  • Practical experience shipping or seriously prototyping at least one ML- or LLM-powered product feature (search, ranking, personalization, content understanding, in-app assistant, etc.).
  • Judgment about responsible AI use: privacy, IP, attribution, and when a human review gate is required.

 

Bonus Skills (Nice To Have)

  • Experience with Video Streaming (HLS / MPEG-DASH)
  • Experience working with ExoPlayer
  • Widevine DRM knowledge

job.title: Lead Software Engineer - CTV
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Location: On-site -  New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale

 

Overview

 

You'll own the technical direction of Paramount's Smart TV applications across Samsung Tizen, LG webOS,
and other CTV platforms. These apps run on web-based runtimes with tight memory budgets, limited CPU, and
hardware that varies by model year and price point. You know these constraints and you know how to build
React applications that perform within them.


You'll lead a team of engineers, write code alongside them, and set the standard for how the team builds. You'll
coordinate with central video engineering, external platform partners, and Product/Design to ship features that
work on the biggest screen in the house.

 

Responsibilities

  • Set technical direction for Paramount's Smart TV applications. Choose the patterns, own the architecture,
    make decisions the team can follow
  • Build and maintain application components using React and TypeScript. This is a hands-on role. You ship
    code
  • Lead a team of Smart TV engineers. Run code reviews, pair on hard problems, give feedback that raises
    the bar
  • Architect around CTV platform constraints: web runtime limitations, memory ceilings, rendering
    performance on low-end hardware, and platform certification requirements for Tizen, webOS, and other
    targets
  • Ship real-time personalization features on Smart TV applications — personalized recommendations,
    dynamic artwork, and ad engagement experiences built for CTV constraints
  • Collaborate with central video engineering teams to integrate and optimize video players across platforms
  • Work with external platform partners (Samsung, LG, and others) to develop, debug, and certify
    applications
  • Plan and prioritize technical work. Scope projects, surface risks before they block the team, keep releases
    on track
  • Write architecture docs, RFCs, and technical guides. Make decisions visible so the team doesn't have to
    guess
  • Improve CI/CD pipelines, testing infrastructure, and build tooling for multi-platform Smart TV deployments
  • Use AI development tools to move faster. Show the team what works and help them adopt it

 

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years writing software
  • 3+ years building Smart TV or CTV applications on web-based platforms (Tizen, webOS, or similar)
  • 2+ years leading a team or serving as a technical lead
  • BS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • React and TypeScript at a level where you can design component architectures, not just use them
  • State management with Redux and RTK. You've made decisions about store shape, middleware, and
    selector performance that held up at scale
  • Client-side routing patterns (React Router or equivalent)
  • Front-end fundamentals: HTML, CSS, modern JavaScript. You can debug layout and rendering issues on
    a TV runtime without guessing
  • You've taken features from concept through delivery on CTV platforms, including certification and
    deployment
  • CI/CD environments with DevOps and SRE principles
  • RESTful API integration and data handling
  • Performance profiling and optimization on resource-constrained devices. You know how to measure, not
    just improve
  • You write and speak about technical decisions in a way that helps people act on them
  • You use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) and can point to specific ways they've changed how
    you work

 

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with multiple CTV platforms (Tizen, webOS, Vizio, Xbox, PlayStation, or others)
  • You've built or maintained cross-platform CTV codebases that share React code across Tizen, webOS,
    and other targets
  • Browser internals knowledge: rendering pipelines, compositing, layout thrashing, and how these behave
    on TV runtimes vs. desktop browsers
  • Video player integration experience (Shaka, hls.js, or native platform players)
  • You've rendered personalized or dynamically served content on memory-constrained CTV hardware
  • You've worked with real-time event pipelines or recommendation APIs on client applications
  • Observability tools: Conviva, New Relic, Datadog, Sentry, or similar
  • Experience working in Agile frameworks across distributed teams and time zones
  • Rapid proof-of-concept experience. You've built throwaway prototypes to answer hard questions fast
  • You've introduced AI tools to a team and helped them stick. Not a demo. Actual adoption
  • You care about UX enough to push back on Product and Design when something isn't right for the 10-foot
    experience
  • You say "I don't know" when you don't know

 

What Good Looks Like

  • Your team ships on time because you scoped the work correctly, not because anyone worked weekends
  • Engineers on your team grow. They take on harder problems this quarter than last quarter. You can name
    what changed
  • You open a Smart TV app codebase you've never seen, connect a Tizen emulator, and start diagnosing a
    rendering issue the same afternoon
  • You know which React patterns cause jank on a 2020-era LG TV and which ones don't. You've written it
    down so the team knows too
  • When a certification submission fails, you read the rejection, fix the issue, and update the team's checklist
    so it doesn't happen again
  • You manage the relationship with platform partners. Samsung and LG engineers know your name and
    trust your team's submissions
  • You write architecture decisions down. Six months later, a new engineer reads one and understands why
    you chose what you chose
  • You push back when a plan has gaps. You suggest a better one. You do this without making people feel
    small
  • You treat the build pipeline, test coverage, and error monitoring like product features
