job.title: Lead Software Engineer - Web
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Location: In-Office, New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale

 

Overview:

 

Paramount is looking for a Lead Software Engineer to join our Web Engineering organization. In this role, you'll own the technical direction and delivery of frontend experiences across Paramount+ and the other brands we support. You'll lead a team of engineers, drive execution on high-impact projects, and raise the bar on code quality, performance, and developer experience — all while shipping features that millions of users interact with every day. This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll spend meaningful time in the codebase while also mentoring engineers, unblocking teams, and partnering closely with Product, Design, and Backend Engineering to deliver great user experiences. If you thrive at the intersection of technical depth and people leadership, this role is for you.

 

Responsibilities:

 

• Lead the technical planning, execution, and delivery of frontend features for Paramount+ and Pluto.tv web applications

• Build and maintain high-quality React and Next.js applications with a focus on performance, reliability, and scalability

• Own and evolve frontend architecture decisions — component design, data fetching patterns, state management, and rendering strategies

• Develop and maintain a GraphQL API layer (Apollo Server) consumed by multiple frontend applications

• Contribute to and steward shared packages across a monorepo (pnpm workspaces, Turborepo)

• Lead and mentor a team of engineers — provide technical guidance, conduct code reviews, and foster a culture of continuous improvement

• Drive web performance optimization across the application, with a focus on Core Web Vitals, critical rendering path, and perceived load times

• Work with personalization and engagement teams to ship real-time recommendations, personalized artwork, sign-up flow optimization, and short-form video experiences across Paramount+ and Pluto.tv web surfaces

• Partner with Product and Design to translate requirements into well-scoped, well-executed technical solutions

• Collaborate with Backend Engineering and DevOps/SRE teams to build and deploy high-performing services

• Continuously improve CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins), testing infrastructure, and developer tooling

• Champion the adoption of modern AI-powered development tools and workflows to accelerate team velocity and code quality

• Communicate tradeoffs, technical decisions, and project status clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Write things down — RFCs, ADRs, Confluence pages, Slack threads — and default to async communication that scales

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

• 7+ years of experience in web application development

• 2+ years of experience in a technical leadership or lead engineer role

• BS degree in Computer Science, a similar technical field of study, or equivalent applicable experience

• Deep knowledge of web application development, best practices, and modern frontend architecture

• Deep knowledge of Object Oriented Programming and Design, data structures, and algorithms

• Expert-level JavaScript/TypeScript, CSS, Sass, HTML

• Strong experience building production applications with React (including SSR) and Next.js or similar frameworks

• Solid understanding of GraphQL — schema design, resolvers, federation

• Familiarity with monorepo tooling (pnpm workspaces, Turborepo or equivalent)

• Deep understanding of web performance, browser rendering, Core Web Vitals, and the critical rendering path

• Experience with Webpack, Rspack, and/or Turbopack

• Strong testing discipline — Jest, Cypress, or equivalent

• Good understanding of HTTP protocol and caching layers

• Solid knowledge of the HTML DOM and Event APIs

• Demonstrated ability to lead engineers, make architectural decisions, and communicate design concepts clearly — in writing, design reviews, and real-time discussions with engineers at all levels

• Experience using modern AI agents and tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude, Cursor) to improve personal and team productivity

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

• Familiarity with micro-frontend architectures, multi-zones, or platform/design system integration

• Experience with microservices and distributed systems

• Experience with GraphQL, PHP

• Experience with E2E testing frameworks — Cypress, Synergy, or similar

• Working knowledge of Docker and CI tools

• Observability experience (New Relic, Datadog, or similar)

• Understanding or experience with Atomic Design concepts

• You've integrated recommendation or personalization APIs into production frontend applications

• You've worked with streaming event pipelines or real-time decisioning systems

Lead Software Engineer, Solutions Team - CBSSports

Join CBS Digital  and shape the future of sports & news  media through cutting-edge AI-powered content and deeply personalized fan experiences across mobile, web, and digital platforms. We are seeking a Lead Software Engineer to be a core member of our Content Management team. 


What You Will Do
●    Implement AI Features: Implement and assist in the architecture of advanced Generative AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems to power intelligent recommendations and dynamic user personalization.

●    Operational Excellence: Implement solutions with scalability and reliability in mind, incorporating appropriate testing, monitoring, and alerting.

●    Monorepo Tooling: Utilize and contribute to the evolution of monorepo tooling and workflows (e.g., Turborepo, Nx) to support build, test, and deploy across web and mobile applications.
●    Type Safety & Standards: Adhere to and contribute to the evolution of TypeScript and typing standards (e.g., strict mode, shared types, codegen) so that codebases stay maintainable, type-safe end to end, and refactor-safe.


Required Qualifications
●    Experience in AI:  Experience or familiarity with Generative AI and RAG architectures.
●    Platform Experience: Experience contributing to scalable platform products and adhering to cross-team engineering standards.
●    Stakeholder Collaboration: Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
●    Browser & Performance: Solid understanding of browser behavior, rendering, and front-end performance (e.g., Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code splitting).
●    Monorepo Experience: Experience with monorepo tooling and workflows (e.g., Turborepo, Nx), including shared packages, task pipelines, and cross-project dependencies.
●    Education & Experience: BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
●    7+ years of experience building scalable, production-grade web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Next.js) and Node.js.
●    Strong expertise in JavaScript and TypeScript, including asynchronous programming, generics, strict typing, and advanced ES6+ features.
●    Deep knowledge of HTML and CSS, including responsive layout, cross-browser compatibility, accessibility, and performance optimization.
●    Experience consuming and designing APIs (REST and GraphQL), including Apollo Client and microservices-based architectures.
●    Proven experience modeling complex data flows for transactional and integration workflows.
●    Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or OCI) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
●    Familiarity with distributed systems concepts including caching (Redis, Memcached) and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
●    Experience designing and developing highly scalable, high-performance applications.
●    Strong debugging and performance troubleshooting skills, including use of monitoring/observability tools (e.g., OpenTelemetry, New Relic).
●    Soft Skills: Able to analyze, debug, and troubleshoot complex code problems. Passion for sports and a dedication to creating exceptional fan experiences.


Preferred Qualifications

●    Exposure to popular proprietary or open-source CMS systems such as Wordpress, Drupal, Joomla, Magento
●    1+ years experience with one or more vector databases (e.g., TurboPuffer, Mongo Atlas).
●    Cloud Focus: 3+ years experience working with Cloud technologies (AWS is strongly preferred).
●    Frontend Skills: React/Next.js experience with fundamental HTML/CSS (layout, specificity, cross-browser compatibility).
●    Collaboration: Proven experience in cross-team collaboration for requirements, implementation, and testing.
●    Certifications: Cloud certifications (GCP, AWS, OCI).
●    AI Tooling & Standards: Experience with AI development tools (Cursor, Copilot, etc.) and with setting up guardrails—rules, commands, skills, sub-agents—to keep AI-generated code clean, consistent, and production-ready.

job.title: Manager, Internal Audit, Risk and Analytics
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview and Responsibilities

As a Manager of Risk & Data Analytics, you deliver data-driven insights, lead risk-based audits, and support investigations, risk assessments, and special projects across Paramount. You work with leaders across corporate, media, streaming, and production to evaluate processes, governance, and controls using useful judgment and analytics. The role requires comfort with complex data, deep risk assessment skills, and the ability to operate in fast-moving, judgment-heavy environments. Engagements include operational reviews, T&E and production audits, and advisory projects in partnership with SOX, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and other teams.   Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  
  • Plan and lead risk‑based analytics to support operational audits, advisory work, and special projects across corporate, media, streaming, advertising, and production areas
  • Develop focused project objectives, scopes, and risk assessments aligned to key business priorities
  • Design flexible approaches for non‑routine or evolving activities requiring solid professional judgment
  • Use analytics to evaluate processes, controls, and governance, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accountability, and growth
  • Conduct end‑to‑end process walkthroughs and root‑cause analysis to address underlying issues
  • Assess operational maturity and scalability in high‑growth or transformational initiatives
  • Apply advanced analytics to audit planning, testing, investigations, and continuous risk monitoring
  • Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and emerging risks across areas such as production, T&E, payroll, vendor payments, and revenue
  • Translate business risks into targeted, meaningful analytics and communicate insights through clear visuals and presentations
  • Lead or support special projects through data collection, validation, analysis, and documentation of findings
  • Synthesize insights from multiple systems and data sources and present conclusions through dashboards and presentations
  • Build robust relationships with business leaders and cross‑functional partners, including SOX, Compliance, Finance, and Legal
  • Communicate results and recommendations clearly, explaining root cause, risk, and business impact in an accessible language
  • Create recommendations that fit the business needs. When needed, promote remediation plans while keeping a focus on solutions
  • Serve as a trusted advisor while maintaining sovereignty and objectivity
  • Manage, coach, and develop team members while ensuring quality, consistency, and adherence to internal standards
  • Advance the team’s shift toward insight‑driven, judgment‑based auditing
  • Contribute to annual risk assessments and audit planning using data and industry insights
  • Support continuous improvement of Internal Audit methodologies, analytics capabilities, and investigative approaches
  • Partner with the Audit executive team on analytics tools, technologies, and industry trends to enhance the function’s capabilities
  • Assess audit and operational risks, design effective analytics procedures, identify control gaps, and manage multiple engagements in a dynamic environment
  • Apply sound judgment, professional skepticism, and well-developed communication skills to drive outcomes and maintain high standards of quality and integrity
  Basic Qualifications  
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 7+ years of experience in internal audit, external audit, risk management, data analytics, or a related discipline
  Additional Qualifications  
  • Experience leading or executing analytics-driven reviews, including areas such as T&E, production, vendor payments, or revenue-related processes
  • Big Four or consulting experience preferred
  • Professional certification(s) such as CIA, CPA, CFE, CISA, or equivalent (active or in progress) preferred
     

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

job.title: Manager, Publicity - Germany
job.description:
Got a nose for a great story and the relationships to get it placed? Paramount+ is looking for a Publicity Manager to join our Direct-to-Consumer team in Berlin on a temporary contract for circa 1 year — helping bring our Originals to life across Germany, Switzerland, and Austria.

This is a fast-start opportunity for a publicity pro who wants to get straight into the action. You'll sit at the centre of campaigns from first announcement through premiere night: building media strategy, wrangling talent schedules, pulling off press days that actually land, and keeping a fast-moving campaign calendar on track. One day you're pitching a top entertainment journalist, the next you're briefing talent ahead of a junket, the next you're in the room with Marketing and Creative shaping how a show gets positioned in a crowded streaming market.

What you'll be doing

  • Executing publicity campaigns for Paramount+ Original series — scripted and unscripted
  • Securing coverage across broadcast, trade press, podcasts, and digital platforms
  • Coordinating talent availability, media appearances, and press events (including the occasional evening or weekend when a premiere calls for it)
  • Partnering across Marketing, Creative, Awards, and Events to keep campaigns joined-up
  • Tracking coverage and campaign performance so we know what's working

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in entertainment publicity for TV, streaming, or film
  • A working knowledge of the DACH media landscape — journalists, trades, podcasts, and platforms
  • Comfort managing talent relationships with professionalism and discretion
  • Confidence and experience supporting and leading several campaigns at once without dropping a ball

Why this role
This is a chance to work on some of the biggest titles hitting Paramount+ in the region — with real ownership from day one, not just supporting someone else's plan. It's ideal if you're looking for immediate, high-impact experience at a major global streamer, want to build your network in entertainment publicity fast, or you're available now and ready to hit the ground running. A great way in, whatever comes next.

Paramount+, a direct-to-consumer digital subscription video on-demand and live streaming service from Paramount Global, combines live sports, breaking news, and a mountain of entertainment. The premium streaming service features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including BET, CBS, Comedy Central, MTV, Nickelodeon, Paramount Pictures and the Smithsonian Channel. The service is also the streaming home to unmatched sports programming, including every CBS Sports event, from golf to football to basketball and more, plus exclusive streaming rights for major sports properties, including some of the world’s biggest and most popular soccer leagues. Paramount+ also enables subscribers to stream local CBS stations live across the U.S. in addition to the ability to stream Paramount Streaming’s other live channels: CBSN for 24/7 news, CBS Sports HQ for sports news and analysis, and ET Live for entertainment coverage.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

  Overview:  Step onto the lot where Hollywood history is made. As Manager of Special Events at Paramount Pictures, you'll be at the center of some of the entertainment industry's most iconic and high-profile gatherings, set against the backdrop of our legendary Hollywood studio.    Based on the Paramount Pictures lot, you'll report directly to the Executive Director of Event Operations and serve as the connective tissue between clients, creative vision, and impeccable execution. If you thrive on bringing ambitious ideas to life, building relationships that last, and delivering experiences that leave a lasting impression, this is your stage.   Apply now and join our team!   Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
  • Build and maintain solid relationships with internal and external partners, leveraging those connections to deliver innovative, memorable events that exceed client expectations
  • Own end-to-end logistics coordination across all assigned events, ensuring every detail is accounted for from concept through close-out
  • Serve as the primary liaison between clients and all internal and external partners, managing concurrent relationships and ensuring expectations are clearly set and met
  • Lead brainstorming sessions to develop fresh event concepts and translate them into actionable plans
  • Provide accurate, timely communication to clients, vendors, and meeting planners throughout the event lifecycle

  • Oversee payment schedules and ensure all financial milestones are met

job.title: Media Planning Interns
job.description:
Media Planning Intern

Step behind the scenes of television and media broadcasting. We are looking for an ambitious, detail-oriented Media Planning Intern to join our On-Air Media Planning team.

In this role, you will gain hands-on experience in how linear TV campaigns are built, scheduled, and delivered across our network. You will collaborate closely with planners, work directly with broadcast management systems, and see the immediate impact of your work on screen every single day.

What You’ll Do

  • On-Air Support: Partner with the On-Air Media Planning team to coordinate and execute daily and weekly operational tasks.

  • Campaign & Grid Setup: Set broadcast windows, build target parameters, and generate campaigns and GEGs directly within our broadcast system.

  • Agile Grid Management: Adapt quickly to live programming shifts by updating tune-ins according to potential broadcast grid changes.

  • Planning & Drafting: Build weekly media plan drafts and supervise their real-time execution across channels.

  • Data & Project Tracking: Maintain accurate, up-to-date campaign and GEG records in our project management tools.

  • Analytics & Performance: Generate promo reports, monitor weekly NRTX campaigns, and deliver actionable performance statistics.

  • Cross-Department Collaboration: Serve as an active operational point of contact to handle ad hoc requests from partner teams.

What You’ll Bring

  • Education: Currently enrolled in a university program (Media Studies, Communications, Marketing, or a related field).

  • Languages: Native-level Hungarian paired with confident written and spoken English. (Proficiency in Dutch or Polish is a strong plus!)

  • Mindset: Proactive "can-do" approach, solid problem-solving instincts, and the ability to stay organized under tight broadcast deadlines.

  • Eye for Precision: High attention to detail with clear, structured communication skills.

  • Tech Comfort: Solid working knowledge of Microsoft Office or Google Workspace tools.

  • Passion: A genuine interest in the evolving world of TV and broadcast media.

Why Join Us?

  • Real Impact: Your media plans go straight to screen, directly reaching viewers across the region.

  • Industry Tools: Gain practical experience with enterprise broadcast systems and professional project management workflows.

  • Mentorship: Learn alongside seasoned media strategists in an international, supportive environment.

 

 

Paramount Networks International, is comprised of many of the world's most popular multimedia entertainment brands, including MTV, MTV LIVE HD, Nickelodeon, Nick Jr., Comedy Central, Paramount Channel, BET and more. job.title: OTC Customer Master Data Analyst
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

OTC Customer Master Data Analyst

Locations: Nashville, TN or Budapest, Hungary

Department: Order-to-Cash (OTC) | Finance

Reports To: Credit Manager

About the Role

At Paramount Global Skydance, storytelling meets scale. Our Order-to-Cash (OTC) team builds the financial infrastructure powering our global entertainment footprint—from television and streaming to theatrical releases and global advertising.

As an OTC Customer Master Data Analyst, you will be the foundational gatekeeper of our customer relationships worldwide. You won’t just enter records—you will safeguard data integrity, drive operational efficiency across our financial systems, and directly influence how quickly and accurately deals are closed, billed, and collected. Collaborating with cross-functional partners in Sales, Billing, Tax, and Data Governance, you will ensure our global commercial engine runs seamlessly.

Key Responsibilities

  • Global Master Data Integrity: Oversee end-to-end customer record setup, validation, and ongoing maintenance in core ERP and sales platforms across all Paramount Global Skydance divisions.

  • Credit & Risk Stewardship: Update customer credit limits and maintain proactive "watch reports" to monitor adverse financial shifts or credit-related events.

  • Tax & Compliance Administration: Ensure adherence to global compliance standards by collecting and managing critical documentation (such as IRS Form 6166), validating credit agreements, and maintaining accurate withholding tax rates.

  • Data Governance Partnership: Collaborate closely with Enterprise Data Governance to uphold setup standards, resolve exceptions, and drive continuous data-cleansing initiatives.

  • Cross-Functional Enablement: Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales, Billing, Cash Application, and Accounting teams to resolve onboarding bottlenecks and align customer master records.

  • Knowledge Sharing & Onboarding: Help train and mentor team members on standardized setup workflows, SharePoint tools, and best-practice intake forms.

What You Bring to the Team

  • Experience: 2+ years in an Accounts Receivable (AR), Master Data, or Corporate Customer Service role within a complex, multi-location organization.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline preferred.

  • Technical Proficiency: Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills (proficient with lookups, data validation, and pivot tables). Familiarity with major ERP platforms such as SAP or Oracle is a strong advantage.

  • Industry Acumen: Background in media, entertainment, or advertising/media-buying agencies is highly desirable.

  • Detail & Compliance Mindset: High integrity with an eye for spotting duplicate data, incomplete documentation, and regulatory risks before they impact billing.

  • Communication & Influence: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with the diplomatic assertiveness needed to partner effectively with sales and finance leaders across multiple time zones.

  • Agility: A proactive, self-starter mindset comfortable adapting in a dynamic, high-energy global enterprise.

Key Internal Collaborators

  • Revenue & Go-to-Market: Sales Management & Account Teams

  • Finance Operations: Credit, Billing, Collections, and Cash Application Teams

  • Controllership: Corporate Accounting & Disbursement Teams

 

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

job.title: Principal Product Manager, Ads Monetization (Consumer AI)
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview
As Principal Product Manager, Ads Monetization, you’ll use machine learning and AI to help Paramount+ and Pluto TV earn more from advertising while keeping the viewing experience great. Sitting within our Consumer AI group, you’ll do two things: lead the product direction for ML-driven improvements to our ad systems, and act as the Ads team’s go-to product partner for AI/ML needs. You’ll work as a senior individual contributor under limited supervision, setting your own priorities and making most product calls individually, with executive team guidance on overall strategy. This is a [hybrid] role.

 

Primary Responsibilities

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for AI/ML-driven ads monetization across Paramount+ and Pluto TV, spanning areas such as ad decisioning, result optimization, pacing, forecasting and personalization. Make self-directed decisions on prioritization, trade-offs and sequencing, and align the roadmap with Consumer AI and Ads executive team.
  • Drive ML-powered optimization of ad systems by partnering with data scientists and ML engineers to define model objectives, constraints and success metrics. Balance revenue, viewer experience and advertiser outcomes, and decide independently which model and product bets to pursue.
  • Serve as the AI/ML product partner to the Ads team. Gather needs from Ad Sales, Ad Operations, Planning and Finance, and shape them into AI/ML solutions (including generative AI workflows). Prioritize requests independently, and align on cross-team commitments with Ads product leadership.
  • Define requirements and evaluation frameworks for ML-based products, including data needs, experiment design, A/B testing and ongoing model performance monitoring. Use results to quantify revenue impact and decide whether to scale, iterate or stop initiatives.
  • Influence stakeholders at all levels, including Engineering, Data Science, Ad Sales, Ad Operations, Finance, Legal and Privacy. Present strategy, results and trade-offs to senior executives. Decisions with significant budget, privacy or advertiser-contract implications are made jointly with the hiring manager or relevant committees.
  • Raise the bar for product practice by mentoring other product managers, setting standards for how ML products are scoped and measured, and sharing learnings across Consumer AI. Provide indirect executive team through influence, with no formal direct reports at this time.

Basic Qualifications  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years managing advertising, ad tech or monetization products.
  • Extensive knowledge of how ML is applied to advertising problems such as ranking, prediction, forecasting and optimization, with 3+ years shipping ML-driven products in partnership with data scientists and ML engineers.
  • Working knowledge of the ad serving and decisioning stack, including auctions, pacing, outcome management, and supply- and demand-side technologies.
  • Expertise in experimentation and measurement, including defining success metrics, A/B testing and interpreting results to drive decisions.
  • Knowledge with generative AI and LLM product concepts, including evaluation and iteration.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functionally without direct authority and to communicate clearly with senior executives.

 

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with linked TV (CTV), video or live sports advertising.
  • Advanced degree or hands-on technical skills (e.g., SQL, Python) for working directly with data.
  • Experience with identity, audience signals, clean rooms or privacy-compliant data use in advertising.
  • Experience with generative AI applied to ad creative or ad operations workflows.
  • Experience mentoring or managing product managers.
    #LI-PV1

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

CBS Sports Digital is looking for a Product Growth Manager to own growth on the CBS Sports app. You'll sit on the app product team and carry your own roadmap alongside feature work. The job is to make sure what we build gets found, adopted, and kept.
That means owning the parts of the product where growth actually happens: onboarding, activation, how users discover new features, and the store listing as a conversion surface. It also means owning the acquisition spend pointed at the app and the instrumentation that tells us whether any of it worked. You'll be measured on install volume, install quality, feature adoption, and retention.
You should be comfortable in a standup and comfortable in a spreadsheet. You think in funnels, you ship experiments, and you can tell the difference between a number that moved and a number that matters.


Responsibilities:
●    Own a growth roadmap for the CBS Sports app, scoped and prioritized alongside feature work.
●    Own onboarding, activation, and in-product feature discovery, from problem definition through shipped changes.
●    Own the app store listing as a conversion surface, including testing, positioning, and editorial pitches for featuring.
●    Own paid acquisition for the app, optimizing toward high-LTV users and aligning spend to the roadmap and the sports calendar.
●    Define the growth instrumentation and reporting the product team runs on. Monitor installs, adoption, engagement, retention, and funnel performance, and act on what you see.
●    Run experiments with clear hypotheses and readable results. Kill what doesn't work.
●    Sequence releases against tentpole windows so launches land when fan demand is highest.
●    Test new acquisition channels and fold the ones that work into a single growth approach.
●    Work with brand, creative, and lifecycle teams so what ships in-product and what runs outside it say the same thing.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
●    5+ years in growth product management, product growth, or mobile growth.
●    Experience owning a growth funnel end to end, including shipping changes to a live product.
●    Hands-on experience running paid user acquisition (Apple Search Ads, Google App Campaigns, or similar).
●    Fluency with app metrics: installs, CAC and LTV, activation, adoption, retention, and cohort analysis.
●    Experience running A/B tests and making calls off the results.
●    Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.


ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
●    Experience embedded on a product and engineering team in an Agile environment.
●    Background in sports, streaming, media, or consumer subscription apps.
●    Familiarity with ASO and app store editorial and featuring processes.
●    Experience with product analytics (Amplitude, Mixpanel), attribution (Kochava, AppsFlyer, Branch, Adjust), and lifecycle tools (Braze, Iterable, Airship, SalesForce Marketing Cloud).
●    A real interest in sports and how the sports calendar shapes fan behavior.


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

job.description:

PTP Invoice Auditor

Department: Procure-to-Pay (PTP)

Location: Budapest, Hungary — hybrid, on-site 2–3 days per week

Employment Type: Fixed term Contract – 1 year (extension possible based on business needs)

Reports To: Sr Manager – PTP Invoicing

Start Date: Immediate — candidates must be available to commence on short notice and commit fully to the duration of the assignment

 

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented PTP Invoice Auditor to join our GBS PTP team reporting to the Senior Invoicing Manager. This role performs quality control reviews of invoices for accuracy and compliance. The role is based in Budapest and requires 2–3 days per week on-site, with flexibility for remote work on the remaining days. Familiarity with Oracle Fusion (Fusion Cloud ERP/Financials) is a plus.



Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor invoice processing and error resolution queues, performing detailed analytical reviews to identify and resolve issues preventing successful invoice posting within SAP and Oracle systems.

  • Manage and monitor aged and open Purchase Orders, proactively following up with business stakeholders on Goods Received/Invoice Not Received (GR/IR) and Invoice Received/No Goods Receipt exceptions.

  • Monitor, investigate, and resolve aged invoices to ensure timely processing and payment.

  • Perform fiscal and tax compliance reviews of invoices for international entities in accordance with local statutory requirements.

  • Execute manual entry of approved invoices when automated processing is not feasible.

  • Initiate, coordinate, and drive resolution of issues impacting invoice processing and vendor payments, engaging cross-functional teams as required.

  • Prepare and maintain operational reports, ensuring effective tracking, monitoring, and resolution of outstanding invoice and payment issues.

  • Conduct research and recovery activities related to vendor credit balances, overpayments, and unapplied credits.

  • Respond to and resolve internal and external inquiries in a timely and professional manner, providing support to vendors, business stakeholders, and other finance teams.

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying process gaps, root causes of recurring issues, and opportunities to enhance efficiency and controls within the PTP process.

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls, and service level agreements (SLAs) across all assigned activities.



Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

  • 1-3 years of experience in Procure-to-Pay (PTP), Accounts Payable, or a related finance operations environment.

  • Experience working with ERP systems is required; Oracle Fusion Cloud and/or SAP experience is highly preferred.

  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting, and reconciliation activities.

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills, with strong attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with vendors, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.

  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned tasks, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken; additional language skills, including Hungarian, are considered an advantage.

  • Ability to work in a hybrid environment, with availability to commute to the Budapest office 2-3 days per week.

  • Collaborative team player with the ability to build effective working relationships within a Shared Services or Global Business Services organization.

  • Demonstrated customer-focused mindset, delivering high-quality service and support to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Proactive, adaptable, and solution-oriented approach, with a continuous improvement mindset.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize workload and consistently meet service level agreements (SLAs) and deadlines.

  • High level of professionalism, accountability, and enthusiasm, with a willingness to learn and take on new challenges.

Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

job.title: Senior Data Engineer
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

    Overview    As a Senior Data Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in driving our data strategy and standard methodologies for data collection, pipelines, usage, and infrastructure. We are looking for someone with a deep sense of curiosity and an affinity for building innovative products based on data. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to communicate data constellations and tools, leveraging your skills in reverse engineering, analytics, and creative problem-solving to devise data and BI solutions.     Responsibilities
  • Work with large volumes of traffic data and user behaviors to develop pipelines that enhance raw data quality.
  • Break down complex data problems and communicate feasible solutions proficiently.
  • Extract patterns from large datasets and transform data into actionable insights.
  • Utilize tools such as Jupyter, SQL, dashboards, statistical analysis, and data visualizations to explore datasets and find answers to business questions.
  • Partner with internal product and business intelligence teams to identify optimal data ingestion, structure, and storage approaches.
  • Collaborate with technology field partners to ensure reliable implementation of data solutions.
  • Provide innovative ideas to improve data and collaborate with engineering, BI teams, and business units to implement changes.
  • Lead projects from inception to completion, ensuring successful implementation of data solutions.
  • Contribute to advancing the team in technology and best practices
  • Mentor junior team members on best practices and approaches around data.

 

Basic Qualifications
  • STEM undergraduate degree with 4+ years of work experience or STEM graduate degree with 2+ years of post-graduation work experience in Analytics/Measurement/Data Operations fields or consulting roles focusing on digital analytics implementations.
  • Knowledge with relational and NoSQL data management systems (e.g., BigTable, HBase, Cassandra, MongoDB).
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Experience with exploratory data analysis using tools like iPython Notebook, Pandas, and matplotlib.

Platform & Tooling Innovation ● Build the front-end for internal QE platforms, including automation dashboards, triage tools, and AI-assisted testing interfaces. ● Implement real-time data visualizations and telemetry streams, ensuring that even complex, AI-curated data is presented with clarity and performance. Can manually correct these issues to meet senior-level engineering standards. ● Security & Architecture: Proficient in secure front-end development according to OWASP standards. Knowledge of browser performance and scalable architectural patterns.

Preferred Qualifications ● Experience building developer productivity tools or internal engineering dashboards. ● Familiarity with data visualization (D3.js, Recharts) and real-time interfaces (WebSockets). ● Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS) and CI/CD workflows.   Key Competencies ● AI-Augmented Execution: The ability to achieve 10x output by effectively prompting and managing AI agents without sacrificing code quality. ● Architectural Rigor: A refusal to accept "working code" if it violates long-term maintainability or security standards. ● Systems Thinking: Understanding how front-end applications integrate with complex backend data pipelines and AI-driven quality insights.   Success Metrics ● Velocity & Quality: Delivery of high-quality features at an accelerated pace through the expert application of AI tooling. ● Standardization: Successful implementation of reusable patterns that pass all security and architectural audits. ● Efficiency: Significant reduction in manual UI development time through the adoption of AI-assisted workflows.   #LI-JC1

We are seeking a Sr. ML Platform Engineer who is excited to deploy MLOps products that shape business strategy, optimize content, inform marketing investment decisions, and enhance the user experience. You will build the foundations of our ML platform that will enable the Data Science team to deploy models at web scale data driving interactions with millions of customers across the globe. Specific projects will include designing the ML Ops platform and Agentic AI layer that will enable the Data Science team to scale their model deployments and automate analytical workflows. Success in this role requires a strong foundation in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), comfort writing production-quality code in a collaborative environment, effective communication with Data Science team and stakeholders, and a team player who is excited to design and develop the MLOps deployment that will enable the team to multiply their impact.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Design and implement our greenfield ML platform and suite of analytical AI agents, 10Xing the Data Science team’s impact.

  • Work closely with Data Scientists to understand their development needs

  • Work closely with Stakeholders to understand the business problems driving model deployments, translating complex models into self-serve, LLM-callable tools that augment stakeholder workflows.

  • Assess and integrate cutting-edge software and practices in Data Science and MLOps.

  • Refactor disjointed data science scripts and workflows into modular 'skills' that act as procedural knowledge for AI agents, streamlining stakeholder interactions. 

Key Projects:

  • Manage deployment and contribute to models driving Paramount+’s global, financial forecasts 

  • Design and implement Paramount’s model deployment platform

  • Design and implement robust monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability of ML deployments

  • Design and implement UIs and natural-language AI agents that enable a variety of stakeholders to intuitively interact with DS models.

  • Drive adoption of best practices for CI/CD workflows tailored to Data Science & Agentic Workflows

  • Drive adoption of agentic workflows (e.g., automated SQL generation, variance diagnostics, model post-mortems) across Data Science and the larger Paramount organization.

Qualifications:

You Have:

  • 5+ years experience in Data Science and ML Engineering.

  • Deep experience developing as a team using Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Docker, & Kubernetes

  • Deep experience designing and implementing MLOps platforms and multi-agent systems in a cloud environment.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Senior Product Manager, Sign-Up Flow Optimization
Team: Applied Intelligence
Company: Paramount Streaming (Paramount+, Pluto TV)


About the Role
Paramount is building the next generation of personalization and discovery across our global streaming platforms, and we are looking for a Senior Product Manager to contribute to high-impact initiatives across the Paramount+ and Pluto TV sign-up/registration flow. In this role, you will help shape how millions of viewers discover films, series, live sports, and news on Paramount+, Pluto TV, and our future streaming products. You will work closely with senior engineers and applied scientists to build and deploy production systems that improve engagement, retention, and viewer satisfaction. This is a highly collaborative technical role where you will contribute to innovation at the intersection of ML modeling, retrieval and ranking systems, embeddings, experimentation, and real-time user understanding.


What You’ll Do

  • Contribute to the design and development of personalization in the Paramount+ sign-up flow and Pluto TV registration experiences.
  • Help define and lead the multi-year product strategy across Paramount+ and Pluto TV for sign-up flow/registration flow optimization
  • Build the specifications to develop real-time, personalized experiences in the sign-up flow (in cases with both low-information and high-information)
  • Partner with product, design, content, platform engineering, and data science teams to deliver measurable user outcomes.
  • Support the development of semantic search and browse experiences using embeddings, query understanding, and domain-specific model architectures.
  • Apply experimentation best practices, including A/B testing and offline evaluation, to inform model and feature improvements.
  • Collaborate with and learn from senior engineers and scientists, contributing to a solid and growing Applied ML culture.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, with a focus on data, machine learning, or highly technical platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of machine learning concepts (e.g., recommendation systems, ranking, experimentation) and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven track record of spearheading end-to-end product initiatives, from problem definition and strategy through execution, launch, and iteration.
  • Experience working closely with engineering, data science, and design teams to deliver data-driven products at scale.
  • Fluency in experimentation methodologies, including A/B testing, metric design, and interpreting results to inform product decisions.
  • Ability to define clear product requirements, prioritize successfully, and balance short-term wins with long-term platform investments.
  • Strong analytical skills, with comfort using data to identify opportunities, measure impact, and guide decision-making.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and levels.
  • Familiarity with data and ML ecosystems (e.g., BigQuery, experimentation platforms, model lifecycle concepts) is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in streaming, media, growth, or user acquisition funnels (e.g., sign-up, onboarding, personalization) is a plus.


Why Join Us

  • Impact: Your work will directly shape how hundreds of millions of users get to their content.
  • Influence: You will help define our personalization architecture and grow a senior ML team.
  • Innovation: Work alongside experts across Core ML, Causal Science, Content Knowledge, and ML Platform.
  • Growth: Paramount is investing heavily in personalization and foundational AI capabilities—this is a ground-floor opportunity to build what comes next.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview:

We’re looking for an enthusiastic Sr. Publicist who has a deep affinity for news and a knowledge of the media ecosystem. The right person for this position is a team player with solid media contacts and a solid ability to manage deadline pressure. This is an onsite position at our Washington D.C. office.  

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Create and implement press strategies and develop timelines to maximize CBS News programming and talent profiles. 
  • Pitch to secure feature stories and talent interviews across a variety of media platforms and outlets, including online, print, talk shows, podcasts, and industry panels, among others
  • Liaise and align with producers, talent, and key internal departments, including Photo, Marketing, and leadership, to facilitate ongoing publicity support for the News division.
  • Plan, develop, and execute talent trips, press junkets, and on-set media visits in support of series.
  • Handle talent appearances at events.
  • Collaborate with units within the CBS Television Network for cross-promotional opportunities.
  • Write press releases, storylines, bios, and social media copy for News division programming and talent.
  • Work five days a week in the office, with the awareness that hours may fluctuate due to a 24/7 news cycle and may include mornings, evenings, and weekends.

 

Basic Qualifications

  • 4+ years’ experience in media relations.
  • Bachelor’s degree in either English, Communications, Journalism, Publicity or related field.

 

Additional Qualifications

  • A positive attitude is a must.
  • Ability to build deep relationships with press/media (traditional print press as well as online, podcasters, blog writers, social media, and emerging platforms).
  • Exemplary communication, writing skills, and proofreading skills.
  • Deep knowledge and insight of culture and social media/digital/online press.
  • Fluent in social media with the ability to track trends emerging in the digital space.
  • Must be a creative and problem-solving driven individual who can create a well-thought-out press plan to maximize publicity, pitching traditional and non-traditional media.
  • Proficient organizational, leadership, and client/talent relations/customer service skills with great attention to detail.
  • An ability to multitask in high-pressure situations.
  • Must demonstrate a high quality of work performed, both precisely and proficiently.
  • Ability to work successfully in an extremely dynamic, deadline-oriented work environment while maintaining a positive attitude.
  • A team player available to also support fellow publicists and their projects when necessary.

 

 

CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Senior RtR Accountant – Cash & Banking

Contract Type: Initial 1-Year Fixed-Term Contract (with intended 1-year extension, 1+1 model)

Location: Budapest, Hungary (Hybrid)

Reports to: Record to Report (RtR) Team Lead / Manager

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented Senior RtR Accountant – Cash & Banking to join our Record to Report team in Budapest on an initial 1-year fixed-term basis, with a planned extension for a second year.

In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will be responsible for end-to-end cash accounting, daily and monthly bank reconciliations, cash clearing, and supporting month-end close activities across Skydance (previously Paramount) entities. This role is ideal for a proactive General Ledger or Cash Accountant who enjoys operational accounting, keeping balance sheets clean, and partnering daily with operational teams like Treasury, P2P, and O2C.

What You’ll Do

This is an operational, execution-focused accounting role where you will directly handle day-to-day reconciliations and general ledger tasks:

  • Cash Accounting & Reconciliations: Perform daily and monthly bank reconciliations across multi-currency accounts. Investigate, trace, and resolve unallocated cash items and open clearing balances.

  • Journal Entries & Month-End Close: Prepare, post, and review standard cash-related journal entries, bank charges, interest postings, and intercompany cash settlements in line with US GAAP / IFRS.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Liaise directly with Treasury, Accounts Payable (P2P), Accounts Receivable (O2C), Payroll, and local finance teams to resolve daily transactional discrepancies and operational queries.

  • Internal Controls & Audit Support: Maintain internal controls and SOX compliance documentation for all cash processes. Assist internal and external auditors by pulling sample documentation, bank statements, and preparing standard audit workpapers.

  • Process Improvement: Support process standardization and rule configuration for automated cash clearing in ERP and reconciliation platforms as workflows transition into our GBS model.

  • Team Knowledge Sharing: Act as a go-to operational contact for complex reconciliation cases and support onboarding or mentoring junior accountants within the team.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

  • Experience: 4+ years of hands-on accounting experience in General Ledger (GL), Cash & Banking, or RtR within a multinational corporate or Shared Services (SSC/GBS) environment.

  • Technical Accounting: Solid practical understanding of US GAAP or IFRS, particularly around balance sheet reconciliations, accruals, and cash cut-off principles.

  • Systems & Tools: Hands-on experience with major ERP systems (SAP preferred) and cash reconciliation tools (e.g., BlackLine). Proficient Excel skills (lookups, pivot tables, sumifs).

  • Work Style: Hands-on mindset, structured problem-solving approach, high attention to transactional detail, and ability to meet strict month-end deadlines.

  • Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (B2/C1, written and spoken).

  • Contract: Willingness and availability to commit to an initial 1-year fixed-term contract with an expected 1-year extension.

  • Work Authorization: Must hold valid, unrestricted work authorization for Hungary (please note that visa sponsorship or relocation assistance is not available for this role).

Why Skydance (Previously Paramount)?

You’ll be joining a creative, global media powerhouse where your analytical skills help protect and propel the business forward. We value team members who enjoy getting into the numbers and building reliable, scalable ways of working.

What We Offer:

  • Health & Wellness: Private health insurance with private clinic access, annual health screening packages, and eyewear support.

  • Financial Flexibility: Monthly cafeteria plan featuring SZÉP card options, nursery support, and home loan assistance.

  • Office Perks: Fresh fruit delivered weekly, cross-team social events, and a dog-friendly office.

  • Growth & Culture: Company-sponsored language courses (post-probation) and exclusive pre-premiere movie screenings before official releases.

Note for Internal Applicants: Moving to a fixed-term assignment does not impact your permanent contract status. You will retain employment continuity and return to your previous or equivalent role upon completion.


About Skydance
Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

  • Generous paid time off.
  • Complimentary subscriptions to HBO Max, Paramount+, and other Skydance streaming services and digital news products.
  • Robust employee engagement opportunities, including access to exclusive screenings and events, speaker series, volunteer activities and more.

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Tooling & Quality Engineering Platforms
Team: Global Quality Engineering (GQE)
Location: New York City, Los Angeles, San Francisco


Overview
Paramount Skydance Corp. is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design and build
advanced AI‑powered tooling and internal platforms that modernize quality engineering across
the organization. This is not an “in test” role — you will be building production systems,
internal platforms, and intelligent automation services that materially improve engineering
efficiency. You will lead the development of AI‑driven services, RAG pipelines, and automation
accelerators that streamline test authoring, triage, and analysis.

 

Key Responsibilities
● Architect and implement AI‑driven services, micro‑platforms, and developer tools thatsupport GQE.
● Build and optimize RAG pipelines, embeddings systems, and LLM‑powered utilities.
● Develop intelligent automation accelerators that classify failures, detect flakiness, and
recommend fixes.
● Integrate AI capabilities into CI/CD pipelines and existing automation frameworks.
● Partner with QE, Platform, and Data Engineering to define requirements and deliver
scalable solutions.
● Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering standards and best practices.
● Evaluate emerging AI technologies and propose functional applications.

 

Qualifications
● 4+ years of software engineering experience with robust backend expertise.
● Proven experience building production‑grade AI or ML‑powered systems.
● Strong knowledge of distributed systems, microservices, and cloud platforms.
● Hands‑on experience with vector databases, embeddings, and LLM orchestration.
● Experience integrating tools into CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows.
● Strong communication and cross‑functional collaboration skills.

 

Key Competencies
● Technical leadership within a team.
● Strong architectural judgment and design skills.
● Ability to break down complex problems and deliver scalable solutions.
● Mentorship and uplift of junior engineers.


Success Metrics
● Delivery of scalable AI tooling adopted across multiple GQE teams.
● Measurable reduction in triage time and improved automation signal quality
● Increased developer productivity through AI‑powered tools.
● Strong technical influence and mentorship impact

  Job Title: Senior Software Engineer in Test Team: Global Quality Engineering Location: New York City, Los Angeles, San Francisco   Overview Paramount Skydance Corp. is seeking a Senior Software Engineer in Test to design, architect, and deliver high-quality, scalable, and reliable automated testing solutions across our enterprise platforms. This role requires proficient skills in Java engineering. It also requires experience in advanced test automation and knowledge of the media and streaming industry. You will use modern CI/CD practices to improve quality and reduce risk. Your work will help provide great customer experiences on CTV, SmartTV, mobile, and web platforms. As a member of the Global Quality Engineering (GQE) organization, you will utilize our existing departmental automation framework, help drive quality strategies, and mentor engineers across GQE to elevate testing maturity and engineering excellence. You will also leverage AI-augmented development and testing practices using Claude Code, GitHub Copilot (in-IDE), Cursor, and similar tools.   Key Responsibilities   Create Robust & Reliable Automation Coverage across front-end and back-end • Create and maintain automated tests using our existing Java-based departmental test automation framework supporting API, UI, Mobile, CTV/SmartTV, and integration testing; introduce reusable libraries, utilities, and patterns to improve stability and scale. • Utilize scalable patterns for reusable test components, data management, assertions, parallelization, and distributed execution. • Integrate the framework deeply into CI/CD pipelines to support shift-left testing and continuous quality.   AI-Augmented Quality Engineering • Champion AI-assisted development and testing using tools such as GitHub Copilot (IDE), Cursor, and LLM-based assistants to improve developer productivity, test authoring velocity, code reviews, and defect triage. • Apply prompt engineering and retrieval techniques to accelerate test case generation, log/telemetry summarization, video-quality anomaly detection, and root-cause analysis. • Evaluate and integrate functional AI capabilities that measurably reduce flakiness, false positives, and triage time within the existing framework.   Media & Multi-Platform Quality • Expand automation coverage for video playback, streaming resiliency, DRM flows, SSAI/CSAI ad insertion, captions/subtitles, and content protection. • Validate QoE metrics (startup time, rebuffering ratio, frame drops, video/audio sync, error recovery) across Roku, Fire TV, Android TV/Google TV, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Apple TV, iOS/Android mobile apps, and modern web players. • Leverage media tooling such as ffmpeg/ffprobe, Charles/Fiddler, and player inspection APIs for diagnostics and validation. • Ensure consistent adoption of engineering best practices, coding standards, and high-quality test development patterns.   Cross Functional Collaboration • Partner with Video Engineering, Playback/Player, Ads/Monetization, CDN/Streaming Operations, and Platform teams to ensure robust validation of streaming experiences and ad workflows. • Collaborate with Product to ensure test coverage aligns to business priorities and quality goals. • Work closely with Platform and Data Engineering to support scalable test environments, quality data, and telemetry.   Technical Execution • Design and implement complex automated test suites using Java, Selenium, Appium, JMeter, Locust, REST-Assured, TestNG/JUnit, and related tooling within the existing framework. • Build and optimize testing strategies including API/contract, integration, performance/reliability, and device-level testing for CTV/SmartTV, mobile, and web. • Diagnose and tackle issues related to automation reliability, environment instability, device fragmentation, and system integration.   Required Qualifications • 6+ years of experience in software engineering or quality engineering with solid Java development expertise. • Demonstrated experience using and enhancing an existing enterprise/departmental automation framework. • Deep expertise in common test automation tools (Selenium, Appium, Playwright, REST-Assured, TestNG, JUnit, Maven/Gradle). • AI experience (must-have): hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools. This includes tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot (IDE), Cursor, or similar. Candidates should also have useful prompt engineering skills for code and tests. LLMs are leveraged for tasks such as generating tests, suggesting code reviews, summarizing logs, and speeding up triage. • Strong knowledge of CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Argo, Spinnaker) and quality gates. • Proven experience testing media/streaming applications across CTV (Roku, Fire TV, Android TV/Google TV), SmartTV (Tizen/webOS), iOS/Android mobile, and web. • Hands-on validation of HLS/DASH, ABR, DRM, captions/subtitles, and QoE metrics. • Cloud experience (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). • Solid knowledge of software design patterns, data structures, and core engineering principles.   Preferred Qualifications • Familiarity with observability and APM tools (Grafana, Prometheus, NewRelic, DataDog) and media telemetry(Conviva, MUX, NPAW etc). • Experience with contract testing (PACT), service virtualization, or synthetic media test data. • Exposure to CTV/SmartTV automation stacks and remote device labs.   Key Competencies • Quality mindset – commitment to reliability, maintainability, and continuous improvement. • AI fluency – practical judgment on where AI adds measurable value in testing. • Systems thinking – understanding distributed systems and complex media pipelines.   Success Metrics • Increased automation coverage across CTV/SmartTV, mobile, and web; reduced manual regression. • Measurable reduction in escaped defects and media playback incidents. • Improved stability and reliability of automated pipelines and device runs. • Faster release cycles through scalable, AI-augmented automation. • Broad adoption and consistent usage of the GQE test framework across teams.   #LI-JC1

job.description:

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Senior Software Engineer, Smart TV/CTV 

 

Location: New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale


Overview


You’ll build and ship Paramount’s Smart TV applications across Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, and other CTV
platforms. These apps run on web-based runtimes with tight memory budgets, limited CPU, and hardware that
varies by model year and price point. You’ll write React and TypeScript that performs within those constraints.
You’ll own features from concept through certification. You’ll work with central video engineering, external
platform partners, and Product/Design to deliver what millions of viewers see on the biggest screen in the
house.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain application components for Paramount’s Smart TV apps using React and
    TypeScript
  • Optimize application performance on resource-constrained CTV devices. Profile rendering, measure
    memory, fix what’s slow
  • Collaborate with central video engineering teams to integrate and optimize video players across platforms
  • Work with external platform partners (Samsung, LG, and others) to develop, debug, and certify
    applications
  • Manage application state with Redux and RTK. Keep the store clean and selectors fast as the app grows
  • Write clean, tested code and participate in code reviews. Hold your teammates to the same standard
  • Coordinate with Product, Design, and Backend Engineering to turn requirements into working features
  • Work across multiple agile teams and contribute to all phases of the development cycle
  • Improve CI/CD pipelines and testing infrastructure for multi-platform Smart TV deployments
  • Document components, platform-specific patterns, and technical decisions
  • Use AI development tools to move faster and share what works with the team

 

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years writing software
  • 2+ years building Smart TV or CTV applications on web-based platforms (Tizen, webOS, or similar)
  • BS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • React and TypeScript. You build components, not just consume them
  • State management with Redux and RTK. You understand store shape, middleware, and when selectors
    cause unnecessary re-renders
  • Client-side routing patterns (React Router or equivalent)
  • Front-end fundamentals: HTML, CSS, modern JavaScript. You can debug layout and rendering issues on
    a TV runtime
  • You’ve taken features from concept through delivery on CTV platforms, including certification
  • CI/CD environments with DevOps and SRE principles
  • RESTful API integration and data handling
  • You communicate technical decisions in writing and in conversation. People act on what you say because
    it’s clear
  • You use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to write and ship code faster

 

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with multiple CTV platforms (Tizen, webOS, Vizio, Xbox, PlayStation, or others)
  • Performance optimization on TV devices: profiling, memory measurement, rendering analysis. You know
    how to find the bottleneck, not just guess
  • Browser internals knowledge: rendering pipelines, compositing, layout thrashing, and how these behave
    on TV runtimes vs. desktop browsers
  • Video player integration experience (Shaka, hls.js, or native platform players)
  • Observability tools: Conviva, New Relic, Datadog, Sentry, or similar
  • Experience working in Agile frameworks across distributed teams and time zones
  • Rapid proof-of-concept experience. You’ve built throwaway prototypes to answer hard questions fast
  • Enthusiasm for sharing AI tools and workflows that save the team time
  • You care about UX on the 10-foot screen and you’ll push back when something isn’t right
  • You say “I don’t know” when you don’t know

 

What Good Looks Like

  • You open a Smart TV codebase you’ve never seen, connect a Tizen emulator, and start diagnosing a
    rendering issue the same afternoon
  • Other engineers read your code and understand it without a walkthrough
  • You spot a memory leak on a 2020-era LG TV before QA files a ticket. You fix it and write up what
    happened
  • When a certification submission fails, you read the rejection, fix the issue, and flag what the team should
    check next time
  • You own your features end to end. From scoping through deployment, you don’t wait for someone to tell
    you what’s next
  • You know which React patterns cause jank on low-end CTV hardware. You avoid them and explain why to
    teammates who ask
  • You push back when a plan has gaps. You suggest a better approach
  • You treat the build pipeline, test coverage, and error monitoring like product features
  • You help your teammates get better. Through code reviews, pairing, or writing things down so the next
    person doesn’t hit the same wall
