SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER — ROKU

 

Location: On-Site - New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

 

You'll build and ship the Paramount+ Roku application used by millions of viewers. The Roku platform has constraints other platforms don't: tight memory budgets, a single-threaded render loop, device hardware that ranges from flagship to five years old. You'll solve problems inside those constraints.

 

We write software that's simple to read, cheap to maintain, and built to last. You'll own features from design through deployment, work across agile teams, and help other engineers get better at this work.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

• Design, build, and maintain core Roku framework components and application features for Paramount+

• Architect around Roku's constraints: memory limits, render-thread/task-thread boundaries, device performance tiers, and certification requirements

• Use RSG 1.3 data transfer APIs, BrightScript Memory Monitor, and Perfetto tracing to find and fix performance problems before users hit them

• Build real-time personalization and engagement features — personalized recommendations, dynamic artwork, ad engagement — within Roku's memory and performance budgets

• Write clear documentation for components, architecture decisions, and platform-specific patterns

• Measure and improve application performance and stability through instrumentation and observability

• Work across agile teams and coordinate with backend engineering and DevOps/SRE on service builds and deploys

• Review code, pair with teammates, and raise the quality bar across the team

• Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and testing infrastructure

• Design and run A/B tests, then act on what the data says

• Use AI development tools to move faster and share what works with the team

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 

• 6+ years writing software

• 3+ years building Roku applications

• BS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience

• You know OOP, data structures, and algorithms well enough to design systems, not just pass interviews

• BrightScript and SceneGraph SDK, including RSG 1.3

• You can explain Roku's memory model, the render-thread/task-thread split, device tiers, and what certification requires

• RESTful API design and data serialization

• Roku frameworks and services: RAF, RMF, RokuPay

• Unit and integration testing on Roku

• HTTP protocol and caching behavior

• Git and GitHub

• You write and speak about technical decisions in a way that helps people act on them

• You use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to write and ship code faster

 

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 

• BrighterScript and Roku community tooling (ropm, bslint, roku-debug)

• Other OTT platforms: Fire TV, Android TV, Apple TV, Samsung TV, LG webOS

• Observability tools: Conviva, New Relic, Datadog, Sentry

• Microservices and backend-for-frontend patterns

• You've worked with personalization or recommendation APIs on resource-constrained devices

• E2E testing for connected-device applications

• Docker and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins or similar)

• GraphQL

• You share AI tools and workflows that save the team time

• You care about UX enough to push back on Product and Design when something isn't right

• You say "I don't know" when you don't know

• You've worked across time zones without waiting for meetings to unblock you

 

WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE

 

• You open a 200-file BrightScript repo you've never seen and start making changes the same day

• Other engineers read your code and understand it without a walkthrough

• You notice a memory spike on a Roku Express before QA files a ticket. You fix it and write up what happened

• You track Roku OS releases and adopt new APIs when they solve a real problem, not because they're new

• You write architecture docs, component guides, and Slack explanations that save ten people from asking the same question

• You push back when a plan has gaps. You suggest a better one

• You treat the build pipeline, test coverage, and error monitoring like product features

• You make the people around you better at their jobs

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, and we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is…YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team that values authenticity and embraces inclusion for all. We are searching for individuals who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees. You fuel our culture of purpose, passion, and collaboration. We’re in this together.

Senior Software Engineer, Front End – CBS Sports Digital

Req: 45930 | Department: CBS Sports.com Technology | Type: Full-Time, On-Site Locations: Nashville, TN; Louisville, KY; Fort Lauderdale, FL

 

 

 

About the Role

Join CBS Sports Digital and help build the web experiences that millions of sports fans use every day across CBSSports.com and our apps. We are looking for a Senior Front End Engineer to join our Content Management team, a small engineering group that partners closely with design and product to turn ideas into fast, accessible, production-grade fan experiences.

 

You will own the quality of what fans see and feel: how fast pages load, how components behave, and how reliably we ship. Candidates with Lead-level scope are also encouraged to apply.

What You Will Do

  • Build Front-End Features: Design and ship production-grade features for web using React, Next.js, and TypeScript, from prototype through launch.

  • Own Performance: Improve and protect Core Web Vitals through rendering strategy, code splitting, lazy loading, and image and asset optimization.

  • Contribute to Standards: Build and evolve reusable components and shared patterns that scale across the organization.

  • Collaborate and Prototype: Work with design and product to quickly design, develop, and test solutions to key business challenges.

  • Raise the Bar on Code Quality: Review code for style, testability, accessibility, and efficiency, and mentor engineers on front-end best practices.

  • Type Safety: Contribute to TypeScript standards (strict mode, shared types, codegen) so our codebases stay maintainable and refactor-safe.

  • Monorepo Workflows: Use and contribute to monorepo tooling (e.g., Turborepo, Nx) to support build, test, and deploy across web applications.

  • Operational Excellence: Build with reliability in mind, including testing, front-end monitoring, and alerting.

  • Document: Contribute clear documentation and diagrams to help onboard other engineers.

  • Use AI Tools: Use AI development tools to speed up your workflow and share what works with the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building scalable, production-grade web applications with React and Next.js.

  • Strong expertise in JavaScript and TypeScript, including asynchronous programming, generics, strict typing, and modern ES6+ features.

  • Deep knowledge of HTML and CSS, including responsive layout, cross-browser compatibility, accessibility, and performance optimization.

  • Solid understanding of browser behavior, rendering, and front-end performance (e.g., Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code splitting).

  • Experience consuming APIs (REST and GraphQL), including Apollo Client.

  • Experience with monorepo tooling and workflows (e.g., Turborepo, Nx), including shared packages and task pipelines.

  • Experience with component libraries or design systems and with testing front-end code (unit, integration, end-to-end).

  • Working knowledge of Node.js for server-side rendering and API layers.

  • Strong debugging and performance troubleshooting skills, including monitoring tools (e.g., New Relic, OpenTelemetry).

  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

  • Passion for sports and a dedication to creating exceptional fan experiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multiple styling approaches (StyleX, CSS Modules, SASS, CSS-in-JS) and design tokens.

  • Exposure to CMS platforms such as WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, or Magento.

  • Experience with AI development tools (Cursor, Copilot, etc.) and with setting up guardrails (rules, commands, skills, sub-agents) to keep AI-generated code clean and production-ready.

  • Familiarity with Generative AI and RAG concepts, or experience building AI-powered features.

  • Cloud experience (AWS preferred) and familiarity with containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Familiarity with caching (Redis, Memcached) and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).

  • Cloud certifications (AWS, GCP, OCI).

 

CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

job.description:

  Overview  As a member of the Paramount Privacy engineering team, you’ll support the day-to-day operational management and implementation of the global Paramount Privacy Program. You’ll put user data protection first by building and supporting scalable tools, utilities, and infrastructure that keep consumer data secure across platforms—including connected TVs, mobile apps, and web ecosystems. You’ll partner closely with legal, product, and cross-functional technology teams to translate complex privacy regulations (such as GDPR and CCPA) into concrete engineering requirements and embed privacy-by-design principles directly into our systems. You’ll take technical ownership of privacy codebases while facilitating automated testing and compliance frameworks across the company.     Responsibilities
  • Partner with legal, product, and technology teams to embed privacy-by-design principles into products and backend infrastructure.
  • Translate global privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) into concrete engineering requirements, technical specifications, and system architectures.
  • Take technical ownership of privacy codebases and build, enhance, and maintain scalable Privacy infrastructure.
  • Develop new privacy technologies and extend existing tools, utilities, automation, and diagnostic scripts.
  • Conduct comprehensive privacy compliance audits across Web, Mobile, and Connected TV (CTV) platforms.
  • Automate consent management platform (CMP) compliance testing and execute cross-functional integration testing with engineering teams across different business units.
  • Create, maintain, document, and execute manual and automated test plans and test cases against our software platforms and applications.
  • Research, evaluate, and recommend new developer tools, frameworks, and methodologies to assist the privacy engineering team.
  • Document existing and new technical processes, maintaining clear architectural documentation for internal teams.

 

Basic Qualifications
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience with proficient engineering fundamentals (Git, testing, code review, CI/CD).
  • 5+ years of hands-on development experience with JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • 5+ years of experience building software tools, utilities, automation, and diagnostics using Python, Ruby, or Ruby on Rails.
  • 3+ years of experience developing and deploying cloud infrastructure on AWS or GCP.
  • Proven ability to execute automated and manual testing, extend test frameworks, and maintain CI/CD quality gates.

 

Bonus Skills (Nice-to-Haves)
  • 3+ years of experience developing, testing, or debugging mobile and OTT/CTV applications across Apple, Amazon, Android, and Roku platforms.Hands-on experience with SDK development, JavaScript bundlers, and build utilities (e.g., Webpack).
  • Experience conducting privacy compliance audits and diagnosing configuration issues with IAB frameworks.
  • Experience implementing or managing Consent Management Platforms (CMPs).
  • Active IAPP Certification (CIPT preferred).

Maintain and expand the API layer and data models across two provider contexts (Paramount+ and PlutoTV) as the codebase converges toward a unified multi-tenant architecture - Uphold engineering quality through test coverage, code reviews, and consistent application of coding standards Internal Tooling & Curation - Django and Django REST Framework for production backend applications - Google Cloud Platform: Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Secret Manager, GKE - Google Cloud Pub/Sub subscriber/publisher patterns - Overview:

Paramount is looking for Senior Counsel to join the Law Department team supporting the U.S. Distribution (USD) group. This role requires drafting, reviewing, and negotiating a wide range of agreements arising from the distribution of Paramount’s programming services and content. This includes a broad array of media platforms (e.g. cable and satellite television, internet/OTT, connected devices, integrated streaming platforms) with a focus on linear, VOD and streaming distribution agreements. The ideal candidate will bring prior relevant deal experience, and will be expected to take a leadership role on complex negotiations and to help guide the development of more junior attorneys.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Leading and managing complex, high-value negotiations with minimal oversight
  • Providing advice and counsel on a variety of legal and business affairs matters
  • Monitoring contractual and regulatory compliance
  • Assisting with various departmental and administrative functions and assignments requiring interaction with other groups within USD (e.g., Partnerships, Deal Finance, Strategy), with attorneys supporting other client groups and with executives across Paramount.
  • Providing guidance, mentorship, and work-product review to more junior attorneys
  • Supporting and advising senior leadership as needed

 

Basic Qualifications: 

  • Extensive, in-depth knowledge of contract and general corporate law
  • Demonstrated ability to independently evaluate, structure, and draft complex agreements and to optimally distill information for clients • Ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously in a demanding, fast-paced environment
  • Strong verbal and written communication

job.title: Sr Data Engineer (Data Architecture and Modeling)
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Overview and Responsibilities:

 

The Signal Intelligence (SigInt) team turns a high-volume, multi-source data ecosystem — operational systems, client-app event streams, ad-tech platforms, stitcher events, ad server logs, and telemetry — into the trusted data models, metrics, and dashboards that drive business, product, and ad-ops decisions.

We are hiring a Senior Data Engineer who is, in equal measure, a data modeler, a SQL craftsperson, and an analyst — not only a pipeline builder. You will own data end-to-end: modeling raw events into conformed, analytics-ready marts; writing the analytical SQL that answers hard business questions; defining the metrics leadership relies on; and building the pipelines that feed it all. Because we sit close to the business, translating ambiguous questions into durable models and clear insight matters as much as engineering the pipeline.

In practice, you will be the team's data sherpa — the person who knows the data terrain cold, guides analysts and business partners through it, and turns an ambiguous “can we find out X?” into a trusted, well-modeled answer. You own the map — the definitions, lineage, and the “why” behind the numbers — as much as the pipelines.

This is an analytics-engineering role on a semi-business team. It is not a pure platform / infrastructure position — if your passion is exclusively distributed-systems plumbing with little interest in modeling, analysis, or guiding the business, this will not be the right fit.

 

Responsibilities Include:

 

Modeling & architecture — the core of the role

• Design and own the dimensional and semantic models — conformed dimensions, facts, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions (Type 2), and well-defined grain — that serve as the trusted source of truth.

• Architect data marts spanning operational, advertising, and telemetry domains for analytics, reporting, AI, and operational use.

• Establish shared definitions and a semantic / metrics layer so users, sessions, devices, content, campaigns, and impressions mean the same thing everywhere.

SQL & analysis

• Write and optimize sophisticated analytical SQL — window functions, cohort and funnel logic, sessionization, distributions — on large event-scale datasets.

• Analyze complex datasets to find patterns, quantify drivers, and produce actionable insight; define new metrics and KPIs (usage, revenue, etc.) and the logic behind them.

• Independently investigate variance across platforms and communicate findings clearly to peers and senior leadership.

Business partnership

• Be the go-to guide for the data — the person who knows where every number comes from, what it means, and its quirks and landmines.

• Own the institutional knowledge of the data — definitions, lineage, and the reasoning behind metrics — and make it legible so analysts, ad ops, product, and finance can self-serve with confidence.

• Partner with stakeholders and source-system owners to translate ambiguous business questions into durable data models and metrics, and support/conduct strategic investigations and analysis.

Pipelines, quality & delivery

• Build and harmonize the ingestion and transformation pipelines — event data from client apps, ad-tech platforms, stitchers, ad servers, and telemetry — that feed the models, handling deduplication, late-arriving data, sessionization, and schema evolution.

• Stitch identity and sessions across client, server, and ad-side events for accurate user, content, and revenue analytics.

• Establish data-quality standards (testing, monitoring, alerting, freshness and volume SLAs) and troubleshoot incidents end-to-end — from a dashboard anomaly back through marts, transformations, and raw logs.

• Support and improve BI dashboards; document datasets, lineage, and business logic so the data map stays trustworthy and current.

• Mentor engineers and analysts on SQL, modeling, event data, and engineering best practices.

 

Basic Qualifications

 

• Expert SQL, including analytical SQL craft (window functions, complex joins, cohort / funnel / sessionization logic) and performance tuning on large event-scale datasets.

• Deep data-modeling expertise — dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, conformed dimensions, grain, and data-mart design; able to design a trusted source of truth from messy multi-source data.

• Strong data analysis and business translation — able to independently investigate data, define metrics and KPIs, and act as a trusted guide who turns ambiguous business questions into clear answers and enables others to self-serve.

• A guide’s temperament — curiosity to learn the data terrain deeply, patience to help non-technical partners, and communication that earns trust across the business.

• dbt (or an equivalent transformation / modeling framework).

• Cloud warehouse — BigQuery strongly preferred (our environment); Snowflake or Databricks acceptable with a fast ramp.

• Python for data processing and pipeline development.

• Orchestration experience (Airflow).

• High-volume event data — clickstream, telemetry, ad impressions, or similar — including deduplication, late-arriving data, sessionization, and schema evolution.

• Proven track record harmonizing data across multiple source systems with conflicting schemas, identifiers, or grain.

• BI tools (DOMO, Looker, Mode) — comfort both consuming and supporting their development.

• Experience debugging data-quality issues across the full stack — from BI tool to warehouse to raw event logs.

• BA/BS in Computer Science, Math, Physics, Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.

• Strong analytical, logical, and communication skills.

 

Preferred Qualifications

 

• Semantic-layer experience (LookML, dbt Semantic Layer, Cube).

• Streaming-media / ad-tech domain (ad servers, SSAI / stitchers, VAST/VMAP, impression and fill-rate metrics).

• Streaming ingestion (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Kinesis).

• Statistical analysis with R and predictive-analytics tooling; experimentation / A-B analysis.

• Master data management or entity resolution.

• MS in a quantitative discipline; experience mentoring or leading engineers/analysts.

 

How you will succeed in this role:

 

• You think in models and metrics, not just pipelines.

• You are the person others come to when they are lost in the data — and you like being that guide.

• You are as comfortable in a SQL console or a dashboard as in a DAG, and you move fluidly between business context and technical root cause.

• You treat data as a product — with users, definitions, SLAs, and documentation.

• You turn ambiguous business questions into clean models and clear answers.

 

 

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.

Sr Live Event Technology Specialist (Streaming Operations Specialist)

Location:
Flexible / Global (based on operational needs)

Role Overview

As a Sr. Live Event Technology Specialist, you will serve as the primary technical escalation point for Paramount+’s global Live Event Operations team, providing technical support for Tier-1 live streaming events. This role focuses on diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving complex technical issues across the end-to-end live streaming ecosystem while minimizing customer impact during high-profile live broadcasts.

Working alongside Live Event Operators, Engineering, Product, CDN providers, cloud vendors, and distribution partners, you will lead technical investigations, coordinate cross-functional incident response, and drive root cause analysis for issues affecting acquisition, encoding, packaging, delivery, playback, advertising, and platform integrations.

Your expertise will ensure rapid issue mitigation, operational excellence, and continuous improvements across Paramount’s live streaming platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary technical escalation point for the Live Event Operations team during live events.
  • Support global Tier-1 live streaming events by troubleshooting complex issues across the complete video delivery chain.
  • Investigate service-impacting issues involving contribution feeds, cloud encoding, packaging, DRM, origin, CDN delivery, playback, and client applications.
  • Perform detailed technical analysis using streaming manifests, player logs, encoder metrics, QoS/QoE analytics, SCTE-35 signaling, transport stream analysis, and cloud monitoring tools.
  • Coordinate technical response across Engineering, Platform, Network Operations, CDN providers, cloud vendors, and third-party partners to restore service quickly.
  • Lead technical bridge calls during critical incidents, providing real-time updates, impact assessments, mitigation strategies, and recovery coordination.
  • Support Live Event Operators by providing technical guidance during event execution, validating mitigation actions, and assisting with operational decision-making.
  • Perform pre-event technical validation, redundancy verification, workflow testing, and production readiness reviews.
  • Conduct post-event root cause analysis (RCA), identify systemic issues, and drive corrective actions to improve platform reliability.
  • Develop and maintain troubleshooting documentation, operational runbooks, monitoring procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Support certification, onboarding, and production rollout of new streaming technologies, cloud workflows, monitoring tools, and vendor integrations.
  • Participate in on-call rotations supporting global live streaming operations and high-severity production incidents.

 

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years supporting large-scale live streaming, OTT platforms, broadcast technology, or video delivery systems.
  • Experience serving as a technical escalation resource supporting live operations teams during Tier-1 live events.
  • Strong troubleshooting experience across end-to-end streaming architectures including:
    • Contribution and video transport
    • Cloud encoding and transcoding
    • Packaging and origin services
    • DRM
    • SSAI/DAI
    • CDN distribution
    • Player playback
  • Deep understanding of HLS, DASH, CMAF/fMP4, MPEG-TS, SCTE-35, timed metadata, and adaptive bitrate streaming.
  • Experience analyzing manifests, transport streams, encoder logs, player telemetry, QoS/QoE metrics, and cloud infrastructure metrics.
  • Familiarity with AWS Media Services, CDN technologies, cloud networking, and streaming observability platforms.
  • Working knowledge of contribution protocols including SRT, Zixi, RIST, RTP, UDP, and multicast workflows.
  • Strong understanding of DRM, SSAI, client playback behavior, redundancy architectures, and failover strategies.
  • Excellent incident management, root cause analysis, and cross-functional communication skills in high-pressure live production environments.

In This Role You’ll:

In this role, you’ll serve as a technical authority across frontend teams by defining patterns, reviewing architectural decisions, and helping teams navigate complex challenges. job.title: Sr. Product Designer
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

 

Discipline: Design | Team Model: Embedded on a cross-functional CBS Sports App squad

Location: New York, NY

 

The Mission

CBS Sports is the digital stadium for millions of fans. We hold the rights to the biggest moments in sports—NFL, UEFA Champions League, March Madness, the Masters, and UFC. We aren't just a scoreboard; we’re a massive content engine of fantasy leagues, live video, and deep journalism. We’re looking for a Lead Product Designer to join a small, cross-functional squad that operates with the speed of a startup and the scale of a legacy giant.

 

The Role: Build and Own

You won’t just work on a product; you’ll own the design outcomes from first framing through ship. We believe in a builder culture where designers aren't waiting for handoffs or research gates. You will:

  • Own the Project: Take full responsibility for your product squad’s design outcomes. You lead the direction from initial concept to the final shipped experience.

  • Build Constantly: Prototype early and often. We use AI tools (like Cursor or Claude) to visualize ideas and test interactions before they hit engineering, letting us move faster than ever.

  • Lead with Visual Craft: We need designers who bring energy, taste, and dynamic design sensibilities. Whether it’s motion that obeys physics or layouts that capture the intensity of game day, your work should set the bar for the squad.

  • Shape the Product: You’ll trade honest, real-time feedback with engineers and PMs. We don't just "deliver" designs; we shape products in the build.

 

Core Capabilities

  • Visual Design: You have a refined eye for type hierarchy, layouts, and intuitive UI/UX. You deliver high-impact, immersive designs for complex app systems that capture the intensity of game day and live sports.

  • Motion & Interactivity: You understand motion as a logical system. Your designs feel tactile, precise, and alive.

  • Fluency in Native Design: You have deep experience with mobile paradigms (iOS/Android). You know how to leverage native capabilities to elevate the user experience.

  • Owner Mindset: You treat research as a velocity tool, not a gate. You use your intuition, analytics, and direct fan feedback to make smart product decisions quickly.

 

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of end-to-end product design experience.

  • A portfolio showing shipped consumer work on mobile apps or web (required).

  • Comfort moving across prototyping, production, and interaction design without handoffs.

 

Additional Qualifications

  • Passion for sports, betting, live events, or broadcast media.

  • Experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping workflows.

  • Contributions to a design system.

 


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

job.title: Sr. Software Engineer Cloud infrastructure
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Overview

The Applied Intelligence Data Engineering team is seeking a Senior Software Engineer – Cloud Infrastructure. This is a hybrid role that blends deep software engineering with hands-on ownership of cloud infrastructure. It is purpose-built for engineers who are equally writing production Java services and designing multi-cloud platform architecture.

In this role, you will own the full lifecycle of cloud-native systems. You will build high-performance streaming applications and architect the infrastructure they run on. You will also ensure both are production-grade, observable, and secure. You will bridge application and platform engineering, reducing the gap between what software teams need and what the cloud platform delivers.

This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, Kubernetes, and software engineering best practices. You should have a track record of operating at both the application and infrastructure layers.

 

Key Responsibilities

Optimize Data Streaming Applications on Cloud

  • Own end-to-end performance of data streaming applications running on cloud infrastructure — from Kafka topic configuration through consumer processing and downstream delivery.
  • Profile and tune streaming pipelines to maximize throughput and minimize latency, leveraging cloud-native compute, storage, and networking resources.
  • Identify and address bottlenecks at the intersection of application code and cloud resource constraints, including CPU throttling, network saturation, I/O limits, and memory constraints.
  • Design and implement cloud resource utilization strategies. This includes spot/preemptible instances, managed streaming services, and dynamic node pool scaling to balance performance with cost efficiency.
  • Benchmark streaming pipelines end-to-end and translate findings into actionable infrastructure and code improvements.
  • Collaborate with Data and AI/ML engineering teams to ensure streaming pipelines are optimally provisioned for real-time feature engineering, inference, and analytics workloads.


Design & Build Cloud-Native Applications

  • Develop high-throughput, low-latency streaming applications using Java and Kafka.
  • Design event-driven microservices that process, enrich, and route real-time data at scale.
  • Implement reactive, non-blocking architectures to support high concurrency and resilience.
  • Develop reusable streaming frameworks, libraries, and platform capabilities to improve engineering velocity and standardization.


Architect & Operate Multi-Cloud Infrastructure

  • Architect, implement, and optimize multi-cloud infrastructure across GCP and OCI to support large-scale data and streaming workloads.
  • Design and implement advanced networking architectures, including VPC peering, VPNs, load balancers, and cross-region failover strategies.
  • Build and maintain Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code frameworks to standardize deployments and enable developer self-service.
  • Define autoscaling, deployment, failover, and resource optimization strategies for high-volume production systems.
  • Contribute to platform-wide architecture decisions related to scalability, resiliency, high availability, and disaster recovery.


Kubernetes & Container Engineering

  • Deploy and manage containerized microservices within Kubernetes environments (GKE, OKE) across cloud platforms.
  • Implement container orchestration best practices, service-mesh configurations, and rolling-deployment strategies.
  • Partner with platform engineering teams to improve developer tooling, deployment automation, and runtime reliability.

 

Production Reliability & Performance

  • Ensure production-grade reliability, observability, and operational maturity across streaming platforms and infrastructure.
  • Implement comprehensive observability using Prometheus, Grafana, centralized logging, distributed tracing, and health monitoring.
  • Optimize systems for throughput, latency, resiliency, resource efficiency, and cloud cost governance.
  • Build automated testing strategies for streaming and infrastructure workflows, including unit, integration, contract, chaos, and performance testing.
  • Lead incident response, root-cause analysis, and postmortems to improve uptime and reduce operational risk.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Data Engineering teams to integrate streaming architectures with batch processing, data lakes, and analytical platforms.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineering, Product Management, and API teams to enable real-time services and data-driven applications.
  • Work closely with AI/ML engineering teams to support real-time feature engineering, inference pipelines, and operational AI workload.
  • Clearly communicate technical tradeoffs to engineering stakeholders. Also, discuss scalability considerations and operational risks.

 

Technical Management

  • Lead architectural discussions, design reviews, and technical deep dives across distributed systems and cloud infrastructure.
  • Drive engineering standards across code quality, documentation, observability, security, and platform maintainability.
  • Influence long-term technical strategy and modernization initiatives for real-time data infrastructure and cloud platforms.

 

Required Technical Skills

Streaming Optimization & Cloud Resource Utilization

  • Deep expertise in optimizing data streaming applications for throughput, latency, and cost-efficiency across cloud environments.
  • Proficient in tuning Kafka producers, consumers, and brokers — including batch sizing, compression, partition strategies, and consumer lag management — within cloud-hosted deployments.
  • Experience leveraging cloud-native managed services (e.g., Kafka, GCP Pub/Sub, BigQuery Streaming; OCI Streaming) to complement or extend Kafka-based pipelines.
  • Skilled at right-sizing and dynamically allocating cloud compute resources (VMs, node pools, spot/preemptible instances) to match streaming workload profiles and reduce infrastructure spend.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native autoscaling patterns for streaming consumers, including KEDA, HPA, and custom metrics-based scaling in Kubernetes.
  • Ability to identify and address performance bottlenecks at the intersection of application code and cloud resource limits
  • You should have experience benchmarking and profiling streaming pipelines from start to finish. You also need to turn your findings into improvements for infrastructure and code.

 

Basic Qualifications

This is a hybrid role. Candidates must have hands-on experience in both software engineering and cloud infrastructure.

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering and cloud infrastructure, with at least 3+ years in each area.
  • Demonstrated expertise in optimizing data streaming applications on cloud infrastructure.
  • Proven track record building and operating production-grade real-time data platforms.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and collaborating across teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

#LI-PV1

 

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

job.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Data Streaming Systems
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Overview

It will build fault-tolerant streaming applications supporting real-time analytics, APIs, AI workflows, and critical data services.This role will design and build high-performance, fault-tolerant streaming applications that power real-time analytics, APIs, AI workflows, and mission-critical data services across the organization. You will architect and implement distributed, event-driven systems using Java, Kafka, Kubernetes, and modern reactive frameworks. As a senior engineer, you will set the technical direction. You will mentor other engineers. You will also ensure that our streaming platforms are reliable, scalable, and operate smoothly. This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems, concurrency, and cloud-native microservices.

 

Primary Responsibilities

Design & Build Real-Time Streaming Applications

  • Develop high-throughput, low-latency streaming applications using Java and Kafka.
  • Design event-driven microservices that process, enrich, and route real-time data at scale.
  • Implement reactive, non-blocking architectures to support high concurrency and resilience. Create reusable streaming frameworks and libraries. These will help improve engineering efficiency and standardization across the platform.

Architect Scalable Distributed Systems

  • Design and optimize distributed streaming architectures. You will work with Kafka topics, partitioning strategies, consumer groups, schema management, and event lifecycle patterns.
  • Help make architecture decisions for the whole platform. This includes scalability, resiliency, high availability, disaster recovery, and deployments across multiple regions.
  • Drive best practices around event modeling, schema evolution, idempotency, replayability, and data consistency across streaming systems.
  • Build and optimize horizontally scalable services deployed within Kubernetes-based cloud environments.
  • Production Reliability & Performance Make sure that streaming platforms and services are reliable and easy to monitor. Keep these systems operationally mature.
  • Optimize systems for throughput, latency, resiliency, resource efficiency, and infrastructure cost management. Set up full observability using metrics and centralized logging. Use distributed tracing, alerting, and health monitoring tools.
  • Build automated testing strategies for streaming workflows, including unit, integration, contract, chaos, and performance testing.
  • Participate in production support. Help with incident response and root-cause analysis. Work on initiatives to improve reliability continuously.

Cloud-Native & Kubernetes Engineering

  • Deploy and manage containerized microservices within Kubernetes environments across GCP, AWS, or similar cloud platforms.
  • Define strategies for autoscaling, deployment, failover, and resource optimization. These strategies will focus on high-volume production systems.
  • Create and manage CI/CD pipelines. This includes Infrastructure-as-Code and workflows for automated deployment.
  • Collaborate with platform engineering teams to improve developer tooling, deployment automation, and runtime reliability.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Data Engineering teams to integrate streaming architectures with batch processing systems, data lakes, and analytical platforms.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineering, Product Management, and API teams to enable real-time services and data-driven applications.
  • Work closely with AI/ML engineering teams to support real-time feature engineering, inference pipelines, and operational AI workloads.
  • Clearly explain the tradeoffs of different technical options. Discuss scalability considerations and operational risks with engineering stakeholders.

 

Required Technical Skills 

Java & Reactive Programming

  • Advanced proficiency in Java, including concurrency, multithreading, and JVM performance tuning.
  • Strong experience with reactive frameworks such as Spring WebFlux, Project Reactor, or similar.
  • Deep knowledge of asynchronous, non-blocking system design. Kafka & Event-Driven Architecture
  • Extensive experience with Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, streams, schema registry).
  • Strong knowledge of partitioning strategies, offset management, rebalancing, and failure recovery.
  • Experience designing event schemas and managing schema evolution.
  • Familiarity with Kafka Streams, Flink, or similar stream-processing frameworks.

Kubernetes & Cloud-Native Systems

  • Strong hands-on experience deploying and operating applications in Kubernetes. You should have experience using Docker for containerization. It's also important to have knowledge of microservices architecture. You should understand how autoscaling functions. You also need to learn about rolling deployments. It's important to know patterns that ensure reliable production.

 

Basic Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years working on streaming or distributed systems. You should have experience in designing, building, and running production-grade real-time systems. This includes event-driven systems. You should be comfortable working in cloud-based systems that use microservices. This includes engineering environments that focus on these technologies.
  • Ability to take ownership of complex technical work and deliver reliable solutions autonomously.
  • Willingness to mentor junior engineers and contribute to team engineering standards.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across engineering and product teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field; advanced degree preferred.

 

#LI-PV1 

 

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

job.title: SVP, Finance Innovation
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview: 

The Senior Vice President, Finance Innovation is a newly created, high-visibility leadership role responsible for reimagining how the Finance organization operates through the application of artificial intelligence and agentic automation. This role will identify, champion, and implement AI-driven opportunities across the Finance function, with a particular focus on building agentic workflows and AI systems capable of autonomously executing multi-step financial processes with human oversight, across Accounting, Forecasting & FP&A, Treasury, Tax, and operational finance areas unique to a media and entertainment enterprise, including Production Finance and Participations & Residuals. This leader will serve as the bridge between Finance, Technology, and Data/AI teams, translating complex financial processes into scalable, intelligent automation while maintaining rigorous controls, auditability, and compliance standards appropriate for a large public company. The successful candidate will combine deep finance domain expertise with a strong point of view on emerging AI capabilities, and the organizational influence to drive adoption across a broad and often decentralized finance ecosystem. As Finance advances its Fusion systems integration, this leader will be a key voice in shaping how that effort intersects with Finance's broader innovation and automation agenda.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Define and lead the enterprise Finance Innovation strategy and multi-year roadmap for AI and agentic workflow adoption across all Finance sub-functions.
  • Partner with the CFO organization and Finance leadership to identify, prioritize, and business-case AI opportunities based on value creation, risk profile, and feasibility. 
  • Build and maintain a prioritized pipeline of use cases spanning close and consolidation, reconciliations, forecasting and variance analysis, cash and liquidity management, tax provision and compliance, and production finance/participations & residuals calculations and reporting.
  • Stay ahead of the external AI and finance-technology landscape (agentic frameworks, LLM-based finance copilots, RPA-to-agentic evolution) and translate relevant developments into actionable internal opportunities.
  • Partner with Product, Technology, Data & Analytics, and external delivery partners on agentic workflow and AI-tool initiatives as the Finance domain voice, defining use cases, finance requirements, and success criteria, and providing continuous feedback through design, build, and deployment. Product and Technology direct solution design, engineering, and production deployment; this role ensures what gets built reflects finance process reality and business need.
  • Own finance-side accountability across the delivery lifecycle: opportunity identification and prioritization, requirements definition, controls and change management within Finance, driving adoption, and validating realized value while Product and Technology own solution design, build, and rollout execution.
  • Specify the finance control requirements agentic systems must meet: human-in-the-loop oversight, exception handling, and escalation, and validate that the frameworks Product and Technology implement keep those systems within Finance's risk, controls, and SOX/regulatory boundaries. 
  • Convene Internal Audit, SOX, and Compliance to define the control and documentation standards AI-driven finance processes must satisfy, and carry those requirements into the Product and Technology build so solutions meet public-company standards.
  • Partner closely with the EVP of Integration on systems integration work related to Fusion, ensuring Finance requirements, controls, and adoption considerations are represented as Fusion capabilities are integrated into Finance systems and processes.
  • Accounting & Close: Identify opportunities for agentic automation in journal entries, reconciliations, close checklists, and financial reporting. 
  • Forecasting & FP&A: Champion AI-augmented forecasting, scenario modeling, and variance analysis to improve speed and accuracy of business planning.
  • Treasury: Explore agentic support for cash positioning, liquidity forecasting, bank reconciliations, and risk monitoring.
  • Tax: Identify AI applications in tax provision, compliance documentation, and regulatory research and monitoring. 
  • Production Finance: Drive automation of production cost tracking, budget-to-actual analysis, and studio/content cost reporting specific to media production.
  • Participations & Residuals: Champion agentic solutions for the complex, high-volume calculations, contract interpretation, and reporting inherent to participations and residuals processing. 
  • Serve as a visible champion and educator for AI adoption, building Finance-wide fluency and comfort with agentic tools through training, communication, and hands-on enablement.
  • Develop governance structures, including an AI use-case intake process and a Finance Innovation council or working group with representation across Finance sub-functions.
  • Partner with HR and Finance leadership to evolve talent, role design, and ways of working as agentic workflows shift the nature of finance work.
  • Manage change resistance thoughtfully, ensuring adoption is durable and supported by the broader finance organization rather than imposed top-down. Stakeholder Management & Reporting
  • Regularly report progress, value delivered, and roadmap updates to executive leadership, including the CFO and relevant Audit/Risk committees as appropriate.
  • Build strong relationships with Technology, Data/AI, Legal, business-unit finance leaders, and the EVP of Integration to ensure alignment and shared ownership of innovation initiatives, including Fusion-related systems integration work. 
  • Represent the company's Finance Innovation agenda in relevant internal forums and, where appropriate, external industry settings.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field required; MBA, CPA, or equivalent advanced credential preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive finance, accounting, or FP&A experience, ideally within a large, complex, public media, entertainment, or content organization. 
  • Demonstrated track record leading finance transformation, process automation, or technology-enabled change initiatives at scale. 
  • Hands-on familiarity with AI/ML concepts, generative AI, and agentic or RPA-based automation, and how they apply to financial processes; direct experience implementing such tools strongly preferred.
  • Experience with production finance and/or participations and residuals processes is a plus given the specialized nature of these areas in media and entertainment.
  • Prior exposure to SOX controls, internal audit requirements, and the governance considerations of deploying automation in a public-company financial environment. 

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong finance and accounting fundamentals combined with genuine curiosity about, and fluency in, emerging AI capabilities.
  • Executive presence and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Finance, Technology, and business units without direct authority over all of them.
  • Proven ability to translate technical AI/automation concepts into business terms finance professionals can act on, and vice versa.
  • Strong program and change management skills, with comfort operating in ambiguity and building new organizational muscle from scratch.
  • Sound judgment regarding risk, controls, and the appropriate pace and boundaries of automation in regulated financial processes.

 


About Skydance
Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

job.title: TOC/Editor
job.description:
The Ingest/Transmission Operator and Editor oversees all inbound and outbound media, content distribution, and news-gathering operations. Responsibilities include monitoring on-air product quality, ensuring compliance with government regulations, troubleshooting technical equipment, editing news content, and preparing programming for broadcast. This position is governed by the National IBEW Broadcast Agreement for CBS television stations.

 

Duties & Responsibilities


• Monitor and manage inbound and outbound media using various transmission methods, including fiber, Skype, and LiveU.
• Ensure timely response to breaking news events and oversee broadcast delivery.
• Collaborate with team members and network staff, providing operational support as needed.
• Identify, edit, and insert broadcast-quality video and audio into news bulletins on short notice.
• Handle broadcast media and feeds, manage video and audio switching, and operate recording equipment.
• Utilize servers and monitoring systems to manage media acquisition and delivery.
• Ingest media into servers and prepare files for editing and broadcast.
• Perform basic troubleshooting and escalate technical issues when necessary.
• Support live studio production requirements and provide excellent service to internal and external media operations clients.
• Monitor and control video encoding and decoding systems and troubleshoot incoming and outgoing transmission paths.
• Develop and implement backup plans for equipment or transmission failures.
• Edit news content using non-linear editing systems.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

 

Skills & Qualifications


• Strong knowledge of server-based news environments, broadcast hardware, and software systems.
• Understanding of news operations, current events, and the importance of attention to detail.
• Proficiency in quality control (QC) tools and processes.
• Familiarity with digital video formats, ingest workflows, media servers, and broadcast production environments.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure while maintaining accuracy and professionalism.
• Understanding of broadcast production workflows and technical standards.
• Working knowledge of broadcast formats, server systems, and diagnostic tools.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced news environment.
• Strong organizational skills, reliability, and punctuality.
• Experience with Grass Valley Edius editing systems preferred.

 

Education & Experience


• Bachelor's degree in a technical field preferred.
• Minimum of 1–2 years of experience working in a fast-paced television news environment.
• Experience using non-linear editing systems required.
• Must be detail-oriented, deadline-driven, and able to work with minimal supervision.
• Must be a creative and adaptable team player capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously.
• Flexibility to work nights, overnights, weekends, and holidays as needed.

job.title: Video Editor
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.
 
Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.  If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO! 
 
In Australia, we deliver premium content on any screen, anytime, anywhere, via an enhanced viewing ecosystem.   We pride ourselves on creating content that gets people talking and you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as our subscription video on demand service Paramount+.  

 

 

We now have an opportunity for a junior video editor to join our team at Paramount and Network 10 based in Pyrmont. 

 ** this role is permanent full-time, and you must be available to work a 7-day rotating roster.

 

Enough about us! What you’ll do as a Video Editor:

 

You’ll combine your creative flair and technical skills to produce broadcast-quality video content for News, Programming and Production across both linear and digital platforms.

 

Day-to-day, you’ll support our fast-paced News operations, predominantly reformatting international content and editing assets for 10 News programs, while also gaining exposure to a diverse mix of projects and productions.

 

Working with state-of-the-art editing tools in a supportive, high-morale team, you’ll have the chance to expand your skills, collaborate across business units, and engage in storytelling that informs and inspires.   This is a place where variety is the norm, teamwork is strong, and learning opportunities are everywhere!

  

Functions will include:  

  • Manage the ingest, asset management, quality control, distribution, and receipt of News media assets across the network, affiliates, and third parties
  • Edit and deliver high-quality media content for News, Programming and Production using Avid Media Composer and other NLE tools
  • Prepare, QC, and adapt broadcast programs to meet technical and compliance standards across free-to-air, catch-up, and streaming platforms
  • Operate studio EVS systems (IP-Director, LSM-VIA and X-File) to support live studio productions, archive, and restore media assets
  • Contribute to pre-production and creative editing processes, ensuring all content is delivered accurately, on time, and to broadcast-ready standards.

Overview:

CBS News Streaming is seeking a New York-based WGA Line Producer to join our 24/7 news coverage team. This role is ideal for a collaborative, editorially driven producer who thrives in a fast-paced, live news environment. The successful candidate will have exemplary news judgment, well-developed organizational skills, and a passion for visual storytelling. They will play a key role in producing live coverage, making sound editorial decisions under deadline, and partnering with teams across the newsroom to deliver accurate, compelling content. This role is represented by the WGA East.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Work closely with the executive producer & supervising producer in a fast-paced, demanding environment, handling breaking news and news-of-day demands for a 24-hour digital news channel
  • Line produce editorial news content, shape show flow and stack elements in the rundown
  • Work from the control room to guide shows in and out of breaks and to navigate both live and recorded content, including helping to determine when it will run in future hours
  • Partner with assignment desk and booking team to request correspondents and live interview guests
  • Order informative graphics and utilize compelling video to create engaging news programs
  • Distribute assignments and direct a team of writers, associate producers and digital associates to build original content as well as edit and repurpose content from broadcast and other content partners
  • Write teases, headlines, opening package and readers for live programming, including story slugs and lower-third banners
  • Generate story ideas for future coverage
  • Assign and record swap content for automated software wheel
  • Monitor and take newsworthy live events to air in the control room
  • Communicate with anchors, correspondents and control room team ahead of and during live shows, exhibiting a calm and professional demeanor in high pressure situations
  • Serve as a mentor to junior writers
  • Coordinate with sales department to implement accurate ad loads in rundowns
  • May also perform the responsibilities of content producers, producers, and associates producers and digital associates, as needed
 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience producing and writing copy for a national broadcast, cable or streaming network, or equivalent local TV news experience in a major market
  • Command of AP style and broadcast writing with impeccable grammar and spelling
  • Ability to multi-task and handle multiple assignments for regular programming as well as rolling breaking news coverage
  • Superior news judgment & critical thinking skills
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education in journalism or related field
  • Fluency using ENPS is a must
  • Deep knowledge of news standards, rights and clearances and fact-checking practices
  • Must pass comprehensive CBS News Digital writing test
  • Must be available to work all shifts — early morning, dayside, nights, weekends and holidays — sometimes on short notice or as coverage, scheduling and news events warrant, as this is a 24-hour news organization
  • This position is based in New York and requires working in-person at the CBS Broadcast Center
 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Well-developed communication skills and ability to train and advise associate producers, production assistants and junior staff in writing and editing broadcast copy
  • Deep knowledge of editorial production, including control room experience, with well-developed writing and copy-editing skills
  • Detail oriented with ability to work in dynamic environment, deal with intense deadlines and continually react to breaking news with factual programming and creative storytelling
  • Broad knowledge of top stories driving the news cycle, including political news, and a knack for identifying lesser-known angles that resonate with audiences

Maintenance Technician

Pattison Media is looking for an experienced Maintenance Technician to join our Technical Services team in Prince George.

job.title: Business Analyst III, Data Products & Platforms
job.description:
Position Title: Business Analyst III, Data Products & Platforms Department: Enterprise Products & Services Corporate Area: PBS Technology Status: Regular, Full time Exempt Manager Title: Director, Product Management

Position Overview

The Business Analyst III, Data Products & Platforms is responsible for defining, documenting and managing the business requirements for the mbank API layer and the microservices that connect mbank with external media metadata sources, specifically EIDR (Entertainment Identifier Registry) and IMDb. This role serves as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, product managers, data engineers and software developers, translating business needs into clear API specifications, integration requirements and acceptance criteria. The Business Analyst III owns the integration backlog, monitors the health and quality of the data exchanged between mbank and its partner services, and supports user acceptance testing and quality efforts. The role requires a strong understanding of media identifiers and metadata, key business processes and drivers, and the short- and long-term strategies and related technologies of the Data Products & Platforms team.

Key responsibilities

will include, but are not limited to: Serves as business owner and subject matter expert for the mbank API and the microservices that integrate mbank with EIDR and IMDb, aligning technical solutions with business strategies across moderate to complex business processes. Gathers, analyzes and documents business, functional and non-functional requirements for API endpoints, data mappings, and microservice workflows, including user stories, acceptance criteria and process flows. Defines and maintains API specifications and integration documentation (e.g., OpenAPI/Swagger, Postman collections, data dictionaries and mapping documents) in partnership with developers and architects. Manages the integration between mbank and EIDR, including identifier registration, lookup, matching and reconciliation of titles, editions and versions; tracks changes to EIDR schemas, services and registry rules and assesses their impact on mbank. Manages the integration between mbank and IMDb, including data ingestion, field mapping, match logic and refresh cadence; monitors licensing, terms-of-use and usage constraints of the data with Legal and the data owners. Establishes strong, positive relationships with business units, Product Managers and external data providers to identify and document requirements and serves as the point of contact for partner-service questions and issues. Prioritizes business demands; participates in planning and prioritization meetings and maintains a prioritized backlog of enhancements, defect fixes, report requests and other mbank integration work that reflects organizational priorities. Defines data quality rules, validation and exception-handling requirements; monitors API and microservice performance, error rates and data discrepancies, and coordinates root-cause analysis and resolution. Plans and executes user acceptance testing, regression testing and release validation for API and microservice changes; supports deployment, change management and post-release review. Supports data governance and metadata standards by documenting identifier crosswalks, authoritative sources, data lineage and ownership between mbank, EIDR, IMDb and downstream consumers. Collaborates with product and project teams, business partners, IT and security leaders, and often leads planning efforts; manages ambiguity, creates accurate effort estimates, and recognizes the implications of business strategy changes. Develops training materials, process documentation, SOPs and help guides; supports and trains staff and business partners on mbank data and API capabilities. Investigates, resolves and escalates problems, and serves as an escalation point for others. Supports the Scrum Master and acts as a facilitator in all phases of the application lifecycle except development. Requirements for success: 7 years’ related experience, including: Gathering process requirements for IT systems, including writing user stories and acceptance criteria Defining, documenting or testing REST APIs and microservices (e.g., OpenAPI/Swagger, Postman, JSON/XML payloads) Data migration, integration and governance Developing support materials, including SOPs and Help Guides Tracking risks and changes

Experience

with media or entertainment metadata, identifiers or registries (e.g., EIDR, IMDb, EIDR-based title/edition/version models) preferred Bachelor’s degree in a technology-related field Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) or PMI Professional in Business Analysis (PMI-PBA) preferred Skills/Abilities required: Working knowledge of API and microservices architecture, including REST, authentication/authorization, versioning and rate limiting Ability to read and map data models and payloads across systems, and to define match, merge and reconciliation rules Strong understanding of user

experience

and risk management best practices Skilled in business process engineering and information governance Demonstrated knowledge of at least one software development methodology (Agile/Scrum preferred) Demonstrated ability to communicate technical/complex information both verbally and in writing, to technical and non-technical audiences Ability to manage relationships with external data providers and registries Possesses a “can-do” style and a demonstrated interest in understanding the business Effective time management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple competing priorities and respond to emergency situations effectively Strong leadership skills coupled with a drive to innovate Ability to work well both independently and in a team, establishing and maintaining cooperation, understanding, trust and credibility Ability to function and adapt to new goals, practices, etc. within a dynamic work environment Proactively stays current in requisite skills within job scope, and incorporates knowledge and other feedback into work The base pay range for this position at the beginning of employment is expected to be between $130,000/year to $140,000/year. The actual base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position will also include other elements for eligible employees, including: (i) eligibility for discretionary bonuses; (ii) various insurance options, including medical, dental, vision, hearing, life, accidental death and dismemberment, short-term and long-term disability, and business travel accident insurance; (iii) identity protection program; (iv) employee assistance program; (v) financial and retirement savings

benefits

including the PBS Retirement Plan 403(b); (vi) paid time off (17 days per year), paid sick time

benefits

(12 days per year), paid parental leave (60 days / 12 weeks ), and paid holidays (12 days per year). Details of these benefit plans will be provided upon request. The application window for this position is expected to close on 11/16/2026. If hired, the employee will be in an “at-will position,” and the Company reserves the right to modify the base hourly rate/salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.
