job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

21GRAMS, a Real Chemistry subsidiary, is an advertising agency born to make healthcare more human. Not just in our work, but in how we conduct business, approach client relationships, and treat each other. We believe in being good to each other and hard on the work, and in creating work that makes a meaningful difference for patients, caregivers, healthcare professionals, and brands.

Job Summary

The Director, Product Design is a senior design leader responsible for setting the product design vision, raising the quality of the work, and building the conditions for teams to deliver cohesive, accessible, and effective digital experiences. This role leads complex engagements across websites, platforms, products, services, and connected ecosystems, translating user needs, brand strategy, business goals, technology constraints, and healthcare requirements into clear experience direction.

This is not solely an execution role. The Director is accountable for design strategy, client leadership, team development, resourcing, design operations, and measurable experience outcomes. They remain close enough to the work to guide critical decisions, facilitate discovery, critique design, and step into high-impact moments while enabling senior designers to lead day to day.

What You Will Do

Design Vision and Product Strategy

  • Own the product design vision and experience strategy across a portfolio of complex client engagements, connecting user needs, brand intent, business objectives, and technical feasibility.
  • Partner with Experience Strategy, UX, Product Management, Creative, Technology, Data, Medical, Strategy, and Account leadership to frame opportunities, define roadmaps, and establish measurable outcomes.
  • Lead discovery and definition activities, including stakeholder alignment, experience principles, journey framing, service blueprints, value propositions, prioritization, and product or platform planning.
  • Identify opportunities that extend beyond the immediate brief and turn them into clear, decision-ready recommendations for clients and agency leadership.

Design Excellence and Delivery

  • Set and uphold a high bar for interaction design, visual design, responsive behavior, content hierarchy, prototyping, motion, and end-to-end experience coherence.
  • Guide teams from early concepts through detailed design, validation, launch, and optimization, ensuring that strategic intent is maintained through implementation.
  • Oversee scalable design systems, component libraries, pattern governance, and documentation in Figma, working with engineering partners to improve quality and delivery efficiency.
  • Build accessibility into the work from the start, applying WCAG 2.2 AA principles and inclusive design practices rather than treating compliance as a final review step.
  • Use qualitative research, analytics, usability findings, and business measures to evaluate design decisions and recommend iteration.

Client and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as a trusted senior design partner to clients, clearly articulating experience strategy, design rationale, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to executive and working teams.
  • Lead high-stakes presentations, workshops, critiques, and decision-making sessions, creating alignment across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Partner with project and account leadership on scope, staffing, schedules, assumptions, and change management; surface delivery risks early and propose practical solutions.
  • Represent Product Design in new-business opportunities, estimates, proposals, capability presentations, and pitch work.

People Leadership and Practice Development

  • Manage, coach, and develop product designers across levels through clear expectations, actionable feedback, growth plans, and regular career conversations.
  • Create an environment where designers can do their best work, with strong critique, psychological safety, accountability, and thoughtful delegation.
  • Partner with Experience leadership on hiring, staffing, performance management, succession planning, and capability development.
  • Improve the Product Design practice through reusable methods, templates, standards, training, and responsible adoption of emerging tools, including AI-enabled workflows.
  • Contribute to a culture of collaboration across Product Design, UX, Creative, Technology, and Strategy, reducing silos and improving continuity from concept through launch.

What Success Looks Like

  • Clients see Product Design as a strategic partner, not only a production capability.
  • Teams have clear experience direction, decision criteria, and an appropriate level of design leadership from discovery through delivery.
  • Creates a more consistent, accessible, and high-quality experience across the portfolio.
  • Designers receive strong coaching, understand what is expected of them, and demonstrate measurable growth.
  • The practice becomes more scalable through better systems, methods, staffing decisions, and cross-functional ways of working.
  • Experience recommendations connect to defined user, client, and business outcomes.

What You Should Have

  • 10+ years of experience in product design, experience design, interaction design, or a related discipline, including 3+ years managing and developing designers.
  • A portfolio demonstrating leadership across complex, multi-channel digital products or platforms, from strategy and concept through detailed design and launch.
  • Experience leading multiple workstreams or a portfolio of client engagements in an agency, consultancy, product organization, or similarly complex environment.
  • Deep fluency in human-centered design, interaction design, visual systems, prototyping, responsive design, information architecture, and design systems.
  • Strong working knowledge of Figma and modern collaborative design workflows; familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud and prototyping or motion tools is helpful.
  • Practical knowledge of accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.2 AA, and the ability to guide teams in designing inclusive experiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with engineering, product, research, content, analytics, strategy, creative, and account teams.
  • Excellent executive communication, facilitation, storytelling, critique, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Experience defining design outcomes and using research, usability testing, analytics, and performance data to improve experiences.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, making informed trade-offs, and balancing strategic leadership with hands-on guidance when the work requires it.

This Position Is a Strong Fit If

  • You can move between the 30,000-foot view and the detail that determines whether an experience actually works.
  • You are direct, low-ego, generous with feedback, and able to challenge the work while supporting the people doing it.
  • You bring structure to ambiguity, anticipate needs, and help teams make better decisions faster.
  • You care about craft, but judge success by the quality, usefulness, accessibility, and impact of the experience.
  • Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving. 
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data. 
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines. 

Preferred Experience

  • Healthcare, pharmaceutical, patient support, medical technology, or other regulated-industry experience.
  • Experience with privacy, consent, regulated content, and design considerations for patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals.
  • Experience supporting business development, scoping, estimating, and presenting capabilities or pitch work.
  • Experience leading enterprise websites, authenticated platforms, service ecosystems, omnichannel programs, or AI-enabled experiences.

 

Pay Range: $140,000 - $155,000

job.title: 21GRAMS- Medical Copywriter
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Medical Copywriter to join our growing team!

21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, is a full-service healthcare advertising agency built on the belief that healthcare should feel more human. We combine bold creativity, strategic rigor, and deep scientific understanding to create work that changes behavior, improves outcomes, and makes a meaningful impact on people's lives. Our culture is grounded in collaboration, curiosity, and a shared commitment to doing exceptional work. We believe in being good to each other while pushing ourselves to deliver ideas that move audiences, brands, and healthcare forward.

We’re looking for a Medical Copywriter who can bring together scientific fluency and creative instinct — someone who knows how to turn complex clinical information into clear, compelling, brand-building copy. This is not a traditional medical writer role. We’re looking for someone with healthcare advertising experience who can concept, collaborate, and write across a range of promotional and scientific materials while maintaining accuracy, compliance, and brand voice.

The Medical Copywriter is responsible for developing medically sound, strategically sharp, and emotionally resonant copy across healthcare/pharma campaigns. This person will partner closely with Creative, Strategy, Account, Project Management, Editorial, and medical teams to bring ideas to life across multiple channels and deliverables.

The ideal candidate understands how to translate science into stories, can move fluidly between promotional copy and scientific content, and has experience working in an agency environment where deadlines are fast, standards are high, and collaboration is key.

This is a great opportunity for a writer who loves the challenge of making complex science feel human, relevant, and creatively powerful. You’ll work at the intersection of medical rigor and brand storytelling, helping shape work that is strategically grounded, emotionally intelligent, and deeply impactful.

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, San Francisco, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville or Carmel.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Write for healthcare/pharma advertising campaigns across HCP, patient, caregiver, and DTC audiences 
  • Translate complex clinical data, mechanism of action, and product information into clear, engaging, on-brand messaging 
  • Develop copy for a wide range of deliverables, including websites, digital banners, emails, sales materials, patient education, videos, social, and other omnichannel assets 
  • Partner with an Art Director and broader creative team to develop integrated campaign concepts and executions 
  • Ensure all copy aligns with brand strategy, marketing objectives, tone of voice, and audience needs 
  • Work closely with Medical/Scientific leadership to ensure content is accurate, balanced, and compliant 
  • Participate in strategic planning, internal brainstorms, and client meetings as needed 
  • Present concepts internally and incorporate feedback thoughtfully and efficiently 
  • Review and refine copy throughout the agency process for clarity, grammar, consistency, and accuracy 
  • Collaborate with Editorial to resolve stylistic or grammatical concerns 
  • Build a strong understanding of assigned brands, disease states, competitors, and the evolving market landscape 
  • Proactively identify relevant medical, competitive, or regulatory updates that may impact messaging or tactical development
  • Bring a solutions-oriented mindset to projects and contribute to the overall quality of the work 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

job.title: 21GRAMS- New Business Lead
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a New Business Lead to join our growing team!

Real Chemistry seeks an accomplished and strategically minded Head of New Business to lead the agency’s growth function and drive best-in-class business development for 21GRAMS. In this role, you will establish and refine new business processes, develop a high-performing growth team, and serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior leadership, directly impacting pipeline development, win rates, and revenue growth.

This position is integral to 21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, a healthcare advertising and communications firm dedicated to making healthcare more human through innovative, client-centered work conducted with integrity and excellence. You will lead all aspects of new business development, from opportunity identification through pitch execution. You will ensure every team member involved in the pitch process has a seamless, organized experience, fostering collaboration, efficiency and confidence at every stage.

Additionally, you will help own the new client onboarding process, ensuring that day-to-day brand teams are fully equipped with the insights, timelines, and resources needed to service each brand from day one. This critical handoff function bridges the gap between winning the business and delivering exceptional work, setting the foundation for long-term client partnerships.

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.

What you’ll do:

New Business Process Development

  • Establish, refine, and enforce new business processes and standards across the agency
  • Create repeatable frameworks for how opportunities are evaluated, pursued, and executed

Growth Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop a high-performing new business team
  • Ensure every team member involved in the pitch process has a seamless, organized, and collaborative experience

Pipeline Management

  • Identify and qualify new business opportunities 
  • Manage the full pipeline from initial opportunity through close 
  • Track and report on win rates, pipeline health, Saleforce integration, and revenue impact 

Pitch Leadership

  • Lead and support pitch efforts across the agency and with Real Chemistry Partners
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams through the pitch process 
  • Foster confidence and collaboration at every stage of the pursuit

Strategic Partnership with Senior Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted strategic partner to agency leadership on all growth matters 
  • Inform and influence go-to-market strategy across therapeutic areas including launch planning

New Client Onboarding

  • Help own the end-to-end onboarding process for all newly won clients 
  • Ensure day-to-day account teams are fully equipped with the insights, context, and resources needed to service each brand from day one 
  • Bridge the gap between winning the business and delivering exceptional work

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

What you should have:

  • Bachelor's Degree from an accredited institution
  • 12+ years of new business, account management, or project management experience in a healthcare advertising setting
  • Minimum 5+ years in a leadership or supervisory capacity managing high-performing, cross-functional teams in high-pressure environments
  • Demonstrated expertise in pharmaceutical advertising, healthcare communications, or life sciences agency environment with hands-on experience managing teams and new business opportunities
  • Strong understanding of pharmaceutical promotion standards, FDA/OPDP guidance, and healthcare communications
  • Demonstrated ability in data analysis, reporting, and translating metrics into actionable business insights
  • Working knowledge of project management methodologies including Waterfall, Agile, and Hybrid approaches, with ability to select appropriate methodology for each pitch opportunity
  • Proven track record of leading, developing, and motivating teams to high performance
  • Executive-level communication skills—ability to present complex information clearly to C-suite audiences, stakeholders, and clients
  • Strong written and verbal communication with ability to adapt messages for diverse audiences
  • Strategic thinking and sound judgment, with demonstrated ability to solve complex problems, make decisions under uncertainty, and balance competing priorities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Deep expertise in pharmaceutical advertising and healthcare communications, particularly with experience in oncology, rare disease, specialty pharmaceuticals, or other complex therapeutic areas
  • Demonstrated results from process improvement initiatives with measurable impact on efficiency gains, cost reduction, or quality improvement
  • Client relationship management experience at a senior level, including presenting to pharmaceutical and biotech executives

CORE COMPETENCIES & ATTRIBUTES

Professional Competencies

  • Strategic Business Leadership: Setting vision and direction; aligning operations with business objectives; thinking beyond immediate execution to organizational capability building
  • Process Excellence: Designing, implementing, and continuously improving standardized processes and workflows that scale across new business
  • Stakeholder Management: Building and maintaining effective relationships with executives, clients, cross-functional partners, and team members; navigating competing interests
  • Organizational Development: Building high-performing teams, developing talent, creating culture, and leading organizational change

Required Leadership Attributes

  • Change-Positive, Growth-Oriented

You actively seek smarter, faster, and more effective ways to operate. You are not threatened by AI, innovation, new tools, or new ways of working—you're energized by them. You challenge legacy thinking thoughtfully, experiment with confidence, and view change as an advantage rather than a disruption. You don't defend the status quo because "it works"; you see every process, system, and methodology as a candidate for improvement. You are quick to spot opportunities to expand how we operate collectively and you bring others along on that journey. You stay current with emerging PM tools and methodologies because you're genuinely curious about better ways forward, not because compliance requires it.

  • Commercially and Market Aware

You operate beyond internal agency mechanics and understand the bigger picture. You know your clients' business contexts, therapeutic landscapes, and commercial realities well enough to make informed decisions, ask smarter questions, and connect execution to real-world impact. You don't need to be a medical expert, but you are an industry-savvy operator who understands pharma economics, launch timelines, competitive dynamics, and patient access challenges. You ask "why does this matter commercially?" and "what does success look like for the client?" regularly. This commercial acumen informs how you scope projects, allocate resources, and prioritize decisions. You help your team see beyond deliverables to outcomes.

  • Confident Driver of Progress

You embrace being a driver, not just a facilitator or administrator. You create momentum, push for clarity and decisions when you see ambiguity, hold teams accountable constructively without micromanaging, and move work forward even when information is imperfect or circumstances are complicated. You don't wait for consensus to take action; you make smart calls and bring people along. You recognize that indecision is a decision, and you're willing to take that on. You drive toward clear wins and celebrate progress, which energizes your teams and builds confidence across the organization.

  • Steward of Team Balance and Performance

You actively shape the health of the system, not just the output. You recognize burnout early—in individuals and in teams—and you recalibrate workload, expectations, or resources proactively before people break. You also recognize underperformance with equal clarity and you raise the bar constructively, providing support and accountability. You design operating rhythms, sprint cycles, and governance structures that support both sustainable, high performance and uncompromising standards. You understand that how people feel about their work is as important as what they produce, and that sustainable excellence requires both.

  • Ownership Mindset and Creative Agency

You do not wait for permission to elevate the work. You bring forward ideas on how to operate better, propose smarter ways of organizing projects, design stronger plans, and take responsibility for improving outcomes beyond your assigned scope. You see gaps and fill them. You spot inefficiencies and fix them. You don't assume "that's someone else's problem"—you own the enterprise. This doesn't mean doing everything yourself; it means taking initiative to identify what needs to change and driving toward solutions. Your ownership extends to your team's success, your clients' outcomes, and the health of the broader organization.

  • Strong Judgment and Prioritization Instincts

You consistently make good calls under pressure and constraint. You distinguish signal from noise in a sea of competing demands. You make smart trade-offs between speed, quality, and risk with sound instinct—not by formula. You prioritize effectively, recognizing what matters most and what can wait. You have good instincts about people, situations, and strategic priorities, and you trust those instincts while remaining open to new information. When you have to move fast, you do. When you need to be deliberate, you are. You know the difference, and you rarely get it wrong.

  • Courage and Comfort with Productive Discomfort

You are willing to push when it's uncomfortable and challenge constructively when you see a better path. You hold tension without smoothing it away prematurely; you recognize that some of the best solutions come from sitting with uncomfortable questions rather than resolving them quickly. You make difficult calls when needed—hard conversations, tough decisions, unpopular stands—with confidence rather than approval-seeking. You bring backup (data, reasoning, alternatives) to every discussion. You operate with the confidence of someone who takes responsibility for their decisions and is willing to defend them, but you're also genuinely open to being wrong and course-correcting when new information warrants it.

Pay Range: $250,000-$290,000

At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Art Director, to join our growing team!

21GRAMS is in search of a Senior Art Director to generate and delivery quality creative materials. Art directors are responsible for the visual style, art, images and photographs and must adhere to client’s marketing strategies, objectives, and expectations. The main objective is to promote business growth by developing groundbreaking creative concepts

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and execute creative marketing strategies that encompasses and meets the client’s marketing strategies and objectives
  • Understand and maintain understanding of client’s positions and the current marketing environment to adapt and navigate to success
  • Oversee a team to ensure quality for a final product
  • Communicate with team members in a productive manner to ensure goals are being met
  • Think strategically with understanding of assigned accounts, medical categories, and market

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:  

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.  
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.  
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.  
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.  

 

What you should have:   

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • 3+ years of healthcare advertising experience preferred
  • Experience in healthcare advertising
  • Effective oral and written communication skills
  • Computer proficiency with knowledge of design programs
  • Managerial and leadership skills and the ability to work with a team
  • Decisive problem-solving abilities
  • A comprehensive creative portfolio, demonstrating strong conceptual capabilities and ability to produce work in high-science pharma categories.
  • Launch and/or oncology experience is preferred

 

Pay Range: $95,000 - $110,000

Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. job.title: 21GRAMS- Senior Delivery Manager
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a AI-Forward Technical Delivery Manager join our growing team!

21GRAMS, Real Chemistry’s advertising agency, has been ranked the #2 creative health agency in the world by Cannes Lions. ROOM42 is 21GRAMS’ in-house production company, content studio, and Digital & Technology services arm — the team that turns briefs, Figma files, and napkin sketches into working, beautiful, compliant digital deliverables for the top pharma and biotech companies in the world.

We are looking for an AI-Forward Technical Delivery Manager (TDM) to run technical delivery across the full ROOM42 output spectrum — marketing websites, microsites, emails (including Veeva rep-triggered and approved email), banners, IVAs, conference kiosks and interactive experiences — built with in-house developers and specialist vendor partners. This is the person who owns whether the right work gets to the right build team, whether the estimate is real, whether it ships to spec and on time, and who is increasingly using AI to make all of that faster and more consistent. The project manager and account teams own the client relationship and the date. The TDM owns whether that date is achievable and gets the work built — qualifying intake, routing to the right build team, running the review-and-QA lifecycle, holding vendors to standard, and applying AI where it creates genuine delivery leverage, not novelty.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you’ll do:

Intake & Technical Qualification

  • Triage incoming requests from Workfront and Jira; assign deliverable type, complexity tier, and dependency flags (Veeva, MLR, client restrictions) within a defined SLA.
  • Return incomplete requests rather than absorbing them — no handoff to build without specs, assets, link matrix, CTAs/UTMs, and a real level-of-effort estimate.
  • Own or validate the estimate before any build commitment, using ROOM42’s estimation tooling and rate card. 

Build Team Routing & Vendor Management

  • Decide in-house vs. vendor partner per project against MSA offshore rules, client restrictions, Veeva dependency, and capacity — and escalate routing decisions that carry cost or transition implications.
  • Run day-to-day vendor delivery: standing syncs, staging-date accountability, cap-burn visibility against SOW, and knowledge-transfer documentation during vendor transitions.
  • Escalate quality issues to the vendor lead and commercial issues to the Digital & Technology leadership.

Technical Delivery Lifecycle

  • Own delivery from kickoff through post-launch: dev kickoff, staging links, review-round sequencing (R1/R2/R3), MLR/PRC submission readiness, QA gate, and go-live.
  • Maintain a live view of technical progress across a concurrent portfolio; proactively flag risks to Producers and Delivery leadership before they surface in status calls.
  • Drive milestone gates with QA — confirm that what moves from development to QA to UAT to production is actually ready, not optimistically ready.
  • Manage technical dependencies across concurrent projects (shared environments, overlapping timelines, licensing, PDUFA-anchored dates) and surface conflicts before they collide.

AI-Augmented Delivery

  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate the delivery workflow — status synthesis, ticket hygiene, QA support, specification drafting, and documentation — not as novelties but as real accelerators.
  • Partner on ROOM42’s AI-augmented QA and design-to-code workflows (visual regression, accessibility scanning, Figma-to-code handoff) so quality is structural and repeatable across deliverable types.
  • Help define and document AI-assisted delivery playbooks per deliverable type so the approach scales beyond a single practitioner, and evaluate emerging tooling for genuine leverage.
  • Apply judgment to AI output — know where AI-assisted work needs human review before it reaches a client, and keep quality from degrading as volume scales.

Quality, Standards & Portfolio Hygiene

  • Define ‘done’ for each deliverable type with the technical lead and QA — not just ‘it works,’ but performant, accessible, cross-browser validated, MLR-clean, and visually faithful to approved design.
  • Own quality accountability for your portfolio: if something ships broken or fails an MLR technical review, own the root cause and the remediation.
  • Enforce Jira/Workfront field discipline and status accuracy so the portfolio is legible to leadership and reporting is reliable.
  • Lead post-launch reviews on major engagements; translate defect patterns into upstream process improvements.

Partnership & Communication

  • Serve as the technical delivery counterpart to Producers, account teams, UX/UI, developers, and QA — translating between them without jargon.
  • Partner with Producers on SOW scoping: turn creative and functional requirements into accurate hours, stack decisions, and phased rollout plans.
  • Participate in client-facing conversations where technical delivery credibility matters — scoping sessions, risk discussions, and demo walkthroughs.

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

What you should have:

  • Hands-on AI implementation experience in a real delivery context — you have built or stood up AI-assisted workflows that shipped, not just experimented with tools. This means applying AI to concrete delivery problems (specification drafting, estimation, ticket and status synthesis, QA support, documentation, triage classification, deployment), measuring whether it actually saved time, and exercising judgment over the output before it reaches a client.
  • Daily, practical fluency with AI build and delivery tooling — GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Figma-to-code integrations, AI-assisted QA — and the discernment to tell genuine leverage from hype and to catch where AI output degrades quality at scale.
  • 5+ years of digital project or technical delivery management in an agency or production environment, running concurrent digital builds from intake through launch.
  • Hands-on experience delivering across web (WordPress and/or Drupal), email, and banners; exposure to IVAs, Veeva, or interactive experiences a strong plus.
  • Pharma, healthcare, or other regulated-delivery experience — familiarity with MLR/PRC review cycles, compliance gates, and fixed regulatory launch dates.
  • Vendor and cross-functional coordination: routing work, holding external partners to standard, and managing offshore/nearshore delivery.
  • Fluency in delivery tooling: Jira, Workfront or comparable, and a working understanding of QA, staging/UAT/production flow, and design-to-code handoff.
  • Enough technical literacy to hold a credible build conversation with developers and vendors, scope realistically, and know when to pull in the technical lead — without needing to write production code.

Nice to have

  • Experience defining and documenting AI-augmented delivery playbooks so the approach scales beyond a single practitioner across a team or vendor pod.
  • Hands-on work with agentic tooling — MCP servers, AI browser agents, or generative UI frameworks — and a point of view on where each creates real delivery leverage.
  • Built AI-assisted QA automation in production: visual regression, accessibility scanning, or AI-generated test coverage.
  • Veeva certification (approved email and/or IVA).
  • Experience standing up delivery processes, studios, or standards from the ground up.

Pay Range: $95,000-$100,000

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Editor—21GRAMS to join our growing team!

21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, is a full-service healthcare advertising agency built on the belief that healthcare should feel more human. We combine bold creativity, strategic rigor, and deep scientific understanding to create work that changes behavior, improves outcomes, and makes a meaningful impact on people's lives. Our culture is grounded in collaboration, curiosity, and a shared commitment to doing exceptional work. We believe in being good to each other while pushing ourselves to deliver ideas that move audiences, brands, and healthcare forward.

The Senior Editor maintains quality control of agency deliverables during all stages and is a liaison for the Editorial Department to other colleagues to own and reinforce established standard operating procedures. Grows professional relationships with internal brand team members and works collaboratively to ensure best practices. Performs all functions necessary to keep workflow running smoothly and able to maintain a good level of quality control even with crunched timelines.

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.

What you’ll do:

  • Establishes solid working relationships internally and with internal brand team accounts to which they are assigned; proactively and collaboratively engages with Copy, Medical, Account, Art/Studio, and Project Management teams to provide support

  • Is the lead editor for 1 or more accounts

  • Raises a red flag with brand teams and/or senior managers when timelines are too tight, additional resources are needed, or when there is a disruption to normal workflow, among other concerns

  • Maintains oversight for their own jobs to complete them on schedule whether by managing their own time or delegating promptly and responsibly to other resources
  • Supports and reinforces team and agency initiatives established by senior managers
  • Participates in team meetings and contributes to fostering a team mentality
  • Practices a positive “can do” attitude at all times
  • Mentors and trains new and/or junior employees and freelancers

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

 

What you should have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher desirable
  • 2+ years’ experience in medical advertising, medical publishing, and/or medical education, with 0+ years’ experience in medical advertising
  • Expected to be 95%+ billable
  • Advertising, marketing, business, English, or related degree preferred
  • Ability to interact with diverse internal population (e.g., account, creatives, project management)
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and some Excel) and Adobe, and familiarity with digital routing/commenting platforms, spell-check/auto compare programs
  • Ability to comprehend scientific content and data to ensure accuracy of all claims made by agency or its clients

job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Technology Lead to join our growing team!   

21GRAMS, Real Chemistry’s advertising agency, has done a lot in its first 5+ years. Known for our creativity, we've just been ranked as the #2 creative health agency in the world by Cannes Lions. It takes a team to do ambitious things, and our ambition is to help people connect with healthcare – by making advertising less of an interruption and more worth people’s time because it gets them. As an agency with the full capabilities of Real Chemistry at our fingertips, we’ve got endless potential.   

At ROOM42 — 21GRAMS' in-house production company, content studio, and Digital & Technology services arm — we are seeking an AI-Forward Technical Lead who is simultaneously a craftsperson, a creative partner, and an accelerator. This person moves fluidly between writing production-quality code, protecting design intent through every build decision, and orchestrating AI tooling to compress the distance from concept to shipped experience. Whether the starting point is a client brief, a Figma file, or a napkin sketch, this Technical Lead is the person who figures out the fastest, most technically sound path to a working, beautiful, compliant deliverable — and builds it. 

This role spans the full ROOM42 output spectrum: marketing websites, microsites, conference kiosks and panel experiences, interactive apps, and data-driven digital tools for healthcare and pharma clients. The ideal candidate has mastered the traditional web development lifecycle and is actively transforming it — using AI at every meaningful stage. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. 

 

What you’ll do:  

Build and Architect 

  • Own end-to-end technical execution for ROOM42 deliverables — websites, microsites, interactive apps, conference kiosk and panel experiences, and real-world evidence platforms 

  • Write and review production-quality code across the full stack; maintain a target of 50% direct hands-on contribution alongside leadership responsibilities 

  • Architect solutions that balance speed-to-market with long-term maintainability, security, and accessibility compliance 

  • Lead technical solutioning on new engagements — translating UX wireframes and creative briefs into clearly scoped, achievable builds 

DevOps and Delivery Infrastructure: 

  • Own Git workflows, branching strategy, and code review standards across all active ROOM42 builds 

  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines for ROOM42's primary hosting environments (WP Engine, Pantheon, Acquia, Netlify/Vercel for JAMstack); make deployments repeatable and low-risk 

  • Manage staging, UAT, and production environment configurations; provision and document access for all ROOM42 developers 

  • Identify and implement automation opportunities across the DevOps lifecycle — from scaffolding new projects to post-deploy validation 

 

AI-Augmented Design-to-Code Pipeline: 

  • Operate Figma MCP server integration to accelerate design handoff — extracting tokens, components, and layout specs directly into code-ready outputs; eliminating manual interpretation cycles 

  • Leverage AI code generation tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor AI) as daily build accelerators — not novelties — across front-end, back-end, and configuration work 

  • Define and document ROOM42's AI-augmented build workflows for each deliverable type so the approach scales beyond a single practitioner 

  • Stay ahead of emerging agentic tooling (MCP servers, AI browser agents, generative UI frameworks) and evaluate when adoption creates genuine delivery leverage 

 

QA and Test Automation: 

  • Implement AI-assisted QA automation across ROOM42 project types — visual regression testing, accessibility scanning, cross-browser checks, and functional testing pipelines 

  • Establish a QA automation baseline for repeatable deliverable types (CMS sites, kiosk apps, email builds) so that human QA effort concentrates on edge cases and client-specific requirements 

  • Triage technical defects surfaced by QA — classify root cause, assign or resolve remediation, verify fix integrity before re-advancing to UAT  

Standards, Mentorship, and Team Health: 

  • Define and maintain ROOM42's technical standards across deliverable types — coding conventions, repo structure, accessibility requirements, security baselines, deployment protocols 

  •  Conduct code reviews for all ROOM42 developers before deliverables advance to QA; enforce standards consistently and use reviews as teaching moments 

  • Partner with RC's VP of Technology on standards alignment, tooling strategy, and team architecture as the practice scales 

  • Lead technical onboarding for new ROOM42 hires — tool access, standards orientation, and first-week productivity within two weeks of start date 

  • Serve as primary technical escalation point when blockers threaten delivery; resolve environment, integration, and access issues within 24 hours of identification 

 

Technical Delivery: 

  • Partner with Producers and TDMs on SOW scoping — translate creative and functional requirements into accurate technical estimates for hours, stack decisions, and phased rollout 

  • Own the technical delivery lifecycle for key ROOM42 engagement from kickoff through post-launch, work with technical delivery managers to ensure timeline integrity, milestone readiness, and handoff completeness 

  • Maintain a live view of technical progress across all active projects; proactively flag risks to Delivery Managers before they surface in status calls 

  • Drive milestone gates: work closely with QA lead to ensure that what moves from development to QA to UAT to production is actually ready — not optimistically ready 

  • Manage technical dependencies across concurrent projects (shared environments, overlapping APIs, licensing constraints) and surface conflicts before they collide 

  • Own technical documentation throughout each engagement: architecture decisions, environment setup, API integration specs, deployment runbooks — so no knowledge lives only in one person's head 

  • Participate in client-facing conversations where technical credibility matters — scoping sessions, risk discussions, demo walkthroughs — presenting clearly and without jargon 

 

Quality Outcomes: 

  • Define 'done' for every deliverable type — not just 'it works' but that it is performant, accessible, secure, cross-browser validated, and visually faithful to approved design 

  • Own quality accountability end-to-end: if something ships broken, looks wrong, or fails an MLR technical review, this role is accountable for the root cause and the remediation 

  • Work with QA lead to establish and maintain a ROOM42 quality checklist for each deliverable type — covering functional, visual, performance, accessibility, and security checks — so quality is structural, not ad hoc 

  • Review developer output not only for code correctness but for UX implementation fidelity: does the built experience actually look and behave like the approved design? 

  • Lead post-launch quality reviews on major engagements; document defect patterns and translate them into upstream process improvements 

  • Champion performance as a quality dimension: page load, animation smoothness, kiosk responsiveness, and interactive load times are quality metrics, not afterthoughts 

  • Maintain zero tolerance for preventable defects reaching client UAT — own the internal quality bar so clients aren't the ones finding the obvious problems 

 

Design Eye, UX/UI Partnership, and Creative Collaboration: 

  • Speak UX fluently — understand information architecture, user flows, interaction patterns, and content hierarchy well enough to actively contribute to UX decisions, not just receive them 

  • Evaluate wireframes and prototypes through both a user experience lens and a technical feasibility lens simultaneously: identify where a flow creates friction before it's built, and where a design pattern creates technical debt before it ships 

  • Read a Figma file not just for spec values but for design intent — understand what the designer was solving for and protect that intent through every build decision, especially when specs have gaps or edge cases aren't covered 

  • Catch UX implementation drift before QA does: spot when a multi-step interaction is off-sequence, a loading state is missing, an error condition is unhandled, or a mobile breakpoint breaks the intended user journey 

  • Catch visual implementation drift with the same discipline: notice when padding is off, a typeface is rendering incorrectly, a hover state feels wrong, or a component is pixel-perfect in isolation but contextually broken in the live layout 

  • Participating actively in UX and design reviews as a technical partner — able to say 'that interaction pattern will feel laggy on kiosk hardware' or 'here's how we can get the same UX outcome with a lighter implementation' or 'this flow needs an empty state that the design doesn't account for' 

  • Understand foundational UX/UI principles — user task flow design, progressive disclosure, feedback and affordance, responsive and adaptive layout, motion and timing — well enough to make confident decisions when the design file doesn't cover every scenario 

  • Bridge the gap between design and engineering vocabulary; translate UX intent and creative direction into precise technical implementation notes that developers can execute without ambiguity or interpretation risk 

  • Push back constructively when a UX or design spec is technically infeasible at the required timeline or budget — and always bring an alternative that preserves the experience intent, not just a 'no' 

  • Appreciate that in healthcare and pharma, the human story being told is someone's life — and that the quality of the experience we build, how it feels to use, how clearly it communicates, how gracefully it handles errors, is not separate from the mission 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:  

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.  

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.  

  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.  

  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.  

 

What you should have:   

  • 7+ years of hands-on development experience, with at least 3 years in a technical lead, staff engineer, or architect role 

  • Demonstrable full-stack proficiency — not a generalist who dabbles; someone who can build, review, and unblock at every layer 

  • A genuine design eye with UX/UI depth: able to evaluate user flows and interaction patterns for experience quality, read a Figma file for intent, catch UX and visual implementation drift, and make confident decisions at the design-code boundary without designer supervision 

  • Technical delivery experience: has owned milestone tracking, risk communication, and deployment readiness across concurrent projects — not just individual coding output 

  • Demonstrated accountability for quality outcomes: has owned defect triage, post-launch quality reviews, and upstream process improvements when things go wrong 

  • Active, daily practitioner of AI code generation tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Claude Code) — able to define team-wide workflows around them 

  • Hands-on experience with Figma MCP server or comparable design-to-code AI tooling; familiar with design token standards and component handoff patterns 

  • QA automation experience: visual regression, accessibility automation, or AI-assisted test generation in a production environment 

  

Pay Range: $119,000 - $140,000
This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

Job Summary: 

Real Chemistry is looking for a VP, Medical Strategy Director, join our growing team! 

21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, is a full-service healthcare advertising agency built on the belief that healthcare should feel more human. We combine bold creativity, strategic rigor, and deep scientific understanding to create work that changes behavior, improves outcomes, and makes a meaningful impact on people's lives. Our culture is grounded in collaboration, curiosity, and a shared commitment to doing exceptional work. We believe in being good to each other while pushing ourselves to deliver ideas that move audiences, brands, and healthcare forward. 

This is a role for someone who loves science but doesn't stop there. Someone who can connect clinical evidence to human insight. Someone who can challenge thinking, shape strategy, inspire creative teams, and earn the trust of clients. You'll serve as a senior strategic leader across brands and therapeutic areas, helping transform complex science into meaningful, actionable ideas that drive behavior change.  

You'll partner closely with Strategy, Creative, Account, Medical, and Activation teams to ensure the work is not only accurate—but unforgettable.  

Reports To: Head of Medical Strategy 

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN. 

What You'll Do: 

  • A SCIENTIFIC STORYTELLER You turn data into direction and evidence into inspiration. You help teams uncover the strategic implications hidden within the science and ensure every idea is grounded in a compelling medical truth.  
  • A STRATEGIC LEADER You lead medical strategy across brands, franchises, and new business opportunities. You define scientific narratives, identify strategic opportunities, and help shape positioning, messaging, and communication platforms.  
  • A CREATIVE PARTNER You work hand-in-hand with creative and brand strategy teams to elevate the work. You don't simply review ideas—you help make them stronger.  
  • A TRUSTED CLIENT ADVISOR You confidently engage clients as a senior strategic partner, helping them navigate complex scientific and commercial challenges while earning credibility through expertise and thoughtful counsel.  
  • A QUALITY CHAMPION You ensure scientific rigor and medical accuracy across deliverables while maintaining a sharp focus on strategic relevance and business impact.  
  • AN INSPIRING TEACHER You elevate the capabilities of those around you—mentoring junior team members, strengthening agency medical acumen, and helping clients think differently about their brands and opportunities.  
  • A NEW BUSINESS CATALYST You play an active role in pitches, workshops, and growth initiatives, bringing scientific leadership and strategic thinking that help win new business.  
  • A BUILDER You help shape the future of Medical Strategy at 21GRAMS—developing frameworks, processes, thought leadership, and capabilities that keep us ahead of where healthcare marketing is going.  

This position is a perfect fit for you if: 

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead. 
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.  
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.  
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.  

What You Should Have: 

  • Advanced scientific degree required (PharmD, PhD, MD, DO, NP, PA, or equivalent)   
  • 10+ years of experience in pharmaceutical advertising, healthcare communications, medical strategy, or related healthcare marketing environments   
  • Significant agency experience supporting pharmaceutical and biotech brands   
  • Deep understanding of promotional healthcare communications across HCP, patient, and consumer audiences   
  • Experience leading scientific and strategic discussions with senior-level clients   
  • Demonstrated success partnering with creative, strategy, and account teams to develop breakthrough work   
  • Experience contributing to new business pitches and agency growth initiatives   
  • Strong presentation, storytelling, and facilitation skills   
  • Ability to simplify complex science into clear, compelling strategic direction   
  • Experience managing, mentoring, and developing talent   

 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience in rare disease, oncology, immunology, neuroscience, infectious disease, or specialty care categories   
  • Launch experience across pre-launch, launch, and lifecycle brands   
  • Experience leading workshops, advisory boards, and KOL engagements   
  • A healthy obsession with healthcare, culture, technology, and where they're headed next   

 

Pay Range: $180,000 - $195,000

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Account Manager to join our growing team!

 

As an Account Manager, you will act as the key day-to-day client contact, managing relationships and taking responsibility for the delivery of several medium-sized projects. As a captain, you will be responsible for managing the execution of parallel ongoing projects and take an active role in coaching your junior team and ensuring projects are delivered effectively alongside the account lead.

 

 

What you’ll do:

Client delivery

  • Act as day-to-day client contact: provide regular status updates to your client; respond to client queries and share recommendations (following discussion with your account lead); manage client expectations on timelines, scope of project, etc.; take client briefs and clearly communicate to team members, implementing realistic project plans
  • Take responsibility for the day-to-day management of your account, including managing the processes of the account (including running regular internal team meetings), flow of work (review content developed by more junior team members), delegation of tasks (oversee status reports to ensure all team actions are complete) and the status of jobs across the account (not just your own)
  • Ownership of and accountability for medium-sized client projects, ensuring that projects are delivered to highest possible standards within budget and agreed timeframes
  • Actively demonstrate an understanding of your clients’ needs (building an awareness of their strategy and brand) and preferences in your interactions and the delivery of work
  • Confidently develop written content (briefing documents, etc) and gain experience reviewing junior team members’ work, ensuring content is accurate and developed to a high standard ahead of more senior review

 

Business development

  • Start to identify areas for growth (evolving existing programmes and/or additional tactics), proactively sharing new ideas with your team and client
  • Take an active role in new business, which may include undertaking and presenting research to the pitch team, or facilitating team input via brainstorms/presenting as part of the pitch team

 

Team management

  • Maintain an awareness of the professional development of more junior team members on your accounts, through regular catch ups and interactions
  • Develop your coaching, delegation and briefing (both internally and externally with suppliers) skills, and lead by example; use these approaches to upskill, develop and inspire more junior team members
  • Buddy new SAA/AM starters

 

Financial management

  • Develop a greater understanding of the account finances beyond your projects, proactively supporting your account lead with financial management including managing Salesforce opportunities, invoicing and forecasting
  • Develop accurate budgets for clients, reflecting on previous projects and gathering cost quotes
  • Manage the budget for projects that you own, feeding into your account lead as part of the broader programme finances; identify where project is going out of scope and alert your account lead with details of additional budget required
  • Input into the resourcing process by sharing with your account/medical writer lead the requirements for your projects
  • Complete your timesheets and expense claims accurately and on time and take an active role in reviewing timesheets across some of your projects

 

Agency environment

  • Participate in internal initiatives which contribute to the culture or development of the Medical Communications team, or Real Chemistry more broadly (e.g., compliance/socials/inspiration)
  • Immerse yourself in the medical communications and pharma industries, and your client companies and therapy areas: engage with every opportunity to establish an awareness of developments, innovations and trends. Look for opportunities to reflect these in your work and flag your ideas to your teams and wider team to raise your internal profile

 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

 

What you should have:

  • Relevant degree in a scientific subject
  • Highly organised with a mindfulness of deadlines, the ability to manage multiple tasks based on priorities and a strong attention to detail
  • Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration
  • Ability to mentor junior staff and delegate accordingly in order to achieve project deadlines
  • Has confidence to manage upward when required; able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met or when issues are foreseeable
  • Demonstrated strong work ethic, with a track record of following through on client requests and with high-quality deliverables on schedule and on budget
  • Ability to develop project scopes and vendor contracts
  • Excellent business communication ability, including informal/formal presentation and writing skills
  • High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment

Real Chemistry Media is a healthcare-focused media, analytics, technology, and customer engagement organization dedicated to helping life sciences brands create more meaningful customer relationships. Through integrated media, omnichannel strategy, CRM, analytics, and engagement solutions, we help clients design and activate connected experiences across the healthcare ecosystem.

The Associate Director, Client Experience (Media) leads integrated media and omnichannel planning across complex pharmaceutical and life sciences accounts. This role is responsible for translating business objectives, customer insights, and audience needs into strategic media programs that engage healthcare professionals, patients, and caregivers while driving measurable business performance.

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.

What You'll Do

  • Lead integrated planning across paid, earned, owned, and omnichannel engagement initiatives.
  • Develop strategic HCP and DTC media recommendations informed by audience insights, market conditions, and business objectives.
  • Oversee media investment strategies, channel mix recommendations, measurement frameworks, and optimization plans.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor for clients navigating evolving healthcare engagement challenges.
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration with Strategy, CRM, Analytics, Creative, and Activation teams.
  • Guide campaign performance discussions and identify opportunities for innovation and growth.
  • Manage and develop planning talent while maintaining excellence across all client deliverables.

This Position is a Perfect Fit for You If

  • You are a strategic thinker who enjoys turning complex business challenges into integrated media and customer engagement solutions.
  • You understand how media, omnichannel engagement, CRM, analytics, content, and customer experience work together to influence behavior.
  • You can comfortably advise pharmaceutical and life sciences clients on media investment decisions, audience strategy, and performance optimization.
  • You enjoy building strong client partnerships and are viewed as a trusted problem solver rather than simply a service provider.
  • You bring a point of view to discussions, supported by data, research, experience, and industry trends.
  • You are comfortable leading teams while also remaining actively involved in strategic thinking and client problem solving.
  • You enjoy mentoring others and raising the quality standard across a broader portfolio of work.
  • You are motivated by helping healthcare brands create more meaningful, measurable customer experiences.

What You Should Have

  • 8+ years of pharmaceutical, life sciences, or healthcare media experience.
  • Deep expertise across integrated media planning and omnichannel customer engagement.
  • Experience developing HCP and DTC media strategies for complex brands or therapeutic areas.
  • Strong client leadership, presentation, and storytelling abilities.
  • Demonstrated success managing multiple client relationships and teams.

Pay Range: $100,000-$115,000

Real Chemistry Media is a healthcare-focused media, analytics, technology, and customer engagement organization dedicated to helping life sciences brands create more meaningful customer relationships. Through integrated media, omnichannel strategy, CRM, analytics, and engagement solutions, we help clients design and activate connected experiences across the healthcare ecosystem.

The Associate Director, Client Experience (Media) leads integrated media and omnichannel planning across complex pharmaceutical and life sciences accounts. This role is responsible for translating business objectives, customer insights, and audience needs into strategic media programs that engage healthcare professionals, patients, and caregivers while driving measurable business performance.

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.

What You'll Do

  • Lead integrated planning across paid, earned, owned, and omnichannel engagement initiatives.
  • Develop strategic HCP and DTC media recommendations informed by audience insights, market conditions, and business objectives.
  • Oversee media investment strategies, channel mix recommendations, measurement frameworks, and optimization plans.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor for clients navigating evolving healthcare engagement challenges.
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration with Strategy, CRM, Analytics, Creative, and Activation teams.
  • Guide campaign performance discussions and identify opportunities for innovation and growth.
  • Manage and develop planning talent while maintaining excellence across all client deliverables.

This Position is a Perfect Fit for You If

  • You are a strategic thinker who enjoys turning complex business challenges into integrated media and customer engagement solutions.
  • You understand how media, omnichannel engagement, CRM, analytics, content, and customer experience work together to influence behavior.
  • You can comfortably advise pharmaceutical and life sciences clients on media investment decisions, audience strategy, and performance optimization.
  • You enjoy building strong client partnerships and are viewed as a trusted problem solver rather than simply a service provider.
  • You bring a point of view to discussions, supported by data, research, experience, and industry trends.
  • You are comfortable leading teams while also remaining actively involved in strategic thinking and client problem solving.
  • You enjoy mentoring others and raising the quality standard across a broader portfolio of work.
  • You are motivated by helping healthcare brands create more meaningful, measurable customer experiences.

What You Should Have

  • 8+ years of pharmaceutical, life sciences, or healthcare media experience.
  • Deep expertise across integrated media planning and omnichannel customer engagement.
  • Experience developing HCP and DTC media strategies for complex brands or therapeutic areas.
  • Strong client leadership, presentation, and storytelling abilities.
  • Demonstrated success managing multiple client relationships and teams.

job.description:
