Real Chemistry Media is a fully integrated media, analytics, technology, and customer engagement organization that helps healthcare brands create meaningful, measurable connections with their audiences. The Omnichannel Strategy team sits at the center of this ecosystem, partnering closely with Media, Analytics, CRM, Engagement, Creative, Technology, and Client Services teams to design customer-centric experiences that align business objectives, audience needs, and channel activation. Our strategists help clients move beyond channel planning to deliver coordinated engagement across the full customer journey. 

The Associate Director, Omnichannel & Media Strategy will lead the development of omnichannel engagement strategies for assigned brands, products, and business challenges, grounded in a strong understanding of media strategy and how paid media connects across the broader customer experience. This role translates audience insights, customer needs, media behaviors, market dynamics, and business objectives into actionable journey architectures, media and channel strategies, and engagement plans that drive measurable outcomes.   As a strategic leader, you will guide audience segmentation, customer journey development, media and channel planning, engagement strategy, and orchestration design while serving as a trusted strategic partner to clients and internal teams. You will collaborate across Media, Analytics, CRM, Creative, Engagement, and Client Services to create integrated experiences that connect customer needs with business goals.

What you’ll do 

  • Architect omnichannel engagement strategies with media strategy at the core, connecting paid media with owned, earned, CRM, field, and digital channels.
  • Lead audience segmentation, persona development and customer prioritization across healthcare professional, patient, caregiver and other relevant audiences. 
  • Design end-to-end customer journeys that identify audience needs, barriers, behaviors, triggers and engagement opportunities. 
  • Develop media and channel orchestration frameworks that define the role of paid media and connect it effectively across owned, earned, field, CRM, and digital touchpoints.
  • Lead client and internal workshops focused on audience strategy, journey design and engagement planning. 
  • Define measurement frameworks, testing plans and strategic requirements for CRM, analytics and engagement platforms. 
  • Translate client needs, market research, media and campaign performance, and audience insights into clear strategic recommendations for cross-functional teams.
  • Oversee supporting strategists, delegate work and review deliverables for strategic quality and consistency. 
  • Contribute to scoping conversations and manage multiple client workstreams to established timelines and utilization expectations. 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if 

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines. 

What you should have 

  • Demonstrated experience developing media strategy, ideally within healthcare, pharmaceutical marketing, or another highly regulated or complex industry.
  • Strong understanding of paid media strategy and how channels such as paid search, paid social, programmatic, video, and other digital media work together within an omnichannel ecosystem.
  • Experience leading client workshops, strategic planning sessions or collaborative working sessions.
  • Strong understanding of how paid media connects with owned channels, CRM, field engagement, content and digital experiences.
  • Ability to translate research, data, media performance and campaign results into strategic recommendations. 
  • Experience overseeing junior strategists and providing feedback, training or quality review.
  • Strong client communication, presentation development and facilitation skills. 

 

Pay Range: $90,000-$115,000

job.description:

Real Chemistry is looking for an Associate Director, Social Media to join our growing Activation team. This is role for someone who is ready to help manage high-quality social programs, develop smart content and keep complex work moving across healthcare clients. 

For us, social isn’t just a channel — it’s a craft. Our team brings together healthcare knowledge, creative thinking, content development, paid media awareness and strong execution to help clients show up with purpose across platforms. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—New York City, Boston, Chicago, San Francisco, Indianapolis, or Lambertville (NJ)—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Help lead social media programs across organic, paid, influencer and integrated workstreams, translating strategy into clear, compliant and platform-native execution. 
  • Develop and manage social content plans, editorial calendars, campaign assets, post copy, creative briefs and supporting materials in partnership with strategy, creative, paid media and account teams. 
  • Bring an integrated social and digital lens to the work, connecting day-to-day social execution to broader communications goals and client priorities.  
  • Support and, at times, lead recurring client and internal meetings, helping turn discussion, feedback and decisions into clear next steps, timelines and deliverables. 
  • Coordinate across internal teams, vendors and client stakeholders to keep social content, approvals, publishing and reporting workstreams organized and on track. 
  • Communicate recommendations, project updates and social insights in a clear, thoughtful way for clients and cross-functional partners. 
  • Use AI-enabled tools, Canva, social listening platforms and analytics dashboards to support research, brainstorms, content development, reporting and presentations. 
  • Bring a curious, responsible approach to emerging tools and social trends, while keeping healthcare accuracy, client privacy, compliance and brand standards at the center. 
  • Help guide team members by providing direction, feedback and support on content, timelines, reporting and client-ready deliverables. 
  • Contribute to social and cultural POVs, trend notes and thought starters that bring timely, relevant thinking to clients, industry and our RC teams. 
  • Support business growth through research, proposal inputs, client development materials and strong day-to-day relationship management. 

This position is a perfect fit for you if: 

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead. 
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.  
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.  
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact. 

What you should have:  

  • 5–8 years of social media, digital marketing or integrated communications experience, ideally in healthcare, biotech, pharma or another regulated industry. 
  • Agency or client-service experience, with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities and stakeholders at once. 
  • Experience coordinating social content development, review processes, calendars, campaign materials and client-ready deliverables. 
  • Experience guiding or mentoring team members 
  • Comfort balancing hands-on social work with project coordination, client communication, team support and new business or organic growth needs. 
  • College degree required; BA or equivalent preferred; understanding of FDA, fair balance, adverse event and client review considerations preferred. 
  • Strong social media judgment, including the ability to develop content plans, post copy, briefs, recommendations and executional materials that align to strategy. 
  • Understanding of major social platforms, audience behavior, platform-native content best practices and the role of social within broader healthcare communications. 
  • Ability to contribute to channel recommendations, paid social approaches, influencer considerations, content calendars and social media reports that tell a clear story. 
  • Comfort with social publishing, listening, analytics, paid social and AI-enabled tools, including platforms such as Meta Business Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Sprinklr, Sprout Social, Brandwatch, Microsoft Office and Canva. 
  • Strong writing, organization and communication skills, with the ability to synthesize inputs, shape clear copy and serve as a dependable social media partner to clients and internal colleagues. 

 

Pay Range: $90,000 - $115,000

This role combines client leadership, commercial strategy, team development, and operational oversight while serving as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders and a key leader within the Medical capability.

Scientific Visualization (RadScience), a specialized team within Real Chemistry's Medical capability, combines scientific expertise, creativity, and innovation to transform complex science into compelling visual stories and experiences. Our multidisciplinary team of artists, animators, designers, PhDs, and MDs develops scientific illustrations, animations, interactive experiences, congress activations, and educational solutions that help pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies communicate science with clarity and impact.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—New York City, Boston, Chicago, San Francisco, Indianapolis (IN), or Lambertville (NJ)—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. We are also open to remote applicants in Canada. This role requires working eastern US hours.

What you’ll do: 

Client Leadership & Strategy

  • Serve as a senior strategic partner to pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients
  • Lead complex engagements across scientific visualization, medical education, congress strategy, digital experiences, and innovation initiatives
  • Anticipate client needs, identify solutions, and drive long-term account growth
  • Partner closely with Scientific Strategy, Creative, Medical, Experience Design, and Project Management teams to deliver exceptional client outcomes

Business Growth

  • Develop and execute account growth strategies across assigned clients
  • Identify opportunities to expand relationships and introduce new capabilities
  • Lead and support new business opportunities, pitches, proposals, and SOW development
  • Contribute to the continued growth and positioning of the Scientific Visualization practice

Financial Management

  • Own account performance, forecasting, profitability, and resource planning
  • Partner with finance and operations teams to manage budgets, scope changes, and revenue goals
  • Ensure delivery of profitable and sustainable client engagements

People Leadership

  • Build and scale a strong leadership bench through effective coaching, succession planning, performance management, and career development initiatives
  • Create and implement team development strategies that strengthen client service capabilities, business acumen, communication skills, and leadership competencies across all levels
  • Partner with department and practice leaders to identify organizational capability gaps and develop targeted talent and skill-building plans

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate across Real Chemistry's Medical capability and broader organization to deliver integrated client solutions
  • Champion innovative approaches, emerging technologies, and AI-enabled ways of working
  • Serve as an ambassador for the Scientific Visualization practice internally and externally

This position is a perfect fit for you if: 

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you
  • You are passionate about transforming complex science into engaging experiences and communications
  • You thrive in a collaborative, matrixed, and fast-paced agency environment
  • You enjoy building client partnerships and growing businesses
  • You are a strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen and executive presence
  • You embrace innovation, AI, and evolving technologies

What you should have:  

  • 10+ years of experience (AVP) or 12+ years of experience (VP) within healthcare communications, medical education, scientific communications, scientific visualization, healthcare marketing, or related agency environments
  • Demonstrated success leading and growing pharmaceutical and biotechnology client relationships
  • Experience managing large accounts, complex programs, and multidisciplinary teams
  • Strong business development skills with a track record of driving organic growth and contributing to new business wins
  • Familiarity with scientific visualization, medical communications, medical affairs, congress strategy, and digital engagement programs
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, relationship-building, and leadership skills

VP: $190,000 - $205,000

Real Chemistry is seeking a Director, Client Media Solutions to join our growing team!

The Director, Client Media Solutions is a strategic leader responsible for developing audience-first media strategies across a portfolio of healthcare clients. This individual partners closely with internal teams and client stakeholders to deliver integrated planning, investment recommendations, and measurement approaches that support business objectives and drive performance.

The Director plays a key role in translating audience insights, market dynamics, and performance data into actionable media plans. They collaborate across Client Experience, Activation, Analytics, Creative, and Strategy teams to ensure alignment and consistency in planning. This role also contributes to strengthening planning processes, supporting team development, and advancing media capabilities across the organization.

This is a hybrid role based in any of our U.S. offices, including New York, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or Lambertville, or working remotely within the U.S., depending on team and business needs.

 

What You’ll Do

Media Strategy & Planning

  • Lead the development of media strategies and integrated plans across assigned healthcare clients, ensuring alignment to business goals and audience needs
  • Support annual planning, campaign launches, investment allocation, and channel strategy development
  • Translate audience insights, competitive landscape, and performance data into clear planning recommendations
  • Execute audience-first omnichannel strategies across HCP, patient, caregiver, and consumer audiences
  • Identify and recommend emerging media opportunities and innovations that enhance campaign effectiveness

Client Management

  • Serve as a day-to-day strategic partner to client stakeholders, supporting ongoing planning and optimization conversations
  • Present media plans, performance updates, and recommendations with clarity and confidence
  • Build strong client relationships through reliable delivery, proactive communication, and problem solving
  • Partner with account leadership to support organic growth opportunities within existing clients

Planning & Measurement

  • Apply established planning frameworks and best practices across assigned accounts
  • Support budget allocation, KPI development, and channel prioritization to drive results
  • Partner with Analytics to implement measurement plans and translate performance into actionable insights
  • Contribute to a test-and-learn approach that drives continuous optimization

Team Leadership & Collaboration

  • Manage and mentor Managers and Associate Directors, providing guidance on planning execution and career development
  • Provide day-to-day direction and oversight across projects and deliverables
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure integrated delivery
  • Contribute to a positive, accountable, and high-performing team environment

Business Support

  • Support new business efforts through plan development, insights gathering, and pitch participation
  • Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, process improvement, and media capability development

This Role May Be a Good Fit If You Are

  • A strategic thinker who balances data with practicality
  • A strong executor who can turn strategy into actionable plans
  • A collaborative partner who builds trust with clients and colleagues
  • Organized and solutions-oriented, with attention to detail
  • Adaptable and comfortable navigating change
  • Motivated by Real Chemistry’s values: Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an “I”

What You’ll Bring

  • Minimum 8 years of media strategy and planning experience, with healthcare, pharma, biotech, or regulated industry experience preferred
  • 2–4 years of team management experience with a track record of developing talent
  • Strong foundation in omnichannel media planning, audience strategy, and integrated communications
  • Understanding of healthcare media landscapes across HCP and consumer audiences
  • Experience developing media plans tied to performance metrics and business outcomes
  • Ability to interpret data and translate insights into actionable recommendations
  • Comfortable presenting to clients and contributing to strategic discussions
  • Working knowledge of media measurement, attribution, and campaign performance analysis
  • Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work across cross-functional teams
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Director, Real World Data to join our growing team!

At Real Chemistry we’re powering cross-functional teams with real-world data and advanced analytics to drive results for cross-functional teams throughout the lifecycle. Anchored by a rich longitudinal patient database, combined with market leading ML capabilities, Real Chemistry is laser focused on the transformation of data into actionable insights and commercialization strategies.

The Director has a multi-faceted role, with a primary responsibility for exceptional client delivery and strong client relationships. The Director also plays an active role in the sales process, communicating the value of Real Chemistry and uniquely identifying solutions to clients’ business problems. Therefore, this role will straddle both sales and delivery, and provide a critical linkage between the two functions. Given the wide range of the Director's responsibilities, a seasoned understanding of the evolving pharmaceutical market (precision medicine, omnichannel data analytics, patient level data integration, etc.), strong client-facing communication skills/language, and experience working with or at agencies are critical to success.

Travel within the region is estimated at 20%.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

 

What you’ll do:

Delivery

The Director will lead multiple, parallel consulting engagements leveraging health claims data to address client needs. The role will encompass both external, client-facing and internal project leadership responsibilities. The delivery role will involve solutioning for internal Real Chemistry teams as well as external clients, and the clear and detailed translation of sold engagements to the operations team for analysis, while simultaneously managing ongoing project delivery. The Director maintains proactive and consistent communication across client and delivery teams. Responsibilities to include:

  • Understand the agency environment to design and develop strategies, methodologies, and solutions to support advertising, communications, medical, media, and commercially-focused clients.
  • Facilitate and manage all project communication needs, including client-facing communications and internal communications
  • Act as single point of contact with the following parties: Managing Principal, Client, Sales Lead, and Operations team (ongoing and consistent communication with all parties critical for delivery success)
  • Create and maintain delivery timelines in conjunction with client and internal teams
  • Maintain appropriate scope for ongoing client engagements and follow-ups, while managing a portfolio of client engagements
  • Conduct thorough quality control (QC) measures and pressure-test analysis outputs based on desk research and experiential logic
  • Derive insights and create PowerPoint stories from secondary claims data that address client needs/questions, with comfort delivering presentations to internal teams or brand/analytics teams within external organizations

Business Development

The Director also proactively identifies and qualifies leads, supporting teams across the agency to develop, assess, and solution for multiple qualified opportunities at any given time. The Director understands unique client business problems and translates solutions into sales support materials and development of sales-related presentations. Responsibilities include:

  • Cultivate relationships with existing clients and contacts within the biopharma industry, generate interest for Real Chemistry analytics offerings, and translate to sales opportunities
  • Identify client opportunities proactively, and work with Managing Principal and sales team to qualify and pursue sales leads
  • Support the Managing Principal and Sales Lead in developing sales materials for identified opportunities
  • Design and develop strategies and methodologies to deliver against client needs, and translate into compelling sales and pitch materials
  • Understand the dynamic competitive landscape and successfully position Real Chemistry in competitive selling situations
  • Assist the Managing Principal and Sales Lead in managing client relationships
  • Assist the Managing Principal and Sales Lead in identifying upselling opportunities

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

What you should have:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience using real-world data to develop and implement cross-functional solutions in large organizations
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred (MBA, MPH, PhD, PharmD, MD, MS, or equivalent) in economics, epidemiology, public health, biostatistics, health services research, business, marketing, communications, or related discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in the development of productized solutions utilizing real-world data to support advertising, communications, medical, media, and commercial clients.
  • Strong project/program leadership experience, including managing teams on complex, multi-workstream engagements and ensuring scientific and editorial quality.
  • Excellent writing, editing, and executive communication skills; ability to craft clear narratives from technical analyses.

 

Pay Range: $105,000 - $150,000

Real Chemistry is looking for a Director, Social Media to join our growing Activation team and lead smart, platform-native social work that drives meaningful impact for healthcare clients. 

For us, social isn’t just a channel — it’s a craft. Our Social Media team blends deep healthcare expertise with sharp strategy, standout content, paid media fluency and data-driven execution to help clients show up with purpose across platforms. As Director, you’ll be a day-to-day lead across multiple books of business, helping teams move from big ideas to smart execution while coaching people, guiding clients and raising the quality of the work. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—New York City, Boston, Chicago, San Francisco, Indianapolis, or Lambertville (NJ)—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What You’ll Do: 

Social Leadership, Strategy & Business Impact 

  • Lead integrated social media programs across organic, paid and influencer workstreams, translating strategy into smart, compliant, platform-native execution. 
  • Lead complex client engagements with confidence, helping teams deliver strategic, high-quality work that drives measurable impact. 
  • Bring clarity and momentum to client programs by pairing strong creative instincts, sharp copy and smart storytelling with organized, insight-led execution. 

Client Partnership, Meetings & Storytelling 

  • Serve as a trusted day-to-day client lead, running recurring, ad-hoc and planning meetings with confidence, clarity and a little spark. 
  • Connect the dots across social, paid, influencer and performance data, turning analytics into clear insights, recommendations and senior-level narratives. 
  • Stay one step ahead of client needs, bringing thoughtful solutions, clear next steps and a steady hand to help programs run smoothly from planning through execution. 

AI, Innovation & Smarter Social Operations 

  • Champion responsible AI adoption across social workflows, using tools like Microsoft Copilot, Canva, social listening platforms and analytics dashboards to improve research, ideation, content development, reporting and presentations. 
  • Help teams use AI with good judgment, keeping healthcare accuracy, client privacy, compliance and brand standards at the center. 

Business Growth & New Opportunities 

  • Partner with colleagues to identify opportunities to expand, refine or elevate social media programming across existing accounts. 
  • Contribute to growth opportunities by shaping smart social POVs, strategic recommendations and pitch-ready thinking. 

This Position is a Perfect Fit for You if: 

Mindset, Ownership & Leadership Style 

  • You’re a confident, curious social leader who loves the pace of platform change but keeps the work grounded, strategic and reputable. 
  • You can zoom out to spot patterns, connect insights to business opportunities and zoom in to make the strategy, copy, storytelling and details sharper. 
  • You enjoy coaching people, building trust with clients and living our values: Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I.” 

What Experience & Skills You Should have: 

Experience, Leadership & Healthcare Context 

  • 7–10 years of social media, digital marketing or integrated communications experience, ideally in healthcare, biotech, pharma or another regulated industry. 
  • Agency experience in a client-facing role, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, assignments and stakeholders at once. 
  • Experience leading teams, managing performance and supporting the development of direct or indirect reports. 
  • Comfort balancing hands-on client work with team leadership, internal initiatives and business development support. 
  • College degree required; BA or equivalent preferred; understanding of FDA, fair balance, adverse event and client review considerations preferred. 

Social, Paid, Influencer, Analytics & Tools 

  • Deep understanding of social platforms, audience behavior and content best practices across organic, paid and influencer-led programs. 
  • Experience building strategic plans, channel recommendations, paid social approaches and insight-led performance narratives for senior stakeholders. 
  • Fluency with social buying, publishing, listening, analytics and AI-enabled tools, including platforms such as Meta Business Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Sprinklr, Sprout Social, Brandwatch, Microsoft Office and Canva. 
  • Strong communication, organization and judgment, with the ability to synthesize inputs, shape strong copy, delegate effectively and keep work moving. 

Pay Range: $105,000 - $155,000

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Director, Technical Product Operations

Role Summary

Real Chemistry is seeking a hands-on Director, Technical Product Operations to own the end-to-end management, operation, and security of our flagship client-facing SaaS products.  These platforms are hosted in Amazon Web Services (AWS), delivered to clients as a commercial product, engineered to be SOC 2 compliant, and increasingly powered by AI-enabled features.

This is a working leadership role — not a purely strategic one. The successful candidate is a technically credible, roll-up-your-sleeves operator who has personally implemented and run a product on AWS infrastructure, and who can lead a team while remaining directly engaged in architecture, deployment, security, and production support. You will be the single point of accountability for platform availability, performance, security posture, and the fully-supported client experience.

What you'll do:

Platform Ownership & AWS Operations

  • Own the full lifecycle of the client-facing SaaS products hosted on AWS — from infrastructure design and deployment through ongoing operation, optimization, and support.
  • Architect, implement, and maintain scalable, resilient AWS environments (compute, storage, networking, databases, backups) with clear separation across development, staging, and production.
  • Lead high-availability and disaster-recovery (HA/DR) design, including backup, failover, and recovery procedures, to meet client and contractual uptime commitments.
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and controlled promotion paths between environments.
  • Own observability — metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting — and drive continuous improvement of platform performance and cost efficiency (FinOps).

Security, Compliance & SOC 2

  • Maintain and continuously mature the platform's security posture, ensuring controls are designed, implemented, evidenced, and audit-ready.
  • Own SOC 2 compliance for the platform — partnering with Information Security and external auditors to sustain Type I and progress toward Type II attestation.
  • Enforce least-privilege identity and access management (AWS IAM), encryption in transit and at rest, secrets management, and tamper-evident audit logging.
  • Coordinate third-party penetration testing, vulnerability management, and remediation within defined risk timelines.
  • Ensure client-facing security, data-handling, and confidentiality requirements are met and clearly documented for client assurance.

AI-Enabled Product Features

  • Support the secure integration and operation of AI/ML and LLM-enabled features within the product, including approved AI providers, usage boundaries, and cost guardrails.
  • Partner with engineering and data teams to productionize AI capabilities with appropriate data classification, DLP, and human-in-the-loop controls where required.

Support, Reliability & Client Experience

  • Ensure the product is fully supported — establishing SLAs, incident response playbooks, on-call coverage, and runbooks for production systems.
  • Serve as senior escalation point for platform incidents, driving rapid resolution and transparent client communication.
  • Own change management, release governance, and post-incident reviews to continuously improve reliability.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Lead, and mentor the external IT / platform engineering team, setting technical standards and delivery discipline.
  • Partner closely with Information Security, Product, and Client-facing teams to align platform capabilities with commercial and client needs.
  • Communicate platform health, risk, and roadmap clearly to both technical teams and executive / C-suite stakeholders.
  • Manage relationships with key vendors and third parties (AWS and supporting services).

Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on track record — the candidate must be a practitioner who has personally implemented and operated a product on AWS infrastructure, not solely a manager of others who do.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing a product on AWS (compute, networking, databases, IAM, IaC) from build through production operation.
  • 7+ years in IT / platform engineering / cloud operations, including 3+ years operating production workloads in AWS.
  • Prior leadership or people-management experience, ideally leading external IT, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering functions.
  • Strong working knowledge of SOC 2 (and adjacent frameworks) and the practical implementation of the underlying controls.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud security best practices (least-privilege IAM, secrets management, logging/audit).
  • Proven ownership of production reliability — SLAs, incident response, on-call, and HA/DR.
  • Excellent communication skills — equally comfortable with hands-on technical teams and C-suite stakeholders.

 

What you should have:

  • Experience delivering a client-facing / commercial SaaS product (multi-tenant, externally sold).
  • Experience productionizing AI / LLM-enabled features and governing AI usage, data handling, and cost.
  • Familiarity with regulated or enterprise-client environments (HIPAA-adjacent, GDPR, GxP).
  • Experience with containerization/orchestration (ECS/Fargate, EKS), AWS Lambda, and observability tooling.
  • Relevant certifications (AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps / Security, CISSP, CCSP).
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

 

Pay Range: $200,000-$235,000

This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time

Real Chemistry Media is a fully integrated media, analytics, technology, and customer engagement organization that helps healthcare brands create meaningful, measurable connections with healthcare professionals, patients, caregivers, and consumers. Our teams bring together media, omnichannel strategy, analytics, CRM, creative, influencer, technology, and engagement expertise to design connected customer experiences that drive business outcomes across the healthcare ecosystem. 

The Senior Group Director, Client Media Solutions is an executive portfolio leader responsible for advancing strategic innovation, client growth, and operational excellence across high-value pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and life sciences relationships. This role shapes the direction of the Client Experience function, leads enterprise-level solutions, and brings together teams and capabilities to deliver connected HCP and DTC customer experiences. 

This is a hybrid role based in any of our U.S. offices, including New York, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or Lambertville, or working remotely within the U.S., depending on team and business needs. 

What You’ll Do 

  • Set benchmarks for Client Experience Media and lead enterprise-level strategies and capabilities that advance HCP, patient, caregiver, and DTC engagement. 
  • Serve as executive sponsor across high-value client portfolios, anticipating risk, resolving complex challenges, and leading client discussions across strategy, delivery, innovation, and growth. 
  • Lead upsell, cross-sell, organic growth, and new business efforts by combining Real Chemistry’s media, analytics, CRM, technology, creative, and omnichannel capabilities into differentiated solutions. 
  • Shape the strategic direction of the function and lead cross-functional initiatives that improve delivery, operational efficiency, client satisfaction, and market visibility. 
  • Stay ahead of the competitive landscape, emerging platforms, healthcare media trends, and customer engagement innovation to bring new ideas and capabilities to clients. 
  • Oversee the financial health of a large client portfolio, including scopes of work, budgets, MSAs, revenue, margin, utilization, staffing, and commercial performance. 
  • Lead and develop a multi-matrixed organization, strengthening the leadership bench and influencing performance, engagement, and development well beyond direct reports. 
  • Partner with senior leadership, Business Operations, Finance, and people teams to align portfolio priorities, talent, investment, and resources to growth objectives. 

This Position Is a Perfect Fit for You If 

  • You enjoy shaping the future of healthcare media and customer engagement across complex client portfolios. 
  • You are comfortable serving as an executive advisor to senior pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and life sciences stakeholders. 
  • You balance strategic innovation, commercial performance, operational excellence, and people leadership. 
  • You are energized by creating new capabilities, expanding client relationships, and influencing organizational direction. 
  • You communicate a clear vision, secure alignment across diverse stakeholders, and build both immediate solutions and long-term resilience. 

What You Should Have 

  • Extensive leadership experience across media strategy, client experience, integrated marketing, or omnichannel customer engagement, including significant work with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences clients. 
  • Deep expertise across HCP, patient, caregiver, and DTC engagement, including integrated media, audience strategy, measurement, personalization, and performance optimization. 
  • Demonstrated success serving as an executive sponsor and growing high-value client portfolios through retention, organic expansion, cross-selling, and new business. 
  • Strong commercial and financial leadership experience spanning scopes of work, MSAs, budgets, revenue forecasting, margins, staffing, and portfolio economics. 
  • Proven ability to lead large, multi-matrixed teams and develop Directors, Group Directors, and other senior leaders. 
  • Executive-level presentation, negotiation, crisis management, and relationship-building skills. 
  • Experience shaping new capabilities, strategic partnerships, vendor relationships, and enterprise-level client solutions. 
  • Ability to influence organizational direction and lead effectively across Strategy, Analytics, CRM, Activation, Creative, Technology, Business Operations, and Client Experience teams.

Real Chemistry Media is a fully integrated media, analytics, technology, and customer engagement organization that helps healthcare brands create meaningful, measurable connections with their audiences. Our teams bring together media, omnichannel strategy, analytics, CRM, creative, influencer, technology, and client services capabilities to create connected customer experiences that drive business results across the healthcare ecosystem. 

The Manager, Client Media Solutions serves as a day-to-day leader responsible for the successful planning, execution, and stewardship of integrated media programs for pharma and life sciences clients. This role combines strong media planning fundamentals, financial and operational rigor, client partnership, and project leadership to ensure campaigns are delivered accurately, on time, and aligned to client objectives. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Indianapolis, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. 

What You'll Do 

  • Own media plans, flowcharts, budget summaries, project trackers, timelines, and workflow documentation across assigned accounts and brands. 
  • Execute and manage campaign work orders, service requests, deliverable rotations, approvals, and project timelines from planning through launch. 
  • Support the development of integrated media recommendations by conducting research, gathering marketplace intelligence, evaluating vendor opportunities, and managing RFP processes. 
  • Collaborate with media partners and vendors to identify direct-buy opportunities and negotiate recommendations with guidance from senior team members. 
  • Monitor campaign pacing, budget performance, and financial health, proactively identifying variances and partnering with Business Operations on invoicing, reconciliation, and reporting. 
  • Serve as a day-to-day client contact, providing project updates, meeting recaps, and ongoing communication across internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Lead campaign stewardship efforts, ensuring plans are executed accurately and align with approved client objectives and budgets. 
  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships with Analytics, Omnichannel Strategy, Activation, Creative, Influencer, CRM, and Client Services teams to deliver integrated solutions. 
  • Translate strategic direction from senior team members into accurate, high-quality deliverables and actionable recommendations. 
  • Support the development of junior team members by reviewing work, providing feedback, and helping ensure quality and process adherence. 

 

This Position is a Perfect Fit for You If 

  • Our values of Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I" genuinely reflect how you work and collaborate. 
  • You are equally comfortable discussing campaign strategy, managing details, and ensuring flawless execution. 
  • You enjoy owning projects from start to finish and can effectively balance multiple priorities across brands and clients. 
  • You are naturally organized and thrive in environments that require strong attention to detail, budget management, and project coordination. 
  • You are a proactive problem solver who can independently navigate day-to-day challenges while escalating larger strategic or commercial decisions appropriately. 
  • You enjoy building relationships with clients, partners, and cross-functional teams and are viewed as a dependable, solutions-oriented contributor. 
  • You can communicate clearly and confidently, tailoring information appropriately for internal and external audiences. 
  • You embrace new technologies, data, and AI-enabled tools that help improve planning, collaboration, and performance. 

 

What You Should Have 

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. 
  • 3-5 years of experience in media planning, media account management, client services, integrated marketing, or agency environments. 
  • Experience managing media plans, budgets, timelines, and campaign documentation across multiple stakeholders and workstreams. 
  • Strong understanding of digital media channels, including programmatic, social, search, endemic, and other paid media tactics. 
  • Experience partnering with media vendors and supporting RFP, proposal evaluation, and recommendation development processes. 
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen with experience managing budgets, pacing, invoicing, reconciliations, and reporting. 
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality work with minimal oversight. 
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills. 
  • Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and media planning tools such as Prisma, Mediaocean, Comscore, Pathmatics, Kantar, Telmar, or similar platforms. 
  • Healthcare, pharmaceutical, or life sciences marketing experience is preferred. 
  • Experience mentoring junior team members or interns is a plus. 

 

Pay Range: $60,000-$80,000

Real Chemistry is looking for a Manager, Paid Search to join our growing Biddable Media team! 

A Manager, Paid Search is responsible for the end-to-end execution, performance, and day-to-day management of paid search campaigns across assigned accounts. This individual translates client objectives into tactical campaign strategies, owns campaign optimization and budget management, identifies opportunities for account growth, and communicates performance insights and recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders. The Manager also coordinates day-to-day projects and begins developing leadership skills by delegating work, overseeing campaign execution, and mentoring junior team members. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—New York City, Boston, Chicago, San Francisco, Indianapolis, or Lambertville (NJ)—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What You'll Do 

  • Own the day-to-day execution and performance of paid search campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and supporting search technologies, from planning and setup through launch, optimization, and reporting. 
  • Develop tactical paid search strategies aligned with client objectives, audience strategies, KPIs, and broader integrated media plans. Contribute to campaign forecasts, planning inputs, and supporting data analysis. 
  • Oversee flawless campaign launches, including campaign setup, trafficking, quality assurance, tracking, tagging, and delivery requirements. 
  • Own campaign pacing, budget management, and ongoing optimization, monitoring real-time performance and making data-driven adjustments to meet client KPIs and improve account performance. 
  • Track campaign spend, maintain accurate budget forecasts, and actualize budgets monthly while proactively identifying and communicating pacing or delivery risks. 
  • Troubleshoot platform, tracking, attribution, trafficking, and reporting issues using strong platform expertise and analytical problem-solving skills. 
  • Translate campaign data into clear performance narratives, actionable insights, and optimization recommendations that connect results to client objectives. 
  • Proactively identify and recommend account evolutions, testing opportunities, and platform innovations that improve campaign effectiveness and support account growth. 
  • Communicate account status, campaign performance, and recommendations directly to clients and vendors; participate actively in client meetings and lead day-to-day discussions with support from senior leadership as appropriate. 
  • Develop paid search strategies, performance recommendations, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Coordinate day-to-day account projects and collaborate with Integrated Media, Analytics, Strategy, Ad Operations, Creative, and Client Experience teams to deliver campaign objectives and manage cross-functional dependencies. 
  • Delegate and oversee campaign responsibilities assigned to Associates and Senior Associates, breaking down projects into manageable tasks and ensuring deliverables are accurate and timely. 
  • Mentor and train junior team members on platform execution, campaign processes, and best practices while continuing to develop people leadership capabilities. 
  • Contribute to process improvements, documentation, training materials, automation initiatives, and emerging platform capabilities that strengthen team efficiency and performance. 

This Position Is a Perfect Fit for You If  

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead. 
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.  
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.  
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact. 

What You Should Have  

  • 3+ years of professional experience managing digital media campaigns, with significant hands-on experience in paid search. 
  • Strong expertise in Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and paid search campaign management. 
  • Experience managing campaigns end to end, including planning, setup, launch, optimization, reporting, and performance analysis. 
  • Strong understanding of bidding strategies, keyword management, audience targeting, attribution, conversion optimization, and campaign measurement. 
  • Demonstrated ability to monitor campaign performance, manage budgets and pacing, and optimize toward established KPIs. 
  • Experience developing forecasts, tracking spend, and maintaining accurate monthly budget actualization. 
  • Ability to troubleshoot platform, tracking, tagging, attribution, and reporting issues. 
  • Experience translating campaign data into meaningful insights, performance narratives, and optimization recommendations. 
  • Strong client communication, presentation, analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills. 
  • Demonstrated project-management, organizational, and prioritization capabilities, including coordinating deliverables across multiple accounts and teams. 
  • Experience delegating tasks, overseeing campaign workstreams, or mentoring and training junior team members. 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and relevant reporting and analytics platforms. 
  • Experience with bid management, analytics, and attribution tools is preferred. 
  • Pharmaceutical and healthcare marketing experience is preferred but not required.

     

Pay Range: $60,000-$80,000

job.title: Measurement Data & Analytics
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Role Overview

The Measurement Data & Analytics role serves as a key member of the Measurement Enablement team, responsible for ensuring client healthcare marketing data is accurate, current, and ready for reporting and analysis. This role bridges the gap between Data Engineering, analytics teams, and client stakeholders by managing data ingestion processes, validating data quality, maintaining reporting-ready data structures, and resolving issues throughout the data lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating data questions, identifying root causes of data discrepancies, improving data quality, and working across multiple teams to ensure reliable data powers business decisions. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—New York City, Boston, Chicago, San Francisco, Indianapolis, or Lambertville (NJ)—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

Primary Responsibilities 

Data Ingestion & Source Management 

  • Coordinate the onboarding of new client data sources and data feeds.  
  • Partner with Data Engineering to ensure successful ingestion of data into Databricks.  
  • Monitor data delivery schedules and ingestion processes.  
  • Maintain source documentation, field mappings, and data inventories.  
  • Work directly with internal teams and external partners to resolve source-related issues. 

Data Quality & Stewardship 

  • Monitor data freshness, completeness, and accuracy across client datasets.  
  • Perform ongoing quality assurance and reconciliation checks.  
  • Investigate missing, unexpected, or inconsistent data.  
  • Escalate, coordinate and resolve remediation efforts with the appropriate teams.  
  • Maintain documentation of data quality findings and resolutions.  
  • Support the development of automated data quality checks and monitoring processes. 

Data Modeling 

  • Develop and maintain client-specific standard, custom, and master tables and reporting views within Databricks based on a medallion architecture.  
  • Assist with transforming and standardizing data from multiple sources into reporting-ready structures. 
  • Solve problems and help build solutions related to the data model to meet evolving reporting and analysis needs. 
  • Document business rules, transformation logic, and metric definitions.  
  • Support maintenance of reusable reporting datasets and standardized data models. 

Stakeholder Support 

  • Act as the primary point of contact for routine data-related questions.  
  • Partner with Client Services, Media, Strategy, and Data teams to align on data outputs and expectations. 
  • Work with analysts and measurement leads to understand reporting requirements, translate into technical requirements, and provide database-modeled data for reporting.  
  • Communicate data issues, impacts, and resolutions to stakeholders.  
  • Assist with troubleshooting data discrepancies impacting reporting deliverables. 

Reporting Support 

  • Support Power BI developers and business analysts with data-related questions.  
  • Assist with report validation and troubleshooting.  
  • Help verify data displayed in dashboards aligns with source systems and business requirements.  
  • Provide support for semantic models and reporting datasets when needed. 

Qualifications

  • Strong SQL and Python skills, in a Databricks environment preferrable. 
  • Experience using ETL tools and data manipulation concepts (Funnel.io, DBT, or similar applications). 
  • Comfort partnering with Data Engineering on data sources, schemas, and refresh logic. 
  • Deep analytical and problem-solving skills related to data storage and structure for reporting.
  • Experience reviewing data logic, KPI definitions, and QA outputs. 
  • Basic BI (Tableau, Power BI) skills including data modeling, dashboard structure, calculated fields, usability, data storytelling. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Ability to translate complex business reporting requests into modeled data to support current and future analysis. 

Preferred / Bonus 

  • Pharma, HCP, or healthcare media analytics experience, including experience with media PLD (Physician Level Data).  
  • Digital media measurement expertise (media KPIs, attribution concepts, omnichannel analysis). 
  • Experience inheriting or stabilizing existing data warehouse schemas. 

Pay Range: $90,000-$110,000

This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

No-one’s favourite brand is the one that helps them live longer; we believe it should be. Over the last 5+ years, 21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, has been on a mission, bringing a more soulful, meaningful and fundamentally more human approach to healthcare brands. And it’s been successful. But we need to do more. As part of that, we’re looking for a Medical Copywriter with solid experience and a passion for great work to join our growing London team, helping lead client strategy engagements and oversee project and drive new business opportunities.

 

Our mission is about creating the most effective work for clients through the power of creativity, and that starts with listening and thinking. By knowing the audience better than they know themselves, and applying that insight to the client’s business opportunity, we can build brands and create campaigns that are more powerful than any sneaker brand. And for that, we need you in our pursuit of:

  • Using science and creativity to help HCPs improve the lives of patients

  • Putting ourselves in our clients’ shoes

  • Being open to challenges and trying new things

  • Achieving excellence, and persevering…even when it’s tough and we are afraid

  • Doing our personal best – together as a team and as individuals – always!

 

 

What you’ll do:

  • Write clear and concise commercially minded documents, adapting style for different audiences such as healthcare professionals and patients, while adhering to the ABPI code of conduct and quality control processes.

  • Collaborate closely with the strategy, creative and account teams

  • Utilize a variety of credible resources to understand the science and strategy behind assigned projects, ensuring awareness of brand objectives and competitive landscapes.

  • Contribute to proposal development, pitch activities, and brainstorming sessions, while communicating therapy area knowledge effectively.

  • Manage and take ownership of projects, ensuring timelines and deadlines are met, and proactively addressing potential barriers to project completion with solutions.

  • Engage confidently with clients, responding promptly to requests and participating in the briefing process to ensure a clear understanding of project requirements.

  • Participate in the review process, executing editorial deliverables while adhering to project schedules, budgets, and briefs.

  • Immerse in the advertising, medical communications and pharma industry, staying informed about innovations, trends, and developments to integrate into project work creatively.

  • Contribute to maintaining high standards of practice and industry guidelines, ensuring consistent communication and status updates with the account team.

 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • ​You have a passion for science and creativity

  • Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.

  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.

  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

 

What you should have:

  • Relevant degree (minimum Masters, advanced degree preferred [eg, MD, PhD, PharmD] in a science subject required

  • Experience in medical writing, ideally in an agency setting

  • Possesses a solid scientific background and able to learn new therapeutic areas quickly and demonstrate this knowledge

  • Possesses a good understanding and appreciation of the clinical trials process (phases, data representation, drug approval process and key statistical variables)

  • Enthusiasm for learning and a keen eye for detail

  • Demonstrates a clear, concise and accurate writing style, and:

  • Understands the typical language which should and should not be used (comparisons, unverified claims etc.)

  • Understand the processes involved in new business and terminology

  • Demonstrate strong organisational, analytical, and interpersonal communication skills

  • Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration

  • Professional presence, performs with a sense of urgency and with a client service orientation

  • Have confidence to manage upward when required; able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met or when issues are foreseeable

  • High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment

  • Good management of Microsoft Office tools (PowerPoint, Word, Excel) - particularly PowerPoint

Medical Writer

Please note, this is not an entry-level position and requires previous experience. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship. Applicants must already have the legal right to work in the UK. If you do not meet this requirement, please do not apply. This is a hybrid position and is not a fully remote role.

Role Purpose

Our MWs play a fundamental role in our business by contributing to day-to-day project delivery within an account to create outstanding medical content across a variety of therapy areas. This position is ideal for a proactive communicator with a passion for science, a keen interest in AI, and a keen eye for detail who is looking to develop their medical writing career further.  

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Scientific knowledge:
    • Has a good understanding of assigned therapeutic areas
    • Effectively analyses and interprets scientific data to work on a wide range of assigned projects
  • Strategic knowledge:
    • Understands the medical affairs and commercial spaces within which clients work
    • Reviews literature and competitive information to continually expand understanding of brand/marketplace and emerging competitors and shares findings and implications with teams
    • Participates in meetings and strategic discussions with clients, authors, and advisors
  • AI
    • Confidently and efficiently uses AI tools to support assigned tasks, ensuring efficiency and accuracy in their work
    • Seeks out new opportunities to apply AI tools in to improve personal workflow and task management
  • Project ownership:
    • Takes some responsibility for day-to-day delivery of scientific content under supervision of MW2 or SMW and higher
    • Ensures communication objectives are met on assigned projects
  • Editorial:
    • Adapts writing style to suit different audiences (e.g. primary and secondary care physicians, nurses or patients)
    • Structure and writes more commercially focused or complicated materials such as story flows/strategic frameworks, competitor intelligence, advisory board reports, etc. with clear supervision from SMW or higher
  • Quality control:
    • Ensures all work is referenced appropriately and is provided with a full reference pack
    • Ensures all work is tagged appropriately on VVPM
    • Is fully adherent to and shows a good working knowledge the ABPI code of conduct
    • Demonstrates knowledge of good practice/industry guidelines and ensures project work is compliant with these with supervision from senior team
  • On site: May go on-site across a variety of events and interacting with clients and faculty to develop and finalise content
  • Client liaison: Has begun to have client contact for content development on straight-forward projects and escalates queries in more challenging scenarios
  • Project management
    • Adheres to project schedules and briefs
    • Understands key dates in project timelines and keeps the account team apprised of status on projects by providing timely and accurate communication
    • Proactively clarifies how a project status is tracking versus the number of hours available
    • Participates in the tracking of project deliverables, identifying impact of out-of-scope changes
    • Adheres to project budgets, or proactively provides appropriate reasons not to
  • Teamwork: Trains/mentors junior writers on writing and company processes

Qualifications and skills

  • You should bring a strong scientific background with a degree in a scientific or medical discipline (post-graduate degree preferred). A high level of academic achievement is expected
  • A passion for, and profound understanding of, healthcare, science, medicine, and the pharmaceutical industry is essential, as well as a keen interest in AI technologies
  • You’ll need to be personable, articulate, and have a keen eye for detail
  • You should bring previous experience as a (junior) medical writer at an agency or within a pharmaceutical organisation

Medical Writer

Please note, this is not an entry-level position and requires previous experience. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship. Applicants must already have the legal right to work in the UK. If you do not meet this requirement, please do not apply. This is a hybrid position and is not a fully remote role.

Role Purpose

Our MWs play a fundamental role in our business by contributing to day-to-day project delivery within an account to create outstanding medical content across a variety of therapy areas. This position is ideal for a proactive communicator with a passion for science, a keen interest in AI, and a keen eye for detail who is looking to develop their medical writing career further.  

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Scientific knowledge:
    • Has a good understanding of assigned therapeutic areas
    • Effectively analyses and interprets scientific data to work on a wide range of assigned projects
  • Strategic knowledge:
    • Understands the medical affairs and commercial spaces within which clients work
    • Reviews literature and competitive information to continually expand understanding of brand/marketplace and emerging competitors and shares findings and implications with teams
    • Participates in meetings and strategic discussions with clients, authors, and advisors
  • AI
    • Confidently and efficiently uses AI tools to support assigned tasks, ensuring efficiency and accuracy in their work
    • Seeks out new opportunities to apply AI tools in to improve personal workflow and task management
  • Project ownership:
    • Takes some responsibility for day-to-day delivery of scientific content under supervision of MW2 or SMW and higher
    • Ensures communication objectives are met on assigned projects
  • Editorial:
    • Adapts writing style to suit different audiences (e.g. primary and secondary care physicians, nurses or patients)
    • Structure and writes more commercially focused or complicated materials such as story flows/strategic frameworks, competitor intelligence, advisory board reports, etc. with clear supervision from SMW or higher
  • Quality control:
    • Ensures all work is referenced appropriately and is provided with a full reference pack
    • Ensures all work is tagged appropriately on VVPM
    • Is fully adherent to and shows a good working knowledge the ABPI code of conduct
    • Demonstrates knowledge of good practice/industry guidelines and ensures project work is compliant with these with supervision from senior team
  • On site: May go on-site across a variety of events and interacting with clients and faculty to develop and finalise content
  • Client liaison: Has begun to have client contact for content development on straight-forward projects and escalates queries in more challenging scenarios
  • Project management
    • Adheres to project schedules and briefs
    • Understands key dates in project timelines and keeps the account team apprised of status on projects by providing timely and accurate communication
    • Proactively clarifies how a project status is tracking versus the number of hours available
    • Participates in the tracking of project deliverables, identifying impact of out-of-scope changes
    • Adheres to project budgets, or proactively provides appropriate reasons not to
  • Teamwork: Trains/mentors junior writers on writing and company processes

Qualifications and skills

  • You should bring a strong scientific background with a degree in a scientific or medical discipline (post-graduate degree preferred). A high level of academic achievement is expected
  • A passion for, and profound understanding of, healthcare, science, medicine, and the pharmaceutical industry is essential, as well as a keen interest in AI technologies
  • You’ll need to be personable, articulate, and have a keen eye for detail
  • You should bring previous experience as a (junior) medical writer at an agency or within a pharmaceutical organisation

We set up our Medical Education Communications team to bring new energy to our sector. We are fearless in our pursuit of:
  • Using science to help HCPs improve and prolong the lives of patients 
  • Putting ourselves in our clients’ shoes 
  • Being open to challenges and trying new things 
  • Achieving excellence, and persevering…even when it’s tough and we are afraid 
  • Doing our personal best – together as a team and as individuals – always! 
  What you’ll do:
  • Use a range of resources to understand the underlying science and product strategy related to assigned projects 
  • Perform research to support assigned project work (KEE mapping, collating data from resources) and review literature and competitive information to continually expand understanding of brand/marketplace and emerging competitors 
  • Have an appreciation of commercial context and be able, with guidance, to assimilate commercial information for assigned therapeutic areas 
  • Demonstrate awareness of brand strategic objectives in written work 
  • Understand and adhere to the ABPI code of conduct under guidance of the senior team and following training 
  • Structure and develop various forms of scientific communications  (e.g. manuscripts, posters, abstracts, slide decks, MSL material, , advisory board and symposia content and reports) annotate documents, perform data checks, and prepare reference packs 
  • Use existing, or quickly develop, relevant therapy area knowledge to ensure communication objectives are met on assigned projects (under supervision of senior editorial team) 
  • Adapt writing style to suit difference audiences (e.g. primary and secondary care physicians, nurses or patients) under the supervision of the senior team and direct manager 
  • Create, maintain and take ownership of assigned projects  
  • Adhere to quality control processes, including: 
    • Accurate referencing 
    • Data checking 
    • Proofreading 
  • Communicate relevant therapy area knowledge to the wider team to keep them up to date as needed 
  • Develop skills to confidently liaise with clients with appropriate support from more senior team members and respond promptly to client requests  
  • Actively participate in the briefing process for assigned work - interrogate the brief, and confirm understanding 
  • Ensure clarity on timelines, deadlines, and the availability of key people (reviewers) 
  • Prioritise workload accordingly and flag with account lead(s)/line manager at the earliest stage any potential barriers to successful project completion and suggests solutions 
  • Play a pivotal role within the editorial team, always leading by example and demonstrating knowledge of good practice/industry guidelines 
  • Recognise where your skills can be used to support colleagues in both the editorial and account handling teams 
  • Share insights and experiences with peers to support their professional development 
  • Seek feedback and proactively feeds back to improve individual and team performance 
  • Participate in the performance review process and deliver against your objectives 
  • Participate in the execution of established editorial deliverables, and understands the importance of adhering to project schedules, budgets and briefs 
  • Proactively clarify the number of hours available for each assigned project and key dates in project timeline and keeps the account team apprised of status on projects by providing timely and accurate communication 
  • Complete timesheets and expense claims accurately and on time 
  • Immerse yourself in the medical communications and pharma industries, clients' companies, and therapy areas 
  • Engage with every opportunity to establish an awareness of developments, innovations, and trends 
  • Seek opportunities to reflect these in project work and flags ideas to teams 
  This position is a perfect fit for you if:
  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organised self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.
  What you should have:
  • Experience in medical writing, ideally in an agency setting 
  • Understanding of GPP and ICMJE compliance as it relates to the development of publications 
  • Relevant degree (minimum of Masters, PhD preferred) PhD) in a science subject 
  • Possesses a solid scientific background and able to learn new therapeutic areas quickly and demonstrate this knowledge 
  • Possesses a good understanding of the clinical trials process and differences between Phase I-III; how trial data are presented; registrational trials and drug approval process  
  •  Knowledge of the key statistical variables used in clinical trials (e.g. PFS, OS, safety data, relapse rate, etc.) 
  • Knowledge of measurement scales used in clinical trials (e.g. RECIST, EDSS, etc.) o Able to differentiate between strong and weak data 
  • Enthusiasm for learning and a keen eye for detail 
  • Demonstrates a clear, concise and accurate writing style, and: 
  • Understands the typical language which should and should not be used (comparisons, unverified claims etc.) 
  • Understand the processes involved in new business and terminology 
  • Demonstrate strong organisational, analytical, and interpersonal communication skills 
  • Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration 
  • Professional presence, performs with a sense of urgency and with a client service orientation 
  • Has confidence to manage upward when required; able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met or when issues are foreseeable 
  • High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment 
  • Good management of Microsoft Office tools (PowerPoint, Word, Excel) - particularly PowerPoint

Principal Medical Writer

Our Principals play a fundamental role in shaping individual projects within an account with the support and direction of others. They co-lead the creation of outstanding medical content across various therapy areas and provide strategic insights to elevate client deliverables. This position is ideal for a proactive communicator who enjoys managing writing teams, ensuring quality and accuracy, and acting as a primary contact for clients. Our Principals have the opportunity to specialise in content development, team leadership, and/or strategic thinking.

Key Responsibilities

All Principals share the following core responsibilities

  • Therapy area and scientific expertise: Co-lead development of high-quality medical content under senior direction across multiple therapy areas and initiatives to meet/exceed client expectations
  • Strategic thinking:
    • Provide strategic input to aligned accounts
    • Demonstrate confidence and competent in questioning to probe and understand client briefs and distill for Real Chemistry teams
    • Adopt a questioning mindset to scientifically and strategically challenge and elevate outputs with clients and internal teams
  • AI: Co-lead implementation of AI into new projects and initiatives under senior direction within an account
  • Client relationships: Act as day-to-day medical contact for clients
  • Managing and advising:
    • Manage and mentor junior individuals and teams to work competently, confidently and efficiently to deliver high-quality work in high-pressure situations
    • Be responsible for guaranteeing the accuracy and quality of assets and that they are crafted and delivered in line with client objectives and expectations
    • Delegate work within account to ensure everyone is hitting billable targets and learning through new opportunitiesThe Principal, Medical Content additionally has the following responsibilities
  • Project expertise: Co-lead excellent medical content across a broad range of deliverables, demonstrating versatility
  • Content excellence:
    • Uphold and advocate for the highest standards in medical writing within accounts
    • Identify the most appropriate channel, style and format for a project to achieve client objectives and maximise engagement
