job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KTNV
job.description:
At Scripps-owned KTNV, you’ll tell the stories that help Las Vegas viewers understand what’s happening in their community and why it matters. As a Multimedia Journalist, you’ll take stories from idea to air, researching, writing, shooting and editing compelling content for television and digital platforms.


You’ll be out in the community, talking with the people at the center of the story and bringing clarity and context to fast-moving news. From breaking news and live reports to memorable enterprise stories, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase strong journalism, visual storytelling and your own creative voice.


If you’re a self-starter who thrives on deadlines and wants to make an impact through local journalism, this is an opportunity to do meaningful work in one of the country’s most dynamic news markets.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Develop compelling story ideas by evaluating assignments, news leads and tips.
  • Gather and verify information through interviews, observation and research.
  • Write accurate, engaging stories that meet broadcast and AP style standards.
  • Shoot high-quality video and still photography that strengthens your storytelling.
  • Edit video and produce content for television, digital and other multimedia platforms.
  • Deliver taped interviews, narration and live reports from the scene of breaking and developing news.
  • Collaborate with photographers on assigned stories to create cohesive, visually strong coverage.
  • Partner with producers to help prepare newscasts and meet daily editorial needs.
  • Work with digital team members to develop multimedia stories and extend coverage across platforms.
  • Respond quickly and effectively as stories evolve in a fast-paced, deadline-driven newsroom.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred.
  • Generally, 3+ years of related experience preferred.
  • Valid driver’s license, good driving record and ability to provide proof of insurance that meets company-required limits are required. Driving is an essential part of this role.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills with a focus on accuracy, clarity and engaging storytelling.
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment and experience capturing video in the field.
  • Videography and nonlinear editing experience preferred, including Final Cut Pro or similar editing systems.
  • Computer literacy, including familiarity with newsroom computer systems.
  • Confidence posting and adapting content for websites and multimedia platforms.
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with photographers, producers and digital teams.
  • Self-motivation, sound news judgment and the ability to perform in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Flexibility to move between reporting, shooting, editing and live storytelling as the news demands.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

OUR TEAM:

At KTNV, you’ll be part of a collaborative newsroom focused on serving the Las Vegas community with relevant, compelling journalism. Our team brings different backgrounds, perspectives, interests and storytelling strengths to the newsroom, all with a shared goal: connecting audiences with the stories that affect their lives. You’ll work alongside journalists who value teamwork, curiosity, creativity and the energy that comes with chasing a great local story.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Las Vegas gives journalists a remarkable range of stories to tell and experiences to enjoy outside the newsroom. Beyond the world-famous Strip, the Las Vegas Valley offers distinctive neighborhoods, a vibrant food and entertainment scene and a community with plenty of personality.

When you're off the clock, Southern Nevada's landscape offers a dramatic change of pace, with desert scenery and abundant opportunities to get outdoors. Whether you're drawn to live entertainment and restaurants or prefer exploring the desert and surrounding natural areas, Las Vegas offers plenty to discover.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, WEWS
job.description:
WEWS News 5, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC station in Cleveland, Ohio, is looking for a Multimedia Journalist to join our award-winning newsroom. This is not an entry-level position. We are seeking a journalist who can separate us from the competition through exceptional source-building, enterprise reporting, and compelling storytelling. We want someone who knows how to uncover stories that no one else has and deliver them in a way that informs, engages, and serves our community.


Cleveland is a resilient and passionate city with a rich history, diverse neighborhoods, and a strong sense of pride. From the shores of Lake Erie and the vibrant downtown district to world-class healthcare, arts, sports, and cultural institutions, Northeast Ohio offers endless opportunities to tell meaningful stories that impact viewers' lives. WEWS News 5 has a long-standing reputation for trusted journalism, investigative reporting, innovation, and community engagement. Our newsroom is committed to helping journalists grow, develop their skills, and make a difference in the communities they serve. If you're ready to tell stories that matter and be part of a team dedicated to impactful journalism, apply today.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and tips to develop original story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information through interviews, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine story emphasis, and write content according to editorial standards and AP style.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assist in editing, video for television, digital, social, and streaming platforms.
  • Appear on television programs while conducting interviews or providing narration.
  • Deliver live reports from the scene of breaking news and community events.
  • Work collaboratively with photographers and other newsroom staff when assigned.
  • Assist producers in preparing newscasts and coverage plans.
  • Partner with digital teams to create compelling multimedia content for all platforms.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 3+ years of professional reporting experience preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with company-required limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Strong journalism skills, including enterprise reporting, source development, and storytelling
  • Proven ability to develop exclusive stories through relationship-building, public records research, and enterprise reporting that delivers meaningful impact for local communities
  • Computer literacy, including experience with newsroom content management systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment
  • Ability to edit video using Final Cut Pro, Adobe Premiere, or similar editing systems
  • Strong broadcast writing and AP style skills
  • Experience publishing content across digital, social, and streaming platforms
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Strong news judgment and a commitment to accurate, ethical journalism
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Cleveland, Ohio is a city on the rise, blending Midwest charm with big-city energy. Situated on the shores of Lake Erie, Cleveland offers stunning waterfront views, vibrant neighborhoods, and a thriving cultural scene. The city is home to the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, world-renowned Cleveland Orchestra, Cleveland Museum of Art, and championship sports teams including the Guardians, Browns, and Cavaliers. Food lovers will appreciate the city's diverse culinary landscape, from historic West Side Market to innovative farm-to-table restaurants and craft breweries.


Cleveland's affordable cost of living, strong sense of community, and access to outdoor recreation—including Metro Parks, lakefront trails, and nearby Cuyahoga Valley National Park—make it an ideal place to build both your career and your life. With a revitalized downtown, diverse neighborhoods like Tremont, Ohio City, and Little Italy, and a growing tech and healthcare sector, Cleveland offers the perfect balance of professional opportunity and quality of life.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, WGBA
job.description:
WGBA, the NBC affiliate in Green Bay, Wisconsin, owned by The E.W. Scripps Company, is searching for an experienced Multimedia Journalist. In this role, you'll research, write, shoot, and edit stories for TV, digital, social platforms, and a 24/7 stream. You'll dig for community based stories that are hyper-local and matter to the viewers the station serves. Green Bay is a close-knit community with big-time energy and is home to the Packers. Downtown Green Bay has a growing mix of local restaurants, breweries, and the Titletown District, with year-round events along the Fox River. Whether you love summer on the water or a snowy Friday night at the game, this is a place where there's always a story worth telling. Apply today!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Receive assignment or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assists in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.

  • Give live reports from site of event or mobile broadcast unit.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscast.

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems

  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced deadline-driven environment

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, WTKR (Historic Triangle)
job.description:
WTKR, The E.W. Scripps Company CBS affiliate in Norfolk, Virginia, is looking for a motivated Multimedia Journalist to research, write, capture visual content, and edit stories for multiple platforms. This role will be based in the Historic Triangle — serving the communities of Williamsburg, Yorktown, and Jamestown — putting you at the center of one of the most historically significant and story-rich corners of the Hampton Roads DMA. In this role, you'll be on the front lines of local news — from developing story ideas to delivering live reports in the field — helping viewers across Hampton Roads stay informed, engaged, and connected. If you're passionate about journalism and ready to do it all, we want to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Receive assignment or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assists in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on television program when conducting taped interview or narration.
  • Give live reports from site of event or mobile broadcast unit.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscast.
  • Assist online staff in preparing for multi media stories.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Norfolk, Virginia sits at the heart of Hampton Roads, one of the most historically rich and geographically stunning metro areas on the East Coast. As home to Naval Station Norfolk — the largest naval installation in the world — the city carries a proud military heritage that shapes its culture, its people, and its sense of purpose. The waterfront downtown is vibrant and walkable, lined with restaurants, craft breweries, and live music venues, with the iconic Nauticus maritime museum and the battleship Wisconsin drawing visitors and locals alike year-round.


Beyond the city limits, Hampton Roads offers an incredible range of outdoor adventures and coastal living. Virginia Beach is just a short drive away, offering miles of Atlantic coastline perfect for surfing, swimming, and sunsets. The Great Dismal Swamp National Wildlife Refuge provides kayaking, hiking, and wildlife watching just south of the city, while First Landing State Park offers camping among ancient cypress trees. With easy access to Washington, D.C. to the north and the Outer Banks of North Carolina to the south, Norfolk puts you squarely in the middle of one of the most exciting corridors on the Eastern Seaboard.


Culturally, Norfolk punches well above its weight. The Chrysler Museum of Art houses a world-class collection and is free to the public, while the Virginia Arts Festival draws internationally acclaimed performers every spring. The NEON (New East Ocean View Norfolk) arts district buzzes with galleries and community events, and a thriving culinary scene celebrates local seafood — from fresh oysters to blue crab — alongside global cuisines. Norfolk is a city where community pride runs deep and there's always something new to discover.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, WXMI (Ionia / Greenville / Lowell / Belding)
job.description:
WXMI, the FOX affiliate in Grand Rapids, Michigan, owned by The E.W. Scripps Company is searching for its next Multimedia Journalist. The MMJ will tell the stories of the Ionia, Greenville, Lowell, and Belding neighborhoods. The right person will dig for stories, write, capture visual content, and edit stories for multiple platforms. Tucked into the scenic Grand River Valley northeast of Grand Rapids, the Ionia, Greenville, Lowell, and Belding area blends small-town Michigan charm with historic downtowns, riverfront trails, and lively community traditions like the Ionia Free Fair. With affordable housing, outdoor recreation at your doorstep, and a proud manufacturing and agricultural heritage, it's a welcoming place. Apply today to join an award-winning team!

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Receive assignment or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assists in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on television program when conducting taped interview or narration
  • Give live reports from site of event or mobile broadcast unit.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscast.
  • Assist online staff in preparing for multi media stories.

 


WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

job.title: Offices Services Clerk (TEMP) KRTV
job.description:
Are you someone who takes pride in keeping the office running like a well-oiled machine? KRTV in Great Falls, Montana is looking for an Office Services Clerk (Temp) who thrives on organization, loves helping people, and enjoys wearing many hats throughout the day. From managing correspondence and welcoming visitors to stocking supplies and supporting the team with essential clerical tasks, you'll play a vital behind-the-scenes role in everything we do. If you're detail-oriented, resourceful, and ready to contribute to a fast-moving media environment, we want to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Open, sort and distribute incoming correspondence, including faxes and email.
  • Greet visitors and determine whether they should be given access to specific individuals
  • Prepare invoices, reports, memos, letters, other documents, using word processing, spreadsheets, database, and/or presentation software.
  • Perform general office duties such as ordering supplies, maintaining records management systems, and performing basic bookkeeping work.
  • Maintain inventory flow and storage of office supplies
  • Participate in building safety and evacuation team at supervisors direction
  • Perform other duties as needed and as directed by supervisor/management.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • High school diploma or equivalent

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Basic math, reading and computer skills
  • Resourceful, possess excellent communication skills, ability to work with public and with other office personnel in person and by telephone
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

OUR TEAM: We have hikers, rock climbers, mountain bikers, kayakers, runners, skiers, gamers, hunters, fishing enthusiasts, beekeepers, western Montana gardeners, travelers, boaters, community leaders, and every other mixture of diverse backgrounds, passions, and life experiences. We are a community of welcoming, mission-focused, and lively people who continue to grow as we grow our company and rise to our full potential in every aspect of our business.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY: Great Falls, MT, is where outdoor enthusiasts enjoy the big small-town charm and quick access to national parks. Skiing is right outside your door as well as an expansive 40 miles along the River's Edge Trail. Enjoy a picnic at Gibson Park and Giant Springs Heritage State Park or get inspired by the local culture and art at the C.M. Russell Museum. Take a step back in time with The Lewis & Clark Interpretive Center and the First Peoples Buffalo Jump State Park to explore Montana's heritage and history. Whether you want to unplug and get off the grid and onto a hike surrounded by wilderness or enjoy the small-town charm of the local farmers market, restaurants, dog parks, and fly fishing or cultural events and performances at the Mansfield Center for Performing Arts, Great Falls has something for everyone. There are many reasons to claim Great Falls as a great place to live, including the reminder that you are walking in the footsteps of "the greats" from Lewis and Clark, the Blackfeet Indians, and the grizzly bear.Montana_Station_Location_Sections.md

job.title: Producer, Creative Production, (remote)
job.description:
Are you a creative storyteller with a passion for brand-building and a talent for bringing marketing campaigns to life from concept to completion? Scripps is looking for a Producer, Creative Production to join our team and help elevate the brands that millions of viewers trust every day. In this role, you'll develop and execute high-impact marketing campaigns that strengthen local station and news brands and drive audience engagement — crafting premium, scalable work that can be customized across multiple markets. If you thrive at the intersection of strategy, storytelling, and production craft, this is your opportunity to make a real impact at a national scale.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Conceptualize, write, produce, and edit marketing campaigns supporting station and news brands, audience growth, and strategic initiatives.
  • Turn brand strategy and marketing objectives into compelling, consumer-facing creative.
  • Develop scalable campaigns that maintain brand consistency while allowing for local customization.
  • Manage projects from concept and scripting through production, post-production, versioning, and final delivery.
  • Write scripts, promotional copy, headlines, taglines, and campaign messaging.
  • Produce and edit broadcast-quality video using strong visual storytelling, sound design, graphics, and motion design.
  • Direct and coordinate production shoots as needed.
  • Adapt creative across broadcast, streaming/OTT, digital, social, and other platforms.
  • Collaborate with Team leadership, local and regional marketing teams, News, and other partners to develop effective creative solutions.
  • Work with stations to gather footage, talent, photography, and other assets needed to localize campaigns.
  • Maintain established brand standards and organize projects for efficient versioning across markets.
  • Manage multiple projects and deadlines while maintaining high creative and technical standards.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising, Video Production, Journalism, or related field preferred; or equivalent work experience
  • Generally, 3+ years of professional experience in marketing, advertising, broadcast promotion, creative services, agency production, or a comparable creative environment preferred.
  • Proven experience creating professional marketing campaigns from concept through final delivery

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Strong conceptual, writing, editing, and visual storytelling skills
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, with working knowledge of After Effects and Photoshop
  • Experience in television marketing, news promotion, advertising, entertainment marketing, or a similar brand-focused environment
  • Experience marketing local news, journalism, media, or content brands
  • Advanced motion graphics and visual-effects skills
  • Experience directing talent and managing video productions
  • Experience creating campaigns for use across multiple brands or markets
  • Portfolio demonstrating strong conceptual thinking and polished production execution

job.title: Producer, WTKR
job.description:
WTKR, The E.W. Scripps Company CBS affiliate in Norfolk, Virginia, is looking for a creative, driven Producer to create and organize content across multiple platforms. Using your editorial, journalistic, organizational and communication skills, you'll play a vital role in connecting our community to the stories that impact their lives every day — from breaking news to in-depth local coverage.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Develop and organize newscasts or local programs.
  • Write story development and showcasing.
  • Collaborate with reporters, anchors, news managers and assignment editors to determine content needs.
  • Enhance content with graphics, video, research, and station branding.
  • Execute time sensitive decisions.
  • Oversee live broadcast and up to the minute editorial decisions.
  • Perform desktop editing.
  • Post content to station's websites.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 2+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Avid local news consumer: knows daily news, events, trends and happenings on a local level
  • Strong vision and ability to advance stories
  • Excellent interpersonal communicator
  • Extraordinarily passionate about writing; courageous and creative storyteller with attention to even tiny details - choosing the perfect words, grammar, spelling
  • Highly organized
  • Highly adaptable - fast paced, deadline driven environment
  • Strong self-motivation
  • Working knowledge of journalistic ethics and libel laws and strong editorial judgement
  • Able to use web analytics
  • Proficient with newsroom computer systems, MS Office a plus
  • Flexible work hours may be required, including holidays, weekends and evenings

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Norfolk sits at the heart of Hampton Roads, one of the most historically rich and strategically significant regions on the East Coast. As home to Naval Station Norfolk — the world's largest naval base — the city carries a proud military heritage alongside a thriving arts scene, with the Chrysler Museum of Art, the Virginia Opera and the Harrison Opera House all calling Norfolk home. The revitalized Waterside District along the Elizabeth River offers waterfront dining, live entertainment and a vibrant gathering spot for locals and visitors alike.


Outdoor life is woven into the fabric of Norfolk. The Virginia Zoo, Norfolk Botanical Garden and the miles of waterfront parks give residents plenty of ways to enjoy the mid-Atlantic climate and scenery. The nearby Chesapeake Bay and Atlantic Ocean beaches — including Virginia Beach, just minutes away — offer year-round recreation from kayaking and paddleboarding to surfing. College football fans won't have to look far either, with Norfolk State University and Old Dominion University both anchoring the local sports scene.


Norfolk's food culture reflects its coastal character, with a bustling restaurant scene featuring fresh seafood, craft breweries and farm-to-table eateries. The NEON (New East Ocean View Norfolk) arts district and the annual Norfolk Jazz Festival are just two examples of the city's creative energy. With affordable cost of living compared to many coastal metros, a close-knit community feel and easy access to the best of coastal Virginia, Norfolk is a wonderful place to build both a career and a life.

Hourly: $26.83 - $27.40

  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits, as well as certain other health and wellness benefits

  • Retirement savings plan with company match

  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, hospital indemnity, critical illness, life insurance, AD&D, ID protection, pet discount program, and employee assistance program. job.title: Scripps Sports Partnership Lead
job.description:
Are you ready to be part of one of the most exciting partnerships in sports broadcasting? Scripps Sports is seeking an Account Executive who will sell linear, digital, and sponsorship solutions for Scripps Sports, including our partnership as the official broadcast partner of the Nashville Predators on ION and WNPX-TV/WTVF Channel 5. You'll work with regional and national clients to create innovative advertising solutions that connect brands with passionate sports fans, while helping achieve the revenue plan of our growing sports division.

This position can be remote in Nashville, TN, Charlotte, NC, or Atlanta, GA.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Independently prospect regional and national accounts, secure appointments, perform needs analysis, develop customized solutions, conduct presentations and close sales.
  • Create and sell sponsorship/advertising solutions utilizing acquired league and team controlled sports inventory.
  • Attend internal meetings to establish strategy and revenue goals and attend weekly sports division meetings.
  • Serve as trusted advisor with new clients, provide best-in-class customer service, grow accounts, and gain additional business from referrals.
  • Perform client services, including but not limited to media avail negotiations, presentation preparation delivery and execution, copy writing, credit applications, collections of revenue due and retention reports.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, which may include entertaining prospective and existing clients, attending sporting events or other associated functions.
  • Perform routine administrative functions of media sales including makegood resolution, continuous update of CRM system with activity, account information and pending revenue, and communication with VP of Revenue regarding status of accounts.
  • Assist Scripps national or local AE's on key client sales calls for sports sponsorships.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related field required, or equivalent experience
  • Generally 5+ years of sports-related experience required
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated record of success in a goal-oriented, highly accountable sales environment
  • Proficient use of Microsoft Office and other programs such as customer relations software
  • Working knowledge of various media sales platforms
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills required
  • Must have good organizational skills and time management
  • Ability to present and negotiate with confidence and professionalism
  • Strong attention to detail, ability to multitask and meet deadlines in fast pace environment
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Highly self-motivated and goal focused
  • Travel required up to 25%

WHAT WE'LL OFFER:

  • Uncapped sales commission
  • Monthly allowance for mileage and cell phone
  • Extensive Scripps Sales Process training
  • A career path to grow your professional experiences
  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits, as well as certain other health and wellness benefits
  • Retirement savings plan with company match
  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, life insurance, ID protection, pet discount program, and employee assistance program. More details about timing and conditions of benefits eligibility and other plan terms and conditions will be provided upon hire.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Nashville, Tennessee is Music City—but it's so much more. As one of the fastest-growing cities in America, Nashville offers an unbeatable blend of Southern charm, creative energy, and economic opportunity. Beyond the honky-tonks of Broadway, you'll discover a thriving food scene with James Beard Award-winning chefs, a booming healthcare and technology sector, and neighborhoods brimming with character from East Nashville's artistic vibe to the historic charm of Germantown. Sports fans will love cheering on the NFL's Tennessee Titans, NHL's Nashville Predators, and MLS's Nashville SC. With no state income tax, a relatively affordable cost of living for a major metro, mild winters, and a community that welcomes newcomers with open arms, Nashville truly lives up to its reputation as a city where dreams are made.

job.description:
Scripps Sports is looking for a passionate, experienced sports sales professional to help drive revenue growth for the Nashville Predators TV Broadcasts on Scripps Sports, one of the NHL's most recognized franchises. As a Scripps Sports Partnership Lead, you'll leverage the power of live sports and the strength of the Predators-Scripps partnership to develop strategic sponsorships, build lasting client partnerships, and create innovative linear and digital advertising and marketing solutions for regional and national advertisers. If you're a proven seller who thrives on developing new business, exceeding revenue goals, and delivering winning solutions, this is an exciting opportunity to make an immediate impact with a growing sports media organization.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Prospect and develop relationships with regional and national accounts to generate new business opportunities.
  • Conduct needs analyses and create customized sports sponsorship and advertising solutions that align with client objectives.
  • Secure appointments, present recommendations, negotiate agreements, and close sales to achieve revenue goals.
  • Create and sell sponsorship packages utilizing acquired league and team-controlled sports inventory, with a primary focus on Nashville Predators partnership opportunities.
  • Leverage the strength and visibility of the Nashville Predators brand to develop creative, integrated marketing solutions that deliver measurable results for clients.
  • Collaborate with Scripps national and local Account Executives on strategic sports sponsorship opportunities.
  • Participate in internal planning meetings to establish sales strategies, revenue targets, and growth initiatives.
  • Build long-term client partnerships through exceptional service, retention efforts, and referral generation.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to new and existing clients while identifying opportunities to expand partnerships and drive incremental revenue.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling presentations, sponsorship pitches, and partnership recommendations to clients and stakeholders.
  • Manage all aspects of client service, including media negotiations, proposal development, campaign execution, collections, reporting, and account retention activities.
  • Entertain prospective and existing clients through sporting events and other business development opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate client activity, pipeline, forecasting, account information, and revenue projections within CRM systems.
  • Resolve makegoods and other sales-related issues while ensuring client satisfaction.
  • Communicate regularly with sales leadership regarding account status, revenue performance, and business opportunities.
  • Travel up to 25% as needed to support client meetings, sponsorship opportunities, sporting events, and business development activities.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Sports Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in sports, media, sponsorship, advertising, partnership sales, or a related industry.
  • Proven track record of success achieving and exceeding revenue goals in a highly accountable sales environment.
  • Valid driver's license, satisfactory driving record, and proof of insurance meeting company requirements.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Strong understanding of sports sponsorships, media sales, and integrated marketing solutions.
  • Ability to identify client needs and develop strategic, customized partnership programs.
  • Exceptional prospecting, relationship-building, negotiating, and closing skills.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and uncover new revenue opportunities.
  • Experience using CRM platforms and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Knowledge of media sales platforms and advertising solutions.
  • Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to confidently present to executives and audiences of all sizes in both virtual and in-person settings.
  • Strong organizational and time management capabilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively across teams and departments.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented approach with a strong sense of accountability.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit with a passion for sports, partnership development, and revenue generation.
  • Ability to effectively represent the Nashville Predators and Scripps Sports brands in the marketplace.

WHAT WE'LL OFFER

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission opportunity.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits.
  • Retirement savings opportunities, including company matching.
  • Generous paid time off and holidays.
  • Employee wellness programs and resources.
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities.
  • The opportunity to represent one of the most exciting brands in professional sports while helping clients connect with passionate fans.
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture where your contributions directly impact business growth and success.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY

At Scripps Sports, you'll join a team that is redefining local sports media and building powerful connections between fans, teams, and advertisers. Utilizing our Nashville Predators broadcasts, you'll help brands tap into the passion, reach, and engagement of live sports while creating partnerships that drive measurable business results. If you're energized by sports, motivated by sales success, and excited about representing a premier NHL franchise, you'll find an incredible opportunity to grow your career and make a lasting impact in Nashville, Tennessee, one of the country's most vibrant sports, entertainment, and business communities.

job.title: Scripps Sports Partnership Lead, Salt Lake City
job.description:
Are you ready to bring the excitement of sports to life through innovative advertising solutions? Scripps Sports is seeking a dynamic Scripps Sports Partnership Lead in Salt Lake City who will drive revenue growth by selling linear, digital, and sponsorship solutions across our acquired league and team-controlled sports inventory. You'll work with regional and national accounts to create customized advertising packages that connect brands with passionate sports fans.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Independently prospect regional and national accounts, secure appointments, perform needs analysis, develop customized solutions, conduct presentations and close sales.
  • Create and sell sponsorship/advertising solutions utilizing acquired league and team controlled sports inventory.
  • Attend internal meetings to establish strategy and revenue goals and attend weekly sports division meetings.
  • Serve as trusted advisor with new clients, provide best-in-class customer service, grow accounts, and gain additional business from referrals.
  • Perform client services, including but not limited to media avail negotiations, presentation preparation delivery and execution, copy writing, credit applications, collections of revenue due and retention reports.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, which may include entertaining prospective and existing clients, attending sporting events or other associated functions.
  • Perform routine administrative functions of media sales including makegood resolution, continuous update of CRM system with activity, account information and pending revenue, and communication with VP of Revenue regarding status of accounts.
  • Assist Scripps national or local AE's on key client sales calls for sports sponsorships.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related field required, or equivalent experience
  • Generally 5+ years of sports-related experience required
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated record of success in a goal-oriented, highly accountable sales environment
  • Proficient use of Microsoft Office and other programs such as customer relations software
  • Working knowledge of various media sales platforms
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills required
  • Must have good organizational skills and time management
  • Ability to present and negotiate with confidence and professionalism
  • Strong attention to detail, ability to multitask and meet deadlines in fast pace environment
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Highly self-motivated and goal focused

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Salt Lake City offers an unbeatable combination of urban sophistication and outdoor adventure. Nestled against the stunning Wasatch Mountains, you'll have world-class skiing and snowboarding at resorts like Park City, Alta, and Snowbird just 30-45 minutes from downtown. In warmer months, enjoy hiking, mountain biking, and rock climbing in Big and Little Cottonwood Canyons, or explore the unique landscape of the Great Salt Lake.

The city itself boasts a thriving downtown with excellent restaurants, craft breweries, and a vibrant arts scene including the Utah Symphony, Ballet West, and numerous galleries. Temple Square and the historic neighborhoods showcase the city's rich heritage, while the growing tech sector has earned Salt Lake City recognition as the "Silicon Slopes." With 300 days of sunshine annually, a lower cost of living than many major metros, and a family-friendly atmosphere, Salt Lake City provides an exceptional quality of life.

Sports fans will love being home to the NBA's Utah Jazz, Real Salt Lake (MLS), and Utah Hockey Club (NHL), plus easy access to outdoor recreation that rivals anywhere in the country. The city's central location also makes it a convenient hub for exploring Utah's "Mighty Five" national parks and other Western destinations.

job.title: Senior Manager, Community Connections - KPAX
job.description:
Are you a connector, a listener, and a community champion? KPAX is looking for a passionate and strategic community engagement leader to serve as the station's primary bridge to the people and organizations that define our market. In this role, you'll build trusted relationships across civic, nonprofit, business, educational, and government sectors — translating community insight into action that strengthens our journalism, deepens audience trust, and creates lasting local impact. If you thrive at the intersection of storytelling, strategy, and service, this is your opportunity to shape how KPAX shows up for the community it serves.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build and maintain relationships with community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities, and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, and communicate community insights to station leadership, newsroom teams, and partners to inform decision-making and coverage.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources, and support audience engagement across community channels.
  • Serve as the station's primary community liaison, developing trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, and government organizations.
  • Represent the station throughout the community and foster partnerships that create long-term value and impact.
  • Ensure responsive, professional communication with community members, partners, and stakeholders, ensuring audience inquiries are acknowledged, routed and resolved in a timely and professional manner.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs, and other community engagement activities.
  • Partner with News, Sales, Marketing, and station leadership to create meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics, stakeholder coordination, and effectiveness measurement to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant, and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities.
  • Advise station leadership on community needs, emerging issues, and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, while sharing best practices, tracking outcomes, and developing team capabilities.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations, or related field
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills
  • Strong community listening skills and ability to recognize emerging issues and opportunities
  • Strategic thinking and judgment; ability to translate insight into action
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing and presentation skills
  • Ability to influence across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations and community organizations
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion and integrity
  • Ability to work independently and adapt to change
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM/community relationship platforms and collaboration tools
  • Strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns and sensitive community issues

OUR TEAM: We have hikers, rock climbers, mountain bikers, kayakers, runners, skiers, gamers, musicians, community leaders, swimmers, and every other mixture of diverse backgrounds, passions, and life experiences. We are a community of welcoming, mission-focused, and lively people who continue to grow as we grow our company and rise to our full potential in every aspect of our business.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY: Missoula, MT where the Clark-Fork River really does run through this vibrant city. Set at the convergence of five mountain ranges, earning Missoula the name of the "hub of five valleys". Missoula is surrounded by 60,000 acres of wilderness and is an outdoor paradise, with national forests, ski areas, incredible hikes, and bicycling, raging rivers with excellent blue-ribbon trout fishing. Missoula has repeatedly earned its ranking as a top 100 Best Places to live and was recently recognized as one of the healthiest places in the US with the highest life expectancy compared to any other city in Montana. If you seek a life that isn't consumed by your work or your commute, where living is about community, exploring the same trails as Lewis and Clark, as well as new adventures, and a place where "fur babies" are considered part of the Missoulian community than this is the place for you! After Billings, Missoula is the second-largest city and metropolitan area in Montana and is home to the University of Montana, a public research university. Where else can you walk outside and jump on a mountain trailhead or drive two to three hours and arrive at the gates of both Glacier and Yellowstone National Park? The economy is growing, culture and arts are thriving, calling filmmakers such as Paramount's Yellowstone to call on Missoula for some of the most beautiful scenic movie and TV show backgrounds. Truly the last best place!​


Application Review: Applications received by 11/4/2026 will receive priority consideration. Applications received after this date may continue to be reviewed as needed.

job.title: Senior Manager, Community Connections, WTVF
job.description:
At Scripps, we believe strong local journalism starts with strong community connections. As the Sr. Manager, Community Connections at WTVF, NewsChannel 5 in Nashville, Tennessee, you’ll serve as a primary connector between the station and the communities of Nashville and Middle Tennessee, building trusted relationships that deepen local engagement, inform our journalism and create meaningful partnerships.

You’ll bring community voices and insights into the newsroom while helping ensure questions, concerns and story ideas are heard and acted on thoughtfully. Working across News, Sales, Marketing and station leadership, you’ll turn community intelligence into opportunities for greater impact. Your work will help ensure NewsChannel 5 remains an essential, responsive and trusted part of life across Middle Tennessee.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, government and other community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze and share community insights with station leadership, newsroom teams and partners to help inform decision-making, journalism and local engagement.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources and strengthen audience engagement across community channels.
  • Represent WTVF throughout Nashville and Middle Tennessee and develop partnerships that create long-term value, trust and local impact.
  • Respond to community members, partners and stakeholders with timely, professional communication, ensuring audience questions, concerns and story tips are acknowledged, routed and resolved appropriately.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs and other community engagement activities.
  • Collaborate with News, Sales, Marketing, Operations and station leadership to develop meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics and stakeholder coordination while measuring effectiveness to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities, advising leadership on community needs, emerging issues and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, sharing best practices, tracking outcomes and helping build engagement capabilities across teams.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of relevant experience preferred.
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations or a related field.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company-required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills, with the ability to establish credibility across a wide range of communities and organizations.
  • Strong community listening skills and the ability to recognize emerging issues, needs and opportunities.
  • Strategic thinking and sound judgment, with the ability to translate community insights into meaningful action.
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing and presentation skills.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations, station leadership and external community organizations.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion and integrity when working with diverse communities and sensitive topics.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative and adapt effectively to changing community and business needs.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM or community relationship platforms and collaboration tools.
  • A strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns and sensitive community issues.

Application Review:

Applications received by November 18, 2026 will receive priority consideration. Applications received after this date may continue to be reviewed as needed.


Nashville is a growing, dynamic community with a rich history, vibrant neighborhoods and a culture all its own. Known around the world as Music City, Nashville is also home to a thriving business community, major league sports, renowned universities, diverse arts and food scenes, and communities that care deeply about the future of Middle Tennessee. This is an opportunity to build meaningful connections across the market and help WTVF continue making a difference in the communities it serves.

job.title: Senior Reporter, KSBY
job.description:
At KSBY, we believe local journalism is most powerful when it happens where the story is unfolding. As our Senior Reporter, you'll be the face of our morning news coverage, bringing viewers the stories, voices, and issues that matter most across California's Central Coast. You'll spend your time in the field, reporting, developing exclusive stories, building community relationships, and serving as a trusted ambassador for the station. If you're a passionate storyteller who thrives on being where the news happens and enjoys connecting with the community you serve, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact every day.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Generate original story ideas and develop content for broadcast, digital, and social platforms.
  • Front morning newscast, report from the field and turn leading content for other newscasts.
  • Research, write, and deliver accurate, compelling stories that inform and engage audiences.
  • Cultivate a strong network of sources to uncover exclusive and enterprise reporting opportunities.
  • Identify the best angle, approach, and storytelling techniques for each assignment.
  • Serve as a mentor and resource for newer reporters in the newsroom.
  • Represent KSBY throughout the community by participating in station and local events.
  • Meet daily and long-term production deadlines while managing multiple stories and priorities.
  • Drive a personal or company vehicle to cover assignments throughout the viewing area.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience
  • 5+ years of reporting or related journalism experience preferred.
  • Valid driver's license, strong driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance meeting company requirements
  • Ability to drive regularly as part of daily news-gathering responsibilities

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Exceptional reporting and storytelling skills across multiple platforms
  • Strong verbal and written communication abilities
  • A dynamic on-air presence with the ability to connect authentically with viewers
  • Advanced critical thinking and sound news judgment
  • The ability to develop enterprise stories and pursue leads independently
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously
  • A collaborative, team-first mindset and a positive newsroom attitude.
  • A passion for community engagement and relationship building
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds

OUR TEAM:

KSBY's newsroom is made up of curious, dedicated journalists who believe in the value of local news and community connection. We work collaboratively, support one another's growth, and celebrate great storytelling in all forms. Our team brings diverse experiences, perspectives, and interests to the newsroom, creating an environment where creativity, innovation, and public service journalism thrive.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Located along California's spectacular Central Coast, San Luis Obispo offers an exceptional quality of life with a unique blend of coastal beauty, outdoor adventure, and small-town charm. From world-class beaches and scenic hiking trails to renowned wineries, farmers markets, and a vibrant downtown, the region provides endless opportunities to explore and connect with the community you'll cover.


Whether you're catching sunrise along the Pacific, enjoying local restaurants and festivals, or discovering hidden stories throughout the Central Coast, San Luis Obispo is a place where professional fulfillment and personal lifestyle come together.

job.description:
Are you a natural connector who thrives at the intersection of community and journalism? KSTU is looking for a passionate, strategic leader to serve as the station's primary bridge to the people, organizations, and conversations that shape our community. In this role, you won't just be part of the newsroom — you'll be the heartbeat that keeps it connected to the community it serves. From building trusted relationships with civic and nonprofit leaders to guiding story opportunities and leading impactful public forums, you'll help ensure KSTU remains an essential, credible, and trusted voice in the market. If you believe in the power of local journalism and the importance of showing up for your community, this is your opportunity to make a lasting difference.


*Applications received by November 17, 2026, will be prioritized*.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build and maintain relationships with community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities, and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, and communicate community insights to station leadership, newsroom teams, and partners to inform decision-making and coverage.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources, and support audience engagement across community channels.
  • Serve as the station's primary community liaison, developing trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, and government organizations.
  • Represent the station throughout the community and foster partnerships that create long-term value and impact.
  • Ensure responsive, professional communication with community members, partners, and stakeholders, ensuring audience inquiries are acknowledged, routed and resolved in a timely and professional manner.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs, and other community engagement activities.
  • Partner with News, Sales, Marketing, and station leadership to create meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics, stakeholder coordination, and effectiveness measurement to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant, and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities.
  • Advise station leadership on community needs, emerging issues, and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, while sharing best practices, tracking outcomes, and developing team capabilities.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations, or related fields.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills
  • Strong community listening skills and ability to recognize emerging issues and opportunities
  • Strategic thinking and judgment; ability to translate insight into action
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing and presentation skills
  • Ability to influence across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations and community organizations
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion and integrity
  • Ability to work independently and adapt to change
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM/community relationship platforms and collaboration tools
  • Strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns and sensitive community issues

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Salt Lake City is a city that surprises and inspires. Nestled against the dramatic backdrop of the Wasatch Mountains, it offers an unmatched quality of life for outdoor enthusiasts and culture lovers alike. Within an hour's drive you'll find some of the best skiing in the world at world-renowned resorts including Alta, Snowbird, Park City, Brighton, and Solitude — and in warmer months, those same mountains transform into a playground for hiking, mountain biking, and trail running. The nearby Great Salt Lake, Red Butte Garden, and an extensive network of urban trails mean adventure is always close at hand.


Downtown Salt Lake City is a thriving, walkable hub with a booming food and arts scene, eclectic neighborhoods, and a growing reputation as a major tech corridor — often called "Silicon Slopes." The city is home to the NBA's Utah Jazz, Real Salt Lake of Major League Soccer, and the newly arrived Utah Hockey Club, giving sports fans plenty to cheer for year-round. Pioneer Park hosts one of the region's most beloved farmers markets, and the Natural History Museum of Utah and Utah Museum of Fine Arts offer rich cultural experiences for residents of all backgrounds.


Salt Lake City also serves as an ideal home base for exploring some of America's most spectacular landscapes. Zion, Bryce Canyon, Arches, and Canyonlands National Parks are all within a few hours' drive, making weekend adventures legendary. With a relatively affordable cost of living compared to other major western cities, a diverse and welcoming population, and the energy of a city that continues to grow and reinvent itself, Salt Lake City is a remarkable place to build a career and a life.

job.title: Sr Producer, Creative Production (remote)
job.description:
Are you a visionary creative leader ready to make a real impact on how audiences connect with local news and station brands across the country? Scripps is looking for a Senior Producer, Creative Production to lead high-impact marketing campaigns and elevate the creative bar for the entire team. In this role, you'll take full ownership of complex, high-priority projects from strategy and concept all the way through final delivery — developing premium, scalable campaigns that strengthen local station and news brands and drive audience engagement across multiple markets. As a creative leader, you'll mentor fellow producers, set high creative standards, and partner closely with Hub leadership and local teams on the initiatives that matter most.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Lead the concept, writing, production, and editing of high-level marketing campaigns supporting station and news brands, audience growth, and strategic initiatives.
  • Take creative ownership of complex and high-priority campaigns from strategy through production, post-production, versioning, and final delivery.
  • Translate brand strategy, audience insights, and marketing objectives into distinctive consumer-facing creative.
  • Develop scalable campaign platforms that maintain a strong creative foundation while allowing for local customization.
  • Write and refine scripts, promotional copy, headlines, taglines, and campaign messaging.
  • Produce and edit sophisticated, broadcast-quality video using advanced visual storytelling, sound design, graphics, and motion design.
  • Direct production shoots, including talent, field production, and other creative resources.
  • Extend creative concepts across broadcast, streaming/OTT, digital, social, and other platforms.
  • Partner with team leadership, local and regional marketing teams, News, and other stakeholders on major marketing initiatives.
  • Serve as a creative resource to stations, helping teams identify strong storytelling approaches and executions.
  • Establish and maintain high creative standards across Hub-produced work.
  • Provide creative direction, feedback, and mentorship to Producers and other creative team members.
  • Identify opportunities to improve creative workflows and production processes across markets.
  • Manage multiple complex projects and deadlines while maintaining high creative and technical standards.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising, Film/Video Production, Journalism, or related field preferred; or equivalent work experience
  • Generally, 5+ years of professional experience in marketing, advertising, broadcast promotion, creative services, agency production, or a comparable creative environment preferred
  • Proven experience leading significant marketing campaigns from concept through final delivery.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Exceptional conceptual thinking, writing, editing, and visual storytelling skills
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, with strong working knowledge of After Effects and Photoshop
  • Experience producing creative across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms.
  • Strong understanding of branding, positioning, and audience-focused marketing
  • Experience managing complex creative projects involving multiple stakeholders, deliverables, platforms, or markets
  • Strong creative judgment and demonstrated ability to provide effective creative direction and feedback
  • Excellent organizational, communication, presentation, project-management, and collaboration skills
  • Ability to independently own significant assignments while working effectively with teams and stakeholders

job.title: Sr Reporter, KMVT
job.description:
At KMVT, local journalism is about more than covering the news. It’s about building lasting relationships with the people and communities that make southern Idaho home. As a Senior Reporter, you’ll bring experience, curiosity, and strong journalistic judgment to investigative, long-form, breaking, and multi-platform reporting that matters to local audiences.


You’ll develop trusted sources, dig deeper into the stories shaping the region, and create meaningful journalism with accuracy, fairness, and authenticity at its core. This is an opportunity to become deeply connected to the community and make a lasting impact at a station where local relationships matter. For an experienced journalist looking for a place to put down roots, Twin Falls offers an appealing combination of community connection, an affordable lifestyle, and access to Idaho’s remarkable outdoors.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Develop a strong network of sources throughout southern Idaho and build authentic relationships with community members and local experts.
  • Investigate public records, cultivate personal sources, and conduct in-depth research to uncover and tell meaningful stories.
  • Lead coverage of significant breaking news and pursue investigative and long-form reporting that provides context and value to local audiences.
  • Create compelling multi-platform journalism using video, photography, graphics, digital storytelling, and other visual elements.
  • Report live from the field and operate cameras with still photography and video capabilities.
  • Connect audiences with a diversity of perspectives and stories that strengthen community belonging.
  • Collaborate with newsroom colleagues on editorial and content planning, workflows, best practices, and multimedia coverage that meets strategic goals and deadlines.
  • Maintain the highest standards of accuracy, objectivity, fairness, ethics, and sensitivity to community expectations.
  • Engage with the community beyond daily assignments by participating in local events and staying closely connected to the issues important to the region.
  • Drive a personal or company vehicle periodically to cover assignments throughout the market.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • A bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of experience is preferred.
  • Generally, 5+ years of news reporting experience, including in-depth or long-form reporting, is required; experience with community, digital, and solutions-based journalism is preferred.
  • A valid driver’s license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance meeting company-required limits are required.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Deep expertise in investigative and long-form reporting and a strong command of journalistic standards.
  • A talent for memorable storytelling and a distinct, engaging on-air presence.
  • A consumer-focused approach and commitment to understanding what matters most to local audiences.
  • Strong multimedia skills spanning reporting, writing, web publishing, still photography, online video, infographics, databases, and social media.
  • Knowledge of reporting fundamentals, including privacy, ethics, access, open meetings, public records, and applicable state and federal requirements.
  • Exceptional accuracy, fairness, editing, writing, and working knowledge of Associated Press style.
  • Ability to use digital, video, mapping, social networking, and other technology to strengthen reporting across platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook, along with web publishing tools.
  • Adaptability, emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and the ability to produce strong journalism in a deadline-driven newsroom.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

OUR TEAM:

At KMVT, you’ll join a newsroom that values curiosity, collaboration, and a genuine connection to the people it serves. Our team brings different experiences, interests, and perspectives to the work, but shares a commitment to journalism that helps southern Idaho audiences better understand their communities. We believe the strongest local reporting starts with listening, showing up, earning trust, and investing in the relationships that turn a station into a true community partner.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Twin Falls gives you the opportunity to build a life and a career in southern Idaho, with a strong sense of community and an affordable lifestyle that can make it easier to put down roots for the long term. It’s a place where a local journalist can truly get to know the people, organizations, and issues they cover, building the sources and relationships that lead to more meaningful reporting.

Outside the newsroom, southern Idaho’s landscape provides an unforgettable backdrop for life in the region. Whether you’re drawn to outdoor recreation, scenic surroundings, or simply the opportunity to become part of a close-knit community, Twin Falls offers a setting where you can invest in your career, your community, and the place you call home.

job.title: Sr. Manager, Community Connections - Central Coast & Southern Central Valley
job.description:
At Scripps, we believe strong local journalism starts with strong community connections. As the Sr. Manager, Community Connections for the Central Coast (KSBY) and Southern Central Valley (KERO), you’ll serve as the station’s primary connector to the Central Coast community and Southern Central Valley Coast, building trusted relationships that deepen local engagement, inform our journalism, and create meaningful partnerships. You’ll bring community voices and insights into the newsroom while helping ensure questions, concerns, and story ideas are heard and acted on thoughtfully. Working across News, Sales, Marketing, and station leadership, you’ll turn community intelligence into opportunities for greater impact. Your work will help ensure these communities remains an essential, responsive, and trusted part of community life. This position will be located on-site at KSBY in San Luis Obispo, CA.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, government, and other community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities, and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, and share community insights with station leadership, newsroom teams, and partners to help inform decision-making, journalism, and local engagement.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources, and strengthen audience engagement across community channels.
  • Represent the station throughout the community and develop partnerships that create long-term value, trust, and local impact.
  • Respond to community members, partners, and stakeholders with timely, professional communication, ensuring audience questions, concerns, and story tips are acknowledged, routed, and resolved appropriately.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs, and other community engagement activities.
  • Collaborate with News, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and station leadership to develop meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics and stakeholder coordination while measuring effectiveness to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant, and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities, advising leadership on community needs, emerging issues, and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, sharing best practices, tracking outcomes, and helping build engagement capabilities across teams.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of relevant experience preferred.
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations, or a related field.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills, with the ability to establish credibility across a wide range of communities and organizations.
  • Strong community listening skills and the ability to recognize emerging issues, needs, and opportunities.
  • Strategic thinking and sound judgment, with the ability to translate community insights into meaningful action.
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations, station leadership, and external community organizations.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion, and integrity when working with diverse communities and sensitive topics.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and adapt effectively to changing community and business needs.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM or community relationship platforms, and collaboration tools.
  • A strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills, and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns, and sensitive community issues.

Application Review: Applications received by November 9, 2026 will receive priority consideration. Applications received after this date may continue to be reviewed as needed.


OUR TEAM:

We’re a team of journalists, storytellers, relationship builders, and community advocates who care deeply about the people and places we serve. At KSBY, we bring different backgrounds, perspectives, interests, and experiences to our work, united by a shared commitment to meaningful local journalism and stronger communities. You’ll work alongside collaborative colleagues who value curiosity, authenticity, responsiveness, and finding new ways to connect with audiences both inside and outside the newsroom.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

San Luis Obispo offers an incredible Central Coast lifestyle, surrounded by rolling hills and within easy reach of California’s coastline. The area blends an active outdoor lifestyle with a welcoming community, local restaurants, wineries, farmers markets, arts, and plenty of opportunities to hike, bike, explore, and enjoy the outdoors.

As Sr. Manager, Community Connections, you’ll have the opportunity to build relationships with the people and organizations that shape San Luis Obispo and communities across the Central Coast. Whether you’re attending a community event, meeting with local leaders, or discovering the stories people are talking about, you’ll be immersed in the communities KSBY serves.
