job.title: Sr. Mgr., Community Connections, WEWS
job.description:
WEWS, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Cleveland, Ohio, is looking for a dynamic Senior Manager, Community Connections to serve as the station's primary bridge to the communities we serve. In this pivotal role, you'll build the trusted relationships that keep WEWS at the heart of Northeast Ohio — turning community intelligence into real journalistic impact, forging meaningful partnerships, and ensuring our station remains an essential, credible voice in the lives of Clevelanders. From leading newsroom community engagement priorities to coordinating forums, town halls, and public-service initiatives, you'll champion connection at every level and make sure every audience member feels heard and valued.


Application Review: Applications received by 11/04 will receive priority consideration. Applications received after this date may continue to be reviewed as needed.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Build and maintain relationships with community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities, and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, and communicate community insights to station leadership, newsroom teams, and partners to inform decision-making and coverage.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources, and support audience engagement across community channels.
  • Serve as the station's primary community liaison, developing trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, and government organizations.
  • Represent the station throughout the community and foster partnerships that create long-term value and impact.
  • Ensure responsive, professional communication with community members, partners, and stakeholders, ensuring audience inquiries are acknowledged, routed and resolved in a timely and professional manner.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs, and other community engagement activities.
  • Partner with News, Sales, Marketing, and station leadership to create meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics, stakeholder coordination, and effectiveness measurement to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant, and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities.
  • Advise station leadership on community needs, emerging issues, and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, while sharing best practices, tracking outcomes, and developing team capabilities.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations, or related fields
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills
  • Strong community listening skills and ability to recognize emerging issues and opportunities
  • Strategic thinking and judgment; ability to translate insight into action
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing and presentation skills
  • Ability to influence across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations and community organizations
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion and integrity
  • Ability to work independently and adapt to change
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM/community relationship platforms and collaboration tools
  • Strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns and sensitive community issues

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Cleveland is a city that surprises and rewards — a place where world-class culture, deep sports pride, and genuine community spirit come together on the shores of Lake Erie. The Rock & Roll Hall of Fame and Museum calls Cleveland home, as does Playhouse Square, the largest performing arts center in the United States outside of New York City. The Cleveland Museum of Art is internationally renowned and offers free general admission, while the Great Lakes Science Center and Cuyahoga Valley National Park — just a short drive south — give residents endless ways to explore, learn, and unwind.


Cleveland's neighborhoods are as vibrant and diverse as the people who live in them. Ohio City's West Side Market is a beloved institution brimming with local vendors, craft food, and community energy, while Tremont, Little Italy, and the Detroit-Shoreway corridor each bring their own distinct character, dining scenes, and arts communities. The city's food culture has blossomed into a genuine destination, with nationally recognized chefs and a range of restaurant experiences to suit every taste.


Sports are a way of life here — home of the Cleveland Guardians, Cleveland Browns, and Cleveland Cavaliers, the city rallies passionately around its teams season after season. With a cost of living that remains affordable relative to other major metros, a growing job market, and a downtown that continues to reinvent itself, Cleveland offers both roots and opportunity for those ready to be part of something meaningful.

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations, or related fields
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills
  • Strong community listening skills and ability to recognize emerging issues and opportunities
  • Strategic thinking and judgment; ability to translate insight into action
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing and presentation skills
  • Ability to influence across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations and community organizations
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion and integrity
  • Ability to work independently and adapt to change
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM/community relationship platforms and collaboration tools
  • Strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns and sensitive community issues

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Buffalo, New York is a city on the rise — a proud, resilient community with deep roots, genuine warmth, and an exciting future. Sitting at the eastern edge of Lake Erie and just across the border from Canada, Buffalo offers an enviable quality of life at a fraction of the cost of larger metros. The revitalized waterfront along Canalside draws visitors and residents alike year-round, with concerts, ice skating, kayaking, and festivals that celebrate everything Buffalo has to offer. The city's rich architectural heritage — including Frank Lloyd Wright landmarks and the stunning Guaranty Building — gives it a character unlike anywhere else in America.


Buffalo is a food lover's city with a distinct identity. From the birthplace of the Buffalo wing at the Anchor Bar to world-class chef-driven restaurants in Elmwood Village and Larkinville, the dining scene punches well above its weight. The arts community is equally vibrant, anchored by Albright-Knox Northland (now Buffalo AKG Art Museum), Shea's Performing Arts Center, and a thriving live music scene. Sports are a way of life here — Bills fans are legendary for their passion, and the Sabres bring NHL excitement to KeyBank Center each season.


Outdoor enthusiasts will find no shortage of adventure. Niagara Falls is just 20 minutes away, offering one of the world's most iconic natural wonders right in your backyard. The region's state parks, ski areas in the nearby hills, and easy access to the Finger Lakes wine country make Buffalo an ideal home base for those who love to explore. With a strong sense of community, affordable neighborhoods, and a city that genuinely welcomes newcomers, Buffalo is a wonderful place to plant roots and make a real difference.

job.title: Supervisor, Master Control Hub
job.description:
Are you a seasoned master control professional ready to step into a leadership role that shapes how great television gets delivered? Scripps is looking for a Supervisor, Master Control to join our centralized Master Control Hub in Indianapolis, Indiana. In this critical role, you'll work alongside the Master Control Hub Manager to oversee the vision, mission, and day-to-day operations of a team that serves Scripps stations across the country. From managing and mentoring a team of Hub Operators to ensuring seamless, consistent service delivery for our internal station partners, you'll be at the heart of keeping Scripps on the air — and doing it right, every time.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Assumes leadership responsibilities when the Master Control Hub Manager is not available.
  • Together with the Master Control Manager, is responsible for the Master Control Operations, which includes program monitoring and logs, signal monitoring, quality assurance checks, and discrepancy reporting.
  • Together with the Master Control Manager, fosters an environment that ensures all of our internal customers have a consistent experience.
  • Ensures Hub Operators have appropriate procedures and training to interact with internal Hub client stations in a consistent and reliable manner. When and how Master Control Operators send alerts, respond to inquiries, collaborate on problem solving, document and/or resolve issues is of critical importance.
  • Manages a group of seven to ten Master Control Hub Operators. Management duties include staffing, onboarding, training, performance management, feedback/coaching/counseling, development, discipline, and corrective action.
  • Constructs, maintains, improves, and oversees the Master Control program for disaster recovery and associated procedures and tests.
  • Performs management and supervisory duties associated with the Master Control team, including staffing, onboarding, training, expectation setting, work assignments, scheduling, performance management, coaching and development, enforcing policies, and monitoring workflow.
  • When on-air problems are escalated, quickly investigates, resolves, and reports results to all parties concerned.
  • Responsible for forecasting and monitoring budgets in conjunction with the Hub Manager.
  • May be involved in performing Master Control Hub Operator duties as needed.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Must have a high school diploma or equivalent. Technical Certificate or training desirable.
  • Technical or Associate's Degree in related field or equivalent experience is required.
  • A minimum of 5 years of Television Master Control experience is required, with at least 3 of those years in a hubbed master control environment.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Demonstrated leadership ability, including engaging, motivating, and building a high-performance team.
  • Strong customer service orientation.
  • A continuous process improvement mindset.
  • Able to construct, implement, and monitor effective work procedures and training.
  • Composure and command skills: Has a settling influence and is looked to for direction in a crisis.
  • Ability to manage and measure work with the appropriate level of detail to facilitate feedback and continuous improvement.
  • Strong working knowledge of video servers, routing processes, and related equipment as well as master control operations.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Working knowledge of all functions and responsibilities of television Master Control and news operation.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Indianapolis is a city that punches well above its weight — a true American sports capital and a thriving Midwestern hub with an unmistakable sense of community. Home to the Indianapolis 500, one of the most storied racing events in the world, and the NFL's Colts and NBA's Pacers, Indy offers world-class sports and entertainment year-round. The revitalized downtown scene along the Canal Walk and Mass Ave arts district is packed with acclaimed restaurants, eclectic boutiques, live music venues, and a craft beer culture that continues to grow.


Beyond the city center, Indianapolis offers an outstanding quality of life with affordable housing, top-rated suburbs, and excellent schools. Outdoor enthusiasts enjoy Eagle Creek Park — one of the largest municipal parks in the country — along with miles of greenways, trails, and the scenic White River. The city's central location makes weekend getaways to Chicago, Cincinnati, Louisville, and Nashville easily accessible.


Indianapolis is also a city of culture and intellect, home to the renowned Indianapolis Museum of Art at Newfields, the Indiana Repertory Theatre, and a vibrant local food scene that highlights everything from farm-to-table dining to beloved neighborhood gems. It's a place where careers are built, communities are strong, and there's always something new to explore.

job.title: Support Engineer II
job.description:
If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges and keeping broadcast operations running at their best, Scripps wants you on the team. We're looking for a Support Engineer II in Clearwater, Florida, to provide tier II installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting support for the broadcast-specific hardware and software applications that power a national television network. In this hands-on role, you'll be a critical resource for stations and teams across the organization — diving deep into difficult problems, leading special projects, and delivering the kind of reliable, expert support that keeps Scripps on the air around the clock.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Configure, install, maintain, and upgrade hardware/software associated with the broadcast air chain and support infrastructure.
  • Research and resolve difficult and complex problems in a potentially stressful environment and/or under time constraints.
  • Perform systems integration, component-level electronics repair, and construction management in the field.
  • Provide training and direction to local station staff in person, over telephone, email, and video conference.
  • Monitor and respond to hardware and software problems utilizing a variety of tools and techniques.
  • Administer and maintain security of operating systems in broadcast and support equipment.
  • Provide continuous and reliable troubleshooting assistance to the 24/7 internal broadcast help desk.
  • Perform emergency recovery, scheduling, and backup procedures.
  • Manage and drive special projects to support the operation of a national television network.
  • Perform other duties as required by senior-level management within the Scripps organization.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Associate's degree preferred or equivalent vocation/technical experience
  • 5-7 years of broadcast and/or IT experience.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company-required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Strong computer networking skills and organizational skills.
  • Able to conform to a high-security environment and execute the rules governing the Scripps company security and controls policies.
  • Able to work in stressful situations and multitask as necessary.
  • Capable of delivering exceptional customer service to individuals around the organization with varying degrees of knowledge.
  • Flexible working hours required, including holidays, weekends, and evenings with occasional overtime.
  • This is an ON-CALL position.
  • Some travel is required.
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Clearwater, Florida, is one of the Gulf Coast's most beloved destinations — and an exceptional place to call home. Clearwater Beach consistently ranks among the top beaches in the United States, offering sugar-white sand, sparkling turquoise water, and spectacular sunsets year-round. Beyond the beach, the city is home to the Clearwater Marine Aquarium, the beloved destination made famous by Winter the dolphin, as well as a thriving waterfront dining and entertainment scene along Cleveland Street and the downtown Marina District.


As part of the greater Tampa Bay area, Clearwater residents enjoy access to a major metropolitan hub just a short drive away. Tampa Bay is home to professional sports teams including the Buccaneers, Rays, Lightning, and Rowdies, as well as world-class venues like Amalie Arena and Tropicana Field. The region also boasts a rapidly growing arts and culinary scene, with acclaimed museums, craft breweries, music festivals, and diverse dining options that reflect the area's rich cultural mix.


Florida's famous sunshine and warm climate make outdoor living a year-round pursuit in Clearwater. From kayaking and paddleboarding on the Intracoastal Waterway to cycling the Pinellas Trail — one of the longest urban trails in the Southeast — there's no shortage of ways to stay active and enjoy the natural beauty of the area. Add in no state income tax and a relatively affordable cost of living compared to other coastal metros, and Clearwater offers an outstanding quality of life for those ready to put down roots on Florida's stunning Gulf Coast.

job.title: Temporary Sr Producer, HUB (REMOTE)
job.description:
Scripps Producer Hub is looking for someone to REMOTELY produce content for stations across the country. This position is temporary (approx. 2 mo) and this individual hired can expect to work through the holidays.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Champion current and new technologies and provide training on those technologies in assigned markets.
  • Develop, organize and write local content for 24/7 station streams across Scripps local media markets.
  • Work directly with local station news leadership and other key employees to select the most up-to-date information for the daypart.
  • Use solid news judgement and creativity to produce a dynamic product following the Scripps content strategy.
  • Assess current workflows and work with key newsroom employees to implement changes that improve effectiveness and efficiencies.
  • Execute time sensitive decisions with independence and clear messaging.
  • Act as an ambassador for the Scripps Content Strategy.
  • Oversee newscast and up-to-the-minute editorial decisions.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally 6+ years of experience as a television news producer preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Avid news consumer, knows where to find news and how to get up to speed on local news happening in Scripps markets across the country
  • Excellent time and priority management skills, highly organized, and deadline-driven
  • Able to build relationships quickly, communicate clearly, and influence without authority 
  • Experience with editing software in a newsroom environment
  • Strong critical thinker with the ability to adapt on the fly in challenging situations
  • Ability to make decisions independently
  • Creative and curious to learn new styles of producing news
  • Big-picture thinker
  • Ability and desire to learn and test new technology

job.title: Client Coordinator
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About the Role

The Client Coordinator sits within Semafor’s Revenue Operations team and plays a central role in supporting sales, client partnerships, and integrated program delivery.

This role is the connective tissue between Sales, Marketing, Program Management, Events, and Ad Operations. The Client Coordinator supports the execution of integrated media programs by partnering with Sales and cross-functional teams to translate client goals into proposals and ensure seamless delivery across pre-sale functions. This role plays a critical part in maintaining organized workflows, clear communication, and a high-quality client experience across Semafor’s media and events portfolio.

This is an ideal role for a highly organized, detail-oriented individual who is excited to learn the media business end-to-end and grow into sales, client strategy, or revenue operations over time.

Key Responsibilities

Media Planning, Pre-Sale Strategy & Sales Support

  • Partner with Sales to support the development of integrated media programs and media plans across newsletters, digital products, custom content, and events.
  • Support pricing inputs, packaging, deal revisions, and rate guidance within established yield and inventory frameworks.
  • Coordinate proposal kick-offs, deal brief creation, internal feasibility checks, cross-functional inputs, and timeline management 
  • Support RFP responses and the creation of polished, visually engaging proposal decks.
  • Prepare for client meetings by compiling research, agendas, and supporting materials; capture notes and draft follow-ups to ensure clear next steps and accountability.

Client Communication & Relationship Support

  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for client coordination, ensuring timely communication and follow-through.
  • Build familiarity with client priorities, sensitivities, and goals to anticipate needs.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure clarity on scope, deliverables, and timelines.

Post-Sale Transition & Program Coordination

  • Support smooth transitions from pre-sale into execution.
  • Maintain client-facing timelines and deliverable trackers.
  • Coordinate campaign launches across newsletters and digital media.
  • Support asset collection, ad specifications, proofs, and confirms in partnership with Ad Ops and Editorial.

Campaign Support, Performance & Optimization

  • Assist with mid-campaign check-ins and performance updates, including basic metric review and insight generation.
  • Help identify potential optimization, added-value, or upsell opportunities in collaboration with Sales.
  • Ensure a consistently high bar for client experience throughout the lifecycle of the program.

Revenue Operations & Internal Coordination

  • Maintain accurate documentation and updates in our CRM (boostr) and workflow tools.
  • Ensure opportunities, products, budgets, and deal details are up to date and accurate.
  • Support maintenance of rate cards, packaging menus, and go-to-market materials.
  • Contribute to process improvements that strengthen pre-sale workflows and cross-functional alignment.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • 2–4 years of experience in media, advertising, communications, client services, account coordination, or related commercial role. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Media, or a related field.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, judgement, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with comfort interacting with clients.
  • Ability to synthesize concepts into actionable next steps.
  • Interest in media planning, integrated programs, and the business of journalism.
  • Ability to operate calmly under pressure and adapt in fast-moving environments.
  • Comfortable managing a high volume of fast-moving work and shifting priorities
  • High ethical standards and respect for diverse perspectives.
  • Comfort managing administrative details, timelines, and a T&E budget responsibly.
  • Boostr experience is a plus.

Additional Job Details

This position is based in New York, NY.

Comprehensive employee benefits: unlimited PTO, medical, dental, vision, short & long-term disability, flexible spending, health savings accounts, life insurance, 401(k), pre-Tax commuter benefits.

Salary Range: Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, etc. Base: $65,000 - $72,000 per year.

Additional job details

Semafor offers a Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) policy to our full-time, salaried employees who may take paid time off as-needed without a prescribed limit or defined balance.

Semafor, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and enthusiastically encourages people from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. Semafor, Inc. will consider all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

job.title: Director, Partnership Management
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

The Role

Semafor is seeking an experienced, strategically minded Director of Partnerships Management to lead high-value client relationships and oversee the delivery of integrated commercial partnerships across live events, digital advertising, custom content, and other Semafor programs.

Reporting to the Head of Partnerships Management, the Director will own the strategic relationship for an assigned portfolio of clients. You will build trusted relationships with senior executives, understand their business priorities, and ensure Semafor's partnerships deliver meaningful value.

This role emphasizes strategic account leadership rather than day-to-day project administration. Directors are supported by Project Managers who handle timelines, deliverables, and routine follow-up, freeing you to focus on client strategy, executive engagement, satisfaction, and commercial growth.

Your Responsibilities

Strategic Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as primary strategic relationship owner and trusted advisor for a portfolio of high-value, complex client partnerships.
  • Build long-term relationships with senior stakeholders, including C-suite, communications, marketing, and public affairs leaders.
  • Develop tailored account strategies aligned with each client's business objectives, and lead executive-level conversations and planning sessions.
  • Monitor account health and client satisfaction, and act as the primary escalation point for relationship-sensitive issues.

Partnership Strategy and Delivery Leadership

  • Own accountability for delivering contracted partnerships to Semafor's quality standards.
  • Partner with Sales in late-stage deals and lead kickoffs that set objectives, expectations, and success measures.
  • Provide strategic leadership across integrated programs spanning live events, executive convenings, digital advertising, custom content, podcasts, video, and research.
  • Assess risks, resolve complex challenges, and manage changes to scope, timelines, or deliverables with Sales and leadership.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Connect clients with Semafor teams including Sales, Editorial, Audience, Concierge, Events, Marketing, Creative, Revenue Operations, and Product.
  • Work with Project Managers to keep visibility into commitments, progress, and risks without duplicating day-to-day administration.
  • Resolve competing priorities with functional leaders and recommend improvements to the broader operating model.

Commercial Growth and Retention

  • Partner with Sales on retention, renewals, and expansion, identifying opportunities to deepen partnerships through additional Semafor offerings.
  • Lead post-program reviews, translate performance reporting into client insights, and make evidence-based recommendations for future investment.
  • Track partnership economics with Sales, Finance, and Revenue Operations to resolve issues affecting scope, revenue, or profitability.

Executive Engagement and Client Experience

  • Design executive engagement strategies that maximize the value of Semafor's global convenings, editorial platforms, and leadership communities.
  • Serve as a senior point of contact at major events and executive interactions, navigating sensitive requests with discretion and sound judgment.
  • Represent Semafor confidently and professionally while maintaining high standards for responsiveness and client satisfaction.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in program management, client services, or a related field within media, marketing, or editorial environments.
  • Experience working with global clients across the US, the Gulf, and beyond, with a deep understanding of and appreciation for cultural, business, and geopolitical dynamics. Experience with clients focused on B2B and B2G strategies is a plus.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, integrated projects involving multiple stakeholders and deliverables.
  • Experience managing large- and small-format events, digital advertising campaigns, podcasts, and marketing services.
  • Expertise in project management tools and methodologies, with a strong focus on operational efficiency.
  • Deep understanding of and respect for media, journalism, and the importance of editorial independence.

Additional Job Details

  • Based in New York, NY or Washington, DC, with a four-day in-office schedule (Fridays work from home).
  • Flexible hours around events and domestic and international travel as needed.
  • Salary range: $145,000 – $180,000 per year, based on factors including education, experience, and relevant qualifications.

job.title: Project Manager, Partnerships Management
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

The Role

Semafor is seeking a highly organized, proactive Project Manager to join the Partnerships Management team. You will support the execution of integrated client partnerships across live events, digital advertising, custom content, and other commercial programs as Semafor grows its year-round portfolio of global convenings.

Reporting to the Head of Partnerships Management and working closely with senior Partnership Account Leads, you will own the day-to-day coordination behind assigned partnerships: timelines, deliverable tracking, meeting prep, documentation, and cross-functional follow-up. This frees senior leaders to focus on strategy, executive relationships, and commercial growth.

Project Managers work as a shared resource across the portfolio, collaborating with Editorial, Audience, Concierge, Events, Marketing, Creative, Revenue Operations, and other teams, while functional owners remain responsible for their own deliverables. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career project manager who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys bringing structure to complex work.

Your Responsibilities

Partnership Project Management

  • Own project plans, workback schedules, deliverable trackers, and milestones across assigned client partnerships.
  • Coordinate day-to-day work across multiple accounts, keeping deadlines, dependencies, and owners clearly documented.
  • Flag delivery risks and delays early, escalating to Partnership Account Leads with recommended next steps.
  • Track contractual deliverables from kickoff through final reporting and closeout, including deliverable reconciliation.

Client Meeting and Administrative Support

  • Prepare meeting agendas, briefing materials, status updates, and presentations using approved templates.
  • Attend client kickoffs and planning meetings, documenting decisions, action items, owners, and deadlines.
  • Serve as a secondary client contact for routine matters such as scheduling, asset collection, and reminders, escalating strategic or sensitive issues to account leads.
  • Keep correspondence, approvals, and project documentation organized and accessible.

Cross-Functional Delivery Coordination

  • Coordinate timelines and dependencies across Editorial, Audience, Events, Marketing, Creative, Revenue Operations, Product, and other teams.
  • Track partner requirements for live events, digital advertising, newsletter sponsorships, and branded content.
  • Support smooth post-sale handoffs from the Revenue team, ensuring commitments and objectives are documented.
  • Hold teams accountable to deadlines while specialized teams retain ownership of their work.

Materials, Reporting and Documentation

  • Assemble polished client-facing presentations, updates, and partnership reports.
  • Consolidate campaign performance data and event reporting into clear, client-ready summaries.
  • Run quality and completeness checks on materials before circulation.

Process Improvement, AI and Operational Efficiency

  • Help implement standardized project management processes, templates, and workflows.
  • Use AI and automation tools to streamline meeting notes, action tracking, and status reporting, with appropriate quality control and confidentiality.
  • Contribute to scalable systems that give leadership visibility into workload, progress, and risk.

Professional Development

  • Build deep knowledge of Semafor's commercial products and the full partnership lifecycle, taking on more client-facing ownership over time.

What Makes You Qualified

  • 2–4 years of experience in project management, project or account coordination, or client services, ideally in media, marketing, advertising, or events.
  • Exceptional organization and attention to detail, managing multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders at once.
  • Strong project management instincts: anticipating roadblocks, following through independently, and surfacing risks early.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with confidence working with senior stakeholders and external clients.
  • Strong proficiency in Google Workspace (Slides, Sheets, Docs) and experience with tools such as Asana or Monday.com; familiarity with Boostr or Google Analytics is a plus.
  • Comfort organizing campaign data and turning it into clear, accurate updates and reports.
  • Familiarity with, or enthusiasm for, AI and automation tools that improve workflows.
  • Experience with live events, digital advertising, branded content, or integrated marketing programs is a plus.
  • Ability to coordinate across teams without direct authority, with sound judgment on when to escalate.
  • A collaborative, low-ego mindset; respect for journalism and editorial independence; and interest in global business and geopolitics.

Additional Job Details

  • Based at Semafor headquarters in New York, NY or Washington, DC, with a mandatory four-day in-office schedule (Fridays from home).
  • Flexible hours around events, plus domestic and international travel as needed.
  • Salary range: $74,000–$92,000 per year, based on education, experience, and qualifications.

Additional job details

Semafor offers a Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) policy to our full-time, salaried employees who may take paid time off as-needed without a prescribed limit or defined balance.

Semafor, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and enthusiastically encourages people from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. Semafor, Inc. will consider all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

job.title: Senior Digital Designer
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

Your Responsibilities:

  • Design how Semafor's journalism is presented across digital products, bringing rigorous typography, clear information hierarchy, and strong editorial layout to every story, newsletter, and feature.
  • Work with Product and Editorial to envision and design new news products and formats, exploring multiple visual and structural approaches while keeping readability and usability top of mind.
  • Partner closely with Editorial, Product, and Engineering to design and launch elegant, technically feasible solutions, from story templates to special editorial packages.
  • Hold a high bar for the Semafor reading experience, ensuring our products feel cohesive, considered, and unmistakably ours.
  • Own and evolve typographic standards within Semafor's design system and brand guidelines; ensure visual consistency across platforms and teams globally.
  • Support Marketing and Audience teams in creating brand materials that align with Semafor's digital products.
  • Collaborate with freelancers and other designers, offering critique and feedback that keeps design output consistently high quality.
  • Help build a collaborative, productive design culture as a member of Semafor's design team.
  • Bring a strong point of view on how other news and media brands design for readers: what they do well, where they fall short, and how Semafor can break through.

What Makes You Qualified

  • 5+ years of digital and visual design experience, ideally in media, publishing, or high-growth consumer companies.
  • Sophisticated design sensibilities, with deep command of typography, information hierarchy, grid, and layout.
  • Editorial design experience: you know how to make complex information clear, scannable, and compelling for readers.
  • A portfolio that shows typographic and editorial work alongside shipped digital products.
  • Ability to produce high-quality, production-ready designs with a high degree of independence.
  • Solid grounding in product and interaction design for web and mobile.
  • Experience working with, and ideally developing, design systems.
  • Enthusiasm for collaborating with engineers, editors, product managers, and business stakeholders.
  • Experience working on diverse teams with colleagues from many different backgrounds.
  • Comfort incorporating AI tools into your workflow while holding a strong point of view on craft and quality.
  • Experience in a start-up or fast-moving environment, with flexibility and a willingness to jump in wherever needed.
  • An entrepreneurial drive and an eagerness to learn and grow as the company scales.
  • Passion for the media industry and great journalism.
  • Willingness to work in person four days per week in New York and to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

The base salary for this position ranges from $130,000 - $170,000 per year. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including business needs, experience, level of responsibility, and qualifications.

This position is based in our New York City office with a hybrid work arrangement (in-office Monday-Thursday, remote Friday).  Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States.

job.title: Ad Operations Coordinator, Podcasting Specialist
job.description:
Sinclair is seeking an Ad Operations Coordinator, Podcasting Specialist to join our team!

The Podcast Coordinator supports the planning, execution, and ongoing management of podcast sponsorship campaigns. This role serves as a central point of coordination between Sales, Production, Ad Operations, Campaign Management, and other internal partners to ensure all campaign elements are accurately set up, delivered, paced, and reported. 

 Key Responsibilities 

  • Help maintain podcast sales decks and supporting materials, including current social audience metrics (Sprout), O&O digital metrics, sponsorship offerings, and product details. 
  • Own ongoing podcast Media Kit upkeep, ensuring show pages, decks, marketing materials, and available sponsorship opportunities remain current and accurate. 
  • Assist Sales with Web IO entry and ensure required podcast fields, campaign details, deliverables, and supporting documentation are complete before submission. 
  • Support AOS order entry and billing setup, including verification of campaign details, revenue, flight dates, and sponsorship components. 
  • Serve as the primary JIRA ticket owner once a podcast campaign is submitted by Sales; monitor ticket progress, coordinate next steps, and ensure questions or blockers are resolved promptly. 
  • Schedule and facilitate campaign kickoff call with Sales, Production, Ad Operations, Campaign Management, talent/show teams, and other relevant stakeholders. 
  • Coordinate campaign execution across teams to ensure all sponsorship components—such as social, YouTube, audio, live show, podcast page, and O&O display placements—are assigned, launched, and delivered as sold. 
  • Maintain clear communication with internal stakeholders throughout the campaign lifecycle, escalating risks, missing assets, timeline concerns, or delivery issues as needed. 
  • Own the podcast reporting and pacing trackers, ensuring revenue, delivery, campaign status, upcoming deadlines, and sponsor-specific reporting needs are accurately maintained. 
  • Coordinate recurring reporting and pacing updates using available sources, including social, YouTube, audio, O&O digital, and other show-specific reporting platforms. 
  • Support post-campaign reporting and wrap-up by confirming all deliverables have been completed, and reporting has been distributed to the appropriate teams. 
  • Identify process gaps and recommend improvements that streamline podcast campaign submission, execution, reporting, and billing workflows. 

 

Skills & Qualifications Requirements 

  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines at once. 
  • Exceptional attention to detail and follow-through. 
  • Comfortable working across multiple platforms and systems, including Web IO, AOS, JIRA, reporting trackers, and presentation tools. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Ability to work cross-functionally, manage competing priorities, and proactively resolve issues. 
  • Experience: 1–3 years in ad operations, digital media, audio production, or a related coordination role. Familiarity with podcast production coordination a plus. 
  • Experience in digital advertising, media operations, podcasting, sponsorships, or campaign management preferred. 
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in communications, media, broadcasting, marketing, or a related field

 

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. job.title: Customer Service Manager
job.description:
Are you ready to help customers get clear, timely answers and a dependable supportexperience? In this fast-paced role, you will guide digital support requests from intake through resolution, helping stations and sales teams get the information they need to keep campaigns moving.

The Customer Support Manager is a part of a team that manages inquiries through the Digital Helpdesk and responds to questions about programmatic delivery, campaign setup, access, products, and performance. The team uses a ticketing system to organizeand prioritize work, investigate issues, coordinate with internal teams and vendors, and keep customers informed until each request is resolved.

We value thoughtful communication, accountability, and a strong focus on service quality. If you enjoy solving problems and making support easier for customers, this role offers a meaningful way to contribute to our digital media work.

Customer Support Duties:

  • Manage customer inquiries in the Helpdesk ticketing system from intake through resolution, organizing, prioritizing, and tracking each request.
  • Respond promptly to customer questions and issues, keep requests moving, and resolve them within agreed-upon time frames and service-level expectations.
  • Answer questions about programmatic delivery, campaign setup, product access, and performance in clear language customers can understand.
  • Review ticket history, order details, campaign setup, pacing, and available reporting to investigate issues and identify next steps.
  • Resolve requests directly when appropriate and coordinate escalations to Ad Operations, Analytics, Technical Account Support, Product, Engineering, or vendors when additional expertise is needed.
  • Provide clear status updates, explain next steps, and maintain professional communication with customers and internal partners throughout the resolution process.
  • Maintain accurate ticket notes, supporting details, customer communications, and resolution steps so each request has a clear record and can be followed through to closure.
  • Become an expert in the ticketing system and use its features to manage, monitor, and resolve customer inquiries effectively.
  • Meet or exceed established service-level agreements and other service measures forresponse, resolution, and ticket quality.

Role Requirements

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain information in a customer-friendly way.
  • Strong reading comprehension, active listening, and problem-solving skills.
  • Good organization, attention to detail, and reliable follow-through on open requests.
  • Able to prioritize competing requests and work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, hybrid environment.
  • Able to stay calm, professional, and helpful when responding to customer questions or concerns.
  • Commitment to meeting service-level agreements, response and resolution time frames, and quality standards.
  • Willing to learn, receive feedback, and adapt to changing products, systems, and priorities.
  • Customer service, helpdesk, or digital advertising experience preferred.
  • Experience with Jira or another ticketing system is a plus; able to learn ticket workflows and system features in depth.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel, or similar tools.
  • Knowledge of programmatic advertising, digital campaign delivery, or ad operations is a plus.
  • Candidates must be available during regular US business hours, including Pacific Standard Time as needed 

Qualifications

  • College Degree
  • 2+ years job experience ideally in the digital industry

 

The base salary compensation range for this role is $42,500 to $50,000. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Director, Sales and Marketing
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

o Help Us Thrive: You'll be at the forefront of our efforts to amplify our sales and marketing strategy. Your main mission will be to amplify our market presence while ensuring we hit our ambitious sales targets. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!


o Results-Driven: Amplify our media sales efforts by leading the sales team to implement local sales and marketing strategies to attract, grow and retain business, showcase opportunities and deliver results across our multi-media content platforms and digital assets.


o Strategic Planning: You'll develop and implement innovative sales and marketing strategies that will amplify our sales performance. You'll be the mastermind behind tactics that not only meet but exceed our sales goals.


o Team Development:  Leading, mentoring, and inspiring a team of sales professionals is no small feat! Your ability to motivate and enhance their skills will be crucial in driving performance and achieving success together.


o Market Analysis: Dive deep into market trends, data, and customer needs. By understanding what drives our clients, you'll identify new opportunities for expansion and growth, ensuring we stay ahead of the competition.


o Authentic Relationships: Building strong, lasting relationships with key clients and stakeholders is crucial. You'll be the driving force behind our brand, amplifying customer satisfaction and loyalty through excellent service.


What We're Looking For 

o Proven Sales Ability: We're looking for someone with experience as a Sales Director or other sales management and leadership roles, ideally in a media-related industry. We value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 


o High-Impact: A passion for achieving sales goals, amplifying growth and a results-driven mindset will set you apart. We want someone who's excited to push boundaries in a digital first environment and make an impact.


o Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical skills to assess market data and trends. Your insights will help guide our sales and marketing strategies.


o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships, negotiating and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 


o A Passion for Leading Others: You should be able to inspire your team, amplify their strengths while guiding them toward our collective goals, foster a collaborative environment and make a difference.


o A Willingness to Grow:  Do you thrive in unified environments? The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.


The Practical Stuff 

o A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 


Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a bold team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.


o The Compensation Package: Enjoy competitive base salary with an enticing results-based bonus structure that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.


o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)


o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.


AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Drive Auto Account Manager
job.description:
AMP is seeking an accomplished, proactive, and strategically minded Drive Auto Account Manager to join our automotive Account Management team. This role serves as a knowledgeable digital marketing resource and strategic partner to local sales teams and automotive advertisers, with a particular focus on the highly competitive Tier 3 automotive dealership market.

The ideal candidate combines strong digital advertising knowledge, analytical thinking, and communication skills with a proven ability to build and maintain client relationships. This individual will leverage performance data, industry expertise, and strategic insights to help automotive advertisers achieve their business objectives while identifying opportunities for continued growth.

As a key partner in the post-sale client relationship, the Drive Auto Account Manager will proactively oversee advertising performance, collaborate with internal teams to address challenges, and deliver analysis and recommendations that support client retention and long-term success. Success in this role requires someone who takes ownership, works independently, and builds trust through strong communication and follow-through.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Manage assigned automotive advertiser relationships, identify potential risks, and build strong partnerships with local markets and clients to support long-term retention.
  • Partner with local sales teams, automotive advertisers, and internal stakeholders to evaluate marketing strategies, identify optimization opportunities, and keep advertising programs aligned with client objectives.
  • Proactively monitor campaign pacing, performance, and overall account health. Identify trends, investigate concerns, and recommend adjustments that support advertiser goals.
  • Prepare and lead Business Reviews that go beyond campaign metrics to explain performance, identify contributing factors, connect results to dealership business objectives, and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Investigate campaign concerns, coordinate solutions with internal teams, and maintain ownership and follow-through to ensure issues are resolved.
  • Maintain clear, proactive communication with clients and local markets, providing timely updates, setting expectations, and strengthening relationships.
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing advertiser relationships through strategic recommendations, additional digital advertising products, and investment opportunities aligned with client objectives.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of digital advertising products, dealership operations, consumer behavior, and industry trends to support informed recommendations.
  • Work closely with Media, Technology, Operations, and other internal teams to coordinate campaign needs and support successful execution.
  • Maintain accurate account information, manage competing priorities, track outstanding responsibilities, and ensure appropriate documentation and timely follow-through.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned in support of the Account Management team and organizational objectives.

 

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in digital account management, client success, digital marketing, or a related client-facing role.
  • Strong understanding of digital advertising products, campaign performance, and common marketing KPIs.
  • Demonstrated experience building, maintaining, and strengthening client relationships.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to interpret data and develop meaningful recommendations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly and confidently.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple accounts, deadlines, and competing priorities.
  • Proven ability to independently investigate concerns, solve problems, and coordinate solutions across teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in digital advertising, account management, or client success.
  • Experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, YouTube advertising, and Connected TV (CTV/OTT).
  • Familiarity with Tier 3 automotive advertising, dealership operations, inventory management, lead generation, and key dealership business drivers.
  • Experience analyzing multi-channel advertising performance and connecting marketing results to business objectives.
  • Familiarity with marketing technology (MarTech), attribution platforms, CRM systems, and digital reporting dashboards.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Jira, or similar account-management and workflow systems.
  • Experience presenting campaign performance, leading client meetings, and developing strategic recommendations.

job.title: General Assignment Reporter
job.description:
WLUK/WCWF is looking for a take-charge General Assignment Reporter to help us continue to grow and empower our audiences! We are seeking a motivated, energetic, creative, and aggressive reporter who can think and perform outside the box. The ideal candidate should be able to develop focused story ideas and gather information for newscasts, have sound writing skills, a great work ethic, and a can-do attitude. The best person for this job will have excellent live shot skills and thrives on breaking impactful government accountability stories.

No day will look the same as a reporter, however, the main responsibilities of the role will include:

  • Research, plan, write and edit meaningful stories for station’s newscast and website that can be used across multiple platforms
  • Provide news on-air and online as directed from the news management team
  • Engaging with local community members
  • Reviewing material for fairness, accuracy, and balance
  • Work closely with all members of the news team, which includes photographers, producers, anchors and managers

  • Proven knowledge and experience working with current media creation tools and contemporary newsroom systems
  • Excel in storytelling across multiple platforms
  • Strong writing and copy-editing skills are a must

  • Must be able to work well under pressure to meet strict deadlines

job.title: Lead Product Designer
job.description:
Tennis Channel is looking for a Lead Product Designer to help shape the future of our digital experiences across streaming (OTT), mobile, and web. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, craft, and execution. You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and content teams to design industry-leading streaming applications that make tennis—and everything around it—more accessible to fans.

 

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys taking products from 0–1, brings strong design thinking to organizations ready for it, and loves solving complex, strategic problems through systems design. As an early hire in a growing product organization, you’ll help raise the bar for design quality, establish expectations of excellence, and influence how design shows up across the company. You’ll also learn how to take ideas from concept to production, help shift an organization toward a true product mindset, and grow through close 1:1 mentorship as part of a small, high-impact team.

 

We’re a team of tennis obsessives who care deeply about the sport and take pride in building great products together. We work hard, play hard, and genuinely enjoy collaborating with people who are curious, thoughtful, and passionate about what they do.

Tennis Channel operates multiple broadcast and digital platforms, including Tennis Channel, T2, Pickleball TV, and Tennis.com. While this role will focus on our dedicated OTT experiences, responsive web, and native mobile apps, you’ll be designing within a broader ecosystem that reaches fans wherever they watch and engage with the sport.

 

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Design end-to-end product experiences across OTT, mobile, and web — from early concepts and AI-assisted prototyping through high-fidelity execution

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and Engineers to define problems, rapidly prototype and explore solutions using AI-powered tools, and ship high-quality work

  • Contribute to and help evolve the Tennis Channel design system, patterns, and accessibility standards

  • Evolve the brand look and feel across the digital ecosystem

  • Present work clearly to cross-functional partners and leadership, articulating design rationale and tradeoffs

  • Participate in critiques and feedback loops, both giving and receiving thoughtful, actionable feedback

  • Conduct or collaborate on research to incorporate insights, testing, and validation into your design process

  • Balance multiple projects and priorities while maintaining a high bar for craft and usability

  • Model strong design processes and collaboration practices within the team, embracing AI-powered tools to accelerate prototyping, experimentation, and iteration.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience as a product designer working on consumer-facing digital products

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design work, including complex flows and systems

  • Experience designing for mobile and web; OTT/TV experience is a strong plus

  • Excellent visual, interaction, and systems design skills with strong attention to detail

  • Comfort working in Figma, including components, libraries, and design systems

  • Experience using AI-powered tools to rapidly prototype, explore interactions, and accelerate design iteration. 

  • Solid understanding of accessibility, usability, and inclusive design principles

  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and communicate clearly with non-design partners

  • Ability to think strategically while staying grounded in execution

  • Passion for sports, media, or entertainment products is a plus (tennis fans get bonus points)

  • Ability to work in person in Santa Monica three days per week

Tennis Channel is the only multiplatform destination dedicated solely to tennis year-round. Together, the Tennis Channel flagship network, Tennis Channel 2, and the Tennis Channel app (tennischannel.com) deliver the most accessible and concentrated single-sport coverage anywhere. As the exclusive U.S. home of the ATP Tour and WTA Tour, Tennis Channel features live coverage of every Masters 1000 tournament — including Indian Wells, the Miami Open, Madrid, Rome, Cincinnati, and more — alongside live studio programming including its premier series, TC Live. Tennis Channel 2, a free FAST channel available in over 100 million homes, brings fans matches from across the globe at every level of the game. The Tennis Channel app brings it all together in one place, delivering live and on-demand matches, original content, and a personalized multi-view experience for fans, available on mobile and connected TV devices. Owned by Sinclair, Tennis Channel is also a co-owner of PickleballTV (pickleballtv.com), a joint venture with the Professional Pickleball Association.

job.title: Manager, Production Finance
job.description:
Tennis Channel’s Production Finance Manager manages day-to-day production accounting and financial analysis for domestic and international production activities. Reporting to the Director of Production Finance, the role supports live events, studio productions, original content, and digital initiatives through accurate close, event cost reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and financial controls. The manager works closely with Production, FP&A, and Accounting, coordinating broader accounting requirements with the Director of Accounting. This role is onsite and located in Santa Monica, CA.

In this role, you will do the following:

  • Manage the production-related monthly close in accordance with corporate deadlines, including production and program costs by line of business, prepaid assets, accrued liabilities, amortization entries, and account reconciliations. Maintain job-cost schedules and supporting calculations; reconcile production records to the general ledger and investigate discrepancies.
  • Support the Director of Production Finance in preparing annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, long-range planning schedules, variance analyses, and monthly reporting packages for Finance and Production leadership.
  • Maintain event-level estimates of total expected costs, incorporating actual spending, outstanding commitments, and remaining costs. Review assumptions with Production, explain cost drivers, and escalate potential overruns, forecast changes, and financial risks promptly.
  • Track production costs, vendor obligations, talent commitments, and open purchase orders. Prepare recurring event cost reports and post-event analyses, including budget-to-actual comparisons and recommendations for future planning.
  • Review crew payroll, timecards, overtime, labor coding, and related production labor costs for accuracy, budget impact, supporting documentation, and required approvals. Coordinate exceptions with Production, HR, and payroll providers in accordance with established responsibilities and approval authority.
  • Review production payables, purchasing card activity, employee expense reimbursements, and per diem payments for appropriate coding, documentation, approvals, and compliance with policy. Approve transactions within delegated authority and coordinate with Corporate AP and expense systems, including Concur.
  • Support financial review of production agreements and vendor commitments for cost tracking, accounting treatment, payment timing, and budget impact. Escalate exceptions to the Director of Production Finance and coordinate technical accounting questions with the Director of Accounting.
  • Serve as a day-to-day finance contact for Production on project setup, chart of accounts, transactional workflows, policies, and procedures. Coordinate with Production on financial requirements while Production retains responsibility for talent, hotel, and crew booking and operational logistics.
  • Prepare production-related audit schedules and supporting documentation, coordinating submissions and requests through the Director of Accounting. Support Corporate tax requests related to production, including international costs and tax/VAT documentation, as directed by Accounting and Corporate Tax.
  • Coordinate production accounting priorities, close deadlines, and supporting work with Finance and Accounting team members. Maintain clear process documentation, reporting calendars, and follow-up on unresolved items.
  • Improve production accounting, forecasting, and reporting processes through standardized templates, reconciliations, and approved automation and AI-enabled tools. Maintain cost benchmarks, savings trackers, and operational metrics across vendors, staffing, travel, and other production spending.
  • Support production-related corporate initiatives, parent-company integration, and system upgrades under the Director of Production Finance, coordinating with the Director of Accounting and VP Finance/Controller as appropriate.

 

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA or a relevant master’s degree preferred.
  • Five to seven years of progressive accounting or finance experience, including hands-on budgeting, forecasting, production or project job costing, monthly close, and reconciliations.
  • Experience in live sports, production finance, entertainment, or media preferred; familiarity with domestic and international production costs is valuable.
  • Ability to build and maintain event cost forecasts, analyze actuals and commitments, and translate financial results into clear explanations for production managers and Finance leadership.
  • Strong understanding of accrual accounting, financial controls, production labor and vendor cost review.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, and financial modeling; experience with Oracle or a comparable ERP/project accounting system preferred.
  • Strong communication, organization, and judgment; ability to manage competing deadlines, work independently, collaborate across teams, and deliver accurate work with appropriate review.
  • Experience documenting processes and improving reporting workflows; familiarity with BI tools and approved automation is a plus.

job.title: Manager, Sales and Marketing
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

 At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

 Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat.  Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

 o Help Us Thrive: You'll be at the forefront of our efforts to amplify our sales strategies and elevate our market presence. Your main mission will be to lead our sales team to new heights while fostering a culture of success and motivation. We believe that with the right guidance, our team can achieve remarkable results, and that's where you come in. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!

 o Results-Driven: Amplify our media sales efforts by managing the sales team to implement local sales and marketing strategies to attract, grow and retain business, showcase opportunities and deliver results across our multi-media content platforms and digital assets.

 o Strategic Planning: You'll develop and implement cutting edge sales and marketing plans that not only amplify our reach but also align with our company goals.

 o Team Leadership:  Leading a team of sales professionals is no small feat! You'll mentor and inspire them to hit and exceed their targets while cultivating a collaborative environment.

 o Market Analysis: Keeping an eye on market trends and customer needs is essential. You'll identify new opportunities for expansion and growth, ensuring we stay ahead of the competition.

 o Authentic Relationships: Building strong, lasting relationships with key clients is crucial. You'll be the face of our brand, amplifying customer satisfaction and loyalty through excellent service.

 o Dynamic Oversight: You'll track sales performance metrics and provide insightful reports to senior management, helping us make data-driven decisions.

 What We're Looking For 

 o Proven Sales Ability: We're looking for someone with experience in sales management or someone fully ready to take their next career step in sales leadership, ideally in a media-related industry. We value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 o High-Impact: A passion for achieving sales goals and a results-driven mindset will set you apart. We want someone who's excited to push boundaries in a digital first environment and make an impact.

 o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships, negotiating and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 o A Passion for Leading Others: You should be able to inspire your team, amplify their strengths while guiding them toward our collective goals, and make a difference.

 o A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in transformative environments? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.

 The Practical Stuff 

 o A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of an agile team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.

 o The Compensation Package: Enjoy a competitive base salary with an enticing results-based bonus structure that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.

 o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)

 o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.

 AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.     EEO AND INCLUSIVITY Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace.
