job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 
 At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 
 Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat.  Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 
 o Help Us Thrive: You'll be at the forefront of our efforts to amplify our sales strategies and elevate our market presence. Your main mission will be to lead our sales team to new heights while fostering a culture of success and motivation. We believe that with the right guidance, our team can achieve remarkable results, and that's where you come in. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!
 o Results-Driven: Amplify our media sales efforts by managing the sales team to implement local sales and marketing strategies to attract, grow and retain business, showcase opportunities and deliver results across our multi-media content platforms and digital assets.
 o Strategic Planning: You'll develop and implement cutting edge sales and marketing plans that not only amplify our reach but also align with our company goals.
 o Team Leadership:  Leading a team of sales professionals is no small feat! You'll mentor and inspire them to hit and exceed their targets while cultivating a collaborative environment.
 o Market Analysis: Keeping an eye on market trends and customer needs is essential. You'll identify new opportunities for expansion and growth, ensuring we stay ahead of the competition.
 o Authentic Relationships: Building strong, lasting relationships with key clients is crucial. You'll be the face of our brand, amplifying customer satisfaction and loyalty through excellent service.
 o Dynamic Oversight: You'll track sales performance metrics and provide insightful reports to senior management, helping us make data-driven decisions.
 What We're Looking For 
 o Proven Sales Ability: We're looking for someone with experience in sales management or someone fully ready to take their next career step in sales leadership, ideally in a media-related industry. We value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 
 o High-Impact: A passion for achieving sales goals and a results-driven mindset will set you apart. We want someone who's excited to push boundaries in a digital first environment and make an impact.
 o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships, negotiating and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 
 o A Passion for Leading Others: You should be able to inspire your team, amplify their strengths while guiding them toward our collective goals, and make a difference.
 o A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in transformative environments? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.
 The Practical Stuff 
 o A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 
 Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 
 o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of an agile team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.
 o The Compensation Package: Enjoy a competitive base salary with an enticing results-based bonus structure that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.
 o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)
 o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.
 AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. job.title: Master Control Operator
job.description:
Sinclair’s content technology is at the core of our operational excellence. We thrive on innovation and a passion for connecting people with the best local news and sports content. As we grow our content offerings and expand our broadcast, cable, and digital distribution channels, we are embracing modern technologies to fuel that growth. We are excited by the promise of cloud-first approaches and artificial intelligence in media systems. Sinclair believes that flexibility and agility will address rapidly changing media environments and we are confident that great people and great technology equal great solutions.

The role of Master Control Operator is responsible for operating the multi-channel and multi-brand control point for Sinclair Television Stations located in Bristol, VA. Duties include, but are not limited to, Live event operations, graphics insertion, playlist manipulation, and monitoring on-air quality of the TV Station to ensure all content airs accurately and reflects the traffic and programming schedules.

Additional responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Understand and follow standard operating procedures for various networks, including high profile live events and disaster recovery.
  • Modification and verification of playlists for current and future broadcast times.
  • Manipulate playlist for the different “join in progress” scenarios.
  • Consistently monitor on-air material and communicate any discrepancies to Managers.
  • Consistently ensure that playlist information and media content are accurate, which may include but is not limited to:
  • SOM/EOM of segments
  • Database Information
  • Audio specifications
  • Video specifications
  • Secondary events (GPI,SCTE104 and Graphic Insertion)
  • Content
  • Closed Captioning
  • Active Format Descriptor.
  • Ensure proper video routing.
  • Record, Ingest and Prepare content for playout.
  • Monitor equipment for performance / device failures.
  • Capture and document network processes such as timing of log elements, program run times and on air discrepancies.
  • Setup and review content prior to scheduled airtime.
  • Communicate effectively with Managers and Operators to ensure a smooth transition between shifts.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Understand and follow departmental policies.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 1 Year experience in Master Control Operations functions.
  • Experience in Local TV Station Operations. (A PLUS)
  • Experience in Switching Live Local News and Sporting Events. (A PLUS)
  • Must have great attention to detail and ability to multitask, monitoring multiple playlists and video monitors simultaneously.
  • General understanding of industry regulations and standards for video, audio, captioning and loudness.
  • Understanding of broadcast technology such as switchers, server playout, automation systems, waveform monitors and rasterizers.
  • Ability to communicate effectively, work under stress and perform as part of a team.
  • Aptitude for operating electronic equipment and the capability to learn specialized applications.
  • Experience with Systems and Hardware for Content Ingest, Playout and Distribution.
  • Knowledge of Amagi CLOUDPORT Automation system. (A PLUS)  
  • Available to work any shift in a 24/7 Operation as well as holidays and weekends.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite. 

 

 

The hourly compensation range for this role is $16.75 per hour. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

 

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.
 About Us

Sinclair, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBGI) is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports. The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 177 television stations in 79 markets affiliated with all major broadcast networks; owns Tennis Channel, the premium destination for tennis enthusiasts; multicast networks CHARGE, Comet, ROAR and The Nest. Sinclair’s AMP Media produces a growing portfolio of digital content and original podcasts. Additional information about Sinclair can be found at www.sbgi.net. 


 About the TeamThe life-blood of our organization is our people. We have a compelling story, a goal-oriented culture, and we take really good care of people. How good? Here is a glimpse: great benefits, open door policy, upward mobility and a strong desire to see you succeed. Ready to be part of a winning team? Let’s talk.

job.title: Meteorologist
job.description:
KATU News is seeking a creative, forward-thinking Evening Meteorologist to lead weather coverage across our broadcast and digital platforms. We're looking for more than a great forecaster. We want an innovative storyteller and newsroom leader who can help viewers prepare for what's ahead by tracking the "next big weathermaker" and explaining how changing conditions will impact their lives.

 

The ideal candidate combines strong forecasting skills with engaging, conversational storytelling and a willingness to experiment with new ways to reach audiences. This role requires someone who can take ownership of our evening weather coverage, develop original reporting, and help shape the future of local weather.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver accurate, engaging, and conversational weather forecasts during evening newscasts, with an emphasis on tracking the next big weathermaker and its potential impacts.
  • Take a leadership role in shaping the station's weather coverage and identifying opportunities for innovation.
  • Develop original, enterprise weather stories that go beyond the daily forecast to explain trends, impacts, and issues affecting our communities.
  • Create compelling, platform-specific content, including short-form videos, explainers, live streams, and interactive storytelling.
  • Experiment with emerging technology, new storytelling formats, and creative approaches to audience engagement.
  • Provide authoritative, calm, and timely coverage during breaking and severe weather, including live cut-ins and extended coverage.
  • Collaborate with newsroom leadership, producers, reporters, and digital teams to develop creative and impactful weather coverage.
  • Build strong connections with viewers through authentic storytelling, audience interaction, and community engagement.
  • Help establish KATU as a trusted, innovative source for weather information across the Portland DMA.
  • Represent the station professionally on-air, online, and at community events.

 

Qualifications

  • Degree in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong forecasting skills and a confident, conversational on-air presentation style.
  • Demonstrated creativity and a willingness to challenge traditional approaches to weather storytelling.
  • Experience or strong interest in developing original content for social media, streaming, and emerging platforms.
  • Strong leadership and collaboration skills, with the ability to inspire new ideas and help bring them to life.
  • Ability to explain complex weather topics in clear, relatable, and audience-focused ways.
  • Comfortable experimenting, taking creative risks, and adapting to changing audience habits.
  • Ability to work effectively under deadline pressure and respond quickly during severe or breaking weather.
  • Commitment to Sinclair's core values and weather philosophy.

 

What We're Looking For

We want a meteorologist who sees opportunity beyond the forecast. Someone who is passionate about helping viewers understand what's coming next, asks "How can we tell this story differently?" and is willing to turn creative ideas into meaningful coverage.

If you're passionate about forecasting, energized by innovation, and ready to help shape the future of local weather coverage, we want to hear from you.

job.title: Project Baltimore Photojournalist
job.description:
Sinclair, Inc. is seeking an experienced photojournalist to join the award-winning Project Baltimore team. This special investigative reporting unit of WBFF Fox 45 News is one of the top investigative teams in the country. Project Baltimore produces regularly scheduled investigative reports on issues in the public education system. The team also produces documentaries, town halls, and program specials. We are looking for a team member who is eager to hone their craft and set industry-standards for impactful storytelling that combines research and data with human emotion. Must be able to shoot and edit character-driven stories with visual punctuation. The ideal candidate will be passionate about storytelling and skilled in creating cutting-edge graphics to help showcase documents and data.

This is a rare opportunity. Project Baltimore is a five-person team of motivated journalists, committed to digging deeper, holding officials accountable and being a voice for the voiceless. As a member of this team, you will be expected to share ideas and work well with others as part of the collaborative process.

Since its creation in 2017, Project Baltimore’s investigative work has been recognized with dozens of honors, including a National Emmy for Investigative Reporting, four prestigious IRE Awards, five first place National Headliner Awards, the SPJ Sigma Delta Chi Award, a National Press Photographers Association First Place award for best documentary. Additionally, Project Baltimore has been named an Alfred I. duPont finalist and has won 50 Regional Emmy Awards, 13 Regional Edward R. Murrow Awards and 11 Associated Press Awards.

Requirements:

  • At least five (5) years of television news photography and non-linear editing experience
  • Must be professional, organized, and responsible
  • Team-player with a good attitude and strong work ethic
  • Self-motivated to work on long-term projects
  • Ability to communicate effectively with team members and interview subjects
  • Ability to accept input and constructive criticism
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, especially After Effects and Premiere Pro
  • Experience with cine-style FX/alpha series Sony cameras is a plus
  • Part 107 Drone License is a plus

 

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

job.title: Sales and Marketing Associate
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

Start Inside. Grow Into Sales.

Ready to launch a career in sales? At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, you can build the skills, confidence, and media know-how to grow into a client-facing sales role.

You’ll start by learning the business from the inside: supporting our sales team, helping develop media marketing solutions, coordinating campaigns, and seeing how great ideas turn into results for clients. As you gain experience and demonstrate your strengths, you’ll have the opportunity to take on more responsibility and work toward a client-facing role.

We’re looking for a curious, motivated teammate who enjoys learning, communicating, and being part of a team that gets things done. You don’t need years of sales experience—just a strong work ethic, a positive attitude, and an interest in building a career.

If you’re graduating soon or recently earned your degree and want a real starting point in media sales, this could be your next step. Take a look at the checklist below. If it sounds like you, hit Apply Now and let’s talk about where this opportunity could take you.

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

o Help Us Thrive: Amplify our sales and marketing team efforts, by helping us to grow our customer base and enhance our brand presence in the market and providing day-to-day business support. This means helping them fulfill orders, manage accounts, craft proposals, create engaging presentations, and develop materials that clearly communicate the benefits of our services. Your creativity will play a huge role here in driving results. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!

 

o Campaign Development: Work with the sales and marketing team to design and implement campaigns that drive sales and amplify brand awareness across various multimedia platforms.

 

o Market Research: Conduct in-depth market research to understand trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities to amplify our sales strategies.

 

o Data Analysis:  Data-driven decisions are the name of the game! Report and analyze sales data, providing insights to optimize our strategies for better results.

 

o Unleash Your Potential: Dive headfirst into the exciting world of media sales, where every interaction is an opportunity to make a lasting impression!

 

o Collaborate and Grow: Work closely with our focused media sales teams and other departments. Ensuring everyone is on the same page creates a cohesive approach to sales marketing, which is super important for overall success. Connect with internal and external clients, building relationships to understand their needs to provide support. Together, we'll amplify our impact and achieve remarkable results!

 

o Stay Ahead of the Curve: Keep your finger on the pulse of industry trends and competitive strategies to ensure we're always a step ahead in the marketplace.

 

What We're Looking For 

o Proven Business Support Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn): Whether you're a seasoned business support specialist or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results.  

 

o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Analytical thinking is important, as you'll be interpreting data and helping with making informed decisions. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must.  

 

o A Passion for helping Others: You are committed to collaborate with various people and departments, so being adaptable and open to working with others will help you thrive in this role to understanding our teams' needs, providing top-notch administrative and business support, and making a difference.

 

o A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.

 

o Attractive Rewards: Enjoy competitive compensation that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.

 

o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)

 

o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 


Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 


Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 


Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  


A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  


A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.  

 

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY 

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be inﬂuenced or aﬀected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Scheduling Specialist (Remote)
job.description:
Sinclair has a great opportunity for you! We have an open position in our Advertising Support Operations department for a Scheduling Specialist. 

Responsibilities and Requirements:

  • The Scheduling Specialist is responsible for scheduling network and commercial breaks in order to maximize Sales inventory. 
  • You will build on air logs and ensure that they contain correct program information and commercial breaks. 
  • You will program syndicated, local, and network shows to ensure accuracy of show numbers and timing, and you will work closely with the stations to confirm that there are no gaps in programming, to code breaks appropriately, and to swing end breaks as needed to maximize the inventory and revenue potential. 
  • You are required to maintain future broadcast logs by scheduling program changes in a timely manner and communicate inventory availability or programming conflicts to stations.

 

Requirements:

  • You are required to provide assistance as needed for all processes as it relates to programming formats and reconciling discrepancies within established time parameters.
  • You must be computer literate, detail- oriented, and able to work under pressure.
  • You must be dependable and self-motivated.
  • Excellent communication and organization skills are essential.
  • Broadcast TV or radio experience is a plus, but we will train the right candidate.


We are seeking candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zone to support collaboration with our team and business hours.

job.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
job.description:
Make your mark in Broadcasting and Digital Media. Sinclair Broadcast Group and Sinclair Digital Solutions are dedicated to making Sinclair a communications powerhouse! We are the largest and most diversified television broadcasting company in the country. Sinclair owns and operates, programs, or provides services to more television stations than anyone and has affiliations with all major networks. Sinclair Digital group is focused on bringing the most engaging content to web, mobile and over-the-top broadcasting to audiences all over the
country!  Our success is the result of extraordinary employees and an exemplary management team who believe in a vision and are dedicated to ensuring a great future for our employees.  Whether you are an industry veteran or a just starting out, you can find it at Sinclair!  We are advancing the world of Broadcasting and we want YOU to join our winning team!
 
Sinclair Broadcast Group seeks a motivated and experienced Senior Cloud Engineer to join the Cloud Engineering Team. The individual will develop, integrate, and support key Enterprise infrastructure solutions.

Responsibilities:
 

  • Be part of a team that builds programs to design, develop, and govern cloud infrastructure across the enterprise.
  • Collaborate with other internal teams and third-party vendors to define best-in-class solutions.
    Proactively monitor KPIs and address areas of improvement for public, private, and hybrid cloud solutions.
  • Configuration, management, and maintenance of cloud-based solutions across public, private, and hybrid clouds.
  • Configuration, management, and maintenance of Windows and Linux servers across multiple cloud environments.
  • Support and deployment of applications running as containers.
  • Develop and maintain business continuity and disaster recovery processes.
  • Ensure cloud security measures are incorporated into infrastructure implementation.
  • Support and participate in the development of architecture designs for enterprise-wide systems infrastructure environments.
  • Drive efficiencies through process automation and Infrastructure as Code frameworks
  • Work with and support all other Cloud Engineering and DevOps team members.

 

Experience, Skills & Competencies:

  • 7+ years of experience in IT engineering.
  • 5+ years of experience directly building, administering, and supporting cloud solutions including compute, networking, load balancers, storage, identity management, and security.
  • 5+ years of experience with scripting and IT process automation – shell scripting, Terraform, Go, JSON, Jenkins, etc.
  • 3+ years of experience with Python development.
  • 5+ years of Linux systems administration in an enterprise level environment.
  • Experience in the architecture, engineering, and operation of containerization and virtualization technologies.
  • Understanding of industry best practices surrounding proper maintenance and support of a 24x7 cloud infrastructure – service and server hardening, tuning, vulnerability management, and patch management.
  • Demonstrable implementation of infrastructure lifecycles including planning, forecasting, implementation, and tracking of projects/assets deployment.
  • Experience supporting and managing private, public, and hybrid cloud solutions.
  • Experience working within an Agile/SAFe framework.
  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills with a focus on data-driven decision-making.
  • Strong presentation skills with deep experience in data usage in dash-boarding platforms.
  • Advanced understanding and experience with monitoring tools.
  • Advanced experience developing Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Ability to quickly grasp technical issues and offer solutions.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Outgoing and enthusiastic personality.
  • Professional business demeanor.
  • Customer-focused attitude and desire to interface directly with end-user clients.
  • Relevant AWS Certifications required – Solutions Architect Associate, and SysOps Engineer.
  • Additional AWS Certifications desired – Security Specialty, Advanced Networking Specialty
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Management Information Systems, or a related field or equivalent work experience.
  • Immediate authorization to work in the US.

 

The base salary compensation range for this role is $130,490.25 to $173,987. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Senior Creative Producer/Videographer, Original Content
job.description:
AMP Sports is quickly emerging as one of the leading sports media companies producing highly engaging content across podcasts, YouTube, and social platforms. Home to some of the top sports podcasts, including “Cousins with Vince Carter and Tracy McGrady,” “The Triple Option with Urban Meyer, Mark Ingram II, and Rob Stone,” “Unfiltered Soccer with Landon Donovan and Tim Howard,” “Post Moves with Candace Parker and Aliyah Boston,” and “Style of Play with Julie Ertz and Kealia Watt” as well as a network of team-focused podcasts, with more shows slated for 2026 and beyond. With a rapidly expanding digital footprint and a reach spanning 180+ broadcast stations and tens of millions of followers, AMP Sports continues to build scalable content ecosystems that drive audience growth, engagement, and revenue.

We are seeking a Senior Creative Producer/Videographer, Original Content to develop, shoot, produce, and launch original, audience-first video and social franchises across the AMP Sports portfolio that expand our shows beyond the core podcast, drive audience growth, and increase the long-term value of our talent and show IP.

Partnering closely with leadership, content, social, production, and marketing, this role will proactively identify programming opportunities, pitch new concepts, and own approved projects from idea through delivery. They will also work with individual show teams to develop more creative, visual, and repeatable in-show formats designed to perform across YouTube, social, and the broader digital ecosystem.

The ideal candidate is a highly creative video-first producer and director with exceptional original content instincts and the production experience to turn ambitious ideas into finished programming. They are a creator and storyteller, and understand how talent-led digital brands grow across YouTube and social platforms. They should be equally comfortable developing a franchise, directing talent in the field, managing a production budget and external crew, or helping a show producer build a stronger recurring segment. Strong hands-on video production skills are required.

What You’ll Do

  • Proactively develop, pitch, shoot, and produce premium original video franchises, recurring series, tentpole concepts, and shoulder programming built around AMP Sports shows and talent designed to drive audience growth.
  • Own creative process from concept through delivery, including development, ideation, pre-production through post-production, and final delivery.
  • Partner with show producers to level up existing programming through creative concepts designed to improve audience growth, retention, and engagement.
  • Extend the AMP Sports talent and show IP beyond the core podcast, with a particular focus on premium YouTube video, repeatable franchises, and original concepts.
  • Own the entire production process of original video content in, studio, field, and remote environments, maintaining a high standard of creative and technical execution.
  • Direct on-camera talent, athletes, and creators in studio and on location, with the ability to shape story, conversation, performance, and creative execution.
  • Lead post-production process, partner with editors and post-production teams to shape narrative through the edit, providing creative direction on larger projects.
  • Ideate original programming built for discovery, distribution, and growth across YouTube and social platforms; use audience and performance insights to inform creative decisions.
  • Work with show leads to develop and maintain a pipeline of programming ideas and opportunities; consult on new show launches and talent development when appropriate.
  • Serve as a flexible senior creative resource across the portfolio, with the ability to step into lead producer responsibilities when needed.
  • Assist developing and managing project budgets, and hire and oversee freelance production teams, vendors, and other external resources to execute approved concepts.
  • Other duties as assigned.

 

Who You Are

  • 7+ years producing and shooting premium original digital video for a media or production company, sports or entertainment brand, agency, creator-led business, or similar.
  • A highly creative developer and storyteller, with a proven track record of originating compelling programming, video concepts, recurring franchises, or similar and bringing them from concept through execution across YouTube, long-form video, social, and other digital platforms.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates exceptional creative instincts and format development skills across premium digital video content.
  • Expertise producing, shooting, and editing content in both field and studio environments across a variety of formats.
  • Exceptional storytelling skills and editorial instincts, with the ability to identify compelling narratives and turn those into high value content that connects with audiences.
  • Experience directing on-camera talent, creators, athletes, and high-profile personalities, maximizing their skillsets.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (or similar), as well as hands-on production skills with cameras, lighting, microphones, etc. in field, studio, and remote settings.
  • Strong understanding of social and YouTube best practices, audience retention, content packaging, SEO, and how content is consumed by audience across platforms.
  • A self-starter, highly collaborative, and able to lead and work across multiple teams while also working independently without oversight.
  • Someone who has a strong passion for creating digital-first content that cuts through the noise and drives significant audience growth.
  • Experience developing and managing production budgets, and onboarding and managing freelancers, vendors, and other external resources is a plus.
  • Highly organized and communicative, ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring all projects stay on timeline and all key stakeholders are involved.
  • Ability to travel and work nights, weekends, or holidays as projects call for.

 

The base salary compensation range for this role is $100,000 to $130,000. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave,vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Senior Financial Analyst
job.description:
Sinclair is in search of a Senior Financial Analyst for our Business Development team as we seek to drive the evolution of the broadcast industry. In this role, you will join a highly analytical, problem-solving team charged with the strategic and financial development of Sinclair’s growth initiatives. Sinclair needs a self-starter who can work effectively and cross-functionally to take the lead on identifying, evaluating, and implementing company-wide initiatives with the goal of enhancing long-term profitability. As a key team member, you will have the opportunity to directly lead business initiatives, provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership, and interface with multiple corporate departments and television stations.

Job duties include, but are not limited to: 

  • Conduct thorough evaluations of current and future business opportunities, including:
    • Financial projections
    • Likelihood of success/market fit
    • Proper leveraging of existing assets
    • Fit with Sinclair’s strategic goals across content, marketing, and distribution
  • Produce and effectively communicate analyses and recommendations for senior management to drive innovation and evaluate potential strategic alliances
  • Collect and analyze data from both internal and external sources to evaluate profitability across multiple lines of business
  • Conduct independent research into new business opportunities
  • Interpret internal and external data with the intention of discerning opportunities for development
  • Complete ad hoc projects as assigned

 

We are looking for someone who has:

  • 4+ years of pertinent experience - various backgrounds will be considered
  • Strategic thinker with intellectual curiosity and the ability to develop creative solutions to complex challenges
  • Proficiency in Excel with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Highly detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and reliable data
  • Excellent communicator with strong interpersonal skills and a history of working collaboratively with all levels of management
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines

 

Work Location:

This position is a full-time, five-day, in-office position in our Hunt Valley, MD office.

job.title: Senior Manager, Media & Technical Operations
job.description:
Drive Auto is seeking a collaborative, hands-on Senior Manager, Media & Technical Operations to lead the teams responsible for paid-media execution and technical support. This role is ideal for an experienced digital advertising leader who combines deep paid media expertise with strong operational judgment, people leadership, and a commitment to high-quality client delivery.

The Senior Manager will lead the Drive Auto Media and Tech Support Managers, providing direction, coaching, and accountability across both teams. This person will ensure campaigns and technical work are delivered accurately and efficiently; maintain strong support and service standards; and keep the organization prepared for changes across advertising platforms and emerging channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coach the Drive Auto Media and Tech Support teams, fostering a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing culture.
  • Oversee the Drive Auto Media team’s execution of paid campaigns, including campaign builds, optimization practices, quality standards, testing, and performance analysis.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and leadership across Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, and other platforms, including emerging advertising platforms, ensuring teams remain current on meaningful platform changes, new capabilities, and evolving best practices.
  • Evaluate the operational impact of platform updates and new advertising products; determine when the team should test, adopt, document, or train on new capabilities.
  • Oversee the Tech Support team’s work across platform configuration, technical setup, QA, implementations, migrations, troubleshooting, projects, and escalations.
  • Monitor and improve service-level expectations, customer service, workflow consistency, and operational processes across the Tech Support function.
  • Partner closely with the Drive Auto Onboarding, Customer Support, and Account Management teams to deliver media campaigns, issue resolution, and platform deliverables on time and with accuracy.
  • Confidently represent Drive Auto in client-facing conversations, presenting recommendations clearly, making decisive calls when needed, and guiding stakeholders toward the solution that best serves the client and the business.
  • Collaborate with Sales, leadership, and other internal teams to align on operational needs, resolve escalations, and support a strong client experience.
  • Mentor and develop team members through regular feedback, coaching, recognition, and training opportunities.
  • Lead by example through professionalism, adaptability, sound judgment, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

 

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in digital advertising, paid media, automotive marketing, or automotive technology
  • 2+ years of experience leading and developing a team
  • Hands-on experience building and optimizing paid search and paid social campaigns
  • Deep working knowledge of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager; experience with TikTok and other digital advertising platforms 
  • Experience overseeing campaign execution, optimization, QA, and performance analysis
  • Experience with technical support, platform implementation, configuration, migrations, troubleshooting, ticket workflows, and client escalations
  • Strong understanding of digital advertising platform changes, industry trends, and the ability to translate them into practical guidance for operational teams
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify operational issues and implement effective improvements
  • Demonstrated ability to balance established standards with thoughtful flexibility, using sound judgment to make client and business appropriate decisions
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and levels of the organization

 

This position will report into the Lafayette, LA office or Hunt Valley, MD office on a hybrid schedule. Drive Auto is a data-driven marketing and technology company helping automotive dealerships reach in-market shoppers and achieve measurable growth. Our collaborative team combines proprietary data, innovative technology, and digital marketing expertise to shape the future of automotive advertising.

job.title: Sr. Security Engineer
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced, technically driven security professional to advance Sinclair’s Information Security program. You will serve as a Senior Information Security Engineer focused on Security Operations, incident response, and advanced detection engineering. You will independently investigate complex threats, engineer high-fidelity detections across endpoint, identity, network, and cloud environments, and strengthen incident response through security tooling, workflow orchestration, and automation. You will also help evaluate and apply AI-assisted capabilities where they improve investigation quality and response efficiency. You will partner with internal teams, business stakeholders, and external security providers to improve detection coverage, accelerate response, and reduce enterprise risk.

Responsibilities:

Processes & Execution

  • Lead technical investigation, triage, containment, eradication, and recovery activities for complex security incidents across on-premises, cloud, identity, and endpoint environments.

  • Analyze security telemetry, authentication activity, process execution, network traffic, and threat intelligence to determine root cause, attack scope, impact, and appropriate response.

  • Perform proactive threat hunting and retrospective investigations; identify gaps in telemetry, detections, and response capabilities.

  • Own high-severity incident investigations, document evidence-based findings, communicate business impact, and coordinate timely remediation with system owners and external partners.

  • Apply MITRE ATT&CK and other relevant threat-informed methodologies to improve investigation quality, detection coverage, and response effectiveness.

  • Demonstrate independent technical judgment, clear communication, and accountability for outcomes in time-sensitive situations.

Engineering, Collaboration & Partnerships

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and continuously tune complex detection mechanisms for multi-stage attacks, identity compromise, lateral movement, persistence, exfiltration, and other advanced adversary behaviors.

  • Correlate endpoint, SIEM, identity, email, network, and cloud telemetry to create behavioral, contextual, and risk-based detections rather than relying solely on static indicators.

  • Develop and maintain detection-as-code content, queries, analytics, and validation tests; assess false positives, data quality, precision, and detection gaps.

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated SecOps and incident response workflows using security platforms, APIs, SOAR technologies, and enterprise ticketing systems to streamline enrichment, investigation, containment, and remediation.

  • Advance security operations automation by integrating AI-assisted analysis and agent-based capabilities, where appropriate, into existing investigation and response processes to improve context, prioritization, and analyst efficiency.

  • Apply established security engineering controls to automated response workflows, including least-privilege access, action validation, approval for high-impact remediation, logging, exception handling, and escalation to analysts.

  • Integrate third-party alert and investigation outputs with internal telemetry to support independent validation, deeper investigation, and consistent remediation.

  • Collaborate with infrastructure, IAM, cloud, endpoint, IT operations, and external security partners to validate detections, remediate threats, and operationalize new capabilities.

Performance Improvement

  • Measure and improve detection coverage, fidelity, mean time to detect/respond, investigation quality, automation success, and analyst effort saved.

  • Continuously test detections and response workflows using attack simulations, adversary emulation, incident lessons learned, and controlled validation.

  • Document engineering designs, investigation procedures, response decision criteria, automation safeguards, and operational runbooks.

  • Identify repetitive analyst tasks suitable for automation while preserving human oversight for uncertain, destructive, or business-disruptive actions.

  • Mentor engineers and analysts through technical reviews, investigation feedback, and knowledge sharing; promote sustainable engineering standards.

  • Evaluate new security detection and response technologies, including AI-assisted capabilities, based on practical operational value, reliability, security, and measurable risk reduction.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information technology, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, incident response, threat detection, security engineering, or a closely related discipline, including ownership of complex investigations.

  • Demonstrated experience building and tuning advanced detections in a SIEM, EDR/XDR, or cloud security analytics platform; ability to explain detection logic and validate underlying evidence.

  • Strong understanding of attacker techniques, Windows and Linux internals, identity-based attacks, network protocols, cloud security, and incident response methodology.

  • Hands-on experience integrating security platforms through APIs, developing orchestration workflows, and implementing automated investigation or response actions using SOAR tools and enterprise IT service management platforms.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted security investigation, agent-based automation, or LLM-enabled security workflows is a plus; specialized AI development or production AI-agent experience is not required.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with the Microsoft Defender security suite (such as Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365, or Defender XDR) and related Microsoft security/identity technologies, including Entra ID.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with enterprise security technologies such as Zscaler, CrowdStrike Falcon, Abnormal Security, Tines, Armis, and Splunk, or equivalent platforms; strong experience across multiple tools is expected, but experience with every named product is not required.

  • Proven ability to investigate incidents and engineer or tune detections directly in EDR/XDR, SIEM, network security, email security, and identity platforms, including querying telemetry, investigating alerts, and operationalizing response actions.

  • Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, NIST incident response guidance, and security engineering best practices.

  • Professional security certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, GCDA, or equivalent preferred.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, cross-functional collaboration, and demonstrated ownership of technical initiatives.

 

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Strategic Sourcing Associate
job.description:
The Procurement team is growing and looking for a full-time Strategic Sourcing Associate to join our team!

This is an excellent opportunity for an early career procurement or supply chain professional looking to build experience in strategic sourcing, vendor management, and purchasing operations. Working closely with the Purchasing Manager, you'll support sourcing initiatives, collaborate with internal stakeholders, assist with vendor purchasing programs, and help identify cost savings opportunities that contribute to the success of the business.

This role offers hands on experience with sourcing, procurement analytics, vendor management, and contract administration while providing opportunities for professional growth and career advancement within Procurement.

The successful candidate will have 0 to 2 years of experience in purchasing, procurement, supply chain, business operations, or a related field. Internship or co-op experience is welcomed. This position reports to the Purchasing Manager.

Essential Job Functions

  • Assist with vendor contract negotiations, renewals, and purchasing activities while partnering with corporate departments and stakeholders.
  • Support sourcing initiatives and assist in identifying cost savings opportunities across vendor spend.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to assess current and future purchasing needs while identifying opportunities to consolidate spend, improve efficiencies, and increase preferred vendor compliance.
  • Analyze purchasing and spend data to help identify sourcing opportunities, vendor trends, and process improvements.
  • Submit requisitions in the Purchasing system on behalf of business units as needed.
  • Administer various vendor purchasing programs across the company.
  • Partner with the Purchasing Manager on sourcing projects and procurement initiatives throughout the year.
  • Gather feedback from business units regarding vendor performance and assist with resolving purchasing related issues.
  • Obtain vendor quotes and support pricing and contract negotiations with guidance from the Purchasing Manager.
  • Assist in resolving vendor issues related to contract obligations, service levels, product quality, and pricing.
  • Provide support to business units regarding purchasing processes, policies, best practices, and contract submissions.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

Other Skills

  • Ability to build professional working relationships with employees, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and problem solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Comfortable working independently as well as collaboratively on a team.
  • Strong computer skills and willingness to learn new systems and procurement tools.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Eagerness to learn procurement best practices, vendor management, and negotiation techniques.
  • Adaptable and willing to take on new responsibilities as business needs evolve.

 

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Purchasing, Finance, Operations, or a related field preferred.
  • 0 to 2 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, operations, finance, or another related business function.
  • Internship or co-op experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, or sourcing is a plus.
  • Strong interest in procurement, vendor management, and strategic sourcing.
  • Experience organizing or analyzing data in Microsoft Excel is preferred.
  • Knowledge of purchasing principles or vendor management is a plus.
  • Oracle Cloud experience is a plus.
  • Purchasing certification is a plus.

 

This position is on site in Hunt Valley, MD. Candidates must be local or willing to commute.

job.title: Alert Team Lead I
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

 

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

 

SiriusXM Connect (SiriusXM CV) is a leading provider of connected services to vehicle manufacturers, delivering one of the most broadly adopted connected vehicle platforms in North America for the last 25 years. Named the 2020 Company of the Year in the Telematics Industry by Frost & Sullivan, we provide safety, security and convenience services to millions of vehicle owners across major automotive brands. Our teams are continuously working to develop leading-edge technology that can not only add convenience to the daily lives of so many drivers across the country but our advancements in safety and security could also help save their lives.


How you’ll make an impact:
As an Alert Team Lead I, you will play a critical role in supporting the daily operations of the SiriusXM Connect Help Desk and Response Center. This position serves as a second-level support resource for contact center agents, internal business partners, and external customers. The Alert Team Lead I is responsible for resolving complex customer escalations, troubleshooting technical and service-related issues, coordinating with internal support teams, and assisting with time-sensitive safety and security requests.

You will also provide guidance to frontline agents, support operational processes, and help ensure customer concerns are handled accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with established procedures. Success in this role requires strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, attention to detail,
and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

What You'll Do:

Operational Support & Escalation Management
• Serve as a second-level support resource for contact center agents, internal departments and external customers.
• Research, troubleshoot, and resolve complex customer concerns involving connected vehicle services, account management, billing, enrollment, and service delivery.
• Handle escalated customer interactions professionally, demonstrating empathy, accountability, and effective de-escalation techniques.
• Provide real-time guidance to frontline agents to support accurate issue resolution and minimize unnecessary escalations.

• Assist with complex service requests, including account adjustments, refund research, subscription issues, and other operational activities.
• Manage multiple priorities while maintaining service quality, accuracy, and responsiveness.

Technical Troubleshooting & Incident Management
• Investigate technical issues involving connected vehicle functionality, remote services, provisioning, enrollment, and system-related errors.
• Research account information, service history, system activity, and technical errors to identify potential causes and appropriate next steps.
• Create, document, monitor, and escalate technical support tickets through established incident management processes.
• Collaborate with internal technical teams to investigate system defects, service interruptions, and recurring technical issues.
• Communicate known system issues, approved workarounds, and troubleshooting procedures to frontline agents and operational teams.
• Follow up on unresolved technical issues and provide timely updates to appropriate stakeholders.

Safety, Security & Stolen Vehicle Support
• Support Stolen Vehicle Location (SVL) requests in accordance with established company procedures and security requirements.
• Coordinate with law enforcement agencies, Public Safety Answering Points (PSAPs), and authorized third parties when handling specialized or time-sensitive requests.
• Assist with exigent requests, missing/endangered person cases, and other safety-related escalations as authorized by company policy.
• Verify required information and documentation while maintaining customer privacy and compliance with established procedures.
• Coordinate with internal departments and external partners to support timely and accurate handling of safety and security requests.
• Maintain accurate case documentation and follow established escalation and
communication protocols.

Agent Support, Quality & Development
• Provide guidance and support to contact center agents regarding complex procedures, troubleshooting, and customer escalations.
• Reinforce established processes, service standards, and customer experience
expectations.
• Identify recurring agent knowledge gaps and communicate coaching or training opportunities to leadership.
• Assist with quality monitoring, interaction reviews, and performance feedback as assigned.
• Support new and existing agents by sharing knowledge, clarifying procedures, and promoting consistent service delivery.

• Contribute to achieving operational performance, service quality, and customer satisfaction objectives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Client Support
• Partner with Account Managers and internal business teams to research customer concerns and support client relationships.
• Provide accurate updates regarding escalated issues, service tickets, and operational concerns.
• Collaborate with technical support teams, operations, and other departments to resolve issues affecting customers or service delivery.
• Communicate process changes, system updates, and operational guidance to
appropriate teams.
• Identify opportunities to improve workflows, reduce repeat contacts, and enhance operational efficiency.

Documentation, Reporting & Continuous Improvement
• Maintain accurate and complete documentation of customer interactions, escalations, service tickets, and operational activities.
• Assist with operational reporting, quality reviews, audits, and special projects as assigned.
• Monitor recurring issues and identify trends that may require additional investigation or process improvements.
• Support compliance with established policies, procedures, privacy requirements, and quality standards.
• Perform administrative duties and other responsibilities as assigned by leadership.

What You'll Need:

Required Qualifications
• High school diploma or equivalent.
• Minimum of one year of experience in a fast-paced customer service or contact center environment.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex information clearly and professionally.
• Demonstrated customer service skills, including empathy, active listening, conflict resolution, and de-escalation.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
• Ability to research complex issues, exercise sound judgment, and determine appropriate resolution or escalation paths.
• Ability to multitask and manage competing priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
• Willingness to learn new technologies, systems, and operational procedures.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with team members and cross-functional partners.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook and other standard business applications.
• Must have legal authorization to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications
• One to two years of operations, customer service leadership, or contact center support experience.
• Experience providing agent guidance, coaching, training, or second-level operational support.
• Familiarity with contact center performance metrics, quality standards, and escalation procedures.
• Experience with customer relationship management (CRM), ticketing, or incident management systems.
• Familiarity with Salesforce, ServiceNow, Genesys, or similar applications.
• Technical troubleshooting experience involving connected services, mobile applications, account provisioning, or system-related issues.
• Knowledge of automotive connected vehicle services, safety and security operations, or telematics.
• Experience working with internal technical teams, external business partners, or law enforcement agencies.

Key Competencies
• Customer Focus & Accountability.
• Technical Troubleshooting & Critical Thinking.
• Communication & De-escalation.
• Operational Excellence & Attention to Detail.
• Leadership & Team Collaboration.
• Adaptability & Continuous Improvement.
• Sound Judgment & Confidentiality.

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. How you’ll make an impact:

The Vice President Assistant General Counsel, Corporate Finance and Securities will lead the corporate finance and securities legal function and provide executive-level oversight and strategic direction while advising on corporate finance, public company reporting, securities law compliance, and capital markets activities. This position will partner closely with Finance, External Reporting, Investor Relations, and senior leadership to support SEC reporting obligations, financial disclosures, financing transactions, and compliance with securities laws and stock exchange requirements. The ideal candidate will bring deep experience in corporate finance, public company securities reporting, and complex financial transactions. The role is accountable for establishing functional priorities, directing legal risk management strategy, and aligning staffing, outside counsel resources, and execution with enterprise objectives.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Lead the corporate finance and securities legal function, setting its strategy, multi-year priorities, operating standards, and measures of success in alignment with enterprise objectives.
  • Oversee and develop the function’s legal leaders and professionals, including performance management, succession planning, coaching, organizational effectiveness, and talent decisions.
  • Own the function’s resource plan and budget, including headcount planning, allocation of legal resources, external counsel spending, and disciplined financial stewardship.
  • Exercise executive decision-making authority over significant corporate finance and securities legal matters, setting escalation protocols and leading resolution of material legal and regulatory risks.
  • Lead functional change initiatives that strengthen disclosure governance, cross-functional operating processes, risk controls, and responsiveness to evolving regulatory and business needs.
  • Play a lead role in providing legal advice on corporate finance, securities matters, public company reporting, and capital markets transactions.
  • Partner with Finance and External Reporting teams to lead the legal review and preparation of SEC filings, including Forms 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, registration statements, and other required financial disclosures.
  • Advise on compliance with federal securities laws, SEC regulations, NYSE/NASDAQ listing requirements, and applicable disclosure obligations.
  • Provide legal guidance on financial reporting and disclosure matters, including materiality assessments, disclosure controls, and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance.
  • Collaborate with Finance, Treasury, Tax, Investor Relations, External Reporting, and Compliance to address corporate finance matters, financial disclosures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Conduct and oversee due diligence processes, identifying key legal risks and opportunities.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business development, corporate development, compliance, finance and tax, to assess deal feasibility and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Support timely and accurate securities filings, financial disclosures, and ongoing public company reporting obligations.
  • Provide legal support for capital markets and corporate financing activities, including debt and equity offerings, credit facilities, refinancing transactions, and other financing arrangements.
  • Provide legal guidance on corporate structure, subsidiary matters, intercompany arrangements, and related corporate finance considerations.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate documentation related to debt and equity financing transactions, credit agreements, and other corporate finance arrangements.
  • Work closely with Finance, Treasury, External Reporting, and Investor Relations to ensure accurate and consistent financial disclosures and communications.
  • Manage relationships with external legal counsel, auditors, financial advisors, and other corporate advisors.
  • Provide strategic legal counsel to senior executives on corporate finance, public company reporting, securities compliance, and related risk management matters.
  • Participate and collaborate with M&A and other strategic transactions as needed, with a focus on corporate finance, securities law, and disclosure implications.

 

What you’ll need:

  • Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school and active membership in a state bar.
  • Typically has 12 years of legal experience in corporate finance, securities, law, public company reporting, and capital markets matters at a major law firm of in-house legal department.
  • Demonstrated executive leadership of a legal function, including management of senior legal professionals, functional strategy, budget and outside counsel oversight, and accountability for enterprise-level legal risk.
  • Strong expertise in corporate finance transactions, SEC reporting requirements, and federal securities laws.
  • Proven experience advising on SEC filings, including Forms 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K, and related public company financial disclosure obligations.
  • Experience advising on debt and equity financings, credit facilities, and other capital markets transactions.
