job.title: Audience Development Executive
job.description:
The Audience Development Executive grows and deepens the audience for Sony Music's C-POP and J-POP repertoire across Taiwan, Hong Kong and Southeast Asia. You will own how fans find our artists, how they move from a first stream to a committed fan, and how we understand and act on what those audiences tell us. 

C-POP and J-POP are two of the fastest-moving parts of our regional business, with releases and campaigns increasingly running across several markets at once and audience behaviour that differs sharply between the two. This role is the connective tissue: setting audience strategy per artist and per release, coordinating rollout across markets, and turning streaming, social and first-party data into decisions the marketing teams can act on. Success looks like measurable audience growth market by market, a healthier conversion from casual listener to superfan, and a release calendar for both repertoires that runs as one regional plan rather than several disconnected ones. 

The role is based in Taiwan, and covers Hong Kong, Taiwan and Southeast Asia (SEA). You will sit within Hong Kong, Taiwan and Southeast Asia (SEA) International Marketing community, reporting to the Director, International Marketing in Hong Kong and working closely with the Head of Creative, Southeast Asia, ensuring regional creative alignment while executing tailored campaigns locally. 

 

What you'll do:

Own audience strategy for C-POP and J-POP repertoire 

  • Develop and deliver audience development plans for priority C-POP and J-POP artists, releases and catalogue across Taiwan, Hong Kong and Southeast Asia, with clear objectives for audience growth, retention and conversion. 
  • Segment and size audiences by market, identifying where an artist is over- or under-indexed and where the realistic growth is, then shape campaign priorities and budget recommendations around that. 
  • Build the discovery-to-superfan funnel for each project: map how listeners enter, what moves them deeper, and where they drop out, and design interventions at each stage. 
  • Own the audience narrative for both repertoires in regional planning sessions, bringing a clear point of view backed by data to marketing, creative, commercial and repertoire centre stakeholders. 
  • Recognise where C-POP and J-POP audiences behave differently, in discovery route, fandom structure, spending patterns and platform preference, and build strategies that reflect those differences rather than applying one regional template to both. 

Grow audiences on DSPs and across the streaming ecosystem 

  • Work with digital service partners including Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, LINE MUSIC, JOOX, KKBOX and regional platforms on pitching, editorial support, on-platform programming and audience-growth opportunities across both repertoires. 
  • Drive playlist strategy across owned, editorial and algorithmic surfaces, including Filtr and other in-house playlist brands, and track how placement translates into sustained audience rather than a single-week spike. 
  • Partner with the digital marketing and media buying teams to align paid audience targeting with organic audience strategy, so spend is directed where it compounds. 
  • Monitor the creator and short-form ecosystem, identifying tracks and moments gaining traction and working with creative and digital teams to amplify them quickly. 
  • Track and act on the discovery routes specific to J-POP in this region, including anime, film and game sync, tour and event moments, and catalogue resurgence, and convert those spikes into retained audience. 

Build first-party data and superfan capability 

  • Grow first-party data capture across C-POP and J-POP campaigns, working with local teams to embed sign-up and data collection into releases, tours, fan events and D2C moments. 
  • Turn first-party data into usable audience segments for CRM, direct-to-consumer and superfan activity, and support markets in activating those segments responsibly. 
  • Identify and develop superfan opportunities that deepen the relationship with the most engaged part of each artist's audience, and support the commercial cases that sit behind them. 
  • Partner with Sony Music Japan and Greater China repertoire centre teams on first-party data and superfan initiatives, feeding regional audience insight back to them and translating their priorities into market-level plans. 
  • Work within local data protection and privacy requirements across each market, in partnership with legal and the relevant local teams. 

Coordinate across markets and repertoire centres 

  • Act as the regional coordination point for C-POP and J-POP releases and activities, aligning timelines, asset delivery and campaign moments across Taiwan, Hong Kong and Southeast Asia. 
  • Consolidate requirements from local marketing teams into workable regional plans that scale while still allowing for hyper-local adaptation. 
  • Maintain visibility of the release calendar and audience plans across both repertoires so markets and the repertoire centres know what is coming and what is expected of them. 
  • Flag risks, clashes and gaps early, and keep regional stakeholders informed of progress and performance. 

Measure, report and improve 

  • Track and report on audience KPIs including listener growth, retention, market share, playlist performance, and first-party data capture, and communicate results clearly to senior stakeholders. 
  • Lead post-campaign reviews, identifying what drove audience growth and feeding those learnings into the next cycle. 
  • Work with the insights, data and analytics team to develop reporting that markets will actually use, and build data literacy across the regional teams. 
  • Stay ahead of platform, format and consumption changes across Greater China and Southeast Asia, and advise the business on what they mean for how we grow audiences.

 

Who you are:

  • 2+ years' experience in audience development, digital marketing, streaming or artist marketing at a label, DSP, artist management company or comparable media business. 
  • Demonstrable track record of growing an artist, catalogue or content audience, with the numbers to show it. 
  • Strong working knowledge of the streaming landscape across Greater China and Southeast Asia, including DSP editorial and algorithmic mechanics, playlist strategy, and platform-specific audience behaviour. 
  • Genuine fluency in C-POP and J-POP: the artists, the fandoms, the platforms they live on, and how audience behaviour differs between Taiwan, Hong Kong and the Southeast Asian markets. 
  • Comfortable with data. Able to work with streaming, social and first-party data, draw a defensible conclusion from it, and explain that conclusion to people who are not analysts. 
  • Experience with first-party data capture, CRM or direct-to-consumer fan initiatives is a strong advantage. 
  • Fluent in Mandarin (Traditional Chinese) and English. Japanese is a strong advantage given the J-POP scope.
  • Strong coordination skills across multiple markets, time zones and stakeholders, with the ability to keep several campaigns moving at once. 
  • Ability to articulate an idea or point of view succinctly, with clarity and confidence, adapting the message to different audiences, seniority levels and cultures. 
  • Responds and adapts quickly to change, maintaining a flexible attitude and using new conditions to evolve their thinking. 
  • A thorough understanding of lifestyle and cultural trends across Greater China and Southeast Asia.

 

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next

job.title: Finance Analyst - The Merch Collective
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

The Merch Collective is a strategic merchandise partner connecting our clients to their fans. We are an agile creative practice built to solve the commercial and creative challenges of the world’s top artists. As Sony Music’s merchandise partner, we serve a roster of global talented—both within and beyond the Sony ecosystem. We’re defined by our commitment to product excellence, delivering products that are made to be kept, worn, and loved for years to come. Our best-in-class creative team delivers culture-leading, artist-specific collections that build artist brands beyond their music. Most importantly, we deliver customer excellence, embedding ourselves as an extension of each client’s team, bringing transparency, accountability, and tailored support to every partnership.

As a Finance Analyst at The Merch Collective you’ll work closely with the Assistant Controller overseeing financial operations, with a concentration on Artist Royalties and Accounts Receivable. Your role will encompass assisting with providing variance analysis and recommended corrective actions to improve financial performance. Success in the role will be dependent on strong analytical skills. 

What you'll do:

  • Assistance with the ownership of all Royalty Statements, including coordination across departments to reconcile all associated revenue, COGS and other expenses summarized in a completed settlement at the end of each Tour. Oversite and management of data calculations to confirm accuracy before final approvals for settlements and payment submissions.
  • Conduct Quickbooks general ledger activity research in analyzing account balance and transaction details and preparing journal entries as needed. Prepare and analyze monthly financial reporting. Daily banking and QuickBooks reconciliations.
  • Assist with Month end close: monthly reporting of actual performance, reconciling financial statements. Research and collection of Accounts Receivable open invoicing.
  • Communications across multiple departments to resolve discrepancies and process outlying data exceptions.
  • Research and special projects as assigned.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • 2 - 3 years of proven accounting experience in a fast-paced environment managing month-end close processes
  • Proficiency with financial systems and tools (SAP Business Objects/BPC experience preferred)
  • Highly skilled in Microsoft Excel (index/match, lookups, pivot tables, etc.) and proficient in other Microsoft Office suite applications
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

job.description:
Established in 1997, Sony Music Entertainment is an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, Japan, with a presence in over 100 countries through our affiliates. We have nurtured some of music's most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Sony Music's Corporate Development team for Asia & the Middle East works across some of the highest-growth music markets in the world, and has been behind many of the region's most significant transactions. Our work spans M&A and minority investments in music and entertainment businesses, music IP catalogue acquisitions, and strategic joint ventures.

We're seeking a highly analytical Manager to join us, reporting to the VP, Corporate Development, Asia & Middle East. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in financial modeling, commercial analysis, and deal execution, with a genuine interest in music, entertainment, and media.

 

What you will do:

  • Financial Modeling: Build and own the financial models underpinning valuation and deal structuring.
  • Commercial Analysis: Conduct industry and competitor analysis to evaluate potential acquisition and investment targets, joint ventures, and strategic initiatives.
  • Due Diligence: Participate in all aspects of due diligence, including financial, tax, legal, and operational; coordinate with external advisors and cross-functional teams across Asia, London, and New York.
  • Deal Execution: Support the end-to-end deal process from initial assessment through closing.
  • Presentation: Draft investment memos to communicate with senior management, crafting compelling stories and presentations that convey complex information clearly and persuasively.
  • Internal Reporting: Maintain the regional deal pipeline and report on the performance of completed investments against the original investment thesis.

 

Who you are:

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, business, economics, engineering, or a quantitative discipline. MBA, CFA, or an equivalent advanced credential is a plus.
  • Minimum of five years' experience in corporate development, deal advisory, investment banking, private equity, venture capital, or a similar analytical role.
  • Exceptional analytical skills, with strong proficiency in financial modeling and a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working with large datasets, such as digital sales and streaming reports, to support deal analysis. Advanced Excel is essential; Python, SQL, or experience using AI/LLM tools to accelerate analysis is a plus.
  • Ability to craft compelling stories and presentations to convey complex information clearly and persuasively.
  • Fluency in English and Mandarin.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Passionate about the music, entertainment, and media sector.

 

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day.
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best.
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next.
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives.

 

Equal Opportunities

As an active part of a culturally and socially diverse society, Sony Music’s aim is that our workforce is diverse and inclusive. Sony Music is an equal opportunity employer and supports workforce diversity.

We employ, retain, promote and otherwise treat all employees and job applicants according to their merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We apply this policy without regard to any individual’s sex, race, religion, origin, age, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition or disability.

Privacy Policy

Please click here to read our privacy policy before beginning the application process as you will need to agree to the terms of the policy before submitting your information.

job.title: Performance Marketing Manager
job.description:
Sony Music Entertainment är ett av världens ledande musikbolag med drygt 5 000 medarbetare globalt. På Sony Music Sverige arbetar ca 80 medarbetare med att dagligen skapa, utveckla, marknadsföra och distribuera våra artisters musik ur vårt breda urval av svensk och internationell repertoar. Vår vision är att vara Sveriges bästa musikbolag och arbetsplats inom branschen, kända för vår innovation, kreativitet och framgång, präglat av mångfald och passion för musik.

Sammanfattning av rollen
Brinner du för performance marketing och mäter du framgång i konverteringar snarare än räckvidd? Sony Music Sweden söker en datadriven, handlingskraftig och analytisk Performance Marketing Manager med gedigen erfarenhet av avancerad, konverteringsdriven digital annonsering. Du planerar, sätter självständigt upp och optimerar ett stort antal kampanjer – med ett tydligt mål; att driva konvertering och skapa långsiktiga resultat.

Du blir en del av vår Commercial-avdelning, där vi inte bara driver kampanjer för våra artister, utan framför allt marknadsför våra spellistor och artisternas största hits genom tiderna, både i Sverige och internationellt. Vi arbetar i grunden som en e-handlare: våra kampanjer optimeras mot konvertering och faktiska resultat snarare än traditionella räckviddsmål. Hos oss får du arbeta operativt med avancerade, datadrivna kampanjer och våra egenutvecklade marknadsföringsverktyg.

Rollen är baserad i Stockholm.

Vad kommer du att göra?
Som Performance Marketing Manager kommer du bland annat att:

  • Självständigt planera, sätta upp och optimera ett stort antal parallella kampanjer (ca 10–30 per vecka), med ansvar för budget, leverans och resultat.
  • Driva konverteringsfokuserade kampanjer för spellistor, artister, katalog och e-handel – från målgrupp och budskap till konvertering.
  • Granska och analysera kampanjdata över flera plattformar och löpande optimera mot konvertering, CPA och ROAS.
  • Säkerställa korrekt tracking och mätning – pixlar, Conversions API, UTM-struktur och förstapartsdata – i nära samarbete med våra analytiker och utvecklare.
  • Arbeta systematiskt med A/B-testning och konverteringsoptimering av annonser, målgrupper och landningssidor.
  • Bidra med ett varumärkesbyggande perspektiv och förståelse för vad som gör våra spellistor attraktiva och relevanta, med målet att skapa långsiktigt engagemang hos lyssnarna.
  • Samarbeta med teamet för att utveckla nya idéer, arbetssätt och lösningar som förbättrar våra resultat.

Vem är du?

  • Du har gedigen erfarenhet av performance marketing med fokus på konverteringsdriven annonsering, avancerad tracking och komplexa kampanjupplägg, gärna inom e-handel eller liknande digitala verksamheter.
  • Mycket goda praktiska kunskaper i Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads och TikTok Ads Manager. Du är van att självständigt sätta upp, hantera och optimera kampanjer.
  • Goda kunskaper om tracking och mätning, exempelvis spårningspixlar, Conversions API/server-side tracking, attribution och förstapartsdata.
  • Erfarenhet av konverteringsoptimering (CRO) och systematisk A/B-testning.
  • Förståelse för SEO, sökbeteenden och hur digital annonsering kan bidra till organisk tillväxt.
  • Förmåga att analysera och visualisera data samt presentera insikter som leder till konkreta förbättringar.
  • God förmåga att skriva engagerande och säljande texter för digitala kampanjer på svenska och/eller engelska.
  • Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att driva försäljning i en webbshop samt grundläggande kunskaper i Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Premiere Pro, After Effects).

Personliga egenskaper

  • Du är kommersiellt driven och motiveras av mätbara resultat.
  • Du är analytisk, nyfiken och tycker om att testa, utvärdera och optimera för att ständigt förbättra resultaten.
  • Du är kreativ och har känsla för målgrupper, budskap och vad som skapar engagemang.
  • Du är strukturerad, organiserad och trivs med att hantera många parallella kampanjer.
  • Du är självgående, tar egna initiativ och trivs med att arbeta operativt och hands-on.
  • Du är kommunikativ, prestigelös och samarbetar gärna med andra.
  • Du är flexibel och har lätt för att anpassa dig till nya förutsättningar.

Vad erbjuder vi?

  • Som en del av Sony Music får du chans att vidga dina vyer och naturligt växa in i ett globalt nätverk.
  • Möjligheten att arbeta med avancerade, datadrivna kampanjupplägg i en miljö där vi ständigt utvecklar nya verktyg och arbetssätt.
  • Här får din kreativitet flöda fritt; vi uppmuntrar nya idéer som kan revolutionera hur vi skapar banbrytande kampanjer.
  • Ett team och en arbetsmiljö som genomsyras av kreativitet, engagemang och internationellt samarbete.
  • En konkurrenskraftig lön med förmåner och möjligheter till professionell utveckling.

Ansökan
Är detta rollen för dig? Skicka in din ansökan senast den 15 november 2026. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Som en aktiv del i ett samhälle med kulturell och social mångfald är Sony Musics ambition att präglas av inkludering och bred representation, samt vara en arbetsplats med lika möjligheter för alla. Sony Music anställer, bibehåller, befordrar och i övrigt behandlar alla medarbetare och kandidater efter erfarenhet, kvalifikationer och kompetens, oavsett kön, religion, ursprung, ålder, sexuell läggning, könsidentitet eller funktionsvariationer.

job.title: Analyst - Community Intelligence
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.   SoundCloud is looking for an Analyst, Community Intelligence to help us build a deeper understanding of the creators and listeners who make SoundCloud what it is.

Sitting at the intersection of Community, Product, Data, Growth, and Music, you will build the intelligence engine that connects what happens on SoundCloud with what is happening across the broader creator, music, and cultural ecosystem. You will combine product behavior, support conversations, surveys, social signals, market trends, and external intelligence to understand who our creators and listeners are, what they need, where they experience friction, and what drives long-term engagement and retention.

A core part of this role will be owning SoundCloud’s creator segmentation and lifecycle framework, creating a durable understanding of how creators evolve across the platform and turning that understanding into strategic recommendations for Product, Growth, Marketing, Music, and senior leadership. You will also partner closely with our Music Intelligence function, applying the same analytical lens to artist discovery, music trends, forecasting, and artist ecosystem research.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own and evolve SoundCloud’s creator and listener intelligence framework, combining behavioral, transactional, attitudinal, and qualitative data into a clear understanding of our community.
  • Lead the development of creator segmentation and lifecycle models, identifying meaningful creator groups, needs, behaviors, ambitions, and stages of development.
  • Analyze creator journeys, cohorts, funnels, and retention patterns to understand what drives activation, growth, engagement, monetization, and churn.
  • Build a holistic Voice of the Community program by connecting signals from support interactions, NPS and surveys, social channels, community feedback, and in-product behavior.
  • Identify recurring friction points, unmet needs, and emerging shifts in community behavior, and translate them into strategic recommendations for the Product, Engineering, Growth, Marketing, Music, and Business teams.
  • Bring external intelligence into our understanding of the SoundCloud community by monitoring creator-economy trends, competitor and platform developments, music and cultural signals, and relevant industry benchmarks.
  • Connect external shifts with SoundCloud first-party data to identify emerging risks, opportunities, and changes in creator and listener needs.
  • Partner with Music Intelligence on artist discovery, audience and trend analysis, forecasting, and research into emerging artists, genres, scenes, and communities.
  • Articulate cultural trends through data, leveraging contextual and qualitative data types to turn growth trends into fuel for storytelling about where music is heading.  
  • Support reporting around creator and streaming trend analysis, building self-serve tools to allow Music Intelligence, Community and adjacent teams to tell stories about music movements on the platform.
  • Own reporting around NPS, community sentiment, creator behavior, lifecycle health, and experience drivers, turning complex data into clear narratives for senior stakeholders.
  • Leverage analytics, automation, and AI-enabled tools to accelerate research and synthesis while applying strong judgment to validate outputs and turn them into reliable insights.
  • Partner closely with Data Science, Analytics, Research, Product, and Community teams to build scalable frameworks and establish Community Intelligence as a trusted source of user and creator knowledge across SoundCloud.

Experience and Background:

  • 2+ years of experience in customer or consumer insights, product analytics, audience intelligence, strategy, research, or a similar analytical role, ideally within consumer technology, media, entertainment, social, creator, or music businesses.
  • Strong experience turning complex datasets into strategic recommendations that influence product, customer, or business decisions.
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with BI and visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Experience with segmentation, cohort analysis, lifecycle analysis, funnel analysis, and retention/churn analytics.
  • Comfortable combining quantitative analysis with qualitative inputs such as surveys, support conversations, social listening, community feedback, and market research.
  • Strong understanding of customer or audience research methodologies, including NPS, Voice of Customer, segmentation, and behavioral analysis.
  • Strong business judgment and the ability to move from data to insight to a clear recommendation.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with experience presenting complex findings to senior and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Comfortable using AI-enabled tools to accelerate research, analysis, and synthesis while maintaining strong analytical rigor and judgment.
  • A genuine curiosity for creators, music, technology, culture, and online communities.

Nice to Have 

  • Experience in music, entertainment, social media, streaming, or the creator economy.
  • Familiarity with music and audience intelligence tools, social listening platforms, or external market datasets.
  • Experience with Python/R, statistical analysis, forecasting, or network analysis.
  • Experience with artist discovery, cultural trend analysis, or creator growth ecosystems.

The salary range for this role is $115,000 - $122,000 annually. The final salary offered will be determined based on relative experience, skills, internal equity, and location. We also offer a generous total rewards program - read more about additional benefits and perks below!

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as mental health resources
  • Robust 401k program
  • Employee Equity Plan
  • Generous professional development allowance
  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
  • Flexible vacation and public holiday policy where you can take up to 35 days of PTO annually
  • 16 paid weeks for all parents (birthing and non-birthing), regardless of gender, to welcome newborns, adopted and foster children
  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.

At SoundCloud you can find your community or elevate your allyship by joining a Diversity Resource Group. Diversity Resource Groups are employee-organized groups focused on supporting and promoting the interests of a particular underrepresented community in order to build a more inclusive culture at SoundCloud. Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Recommendations (Core)
job.description:
We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join ML Core, the team that builds the shared ML models behind SoundCloud’s recommendations, search and content understanding. New sounds start on SoundCloud. Our job is to connect artists with the communities that will care about their music, and help listeners discover the gems and emerging scenes they’d never find on their own. Recommendations are our largest area, but you’ll work across problems that share the same foundations: representing users, tracks and creators, and ranking them well. We’re also in the middle of modernizing our stack, moving from classical approaches to deep learning on GPU, and you’ll play a big part in that.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, train and ship models for recommendations (candidate generation, user/item modeling, ranking) and related problems in search and content understanding.
  • Lead the move of key models from classical approaches (e.g., word2vec-style embeddings) to PyTorch-based models trained and served on GPU.
  • Adapt, fine-tune and evaluate open-source embedding and ranking models for our catalog and use cases.
  • Own evaluation end to end: offline metrics, A/B experiments, and making sure offline gains show up online.
  • Work with ML, data and backend engineers to get models into production and keep them healthy, and help set modeling standards across the team.

What we’re looking for:

  • 3+ years building ML systems in production, with end-to-end ownership of at least one ranking, retrieval or recommendation model.
  • Strong deep learning skills in PyTorch (or similar frameworks), and a good grasp of recommendation and retrieval fundamentals (embeddings, two-tower models, learning to rank, multi-objective ranking) and their trade-offs.
  • Solid experience with evaluation and experimentation for ranking systems, including biases in implicit feedback such as clicks and plays.
  • Strong Python; comfortable with large-scale data processing (e.g., Spark/BigQuery) and with getting models to production on a cloud platform (GCP preferred).
  • M.Sc. in a quantitative field or equivalent experience.

Nice to have:

  • Fine-tuning or serving transformer-based embedding/ranking models.
  • Applying LLMs or foundation models to recommendations (content understanding, semantic IDs, generative retrieval, feature generation).
  • Audio or music ML, or multimodal representations.
  • Contextual bandits, RL or causal methods for long-term value.
  • Publications at RecSys, KDD, SIGIR, WSDM, NeurIPS or similar.
  • Experience with ANN/vector search and GPU training or serving at scale.

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification. Research suggests that some applicants may doubt their candidacy, so please submit an application if you are interested.

job.title: Lead Software Engineer (Portals)
job.description:
About SoundExchange

SoundExchange is the largest global neighboring rights organization in the world, redefining how creators in the music industry get paid. By turning data into fast, accurate revenue for artists and rights owners, we have collected and distributed more than $13 billion in digital performance royalties to date on behalf of more than 800,000 music creators. As the sole organization designated by the U.S. government to administer the Section 114 sound recording license, SoundExchange seamlessly collects and distributes digital performance royalties from platforms like Pandora, SiriusXM, iHeartRadio, and thousands more, as well as all available international performance royalties through a strong global partnership network. 

 

Title: Lead Software Engineer/Engineering Manager (Portals Team)
Department: Technology
Job Location: Washington, DC or anywhere (Continental US) (If local, on-site Tuesdays and Wednesdays)
Reports To: Director, Engineering
Supervisory Role: No
FLSA Status: Exempt

Position Summary:

The Lead Software Engineer for our Portals team will be a key contributor to full lifecycle software development while coaching, leading, and mentoring their small technical team. This role oversees the technical details and day-to-day execution of all new features and operational activities within the development team in collaboration with the technical product owner. The Lead Engineer is a critical element in our agile delivery process for new features and capabilities to support our growing music royalty processing platform.

Essential Functions:

• Provide hands-on technical leadership to a small team of software engineers
• Collaborate across teams to estimate, design, develop, support, test, and deliver data driven solutions
• Facilitate architecture discussions and decision-making both within and across teams
• Interface with key project stakeholders, mentor team members, and promote and improve software engineering practices
• Demonstrate responsibility, accountability, and dedication to engineering team and company success
• Establish and promote use of technologies and processes that lower risk and increase efficiency
• Support and improve software development standards and best practices, including generative coding, peer reviews, and source control
• Support and improve existing software applications and design, or collaborate on designing, new software applications or features
• Take responsibility for full Agile SDLC, especially from refinement to release
• Lead, coach, and develop team members by setting clear expectations, providing timely feedback, supporting growth, and fostering a collaborative and accountable work environment

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities (KSAs):

• Proficiency at designing and developing software using many of the following: Python, Django, SQL (Postgres), AWS (S3, ECS, OpenSearch, RDS, Cloudfront, etc.), JavaScript, Typescript, JPax, Git, Kiro
• Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure as code technologies
• Experience with Vue3 or other UI frameworks
• Experience with migrating legacy application to modern technologies
• Experience building enterprise software with complex business rules and data models
• Experience designing and developing microservices or other distributed systems
• Experience with scaling to work with large data sets
• Ability to influence and communicate effectively with team members, peers, and business partners
• Proficiency in Agile software development methodology, processes, and practices

Required Education, Certifications/ Licenses, Related Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent experience
• 7 or more years of experience in software engineering
• At least 2 years of experience leading a software engineering team

ADA Specifications:

• This position requires the ability to remain in a stationary position (standing and/or seated) all of the time
• This position requires the ability to spend all of the time viewing computer monitors

Travel Requirements:

• If hired remote, this person is expected to travel to the Washington DC corporate office as needed (3-4 times per year).

 

PAY RANGE: $171,000.00 - $209,000.00 

Note:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary.

Taking Care Of The Band:

At SoundExchange we empower creators and help shape the future of music. One way we do this is by respecting different voices, varied perspectives, and distinct backgrounds of all our team members. We are intentional in creating a culture where we recognize that all employees have the opportunities and support needed to thrive. We strive to create teams that reflect the music community we serve – every individual’s unique attributes and abilities are valued, and are part of how we innovate, create, and deliver experiences to the creators we champion.

SoundExchange has an employee-led committee that focuses on amplifying different voices and backgrounds and undertakes activities to promote inclusion and access. It helps to cultivate SoundExchange culture and policies, advocates for equality within the music industry, and participates in community building activities in the Washington, DC area where SoundExchange is located.

All with the goal of promoting more belonging and access in the workplace, music industry, and local community.

Accommodations:

SoundExchange is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the SoundExchange Careers website as a result of your disability. We will make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.  If you need an accommodation, please email jobs@soundexchange.com.

Position Summary: 

The Senior Software Engineer for our Portals team will be a key contributor to full lifecycle software development while coaching and mentoring other contributors within their technical team. This role is a primary contributor to the software development process for one or more applications and collaborates across the engineering organization to ensure efficient development and delivery of technical solutions.
