  • Contribute as a code author and reviewer within a small team of software engineers
  • Collaborate across teams to design, develop, test, and support data driven solutions
  • Contribute to architecture discussions and decision-making both within their team and coordination with interfacing teams
  • Interface with key project stakeholders, mentor team members, and promote and improve software engineering practices
  • Demonstrate responsibility, accountability, and dedication to engineering team success
  • Utilize AI coding techniques to increase efficiency in coding and troubleshooting without losing ownership of code
  • Follow and improve established software development standards and best practices
  • Contribute actively to full Agile SDLC, especially from refinement to release

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities (KSAs):

  • Proficiency at designing and developing software using many of the following: Python, Django, SQL (Postgres), AWS (S3, ECS, OpenSearch, RDS, Cloudfront, etc.), JavaScript, Typescript, JPax, Git, Kiro
  • Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure as code technologies
  • Experience with Vue3 or other UI frameworks
  • Experience building enterprise software with complex business rules and data models
  • Experience designing and developing microservices or other distributed systems
  • Ability to influence and communicate effectively with team members and business partners
  • Proficiency in Agile software development methodology, processes, and practices

Required Education, Certifications/ Licenses, Related Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent experience
  • 5 or more years of experience in software engineering

ADA Specifications:

  • This position requires the ability to remain in a stationary position (standing and/or seated) all of the time
  • This position requires the ability to spend all of the time viewing computer monitors

Travel Requirements:

  • If hired remote, this person is expected to travel to the Washington DC corporate office as needed (3-4 times per year at minimum).

 

PAY RANGE: $158,000.00 - $190,000.00 

Note:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary.

Taking Care Of The Band:

At SoundExchange we empower creators and help shape the future of music. One way we do this is by respecting different voices, varied perspectives, and distinct backgrounds of all our team members. We are intentional in creating a culture where we recognize that all employees have the opportunities and support needed to thrive. We strive to create teams that reflect the music community we serve – every individual’s unique attributes and abilities are valued, and are part of how we innovate, create, and deliver experiences to the creators we champion.

SoundExchange has an employee-led committee that focuses on amplifying different voices and backgrounds and undertakes activities to promote inclusion and access. It helps to cultivate SoundExchange culture and policies, advocates for equality within the music industry, and participates in community building activities in the Washington, DC area where SoundExchange is located.

All with the goal of promoting more belonging and access in the workplace, music industry, and local community.

Accommodations:

SoundExchange is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the SoundExchange Careers website as a result of your disability. We will make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.  If you need an accommodation, please email jobs@soundexchange.com.

job.title: HR and Administrative Assistant
job.description:
Spanish Broadcasting System, Inc.

Job Title: HR and Administrative Assistant

Reports To: Director of Human Resources

Position Type: Full-time

Location: Miami, FL Job Summary: We are seeking an organized, detail-oriented HR and Administrative Assistant to support Human Resources and assist other departments with administrative tasks as needed. The role includes maintaining personnel records, coordinating recruitment and onboarding, responding to routine employee inquiries, and supporting day-to-day office needs. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with ADP, proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, and the ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining confidentiality.  Core Responsibilities: 
  • Maintain Employee Records: Keep physical and digital personnel files and authorized ADP records accurate and up to date for new hires, transfers, terminations and other employment changes.
  • Coordinate Recruitment Logistics: Post job openings, screen incoming resumes and coordinate interviews with candidates and hiring managers.
  • Assist with onboarding and orientation: Launch onboarding workflows in ADP, prepare new-hire materials, assist employees with required paperwork and coordinate first-day orientations.
  • Support benefits and leave administration: Maintain PTO, sick leave and leave-of-absence records as directed, assist with routine benefits enrollment questions and refer eligibility or policy decisions to the appropriate HR team member.
  • Respond to employee inquiries: Assist with routine questions about company procedures, direct employees to the appropriate resources and promptly escalate sensitive or complex matters to HR management.
  •  Provide administrative support across departments: Assist HR and other departments as needed with printing, copying, scanning, filing, preparing documents, updating spreadsheets, data entry, scheduling and other administrative tasks, with priorities coordinated through the HR supervisor.
  • Coordinate office supplies: Monitor office supply needs, prepare and place orders within approved purchasing procedures, track deliveries and help maintain organized supply areas.
  • Maintain organized records and materials: Support physical and electronic filing systems, prepare meeting materials and correspondence, and assist with other office projects and administrative duties as assigned.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
  • ADP experience: At least one year of direct, hands-on experience using ADP to maintain employee information and support HR workflows.
  • Microsoft Office proficiency: Working proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint and other Microsoft 365 applications. Ability to maintain spreadsheets and trackers, use basic Excel formulas and sorting/filtering, format documents and correspondence, and manage email and calendars.
  • Administrative experience: One to three years of administrative experience, preferably in an HR department or corporate office.
  • Education: High school diploma or GED required. An associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field is a plus.
  • Confidentiality: Ability to handle sensitive employee, compensation, benefits and medical information with discretion and follow established access and records procedures.
  •  Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills and a professional, helpful approach to employees, candidates and colleagues.
  • Organization and accuracy: Ability to prioritize requests, meet deadlines, maintain accurate records and support multiple departments while keeping HR responsibilities on track.
  • Office equipment: Familiarity with printers, copiers, scanners and electronic document management tools.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Basic knowledge of employment laws and HR compliance practices.
  • Experience coordinating schedules and administrative work across remote and in-office teams.

job.title: Part-Time Promotions Assistant
job.description:
Spanish Broadcasting System, Inc.

Job Title: Part-Time Promotions Assistant

Reports To: Marketing & Promotions Manager

Position Type: Part-time

Location: San Jose, CA

 


About the Role:

The Promotions Assistant plays a vital role in supporting the marketing and promotional efforts within the Information and Media Services industry. This position is responsible for assisting in the development, coordination, and execution of promotional campaigns that enhance brand visibility and audience engagement. The ideal candidate will work closely with the marketing team to manage promotional materials, track campaign performance, and liaise with external partners and vendors. By ensuring smooth operational support and timely delivery of promotional activities, the Promotions Assistant contributes directly to the growth and success of the organization’s media presence. This role requires a proactive individual who can manage multiple tasks efficiently while maintaining attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality.


Because this position requires the operation of Company and station vehicles, candidates must possess a valid driver’s license and authorize SBS to obtain a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) as part of the pre-employment screening process. Any offer of employment will be contingent upon the candidate having an acceptable driving record and receiving approval to operate Company vehicles under SBS’s applicable insurance requirements. The employee must maintain a valid driver’s license and continued insurability throughout employment in this position.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred.
  • Basic understanding of marketing principles and promotional strategies.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in the Information and Media Services industry or a related marketing environment.
  • Familiarity with digital marketing tools and social media platforms.
  • Knowledge of graphic design software such as Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Experience with event coordination and vendor management.
  • Ability to analyze marketing data and generate reports.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the planning and execution of promotional campaigns across various media platforms.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors to produce and distribute promotional materials.
  • Monitor and report on the effectiveness of promotional activities and suggest improvements.
  • Maintain accurate records of promotional schedules, budgets, and inventory of marketing collateral.
  • Support event planning and on-site promotional activities as needed to maximize audience engagement.

Benefits & Compensation

  • Employee benefits are available for this position subject to meeting eligibility requirements.

Skills:

The Promotions Assistant utilizes strong organizational and communication skills daily to coordinate promotional campaigns and collaborate effectively with team members and external partners. Proficiency in Microsoft Office enables the creation and management of schedules, reports, and presentations that support campaign tracking and decision-making. Familiarity with digital marketing tools and social media platforms allows the assistant to contribute to online promotional efforts and audience engagement strategies. Knowledge of graphic design software is beneficial for assisting in the development of visually appealing marketing materials. Analytical skills are applied to monitor campaign performance and provide actionable insights that enhance future promotional activities.

job.title: Part-Time Street Team
job.description:
Spanish Broadcasting System, Inc.

Job Title: Part-Time Street Team

Reports To: General Sales Manager

Position Type: Part-time

Location: Chicago, IL


Position Summary

We are seeking an enthusiastic, dependable, and responsible Part-Time Street team member to support our promotions department at on-site events, station remote activations and community events. The Street Team member would be responsible for driving company vehicles and setting up promotional equipment to scheduled events, managing on-site activities and creating engaging experiences for attendees. This individual will work closely with the on-site talent and promotions team to ensure event runs smoothly while representing our company and brands in a professional and positive manner.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

· Safely operate company vehicles to transport promotional equipment, supplies and materials to and from scheduled events.

· Set up, execute, and break down promotional displays, tents, signage and other event materials.

· Manage crowd engagement and interaction, encourage participation and maintain an organized event environment.

· Conduct on-site contests, raffles, giveaways, and other promotional activities in accordance with event guidelines.

· Perform additional promotional duties as assigned.

· Maintain regular and efficient communication.

Minimum Requirements

· High school diploma.

· Valid driver's license with a clean driving record (Motor Vehicle Record check required).

· Must successfully pass background screening and driver insurance clearance.

· 5 years driving experience.

· Reliable and punctual.

· Ability to lift, carry and set up promotional equipment.

· Strong communication skills.

· Self-initiating with the ability to work independently and as a member of a team.

· Ability to work under pressure and adapt easily.

· Organized, dependable, dedicated, and detail-oriented team player.

· Flexible availability includes weekends, evenings, and occasional holidays.

Benefits & Compensation

· Employee benefits are available for this position subject to meeting eligibility requirements.

Physical Requirements

Work involves exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally or a negligible amount of force frequently to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects.

SBS is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Analyst, Royalty Operations
job.description: Royalty Operations owns the operations behind Spotify’s royalty process across music, audiobooks, lyrics, and creator content. We implement content licenses in Spotify’s proprietary royalty systems, calculate and report royalties to our rightsholder partners, provide analytics to Accounting stakeholders, and serve as the go-to team for royalty questions across the company. As our business grows more complex, we’re focused on staying accurate and on time while getting faster and more flexible through scripting, Gen AI, and agentic workflows.

job.title: Client Partner - Emerging & Scaled (French Speaking)
job.description:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 

Sell what you love. For us - and millions of users across the globe - that’s Spotify. If you’re ready to join a team that’s passionate, innovative, and driven, then this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact. At Spotify, our Sales team isn’t just about selling creative solutions, it’s about shaping how the world connects with music and podcasts. We use our deep expertise in ad products, sales channels, and industry trends to redefine our clients’ experience and unlock growth opportunities.

We are looking for an exceptional Client Partner to join our Emerging & Scaled team, one of the fastest-growing units within Spotify’s Ad Sales organization. This role is perfect for someone who wakes up every morning excited to connect with clients and inspire them with the power of Spotify. 

You bring curiosity, resilience, and a collaborative mindset, along with a passion for building meaningful client partnerships. Integrity and a healthy work-life balance are non-negotiable. You’ll shape how Spotify advertisers reach audiences and elevate their connection to our platform. Collaborating closely with fellow EU Client Partners and Sales leadership, you’ll grow and expand Spotify’s advertising presence with advertisers in France.

job.title: Fullstack Engineer - Backstage
job.description:
We are looking for a Fullstack Web Engineer to join the Backstage team, passionate about crafting the best developer experience for millions of developers in the software industry.

Leveraging our thriving open-source developer experience platform, Backstage, our teams are delivering high-impact external commercial products that truly up-level the industry standard of developer experience. Whether it’s a seasoned tech company that wants to build an internal developer portal using Backstage, or smaller companies that just want to quickly and easily increase developer satisfaction, or anything in between - our squads are shipping solutions that meet platform engineering needs all across the industry.

About the team

You will join the Backstage Product Area where you will help play an instrumental role in improving the experience of developers at our customer companies, in our fast-growing open-source community, and at Spotify internally. If you want to make a direct impact in helping Spotify become the industry leader in developer experience, this is the role for you.

job.title: Head of Measurement & Advertising Effectiveness
job.description:
Spotify is building the next generation of advertising, connecting brands with audiences through audio, video, and experiences that are deeply embedded in people's lives. As our advertising business evolves, demonstrating the impact of advertising on Spotify, and helping advertisers achieve better outcomes, will be critical to our long-term success.

We are seeking a Head of Measurement & Advertising Effectiveness to define how Spotify proves the value of its advertising, advances measurement science, and makes advertiser effectiveness a lasting competitive advantage.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Advertising, you will be a member of the global Advertising leadership team, operating within a business with end-to-end P&L accountability. You will play an influential role in shaping our strategy, guiding investment priorities, and strengthening the value we deliver to advertisers.

This is an opportunity to build and lead a differentiated measurement and effectiveness organization at a time when the industry is being reshaped by AI, evolving privacy expectations, and increasing demand for measurable business outcomes. We are looking for a leader who combines scientific rigor, strategic vision, commercial judgment, and exceptional people leadership—and who can represent Spotify as a credible and influential voice in the industry.

job.title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager II
job.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

At Spotify, great personalization is about more than recommending the right song. It's about creating listening experiences that feel effortless and meaningful while balancing the needs of listeners, creators, and our business.
The Samba team, part of Spotify's Personalization Mission, works on multi-objective balancing and sequencing for personalized listening experiences like Autoplay, Radio, and Mixes. Our engineers bring together machine learning, backend engineering, and data engineering to build systems that support Spotify's financial objectives while keeping listeners at the center of what we do.


We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team, develop our engineers, and help shape the technical direction of systems that influence how millions of people experience Spotify.

job.title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager II
job.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

At Spotify, great personalization is about more than recommending the right song. It's about creating listening experiences that feel effortless and meaningful while balancing the needs of listeners, creators, and our business.
The Samba team, part of Spotify's Personalization Mission, works on multi-objective balancing and sequencing for personalized listening experiences like Autoplay, Radio, and Mixes. Our engineers bring together machine learning, backend engineering, and data engineering to build systems that support Spotify's financial objectives while keeping listeners at the center of what we do.


We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team, develop our engineers, and help shape the technical direction of systems that influence how millions of people experience Spotify.

job.title: Product Designer
job.description:
Every great Spotify experience starts with access. From creating an account to signing in and managing your identity, these foundational moments shape how millions of people connect with the music, podcasts, and content they love.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our User Platform team and help make these experiences simpler, smarter, and more delightful.

You'll work at the intersection of design, product, and engineering, tackling complex challenges across authentication, account management, and emerging AI-powered experiences. This is an opportunity to bring exceptional craft to essential user journeys, explore new technologies, and shape experiences that reach millions of people.

We value designers who are curious, hands-on, collaborative, and excited to turn ambitious ideas into beautifully executed products.

job.title: Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead
job.description:
At Spotify, our mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by connecting creators with fans and helping listeners discover the audio they love. As we continue to grow in India, building lasting relationships with our listeners is central to our success.

Our Marketing team plays a key role in shaping how people discover, experience and stay connected to Spotify. We're looking for a Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead to develop strategies that deepen listener engagement, reduce churn and bring inactive users back. You'll combine consumer insights, data and creativity to build experiences that give listeners more reasons to return to Spotify.

job.title: Senior Accountant, General Ledger Accounting
job.description:
We are looking for a Senior Accountant to join our Global Record to Report (RTR) team. Our close is evolving fast, and we’re looking for someone who combines strong accounting judgment with curiosity about how AI and automation can change how we work, and who wants to help build that future rather than wait for it.

As a Senior Accountant on the General Ledger team, you will own key close processes end to end, from preparation and analysis to explaining results to partners across Finance. You will use data and AI tools to remove manual work, spend more of your time on review and insight, and help shape how a lean, global team scales.

job.title: Senior Director, Global Advertising Product Marketing
job.description:
Spotify is shaping the future of advertising by connecting brands with fans through audio, video, and experiences that are part of people's everyday lives. As our advertising business grows, we're focused on bringing innovative products to market, helping advertisers succeed, and turning new ideas into meaningful business growth.

We're looking for a Senior Director, Global Advertising Product Marketing to lead the next chapter of our global Advertising Product Marketing team. Reporting to the Head of Advertising Business Marketing, you'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing leaders to shape product strategy, strengthen our market position, and help advertisers get more value from Spotify.

This is an opportunity to build and lead a product marketing function with a clear voice in product decisions and a direct impact on business growth. You'll bring customer insights into product development, establish a disciplined approach to go-to-market execution and product adoption, create compelling reasons for advertisers to choose Spotify, and help a global team deliver measurable results.

job.title: Senior Product Manager — Subscriptions (Freemium)
job.description:
Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.

The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on helping listeners discover, experience, and unlock the full value of Spotify through awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to help shape the future of Spotify's Freemium experience, with a particular focus on India. You'll lead product initiatives that make Premium more compelling, improve the journey from Free to Paid, and create experiences that reflect the needs of local audiences. Working closely with engineering, design, data science, research, marketing, and regional teams, you'll turn consumer insights into meaningful product experiences that drive sustainable subscriber growth.

job.title: Staff Backend Engineer - Content Platform
job.description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

Policy & Safety (P&S) is a domain within Content Platform in the Experience Mission, responsible for building Spotify’s content moderation and regulatory compliance infrastructure. This includes rule engines, enforcement pipelines, policy configuration systems, and compliance data platforms that ensure safety at scale.

The team operates at the intersection of backend platform engineering, machine learning systems, and regulatory compliance, partnering closely with Licensing, Trust & Safety, Legal, and Public Affairs. Sitting on the critical path for every new content type and feature, P&S enables safety-by-default experiences while supporting global regulatory requirements and evolving product innovation.

job.title: Employment Counsel
job.description:
About Us

Stagwell empowers talented, passionate, and creative leaders with vision to deliver breakthrough ideas on behalf of the world’s most ambitious clients.

We believe that the differences among us fuel innovation and drive us to achieve extraordinary results. We take great pride in a work force with rich diversity of age, race, ethnicity, gender, nationality, sexual orientation, ability and background. As a network, we seek out a skilled and dynamic talent pipeline, invest in programs that help develop diverse talent for the future benefit of our industry, and strive to build an inclusive environment where all employees can bring their full selves to work.

Creating a collaborative environment at our state-of-the-art campuses, where we can bring people together at the office to inspire and innovate, is central to our culture-moving creative edge. We believe that by being together, we can transform marketing. Join us at www.stagwellglobal.com.

Overview

Stagwell is seeking a talented, highly motivated, and business-oriented employment attorney with experience advising on U.S. employment law, executive contracts, and litigation management across a global organization. In this position, you will partner with Stagwell’s Human Resources team, and our dynamic agencies around the world to deliver high-quality legal advice and strategic business guidance on a broad range of employment matters with a primary focus on U.S. federal, multi-state law and Canada (Ontario).

Responsibilities

  • Reporting to the Head of Global Employment Law, you’ll oversee employment law across the U.S. and other global markets as needed— advising on complex employment matters, partnering closely with HR leaders, and serving as a trusted problem-solver for business teams across the region.
  • Provide day-to-day advice on a broad range of employment issues including investigations, HR best practices, performance management, RIF and individual terminations, recruiting, hiring, compensation and benefits, wage and hour, and other strategic advice.
  • Deliver proactive, commercial, and risk-based employee relations guidance with a strong ability to advise and counsel effectively.
  • Advise senior leadership and HR on complex and high-risk matters including investigations, litigation strategy, workforce restructuring, regulatory risk, and reputational concerns.
  • Manage dispute matters across global and international markets, create a framework for evaluating legal claims proactively.
  • Lead and collaborate with cross-functional partners on complex projects to sustain and enhance employment law compliance across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Collaborate with the legal and People Operations teams to help manage equity awards and ensure compliance with applicable global, regional, and local requirements.

Qualifications

  • J.D. with New York Bar admission
  • Big Law experience, with experience advising on U.S. federal and multi-state employment law matters, required
  • Experience with Canadian or EMEA or APAC employment law a plus
  • Outstanding writing, drafting and communication skills
  • Ability to use good judgment and demonstrate attention to detail
  • Ability to deliver complex legal advice in a business-friendly manner
  • Must be able to balance large volume of work through effective time management and prioritization
  • A team player who acts with high integrity and professionalism
  • Inspire, trust, and earn the confidence and cooperation of your business partners

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of total compensation in New York City for this role is $275,000 - $285,000. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location. Total compensation includes a highly competitive bonus and equity structure.

 

In addition to medical, dental and vision coverage, we offer a generous PTO plan, 401k program, comprehensive family planning benefits (including paid parental leave), tuition reimbursement, and pre-tax commuter benefits. Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Stagwell and the location where you work.

job.title: Senior Director, Sales Operations
job.description:
About Us

The Marketing Cloud (TMC) is Stagwell's technology division, bringing together marketing technology, media intelligence, AI-driven products, and data solutions that help brands better understand audiences and drive growth.

Overview

The Marketing Cloud is seeking a Senior Director, Sales Operations to join a team focused on leveraging financial data to help the business scale.  This is a senior position responsible for creating a predictable, scalable, and data-driven revenue engine across Sales, Marketing, and Finance teams supporting a dozen differentiated global brands. The role will build and lead the systems, processes, and insights that power our growing revenue organization. The role will partner with sales leadership across the company to provide timely, fact-based, data-driven decision support to help drive critical revenue decisions supporting our mandate for growth at all costs. This includes forecasting, territory and quota planning, pipeline management, reporting, systems, new product roadmaps, process optimization, and cross-functional GTM planning.  This is a forward-looking team.  We support a global business with a diverse product set and go to market strategy.  The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast-paced and consistently evolving environment.  This role requires an ability to build close working relationships with stakeholders across the business.  A revenue first mindset and constant focus on driving growth and long-term scale is expected, along with a strategic and hands-on approach dynamic enough to establish best practice, bring together disparate data, and handle ad hoc requests with ease.  Excellent communication skills and an ability to work within a global organization are required.  This is a unique opportunity to build processes, take ownership, and make an immediate impact while growing alongside the business.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with C-level and Sales leadership across our brands to develop strategies for scaling the revenue organization, introducing new products and services to market, pricing, packaging, and new monetization opportunities
  • Identify opportunities to improve revenue growth, productivity, and retention through data and operational insights
  • Develop forecasting methodologies, pipeline coverage models, and performance benchmarks
  • Monitor pipeline health, conversion rates, sales cycles, win rates, churn, retention, and expansion
  • Identify risks and opportunities within the revenue funnel and proactively recommend actions
  • Establish a single source of truth for pipeline, forecast, and revenue reporting
  • Build and mature scalable processes, playbooks, and workflows across the revenue lifecycle
  • Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies and implement solutions that improve conversion, productivity, and time-to-close
  • Drive consistent process adoption across Sales teams
  • Continuously assess whether existing systems and tools are effectively supporting the needs of the business
  • Build scalable infrastructure that can support continued growth and scale
  • Build dashboards, reporting, and analytical models for Sales and executive leadership
  • Translate complex data into clear business insights and actionable recommendations
  • Develop reporting that enables leaders to understand performance, identify trends, and make better decisions
  • Ensure leadership has a clear understanding of the health and trajectory of the pipeline
  • Deeply understand and effectively communicate the business to internal and external stakeholders
  • Use our tools and systems to streamline processes, improve visibility and understanding, and increase team efficiency
  • Identify, develop, implement, and champion financial and non-financial KPIs that are tangible to the business

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of progressive Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, or FP&A experience, ideally at a global, technology focused, Rule of 40 company
  • Experience building or significantly scaling a RevOps organization, ideally in a growth-stage company
  • Proven experience with forecasting, revenue planning, territory design, quota setting, pipeline management, and GTM analytics
  • Experience in varied forecasting ERPs (Salesforce, Hubspot, OneStream, and Maconomy a plus)
  • Demonstrated history of working with C-level, board, or senior leadership teams
  • Keen attention to detail and financial data accuracy
  • Strong analytical, financial, and data modeling skills
  • Experience using data and technology to improve revenue performance and operational efficiency
  • A growth mindset

Compensation

150K

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Stephens Media Group is a privately-owned company that helps to generate revenue for local businesses. We do this by communicating the right message, to the right audiences, so businesses can start seeing new customers right away.

We are looking for a skilled Account Executive to find business opportunities and manage customer relationships. You’ll be directly responsible for the preservation and expansion of our customer base. The ideal candidate will have a passion for sales and experience in media and digital advertising with exceptional customer service. The right candidate is a reliable professional able to achieve a balance between customer orientation and a results-driven approach. The goal is to find opportunities and turn them into long-term profitable relationships based on trust and mutual satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  • Create detailed business strategies to facilitate the attainment of goals and quotas
  • Manage the entire sales cycle from finding a client to securing a deal
  • Unearth new sales opportunities through networking & prospecting in order to develop into long term partnerships
  • Present products & capabilities to prospective clients
  • Recommend and process digital advertising campaigns
  • Provide professional post-sales support to enhance customer devotion
  • Remain in frequent contact with clients in order to uncover their additional needs
  • Respond to complaints and resolve issues aiming toward customer contentment and the preservation of the company’s reputation
  • Negotiate agreements and keep records of sales and data

Requirements

  • Proven experience as an Account Executive, or in other sales/customer service role
  • 2+ years in media &/or digital advertising sales is preferred, but not required
  • Knowledge of market research, sales and negotiating principles
  • Outstanding knowledge of MS Office; knowledge of CRM software is a plus
  • Excellent communication/presentation skills and ability to build relationships
  • Organizational and time-management skills
  • A business acumen
  • Enthusiastic and passionate

Education

  • High school diploma
  • BS or BA in business administration, sales or marketing, preferred but not required

Here are the 7 must-have qualities we look for in every Account Executive:

  1. Extremely competitive
  2. Deep need to get others to see things from his/her perspective

Stingray Group Inc. is a leading music, media, and technology company with over 1,200 employees worldwide. As a premium provider of curated direct-to-consumer and B2B services, we reach 400 million subscribers in 156 countries.

Reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), you will be pivotal in positioning Stingray Advertising’s multi-platform music ecosystem—spanning digital streaming audio, CTV audio & video, in-car audio, and North America’s leading in-store retail audio network—to OMG agency leads. You will leverage your existing senior agency relationships to unlock significant agency holdco growth and establish Stingray as a core omnichannel partner.

job.title: IT Engineer
job.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

Our Los Angeles office is home to Suno's largest concentration of musicians, producers, and music-industry partners, and the technology they depend on is different from a typical office: studios, DAWs, audio interfaces, monitoring, high-resolution playback, and the networks and storage that move large sessions around. As Staff IT Engineer, you'll own the audio and studio technology domain for Suno company-wide — designing, building, and supporting the production environments our Music team works in — while also serving as the senior IT presence on the ground in LA. You'll report to the Senior Manager, IT Operations and work alongside IT Engineers in Cambridge, NYC, and San Francisco, who manage identity, endpoint, SaaS, and office-infrastructure. You'll work with the rest of the team to manage our Corporate IT systems stack, but you'll be our audio and A/V expert. Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/ldMCcRAh5ln0LgNA

What You'll Do

Run IT for the LA office — identity and onboarding, endpoint management, SaaS Administration, wired/wireless networking, zero-trust VPN, and A/V and videoconferencing. Own audio and studio systems as a domain — set the standard for how Suno builds and supports production spaces across offices: studio and listening-room design in partnership with acousticians and integrators, DAW and plugin management, audio interfaces and I/O, monitoring and calibration, and the storage and networking that production work needs. Support the Music team at a professional bar — keep sessions running; manage DAW environments (Pro Tools, Logic, Ableton, and others), licensing, plugin fleets, and audio drivers across a Mac fleet; troubleshoot latency, clocking, and routing problems the rest of IT can't. Partner on the product — work with Engineering and the Suno Studio team to make sure internal creators have the hardware, routing, and environments they need to use and test our tools the way professional producers do. Design for the next space — specify audio, A/V, and network requirements for LA buildouts and expansions and for studio spaces in other offices; manage integrators and vendors to a result. Scale support — write runbooks and knowledge articles that let office managers and AI-powered self-service handle the routine, and automate what you've done twice.

What You'll Need

Must-Haves 10+ years of IT engineering experience, including significant time supporting professional audio production environments — studios, post-production, broadcast, live, or music-technology companies. Deep professional-audio competence — signal flow, digital audio (sample rates, clocking, word clock, Dante or AVB), DAW administration, audio interfaces and converters, monitoring and room calibration — and the ability to diagnose problems producers describe by ear. Demonstrated breadth across the IT stack — identity, endpoint, SaaS administration, networking, and office IT — with the depth to operate independently as the only IT engineer in an office.

Experience

owning a technical domain end to end — you've set the standard others follow, not just executed it. Strong written and verbal communication — you can work comfortably with producers, engineers, executives, and vendors, and translate between them. Learning agility — you pick up new platforms quickly, you're comfortable being the first person at the company to figure something out, and you aren't afraid to ask for help. Nice-to-Haves Studio design and buildout

experience

— acoustic treatment, room tuning, patchbay and infrastructure design, working with acousticians and AV integrators. Hands-on

experience

with a modern IdP (Okta or equivalent), modern Apple MDM (Iru, Jamf, Jumpcloud), and endpoint security (CrowdStrike or similar). Networking depth — AV-over-IP, multicast, QoS for audio networks, and managed switching.

Experience

supporting creative or music teams at a technology company, or IT at a label, studio, or music-tech company. Comfort with at least one scripting language (Python, TypeScript, or Bash) and config-as-code approaches. Working knowledge of music production — you've made or recorded music yourself.

Work Location

Policy This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US. Willingness to travel (up to 20%) to collaborate with team members and support studio spaces across Suno office locations. Perks &

About the Role

As a Staff Software Engineer on Suno’s new Bots & Fraud team, you’ll help lead the backend engineering behind our defenses against abuse, fraud, and bots. You’ll build real-time services that turn request telemetry, behavioral signals, and device and app attestation into enforcement, such as rate limits, challenges, and account actions, across every layer from the edge to product services. The team is new and pulls together work from across the company, so you’ll shape both what we build and how we build it. You’ll report to the Bots & Fraud Engineering Manager. Listen to the Suno version of this role! https://suno.com/s/rieJJLO5xgUm2L0B

What You'll Do

Design and build backend services for real-time abuse, fraud, and bot defense, including rate limiters, challenge flows (CAPTCHA, proof-of-work, 2FA), rules engines, and account enforcement APIs. Deploy defenses from the edge to product services, with detection and enforcement that’s easy to roll back, auditable, and low-friction for real users. Build the logging and metrics that show what’s getting through, what we block, and our false-positive rate. Protect high-value flows, including signup, login, payments, and song generation, from account farming, credential stuffing, card testing, and credit abuse. Shape the new Bots and Fraud team's architecture, roadmap, and on-call practices, and raise the engineering bar for everyone around you. Protect the people Suno is built for, so the platform stays a place where anyone can make music and that becomes part of everyday life.

with AWS (ECS, Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB, S3), Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, and Valkey/Redis

detecting and stopping automated abuse of public APIs through request telemetry, rate limiting, and challenges

job.title: Revenue Operations Manager
job.description:
About the role

The Revenue Operations Manager owns everything that happens after a deal closes. You make sure campaigns launch on time, run as planned, and are set up to renew, and you make sure what each campaign teaches us shapes the next one. Sales owns the commercial relationship; you own delivery quality, O&O ad operations, buying, measurement, workflow, vendors and team capacity.

Launch Point runs two sides of one revenue cycle. Presale support (Digital Strategist and Sales Enablement) helps Sales win the work. Post-sale delivery, which you lead, gets it done. Closed deals move between the two through a single documented handoff, and you are the person who accepts it.

What you will own

  • Team leadership. Lead the Campaign Coordinators and Media Operations Lead, with the two Ad Order Entry Specialists reporting through the Media Operations Lead. Set workload, priorities and standards.
  • Handoff and kickoff. Accept closed-won handoffs, run internal kickoffs, and return incomplete submissions to Sales.
  • Delivery workflow. Maintain delivery workflows, QA checklists and turnaround standards across digital, O&O and print.
  • O&O ad operations. Own creative execution and standards for all O&O placements, including premium executions like Home Page Takeovers, and oversee seller submissions and changes. Work with product and technology teams to improve ad position performance, CTR and site speed.
  • Vendors and partners. Manage managed-service vendors and partners, including terms and escalations.
  • Media buying. Oversee buying across Google Ads, Meta, DV360, Basis and other DSPs, including programmatic and CTV. Set buying standards, review plans and optimizations, and step in hands-on on complex or high-value campaigns.
  • Conversion tracking and attribution. Own conversion tracking setup and attribution across campaigns using Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics, connecting all media platforms (Meta, Basis, Reddit, Google Ads and others) and client CRM data so performance ties back to client goals and ROI.
  • CRM integration and automation. Connect HubSpot with ad platforms, call tracking and client CRMs, and automate handoffs, status updates and reporting to reduce manual work.
  • Book health. Monitor pacing, delivery issues, margin and client retention risk across all accounts.
  • Reporting and insights. Work with Sales Enablement to keep post-sale data in HubSpot and client reporting dashboards accurate. Pair results with insights, open questions and recommended next steps, so each report gives Sales a reason to revisit client priorities and uncover new needs.
  • Campaign learnings. Capture what worked across audiences, creative and channels, and make sure those learnings carry into the next campaign.
  • Visibility. Report delivery health, staffing capacity and issues to the Director, and escalate systemic risks early.

What you will partner on

  • Sales. Clean handoffs in, renewal and upsell conversations out. Sales owns the client relationship and commercial decisions; you bring the performance insights and recommendations that support those conversations.
  • Digital Strategist. Making sure what was sold is what gets delivered, and turning campaign learnings into specific recommendations for the next plan and for broader client growth.
  • Audience-based sponsorships. Help Sales and the Digital Strategist spot high-impact sponsorships that pair O&O assets with the full digital media platform, such as sports, holiday initiatives, music events and other major community moments.
  • Product and technology. Ad position performance, page and ad load issues, and site changes that improve O&O delivery.
  • Sales Enablement. HubSpot fields, the handoff checklist, and reporting templates.
  • Agency. Coordination on accounts over $5,000 per month and other complex opportunities.

What you bring

  • 8 or more years in agency operations, ad operations, account services or campaign delivery at an agency, media company or publisher.
  • Two or more years leading people, including setting priorities and coaching.
  • Hands-on buying experience in Google Ads, Meta and at least one DSP (Basis, DV360 or similar), plus working knowledge of O&O, programmatic, CTV, search and social delivery and managed-service relationships.
  • O&O ad operations experience: creative specs, premium and takeover placements, ad server trafficking (GAM preferred), and working with product or development teams on ad load and site performance issues.
  • Experience setting up conversion tracking and reporting on attribution with Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, and CRM data, and explaining performance and ROI to clients.
  • Experience integrating a CRM with ad platforms and other tools, and automating workflows and reporting.
  • Process discipline: you build checklists and standards that hold up under volume.
  • Comfort with pacing, budget and margin math, and with CRM reporting.
  • Clear communication with sellers, clients, vendors and leadership, including turning performance data into practical recommendations.

Bonus points: HubSpot administration or integration experience; Google Ads, Google Analytics or Basis certifications; experience with sponsorships or event-driven media packages; print production exposure; experience building an operations function rather than inheriting one.

Why Work at the Tampa Bay Times

  • Be part of an organization committed to public service and journalistic excellence.
  • Support a diverse workforce that includes newsroom, production and corporate teams.
  • Work in a collaborative, mission-driven environment.
  • Health coverage for you and your family through medical, dental and vision plans.
  • 100% employer-paid short-term and long-term disability and basic life insurance.
  • Supplemental life insurance and flexible spending account options.
  • Tax-deferred savings plan for retirement.
  • A generous PTO program and much more.

Equal Opportunity Employer

The Tampa Bay Times is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KENS-TV San Antonio, the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in San Antonio, is seeking a competitive, coachable and results-driven Account Executive to develop new business and grow a portfolio of advertising clients. This is an opportunity to build a career in media sales while gaining experience across broadcast television, streaming, connected TV and digital advertising.

You’ll sell one of the strongest portfolios in the market, combining the reach and trust of KENS broadcast television with the targeting and growth of streaming. On the linear side, you’ll connect advertisers with the large, engaged local audiences that turn to San Antonio’s trusted news and programming. On the streaming side, you’ll leverage Premion, TEGNA’s streaming and CTV advertising business, to reach cord-cutting audiences across a premium marketplace of 125+ OTT and connected-TV publishers. Together with digital video, display and content solutions, you’ll have a powerful cross-screen portfolio to help local businesses reach their customers and achieve their goals.

We provide the coaching, tools and support to help you build your skills and your business. You bring the drive to learn, compete and succeed.

Responsibilities

Develop new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline through consistent prospecting. Research local businesses, identify key decision-makers and create opportunities across broadcast TV, Premion streaming/CTV and digital.

Manage the full sales process. Prospect, qualify, uncover client needs, present solutions, handle objections and close business while working toward established activity and revenue goals.

Sell consultatively. Learn each client’s business and marketing goals and recommend the right mix of broadcast television, Premion streaming/CTV and digital solutions to deliver measurable results.

Build compelling proposals. Develop data-informed presentations that demonstrate how broadcast reach and connected-TV targeting can work together to meet client objectives.

Grow client relationships. Build new accounts into long-term partnerships by delivering results, maintaining strong relationships and identifying opportunities for continued growth.

Manage your pipeline. Use CRM and prospecting tools to manage activity, maintain an accurate pipeline and keep opportunities moving. Partner with account, creative and product teams to deliver effective campaigns for clients.

Requirements

Competitive, self-motivated and goal-oriented with a genuine interest in building a career in sales.

Strong communication, presentation and relationship-building skills.

Coachable, curious and motivated to learn consultative media sales.

Strong organizational skills and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Interest in broadcast television, streaming/CTV and digital advertising, with a willingness to learn and stay current on the evolving media landscape.

Sales, customer service, marketing or advertising experience preferred but not required. Internships, relevant coursework and transferable experience are welcome.

Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Comfort with Microsoft Office; familiarity with CRM or digital advertising tools is a plus.

Valid driver’s license and ability to travel locally to meet with clients as needed.

Salary: Competitive base + commission

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year. 

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

EEO statement:

TEGNA Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com 

Recruiting Fraud Alert:

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are important to us. Only TEGNA Recruiters or Hiring Managers will reach out to you regarding consideration of your application or background.  Communications with TEGNA employees will either come from a TEGNA email address with a domain of tegna.com or one of our affiliate station domains.  

Recruiters or Hiring Managers will never request payments, ask for financial account information or sensitive information such as social security numbers.

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. WXIA WATL-TV Atlanta, the TEGNA-owned NBC/MNTV affiliate in Atlanta, is seeking a proven, results-driven Account Executive to grow new business and manage a book of advertising clients across one of the strongest cross-screen portfolios in the market. This is a seat for a closer who can walk into a business owner's office or an agency pitch, uncover what's really driving their marketing decisions, and build the multi-platform solution that wins the budget. 

You'll sell the full weight of TEGNA: the mass reach and trust of NBC/MNTV broadcast television paired with the targeting and growth of streaming. On the linear side, you'll connect advertisers to the large, engaged local audiences that tune in to Atlanta's trusted news and programming. On the streaming side, you’ll leverage Premion, TEGNA’s streaming and CTV advertising business, to deliver premium, brand-safe connected-TV inventory. Premion’s curated marketplace includes 125+ OTT and CTV publishers, offering the same premium environments national buyers demand. Layered with digital video, display, and content solutions, it's a cross-screen story few competitors can match and in your hands, a clear advantage in every pitch. 

We give experienced sellers the portfolio, the autonomy, and the support to build something significant. Top performers grow their books, their earnings, and their careers. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Drive new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of local and regional advertisers, connect with key decision-makers and create opportunities across broadcast TV, Premion streaming/CTV and digital.
  • Sell strategically and consultatively. Uncover each client's real business goals, read the market and competitive landscape, and architect tailored, multi-platform solutions that tie directly to measurable outcomes. 
  • Own the full sales cycle. Prospect, qualify, present, negotiate and close business while consistently meeting activity and revenue targets.
  • Grow and defend the book. Turn accounts into long-term partnerships; expand them through smart upsell and cross-sell across the portfolio and stay close enough to results to renew and grow every cycle. 
  • Pitch with data. Build compelling, insight-driven proposals that show advertisers exactly how broadcast reach and connected-TV targeting combine to deliver ROI. 
  • Run your business. Manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and keep deals moving in CRM and partner with account, creative, and product teams to deliver campaigns that perform and retain. 

Requirements:  

  • 1-3+ years of media, digital, or advertising sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in a competitive market 
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, open new business, and build a self-sustaining pipeline. You don't wait for leads 
  • Command of the modern media landscape: broadcast television, streaming/CTV, programmatic, digital video, display, social, and content 
  • Experience selling to business owners and/or agencies, and the presence to lead the room in a strategic pitch 
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills 
  • Fluency in turning data and analytics into a clear ROI story clients believe 
  • Proficiency with CRM and Microsoft Office; familiarity with Google Analytics, DSPs/SSPs, and ad-management tools a plus 
  • Valid driver's license with the ability to travel locally to meet clients and partners as needed

KFSM 5NEWS, a TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Fayetteville–Fort Smith, Arkansas, is seeking an engaging Anchor / Multi-Skilled Journalist to lead our weekend morning newscasts and report stories that matter across Northwest Arkansas and the River Valley. This journalist will help viewers start their day informed, prepared and connected to their communities.
We are looking for a journalist with strong news judgment, clear and conversational on-air delivery, and the curiosity to find the people and context behind the headlines. The successful candidate will work closely with producers and the newsroom team to shape useful, accurate newscasts, while also reporting, shooting, writing and editing original stories for broadcast and digital platforms. This is a visible newsroom role that calls for a dependable teammate, a thoughtful community presence and a calm, flexible approach to breaking news.

Responsibilities
• Anchor 5NEWS This Morning on Saturday and Sunday with accuracy, warmth, authority and energy.
• Partner with producers, editors, photographers and newsroom leaders to plan and deliver clear, compelling newscasts; contribute ideas, editorial judgment and strong writing.
• Prepare for each broadcast by reviewing scripts, confirming facts and pronunciations, tracking developing stories and making timely updates as news changes.
• Report, write, shoot, produce and edit original stories and live reports for television, streaming, mobile and social platforms.
• Develop enterprise and community-focused stories through social listening, public records, independent research and trusted local sources.
• Build and maintain relationships with people and organizations throughout Northwest Arkansas and the River Valley, reflecting the range of communities in our viewing area.
• Use social media and digital tools to discover story ideas, engage with the audience and distribute accurate, useful journalism.
• Create or contribute to digital content, including web stories, video, live updates, images and social posts, in coordination with the newsroom.
• Deliver clear, authoritative live coverage during breaking news and severe weather, adapting quickly while following newsroom standards and direction.
• Represent 5NEWS professionally at community events
• Serve as a fill-in anchor and fulfill other duties as assigned

Requirements
• 1-3 years news anchor/reporting experience preferred
• Journalism, communications or related degree preferred
• Excellent writing, interviewing and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex issues in clear, conversational language.
• Sound editorial judgment and a demonstrated commitment to accuracy, fairness, ethics and accountability.
• Ability to shoot and edit video and produce content for broadcast and digital platforms.
• Experience with newsroom systems, editing tools and graphics
• Ability to report, publish and engage with the community on social media daily.
• Ability to work any shift in a 24/7 newsroom environment

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. Assistant News Director (Morning) 

WTHR-TV • Indianapolis, Indiana 

WTHR-TV, the TEGNA-owned NBC affiliate in Indianapolis, is searching for a transformational and people-first leader to oversee our morning daypart across broadcast, streaming and digital platforms. This is an overnight/early morning leadership position that plays a critical role in shaping our morning news coverage and ensuring our teams are positioned to deliver impactful journalism as Central Indiana starts its day. This is a rare opportunity to help shape the future of a legacy newsroom in Indiana's capital city, a thriving metropolitan area with a strong sense of community, a rich sports tradition and a dynamic news landscape. 

This leader will uphold TEGNA’s values in every decision: demand the truth, work smarter, do the right thing and win. These values guide how we serve our audiences, support our teams and deliver essential journalism every day. 

The Assistant News Director plays a central role in our newsroom transformation, directly overseeing the station's morning daypart and leading editorial strategy and execution during overnight and early morning hours. You will partner closely with anchors, producers, reporters and the story desk (digital team and assignment desk combined) to own the big story, deliver the most trusted weather information and elevate our coverage on every screen. 

This role demands a coach who can grow talent, push innovation and inspire a newsroom committed to serving Indianapolis and Central Indiana with journalism that matters. 

This position reports to the News Director. 

Key Responsibilities 

Morning Editorial Leadership 

  • Directly oversee the station's morning daypart, providing hands-on editorial leadership during overnight and early morning hours 
  • Own editorial decision-making for the morning daypart on all platforms 
  • Ensure content is competitive, urgent and rooted in context, accountability and solutions 
  • Shape daily story development with producers, reporters and digital journalists 
  • Lead breaking news coverage and special events with speed and clarity 
  • Champion WTHR’s commitment to earning trust in every story we tell 

Streaming & Digital Strategy 

  • Develop and execute a multi-platform content plan that reflects TEGNA’s transformation strategy 
  • Prioritize vertical video, content for OTT/CTV audiences and storytelling built for mobile-first users 
  • Optimize workflows for 24/7 content delivery across multiple platforms 
  • Drive experimentation with new formats, interactive experiences and innovative presentation 

Audience Growth & Analytics 

  • Use analytics, research and audience behavior insights to guide editorial choices 
  • Execute SEO, push alerts, newsletters and social strategies that strengthen reach and loyalty 
  • Ensure content serves the unique needs of Indianapolis and communities across Central Indiana 

Team Leadership & Talent Development 

  • Coach, mentor and elevate producers, reporters, editors and digital journalists 
  • Deliver consistent feedback and build a culture rooted in curiosity, collaboration and accountability 
  • Support recruitment and development of high-potential talent 
  • Model leadership that reflects WTHR’s values, TEGNA’s values and the expectations of a modern multi-platform newsroom 

Strategic Planning 

  • Collaborate with the News Director on long-term editorial, workflow and staffing strategy 
  • Implement new tools, technology and partnerships that make the newsroom more efficient 

Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of news management experience with proven success leading a high-performing team 
  • Strong track record in morning television or real-time content environments 
  • Ability and willingness to work an overnight/early morning schedule to directly oversee the station's morning daypart 
  • Deep understanding of streaming, mobile platforms and multi-platform storytelling 
  • Strong editorial judgment, communication skills and ability to lead tough conversations 
  • Proven experience growing audience share across platforms 
  • Expertise in producing compelling, content-driven newscasts 
  • Ability to stay calm and decisive during breaking news and live coverage 
  • Understanding of the tenets of professional journalism and the responsibility to hold the powerful accountable 
  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or related field preferred 
  • Familiarity with Indianapolis and Central Indiana or a strong interest in serving this community

job.title: Associate Producer
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KENS 5, the CBS affiliate in San Antonio, Texas, is seeking a highly motivated, organized, and creative Associate Producer to join our weekday morning lifestyle program, Great Day SA. This position is ideal for someone looking to grow their television production career while contributing to a dynamic, live-broadcast environment.


The Associate Producer will play a key role in the day-to-day execution of the show by helping develop engaging content, coordinating guests, managing production logistics, and supporting broadcast, digital, and social media initiatives. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator, thrives under tight deadlines, embraces collaboration, and has a passion for storytelling, audience engagement, and creative content development. If this is you, apply today!


Responsibilities
•    Assist producers with the planning, coordination, and execution of daily LIVE broadcasts.
•    Research and develop segment ideas, trending topics, community stories, local events, and guest opportunities.
•    Coordinate and book guests for in-studio, remote, and pre-recorded segments.
•    Serve as a primary point of contact for guests, clients, and community partners before, during, and after their appearances.
•    Write and format segment scripts, teases, graphics information, and supporting show materials.
•    Assist with daily show rundowns and ensure all production elements are accurate, organized, and ready for air.
•    Support pre-show preparation, live production needs, and post-show follow-up.
•    Manage studio logistics, including set preparation, prop placement, display setup, and guest microphone coordination.
•    Collaborate closely with producers, hosts, editors, photographers, sales teams, and other members of the production staff.
•    Lead and manage Great Day SA's social media presence across multiple platforms.
•    Create, schedule, and publish engaging daily content that promotes upcoming segments, highlights memorable moments, and strengthens audience engagement.
•    Develop original digital content and innovative segment ideas that enhance and extend the Great Day SA brand.
•    Write compelling and accurate social media copy, website content, and promotional materials.
•    Monitor social media trends, audience analytics, and engagement metrics to identify growth opportunities and optimize performance.
•    Utilize Cuez to manage show rundowns, coordinate workflows, and facilitate communication across the production team.
•    Produce and manage original content for KENS 5 streaming platforms, including planning, writing, and executing recorded streaming shows.

Requirements
•    Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Journalism, Communications, Television Production, Film, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
•    Strong writing, communication, and organizational skills.
•    Ability to create and adapt content for broadcast, digital, web, and social media platforms.
•    Demonstrated ability to generate fresh, creative content ideas and proactively pitch segment and digital opportunities.
•    Strong understanding of social media platforms, content creation strategies, and audience engagement best practices.
•    Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
•    Creative storyteller with strong editorial judgment and news awareness.
•    Self-starter who can work independently while contributing effectively in a collaborative team environment.
•    Positive, solution-oriented mindset and strong interpersonal skills.
•    Ability to adapt quickly and problem-solve in a fast-paced live television environment.
•    Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe Photoshop.
•    Experience with Cuez or similar newsroom and production workflow systems is preferred.
•    Prior television, digital media, or content production experience is a plus.


Work Environment
•    Primarily based in a television studio and office setting.
•    Requires occasional lifting of props and production materials, standing for extended periods, and assisting with studio setup and breakdown.
•    Must be comfortable working early morning hours and adapting to changing production needs.
•    Minimal travel required, generally less than 10%.

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

The ideal candidate can balance multiple ongoing projects while addressing the immediate maintenance needs of a 24/7 operation. If you enjoy problem solving, are a people person, like solving technical/IT challenges and enjoy communicating, we want to hear from you.

Current driver’s license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations required

Responsibilities: 

  • Support day to day operations of station including all daily news operations, equipment, and computer-based IT systems.
  • Install and maintain broadcast and IT equipment at studio facilities, transmitter site, in remote broadcast vehicles, and at other remote locations.
  • Troubleshoot equipment issues, making repairs or implementing workarounds as needed.
  • Perform routine security updates and reboots of broadcast servers.
  • Contribute to technical documentation that accurately represents installed equipment.
  • Occasional field work on remote productions.
  • Minor building-related maintenance tasks occasionally required.

Requirements: 

  • 1-3 years’ experience in broadcast engineering or related.
  • Strong organizational, communications, and time-management skills. Able to work efficiently without direct supervision.
  • Ability to work well under pressure, take initiative, and work well with others.
  • Solid understanding of current computer hardware, network technologies, and Microsoft’s Active Directory environment.
  • Ability to plan technical projects and clearly communicate the status of problems, provide updates to progress on projects, and offer solutions to technical issues.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays. Available on call.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs., climb ladders and work on elevated surfaces, pull and install wiring, use hand and power tools, work on small components, and perform other physical tasks.
