job.title: Broadcast Engineer Lead
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WATN / WLMT TV seeks a Broadcast Engineer Lead to own the broadcast and IT systems behind our 24/7 news operation. Reporting to the Head of Technology as the station’s senior technical leader, you will set technical direction, lead major projects, and serve as the escalation point for engineering staff, with decision-making authority and no direct reports.

Responsibilities:

  • System Ownership: Ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of key broadcast and IT systems.
  • Technical Direction: Set system architecture and engineering standards within corporate guidelines, and recommend technology roadmaps.
  • Project Leadership: Plan, design, and deliver local, capital, and corporate engineering projects.
  • Systems Integration: Design and approve integration of studios, control rooms, transmission, automation, and asset management systems.
  • Mentorship: Guide engineering staff, delegate routine work, and review work for quality.
  • Maintenance & Troubleshooting: Maintain servers, storage, and networks; resolve complex issues; support HVAC, UPS, and backup power.
  • Compliance: Ensure adherence to FCC, IT security, OSHA, and disaster recovery requirements.
  • Documentation: Maintain engineering standards, wiring documentation, and operating procedures.
  • Collaboration: Coordinate with corporate engineering, vendors, IT security, and station leadership.

Requirements:

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor's degree in engineering, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience) and 5+ years in broadcast operations or technology, including leading complex projects.
  • Technical Expertise: Hands-on experience with broadcast systems, networking, servers, and desktop support; satellite, microwave, and IP newsgathering knowledge preferred.

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Position:        Inventory Specialist
Department:    TEGNA Commercial Operations (TCO)
Location:    Any TEGNA market 

Description:
We are hiring! The TEGNA Commercial Operations (TCO) team is looking for a talented and motivated person to join our team.
A broadcast Traffic department maximizes revenue for a television station through careful consideration of spot placement and program formatting. We describe our group as “Commercial Operations” because we do more than just place spots on a log; we work hand in hand with the sales, marketing/promotions, programming, news and engineering departments to create an on-air product that generates positive results for both our stations and clients. Our daily workflow has often been described as working a puzzle; we manipulate commercial inventory to maximize an advertiser’s return on investment. 
A successful Inventory Specialist pays attention to detail, is customer-service oriented, shows initiative and can balance multiple projects and requests while meeting daily deadlines.  

Specific job requirements include:
•    Using WideOrbit Traffic software, manage commercial inventory by accurately preempting or placing spots on the broadcast log
•    Meet daily log finalization deadlines and clear oversold inventory 13 weeks out
•    Understand and follow spot placement guidelines to ensure client specifications are met
•    Verify the broadcast log is maximized for revenue and meets product and advertiser separation requirements
•    Collaborate with TCO and station teammates to identify and communicate revenue opportunities to the sales team
•    Process sales orders and assist sales team with accurate order entry
•    Various other duties as assigned


If this sounds like a great fit, we are looking for applicants with the following skills and experience:
•    High school diploma (required)
•    Undergraduate degree in marketing, communications, or a related field (preferred)
•    Broadcasting, cable or radio traffic or sales support experience (preferred)
•    WideOrbit traffic system knowledge (preferred)
•    Proficient with computer software/applications, including Microsoft Office: Outlook, Word and Excel (required)
•    Attention to detail and strong organizational skills (required)
•    Desire to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment (required)
•    If you have relevant work experience, we are willing to train the right candidate
•    Work from home flexibility, must be in a TEGNA market

job.title: Chief Photographer
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WTSP-TV (10 Tampa Bay News), the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Saint Petersburg, FL, is looking for a Chief Photographer to lead our team of photojournalists to visual excellence across broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms.
This is a hands-on leadership role. Our Chief Photographer sets the bar in the field, shooting and editing daily and breaking news, while scheduling, supervising and coaching our photojournalists and MSJs. You'll own our field equipment and fleet, plan crew coverage for hurricanes and other major events, and partner with news managers to recruit and develop the next generation of visual storytellers at 10 Tampa Bay News.

The Ideal Candidate
You are a highly skilled, creative photojournalist and storyteller who loves local news. You lead by example, coach with clear and constructive feedback, and inspire a team to raise its standards every day. You're organized, calm on deadline, a breaking news champion, and always looking for the next tool or technique that helps us tell better stories for our audience.

Responsibilities:
In this role, you will:
• Shoot, edit and go live on daily news, enterprise and breaking stories, leading by example in the field
• Set and maintain visual and storytelling standards for the photojournalism team
• Coach photojournalists and MSJs on storytelling, lighting, audio, natural sound, composition and editing through regular critiques and hands-on training
• Build and manage photojournalist schedules covering all newscasts, streaming and digital needs, including nights, weekends, holidays and severe weather
• Supervise photojournalists day to day, including assignments, time and attendance, overtime and performance
• Manage field equipment and the news fleet, including inventory, maintenance, repairs, budgeting and purchase recommendations for cameras, audio, lighting, bonded cellular units and news vehicles
• Oversee the station's drone program in partnership with news leadership and TEGNA's drone team, including FAA compliance and pilot certification
• Plan crew deployment and logistics for hurricanes, elections, major sporting events and other large-scale coverage
• Work closely with the assignment desk, producers and managers to match crews to stories
• Partner with news managers to source, interview, onboard and train new photojournalists
• Uphold TEGNA's ethics, safety and legal standards in the field
• Take part in the management on-call rotation
• Perform other tasks as required by the news leadership team

Requirements:
Here's what you need:
• 7+ years of experience as a news photojournalist/editor, preferably in a local TV newsroom
• Previous experience as a chief photographer, lead photographer or in a similar leadership role preferred
• Advanced skills in shooting, lighting, audio and nonlinear editing (Edius and/or Adobe Premiere)
• Experience operating live newsgathering tools such as LiveU, TVU or Dejero
• Strong coaching, communication and organizational skills
• Ability to make quick, sound and ethical decisions under deadline pressure
• Flexibility to work any shift, including nights, early mornings, weekends, holidays, overtime and extended hours during severe weather and breaking news
• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds of gear and work outdoors in all weather conditions
• Must have and maintain a valid driver's license and a clean driving record

Preferred:
• FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate, or the ability to earn it soon after hire
• Experience covering hurricanes and severe weather
• Experience creating content for streaming, digital and social platforms, including vertical video
• NPPA recognition

job.title: Cloud Team Lead
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We are looking for a Cloud Team Lead to lead the cloud and DevOps team that builds and operates the infrastructure behind TEGNA's content management and streaming platforms across Azure and AWS. Content management runs on Azure (C#/.NET Function Apps, Service Bus), streaming runs on AWS media services, and cloud-agnostic services run on Kubernetes — all Terraform-managed. Reporting to the Platform Engineering Manager, this is a hands-on technical leadership role: you lead a team of onshore and offshore cloud engineers, own the team's delivery and the reliability of the platform's infrastructure, and stay hands-on in the work. You partner closely with the Cloud Architect — who sets reference architectures and standards and holds production approval — to deliver well-architected infrastructure, and with the microservices pods on their infrastructure needs.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead a distributed team of cloud/DevOps engineers (onshore and offshore), owning planning, delivery, quality, and day-to-day technical direction.
  • Remain hands-on: contribute to Terraform/infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and Kubernetes workloads across Azure and AWS.
  • Own the reliability, performance, and operational excellence of the platform's infrastructure, including incident response and the on-call rotation.
  • Break infrastructure initiatives and epics into actionable, well-sequenced work, balancing near-term delivery with long-term platform health.
  • Partner with the Cloud Architect to apply the standards, reference architectures, and guardrails they define, and with the dev pods to support their delivery.
  • Drive engineering practices across the team: IaC standards, pipeline safety, observability, and security.
  • Mentor and grow engineers, and manage the throughput and quality of offshore contributors.
  • Run an Agile/Scrum delivery cadence with disciplined source control.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years in cloud, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering, including 2+ years leading or mentoring a team.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform/infrastructure-as-code across Azure and/or AWS; multi-cloud experience is a strong plus.
  • Solid experience with CI/CD, containers and Kubernetes, cloud networking, IAM/identity, observability, and security best practices.
  • Experience operating production infrastructure and leading incident response.
  • Proven ability to lead distributed and offshore teams, keeping quality and velocity high across time zones.
  • Strong communication skills across front-end, architecture, and microservice development teams.
  • Media, streaming, or high-traffic platform experience is a plus.

Why Join TEGNA?

You'll lead the team that keeps modern digital products running at real scale, in a genuinely multi-cloud Azure/AWS environment with a rich media and streaming footprint. This is an opportunity to shape both the reliability of the platform and the engineering culture of the team that powers content management and streaming delivery across all of TEGNA's media properties. We are investing heavily in AI-assisted development, modern cloud-native services, and flexible architecture patterns that let our teams innovate quickly while delivering high-quality, high-impact products.

Benefits:

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We are looking for an experienced Director, Commercial Production to lead and evolve TEGNA’s commercial production organization across our local markets. This role will lead a team of approximately 5 Commercial Production Managers, who collectively oversee a distributed team of commercial producers, and will have responsibility for the broader operating model that enables the team to deliver high-quality commercial creative efficiently and consistently at scale. 

The Director will set the strategy, standards, workflows, and tools for commercial production, with a focus on consistent creative quality, operational efficiency, resource optimization, and an exceptional experience for our sales teams and clients. This role will also oversee TEGNA’s network of freelance production resources, ensuring we have the right talent and capacity available to support changing business needs across markets.

The ideal candidate is an experienced people and operational leader who understands commercial video production but also knows how to build and improve systems at scale. This person will be a strong cross-functional partner to sales and other key stakeholders, a pragmatic problem solver, and an effective change leader who can bring teams along as workflows, technology, and expectations evolve.

This position can be located at any TEGNA station location.

Responsibilities

  • Leadership and Team Development: Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 5 Commercial Production Managers, establishing clear expectations and accountability while building strong, consistent leadership practices across the organization. Create a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, accountability, and high performance.
  • Commercial Production Strategy: Establish and execute the strategy and operating model for commercial production across TEGNA markets. Translate business priorities into clear production standards, processes, resource strategies, and team priorities.
  • Quality and Creative Standards: Establish clear standards for commercial creative and production quality across markets. Build mechanisms for sharing best practices, reviewing work, providing feedback, and increasing consistency while preserving the ability to meet individual client and market needs.
  • Operational Excellence and Efficiency: Continuously evaluate how work moves through the organization and identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce unnecessary work, improve turnaround times, increase capacity, and make better use of internal and external resources.
  • Resource and Capacity Management: Develop a holistic view of production demand and capacity across markets. Partner with Commercial Production Managers to balance workloads, deploy resources effectively, identify capacity constraints, and determine when work should be handled locally, shared across markets, or supported by freelance resources.
  • Freelance Network Strategy and Management: Own the strategy and operating model for TEGNA’s commercial production freelance network. Develop and maintain a strong bench of qualified creative and production partners, establish consistent standards and processes for engaging freelance talent, and ensure external resources deliver the expected quality, value, and reliability.
  • Production Technology and Tooling: Own the strategy, adoption, and optimization of tools and technologies that support commercial production. Evaluate opportunities to improve workflows through technology, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities, ensuring investments deliver measurable improvements in quality, speed, capacity, or cost.
  • Sales Partnership: Build strong relationships with sales leadership and serve as a senior partner in improving how sales and production work together. Ensure production processes support revenue goals, client needs, and a strong customer experience while establishing realistic expectations around timelines, resources, and production capabilities.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with sales, marketing, technology, finance, procurement, legal, station leadership, and other stakeholders to ensure commercial production priorities and processes align with broader business objectives.
  • Change Leadership: Lead the organization through changes in workflows, technology, team structure, and production practices. Clearly communicate the rationale and expected outcomes of change, engage managers and producers in implementation, and create the structure and accountability needed to drive sustained adoption.
  • Performance Management and Measurement: Establish meaningful performance measures for the commercial production organization, including quality, productivity, turnaround time, capacity, resource utilization, client and sales experience, and freelance performance. Use data and feedback to identify opportunities and drive continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Film Production, Media Studies, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in commercial production, creative operations, media, or a related field, with progressive leadership responsibility.
  • Demonstrated experience leading leaders and managing distributed teams, preferably across multiple markets or locations.
  • Strong understanding of commercial video production, including creative development, pre-production, production, post-production, and delivery.
  • Proven experience building and improving operational processes at scale, with demonstrated success increasing efficiency, consistency, or organizational capacity.
  • Experience developing and managing freelance, contractor, or external production networks, including resource planning, quality standards, and cost management.
  • Experience evaluating, implementing, or optimizing production technology and tools, with an interest in emerging AI-enabled creative and production capabilities.
  • Strong track record of partnering with sales organizations and other cross-functional business leaders, with the ability to balance creative, client, operational, and revenue priorities.
  • Demonstrated change management experience, including successfully leading teams through new processes, technologies, structures, or ways of working.
  • Strong business judgment and a pragmatic, solutions-oriented approach to decision-making.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence across functions and organizational levels.
  • Strong analytical and operational skills, including the ability to use data to evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and make resource decisions.
  • Experience managing budgets, vendors, and external partners. #LI-MS1

This position works closely with the sales and programming teams to develop compelling audio content that supports client goals, strengthens partnerships, and reflects the station's brand. • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Director, Marketing - West
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

The Regional Marketing Director is the senior marketing leader for the regional marketing team — setting strategy, owning station relationships, and directing the full ecosystem of centralized capabilities toward outcomes that grow audiences and drive business results across the portfolio of markets.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution: close enough to station leadership to understand what each market needs, and senior enough to direct how Production, Paid Media, Social, CRM and Lifecycle work together to deliver it. The RMD leads a lean operational team and is accountable for the marketing performance of every station in the region.

Strategy & Direction

  • Own the audience and market point of view; be the authority on who each station serves and what their market requires, and carry that perspective into every strategic decision and campaign investment.
  • Set the marketing strategy; translate enterprise priorities, station business objectives and competitive dynamics into market-specific plans that direct the full scope of centralized capability investment and drive results.
  • Synthesize audience research, ratings, digital performance and market intelligence into strategic insight that sharpens plans over time and informs enterprise-level decisions.
  • Review and approve campaign briefs before execution begins; serve as the final review before campaigns reach market, ensuring every initiative meets the standard for strategy and quality.

Station Partnership & Leadership

  • Serve as the senior marketing relationship for station general managers, news directors and content leaders across the region; build the trust and institutional knowledge that positions marketing as a strategic voice in station leadership decisions.
  • Own the strategic marketing conversation, aligning with station leadership on business objectives, campaign priorities and resource commitments; manage expectations when capacity or strategy requires adjustment.
  • Serve as the final escalation point for station-level marketing decisions, stakeholder conflicts and cross-market trade-offs.

Capability Direction & Performance

  • Direct the deployment of centralized capabilities — Production, Paid Media, Social, CRM and Lifecycle — across markets; ensure resources are allocated against the highest-priority campaigns and that each channel lead has clear strategic direction.
  • Own marketing performance accountability for the region; track results against station KPIs to evaluate campaign effectiveness and guide resource allocation.
  • Own the regional brand marketing budget; partner with the Paid Marketing Director to manage station performance marketing investment, allocating resources against the right priorities and delivering measurable return.
  • Identify patterns across the portfolio and bring those insights back to inform enterprise strategy and best practice.
  • Own the decision to activate marketing channels in response to breaking news or urgent market situations; the Marketing Lead and Specialist execute under that direction.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead and develop the regional team — Marketing Lead and Marketing Specialist — providing strategic direction, coaching and the clarity of priorities that allows the team to operate with confidence and speed.
  • Model the standard for strategic thinking, stakeholder partnership and campaign discipline.

Requirements

  • 8–12 years in marketing, brand strategy or integrated campaign leadership — media, broadcast or a multi-market content environment strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to set and execute marketing strategy across multiple markets simultaneously; track record of connecting campaign work to measurable audience and business outcomes.
  • Exceptional stakeholder leadership skills; able to earn the trust of station GMs and news directors, align on competing priorities and navigate complex organizational dynamics with credibility.

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. KSDK-TV Saint Louis, the NBC TEGNA-owned affiliate in St. Louis, Missouri is looking for a dynamic, creative and engaging Lifestyle Host & Multimedia Journalist to join Show Me St. Louis, our locally produced lifestyle and entertainment program. We are interested in finding a journalist who can create unique, memorable and well written stories, who can share them on all platforms.
St. Louis is filled with incredible people, neighborhoods, restaurants, businesses, nonprofits, attractions and experiences, and we’re looking for someone who is excited to tell their stories.


The ideal candidate is an engaging on-air personality and strong storyteller who is equally comfortable hosting in the studio, reporting in the field and working behind the camera. This person should know how to take an idea from concept to air, whether that means interviewing a guest live, shooting and editing a feature story, creating an engaging live shot or working with a local business or community partner to develop compelling content. Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Responsibilities:
•    Host Show Me St. Louis and deliver on-air content in an engaging, conversational and accurate manner.
•    Shoot, write, edit and report compelling lifestyle and community stories.
•    Conduct engaging interviews both in studio and in the field.
•    Develop original content showcasing the people, places, businesses, food, entertainment, nonprofits and experiences that make the St. Louis region unique.
•    Pitch fresh, creative and timely story ideas and help shape future Show Me St. Louis programming.
•    Generate fun, creative and content-driven live shots and field segments.
•    Work professionally and collaboratively with advertising clients and community partners to turn their ideas into compelling television.
•    Create content for broadcast, digital and social platforms.
•    Maintain an active and professional social media presence while finding new ways to engage with viewers.
•    Use photography and editing tools to create polished, visually engaging stories.
•    Contribute to sponsored content, station initiatives, special programming and community events.
•    Collaborate with producers, photographers, sales teams and other departments to execute content across platforms.
•    Manage multiple stories and projects while consistently meeting deadlines.

Requirements:
•    2–4 years of experience in broadcast journalism, multimedia journalism, lifestyle television, hosting or a related field preferred.
•    Strong on-camera presence with an authentic, approachable personality.
•    Strong interviewing, writing and storytelling skills.
•    Experience shooting and editing video.
•    Ability to independently take a story from idea to finished product.
•    Comfortable working with advertising clients, local businesses, nonprofits and community organizations.
•    Creative thinker who understands how to make lifestyle content informative, entertaining and visually compelling.
•    Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to perform under tight deadlines.
•    Experience in creating content for social and digital platforms.
•    Experience with ENPS and EDIUS is preferred.
•    Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field preferred.

Who We're Looking For
We want someone who is curious about St. Louis and genuinely excited to explore it. Someone who can walk into a restaurant kitchen, community event, local business or live studio interview and immediately make people feel comfortable.
This person should bring personality and creativity to the show while also having the journalistic and production skills to find a story, shoot it, write it, edit it and tell it well.


Most importantly, we're looking for someone who wants to help viewers discover something new about St. Louis every day.

WFAA/KFAA, the TEGNA-owned ABC affiliate in Dallas, TX, is searching for a Local Sales Manager (LSM) to lead and develop a high-performing sales team while driving revenue growth across television, streaming and digital.

WFAA/KFAA offers an exciting opportunity to sell across one of the most diverse media portfolios in Dallas-Fort Worth. From WFAA's strong local news presence and WFAA+ streaming platform to KFAA's partnerships with the Dallas Mavericks and Dallas Wings, along with PREMION's connected TV solutions, our sales team has a wide range of opportunities to help local businesses grow.

The LSM will focus on growing market share, developing new business opportunities and coaching Account Executives and Account Managers to achieve their goals. This position reports to the Director of Sales.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Recruit, retain and effectively train top sales and support talent on how to sell TV and TEGNA's portfolio of digital products.
  • Lead and develop a team of Account Executives and Account Managers, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration and strong sales performance.
  • Provide hands-on field coaching, including prospecting, client meetings, needs analysis, proposal development, presentations and closing business.
  • Identify market potential through lead generation, prospecting and qualification, with a strong focus on growing local direct business.
  • Develop sales strategies to ensure the team meets or exceeds revenue goals across broadcast, streaming, CTV and digital.
  • Hold the team accountable for sales activity, pipeline development, new business growth and individual performance goals.
  • Analyze client needs to develop integrated marketing solutions that deliver measurable results, while completing required business activity reports and forecasts.
  • Develop strong relationships with local clients, agencies and community partners, manage key accounts with the team and ensure excellent customer service.
  • Identify opportunities to grow revenue through sponsorships, sports partnerships, special projects and integrated marketing programs.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Sales on forecasting, budgeting, pricing strategy and revenue planning.
  • Review and adjust metrics to monitor sales performance, market share and emerging business opportunities.

Requirements:

  • Minimum 5 years of successful broadcast TV sales and account engagement experience, including demonstrated sales leadership experience.
  • Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales goals in the broadcast TV industry, including linear TV, streaming, digital and OTT/CTV.
  • Strong background in local direct business development, with previous success as an Account Executive preferred.
  • Established leadership skills and demonstrated ability to recruit, coach and develop high-performing sales teams.
  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing solutions, including digital advertising platforms, audience data and campaign performance.
  • Strategic thinker and disciplined executor comfortable developing and making recommendations to senior management.
  • Ability to build an inclusive, positive and accountable sales culture.
  • Proficiency with Excel, Word, PowerPoint, WideOrbit Sales, Salesforce, WideOrbit Traffic, WideOrbit Analytics, Comscore, Matrix, Media Monitors and qualitative data.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects effectively under deadline pressure.
  • Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills and accuracy.
  • Strong presentation and communication skills with internal and external customers and partners.

This position is eligible for Companies Bonus Plan(s).

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

  • Prepare and deliver severe weather updates, interrupting regular programming as necessary.
  • Produce clean, creative and informative graphics to tell the weather story
  • Fill in on other shifts when necessary.
  • Write and report from the field or inside the newsroom
  • Update website and interact with viewers on social media platforms daily
  • Perform special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Make public appearances

job.description:

KARE 11 News, the TEGNA-owned NBC affiliate in Minneapolis/St. Paul, MN is seeking an innovative, passionate News Director with experience leading teams and growing talent. 

At KARE 11 News, we have our eyes firmly fixed on the future, always looking for new ways to engage, educate and inform our audiences. We are looking for a leader who embraces creative storytelling and investigative journalism as key components of newscasts, as well as digital, streaming and social platforms. 

The News Director oversees all content operations and is a leader in the strategic vision for station growth. The ideal candidate has excellent news judgment and strong management skills to own the big story each day. 

Most importantly, this News Director should be a motivator who fosters an inspiring and inclusive culture. 

KARE and TEGNA are re-imagining local news in the digital age – thinking big and being bold to deliver content to our audience on multiple platforms. The ideal News Director can deliver impactful journalism and develop a digital-first road map in line with the strategic vision of our company. 

Responsibilities:

  • Strategically lead, inspire and manage the news department.
  • Oversee on-air and digital news content.
  • Work closely with the news team to produce high-quality, relevant, local content that sets the station apart from competitors.
  • Prioritize collaboration between television and digital content teams, along with marketing, to create original programming and breaking news coverage for all platforms.
  • Foster, encourage and reward out-of-the-box thinking that leads to differentiation and success.
  • Emphasize the importance of solid research to build credibility.
  • Use consumer analytics to determine content.
  • Skillfully use social media and digital tools to research, discover and distribute content.
  • Lead a culture that owns enterprise reporting and breaking news across all content platforms. 
  • Inspire and coach superior, unique and engaging storytelling.
  • Interact daily with all department heads in a mutual effort to achieve station goals and extend our brand.
  • Perform other duties, as assigned, to drive and fulfill the mission while abiding by the values of this organization.

 Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree and news leadership experience highly desired or equivalent years of experience in news leadership
  • 8-10 years of content leadership experience, including generation of original content, and 4-5 years managing other journalists.
  • Successful innovative leadership, along with staff and product development skills. 
  • Top notch communication skills are an absolute must.
  • Solid journalistic judgement and a news philosophy that emphasizes accurate, fair and unique local content, along with community engagement. 
  • Understanding of the tenets of professional journalism.
  • Skills in producing engaging, content-driven newscasts and digital content.

KHOU-TV, the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Houston is seeking an innovative Producer to shape our daily newscasts. job.title: Photographer (Tucson)
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

Help us build the future of statewide local news in Arizona.
TEGNA is creating a statewide news operation by bringing together teams in Phoenix and Tucson to build a stronger content organization serving viewers across Arizona.
We are looking for a photojournalist based in Tucson to be part of a dedicated Southern Arizona news team serving our Tucson stations while also contributing to statewide coverage across our Phoenix and Tucson broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms. This photojournalist will cover breaking news, enterprise stories, major community issues and the people shaping Tucson and Southern Arizona. They will be deeply connected to the Tucson community while working as part of one collaborative Arizona newsroom serving audiences across both markets. This is an opportunity for an enterprising journalist who wants to help build something new: a truly statewide local-news operation with strong local teams in both Phoenix and Tucson.
Job summary
The photojournalist will be based in Tucson and serve as a key member of our Southern Arizona content team. This person will report, shoot, write and edit compelling journalism for our Tucson and Phoenix broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms.
The successful candidate will work closely with fellow reporters, photographers, producers and newsroom leaders in Tucson and Phoenix as part of one coordinated statewide content operation. They will be expected to develop original story ideas, build trusted sources, deliver compelling live reports and ensure the issues and communities of Southern Arizona are strongly represented across our coverage.

Responsibilities:
•    Cover live breaking news, enterprise stories, major community issues across our Tucson and Phoenix newscasts and platforms
•    Collaborate daily with newsroom teams in both Tucson and Phoenix as part of an integrated statewide content operation
•    Shoot, write, edit and produce impactful content for broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms.
•    Own and develop original story ideas rooted in Tucson and Southern Arizona that are relevant locally and statewide
•    Build deep relationships and trusted sources throughout Southern Arizona
•    Be ready to go live for planned coverage and breaking-news situations across our Tucson and Phoenix newscasts and digital/streaming platforms, delivering clear, confident and conversational live reports in planned coverage and breaking-news situations
•    Use social media and digital tools to discover, research, verify and share news content.

job.description:

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. Help us build the future of statewide local news in Arizona.
TEGNA is creating a statewide news operation by bringing together teams in Phoenix and Tucson to build a stronger content organization serving viewers across Arizona. We are looking for MMJ Reporters based in Tucson to be part of a dedicated Southern Arizona news team serving our Tucson stations while also contributing to statewide coverage across our Phoenix and Tucson broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms. This reporter will cover breaking news, enterprise stories, major community issues and the people shaping Tucson and Southern Arizona. They will be deeply connected to the Tucson community while working as part of one collaborative Arizona newsroom serving audiences across both markets. This is an opportunity for an enterprising journalist who wants to help build something new: a truly statewide local-news operation with strong local teams in both Phoenix and Tucson.
Job summary
The MMJ Reporter will be based in Tucson and serve as a key member of our Southern Arizona content team. This person will report, shoot, write and edit compelling journalism for our Tucson and Phoenix broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms.
The successful candidate will work closely with fellow reporters, photographers, producers and newsroom leaders in Tucson and Phoenix as part of one coordinated statewide content operation. They will be expected to develop original story ideas, build trusted sources, deliver compelling live reports and ensure the issues and communities of Southern Arizona are strongly represented across our coverage.

Responsibilities:
•    Cover live breaking news, enterprise stories, major community issues across our Tucson and Phoenix newscasts and platforms
•    Collaborate daily with newsroom teams in both Tucson and Phoenix as part of an integrated statewide content operation
•    Report, shoot, write, edit and produce impactful content for broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms.
•    Own and develop original story ideas rooted in Tucson and Southern Arizona that are relevant locally and statewide
•    Build deep relationships and trusted sources throughout Southern Arizona
•    Deliver clear, confident and conversational live reports in planned coverage and breaking-news situations
•    Serve as a regular live presence across our Tucson and Phoenix newscasts and digital/streaming platforms, delivering clear, confident and conversational live reports in planned coverage and breaking-news situations
•    Use social media and digital tools to discover, research, verify and share news content.
•    Uphold our newsroom standards for accuracy, fairness, urgency and compelling storytelling.

Requirements:
•    2 years of reporting experience preferred.
•    Proven ability to shoot, write, edit and produce strong broadcast and digital stories independently.
•    Demonstrated ability to deliver polished, engaging live reports daily, including during breaking news.
•    Strong news judgment, writing ability, ethical decision-making and attention to accuracy.
•    A track record of generating original story ideas and building trusted sources in a community.
•    Comfort working independently in the field while collaborating closely with a larger newsroom.
•    Ability to work quickly, calmly and accurately under deadline pressure.
•    Experience using social media and digital platforms for newsgathering and audience engagement

This is a department-wide sales support position and is not dedicated exclusively to individual Account Executives. Responsibilities and priorities may shift based on the operational, Account Manager, sales and leadership needs of the department.
  The position will support sales leadership, assist Account Executives as needed, provide backup Account Manager coverage, and develop knowledge of KWES's broadcast, streaming and digital sales solutions. This role is also designed to provide professional development and exposure that may prepare a successful employee for a future Account Executive opportunity as business needs and openings arise.
Four Core Areas of Responsibility
1. Director of Sales & Department Support
Serve as a primary support resource to the Director of Sales and overall
KWES sales organization.
Responsibilities include:
• Assist the DOS with sales reports, presentations, meeting preparation
and follow-up. • Support preparation for weekly sales meetings, revenue discussions
and sales initiatives.
• Assist with revenue, inventory and sales activity reporting.
• Maintain current sales materials, programming information,
sponsorship opportunities and other department resources.
• Track department deadlines, outstanding items and projects requiring
follow-up.
• Assist with special sales initiatives, client events and station
opportunities.
• Coordinate information and workflow between Sales and other
departments, including Traffic, Creative Services, Finance, Digital and
Sales Fulfillment.
• Assist with organization and execution of seasonal programming,
sports, political and special sales opportunities.
• Provide administrative and project support as assigned by the DOS.
• Take on additional responsibilities based on changing department
priorities and business needs.
2. Account Executive & Sales Support
Provide operational and administrative support to Account Executives as
needed and based on department priorities to allow sellers to maximize
client-facing and new-business development time.
Responsibilities include:
• Assist with order entry, revisions and schedule changes.
• Support campaign setup and maintenance.
• Monitor active schedules and campaign delivery.
• Assist with makegoods, preemptions and discrepancy resolution. • Prepare and update client presentations, proposals and sales
materials.
• Assist with avails and inventory coordination.
• Coordinate commercial materials, scripts and creative needs.
• Follow up with Traffic, Creative Services and Sales Fulfillment on
outstanding items.
• Assist with routine client and agency administrative requests.
• Support campaign recaps and post-campaign reporting.
• Help maintain accurate client, account and campaign information.
• Assist with Matrix/CRM administrative support while maintaining AE
accountability for prospecting activity, opportunities and pipeline
management.
The Sales Assistant supports the business of the sales department rather
than being permanently assigned to any individual Account Executive.
3. Account Manager Coverage & Operational Support
Develop proficiency in Account Manager responsibilities to provide reliable
backup coverage during vacations, PTO, vacancies, periods of increased
workload or other business needs.
Responsibilities include:
• Become proficient in WO Media Sales and applicable sales systems.
• Enter and revise orders accurately.
• Understand Traffic workflow, deadlines and requirements.
• Assist with schedule maintenance and campaign stewardship.
• Coordinate makegoods and resolve scheduling discrepancies.
• Assist with billing and invoice questions as appropriate.
• Track commercial materials and creative requirements. • Understand MediaFerry and applicable creative workflows.
• Provide professional client and agency administrative communication.
• Coordinate with internal departments to ensure campaign fulfillment.
• Maintain continuity of sales operations when Account Manager
coverage is needed.
The expectation is that this employee becomes a dependable cross-trained
resource who can step into operational gaps without disrupting service to
clients or the sales team.
4. Account Executive Development
Develop the foundational skills, product knowledge and sales experience
necessary to potentially advance into a future Account Executive position.
Development opportunities may include:
• Participate in sales and product training.
• Develop knowledge of KWES/KIDY/KXVA broadcast programming and
sales opportunities.
• Learn TEGNA's Total TV approach: Broadcast + Streaming + Digital.
• Develop working knowledge of Premion, CTV/OTT, Audience
Marketplace and other digital solutions.
• Learn Matrix CRM and proper pipeline management.
• Participate in prospect research and new-business development
exercises.
• Learn effective prospecting techniques.
• Observe and participate in client discovery.
• Attend selected client meetings and AE ride-alongs.
• Assist with development of integrated client recommendations.
• Learn proposal development and presentation skills. • Gain exposure to pricing and inventory strategy.
• Develop understanding of campaign measurement, stewardship and
renewal.
• Participate in role-play, presentation and sales-development exercises.
• Demonstrate the ability to communicate the value of
KWES/KIDY/KXVA and TEGNA solutions to local businesses.
Career Development Opportunity
This position is designed to provide broad exposure to the KWES/KIDY/KXVA sales organization and may serve as a developmental pathway toward a future Account Executive opportunity. As the employee demonstrates proficiency in their core responsibilities, additional opportunities may be provided to develop prospecting, discovery, presentation, client relationship and new-business skills. Advancement into an Account Executive position is not guaranteed and will depend upon individual performance, demonstrated sales readiness, business needs and future position availability.
Key Qualifications
The ideal candidate should demonstrate:
• Strong organization and attention to detail.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
• Professional written and verbal communication.
• Strong customer-service mindset.
• Ability to work effectively across multiple departments.
• Comfort learning new software, systems and processes.
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Teams,
PowerPoint and Excel. • Ability to analyze information and identify potential problems before
they affect clients.
• Initiative and willingness to take ownership of assignments.
• Interest in sales, marketing, advertising and business development.
• Ability to work independently while functioning as part of a larger
sales team.
• Desire to learn and grow within the organization.
Experience in media, advertising, sales support, customer service or account
management is beneficial but not necessarily required for the right
candidate.
Measures of Success
Success in this position will be measured by:
• Accuracy and timeliness of work.
• Responsiveness to DOS and department priorities.
• Reliability of AE and AM support.
• Ability to manage and follow through on assigned projects.
• Reduction of administrative and operational workload on sellers and
sales leadership.
• Quality of internal and external communication.
• Campaign and order accuracy.
• Ability to identify and resolve issues proactively.
• Growth in product, system and sales knowledge.
• Demonstrated readiness to assume increasing responsibility.     Role Philosophy
The purpose of this position is straightforward: Support the sales operation. Protect the client experience. Give sellers more time to sell. Provide the DOS with additional operational support. Build organizational depth. Develop future sales talent.

job.description:
About TEGNA

In the Sales Marketing Coordinator role, you will collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless activations and support sales efforts by developing compelling sales presentations alongside Account Executives. You will contribute to campaign strategies, oversee post-sales execution, and track performance. This role is crucial to driving growth and success across our Television, Streaming, and Digital platforms by fostering value-driven partnerships and delivering measurable results.
As a Sales Marketing Coordinator (SMC), you will become an expert in 9NEWS programming, the TEGNA Digital Product Suite, and sales tools. You will develop a deep understanding of how to create effective sales materials, manage ongoing sales initiatives, community events, and execute digital media campaigns that drive optimal results for advertisers. Your expertise will be a key component of the ad solutions we deliver to clients.
The SMC will work closely with Account Executives, marketing, research, Colorado & Company, community affairs, and production teams to support advertisers' business needs and challenges, translating them into innovative advertising solutions that maximize ROI.

Responsibilities:
•    Project Management: Translates client needs into tailored advertising solutions, supporting Account Executives (AEs) throughout interactions with prospective and current advertisers. Possesses deep knowledge of TEGNA’s products, verticals, and solutions.
•    Sales Material Development: Creates compelling sales materials that outline strategic advertising solutions leveraging TEGNA’s products and services.
•    Solution Development: Collaborates with AEs throughout the ideation process to develop innovative ad solutions and client proposals.
•    Proposal Review & Presentation: Reviews proposals with AEs to ensure accuracy and effectiveness. May participate in proposal presentations to advertisers when needed.
•    Solution Deployment: Works with internal TEGNA teams to determine if existing solutions (e.g., TEGNA Marketing Solutions programs) can be utilized or if unique concepts need to be developed to achieve desired business outcomes.
•    Post-Sale Transition: Collaborates with AEs to ensure a seamless transition from sale to execution, coordinating with the Account Manager and fulfillment team.
•    Cross-Department Coordination: Serves as a liaison between the sales, community, and news departments to launch sponsored content programs across linear and digital platforms.
•    Sponsored Content Management: Oversees social media posts and ad strategies related to sponsored content initiatives.
•    CRM & Campaign Management: Ensures AEs complete Campaign Briefs in CRW, acknowledges receipt, and gathers any additional information needed for campaign execution.

Requirements:
•    Education: Bachelor’s degree preferred.
•    Experience: 2+ years in a pre-sales solutions role, preferably within the advertising industry.
•    Technical Skills:
•    Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, with strong PowerPoint skills for developing professional client-facing presentations.
•    Experience with CRM and Project Management software.
•    Knowledge of TV, streaming, and digital marketing.
•    Experience using social media ad platforms (Facebook Ad Manager preferred).

Other Qualifications:
•    Strong verbal and written communication skills.
•    Highly detail-oriented with strong project management and proofreading skills, ensuring accuracy and consistency in all materials and communications.
•    Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

 

The application deadline for this position is Dec 9, 2026

job.title: Sr. Web Developer
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

Are you ready to shape the web experiences of tens of millions of Americans every month? Join TEGNA’s Development team, where we build cutting-edge websites, mobile apps, OTT apps, and custom editorial tools. Despite being part of a large, publicly traded company, our team operates with the agility and excitement of a startup. We’re a fun-loving group of professionals who thrive on innovation and getting things done.
We are seeking a Senior Web Developer to help lead the evolution of our web platform, which powers experiences for millions of users across a large network of local news stations. In this role, you’ll build new features, mentor teammates, tackle our toughest performance and architecture challenges, and help set the technical direction for the platform. If you love modern web development and working in a collaborative environment, this is the perfect opportunity for you.
This is a hybrid role based in Knoxville, TN, with a mix of in-office and remote work.

Responsibilities
•    Design, build, and ship features for our web platform using JavaScript and contemporary web technologies, aligned with the product roadmap and our engineering standards.
•    Own significant areas of the codebase and serve as a key resource for investigating and resolving complex product issues.
•    Write efficient, reusable, and reliable code that is scalable and maintainable.
•    Identify performance bottlenecks—especially around Core Web Vitals, rendering, and page load—and drive solutions.
•    Mentor other developers through code review, pairing, and technical guidance.
•    Collaborate with developers, designers, product/business managers, backend, and CMS teams to translate requirements into well-architected solutions.
•    Help maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and release processes for web deployments.
•    Rapidly learn new technologies and adapt to changing business and customer needs.
Requirements
•    5+ years of professional software development experience, including 3+ years building production, client-facing web applications with JavaScript.
•    Hands-on experience with modern web development and contemporary web technologies.
•    Solid understanding of modern application architecture and separation of concerns.
•    Experience with modern state management and asynchronous programming patterns.
•    Experience consuming RESTful APIs and working with JSON.

Experience with CMS, photo and video-editing systems preferred

The ability to write in an exciting, captivating and conversational tone is preferred

Experience creating and managing content on social media platforms, including Instagram, Twitter and Facebook

An aptitude for creating and packaging engaging, audience-driven content

Knowledge of how to interpret and use digital analytics is a plus

Knowledge of ENPS, Edius, Canva is a plus

Ability to work various shifts, including mornings, nights and weekends

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

The YCL Videographer/Producer is responsible for capturing, producing, and supporting the creation of engaging lifestyle content for Your California Life. This hybrid role combines field and studio videography, technical production, control room automation, and segment development.

Working closely with the Host/Executive Producer and the YCL team, this position supports daily program production and contributes to field segments, special programming, and branded or partner content. The successful candidate brings strong technical skills, creative storytelling ability, sound judgment, and a collaborative approach, with the opportunity to expand producing and writing

Responsibilities:

Videography and Content Production
•    Shoot field segments, lifestyle features, interviews, packages, and other program content that aligns with YCL’s editorial and creative objectives.
•    Capture high-quality video and audio in field and studio environments.
•    Collaborate with the production team to develop visually engaging stories and segments for broadcast and digital platforms.
•    Assist with planning and executing field-based specials, seasonal programming, location shoots, and partner packages.
Studio and Control Room Operations
•    Operate show automation, including Cuez, during YCL tapings and productions.
•    Support studio production by setting up and adjusting cameras, preparing microphones, and assisting talent and guests.
•    Monitor production workflows and troubleshoot technical issues to help ensure smooth, timely recordings.
•    Coordinate with studio crew and station operations teams to maintain production quality and readiness.
Producing and Editorial Support
•    Collaborate with the Host/Executive Producer on daily show planning, segment development, and production needs.
•    Assist with researching, developing, and preparing lifestyle content and guest segments.
•    Contribute to writing and producing segments, with coaching and support from the Executive Producer.
•    Help coordinate field shoots, production elements, and content requirements to meet program deadlines.

Collaboration and Production Coordination
•    Work closely with the YCL team, studio crew, and station departments to deliver polished programming on schedule.
•    Communicate production needs, schedules, and technical considerations effectively.
•    Demonstrate flexibility and initiative in balancing creative, technical, and operational responsibilities.
•    Perform other related duties as assigned.

Requirements:
•    Demonstrated hands-on videography experience, including field and/or studio shooting.
•    Experience in broadcast production, such as studio, control room, or master control operations.
•    Working knowledge of cameras, audio equipment, microphones, and related production technology.
•    Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and adapt to changing production needs.
•    Strong organizational, communication, and collaboration skills.
•    Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced broadcast environment.
•    Interest in developing producing, writing, and editorial skills.
•    A proactive, flexible, and team-oriented approach to work.
Preferred Qualifications
•    Experience with broadcast automation systems, including Ross Overdrive, Sony ELC, Cuez, or vMix.
•    Previous experience as a director, technical director, production supervisor, or operations manager.
•    Master control experience, including playlist execution and coordination with a hub.
•    Production assistant experience supporting studio or field operations.
•    Producing or writing experience in lifestyle, news, entertainment, or other broadcast programming.
•    Experience supporting field-based specials, branded content, or partner productions.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
•    Strong visual storytelling and production skills.
•    Ability to operate technical equipment while maintaining awareness of editorial and creative goals.
•    Sound problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
•    Ability to work independently in the field and collaboratively in a studio environment.

job.title: Analista en Ad Operations & Google Ad Manager 360
job.description:
Analista en Ad Operations & Google Ad Manager 360

Ubicación: Ciudad de México (Santa Fe), Presencial

 

Acerca del puesto y el equipo

Forma parte del equipo de TelevisaUnivision, la empresa líder mundial en medios y contenido en español. Con la videoteca más extensa de contenido propio y una capacidad de producción sin igual en la industria, impulsamos nuestras plataformas de streaming, televisión tradicional y radio, creando experiencias que conectan con millones de personas.

Somos una empresa vibrante con más de 10,000 colaboradores en México, Colombia y Estados Unidos, unidos por la pasión por el entretenimiento, la creatividad y la innovación. En TelevisaUnivision encontrarás un entorno inclusivo, dinámico y lleno de oportunidades para crecer personal y profesionalmente, ¡Únete y sé parte de este gran equipo creativo!

TelevisaUnivision está en búsqueda de un Especialista AdOps ADTV (Google Ad Manager 360) para integrarse a la VP. de Ventas, Dirección de Ad Operations.


El área es responsable del trafficking, la configuración técnica y la operación diaria de las campañas de Addressable TV (ADTV) de izzi dentro del ecosistema digital de TelevisaUnivision, asegurando la correcta entrega de campañas en video y CTV, el cumplimiento de SLAs y el correcto reconocimiento de ingresos.


Sobre ti

Eres un perfil técnico y analítico con experiencia en Ad Operations y ad serving de video y CTV, capaz de ser el enlace entre izzi y TelevisaUnivision, con gran atención al detalle y habilidad para resolver problemas bajo presión.


Tu día a día

  • Ejecutar el trafficking de campañas ADTV en Google Ad Manager 360: órdenes, line items, creatividades y segmentación.
  • Configurar y mantener el targeting addressable en GAM, en coordinación con izzi y el área de datos.
  • Elaborar forecast y gestionar la disponibilidad de inventario ADTV por canal, señal y evento.
  • Operar y dar soporte técnico a la entrega de video y CTV (tags VAST, SSAI, pods y SCTE-35).
  • Monitorear la entrega y conciliar discrepancias entre GAM y los as-run de izzi, asegurando el correcto reconocimiento de ingresos.
  • Configurar, activar y dar seguimiento a deals Programmatic Guaranteed (PG) y Private Marketplace (PMP) con DV360, Amazon DSP y otras plataformas.
  • Coordinar con izzi, programación de canales y producción la operación comercial de eventos en vivo.
  • Generar reportes de entrega, rendimiento y calidad, y proponer mejoras de procesos y automatización de la operación ADTV.


Tu deberías de tener

  • Licenciatura concluida en Comunicación, Mercadotecnia, Sistemas o afín.
  • Conocimiento comprobable de Google Ad Manager 360; deseable certificación GAM, DV360 o Amazon DSP.
  • Experiencia en Ad Operations / trafficking en medios, broadcaster, OTT o agencia.
  • Experiencia en video y CTV: VAST, SSAI, pods y SCTE-35.
  • Experiencia en conciliación de entrega y activación de deals PG y PMP.
  • Deseable experiencia en Addressable TV / Pay TV (izzi, Sky u operadores de cable) y conocimientos de SQL / BigQuery.
  • Pensamiento analítico, atención al detalle y capacidad de trabajar bajo presión en eventos en vivo.
  • Modalidad de trabajo:En sitio

Experiencia requerida: +3 años. Inglés intermedio-avanzado (B2 técnico); deseable C1.


Beneficios

En TelevisaUnivision, valoramos el bienestar integral de nuestros colaboradores. Promovemos un equilibrio saludable entre la vida personal y profesional, ofreciendo beneficios de ley y superiores que impulsan la productividad, la creatividad y el desarrollo personal y profesional.


Nuestro compromiso con la inclusión

job.title: Anchor & Reporter
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision Local Media has an immediate opening for a full-time Anchor & Reporter. This position will be responsible for investigating, writing and presenting accurate, balanced news stories and anchoring for the station’s newscasts. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: shooting, editing, daily newsgathering, and reporting as well as appearances at community and station events in a fast-paced, extremely competitive market.


YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Produce and report news stories using ENG equipment, non-linear editing equipment, and related broadcasting equipment and newsroom computer systems.
  • Write and proofread copy for accuracy prior to going on air.
  • Research, investigate, interview, write, produce and report daily news packages, special news series or weather-related stories on tape and/or live from the field.
  • Research, investigate, interview, write, produce and present news for station’s social media pages, other company broadcasts, websites and printed publications as assigned.
  • Work well with P2 and XD cameras to shoot interviews
  • Establish a good working-relationship with newscast producers and co-anchors to ensure a well-paced, accurate and informative broadcast.
  • Must be a strong and fast writer and have solid news judgment as a Producer.
  • Attend and participate in off-site company-sponsored and community events as assigned by station management.
  • Create, publish, and manage engaging social media content across multiple platforms to promote news coverage, increase audience engagement, and support daily newsroom initiatives.
  • Work flexible hours, including holidays, weekends and evenings.

 

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • High school diploma required
  • Must be fully bilingual in English and Spanish. Written and oral communication skills required
  • Must have working knowledge of television news photography and technology
  • Must be able to shoot with P2 and XD Cameras, and edit under deadline pressure
  • Must have and maintain a good driving record and a valid driver’s license, along with the ability to drive daily

 

Desired Skills & Experience

  • College degree in Journalism, Communication Studies, Radio-TV-Film, or equivalent experience
  • Broadcast news experience as reporter or photographer/editor
  • Prior experience in Spanish language broadcasting
  • Personal computer experience required, including non-linear editing equipment
  • Must be able to multi-task, work well under extreme pressure, and communicate effectively

 

Eligibility Requirements

  • Employment/education will be verified
  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis

 

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to lift and carry broadcast video equipment (approximately 45 pounds), and have manual dexterity in use of keyboard, video editing equipment (linear and non-linear) video machines, server-based video editing and playback systems and broadcast equipment

 

OUR BENEFITS:

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

 

#LI-ONSITE (100% onsite requirement)


Salary Range $65,000 – 75,000 + benefits


Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. Please note the national salary range listed in the job posting reflects the new hire salary range across levels and U.S. locations that would be applicable to the position.

job.title: Digital Planner
job.description:
Digital Planner



Acerca del puesto

El Digital Planner – IZZI Ops será responsable de planificar, administrar y optimizar la distribución y comercialización del inventario publicitario digital de IZZI, asegurando la correcta ejecución de las campañas y el cumplimiento de los compromisos comerciales.

Trabajará de manera transversal con los equipos de Ventas, Marketing, Producto y Operaciones para maximizar el rendimiento del inventario, impulsar oportunidades de monetización y generar insights que contribuyan a la toma de decisiones estratégicas del negocio.


Sobre el puesto

  • Asegurar el cumplimiento de los acuerdos de servicio (SLAs) con clientes internos y externos.
  • Maximizar el rendimiento y la monetización del inventario publicitario digital.
  • Contribuir a la optimización de ingresos y resultados de las campañas.
  • Generar análisis e insights basados en datos para identificar oportunidades de mejora y crecimiento.

Tu día a día

  • Administrar y optimizar campañas programáticas, supervisando su ejecución, monitoreando indicadores de desempeño y generando reportes analíticos periódicos.
  • Validar el correcto registro y reconocimiento de ingresos de las campañas en Google Ad Manager.
  • Planificar y supervisar la implementación de campañas publicitarias en las plataformas digitales de IZZI.
  • Analizar métricas históricas y resultados de campañas para identificar tendencias, oportunidades de optimización y áreas de mejora.
  • Monitorear la disponibilidad y distribución del inventario publicitario digital de IZZI en sus diferentes plataformas y canales, incluyendo HLS, Stitch y otros formatos de distribución.
  • Proponer e impulsar proyectos e iniciativas que contribuyan al crecimiento, aprovechamiento y monetización del inventario digital.
  • Elaborar forecasts y administrar la disponibilidad de inventario para eventos especiales, anticipando necesidades y oportunidades comerciales.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de Marketing, Producto, Operaciones, Administración, agencias y Ventas Digitales para asegurar la correcta ejecución de las estrategias comerciales.
  • Dar seguimiento al desempeño de las campañas y generar recomendaciones basadas en datos para mejorar su rendimiento y retorno de inversión (ROI).

Sobre ti

Buscamos una persona analítica, organizada y orientada a resultados, con capacidad para gestionar múltiples campañas e iniciativas simultáneamente, interpretar indicadores de desempeño y colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios.


Conocimientos y habilidades relevantes:

  • Administración y optimización de campañas digitales y programáticas.
  • Manejo de Google Ad Manager.
  • Análisis de métricas, elaboración de reportes y seguimiento de KPIs.
  • Planeación y administración de inventario publicitario digital.
  • Forecasting y análisis de disponibilidad de inventario.
  • Conocimiento de ecosistemas de distribución de contenido digital y tecnologías como HLS y Stitch.
  • Capacidad de análisis, organización, comunicación y colaboración transversal.

job.title: Graphics Operator
job.description:
Production Operations at Televisa Univision is looking for a Graphics Operator to join our team!

Responsibilities include playing back graphics for live and pre-produced shows and working closely with show producers, graphic artists and production staff. The Graphics Operator will report to the Production Manager.

 

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Cue and trigger graphic elements such as name and location lower thirds, boxes, full screens and wall graphics
  • Along with a strong technical background, the Graphics Operator must be alert, fast paced and able to work productively under high pressure situations
  • Be highly organized and able to work closely with show producers, graphic artists and production staff
  • Knowledge of iNews and basic computer skills (i.e. Microsoft Office and Outlook)
  • Knowledge of Vizrt Graphic System is preferred

 

 

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Minimum Associates Degree or equivalent college degree
  • Minimum 2-years’ experience on live shows
  • Bi-lingual (English and Spanish) required
  • Must have a working knowledge of control room workflows, basic GFX formats and execution
  • Able to perform many different duties, often changing from one task to another of a different nature without loss of efficiency or composure
  • Strong knowledge and understanding of broadcast and production technology
  • Interpersonal and professional communication skills
  • As this position supports 24x7 operation, candidate must, in addition to being able to work regular hours, have on-call availability and flexibility to work days, nights, overnights, weekends and holidays as needed and without advance notice.  Additionally, candidate may be required to work on site for extended periods of time to provide coverage in special circumstances, such as during tropical storms/hurricanes
