job.title: Manager, Technical Product Management
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

TelevisaUnivision is the leading Spanish-language media company in the world! We’re investing in our content, our people, and our platforms across digital, streaming, social, audio, linear, and live events. As we continue to grow our global streaming platform, ViX, we are focused on leveraging emerging technologies, artificial intelligence, and scalable digital solutions to enhance content management, operational efficiency, and the overall streaming experience.

 

TelevisaUnivision is seeking an experienced Technical Product Manager to lead product strategy, development, and execution for ViX's Content Management System (CMS), supporting backend engineering teams and driving AI-powered platform transformation.

This technical leadership role combines strategic product management, AI implementation, cross-functional collaboration, and Agile delivery. The position will play a critical role in modernizing editorial and content management workflows, translating business needs into scalable technical solutions, and advancing AI initiatives from experimentation to production-ready capabilities.

 

YOUR DAY-DAY: (Responsibilities)

·       Define and drive the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for ViX's Content Management System (CMS), with a focus on AI-powered modernization and platform enhancements.

·       Lead the implementation of AI-powered workflows, intelligent automation, and agent-based solutions to improve editorial processes and content management operations.

·       Evaluate and integrate AI technologies, including Gemini, Claude, and other emerging tools, into existing products, platforms, and business workflows.

·       Partner closely with backend engineering teams to define technical requirements, evaluate solutions, and support the development of scalable products and integrations.

·       Translate business objectives and stakeholder needs into detailed product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable development priorities.

·       Serve as a primary point of contact for CMS stakeholders, including Content Editorial, Pricing, Marketing, and other teams utilizing or integrating with the platform.

·       Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, as part of broader technical product management responsibilities.

·       Coordinate cross-functional initiatives involving backend engineering, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), APIs, and other technical integrations to ensure alignment and timely execution.

·       Manage product development dependencies, priorities, risks, and deliverables across engineering teams and business stakeholders.

·       Utilize Jira, Confluence, and other project management tools to maintain visibility into product development, execution, and delivery.

·       Drive alignment across technical and business teams, communicating product priorities, progress, challenges, and recommendations to key stakeholders.

·       Support continuous improvement initiatives, technical documentation, and process optimization to enhance product delivery and operational effectiveness.

 

YOU HAVE: (Required Skills, Qualifications and Experience)

·       7+ years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, or related technical product leadership roles.

·       Strong technical foundation with demonstrated ability to engage in complex technical discussions with backend engineering teams.

·       Proven experience defining and executing product strategies, roadmaps, and technical product initiatives.

·       Demonstrated hands-on experience implementing AI-powered workflows, AI agents, or intelligent automation solutions in production environments, beyond proof-of-concept or pilot initiatives.

·       Experience developing AI-enabled products or integrating AI capabilities into existing platforms and business processes.

·       Working knowledge of cloud-based infrastructure, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and API integrations.

·       Familiarity with AI technologies and platforms such as Gemini, Claude, or comparable solutions.

·       Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, including facilitating ceremonies, managing product backlogs, and coordinating engineering delivery.

·       Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and related product and project management tools.

·       Strong analytical, problem-solving, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills.

·       Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business requirements and communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical audiences.

·       Professional fluency in English required.

 

Preferred Experience

·       Previous people management or technical team leadership experience.

·       Experience in media, entertainment, streaming, or digital content platforms.

·       Familiarity with Content Management Systems (CMS), editorial workflows, and content distribution technologies.

·       Experience developing technical documentation, product guides, or user manuals.

·       Professional certifications in Product Management, Agile/Scrum, or Project Management (PMP).

 

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS

·       Must be willing to work in Bogota, Colombia.

Employment and education will be verified.

TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Meteorologist
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

TelevisaUnivision at N+ Univision Chicago is looking for a Meteorologist to join our morning news team! The Meteorologist will be responsible for live weather reporting for 5am, 6am and midday newscast. The ideal candidate must be a certified broadcast meteorologist and have an “always-on” weather mindset. He or she should be an excellent communicator, possess commanding and professional on-camera presence with top-notch judgment. Strong knowledge required of severe weather including tornadoes and winter storms.

ABOUT YOU:

Our meteorologists take a proactive approach to active weather coverage, keeping audiences informed across multiple platforms with timely, accurate updates. They work in a collaborative and supportive role with our news producers, assignment desk, reporters, and our management team. Our meteorologists are essential to create engaging weather content on air and online while preparing audiences for changing conditions and potential threats.

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Produce and effectively present lifestyle weather and daily forecast
  • Develop strategies for multiple dayparts, identifying opportunities to produce content for specific newscasts
  • Clearly communicating weather forecast and risk for potential active weather across platforms
  • Conceive creative graphics and execute them on air and online

job.title: News Media Desk Coordinator-Temp
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM

TelevisaUnivision is seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized News Media Desk Coordinator to join its News Department.

The News Media Desk Coordinator is responsible for ensuring the timely retrieval, processing, and delivery of media content for live and pre-recorded news programming. This role also ensures that all video assets are properly logged, tagged, and assigned accurate metadata to support efficient archival storage and future retrieval.


ABOUT YOU

You thrive in a fast-paced, highly technical, and automated broadcast environment. You are resourceful, detail-oriented, and capable of making sound decisions under pressure. You communicate clearly, provide accurate instructions, and take pride in delivering exceptional service and support to producers, journalists, and field personnel.


YOUR DAY-TO-DAY


  • Provide creative input and assist producers in identifying and sourcing relevant content for news programming.
  • Utilize Avid systems to search for, retrieve, and deliver media content to news bureaus and field personnel.
  • Use iNEWS to transfer and synchronize metadata from program rundowns to the PAM archival system.
  • Ensure all video assets are properly logged, categorized, and assigned accurate metadata for archival and future retrieval.
  • Perform basic video editing and clip selection using Avid Media Composer.
  • Ingest and process video files in various formats and codecs to prepare content for the editing workflow.
  • Maintain a working knowledge of current events and breaking news developments.
  • Respond promptly to media requests while providing proactive, service-oriented support to the News Department.
  • Prioritize and manage multiple requests while maintaining accuracy and meeting tight deadlines.

YOU HAVE


  • Previous experience working with Avid media management systems.
  • Strong typing skills with a high level of speed and accuracy.
  • Excellent multitasking, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy under pressure.
  • Full professional proficiency in both English and Spanish (bilingual required).
  • Basic video editing skills and hands-on experience with Avid Media Composer.
  • The ability to make quick decisions and communicate clear, accurate instructions.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • A proactive, service-oriented approach and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • The ability to work in a fast-paced newsroom, including during breaking news situations.
  • Physical ability to lift and move boxes as required.

TECHNICAL SKILLS & SYSTEMS

Working knowledge or experience with the following systems and equipment:

  • Avid Media Composer
  • Avid Interplay Access
  • Avid Interplay | MAM Desktop
  • MediaCentral
  • iNEWS
  • MediaPulse
  • File Transfer
  • DIVA
  • Video converters and media ingestion equipment

job.title: Photographer I
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision is seeking a dedicated, creative, and passionate full-time Photographer to join our news team. The Photographer will play an essential role in bringing stories to life by capturing compelling visuals for our news programming across live and taped events. As part of a fast-paced and collaborative team, you will work closely with reporters, producers, and other newsroom partners to deliver high-quality visual storytelling. The ideal candidate has a strong eye for compelling images, can think quickly in a dynamic environment, and is passionate about covering the stories that matter most to our community. If you can capture images that speak volumes, see beyond the lens, and bring creativity and strong storytelling instincts to every assignment, we’d love to have you on our team.


YOUR DAY-TO-DAY:

  • Shoot and edit daily news stories, breaking news, special reports and stories as assigned with or without reporter using non-linear, computer-based editing equipment.
  • Set up, test, and operate equipment for live and recorded broadcasts, including LiveU and other mobile transmission technology.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues in the field and communicate equipment or transmission concerns to the appropriate team.
  • Edit materials to match script prepared by reporter, producer or associate producer using on-location facilities or any other location required. 
  • Work with reporters to get complete stories and makes suggestions on how a story should be produced. 
  • Be able to drive, operate and handle all necessary equipment and/or other equipment used in live transmissions. 
  • Keep assigned equipment and/or vehicle in good working condition and files all required paperwork, as deadlines require. 
  • Be able to work various shifts and times as well as during inclement weather.
  • Might be required to upload video, digital pictures, and copy to the station’s website and social media.
  • Perform routine maintenance and light troubleshooting on equipment.
  • Assist with news production and assignment desk as assigned.
  • Follow all station and company safety policies and procedures, particularly when operating vehicles, working around live events, or covering hazardous weather and breaking news
  • Use sound judgment and editorial awareness when covering sensitive, fast-moving, or high-profile news events.
  • Manage, organize, and archive video and other digital media according to newsroom and company standards.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

YOU HAVE:

  • College Degree or equivalent work experience in Broadcast Communications.
  • At least 2 years’ experience in camera/editing
  • Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills both written and oral
  • Knowledge of editing software’s such as Avid Media Composer
  • Knowledge I-news rundown
  • Valid Driver’s license with clean driving record, as driving a news vehicle daily to and from stories is an essential part of the daily routine.
  • Be able to lift heavy equipment up to 45 pounds, bend and set-up equipment for remotes to allow transmission of pictures or live from-the-scene reports back to the station.
  • Must be able to work outdoor and inclement weather conditions.
  • Must have unrestricted authorization to work in the United States
  • Strong visual storytelling, composition, lighting, and audio skills.
  • Ability to work independently and make sound decisions in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and teamwork skills.
  • Familiarity with newsroom systems, digital platforms, and emerging technology.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing assignments, priorities, and breaking news situations.

job.title: Planner Digital Jr
job.description:
Nombre de la Posición 

Planner Digital Jr

Ubicación

Ciudad de México, Presencial


Acerca del puesto y el equipo

Formarás parte de la Vicepresidencia de Ventas, dentro de la Dirección de Inventarios e Ingresos Publicitarios. El equipo es responsable de la planificación y optimización del inventario digital y la ejecución de campañas publicitarias en múltiples plataformas, trabajando de manera transversal con Marketing, Producto, Operaciones, Administración, agencias y clientes. 


Sobre el puesto

El objetivo del puesto es asistir en la planificación, ejecución y optimización de campañas de marketing digital, analizando datos de rendimiento y apoyando en la gestión de inventario digital. El rol colabora con el Planner Senior y otros stakeholders para asegurar una correcta planificación basada en datos históricos, disponibilidad de inventario y objetivos comerciales, contribuyendo al crecimiento de ingresos publicitarios digitales.


Sobre ti

Eres una persona analítica, organizada y orientada a datos, con interés en marketing digital y medios. Tienes facilidad para trabajar con múltiples tareas, comunicarte con diferentes áreas y aprender nuevas tecnologías. Te gusta trabajar en equipo, gestionar información compleja y convertir datos en insights accionables.


Tu día a día

• Desarrollar y ejecutar estrategias de publicidad digital alineadas con los objetivos comerciales. 
• Planificar y supervisar la implementación de campañas publicitarias en plataformas digitales de TelevisaUnivision. 
• Analizar métricas históricas de rendimiento digital para evaluar campañas, identificar tendencias y apoyar la planificación basada en datos. 
• Mantenerse actualizado sobre la disponibilidad de inventario digital en múltiples plataformas (AVOD, SVOD, Live Streaming, AA.EE). 
• Proponer proyectos e iniciativas que contribuyan al crecimiento de la Dirección de Inventario e Ingresos Publicitarios. 
• Realizar forecast y administración de inventario en eventos especiales. 
• Explorar el uso de data 1st y 3rd party para campañas digitales en operación diaria. 
• Colaborar con Marketing, Producto, Operaciones, Administración, agencias y equipos de ventas digitales. 


Tú deberás tener

• Licenciatura concluida. 
• Deseable certificaciones digitales (Google Ad Manager, Facebook Ads, Looker, conocimientos en programática). 
• Inglés nivel intermedio (B1–B2). 
• Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en marketing digital, medios, publicidad, ventas o administración de cuentas. 
• Conocimientos básicos en herramientas de marketing digital. 
• Excelentes habilidades analíticas y de resolución de problemas. 
• Capacidad para analizar datos, identificar tendencias y extraer insights. 
• Organización, atención al detalle y gestión de múltiples tareas. 
• Habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo. 
• Deseable habilidades de presentación y gestión de proyectos. 


Beneficios

Ofrecemos prestaciones de ley y superiores, así como oportunidades de desarrollo profesional dentro de una organización líder en medios y publicidad digital, con exposición a proyectos estratégicos y tecnologías de vanguardia.

job.title: Project Management Coordinator
job.description:
The Engineering Project Management department supports the planning and execution of engineering, technology, and broadcast infrastructure projects across the organization. The team works closely with Engineering, Broadcast Operations, Technology, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, and external vendors to keep projects organized, on track, and moving forward. The Coordinator is the operational backbone of the team, providing day-to-day coordination, tracking, documentation, and follow-through across the project portfolio.


ABOUT YOU:

You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities at once. You enjoy keeping projects moving, making sure the right people have the right information, and following through on the details that drive successful execution. You are proactive, resourceful, and comfortable working across Engineering, Operations, Finance, Procurement, and vendors. You don't need to be the technical expert—you know how to coordinate people, information, schedules, and resources to help the team deliver.


YOUR DAY-DAY:

  • Maintain project plans, schedules, trackers, action items, milestones, and deliverables.

YOU HAVE:

job.title: Scheduling Coordinator
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision is seeking a detail-oriented Scheduling Coordinator to support Noticias 24/7, a News streaming channel on our streaming service, VIX. This position plays an essential role in ensuring the integrity of the streaming service to deliver viewer satisfaction.


The Scheduling Coordinator will accurately schedule content playlists, maintain program calendars, oversee playout, and manage all program data. Additionally, this role contributes to the execution of scheduling strategies and operations, including collaboration in the development of promotional materials, coordinating deliverables between multiple departments, and participating in the evaluation and implementation of workflows and systems.

The successful candidate will be organized, detail-oriented and deadline-driven, as well as very comfortable learning and using program scheduling and playout systems both on-site and remotely.   • Self-starter, resourceful, adaptable and able to work well under pressure and on multiple projects at the same time.

job.title: Senior de Contabilidad General, Inglés Avanzado
job.description:
Nombre de la posición: Senior de Contabilidad General, Inglés Avanzado

Ubicación:  Ciudad de México (Santa Fe) 


Forma parte del equipo de TelevisaUnivision, la empresa líder en el mundo de medios y contenido en español. TelevisaUnivision cuenta con la más extensa videoteca de contenido propio y es líder en capacidad de producción en el sector, lo que impulsa su contenido digital de streaming, televisión tradicional y plataformas de radio. 

Somos una empresa vibrante con más de 10,000 colaboradores en México, Colombia y EE. UU. Nos une la pasión por el entretenimiento, la creatividad y los grandes hitos. En TelevisaUnivision encontrarás un ambiente amigable y lleno de equidad para crecer personal y profesionalmente. 

 

Acerca del puesto y equipo 

 

El área de Operación Contable y Reporteo UNV GBS desempeña un papel fundamental en la gestión financiera de las operaciones de Estados Unidos, asegurando la precisión, integridad y cumplimiento de la información contable. 

Somos un equipo enfocado en la excelencia operativa, el análisis financiero y la mejora continua, donde la atención al detalle, el pensamiento analítico y la colaboración entre áreas son esenciales para garantizar información confiable y oportuna para la toma de decisiones. 

 

La posición de Senior de Contabilidad General pertenece a la: 

Contraloría y Reporteo / Operación Contable y Reporteo UNV GBS 

 

Sobre ti 

Serás responsable de supervisar y gestionar las actividades relacionadas con el procesamiento diario del libro mayor (General Ledger), asegurando el correcto registro de ingresos y gastos, así como la integridad de la información financiera de las operaciones de Estados Unidos. 

 

Tu rol será clave para garantizar cierres financieros oportunos, analizar transacciones contables, revisar conciliaciones, identificar variaciones y preparar reportes financieros para la alta dirección. 

 

Además, colaborarás con distintas áreas financieras y operativas para asegurar el cumplimiento de las políticas contables, apoyar auditorías y contribuir a la implementación de mejoras y soluciones que fortalezcan los procesos financieros. 

 

Tu día a día incluirá: 

  • Gestionar diariamente el libro mayor (General Ledger) y realizar el cierre financiero, asegurando que todos los ingresos y gastos estén registrados correctamente. 
  • Analizar los ingresos provenientes de socios de plataformas de streaming. 
  • Revisar contratos de socios de contenido para determinar y aplicar el tratamiento contable adecuado. 
  • Apoyar en el mantenimiento y actualización de la base de datos en línea de activos de contenido. 
  • Revisar conciliaciones bancarias y dar seguimiento al proceso diario de administración de efectivo. 
  • Asegurar que las conciliaciones de cuentas se preparen y revisen conforme a las políticas de la empresa y al calendario de cierre mensual. 
  • Realizar investigaciones complejas y análisis de transacciones del libro mayor. 
  • Preparar y presentar análisis de variaciones trimestrales (Flux Presentations) para la alta dirección. 
  • Coordinar auditorías internas y externas, así como atender requerimientos fiscales mediante la preparación de reportes y documentación de respaldo. 
  • Identificar oportunidades de mejora en los procesos contables y desarrollar soluciones que contribuyan a la eficiencia operativa. 
  • Apoyar actividades de integración contable e implementación de soluciones financieras y contables. 
  • Elaborar reportes financieros y ejecutivos para la alta dirección. 

 

 

Tú deberías tener

job.title: VP, Agency Sales
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

 

TelevisaUnivision is the world's leading Spanish-language media company, reaching audiences across streaming, digital, social, audio, live events, sports, and linear television. Powered by the scale of ViX, premium content, first-party audience capabilities, and deep cultural connection with Hispanic consumers, we help brands drive measurable business outcomes across every stage of the consumer journey.

 

We are seeking a strategic, client-focused Vice President, Agency Sales based in New York to lead revenue growth across a portfolio of major agency and client relationships. This executive will serve as a trusted advisor to senior agency and brand leaders, developing innovative, outcome-based advertising solutions that leverage TelevisaUnivision's full ecosystem.

 

The ideal candidate brings a modern understanding of media and advertising, including streaming, audience-based buying, programmatic, social content partnerships, commerce and retail media integrations, data and measurement solutions, and cross-platform sponsorship opportunities. This leader will inspire high-performing sales teams, strengthen marketplace partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth through consultative selling and strategic account leadership.

 

This is a highly visible leadership opportunity for a dynamic sales executive with deep agency relationships, strong business acumen, and a passion for helping brands connect authentically with Hispanic audiences at scale.

 

YOUR DAY-DAY:

  • Drive quarterly and annual revenue goals across assigned agency and client portfolios.
  • Build and grow executive-level relationships with agencies and advertisers.
  • Lead sales strategies across Streaming/CTV, Digital, Social, Audio, Live Events, and Linear platforms.
  • Develop integrated, audience-led marketing solutions that deliver measurable client outcomes.
  • Negotiate complex, high-value partnerships and sponsorships.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Research, Pricing & Planning, Client Success, and Ad Operations teams.
  • Coach and develop a high-performing team of Account Executives and sales support professionals.
  • Identify new business opportunities, market trends, and revenue growth strategies.
  • Deliver accurate forecasting and business insights to senior leadership.
  • Responsible to delivering their sales targets as provided by the EVP of U.S. Agency sales

YOU HAVE:

·       Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

·       10+ years of media advertising sales experience, including leadership responsibilities.

·       Proven success exceeding revenue goals and managing large agency/client relationships.

·       2+ years of product knowledge and expertise across Streaming/CTV, Digital, Social, Data & Measurement, Audience-Based Buying, and Linear TV.

·       Strong understanding of today's advertising ecosystem, including programmatic, retail media, attribution, and AI-enabled sales solutions.

·       Established relationships with major agencies and advertisers.

·       Exceptional leadership, negotiation, presentation, and communication skills.

·       Excellent executive-level presentation, leadership and interpersonal skills, as well as influencing skills

·       Strong problem solving, analytical capabilities and collaboration skills

·       Spanish language skills are a plus.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience leveraging AI-powered tolls to support sales strategies, client prospecting, proposal development, and business reporting.
  • Proficiency in prompt engineering, including the ability to develop clear, effective prompts to generate actionable business insights and improve workflow efficiency.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven advertising solutions, including audience targeting, campaign optimization, and performance measurement.

 

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be willing to work from office in New York, NY
  • Employment/education will be verified

job.title: VP, Ad Operations & Campaign Management
job.description:
About the Daily Beast

The Daily Beast delivers award-winning original reporting and sharp opinions from big personalities in the arenas of politics, pop culture, world news, and more. Fiercely independent and armed with irreverent intelligence, The Daily Beast now reaches more than 20 million readers per month.

Job Description

The Daily Beast is seeking a dynamic and dedicated VP, Ad Operations & Campaign Management to join our news team.

About the Role

We're hiring an analytical, hands-on and detail-oriented leader to run our ad business across our audience of nearly 50 million. You'll lead a small team, manage ad tech and inventory performance, and make sure every campaign delivers and every client comes back.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach and grow a small team across ad operations, media planning and campaign management, including full-time contractor resources
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing on RFPs, media plans and avails that win business and are built to deliver
  • Bring fresh thinking to how we manage and package our wide range of inventory, including web, in-app, podcasts, newsletters, social and more, and partner with Sales and Product to develop new ad products across these and emerging channels
  • Set the standard for flawless campaign execution, from launch, trafficking and QA through pacing, delivery and post-sale reporting, and turn results into renewals
  • Drive ad tech and performance across all inventory: viewability, fill, ad load, page speed and discrepancies
  • Lead the ad tech stack strategy and operations (GAM, header bidding, SSP integrations, ads.txt, CMP), plus verification and measurement vendors
  • Partner with EPD (Engineering, Product & Design) and Programmatic as a key stakeholder on all things ad product
  • Work with the Programmatic team on new partner integrations and A/B tests of new products and solutions, balancing revenue growth with page experience
  • Build the workflows and reporting that give leadership a clear view of campaign and delivery health
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for priority clients

What You Bring

  • 10+ years in digital ad operations or campaign management, ideally at a publisher; 5+ years leading teams
  • Expert in ad tech platforms (GAM, SSPs, OMS) and programmatic
  • Cross-channel campaign experience beyond web display
  • Full sales cycle experience: RFPs, media planning, execution, reporting and renewals
  • Hands-on with Boostr (or similar), DoubleVerify/IAS, Comscore and Google Analytics
  • Track record of improving delivery, efficiency and retention, with the numbers to show it
  • Analytical, detail-oriented and hands-on with data; calm and decisive in a fast-paced environment

Pay Range Salary

The pay range for this position is $140,000 - $175,000.

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high ends of the salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location, experience, performance, and other factors.

Additional Information

Don’t meet every single requirement listed here? If you’re interested in joining the Beast but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with this job description, we encourage you to give it a shot all the same. It might turn out that you’re just the right candidate for this or other roles. See more about our commitment to diversity at https://www.thedailybeast.com/company/diversity

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

job.title: Deputy head of multimedia
job.description:
Guardian Australia is part of Guardian News & Media (GNM), publisher of theguardian.com. As a leading global media organisation, we are renowned for our pioneering independent journalism and our award-winning digital products.

We are seeking for a deputy head of multimedia to help lead Guardian Australia's multimedia department, fostering an experimental culture to ensure it stays ahead of market trends and remains at the cutting edge of audio, video and social media journalism.

This role is being offered on a full-time, permanent basis, with early starts or late finishes. This role is open to candidates based in both Sydney and Melbourne.

In this role you will…

  • Manage the production and oversight of audio, video and off-platform content to ensure it meets editorial goals, standards, objectives and purpose.
  • Stay across developments in video, audio and off-platform storytelling and innovate to find and engage new audiences.
  • Manage the planning, development and execution of content across platforms, including budget considerations.
  • Liaise with UK and US audio, video and off-platform teams to make sure Guardian Australia is benefitting from their work and innovation, and is reaching  global audiences where appropriate.  
  • Provide team leadership, strategic direction and management to executive producers, producers and hosts. 
  • With the head of multimedia, manage video and off-platform teams, including day-to-day editorial tasks.  

 

You’ll bring….

Knowledge and experience

  • At least 8 years of experience editing in a national newsroom, including multimedia reporting and editing 
  • Proven experience in managing staff, news editing and editorial decision making 
  • Able to commission compelling and accurate stories to tight deadlines
  • Wide knowledge of and interest in news and current affairs, domestically and internationally
  • Proven experience in multimedia production and commissioning 
  • Excellent knowledge of Australian media law
  • Excellent knowledge social media platforms and how to effectively use them to boost reputation and engagement
  • Expert understanding of the evolving ways people consume news video and audio on and off platform
  • Track record in journalism innovation 
  • Excellent team leadership skills
  • Experience mentoring and developing talent
  • Familiarity with the issues that prompt debate within Guardian Australia’s  readership
  • Clear vision of the purpose, aims and values of Guardian Australia
  • Understanding of the demands of a fast-moving news organisation
  • Able to respond quickly to changing events and breaking new

 

Skills / behaviours

  • A passion for independent journalism and an understanding of our editorial code and values
  • Proactive self-starter and strong team player
  • Excellent interpersonal and management skills
  • Ability to work under pressure, to prioritise and meet deadlines
  • Imaginative and able to work independently as well as generate ideas and motivate others 
  • High attention to detail
  • Good organisation, planning and time-management skills 
  • Collaborative team player who is also open to feedback, correction and is comfortable with performance accountability
  • Resilient and comfortable working under pressure
  • Willingness to experiment with new ideas and formats

 

About working at Guardian Australia… 

  • Hybrid working 
  • Employee assistance program (EAP) to support employee wellbeing
  • Paid volunteer leave
  • Dedicated diversity and inclusion employee groups, action plans (including our Reconciliation Action Plan) and cultural competency training
  • Guardian digital subscription

 

For more information please view the full job description here.

This role is being offered on a full-time, permanent basis, with early starts or late finishes. This role is open to candidates based in both Sydney and Melbourne.

To apply for this position, please apply online and upload your résumé (maximum three pages) plus covering letter. In your covering letter please outline your motivation for applying for the role and why you think you are suitable.

Closing date for applications: 17 November 2026

If you have application questions or if you require an adjustment to be made during the recruitment process, please email australia.hr@theguardian.com

GNM Australia Limited (Guardian Australia) is proud to be a fair and ethical employer. Australian editorial minimum rates of pay by band and grade are outlined in the Journalists (GNM Australia Pty Ltd) Enterprise Agreement 2024 for roles that fall under its coverage. 

We believe that our role in the Australian media is to give a voice to the most marginalised people in society and value and respect all differences in all people — including people of colour, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people from different social classes, people with diverse gender and sexual identities, and people with disabilities (seen and unseen). We believe that these communities must be centred in the work we do, bringing a new perspective and a diversity of thought. We also encourage flexible working and aim to create a work environment where all employees feel respected.

job.title: Editorial Data Analyst
job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism, and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals, and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

 

We are now looking for a Data Analyst to join our Editorial Analytics team. You’ll use data to help understand how our journalism reaches and engages readers, and supports decision making across the newsroom and wider business. 

 

About the role

  • Provide insights on reader engagement and content performance to inform newsroom strategy.
  • Develop an understanding of editorial workflows, audience behaviour and business priorities, and apply this context when interpreting data.
  • Communicate findings clearly, tailoring outputs to different audiences and explaining context and limitations.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering and other teams to support feature development, experimentation and performance analysis.
  • Work responsibly and ethically with data, following privacy and governance standards.

 

About you

  • Experience working with data using SQL (in a professional or academic setting).
  • Understanding of core analytical concepts (e.g. averages, distributions, basic statistical testing).
  • Familiarity with data visualisation tools (e.g. Tableau, Looker).
  • Ability to think logically about problems and break them down into manageable analyses.
  • Comfortable working with stakeholders and building positive working relationships.

We operate in a hybrid environment working 3 days a week from our offices in Kings Cross and 2 days a week remotely. 

We actively encourage applications from groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media

 

We value and respect all differences (seen and unseen) in all people. We aspire to have inclusive working experiences and an environment that reflects the audience we serve, where our people have equal access to career development opportunities, their voices are heard and can contribute to our future. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. Many of our staff work flexibly and we will consider all requests for flexible working arrangements.

 

How to apply

To apply, please upload your latest CV. You don't need to provide a cover letter. Instead, we have included a question on the application questionnaire relating to editorial analytics that we would like applicants to complete. This question should take about 5 minutes to answer, so please factor in the extra time when applying.

 

We appreciate the time taken to prepare each application we receive. We do not use AI-assisted technology to review applications; every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team. Thank you for bearing with us during the screening process. 

 

The closing date for applications is Wednesday 18th November 2026. 

 

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs. Please contact Anna Vipers on anna.vipers@guardian.co.uk to discuss further so we can work with you to support you through your application.

 

Benefits at the Guardian

You'll have 30 days of annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase an additional 5 days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.

job.title: Executive producer, Full Story
job.description:
Guardian Australia is part of Guardian News & Media (GNM), publisher of theguardian.com. As a leading global media organisation, we are renowned for our pioneering independent journalism and our award-winning digital products.
 

We are seeking an Executive producer for Guardian Australia’s flagship daily podcast, Full Story. You will have a pivotal role in brainstorming ideas to commissioning them, through to production and editorial sign off. 

 

This role is being offered on a full-time, permanent basis, with early starts or late finishes.


In this role you will…
 

  • Manage and executive produce our daily news podcast - Full Story - including commissioning daily episodes, managing staff and production schedules 
  • Ensure that Full Story covers topics our audience is interested in and that showcase Guardian Australia’s award-winning journalism in a timely manner
  • Manage and mentor staff as directed
  • Oversee episode editing sessions, including directing and signing off sound design, audio and video edits
  • Ensure episodes meet the highest editorial standards and legal compliance
  • Work closely with producers on interviews and scripting, and with sound designers to elevate stories
  • Work with hosts to continually develop the show’s sound and structure
  • Ensure that senior editorial staff are updated on progress and work with department heads to guide our marketing and social media teams to make sure the shows are promoted to the widest audience possible
  • Create audio and video episode pages with engaging headlines
  • Create site-specific thumbnails and headlines for YouTube and social clips  
  • Stay up to date with the latest developments in audio and video podcasting


You’ll bring….
 

  • At least 6-7 years’ experience in news storytelling in a digital news environment 
  • Substantial experience of producing news accurately and quickly under tight deadlines
  • Advanced level of editorial judgement, preferably developed in a national newsroom 
  • Significant experience of managing journalists and/or producers, key contributors and on-air talent
  • Proven track record in making high quality audio programming
  • Experience in producing interviews, collaborating on scripting and overseeing schedules 
  • Understanding of video podcasting processes and promotion
  • Commitment to showcasing diverse perspectives
  • Good knowledge of media law
  • Ability to consistently meet tight deadlines 
  • Ability to recognise and develop growth opportunities 
  • Excellent understanding of the tone, purpose and editorial aims and values of the Guardian
  • Understanding of (and interest in) the latest developments in audio 
  • Understanding of podcast distribution platforms and analytics 
  • The Guardian’s values: honesty, integrity, courage, fairness, and a sense of duty to the audience and the community 
  • Collaborative manager with excellent communication skills
  • Comfortable producing work on a tight deadline
  • Organised and able to manage multiple projects at a time
  • Good problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work with high profile journalists and external contributors
  • Flexible and able to adapt to changing priorities
  • Ability to build relationships at all levels
  • Passion for narrative audio, podcast production and digital journalism
  • Proven journalistic instincts
  • Creative team player
  • Open to feedback and correction


About working at Guardian Australia… 
 

  • Hybrid working 
  • Employee assistance program (EAP) to support employee wellbeing
  • Paid volunteer leave
  • Dedicated diversity and inclusion employee groups, action plans (including our Reconciliation Action Plan) and cultural competency training
  • Guardian digital subscription


For more information please view the full job description here.


This role is being offered on a full-time, permanent basis, working over a seven-day roster with early starts or late finishes.
 

To apply for this position, please apply online and upload your résumé (maximum three pages) plus covering letter. In your covering letter please outline your motivation for applying for the role and why you think you are suitable.
 

Closing date for applications: Thursday, 19 November 2026

 

If you have application questions or if you require an adjustment to be made during the recruitment process, please email australia.hr@theguardian.com


GNM Australia Limited (Guardian Australia) is proud to be a fair and ethical employer. Australian editorial minimum rates of pay by band and grade are outlined in the Journalists (GNM Australia Pty Ltd) Enterprise Agreement 2024 for roles that fall under its coverage. 


We believe that our role in the Australian media is to give a voice to the most marginalised people in society and value and respect all differences in all people — including people of colour, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people from different social classes, people with diverse gender and sexual identities, and people with disabilities (seen and unseen). We believe that these communities must be centred in the work we do, bringing a new perspective and a diversity of thought. job.title: Journalist Wellbeing and Safety Editor
job.description:
Fearless, independent reporting requires a steadfast commitment to the wellbeing and safety of those who deliver it. At the Guardian, safeguarding our journalists is fundamental to our editorial mission.

 

We’re looking for a journalist wellbeing and safety editor to develop and implement deliverable and effective strategies to protect Guardian journalists from physical and online harm and provide wellbeing support, for work-related matters.

 

Working closely with the managing editors’ team, you will act as the Guardian’s central lead on duty of care for journalists. You will design, embed and oversee practical strategies that protect our editorial staff, in an evolving and increasingly hostile climate.

 

This role primarily supports our UK editorial operations including our network of international correspondents, while collaborating closely with colleagues across Guardian US and Guardian Australia to maintain and elevate global best practices. 

 

This is a permanent NUJ contract, on a 5-day-week working pattern.

 

About the role

  • Work with managing editors to review and formalise newsroom-wide risk assessment protocols, ensuring rigorous health and safety standards are applied to all reporting assignments, particularly in high-risk environments.
  • Build a picture of the wellbeing and psychological challenges faced by journalists as a result of their work, consider how we can best support staff, and make costed and practical recommendations, leading on delivery following adoption.
  • Be a central point for reporting online abuse and physical safety concerns, managing and triaging cases, ensuring affected journalists receive timely support, and coordinating with security, information security and legal teams and managing editors as needed.
  • Design and implement comprehensive training programmes for journalists and managers (eg, hostile environment training), working in conjunction with the editorial training and development editor.
  • Develop and deliver training for journalists and managers on digital safety, such as securing social media accounts and preparing for potential responses to our published journalism.
  • Work with our commercial partners and with social media companies and tech platforms to address specific incidents and push for action on abusive accounts or content as well as systemic improvements to platform safety.
  • Gain a real-time understanding of the frequency and type of abuse our staff are facing (online and offline) to understand patterns of behaviour and implement relevant safety precautions and training in an informed way.

 

About you

  • The ability to develop and deliver mental health and wellbeing frameworks and strategies for journalists, ideally within a newsroom environment
  • Familiarity with digital threats such as doxing, hacking, and platform-specific privacy settings
  • The ability to develop and deliver safety strategies and training for both journalists and managers
  • Good knowledge of, or demonstrable interest in, online threats, digital security and relevant policies 
  • Strong knowledge of physical safety protocols, including risk assessments and health and safety regulations relevant to reporting
  • Understanding of the UK and global political landscape and how this might impact staff safety or lead to targeted abuse
  • Ideally, experience of dealing with social media platforms and lobbying them to take action when online abuse is posted and shared
  • Ability to respond calmly and systematically to high-severity threats or coordinated attacks, with experience in crisis management a benefit
  • Extensive experience of working in a fast-paced digital environment with a deep understanding of a newsroom and the environments where journalists work
  • Experience of working collaboratively with the media  industry, platforms, government, academics and training providers
  • Ideally, you’ll have a demonstrable ability to bring a diverse perspective to this role.

 

We actively encourage applications from groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media.

 

We operate in a hybrid environment with both working from our offices in King's Cross in London at least three days a week, and from home.

 

The salary for this NUJ position starts from £76,728, with the final offer determined by the successful candidate's skills, experience, and responsibilities. 

 

How to apply

To apply, please upload your latest CV and a cover letter which outlines why you’d love to take on this role, and why you’re a great match for what we’re looking for. 

 

We appreciate the time taken to prepare each application we receive. We do not use AI-assisted technology to review applications; every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team. Thank you for bearing with us during the screening process. 

 

The closing date for applications is Monday 16 November 2026. 

 

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs. Please contact Sean on sean.brinkley@theguardian.com to discuss further so we can work with you to support you through your application.

 

Benefits at the Guardian

You'll have six weeks of annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase additional days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.

 

You are entitled to life cover, income protection, and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.

 

We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.

 

Culture and wellbeing

We want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. Our various employee forums provide a platform to use their voice to foster an inclusive workplace. We became the first major media organisation to achieve B Corp status.

 

We offer tools to help you prioritise your wellbeing including access to our employee benefits platform which provides tailored support for health and wellbeing. In addition, we also offer free yoga and pilates classes. These run alongside our corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.

 

Our staff restaurant has views overlooking the Regents Canal and caters for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

 

Learning and development

  • Helping to create our First Thing flagship newsletter for US readers five days a week
  • Taking on the role of lead writer on this and other US newsletters when other writers are away
  • Writing stories about US news and politics during UK morning hours

job.title: Advertising Business Data Analyst Intern
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times is seeking an intellectually curious individual who is eager to dive into the various advertising analytics and optimization challenges in our advertising business.

The Advertising Business Data Analyst Intern will serve the Advertising and Sales teams by analyzing our suite of products and their supporting data sources, using insights to help innovate and optimize our sales efforts. This analyst will partner with Ad Product, Ad Measurement, Sales, Ad Operations, Sales Operations, and Finance to better understand their specific needs to optimize their business. Candidates will learn to communicate effectively across advertising and technology departments, improve presentation skills, identify opportunities to increase advertising revenue retention, and learn about the print and digital advertising ecosystem from initial pitch to ad delivery. 

Responsibilities

  • Analyze advertising and sales datasets to optimize overall performance. Develop, monitor, and analyze performance through dashboards and provide strategic optimization alerts and recommendations.
  • Help define and develop requirements for analytics tools and reporting dashboards.
  • Provide key business insights to senior sales and advertising leadership based on campaign performance trends. 
  • Visualize key metrics on an ongoing basis to communicate out to product, sales, and exec teams.
  • Partner and provide thoughtful and actionable analysis to Sales, Ad Innovation, and Product teams.
  • Collaborate with cross functional groups including Ad Product, Ad Operations, Sales Operations, and Sales to identify key opportunities.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications

  • Education: Pursuing a degree in Analytics, Economics, Mathematics, Business or related field
  • Experience with Excel, SQL, Salesforce, Tableau, BigQuery, BusinessObjects, or Google Ad Manager preferred
  • Interested in pursuing a career in analytics or digital advertising 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience at a digital publishing company
  • Experience with collaboration

REQ-020923

job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role, Mission or Department Overview

The New York Times is looking for an analyst who is passionate about promoting security and technology awareness across our newsroom, engineering, and business departments. You will help design technical training and communications throughout the organization, striving to cultivate a company-wide security culture where all employees share responsibility for safeguarding and protecting us.

Based in New York City, this hybrid role involves regular in-person office visits to host group training sessions and individual meetings with staff.

Who are we?

Enterprise Technology enables the people, platforms, and practices that support The New York Times' journalism and business operations. We partner with departments across the company to help employees work securely,, and productively through thoughtful technology solutions. We support the systems and capabilities that keep us running while looking for new ways to reduce friction and improve the daily experience of our workforce.

The Education team's mission is to help our technical and non-technical workforce adopt secure, technology practices through data-driven insights, training, and specialized programming that inspire meaningful behavior change.

This is a hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters. You can typically expect to come into the office 3 days/week.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with staff throughout the company to lead personal and group security and technology education sessions.
  • Coordinate and lead workshops, events, and training projects focused on information security and IT topics and initiatives.
  • Deliver high-touch technical support and 1:1 briefings for all staff, including the newsroom, providing hands-on guidance on digital hygiene, device hardening, and secure communication workflows.
  • Craft and distribute routine security updates for specific teams or the entire organization in collaboration with corporate communications.
  • Produce instructional resources, including user guides, manuals, video content, and online modules.
  • Support user requests and participate in an on-call rotation to address urgent security inquiries.
  • Design and implement internal phishing simulation campaigns and remediation programs.
  • Manage the logistical and administrative tasks required to schedule and track training projects.
  • Report on security engagement metrics from direct interactions, identifying trends to help refine support strategies and harden newsroom defenses.
  • Visit several bureaus and office sites to deliver training; expected travel is approximately 10% annually.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to the Manager, Information Security

Basic Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience training on topics related to information security (phishing, account security, data security, secure communications) in person and virtually
  • Familiarity with basic cybersecurity concepts, including social engineering, common tactics, techniques, and procedures.
  • Experience helping people build and understand threat models for themselves and their function or role within an organization.
  • Experience with breaking down complex topics to different audiences, including technical and non-technical partners.
  • Comfortable with public speaking and adjusting content based on audience response.
  • understanding of the audience to produce engaging materials in multiple formats and media, user guides, and gamification elements.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with phishing platforms.
  • Experience with Zendesk or working in a support environment.
  • Experience with learning, creating, and integrating new digital technology such as audio, video, social media, and other web-based technologies.
  • Experience working with journalists or other high-risk groups.
  • Experience working with leadership and management.
  • Knowledge of networking basics, including VPNs, travel routers, and secure Wi-Fi configurations.
  • Interest in or experience with specialized security hardware (e.g., YubiKeys, encrypted storage).
  • Basic data analytics skills.

#LI-Hybrid

Every day, journalists at The New York Times report more than 200 stories from dozens of countries around the world on topics ranging from major international events to the best way to roast a chicken. Those stories are read, listened to and watched by millions of users across our web and mobile products. We are looking for Android engineers on a variety of teams to join our organization in impactful, hands-on roles. Check out some of our Times Open blog posts, written by engineers and other technical team members: on working remotely, on developing your career, and working with next gen technology. job.title: Associate Creative Director, Earned Marketing (Temporary)
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. In service of that mission, we have a journalism operation that includes thousands of people reporting on the ground from most countries around the world, producing journalism with the independence, accuracy, depth and authority for which The Times is famous.

Marketing plays a key part in extending this journalistic legacy into the future. Our job is to answer the question, “Why is quality journalism worth paying for?” We create award-winning marketing that builds our brand and deepens affinity for our journalistic offering. Above all, we strive to be timely, straightforward and relevant — illustrating in new and creative ways how The New York Times can enrich the lives of our readers.

We are seeking an Associate Creative Director, Earned Activations (Contract) to lead the creative vision for our specific “earned” marketing initiatives. This is a critical leadership role for a creative strategist who can move beyond traditional advertising to produce culturally resonant work that drives organic press and social conversation.

Reporting to the Creative Director, Design, with a dotted line to the Executive Director, Brand Marketing, you will serve as a creative partner to our marketing, editorial, comms, commerce, photo, external agency partners, Games and The Athletic creative teams. You will be responsible for dreaming up and executing ideas that turn the value of our world-class journalism and lifestyle products into shareable experiences. You will focus exclusively on creating a cohesive but distinct earned lens for our core products: News, The Athletic, Games, and Cooking.

We will look to you to bring unexpected, deeply resonant thinking to how we market our journalism, championing creative ideas that can break through the noise of the modern media landscape.

This is a temporary hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters, reporting to the the Creative Director, Design. You can typically expect to come into the office 3 days per week.

Responsibilities:

  • Concept and lead the development of brand-building activations, partnerships, and communications content designed specifically to generate earned media and social sharing.

  • Direct the day-to-day work of a Senior Designer, Earned providing clear conceptual vision to guide projects from strategy to launch. You will oversee the translation of earned media concepts into high-quality design solutions, ensuring that every deliverable—from seeding kits to social assets—upholds The New York Times's rigorous brand standards.

  • Translate marketing strategies into clear, provocative creative directives that excite internal teams and external partners.

  • Develop creative ideas tailored to the unique audiences of our core products, ensuring a cohesive visual and conceptual narrative for News, The Athletic, Games, and Cooking.

  • Create work that natively integrates celebrities, influencers, and culturally noteworthy subscribers to amplify our mission in ways that feel authentic and newsworthy.

  • Guide the creation of "social-first" activations designed to thrive on digital platforms and spark community engagement without relying solely on paid media or editorially motivated social media handles.

  • In partnership with the Director, Creative Strategy and Earned Production and Director, Brand Earned Activations, guide external agency relationships to ensure top-notch quality and brand/product standards are enforced.

  • Work closely with the Executive Director of Brand Activations and Talent to ensure earned ideas align with broader business goals.

  • Act as an ambassador for earned thinking across the organization, engaging the right stakeholders in productive conversations to build alignment.

  • Execute high-concept ideas, balancing quality with the demands of the news cycle.

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in creative leadership, with a heavy focus on earned media, PR-led activations, or non-traditional advertising.

  • A portfolio that demonstrates “work the world talked about”—campaigns that broke through via PR, social trends, or cultural moments.

  • Deep understanding of how to leverage Social, Celebrity, and Influencer ecosystems to drive brand discovery.

  • Experience translating marketing strategies, product roadmaps, and the news cycle into clear creative directives.

  • Service diverse categories across the NYT portfolio, from the rigor of News to the fandom of The Athletic and the community-driven spaces of Games and Cooking.

  • Cultivate trusted relationships across the organization and navigate complex stakeholder dynamics.

  • Operational agility to navigate the time sensitive requirements of earned media while maintaining high standards of craft.

job.title: Audience Insights Intern
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times is seeking an inquisitive and organized intern to join the Audience Insights team this summer. Audience Insights is a multidisciplinary team of researchers who conduct qualitative and quantitative research projects to support our product, design, and marketing efforts. Our mission is to help The Times grow by understanding our audience. We uncover and tell stories about our audience’s preferences, behaviors, and needs by conducting user interviews, focus groups, surveys, and many other types of research methods. By examining both sentiment and behavior, we determine the best ways to express our journalism and brand value in order to drive deeper engagement and increased subscriptions. 

In this role, you will engage in audience and product research across the company. You will expand your knowledge of the practice of research and get the chance to contribute to the larger New York Times strategy by leading your own multi- phase research project. You will be exposed to many different streams of work across The New York Times portfolio of products. Depending on your interests and the company’s needs, you will have the opportunity to improve one of our marketing strategies, to refine one of our user flows, or to boost the development of new products and services. 

About Our Summer Internships 

  • The duration is 10 weeks long, starting on June 7, 2027. 
  • The rate of pay for this role is $30.00 per hour. 
  • Interns work 35 hours per week. 
  • This is a hybrid position that must be completed onsite at our office in New York 

Responsibilities: 

  • Completing a literature review 
  • Designing and moderating user interviews 
  • Qualitative research design and analysis 
  • Designing and fielding a survey 
  • Quantitative research design and statistical analysis 
  • Demonstrates support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world. 

Basic Qualifications: 

  • Completing a graduate degree in Marketing, Statistics, Psychology, Communications, Human Computer Interaction, or a related field 
  • Experience in moderating or observing research interviews 
  • Experience with developing, writing, and analyzing surveys 
  • Experience compelling research-focused presentations and data visualizations 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience in journalism and digital media (Academic or professional)

It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The B2B Subscription Marketing Team is looking for an enthusiastic intern, interested in learning and applying problem solving skills to engagement marketing, acquisition strategy, and other work to connect and build their audience. 

The B2B Subscription Team’s mission is to cultivate an audience of millions of curious readers and the next generation of paying Times subscribers. They do this through the sale of digital access and group subscriptions in Education (High School and Higher Ed), the Corporate/Government space, and Public Libraries. We also support Subscription Partnerships. 

You will be a part of a small but mighty team whose goal is to drive acquisition and engagement with B2B Subscription Clients across verticals. 

About Our Summer Internships 

  • The duration is 10 weeks long, starting on June 7, 2027. 
  • The rate of pay for this role is $20.00 per hour. 
  • Interns work 35 hours per week. 
  • This is a hybrid role  based in New York City. 

Responsibilities:

job.title: Creative Development Intern, Wirecutter
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Team

The Creative Development team sits at the vital intersection of Revenue and Editorial at Wirecutter. We transform Wirecutter’s world-class consumer journalism and tentpole moments (e.g. Holiday Gifting, Back to School, and Wirecutter’s Hall of Fame) into ambitious, multi-format commercial programs across advertising, podcasts, social video, and live events. All while strictly safeguarding editorial independence and reader trust.

Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented, collaborative, and innovative Creative Development Intern to help support our growing pre-sale and post-sale operations. In this role, you will work closely with Creative & Business Development leads to organize incoming commercial briefs, maintain our concept library, assist in pitching high-impact sponsorships, and track cross-functional execution across Editorial, Product, Marketing, and Sales.

This is an ideal opportunity for anyone interested in media strategy, commercial publishing, ad operations, or creative strategy at a major digital publisher.

Responsibilities

  • Concept Library & Database Management: Assist in maintaining and organizing our internal database of creative content opportunities, cataloging pre-approved editorial sponsorship packages, budget thresholds, and production lead times.
  • RFP Intake & Pitch Support: Help triage incoming RFPs from top-tier brand partners. Assist in drafting pitch one-sheets, organizing ideation materials, and tracking response timelines.
  • Go to Market Planning Support: Support weekly and monthly cross-functional alignment meetings by helping update presentations, leadership updates and logging action items across newsroom and commercial teams.
  • Competitive & Market Research: Conduct industry research on brand sponsorship trends, competitor event activations, and emerging digital content formats (social video, podcast integrations, newsletter sponsorships) to inform new commercial packages.
  • Post-Sale Campaign Tracking: Support the post-sale handoff process by creating partnership tracking documents, auditing media plans, and organizing asset handoffs between Creative Strategy, Design, and Ad Ops.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications

  • Interest in Digital Media & Advertising: Strong interest in how journalism, commerce, and digital publishing intersect.
  • Exceptional Organization: Highly organized with strong attention to detail; comfortable managing data and workflows in Airtable, Google Workspace, and Slack.
  • Clear Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to summarize complex project statuses clearly and concisely.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Creative Thinker: You enjoy thinking creatively, have a pulse on what's happening in culture both digitally and in society at large.
  • Collaborative Mindset:  Enthusiastic about working across diverse teams (sales, editorial, product, design) in a fast-paced environment.
  • Respect for Editorial Integrity: Understanding of the importance of maintaining a strict firewall between commercial partnerships and independent newsroom reviews.
