job.title: Acquisition Sales Specialist - MLF
job.description:
Job Description


The Acquisition Sales Specialist is a quota-carrying, full-cycle sales role focused exclusively on acquiring net-new customers within our Mid Sized Law Firm (MLF) segment. This role is foundational to building a scalable new-logo engine, and your performance will directly shape our go-to-market strategy and long-term growth trajectory.

The product bag will have a heavy emphasis on leading with CoCounsel Legal and CoCounsel and all our AI tools, while also promoting Westlaw/Practical Law and our Partnership products, Supio and DeepJudge and others, depending on the situation and fit/need.

This is an overlay role, but different than other roles and not a support role or a tag-along function. Acquisition Reps own the entire sales process, from first touch through closed won, inside a clearly defined territory. Success is driven by real quotas, operational data, and performance KPIs that measure pipeline creation, conversion efficiency, and closed-won revenue. This role does not include renewals or expansion revenue with existing customers, nor reactive account management unrelated to net-new acquisition.

Each Acquisition Specialist will have a dotted line to a Regional Core Growth Manager and will be embedded with that manager's team to promote collaboration and strategic alignment.

Key Responsibilities


  • Own full-cycle sales of net-new Core Growth MLF accounts (1-49 attorneys)
  • Conduct outbound prospecting into white space accounts within the MLF segment
  • Perform account research, prioritization, and multi-threaded engagement
  • Lead discovery, demos, deal strategy, pricing, negotiation, and closing
  • Manage pipeline that supports monthly and quarterly quota attainment
  • Maintain accurate CRM usage and disciplined sales process execution
  • Collaborate with your aligned MLF Manager to support pod-level priorities and segment strategy
  • Attain net-new pipeline creation targets per month
  • Achieve closed-won revenue from first-time Core Growth Law Firm customers
  • Demonstrate strong conversion rates from target account to qualified opportunity and high win rates on sourced opportunities
  • Optimize average deal cycle time while meeting activity KPIs tied directly to new logo production

Required Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience in quota-carrying B2B sales or new logo acquisition
  • Demonstrated ability to generate pipeline through outbound prospecting
  • Strong discovery, qualification, and closing capabilities
  • Data-driven, highly accountable, and coachable
  • Ability to thrive in a pod model while maintaining full deal ownership
  • Finding enjoyment in your job and bringing positive energy to the team
  • Ability to test new approaches within established boundaries and pivot quickly based on desired outcomes

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience selling into law firms or professional services
  • Ability to challenge the status quo and look for better ways to win


#LI-AY1


 

 

What’s in it For You?

  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.

  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.

  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

 

 

In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The target total cash compensation range varies across locations. For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the target total cash compensation range for this role is $136,500 USD - $253,500 USD. Pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay and any target sales incentive are part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs. Target total cash compensation ranges are inclusive of both base pay and any target sales incentive.

This job posting will close 12/19/2026.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

job.title: Agente de Suporte
job.description:
Você deseja desenvolver sua carreira como Analista de Suporte - TI em uma empresa líder no segmento de Tecnologia, que promove integração e crescimento para seus clientes? Junte-se a nós!


Job Description


Como Agente de Suporte (Suporte Técnico T.I), você estará na linha de frente, auxiliando nossa base de clientes com rapidez e eficiência, garantindo a melhor experiência possível.

Key Responsibilities

Você atuará com as Soluções Domínio, uma suíte de sistemas integrados que oferece gestão, eficiência e segurança para profissionais do segmento contábil. Suas responsabilidades serão:


  • Prestar suporte técnico aos usuários em acesso ao sistema, atualizações, instalação, configuração, certificados digitais, impressoras e utilitários, garantindo o funcionamento adequado das soluções.
  • Comunicar informações ao cliente com clareza e assertividade.
  • Conduzir o atendimento com eficiência, buscando a resolução rápida dos problemas.
  • Conhecer a jornada do cliente e os caminhos indicados para cada necessidade.
  • Encaminhar solicitações de alterações e correções dos produtos às equipes responsáveis.
  • Praticar e promover os valores e comportamentos da organização.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre a evolução das soluções e a legislação vigente da área.

Required Qualifications


Para esta posição, buscamos profissionais com as Habilidades & Experiência:

 

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Informática ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência ou interesse comprovado em atendimento e suporte técnico.
  • Boa capacidade de raciocínio lógico e comunicação clara para explicar soluções a diferentes públicos.
  • Facilidade em trabalhar com metas e em se adaptar a processos de trabalho.
  • Facilidade em lidar com pessoas e em trabalhar em equipe. 

Preferred Qualifications


  • Vivência com o software Domínio.
  • Conhecimento em SQL.
  • Experiência prévia em suporte ao cliente ou help desk.

#LI-GG1

 

 


O que iremos te oferecer?

  • Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido: Adotamos um ambiente de trabalho híbrido e flexível para as nossas funções baseadas em escritório, proporcionando uma experiência integrada e coerente tanto no âmbito digital quanto físico.
  • Flexibilidade e Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal: ""Flex My Way"" consiste em um conjunto de políticas de projetadas para facilitar a gestão das responsabilidades pessoais e profissionais, seja cuidando da família, participando de atividades comunitárias ou dedicando tempo para descanso e renovação pessoal. Essas políticas se baseiam em nossa abordagem flexível de trabalho, permitindo que os funcionários trabalhem de qualquer lugar por até 8 semanas por ano, promovendo assim um equilíbrio ideal entre seus compromissos de trabalho e pessoais.
  • Desenvolvimento e Crescimento Profissional: Promovemos uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento de habilidades, preparando nossos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do futuro e oferecer soluções reais. Nosso programa ""Grow My Way"" e a abordagem focada em habilidades garantem que você tenha as ferramentas e conhecimentos para crescer, liderar e prosperar em um futuro habilitado pela inteligência artificial.
  • Benefícios Competitivos do Setor: Oferecemos planos de benefícios abrangentes que incluem assistência médica e odontológica, dois dias de feriado corporativo para saúde mental, programas de incentivo por performance e recursos para o bem-estar mental, físico e financeiro.
  • Cultura: Reconhecida globalmente por inclusão e pertencimento, flexibilidade, equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Vivemos nossos valores: obsessão pelos nossos clientes, competir para ganhar, desafiar o (seu) nosso pensamento, agir rápido e aprender rápido e juntos somos mais fortes.
  • Impacto Social: Gere um impacto em sua comunidade com nosso Instituto de Impacto Social. Oferecemos a todos colaboradores dois dias de voluntariado pagos anualmente e oportunidades para se envolver em projetos de consultoria pro bono e iniciativas de Meio Ambiente, Sociais e de Governança (ESG).

Trabalhando em conjunto com os profissionais e instituições que servimos, contribuímos para sustentar o estado de direito, fomentar o comércio, detectar infratores, relatar os fatos e oferecer informações confiáveis e imparciais para pessoas em todo o mundo.

 

 

Quem somos

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. Servimos profissionais nos setores jurídico, fiscal, contábil, de conformidade, governamental e de mídia. Contamos com o talento de 26.000 colaboradores em mais de 70 países, onde todos têm a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer profissionalmente em ambientes de trabalho flexíveis. Em um momento em que objetividade, precisão, equidade e transparência estão sob ataque, estamos comprometidos em buscá-los. Ficou interessado? job.title: Analyst - Global Trade Content
job.description:
Job Description:

The Analyst – Global Trade Content is responsible for the accurate compilation, maintenance, validation, and quality assurance of global trade regulatory content. This role supports regulatory research, tariff content management, data analysis, standardization, product support, and documentation activities to ensure trade content is accurate, timely, and compliant with internal standards. The analyst is also expected to actively utilize AI and digital tools to improve productivity, accuracy, consistency, and content quality while adhering to company governance and data privacy requirements.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conducts comprehensive research and analysis to interpret and update global trade regulations from official government sources.
  • Monitors official sources for assigned tariffs and promptly delivers accurate updates into internal systems.
  • Converts regulatory updates into standardized or system-compatible formats for loading.
  • Analyzes customer or internal inquiries related to assigned tariffs and provides well-researched, accurate responses in a timely manner.
  • Identifies reliable contacts and official data sources for assigned countries and establishes effective working relationships.
  • Documents processes, procedures, and work instructions according to established guidelines and templates.
  • Identifies and reports bugs in standard files and systems and assists in testing new features and improvements through the ADO process.
  • Supports project management tasks including data collection, analysis, and reporting.
  • Uses AI and digital tools daily to support research, comparison, validation, formatting, content updates, and efficiency improvements.
  • HS nomenclature, classification rules, explanatory notes.
  • Tariff schedules and regulatory interpretation related to HS.
  • HS related data validation includes HS codes, Description, UOM charges, controls, regulations, additional codes, etc.
  • Data Extraction, Validation and analysis of the HS tariffs content data.
  • Shift Timings: 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM (IST).
  • Work from office for 2-3 days in a week (Mandatory)

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in International Trade, Business, Economics, Information Science, or a related field.
  • 1 to 3 years of relevant work experience.
  • Knowledge of Harmonized System (HS) and Customs regulations.
  • Knowledge in import and export operations.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills.
  • Ability to independently gather, analyze, and interpret trade data.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Excel.
  • AI-enabled productivity and research tools.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools in a professional or academic environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with data extraction, transformation, validation, and content management processes.
  • Experience working with large datasets and regulatory content.
  • Strong documentation and process improvement skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and digital tools to improve operational efficiency and content quality.

#LI-GS1

job.title: Associate Sales Executive (Legal)
job.description:
Job Description


El Associate Sales Executive será responsable de impulsar el crecimiento de nuevos negocios dentro del segmento Mid Market Legal de Thomson Reuters en Argentina. Esta posición está enfocada en la venta de soluciones legales a estudios jurídicos pequeños y medianos, incluyendo productos habilitados con inteligencia artificial, contenido de investigación jurídica y soluciones de software adaptadas al mercado legal.


Esta posición requiere un profesional altamente proactivo, con fuerte orientación comercial, capaz de gestionar el ciclo completo de ventas de principio a fin, desde la prospección en frío y la generación de oportunidades, hasta las demostraciones de producto, negociación y cierre. La persona ideal deberá sentirse cómoda trabajando en un entorno comercial dinámico, donde el éxito depende de una actividad de prospección constante, resiliencia y capacidad para construir relaciones sólidas con profesionales del sector legal.



Key Responsibilities

  • Generar nuevas oportunidades de negocio dentro del mercado legal en Argentina.
  • Prospectar y contactar clientes potenciales mediante llamadas en frío, correos electrónicos y reuniones virtuales.
  • Gestionar el ciclo completo de ventas, incluyendo generación de leads, calificación, demostraciones de producto, conversaciones de precio, negociación y cierre.
  • Construir y mantener un pipeline comercial sólido, con foco en adquisición de nuevos clientes.
  • Dar seguimiento a leads entrantes generados por marketing o equipos de prospección, cuando aplique.
  • Comercializar soluciones legales de Thomson Reuters, incluyendo herramientas con inteligencia artificial, bases de datos jurídicas y software para estudios jurídicos pequeños y medianos.
  • Desarrollar relaciones sólidas con clientes y representar a Thomson Reuters de manera profesional en todas las interacciones.
  • Participar en eventos comerciales, actividades con universidades, colegios de abogados y visitas de campo ocasionales cuando sea necesario.
  • Utilizar herramientas CRM como Salesforce para gestionar actividades, oportunidades y visibilidad del pipeline.
  • Aplicar herramientas de inteligencia artificial y recursos digitales para mejorar la productividad, la preparación y la efectividad comercial.
  • Colaborar de manera cercana con el manager y stakeholders internos para alcanzar los objetivos de facturación y negocio.

Required Qualifications

  • Experiencia comprobable en ventas, desarrollo de negocio o adquisición de nuevos clientes.
  • Fuerte perfil comercial, con capacidad para generar oportunidades de manera proactiva.
  • Experiencia gestionando o participando en el ciclo completo de ventas, desde la prospección hasta el cierre.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y presentación.
  • Alto nivel de resiliencia y capacidad para manejar el rechazo en un entorno comercial de alta actividad.
  • Comodidad en el uso de sistemas CRM como Salesforce o similares.
  • Interés y apertura para utilizar inteligencia artificial como parte del trabajo diario.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experiencia vendiendo soluciones legales, tecnología, SaaS u otros servicios intangibles.
  • Experiencia vendiendo a estudios jurídicos o profesionales del sector legal.
  • Formación académica en Derecho o estudios jurídicos.
  • Conocimiento o exposición previa al mercado legal argentino.
  • Experiencia en entornos de ventas outbound con fuerte expectativa de prospección.

#LI-AC1

 

 


¿Qué te ofrecemos?

  • Modelo de Trabajo Híbrido: Hemos adoptado un entorno de trabajo híbrido y flexible para nuestros roles en oficina, ofreciendo una experiencia fluida que está conectada digital y físicamente.
  • Flexibilidad y Equilibrio entre Trabajo y Vida Personal: "Flex My Way" Consiste en un conjunto de políticas de apoyo en el entorno laboral, diseñadas para facilitar la gestión de las responsabilidades personales y profesionales, ya sea atendiendo a la familia, participando en actividades comunitarias o dedicando tiempo al descanso y la renovación personal. Estas políticas se basan en nuestro enfoque flexible de trabajo, que permite a los empleados trabajar desde cualquier lugar hasta 8 semanas al año, promoviendo así un equilibrio ideal entre sus compromisos laborales y personales.
  • Desarrollo y Crecimiento Profesional: Fomentamos una cultura de aprendizaje continuo y desarrollo de habilidades, preparando a nuestro talento para enfrentar los desafíos del futuro y ofrecer soluciones reales. Nuestro programa "Grow My Way" y el enfoque en habilidades garantizan que tengas las herramientas y conocimientos para crecer, liderar y prosperar en un futuro habilitado por la inteligencia artificial.
  • Beneficios Competitivos del Sector: Ofrecemos planes de beneficios integrales que incluyen seguros de gastos médicos, dos días de descanso por salud mental a nivel de la empresa, programas de incentivos para empleados y recursos para el bienestar mental, físico y financiero.
  • Cultura: Reconocida globalmente con una reputación premiada por inclusión y pertenencia, flexibilidad, equilibrio entre trabajo y vida personal, y más. Vivimos nuestros valores: Obsesión por nuestros Clientes, Competir para Ganar, Desafiar nuestro Pensamiento, Actuar Rápido / Aprender Rápido, y Más Fuertes Juntos.
  • Impacto Social: Genera un impacto en tu comunidad con nuestro Instituto de Impacto Social. Ofrecemos a los empleados dos días de voluntariado pagados anualmente y oportunidades para involucrarse en proyectos de consultoría pro bono e iniciativas de Medio Ambiente, Sociales y de Gobernanza (ESG).
  • Haciendo un Impacto Real en el Mundo: Somos una de las pocas compañías a nivel global que asiste a sus clientes en la búsqueda de justicia, verdad y transparencia. Trabajando en conjunto con los profesionales e instituciones a los que servimos, contribuimos a sostener el estado de derecho, fomentar el comercio, detectar a los infractores, informar sobre los hechos y ofrecer información confiable e imparcial a personas en todo el mundo.

 

 

Quiénes somos

Thomson Reuters marca el camino hacia el futuro al reunir contenido confiable y la tecnología que las personas y organizaciones necesitan para tomar decisiones correctas. Servimos a profesionales en los sectores legal, fiscal, contable, de cumplimiento, gubernamental y de medios. Nuestros productos combinan software altamente especializado e información para capacitar a los profesionales con los datos, inteligencia y soluciones necesarias para tomar decisiones informadas y ayudar a las instituciones en su búsqueda de justicia, verdad y transparencia. Reuters, parte de Thomson Reuters, es un proveedor líder mundial de periodismo y noticias confiables.

Contamos con el talento de 26,000 colaboradores en más de 70 países, donde todos tienen la oportunidad de contribuir y crecer profesionalmente en entornos de trabajo flexibles. En un momento en el que la objetividad, precisión, equidad y transparencia están bajo ataque, nos comprometemos a buscarlos. ¿Suena emocionante? Forma parte de nuestro equipo y contribuye a moldear las industrias que impulsan el progreso de la sociedad.

Como empresa global, confiamos en los antecedentes únicos, perspectivas y experiencias de todos los empleados para cumplir con nuestros objetivos comerciales. Para asegurarnos de poder hacerlo, buscamos colaboradores talentosos y calificados en todas nuestras operaciones alrededor del mundo, sin importar raza, color, sexo/género, incluyendo embarazo, identidad y expresión de género, origen nacional, religión, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad, estado civil, estado de ciudadanía, condición de veterano u otra clasificación protegida bajo la ley aplicable. Thomson Reuters se enorgullece de ser un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades laborales, proporcionando un ambiente de trabajo libre de drogas.

Asimismo, ofrecemos adaptaciones razonables para personas calificadas con discapacidades y para aquellas con creencias religiosas sinceras, conforme a la legislación vigente. Puedes encontrar más información sobre cómo solicitar una adaptación aquí.

Descubre cómo protegerte de anuncios de empleo fraudulentos aquí. Para obtener más información sobre Thomson Reuters, visita nuestro sitio web en thomsonreuters.com

job.title: Business Process Analyst
job.description:
Business Process Analyst | Operations Customer Service & Support


Job Description

This role leads project delivery and process improvement across internal operations and client engagements, from planning and milestones through production testing and rollout. You will also train and support operational teams, document processes, and partner with business stakeholders to deliver measurable, customer-focused improvements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Contributes to, defines, and implements comprehensive project plans, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
  • Manages key stages of the project lifecycle from initiation through closure.
  • Agrees to and delivers against key project milestones and commitments.
  • Identifies, tracks, and manages project issues, dependencies, and risks proactively.
  • Manages overall project deadlines and actively monitors scope creep.
  • Delivers measurable benefits as per area of ownership, within approved plans.
  • Identifies project support requirements and enables progression toward confirmed delivery.
  • Identifies, develops, and implements process improvements to support internal operations and client engagements.
  • Contributes to securing new assignments and growth opportunities for staff.
  • Analyzes and streamlines business processes with business partners, identifying opportunities for efficiency and automation.
  • Designs and implements process enhancements.
  • Enhances forms and workflows to improve user experience for both internal teams and external customers.
  • Validates system enhancements and conducts production testing to ensure quality and customer impact.
  • Provides comprehensive training and process documentation to operational teams to improve understanding and system adoption.
  • Conducts regular Q&A sessions with operational teams and leadership to address questions and share best practices.
  • Partners with managers on organizational changes, system updates, and process modifications affecting their teams.
  • Responds promptly to questions and requests, maintaining strong communication and support.
  • Creates and maintains detailed process documentation and technical reference materials.
  • Adopts and evaluates new tools and technologies to drive process improvement and operational efficiency.
  • Demonstrates agility in learning new systems and tools, applying them quickly to solve business problems.
  • Solicits and incorporates feedback from stakeholders, agents, and team members to refine processes.
  • Challenges legacy processes and recommends data-driven improvements.
  • Collaborates closely with business partners and stakeholders on daily operations and strategic initiatives.
  • Maintains a customer-centric mindset, ensuring process improvements enhance both internal operations and external customer experience.
  • Acts as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor to internal clients and operational teams.
  • Identifies data flow issues and root causes, coordinating across teams for resolution.

Required Qualifications

  • Project Management: Planning, execution, tracking, and delivery.
  • Process Analysis & Improvement: Identifying bottlenecks and implementing solutions.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Clear articulation to diverse audiences.
  • Technical Acumen: Understanding of systems, automation, and data flows.
  • Responsiveness & Accountability: Timely follow-up and commitment to results.
  • Adaptability: Flexibility in rapidly changing environments and ability to learn new tools quickly.
  • Problem Solving: Data-driven approach to identifying and resolving operational challenges.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce Service Cloud.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in project management or operations improvement.
  • Familiarity with process documentation or workflow tools.
  • Interest in continuous improvement and customer experience.

#LI-KG1



What’s in it For You?

  • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

job.title: Content Author
job.description:
Content Author


Job Description

The Content Author is an entry point into the content team's career path, combining hands-on content authorship with full ownership of the content production process. This role analyzes source material from multiple resources and writes, edits, and updates clear, accurate, customer-facing content, while also performing the technical production tasks — coding, copyreading, merging, rendering, loading, and validating — needed to move that content through the team's systems and into publication. The Content Author works under the guidance of more senior team members while building independent proficiency in the team's content, processes, and systems, with the goal of taking on progressively broader responsibility over time. Specific product knowledge is not required at entry; the role is designed around generalizable content and systems skills that apply across the team's product portfolio.


Key Responsibilities 

  • Read source material from multiple places and write, edit, and update content so it's clear and correct, with guidance from senior team members. 
  • Handle the full content production process in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM): coding, copyreading, editing, merging, DITA formatting, and checking content. 
  • Turn confusing, incomplete, or mixed-up source material into clear, well-organized content for customers. 
  • Take ownership of your own content's accuracy and completeness; work independently on familiar tasks and ask for help on harder ones. 
  • Spot routine content problems, fix what you can, and know when to ask for help on anything unclear. 
  • Meet deadlines by managing your own workload and working well with teammates. 
  • Help test and review content to make sure it works and reads well across different formats. 
  • Suggest small process improvements when you spot them. 
  • Leverage strong product knowledge to enhance our workflow and content, for strategic products. 
  • Learn the team's content, systems, and tools, and pick up general product knowledge over time. 

Required Qualifications

  • Process-oriented: comfortable following and improving structured, multi-step content workflows. 
  • Attention to detail: consistently accurate, complete, and quality-checked work. 
  • Strong writing skills: clear, well-organized, professional writing across content types. 
  • Strong sense of voice: able to write and edit in a consistent, appropriate tone and style. 
  • Ability to deal with ambiguity: works effectively from incomplete, conflicting, or multi-source information and knows when to escalate. 
  • General product knowledge: comfortable learning new product context quickly; deep expertise in any single product is not required at entry. 
  • Works successfully in a team environment and understands team member roles. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Exposure to AI-assisted content tools or workflows. 
  • Familiarity with knowledge maps or other structured-content models. 
  • Basic content or data analytics skills. 
  • Experience with DITA or other structured-authoring frameworks. 
  • Experience working in a component content management system (CCMS). 
  • Broader content creation experience (e.g., digital, consumer-facing, or SEO-oriented content). 
  • Strong product knowledge in a strategic product area.  

#LI-HB1


What’s in it For You?

  • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

job.title: Coordenador de Atendimento ao Cliente
job.description:
Job Description

Buscamos um(a) Supervisor(a) de Atendimento ao Cliente para liderar a operação de atendimento de uma fintech em crescimento, garantindo excelência na experiência do cliente, eficiência operacional e desenvolvimento da equipe.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Liderar e desenvolver a equipe de atendimento, realizando acompanhamento de performance, feedbacks e planos de desenvolvimento.
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos indicadores de qualidade, produtividade e satisfação do cliente.
  • Monitorar métricas como SLA, TMA, FCR, CSAT, NPS.
  • Atuar na gestão da rotina operacional, escalonamento de casos críticos e resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos e na jornada do cliente.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com as áreas de Produto, Tecnologia, Operações para solucionar causas-raiz dos atendimentos.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e apresentar resultados para liderança.
  • Conduzir a evolução das ferramentas de atendimento

Required Qualifications

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Gestão, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência anterior liderando equipes de Customer Service, Customer Support ou Atendimento ao Cliente.
  • Vivência em fintechs, instituições financeiras, meios de pagamento, bancos digitais ou empresas de tecnologia.
  • Conhecimento de indicadores operacionais e ferramentas de gestão de atendimento.
  • Experiência com canais omnichannel (telefone, chat, e-mail e WhatsApp).
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de relacionamento
  • Experiência na gestão de operações com alto volume de demandas, demonstrando organização, resiliência e capacidade de priorização em ambientes dinâmicos.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Vivência em ambientes de alta volumetria e crescimento acelerado.
  • Foco na experiência do cliente e na entrega de resultados.
  • Experiência prévia no atendimento ou suporte a PMEs, escritórios de contabilidade, empresas de tecnologia, fintechs ou soluções B2B.

#LI-FM1

 

 


O que iremos te oferecer?

  • Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido: Adotamos um ambiente de trabalho híbrido e flexível para as nossas funções baseadas em escritório, proporcionando uma experiência integrada e coerente tanto no âmbito digital quanto físico.
  • Flexibilidade e Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal: ""Flex My Way"" consiste em um conjunto de políticas de projetadas para facilitar a gestão das responsabilidades pessoais e profissionais, seja cuidando da família, participando de atividades comunitárias ou dedicando tempo para descanso e renovação pessoal. Essas políticas se baseiam em nossa abordagem flexível de trabalho, permitindo que os funcionários trabalhem de qualquer lugar por até 8 semanas por ano, promovendo assim um equilíbrio ideal entre seus compromissos de trabalho e pessoais.
  • Desenvolvimento e Crescimento Profissional: Promovemos uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento de habilidades, preparando nossos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do futuro e oferecer soluções reais. Nosso programa ""Grow My Way"" e a abordagem focada em habilidades garantem que você tenha as ferramentas e conhecimentos para crescer, liderar e prosperar em um futuro habilitado pela inteligência artificial.
  • Benefícios Competitivos do Setor: Oferecemos planos de benefícios abrangentes que incluem assistência médica e odontológica, dois dias de feriado corporativo para saúde mental, programas de incentivo por performance e recursos para o bem-estar mental, físico e financeiro.
  • Cultura: Reconhecida globalmente por inclusão e pertencimento, flexibilidade, equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Vivemos nossos valores: obsessão pelos nossos clientes, competir para ganhar, desafiar o (seu) nosso pensamento, agir rápido e aprender rápido e juntos somos mais fortes.
  • Impacto Social: Gere um impacto em sua comunidade com nosso Instituto de Impacto Social. Oferecemos a todos colaboradores dois dias de voluntariado pagos anualmente e oportunidades para se envolver em projetos de consultoria pro bono e iniciativas de Meio Ambiente, Sociais e de Governança (ESG).
  • Fazendo um Impacto Real no Mundo: Somos uma das poucas empresas globalmente que auxilia seus clientes na busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. Trabalhando em conjunto com os profissionais e instituições que servimos, contribuímos para sustentar o estado de direito, fomentar o comércio, detectar infratores, relatar os fatos e oferecer informações confiáveis e imparciais para pessoas em todo o mundo.

 

 

Quem somos

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. Servimos profissionais nos setores jurídico, fiscal, contábil, de conformidade, governamental e de mídia. Nossos produtos combinam software altamente especializado e informações para capacitar profissionais com os dados, inteligência e soluções necessárias para tomar decisões informadas e ajudar as instituições em sua busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. A agência de notícias Reuters, parte da Thomson Reuters, é líder mundial na área de jornalismo e notícias confiáveis.

Contamos com o talento de 26.000 colaboradores em mais de 70 países, onde todos têm a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer profissionalmente em ambientes de trabalho flexíveis. Em um momento em que objetividade, precisão, equidade e transparência estão sob ataque, estamos comprometidos em buscá-los. Ficou interessado? Faça parte da nossa equipe e contribua para moldar as indústrias que impulsionam o progresso da sociedade.

job.title: Correspondent - Financial News
job.description:
Correspondent, India


Correspondent, India:

The India team is looking for a talented, versatile, and driven journalist with at least two years of reporting experience to help cover one of the world's most dynamic corporate landscapes. The role combines fast-paced breaking news and day-to-day company coverage with opportunities to pursue initiative stories for a global audience and conduct reporting on the ground. The successful candidate will be a strong reporter, clear writer and collaborative teammate who thrives in a deadline-driven environment and is excited by the challenge of covering India's rapidly evolving business landscape.


About the Role:

  • Be comfortable working with facts, figures, and financial data.
  • Be familiar with the India file and what makes a strong Reuters story.
  • Demonstrate strong news judgment, sharp writing skills, and the ability to handle Reuters' fast-paced news file.
  • Be a proactive reporter who can jump on breaking news, interview senior executives, and pursue trend and initiative stories with ease.
  • Communicate effectively with reporters, desk editors, and colleagues across India and globally to ensure seamless coverage.
  • Thrive under pressure, consistently delivering spot stories, snaps, and initiative stories to deadline.
  • Be versatile and willing to contribute across snapping, reporting, and writing as newsroom needs evolve.
  • Uphold Reuters' standards of accuracy, fairness, and independence in all reporting.

About You:

  • At least two years of reporting experience in Financial market.
  • Knowledge of India Inc., business and financial markets, or the ability to develop expertise quickly.
  • Strong command of English, with excellent reporting and writing skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented newsroom.
  • Flexibility to work shifts that may begin anytime between 7 a.m. and noon.

#LI-BD1

 

 

What’s in it For You?

At Reuters, our people are our greatest assets. Here are some of the benefits we offer for your personal and professional growth:

  • Global Career: As a global company, we can offer a truly international career and progression opportunities.

  • Learning & Development: On the job learning and coaching. We also have a dedicated training team focused on the continuous development of our journalists.

  • Industry Competitive Benefits:  We offer competitive salary packages and market leading benefits including paid volunteering days.

  • Perks: Work alongside Pulitzer Prize-winning journalists and a team who provide unmatched, award-winning coverage of the world’s most important stories.

About Reuters

Reuters is the world’s largest multimedia news provider. Founded in 1851, it is committed to the Trust Principles of independence, integrity and freedom from bias. With unmatched coverage in over 16 languages, and reaching billions of people worldwide every day, Reuters provides trusted intelligence that powers humans and machines to make smart decisions. It supplies business, financial, national and international news to professionals via desktop terminals, the world's media organizations, industry events and directly to consumers.

 

 

About Thomson Reuters

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. job.title: Customer Success Manager, Government - Legal
job.description:
Job Description

The Customer Success Manager, Government will engage with customers to understand their business goals, develop tailored strategies and drive successful adoption of Thomson Reuters’ legal AI solutions. The Customer Success Manager, Government will typically focus on a portfolio of customers, actively prioritizing customers based on adoption, health and other key parameters. The Customer Success Manager will use a standard CSM playbook to proactively engage throughout the customer lifecycle to grow adoption and deliver value.


This role will be specifically aimed at supporting Federal or State and Local courts and/or government customers in their adoption and use of TR Legal AI solutions. It is critical to understand the type of work performed by Federal or State and Local government customers to help these clients identify the right use cases for TR Legal AI solutions.


Thomson Reuters is transforming the legal industry with unmatched legal content, expertise, and innovative technology. As part of our transformation, we are building a world-class Customer Success organization to ensure our customers achieve their goals and unlock the full value of our solutions.


Key Responsibilities:

In the role of Customer Success Manager, Government, you will focus on:

  • Strategic Relationships: Engage regularly with senior executives to understand their goals and provide strategic guidance, acting as their trusted advisor throughout the customer journey. 
  • Customer Success Plan: Jointly create success plans with customers to deliver value and outcomes from Thomson Reuters’s legal AI solutions.  
  • Transform Legal Workflows with AI: Collaborate with customers to identify their specific business challenges and design tailored workflows / use cases that deliver sustained value from Thomson Reuters' legal AI solutions. 
  • Change Management: Partner with customers to help gain executive sponsorship, identify champions and define change management strategies to help transform the work of attorneys at large law firms. 
  • Drive Adoption: Partner with customers to ensure users are trained appropriately (leveraging TR customer education managers) and define mutual strategies to grow adoption of the TR Legal AI solutions. 
  • Lead Executive Business Reviews: Capture value delivered to customers from TR Legal AI solutions, lead executive business reviews and develop the joint roadmap for success with customers.

**This Data Engineer position requires work to be performed onsite full time in the Crystal City, VA location.**


As a Data Engineer, you will support the implementation of internal and external data-enabled solutions for Thomson Reuters Special Services (TRSS). This role requires hands-on technical expertise in the cleaning, integration, extraction, analysis, and delivery of structured and unstructured data.

You will collaborate closely with teams across the technology organization, including Product Development, Software Engineering, Data Science, and Business Development. The role also includes direct customer engagement to implement and support existing and new applications at customer locations.

job.title: Data Scientist
job.description:
Job Description

Thomson Reuters Special Services (TRSS) is looking for a Data Scientist to support our Federal Law Enforcement customers. TRSS Data Scientists serve several Federal Law Enforcement agencies by collecting, integrating, resolving, analyzing, modeling, and explaining large data in support of complex investigations. Success in this role requires strong technical depth, the initiative to operate with minimal direction, creativity to develop novel solutions, and a mission-focused mindset.


TRSS Data Scientists support the full range of Federal Law Enforcement missions including, but not limited to: Emerging Threat Detection, Money Laundering, Fraud, Force Protection, Human Rights Crimes, Transnational Crime, and more. Outside of contract work, TRSS Data Scientists contribute to internal innovation by participating in research and development (R&D), developing and maintaining shared capabilities, strengthening technical skills, and supporting business development efforts such as proof-of-concept projects and capabilities briefings.

This opportunity is specifically for positions located on US Government customer sites in the Merrifield, Crystal City and DC area. This is not a telework position. We recruit from a broad range of disciplines and experience. If you are passionate about the chance to put your Data Science skills to practice in support of Federal Law Enforcement, then we are looking for you!


Key Responsibilities

Data Scientists in this role will support Federal Law Enforcement missions by applying technical expertise to complex investigative and operational challenges. Responsibilities include:

  • Collect, integrate, clean, verify, resolve, and maintain large and complex datasets.
  • Analyze data using statistical methods, graph networks, anomaly detection, spatial analysis, pattern-of-life analysis, sentiment analysis, and related techniques.
  • Develop and apply data models, including risk models, community detection, classification, computer vision, machine learning, and artificial intelligence models.
  • Translate data findings into actionable insights through dashboards, visualizations, briefings, and clear explanations for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Write, edit, customize, and execute Python code to support mission requirements.
  • Use SQL for data extraction, pipelining, exploration, and analysis.
  • Work directly with customers to understand problem statements, define project goals, develop methods, and deliver results within required timeframes.
  • Contribute to internal innovation, research and development, shared capabilities, technical skill development, and business development efforts such as proof-of-concept projects and capabilities briefings.

Required Qualifications
  • United States Citizenship, as required to comply with government contract requirements.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance or agency work suitability determination, as required by assignment.
  • Willingness to work full time on-site at U.S. Government customer sites in the Merrifield, Crystal City and DC area. This is not a telework position.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field, such as data science, statistics, computer science, mathematics, physical or biological sciences, geographic information systems, or a related discipline.
  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in data management, data analysis, data modeling, data storytelling, programming, SQL, or related technical areas.
  • Practical experience writing, editing, customizing, and executing code in Python.
  • Experience using SQL for data extraction, pipelining, exploration, or analysis.
  • Ability to handle sensitive, confidential, or regulated data in accordance with applicable policies and requirements.
  • Ability to interface directly with customers at all levels and represent TRSS professionally.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with Data Scientists, Subject Matter Expert Analysts, Data Engineers, and cross-disciplinary teams.

Advanced degrees may be considered as a substitute for experience: a Master’s degree in a related field may substitute for two years of experience, and a PhD or equivalent in a related field may substitute for four years of experience.


Preferred Qualifications

Preference will be given to candidates who meet the required qualifications and also bring one or more of the following:

  • Current/Active government work suitability or security clearance.
  • Experience working with law enforcement agencies.
  • Programming skills in multiple languages other than Python (Python is a minimum requirement) including R, Java, or SQL.
  • Experience with software development, including managing collaborative codebases, version control, linting/testing, containerization, and interacting with REST APIs.

  • #LI-SW1

 

 


What’s in it For You?

  • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

 

 

In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The base compensation range varies across locations. Eligible office location(s) for this role include one or more of the following: New York City, San Francisco, Los Angeles, and/or Irvine, CA; McLean, VA; Washington, DC. The base compensation range for the role in any of those locations is $117,700 USD - $218,600 USD. For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the base compensation range for this role is $102,200 USD - $189,800 USD. Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs. This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

Thomson Reuters makes reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities, including veterans with disabilities, and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. If you reside in the United States and require an accommodation in the recruiting process, you may contact our Human Resources Department at HR.Leave-Expert@thomsonreuters.com. Disability accommodations in the recruiting process may include things like a sign language interpreter, making interview rooms accessible, providing assistive technology, or other relevant accommodations. Please note this email is not intended for general recruitment questions and we will promptly respond to inquiries regarding accommodations. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

job.title: Field Marketing Content Analyst
job.description:
Analista de Marketing de Conteúdo

Job Description

A Thomson Reuters é referência global em soluções para o mercado jurídico, da rotina processual à gestão do negócio.

Estamos ampliando nosso time de Marketing para fortalecer a presença da marca como fonte de conhecimento para o mercado jurídico. A posição é transversal e conecta Marketing de Produto, Customer Success, Comercial e Comunidade em torno de uma pergunta central: como transformar o conhecimento que construímos com os escritórios em conteúdos que educam, engajam e geram demanda de forma consistente.

É uma cadeira para quem gosta de criar com estratégia: você terá espaço para estruturar calendários editoriais, desenvolver formatos próprios e construir uma voz reconhecida no ecossistema jurídico brasileiro.

Principais Responsabilidades (Key Responsibilities)

Planejar conteúdo

  • Desenvolver e executar o calendário editorial de blog, e-mail, redes sociais e materiais para a BU de softwares jurídicos;
  • Direcionar a produção de artigos, guias, e-books, roteiros de vídeo e outros formatos voltados a advogados e gestores de escritórios
  • Adaptar a linguagem técnica do produto e do direito para formatos claros, envolventes e acessíveis

Transformar conhecimento em conteúdo de mercado

  • Converter aprendizados de clientes, pesquisas e dados de uso em cases, benchmarks e conteúdos de referência
  • Trabalhar com especialistas jurídicos e de produto para validar informações e garantir precisão técnica
  • Identificar tendências do mercado jurídico e oportunidades de pauta com base em dados e escuta ativa

Medir e otimizar resultados

  • Acompanhar métricas de performance (engajamento, geração de leads, tráfego orgânico e conversão) e propor melhorias
  • Realizar testes de formatos, canais e chamadas para ação, documentando aprendizados
  • Apoiar o time de SEO e a área comercial com conteúdos que acompanhem a jornada de compra

Apoiar a comunidade e a marca

  • Gerenciar conteúdos para a comunidade de inovação jurídica e para o engajamento de clientes embaixadores
  • Manter a consistência de tom de voz e padrões de marca em todos os canais
  • Acompanhar tendências de conteúdo e formatos emergentes no mercado B2B de serviços profissionais

Qualificações Obrigatórias (Required Qualifications)

  • Experiência consolidada em marketing de conteúdo, redação ou jornalismo corporativo, preferencialmente em B2B
  • Capacidade de transformar informações técnicas em narrativas claras e envolventes
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados e métricas de marketing digital
  • Noções de SEO e de gestão de calendário editorial
  • Inglês fluente

Qualificações Desejáveis (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Formação em Comunicação, Jornalismo, Marketing ou Direito
  • Experiência com conteúdo para o público jurídico ou de escritórios de advocacia
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de automação de marketing e CMS
  • Vivência com produção de vídeo, podcast ou formatos multimídia

#LI-MG1

 

 


O que iremos te oferecer?

  • Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido: Adotamos um ambiente de trabalho híbrido e flexível para as nossas funções baseadas em escritório, proporcionando uma experiência integrada e coerente tanto no âmbito digital quanto físico.
  • Flexibilidade e Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal: ""Flex My Way"" consiste em um conjunto de políticas de projetadas para facilitar a gestão das responsabilidades pessoais e profissionais, seja cuidando da família, participando de atividades comunitárias ou dedicando tempo para descanso e renovação pessoal. Essas políticas se baseiam em nossa abordagem flexível de trabalho, permitindo que os funcionários trabalhem de qualquer lugar por até 8 semanas por ano, promovendo assim um equilíbrio ideal entre seus compromissos de trabalho e pessoais.
  • Desenvolvimento e Crescimento Profissional: Promovemos uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento de habilidades, preparando nossos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do futuro e oferecer soluções reais. Nosso programa ""Grow My Way"" e a abordagem focada em habilidades garantem que você tenha as ferramentas e conhecimentos para crescer, liderar e prosperar em um futuro habilitado pela inteligência artificial.
  • Benefícios Competitivos do Setor: Oferecemos planos de benefícios abrangentes que incluem assistência médica e odontológica, dois dias de feriado corporativo para saúde mental, programas de incentivo por performance e recursos para o bem-estar mental, físico e financeiro.
  • Cultura: Reconhecida globalmente por inclusão e pertencimento, flexibilidade, equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Vivemos nossos valores: obsessão pelos nossos clientes, competir para ganhar, desafiar o (seu) nosso pensamento, agir rápido e aprender rápido e juntos somos mais fortes.
  • Impacto Social: Gere um impacto em sua comunidade com nosso Instituto de Impacto Social. Oferecemos a todos colaboradores dois dias de voluntariado pagos anualmente e oportunidades para se envolver em projetos de consultoria pro bono e iniciativas de Meio Ambiente, Sociais e de Governança (ESG).
  • Fazendo um Impacto Real no Mundo: Somos uma das poucas empresas globalmente que auxilia seus clientes na busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. Trabalhando em conjunto com os profissionais e instituições que servimos, contribuímos para sustentar o estado de direito, fomentar o comércio, detectar infratores, relatar os fatos e oferecer informações confiáveis e imparciais para pessoas em todo o mundo.

 

 

Quem somos

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. Servimos profissionais nos setores jurídico, fiscal, contábil, de conformidade, governamental e de mídia. Nossos produtos combinam software altamente especializado e informações para capacitar profissionais com os dados, inteligência e soluções necessárias para tomar decisões informadas e ajudar as instituições em sua busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. A agência de notícias Reuters, parte da Thomson Reuters, é líder mundial na área de jornalismo e notícias confiáveis.

Contamos com o talento de 26.000 colaboradores em mais de 70 países, onde todos têm a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer profissionalmente em ambientes de trabalho flexíveis. Em um momento em que objetividade, precisão, equidade e transparência estão sob ataque, estamos comprometidos em buscá-los. Ficou interessado? Faça parte da nossa equipe e contribua para moldar as indústrias que impulsionam o progresso da sociedade.

Como uma empresa global, confiamos no conhecimento único, perspectivas e experiências de todos os colaboradores para cumprir nossos objetivos comerciais. Para garantir que possamos fazer isso, buscamos colaboradores talentosos e qualificados em todas as nossas operações ao redor do mundo, independentemente de raça, cor, sexo/gênero, incluindo gestantes, identidade e expressão de gênero, origem nacional, religião, orientação afetivo-sexual, deficiência, idade, estado civil, status de cidadania, ou outra classificação protegida pela lei aplicável.

Além disso, oferecemos acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiências e para aquelas com crenças religiosas sinceras, conforme a legislação vigente. Você pode encontrar mais informações sobre como solicitar uma adaptação aqui.

job.title: Gerente de Produtos SR (Adquirência)
job.description:
Job Description

Buscamos um(a) Gerente Sênior de Produtos com forte experiência em adquirência e meios de pagamento para liderar a estratégia, desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções de pagamentos físicos e digitais. Será responsável pela gestão do roadmap do produto, integração entre POS e ERP, conciliação financeira, antecipação de recebíveis, relacionamento com parceiros estratégicos e garantia de conformidade regulatória. É essencial possuir sólida vivência em produtos de pagamentos, conhecimento do ecossistema de adquirência e experiência na liderança de produtos complexos e de alto impacto.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Definir e comunicar a visão estratégica da solução de adquirência, abrangendo meios de pagamento físicos e digitais.
  • Construir e gerenciar o roadmap do produto considerando tendências de mercado, evolução tecnológica e mudanças regulatórias.
  • Identificar oportunidades de inovação e garantir a competitividade da solução.
  • Liderar a estratégia de integração entre adquirência, ERP, financeiro, fiscal e contabilidade.
  • Garantir a emissão fiscal integrada ao processo de venda e a rastreabilidade completa das transações.
  • Estruturar e evoluir processos de conciliação de cartões e lançamentos contábeis automáticos.
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar ofertas de antecipação de recebíveis.
  • Garantir conformidade regulatória junto ao Bacen, LGPD, PCI-DSS e demais normativos do setor.
  • Gerenciar relacionamento e negociações com adquirentes, processadoras, fornecedores de infraestrutura e parceiros financeiros.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de arquitetura, engenharia e desenvolvimento para evolução da plataforma.
  • Definir requisitos técnicos, especificações funcionais e critérios de aceite.
  • Priorizar iniciativas com base em impacto de negócio, viabilidade técnica e regulatória.
  • Liderar lançamentos e evoluções de produto em parceria com áreas de Produto, Tecnologia, Comercial e Operações.
  • Definir, acompanhar e analisar KPIs de negócio, operação, conciliação e antecipação de recebíveis.
  • Apresentar estratégias, resultados e roadmap para stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Representar a solução em discussões estratégicas e fóruns executivos

Required Qualifications

  • Graduação em Engenharia, Tecnologia, Administração, Finanças ou áreas correlatas.
  • Mais de 10 anos de experiência em produtos, tecnologia ou meios de pagamento.
  • Entre 6 e 8 anos de experiência específica em adquirência ou mercado de pagamentos.
  • Pelo menos 4 anos como Gerente Sênior de Produto ou posição equivalente.
  • Experiência comprovada na estruturação, lançamento e evolução de produtos complexos.
  • Histórico de atuação com arquitetos, engenheiros e equipes técnicas.
  • Conhecimento profundo de arquitetura de pagamentos, processamento, tokenização e roteamento de transações.
  • Forte conhecimento em POS, adquirência, PIX, cartão de crédito, débito, wallets e Open Banking.
  • Domínio de EMV, NFC, Contactless, Tap2Pay, QR Code, APIs, webhooks e integrações.
  • Experiência com integração de POS e ERP via TEF, APIs e SDKs.
  • Conhecimento de emissão fiscal integrada (NFC-e, NF-e e NFS-e).
  • Conhecimento de conciliação financeira e contábil de cartões.
  • Conhecimento de antecipação de recebíveis, funding e risco de crédito.
  • Conhecimento de regulamentações do Bacen, PCI-DSS, LGPD e compliance para meios de pagamento.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA em Gestão de Produtos, Negócios ou Finanças.
  • Experiência em adquirentes, fintechs, processadoras ou instituições de pagamento.
  • Experiência com Tap2Pay em produção.
  • Participação na criação de produtos de pagamento do zero.
  • Experiência com Open Finance/Open Banking.
  • Experiência com APIs de pagamento e Pix.
  • Vivência em integração completa entre POS, ERP e emissão fiscal.
  • Experiência com antecipação de recebíveis, registradoras, FIDC e SCD.
  • Experiência com conciliação contábil automatizada.
  • Atuação em ambientes de alto volume transacional.
  • Rede de relacionamento consolidada no ecossistema de pagamentos.

  • Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido: Adotamos um ambiente de trabalho híbrido e flexível para as nossas funções baseadas em escritório, proporcionando uma experiência integrada e coerente tanto no âmbito digital quanto físico.
