job.title: HR Manager, People & Leader Advisory - Nordics (Fixed Term)
job.description:
Job Description


Are you passionate about partnering with leaders and helping organizations thrive through people? Do you enjoy navigating complex employee situations while influencing business outcomes in a dynamic, global environment? If so, we'd love to hear from you. Join our team as an HR Manager, People & Leader and play a key role in supporting business leaders and employees across Thomson Reuters in Finland and the Nordics. In this role, you will provide strategic and operational HR partnership, guide leaders through people-related decisions, and contribute to initiatives that drive engagement, performance, and organizational effectiveness. 

 

You will be the trusted advisor and escalation point for managers, employees, and HR Business Partners across the Nordics. You will provide support for Finland, Norway, and Denmark as well as closely collaborating with the HR team in Sweden and the CEMA region. 

 

This is a fixed-term role covering a parental leave for at least 12 months, ideally starting January 2027.  

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Advise and coach managers and employees on Employee Relations, performance management, bonus/pay reviews, talent management, absence, terminations, and complex people decisions, acting as the Tier 2 escalation point. 
  • Deliver local HR cycles (performance, talent, engagement surveys, pay and bonus) on time and consistently, with the HR specialist teams. 
  • Advises first to middle management in medium to higher complexity of Employee Relations activity. 
  • Lead investigations and grievances that are fair, confidential, and compliant.  
  • Contribute to strategic people initiatives in a global organization. 
  • Develop in-depth knowledge of supported Business Units. 
  • Use sound judgment to assess facts, spot risks, and recommend practical solutions that balance business needs, employee experience, compliance, and company values, leading with empathy in every interaction. 
  • Work with HRBPs and business leaders to identify workforce themes, risks, and trends, and prepare reports and analysis to support workforce planning. 
  • Support reorganizations, and other workforce changes. Work with Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, and others to stay compliant with local labor laws, collective bargaining agreements, and union requirements. 
  • Leverage data, analytics, AI-enabled tools, and automation to improve HR advisory effectiveness, streamline work, and enhance decision-making. 
  • Keep people matters, compliance and the Finland site running smoothly. Act as Site Lead for Finland, champion engagement, build the office community and promote our values and culture. 
  • Contribute to regional and global HR projects and collaborate with a global HR team. 

 

How you’ll work 

Our values show up in how you do the job. 

  • Obsess over our Customers: Delivers responsive, high-quality HR support that balances business needs, employee experience, compliance, and risk. 
  • Compete to Win: own outcomes, meet deadlines and hold quality high. 
  • Challenge (Y)our Thinking: assess risk, make balanced recommendations, and push back constructively. Look for opportunities to simplify, standardise, automate, and improve how HR work is delivered. . 
  • Act Fast / Learn Fast: move between day-to-day queries and complex cases, and pick up new tools, data, and automation quickly. 
  • Stronger Together: partner openly with HR Business Partners, specialist teams, Legal and local leaders. Build strong partnerships across HR, the business, and specialist teams, using diplomacy and influence to achieve outcomes.  

 

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, Law, Psychology or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
  • 5 + years of HR generalist experience, ideally in a multinational or matrixed organization. 
  • Strong knowledge of Finnish employment law, HR practices, and employee relations processes. 
  • Working knowledge of HR practices, employment policies & relations, employee engagement & performance management. 
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Experience partnering with managers and influencing decision-making. 
  • Proven experience with complex employee relations cases, grievances, and organizational change, including employee representative processes. 
  • Lead and coordinate employee engagement events, wellbeing initiatives, and local People programs 
  • Fluent English and Finnish. 
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and coaching skills, with sound judgment and discretion. 
  • Confidence with HR systems (ideally Workday), case management tools, and reporting. 

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting other Nordic countries. 
  • Swedish language skills. 
  • Experience using data, automation, or AI-enabled tools to improve HR service.

Trabalhando em conjunto com os profissionais e instituições que servimos, contribuímos para sustentar o estado de direito, fomentar o comércio, detectar infratores, relatar os fatos e oferecer informações confiáveis e imparciais para pessoas em todo o mundo.

 

 

Quem somos

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. Servimos profissionais nos setores jurídico, fiscal, contábil, de conformidade, governamental e de mídia. job.title: Integration Consultant
job.description:
Integration Consultant


Job description


Are you a curious, proactive problem solver eager to take on the challenge of becoming an Integration Consultant at Thomson Reuters, where you´ll collaborate with a dynamic team and develop technical solutions in a rapidly growing network? If you thrive in a supportive, knowledge sharing environment, this role might be perfect for you!


As an Integrator at Thomson Reuters, you'll play a key role in identifying and implementing technical solutions, and connecting customers to our global network. You'll work closely with various departments, handling tasks like configuration, format development, testing, and troubleshooting. The Integration department is divided into several sub teams and the role offers opportunities for cross-functional collaboration and specialization in areas that interest you most.

Ideal candidates are curious, proactive problem-solvers who thrive in a dynamic and knowledge sharing environment. You'll receive comprehensive training and mentorship to support your growth.


Together, we are building the world’s largest, open business network. With our cloud-based network, customers can reach any business, anywhere in the world – no matter how many borders their operations may cross. We take care of the technical and regulatory requirements across the entire order-to-cash, purchase-to-pay and freight processes, to give customers data accuracy and security, transparency, and real-time visibility. All this through a single connection.

This position is open for Stockholm and Gothenburg applications.


Key Responsibilities:


In this opportunity as Integration Consultant, you will:

  • Guide and suggest best practice solutions, based on scalability, supportability, security, and efficiency.
  • Run thorough gap analyses.
  • Build support for customers file formats
  • Act as stakeholders to R&D in development of new services and solutions
  • Configure, test, troubleshoot and implement customized solutions.
  • Be a technical resource in both local and global customer projects.
  • Connect customers’ data platforms to our global network.
  • Have cross-functional cooperation within the Professional Services, R&D and Support organizations.

Required Qualifications:


You’re a fit for the role of Integration Consultant if you have the following required qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science in Systems Engineering, Information Technology or equivalent education background with some experience in relevant practice field.
  • Team player with strong collaboration skills.
  • Analytical and quality conscious.
  • You’re able to perform GAP analyses and understand requirements from data.
  • Technically curios with attention for details and the ambition to always learn more.
  • Understanding of business processes/flows and data exchange on a technical level.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
  • Successfully pass an extended background check (criminal and credit).

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Hands on experience from working with integration.
  • Experience of working with XML/XSLT.
  • Experience of EDI (e-invoice/order).
  • Experience of working with communication protocols (SFTP, AS2, HTTPS, API etc)
  • Familiarity or experience with concepts such as PEPPOL, Azure DevOps, GitHub, and Visual Studio Code.
  • Additional languages.

job.title: Lead Financial Analyst
job.description:
Job Description


Westbridge Print FP&A is responsible for financial reporting, financial processes, and analytics, supporting the global operations of Westbridge Print. The team needs a Lead Financial Analyst who will play a crucial role in the Westbridge Print FP&A Team supporting expenses and Core Print Solutions.


As part of a strategic transaction, Thomson Reuters Corporation has entered into a joint venture with KKR, a leading global investment firm. Through this transaction, the Global Print business of Thomson Reuters has transitioned to Westbridge Print, a standalone organization dedicated to serving the legal, tax, government, academic, and corporate sectors.

Please note that this position is with Westbridge Print, and the successful candidate will be employed by and work as part of the Westbridge Print organization. Westbridge Print is a leading provider of professional information solutions, delivering trusted legal and tax content through print and digital platforms, including ProView. The business also provides commercial printing services to a diverse range of publishing customers across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom, building on a long-standing reputation for quality, innovation, and customer service.


Key Responsibilities


  • Drive a deeper understanding of Core Print Solutions revenue and related costs.
  • Support the Account Management function and their interactions with customer-to-cash processes.
  • Responsible for journal entries, data collection and month end activity process. Including billing, revenue accrual processing, and monitoring the variances.
  • Conduct detailed financial analysis to support business decisions, including variance analysis, trend analysis, audit reviews, and forecasting.
  • Prepare and present financial reports, including monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
  • Create financial models to support real-time and ongoing analysis.
  • Monitor actual performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying variances and recommending corrective actions.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to support strategic planning and decision-making.
  • Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency and accuracy of financial analysis and reporting.
  • Leverage technology and automation to streamline financial processes and reporting.
  • Collaborate with various departments (e.g., Operations, Sales, Pricing) to provide financial insights and support.
  • Participate in cross-functional meetings to provide financial input and support decision-making.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 6-10 years of experience finance/analytics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
  • Good knowledge of Finance and Accounting
  • Good Knowledge of MS office- Excel, Power Point Knowledge of SAP, Financial Planning Tools - e.g., OneStream

Preferred Qualifications

  • Qualifications: Qualified CA, MBA Finance preferred
  • Knowledge of automation and visualization tools – Access/Alteryx/Power BI

job.title: Legal AI Engineer, Strategic Accounts - Mid Law
job.description:
Job Description


Thomson Reuters is looking for a Senior Legal AI Engineer to lead pre-sales engagements of Thomson Reuters Legal AI solutions within strategic mid-size law firm accounts. You will combine deep legal practice experience with a practical understanding of AI to design customized, in-depth use cases by practice area, and showcase to prospective firms how AI deployment will deliver measurable return on investment. You will own the technical and business case from first discovery conversation through proposal and executive sign-off. You will work with Sales, Practice Innovation Advisors, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Product to scope solutions that firms can see, test, and believe in before they commit. This is a senior, client-facing role for someone who can build meaningful, strategic relationships with managing partners, practice group leaders, and innovation and knowledge management teams.


Key Responsibilities 


  • Lead discovery and qualification with law firm prospects, including in-person discovery sessions, workflow workshops, and executive briefings, to identify high-value legal workflows and the business outcomes that matter most to each firm
  • Design customized AI use cases by practice area (e.g., litigation, transactional, regulatory, employment, IP) that reflect how each practice actually works, and translate them into specific, testable solution proposals
  • Build quantifiable ROI cases by establishing baseline metrics with the firm, modeling time savings, capacity gains, realization and write-off impact, and risk reduction, and presenting those findings in terms that partners and finance leaders will accept
  • Run solution demonstrations and proofs of concept that show Thomson Reuters Legal AI solving the firm’s real work, using the firm’s own documents and workflows where appropriate
  • Partner with Sales and Account Executives to shape deal strategy, identify stakeholders and decision-makers, anticipate objections, and co-develop proposals, pricing rationale, and executive presentations
  • Work with Forward Deployed Engineering to translate complex requirements into solution designs, prototypes, and integrations, and to confirm feasibility before commitments are made
  • Determine the right solution path for each prospect, whether a Thomson Reuters product, a partner technology, a customer system integration, or custom development, and be candid about fit and limitations
  • Document solution patterns, ROI frameworks, and lessons learned so that successful approaches can be reused across practice areas and future deals
  • Serve as the voice of the prospect internally by communicating market needs and objections to Product, Engineering, and Marketing, and by identifying opportunities to improve Legal AI offerings
  • Contribute to thought leadership through firm-facing content, webinars, advisory boards, and industry events
  • Stay current on generative AI capabilities, legal technology trends, and the competitive landscape, and be able to position Thomson Reuters products accurately and persuasively against alternatives. 

Required Qualifications 


  • J.D. from an accredited U.S. law school
  • Prior experience practicing law, such as in a law firm, in-house legal department, government, clerkship, or comparable legal setting
  • Proven experience in senior, customer-facing or sales-adjacent roles, ideally with large or mid-size law firms or other complex enterprise accounts
  • Strong familiarity with legal workflows such as due diligence, eDiscovery, large document review, compliance, and litigation or transactional practice
  • Demonstrable hands-on experience with generative AI applications
  • Substantial experience with online legal research and practice tools (e.g., Westlaw, Practical Law, HighQ, Relativity, Everlaw)
  • Track record of building business cases, ROI analyses, or value assessments, or equivalent experience in a consultative selling environment
  • Ability to present confidently to senior partners and executives and to handle technical and commercial objections
  • Willingness to travel approximately 25–30% (varying by quarter) to firm sites and customer engagements. Travel is a condition of employment. 

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience in legal technology sales, pre-sales, solutions consulting, or innovation roles at a law firm or legal technology company
  • Understanding of how large language models work and how to design, test, and refine prompts, context, and workflows for legal use cases

job.title: Producer, Video Podcasts (Level 1 Journalist, TEMP)
job.description:
Job Description


Producer, Video Podcasts (Level 1 Journalist, Temp Guild)


Are you a video-first news producer who can turn a major developing story into a polished, audience-ready program on deadline? If so, we want to hear from you.


Reuters World News delivers authoritative, visually compelling global-news coverage to millions of viewers and listeners across streaming, video, and podcast platforms.


Based in Los Angeles, you will produce the daily afternoon update for Reuters World News, a flagship 10-minute news program. You will collaborate with colleagues across Reuters’ global newsroom, using strong editorial judgment and sophisticated video-production skills to script and produce high-value journalism for digital audiences.



This assignment is expected to last approximately six months and reports to the Senior Podcast Producer.

 


Key Responsibilities



As Producer, Video Podcasts (Level 1 Journalist, Temp Guild), you will:


  • Video news production:  produce the daily afternoon Reuters World News update from editorial planning through final delivery, creating polished, visually engaging video coverage for streaming and digital audiences.
  • Breaking-news storytelling: Monitor developing news, identify the stories that matter most, and rapidly shape accurate, compelling video segments under tight deadlines.
  • Visual editorial execution: Write scripts, select and sequence visuals, edit footage, and package stories with strong pacing, clarity, and production value
  • Editorial judgment: Apply sound news judgment to prioritize coverage, ensure accuracy and impartiality, and present complex global stories in an accessible way.
  • Multi-platform adaptation: Create video-first programming that also translates effectively to podcast and audio audiences, preserving the direct, engaging style that connects creators with listeners and viewers.
  • On-air presentation: Host segments or provide on-camera and audio presentation when needed, communicating with authority, clarity, and credibility.
  • Independent collaboration: Work autonomously while coordinating effectively with reporters, editors, producers, and technical teams across locations and time zones.



Required Qualifications



  • Experience: Demonstrated experience independently producing polished video news content in a fast-paced newsroom, broadcast, streaming, or digital-news environment.
  • Video production skills: Strong hands-on ability to edit and package audience-ready video, including scripting, audio-visual storytelling, pacing, and delivery to professional editorial standards.
  • Editorial judgment: Proven ability to make sound editorial decisions, manage competing priorities, and deliver accurate coverage under deadline pressure.
  • Writing and presentation: Excellent news writing and scripting skills, with experience or demonstrated ability to present on camera and/or on audio as required.
  • Independent working style: Ability to take the initiative running the full production process with limited minute-to-minute supervision while maintaining clear communication with a manager and colleagues working in other locations and time zones.
  • Journalistic standards: Commitment to Reuters’ principles of independence, integrity, accuracy, and impartiality, along with a strong interest in global news and current affairs.



Preferred Qualifications



  • Streaming and digital-video experience: Experience producing short-form video news for streaming, digital-first, or social video audiences.
  • Breaking-news experience: Experience covering live events or fast-moving breaking news, particularly in a global-news environment.
  • Podcast expertise: Experience producing podcasts or audio journalism, with an understanding of how hosts and creators build a direct connection with their audience.
  • Subject-matter knowledge: Familiarity with international affairs, politics, business, or other major Reuters coverage areas.
  • Additional qualities: Strong organization, visual creativity, calmness under pressure, curiosity, and a collaborative approach to producing trusted journalism.



#LI-JB2

 

 

What’s in it For You?

At Reuters, our people are our greatest assets. Here are some of the benefits we offer for your personal and professional growth:

  • Global Career: As a global company, we can offer a truly international career and progression opportunities.

  • Learning & Development: On the job learning and coaching. We also have a dedicated training team focused on the continuous development of our journalists.

  • Industry Competitive Benefits:  We offer competitive salary packages and market leading benefits including paid volunteering days.

  • Perks: Work alongside Pulitzer Prize-winning journalists and a team who provide unmatched, award-winning coverage of the world’s most important stories.

Reuters is the world’s largest multimedia news provider. Founded in 1851, it is committed to the Trust Principles of independence, integrity and freedom from bias. With unmatched coverage in over 16 languages, and reaching billions of people worldwide every day, Reuters provides trusted intelligence that powers humans and machines to make smart decisions. It supplies business, financial, national and international news to professionals via desktop terminals, the world's media organizations, industry events and directly to consumers.

job.title: Product Manager, UK Practice Software
job.description:
Job Description


Thousands of UK accountancy practices rely on our software every day to run their firms, serve their clients and meet their compliance obligations. As Product Manager, you will own part of that portfolio and help take it from a set of well-run products to a connected, AI-enabled platform that practices and partners can build on. This is a build-and-converge mandate, not a maintenance role.

The Product Manager role is changing. AI is changing the way we work: the time from idea to working software is shrinking, prototyping is moving towards real development with tools like Claude Code, and the lines between product, engineering and design are blurring. The successful candidate will be flexible and willing to lean into that change, and will partner heavily with engineering and design, shaping, prototyping and building alongside them rather than handing over documents.

You will use the latest AI tools to move from idea to validated prototype faster than traditional product management allows, in a team that treats AI as part of its everyday toolkit.


The opportunity:

  • Practices are consolidating fragmented point tools into one connected workflow and want a single partner to deliver it.
  • Clients expect a modern, mobile, trustworthy way to share documents and receive finished work.
  • Document data extraction, preparation and review are going AI-native, and practices are adopting agentic tools now.
  • Practices increasingly want open APIs, so their own portals, data and reporting stay connected as the market converges.
  • Regulatory change, such as Making Tax Digital, keeps raising the bar for reliability at filing peaks.

Key Responsibilities


  • Own the product vision and roadmap. Balance customer needs, regulatory change and commercial priorities into a clear, evidence-based plan, and own the commercially consequential decisions that follow from it.
  • Deliver the portfolio, season over season. Own your products end to end, at the reliability and scale that filing deadlines and compliance peaks demand.
  • Converge products without disrupting customers. Bring overlapping products and capabilities together into one connected experience for every practice and client, and migrate existing customers without breaking what they rely on.
  • Componentise the portfolio. Turn each part of the product into reusable workflow components that can be recomposed across the practice workflow and the wider platform, rather than locked inside a single application.
  • Open the platform through APIs and orchestration. Expand the API surface (open APIs, events and integrations) as a first-class capability, so practices and partners embed our products in their own portals and workflows, and AI agents and partner systems can coordinate work programmatically.
  • Bring agentic, AI-driven workflows to practices. Work with the platform team to bring AI-driven extraction, preparation and review into the product experience, so more of the work shifts from practice staff to the platform while the practice stays in control.
  • Turn customer problems into well-defined solutions. Use AI tools to turn customer problems into clear, testable requirements that engineering and design can build from with confidence, in whatever form works best for the team.
  • Prototype early, then build. Use Claude Code or similar tools to build working prototypes that test ideas with customers and stakeholders before significant engineering investment is made, and increasingly contribute real, reviewed code alongside engineering.
  • Partner heavily with engineering and design. Work side by side with engineers and designers, often shaping ideas together in prototypes and in the build itself, to prioritise the backlog, clarify requirements and remove blockers, so valuable releases reach customers predictably.
  • Listen to customers and use data to decide. Run discovery with accountants and practice staff, work with large practices as design partners, and use usage analytics and support insight to measure whether what we ship delivers real outcomes.
  • Keep stakeholders informed and aligned. Communicate progress, trade-offs and decisions clearly to senior leaders, sales, support and customer-facing teams.
  • Raise the team's AI capability. Share effective prompts, skills, workflows and lessons learned so that AI-assisted product practice becomes the norm across the team.

What success looks like

  • Practices experience one connected workflow, whatever mix of products they run today.
  • Our APIs are something practices and partners actively build on, not a bespoke integration project.
  • Practices reach AI-driven, agentic preparation and review through our products, season over season.
  • Clients get a simpler, faster, more trustworthy experience, and practices see measurably less manual work.
  • Releases land predictably, and roadmap decisions are backed by customer evidence and usage data.
  • Colleagues across the team are using AI-assisted ways of working because you showed them how.

Required Qualifications


Education and experience

  • Degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 or more years as a Product Manager or Product Owner in a software product environment, delivering in an agile/scrum setting.
  • Demonstrable experience turning customer problems into clear requirements and acceptance criteria that engineering teams can deliver against.
  • Experience working on platform, API or developer-facing capabilities, not only features on top of them.
  • A track record of converging, migrating or replacing product capabilities without disrupting existing customers.

Technical skills and tools

  • AI tools for product work (such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot) for drafting requirements, analysis and synthesis.
  • Hands-on building with Claude Code or similar AI-assisted development tools, from prototypes through to contributing code alongside engineering.
  • Familiarity with AI-native products (data extraction, agents, orchestration) and comfort partnering with a platform team.
  • Backlog management tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira.
  • Product analytics or customer feedback tools such as Pendo.
  • Working familiarity with APIs and product architecture: able to read API documentation, understand how services and components fit together, and discuss design trade-offs with engineers.

Core competencies

  • Customer focus: seeks out real user problems and keeps them central to decisions.
  • Systems thinking: sees a portfolio as composable components rather than a monolith.
  • Structured, clear communication: writes precise requirements and explains trade-offs simply to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Prioritisation and judgement: makes sound decisions with incomplete information, owns commercially consequential calls and can say no with good reasons.
  • Curiosity and adaptability: learns new tools and domains quickly, is comfortable in a role that is still being redefined, and leans into new ways of working.
  • Collaboration and ownership: partners heavily with engineers and designers, builds trust with stakeholders, influences without authority and follows through on commitments.

Preferred Qualifications


Experience

  • Experience of the UK accountancy software market, or of working in or alongside an accountancy practice.
  • Familiarity with UK compliance-driven products, such as practice management, workflow, document management or tax software.
  • Background in document or data-processing workflows, fintech, or tax and accounting.
  • Experience of API development or of managing an API as a product.
  • Experience partnering with large, demanding customers as design partners.
  • Experience of discovery work with customers, including interviews, usability testing and feedback loops.
  • Familiarity with traditional product management artefacts and processes, such as PRDs, Epics, Features and User Stories, and how scrum teams use them.

Technical skills and tools

  • Advanced use of AI in the product lifecycle, such as building reusable prompts, skills or agent workflows.

job.title: Retention & Renewal Analytics - CS Lead
job.description:
Job Description


We are seeking a data-driven CS Operations professional to lead retention and renewal operations and analytics within the Asia and Emerging Markets (AEM) Customer Success Operations team. In this role, you will own the operational and analytical frameworks that underpin renewal forecasting, churn risk identification, and revenue retention operations strategy. Reporting to the Director of CS Operations, you will serve as the analytical backbone for Customer Success Managers and leadership — including VP of Customer Success and CS Directors — translating complex customer data into clear, actionable intelligence that drives measurable retention outcomes.


Key Responsibilities


  • Renewal Pipeline Analytics: Own end-to-end analytics for the renewal pipeline — track renewal rates, ARR/ACV at risk, and on-time renewal performance across segments and regions; publish CS key metrics regularly.
  • Churn & Contraction Modelling: Build and maintain predictive models to identify churn risk signals, contraction patterns, and at-risk cohorts; deliver proactive alerts to CS leadership and account teams.
  • Retention Performance Reporting: Design and manage recurring retention dashboards and scorecards (weekly, monthly, QBR-level) surfacing retention metrics, win-back trends, and save-play effectiveness; leverage AI and automation tools to develop a programmatic approach for retention operations reporting.
  • Root Cause Analysis: Lead post-churn or cancellation root cause analysis to identify systemic patterns; synthesise findings into actionable recommendations for Product, CS, and Commercial teams.
  • Renewal Process Optimisation: Partner with CS and Finance to refine renewal workflows, escalation triggers, and SLA frameworks within tools like Gainsight and Salesforce.
  • Executive Storytelling: Translate analytical findings into crisp executive narratives, supporting QBRs, exec-level reporting, and business reviews.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales Ops, Finance, and Product to align retention KPIs with broader go-to-market objectives.

Required Qualifications
 

  • 8–12 years of experience in Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, or a similar analytically focused role within a SaaS or subscription-based business.
  • Proven expertise in renewal and retention operations and analytics, including Gross Retention Rate (GRR), Net Retention Rate (NRR), churn rate, logo retention, and ARR/ACV metrics.
  • Advanced proficiency in Salesforce (SFDC) and Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight including experience building reports, dashboards, and customer lifecycle journeys.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial and data modelling, scenario analysis, and cohort/funnel analysis.
  • Hands-on experience with BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent) for self-service dashboard development and executive reporting.
  • Strong statistical aptitude — comfortable with cohort analysis, funnel analysis, and basic predictive modelling techniques.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; ability to present data-driven narratives clearly and concisely to senior stakeholders.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Background in revenue accounting or finance, particularly for ARR reconciliation and SaaS metrics reporting.
  • Exposure to Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero, Planhat, or similar tools.
  • Experience supporting or leading digital Customer Success or tech-touch retention programmes at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered analytics or automation solutions integrated within CS or CRM workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience in stakeholder management across cross-functional teams including Finance, Sales, and Product.
  • Exposure to global or multi-regional SaaS operations with an understanding of India-based delivery and GTM models.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Working knowledge of SQL or Python for data extraction and analysis; comfort with large datasets and data validation.
  • Familiarity with machine learning or propensity modelling frameworks applied to churn prediction (e.g., logistic regression, gradient boosting).

Are you looking to accelerate your sales career with a global technology and information leader? Job Description


The Sales Executive promotes and sells CoCounsel solutions to new acquisitions, primarily through outbound prospecting activity, to new corporate SMB customers within an assigned territory. You will be expected to meet/exceed sales and outbound activity (emphasis on calls and pipeline adds) target objectives as established. Additionally, the Sales Executive will be expected to meet/exceed a defined sales quota target targeting new customers.

This position supports the efforts of the SMB Corporates organization within Thomson Reuters Legal by growing our CoCounsel Solutions footprint. This role is expected to prospect for new opportunities, and consistently apply superior sales acumen to win competitive opportunities, which requires a very high level of consultative and solution-based selling.

Key Responsibilities

  • Focus daily effort selling to Corporate SMB customers that are new subscribers within an assigned territory
  • Achieve and exceed monthly and annual quotas through negotiations and product offering within set parameters

job.title: Senior Cloud and DevOps Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Design, develop, and troubleshoot the software for Thomson Reuters' software applications.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement the application infrastructure using computer science principles and concepts;
  • Write automation scripts to automate manual tasks; use IaC code to develop the AWS infrastructure;
  • Monitor the applications to ensure they adhere to the organization’s security best practices;
  • Design, develop, work with, and troubleshoot the AWS cloud service to support the application platform;
  • Push the developed code in the Git repository; review peers’ code on a day-to-day basis to maintain the consistency of the code;
  • Troubleshoot issues to unblock the development team’s work, including fixing pipeline issues;
  • Communicate technical requirements for task accomplishment.

 

Required Qualifications

  • A Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field followed by 3 years of post-baccalaureate experience in a software development-related occupation
  • Experience must include the following, which may have been gained concurrently:
  • 3 years of experience with DevOps;
  • 3 years of experience with AWS cloud platform;
  • 3 years of software development experience using Python or other systems automation language;
  • 3 years of experience with AWS services, including RDS, API Gateway, Lambda, CloudFormation, and CloudWatch;

You are organized, focused, and able to structure your tasks and priorities independently. You learn new tasks quickly and have both the ability and the willingness to support others, including colleagues and customers.


Senior Implementation Specialist is a dynamic role that involves a broad range of responsibilities. The primary responsibility is to act as an application and solution specialist for the ONESOURCE Pagero platform. job.title: Senior Manager, Subscriptions Strategy
job.description:
Job Description

Reuters Professional is seeking a Senior Manager, Subscription Strategy to lead global subscriber growth across web and app. Reporting to the Director of Subscriptions, you will own the product testing strategy and paywall and registration optimization while partnering with Product, Analytics, Newsletters, and Editorial to meet and exceed subscription goals. This is an opportunity to turn performance data into clear, actionable roadmaps and bring new ideas that drive growth across a premium news business.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead a global, full-funnel strategy that drives engagement, subscriber acquisition, and retention.
  • Own the web and app testing roadmap for registration walls, paywalls, and product journeys, partnering with Product and Engineering to continuously improve conversion and engagement.
  • Build install-to-paid acquisition strategies across mobile web and apps, and test campaign structures, audience segments, and ad creatives to improve efficiency across all acquisition channels.
  • Define audience cohorts from performance data to guide marketing and product decisions, and work with Product, Engineering, and Design to optimize landing pages, funnels, and onsite experiences.
  • Ensure the subscription value proposition is clearly defined across all consumer touchpoints.
  • Partner with Analytics on retention and churn analyses, identifying drivers of cancellation and opportunities to grow subscriber lifetime value.
  • Translate campaign, subscription, and testing performance into actionable insights, roadmaps, and recommendations, while overseeing marketing processes, timelines, and creative development.

 

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience developing and implementing subscription growth strategies for a premium news media organization.
  • Deep understanding of acquisition funnels, paywall and registration strategies, user behavior, and subscription models, with experience driving engagement and growth across paywalled content.
  • Experience partnering with editorial, product, and marketing teams to grow digital subscriptions.
  • Ability to use data to inform decisions, including analyzing customer journeys, applying attribution models, and optimizing acquisition funnels.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to build data-driven strategy roadmaps with a detailed approach.
  • Core competencies: problem solving and original thinking, data-informed decision making, collaboration across a matrixed organization, and a commitment to shared goals.
  • Experience at a premium news media organization.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding of the dynamics of audience engagement, subscription acquisition, and retention.
  • Track record of identifying new growth opportunities and bringing forward fresh ideas.

 About The Role:​

  • As a Senior Software Engineer – AI, you will collaborate with a cross-functional team of product managers, UX designers, and engineers to design, build, and deliver AI-powered solutions.​​

  • Architect and implement advanced AI systems, including multi-component pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and custom AI agents with multi-step reasoning.​

  • Integrate AI models into production software through robust APIs and scalable data pipelines.​

  • Adapt AI models and techniques to specialized domains, tailoring solutions for expert systems in areas such as legal, tax, and compliance.​

  • Evaluate and prototype cutting-edge AI techniques to solve business challenges​

  • Break down functional requirements into scalable technical specifications​

  • Mentor junior engineers and facilitate technical discussions​

  • Contribute to MLOps and LLMOps practices, both in design and implementation​

  • Act as a thought leader, sharing expertise in company-wide forums and representing the organization in emerging technology areas.​

  • Implement comprehensive testing frameworks and monitoring systems for AI model performance​

  • Ensure compliance with ethical AI principles and security standards​

  • Conduct systems analysis and recommend operational improvements​​

  • Work closely with AI researchers, engineers, designers and product teams to translate AI capabilities into real-world applications.​

  • Optimize AI system performance considering factors like latency and resource usage​

  • Support application feature enhancements through AI capabilities.​


About You:​
You are a fit for the position of Senior Software Engineer- AI if your background includes:​

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience​

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering; at least 2 years focused on AI/ML​

  • Proficiency in Python and experience with AI/ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow)​

  • Strong understanding of machine learning principles, evaluation, and system design​

  • Knowledge of MLOps and the end-to-end lifecycle of AI-powered software applications ​

  • Experience integrating AI models into production systems using APIs and data pipelines​

job.title: Senior Software Engineer AI
job.description:
Job Description

Senior Software Engineer, AI

Are you passionate about transforming the future of legal research with AI? Join our Global Westlaw Engineering organization and help shape the next generation of intelligent legal research solutions.

 

The Global Westlaw Engineering organization builds and operates the technology that powers Westlaw, the world’s leading legal research platform. Our teams develop innovative products and fiduciary-level, AI-based solutions that help legal professionals find trusted answers, uncover insights, and make confident decisions faster. Working across engineering, AI, data, platform, and product disciplines, we deliver secure, scalable, and intelligent experiences for customers around the globe.

 

As a Senior Software Engineer, AI, you will be a key technical contributor on a team that delivers the full-stack products, AI-enabled features, and services behind Westlaw’s next generation of experiences. You will build agentic legal research experiences and the retrieval services that ground them in trusted legal content.

 

You will be deeply hands-on, designing and writing production code, contributing to architecture, and raising the engineering bar for your team. You will build with agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and large language models (LLMs), and use AI-assisted development as a core way of working so you can deliver intelligent, trustworthy, and high-performing solutions for legal professionals worldwide.

 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Ownership

·       Design, build, and ship scalable user interfaces, backend services, and RESTful APIs.

·       Build GenAI and LLM integrations, including agentic workflows, prompt and context design, and retrieval services grounded in trusted legal content.

·       Contribute to architecture, engineering standards, coding practices, and code review, with a focus on deep technical ownership.

·       Own your work through to reliable production operations, including build, deployment, monitoring, and reliability, supported by automation and CI/CD.

·       Ensure delivery meets functional and non-functional requirements, including performance, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.

·       Embed quality and security into every stage of development, with rigorous testing, secure coding practices, and continuous evaluation of quality.

·       Design and build cloud-native solutions on AWS.

·       Evaluate and integrate emerging tool protocols (such as MCP) and retrieval patterns, with a clear understanding of production readiness and operational implications.

·       Resolve critical production issues and drive root-cause fixes.

 

AI-Enabled Engineering

·       Use AI-assisted and agent-driven development daily, and monitor and optimize token consumption to balance productivity, quality, and cost.

·       Deliver features using AI agents, applying clear task specification, careful human review of agent-generated code, and accountability for what ships.

·       Apply AI across the engineering lifecycle, including code generation, code review, test automation, and quality evaluation, with guardrails for security, data handling, and responsible use.

·       Help measure the impact of AI and agents on delivery speed, code quality, and defect rates.

·       Build and apply evaluation practices for agents, including testing, benchmarking, and monitoring agent behavior.

 

Collaboration and Mentorship

·       Mentor and coach engineers, sharing knowledge in information retrieval, agentic system design, and AI-assisted development.

·       Help shift team mindsets by modeling continuous learning and introducing new tools, practices, and ways of working.

·       Partner with Product, Design, and cross-functional teams to translate requirements into well-designed solutions.

·       Translate complex technical concepts and trade-offs into clear terms for stakeholders.

·       Delivery

·       Deliver solutions aligned with product roadmaps through incremental delivery, managing dependencies and tracking success metrics.

·       Follow and help improve secure engineering processes for the team that builds and delivers our flagship legal research products.

 

Continuous Learning

·       Stay current with developments in AI, cloud computing, and software engineering, and bring them into the team’s practices.

 

Required Qualifications

·       5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience across front-end and back-end, building scalable web applications.

·       A track record of shipping and operating production-grade full-stack systems at scale, including secure coding practices and reliability.

·       Hands-on experience building with LLMs in production or in serious prototypes, such as RAG, prompt and context design, evaluation, or agent workflows, and daily use of AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code).

·       Experience working hands-on in a team that builds and uses AI agents, with strong practices for review, quality, and security.

·       Clear understanding of RESTful API design principles, including:Resource modeling and URI designCorrect use of HTTP methods and status codesIdempotencyPagination, filtering, and versioningAuthentication and authorizationConsistent error handlingAPI documentation (e.g., OpenAPI/Swagger)

·       Strong proficiency in Python and in designing and building RESTful APIs.

·       Working proficiency in React or a similar modern UI framework (such as Angular or Vue), and experience with TypeScript and Node.js.

·       Strong knowledge of AWS architecture and services, with experience in DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code.

·       Experience mentoring and supporting the growth of other engineers.

·       Experience partnering with Product, Design, and cross-functional teams.

·       Excellent communication skills, with the ability to give clear updates, provide direct feedback, and align stakeholders.

·       Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment, making data-driven decisions as priorities evolve.

·       A strategic mindset, with the ability to ensure technical decisions align with business goals.

·       A Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

 

Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience shipping AI-driven or agentic systems in production, such as LLM orchestration, RAG and information retrieval, agent frameworks, and tool protocols (e.g., MCP), using LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) reliably at scale.

·       Experience with agent evaluation, including testing, benchmarking, and monitoring agent behavior.

·       Experience with Python frameworks such as Django, Flask, or FastAPI.

·       Experience working across front-end, back-end, and AI engineering disciplines.

·       A track record of helping teammates adopt new tools and ways of working.

·       Exposure to legal or other regulated professional domains.

·       AWS certifications, such as Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer.


#LI-SB1

job.title: Sr. Manager, Sales Operations
job.description:
Job Description


Are you looking to grow your career as a Sr. Manager, Sales Operations at a leading company in the Technology sector? Join us!

Thomson Reuters combines intelligence, technology and human expertise to deliver trusted answers that help professionals make confident decisions and run their businesses better.
We help reinvent the way professionals work. Our team of experts brings together information, innovation and insight to unravel complex situations in the Tax, Foreign Trade, Accounting and Legal markets, supporting our customers in their decision-making.

 

Key Responsibilities


  • Be part of a Customer Success team focused on operations.
  • Lead a team, ensuring that all processes, systems and support activities are executed efficiently.
  • Analyze Renewals data, implement improvement strategies and coordinate across departments to optimize renewal performance.
  • Facilitate communication and collaboration between the Operations, Finance and Customer Success teams.
  • Validate billing, delinquency, renewals and invoice information.
  • Support Customer Success managers in administrative areas such as opportunity processing, customer quotes and Renewals information management.
  • Renewals reporting and tracking; knowledge of Salesforce and SAP.

 

Required Qualifications


  • Advanced English – Mandatory.
  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields.
  • Experience in Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations or Business Operations.
  • Proven experience working with Customer Success teams or providing operational support to these areas.
  • Experience in direct people management.
  • Experience managing operational projects and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Solid experience with Customer Success platforms (Gainsight, Totango, Sensedata, ClientSuccess or similar).
  • Advanced experience with CRM platforms, especially Salesforce.
  • Advanced experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker).
  • Experience implementing automations and operational optimizations.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Solid knowledge of SaaS metrics (MRR, ARR, NRR, GRR) and customer satisfaction metrics.

#LI-KN1

 

 


O que iremos te oferecer?

  • Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido: Adotamos um ambiente de trabalho híbrido e flexível para as nossas funções baseadas em escritório, proporcionando uma experiência integrada e coerente tanto no âmbito digital quanto físico.

  • Desenvolvimento e Crescimento Profissional: Promovemos uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento de habilidades, preparando nossos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do futuro e oferecer soluções reais.   • Benefícios Competitivos do Setor: Oferecemos planos de benefícios abrangentes que incluem assistência médica e odontológica, dois dias de feriado corporativo para saúde mental, programas de incentivo por performance e recursos para o bem-estar mental, físico e financeiro.
  • Cultura: Reconhecida globalmente por inclusão e pertencimento, flexibilidade, equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Vivemos nossos valores: obsessão pelos nossos clientes, competir para ganhar, desafiar o (seu) nosso pensamento, agir rápido e aprender rápido e juntos somos mais fortes.
  • Impacto Social: Gere um impacto em sua comunidade com nosso Instituto de Impacto Social. Oferecemos a todos colaboradores dois dias de voluntariado pagos anualmente e oportunidades para se envolver em projetos de consultoria pro bono e iniciativas de Meio Ambiente, Sociais e de Governança (ESG).
  • Fazendo um Impacto Real no Mundo: Somos uma das poucas empresas globalmente que auxilia seus clientes na busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. Trabalhando em conjunto com os profissionais e instituições que servimos, contribuímos para sustentar o estado de direito, fomentar o comércio, detectar infratores, relatar os fatos e oferecer informações confiáveis e imparciais para pessoas em todo o mundo.

 

 

Quem somos

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. Servimos profissionais nos setores jurídico, fiscal, contábil, de conformidade, governamental e de mídia. Nossos produtos combinam software altamente especializado e informações para capacitar profissionais com os dados, inteligência e soluções necessárias para tomar decisões informadas e ajudar as instituições em sua busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. A agência de notícias Reuters, parte da Thomson Reuters, é líder mundial na área de jornalismo e notícias confiáveis.

Contamos com o talento de 26.000 colaboradores em mais de 70 países, onde todos têm a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer profissionalmente em ambientes de trabalho flexíveis. job.title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator -Contract
job.description:
Talent Acquisition Coordinator - 3 Month Contractor

Job Description

We are hiring a Talent Acquisition Coordinator to provide administrative support across the recruiting process for the Westbridge Print business. This is a 3-month contract opportunity with potential to extend. The role works in partnership with recruiters and HR Business Partners to manage candidate interactions and support recruiting and onboarding.


Location: Remote - United States

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide scheduling support to high-volume corporate recruiters across the full recruiting life cycle
  • Schedule candidates for interviews, send follow-up reminders, and collect interview notes for retention and compliance
  • Maintain the applicant tracking system to ensure data integrity and compliance
  • Audit applicant tracking system data and make corrections in the HRIS or ATS as needed
  • Coordinate background checks and required drug testing, serving as the primary contact with the background check vendor
  • Coordinate internal and external job postings, including niche job boards when requested
  • Prepare offer letters, disposition letters, and acknowledgement letters as appropriate
  • Handle new hire processes, including offer letter delivery and background check forms, and hand off to hiring managers for a positive onboarding experience
  • Assist with preparing recruiting reports
  • Identify process improvements and partner with peers and Recruiting Operations to implement them

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of professional or administrative experience
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to meet tight deadlines, manage multiple projects, and set priorities
  • Detail-oriented and customer-focused, with excellent organizational and follow-up skills
  • Proven ability to build positive working relationships with recruiters, hiring managers, HR Business Partners, and candidates
  • Strong work ethic and sense of urgency while staying composed under pressure
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook)
  • High proficiency with automated applicant tracking systems

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field
  • Prior experience on a corporate talent acquisition team or at a staffing agency
  • Understanding of the recruiting life cycle

#LI-CB1

 

 

What’s in it For You?

  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.

  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.

  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

 

 

In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The base compensation range varies across locations. For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the base compensation range for this role is $47,600 USD - $88,400 USD. Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs. This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.

This job posting will close .

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

job.description:
Account Executive 

*Non-Remote, In-Person Opportunity. * 

 

The Opportunity: 

Townsquare Media is looking for a bright, confident, driven individual to join our multimedia advertising sales team in Bozeman Montana.  Townsquare Media Bozeman is an industry leader in digital advertising and an accredited marketing partner of both Google and Meta as well as home to five top radio stations.   

 

At Townsquare Media Bozeman, we are a team of ambitious individuals who work together to push ourselves and those around us to grow personally and professionally. You can expect a dynamic and competitive work environment that fosters success, training, development, and an unlimited earning potential! 

 

If you’re ready to embark upon an exciting career that affords you the opportunity to form meaningful client relationships, develop creative advertising campaigns using our best-in-class multimedia solutions, all while having your finger on the pulse of Southwest Montana…then we want to hear from you!  

 

What You’ll Do: 

  • Identify, pursue, and schedule meetings with local business owners and decision makers to discuss and uncover their marketing needs and challenges 
  • Use our proprietary data, analytics, and multimedia marketing solutions to build, present, and sell customized advertising plans to potential clients  
  • Build, maintain and develop close working relationships with your clients to identify and upsell new advertising solutions 
  • Use your influence and relationship-building skills to provide ongoing customer service, research, and market analysis 
  • You will be responsible for bringing our premier marketing and advertising solutions to local and regional businesses in the Bozeman area and beyond 
  • You will work with and sell integrated advertising solutions including broadcast radio, LIVE event sponsorships and digital including website design, SEO, SEM, Programmatic, Social, Streaming TV and much more 

 

What You’ll Bring: 

  • 1+ year of sales or marketing experience (preferred) 
  • Strong marketing and advertising acumen 
  • Effective verbal and written communications are essential 
  • Experience selling or a working knowledge of digital advertising solutions preferred 
  • Goal-oriented, strong work ethic and a desire to learn and grow a career in Sales 
  • A passion towards customer focused solution sales 
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required) 
  • BA/BS degree (preferred) 

 

What’s In It for You? 

  • Competitive compensation package with UNCAPPED earning potential  
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days) 
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community 
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance 
  • 401(k) with company match + Employee Stock Purchase Plan 
  • Company-provided laptop 
  • Casual, high-energy, supportive, and collaborative work environment 
  • 4-week long sales training program  
  • Unlimited growth opportunities!  

 

Why Townsquare Media Group? 

Townsquare is a community-focused digital media, digital marketing solutions, and radio company focused outside the Top 50 markets in the U.S. Our assets include Townsquare Interactive, a digital marketing services subscription business providing websites, search engine optimization, social platforms, and online reputation management for approximately 21,900 SMBs; Townsquare IGNITE, a proprietary digital programmatic advertising technology with an in-house demand and data management platform; and Townsquare Media, our portfolio of 357 local radio stations in 74 cities with corresponding local news and entertainment websites and apps along with a network of national music/content brands.

job.title: Business Development Representative
job.description:
Business Development Representative

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

This Isn't Another Sales Job. It's Your Chance to Build Something Bigger.

Let's be honest—there are thousands of sales jobs.
Most ask you to sell one product. Make cold calls. Hit a quota. Repeat.
This isn't one of them.

At Townsquare Media Grand Rapids, you'll help shape the success of local businesses while representing some of the most recognized brands in West Michigan. You'll have the backing of a company that combines the power of market-leading radio stations, streaming audio, live events, streaming TV, websites, social media, search marketing, programmatic advertising, SEO, websites, and cutting-edge digital solutions—all under one roof.

Every day is different. Every client is different. Every success story is yours to create.

If you're energized by competition, love solving business challenges, and want unlimited earning potential while working alongside an exceptional team, we'd love to meet you.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare Media is one of America's largest and most innovative local media companies, operating 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets nationwide.

In Grand Rapids, we're more than a media company—we're woven into the fabric of the community. Our brands entertain, inform, and connect hundreds of thousands of people every week while helping businesses grow through powerful, measurable marketing solutions.

Our clients don't hire us to buy advertising.
They partner with us to grow their businesses.
That's where you come in.

 

What You’ll Do:

You'll become a trusted marketing advisor to local business owners and decision-makers, helping them navigate today's rapidly evolving media landscape.
You'll work with entrepreneurs, CEOs, marketing directors, nonprofits, and community leaders to develop customized marketing strategies that deliver real business results.

Every day you'll:

  • Build new relationships with businesses throughout West Michigan
  • Create strategic marketing plans using radio, streaming audio, streaming TV, websites, social media, SEO, search marketing, programmatic advertising, events, and more
  • Present creative ideas that help clients grow revenue and strengthen their brands
  • Negotiate and close new business
  • Collaborate with creative, digital, programming, and leadership teams to bring campaigns to life
  • Become a respected business resource within the community

No two days look alike—and that's exactly what makes this role exciting.

 

Who Thrives Here?

Our best Account Executives are naturally curious, highly competitive, resilient, and genuinely enjoy helping people succeed.
They don't see themselves as salespeople.
They see themselves as consultants, entrepreneurs, and problem-solvers.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Love building relationships
  • Enjoy winning new business
  • Are energized by goals and competition
  • Take pride in delivering exceptional client service
  • Want to continue learning in one of the fastest-changing industries in business
  • Believe your income should reflect your performance

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 2+ years of experience in sales (required)
  • Consistent record of meeting or exceeding sales goals
  • Confidence prospecting and developing new business opportunities
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)
  • BA/BS degree (preferred)

 

What’s In It for You?

We know sales is a grind, but the rewards are real. Here’s what you get:

  • Uncapped earning potential with a competitive compensation plan
  • Comprehensive onboarding and industry-leading sales training
  • Continuous coaching from experienced local leadership
  • Career advancement opportunities within one of America's leading media companies
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days)
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) with company match + Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Company-provided laptop

 

More Than a Job. Build your future. Build your community. Build something extraordinary—with Townsquare Media Grand Rapids.

When you join Townsquare Media Grand Rapids, you're joining a team that celebrates big wins, supports one another, embraces innovation, and believes local businesses deserve world-class marketing.
You'll help launch new ideas, work with recognizable brands, attend exciting community events, collaborate with talented teammates, and build a career where your effort directly impacts your success.
If you're looking for a place where your ambition is rewarded, your ideas matter, and no two days are ever the same, we'd love to talk.

job.title: Director of Digital & Radio Content - Fort Collins
job.description:
Director of Digital & Radio Content – Fort Collins

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Where Creative Leadership Meets Local Impact:

Are you a strategic, people-first content leader with a passion for building winning brands and developing top-tier talent? At Townsquare Media Group, we’re looking for a Director of Digital & Radio Content to lead our MARKET market—overseeing strong local brands and driving audience growth across on-air, digital, social, and live platforms.

This is a full-time, in-office leadership role working closely and collaboratively with a talented local team. You’ll set the vision for local content, coach and develop market-leading talent, and play a hands-on role in creating compelling, clickable, and shareable content that resonates with the local community—while partnering closely with sales and leadership to drive revenue and impact.

 

Why Townsquare Media?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Fort Collins stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As Director of Digital & Radio Content for Fort Collins, you’ll provide leadership, strategy, and creative direction for our local brands—ensuring excellence across on-air, online, and on-site experiences. This role blends high-level strategy with hands-on leadership and content creation. You will:

  • Establish and execute a clear, competitive vision for local content while maintaining ownership of the overall sound, content strategy, and brand execution across all stations to drive audience growth, market leadership, and business results.
  • Lead from the front as an active influencer, content creator, and brand ambassador, setting the standard for audience engagement while coaching team members to build meaningful connections across on-air, digital, social, and live platforms.
  • Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing on-air, digital, and production talent, fostering a positive, collaborative, high-performance culture that drives market-leading results across all brands.
  • Partner closely with sales leadership and cross-functional teams to develop compelling, revenue-generating content, sponsorships, promotions, features, and events, creating innovative marketing solutions for clients while ensuring alignment across programming, sales, production, and market leadership.
  • Develop innovative, multi-platform content strategies that build highly engaged audience communities, drive ratings and digital growth, cultivate strong relationships throughout the market, and create revenue-generating partnerships across all channels.
  • Host a live, engaging on-air show on a regular, ongoing basis, preparing daily content that entertains, informs, and connects with the target audience
  • Create and publish a minimum of two original local articles per day for the station website and mobile app
  • Create and oversee compelling local content and digital storytelling across websites, mobile platforms, and social channels
  • Design and execute programming clocks, music strategy, and tactical plans to grow time spent listening, audience occasions, and digital reach
  • Oversee sound design, station imaging, and audio architecture—keeping content fresh, creative, and impactful
  • Creating and publishing original video content regularly, including social-first short-form video (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) and longer-form segments that grow your personal on-screen brand
  • Prospecting and developing endorsement and influencer partnerships with local businesses, pitching yourself as a trusted community voice who can authentically promote products and services across on-air, video, and social platforms
  • Participating in person in high-visibility community events, client meetings, and business functions as a station ambassador who builds relationships that translate into revenue

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • Demonstrated success as a content leader with strong people management skills
  • 3+ years of management experience
  • Strategic mindset with a strong understanding of industry trends and audience behavior
  • On-air programming experience with deep knowledge of content creation and curation
  • Strong writing, communication, and storytelling skills across platforms
  • Familiarity with a wide range of digital assets, tools, and publishing workflows
  • Proven ability to lead in competitive markets and drive measurable results
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to connect content strategy to revenue outcomes
  • Sound judgment, creativity, and a strong desire to win
  • High School Diploma (required)
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)

 

What’s In It for You?

We know leadership roles come with high expectations—and we back that up with meaningful rewards:

  • Competitive salary + bonus program
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Casual, high-energy work environment
  • Opportunities for upward mobility within a growing media organization
  • Company discounts
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • And much more…

 

Think You Have What It Takes? Apply Today!
