job.title: Business Director
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business, not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are looking for a Business Director to join Translation and help lead our growing Eli Lilly partnership, bringing culturally relevant creative work to life for brands that impact people’s health.

Position Summary

As a Business Director, you will serve as a strategic leader and trusted client partner across assigned Eli Lilly brands and workstreams. You will build a deep understanding of the client’s business, patient audiences, and category, translating those insights into clear direction and creative opportunities that connect brands with people in meaningful ways.

Working with the account’s Executive Director, you will lead client relationships, guide cross-functional teams, develop Business Leadership talent, and identify opportunities for growth. You will partner closely with Program Management on delivery and account financial health, balancing creative ambition with the rigor of a regulated category and the needs of a fast-growing business.

What You Will Do

Drive Business and Strategic Leadership

  • Act as the day-to-day senior business lead across assigned Lilly brands and workstreams, building trusted relationships with mid-to-senior client stakeholders and proactively shaping the business agenda.
  • Develop a strong understanding of brand priorities, patient experiences, barriers to engagement, and competitive dynamics to inform strategic counsel and creative development.
  • Translate complex client needs and feedback into clear priorities and actionable direction, constructively challenging clients when needed to strengthen the work.
  • Monitor relationship health and business performance, anticipating risks and partnering with the Executive Director to address issues before they affect the partnership.

Lead Creative Solutions with Business Impact

  • Partner with Strategy, Context, Creative, and Analytics to develop culturally relevant work grounded in business objectives, audience insights, and clear measures of success.
  • Champion communication that reflects real patient experiences and makes complex health topics understandable, empathetic, and relevant to everyday life.
  • Ensure work is strategically sound and client-ready, with compelling rationale and alignment to client-provided medical, legal, and regulatory guidance.
  • Work with Lilly’s brand teams, internal creative team, and agency partners to clarify roles, align recommendations, and maintain continuity across the work.
  • Partner with Production and Program Management to bring approved concepts to life within agreed scope, timing, and budget, advocating for additional investment when warranted.

Lead Teams and Strengthen Partnerships

  • Guide cross-functional teams with clear priorities, expectations, and decisions, creating a collaborative environment with shared accountability for the work.
  • Lead, coach, and develop Business Supervisors and other assigned Business Leadership team members through regular feedback and meaningful development opportunities.
  • Partner with Program Management, which leads operational planning and delivery, to align client expectations with scopes, schedules, staffing, and review requirements.
  • Work with client stakeholders and Program Management to anticipate approval needs, consolidate feedback, and help teams understand review decisions and their implications.
  • Navigate competing stakeholder needs and resolve day-to-day challenges independently, escalating significant relationship, commercial, or delivery risks appropriately.

Champion Growth and Financial Health

  • Develop and action growth plans for assigned brands and workstreams, connecting unmet client needs with Translation’s capabilities.
  • Co-own account financial health with Program Management, contributing to scope development, staffing recommendations, forecasting, and profitability management.
  • Identify scope changes and investment needs early, leading clear client conversations about the associated fees, priorities, and trade-offs.
  • Contribute to new business, recruiting, and departmental improvements that strengthen the agency and develop future Business Leadership talent.

Knowledge Skills and Abilities

  • Strong business judgment and strategic fluency, with the ability to learn complex categories and turn ambiguity into clear direction.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills, including the confidence to advise clients, explain creative rationale, and navigate sensitive conversations.
  • Ability to balance creative ambition with accuracy and client review requirements, partnering effectively with medical, legal, and regulatory stakeholders.
  • Experience leading integrated campaigns across channels, with a strong understanding of creative development and production.
  • Commercial acumen across scopes, staffing, budgets, and account performance, paired with a collaborative approach to Program Management.
  • A proactive, hands-on leadership style, with sound prioritization, attention to detail, and the ability to develop others in a fast-moving environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7-10 years of experience in an agency or communications-related industry, with a well-rounded understanding of advertising, marketing, media, creative, production, and agency finance.
  • Proven success managing integrated campaigns, partnering with mid-to-senior-level clients, and leading cross-functional teams.
  • Hands-on production experience with large-scale, multi-channel initiatives.
  • Experience coaching junior account team members and contributing to scope development, account financial management, and organic growth.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other regulated brands, including familiarity with medical, legal, and regulatory review processes. Direct pharma experience is a plus, not a requirement; curiosity about the category and an eagerness to learn are valued.
  • Experience with consumer-facing health communications, patient storytelling, or brand launches.
  • Experience partnering with in-house creative teams and working within a multi-agency environment.
  • Experience developing culturally relevant campaigns, including talent partnerships, social content, or experiential work.
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $115,000 - $135,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

job.title: Business Supervisor
job.description:
Business Supervisor

Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are seeking a Business Supervisor to support our Eli Lilly business, helping bring culturally relevant creative work to life for brands that impact people’s health. This role is hybrid and requires 4 days a week in our Brooklyn office, with 1 day remote. 

Position Summary

The Business Supervisor (BS) is the day-to-day client partnership lead, responsible for managing client communication, translating business needs into actionable direction, and ensuring clarity across internal teams. Serving as the critical connection point between Business Leadership and Program Management, the Business Supervisor helps create exceptional client experiences while enabling efficient delivery.

This role operates with guidance while independently managing day-to-day client relationships and workstreams. Business Supervisors build trusted client partnerships, drive alignment across disciplines, proactively manage expectations, and help ensure every engagement is strategically grounded and executionally set up for success.

What You'll Do

Client Partnership & Communication

  • Own day-to-day client relationships and communication across assigned workstreams.
  • Lead routine client meetings, status calls, working sessions, and follow-up communications.
  • Build trust through proactive communication, responsiveness, and thoughtful partnership.
  • Ensure every client interaction is organized, productive, and aligned against business objectives.

Translation & Alignment

  • Translate client needs, feedback, and business objectives into clear direction for internal teams.
  • Partner closely with Strategy, Context, Creative, and Business Directors to develop and refine creative briefs.
  • Ensure cross-functional teams understand priorities, expectations, success metrics, and next steps.
  • Create alignment between client goals and agency recommendations throughout the life of a project.
  • Build a working understanding of the client’s brands, patient audiences, competitive landscape, and business priorities to inform day-to-day client partnership and internal direction.

Creative Development Support

  • Prepare clients for presentations and key decision-making moments.
  • Help articulate strategic and creative rationale in a clear, compelling, and client-ready manner.
  • Anticipate client feedback and guide internal teams on effective responses.
  • Support creative development by ensuring work remains aligned to client objectives, approved strategy, and client-provided medical, legal, and regulatory guidance.

Risk & Expectation Management

  • Proactively identify risks, ambiguities, or changing client needs before they become issues.
  • Manage client expectations through transparent communication and thoughtful problem solving.
  • Resolve day-to-day challenges independently, escalating only when appropriate.
  • Ensure alignment between what clients expect and what teams are prepared to deliver.

Team Contribution & Development

  • Mentor junior Business Leadership team members in client communication, relationship management, and presentation skills.
  • Support Business Directors in strengthening client relationships and identifying opportunities for organic growth.
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and positive team environment across disciplines.
  • Model strong judgment, professionalism, and ownership in client-facing situations.

Partnership with Program Management

  • Partner closely with Program Management to ensure alignment between client expectations and delivery plans.
  • Support scope definition by helping clarify client objectives, priorities, and desired outcomes.
  • Maintain awareness of timelines, budgets, and executional progress while allowing Program Management to lead delivery.
  • Work collaboratively to ensure clients receive a seamless experience from strategy through execution.
  • Partner with Program Management and client stakeholders to clarify review requirements, consolidate feedback, and ensure teams understand approval decisions and their implications.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in advertising, marketing, consulting, or related client leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted client relationships and manage day-to-day business communications.
  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Strategy, Creative, Production, Context, and Program Management.
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional organization and attention to detail.
  • Experience mentoring junior team members and contributing to a collaborative team culture.
  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing, creative development, and client service best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience supporting healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other regulated brands is a plus, but not required. Curiosity about the category and an eagerness to learn are valued.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

#TRANSLATION

job.title: Context Director
job.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters, Inc. is a first-of-its-kind company that lives at the intersection of culture, tech and storytelling. Through our creative solutions company, Translation, we build ideas that transcend traditional marketing to 

drive business results through cultural impact. Through our music tech platform, UnitedMasters, we power the careers of independent artists through music distribution services and partnership opportunities with the world’s biggest brands. As one-company, we are building a world where cultural capital is equitably exchanged at scale by serving as the go-to source for shared gains between artists and brands. 

If this description makes you feel like running through a brick wall, you’re in the right place.

The Role

Context Planning is the connective tissue between what we make and who we’re making it for. This is a team that only exists at Translation and we built it to help brands diffuse their ideas through culture by focusing on where, when and who they live through.

This role is for a leader who can translate raw insight into real influence, help brands find their voice inside the communities they are looking to engage with, and build systems that make great ideas scale. At your core, you're not just a comms planner. You’re a front row student of culture, a campaign conductor, and an idea amplifier. The Context Director is a leadership position that demands creative foresight, cultural nuance, business acumen, cross-functional collaboration, and a deep connection to what’s moving the world today. 

What You’ll Do

Functional Skills

  • Cultural Research: Lead and assign cultural deep dives that inform strategy and creative development.
  • Comms Planning: Own authorship of holistic GTM plans that connect the dots creatively while translating business objectives into actionable rollouts over time and space/channels.
  • Casting & Talent Strategy: Lead authorship of casting filters that help identify talent who personify our campaign message while ensuring brand safety and creative alignment. 
  • Creative World-Building: Analyze hero deliverables (e.g., film scripts) and provide cultural nuance that infuses insider fan perspective in the form Easter eggs, and additional engagement tactics that will resonate with core audience members.
  • Convergence & Collaboration: Facilitate onboarding for new hires to ensure alignment on Context’s function and value. Partner across PR, Media, and Social teams to preserve creative integrity and contextual fluency from pitch to publish.
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as a core member of the business leadership team, aligning day-to-day execution with our broader One Company Vision. Mentor DRs across IC1–IC3 levels and informally coach team members outside your direct reporting line.

Who You Are

  • A systems thinker who can orchestrate brand storytelling through people, platforms, and moments.
  • A culture junkie with strong intuition and analytical rigor—you know what’s next, and why it matters.
  • A collaborator who’s equally fluent in creative, strategy, talent, and media environments.
  • A researcher at heart, with a passion for ethnography, behavioral analysis, and emerging platforms.
  • A mentor and motivator who uplifts junior talent and brings out the best in cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

  • 7–9 years experience in cultural strategy, brand planning, or creative strategy roles.
  • Proven experience leading multi-channel campaigns from insight through execution.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills—must be comfortable presenting work to senior leaders and clients.
  • Proficiency in Keynote, Google Suite, and qualitative research tools.
  • Deep understanding of subcultures, niche internet communities, and artist ecosystems.
  • Bonus: Background or minor in a creative craft, artistic discipline, or subcultural space.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $120,000 - $140,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

job.description:
Who We Are

We are a well-established independent agency and thriving music business, built to help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. In 2022, Translation was awarded the number three spot in Ad Age’s Agency A-List and AdWeek’s Multicultural Agency of the Year. One year before, Translation was awarded Ad Age’s Small Agency of the Year. We’re unapologetically ambitious, but we’re also a tight-knit crew.

We are looking for a Context Planner to join Translation! Please note that this role is a Hybrid role: four days in office and one day remote.

What You'll Do

The Context planner is client-facing on a case by case basis and plays a key role in choreographing campaigns and designing integrated go-to-market plans that incite audience participation. It is your responsibility to gain an in-depth understanding of the people, passions, and platforms that matter most to the audience, and to rethink media in new ways to help our brand partners communicate through the places, spaces, times and people that our audience will be most receptive to.

  • Core contributor to comms plans, campaign rollouts, creative ecosystems, and customer journeys 
  • Leadership of social influencer identification, sample social post instructions, and platform best practices
  • Proactively research culturally relevant moments that lead to bespoke activation calendars 
  • Partner with creative teams by contributing out-the-box extension tactics to support big idea platforms
  • Partner with UMT’s “stratpack” to create “Get Smart” research docs in support of project kickoffs that help retrace recent brand activity, categorical trends, consumer insights, and white-space opportunities to inform brand action
  • Lead media partner recommendations and identify unique integration opportunities that amplify the core idea
  • Create risk assessment documents in moments where stakeholders want to pursue a potentially problematic idea
  • Deconstruct best-in-class campaigns to extract key learnings that are applicable to our brand partners
  • Proactively contribute thought leadership throughout the agency (Flash Forecast weekly newsletter)
  • Subscribe to a constant plan of refinements and updates as new tech, media and consumer insights arise

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Recognize patterns and mechanics displayed by people and brands that move culture and incite action. 
  • Become fluent in the sub-cultures our audience subscribes to by immersing yourself in the networks, rituals, artifacts and language they practice.
  • Constantly seek out first-to-market media opportunities that position our brands as category disruptors.
  • Confidence in packaging and presentation of work to inspire both internal and external sell through.
  • Possess and demonstrate a vibrant connection to and fluency in pop culture and brand trends. 
  • Passion for diving deep into research and data to unearth actionable insights that propel the creative.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Possess excellent time management, organization and prioritization skills.
  • Have the proven ability to work under tight deadlines and handle pressure, while consistently paying attention to accuracy and quality of work.
  • Exercise the ability to quickly and effectively adapt to changing needs and expectations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum 3-5 years experience in a strategic position in an agency or brand environment
  • 4-year college degree in Marketing, Advertising or Business preferred.
  • Digitally savvy; MUST be proficient in Google Suite and Keynote (Mac preferred).

job.title: Group Business Director
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business, not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are looking for a Group Business Director to help lead our growing Eli Lilly partnership, shaping culturally relevant creative work for brands that impact people’s health.

Position Summary

As a Group Business Director, you will own the health, growth, and performance of a portfolio of Eli Lilly brands and workstreams. You will serve as a senior strategic partner to VP- and SVP-level marketing stakeholders, connecting brand priorities, patient needs, and cultural opportunities into a clear vision for the business.

You will make portfolio-level decisions with minimal executive oversight, lead and develop Business Directors and Business Supervisors, and co-own financial performance with Program Management. You will balance creative ambition with the rigor of a regulated category, bringing clear judgment to complex decisions and engaging executive leadership when significant risks or investments require alignment.

What You Will Do

Lead Portfolio Strategy and Growth

  • Partner with the Executive Director to drive portfolio performance and strengthen client relationships, setting priorities across assigned brands and workstreams and proactively addressing risks to the partnership.
  • Develop and drive growth plans that connect unmet client needs with Translation’s capabilities, expanding relationships and agency impact.
  • Build a deep understanding of Lilly’s business, patient audiences, and competitive dynamics; identify opportunities across brands and connect them into a broader business vision.

Build Senior Client Partnerships

  • Build trusted relationships with senior marketing leaders, shaping client agendas and influencing decisions through clear, proactive counsel.
  • Navigate complex stakeholder needs, constructively challenge assumptions, and lead sensitive conversations about priorities, investment, and the work.
  • Maintain a consistent pulse on client satisfaction, risks, and opportunities, aligning Lilly’s brand teams, internal creative team, and agency partners.

Champion Strategic and Creative Excellence

  • Ensure work solves meaningful business problems and meets Translation’s standards for strategic rigor, creative and cultural excellence, and client readiness.
  • Guide Strategy, Context, Creative, and Analytics toward ambitious ideas grounded in audience insight, business objectives, and clear measures of success.
  • Champion empathetic, accessible health communications that reflect real patient experiences, with alignment to client-provided medical, legal, and regulatory guidance.

 Own Commercial Performance

  • Co-own portfolio financial performance with Program Management, including resource allocation, profitability, forecasting, and long-term growth.
  • Lead senior client conversations on scopes, fees, changing needs, and investment; ensure commercial implications are addressed before commitments are made.
  • Coach Business Directors on commercial judgment and make investment recommendations across the portfolio, balancing immediate needs with long-term opportunity.

Develop Teams and Align Delivery

  • Lead, mentor, and develop Business Directors and Business Supervisors through regular coaching, semi-annual performance reviews, and meaningful development opportunities.
  • Establish clear roles, accountability, and development pathways, building teams that exercise sound judgment and collaborate effectively.
  • Partner with Program Management, which leads operational planning and delivery, to align staffing, scope, schedules, and review requirements with business goals.
  • Ensure seamless integration across Strategy, Context, Creative, and Production; confirm feasibility before major commitments and resolve competing portfolio priorities.

Strengthen the Agency

  • Partner with department leaders to shape Business Leadership standards, improve ways of working, and strengthen agency capabilities.
  • Support new business pitches and represent Translation through relevant partnerships and industry participation.
  • Help recruit and develop a strong pipeline of future Business Leadership talent.

Knowledge Skills and Abilities

  • Strong business judgment and strategic fluency, with the ability to turn complex client needs into clear priorities across multiple brands.
  • Executive presence and exceptional communication skills, with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and navigate difficult conversations.

job.title: Group Strategy Director
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious! 

We are looking for a Group Strategy Director to join Translation. This role demands four days in office and one day remote.

What You'll Do

  • Set the strategic direction across key client accounts, ensuring our thinking is clear, differentiated, culturally informed, and connected to meaningful business outcomes.
  • Define the real problem behind complex business and brand challenges, quickly identifying the tensions, opportunities, and strategic choices that should guide the work.
  • Lead the development of brand, cultural, and creative strategy, translating insight into a clear point of view that inspires both clients and creative teams.
  • Lead multiple engagements and workstreams simultaneously, maintaining a high standard of strategic quality while helping teams prioritize what matters most.
  • Shape the strategic approach to major briefs and opportunities, determining what we need to learn, questions to answer, and how different disciplines should come together.
  • Partner with Data Strategy, Context, Business, and Creative leadership to create an integrated strategic vision for the work.
  • Develop and mentor strategists, providing clear direction and feedback while helping junior and mid-level talent strengthen their judgment, storytelling and strategic craft.
  • Raise the quality of the Strategy discipline, establishing strong standards for briefs, narratives, presentations, research, and strategic recommendations.
  • Contribute to Translation’s intellectual capital, developing perspectives that advance how we understand audiences, culture, brands, and business.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Exceptional strategic judgment with the ability to distinguish an interesting observation from an insight that can meaningfully change the work.
  • Strong command of brand, cultural, and creative strategy, with the ability to connect them into a cohesive strategic narrative.
  • Ability to simplify complex business and cultural challenges into clear, compelling strategic choices.
  • Persuasive storyteller who can build and present a strategic argument with clarity, confidence, and conviction.
  • Strong client leadership skills and the ability to build credibility with senior clients.
  • Ability to lead through ambiguity, bringing structure and direction to assignments that may not begin with a clearly defined answer.
  • Strong creative instincts and the ability to translate strategy into direction that inspires and improves creative work.
  • Strong understanding of qualitative and quantitative research, with the judgment to determine when additional research is necessary and how findings should inform strategy.
  • Ability to lead, coach, and elevate other strategists while maintaining accountability for the quality of their work.
  • Collaborative leadership style with the ability to bring different disciplines and perspectives toward a common strategic ambition.
  • Deep curiosity about people, culture, brands, and business, informed by interests and experiences that contribute a distinct point of view.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in strategy, brand development, communications, cultural strategy, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience leading strategy for significant client accounts, campaigns, brand platforms, or integrated engagements.
  • Proven ability to independently develop and defend strategic recommendations with senior clients and internal leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize research, cultural intelligence, business context, and audience understanding into actionable strategy.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading strategy across multiple/ complex, multi-workstream accounts.
  • Strong understanding of the digital, social, media, and creator ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated ability to turn cultural understanding into distinctive brand, cultural, and creative strategies.
  • Proven ability to uncover and translate audience-specific insights into impactful brand, cultural, and creative strategies

job.description:
Who we are 

As a new industry alternative for independent artists, UnitedMasters provides premium music distribution services and facilitates unique partnerships between artists and the world’s biggest brands. We enable artists to maintain full ownership over their master recording rights while introducing them to millions of new fans worldwide through our direct brand partnerships.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Instagram, Dropbox, Complex, VICE and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation. 

Essential Responsibilities You’ll Own

  • Participate in the monthly royalty payout run process 
  • Preparation of monthly royalty payment reports and support documentation
  • Reviewing contracts to determine royalty payment requirements
  • Assists in the review of new contracts received from Licensors
  • Enter required contractual data points into the rights management system
  • Review and upload royalty reports including identification and resolution of any data conflicts
  • Liaise with agents to ensure timely receipt of royalty statement reporting
  • Prepare monthly 3rd party royalty statements
  • Work closely with Corporate Finance/Accounting team
  • Ad hoc requests and analytics to support Sales and Finance team
  • Process and review Artist royalty statements for contract compliance
  • Record transactions in our Royalty system
  • Track statements to be processed and update with status of outstanding issues
  • Prepare licensing and royalty data for reporting out to internal business partners
  • Other duties as assigned, including assist with month-end close, assist in preparation of participation reporting to parent company and other parties, assist with licensee audit program, assist with development of standards, processes, and procedures

What will set you up for success

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business/Music Business or closely related field
  •  2+ years of royalty experience
  • Must be detail-oriented and have excellent organizational, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Flexible work style: able to adjust to multiple demands and a changing and fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and exercise professional judgment
  • Attention to detail and a high level of accuracy required
  • Required technical skills: Advanced MS Excel (knowledge of pivot tables, subtotal, sort, filter, if statements, vlookups, etc. required)

job.title: Sr. Context Planner
job.description:
Who We Are

We are a well-established independent agency and thriving music business, built to help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. In 2022, Translation was awarded the number three spot in Ad Age’s Agency A-List and AdWeek’s Multicultural Agency of the Year. One year before, Translation was awarded Ad Age’s Small Agency of the Year. We’re unapologetically ambitious, but we’re also a tight-knit crew.

We are looking for a Senior Context Planner to join Translation! Please note that this role is a Hybrid role: four days in office and one day remote. 

Summary

The Senior Context Planner leads integrated communications and go-to-market planning that turns brand strategy and creative ideas into audience participation. As a strategic partner to clients and colleagues across disciplines, you define where, when, with whom and why a brand should show up, giving every channel a clear role. You move quickly and independently, form and defend a clear point of view, and translate complex thinking into compelling stories, thoughtfully designed decks and actionable plans.

You pair that planning craft with cultural fluency across sports, music, entertainment and the worlds they intersect with, from creators and fandom to fashion, gaming and internet behavior. With strong social instincts and a sharp creative eye, you understand how ideas come to life in-feed, spot emerging behaviors and formats, and turn those insights into meaningful opportunities for brands.

What You'll Do

Comms Planning.

  • Translate cultural insights and creative platforms into campaign architecture, defining the role of messaging, channels, moments and partners.
  • Build phasing and sequencing that shows how the idea unfolds over time.
  • Communicate the approach clearly and visually, making complex ecosystems simple and actionable

Cultural Insights

  • Identify meaningful cultural shifts, behaviors and communities relevant to the audience and brand.
  • Frame those signals into clear implications and opportunities for strategy and creative.
  • Use research and cultural inputs to sharpen the comms approach, not just report what’s happening, and contribute insights to company thought leadership (e.g. newsletters, social, etc.) beyond client work.

Creative world-building

  • Maintain a clear narrative throughline as the idea extends across the campaign ecosystem.
  • Shape how the idea is expressed across different touchpoints while preserving what makes it distinctive.
  • Identify opportunities for participation and amplification that help the idea travel further.

Campaign casting

  • Synthesize best practices across the talent x brand landscape into clear POVs
  • Develop talent filters and casting recommendations for creators, artists and partners who credibly bring the idea to life.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Build trust through clear and persuasive presentations
  • Collaborate across departments including strategy, creative, business leadership and production, including risk assessments, case studies and awards.
  • Mentor associate and mid level Context Planners, delegating clearly and providing feedback that strengthens their craft.
  • Actively connect with the UnitedMasters team for an understanding of upcoming milestones and priority artists for casting consideration in Translation brand campaigns.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Comfortable working quickly and independently, owning deliverables with light oversight and adapting as priorities shift.
  • Able to form and defend a clear POV, using cultural insights and research to make actionable recommendations.
  • Strong comms planning instincts, connecting audience behavior, brand opportunity and campaign choreography.
  • Sharp information design and visual taste: build strong decks, shape a clear story and make complex ideas simple and actionable.
  • Cultural fluency across sports, music, entertainment and pop culture, including their intersections with creators, fandom, fashion, gaming and internet behavior.
  • A social-first thinker with a strong creative eye for how ideas work in-feed and an instinct for emerging behaviors and formats.
  • Strong collaborator across disciplines, receptive to feedback and confident presenting to internal teams and clients.
  • Resourceful in research, curious about new platforms and media opportunities, and committed to refining the work.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Possess excellent time management, organization and prioritization skills.
  • Have the proven ability to work under tight deadlines and handle pressure, while consistently paying attention to accuracy and quality of work.
  • Exercise the ability to quickly and effectively adapt to changing needs and expectations.                                                                                        

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum 4-7 years experience in a strategic position in an agency or brand environment
  • 4-year college degree in Marketing, Advertising or Business preferred.
  • Digitally savvy; MUST be proficient in Google Suite and Keynote (Mac preferred).

About UnitedMasters Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

job.title: Temporary Copywriter
job.description:
UnitedMasters

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans - empowering artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first - disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters' music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists and change-makers to grow and earn unlike any other platform.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Facebook, Uber, Dropbox, Complex, VICE, and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation (our in-house creative advertising agency).

We are looking for a versatile, culture-obsessed part-time Copywriter to join our team on a part-time basis. 

The Role

This role will sit at the intersection of music, tech, and media, supporting both the UnitedMasters brand and the 16Bars platform.

The ideal candidate has a sharp ear for voice, a deep understanding of music culture, and the ability to pivot between high-level brand storytelling and punchy social communications. You will collaborate closely with the Integrated Marketing, Social and Creative teams to drive engagement across our digital ecosystem.

What You’ll Do 

  • Digital & Web: Draft compelling website copy for landing pages and product launches, ensuring a seamless user experience.
  • Go-To-Market (GTM): Develop clear, impactful messaging for brand initiatives and new feature rollouts.
  • CRM & Editorial: Write engaging weekly newsletters and email marketing campaigns that drive conversion and community loyalty.
  • Social Media: Craft platform-specific copy (Instagram, TikTok, X) that resonates with independent artists and music fans.
  • Creative Development: Assist in writing creative treatments and "big idea" pitches for brand partnerships.
  • Content Scripts: Script short-form video content (Reels/TikToks) that feels authentic, trendy, and on-brand.

Who You Are 

  • 4-7 years of experience: working on internal and external facing brand copy across digital and social platforms
  • Culture-First Mindset: You’re plugged into music and culture, specifically the independent artist landscape.
  • Versatile Portfolio: Proven experience writing for tech, music, or lifestyle brands across web, email, and social.
  • Adaptability: Ability to switch voices between the professional/empowering tone of UnitedMasters and the editorial/sharp tone of 16Bars.
  • Efficiency: Capable of managing multiple projects under tight deadlines without sacrificing quality.
  • Collaboration: A team player who can take feedback from integrated marketing leads and turn it into polished prose.

Our Values

  • We Get on the Plane — Entrepreneurial spirit means fully committing to the journey not just having the idea.
  • We Expect Challenge + Respect — We constantly challenge each other and the work to reach excellence, always with respect.
  • We Are Defined by Our Resilience — We stay resourceful, fail fast, keep getting better, and never quit on our mission or our team.
  • We Pursue Answers Before the Question Has to Be Asked — We understand our customers so well that we anticipate what they need before they ask.
  • We Run Towards Darkness — We have the courage to work through uncertainty rather than settling for an easier, inferior plan.
  • We Know What We Don't Know — We bring confidence in what we do know, and honesty about what we don't.

Compensation

Salary Hiring Range: $45 - $55/ hr 

Our salary ranges are designed to be competitive for companies of our size and within our industry and represent just one part of our overall rewards package. We also offer company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision plans, a 401(k) with company match, and, depending on the role and individual circumstances, additional compensation opportunities such as bonuses and stock options.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. Director of Business Intelligence

CD Baby | A Virgin Music Group Company

Full-Time | Los Angeles, CA / Nashville, TN / New York, NY | Remote Considered

The Opportunity

As Director of Business Intelligence, you will define and own the strategy and roadmap for making data accessible, trusted, and actionable across CD Baby. You’ll establish the metrics that matter most, drive data normalization across teams, and build the infrastructure that enables self-service insights at scale.

You will partner closely with Product, Marketing, Finance, Data Engineering and stakeholders across the company to prioritize the highest-impact KPIs, ensure consistent definitions across the organization, and embed data into how decisions get made.

This role is both strategic and hands-on: you’ll architect the BI function while also building dashboards, leading analyses, and translating complex data into clear business recommendations.

What You'll Do

Define the BI Strategy & Roadmap

• Establish a company-wide BI vision and multi-quarter roadmap.

• Standardize core metrics and KPIs across business, product and technology teams.

• Prioritize the highest-impact insights that drive growth, retention, and artist success.

• Build scalable and self-service reporting that reduces ad hoc dependency.

• Evaluate and deploy AI-enabled analytics tools that scale insight generation and reduce dependency on manual reporting

Drive Customer & Product Insights

• Lead segmentation, cohort analysis, lifetime value modeling, and churn analysis.

• Identify growth opportunities, at-risk artists, and high-value segments.

• Define and measure success metrics for new product and feature launches.

• Support experimentation and A/B testing with rigorous statistical analysis.

• Analyze streaming consumption, revenue, and audience trends across digital platforms to identify opportunities for artist growth, monetization, and business performance.

Build Data Analytics Models

• Partner with Data Engineering to continuously improve data quality, modeling, and governance.

• Own the business-facing analytics layer, building scalable data models, reporting infrastructure, and self-service tools that enable trusted, actionable insights across the organization.

• Translate complex datasets into clear, executive-ready narratives.

What You Bring

• 7 or more years of experience in data analytics, customer insights, business intelligence, or a related field.

• Advanced SQL; experience with modern BI tools and cloud warehouses, such as Snowflake,

BigQuery, dbt, Cube.

• Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports in enterprise BI tools.

• Strong foundation in customer and commercial analytics, including segmentation, lifetime value,

retention, churn, experimentation, and revenue performance.

• Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and communicate clearly at all levels.

About CD Baby

CD Baby is a music industry pioneer, empowering independent artists to distribute, monetize, and grow

their music careers globally. As a Virgin Music Group company, we combine the entrepreneurial spirit of

an indie platform with the resources and reach of a major music group. Our technology and data teams sit

at the heart of how we serve millions of artists worldwide.

job.title: Identity Operations Engineer
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Job Summary:

As a key member of the UMG Operations Center, the Identity Operations Engineer operates and continuously improves UMG’s hybrid identity, access, authentication, privileged-access, and identity-governance services. The role provides specialist operational support across Workday-driven identity lifecycle processes, Saviynt/IGA, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, MFA, PAM, enterprise application integrations, and connected services.


The position will be a team player working to maintain reliable identity integrations and resolve operational issues involving joiners, movers, leavers, contractors, rejoiners, application access, entitlements, authentication, privileged accounts, and non-human identities. The role includes incident, request, change, problem, access-review, audit-evidence, monitoring, and automation activities. The role partners closely with Engineering, Architecture, Cloud, Observability, ITSM, security, regional IT teams, and external providers. Effective communication skills are a must, all while being sensitive to a wide diversity of cultural and technical backgrounds in a global business environment.


Job Functions:

  • Apply least-privilege, segregation-of-duties, secure administration, and identity-governance best practices to protect UMG information resources from unauthorized use, inappropriate access, disclosure, damage, or loss.
  • Troubleshoot and resolves issues related to identities, systems, access, accounts, authentication, authorization, entitlements, and permissions.
  • Investigate and resolve specialist escalations from AD Services and TechOps IAM queues, including application-role access, SecAdmin access, reference-user comparisons, disabled application accounts, access removals, and entitlement issues.
  • Provide ITIL-based operational support across identity services, including incident, request, change, problem, and major-incident participation. Maintain clear ServiceNow assignment, evidence, troubleshooting notes, resolution details, and closure criteria.
  • Operate and troubleshoot identity lifecycle integrations, including joiner, mover, leaver, contractor, rehire/rejoiner, and exception scenarios. Investigate failed provisioning tasks, reconciliation issues, orphaned accounts, and mismatches between authoritative HR data, IGA records, directories, and target applications.
  • Support Workday-driven lifecycle processes and Saviynt/IGA workflows, including access requests, approvals, entitlement ownership, access reviews, remediation, audit evidence, and provisioning/reconciliation failures.
  • Operate and support on-premises and cloud identity services and their configuration, including Active Directory domain services, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Duo, YubiKey/FIDO/PIV authentication, CyberArk/PAM, Saviynt/IGA, Splunk, Active Roles where applicable, PingOne/Aura where applicable, 1Password, HashiCorp Vault, and connected enterprise applications.
  • Troubleshoot Microsoft Entra enterprise applications and federation integrations, including SAML, OIDC/OAuth, claims, redirect URIs, app registrations, group assignments, Conditional Access, Microsoft Graph, certificates, and token/authentication failures.
  • Support privileged and non-human identities, including elevated accounts, service accounts, application accounts, RPA accounts, resource/test accounts, B2B/guest identities, and accounts requiring vault onboarding, password rotation, or ownership validation.
  • Support MFA and authentication operations, including Duo, YubiKey, FIDO/PIV, recovery/reset workflows, OAuth-token issues, and authentication failures across workforce and application services.
  • Complete the key metric reporting and analysis for the Identity Management environment as required.
  • Work to ensure audit tasks related to Identity Management are completed on time, with participation of appropriate parties. Maintain auditable evidence for access approvals, reviews, privileged access, lifecycle actions, exceptions, and remediation.
  • Participate in security incident response teams as needed, including identity compromise, suspicious authentication, privileged-access, credential, and account-containment activities.
  • Utilize industry best practices for appropriate standards, processes, procedures, tools, and documentation.
  • Ensure the maintenance, patching, operating, and monitoring of IAM systems is in place and completed on schedule. Use Splunk and observability service dashboards to identify failures, trends, and emerging operational risk.
  • Maintain accurate ServiceNow CMDB relationships for identity services, configuration items, application integrations, owners, support groups, and dependencies; identify and report stale or incomplete CMDB data.
  • Participate in developing automation to reduce the time spent on routine tasks.
  • This is a shift-based role supporting UMG’s 24/7 follow-the-sun Technical Operations Center. The role participates in scheduled shifts, weekend/public-holiday coverage, on-call rotation, and structured handoffs with regional operations teams

Essential:

  • Solid technical skills in the Identity Management space, including Active Directory and Entra ID.
  • Minimum of five years directly related experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM)
  • A strong ability for troubleshooting and problem analysis is required, along with the ability to clearly communicate the results of problem analysis to business stakeholders, IT support teams, and network providers to quickly and effectively resolve operational issues.
  • Experience troubleshooting and solving issues related to identities, systems, access, accounts, authentication, authorization, entitlements, and permissions
  • Hands-on experience operating and supporting Active Directory and Entra ID, including directory services, delegated administration, group policy, OUs, sites/replication, identity synchronization, enterprise applications, federation, Conditional Access, and authentication.
  • Hands-on experience with Saviynt or another IGA platform, including access requests, approvals, entitlement administration, access reviews, failed-task remediation, reconciliation, and audit evidence.
  • Experience with identity lifecycle integrations from an authoritative HR source such as Workday, including joiner/mover/leaver, contractor, rehire, and exception handling.
  • Customer service driven/focused with a proactive and positive can-do approach. Demonstrates commitment to organization’s policy framework and practices continuous improvement.
  • Hands-on experience and skills with systems such as M365 and ServiceNow are required. Experience using ServiceNow for IAM incidents, requests, changes, knowledge, evidence, assignment groups, and CMDB relationships is required.
  • Demonstrated current work experience supporting integrated IAM solutions such as Entra ID, Active Roles where applicable, Duo, PKI, and CyberArk/PAM
  • Working knowledge of site-reliability/operational-engineering principles, monitoring, automation, and safe use of AI-assisted tools.
  • Demonstrated organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Solid written, oral, and interpersonal communications skills

Desirable:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, a closely related field, or comparable education and experience.
  • Experience with at least two of the following is desirable: PingOne/Aura, 1Password, HashiCorp Vault, Microsoft Graph, SAML/OIDC/OAuth, enterprise application onboarding, or secrets/service-account rotation.
  • Experience integrating or troubleshooting ServiceNow orchestration with identity platforms, directories, SaaS applications, or enterprise applications is desirable.
  • Understanding of Microsoft 365 identity, group, collaboration, and federation dependencies.
  • Experience using PowerShell, Python, JSON/REST, Microsoft Graph, SQL, or comparable scripting/API technologies for IAM automation and troubleshooting. Legacy Java, SOAP, or database experience
  • IT Certifications including MCSE Certification specialization in Identity Management, Certified Access Management Specialist (CAMS), and ITIL Foundations certifications desired
  • International experience beneficial; multiple language skills a plus

job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. How we LEAD:

Universal Music Group is building an Applied AI and Machine Learning function to help our teams discover and develop artists, connect with fans, make stronger commercial decisions, and protect the integrity of the music ecosystem.


We are looking for a Lead Machine Learning Engineer to build, ship, and operate reliable machine learning and AI systems that create durable value across UMG. This is a senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who combines strong software and systems expertise with practical knowledge of the AI and ML lifecycle.


You will turn models, data products, and AI workflows into maintainable production capabilities across revenue forecasting, artist, catalog intelligence and talent scouting, release marketing, and rights and ecosystem integrity. The role focuses on reproducible development, rigorous evaluation, safe deployment, observability, cost efficiency, and continuous improvement.


How you’ll CREATE:

Core MLOps & Production Infrastructure

  • Lead initiatives from problem framing and data assessment through deployment, evaluation, monitoring, and sustained adoption (versus reach a well-evidenced decision not to build).
  • Build and operate reliable ML and LLM-powered workflows, including retrieval and grounding, structured outputs, tool and API integrations, orchestration, batch or real-time inference, CI/CD, and safe rollback.
  • Establish AI evaluation and observability using representative and adversarial test sets, regression tests, human review where appropriate, traces, drift detection, latency, quality, safety, usage, and cost metrics.

Data & Feature Engineering

  • Build reliable data and feature pipelines from streaming consumption data, release metadata, social campaign data, catalog information, and commercial finance systems; monitor completeness, freshness, anomalies, and data lineage.
  • Develop and operate models across personalization, recommender systems, search and ranking, time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, and decision support—choosing a simpler reliable approach whenever is appropriate.

Business Stakeholders

  • Move generative and multimodal AI capabilities from prototypes into dependable, cost-effective workflows that help people make decisions and take action.
  • Partner with ML scientists, data engineers, product managers, designers, domain experts, A&R, Marketing, Finance, and labels; contribute to architecture, code reviews, mentoring, and pragmatic build-versus-buy decisions.

What success looks like in your first 12 months

  • Ship production ML or AI capabilities that improve a meaningful UMG decision or workflow.
  • Establish automated evaluation and regression coverage for AI workflows, with trusted measures for quality, safety, latency, cost, and business usefulness.
  • Improve the reliability, observability, performance, scalability, or cost-efficiency of existing workflows.
  • Move a prototype or manual process into a dependable workflow used for a real decision, such as allocating marketing spend, prioritizing an A&R opportunity, reviewing a forecast, or investigating an integrity alert.
  • Raise the technical bar through documentation, reviews, and mentorship.
  • Effective collaboration and communication with business stakeholders, labels, central teams, and other non-technical partners.

Bring your VIBE:

  • A bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Typically 5+ years of experience in software, machine learning, data, or platform engineering with ownership of production systems and ambiguous, high-impact problems.
  • Experience engineering modern AI systems, including LLM-based workflows, retrieval, grounding, structured generation, tool use, safety controls, and human review, with clear evaluation and monitoring practices.
  • Strong Python and software engineering skills, including testing, code review, version control, debugging, maintainable design, and experience with a second production language or equivalent systems experience.
  • Experience with cloud-based data and ML platforms. UMG workloads use GCP and BigQuery; experience with services such as Vertex AI, Dataflow, or Cloud Composer is valuable, while equivalent AWS or cloud-agnostic experience is also relevant.
  • Experience building and operating data pipelines, distributed systems, APIs, services, workflow orchestration, model serving, batch or online inference, and refresh or retraining processes.
  • Ability to collaborate across technical and business disciplines, communicate tradeoffs clearly, take ownership without formal authority, and choose a simpler reliable solution when it is better than a more complex model.

Especially valuable

  • Experience in music, media, entertainment, streaming marketplaces, advertising, or another industry where culture, consumer behavior, and business conditions change rapidly.
  • Experience working with complex non-tabular data, such as audio, text, images, or video.
  • Experience building decision-support products and automated workflows rather than standalone models or static dashboards.

job.title: Senior Data Product Manager - Streaming and Social
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

We seek an experienced and driven Sr. Data Product Manager – Streaming & Social within the Global Data & Analytics Products team.

As AI transforms how artists are discovered, audiences are understood, and content performance is optimized; trusted consumption data becomes a strategic enterprise asset. In this role, you will ensure UMG's streaming and social data products are AI-ready by design—governed, semantically consistent, observable, and trusted—enabling analytics, predictive models, intelligent agents, and generative AI applications to reliably consume music consumption data at enterprise scale. You'll also embrace AI as part of your own product management practice, using modern AI tools to accelerate discovery, documentation, prototyping, and collaboration while maintaining a relentless focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.

You are passionate about treating data as a product and building trusted, scalable data foundations that enable data-driven decision-making across UMG. You understand that great data products require more than pipelines—they require clear ownership, reliability, governance, usability, and stakeholder trust.

In this role, you will lead the strategy and execution of enterprise data products and domain-specific data marts that serve as the authoritative source of truth for music consumption and streaming/social engagement across UMG. These products will power reporting, analytics, predictive modeling, AI applications, intelligent audience insights, artist development, repertoire strategy, marketing effectiveness, forecasting, and executive decision-making. By establishing trusted, governed, and semantically rich data products, you will help create the enterprise data foundation that enables AI-driven insights and intelligent decision-support across UMG.

You will partner closely with Global Insights, Commercial Strategy, Digital Business, Marketing, Label Analytics, Data Engineering, and Governance teams to define, build, and continuously improve trusted data products that are reliable, discoverable, and broadly adopted across the organization.

You will champion product management principles within the data ecosystem, ensuring consumption & social data products have clear roadmaps, service levels, semantic definitions, documentation, quality standards, and measurable business outcomes.

This role reports to the Sr. Director of Product Management (Data Platform).

How you’ll CREATE:

  • Champion AI-ready data products by ensuring trusted business definitions, semantic consistency, metadata, lineage, observability, documentation, and governance are embedded into every streaming and social data product.
  • Ensure data products are designed to support emerging AI capabilities—including semantic retrieval, recommendation systems, intelligent agents, and LLM-powered experiences—through high-quality, well-governed enterprise data
  • Partner with Commercial Strategy, Global Insights, Label Analytics, Marketing, Finance, and Digital Business teams to define trusted business metrics, KPIs, and standardized consumption definitions.
  • Manage the lifecycle of external consumption data sources, ensuring licensed datasets are consistently ingested, governed, documented, monitored, and integrated into trusted enterprise data products.
  • Define scalable dimensional models and semantic layers supporting streaming activity, audience engagement, artists, releases, tracks, playlists, social engagement, territories, and commercial performance.
  • Establish authoritative data products that serve as the source of truth for music consumption performance across labels, artists, releases, and markets.
  • Standardize business definitions for metrics, including streams, listeners, followers, saves, playlist reach, engagement, audience growth, chart performance, market share, and consumption trends.
  • Partner with engineering teams to implement SLAs, monitoring, observability, incident management, and operational support processes.
  • Establish and maintain data contracts with internal and external consumption data providers to improve reliability and predictability.
  • Drive adoption of consumption data products through business-friendly documentation, semantic models, stakeholder enablement, and training.
  • Evaluate opportunities to improve business outcomes by applying AI to music consumption, audience behavior, and content performance while maintaining strong governance and data quality standards.

Bring your VIBE:

  • 5+ years of product management experience supporting digital music, streaming, audience analytics, media, entertainment, or digital content organizations.
  • Experience delivering data products that support AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, or generative AI initiatives
  • Strong understanding of the digital music ecosystem, including streaming platforms, social media platforms, audience measurement, and music consumption trends.
  • Experience working with music consumption datasets, including streaming activity, artist performance, release performance, audience engagement, playlists, social signals, and chart data.
  • Familiarity with industry data providers and platforms such as Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Amazon Music, TikTok, Meta, Luminate, Chartmetric, SoundCloud, Pandora, or similar consumption and audience analytics platforms.
  • Understanding of artist lifecycle analytics, audience development, catalog performance, playlisting, fan engagement, and commercial music performance measurement.
  • Demonstrated experience owning data products throughout their lifecycle, from strategy and requirements through adoption and operational support.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage modern AI tools to accelerate product discovery, documentation, analysis, and collaboration.
  • Strong understanding of the data foundations required for enterprise AI, including dimensional modeling, data warehousing concepts, data marts, semantic layers, and modern analytics architectures.
  • Experience in defining and managing data quality frameworks, governance standards, and operational reliability practices.
  • Experience in establishing and managing data contracts and cross-functional data ownership models.
  • Strong SQL proficiency preferred, with the ability to independently validate requirements and investigate data issues.
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes and stakeholder value.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and influence skills.
  • Strong systems thinker with a customer-centric product mindset.
