job.title: Senior Manager, Audio Visual (Workspace Technology)
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Job Summary

Universal Music Group (UMG) is the world’s leading music company. We are committed to artistry, innovation, and entrepreneurship, with businesses spanning recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content across more than 60 countries.


The A/V Senior Manager leads the strategy, architecture, engineering, and operational excellence of UMG’s global audiovisual and workplace technology capabilities. This role enables reliable, secure, and intuitive experiences across conferencing, telephony, meeting rooms, workspace reservation, digital signage, performance spaces, and related collaboration technologies.


Based in Nashville, this is a global leadership role overseeing and enabling a distributed A/V and Workspace Engineering team across Australia, the United States, and the United Kingdom. The leader partners closely with Infrastructure, Facilities, Security, Operations, and business stakeholders to deliver consistent standards while supporting the distinct needs of UMG’s offices, artists, and business functions.


Key Responsibilities

·    Strategy and roadmap: Define and execute UMG’s global A/V and workplace technology strategy, translating business needs into a prioritized, outcome-oriented roadmap and investment plan.

·    People leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing, globally distributed team. Set clear expectations, support career growth, manage performance, and attract and retain exceptional technical talent.

·    Architecture and standards: Establish reference architectures, engineering standards, design patterns, and governance for conferencing, telephony, room systems, workspace technology, and associated integrations.

·    Portfolio and lifecycle management: Evaluate, select, implement, standardize, and retire platforms and devices across their lifecycle, balancing user experience, interoperability, resilience, security, supportability, and total cost of ownership.

·    Service reliability and operations: Strengthen incident, problem, change, and request-management practices; improve service availability; and drive disciplined root-cause analysis and continual service improvement.

·    Automation and observability: Create a practical framework for inventory, telemetry, monitoring, automation, capacity planning, and health reporting so that teams can identify issues proactively and make decisions using reliable data.

·    Stakeholder partnership: Build trusted relationships with senior leaders, Facilities, Real Estate, Security, Network, End User Computing, Production, and business teams. Explain trade-offs clearly and influence outcomes across organizational boundaries.

·    Budget and vendor management: Own or contribute to budget planning, sourcing, contract management, vendor performance, and financial optimization for the A/V and workplace technology portfolio.

·    Risk, security, and compliance: Partner with Security and Risk teams to incorporate appropriate access controls, privacy, resilience, data protection, and lifecycle controls into A/V and workplace solutions.

·    Innovation and continuous improvement: Monitor industry trends and emerging technologies, test promising capabilities, and recommend adoption when they create measurable value for UMG.

·    Executive communication: Provide concise reporting on service health, priorities, risks, investments, roadmap progress, and business outcomes to senior leadership and key stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

·    Leadership experience: Progressive experience leading A/V, workplace technology, unified communications, or related infrastructure engineering teams, including responsibility for direction, delivery, and talent development.

·    Technical depth: Strong knowledge of enterprise A/V and workplace technologies, including conferencing and collaboration platforms, telephony, room and workspace reservation systems, digital signage, signal flow, and related integrations. Experience with Dante or comparable audio-over-IP technologies is expected.

·    Engineering and architecture: Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, integrating, automating, and supporting reliable A/V solutions in complex enterprise environments.

·    Operational discipline: Strong background in IT service management, incident and problem management, change enablement, service measurement, and continual improvement.

·    Program and commercial management: Experience managing cross-functional programs, business analysis, vendor relationships, budgets, and competing priorities.

·    Communication and influence: Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues in plain language and convert business needs into practical technology outcomes.

·    Hands-on problem solving: Comfortable deep-diving into existing and emerging technologies, diagnosing issues, evaluating options, and guiding teams toward pragmatic solutions.

·    Education and experience: Bachelor’s degree in technology, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, plus at least eight years of relevant A/V, workplace technology, unified communications, or infrastructure experience.

·    Global collaboration: Experience working across regions, time zones, cultures, and organizational boundaries. Occasional travel may be required but is not expected to be part of the regular work schedule.


Preferred Qualifications

·    Experience operating A/V or workplace technology services at global scale, including distributed offices and high-visibility executive, artist, or performance environments.

·    Experience with AV-over-IP, DSP, room control, room analytics, digital signage, device management, and enterprise collaboration ecosystems.

·    Relevant certifications such as CTS/CTS-D, Dante, ITIL, PMP, or equivalent practical experience.

·    Experience building service catalogs, operating models, technology standards, or reference designs that improve consistency and reduce operational complexity.

·    Experience in the music, media, entertainment, creative, or live-events industries.


How Success Is Measured

·    Improved reliability, availability, and user experience across critical A/V and workplace services.

·    Reduced repeat incidents and faster, more consistent resolution through effective service management and root-cause practices.

·    Clear standards, lifecycle plans, inventory visibility, and adoption of supported solutions across locations.

·    Responsible use of budget and vendor capacity, with transparent reporting on value, risk, and total cost of ownership.

·    A strong, engaged, and developing global team that delivers predictably and is recognized as a trusted partner by the business.


Additional Information

job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Please Note: This position is hybrid (2 days in-office - Woodland Hills)

How We LEAD:

The Senior Payroll Operations & Tax Analyst helps deliver accurate, timely payroll and compliant payroll tax administration across a large, multi-state U.S. workforce. This role combines hands-on payroll processing support with ownership of payroll tax and garnishment activities, and contributes to strong controls, responsive employee service, and practical process improvements.

The analyst works with Payroll, People, Finance, Legal, Corporate Tax, and external service providers to resolve issues, maintain compliance, and support reliable payroll operations. The role also evaluates technology and automation opportunities that can improve accuracy, reporting, and efficiency while protecting employee data.


How You’ll CREATE:

  • Coordinate payroll operations across weekly, bi-weekly, and semi-monthly cycles, providing coverage during peak periods and planned or unexpected team absences.
  • Prepare, validate, and enter payroll data, including hours, earnings, deductions, taxes, leave, direct deposits, and payroll adjustments.
  • Review employee changes and payroll records, including hires, terminations, transfers, retroactive transactions, tax elections, and direct deposit updates.
  • Own payroll tax administration, including tax account registration and maintenance, jurisdiction setup, withholding, quarterly and annual filings, reconciliations, amendments, W-2 and W-2C processing, and year-end activities.
  • Administer ADP SmartCompliance and resolve filing issues, agency notices, tax account questions, and other payroll tax exceptions.
  • Review payroll registers and reconcile payroll and tax reports; investigate out-of-balance items and correct discrepancies before or after payroll completion as appropriate.
  • Process manual checks, off-cycle payrolls, payroll corrections, and other adjustments, confirming related tax and deduction impacts.
  • Administer employee garnishments from receipt through resolution, including legal-order review, withholding priorities, deduction setup, remittance, recordkeeping, and employee or agency responses.
  • Research and resolve payroll, tax, garnishment, and timekeeping questions from employees and business partners through the established case-management process.
  • Partner with People, Finance, Legal, Corporate Tax, vendors, and other stakeholders on employment tax matters and payroll questions that require coordinated resolution.
  • Monitor federal, state, and local employment tax requirements and assess changes that affect payroll practices, systems, or procedures.
  • Support payroll tax treatment for supplemental wages, relocation, severance, bonuses, equity and executive compensation, and other employee pay programs.
  • Prepare documentation and analyses for payroll tax audits, tax authority examinations, internal reviews, and SOX controls; respond to audit requests and track follow-up actions.
  • Analyze payroll and tax data to identify trends, strengthen controls, reduce compliance risk, and recommend improvements to reporting and reconciliation practices.
  • Maintain payroll procedures, process documentation, and control records; support system updates, implementations, acquisitions, and other payroll projects.
  • Evaluate and use automation, analytics, and AI-enabled tools where appropriate to streamline research, reconciliations, reporting, and compliance monitoring, following governance and data privacy requirements.
  • Share payroll tax and processing knowledge with colleagues and handle employee information with professionalism, discretion, and care.

Bring Your VIBE:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • At least five years of progressive payroll experience in a large, multi-state U.S. payroll environment.At least four years of payroll tax experience, with working knowledge of U.S. federal, state, and local employment tax requirements.
  • Experience managing payroll tax operations, including quarter-end and year-end activities, reconciliations, agency notices, account maintenance, and compliance.
  • Hands-on experience administering employee garnishments, including order implementation, remittance, and employee or agency communication.
  • Experience with ADP SmartCompliance or a comparable payroll tax administration platform.
  • Experience processing payroll in Workday Payroll and Time Tracking or a comparable enterprise payroll system.
  • Knowledge of payroll tax reporting, payroll accounting, payroll audits, wage and hour requirements, and payroll compliance.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including analysis, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Ability to use technology, automation, data analytics, or AI-enabled tools to improve payroll processes and operational results.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to explain payroll and tax topics to different audiences.
  • Ability to build productive working relationships across Payroll, People, Finance, Legal, Corporate Tax, and external service providers.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP), Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC), or another relevant professional credential.
  • Experience supporting executive compensation, supplemental wage taxation, equity compensation, and employee benefits taxation.
  • Experience with payroll tax audits, tax authority examinations, or SOX controls.
  • Experience with payroll system implementations, payroll tax technology, automation, or process improvement initiatives.
  • Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, or organizational changes that affect payroll.
  • Knowledge of general ledger reconciliations and payroll-related financial reporting.

job.description:
Your next opportunity is here! We’re looking for a detail-oriented and reliable Accounts Payable Clerk to join the Vista Radio Finance team in Kelowna, BC. The right candidate enjoys working with numbers, staying organized, and making sure the details are right the first time.

We are looking for a lifer, someone who gets us and wants to grow with us long-term 😉 We’re collaborative, supportive, and passionate about what we do, and we’re looking for a teammate who enjoys keeping financial processes running smoothly behind the scenes.

If you are looking for a role where accuracy, organization, and teamwork make a real difference in day-to-day operations, we’re ready to talk to you!

About the Job:

Vista Radio has an immediate opening for a full-time Accounts Payable Clerk, based in Kelowna, BC.

Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills

Excellent communication and customer service skills when interacting with vendors and internal departments

Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications

Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

Ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with the Finance team

job.title: Audio/Video Producer, Today, Explained and Explain It to Me
job.description:
Vox is a user’s guide to the news produced by those who know it best. Today, Explained and Explain It to Me are the podcast expressions of that mission. 

As a multiplatform community of journalists and storytellers, business professionals, creators and technologists, at Vox Media we believe it is a moral and business imperative to amplify voices. This applies to our candidates, our teams, our storytelling, our creative work, and our platforms, products, and partnerships.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

We’re looking for an experienced and versatile audio and video producer with a track record of producing creative and ambitious podcasts across platforms. This role will involve producing episodes for both our daily and weekly shows, helping organize vertical video production, and ideating on future video elements for the shows. Producers on this team come up with smart pitches; book and interview guests; construct the segments; and edit and score episodes. The right person for this position is delighted by the idea of innovating on foundational news formats in both audio and video, and has a demonstrated knack for taking unexpected approaches to curiosity-driven stories. 

  • Research timely and distinctive story segments; pitch ideas for both Today, Explained and Explain It to Me
  • Cover news and feature topics clearly and respectfully, never underestimating the audience’s intelligence or overestimating how much they know
  • Assemble research prep and write sharp, focused host questions for interviews 
  • Locate and book diverse sources and podcast guests 
  • Edit episodes using ProTools 
  • Score and edit audio segments
  • Produce vertical videos using Descript or Premiere 
  • Ideate on social video and podcast video formats
  • Write site posts for Vox.com 

 WHO YOU ARE

The successful candidate for this role is an editorial-minded producer with a focus on serving the audience. The right person is ambitious and innovative across platforms; they are a voracious learner excited by domestic and global news as well as by internet and culture. 

What you’ll bring:

  • Significant experience creating audio stories as part of a fast-moving, collaborative team under deadline pressure

Proficiency in audio editing/mixing in ProTools

  • Proficiency in video editing and experience producing social video content
  • A portfolio that demonstrates an ear for great tape and inventive approaches to storytelling
  • Experience working on complex teams in newsrooms 
  • A highly organized and dogged approach to landing bookings on a quick turnaround
  • Experience scripting and editing compelling, curiosity-driven stories or segments
  • A track record of developing stories that draw on diverse perspectives/source lists
  • Creativity and a desire to be innovative

WHERE YOU’LL WORK

This position is based in Washington, DC, and the candidate will work from the Vox office at least 2 days a week.

Please note: Your application should include your resume and a short cover letter describing your interest in the position. Also Include links to examples of your work and descriptions of what your role was on relevant previous projects. 

This role is a part of the Vox Media Union, represented by the Writers Guild of America, East

job.title: Director, Podcast Partnerships - Beltway Specialist
job.description:
Director, Podcast Partnerships - Beltway Specialist

Who We Are

The Vox Media Podcast Network is one of the largest U.S. podcast publishers, home to some of the most popular and influential shows. Reaching a monthly audience of tens of millions across audio, video, and social platforms, our podcasts spark conversations and shape culture, covering everything from politics, technology, and business to food, lifestyle, sports, entertainment, and more. The Vox Media Podcast Network is powered by thought leaders in modern media, and home to a prestigious portfolio of voices from New York Magazine, Vox.com, The Verge, and The Bulwark. Learn more at podcasts.voxmedia.com.

 

As a Director of Podcast Partnerships, you will be a revenue contributor responsible for expanding high-value DC Beltway Agency and client direct relationships and driving new business growth across the Vox Media Podcast Network. You will serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior brand marketers and agencies, delivering innovative podcast and talent solutions that connect brands with highly engaged, intellectually curious communities at scale.

Leveraging Vox Media's premium podcast network — including leading shows and high profile talent specializing in politics, policy, news, and culture  — high-value audiences, and unique scale, you will build partnerships that drive measurable business outcomes. This role demands a consultative mindset, strong relationship-building skills, the ability to influence at senior levels of marketing organizations, a passion for podcasts and talent, and a relentless drive to grow revenue in a fast-paced, ambitious environment.

What You'll Do

  • Lead Strategic Growth: Develop and execute a long-term revenue strategy to expand business with existing and new beltway and news driven clients across the Vox Media Podcast Network, with a focus on new business expansion, while also executing 360 campaign integrations, bringing performance agencies into the new world of audio, social, and video talent based programming. 
  • Cultivate Executive-Level Relationships: Build and deepen relationships with senior decision-makers at the top DC and political adjacent agencies and pertinent client side partners — CMOs, VPs of Marketing, Heads of Demand Generation and Brand — positioning Vox Media as a go-to strategic partner for podcast and talent investment.
  • Proactive Market Engagement: Identify industry trends, evolving buyer behaviors, and client challenges within the performance marketing sector, proactively delivering cross-platform podcast and talent solutions before RFPs are issued.
  • Consultative Sales Leadership: Translate client objectives into high-impact campaigns using Vox Media podcasts, host talent, video, social and live event capabilities.
  • Emphasis on Beltway Relationships: Serve as an internal and external thought leader on the DC Beltway landscape, providing market intelligence and insights to shape sales strategies and inspire innovative client solutions.
  • Revenue Accountability: Own forecasting, pipeline development, and quarterly and annual sales targets, with full accountability for results and strategic account planning.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with editorial, marketing, creative, production and operations teams to deliver custom, culturally resonant proposals that reflect how performance p brands communicate with their audiences.
  • Brand Advocacy: Represent the Vox Media Podcast Network at key industry events and client forums to expand our presence and thought leadership within the DC Beltway ecosystems.

Who You Are

  • Proven Beltway Media Seller: 10+ years of digital media and/or podcast & talent sales experience with a demonstrated track record of success in the DC Beltway sales space. This is a NYC based role with potential for extensive DC responsibilities.
  • Strategic Dealmaker: Skilled in complex, consultative sales to senior marketing executives and agency leadership, with experience securing large-scale, integrated partnerships.
  • Podcast & Talent Native: Deep familiarity with the podcast and talent advertising landscape — editorial and talent integrations, multi-platform partnerships, scaled podcast buys — and a genuine passion for the medium.
  • Visionary & Entrepreneurial: A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with the ability to anticipate market shifts and client needs before they surface.
  • Influential Communicator: Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to inspire and persuade at the highest levels of a client organization. Ability to think critically, connect advertiser needs to the right show and talent and communicate the value proposition with clarity and confidence.
  • Data-Informed Strategist: Comfortable leveraging performance data, audience insights, and category trends to craft compelling, measurable solutions that justify and grow podcast and talent investment.
  • In this role, you are not just selling media — you are shaping how Beltway brands and initiatives connect with audiences through premium audio and video content, trusted voices, and unique scale. As a Director of Podcast Partnerships, your ability to see around corners, anticipate client needs, and deliver category-defining ideas will directly influence Vox Media's position as a leading force in the podcast and talent space!

Where You’ll Work

This job is located in New York City and requires in-office presence Tuesday through Thursday, with additional in-person expectations for client and agency meetings in and outside of NYC.

job.title: Head of Podcast Growth & Operations
job.description:
Vox Media is seeking three entrepreneurial, action-oriented Heads of Podcast Growth & Operations to own the growth, business performance, and operations for three distinct groups of shows and talent in our fast-growing portfolio: business, tech, and leadership; news, politics, and current affairs; lifestyle, culture, and sports. 

The Head of Growth & Operations will be accountable for day-to-day operations, P&L performance, and audience and revenue growth for each show in their portfolio. They will convene a dedicated cross-functional team spanning sales, sales marketing, production, audience marketing, YouTube and social strategy, and business operations. They will also bring sharp insight on the podcast industry, the creator economy, and the competitive landscape to shape how we grow the category and its key franchises. 

This is a hands-on role: the Head of Growth & Operations is close to the week-to-week details of every show, including release calendars, ad load and inventory, guest booking, episode performance, and production workflows, and steps in directly when something slips.

  • Set growth strategy and execution roadmaps for the shows in the category, working with the category team to monitor and drive audience and revenue growth

  • A track record of growing audience and revenue across platforms (audio, YouTube, social, and live)
  • Experience managing high-profile talent relationships and complex partnerships, with the empathy and directness to deliver hard news well

Leadership qualities

  • A high-metabolism, action-oriented leader, who will drive progress week-to-week

  • A confident, poised, clear communicator with senior audiences
  • A collaborative teammate who leads through influence

job.title: Head of Shows, New York Magazine
job.description:
THE ROLE

New York Magazine is seeking a Head of Shows to lead our multiplatform show strategy across audio and video programming. This person will identify the most promising opportunities across our editorial brands, develop original franchises, and build a sustainable slate of shows that extend the reach and impact of New York Magazine across audio, video, social, and live platforms.

The ideal candidate is both a creative leader and a skilled production operator: someone who has successfully developed and launched multiple shows out of newsrooms, understands the audio and video landscape, and can recognize distinctive editorial voices and talent that translate into compelling programming.

In this role, you will work across New York Magazine’s portfolio, including The Cut, Vulture, and its four additional verticals, to identify talent, concepts, and audience opportunities that can become signature New York franchises.

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life.

This role is located in our New York City office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Develop and execute a long-term video and audio strategy for New York Magazine, identifying the largest audience, editorial, and business opportunities across the magazine’s brands, coverage areas, and talent roster.
  • Conceive, develop, and launch new show concepts from idea through pilot, testing, and release, including the creation of multiple pilots and proof-of-concept projects in the first year.
  • Oversee all aspects of show development, including editorial direction, host development, visual approach, production workflows, and programming.
  • Build a long-term roadmap and development pipeline for a portfolio of multiplatform shows that support audience growth, engagement, and revenue objectives.
  • Partner with audience, video, and social teams to develop programming and distribution strategies for YouTube, podcast platforms, and social channels, including episode packaging, clips, and original social content.
  • Use audience insights and performance data to refine formats, grow existing shows, and inform development and investment decisions.
  • Identify and evaluate the potential to acquire or partner with existing external shows, creators, and talent when there is an opportunity to strengthen coverage areas aligned with the magazine’s audio and video strategy.
  • Build and manage a team, recruiting producers, external creative partners, and talent as needed, and oversee production budgets and schedules.
  • Work with the editorial team to integrate show appearances and video opportunities into major editorial bookings.
  • Partner with editors and production teams to develop author-read audio versions of major stories at a regular cadence.
  • Lead broader cross-functional stakeholder management and execution, e.g., collaborating with the audience team to develop multiplatform growth strategies and partnering with ad sales and subscription teams to build out franchise business opportunities

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 10+ years of experience developing, launching, and growing original video programs, podcasts, or multiplatform franchises.
  • Demonstrated track record of taking shows from concept to launch and audience growth, with experience across both video and audio.
  • Strong editorial instincts and experience translating culture, politics, business, lifestyle, or entertainment coverage into compelling audio and video formats.
  • Experience identifying, developing, and coaching on-air and on-camera talent.
  • Experience cultivating, managing, and collaborating with top-tier talent, creators, and celebrities.
  • Strong understanding of original video programming, video podcasting, creator-led media, and cross-platform content strategies.
  • Deep knowledge of audience behavior and distribution across YouTube, podcast platforms, and social channels.
  • Understanding of how shows can extend into newsletters, community, and live experiences.
  • Experience building teams, managing production budgets, and establishing development and production workflows.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills, including experience working closely with audience and revenue teams.
  • Ability to operate strategically while also executing hands-on development work.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and comfort building programs from the ground up

job.title: Background Painter
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Background Painter Job ID 10164900 Location Vancouver, Canada Business Walt Disney Animation Studios Date posted Nov. 13, 2026 Background Painter Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements Background Painters visually explore and collaborate in the creation of animated worlds through fully rendered paintings that utilize color and mood to serve a film’s storytelling. Learn more about our filmmaking process here . We’re looking for Background Painters who have a sense of whimsy, appeal, and masterful painting skills. Expertise in color and lighting are key skills in breathing life into our worlds. The ability to work both traditionally and in digital media is appreciated. We are looking for passionate Background Painters to join our Set Extension team at our Vancouver, BC Studio starting in December 2026. To apply for this position, you must upload a portfolio and a resume consisting of your background painting work.

What You’ll Do

Paint inspiring worlds and environments, responding constructively to the director’s vision and production needs Execute detailed, full-rendered paintings in thoughtful collaboration with other departments in the pipeline Paint over set models that are lit and rendered with a simple value structure and color palette, finishing the set painting with full render and appeal Interpret small, vaguely indicated key paintings and expand them into fully realized, rendered scenes, filling in the appropriate amount of detail and adapting to composition or location changes while remaining true to the original lighting and color scheme Execute paintings in the style of examples provided to you and making necessary decisions that fit your specific layout, such as which edges to indicate softly and which to paint crisply, the amount of details to render at different distances, and how much of the vignette is needed to direct the eye accordingly to the storytelling needs of the shot Execute paintings that seamlessly “hook up” to the backgrounds of other painters in an established style to ensure smooth and invisible sequence cuts What We’re Looking For: Ability to utilize dynamic relationships of color and value structures to evoke a wide range of immersive moods that enhance the storytelling of your images Ability to digitally paint in the style of Californian/Russian plein air impressionism that evokes the look and feel of oil painting textures in a variety of strokes from sharp to soft as well as smudging, blending, and glazing Ability to use color to convincingly represent light and depth Proficiency in Photoshop Graphic design and traditional painting skills encouraged Bachelors degree or equivalent

experience

Portfolios Should Include: Paintings and environment designs that demonstrate strong painting skills and a strong understanding of storytelling, observation, mood, clarity, color, lighting, and appeal Illustrations of narrative moments, character and environment interactions encouraged Variety of environmental work including organic, architectural, interiors, and high concept Observational studies If any of your work is password protected, please include the password with your application (even if just included on your resume) Social media accounts may be submitted as a supplement to your portfolio but should not be your primary portfolio (websites or multipage PDF files submitted via a Google drive preferred) At Walt Disney Animation Studios, we believe strong design builds unforgettable stories. job.title: Workroom Manager- 3rd Shift
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Workroom Manager- 3rd Shift Job ID 10163316 Location Lake Buena Vista, Florida, United States Business Walt Disney World Resort Date posted Nov. 06, 2026 Workroom Manager- 3rd Shift Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements

About the Role

& Team "We make magic.” That’s our motto at Walt Disney Parks and Resorts, and it permeates everything we do. At Disney, you’ll help inspire that magic by enabling us to push the limits of entertainment and create the never-before-seen!" Bring your leadership and passion for craftsmanship to a talented team of skilled artisans and Costuming specialists! As Workroom Manager, you’ll lead the day-to-day operation of both people and processes, fostering teamwork, supporting Cast development, and championing safety and exceptional show quality. From costume builds and alterations to collaboration with creative and technical partners, you’ll help keep projects moving on time and on budget. This third-shift opportunity brings together hands-on artistry and people leadership to help deliver the distinctive details that bring Disney experiences to life. This position reports to the Proprietor of Costuming Operations for EPCOT. This is a full-time, third shift role. What You Will Do Oversee a cast of Costuming Specialist Seniors and Sewing Specialists on a third shift (early morning) schedule. Ensure safe working conditions and proper documentation and execution of safety-critical work, including the maintenance of audio animatronic costumes within attractions. Facilitate builds and alterations for audio animatronics, entertainment, and character costumes. Handle confidential information pertaining to employees and intellectual property. Partner with multiple collaborators to maintain product quality and designs. Partner with Costumers, Cosmetology, Engineering Services, and WDI. Forecast and order needed supplies, tools, and notions. Responsible for ensuring that Cast issues are addressed in a timely manner. Ensure that manufacturing is on time, on budget, and of the utmost quality.

Required Qualifications

& Skills 3+ years

experience

in garment construction, alterations, and/or patterning techniques 3+ years

experience

directing garment/costume fittings 1+ years

experience

in leadership

Experience

in the theater, film, apparel, or garment manufacturing industry

Experience

with performers in various stages of dress/undress

Experience

with sewing terms, fabric types, and garment notions

Experience

leading workflow and project budgets

Experience

communicating (both verbal and written) with a variety of partners at all levels

Experience

working in a team environment where collaboration is key

Experience

in planning, problem-solving, conflict resolution, influencing, and negotiating

Experience

with continuous improvement process Ability to work around all types of fabrics, fibers, foams, and synthetic furs Valid Drivers License

Preferred Qualifications

Experience

using Maximo (WDW system) and Microsoft Suite

Experience

leading in a unionized environment Proficient or fluent in Vietnamese or Spanish

Education

High School Diploma or equivalent is required Advanced degree in a Costuming, Textiles, or Apparel-related field is preferred Additional Information · Fully On-Site Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Orlando, FL is $57,500 to $77,100 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and

experience

among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. job.title: Coordinator, Digital Production
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

Job Title: Coordinator, Digital Production


A little bit about our team:

Our team sets up, schedules, and gathers all the pieces for new digital releases to be delivered to digital service providers like Spotify, Apple, etc., and also new physical releases (Vinyl, CDs, Cassettes), to be manufactured. We ensure that all digital and physical products appear in the marketplace as intended by the label and artist.


Your role:

You will play an integral role in supporting Warner Records, Warner Records Nashville and 10K Projects. This position will handle day-to-day support on products with various digital service providers as well as operations processes. The ideal candidate will be able to work and communicate effectively with multiple stakeholders. Flexibility and the ability to prioritize various tasks in an ever-changing environment will also be key.


Here you’ll get to:

  • Run the production schedules, ensuring their accuracy and sending out to large distribution lists; you’ll also build and send the Daily Schedule Changes memo, with late-breaking changes not yet published in the schedule.
  • Assist with setting up and scheduling products to digital service providers, often making numerous changes to setup both before and after product delivery.
  • Be responsible for coordinating new album and single releases on a weekly basis for releases assigned to you. This includes verifying that audio/video, art, metadata, and scheduling, and pricing are in place and compliant with current industry standards.
  • See your projects through by completing digital bill of materials (dBOM) approval for delivery to digital service providers. 
  • Conduct weekly checks to ensure products assigned to you have successfully completed delivery to accounts and reconcile the release details back to the release intention.
  • Handle takedowns and price changes as requested by the labels.
  • Coordinate the delivery and tracking of all digital releases for your assigned projects.
  • Enter in-network video claims for video products live at YouTube.
  • Utilize automated robot to create still image audio products for delivery to YouTube.
  • Provide coverage for absent team members.

About you:

  • Creative self-starter with exceptional follow-up skills.
  • General understanding of current digital music distribution partners and industry best practices. 
  • Must be able to accept changes readily, both in job responsibilities, as well as in the work environment, and can be flexible in adapting to re-prioritized tasks.
  • Minimum one year experience in the music industry.  
  • Data analysis/research skills.
  • You have knowledge of digital retailer metadata requirements and broad knowledge of the audio production process.
  • You have great people skills, able to work with varied personalities at many levels of the company.
  • You’re extremely flexible, are extremely detail-oriented, like constant change, and are comfortable juggling multiple responsibilities and last-minute requests. 
  • You’re a problem solver with a keen deadline awareness.
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • You have excellent computer skills, including working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets
  • You possess a genuine interest in music and the music business.
  • You have excellent time management and organizational skills.
  • You’re a team player, who can tolerate ambiguity.

We’d love it if you also had:

• Mastery of Excel, including formulas for date calculation and calendaring.

• Experience with music industry production schedules.

• Experience using and designing workflows in AirTable.



As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
 

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. We value in-office collaboration, which is essential for talent development and strong working relationships. #LI-Onsite Salary Range: $25.00 to $29.00 Hourly Salary ranges are included for job postings where required by law. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as work experience and business needs. The pay range is subject to change at any time dependent on a variety of internal and external factors.

You must be legally authorized to work in the United States as of your first day of employment with WMG. Valid proof of work authorization will be required upon hire in accordance with federal law.

Your role:

As the Strategy & Growth Coordinator, you will provide critical project coordination, administrative rigor, and operational support to ensure high-priority critical initiatives run smoothly across Warner Chappell Music (WCM). Reporting directly to the S&G Sr. Manager, you will serve as the organizational foundation for our global team – tracking deliverables, coordinating cross-functional communications, maintaining project platforms, and helping modernize business workflows.

This is an ideal role for a proactive, highly organized professional who excels at detail management, enjoys building order out of fast-moving initiatives, and wants hands-on exposure to strategy, technology rollouts, and business operations in the music publishing industry.


Here you’ll get to:


Project Management & Tracking Support

  • Maintain and update project trackers, roadmaps, and centralized databases (e.g., Airtable, project boards) to ensure all achievements, task owners, and deadlines are current.
  • Follow up on action items across cross-functional workstreams, helping identify bottlenecks early and keeping team members aligned.
  • Support intake and triage workflows for team requests, ensuring proper documentation, categorization, and routing.

Operational & Administrative Enablement

  • Schedule and coordinate cross-functional global syncs, capturing meeting minutes, key takeaways, and action item follow-ups.
  • Assist with change management and user adoption efforts for internal tools, systems, and platforms (e.g., coordinating training sessions, handling invite lists, and gathering user feedback).

Executive Presentation & Reporting Assistance

  • Partner with the Sr. Manager to draft, format, and polish slide decks, one-pagers, and visual resources for executive presentations and cross-departmental reviews.
  • Gather, clean, and organize qualitative and quantitative data from internal teams and operational systems to support reporting and analysis.
  • Serve as a reliable, responsive point of contact for internal partners across regions and departments.

About you:

  • Experience: 1–3 years of experience in project coordination, business operations, administrative support, or a related role (music or entertainment industry experience is a plus).
  • Highly detail-oriented and structured, with a proven ability to manage multiple competing tasks, timelines, and priorities without missing a beat.
  • Clear, professional, and confident written and verbal communication skills; comfortable interacting with stakeholders at various levels.
  • Proficiency with modern collaboration and project management platforms (e.g., Airtable, Monday.com) in addition to Google Suite. 
  • Familiarity with or curiosity about employing modern AI productivity tools (e.g., Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude) to streamline everyday workflows.

Mindset & Approach:

  • Proactive problem-solver who thrives in dynamic, evolving environments and comfortably brings order to ambiguity.
  • Discretion and professionalism when handling confidential strategic information.
  • Location: New York, NY (Hybrid) (or Los Angeles, CA)



We’d love it if you also had:

The legal department is located at the corporate headquarters of Warner Music Group (“WMG”). The legal department supports WMG and its operating companies in all corporate legal matters, including information technology (IT), mergers and acquisitions (M&A), securities, compliance, employment, records management, litigation, digital and intellectual property.


Your role:

This position is a unique opportunity to be a generalist in the corporate legal department of a global entertainment company and participate in a range of corporate activities and practice areas, with a focus on corporate, IT and M&A matters. The Counsel will primarily support the corporate, IT and M&A areas and work on various corporate matters/contracts. 


Here you’ll get to:

  • Lead the legal work on domestic and cross-border acquisitions, dispositions, mergers, and carve-outs, including share and asset deals, catalog and rights acquisitions, and acqui-hires.
  • Structure, negotiate, and document joint ventures, strategic partnerships, and commercial alliances, including JV agreements, shareholders' agreements, operating agreements, and related governance, exit, and deadlock provisions.

  • Assist on corporate secretarial matters managing numerous domestic and global entities of the Company.
  • Work closely with members of the legal group and teams from across the company to support numerous projects, including researching and analyzing various legal issues.

  • 4-7 years of experience with a primary focus on corporate / M&A and at least several years in a major law firm.
  • Developed negotiation skills and experience.
  • Developed drafting skills (including, the ability to identify and cultivate creative solutions in areas with evolving legal guidance).
  • Ability to manage a variety of responsibilities and multi-task in a sometimes fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Motivated, team player and dedicated professional.

job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

A little bit about our team:

Warner Music’s Shared Service Center, opened in 2017 and is the home to the financial, legal and administrative functions that provide critical support and best-in-class services to our US Recorded Music and Publishing businesses. The Americas center embodies the innovative and creative spirit that stems from the company’s deep history in nurturing entrepreneurial thinking and artist-focused innovation, enabling our employees to develop a wide range of skills through cross-function collaboration and development opportunities.

The Finance department is responsible for managing all the center’s accounting and cash management functions. As a critical component of the Finance department, the Accounting Operations group provides accounting services and support to WMG’s corporate finance, US record labels and US publishing business.

Your role:

  • The Director, Accounting - Global Intercompany is responsible for overseeing reconciliations, settlements, eliminations, and dispute resolution across all legal entities globally.

  • General Accounting – responsible for general ledger accounting, including monthly close, balance sheet reconciliations, intercompany accounting, Consolidations, and Asset accounting.

  • Work with team to complete submission to corporate and review of related schedules submitted to

  • Corporate in conjunction with the monthly/quarterly financials

  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, and ensure compliance with SOX requirements including drafting and updating process narratives, and maintenance of requirement documentation

  • Reporting and analytics – responsible for reporting and analytics as needed.

Here you'll get to:

  • Lead the end-to-end global intercompany accounting function, ensuring accurate and timely reconciliations and settlements across all legal entities

  • Oversee the elimination of intercompany balances during the monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidation process

  • Lead dispute resolution processes related to intercompany transactions between global affiliates

  • Ensure effective financial internal controls and SOX compliance for all intercompany activities

  • Lead and mentor a diverse global team of accounting professionals to ensure accurate financial reporting

  • Provide Oversight over the preparation of supporting schedules for quarterly filings

  • Special projects as requested by business divisions and corporate

  • Provide excellent customer service and develop / maintain strong relationships with different business unit finance organizations, including the respective CFO and VP of Finance

  • Develop an environment of constant operational improvement that results in definable projects that are delivered timely and result in cost savings to the entire organization

  • Facilitate and bridge gaps between the areas of Finance, Accounting, IT, Strategy and Operations.

  • Develop, recommend, and implement all strategy relating to Financial Shared Services functions

  • Monitor and analyze monthly operating results against budget

  • Interact with internal and external auditors to resolve potential issues and new transactions, Act as primary point of contact for area of oversight

  • Apply Blackline to automate and monitor closing tasks for area of oversight, and ensure compliance with leadership initiatives related to Blackline.

  • Ad hoc analysis and projects

About you:

  • BA/BS in Accounting, Master’s of Accounting a plus

  • 8-10 years of progressive accounting or controllership experience with at least 3-5 years in a Global Business Services (GBS) leadership role (supporting executive leadership at the CFO or corporate level)

  • 10K schedule support experience

  • Fixed Asset accounting oversight experience

  • Experience with Intercompany accounting, consolidations, and Foreign currency translations

  • Large, multinational company experience

  • Driver of “change”, and thinks creatively and strategically

  • Strong understanding of Sarbanes-Oxley compliance

  • Quantifiable examples of achievements and strong track record of success

  • Experience in strong communication and strategy presentation

  • Strong leader who can influence and lead initiatives within the company.

  • Ability to achieve results through influence over external and internal parties who are not direct reports

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Team player who can collaborate with all business units and departments within the company

  • Ability to optimally prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment is essential.

  • Solid project management skills, from initial idea through execution

  • A “Process First” mentality, understanding that the software only works if the underlying workflow is clean

  • Demonstrated professional maturity with unquestioned personal and business integrity

  • Knowledge of finance, accounting, budgeting and cost control principles including Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)

  • CPA a plus

Technical Experience Required:

  • SAP S/4HANA

A Little Bit About Our Team:

The Record to Report (RTR) Accounting Team serves as the central operational backbone for financial integrity, revenue recognition, cash management, and financial reporting across Warner Music Group.

Operating within our Shared Services / Global Business Services framework, the Recorded Music RTR team provides specialized accounting expertise, revenue assurance, and critical month-end closing support across WMG’s renowned domestic and international record labels. We work with the GBS Revenue Team translating complex data into accurate financial reporting under US GAAP.


Your Role:

As the lead Lead Revenue Operations Analyst for Recorded Music, you will serve as the technical subject matter expert (SME) for our recorded music revenue accounting life cycle. This role bridges technical accounting, data analytics, and financial systems design. You will take ownership of the end-to-end accounting for high-volume, multi-source revenue streams, drive compliance with ASC 606, spearhead systems automation, and unlock actionable financial insights through advanced data mining. In addition to technical execution, you will provide training and education to other members of the Recorded Music RTR team.


Here you'll get to:

  • Lead the technical accounting, accrual modeling, and reconciliation for all Recorded Music revenue streams, including Digital Streaming Partners (Spotify, Apple, YouTube, Amazon), Digital Downloads, DMCA statutory royalties, Physical manufacturing and distribution (vinyl, CD, merch), Synchronization (film, TV, gaming, advertising), Master Licensing, and foreign affiliate distributions.
  • Architect and maintain robust ASC 606 recognition schedules, monthly flash revenue accruals, deferred revenue tracking, and automated reversals based on consumption ingestion files vs. actual cash settlements.
  • Query, clean, and analyze Revenue Operational Reporting datasets across disparate DSPs using Analysis for Office and Gemini AI Tools.    Reconcile Multi-System Reporting from Source to Financial Ledger.
  • Bridge consumption metadata (streams, downloads, play counts, tier rates) with transactional general ledger activity to detect anomalies, underreported royalties, missing catalog codes, and system mismatches.
  • Conduct granular month-over-month (MoM) and quarter-over-quarter (QoQ) variance analyses; present variance drivers to label finance leaders.
  • Serve as the RTR business lead for financial systems optimization across SAP (ECC / S/4HANA), BlackLine, and proprietary music revenue sub-ledgers.
  • Design, test, and implement automated reporting simplify manual journal entries and compress the monthly close cycle.
  • Direct the monthly and quarterly close deliverables for recorded music revenue, reviewing high-volume journal entries, complex accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Review work products prepared by staff accountants and offshore shared service partners (e.g., Shopify D2C sales tie-outs, DSP settlement matching, clearing account reconciliations), providing structured guidance and establishing standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Actively investigate and resolve persistent balances in revenue clearing, suspense, and partner withholding accounts.
  • Maintain and enhance internal control matrices under Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX 404), ensuring proper segregation of duties, automated validation checks, and data lineage documentation.
  • Serve as primary revenue audit liaison for internal and external auditors (e.g., Big 4), providing PBC audit schedules, roll-forwards, sample testing support, and technical accounting memos.
  • Partner proactively with Label Finance VPs/Directors, Commercial Revenue Operations, Business & Legal Affairs, IT/Data Engineering, and Corporate Royalty teams to align accounting treatments with evolving contract structures and deal terms.

About you:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related analytical field required.
  • Active CPA license (or international equivalent) strongly preferred.
  • Master’s Degree (MAcc, MBA) or coursework in Financial Data Analytics / Information Systems is a significant plus.
  • 10 to 15+ years of progressive, hands-on accounting experience in Corporate Accounting, Shared Services, or Big 4 Public Accounting.
  • Extensive specialization (7+ years) in high-volume revenue accounting, billing assurance, or royalty accounting within the music, digital entertainment, streaming media, or intellectual property/licensing sectors.
  • Proven track record leading technical ASC 606 revenue recognition implementations or oversight for complex multi-element arrangements.
  • Demonstrable experience directing and reviewing work performed by distributed, hybrid, or offshore delivery centers.
  • Deep experience working with enterprise ERPs (specifically SAP FI/CO, S/4HANA) and automated balance sheet reconciliation tools (such as BlackLine or Cadency).
  • Expert-level Microsoft Excel proficiency (SAP Analysis for Office, Power Query, dynamic arrays, VBA/macros, advanced nested logic).
  • Experience with eCommerce and digital billing platforms (e.g., Shopify, DSP vendor reporting portals) is highly desirable.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Ability to untangle intricate data anomalies and synthesize findings into clear executive summaries.
  • Proactive drive to evaluate status-quo manual workflows and design scalable, automated alternatives.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the confidence to collaborate across label executives, data engineers, and external auditors.
  • Proven capacity to manage high-pressure close deadlines and competing stakeholder requests with composure and precision.

As Manager of Revelator Distribution Operations, you will play a critical role in supporting key clients and internal teams during US business hours. You will build deep expertise in the Revelator platform to oversee end-to-end operational workflows. In this position, you will drive seamless catalog ingestion support, monitor release deliveries, resolve technical DSP issues, optimize metadata and assets, and deliver actionable operational reporting to ensure independent labels and artists are set up for success across global digital service providers.


Here you’ll get to:


  • Catalog ingestion & delivery - provide support to the DSCO Catalog Ingestion team as they lead on catalog creation and delivery into Revelator
  • Delivery monitoring - Monitor delivery feeds and supply chain events daily; identify failed, stalled and rejected deliveries and action them within agreed turnaround time
  • Delivery monitoring - Manage (Investigate and resolve) DSP delivery errors, metadata rejections and asset failures
  • Delivery monitoring - bring up relevant issues to engineering with reproducible detail where a platform fix is required.
  • Delivery monitoring - Raise, track and chase tickets with DSP partners (Apple, Spotify, YouTube, Amazon and others) through to closure.
  • Metadata & asset optimization - Identify and optimize metadata including artist disambiguation / profile mapping, contributor enhancement, artwork / audio replacement, 
  • Operational reporting - Produce recurring operational reporting on delivery volumes, error rates, open partner tickets and ingestion progress.
  • Operational reporting - Respond to internal and client queries on delivery and catalogue status within agreed service levels
  • Key direct operational contact - provide key direct operational support to US time zone business entities

About you:

  • 2–4 years' experience in digital distribution, digital supply chain or content operations within the music, media or entertainment industry.
  • Hands-on experience of content ingestion, metadata management and delivery to digital service providers including their unique CMSs (Apple Connect, S4MP etc)
  • Working knowledge of music metadata standards and the identifiers that underpin them (ISRC, UPC/EAN, ISNI), and familiarity with DDEX message types and delivery feeds.
  • Intermediate SQL — able to write and adapt queries with joins and filters against a relational database without assistance.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Passion for supporting independent music
  • An interest in efficiency tools (Airtable etc) and application of AI tools for business 
  • Working knowledge of industry developments and commercial practices

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

The Finance Transformation team is a group of professionals across the WMG organization brought together to re-imagine our processes and systems to establish more standardized and efficient ways of working that will drive WMG’s growth and business aspirations. 


Your role:

The OTC Manager holds a global remit and is responsible for defining the future state Order to Cash (OTC) processes and measures within SAP S/4 HANA and Fiori that are aligned with organizational strategies, country-specific knowledge, and operational requirements. This process lead will strive to assemble opportunities, reviewing existing and best-practice workflows, tools, and data. The role moves through design, architecture, implementation, release, and steady state with an ongoing focus on continuous improvement and the integration of OTC finance processes into the overall WMG landscape. Specific accountability from revenue to the sales order and billing documents (plus ebilling where required) for digital, physical, D2C, 3rd party licensing and merchandise revenue streams.


Here you’ll get to:

  • Support the transformation team by leading cross-functional and virtual teams in the review, design, development, and implementation of global processes and procedures, including customer master data, credit management, order management/billing, accounts receivable (AR), collections, cash application, and revenue recognition. 
  • Lead process design meetings with internal Subject Matter Resources (SMRs) and third-party vendors through design, implementation, and release. 
  • Lead technical and operational teams to conduct testing, defect resolution, and ongoing configuration of SAP SD/FI-AR modules and associated sub-systems. 
  • Be responsible for OTC testing across credit limit setting, billing, cash application, dispute management, credit/debit memo processing, customer statement generation, and collaborate with sales, distribution, and licensing platforms. 
  • Work closely with the SAP Master Data Management team to ensure customer master data configuration and governance are consistent with global processes. 
  • Work closely with WMG Tax to solve complex scenarios involving worldwide tax.
  • Act as representative for intercompany billing between service centers and transformation.
  • Leverage OTC and industry process and systems knowledge/experience to implement standardization of global, regional, and/or local processes, challenging the status quo while taking input from SMRs and program partners to understand required localizations. 
  • Lead the design, documentation, and ongoing socialization of end-to-end OTC processes. 
  • Obtain consensus for Finance Transformation from key WMG partners across the globe by credibly communicating deep operating process and systems knowledge and an appreciation of the impact at a local level. 
  • Attend and/or present in update meetings as required for key decision, issue, and risk points. 
  • Work with collaborators to ensure Product / Policy / Process / Procedure / System decisions account for territory variances, commercial needs, and local legal/regulatory requirements. 
  • Partner with IT to identify integration points between commercial/sales operations systems, billing platforms, and core finance systems. 
  • Partner with people and change management resources to develop job aids, communications, and training approaches to embed new ways of working and systems training for the OTC area. 
  • Act as a spokesperson across the WMG organization for the benefits delivered by the Finance Transformation in the OTC space. 
  • Represent the OTC Business Process at individual Fit/Gap sessions in markets to ensure all business requirements are considered (and documented via User Requirements Specification). Ensure that any business needs driving a requirement for customization are strongly challenged and options for process redesign are considered. Where customizations are needed, ensure justification is documented and changes progress via the governance model. 
  • Update relevant OTC documentation based on changes to the global template (including SOPs, User Guides, and training materials). 
  • Participate in the preparation of OTC training materials. 
  • Be responsible for the resolution and review of OTC issues, risks, and business impacts for the owned process. 
  • Proactively and on an ongoing basis identify internal and external OTC guidelines (e.g., automation in cash application, AI-driven credit scoring, streamlined collections) that will enable improvement of the standard end-to-end process. 

About you:

  • Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university in Business, Finance, Accounting, Business Information Systems, Management Science, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • Daily user of SAP with deep knowledge of OTC Processes focusing on OTC processes (Credit, Collections, Cash Application, Billing, AR) or related finance transformation experience. 
  • Strong Order to Cash process and systems knowledge, preferably within a music, media, digital licensing, or entertainment industry context. 
  • Facilitative style, with prior experience leading workshops and engaging collaborators through a series of approaches that require a targeted level of consensus. 
  • Relevant operational OTC experience supervising credit management, order fulfillment/billing workflows, cash management, dispute resolution, AR ledger management, and internal controls. 
  • Technically savvy with a robust organizational change skillset. 
  • Experience with a previous SAP implementation (specifically SAP SD, FI-AR, or FSCM) is crucial. 
  • Exemplary collaborator engagement and management skills internationally and within complex, multi-faceted organizations. 
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to perform complex dispute, credit risk, and receivables analysis. 
  • Ability to develop, articulate, and build support around a long-term OTC vision and implement incremental turning points in support of that vision. 
  • Team player who can participate and collaborate with varied business units (sales, licensing, supply chain, legal, finance) to effectively implement transformation initiatives. 


We’d love it if you also had:

  • Transformational leadership experience. 
  • Media, entertainment, digital distribution, or music industry experience preferred. 
  • Familiarity with SAP FSCM (Credit Management, Dispute Management, Collections Management) and modern automated cash application tools.

And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

We currently have a fantastic opportunity for talented individuals to join our innovative and highly sought-after Emerging Talent Associate Program as an Emerging Talent Associate (ETA) this Spring.


Warner Music Group’s Emerging Talent Associate Program is a paid internship program designed to provide individuals with the opportunity to apply their skills and gain hands-on experience in the music industry. This multidimensional, semester-long program begins by matching ETAs to specific departments based on their interests as well as the position qualifications.


Here you’ll get to:


Upon joining the program, Emerging Talent Associates (ETAs) are fully immersed in the day-to-day activities of their assigned department.  They participate in strategic meetings, help solve key business issues, and offer ideas and perspectives to further WMG’s global success. In addition, working as an Emerging Talent Associate ensures access to incredible developmental activities such as our Professional Development Workshops, Industry Insights, and the Emerging Talent Associate Capstone Project.  


A little bit about the program:

  • Application Deadline: Friday, January 1, 2027 at 11:59pm

    • OPTION THREE: February 1, 2027 - April 9, 2027
  • Scheduled Weekly Hours: 20-25 hours per week (varies based on department)
  • Internship Credit is also provided for students seeking academic credit for this experience

A little bit about you:

  • At least 18 years of age by January 19, 2027
  • Located and legally authorized to work within the United States for the duration of the program
  • Emerging Talent Associates are responsible for their own housing and transportation within the designated city
  • A self-starter attitude with a genuine curiosity for our business
  • Able to commit to a 20-25 hour work week

  • Professional goals that align with Warner Music Group’s core values and business objectives
  • Knowledge of and passion for the different business units that makeup WMG
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as effective problem solving and organizational skills
  • Strong passion for and knowledge of the music industry
  • Leadership experience on or off campus

**Business & Legal Affairs is reserved for individuals actively pursuing a law degree.

  • Artist Brand Management (Hybrid New York, NY)
  • Brand & Audience Services (Hybrid Los Angeles, CA)
  • Creative Services (Hybrid Los Angeles, CA)
  • Legal Affairs (Hybrid Nashville, TN)
  • Nonesuch Records (Hybrid New York, NY)
  • Press & Marketing (Hybrid Los Angeles, CA)


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:
