WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

Your role:

We are seeking a world-class, execution-focused Senior Vice President (SVP) of Global Supply Chain Transformation to lead the comprehensive modernization of our physical operations. In this role, you will redefine the future-state of our physical operations—spanning global manufacturing partnerships, distribution hubs, e-commerce fulfillment, and inventory optimization—while spearheading the end-to-end implementation of a modern, enterprise-wide Supply Chain Management (SCM) system.


While our industry is music, prior music industry experience is not required. We are specifically seeking a sophisticated supply chain leader trained in best-in-class Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), retail, or high-volume manufacturing and shipping environments who can bring world-class operational discipline, predictive data modeling, and rigorous systems architecture to our global physical business.


Here you’ll be responsible for:

  • Operational Transformation: Evaluate, re-engineer, and optimize our global physical supply chain network , physical media, and merchandise) to improve speed-to-market, reduce fulfillment costs, and scale for massive demand spikes around global release cycles.
  • Systems Architecture & Rollout: Serve as the executive sponsor for the selection, design, and phased global implementation of an advanced enterprise SCM / ERP technology platform, moving the organization away from tech debt accumulated in  legacy, fragmented systems.
  • CPG-Style Rigor & Planning: Introduce sophisticated demand forecasting, sales and operations planning (S&OP), and inventory replenishment models tailored to a highly variable, hit-driven physical product lifecycle.
  • Change Management: Direct a comprehensive organizational change management strategy, ensuring corporate stakeholders, global territory leads, and physical warehouse operators successfully adopt new digital workflows and standardized processes.
  • 3PL & Vendor Optimization: Partner with operational leadership to create a framework enabling them to standardize and hold global third-party logistics (3PL) providers, manufacturers, and freight forwarders accountable to strict, data-driven SLAs
  • Executive Leadership: Partner closely with the C-suite, technology teams, and global business unit heads to integrate supply chain capabilities into the broader corporate data ecosystem.

About you:

  • 15+ years of progressive supply chain leadership experience, with a proven track record as a VP or SVP managing large-scale physical logistics and distribution network footprints.
  • Deep operational, foundational experience within a premier CPG, retail, or fast-moving consumer goods environment 
  • Proven success as the business lead for a large-scale, global SCM or ERP system implementation (e.g., o9 solutions, SAP) from blueprinting through to post-go-live optimization.
  • Mastery of advanced demand planning, data-driven inventory optimization, and setting up rigorous KPIs across a complex, multi-region distribution network.
  • Exceptional cross-functional influence and communication skills; the ability to translate complex, rigid supply chain methodologies into agile strategies that support a creative, fast-paced industry.
  • A proven track record of delivery in a creative or similarly unpredictable environment, driven by high pressure or release date driven deadlines.

We’d love it if you also were:

  • Excellent communicator, and dedicated professional with strong organization skills
  • Goal Oriented - setting both short- and long-term goals for teams, motivating them towards high performance.
  • Relationship Builder - develops internal and external relationships globally to accomplish business and revenue goals.
  • Strong Leader who exhibits problem-solving skills to drive and motivate cross functional team members and major projects or initiatives.
  • Capable of establishing and maintaining excellent relationships with top level executives globally and decision-makers, continuously communicating priorities and exploring new opportunities to drive new revenue.
  • Commercially-minded, with sound and practical business judgment


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Job Title: Vice President, Communications


A little bit about our team:

Global Catalog is the catalog division of Warner Music Group, responsible for Warner’s vast, eclectic roster of iconic artists, songs, albums, and labels. We work closely with our artists and the frontline labels under the Recorded Music division to create new catalog opportunities through marketing, A&R, content development, and engagement strategies that are deployed across the company to our catalog teams around the world. 


Your role:

As the Vice President, Communications, you will lead the global communications and radio strategy for Warner Music Group's Global Catalog division, overseeing publicity, media relations, corporate communications and radio promotion across the division's iconic artists, music and labels. You will develop and execute strategic communications initiatives that elevate the profile of Global Catalog, amplify priority campaigns and business achievements, and connect catalog music with audiences around the world. Working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams across Warner Music Group, you will identify opportunities to translate business priorities, cultural trends and audience insights into compelling narratives that drive visibility, engagement and impact


Here you’ll get to:

Media Relations

  • Develop and lead the overarching global communications strategy for Warner Music Group's Global Catalog division, ensuring alignment with corporate, brand, marketing, product and commercial priorities.
  • Partner with international teams to identify global publicity opportunities, coordinate regional media strategies and maximize the reach of priority campaigns.
  • Establish global communications frameworks, planning processes and best practices to improve visibility, coordination and execution across markets.
  • Pitch and secure a wide range of media coverage focused around new album releases, artists on tour, and artist milestones (anniversaries, awards, birthdays, etc.) with national and regional press (print and online), podcasts, television, radio, and industry trades
  • Lead Global Catalog Corporate Communications with Warner Music Group including deal, partnership, new hire, and promotion announcements as well as official label press statements and executive interviews
  • Translate business objectives, audience insights, streaming trends and cultural moments into proactive communications opportunities that elevate the profile of Global Catalog and its artists.
  • Advise senior leadership on communications strategy, messaging, reputational considerations and emerging media opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to engage new audiences and generations through strategic storytelling, digital media, creator platforms and cultural partnerships.
  • Hire and manage outside publicity firms, photographers, videographers, and bio writers as needed

Radio Promotion

  • Implement and handle national and local radio campaigns for all releases
  • Coordinate schedules for interviews, satellite radio tours, in-studio appearances, and performances in relation to new releases, tours, and other artist activity
  • Service full albums and singles to wide array of radio formats, based on content
  • Organize both nationally syndicated and locally focused product giveaway campaigns in exchange for promotional consideration
  • Develop and lead all aspects of production and distribution of radio specials on projects as needed
  • Supervise radio single campaigns for newly recorded and/or previously unreleased tracks and hire independent radio promoters to execute to appropriate formats
  • Hire and manage outside radio promotion firms in execution of radio single, product giveaway, and other radio visibility campaigns

About you:

  • Committed, hard-working and upbeat
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Stays up to date and maintains curiosity regarding digital media and consumer behavior trends
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Ability to communicate effectively and maintain composure under stressful and complex situations between label staff, artist management, and artists
  • Is a team player and able to lead media outreach on all designated projects large and small
  • Have strategic agility in terms of foreseeing trends and problems before they occur
  • Are familiar and interested in working across different genres of music

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Background in building compelling presentations that relay key ideas
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Keynote, and other formats
  • Experience managing budgets and third-party vendors

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

Job Title: VP, Marketing Strategy (Urban Music)


A little bit about our team:

The Marketing department at Warner Records is the strategic engine of the label. Informed by modern consumer behavior, our mission is to drive market impact through rigorous research, creative disruption, subcultural immersion, and front-line campaign leadership. From ideation to post-mortem, we work across every department to build integrated marketing plans that ignite global fandoms, shift culture, and expand market share. In this role, you’ll be at the heart of the action, collaborating with A&R, Digital, Sync, and Radio to turn artistic vision into a global cultural movement and shaping the trajectory of our artists.


Your role:

As the VP of Marketing Strategy (Urban Music), you will serve as the chief strategist for a diverse roster ranging from groundbreaking emerging talent to global icons. Leveraging a deep, authentic fluency across Hip-Hop, R&B, Afrobeats, and emerging subgenres, you will build distinct, competitive brand identities that penetrate both mainstream markets and niche subcultures.

This is a high-visibility leadership role requiring a synthesis of creative intuition, subcultural intelligence, and data-backed decisiveness. You will lead comprehensive, multi-channel marketing campaigns blending traditional strategy, creator ecosystems, subcultural touchpoints, streaming growth tactics, and digital awareness to turn music into commercial dominance. If you live for "first-of-its-kind" campaigns and possess the executive presence to command high-stakes creative and business discussions, this is where you belong.


Here you’ll get to:

  • Develop holistic, 12-month+ marketing roadmaps that position artists at the center of modern culture, bridging initial signing with sustained global stardom
  • Identify and engage grass-roots movements, subcultures, and burgeoning creative scenes to generate organic momentum before scaling across broader mainstream channels
  • Direct cross-functional alignment across Digital Strategy, Streaming/Commerce, Sync, Radio, PR, and International Teams, ensuring a unified strategic vision across every consumer touchpoint
  • Utilize real-time consumer analytics, social listenership data, and consumption telemetry to adapt campaigns mid-flight, maximizing ROI and hitting label OKRs
  • Collaborate with Creative Services, visual directors, and creative partners to curate and cultivate authentic visual worlds, video strategies, and story arcs across all campaign channels
  • Partner with touring teams, live agents, and festival promoters to align recorded releases with immersive live experiences, pop-ups, and global tour rollouts
  • Partner with Commerce and Direct-to-Fan teams to design exclusive physical drops, limited-edition vinyl/merch variants, and streaming strategies that deepen fan loyalty and generate incremental revenue
  • Secure non-traditional alliances across sports, streetwear, gaming, luxury, and LGBTQ+ subcultures to extend artist footprints into broader sectors
  • Take full P&L accountability for global project budgets, ensuring resource allocation is continuously optimized for maximum market impact

About you:

  • Proven track record at a major record label or premier entertainment entity, specifically driving high-impact marketing campaigns within Hip-Hop, R&B, and Afrobeats
  • Strong understanding of contemporary media consumption, short-form content ecosystems, audience growth, and viral cultural mechanics, with a perspective on how digital tools support broader marketing goals
  • Deep structural understanding of urban culture, street fashion, global youth movements, and subgenres, paired with the industry relationships needed to execute authentic campaigns
  • Ability to distill complex consumption data and audience insights into sharp, imaginative marketing blueprints while protecting artistic vision
  • Exceptional communication skills to act as the core liaison between executive management, artist managers, and external partners, building trust through execution and innovation

We’d love it if you also had:

  • 4-year undergraduate degree (or equivalent real-world industry achievement) with a documented history of leading award-winning, large-scale music campaigns
  • Experience using audience segmentation, consumption modeling, and market analysis tools to unlock new growth opportunities
  • Pre-existing relationships with international tastemakers, cross-border marketing partners, playlist curators, and subcultural influencers
  • Direct experience in A&R, creative direction, or artist management to seamlessly bridge sound development, visual identity, and strategic marketing


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
 

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. We value in-office collaboration, which is essential for talent development and strong working relationships. #LI-Onsite Annual Rate: $150,000 - $200,000 Annually

You must be legally authorized to work in the United States as of your first day of employment with WMG. Valid proof of work authorization will be required upon hire in accordance with federal law.

job.title: Executive Assistant to Chief Product Officer
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

This role ensures that the Chief Product Officer (CPO) can operate at their highest level by keeping their schedules organized, aligned, and free of conflicts. By managing the daily flow of meetings and priorities, the EA helps both leaders stay focused on strategic work and maintain momentum across the organization.


What Motivates You

  • You enjoy creating order, clarity, and structure in fast-moving environments.
  • You excel at anticipating scheduling needs and staying ahead of conflicts.
  • You take pride in supporting senior leaders so they can operate at their best.
  • You’re energized by being a trusted, reliable point of coordination for others.
     

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Manage highly dynamic calendars for the CPO, ensuring meetings are prioritized and aligned with organizational needs.
  • Coordinate internal and external meetings, resolving conflicts, scheduling holds, and adjusting plans quickly as priorities shift.
  • Monitor upcoming commitments and proactively flag risks, overlaps, or changes that may impact either executive’s day.
  • Ensure executives have the necessary meeting context, agendas, and pre-reads (provided by others).
  • Coordinate meeting logistics, including video links, room reservations, and attendee availability.
  • Serve as a primary contact for scheduling requests and time-sensitive coordination across teams.
  • Book travel arrangements and ensure prober travel documentation.
  • Manage and submit executive’s expenses.
  • Admin support for Product team.
  • Plan and execute culture-building events such as pizza days, snack breaks, cake for birthdays, appreciation weeks, and seasonal team activities.

 

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • Proven experience supporting senior leaders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong calendar management skills, with the ability to juggle shifting priorities and anticipate needs.
  • Excellent communication and follow-through, especially when coordinating across teams.
  • High attention to detail, organization, and reliability.
  • Comfort handling sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Ability to stay calm and solution-oriented when schedules or priorities change rapidly.
     

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting technology, product, or executive leadership teams.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and modern productivity tools.
  • Prior experience in a role focused primarily on scheduling or operational coordination.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development programs

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.

The salary range for this position is:

$85,100 - $127,700 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

Your story awaits. Apply today!

job.title: Manager, FP&A - Revenue & Growth
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Manager, FP&A – Revenue & Growth is a key finance business partner supporting The Washington Post’s B2C digital subscription, B2B revenue, and emerging growth initiatives. This role translates business performance, market dynamics, and operating decisions into clear financial insight that helps leaders invest wisely, manage risk, and build sustainable revenue.

Reporting within the FP&A organization, the Manager leads planning, forecasting, and performance analysis for assigned revenue businesses while developing financial talent and strengthening the tools, processes, and partnerships that support informed decision-making across the company.

 

What Motivates You

  • You are energized by helping mission-driven media organizations build durable, diversified revenue models.
  • You enjoy translating complex financial and operating data into clear insights that guide decisions.
  • You value collaborative partnership with leaders across Product, Marketing, Sales, Newsroom, Data Analytics & Insights, and Finance.
  • You are motivated by improving planning processes, models, and reporting so teams can act with greater clarity and confidence.
  • You take pride in developing financial talent and creating an inclusive, accountable team environment.

 

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Lead annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and long-range plans for assigned revenue streams, producing aligned financial plans that support enterprise priorities and growth goals.
  • Develop driver-based revenue models that connect pricing, volume, pipeline, customer behavior, and other operating metrics to reliable financial outcomes.
  • Analyze actual revenue performance against budget and forecast, identifying variance drivers, risks, opportunities, and outlook changes that enable timely leadership action.
  • Advise business leaders on operating performance, investment choices, and resource-allocation decisions, resulting in actionable recommendations grounded in financial and strategic analysis.
  • Evaluate new products, partnerships, pricing strategies, and growth initiatives through business cases, scenario analyses, and financial models, enabling informed decisions on investments and tradeoffs.
  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, Product, Newsroom, Data Analytics & Insights, and other teams to improve revenue performance and align business plans with financial objectives.
  • Incorporate relevant market, competitive, and industry trends into forecasts and planning, strengthening the organization’s ability to anticipate changes in the revenue environment.
  • Strengthen revenue reporting, forecasting, and planning processes through improved data quality, automation, and planning tools, increasing consistency, efficiency, and confidence in financial information.
  • Integrate monthly close results and performance-review insights into forecasts, ensuring leaders understand results and their implications for the forward outlook.
  • Manage and develop financial analyst(s) through clear priorities, coaching, and quality review, building stronger financial modeling, business acumen, and partnership capabilities.
  • Lead strategic analyses and ambiguous growth-related projects, structuring complex questions and communicating conclusions that advance executive decision-making.

 

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • Six or more years of progressively responsible experience in financial planning and analysis, strategic finance, corporate finance, or a related discipline.
  • Experience supporting revenue-oriented, subscription, digital, consumer, B2B, or growth businesses; media-industry experience is valuable but not required.
  • Experience managing, coaching, or formally leading financial analysts and reviewing complex analytical work.
  • Strong financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, and scenario-analysis skills, including the ability to connect operating drivers to financial results.
  • Ability to synthesize complex financial and business information into concise, practical recommendations for senior leaders.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with demonstrated success partnering across functions and levels of an organization.
  • Sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, and comfort navigating evolving priorities and incomplete information.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with financial planning and analysis platforms, such as Oracle, SAP, Planful, Adaptive Insights, or Anaplan.
  • Experience with data analytics and visualization tools, such as Tableau or Power BI.
  • Knowledge of digital media, consumer subscription, advertising, SaaS, or other recurring-revenue business models.
  • Familiarity with investment analysis, corporate development, partnerships, or mergers and acquisitions.
  • MBA, CFA, CPA, or comparable advanced finance credential.

job.description:
Application Instructions

Please list all professional experience and explain any gaps in employment history. All of your application materials, which may include PDF files of work samples and/or links to audio, video, photography or graphics, must be uploaded to the field labeled Resume/Cover Letter/Work Samples to be considered for the position.


Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking a strategic, creative and collaborative leader to serve as Manager, News Video, helping drive how our journalism reaches audiences across social and video platforms.


This role sits at the center of The Post's off-platform strategy, overseeing a team of social video editors responsible for producing engaging, platform-native journalism for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and other emerging platforms. The Manager, News Video will lead editorial strategy, programming and execution, ensuring our video journalism reaches audiences wherever they consume news while upholding The Post's standards for accuracy, creativity and innovation.


We are looking for a leader who sees video as a core journalistic product—not simply a promotional tool—and who understands the rapidly evolving dynamics of social platforms and audience behavior. The ideal candidate combines editorial judgment, audience expertise and operational excellence with the ability to coach journalists, develop new formats and execute a clear vision for audience growth.

Working closely with the Head of Off-Platform Strategy and leaders across the newsroom, this manager will play a central role in shaping the future of The Post's digital video presence.


This position is based in our Washington, D.C., newsroom.


What Motivates You

  • You are passionate about bringing journalism to audiences wherever they are.
  • You thrive on building teams and helping journalists develop new storytelling skills.
  • You are fascinated by evolving video platforms, audience behavior and emerging formats.
  • You enjoy balancing editorial excellence with audience growth and innovation.
  • You are energized by experimentation, collaboration and continuous learning.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Lead and develop a team of social video editors, fostering a collaborative culture centered on creativity, journalistic excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Manage daily video programming, staffing and production schedules to ensure the team is positioned to cover major news events and execute long-term priorities.
  • Develop quarterly and annual editorial strategies for news video in partnership with newsroom leadership, establishing clear goals and success metrics.
  • Identify opportunities for original news video coverage and oversee production from concept through publication, including editing and programming responsibilities when needed.
  • Own the editorial strategy and audience growth for The Post's YouTube channels, including news, topical and talent-driven programming.
  • Partner closely with Shows, Originals and other newsroom teams to develop and distribute original video journalism across platforms.
  • Coach editors and producers on platform-specific best practices, storytelling techniques and emerging video formats.
  • Monitor audience engagement and performance across platforms, using data and experimentation to continuously refine strategy and maximize reach.
  • Oversee operational aspects of news video production, including live video workflows, licensing resources and vendor relationships.
  • Collaborate across coverage desks and with Product and Design to identify new opportunities for video innovation and audience engagement.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • Significant experience leading digital video production or social video teams at a major news organization or media company.
  • Demonstrated success developing video strategies that grow audiences while maintaining high editorial standards.
  • Deep understanding of YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and other video platforms, including programming, audience development and platform best practices.
  • Strong editorial judgment and experience overseeing breaking news as well as longer-form and original video projects.
  • Experience managing and developing journalists or video creators in a collaborative newsroom environment.
  • Ability to interpret audience metrics and translate insights into editorial strategy and production decisions.
  • Excellent communication, organizational and project management skills.
  • A passion for experimentation, innovation and helping shape the future of digital journalism.

We will consider strong candidates who do not meet all of the qualifications above. job.title: Manager, Software Development, iOS Mobile App
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking a Manager, Software Development to lead the engineering team responsible for our iOS app, the foundation for personalization, ads, sections, articles, App Store subscription management, analytics, audio, video and more, and one of The Post’s most important channels for reader engagement. This role provides dedicated people and delivery leadership for the team while partnering closely with Android, Staff Engineering, Product, and shared engineering teams to deliver high-quality mobile experiences quickly and predictably.


This is a hands-on engineering management role. The Manager, Software Development will set priorities and assignments, develop engineers, remove blockers, identify delivery risks early, and establish clear accountability for delivering approved work to readers, while remaining close enough to the technology to guide difficult engineering decisions. The manager is expected to write code, build prototypes, and review pull requests on a regular basis, and will partner with Staff Engineers and feature leads to verify progress, identify misalignment, and follow work through to release.


The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with deep iOS engineering knowledge, sound technical judgment, and a disciplined approach to execution. This manager will help the team ship faster while maintaining the architecture, performance, reliability, quality, and technical health readers expect from The Washington Post’s flagship mobile experience. The role is data-driven: priorities, estimates, improvements, and results are tracked against agreed baselines and measured by evidence, such as time to users, commitments met, blocker resolution time, and app stability and performance, not by activity or opinion.


What Motivates You

  • You want to help bring The Washington Post’s journalism to readers through high-quality mobile experiences.
  • You measure success by the value delivered to users and how quickly it reaches them.
  • You develop engineers through direct feedback and clear expectations, and you judge your impact by their growth.
  • You care about predictable execution. You know the real remaining work, test whether estimates and status reports are credible, and surface risk before it becomes a missed commitment.
  • You want to stay technically hands-on, writing code, prototyping, and reviewing pull requests to solve problems, evaluate approaches, and stay connected to the systems your team builds.
  • You care deeply about mobile architecture, application quality, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
  • You enjoy removing blockers and working across engineering and product teams to move complex work forward, while leaving ownership with the people who hold it.
  • You hold yourself to the standard you set for others: you own your commitments, communicate risk early, and confirm that issues are closed.
  • You look for wasted effort and ways to improve how teams work, and you measure whether those improvements create value.
  • You enjoy building AI agents and automation that solve real mobile engineering problems, and you care about proving that they work and that people actually use them.
  • You stay current on the iOS ecosystem, including new Apple platform releases, Swift language and concurrency changes, and AI-assisted development in Xcode, and you know which changes are worth adopting and when.

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Lead and develop the software engineers responsible for The Washington Post’s iOS app, providing timely feedback, career development, performance management, and coaching that builds independent ownership and accountability.
  • Establish priorities and assignments, set delivery baselines, and track progress against estimates through to availability for users. Report on measures such as time to users, commitments met by the agreed date, and blocker resolution time, and surface material delivery risks early with clear facts, tradeoffs, and decisions needed.
  • Address performance concerns promptly and directly, set clear expectations, and confirm that behavior and results improve.
  • Partner with the Android Manager, Staff Engineers, Product, feature leads, and shared teams to sequence work, resolve dependencies and blockers, and keep mobile initiatives aligned without taking over others’ ownership.
  • Provide technical leadership across iOS architecture and development in partnership with Staff Engineers, helping the team make sound decisions on application design, performance, testing, maintainability, and platform best practices across Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Objective-C, and Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP).
  • Track changes in the iOS ecosystem, including new Apple OS releases and design updates, Swift and Swift Concurrency evolution, and agentic and AI-assisted tooling in Xcode, and turn them into clear recommendations on what the team should adopt, when, and at what cost.
  • Stay hands-on by writing code, building prototypes, and reviewing pull requests to solve technical problems, evaluate approaches, and set the quality bar for the team.
  • Establish and reinforce engineering practices that support robust testing, code quality, application performance, reliable releases, and the long-term health of the iOS platform.
  • Identify bottlenecks, unnecessary work, technical debt, and opportunities to improve engineering processes and productivity, setting a baseline before each change and measuring the benefit afterward against its cost, rework, and any regressions.
  • Partner with Product and engineering leadership to balance reader experience, business priorities, delivery commitments, and long-term technical health.
  • Build and roll out AI agents and automation that solve iOS and mobile engineering problems, including crash and issue triage, test generation, code review assistance, release workflows, estimation, and detection of stalled work. Verify their output, keep human accountability for decisions, and measure whether they remove delay and effort or only move it.

The Skills and Experience You Bring


Minimum Qualifications

  • BA/BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of professional native iOS development experience with the iOS SDK, including Swift and modern iOS tools and frameworks, and experience building and releasing production mobile applications.
  • Substantial experience writing production iOS code and designing app architecture, including modular design, concurrency, performance, and testable code, with the ability to review pull requests and architecture proposals at a senior level, evaluate tradeoffs, and diagnose and fix defects.
  • Experience directly managing software engineers, including coaching, career development, and performance management, with a record of timely, specific feedback and of coaching engineers toward independent ownership.
  • Experience leading complex engineering work from planning and estimation through implementation, testing, release, and production support, including setting priorities, managing dependencies, identifying delivery risks, and revising forecasts as evidence changes.
  • Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, version control, and software delivery practices for production mobile applications.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with experience partnering effectively with Product, senior technical contributors, other engineering teams, and cross-functional stakeholders, including escalating material risks promptly.
  • Experience defining and using engineering metrics and delivery data, including baselines and targets, to identify bottlenecks, make decisions, and demonstrate improvement in team effectiveness.
  • Working knowledge of the current iOS platform, Swift, and Xcode tooling.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep experience developing and releasing large-scale consumer iOS applications to the App Store.
  • Experience with modern iOS technologies such as SwiftUI, UIKit, Swift Concurrency, App Intents, Apple’s latest design system, on-device AI frameworks, or comparable technologies; familiarity with Objective-C and Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Experience with mobile performance optimization, debugging, memory management, and application reliability.
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs, third-party SDKs, or other services into native mobile applications.
  • Experience leading teams responsible for the full mobile application lifecycle, including architecture, development, automated testing, CI/CD, release, observability, and production support.
  • Experience coordinating engineering work across iOS, Android, backend, platform, or other shared technical teams.
  • Experience improving engineering productivity, delivery predictability, or development processes and measuring the impact of those improvements.
  • Experience mentoring engineers across career levels and partnering effectively with Staff-level or other senior technical contributors.
  • Hands-on experience building AI agents or automation that solve real iOS or mobile engineering problems, with verification of the output and measured benefit.
  • Experience with agentic development workflows in Xcode and with connecting agents to engineering tools such as issue trackers, CI, crash reporting, and source control, for example through Model Context Protocol (MCP).

job.title: Senior Financial Accounting Process and Automation Analyst
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Financial Accounting team enables The Washington Post to report accurately, operate with sound controls, and make timely business decisions. The Financial Accounting Process and Automation Analyst strengthens the way that work gets done by translating accounting needs into practical process improvements, automation opportunities, and ERP-enabled solutions. This role helps reduce manual effort, improve data quality, and create consistent, well-documented workflows across the financial accounting function.


What Motivates You

  • You enjoy understanding how accounting work moves from source data to financial reporting and finding practical ways to make each step clearer, faster, and more reliable.
  • You are curious about automation, ERP capabilities, and data, and you can connect technical possibilities to real accounting and control needs.
  • You value disciplined processes, accurate records, and thoughtful documentation because they make it easier for people to do high-quality work.
  • You like working across Accounting, Finance, Technology, and external partners to turn requirements into solutions that colleagues can adopt.
  • You take ownership of details, follow through on commitments, and use feedback and results to continuously improve the work.

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Map financial accounting processes by documenting current-state workflows, systems, dependencies, controls, and pain points across areas such as the general ledger, close, reconciliations, reporting, and accounting operations, creating a shared foundation for improvement.
  • Design improved workflows by translating accounting requirements into clear future-state processes, business requirements, and acceptance criteria that reduce rework, improve consistency, and preserve appropriate financial controls.
  • Advance automation opportunities by identifying repeatable manual work, evaluating automation and AI-enabled options with appropriate human review, and helping implement solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and auditability.
  • Contribute to ERP design and enhancement by supporting requirements gathering, configuration decisions, testing, data validation, and release readiness so ERP capabilities meet financial-accounting needs.
  • Strengthen data quality and controls by investigating process and data issues, partnering with stakeholders to resolve root causes, and helping maintain reliable handoffs, reconciliations, and documentation.
  • Enable change adoption by developing process documentation, job aids, and training materials that help accounting colleagues understand and consistently use new workflows and tools.
  • Support close and reporting readiness by coordinating process improvements with the accounting calendar and ensuring changes are tested, communicated, and implemented without disrupting critical reporting obligations.
  • Measure process performance by maintaining process metrics, issue logs, and improvement recommendations that help the Controller and accounting leaders prioritize work and assess results.
  • Collaborate across teams by serving as a trusted accounting-process partner to Financial Accounting, FP&A, Technology, Internal Audit, and vendors, bringing clear requirements and disciplined follow-through to shared initiatives.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • 3-5 years of experience in financial accounting, accounting operations, finance systems, audit, consulting, or a comparable environment that combines accounting knowledge with process improvement.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. GAAP, core financial-accounting processes, internal controls, and the close and reporting cycle.
  • Experience documenting business processes, gathering requirements, testing changes, and translating stakeholder needs into usable process or system improvements.
  • Experience working with ERP, financial-reporting, workflow, or reconciliation tools; familiarity with platforms such as Workday, Oracle, SAP, BlackLine, Alteryx, or comparable tools is welcome.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate data or process exceptions and identify practical root-cause solutions.
  • Ability to use data, automation, and AI-enabled tools responsibly, with attention to data governance, source validation, access controls, and human review.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create concise documentation and work effectively with both accounting and technical partners.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience

job.title: Senior Product Manager, Subscriptions
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Subscriptions. Our product team shapes how readers discover our subscription, decide to join, and build habits as long-term subscribers. We own the flows people move through on the way to becoming a subscriber, and we work closely with our subscriptions marketing team to bring new readers in.

 

The Senior Product Manager, Subscriptions, leads a cross-functional team focused on turning unknown users into known users, and known users into paying subscribers. You will dig into how people behave, find the spots where they hesitate or drop off, and turn what you learn into a clear roadmap. You will also work with our revenue science team on the models that help us show the right offer to the right user at the right time.


What Motivates You

  • You get energized by the puzzle of why people choose to subscribe and what makes them stay.
  • You like working across teams and are good at turning ideas from marketing, design, data science, and engineering into something everyone can build toward.
  • You're curious about customers. You want to understand what they need, where they get stuck, and what would make the experience feel easy.
  • You care about the mission and values of the organization and bring determination and good organization to the work.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Own the roadmap for conversion and acquisition flows, from a reader's first visit through registration, checkout, and early onboarding.
  • Develop strategies that move unknown users to known users and known users to payers.
  • Partner with the revenue science team on the models and testing that inform which offer reaches which user, and when.
  • Partner closely with the subscriptions marketing team to plan and launch experiments and campaigns that bring in new subscribers.·       Work with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Analytics, and QA to ship high quality products on a steady rhythm.
  • Write clear requirements and prioritize features against our acquisition and revenue goals.
  • Use A/B testing and other experimentation to learn what works, then apply it to the next round of improvements.
  • Spot roadblocks early and clear them before they slow the team down.
  • Share updates, risks, and new opportunities with leadership on a regular basis.
  • Keep up with trends in subscription products, conversion optimization, and consumer behavior.

The Skills and Experience You Bring


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in digital subscriptions.
  • Experience improving conversion funnels or acquisition flows, ideally in a B2C digital subscription product. This is a strong plus.·      
  • Experience using data to inform decisions, including a track record of running experiments and combining numbers with customer feedback to decide what to build.
  • Comfort working with data science or analytics partners on models and personalization, even if you aren't building the models yourself.
  • A collaborative style and the ability to build good working relationships with marketing, design, engineering, and analytics partners.    
  • Strong attention to detail, and the ability to juggle several projects in a fast-moving environment.    
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex ideas and share results with people at every level of the company.
  • Experience working with research and design teams to run qualitative studies and turn what you learn into product improvements.  
  • Media experience is welcome and not required.

job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

  • The Senior Systems Engineer helps keep The Washington Post’s identity, collaboration, endpoint, and core IT service platforms secure, reliable, and available.
  • This role serves as a senior technical resource for Identity and Access Management, supporting Active Directory, Okta, single sign-on, and automated user-lifecycle processes.
  • Through hands-on systems engineering, administration, integration, and automation, this role improves the reliability and efficiency of technology services used across the organization.
  • Working with IT Operations, Cybersecurity, Legal, Compliance, HR, and other partners, this role helps translate operational and security requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • As an individual contributor, this role provides technical guidance and project leadership but does not have formal people-management responsibilities.

What Motivates You

  • You enjoy solving complex systems and infrastructure problems through careful analysis and hands-on technical work.
  • You are interested in identity management, enterprise platforms, automation, and secure service delivery.
  • You look for practical ways to reduce manual work, improve reliability, and strengthen operational controls.
  • You take pride in building solutions that are documented, supportable, and sustainable for the broader team.
  • You are comfortable responding to immediate operational needs while continuing to improve the underlying systems and processes.
  • You enjoy collaborating with cybersecurity professionals, administrators, engineers, and business partners to solve shared problems.
  • You value sharing your knowledge and helping colleagues develop their technical capabilities.

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Administer and improve Identity and Access Management services, including Active Directory, Okta, single sign-on, multifactor authentication, and role-based access, supporting secure and reliable access to enterprise systems.
  • Design and implement automated provisioning, deprovisioning, and access-change workflows within established security and platform standards, improving the accuracy and timeliness of identity administration.
  • Develop and maintain integrations among platforms such as Workday, Okta, Active Directory, Google Workspace, Proofpoint, and ServiceNow, improving the consistency of data and service workflows.
  • Engineer and support assigned enterprise platforms, which may include Google Workspace, storage and collaboration services, endpoint-management tools, asset-management systems, and ITSM platforms, maintaining reliable day-to-day operations.
  • Use APIs, scripting, and systems-management tools to automate recurring administrative and operational processes, reducing manual effort and preventable errors.
  • Troubleshoot complex incidents involving identity, access, integrations, endpoints, systems administration, and enterprise applications, restoring service and identifying corrective actions.

  • Support the technical implementation of data-retention requirements, legal holds, and e-discovery requests in partnership with Legal, Cybersecurity, and designated data owners, ensuring requests are executed accurately and securely.
  • Contribute technical expertise to system upgrades, platform changes, integration projects, and service improvements, helping projects meet operational, security, and delivery requirements.
  • Maintain system documentation, technical procedures, integration records, and operational runbooks, improving service continuity and reducing reliance on individual knowledge.
  • Recommend improvements to system configurations, workflows, and working methods, strengthening the effectiveness and reliability of the IT Operations team.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • Advanced knowledge of Active Directory, Okta, SSO integrations, multifactor authentication, access provisioning, and role-based access controls.
  • Experience administering Google Workspace in a large or complex environment, including experience with the Google Admin SDK, OAuth, and service accounts.
  • Hands-on experience integrating enterprise systems, SaaS applications, IAM tools, HR platforms, or IT service-management platforms.
  • Proficiency in at least one relevant scripting language, such as Python, JavaScript, Bash, PowerShell, or Google Apps Script.
  • Experience working with REST APIs and troubleshooting system-to-system integrations.
  • Practical experience implementing identity, endpoint, configuration, or access controls in partnership with cybersecurity or compliance teams.
  • Experience supporting ITSM, CMDB, asset-management, endpoint-management, storage, or enterprise collaboration platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, including the ability to identify root causes and resolve issues involving multiple systems.
  • Ability to manage assigned projects and technical work independently while recognizing when decisions or risks require escalation.

job.title: Camera Operator
job.description:
Camera Operator

Position Summary: 

Operate robotic, manual, handheld cameras as well as operate a JIB / Crane for live or taped productions for Weather Group initiatives. Working with show directors, establish and maintain network level camera blocking and composition standards for studio set locations. Assignments will include performing any of the above jobs in alternating roles during the course of a shift or work week.  Accept new assignments and technological challenges as required to support future company initiatives and an ever-changing dynamic broadcasting/video production environment.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Operate robotic, manual, handheld and Jib/Crane cameras as assigned for live or taped productions. 

  • Provide network level shot composition and execution at all times.

  • Perform daily technical function checks of all camera equipment to ensure all operational functions are performing as expected.

  • Must know how to target all robotic cameras as well as use these cameras in Manual or Local mode.

  • Participate in pre-show camera meeting with show director to review robotic, manual camera shot expectations or JIB/Crane assignments.

  • Present shot composition and blocking options / ideas to improve presentation and production value.

  • Work closely with Floor Manager to coordinate the movement of robotic cameras with floor monitors and other studio set pieces.

  • Be proficient with robotic touch screen equipment and act as an expert for storing, modifying, recalling camera shots.   

  • Maintain working knowledge of the operation for robotic computers to assist with diagnosing / solving production issues related to robotic or manual cameras.

  • Maintain shot blocking guide sheets and contribute to departmental training records.

  • Operate teleprompter for live and pretaped productions 

  • Will be expected to load and unload specific teleprompter scripts.

  • Must be able to operate teleprompter simultaneously while operating robotic cameras. 

  • Perform other duties as assigned to support the overall company operation.


Minimum Education and Experience Requirements:


  • Minimum of 3-5 years experience in a live television environment. 


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:  

    • Demonstrated knowledge and experience in building, troubleshooting and repairing camera equipment.

    • Must have a strong desire to continually increase technical and operational proficiency.  

    • Stays current with industry knowledge of new equipment /technologies and recommend best in class technical solutions for production challenges. 

    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

    • Must be able to work in a multitasking environment.

    • Must be a self-starter and be able to work independently.

    • Must be able to lift and move equipment and scenery as required.

    • Strong customer service skills.

    • Willing to work in a team environment on an as needed basis.  

    • May be required to lift lighting fixtures, move scenery or other equipment.  The weight may range from 20-100 lbs.   Anything over 25 lbs would be carried by multiple crew members.

job.title: Content Operations Specialist
job.description:
Content Operations Specialist

Overall Responsibilities

The Content Operations Specialist is responsible for managing and ensuring the technical and broadcast quality of all inbound and outbound content feeds, including video and audio signals, for live and recorded programming at Weather Group Television (WGT). This role combines responsibilities from media acquisitions and master control operations and longform content preparation for Entertainment Studios eight digital channels. As this position supports a 24x7 news/weather environment, candidates must have flexibility to work days, nights, overnights, weekends, and holidays as needed and without advance notice.

Specific Responsibilities

ESN - Network Content Operations

  • Review the next day’s list of “barter shows” and editing requirements.

  • Edit barter show segments for two channels, match file titles, segment lengths, and proper transmission standards.  

  • Make necessary adjustments and verify all file segments for final delivery and playback.

  • Review playlists and associated content for missing segments or other incomplete assets

  • Purge older content files, per policy and procedures.

  • Verify all assets for all channels' playlists are correct and ready for playback

  • Verify timing for all playlists for the current day/weekend days.  

  • Communicate playlist or file issues to the appropriate internal or external partner and work toward a solution prior to air time. 

  • Process dub list for promotional/commercial assets

  • Upload/download files to/from the assigned storage repository (local or cloud)

WGT - MEDIA ACQUISITIONS

  • Ensure broadcast quality of all inbound/outbound video and audio feeds using scopes, analyzers, and level monitoring equipment.

  • Monitor multiple networks for high-standard quality control and report technical issues to appropriate departments.

  • Operate video/audio/L-Band routers, route remote feeds, and perform corrective actions to maintain broadcast signal integrity.

  • Manage content acquisition platforms, including LiveU, Dejero, TVU, LTN, and The Switch.

  • Use newsroom content systems to manage recordings and elements for live broadcasts.

  • Coordinate remote resources (IRDs, encoders, and format converters), adjusting levels and troubleshooting in real time.

  • Operate playout automation across networks to edit, load, and update playlists for live programming.

  • Perform daily checks on critical broadcast gear to maintain industry standards and proactively resolve system issues.

  • Utilize technical software tools, including FTP clients, satellite/scheduling software, MAM, MS Office, and Google Workspace.

TWC - MASTER CONTROL OPERATION

  • Responsible for editing, loading, and monitoring The Weather Channel (TWC) playlist using the automation systems.  

  • Work with Editorial and Programming teams to alter the playlist, within approved guidelines to maintain operational “on-air” continuity. 

  • Monitor multiple TWC feeds (uplinks, downlinks, STAR feeds, etc.) and those of other Allen Media & Entertainment Studios networks. 

  •  Provide Tier 1 technical support to internal technical teams by reporting/requesting Engineering  / IT assistance.   

  • Work closely with Engineering on any signal issues, alarms, or technical issues related to monitored network feeds. 

  • Perform operational checks, monitor video/audio quality, and proactively resolve system defects or failures.

  • Maintain shift logs, outage notifications, service request forms, and operational documentation.

  • Communicate status updates and repair workflows with management, engineering teams, and MCR clients.

  • Participate in technical training and adapt to changing operational demands.

Education, Experience, Certification Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Broadcasting, Communications, a related technical field, or equivalent work experience.

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in news environments, teleport operations, cable, or national broadcast environments.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to communicate professionally with multiple internal technical teams and external vendors. 

  • Strong multitasking and organizational skills, with the ability to manage time effectively and operational resources in a dynamic, 24/7 environment with critical deadlines.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of satellite news gathering (SNG) processes, digital satellite equipment, waveform and vector scopes, and spectrum analyzers.

  • Understanding of broadcast automation systems and how to monitor signal workflow for troubleshooting

  • Experience understanding file formats, including codecs, wrappers, and technical specs

  • Proficiency in HDTV, SDI, ASI, and IP formats, as well as conversion technologies

  • Experience with electronic news/field gathering, teleport, and satellite truck operations, including ingest operations, is desired.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, with the ability to respond quickly to technical issues and implement solutions under operational constraints.

  • Ability to interact effectively and collaboratively across departments and with management, maintaining professional communication with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Sensitivity to the unique needs and challenges of a 24/7 operation, ensuring operational continuity and quality.

job.title: (Senior) Data Engineer – Data Modeling & Core Systems
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why We’re Hiring

We are scaling the core engineering capability behind real-time, high-throughput ad-tech infrastructure that processes large-scale audience data at global scale.

This is not a role for basic ETL scripts or glue code. In this role, data engineering is treated as a true software engineering discipline. You will take deep technical ownership of complex, multi-layered data models (canonical schemas, high-dimensional behavioral signals, and vector embeddings) that power live targeting and measurement decisions for advertisers worldwide.

You’ll help evolve a distributed, production-grade data platform while collaborating with a high-trust engineering team that values clean architecture, continuous improvement (kaizen), and modern development standards.

 

Who You’ll Be Working With

You’ll work closely with fellow engineers across backend systems, Quality Assurance, Analytics, and connector teams. We value teamwork over ego, collaboration over competition, open and honest communication, strong opinions held with curiosity, and delivering well-tested, maintainable code.

Our Technology Environment

  • Languages & Core: Scala, functional programming, strongly typed distributed services
  • Processing & Streaming: Apache Spark for large-scale distributed processing, event-driven architectures
  • Cloud & Storage: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), BigQuery, Parquet
  • Engineering Standards: Automated CI/CD, robust unit & integration testing, Git workflows, and Tyda (our open-source, automation-driven SDLC process)

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own and evolve production data models spanning input/output models, schema evolution, field types, and partitioning strategies across multi-stage distributed pipelines.
  • Maintain and extend our audience framework, normalizing high-velocity raw inputs into standardized, canonical formats across behavioral signals, demographics, and brand affinity.
  • Design and manage models handling relational structures, real-time behavioral signals, high-dimensional embeddings, and anomaly detection.
  • Develop and maintain Spark-based data services in Scala and GCP, adhering to software design patterns, modular architecture, and edge-case resilience.
  • Lead by example with automated unit/integration testing, strict code reviews, Git branching discipline, and CI/CD best practices.
  • Partner with QA, Analytics, and downstream product teams to guarantee contract integrity, data correctness, and reliable system consumption.

 

What You’ll Need

  • 3+ years of software engineering or data engineering experience, with a proven track record of shipping production-grade distributed data systems.
  • Production experience writing quality code in Scala OR another statically typed language (Java, Kotlin, C#, Go). If your background is in Java/Kotlin/Go, you are eager and excited to build in a Scala-first environment.
  • Hands-on experience collaborating on large codebases with automated testing (unit/integration testing), version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and structured code reviews.
  • Proven ability to design and reason about complex, multi-layered data architectures (e.g., canonical schemas, dimensional modeling, Data Vault, or domain-driven data design).
  • Solid experience with Apache Spark (or similar distributed frameworks) handling high-volume datasets.
  • Experience with GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Storage) or equivalent cloud data platforms (AWS/Azure).
  • The ability to explain complex data models, schema trade-offs, and technical designs clearly to both technical and product stakeholders.

What Makes This Role Different? Real Software Rigor. You won't just be stitching together SaaS tools; you'll be writing modular, compiled, testable code for real-time systems.

 

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

#LI-Hybrid 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

 About the role Help shape how AI transforms media and marketing for one of WPP Media's key clients: Google. This newly created leadership role within Media Futures Group (WPP Media's bespoke agency for Google) brings together media expertise, practical AI delivery and organizational transformation. Based in Japan, you will help pioneer agentic workflows at scale for Google, connecting regional and global capabilities with the needs of the local market. Your remit is to turn AI ambition into everyday practice: identifying high-impact opportunities, piloting and deploying AI agents across live campaigns, developing solutions for Japan-specific needs, and helping teams adopt new ways of working. You will partner with senior client and agency stakeholders, cross-functional media teams, and APAC AI specialists to move successful experiments into repeatable, measurable solutions. We are looking for someone who understands how media works, brings strong practical fluency in generative AI, and can lead change from initial use case through deployment and sustained adoption.

What you’ll do
  • Lead AI adoption in Japan. Own the execution of the Japan market AI agenda, aligning local priorities with regional and global capabilities.
  • Deploy AI into live media workflows. Partner with strategy, planning and activation teams to identify opportunities, pilot verified agents, and embed successful workflows into campaign delivery.
  • Build and localize solutions. Architect, localize, test, deploy and maintain custom AI tools and agents that address Japan-specific business and workflow needs.
  • Enable teams and lead change. Deliver practical workshops, training and onboarding, while working with cross-functional leaders to overcome adoption barriers and embed new ways of working.
  • Advise senior stakeholders. Translate business challenges into actionable AI initiatives, clearly communicating opportunities, trade-offs and results to client and agency leadership.
  • Measure, govern and scale. Track adoption, quality, productivity and business impact; uphold enterprise standards for responsible AI; and share successful local innovations across the wider APAC network.
What we’re looking for
  • Substantial relevant experience across media strategy, marketing transformation, consulting, marketing technology or adjacent disciplines, with demonstrated leadership of complex initiatives.
  • Business-level or native Japanese and professional English—both essential.
  • Strong understanding of the media ecosystem, including how campaigns are planned, activated, optimized and measured.
  • Deep understanding of Japan’s media landscape, audiences and cultural context.
  • A track record of driving AI adoption across teams, with hands-on experience piloting or deploying AI workflows or custom agents.
  • Strong practical fluency in generative AI and AI agents, including familiarity with GenAI tools and large language models.
  • Working knowledge of prompt and context engineering, agent testing and evaluation, and responsible AI practices.
  • Proven success leading large-scale change or technology adoption across cross-functional teams.
  • Experience working with major global brands and influencing senior stakeholders.
  • Strong strategic and analytical judgment, with the ability to translate complex business needs into practical solutions and measurable outcomes.
  • Confidence working across local, regional and global teams in a fast-evolving environment.
Why this role is different This is an opportunity to help define how agentic AI becomes part of everyday media delivery for Google, one of the world’s most influential technology brands. You will help build the playbook for Japan: shaping priorities, piloting new workflows, developing local capabilities and turning successful use cases into solutions that can scale. The impact spans both the work and the people delivering it—improving how campaigns run while equipping teams to achieve more with AI. With dedicated Japan ownership and connections across APAC, you will have the opportunity to influence local delivery and contribute to a broader transformation.
