job.title: Data Steward - People Platforms
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

As a Data Steward in the WPP’s Enterprise Technology Data team, you will be responsible for the hands-on administration and maintenance of master data across one or more enterprise data domains. Reporting to the Global Programme Director - Data, you will be the first line of stewardship, ensuring that golden records are accurate, source system mappings are maintained, and data governance standards are consistently applied.

You will execute matching and mapping activities, triage stewardship exceptions, and support the onboarding of new source systems into the MDM framework. Your work will directly impact the trustworthiness and completeness of master data flowing through WPP’s enterprise platforms.

This role involves daily data administration including investigating and resolving match conflicts, maintaining entity mappings and hierarchies, classifying data assets, and supporting the operational processes that keep master data healthy across the enterprise.

You will be part of a Data Steward team led by the Global Programme Director - Data, with the opportunity to develop deep expertise in master data management, data governance, and stewardship at enterprise scale.

What you'll be doing:

Master data stewardship and golden record maintenance

  • Execute day-to-day stewardship activities including reviewing, approving, and correcting master data records in line with governance standards set by the Global Programme Director - Data.
  • Maintain and curate golden records, ensuring survivorship rules are correctly applied and master entities remain accurate and complete.
  • Investigate and resolve match conflicts, potential duplicates, and merge exceptions, escalating complex cases to the Global Programme Director - Data with supporting analysis.
  • Process new entity creation requests, validating source data against matching rules before golden record creation.

Source system mapping and onboarding support

  • Manage and maintain mappings between source system entities and golden master records, ensuring traceability and accuracy.
  • Support the onboarding of new agencies and source systems by executing mapping activities and validating initial data loads against MDM standards.
  • Maintain reference data configurations, ensuring code sets and lookup values remain aligned across source systems.

Data governance and classification

  • Apply data classification standards to master data entities as defined by the governance framework, covering sensitivity, confidentiality, and regulatory categorisation.
  • Review and correct AI-generated data classifications, providing feedback to improve automated tagging accuracy over time.
  • Follow and enforce stewardship workflows including exception handling, approval processes, and escalation procedures.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of entity mappings, transformation rules, hierarchy structures, and stewardship decisions.

AI-assisted stewardship operations

  • Act as the human-in-the-loop for AI-assisted matching and entity resolution, reviewing model-suggested matches, adjudicating low-confidence merge candidates, and approving or rejecting proposed golden record updates.
  • Review and validate AI-generated mapping recommendations during source system onboarding, ensuring accuracy before mappings are committed.
  • Provide feedback on AI model outputs to support continuous improvement of match accuracy, classification quality, and enrichment relevance.
  • Work with AI-driven anomaly detection alerts, investigating flagged records and determining appropriate stewardship actions.

Data quality monitoring and remediation

  • Monitor data quality dashboards and alerts, investigating exceptions and applying remediation actions in a timely manner.
  • Execute data quality checks across master data entities, documenting findings and tracking resolution through to completion.

job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Why we're hiring:

The Director of Employee Listening & Insights will lead WPP’s global approach to understanding and responding to employee sentiment, creating a scalable, insight-led listening ecosystem that drives visible action and sustains trust through transformation.

At the heart of the role is connecting employee voice with leadership decisions and tangible employee experience outcomes. The Director will harness technology, analytics and automation to provide timely, actionable workforce insights and embed employee sentiment more deeply into decision-making across WPP.

Partnering closely with HR, People Analytics, Communications, GBS and business leaders, the role will help create a single, trusted view of workforce insights and ensure employee feedback leads to meaningful action and measurable improvements throughout Elevate28 and beyond.

What you'll be doing:

Employee Listening Strategy & Delivery
  • Lead the evolution of WPP’s global employee listening strategy, developing a clear roadmap for implementation from 2027 onwards.
  • Build and embed a scalable, insight-led listening ecosystem that strengthens employee voice, drives visible action and sustains trust through transformation.
  • Review and optimise WPP’s employee listening technology landscape, leveraging technology, analytics and automation to deliver more timely and actionable insights.
  • Lead and continuously enhance WPP’s global listening framework, including engagement surveys, pulse surveys, lifecycle surveys, exit feedback and employee advisory forums.
  • Deliver monthly pulse surveys and transformation sentiment tracking across major geographies, providing leaders with timely visibility of employee sentiment and experience.
  • Ensure listening activities are closely aligned to business priorities, transformation milestones and employee experience objectives.
  • Lead survey governance, stakeholder engagement, vendor relationships and communications, ensuring a consistent and effective global approach.
  • Monitor participation, engagement and feedback quality, identifying opportunities to strengthen employee voice and increase the impact of listening.
  • Partner with the broader People Experience team to identify key employee experience pain points and prioritise areas for improvement.
  • Partner closely with People Analytics, GBS and Technology teams to create a more connected, automated listening ecosystem and a single source of truth for workforce insights.

Employee Insights & Action

  • Define and embed WPP’s employee insights strategy, establishing clear governance, reporting and action-planning frameworks.
  • Translate employee feedback and listening data into clear, actionable insights that strengthen the connection between employee voice, leadership decisions and employee experience outcomes.
  • Analyse data to identify emerging trends, organisational risks, opportunities and areas requiring intervention.
  • Provide executive-ready insights and recommendations for People Leadership, EMT reviews and transformation governance forums.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards that provide real-time visibility of employee sentiment, engagement and experience trends.
  • Track key indicators including engagement, transformation sentiment, change readiness, retention risks and wellbeing.
  • Identify leading indicators and early warning signals, enabling leaders to take proactive action.
  • Partner with HR and business leaders to translate insights into measurable actions and track their impact over time.
  • Build a data-driven culture where employee sentiment and experience are embedded into decision-making at all levels.
  • Lead the development of WPP’s “You Said, We Did” communications, demonstrating how employee feedback is influencing decisions and driving tangible change.

Key Measures of Success & Year One Deliverables

Success in the first year will be focused on establishing a stronger, insight-led listening approach and demonstrating a clear connection between employee feedback and action. Key priorities will include:

  • Delivering a reimagined WPP Employee Listening Strategy and roadmap for 2027.
  • Establishing a Continuous Listening Model, including monthly pulse surveys across major geographies.
  • Developing an Employee Insights Dashboard providing timely visibility of employee sentiment, engagement and experience trends.
  • Delivering the first cycle of the “You Said, We Did” programme, clearly demonstrating how employee feedback translates into action.
  • Driving strong listening participation and satisfaction, ensuring employees see value in sharing their feedback.
  • Increasing the insight-to-action ratio, with listening insights translated into tangible and communicated actions.
  • Monitoring transformation sentiment and fatigue, identifying emerging risks and enabling timely intervention.

What you'll need:

  • Significant experience in a senior HR, Employee Experience, People Insights or Employee Listening role, with a strong track record of delivering listening programmes at scale.
  • Proven experience shaping and activating employee listening and insights strategies, translating feedback into meaningful organisational change and action.
  • Strong partnership skills, with experience working across People Analytics, HR, GBS, Communications and Technology to deliver an integrated listening and insights approach.
  • A highly data-driven and insight-led mindset, with the ability to turn complex employee data into clear recommendations, executive-level insights and measurable improvements to the employee experience.
  • Experience working within large, complex, global and federated organisations, balancing global consistency with local and regional needs.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the credibility to engage senior leaders and drive action through compelling data and insights.
  • A strong understanding of how technology, analytics and automation can enhance employee listening, provide more timely insights and strengthen organisational decision-making.

About Data & Technology Solutions 

WPP’s Data & Technology Solutions is WPP’s unified global data and technology organisation. We build the platforms, products, and engineering capabilities that power marketing transformation at scale. 

WPP Open is our AI-powered platform for marketing. It connects people, data, tools, and AI into a single ecosystem, enabling teams to deliver better outcomes faster, more efficiently, and at global scale. 

Our teams of engineers, product leaders, and operators work across multiple domains to build systems that power planning, execution, and delivery for some of the world’s largest brands. 

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR 

We are looking for a senior product-minded engineering leader to drive delivery and execution for our commerce product area and to lead the application of AI into our SDLC. 

 

You will be core part of our product development process and help to inform roadmap and will lead your team in translating product priorities into reliable, high‑quality engineering outcomes. Additionally, you will lead the application and adaptation of AI-driven development practices, ensuring systems operate effectively in real‑world, production environments. This role requires strong systems thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to manage complex integrations in a rapidly developing environment. 

 

Work in this area spans both core commerce marketing systems and the data flows and pipelines required to interact with these systems, requiring a blend of data-aware system design, application engineering, and integration engineering. 

 

You are: 

  • A product-focused engineering leader with strong technical credibility and demonstrated ability in influencing and driving the roadmap.  
  • Comfortable operating in integration-heavy, business-critical systems 
  • Significant experience in programme design and systems architecture. 
  • Demonstrated portfolio incorporating AI driven development into the end-to-end SDLC.  
  • Data & metrics-driven, able to manage complexity across multiple teams, platforms and external partners. 
  • Focused on outcomes tied to business performance. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO 

Engineering Leadership & Team Development 

  • Lead engineering delivery across teams building commerce marketing capabilities. 
  • Establish and develop team mentorship paths aiming to incorporate agents into day-to-day work. 
  • Accountable for the career growth and development of senior engineers and their teams across craft, delivery and business outcomes. 

Stakeholder Alignment & XFN Collaboration 

  • Act as the primary engineering partner to Product, Design, Commercial, and Delivery stakeholders. 
  • Translate business requirements into actionable engineering outcomes and technical product direction. 
  • Drive alignment with engineering leads and XFNs from partner teams to deliver integrated roadmaps. 

End-to-End Accountability 

  • Take ownership across the full software development lifecycle — from discovery through to release and post-production maintenance. 
  • Ensure systems are reliable, performant, and capable of operating under real-world conditions. 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED 

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience 
  • Proven experience delivering complex, operational systems at scale 
  • Strong experience with APIs, distributed systems, and integrations 
  • Experience working with systems that integrate with external platforms or partner ecosystems 
  • Strong understanding of system performance, latency, and production reliability 
  • Hands-on experience delivering AI-enabled product features into production, including integrating LLMs and generative AI services 
  • Strong experience with modern cloud data warehouse and lakehouse platforms (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift) 
  • Solid understanding of data modelling, ELT/ETL pipelines, and orchestration tooling (e.g. dbt, Airflow), including data quality, lineage, and governance 
  • Deep experience architecting and operating systems on major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP) 
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-native architecture patterns, including microservices, containers and Kubernetes, serverless, and event-driven design 
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform), CI/CD, observability, cloud security and IAM, and cloud cost optimisation (FinOps) 
  • Demonstrated ability to lead delivery in multi-team, dependency-heavy environments 
  • Strong stakeholder management across Product, Delivery, and Engineering 

 

If you are ready to lead engineering delivery at scale, working across complex systems and driving real business outcomes, we encourage you to apply.

We are hiring a GL Reporting Analyst to take ownership of complex general accounting and reporting activities within our Finance Shared Services environment. This role plays a key part in ensuring accurate financial records, strong controls, timely month-end close, high-quality reconciliations, audit-ready evidence and effective collaboration across Finance teams.

This position is also expected to actively contribute to our Finance Transformation journey, helping drive process standardisation, automation, AI adoption and continuous improvement across RTR activities. The role requires a finance professional who combines strong accounting expertise with a transformation mindset and the ability to challenge existing ways of working.

 

What you'll be doing:

Own general ledger accounting activities for assigned entities or processes, including complex journal entries, accruals, prepayments, reclassifications and balance sheet reconciliations.

Coordinate month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities in line with defined timelines, ensuring issues are identified, escalated and resolved on time.

Ensure accurate and timely posting of accounting entries in the ERP system and challenge unusual, incomplete or unsupported transactions.

Prepare and review balance sheet account reconciliations, identifying and resolving discrepancies, aged items and unusual movements.

Ensure compliance with internal controls, SOX requirements, and audit standards, with a strong focus on evidence quality and traceability.

Maintain and review appropriate documentation and audit trails for internal and external audits.

Support financial reporting, variance analysis and accounting reviews, identifying unusual transactions, risks or trends.

Liaise with other Finance functions (PTP, OTC, Treasury, Tax) and OpCo stakeholders to resolve complex accounting issues.

Act as a technical reference point for Analyst profiles, supporting knowledge transfer, coaching and process clarification.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate RTR processes.

Promote the responsible use of automation, digital finance tools and AI-enabled solutions across accounting, reconciliation, reporting and documentation activities.

Support ad-hoc accounting, reporting, audit and transformation requests as required.

Finance Shared Services and Record-to-Report (RTR) teams

Internal and external auditors

OpCo finance teams and regional stakeholders

Process improvement, automation and Finance Transformation stakeholders

 

What you'll need:

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

Relevant experience in accounting, RTR, audit or financial reporting within a Shared Services or corporate environment.

Solid understanding of statutory accounts and disclosure requirements, with proven experience coordinating annual audit processes and reviewing information provided to external auditors.

Proven experience performing and reviewing intercompany reconciliations.

Strong understanding of accounting principles, with solid exposure to Spanish GAAP and IFRS (including IFRS 16).

Knowledge or exposure to Belgian GAAP (BE GAAP) and Dutch GAAP / Dutch Financial Reporting Standards (NL GAAP) is highly desirable.

Experience working with ERP systems (e.g. SAP, Oracle, BC Media, Maconomy, or similar).

Strong Microsoft Excel skills and confidence working with digital finance, automation and AI-enabled tools.

High attention to detail and accuracy, with the ability to review and challenge accounting outputs.

Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and priorities with limited supervision.

Clear and professional communication skills, with the ability to coordinate stakeholders and explain accounting issues effectively.

job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

WPP is delivering a significant People Technology transformation, modernising the platforms, processes and data that underpin how we manage and support our people globally.

We’re looking for an experienced PMO Lead to sit at the centre of this transformation, bringing the structure, discipline and visibility needed to successfully deliver a complex, global programme. This is more than a reporting PMO role. You’ll create the governance, integrated planning and delivery controls that enable leaders to make informed decisions and teams to deliver effectively. You’ll connect multiple workstreams, make risks and dependencies visible, ensure actions translate into delivery, and provide a clear view of whether the programme is achieving its objectives and intended benefits.

Working across the intersection of People, Technology, HR processes, data and organisational change, you’ll partner closely with programme leadership, Workstream Leads and cross-functional teams to turn strategy into an executable plan and create the rhythm and discipline needed to deliver transformation at scale.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own and maintain the integrated programme plan, ensuring milestones, dependencies, deliverables and critical paths are clearly understood and actively managed.
  • Establish and maintain effective programme governance, providing appropriate control over scope, cost, timelines, risks and delivery.
  • Lead programme reporting, providing clear and insightful updates on progress, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions and areas requiring intervention.
  • Own the programme RAID process, proactively identifying risks and issues and ensuring clear mitigation, escalation and resolution plans are in place.
  • Coordinate dependencies across workstreams, ensuring actions have clear owners, deadlines and accountability through to closure.
  • Support and facilitate programme governance forums, ensuring decisions are captured and translated into clear actions and outcomes.
  • Establish and maintain the frameworks, processes, templates and programme documentation required to drive consistency and effective ways of working.
  • Ensure programme benefits are clearly defined, baselined and tracked, with appropriate business ownership and measurable outcomes.
  • Develop meaningful metrics and reporting to monitor programme performance and benefits realisation.
  • Partner with Workstream Leads and delivery teams to identify roadblocks, resolve delivery challenges and maintain momentum.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to project and workstream teams, championing strong programme management disciplines and collaborative ways of working.
  • Work across the wider organisation to identify interdependencies with other transformation initiatives and ensure these are reflected in programme planning.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve operational effectiveness and strengthen programme delivery.
  • Champion effective ways of working across globally dispersed and cross-functional teams.
  • Act as Project Manager for selected strategic initiatives or workstreams where additional delivery leadership is required

What you'll need:

  • Significant experience working as a PMO Lead, Senior PMO, Programme Manager or in a similar role within a large-scale transformation environment.
  • Strong programme management capability, with hands-on experience of integrated planning, governance, RAID management, dependency management and executive-level reporting.
  • Experience supporting complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, geographies and cross-functional teams.
  • Experience delivering People Technology, HR transformation or enterprise technology programmes would be highly valuable.

job.title: Governance Analyst
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Role Purpose

The Governance & Assurance Analyst supports WPP's governance, certification, assurance, and digital risk management activities.

The role helps maintain governance documentation, support certification and audit readiness activities, coordinate evidence collection, and contribute

to client assurance requests and governance reporting.

Working closely with Strategy & Risk, Technical Security Governance, Assurance, Privacy, Legal, Enterprise Technology, and business stakeholders,

the Governance & Assurance Analyst helps ensure governance processes remain effective, documentation remains current, and evidence required

for certifications, audits, and client assurance activities is readily available.

A key focus of the role is supporting the day-to-day operation of WPP's Information Security Management System (ISMS), maintaining certification

readiness, and coordinating governance and assurance activities across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities

Governance & Policy Support

Maintain governance frameworks, policies, standards, procedures, and related documentation.

Support periodic reviews and updates of governance artefacts.

Maintain mappings between policies, standards, controls, and certification requirements.

Assist with governance forums, working groups, and documentation reviews.

Support the preparation of governance materials, meeting outputs, and action tracking.

Provide research and analysis to support governance activities and decision-making.

Digital Risk Governance Support

Support governance reporting activities related to digital risk management.

Assist with the collection and analysis of governance-related metrics and indicators.

Maintain governance dashboards, scorecards, and reporting materials.

Track governance actions and follow-up activities.

Support reviews of governance processes and documentation.

ISO 27001 & Certification Support

Support the operation of the Information Security Management System (ISMS).

Coordinate activities required to support ISO 27001 certification and surveillance audits.

Maintain certification-related records, registers, and supporting documentation.

Coordinate evidence collection and stakeholder engagement activities required for audits.

Track audit findings, corrective actions, and improvement activities through to closure.

Support management review preparation and governance reporting.

Help maintain ongoing audit and certification readiness.

Client Assurance Support

Coordinate responses to client security, governance, risk, and compliance due diligence requests.

Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to gather information required for assurance activities.

Maintain reusable assurance content, responses, and supporting evidence.

Track assurance requests and response status.

Support the continuous improvement of assurance documentation and response quality.

Evidence Management & Audit Readiness

Maintain repositories used to support governance, certification, audit, and assurance activities.

Coordinate evidence collection across relevant business functions.

Ensure evidence is current, appropriately classified, and available for authorised use.

Maintain evidence ownership information, review dates, and supporting metadata.

Identify missing, outdated, or incomplete evidence and coordinate remediation activities.

Support internal, external, certification, client, and regulatory reviews through effective evidence coordination.

Reporting & Operational Improvement

Support the development of governance dashboards, scorecards, metrics, and reporting packs.

Analyse governance and assurance data to identify trends and reporting insights.

Support the standardisation of governance documentation, evidence collection, and reporting practices.

Identify opportunities for process improvements and raise recommendations to management.

Contribute to the continuous improvement of governance operational processes and reporting effectiveness.

Skills & Experience Required

Must-Haves

Fluent English, written and verbal.

Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Risk Management, Audit, Compliance, Business Administration, or a related discipline, or

equivalent relevant experience.

2-4 years of experience in governance, information security, compliance, audit, risk management, assurance, or a related discipline.

Experience supporting an ISO 27001-based management system, audit programme, or certification activity.

Understanding of governance frameworks, controls, audit principles, and certification requirements.

Experience supporting audits, assurance reviews, or certification activities.

Experience coordinating evidence collection and documentation activities.

Strong reporting, documentation, and organisational skills.

Ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Strong communication and stakeholder coordination skills.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a global environment.

Nice-to-Have

ISO 27001 Foundation, Lead Implementer, Lead Auditor, or similar qualification.

CISA, CISM, CRISC, CISSP, or equivalent certification.

Exposure to frameworks such as SOC 2, GDPR, NIS2, or similar.

Experience supporting client assurance or security questionnaire activities.

Experience using GRC, audit, compliance, or certification management platforms.

Experience within a large multinational organisation.

Key Behaviours & Competencies

Governance Awareness

Understands the importance of governance, accountability, and effective documentation in supporting organisational objectives.

Analytical Thinking

Uses structured analysis and evidence-based reasoning to support governance activities and reporting.

Quality Focus

Maintains attention to detail and supports high-quality governance and assurance outcomes.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Works effectively with stakeholders across business and technical teams.

Communication

Communicates clearly and professionally with a range of audiences.

Organisation & Planning

Demonstrates a structured approach to documentation, coordination, reporting, and action tracking.

Continuous Learning

Seeks opportunities to improve processes, skills, and ways of working.

Professional Integrity

Acts with objectivity, accountability, professionalism, and discretion.

What This Role Explicitly Does Not Do

This role does not:

Own governance frameworks, policies, or standards.

Own cyber security strategy.

Own enterprise risk management processes or risk registers.

Own Digital Risk Governance frameworks.

Make risk acceptance or risk treatment decisions.

Own technical security controls, security architecture, engineering, or operational security functions.

Perform incident response, vulnerability management, monitoring, or security operations activities.

Act as Internal Audit or provide independent assurance.

Own regulatory compliance programmes.

Serve as the accountable owner for ISO 27001 or certification outcomes.

Own the ISMS.

Design governance operating models or policy architectures.

Approve policies, standards, exceptions, or governance decisions unless formally authorised.

Replace the accountability of risk owners, control owners, policy owners, or business stakeholders.

job.title: Head of Inclusion Partnerships and Industry Engagement
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

ABOUT WPP

WPP is undergoing its most significant structural transformation in decades. Through Elevate28, we are moving from a holding company model to a single integrated operating company. The EVP WPP is building for the Elevate28 era is anchored on five dimensions – one of which is Inclusion & Belonging. This role ensures WPP shows up in the industry as one company and as a recognised leader in inclusive practice.

Within this transformation, WPP’s Inclusion & Impact (I&I) team is pioneering an innovative, enterprise-wide approach that moves decisively beyond traditional DEI. We treat inclusion as a strategic business enabler—designing and embedding scalable, measurable, and innovative practices directly into our business operations, creative work, client relationships, and workplace culture to shape meaningful behavioral change. This role ensures WPP show up across the creative, marketing, and media ecosystem as one unified company and recognized voice in inclusive practice.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Head of Inclusion Partnerships & Industry Engagement is an enterprise-wide strategic, advisory, and ambassadorial leader who defines where and how WPP shows up globally for inclusion and impact. This role consolidates historically fragmented decisions into a unified WPP strategy—curating where we invest our brand equity, which strategic partners we ally with, which major industry stages we command, and which recognition benchmarks we pursue.

This is a brand positioning, external engagement, and strategically influential role, centered in inclusion. Operating at the intersection of brand reputation, industry engagement, and modern inclusion, you bring deep agency ecosystem fluency and the presence to build immediate credibility with senior executives, brand marketers, and cultural changemakers. You will establish rigorous investment criteria, steward a dedicated global budget, and serve as an articulate champion for WPP—shaping industry behavior, reinforcing client trust, activating diverse talent pipelines, and earning industry recognition.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Strategic Inclusion Partnership & Investment Strategy (40%)
    Establish a criteria-led, enterprise approach to external alliances and partners.
  • Partnership Strategy: Set the global framework for identifying, assessing, and prioritising external inclusion partners, industry bodies, and community organizations – ensuring alignment to the Inclusion & Impact Strategy.
  • Sponsorship Governance: Build and lead an enterprise intake and evaluation model for global industry partnerships, transitioning legacy, ad-hoc agency investments into a cohesive, high-impact One WPP investment strategy.
  • Investment Allocations: Recommend annual allocations from the dedicated sponsorship budget based on strategic fit, audience, and expected impact. Spend tracking and vendor administration sit with P&C Operations and GBS.
  • Partnership Portfolio Leadership: Direct the overall partnership lifecycle – including renewals, tiering, strategic evolution – with guidance from the Inclusion Partnerships & Client Engagement Lead.

Key KPIs & Objectives:

  • Establish Partnership & Sponsorship Framework, with tiering, selection criteria, and an intake process for event and sponsorship requests.
  • Set an Annual Sponsorship Investment Plan recommended and approved within the allocated budget.
  • Consolidate Legacy agency-level commitments into high-yield, unified enterprise partnerships
  1. Industry Presence & Engagement (35%)
    Positioning WPP as a global growth partner centered on inclusion
  • Event Activation: Lead WPP’s inclusion presence at priority industry moments (e.g., Cannes Lions, Advertising Week, CES, Campaign, Adobe Summit), embedding I&I into mainstage programming, brand roundtables, and other engagements.
  • Frontline Ambassador: Serve as a representative, building relationships with partners, clients, and industry leaders across a range of settings and audiences.
  • Thought Leadership Curation: Translate progressive organizational practices into compelling public narratives; collaborate with Regional Inclusion Directors and MarComms to prepare, position, and amplify diverse executive voices, ERG leaders, and breakthrough creative talent on international stages.
  • Client Co-Creation & Alignment: Partner with client-facing agency leads and the Inclusion Partnerships & Client Engagement Lead to design joint, values-aligned thought leadership platforms and client-partner roundtables that deepen brand relationships.
  • Talent Pipeline Integration: Partner with Talent Acquisition to ensure global sponsorships and partnerships alliances actively generate pathways for emerging, diverse creative and strategic talent.

Key KPIs & Objectives:

  • Launch comprehensive Global Industry Activation Plan, that includes details on key messaging and objectives
  • Co-create diverse WPP Thought Leadership & Speaker Bureau.
  • Curate relationships with partners and clients to support business growth and inclusion client opportunities for ongoing engagement.
  1. Industry Recognition, Influence & Impact Measurement (25%)
    Earning recognition for WPP’s inclusive practices through industry benchmarks and measurable business impact.
  • Global Recognition Strategy: Define and lead the enterprise awards and recognition roadmap, identifying high-credibility global, regional, and industry inclusive benchmarks.
  • Integrated Benchmarking Process: Run a shared awards process with Regional Inclusion Directors, GBS team, and the Global Head of Inclusion & Impact.

job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

 

Title: Lead Software Engineer

Level: Lead Engineer, Data & Technology Solutions

Location: Copenhagen

Reporting to: Director of Engineering

About Open Intelligence:

We are the Activation arm of WPP Open Intelligence. Our team builds the foundational data infrastructure and high-performance edge services that power WPP’s position in the market. With approximately one-third of all global media spend flowing through WPP, our platform operates at the core of this massive network-deeply integrated and adopted by the largest supply-side partners in the AdTech industry. Operating at our scale presents unique engineering challenges. Our edge services currently handle over 60,000 classification requests per second, while our contextual classification pipelines process 10,000 requests per second. With operations spanning the US, UK, and ongoing expansion into EMEA and APAC, our infrastructure continuously interacts with up to 98% of the population in our active markets. We are an engineering-led team focused on building robust, scalable, and highly reliable systems.

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer who thrives on owning backend systems end to end — architecture, delivery, and the people who build them. You care more about sound software design, reliable APIs, and clear ownership than about any single framework or language.

You are comfortable setting technical direction for a squad, mentoring engineers, and turning product roadmap into shippable, versioned contracts. Hands-on when it matters, you design and operate services, partner integrations, and orchestration components in production — authentication, retries, idempotency, rate limiting, and the operational discipline that keeps live systems healthy. You are likely highly proficient in a backend language such as Python, Go, or Java/Kotlin, and experienced with cloud platforms, containers/Kubernetes, CI/CD, and production observability. Interest in infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform), durable workflows, and AI coding assistants is a plus when it helps the team ship faster without lowering the quality bar.

Beyond the technical craft, you are a strong communicator who can explain trade-offs to engineers, Product, and non-technical stakeholders, and align sibling teams on interfaces. You take ownership of reliability and technical debt for the systems your squad runs, escalate blockers early with clear options, and are motivated by growing both the platform and the engineers who build it.

 

WHY ARE WE HIRING We are at a critical inflection point in our growth and need to scale our engineering team to tackle an expanding set of complex challenges. As the digital ecosystem evolves, we are actively developing and releasing a new catalog of privacy-preserving data products. These solutions are designed to scale advanced targeting capabilities while remaining uncompromising on our promise to protect user privacy.

To support this product evolution, our infrastructure is undergoing massive global expansion. By the end of this year, we will be fully operational across the rest of the EMEA and APAC regions. Concurrently, we are deepening our integrations to support even more of the largest supply-side partners in the AdTech industry. We are hiring because we need strong engineering talent to help us architect for this next order of magnitude in scale-ensuring our systems remain resilient, performant, and compliant as our global footprint and feature set rapidly expand.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

· Lead an engineering squad: set technical direction, prioritize delivery, run design and code reviews, and grow engineers through mentoring and clear ownership.

· Own the architecture and health of activation and orchestration services — API, databases, partner gateways, internal integrations, MCP and agentic integrations.

· Partner with Product and sibling teams to turn roadmap phases into shippable, versioned contracts — not ad hoc

integrations.

· Drive API integration engineering: authentication, rate limiting, idempotency, retries, partial-update patterns, and runbooks as partner APIs evolve.

· Establish and uphold production standards — CI/CD, testing, observability, auditability, and safe release practices.

· Keep an end-to-end overview of how data flow through activation — what is live, what is in progress, and where dependencies or technical debt block the next phase.

· Contribute hands-on where it matters: critical paths, new gateways, framework foundations (e.g. tool registry, workflow runtime, guardrails hooks).

· Identify and address technical debt deliberately; balance speed with reliability for systems that support live campaigns.

· Share knowledge in design reviews, stand-ups, and cross-team forums; escalate blockers early with clear options.

· Stay curious about agentic orchestration, durable workflows, and AI coding assistants to improve how the team designs and ships software.

 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

· Strong communication — you explain trade-offs to engineers, product, and non-technical stakeholders and align multiple teams on interfaces.

· 6+ years in software engineering with 2+ years leading engineers or owning a significant technical area (team lead, staff, or equivalent).

· Proven delivery of backend and API-centric systems in production — services, integrations, or platforms at meaningful scale.

· Solid experience building and operating REST/HTTP APIs and event- or workflow-driven systems (durable state, async jobs, or orchestration).

· Comfort owning third-party integrations — auth, errors, versioning, operational monitoring, and partner-driven change.

· Strong proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g. Python, Go, or Java/Kotlin) and sound software design (patterns, testing, code review).

· Experience with CI/CD, Git, and testing — unit, integration, and boundary/contract tests where APIs matter.

· Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and deploying services with containers and Kubernetes.

· Familiarity with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform) and production observability (metrics, logs, tracing).

· A track record of technical debt and reliability ownership — incidents, postmortems, and systemic fixes, not one-off firefighting.

· Interest in leveraging AI coding assistants and prompt engineering to improve team productivity without lowering the production bar.

 

NICE TO HAVE

· Experience leading delivery of orchestration, workflow, or agentic systems (tool registries, policy/guardrails, human-in-the-loop flows).

· Full-stack exposure — internal UIs or ops tools (e.g. change logs, escalations) backed by the same APIs you own.

· Familiarity with AdTech / MarTech — SSPs, DSPs, deals, audiences, or campaign activation terminology.

· Experience in a monorepo or large shared codebase with many integration surfaces.

· Awareness of data privacy and safe handling of sensitive data in distributed deployments.

· Prior work on audit trails or decision logs for high-trust or automated systems.

If you are ready to be at the forefront of the AdTech industry, shaping its future, and driving success for both our clients, we encourage you to apply and join our team.

WPP Shared Service Centre (SSC)

The WPP SSC provides transactional financial services to WPP companies in the UK, including:

-             Accounts Payable, including Intercompany transactions

-             Accounts Receivable (Billing, Credit Control & Cash Allocation)

-             Treasury

-             Accounting and Reporting

-             Statutory Reporting

By consolidating activities, the WPP SSC takes advantage of volume to deliver increased efficiency.  This is achieved by standardising, streamlining, and aligning relevant processes, and introducing tools and technology to drive effectiveness across our operations. By taking over transactional financial activities, the WPP SSC enables our agencies to focus on commercial activities, client management as well as revenue and cost management.

In 2021, the WPP SSC UK organisation transferred specific process and transactional activities to the WPP SSC in India. The WPP SSC teams in the UK and India work together to provide services to WPP companies in the UK.

Why we're hiring:

The WPP SSC is on a global transformation journey, and this is an opportunity to join the UK team to help us deliver exceptional financial services to our UK companies.

What you'll be doing:

Management and delivery of the Statutory reporting for all UK registered entities at Companies House.  This role will report into the Head of Global Statutory Reporting.

  • The team manages the delivery of approximately 150 UK statutory accounts annually;
  • End-to-end production of statutory accounts using both an excel template for data collection and input on our statutory reporting software system, including generation of iXBRL files;
  • Key contact along with the Head of Global Statutory Reporting for CFOs, Finance Directors and Financial Controllers on statutory reporting requirements, issues and associated questions;
  • Working with the Head of Global Statutory Reporting to onboard a number of new operating companies supported by GBS UK for their statutory reporting needs;
  • Key point of contact for external auditors on statutory audit related issues and questions; to provide guidance and advice on auditing, audit tests and SoX guidelines across GBS UK;
  • Collation of corporation tax packs, working with the operating company teams on submission to the Group’s tax consultants to ensure timely submission of corporate tax returns;
  • The department also assists with the dissolutions of WPP Holding and operating companies in conjunction with WPP Legal, WPP Tax and the operating companies;
  • Review accounting step plans for dissolutions and assist WPP Legal in writing up the legal documentation surrounding dissolutions;

What you'll need:

  • Qualified accountant (ACA/ACCA) with strong technical accounting skills
  • Experience of reporting under IFRS and in a SOX control environment;
  • Experience producing UK statutory accounts for multiple entities using statutory reporting software (ideally Caseware or Workiva);
  • Experience dealing with external auditors and ability to drive the audit process;
  • Excellent communication skills – able to communicate effectively both internally and externally, verbally and in writing, as well as at different levels of an organization;
  • Commercially focused with a proactive service-oriented approach;
  • Able to build and maintain strong internal and external working relationships;

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail;

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

About WPP Open:

Built on WPP IP and owned technology, and strengthened by strategic partnerships with leading technology firms, WPP Open leverages decades of experience serving enterprise clients to deliver highly optimised, automated and transformative marketing solutions that elevate brand experiences, push the boundaries of creativity and drive measurable growth.

Role Summary:

The WPP Open Product Analyst plays a crucial role in the successful deployment and adoption of the WPP Open platform within agency and client teams.  This individual acts as a bridge between client needs and the platform's capabilities, ensuring seamless integration and optimal user experience.  The Product Analyst is responsible for gathering and documenting requirements, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders, managing project scope, and supporting the overall workspace delivery process.

Role Requirements:

  • Partnering with Agency/Clients: Collaborate with Agency/Client Leads to finalize project scope, ensuring alignment between agency/client needs and platform capabilities.
  • Needs Analysis: Conduct thorough internal gap analyses to identify discrepancies between the WPP Open platform's current capabilities and specific client requirements.
  • Feature Request Management: Work closely with Professional Services Product Lead to capture and articulate requirements for new client features and platform enhancements.
  • Platform Demonstrations: Showcase the capabilities of the WPP Open platform to agency/client teams through compelling live demos and video recordings.
  • Stakeholder Management: Identify and engage key stakeholders across agency/client teams to define workspace requirements, manage expectations, and ensure effective communication.
  • Workspace Personalization: Where appropriate gather requirements for workspace personalization, including look and feel, widgets, content integration, and quick links.
  • Branding & Theming: Collect theming and identity parameters such as colour palettes, brand books, and image libraries to ensure consistent branding within the workspace.
  • Design Collaboration: Work with the WPP Open design team to develop prototypes for homepages, hubs, and Learning Spaces, incorporating feedback and iterating on designs.
  • Sign-off Management: Secure sign-off on homepage/hub/Learning Space designs from agency/client teams.
  • Campaign Structure Mapping: Identify campaign structure and translate it into requirements for the Open Hierarchy structure within the platform.
  • User Management: Understand agency/client team structures and set up user groups and permissions to optimize platform utilization and collaboration.
  • Use Case Documentation: Document agency/client use cases and acceptance criteria for the WPP Open platform, creating a valuable knowledge base for future reference.
  • Tool Configuration: Understand supported agency/client 3rd party tool requirements and ensure proper configuration within the WPP Open environment.
  • Workflow Mapping: Conduct ways-of-working workshops to identify end-to-end campaign processes for both agency and client teams, mapping these processes within the WPP Open workflow management system capabilities.
  • Process Visualization: Partner with the WPP design team to visualize campaign processes and create detailed process pages within the platform capabilities.
  • Approval Process Implementation: Identify touchpoints between agency and client teams in workflow and implement streamlined approval processes within the platform capabilities.
  • Adoption Support: Partner with the Adoption Lead to develop and execute UAT/Pilot/Adoption plans, including conducting live demo sessions during these phases.

Desired Skills and Experiences:

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Business, Marketing, Technology).

job.title: Product Manager, OI Activate
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

You're disrupting AdTech from inside one of the world's largest media companies—with startup velocity and enterprise muscle to make SSPs and agencies move. We're building Open Intelligence Activation, a programmable platform enabling cross-channel audience orchestration, supply-side targeting, and activation across SSP partners and Publishers. 

This isn't feature-shipping. It's product leadership where your AdTech expertise, AI-powered strategy, and go-to-market conviction directly determine whether our products reshape how agencies activate audiences at scale. 

What you'll be doing:

What You Own 

AdTech Strategy & Market Intelligence 

  • Deep understanding of programmatic ecosystems, SSP partner incentives, and supply-side dynamics 
  • Expertise in cross-channel audience creation (CTV, display, video) 
  • Use AI to synthesize competitive intelligence, market research, and customer feedback into strategic opportunities 
  • Stay obsessed with where the market is heading; use AI to stress-test concepts and anticipate partner objections 

Go-to-Market as Product Strategy 

  • Ensure partner alignment before launch—SSPs, agencies, and tech vendors understand not just what we built, but why they should care 
  • Develop positioning narratives that differentiate us (why this reshapes cross-channel activation, not just another feature) 
  • Own launch readiness: sales collateral, partner enablement, and customer success playbooks are battle-tested before go-live 
  • Collaborate with Supply and Demand team so messaging is tightly aligned across all stakeholder groups 

Execution & Prioritization 

  • Maintain a prioritized, outcome-focused product backlog 
  • Translate product vision into clear requirements and user stories with Engineering 
  • Ship, learn, iterate—fast cycles beat perfect planning 
  • Ruthlessly kill features that don't move the needle 
  • Work closely with Design, Data, and cross-functional teams to unblock and drive adoption 

 

Who you'll be working with:

Global advertising agencies are finally innovating in AdTech—and we're leading. We have the technical capability to build what agencies need, the enterprise relationship muscle to make SSP partners move, and the startup velocity to iterate faster than incumbents. We're literally on the edge of what's possible in supply-side targeting and cross-channel orchestration. 

What you'll need:

AdTech Expertise  

  • 5+ years in AdTech/MarTech product, sales, or strategy 
  • Deep understanding of programmatic advertising, SSP ecosystems, supply-side dynamics, and agency workflows 
  • Familiarity with cross-channel activation (CTV, display, video) Behavioral and contextual targeting 
  • Track record of shipping products that agencies or partners adopted 

Founder Mentality 

  • Uncomfortable managing process instead of driving outcomes 
  • Have conviction and communicate it compellingly 
  • Willing to take calculated risks and iterate 
  • Seen products fail and succeed—you know what makes the difference 

AI-Forward & Go-to-Market Focused 

  • Comfortable using AI as research and thinking partner for competitive analysis, market synthesis, and rapid ideation 
  • You've successfully launched products with Sales/Marketing alignment 
  • Understand that product success requires narrative alignment across engineering, sales, and strategy 
  • Hands-on in drafting positioning frameworks, use cases, and enablement materials 
  • Product Marketing experience a plus 

Execution Excellence 

  • Comfortable operating with incomplete information and making decisions anyway 
  • Detail-oriented on user stories and acceptance criteria, but never lose sight of strategy 
  • Communicate clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders 
  • Work effectively within Agile frameworks without being religious about ceremony

job.title: Product Owner
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

About WPP Open: 

WPP Open is at the forefront of transforming how WPP delivers value to its clients. We are building a unified product ecosystem that empowers our agencies and clients with cutting-edge tools and data-driven insights. Our product organisation is driven by a clear vision, strategic execution, and a commitment to continuous innovation.

The Opportunity: 

We are seeking a highly autonomous and results-driven Senior Product Owner to join our WPP Open product team. In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in driving the execution and optimisation of a critical, often specialised, product capability.

You will translate defined product strategies into meticulously prioritised and actionable backlogs, proactively guide complex feature sets through the development lifecycle, and ensure the delivery of measurable, high-impact product outcomes.

You will work closely with Product leadership, engineering teams, and various stakeholders to deliver value that directly contributes to WPP Open's success. This role requires deep domain expertise, a strong understanding of agile methodologies, exceptional communication skills, and a relentless focus on delivering value to users and the business.

What you'll do:

Complex Product Backlog Ownership & Execution Leadership:

  • Own and manage complex or high-impact product backlogs for your designated, often specialised, product capability. Ensure these backlogs are meticulously prioritised, well-defined, and directly support the overarching product strategy and roadmap defined by the Product Lead.
  • Drive the execution of the product roadmap for your capability, translating strategic objectives into actionable epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality solutions.
  • Focus on defining clear, measurable outcomes for each initiative and feature, and track progress against these metrics, providing regular updates to the Product Lead.

 Proactive Requirement Definition & Refinement:

  • Translate defined product strategy and user needs into clear, concise, and actionable epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that lead to clear, testable outcomes.
  • Proactively engage with engineering and design to refine requirements, identify technical dependencies, and ensure feasibility and optimal implementation for complex features.
  • Act as the primary source of truth for the development team regarding product requirements and user needs for your specialised capability.

 Cross-functional Orchestration & Collaboration:

  • Act as the central orchestrator within your agile development team, working closely with engineering teams, UX/UI designers, and other product stakeholders throughout the entire product development lifecycle, from concept to release.
  • Drive alignment and resolve impediments within the development team to ensure smooth and efficient delivery of complex features.
  • Facilitate agile ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews) to ensure effective team collaboration and progress.

Strategic Stakeholder Engagement & Communication:

  • Proactively engage with relevant stakeholders, including Product leads, engineering leads, and end-users, to gather feedback, clarify requirements, and ensure strong alignment for your product capability.
  • Communicate product progress, plans, and insights to your Product leads and relevant stakeholders, ensuring clarity in complex discussions with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Articulate the "why" behind product decisions at the feature level and the measurable impact of delivered features.

Continuous Improvement & Optimisation:

  • Establish and manage robust mechanisms for gathering user feedback, analysing product performance data, and identifying areas for continuous improvement within your product capability.
  • Translate insights from market performance, user feedback, and data analytics directly back into the product backlog and inform the Product Leads of potential strategic adjustments.
  • Champion continuous optimisation of features post-launch, ensuring they meet user needs and business objectives.

Mentorship & Guidance (Informal):

  • Act as a subject matter expert and informal mentor to less experienced Product Owners or Product Analysts, sharing best practices and contributing to their professional development and the overall product team's capabilities.

Complex Problem Solving & Decision Making:

  • Analyse and resolve complex product-related problems within your capability, collaborating with the Product Lead and engineering to find efficient and effective solutions.
  • Demonstrate strong prioritisation and decision-making skills for your product backlog, especially under ambiguity, to ensure the most valuable features are delivered and the product area's strategic goals are met.

 Contribution to Product Strategy (Informative):

  • Actively contribute insights and data from your product capability to inform the Product Lead's strategic direction and the overall WPP Open product vision and roadmap.
  • Ensure your product area's backlog consistently aligns with the defined product strategy and broader strategic themes and business objectives.

 What you'll need:

  • 4+ years of progressive experience in product ownership or a similar role, with a demonstrable track record of successfully driving complex product features and capabilities from definition to launch and beyond.
  • Proven ability to own, manage, and prioritise complex or high-impact product backlogs, ensuring alignment with defined product strategies and measurable business outcomes.
  • Deep domain expertise in a critical product capability, demonstrating the ability to handle significant technical or business complexity.
  • Strong understanding and practical experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban). Agile certification (e.g., CSPO, SAFe PO/PM) is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional ability to translate high-level product strategy into clear, concise, and actionable epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, demonstrating a deep understanding of technical considerations, constraints, and opportunities.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional development teams to achieve shared goals, acting as a leader within the team.
  • A strong analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data and user feedback to inform product decisions, measure success, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Ability to analyse and resolve complex problems within the scope of your product capability, collaborating effectively with Product Leads and engineering.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication style to suit different audiences (technical and non-technical) and effectively articulate complex product concepts and execution rationale.
  • Proven ability to proactively engage with Product Leads, engineering leads, and other stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and contribute to the efficient delivery of the product roadmap.
  • A strong track record of successfully delivering features from concept to release in multiple sprints, with a focus on achieving clear, testable outcomes and demonstrating accountability for post-launch performance.

Why WPP Open? At WPP Open, you'll be part of a pioneering team building the future of marketing and advertising. We offer a collaborative and innovative environment where your contributions will have a tangible impact on product delivery and user experience. You'll have the opportunity to work on challenging projects, grow your skills, and shape the product landscape for one of the world's leading creative transformation companies.

Join us and help us build the future of WPP!

Who you are:

You're open: we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

Passionate, inspired people – we champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work

Scale and opportunity – we offer the opportunity to create, influence and deliver projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers.

job.title: Professional Services Solution Consultant
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Role summary:

The Solution Consultant is a trusted advisor and hands-on solution partner within Professional Services. The role combines solution consulting, business and product analysis, technical understanding, stakeholder management, project management, and disciplined delivery thinking.

Working across agency and client teams, Product, Engineering, Growth, Enablement, Training, Support and delivery colleagues, the consultant discovers needs, shapes requirements, designs and demonstrates solutions, supports scoping and implementation, and feeds learning back into reusable patterns and product improvements.

Success means clients and WPP teams understand what is possible, requirements are clear before delivery starts, proven capabilities are configured appropriately, hand-offs are clean, and repeatable solutions can be deployed with less friction and faster time to value.

Key responsibilities:

Discovery & requirements:

  • Lead structured discovery with agency, client and internal stakeholders to understand objectives, users, workflows, data, constraints and expected outcomes.
  • Analyse current-state processes, usage and needs, separating problems to solve from requested features.
  • Translate needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, solution specifications and, where required, scope inputs for statements of work.
  • Identify dependencies, assumptions, risks and gaps early, and ensure the right Product, Engineering, Enterprise Solutions or Professional Services owners are engaged.

Solution design & consulting:

  • Map business needs to proven, ready-to-deploy WPP Open capabilities and recommend an appropriate foundation or configured solution.
  • Design and present solution options that explain the value, trade-offs, dependencies and delivery implications in language suited to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Create and deliver demonstrations that show how selected WPP Open capabilities address the defined use case.
  • Support business-case and value-realisation thinking by linking the proposed solution to measurable client or operational outcomes.

Technical & platform expertise:

  • Build and maintain strong knowledge of WPP Open architecture, capabilities, agents, configuration options, data and integration touchpoints.
  • Stay current on platform releases, capabilities and deployment guidance, and distinguish proven, scalable capabilities from functionality still in development or testing.

Delivery partnership & quality:

  • Partner with Project Managers, Product Analysts, Deployment Specialists, Configuration Admins and implementation teams from scope through go-live and handover.
  • Ensure solution intent, requirements and acceptance criteria remain traceable through configuration, testing and delivery.
  • Support UAT, solution validation and issue resolution, escalating material scope, quality or dependency risks through the appropriate delivery route.
  • Contribute to clear handovers into Enablement, Training or Support where those teams own the next stage of adoption.

Project management & delivery coordination:

  • Develop and maintain clear delivery plans that define milestones, dependencies, ownership, decision points and critical path activities for assigned engagements.
  • Coordinate day-to-day project activity across stakeholders, ensuring actions are tracked, blockers are surfaced early and progress remains visible to the right delivery and leadership audiences.
  • Maintain disciplined RAID management, including proactive identification of risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies, with clear mitigation plans and escalation routes.
  • Support governance routines such as status reporting, checkpoint reviews, decision logs and delivery readiness assessments, ensuring stakeholders have confidence in progress and next steps.
  • Balance speed, scope and quality by making delivery trade-offs explicit, aligning expectations early and ensuring changes are assessed for impact before commitments are made.
  • Drive clean closure by confirming acceptance criteria, documenting outcomes, capturing lessons learned and ensuring handover routes are agreed before the engagement is considered complete.

Scale, product feedback & continuous improvement:

  • Convert lessons from engagements into reusable solution patterns, templates, playbooks and configuration standards.
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on recurring client needs, friction, feature gaps and opportunities for improvement.
  • Help standardise intake and scoping so requests arrive with the information needed to route and estimate work accurately.
  • Use delivery and usage evidence to identify opportunities to improve solution quality, reduce avoidable effort and accelerate time to value.

Stakeholder relationships:

  • Act as a credible, pragmatic bridge between business, product and technology stakeholders.
  • Build trust through transparent recommendations, clear documentation, realistic commitments and proactive communication.
  • Work collaboratively across WPP, maintaining client-team ownership of client relationships while providing the expertise needed to make good solution decisions.
Skills & experience:
  • 5+ years of experience in solutions consulting, business analysis, product analysis, implementation consulting or a comparable role, ideally within marketing technology or professional services.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with experience turning ambiguous business needs into structured, actionable requirements and solution options.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation and facilitation skills, including the ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working across product, engineering, delivery and commercial stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Working knowledge of Agile delivery and backlog practices, including user stories, acceptance criteria and prioritisation.
  • Ability to manage and coordinate the intake of features and change requests, clarifying need, priority, impact and ownership so requests can be translated into actionable outcomes.
  • Understanding of digital marketing technology and related cloud, data, integration and workflow concepts.
  • Experience with platform implementation, configuration, adoption or service design is advantageous.
  • Experience with WPP Open, agent deployment, API integration, data modelling, Jira/Confluence or process-mapping tools
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, make sound trade-offs and maintain high-quality documentation and stakeholder communication.
Working principles:
  • Client value first: recommend capability because it improves an outcome, not simply because it exists.
  • Deliver what is available: favour proven, ready-to-deploy capabilities and be explicit about anything that is not yet scaled.
  • Enable the enablers: design solutions and handovers so administrators, champions and enablement teams can sustain adoption.
  • Client teams stay in control: provide expertise behind the scenes while respecting ownership of client conversations and ongoing relationships.
The person:

You are curious, structured and commercially aware, with enough technical depth to be credible with engineers and enough empathy and communication skill to make complexity understandable. You are comfortable challenging unclear requirements, bringing the right people together and turning a good bespoke answer into a better repeatable pattern. Above all, you focus on outcomes: dependable delivery that builds trust, scalable ways of working and faster realisation of value from WPP Open.

Who you are:

You're open: we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – we champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work

Scale and opportunity – we offer the opportunity to create, influence and deliver projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.
