job.title: Professional Services Solution Consultant
job.description:

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Role summary:

The Solution Consultant is a trusted advisor and hands-on solution partner within Professional Services. The role combines solution consulting, business and product analysis, technical understanding, stakeholder management, project management, and disciplined delivery thinking.

Working across agency and client teams, Product, Engineering, Growth, Enablement, Training, Support and delivery colleagues, the consultant discovers needs, shapes requirements, designs and demonstrates solutions, supports scoping and implementation, and feeds learning back into reusable patterns and product improvements.

Success means clients and WPP teams understand what is possible, requirements are clear before delivery starts, proven capabilities are configured appropriately, hand-offs are clean, and repeatable solutions can be deployed with less friction and faster time to value.

Key responsibilities:

Discovery & requirements:

  • Lead structured discovery with agency, client and internal stakeholders to understand objectives, users, workflows, data, constraints and expected outcomes.
  • Analyse current-state processes, usage and needs, separating problems to solve from requested features.
  • Translate needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, solution specifications and, where required, scope inputs for statements of work.
  • Identify dependencies, assumptions, risks and gaps early, and ensure the right Product, Engineering, Enterprise Solutions or Professional Services owners are engaged.

Solution design & consulting:

  • Map business needs to proven, ready-to-deploy WPP Open capabilities and recommend an appropriate foundation or configured solution.
  • Design and present solution options that explain the value, trade-offs, dependencies and delivery implications in language suited to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Create and deliver demonstrations that show how selected WPP Open capabilities address the defined use case.
  • Support business-case and value-realisation thinking by linking the proposed solution to measurable client or operational outcomes.

Technical & platform expertise:

  • Build and maintain strong knowledge of WPP Open architecture, capabilities, agents, configuration options, data and integration touchpoints.
  • Stay current on platform releases, capabilities and deployment guidance, and distinguish proven, scalable capabilities from functionality still in development or testing.

Delivery partnership & quality:

  • Partner with Project Managers, Product Analysts, Deployment Specialists, Configuration Admins and implementation teams from scope through go-live and handover.
  • Ensure solution intent, requirements and acceptance criteria remain traceable through configuration, testing and delivery.
  • Support UAT, solution validation and issue resolution, escalating material scope, quality or dependency risks through the appropriate delivery route.
  • Contribute to clear handovers into Enablement, Training or Support where those teams own the next stage of adoption.

Project management & delivery coordination:

  • Develop and maintain clear delivery plans that define milestones, dependencies, ownership, decision points and critical path activities for assigned engagements.
  • Coordinate day-to-day project activity across stakeholders, ensuring actions are tracked, blockers are surfaced early and progress remains visible to the right delivery and leadership audiences.
  • Maintain disciplined RAID management, including proactive identification of risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies, with clear mitigation plans and escalation routes.
  • Support governance routines such as status reporting, checkpoint reviews, decision logs and delivery readiness assessments, ensuring stakeholders have confidence in progress and next steps.
  • Balance speed, scope and quality by making delivery trade-offs explicit, aligning expectations early and ensuring changes are assessed for impact before commitments are made.
  • Drive clean closure by confirming acceptance criteria, documenting outcomes, capturing lessons learned and ensuring handover routes are agreed before the engagement is considered complete.

Scale, product feedback & continuous improvement:

  • Convert lessons from engagements into reusable solution patterns, templates, playbooks and configuration standards.
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on recurring client needs, friction, feature gaps and opportunities for improvement.
  • Help standardise intake and scoping so requests arrive with the information needed to route and estimate work accurately.
  • Use delivery and usage evidence to identify opportunities to improve solution quality, reduce avoidable effort and accelerate time to value.

Stakeholder relationships:

  • Act as a credible, pragmatic bridge between business, product and technology stakeholders.
  • Build trust through transparent recommendations, clear documentation, realistic commitments and proactive communication.
  • Work collaboratively across WPP, maintaining client-team ownership of client relationships while providing the expertise needed to make good solution decisions.
Skills & experience:
  • 5+ years of experience in solutions consulting, business analysis, product analysis, implementation consulting or a comparable role, ideally within marketing technology or professional services.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with experience turning ambiguous business needs into structured, actionable requirements and solution options.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation and facilitation skills, including the ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working across product, engineering, delivery and commercial stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Working knowledge of Agile delivery and backlog practices, including user stories, acceptance criteria and prioritisation.
  • Ability to manage and coordinate the intake of features and change requests, clarifying need, priority, impact and ownership so requests can be translated into actionable outcomes.
  • Understanding of digital marketing technology and related cloud, data, integration and workflow concepts.
  • Experience with platform implementation, configuration, adoption or service design is advantageous.
  • Experience with WPP Open, agent deployment, API integration, data modelling, Jira/Confluence or process-mapping tools
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, make sound trade-offs and maintain high-quality documentation and stakeholder communication.
Working principles:
  • Client value first: recommend capability because it improves an outcome, not simply because it exists.
  • Deliver what is available: favour proven, ready-to-deploy capabilities and be explicit about anything that is not yet scaled.
  • Enable the enablers: design solutions and handovers so administrators, champions and enablement teams can sustain adoption.
  • Client teams stay in control: provide expertise behind the scenes while respecting ownership of client conversations and ongoing relationships.
The person:

You are curious, structured and commercially aware, with enough technical depth to be credible with engineers and enough empathy and communication skill to make complexity understandable. You are comfortable challenging unclear requirements, bringing the right people together and turning a good bespoke answer into a better repeatable pattern. Above all, you focus on outcomes: dependable delivery that builds trust, scalable ways of working and faster realisation of value from WPP Open.

You're open: we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

Scale and opportunity – we offer the opportunity to create, influence and deliver projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers.

Why we’re hiring

WPP is seeking a versatile and highly capable Senior People Partner to join our Corporate People Team and based in New York. This role will serve as a trusted right hand to the VP, People, North America while providing dedicated People partnership to assigned global functions, likely including Finance and People subfunctions. We are a company and a function driving critical simplification and modernization. Agility and judgement has never been more important in our work – and that is our global team mindset.

The Senior People Partner will support the employee experience for more than 600 WPP HQ employees in the US. This includes coordinating annual People core process cycles, overseeing hiring and onboarding activities, responding to employee and leader needs, and serving as a point of escalation for our global team of HR Business Partners on US-centric matters.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can move easily between strategic, operational, and administrative work as a key member of a global HRBP team. One day may involve helping a leader navigate a sensitive employee matter; the next may include coordinating a hiring exception, validating Workday data, updating an orientation presentation, or drafting communications for the annual compensation cycle.

The right person will bring strong judgment, discretion, warmth, resourcefulness, and exceptional follow-through. They will be comfortable with ambiguity, energized by change, and motivated to find practical solutions to whatever comes their way.

What you’ll do

People partnership and US support

  • Serve as the People Partner for assigned global corporate functions, building trusted relationships with senior leaders and employees in New York and other locations.  The portfolio may evolve as business needs change.
  • Develop an understanding of each HQ function’s business priorities, organizational structure, talent, and ways of working.
  • Advise leaders on day-to-day People matters, including organizational changes, workforce planning, performance management, employee engagement, and team effectiveness.
  • Serve as a trusted right hand to the VP, People, helping translate priorities into action and ensuring decisions and commitments are carried through.
  • Help support the broader experience of WPP’s 600+ HQ employees in the US.
  • Act as a point of escalation for HR Business Partners on US-centric People matters, resolving issues within the role’s scope and escalating to the VP, People when appropriate.
  • Partner closely with Finance, Legal, Employee Relations, and other specialist teams on sensitive or higher-risk matters.
  • Help oversee and support WPP’s US Executive Assistant population, including hiring, onboarding, performance, development, and employee experience needs.

Annual People cycles and communications

  • Coordinate annual People processes, including goal setting, performance reviews, salary and bonus planning, stock planning, and related talent activities.
  • Develop project plans, timelines, trackers, presentations, FAQs, manager resources, and other materials needed to execute these programs successfully.
  • Create and implement communication plans that help leaders and employees understand process requirements, deadlines, and available resources.
  • Draft clear employee communications, leader guidance, talking points, presentations, and follow-up messages.
  • Monitor participation and completion, follow up with leaders and employees, troubleshoot issues, and escalate risks where needed.
  • Coordinate with People Centers of Expertise (COEs), Global Business Services (GBS), Finance and other stakeholders to ensure decisions and employee changes are processed accurately and on time.

Hiring, onboarding, and employee support

  • Serve as the primary People point of contact for hiring within assigned Finance and People functions.
  • Act as the day-to-day liaison among Finance and/or People leaders, Talent Acquisition, GBS, and other stakeholders, maintaining momentum and resolving bottlenecks.
  • Manage the hiring exception approval process, including gathering information, coordinating approvals, maintaining trackers, communicating decisions, and following requests through completion.
  • Facilitate new-hire orientation and partner with managers to create effective onboarding plans.
  • Coordinate with GBS on onboarding workflows, Workday steps, documentation, and employee data, monitoring execution and resolving issues that could affect the new-hire experience.
  • Maintain and update orientation presentations, onboarding materials, and manager resources.
  • Serve as an accessible and trusted contact for employees, helping them navigate People policies, benefits, systems, and resources and connecting them with the appropriate specialist when needed.
  • Act as an authentic champion of WPP’s culture, helping employees feel welcomed, informed, and supported.

Operational oversight, data, and process improvement

  • Partner closely with the offshore Global Business Services (GBS) HR Operations team, which executes Workday transactions, onboarding workflows, employee lifecycle administration, and other recurring People activities.
  • Provide GBS with clear requirements, context, priorities, and deadlines; monitor progress and review work for accuracy and completeness.
  • Manage cross-team handoffs, address service gaps, and resolve or escalate delays and other delivery issues.
  • Remain accountable for the quality and timeliness of the employee and leader experience, even when administrative execution sits with GBS.
  • Navigate Workday to review, validate, and reconcile employee information and confirm that required transactions are completed accurately.
  • Respond to employee and leader data requests and use Excel to organize, reconcile, manipulate, analyze, and summarize employee data.
  • Create useful reports, trackers, presentations, and insights to support People processes and business decisions.
  • Identify inefficient or unclear processes and develop practical workflows, documentation, templates, and tools to improve them.
  • Bring structure and momentum to ambiguous assignments, clarify ownership, remove roadblocks, and drive work through completion.
  • Explore how technology, automation, and AI can improve People-team efficiency, data analysis, communications, and service delivery.

What you’ll bring

  • At least eight years of progressive experience in Human Resources, People Operations, HR business partnering, or a related People function.
  • Broad HR experience and the judgment to move confidently between employee support, leader advising, operational execution, detailed administration, and strategic problem-solving.
  • Experience supporting employees and leaders in a complex, fast-moving, and preferably global or matrixed organization.
  • Experience coordinating annual People processes such as performance reviews, goal setting, compensation planning, and talent activities.
  • Experience partnering with Talent Acquisition and managing hiring workflows, approvals, and stakeholder follow-up.
  • Experience overseeing HR operational delivery through GBS, offshore, or similarly matrixed teams and influencing outcomes without formal authority.
  • Working knowledge of US employment practices and the judgment to recognize when Legal, Employee Relations, or another specialist should be engaged.
  • Workday proficiency, including the ability to review employee information, validate transactions, and identify discrepancies.
  • Strong Excel, data-management, PowerPoint, project-management, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent writing skills, with the ability to create polished, concise communications and materials for employees and leaders.
  • The maturity, discretion, and composure required to handle sensitive information and interact credibly with senior leaders.

How you’ll work

You will thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a “get it done” mentality and take ownership through final resolution.
  • Are equally comfortable advising a leader, welcoming a new employee, analyzing a spreadsheet, updating a presentation, or chasing down an approval.
  • Exercise strong judgment without needing a playbook for every situation.
  • Anticipate needs and bring forward practical solutions—not just problems.
  • Communicate clearly, follow up reliably, and care about the details.
  • Build trust with employees while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and boundaries.
  • Remain calm, flexible, and solutions-oriented when priorities change.
  • Are an enthusiastic and credible champion of WPP, its people, and its continued transformation.

Working model

This position is based at 3 World Trade Center in New York City and requires four days per week in the office. Some flexibility may occasionally be needed to support global stakeholders, orientation sessions, employee events, or other business priorities.

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

About WPP Open: 

WPP Open is at the forefront of transforming how WPP delivers value to its clients. We are building a unified product ecosystem that empowers our agencies and clients with cutting-edge tools and data-driven insights. Our product organisation is driven by a clear vision, strategic execution, and a commitment to continuous innovation.

The Opportunity: 

We are seeking a highly autonomous and results-driven Senior Product Owner to join our WPP Open product team. In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in driving the execution and optimisation of a critical, often specialised, product capability.

You will translate defined product strategies into meticulously prioritised and actionable backlogs, proactively guide complex feature sets through the development lifecycle, and ensure the delivery of measurable, high-impact product outcomes.

You will work closely with Product leadership, engineering teams, and various stakeholders to deliver value that directly contributes to WPP Open's success. This role requires deep domain expertise, a strong understanding of agile methodologies, exceptional communication skills, and a relentless focus on delivering value to users and the business.

What you'll do:

Complex Product Backlog Ownership & Execution Leadership:

  • Own and manage complex or high-impact product backlogs for your designated, often specialised, product capability. Ensure these backlogs are meticulously prioritised, well-defined, and directly support the overarching product strategy and roadmap defined by the Product Lead.
  • Drive the execution of the product roadmap for your capability, translating strategic objectives into actionable epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality solutions.
  • Focus on defining clear, measurable outcomes for each initiative and feature, and track progress against these metrics, providing regular updates to the Product Lead.

 Proactive Requirement Definition & Refinement:

  • Translate defined product strategy and user needs into clear, concise, and actionable epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that lead to clear, testable outcomes.
  • Proactively engage with engineering and design to refine requirements, identify technical dependencies, and ensure feasibility and optimal implementation for complex features.
  • Act as the primary source of truth for the development team regarding product requirements and user needs for your specialised capability.

 Cross-functional Orchestration & Collaboration:

  • Act as the central orchestrator within your agile development team, working closely with engineering teams, UX/UI designers, and other product stakeholders throughout the entire product development lifecycle, from concept to release.
  • Drive alignment and resolve impediments within the development team to ensure smooth and efficient delivery of complex features.
  • Facilitate agile ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews) to ensure effective team collaboration and progress.

Strategic Stakeholder Engagement & Communication:

  • Proactively engage with relevant stakeholders, including Product leads, engineering leads, and end-users, to gather feedback, clarify requirements, and ensure strong alignment for your product capability.
  • Communicate product progress, plans, and insights to your Product leads and relevant stakeholders, ensuring clarity in complex discussions with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Articulate the "why" behind product decisions at the feature level and the measurable impact of delivered features.

Continuous Improvement & Optimisation:

  • Establish and manage robust mechanisms for gathering user feedback, analysing product performance data, and identifying areas for continuous improvement within your product capability.
  • Translate insights from market performance, user feedback, and data analytics directly back into the product backlog and inform the Product Leads of potential strategic adjustments.
  • Champion continuous optimisation of features post-launch, ensuring they meet user needs and business objectives.

 Mentorship & Guidance (Informal):

  • Act as a subject matter expert and informal mentor to less experienced Product Owners or Product Analysts, sharing best practices and contributing to their professional development and the overall product team's capabilities.

Complex Problem Solving & Decision Making:

  • Analyse and resolve complex product-related problems within your capability, collaborating with the Product Lead and engineering to find efficient and effective solutions.
  • Demonstrate strong prioritisation and decision-making skills for your product backlog, especially under ambiguity, to ensure the most valuable features are delivered and the product area's strategic goals are met.

 Contribution to Product Strategy (Informative):

  • Actively contribute insights and data from your product capability to inform the Product Lead's strategic direction and the overall WPP Open product vision and roadmap.
  • Ensure your product area's backlog consistently aligns with the defined product strategy and broader strategic themes and business objectives.

 What you'll need:

  • 4+ years of progressive experience in product ownership or a similar role, with a demonstrable track record of successfully driving complex product features and capabilities from definition to launch and beyond.
  • Proven ability to own, manage, and prioritise complex or high-impact product backlogs, ensuring alignment with defined product strategies and measurable business outcomes.
  • Deep domain expertise in a critical product capability, demonstrating the ability to handle significant technical or business complexity.
  • Strong understanding and practical experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban). Agile certification (e.g., CSPO, SAFe PO/PM) is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional ability to translate high-level product strategy into clear, concise, and actionable epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, demonstrating a deep understanding of technical considerations, constraints, and opportunities.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional development teams to achieve shared goals, acting as a leader within the team.
  • A strong analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data and user feedback to inform product decisions, measure success, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Ability to analyse and resolve complex problems within the scope of your product capability, collaborating effectively with Product Leads and engineering.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication style to suit different audiences (technical and non-technical) and effectively articulate complex product concepts and execution rationale.
  • Proven ability to proactively engage with Product Leads, engineering leads, and other stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and contribute to the efficient delivery of the product roadmap.
  • A strong track record of successfully delivering features from concept to release in multiple sprints, with a focus on achieving clear, testable outcomes and demonstrating accountability for post-launch performance.

The Opportunity: 

We are seeking a highly autonomous and results-driven Senior Product Owner to join our WPP Open product team. In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in driving the execution and optimisation of a critical, often specialised, product capability.

You will translate defined product strategies into meticulously prioritised and actionable backlogs, proactively guide complex feature sets through the development lifecycle, and ensure the delivery of measurable, high-impact product outcomes.

You will work closely with Product leadership, engineering teams, and various stakeholders to deliver value that directly contributes to WPP Open's success. This role requires deep domain expertise, a strong understanding of agile methodologies, exceptional communication skills, and a relentless focus on delivering value to users and the business.

What you'll do:

Complex Product Backlog Ownership & Execution Leadership:

  • Own and manage complex or high-impact product backlogs for your designated, often specialised, product capability. Ensure these backlogs are meticulously prioritised, well-defined, and directly support the overarching product strategy and roadmap defined by the Product Lead.
  • Drive the execution of the product roadmap for your capability, translating strategic objectives into actionable epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality solutions.
  • Focus on defining clear, measurable outcomes for each initiative and feature, and track progress against these metrics, providing regular updates to the Product Lead.

Proactive Requirement Definition & Refinement:

  • Translate defined product strategy and user needs into clear, concise, and actionable epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that lead to clear, testable outcomes.
  • Proactively engage with engineering and design to refine requirements, identify technical dependencies, and ensure feasibility and optimal implementation for complex features.
  • Act as the primary source of truth for the development team regarding product requirements and user needs for your specialised capability.

 Cross-functional Orchestration & Collaboration:

  • Act as the central orchestrator within your agile development team, working closely with engineering teams, UX/UI designers, and other product stakeholders throughout the entire product development lifecycle, from concept to release.
  • Drive alignment and resolve impediments within the development team to ensure smooth and efficient delivery of complex features.
  • Facilitate agile ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews) to ensure effective team collaboration and progress.

Strategic Stakeholder Engagement & Communication:

  • Proactively engage with relevant stakeholders, including Product leads, engineering leads, and end-users, to gather feedback, clarify requirements, and ensure strong alignment for your product capability.
  • Communicate product progress, plans, and insights to your Product leads and relevant stakeholders, ensuring clarity in complex discussions with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Articulate the "why" behind product decisions at the feature level and the measurable impact of delivered features.

Continuous Improvement & Optimisation:

  • Establish and manage robust mechanisms for gathering user feedback, analysing product performance data, and identifying areas for continuous improvement within your product capability.
  • Translate insights from market performance, user feedback, and data analytics directly back into the product backlog and inform the Product Leads of potential strategic adjustments.
  • Champion continuous optimisation of features post-launch, ensuring they meet user needs and business objectives.

  • Act as a subject matter expert and informal mentor to less experienced Product Owners or Product Analysts, sharing best practices and contributing to their professional development and the overall product team's capabilities.

Complex Problem Solving & Decision Making:

  • Analyse and resolve complex product-related problems within your capability, collaborating with the Product Lead and engineering to find efficient and effective solutions.
  • Demonstrate strong prioritisation and decision-making skills for your product backlog, especially under ambiguity, to ensure the most valuable features are delivered and the product area's strategic goals are met.

Contribution to Product Strategy (Informative):

  • Actively contribute insights and data from your product capability to inform the Product Lead's strategic direction and the overall WPP Open product vision and roadmap.
  • Ensure your product area's backlog consistently aligns with the defined product strategy and broader strategic themes and business objectives.

What you'll need:

  • 4+ years of progressive experience in product ownership or a similar role, with a demonstrable track record of successfully driving complex product features and capabilities from definition to launch and beyond.
  • Proven ability to own, manage, and prioritise complex or high-impact product backlogs, ensuring alignment with defined product strategies and measurable business outcomes.
  • Deep domain expertise in a critical product capability, demonstrating the ability to handle significant technical or business complexity.

  • A strong analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data and user feedback to inform product decisions, measure success, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Ability to analyse and resolve complex problems within the scope of your product capability, collaborating effectively with Product Leads and engineering.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication style to suit different audiences (technical and non-technical) and effectively articulate complex product concepts and execution rationale.
  • Proven ability to proactively engage with Product Leads, engineering leads, and other stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and contribute to the efficient delivery of the product roadmap.
  • A strong track record of successfully delivering features from concept to release in multiple sprints, with a focus on achieving clear, testable outcomes and demonstrating accountability for post-launch performance.

job.title: Supervisor - Global Payroll (US)
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

 

Why we're hiring:

 

As part of the Global Payroll Team, you will contribute to the ongoing development of the global People strategy. Supporting business growth in an increasingly regulated environment whilst ensuring payroll and tax are compliant across the region. The Payroll Supervisor will have the responsibility for ensuring that their team performs payroll processing, compensation, as well as associated deductions and benefits payments are processed/paid on a timely basis for assigned populations. They will also be responsible for ensuring all statutory filings are completed and deadlines met.

 

What you'll be doing:

 

  • Oversee and manage payroll processing, ensuring compliance with statutory requirements and accuracy of payments.
  • Review and approve payroll runs before sign‑off
  • Handle complex cases (tax, retro, expatriate payroll)
  • Coordinate with HR, Finance, and vendors
  • Drive standard work instructions and SOP adherence
  • Ensure bank reconciliations are completed daily to maintain financial accuracy and liquidity.
  • Ensure compliance with financial regulations, tax laws, and internal governance standards.
  • Develop and maintain strong internal controls and financial policies to safeguard assets and ensure regulatory compliance.
  • Assist the Financial Controller with external audits and liaise with auditors, tax advisors, and regulatory authorities as required.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration
  • Act as a key liaison between the India SSC and Global finance teams to ensure alignment of financial processes and reporting.
  • Lead and manage the finance payroll team, ensuring optimal performance across all functions.
  • Provide coaching, mentoring, and career development opportunities for team members.

 

KPIs

  • First‑time‑right payroll (%)
  • Escalation volume and ageing
  • Team SLA adherence (%)
  • Audit issues / control breaches
  • Productivity per analyst (payrolls per FTE)

 

What you'll need:

 

Skills and competencies

  • Excellent Communicator: Demonstrates clear and effective written and oral communication, tailoring messages to different stakeholders while maintaining professionalism and confidentiality.
  • Excellent Stakeholder Management Skills: Builds and maintains strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, addressing their needs and concerns while ensuring alignment with organizational objectives.
  • Organized and Detail-Oriented: Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and compliance in all tasks and maintaining data integrity.
  • Exceptional Problem-Solving, Analytical, and Decision-Making Ability: Skilled in identifying and resolving issues through analysis and critical thinking, making informed, data-driven decisions.
  • Strong project management skills: Ability to manage multiple priorities in a high volume, fast-paced environment.

 

Qualifications and experience

  • 8–10 years of end-to-end payroll experience, including team leadership
  • Proficiency in English, both written and verbal
  • Strong understanding of global payroll controls and compliance
  • Significant experience in a shared services setting across Finance or HR, with proven success in a leadership role
  • Experience working in a shared service centre or multinational environment, managing multi-entity and multi-currency financial operations
  • Understanding of regional financial regulations and compliance requirements
  • Experience with service request ticketing systems is a plus.
  • Experience with Workday HCM is a plus.

job.title: SVP, Head of Marketing Performance
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

THE OPPORTUNITY 

We are seeking an experienced, visionary, and transformative SVP, Product to lead the critical capability area of Marketing Performance within the WPP Open platform. This is a truly unique opportunity to define the future of how WPP measures and attributes marketing effectiveness across our vast and diverse agency and client ecosystem. 

Leveraging WPP's pioneering agentic marketing platform, you will lead the development of best-in-class solutions that turn live signals into predictive intelligence, empower our agencies and clients to drive superior outcomes, and solidify WPP Open's competitive edge. Your mandate will extend beyond traditional paid media measurement, encompassing a holistic view of performance across the entire Paid, Earned, Shared, and Owned media spectrum. 

This role demands a leader who can not only set a compelling product vision, but also inspire and lead a multi-disciplinary team, ensuring robust commercial accountability and sustainable growth. You will directly contribute to achieving key WPP Open priorities, including driving profitability, maximizing strategic advantage, and delivering an integrated, intelligent experience for our users and clients. 

JOB PURPOSE 

The SVP, Product for Marketing Performance will be responsible for defining and executing the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for all capabilities related to marketing measurement, attribution and reporting within the WPP Open platform. This includes the development of visualizations and user experiences to democratize and utilize campaign and performance data, and the development of advanced analytics capabilities to enable Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), Incrementality testing, and Geo-experimentation.  Including the use of agentic tooling for automated analytics outputs and conversational data analytics. 

You will build, inspire, and mentor high-performing, 'full-stack' product teams comprising product managers, engineers, data scientists, UX/UI designers, and enablement specialists. A core part of your mandate will be to foster a culture of agility, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement, making decisive progress over perfection in a fast-paced environment. 

KEY RESPONSIBLITIES

Strategic Product Vision & Leadership:

  • Define and champion the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Marketing Performance within WPP Open, ensuring seamless alignment with WPP's overarching business goals, strategic product drivers, and client needs. 
  • Conduct in-depth market research, competitive analysis, and client needs assessment, relentlessly pursuing truly differentiating products that provide a clear competitive advantage. 
  • Translate complex business problems and evolving client challenges into clear, actionable product requirements and features, with a strong emphasis on holistic performance measurement. 
  • Develop and execute a clear strategy for integrating, harmonizing, and evolving existing performance measurement and reporting products/features into a unified, AI-enabled WPP Open offering, moving from customization to configurability. 

 Product Leadership & Team Transformation:

  • Lead, inspire, and mentor high-performing, multi-disciplinary 'full-stack' teams (Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, UX/UI, Enablement specialists), fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
  • Set clear Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and performance metrics for the Marketing Performance product area and individual team members, ensuring product KPI metrics track adoption, impact, and performance. 
  • Cultivate an environment where innovation thrives, talent flourishes, and every team member is empowered to deliver their best work. 

 Commercial Acumen & Growth:

  • Own a significant operating and capital expenditure budget for the Marketing Performance product area, making critical decisions within the financial framework. 
  • In partnership with commercial teams, define and manage the product commercials for your portfolio, including pricing strategy, revenue forecasting, and profitability analysis, ensuring robust commercial accountability and sustainable growth. 
  • Demonstrate ruthless prioritization to maximize business value and achieve ambitious goals, continually identifying and addressing customer pain points and opportunities. 
  • Ensure maximized product investment impact by simplifying the product portfolio and rationalizing product priorities effectively. 

 Cross-functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management:

  • Collaborate seamlessly with Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX/UI Design, Data & Intelligence, Architecture & Infrastructure, and Enablement teams to ensure unified platform vision and successful development and delivery. 
  • Partner with WPP agency leadership, client teams and strategic external partners to understand evolving needs, gather feedback, and ensure optimal product market fit and adoption. 
  • Communicate product strategy, roadmap, and progress effectively and influentially to senior leadership, diverse stakeholders, and internal teams, translating complex concepts into clear, compelling presentations. 
  • Cultivate and manage high-impact relationships with key internal and external partners, driving collaborative initiatives and maximizing mutual value. 

Product Development & Execution:

  • Oversee the entire product lifecycle from discovery and ideation through development, launch, and post-launch iteration, emphasizing agile and iterative development. 
  • Prioritize features and initiatives based on strategic impact, client value, technical feasibility, and business objectives, with a relentless focus on driving meaningful adoption and impact. 
  • Ensure timely delivery of high-quality, scalable products and features that meet defined requirements, performance standards, and the architectural principles of WPP Open. 
  • Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for product success, continually optimizing based on data and user feedback. 

 Domain Expertise & Innovation:

  • Maintain deep expertise in marketing performance measurement, advanced attribution models (MTA, MMM, including various methodologies), media mix optimization, incrementality testing, and experimentation design (e.g., geo-experimentation). 
  • Lead the application of AI and agentic tooling to enhance marketing performance reporting, diagnostics, automated analytics output (eg; Post Campaign Analyses), and recommendations, evolving towards conversational data analytics. 
  • Identify and evaluate emerging technologies and trends (in data architecture, analytics, AI) to ensure WPP Open remains at the forefront of marketing performance innovation. 
  • Serve as the definitive subject matter expert on Reporting & Analytics data and technology, offering invaluable support during client pitches and fostering thought leadership within the organization. 

 

REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS 

Experience: 

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in Product Management, with at least 8 years in a senior leadership role (e.g., SVP, VP) managing multiple product teams. 
  • Demonstrable experience leading product strategy, vision, and execution for large-scale marketing performance, analytics, attribution, or optimization platforms in the AdTech, MarTech, or Agency domain. 
  • Proven track record of successfully bringing complex, data-driven, and AI-enabled products from concept to market, driving significant competitive advantage and exponential growth. 
  • Extensive experience navigating and leading product teams through significant organizational change, mergers, or integrations, transforming disparate teams into a unified, high-performing organization. 
  • Strong understanding and application of modern agile product development methodologies. 
  • Experience managing significant operating and capital expenditure budgets and defining commercial models for product portfolios. 
  • Proven experience in managing global product rollouts and supporting a large, diverse client base (e.g., 1000+ clients across multiple markets). 

 

Domain Expertise: 

  • Advanced, hands-on knowledge of how marketing activity across Paid, Earned, Shared, Owned media channels is measured, coupled with a proven ability to translate this expertise into a compelling product vision and strategic roadmap. 
  • Deep expertise in advanced measurement techniques including Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) (including various methodologies like Bayesian), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), Incrementality testing, and marketing experimentation. 
  • Strong understanding of marketing data sources, data ingestion, transformation, and reporting challenges. 
  • Deep expertise in data architecture and engineering principles, data modeling, ETL processes, data warehousing, and advanced analytics, particularly in the context of marketing data. 

 

Leadership & Communication: 

  • Exceptional leadership, team-building, and people management skills, with a passion for mentoring and developing diverse talent. 
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and strategic concepts to diverse audiences (technical, business, executive, client) and build compelling presentations. 
  • Strong influencing, negotiation, and conflict resolution abilities, capable of building strong relationships and collaborating effectively with internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Proven ability to navigate and excel within a fast-paced, multi-market, matrixed global organization. 

 

Strategic & Analytical Thinking: 

  • Exceptional strategic thinking and complex problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to identify ptimal courses of action and articulate a clear, long-term vision. 
  • Highly analytical and data-driven, with the ability to make informed decisions based on market insights, user data, and business objectives. 
  • A proactive, independent, and adaptable leader with a strong sense of ownership, thriving within demanding, fast-paced environments. 

 

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

#LI-Hybrid 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

job.title: Tech Lead
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 11 years of professional software development in TypeScript and Node.js or Python, including 5 years of architecture across multiple systems.
  • 3 years of experience owning engineering standards adopted beyond your own team, and mentoring senior engineers.
  • Experience working in globally distributed teams across time zones, with engineering, product and business stakeholders in other regions.
  • Backend language and craft. You are an expert in TypeScript with Node.js or in Python, and a practitioner in the other. You set our backend and frontend coding patterns, framework choices and upgrade path, and you are a practitioner in at least two other crafts. • React and frontend. You set our full-stack conventions across teams: where logic lives, how APIs serve user interfaces, and how shared components are built and maintained.
  • APIs and data formats. You design REST APIs with OpenAPI from first principles: resource modelling, HTTP semantics, pagination, consistent error formats, versioning, idempotency and rate limiting. You know when to use JSON and when to use Protocol Buffers, and how to evolve both without breaking consumers. You set our API and serialisation standards and decide on exceptions.
  • Data. You are fluent in PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing, query plans, transactions and zero-downtime migrations with Prisma, TypeORM or SQLAlchemy. You design DynamoDB and MongoDB models around access patterns, use Redis for caching, and choose the right store for each workload. You own our data-architecture standards, including how datastores are introduced and retired.
  • Asynchronous systems and reliability. You design event-driven systems on queues and streams such as SQS, Kafka and BullMQ or Celery, using retries, dead-letter queues and idempotent consumers so that at-least-once delivery is safe. You know the outbox and saga patterns and when orchestration is better than choreography. You own our reference architecture for reliability.
  • Cloud and platform. You have built and run production services on AWS or GCP, both as Lambda functions and as Kubernetes workloads, and you understand the trade-offs between them: cold starts, concurrency, cost, capacity and deployment risk. You define infrastructure as code with Terraform or AWS CDK and release safely with canary and blue/green deployments. With Platform Engineering, you decide when we use serverless and when we use Kubernetes, and you set the reference architectures for both.
  • Testing and quality. You practise test-driven development and expect every team to do the same. You build balanced test suites: unit tests with Jest, Vitest or pytest, integration tests with Testcontainers, contract tests with Pact, and Playwright end-to-end tests that gate releases. You set our quality standard and approve any exceptions to it.
  • Observability and performance. You instrument services with OpenTelemetry and use Datadog and CloudWatch to find problems before users do. You profile with flame graphs, measure p95 and p99 latency, and fix causes rather than symptoms. You set our standards for SLOs, dashboards, alerting and performance budgets, and you lead the hardest incidents to their root cause.
  • Security and identity. You write secure code by default and apply the OWASP Top 10 and API Security Top 10 in practice. You design authentication and authorisation with OAuth 2.0 and OIDC, secure service-to-service traffic with mTLS and workload identity, and integrate identity providers such as Okta, Keycloak and Cognito. You set our identity and security standards and own security reviews with the Security team
  • Architecture and design. You design systems that span many services and teams, and you write architecture decision records that make the trade-offs explicit. You own our technical roadmap and style guide, act as the arbiter on standards, and decide on evidence rather than authority. You are able to trace many symptoms back to a single root cause and fix it once.
  • Engineering practices. You work trunk-based with GitHub Flow, small changes and feature flags, and you know CI/CD pipelines inside out. You have led deprecations and migrations all the way to switching the old system off. You set our Git, CI/CD and dependency policies, and you make large-scale change routine rather than exceptional.
  • AI-first engineering and LLMs. You use Claude Code every day and understand how large language models work: tokens, context windows, cost, structured output, embeddings and retrieval. You have built production features with the Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs, including tool calling and evaluations, and designed agentic services with clear guardrails and human review. You set our AI-first operating model, covering approved models and frameworks, Claude Code conventions, evaluation and release gates, and governance.
  • Communication, collaboration and initiative. You communicate clearly and concisely in writing and in conversation, and you adapt your message for engineers, product leaders and executives. You understand complex problems quickly, ask the right questions and confirm shared understanding before acting. You collaborate well across locations and cultures, working asynchronously and handing over cleanly between time zones. You are proactive: you spot problems and opportunities before you are asked, propose solutions and innovations of your own, and drive them through without waiting for instructions.
  • Leadership and behaviours. You lead without authority and influence engineering heads and teams across the organisation. You define the hiring bar for each level, calibrate interviewers and give Talent Acquisition clear screening criteria. You mentor senior engineers into technical leaders, build an engineering practice that does not depend on you, and hold the bar under commercial pressure. You say "I don't know" when you don't, and you dig in until you do.

Preferred qualifications:

  • B.Tech or B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
  • Experience maintaining a widely used open-source library.
  • Experience with multi-region and disaster-recovery architecture.
  • Experience mapping engineering controls to SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Experience with multi-agent systems and agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, Google ADK or the Anthropic Agent SDK.
  • Experience running an engineering-productivity measurement programme.
  • Experience in the second backend language.

About the job:

WPP Open is WPP's AI-enabled marketing operating system, used by brands and agencies around the world. Our engineering teams in India build and run it alongside colleagues in the UK and Europe. As a Principal Engineer you own architecture and engineering standards for full-stack engineering across teams. You stay hands-on and set the bar for hiring. The role is backend-heavy, and you also build the React interfaces for the features you deliver. Our interviews are practical and hands-on.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the architecture of TypeScript and Node.js or Python systems across multiple teams, and set the technical roadmap that takes them from where they are today to where the platform needs to be.
  • Stay hands-on: write, review and ship production code, lead by example on test-driven development, profiling and AI-first delivery, and take on the hardest technical problems yourself.
  • Set and maintain our engineering standards for API design, data, reliability, security, observability and testing; publish them as a style guide and reference architectures, certify teams against them, and decide on exceptions.
  • Review designs and architecture decision records across teams, challenge assumptions, and make sure decisions are made on evidence and recorded with their trade-offs.
  • Decide, with Platform Engineering, how we use AWS Lambda and Kubernetes, and own the cost, capacity and reliability consequences of those choices.
  • Lead the response to the most serious production incidents and performance problems, find the root cause and make sure it does not happen again.
  • Drive large-scale change such as migrations, framework upgrades and deprecations across many codebases through to completion, including switching off what has been replaced.
  • Define how we build with AI: the models, SDKs and agentic frameworks we use, how Claude Code is used day to day, and how AI-written code and AI features are evaluated and released.
  • Work with product, engineering and business leaders in other regions to shape what we build, turn business goals into technical plans, and make trade-offs visible.
  • Set the hiring bar for full-stack engineers at every level, write interview material, calibrate interviewers and give recruiters clear screening criteria.
  • Mentor senior engineers, grow the next generation of technical leaders, and build a community of practice through reviews, talks and knowledge sharing.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

You set our quality standard and approve any exceptions to it.
  • Observability and performance. You instrument services with OpenTelemetry and use Datadog and CloudWatch to find problems before users do. You profile with flame graphs, measure p95 and p99 latency, and fix causes rather than symptoms. You set our standards for SLOs, dashboards, alerting and performance budgets, and you lead the hardest incidents to their root cause.
  • Security and identity. You write secure code by default and apply the OWASP Top 10 and API Security Top 10 in practice. You design authentication and authorisation with OAuth 2.0 and OIDC, secure service-to-service traffic with mTLS and workload identity, and integrate identity providers such as Okta, Keycloak and Cognito. You set our identity and security standards and own security reviews with the Security team
  • Architecture and design. You design systems that span many services and teams, and you write architecture decision records that make the trade-offs explicit. You own our technical roadmap and style guide, act as the arbiter on standards, and decide on evidence rather than authority. You are able to trace many symptoms back to a single root cause and fix it once.
  • Engineering practices. You work trunk-based with GitHub Flow, small changes and feature flags, and you know CI/CD pipelines inside out. You have led deprecations and migrations all the way to switching the old system off. You set our Git, CI/CD and dependency policies, and you make large-scale change routine rather than exceptional.
  • AI-first engineering and LLMs. You use Claude Code every day and understand how large language models work: tokens, context windows, cost, structured output, embeddings and retrieval. You have built production features with the Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs, including tool calling and evaluations, and designed agentic services with clear guardrails and human review. You set our AI-first operating model, covering approved models and frameworks, Claude Code conventions, evaluation and release gates, and governance.
  • Communication, collaboration and initiative. You communicate clearly and concisely in writing and in conversation, and you adapt your message for engineers, product leaders and executives. You understand complex problems quickly, ask the right questions and confirm shared understanding before acting. You collaborate well across locations and cultures, working asynchronously and handing over cleanly between time zones. You are proactive: you spot problems and opportunities before you are asked, propose solutions and innovations of your own, and drive them through without waiting for instructions.
  • Leadership and behaviours. You lead without authority and influence engineering heads and teams across the organisation. You define the hiring bar for each level, calibrate interviewers and give Talent Acquisition clear screening criteria. You mentor senior engineers into technical leaders, build an engineering practice that does not depend on you, and hold the bar under commercial pressure. You say "I don't know" when you don't, and you dig in until you do.

Preferred qualifications:

  • B.Tech or B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
  • Experience maintaining a widely used open-source library.
  • Experience with multi-region and disaster-recovery architecture.
  • Experience mapping engineering controls to SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Experience with multi-agent systems and agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, Google ADK or the Anthropic Agent SDK.
  • Experience running an engineering-productivity measurement programme.
  • Experience in the second backend language.

About the job:

WPP Open is WPP's AI-enabled marketing operating system, used by brands and agencies around the world. Our engineering teams in India build and run it alongside colleagues in the UK and Europe. As a Principal Engineer you own architecture and engineering standards for full-stack engineering across teams. You stay hands-on and set the bar for hiring. The role is backend-heavy, and you also build the React interfaces for the features you deliver. Our interviews are practical and hands-on.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the architecture of TypeScript and Node.js or Python systems across multiple teams, and set the technical roadmap that takes them from where they are today to where the platform needs to be.
  • Stay hands-on: write, review and ship production code, lead by example on test-driven development, profiling and AI-first delivery, and take on the hardest technical problems yourself.
  • Set and maintain our engineering standards for API design, data, reliability, security, observability and testing; publish them as a style guide and reference architectures, certify teams against them, and decide on exceptions.
  • Review designs and architecture decision records across teams, challenge assumptions, and make sure decisions are made on evidence and recorded with their trade-offs.
  • Decide, with Platform Engineering, how we use AWS Lambda and Kubernetes, and own the cost, capacity and reliability consequences of those choices.
  • Lead the response to the most serious production incidents and performance problems, find the root cause and make sure it does not happen again.
  • Drive large-scale change such as migrations, framework upgrades and deprecations across many codebases through to completion, including switching off what has been replaced.
  • Define how we build with AI: the models, SDKs and agentic frameworks we use, how Claude Code is used day to day, and how AI-written code and AI features are evaluated and released.
  • Work with product, engineering and business leaders in other regions to shape what we build, turn business goals into technical plans, and make trade-offs visible.
  • Set the hiring bar for full-stack engineers at every level, write interview material, calibrate interviewers and give recruiters clear screening criteria.
  • Mentor senior engineers, grow the next generation of technical leaders, and build a community of practice through reviews, talks and knowledge sharing.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

  • Experience with multi-agent systems and agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, Google ADK or the Anthropic Agent SDK.
  • Experience running an engineering-productivity measurement programme.
  • Experience in TypeScript.

About the job:

 WPP Open is WPP's AI-enabled marketing operating system, used by brands and agencies around the world. Our engineering teams in India build and run it alongside colleagues in the UK and Europe. As a Principal Engineer you own architecture and engineering standards for Python across teams. You stay hands-on and set the bar for hiring. Our interviews are practical and hands-on.

job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Why we're hiring 

We are looking for a Lead Application Security Engineer to strengthen Secure Development across WPP. 

Working within TSG, you will partner with software engineers, architects and product teams to establish practical security guardrails, help teams build the capabilities needed to meet them, and develop technical assurance that demonstrates whether those controls remain effective. 

You will not own development pipelines, security tooling or software delivery. Instead, you will provide the technical leadership, evidence and challenge that helps engineering teams build security into the way they develop software and continuously improve their security practices. 

Success requires strong technical credibility with engineers, a practical understanding of modern software development, and the ability to influence technical outcomes without direct authority. 

The role sits within Technical Security Governance (TSG), reporting to the Director, Security Governance & Posture within the Group CISO organisation. 

 What you'll be doing 

  • Act as WPP’s technical lead for Application Security, providing senior judgement on Secure Development, assurance and software-security risk. 
  • Understand how software is designed, built, tested and released across WPP, identifying where common guardrails and engineering capabilities will most improve security. 
  • Define practical Secure Development guardrails across secure design, threat modelling, coding, dependencies, software supply chains, CI/CD, cloud-native and AI-enabled development. 
  • Work directly with software engineers, architects and product managers to help establish the security capabilities and practices needed to meet those guardrails. 
  • Develop technical assurance capabilities that continuously demonstrate whether Secure Development controls are present, operating and effective. 
  • Use engineering evidence, security tooling and targeted validation to identify gaps, challenge assumptions and drive meaningful improvement. 
  • Help engineering teams understand recurring weaknesses and improve their own ability to identify, prioritise and address software-security risk. 
  • Provide evidence and technical challenge where controls are ineffective or risks remain, while keeping implementation and remediation ownership with the teams responsible for the software. 
  • Continuously evolve WPP’s Secure Development approach as engineering practices, technologies and threats change. 
  • Own Application Security Risk Factors through their lifecycle, raising and documenting issues, advising teams on remediation, tracking progress and challenging where exposure is not being addressed effectively. 

What you'll need 

Essential criteria: 

  • Strong practical understanding of modern software development and how security fits across design, development, testing, CI/CD and release. 
  • Meaningful experience in Application Security, Product Security, DevSecOps or Secure Development, with enough technical depth to work credibly with software engineers and architects. 
  • Ability to translate security expectations into practical engineering guardrails that teams can understand and implement. 
  • Strong communication and stakeholder skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineers, architects, product managers and senior management. 
  • Sound technical judgement, balancing security outcomes with engineering constraints and knowing when to challenge and when different approaches can achieve the same outcome. 
  • Ability to lead through technical credibility, evidence and influence rather than direct authority. 

Nice to have: 

  • Previous hands-on experience in software development, software engineering, DevOps or a closely related engineering role; 5+ years would be particularly valuable. 
  • Experience establishing or improving Application Security, Secure Development or DevSecOps practices with engineering teams. 
  • Familiarity with common capabilities such as threat modelling, SAST, SCA, DAST, secrets detection, CI/CD security, API security or software-supply-chain controls. 
  • Experience using technology, automation or engineering evidence to provide security assurance at scale. 
  • Experience influencing technical decisions where security and delivery priorities compete. 
  • Security Champions, paved roads, developer enablement or similar experience. 
  • Cloud-native, SaaS or highly distributed application experience. 
  • AI-enabled application or AI-assisted development security experience. 
  • OWASP SAMM, ASVS, NIST SSDF, SLSA or similar frameworks.

job.title: Technical Security Governance Lead - Exposure Management
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.
