For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

We are looking for a lead for Exposure Management to provide deep technical investigation of suspected security exposures across WPP's global technology estate. 

Working within TSG, this role will investigate vulnerabilities and attack opportunities across a highly diverse environment spanning cloud, infrastructure, operating systems, identity, applications, AI and emerging technologies. You will use modern security, exposure and adversarial-testing capabilities to understand whether weaknesses are genuinely exploitable, how they could combine into realistic attack paths, and which exposure deserves attention first. 

This is a hands-on technical role with enterprise-wide reach. You will investigate complex security questions, challenge assumptions with evidence, identify systemic patterns, and translate technical findings into clear priorities for the teams responsible for remediation. You will not own every fix. Your role is to establish technical reality, determine what matters, and direct attention towards the improvements that will most meaningfully reduce WPP's exposure. 

The role sits within Technical Security Governance (TSG), reporting to the Director, Security Governance & Posture within the Group CISO organisation. 

What you'll be doing:

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as WPP’s technical Principal for Exposure Management, providing senior technical judgement on attack paths and systemic exposure across the global technology environment.
  • Investigate suspected vulnerabilities across infrastructure, operating systems, identity, cloud, applications, data and AI.
  • Follow the evidence beyond the tool output, combining information from multiple sources to determine what is genuinely exploitable, how weaknesses connect, and what actually matters.
  • Assess attack paths and systemic exposure, maintaining enough perspective to distinguish significant enterprise risk from isolated or technically interesting findings.
  • Establish technical priorities for mitigation, helping teams focus effort on the exposures most likely to materially improve WPP's security posture.
  • Work with TSG specialists across Cloud, Identity, Data, Infrastructure, Application and AI to understand findings in context and develop technically credible recommendations for system owners.
  • Provide broad technical security expertise on complex security questions, technologies and protective approaches, including areas such as encryption, security tooling and emerging threats.
  • Support major security events where rapid technical investigation, exposure analysis and remediation prioritisation are required.
  • Continuously improve how WPP understands exposure, identifying recurring patterns, challenging assumptions and helping us get better at finding the problems that actually matter. 

What you'll need:

Essential: 

  • 5+ years of hands-on technical security experience, with meaningful practical experience investigating, defending or validating real enterprise technology.
  • Strong foundations across enterprise technology, such as networks, infrastructure, operating systems, identity, cloud, applications or security operations, with enough breadth to understand how weaknesses interact across domains.
  • Practical attacker and defender knowledge, with the ability to reason about vulnerabilities, exploitability, attack paths, defensive controls and realistic attack opportunities.
  • Strong investigative and critical-thinking skills, including the curiosity to challenge assumptions, question tool output and follow evidence until the underlying technical reality is understood.
  • The judgement to prioritise, knowing when to investigate deeply, when enough is known to act, and when an interesting technical issue is not the most important problem.
  • Professional English, sufficient to investigate, collaborate and communicate effectively across WPP's global technology and security organisation.
  • Ability to work primarily from WPP's São Paulo office as part of the wider security team. 

Desirable: 

  • Practical experience in one or more of Red Team, Blue Team, Purple Team, Vulnerability Management, Exposure Management, Security Engineering, Security Research, Vulnerability Research, adversarial validation or attack-path analysis.
  • Experience translating complex technical findings into clear priorities and recommendations that other technology teams can act on.
  • Experience working across multiple technology domains rather than remaining exclusively within a single technical specialism.
  • Experience operating with substantial autonomy, creating structure from ambiguity and maintaining perspective across competing technical problems.
  • Experience influencing technical outcomes through expertise, evidence and collaboration, rather than relying on direct authority.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work equally well with deep technical specialists and senior stakeholders.
  • 10+ years of broader IT or cybersecurity experience, ideally including earlier hands-on experience with enterprise infrastructure, networks, operating systems, applications or security operations.
  • Experience with enterprise vulnerability, attack-surface, exposure, BAS or security-posture platforms, particularly where multiple sources must be correlated to understand the real picture.
  • Experience investigating exposure across cloud, identity, applications, AI or agentic systems.
  • Experience supporting major incidents, urgent remediation programmes or complex technical investigations under time pressure.
  • Experience designing or improving technical security methodologies, processes, metrics or prioritisation approaches.
  • Relevant technical education or certifications. Practical experience and demonstrated technical judgement matter more than certification volume.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Business Consulting Director is a senior consulting leader responsible for leading global branding and global marketing consulting for Japan's leading B2B corporations. As a core member of VOJ's Business Consulting practice, you will own the full engagement lifecycle — from originating new client relationships and structuring complex business challenges, to developing strategy and directing creative development — ensuring that brand thinking translates into tangible business value on a global stage. Working in English with overseas offices and global client stakeholders, you will design and facilitate cross-functional workshops, lead multiple engagements in parallel, and serve as the bridge between client leadership and our creative teams. This role combines consulting rigor, a deep understanding of global B2B business, and a genuine appreciation for creativity, contributing directly to the global brand value and business growth of our clients.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Business Development & Client Growth
  • New Client Acquisition: Proactively identify, approach, and develop new client opportunities, leading the strategic development of proposals and pitches for major Japanese B2B corporations.
  • Proposal Development: Create compelling, well-structured proposals and planning documents that clearly articulate client challenges, recommended approaches, and expected business outcomes.
  • Trusted Client Partnership: Build deep, trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, positioning VOJ as a long-term business partner in their global brand and marketing agenda.
  1. Global Branding & Marketing Consulting
  • Issue Structuring: Diagnose and structure clients' business and brand challenges, translating complex, multi-stakeholder situations into clear problem definitions and priorities.
  • Strategy Development: Lead the development of global brand strategies, positioning, and marketing strategies that support clients' international business growth.
  • B2B Business Insight: Apply a strong understanding of global B2B business models, buying processes, and decision-making to ensure recommendations drive measurable business value.

III. Workshop Facilitation & Stakeholder Alignment

  • Workshop Design & Facilitation: Plan and facilitate high-impact client workshops that bring together multiple departments, driving alignment, consensus, and co-creation of solutions.
  • Cross-Departmental Coordination: Align diverse client stakeholders and internal agency teams around shared objectives, managing differing interests and building momentum toward decisions.
  • Global Communication: Communicate effectively in English with overseas offices, global clients, and the wider network, including meetings, presentations, and English-language proposals.
  1. Creative Direction & Integrated Delivery
  • Creative Briefing: Write clear, incisive creative briefs that translate consulting outputs into inspiring direction for creative teams.
  • Creative Collaboration: Engage actively in discussions with creative teams, providing strategic input to idea development and evaluating creative work with constructive feedback.
  • Strategic Consistency: Ensure that creative and communication output remains grounded in the agreed brand and marketing strategy and business objectives from concept through execution.
  1. Engagement Management & Practice Contribution
  • Multi-Project Leadership: Lead multiple consulting engagements in parallel, managing scope, timelines, resources, and quality to maximize client value.
  • AI-Enabled Ways of Working: Actively leverage generative AI and other AI tools to enhance the speed, depth, and quality of research, analysis, and deliverables.
  • Practice Development: Contribute to the growth of the Business Consulting practice by sharing knowledge, refining consulting methodologies, and supporting colleagues.

SKILLS and QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience: 10+ years of relevant experience in brand consulting, marketing strategy, or a related field, including hands-on experience in global B2B business.
  • Branding & Marketing Knowledge: Solid foundational knowledge of marketing and branding principles, and the ability to apply them to complex B2B business challenges.
  • Business-Level English: Ability to lead meetings and presentations, read English-language materials, and write proposals in English.
  • Workshop Facilitation: Proven ability to facilitate workshops involving multiple departments and stakeholders, driving productive discussion and alignment.
  • Creative Understanding: A sound understanding of creativity, with the ability to write creative briefs and to evaluate and give feedback on creative ideas.
  • Multi-Tasking: Ability to drive multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
  • Digital & AI Proficiency: Practical, day-to-day proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word, and the ability to make effective use of generative AI and other AI tools in daily work.
  • Preferred Background: Experience at a global agency, brand consulting firm, or consulting firm, or in a B2B company (e.g., marketing, brand, or corporate planning functions). Basic knowledge of and experience with CRM is a plus.
  • Personal Attributes: A constant drive to take on new challenges; a passion for engaging deeply with clients' business issues and solving them through the power of brand and creativity; and self-driven leadership in a fast-changing environment.

About the Team

The Enterprise Subscriptions team at Dow Jones focuses on growing and managing business-to-business (B2B) subscriptions across Dow Jones's premium news brands and products. The team partners with corporations, universities, and other organizations to provide employees, students, and members with access to trusted news, data, and insights from brands such as The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, and Investor's Business Daily. The organization works closely across sales, marketing, product, customer success, data and insights to drive subscriber growth, engagement, retention, and revenue while identifying new opportunities to expand Dow Jones's enterprise footprint. Enterprise News is a key growth area for Dow Jones, with the broader Enterprise business also including Factiva and Dow Jones Newswires.

About the Role

As the Account Manager, Corporate Subscriptions, you will manage and grow corporate subscription accounts within your assigned territory. You will serve as a strategic partner to clients, ensuring subscription renewals, driving new revenue, and maximizing client value. You will be part of the Sales & Account/Client Management team.

job.title: Analyst, Newsroom Data
job.description:
Job Description:


WSJ Newsroom | Data Analyst (September 2026)

Title: Data Analyst, Newsroom Analytics

The Wall Street Journal is seeking a Data Analyst to join our newsroom data team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Newsroom Analytics. You will work alongside our senior analysts to produce the reports, dashboards, and analyses the newsroom relies on to make editorial, audience, and product decisions every day.

This role is a chance to build real analytical range in a fast-moving newsroom environment. You will spend most of your time in SQL, pulling data, building and maintaining dashboards, and helping the newsroom get answers quickly. You will use AI tools to accelerate this work, building lightweight utilities and automations that improve efficiency across the team and free up time for deeper analysis. You will collaborate closely with more senior colleagues as you take on progressively more independent work, from ad hoc analyses to experiment analysis and measurement projects.

This position will be based in our New York office.

You will:

  • Write SQL to answer questions from newsroom editorial, audience, and product partners, translating requests into clean, well-scoped queries and clearly communicated results.

  • Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports that expand self-serve access to newsroom data.

  • Support deep-dive analyses on major news events, high-priority moments, and shifts in performance.

  • Help keep the reporting stack reliable by troubleshooting data quality issues, tracing problems back to their source, and partnering with data engineering to resolve them.

  • Contribute to A/B tests and experiment analysis in partnership with senior analysts, growing into independent experiment ownership over time.

  • Learn the newsroom's taxonomies, instrumentation, and foundational datasets, and help maintain shared documentation and analytical patterns the team pulls from.

You have:

  • 1 to 2 years in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, or an equivalent internship and project background.

  • Proficient SQL skills, with experience writing queries against non-trivial datasets.

  • Comfort with a modern BI or dashboarding tool (Looker, Tableau, Mode, or similar).

  • Curiosity and speed in picking up new technical concepts and frameworks, and a track record of getting productive on unfamiliar stacks.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to explain data clearly to non-technical partners.

  • Care for accuracy and detail in work the newsroom will act on.

Standout candidates will have strengths in one or more of the following:

  • Experience with large-scale data warehouses like BigQuery or Snowflake, or with dbt.

  • Familiarity with Python for analysis, data wrangling, or automation, and comfort maintaining code in Git.

  • Exposure to A/B testing and applied statistics.

  • A background or strong interest in journalism, media, or content, and enthusiasm for driving journalistic outcomes.

  • Comfort using AI/LLM tooling to speed up analytical workflows.

job.title: Audience Data Analyst, Opinion
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

The Wall Street Journal is a global news organization that provides leading news, information, commentary and analysis. The Wall Street Journal engages readers across print, digital, mobile, social, podcast and video. Building on its heritage as the preeminent source of global business and financial news, the Journal includes coverage of U.S. & world news, politics, arts, culture, lifestyle, sports, and health. It holds 38 Pulitzer Prizes for outstanding journalism. The Wall Street Journal is published by Dow Jones, a division of News Corp (Nasdaq: NWS, NWSA; ASX: NWS, NWSLV).

 

The WSJ Opinion section has long served as a forum for intelligent, values-driven commentary, dedicated to advocating a consistent philosophy that can be summed up as ‘free markets, free people.’ While we aim to persuade, every word we publish is the product of rigorous reporting, research and debate. WSJ Opinion offers sharp, original analysis and strong points of view on the news of the day. This position supports the Opinion section’s audience data and insights work.

 

About the Role:

The Wall Street Journal’s Opinion section is seeking an Audience Data Analyst based in New York to support our audience reporting and editorial performance tracking.

Reporting directly to the Manager of Audience Data Analysis and Insights, you will be responsible for tracking audience trends, updating reporting dashboards, and translating audience behavior into clear takeaways for editorial leadership. You will assist in compiling recurring reports and ad-hoc analyses covering Opinion, Free Expression, Books and Arts in Review across web, mobile apps, newsletters, video, and podcasts. This is a hybrid role based in New York, with an expectation of working in the office three days per week.


You Will:

  • Extract, validate, and analyze reach, engagement, and subscription data from Snowflake using SQL to support editorial decision-making.
  • Help build, update, and maintain dashboards and reporting views in Tableau.
  • Support the Manager of Audience Data Analysis and Insights in compiling the recurring weekly analytics report and monthly performance summaries, with the expectation of taking ownership of these reporting processes.
  • Monitor audience interaction, visitor loyalty, and how effectively content converts visitors into subscribers across articles, newsletters, video series, and podcasts.
  • Utilize Adobe Analytics, Parse.ly, and native analytics tools from platforms such as YouTube Studio, TikTok Studio, and Meta Business Suite to pull performance data
  • Assist with data quality assurance, reviewing query outputs and validating metrics between reporting dashboards and warehouse data sources.
  • Contribute to code updates and documentation following team version control practices in GitHub.

You Have:

  • 1–4 years of professional experience in data analytics, digital analytics, or business intelligence, preferably in a media, publishing, or subscription environment.
  • Proficiency in writing SQL queries to aggregate, filter, and join multi-table datasets.
  • Experience developing and updating data visualizations and dashboards in Tableau.
  • Knowledge of GitHub for basic version control and documentation.
  • Experience working with audience, subscription, or editorial performance data preferred.
  • Experience using AI-assisted productivity tools such as Claude or Glean preferred.
  • Familiarity with Python or dbt preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail, with a focus on data accuracy and proactive communication regarding task progress.
  • An interest in news and opinion journalism, and an appreciation for the Opinion section's editorial standards and philosophy.

job.title: Automated Controls Audit Lead
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

This role sits at the front line of AI adoption in Finance — auditing and shaping the controls that let automation scale safely. It offers broad exposure across Finance Operations and the opportunity to build practical AI-controls expertise at one of the world's most trusted business-information companies.


About the Role

As a key member of the Internal Audit team, the Automated Controls Audit Lead supports the planning and execution of AI audits and internal controls work, along with related initiatives and projects, across Finance Operations. The role evaluates both traditional control frameworks and automated, machine-learning-enabled systems, and assesses AI internal controls supporting business process improvement initiatives. The Lead supports ongoing compliance monitoring and drives the resolution of internal control inquiries and enhancements. Because the AI landscape shifts quickly, the role demands knowledge agility: continuously evaluating and integrating fast-changing AI capabilities and audit tooling into internal processes and controls, and communicating clearly with stakeholders across departments as the Finance organization adapts. You will report to the Manager, FMA, Compliance & Technical Accounting and be based in our New Jersey office.


You Will:

  • Evaluate controls over automated and AI-enabled processes — including model inputs and outputs, system-generated reports, and human-review checkpoints — alongside traditional controls.
  • Provide general audit support, including document retrieval, review, and research in response to internal and external audit requests.
  • Proactively manage the impact of AI-driven shifts on company controls and processes, identifying where control design must adapt before gaps emerge.
  • Continuously align process workflows, control documentation, and knowledge bases with rapid AI advancements throughout the company processes.
  • Lead and/or engage in business process improvement initiatives and projects as assigned, embedding appropriate controls into redesigned and automated processes.
  • Independently research and bring to resolution general compliance issues as they arise, escalating appropriately.
  • Compile, analyze, review, and research Finance Operations data to support issue resolution and AI-supported improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain clear, audit-ready documentation of AI-related control decisions, changes, and remediation status.

 

You Have:

  • Minimum 5 years of related work experience in audit, internal controls, compliance, or finance operations.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent work experience preferred. 
  • Demonstrated knowledge of auditing principles and standards and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance, including the agility to apply them to AI-enabled processes.
  • Relevant background and understanding of finance operations processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve internal control and compliance issues.
  • Strong data analysis skills and demonstrated prior business process improvement experience.
  • Ability to quickly understand, interpret, and communicate business and technical issues; excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to quickly learn and utilize a variety of systems and available and developing AI solutions; strong organization, time management, and multi-tasking skills.
  • Professional certification or active pursuit thereof (CPA, CIA, CISA, or CRISC) (Preferred).
  • Working familiarity with AI risk and governance concepts and controls over automated processes (Preferred).
  • Experience in project coordination or management for systems implementations (Preferred).
  • Experience with financial systems modules (ERP, billing, or reporting platforms) (Preferred).
  • Familiarity with data and automation tools used in audit and controls work (e.g., advanced Excel, Alteryx, Power BI, or SQL) (Preferred).

job.title: Client Success Manager
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team

Our team brings together the capabilities to position, commercialize, and grow Dow Jones’s B2B and enterprise portfolio. We translate customer needs, audience insight, and market intelligence into product strategy, clear value propositions, differentiated positioning, and relevant product and content experiences.


We enable commercial performance through sales operations, go-to-market enablement, and cross-functional coordination. We also help drive client outcomes across onboarding, adoption, engagement, and retention. Working in close partnership with Product, Editorial, Sales, and Client Success, we ensure Dow Jones’s enterprise solutions are compelling in the market, equipped for commercial success, and deliver sustained value to clients.


About the Role

We are seeking a Client Success Manager to own the post-sale client journey for assigned new business accounts-  from signed deal through launch, activation, early adoption, and handoff into ongoing account management. This role serves as the primary relationship owner and cross-functional coordinator during the early post-sale phase, working closely with Sales, Regional Sales Coordinators, Operations, Engagement, Customer Care, and Account Management.


The goal is a seamless transition from signed account to active, engaged client-  reducing friction, accelerating time to value, surfacing risk early, and bringing in the right resources at the right time.


The Client Success Manager is the primary post-sale relationship owner and "quarterback" across the early client lifecycle, accountable for client readiness, launch coordination, onboarding progress, standard-account adoption execution, early engagement, and risk management. The role doesn't personally own every specialist workstream, but ensures each one happens successfully.


This is not a quota-carrying role. Success is measured by how effectively clients launch, activate, adopt key products and workflows, engage early, and transition cleanly into ongoing account management.


You Will:

Own the post-sale relationship and launch orchestration

  • Serve as the primary point of contact from signed deal through onboarding and early adoption.
  • Lead the handoff from Sales, ensuring client goals, use cases, stakeholders, and launch priorities are clearly understood and documented.
  • Build 60–90 day onboarding milestones and success plans so clients know what success looks like and can achieve early wins.
  • Maintain proactive, coordinated communication with clients and internal stakeholders to keep launches on track.

Coordinate account setup with Regional Sales Coordinators and Operations

  • Partner with RSCs on order processing, account setup/changes, billing, CRM updates, and related handoffs.
  • Partner with Operations and Fulfillment on provisioning, entitlements, technical readiness, SLA readiness, and launch execution.
  • Own coordination and follow-through, while RSCs and Operations retain responsibility for their own administrative execution.

Drive onboarding and adoption for standard accounts

  • Execute onboarding using established playbooks, milestones, and training guidance.
  • Ensure clients understand activation steps and build early usage habits.
  • Support in designing and implementing playbooks and frameworks
  • Apply learnings and best practices across the client base.

Partner with Engagement and Lifecycle teams to deepen usage

  • Work with Engagement Strategy & Performance and Customer Lifecycle Marketing to ensure clients get the right communications, campaigns, and enablement programs.
  • Use engagement reporting and health signals to prioritize interventions.
  • Connect clients to the right in-life programs as they move from onboarding into sustained engagement.

Monitor account health and manage risk

  • Track usage, activation milestones, and health signals to catch stalled onboarding, weak adoption, or early churn risk.
  • Escalate early and coordinate support across Engagement, Customer Care, Operations, and Account Management.
  • Ensure critical issues stay owned and teams stay aligned on actions and timing.

Act as the voice of the client internally

  • Share feedback, adoption insights, and emerging needs with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Care, and Client Success leadership.
  • Partner with the Enterprise Customer Care & Voice of Customer Lead on escalations and service themes.

Support a clean handoff into ongoing account management

  • Ensure a clear transition from early post-sale ownership into the ongoing account management motion once onboarding and early adoption are complete.
  • Share account context, progress, risks, and adoption status with Account Managers so momentum carries through on high-value accounts.

Success Measures

Measured on adoption, engagement, readiness, and handoff outcomes rather than direct revenue. KPIs may include:

  • Account launch readiness and setup completion rate
  • Time to onboarding completion and time to first value
  • Activation and seat activation rate
  • Adoption of priority products, workflows, and features
  • Usage frequency, engagement depth, and health score movement
  • Participation in training, webinars, and lifecycle programs
  • Early identification and escalation of churn risk or stalled onboarding
  • Quality of handoff into ongoing account management

Cross-Functional Partnerships

  • Sales Account Executives — post-sale handoff and continuity from signed deal into launch
  • Regional Sales Coordinators — order processing, account setup/changes, billing coordination
  • Operations and Fulfillment — provisioning, entitlements, technical readiness, launch execution
  • Engagement Strategy & Performance / Customer Lifecycle Marketing — health monitoring, engagement plays, in-life programs
  • Enterprise Customer Care & Voice of Customer — escalations, white-glove service, feedback loops
  • Account Managers — transition planning and ongoing relationship continuity

You Have:

  • 7 years of experience in client success, onboarding, implementation, account coordination, or related post-sale roles in B2B, SaaS, media, or subscription environments
  • Strong cross-functional project management skills, able to coordinate multiple stakeholders through launch, onboarding, and adoption milestones
  • Excellent client communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills
  • Comfort using data and health indicators to monitor trends and flag risk early
  • A proactive, organized, solutions-oriented approach to client coordination
  • A client-first mindset focused on driving value through usage, adoption, and engagement — not transactional account support

job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

The Dow Jones Customer Service (DJCS) mission is to provide great service for our customers and great experiences for our people. 


Our team has the privilege of delivering impactful experiences by helping our customers access the trusted news and business information published and produced by our marquee brands including, The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, MarketWatch, Investor’s Business Daily, Dow Jones Factiva and Dow Jones Risk & Compliance. About the Role:


The Developer Support Executive will provide support to Dow Jones customers as they build applications that use Dow Jones API’s and Services. As a Developer Support Representative, you’ll represent Dow Jones as you manage and resolve complex technical issues from customers who build applications with our APIs or services. You’ll serve as an advocate for developers using the Dow Jones platform by ensuring the accuracy of our technical documentation, developing and testing the platform, creating relevant sample code, and managing the content on the Dow Jones Support site. Hours of Support*: Working Hours based in US West Coast Time: 4:30 PM - 12:30 AM PT.  *Hours subject to change. You will report to the Supervisor of Developer Support.

 

You will:

 

  • Provide Phone and Email support for developers who are implementing one or more of Dow Jones API’s or products.
  • Certify Customer applications to ensure they adhere to Dow Jones Technical and Branding Guidelines.
  • Provide support for Dow Jones Integration and Destination products.
  • Handle 3rd Level support for unresolved Technical Support issues.
  • Escalating issues to other departments when appropriate
  • Getting status’ on outsourced issues and keeping the technical staff informed
  • Assist with mentoring, and coaching technical staff.
  • Recognize and report problem trends.
  • Review and communicate system enhancement needs, leading the solution implementation.
  • Be responsible for helping with coverage for other regions or for any “on call” or weekend duties.
  • Conduct Kick off meetings with customers to design workflows that adhere to Certification rules for the Dow Jones Platform.
  • Communicate best practices on using Dow Jones API's and Services.
  • Work with customers to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
  • Write code samples, tutorials, and technical articles for the developer support portal.
  • Developing internal tools/applications as directed by management. 



Key Relationships:

  • Work closely with the various system development groups, Global operations, and Product Testing
  • Work as a team member in the Development Support Group Team

  • Networking or communication protocol knowledge.

job.title: Director - Chemical Research & Analysis, Resins Markets (Americas)
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.


Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.



About the Role:

As ​​Director - Chemical Research & Analysis, Resins Markets (Americas), you will lead the Global Engineering Resins Market Advisory Service and be responsible for developing and supporting the Chemical Market Analytics resins practice in the Americas by providing market research and insights relative to the polyethylene and polypropylene markets. You will provide thought leadership relating to supply, demand, price, and economics, as well as competitive dynamics and changing industry structural elements. You will serve as a key external interface for these markets and provide coordination with relevant internal functions. You will report directly to the Head of Plastics.



You Will:
  • Complete primary research and analysis for the Americas resins markets 
  • Establish and maintain a reputation for resins market expertise
  • Build and manage North American and Latin America resins industry contact relationships across producers, consumers, distributors, traders, and the financial community
  • Regularly provide unique, neutral and objectively written Global Resins Market Advisory Service content including the monthly report, Focus Reports and the World Resins Analysis
  • Develop and maintain an understanding of Chemical Market Analytics supply/demand, econometric price forecast, and trade grid models 
  • Maintain the North America and Latin America production capacity database and supply-demand balances and price forecasts
  • Develops new and unique approaches to leverage Chemical Market Analytics data and models for enhanced predictive services.
  • Develop and deliver market presentations at Chemical Market Analytics and external events
  • Pursue opportunities to present information in client meetings and at conferences; and actively market Chemical Market Analytics services
  • Contribute to global resins team dynamics to ensure consistent global market coverage and analysis
  • Support the Circular Plastics Service by analyzing circular plastics trends impacting the  resins markets
  • Identify new business opportunities for sales and consulting follow-up
  • Provide polyolefin related market expertise for Chemical Market Analytics Consulting projects and Sales client development
  • Operate as a key liaison with the Port of Houston and understand regional and global logistics
  • Develop relationships with principal packaging facilities to understand critical export dynamics of the region
  • Solid understanding of key polyolefin technologies applicable to producers and processors
  • This individual will possess a solid understanding of plastics recycling and sustainability initiatives
  • Lead base chemical weather special reports in response to industry events such as hurricanes, freezes, fires, force majeure events, etc.



You Have:
  • At least 12 years’chemical industry experience, including commercial resins experience and team leadership experience
  • Understanding of the Chemical Market Analytics business model
  • Established relationships with key resins buy and sell side market participants - including executive management 
  • Team player ability to internalize organizational strategy and objectives and provide peer leadership for collaborative success
  • Ability to identify and articulate core/essential issues within complex problems and deliver insights and solutions
  • Ability to effectively distill complex information into key points for audiences of varying sizes in an organized and persuasive manner
  • Strong computer modelling and excel spreadsheet management skills 
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally
  • Spanish and/or Portuguese language competency (a plus)
  • Chemical engineering or chemistry (preferred), economics, or related degree -OR- MBA or other graduate degree (desired) -OR- equivalent experience

job.title: Director, Business Optimization & Operational Excellence
job.description:
Job Description:

About the Team

Dow Jones Energy is a leading global energy intelligence business providing trusted price reporting from our specialist Price Reporting Agency (PRA) OPIS, Chemical Market Analytics (CMA) and McCloskey, proprietary data, market intelligence, news and research to help customers navigate increasingly interconnected energy markets. Through our specialist businesses, Dow Jones Energy makes it easier to discover and access trusted expertise spanning oil and gas, chemicals, refined fuels, coal, electric vehicle infrastructure and renewables. Our specialist businesses combine rigorous pricing methodologies with world-class human judgment to deliver the trusted intelligence and specialist insight customers need to make confident decisions. 

About the Role

The Director of Business Optimization & Operational Excellence will play a pivotal role in transforming commercial operations into a highly efficient, value-impacting engine. Reporting directly to the VP of Operational Excellence, this role is tasked with managing the Business Optimization team driving the end-to-end Customer Journey process improvement, strengthening commercial and commercial operations execution, and enabling sustainable business growth. In addition, implement systematic collection of VOC across customer facing functions for actionable insights.The successful candidate will leverage Lean management frameworks, process mapping methodologies, automation technologies, and advanced Salesforce CRM optimization to eliminate friction across commercial workflows. Furthermore, this role will champion cross-functional alignment and operational efficiency across critical commercial partnering functions, including Sales Excellence, Customer Service, Sales Coordination, RevOps, Marketing, Billing and Legal teams. 

You Will

1. Process Mapping, Streamlining & Lean Optimization

  • Workflow Documentation: Map existing end-to-end commercial operations, creating comprehensive As-Is process maps, standard operating procedures, and To-Be future-state designs.  
  • Lean & Continuous Improvement: Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen methodologies to identify operational bottlenecks, redundancies, waste, and friction points across departments. 
  • Optimization Execution: Redesign Lead to Cash workflows to reduce cycle times, minimize error rates, eliminate rework, and enhance overall service delivery quality.
  • Customer Journey Optimization: Partner with marketing, sales and sales operations to design, evaluate, and refine automated lead journeys that nurture prospects and generate high-intent sales leads. 

2. Salesforce CRM Maximization & Commercial Enablement

  • Salesforce Utilization & Optimization: Serve as the primary business bridge between commercial teams and Salesforce administrators to enhance user adoption, workflow automation, lead-to-cash process efficiency, and pipeline management.
  • Commercial Execution & Sales Enablement: Streamline sales workflows, lead routing, opportunity tracking, and CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) integration to remove administrative burden from sales. 
  • Manage the implementation of digital adoption training tools (WalkMe).

3. Process Innovation, Digital Transformation & Automation

  • Automation Tool Integration: Identify and champion innovative technology solutions, including Robotic Process Automation (RPA), AI-driven workflows, smart forms, and document management automation.
  • Digital Workflow Solutions: Modernize manual, e-mail based, paper-based, or spreadsheet-heavy tasks across commercial and support operations into automated digital tools.

4. Cross-Functional Support Team Operational Efficiency 

  • Commercial Support Optimization: Drive operational excellence across Customer Service, Contract Support, and Sales Coordinator teams to align service metrics with commercial growth objectives.
  • Customer Service & Order Execution: Enhance ticket resolution workflows, order management, and inquiry handling to improve Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) and key SLA performance. 

You Have

Experience

  • 12+ years of progressive professional experience in business operations, management consulting, or commercial operational excellence.
  • 4-5+ years of direct people management, with proven success leading optimization or continuous improvement teams
  • Lean / Six Sigma: Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification strongly preferred.
  • Salesforce Expertise: Proven experience optimizing Salesforce CRM from a business/ operational perspective (Salesforce Administrator certification or deep business architecture experience is a strong plus).

Skills & Technical Proficiencies

  • Process Mapping Tools: Advanced proficiency in Visio, Lucidchart, Signavio, or similar workflow mapping platforms.
  • Sales Enablement & CRM: Deep understanding of Salesforce functionality, pipeline hygiene, reports/dashboards, and automated commercial workflows.
  • Change Management & Leadership: Strong stakeholder management skills with a demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional leaders and drive change adoption without direct line authority.

job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:
The Events team is responsible for the development, planning, and execution of Dow Jones Energy's global paid events, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and provide a best-in-class attendee experience.

We thrive in a collaborative environment, working toward shared goals with an open-minded, can-do attitude. Efficiency, teamwork, and alignment are essential to the success of every event.

About the Role:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, proactive Event Operations Coordinator to join the Dow Jones Energy Events team. Reporting to the Events Director, this role supports the operational and logistical planning and execution of live events from pre-production through post-event evaluation.

The successful candidate will assist with vendor management, event technology, budget administration, project planning, and onsite event execution while helping deliver exceptional experiences for attendees, sponsors, and stakeholders.

You Will:

  • Event Logistics Coordination
  • Assist in planning and managing event logistics, including:
    • Venue selection and vendor management
    • Registration and attendee management
    • Food & beverage coordination
    • Sponsorship fulfillment and deliverables
    • Hotel accommodations 
    • Audio-visual production
    • Floor plans and room layouts
    • Décor, signage, and branded materials
    • Event technology, including event websites, registration platforms, and mobile event apps
  • Project Management: Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, critical paths, production schedules, and operational checklists to ensure successful event execution.
  • Financial Administration: Track event expenses, create purchase orders, process invoices, and manage payments to ensure events remain within budget.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Build strong working relationships with event internal stakeholders, senior leadership, sponsors, and external vendors to ensure seamless event coordination.
  • Event Technology: Develop expertise in event technology platforms, including registration systems, event websites, mobile apps, onsite registration equipment, and attendee engagement tools.

You Have:

  • Technology Proficiency: Experience using event management platforms such as Cvent, event websites, i.e. WordPress, mobile event apps, and attendee engagement tools.
  • Project Management: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, timelines, budgets, and competing priorities while maintaining a high level of quality.
  • Vendor Management: Experience working with third-party vendors, reviewing contracts, and supporting negotiations.

  • Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across departments while building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate professionally at all organizational levels.
  • Adaptability: Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends during peak event periods, while supporting international business schedules.

  • Travel: up to 25% (domestic and international) to support onsite event setup, execution, and breakdown. Candidates should reside within reasonable proximity to a major U.S. airport to support travel requirements.
  • Positive, high-energy, solution-oriented mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for continuous learning and improving operational excellence.
  • Innovative thinker who embraces technology and identifies opportunities to improve processes and attendee experiences.
  • Collaborative team player who values inclusion, partnership, and shared success.
  • Professional judgment with the ability to make informed decisions and adapt quickly to changing priorities.

job.title: Executive Assistant, Office of the Deputy Editors in Chief
job.description:
Job Description:


Position Summary


The Wall Street Journal is seeking a highly organized Executive Assistant to support two Deputy Editors in Chief. This role is central to the smooth operation of the Journal's senior editorial leadership team: in addition to day-to-day support for the Deputy Editors in Chief, this person will serve as a trusted backup to the Executive Assistant to the Editor in Chief and the Executive Assistant to the Managing Editor, ensuring seamless coverage whenever either is unavailable or at capacity.


The ideal candidate has at least five years of experience supporting senior executives in a fast-paced environment, exercises excellent judgment with highly confidential and sensitive information, and is comfortable managing shifting priorities under tight deadlines. This is an in-office role, five days a week, reflecting the collaborative, fast-moving nature of newsroom leadership support.


You Will

•     Manage complex, frequently changing calendars for two Deputy Editors in Chief, proactively resolving scheduling conflicts and prioritizing competing demands.

•     Coordinate internal and external meetings — including interviews, and events — arranging logistics, agendas, and briefing materials.

•     Arrange domestic and international travel, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, and visas; process expense reports accurately and on time.

•     Serve as a primary point of contact for the Deputy Editors in Chief, screening and prioritizing calls, emails, and requests with professionalism and discretion.

•     Prepare, proofread, and format correspondence, memos, presentations, and other materials on behalf of the Deputy Editors in Chief.

•     Liaise with senior leaders, reporters, editors, and external contacts, representing the Deputy Editors in Chief's with professionalism and sound judgment.

•     Provide seamless backup coverage for the Executive Assistant to the Editor in Chief and the Executive Assistant to the Managing Editor during absences, high-volume periods, or as otherwise needed.

•     Handle highly confidential and sensitive information — including personnel matters, editorial strategy, and pre-publication material — with absolute discretion.

•     Anticipate the needs of the Deputy Editors in Chief, proactively solve problems before they escalate, ensure timely follow through to effectively manage the deputy’s time. 

•     Coordinate special projects, newsroom events, and off-site meetings as assigned.

•     Maintain organized filing systems, contact databases, and records for the office.

•     Partner closely with other executive assistants across the newsroom to coordinate schedules and share coverage.


You Have

•     Minimum five years of experience as an executive assistant or in a similar role supporting senior executives, ideally within a newsroom, media company, or other fast-paced professional environment.

•     Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines with composure and sound judgment.

•     Exceptional discretion and demonstrated ability to handle confidential information with the utmost integrity.

•     Strong written and verbal communication skills.

•     Highly organized, with meticulous attention to detail and strong follow-through.

•     Proficiency in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace, calendar management tools, and expense-reporting systems.

•     Flexibility and willingness to adapt quickly to shifting priorities in a 24/7 news environment.

•     Collaborative, team-oriented approach, with willingness to provide backup coverage for other executive offices as needed.

•     Professional demeanor and sound judgment when interacting with senior leaders, journalists, and external contacts at all levels.


Work Environment

•     This role is based in the Journal's New York newsroom and requires in-office presence five days per week.

•     May occasionally require availability outside standard business hours to support breaking news coverage or urgent scheduling needs.

job.title: Executive Director - Chemical Markets Price Reporting
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:

As Executive Director - Chemical Markets Price Reporting, you will lead Dow Jones Energy's global chemicals price reporting business. You will oversee the editorial teams responsible for the assessment and publication of benchmark prices, assessments and market-moving news across global petrochemical and chemical markets from our PCW brand.

You ensure the integrity, quality, transparency, and market relevance of chemical price assessments while maintaining the highest ethical and methodological standards. You will lead a global team of price reporters and editors responsible for market coverage across key chemical value chains - including aromatics, olefins, plastics, polymers, syngas, methanol, feedstocks, and emerging chemical markets.

You will drive editorial excellence, benchmark innovation, and market engagement, while ensuring compliance with legal requirements and industry standards. You will partner closely with Product, Standards & Compliance, Risk, and other Editorial leaders to ensure Dow Jones Energy's chemicals assessments remain trusted, transparent, and indispensable to global commodity markets.

You will report to the SVP - Markets & Price Reporting.

About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.

Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.

You Will:

  • Lead and develop a global team of chemicals price reporters, editors, and market specialists, fostering a culture of editorial excellence, accountability, and collaboration

  • Ensure all chemical market assessments are developed, maintained, and published in accordance with the highest standards of price assessment integrity, market transparency, governance, and ethical conduct consistent with Dow Jones’ and The Wall Street Journal’s values

  • Lead methodology development, periodic methodology reviews, market consultations, and stakeholder engagement processes to ensure pricing methodologies remain robust, representative, and responsive to evolving market dynamics

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with producers, consumers, traders, brokers, exchanges, trade associations, and other market participants to strengthen market engagement, data integrity, and confidence in Dow Jones Energy's petrochemical and chemical markets assessments

  • Partner with Standards & Compliance, Legal, and Risk teams to ensure ongoing compliance with applicable benchmark regulations, internal controls, audit requirements, and governance frameworks

  • Partner with Product to execute the strategic roadmap for global chemicals market coverage, including identifying opportunities for new benchmarks, market expansion, and portfolio optimization

  • Monitor benchmark performance, market adoption, customer feedback, and competitive developments - recommending changes to methodologies, coverage, and editorial priorities as appropriate

  • Recruit, develop, mentor, and retain high-performing editorial talent, ensuring appropriate succession planning, capability development, and organizational resilience across the chemicals price reporting organization

  • Act as a senior spokesperson and subject matter expert for chemicals markets, representing Dow Jones Energy at industry conferences, customer engagements, webinars, and regulatory forums

You Have:

  • 15+ years’ experience in commodity price reporting, market intelligence, or related information services organization

  • Deep knowledge of global chemicals and petrochemical markets, including physical market structures, trading practices, supply chains, and pricing mechanisms

  • Significant leadership experience managing geographically dispersed editorial, price reporting, or market analysis teams

  • Demonstrated experience developing, managing, or launching benchmark price assessments, methodologies, or market intelligence products

  • Strong understanding of IOSCO Principles for Oil Price Reporting Agencies and familiarity with benchmark regulation, governance, assurance, and audit requirements

  • Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to cultivate relationships with senior leaders and external market participants

  • A university degree -OR- relevant professional experience

job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team: This role offers direct exposure to a transforming, AI-enabled Finance organization, a broad view across Finance Operations workflows, and the opportunity to shape a leaner, more automated control environment at one of the world's most trusted business-information companies.


About the Role

As a key member of the Internal Audit team, the Internal Controls Optimization Lead supports the evaluation, streamlining, and enhancement of the organization's internal control environment, with the goal of reducing compliance cost while maintaining the effectiveness of risk management. The role spans traditional control frameworks and automated, machine-learning-enabled systems, and contributes to business process improvement initiatives and related projects across Finance Operations. The Lead supports ongoing compliance monitoring and drives the resolution of internal control inquiries and enhancements. A defining feature of the role is pace: the successful candidate will evaluate and integrate fast-changing knowledge and audit tooling — including AI-driven capabilities — into internal processes and controls, and communicate effectively with stakeholders across departments as the Finance organization evolves. You will report to the Intnl Controls/Compliance Manager and be based in our New Jersey office.


You Will:

  • Lead and/or engage in business process improvement initiatives and projects as assigned, identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate controls.
  • Evaluate the control impact of process and system changes; recommend control rationalization and design enhancements that reduce manual effort without reducing assurance.
  • Support the adoption of new audit and monitoring tools, including AI-enabled solutions, into day-to-day control operation. Assist business operations with implementation of new solutions.
  • Independently research and bring to resolution general compliance issues as they arise, escalating appropriately.
  • Compile, analyze, review, and research Finance Operations data to support issue resolution, management reporting, and AI-supported improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain clear, audit-ready documentation of decisions, control changes, and remediation status.

 

You Have:

  • Minimum 5 years of related work experience in internal controls, audit, compliance, or finance operations.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent work experience. 
  • Demonstrated knowledge of auditing principles and standards and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance.
  • Relevant background and understanding of finance operations processes (e.g., order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, record-to-report).
  • Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve internal control and compliance issues.
  • Proficiency in the design and implementation of internal control policies and procedures.
  • Strong data analysis skills and demonstrated prior business process improvement experience.
  • Ability to quickly understand, interpret, and communicate business and technical issues to varied audiences; excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to quickly learn and utilize a variety of systems and new developing AI solutions; strong organization, time management, and multi-tasking skills.
  • Professional certification or active pursuit thereof (CPA, CIA, or CISA) (Preferred).
  • Experience in project coordination or management for systems implementations (Preferred).
  • Experience with financial systems modules (ERP, billing, or reporting platforms) (Preferred).
  • Exposure to process documentation and improvement methodologies (Preferred).

job.title: Lead Data Scientist, Newsroom Analytics
job.description:
Job Description:


The Wall Street Journal is seeking a Lead Data Scientist, Newsroom Analytics to drive our newsroom's audience-data strategy. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Newsroom Data, you will be embedded in one of the world's most influential newsrooms, working directly with newsroom coverage, audience, and product strategy teams on the decisions that shape how news is reported, prioritized, and delivered to millions of readers. 


This is a highly autonomous and strategic role that demands both rigorous data science and sharp analytical instincts in equal measure. Working closely with editorial and audience leaders, you'll surface the right problems and own the full arc from solution design to adoption, building the metrics, models, and forecasts that teams rely on. This includes developing tools teams actually use, translating complex methodologies into clear recommendations, and consistently connecting your work to outcomes that matter: how readers discover, engage with, and return to WSJ journalism. Beyond your own output, you will serve as a technical anchor for the team, mentoring colleagues, establishing shared standards for analytical rigor, and proactively driving continuous improvements across our workflows. The ideal candidate seamlessly balances statistical rigor, strategic newsroom thinking, and a genuine investment in the people and practices around them.


This position will be based in our New York office.

You will:


  • Partner with our digital strategy, coverage and product teams to identify the highest-impact analytical opportunities, define the right questions, and shape the data science roadmap around problems that drive real newsroom outcomes.
  • Design and build predictive and explanatory models end-to-end, from feature engineering and validation through production, making principled tradeoffs between complexity and interpretability along the way.
  • Translate quantitative findings into clear, actionable recommendations for senior newsroom and business stakeholders, and partner with cross-functional teams to see those recommendations through to adoption.
  • Own the core metrics and measurement systems that newsroom teams rely on to evaluate performance and make editorial decisions,  ensuring they are accurate, well-documented, and trusted.
  • Apply rigorous statistical thinking to measure real-world editorial and audience impact, drawing on causal inference and observational methods alongside controlled experimentation to isolate what's actually driving outcomes. 
  • Mentor and develop junior data team members, establishing shared standards for rigorous, production-ready analysis and building the team's collective technical capability over time.


 

You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or applied machine learning, preferably in a media, publishing, or subscription-based environment.
  • Proven ability to own models end-to-end in a lean team setting, including scheduling, maintaining, and iterating on outputs using orchestration tools such as Airflow.
  • Strong proficiency in Python including feature engineering, model training, validation, and interpretation, with experience maintaining production-quality, reproducible code in Git.
  • Advanced SQL and hands-on experience with large-scale data warehouses (Snowflake/BigQuery) as well as ETL workflows/analytics engineering frameworks (dbt).
  • Experience applying causal inference and statistical methods to measure real-world outcomes from observational data.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to frame quantitative findings as clear business or editorial recommendations for senior non-technical stakeholders, and a demonstrated ability to influence decisions without direct authority.
  • Experience building models that influence content strategy, audience development, or consumer retention.

Standout candidates will have strengths in one or more areas of the following:

  • Experience with NLP or text analysis methods, including topic modeling, classification, or entity extraction applied to content data.
  • Familiarity with off-platform attribution and audience measurement, specifically modeling the relationship between distributed content, platform referrals, and downstream subscription or engagement outcomes.
  • Experience leveraging AI to democratize data and enable faster time-to-insight.

To apply, please submit a resume and a cover letter explaining how your skills, experience and interests align with the expectations of the role by July 28th. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and we encourage early submission as the position may be filled before the deadline.


The Journal’s reporters, editors, developers, and audio and visual journalists create important and impactful stories, firmly rooted in fact and adhering to the highest ethical standards. We report without fear or bias, and we maintain a proper sense of perspective, detachment and objectivity in our reporting.

*LI-JA1-WSJ.

job.title: Manager, Integrated Marketing
job.description:
Job Description:



About the Team 

The Integrated Marketing team leads the process of developing RFP responses from end to end, ensuring that they're not only delivered on time and on budget for our clients but that they also promote our clients' businesses and lead to long term partnerships with The Wall Street Journal and Barron's Group.

 

Our team brings together the right people and resources to provide the best possible ideas and strategies to our customers -- understanding client goals, assembling teams of specialists, and leading the process to completion. We oversee the RFP response from end to end, starting with 'what is the problem we're solving?' to 'how are we going to measure success?', and we work with the right people to get to those answers.

 

Success within the Integrated Marketing team requires a passion for media, an editorial mindset, and a high standard for visual presentations, all brought to life through a working understanding of the media and advertising landscape, and an ability to translate data and insights into compelling and engaging advertising and branded content programs.


About the Role

We are looking for a Manager, Integrated Marketing - The Wall Street Journal. You will report to the Executive Director of Enterprise, Integrated Marketing and work in our Midtown Manhattan office 3 days each week.

 

You Will

  • Manage daily pitch and proposal work that responds to client needs and telegraphs the value of The Wall Street Journal & Barron's Group media offerings
  • Develop a broad understanding of all The Wall Street Journal & Barron's Group media ad products and creative capabilities
  • Develop and articulate creative marketing programs in many forms, including written creative proposals and visually-motivated pitch decks (often in collaboration with other disciplines such as our creative studio, Events, etc.)
  • Use research and data to share insights and support value propositions for client pitches and proposals
  • Work with and project manage across relevant areas of the organization (including Sales, Product Marketing, Ad Operations & Planning, Research, Events, etc.) to develop pitches and integrated programs for clients
  • Educate and keep the team up to date with advertising industry trends and what opportunities or challenges they might present for our business
  • Present and participate in client meetings

 

You Are

  • Highly organized and attentive to detail; design skills a plus
  • An effective communicator
  • A demonstrated resourceful problem solver with critical thinking skills
  • Curious in an environment of constant learning
  • Engaging and able to build relationships and credibility
  • An excellent writer
  • Able and willing to work in our Midtown Manhattan office 3 days each week


You Have

  • B.A. or B.S., plus 5+ years of cross-platform Marketing experience, preferably within publishing and/or digital advertising environment, or equivalent experience 
  • A foundational understanding of an ad sales, planning, and account management environment
  • Experience working in collaborative sales and marketing processes, including the interaction and strategy required in an advertising sales environment; experience working with Enterprise sector a plus
  • Experience translating product marketing materials into compelling proposals customized to the goals and strategy of individual clients
  • Proficiency with Google Suite (Sheets, Slides, etc.); design skills a plus
  • Confidence interfacing with a variety of internal teams, leading brainstorms and working in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a deadline-driven atmosphere

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance Plans
  • Paid Time Off

  • Education Benefits
  • Paid Maternity and Paternity Leave
  • Family Care Benefits
  • Commuter Transit Program

job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team

Dow Jones Media Sales connects leading brands with influential audiences through our trusted portfolio, including The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, MarketWatch and Investor’s Business Daily. Our teams across Sales, Marketing, Creative and Client Success work together to deliver innovative advertising solutions and exceptional client experiences across digital, print, video, audio, events and custom content.


About the Role

We are looking for a solution driven candidate who would describe themselves as being analytical, collaborative and highly organized. The Sales Planning team is comfortable working in a deadline driven environment and being communicative about their deliverables. The most successful individuals understand how to prioritize their workload and can be agile and adapt quickly if an urgent matter arises. The team is focused on pricing integrity, media plan strategy and campaign delivery, but also on continued upskilling and leadership training and opportunities. By joining our global Sales Planning organization you will be a part of a diverse and growing team where you will continue to learn, be challenged and work directly with our clients on best-in-class advertising campaigns.

 

You Will:

  • Partner with the sales team on RFPs to provide proposal ideas and inventory solutions that best meet the client expectations and proposal objectives while maintaining pricing integrity and inventory package strategy
  • Produce sales proposals in order management system leveraging yield tools required (does not include creation of client presentations) and reserve inventory once deal is approved 
  • Work directly with advertisers or media agencies to collect campaign assets and communicate across internal teams for a successful and timely launch  
  • Monitor and optimize campaigns so that revenue is maintained and balanced with client goals (this includes providing recommendations and insights directly to advertisers or media agencies) 
  • Solid understanding of Dow Jones product offering and operational capabilities
  • Analyze user data and audience metrics via advertising tools
  • Assist Senior Planners and Planning Managers by utilizing historical data to support strategic decision about new media sales initiatives 

 

You Have:

  • Proven experience of working with an advertising operations or media planning team, preferably in a client-facing role 
  • 2-4 years of experience
  • Experience using one or more ad serving and/or order management systems (i.e. Google Ad Manager, OperativeOne, etc.) preferred
  • Ability to work independently as well as with a team
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast paced environment while managing multiple projects and tight deadlines
  • Detail-oriented and highly motivated with proven analytical, strategic, and creative problem solving skills
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills in person, over email and virtual meeting spaces with the ability to articulate complex scenarios to clients and internal teams effectively

job.title: Principal - Finance Operations (Dow Jones Technology)
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:

 As Principal - Finance Operations, you will transform Technology Finance Operations from a manual, spreadsheet-driven function into an AI-enabled, systems-oriented operating model that delivers greater speed, transparency, and operational leverage. 

You will own the business and financial operating cadence for Technology Operations while helping redesign how planning, governance, and execution works across both capital and operating investments. You will lead the redesign of the FY28 budget process, modernizing how Product, Engineering, and Design triads operate alongside PMO partners, business stakeholders and executives, and build scalable operating systems that allow Technology to accelerate with precision and accountability. 

This is a rare opportunity to build an operating model rather than inherit one. You will help shape how Technology plans investments, governs execution, and measures performance across a $300M+ portfolio while partnering directly with senior Technology and Finance leadership. 

You will report to the Vice President - Head of Financial Operations. 

About the Team:

Technology Operations is in the middle of a significant operating-model transformation: shifting from initiative tracking to OKR-driven governance, driving a vendor-partnered efficiency transformation, consolidating location strategy around strategic hubs, and redesigning processes with automation and AI-enabled capabilities at the core. Business Operations helps translate these strategic priorities into measurable operational and financial outcomes.

Working across Technology, Finance, Sourcing, Human Resources, the PMO, and external vendors, our team provides the operational discipline, financial stewardship, and governance needed to turn strategy into execution, enable better investment decisions, and build a simpler, more scalable operating model.

You Will:

  • Own the Technology Operations business management function, establishing the operating rhythm for planning, forecasting, decision support, governance, and execution

  • Lead the redesign of the FY28 budget process

  • Oversee the operating cadence for the $300M+ Product & Technology budget

  • Reengineer recurring financial and operational workflows by replacing manual processes with automation, intelligent workflows, and durable management systems

  • Partner with Finance, Sourcing, Human Resources, PMO, and Technology Executive and other stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into annual and multi-year operating plans

  • Improve governance and planning across triads by strengthening decision-making, planning discipline, accountability, and operating transparency in partnership with PMO leadership

  • Build and continuously evolve executive dashboards, KPIs, and operating reviews

  • Oversee vendor and investment governance across a complex technology portfolio

  • Establish scalable governance and financial controls across planning, forecasting, reporting, capitalization, and monthly operating reviews

  • Identify and deliver cost optimization opportunities while protecting service quality, resiliency, and long-term transformation objectives

  • Continuously raise the standard for business operations, financial stewardship, systems thinking, and execution excellence

You Have:

  • 12+ years’ experience in business operations, financial operations, FP&A, PMO, strategic planning, or related leadership roles supporting technology, infrastructure, or enterprise operations

  • Significant experience managing budgets, forecasts, business cases, capitalization planning, and executive financial reporting within complex organizations

  • A proven track record of redesigning operating models, governance frameworks, planning processes, or business management functions

  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional transformation in ambiguous, high-impact environments while influencing senior leaders across multiple functions

  • Strong expertise in financial operations, vendor management, investment governance, cost optimization, and executive reporting

  • Experience designing executive dashboards, KPIs, and operating review mechanisms that improve business decisions

  • Proven ability to translate strategic priorities into structured plans, measurable outcomes, and repeatable operating systems

  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and align organizations without direct authority.

  • A systems-thinking mindset with sound business judgment and a bias toward simplification, standardization, and continuous improvement

  • Experience designing, implementing, or leading the adoption of automation, analytics, dashboards, or AI-enabled workflows that materially reduced manual work in finance, planning, or business operations

  • Comfort working hands-on with automation, advanced analytics, and modern technology to improve cycle time, quality, and operational effectiveness

  • Bachelor's degree -or- equivalent practical experience

job.title: Principal Consultant, Polyolefins
job.description:
Job Description:

Job Title: Principal Analyst: Polyolefins – India (Internal Profile: Principal Market Research Analyst - CON9961)

Location: India

 

 

About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy is a leading global energy intelligence business providing trusted price reporting from our specialist Price Reporting Agency (PRA) OPIS, Chemical Market Analytics (CMA) and McCloskey, proprietary data, market intelligence, news and research to help customers navigate increasingly interconnected energy markets. Through our specialist businesses, Dow Jones Energy makes it easier to discover and access trusted expertise spanning oil and gas, chemicals, refined fuels, coal, electric vehicle infrastructure and renewables. Our specialist businesses combine rigorous pricing methodologies with world-class human judgment to deliver the trusted intelligence and specialist insight customers need to make confident decisions.

 

 

About the Role:

We are seeking a Principal Analyst for Polyolefins to develop Chemical Market Analytics' polyolefins (PE/PP) practice in India. Reporting to the Asia Middle East & India Market Advisory Leader, you will lead market research, price/supply/demand modeling, and provide actionable commercial and technical insights for external clients and internal research teams.

 

 

You Will:

 

 

 

  • Lead primary research on producer capacities, production costs, supply/demand balances, trade flows, and pricing for PE and PP markets in India.

 

  • Author regular advisory content—including monthly reports, Focus Reports, and event-driven updates—and deliver technical market presentations at industry conferences.

 

  • Build and maintain relationships with buy-side and sell-side contacts across the Indian polyolefin supply chain to gather primary intelligence and support custom consulting projects.

 

 

 

You Have:

 

 

 

  • 7+ years of chemical industry experience with direct commercial polyolefins (PE/PP) experience and a leadership background.

 

  • Strong understanding of PE/PP production and processing technologies, recycling, and sustainability initiatives.

 

  • Advanced Excel skills with experience in econometric modeling and database management.

 

  • An established executive network within the Indian polyolefins market.
