job.title: Principal Product Designer - Market Data
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:

As Principal Product Designer - Market Data, you will own the design strategy for our Market Data platform—the real-time quotes, charting, watchlists, screeners, and visualization systems that power how millions of people read and act on financial markets across The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, and Investor's Business Daily. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who sets direction across our financial brands and is the go-to design expert for how Dow Jones presents market data.

Market Data connects across every one of our financial brands, and this role sets the design strategy that spans all of them. Your decisions will establish shared patterns—for quotes, charts, tables, portfolios, and alerts—that these brands build on. You will own the direction for how investors of every kind, from first-time savers to sophisticated professionals, interpret dense, fast-moving data and turn it into confident decisions, balancing the distinct needs of each brand against the consistency and quality users expect wherever they encounter our data.

And this reach won't stop at the consumer. Market and pricing data runs across much of Dow Jones—so your influence will extend well beyond the consumer brands into our professional and enterprise products, from Factiva and Dow Jones Risk & Compliance to Dow Jones Energy, wherever market data underpins the experience. Where data meets the broader product, you will be the design lead who makes it cohere.

This is a role of real influence and scope. You will shape strategy with senior leadership, resolve tension between individual brand priorities and platform consistency, define the market-data patterns that live in our Index Design System, and mentor senior designers across the financial brands. You will be the design authority for your domain—navigating ambiguity and setting the standard others in your area build on.

You will report to the VP of Product Design within the Design & Research organization.

About the Team:

Our Design & Research org brings together world-class designers and researchers with a unified purpose: to connect people to the news and information that matters most. We're the strategic force that transforms deep user understanding into exceptional product experiences across our entire portfolio—from The Wall Street Journal to Factiva.

Our integrated approach ensures that research insights directly shape design decisions, while design explorations reveal new research opportunities. Together, we're building coherent, accessible experiences that honor our 135-year legacy while pushing us boldly into the future. We're a globally distributed team spearheading a digital transformation at Dow Jones, newly staffed by industry leaders from Google, LinkedIn, The New York Times, and more. Through our combined expertise in design craft and research rigor, we ensure that millions of users can depend on our platforms for truth in a world full of noise.

You Will:

  • Own the design strategy for the Market Data platform across our financial brands—setting a coherent, multi-year direction for quotes, charting, watchlists, screeners, portfolios, and data visualization that spans The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, and IBD, and connecting it to measurable outcomes like engagement, retention, and revenue

  • Shape strategy with senior leadership. Present your design direction for the Market Data platform to senior design, product, and business leaders—and to executives where the work warrants—building the partnerships that advance it across brands and making the case for how well-designed data experiences create competitive advantage

  • Solve the hard, ambiguous problems in your domain—developing new patterns, methods, and approaches for presenting complex financial information across multiple brands, and building a deep understanding of the problem space that lets you see opportunities ahead

  • Shape the market-data patterns in our Index Design System. Establish the charting, data-table, real-time, and visualization standards that become the norm across the financial brands—knowing when consistency serves the user and when a brand's audience warrants a tailored approach—and help adjacent teams adopt and evolve them

  • Extend your influence beyond our consumer brands into the wider portfolio—the professional and enterprise products, from Factiva and Risk & Compliance to Newswires and OPIS, where market and pricing data is just as central—so the experiences built on our data share the same clarity, rigor, and craft. Be the design lead wherever data shapes the product

  • Set a high bar for craft. Define what excellence looks like for dense, real-time financial information—typography, information density, motion, and the accessibility of complex tables and charts—and ensure consistent quality across the brands through design reviews and audits

  • Connect design to outcomes. Partner with Research and analytics to tie your decisions to engagement, retention, and subscription metrics, and help teams across the financial brands understand which measures matter for market-data experiences

  • Mentor and grow senior designers across the financial brands, shape a strong design culture, and strengthen the talent pipeline through the standards you set and the craft you share

You Have:

  • 10+ years of product design experience, including significant time owning complex, systems-level or platform work, with a track record of setting design direction that spans multiple products or brands

  • Deep expertise designing data-rich experiences—financial data, analytics, dashboards, data visualization, or other complex information display—where clarity, density, and trust matter as much as visual polish

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strategic impact across multiple products or brands: platform or design-system contributions, cross-team pattern-setting, and strong end-to-end craft on sophisticated products

  • A proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, translating design strategy into business terms and building alignment across teams whose priorities compete

  • Mastery of data visualization and information design—charting, tables, real-time data, progressive disclosure—and the judgment to know when complexity serves the user and when it gets in the way

  • Strong systems thinking and deep experience with design systems, including establishing patterns that other teams adopt and evolve

  • Excellence in Figma, with the ability to set standards for design communication, specifications, and documentation across teams

  • A deep command of design fundamentals and accessibility standards (WCAG), with particular fluency in making dense, complex data usable for everyone

  • A track record of mentoring designers and helping raise the craft and quality of the teams around you

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity—setting direction in your domain amid shifting priorities and emerging technology, and acting as the go-to expert others turn to

  • Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, related field -OR- equivalent experience 

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing for financial services, investing, trading, or fintech products

  • Familiarity with real-time or streaming data systems and the constraints they place on design

  • Working knowledge of financial concepts—markets, instruments, portfolio construction—sufficient to partner deeply with domain experts

  • Background in news media, publishing, or other content-heavy products

  • Experience designing across a multi-brand portfolio

  • Experience contributing meaningfully to a design system

  • An external presence through speaking or writing on data visualization, information design, or design at scale

  • International or cross-cultural design experience

job.title: Principal Product Designer - Subscription Growth (Acquisition)
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:

As Principal Product Designer - Subscription Growth (Acquisition), you will define the future of subscriber growth across Dow Jones' portfolio of brands, including The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, Investor's Business Daily, and future subscription products.

In this senior individual contributor role that operates at the intersection of design strategy, business strategy, and growth, you'll establish the long-term vision for how prospective customers discover, evaluate, and subscribe across our Commerce ecosystem - spanning registration, paywalls, shop experiences, pricing and packaging, checkout, identity, and experimentation.

You will partner closely with Product, Marketing, Brand, Engineering, Research, Analytics, and executive leadership to solve highly ambiguous challenges and shape investment priorities that accelerate subscriber growth. Your work will define scalable Commerce patterns, influence our acquisition platform strategy, and connect design decisions to measurable business outcomes across multiple brands.

Beyond delivering exceptional product experiences, you'll mentor senior designers, elevate design quality across Commerce, and establish standards that scale throughout the organization.You will report to the Director of Product Design, Commerce.

About The Team:

Our Design & Research org brings together world-class designers and researchers with a unified purpose: to connect people to the news and information that matters most. We're the strategic force that transforms deep user understanding into exceptional product experiences across our entire portfolio—from The Wall Street Journal to Factiva.

Our integrated approach ensures that research insights directly shape design decisions, while design explorations reveal new research opportunities. Together, we're building coherent, accessible experiences that honor our 135-year legacy while pushing us boldly into the future. We're a globally distributed team spearheading a digital transformation at Dow Jones, newly staffed by industry leaders from Google, LinkedIn, The New York Times, and more. Through our combined expertise in design craft and research rigor, we ensure that millions of users can depend on our platforms for truth in a world full of noise.

You Will:

  • Define the long-term design strategy for subscriber growth across multiple Dow Jones brands.

  • Lead highly ambiguous, business-critical initiatives spanning registration, identity, paywalls, shop experiences, pricing, packaging, checkout, and experimentation.

  • Partner with senior leadership across Product, Marketing, Brand, Engineering, Research, and Analytics to shape roadmap priorities and strategic investments.

  • Create scalable acquisition patterns, frameworks, and interaction models that extend our Index Design System and can be reused across brands.

  • Drive experimentation strategy by identifying high-impact opportunities throughout the acquisition funnel and translating insights into long-term product improvements.

  • Translate customer research, behavioral data, market trends, and business goals into experiences that improve acquisition performance while maintaining a high bar for user experience.

  • Lead strategic design explorations, vision work, and cross-functional workshops that align teams around future Commerce investments.

  • Mentor junior and mid-level designers through design reviews, coaching, and thoughtful feedback that elevates craft across the organization.

  • Influence how Commerce measures success by defining experience quality metrics alongside conversion, acquisition, and revenue KPIs.

  • Represent Commerce Design within the broader Design & Research organization while contributing to company-wide design strategy and thought leadership.

You Have:

  • 10+ years of product design experience leading complex digital products.

  • Portfolio demonstrating systems thinking, product vision, and measurable business impact.

  • Experience leading highly ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives.

  • Exceptional interaction, visual, systems, and service design skills.

  • Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across disciplines.

  • Experience defining design systems, reusable frameworks, and scalable product patterns.

  • Outstanding communication and storytelling skills.

  • Expert proficiency in Figma and modern design workflows.

  • Deep understanding of accessibility and inclusive design.

  • Experience mentoring senior designers and raising design quality across organizations.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience partnering closely with Marketing or Growth organizations.

job.title: Sales Specialist
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Our Global Risk Insights business provides geopolitical, security, macroeconomic and regulatory insights to a wide range of customers including financial institutions, corporations, universities, government agencies, executives and business professionals. We help organizations navigate an increasingly complex world and manage risk to their business and staff. This role will be driving sales for Global Risks Insights on Oxford Analytica and Dragonfly platforms as well as bespoke advisory projects. 


About the Role:

As a Sales Specialist, you will play a pivotal role in expanding Dow Jones' footprint across the US by driving adoption of our geopolitical, security and macroeconomic analysis. This role is designed for a seasoned sales professional with a strong track record in enterprise solution selling, deep understanding of the security and geopolitical risk, and the ability to influence senior business and technical stakeholders.

You’ll partner closely with Sales Generalists, Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams to craft strategic solution narratives that resonate with enterprise clients. Your consultative approach, commercial acumen, and ability to translate complex technology into meaningful business impact will be key to your success.

 

You Will:

  • Own and drive complex, high-value sales cycles for Global Risk Insights solutions across the European region. This includes but is not limited to our flagship subscription services Security Intelligence and Analysis Service (SIAS), the Oxford Analytica Daily Brief and our advisory services.
  • Create a sales strategy to maximise revenue growth and market expansion within your geographical territory and specialization.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders (e.g., CSO, Head of Intelligence, Head of Public Affairs etc), positioning Dow Jones GRI as a long-term strategic partner.
  • Lead advisory discussions with the internal Advisory  teams and external client stakeholders to shape integrated use cases that align to customer priorities 
  • Exceed on the position’s sales target and role based KPIs - the role’s primary focus will be on generating and closing new opportunities across your geographical territory
  • Drive strategic pursuit planning and pipeline development in collaboration with Sales Generalists, unlocking net-new opportunities and expanding existing relationships
  • Contribute to or lead the writing of any proposal, statement of work or technical document relating to the products
  • Analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitive dynamics to identify whitespace opportunities and differentiate Dow Jones’ offerings
  • Participate in, lead or coach the negotiation of terms, conditions, or prices leading to the closure of the contract
  • Contribute to thought leadership and client education through events, briefings, and strategic workshops.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap based on customer feedback and emerging market needs.
  • Maintain accurate sales reporting, pipeline forecasts, and opportunity tracking in our global CRM system
  • Other activities, tactics and behaviours as directed by management

You Have:

  • 7+ years of quota carrying experience in enterprise sales or business development, with a focus on the geopolitical/security/macroeconomic/data or analysis space
  • Proven success in selling to large enterprises and managing complex deal cycles with multiple stakeholders across business and technology functions.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate strategic accounts, identify key decision-makers, and build influence at the executive level.
  • Strong commercial acumen with consultative selling skills and familiarity with methodologies such as Challenger, MEDDPICC, or SPIN.
  • A collaborative mindset with experience working across matrixed teams including marketing, product, and customer success.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills tailored to both business and technical audiences.
  • Regional experience and cultural fluency across relevant markets.
  • Business-level proficiency in local language is a plus; English fluency is required. Additional languages are preferable. 
  • Experience in field sales and willingness to travel across the region (approximately 30%).

job.title: Senior Account Manager
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team

Dow Jones Risk Sales is a dynamic, global organization focused on helping businesses make smarter decisions through trusted news, data, insights, and information solutions. Our teams partner with organizations across industries to understand their unique challenges and connect them with the Dow Jones products and services that drive growth, manage risk, and support informed decision-making.


About the Role

Dow Jones is seeking a Senior Account Manager to manage a complex portfolio of customers across our Risk & Compliance, Factiva, and Newswires solution lines. This role oversees a sophisticated book of business consisting of multiple high-value Financial Services accounts with diverse stakeholders and significant growth potential.


The Senior Account Manager is a seasoned commercial professional who leverages 8+ years of experience to build strategic customer relationships, drive revenue growth, manage complex renewals, and lead account strategy across challenging customer environments. The role also provides guidance, coaching, and training to SDRs and other Account Managers and frequently acts as the lead commercial resource on the organization’s most complex accounts.


You Will:

Strategic Account Management

  • Manage a complex portfolio of strategic accounts within the Financial Services sector with significant revenue responsibility.
  • Develop deep relationships with senior customer stakeholders and become a trusted advisor to clients.
  • Understand customers' business objectives, industry trends, and competitive landscape to identify long-term growth opportunities.
  • Lead account strategy and coordinate cross-functional resources to deliver customer value.

Revenue Growth & New Business

  • Generate new revenue streams through the sale of Dow Jones products and services that address customer business needs.
  • Identify and execute upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of expansion opportunities across the territory.

Renewals & Customer Retention

  • Develop and execute strategic renewal plans for complex and high-value accounts.
  • Anticipate renewal risks and proactively implement retention strategies.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure successful contract negotiations and customer outcomes.

Customer Success & Adoption

  • Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through regular engagement and relationship management.
  • Partner closely with Customer Engagement and other internal teams to support product rollout, training, and adoption.
  • Help customers maximize the value of Dow Jones solutions.

Forecasting & Business Planning

  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts and pipeline reporting.
  • Track renewals, expansion opportunities, revenue projections, and key account milestones.
  • Contribute to departmental planning and operational goals.

Leadership & Team Contribution

  • Serve as a lead Account Manager on the organization's most complex accounts.
  • Provide guidance, coaching, and training to SDRs and other Account Managers.
  • Share best practices and help elevate commercial capabilities across the team.
  • May lead major account initiatives and coordinate work across multiple stakeholders.

  • Proven success managing complex Financial Services accounts.
  • Strong consultative selling and relationship management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

job.title: Senior Analyst, Newsroom Data
job.description:
Job Description:


WSJ Newsroom | Senior Data Analyst (September 2026)

The Wall Street Journal is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our newsroom data team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Newsroom Analytics. You will work directly with editorial, audience, and product teams on the decisions that shape how our journalism is reported, prioritized, and delivered to readers.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role that blends strong analytical craft with sharp newsroom judgment. You will own the analyses, dashboards, and measurement frameworks the newsroom depends on, and see your work through from question to adopted decision. You will also help set the technical bar for the data team, mentoring more junior colleagues and strengthening our shared practices.

This position will be based in our New York office.

You will:

  • Serve as a trusted analytics partner to newsroom editorial and strategy leaders, driving audience growth, engagement and retention. Frame the right questions, answer them with rigorous analysis, and translate findings for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Develop and maintain centralized dashboards and automated reports that expand self-serve access to newsroom data.

  • Run deep-dive analyses on areas of opportunity, major news events, high-priority moments, and unexplained shifts in performance.

  • Push measurement forward by developing novel metrics and analytical frameworks that inform newsroom strategy, and drive adoption across editorial, product, and business teams.

  • Own and maintain the reporting stack, partnering with data engineering and product to keep our data accurate, fresh, and high-quality, and to strengthen the taxonomies, instrumentation, and foundational datasets the newsroom relies on. Respond to and prevent pipeline incidents so daily reporting stays reliable.

  • Design and run A/B tests and experiments in partnership with strategy, product, and tech teams, applying statistical measurement to interpret results and translate them into decisions about editorial and audience strategy.

  • Mentor junior analysts, set shared standards for technical and non-technical outputs, and contribute to a shared library of methods and lessons the team can pull from.

You have:

  • 3+ years in data analytics, data science, or a related field, preferably in media, publishing, or content.

  • Track record of owning recurring reporting end-to-end and delivering analyses whose findings have shaped business decisions.

  • Strong SQL skills, with experience working in large-scale data warehouses like BigQuery or Snowflake, and analytics-engineering frameworks like dbt.

  • Experience designing and running A/B tests, and applying statistical methods to interpret results

  • Proficiency in Python for analysis, data wrangling, and automating analytical workflows, with experience  maintaining code in Git.

  • Strong communication skills, with a track record of driving alignment and consensus across cross-functional groups.

Standout candidates will have strengths in one or more of the following:

  • A background in content performance analysis, audience segmentation, cohort analysis, or editorial research.

  • Working knowledge of off-platform attribution, connecting distributed content and platform referrals to downstream engagement.

  • Comfort using AI/LLM tooling to speed up analytical workflows or make data more accessible to non-technical partners.

  • Prior newsroom experience with an interest in driving journalistic outcomes.

job.title: Senior Content Integration Specialist, Middle East
job.description:
Job Description:

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Content Integration Specialist to join the Risk & Compliance Implementation and Integration team. Based in Dubai, this role will support customers and partners operating in and from the Middle East.



The role will be heavily market facing, with interactions with customers pre- and post-sales. The successful candidate will combine strong technical integration expertise with proven customer-facing and commercial experience. They will work in a fast-growing market where customers often require hands-on guidance throughout pre-sales, implementation, migration, go-live, and post-go-live support.



This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can confidently engage with technical teams, business stakeholders, senior executives, and commercial teams. They will be expected to own complex integration conversations, influence solution design, identify risks and opportunities, and represent Dow Jones credibly with strategic customers and partners.



The role will report to the Director of Implementation and Integration, EMEA.




You Will

  • Own and lead complex customer and partner integrations involving Dow Jones Risk & Compliance products, APIs, data feeds, and associated workflows.
  • Provide expert guidance during pre-sales, solution design, implementation, migration, testing, go-live, and post-go-live activities.
  • Act as a senior technical and business-facing advisor to customers, partners, Sales, Product, Technology, Support, and Implementation teams.
  • Translate customer requirements into practical integration approaches, including data mapping, API usage, workflow design, testing, monitoring, and operational handover.
  • Lead the investigation and resolution of complex API, data feed, upload, data quality, and workflow issues.
  • Coordinate cross-functional responses to high-priority customer issues, ensuring clear ownership, communication, escalation, and resolution plans.
  • Facilitate customer workshops, technical discovery sessions, integration reviews, implementation meetings, and executive-level discussions.
  • Work closely with Sales to shape commercially viable integration solutions, support proposals and opportunities, and improve the likelihood of successful conversion and adoption.
  • Identify opportunities to expand customer value, improve retention, support migrations, and contribute to revenue growth.

job.description:

About the Team:

Our Technology team drives the evolution of our Technology, Engineering, Data, Product and User Experience functions. With a keen focus on delivering cutting-edge solutions, we shape the digital landscape for our customers, readers and users. From revolutionizing visuals to optimizing tools and harnessing the power of data, mobile, video and social platforms, our team is committed to providing a seamless and immersive experience across all touchpoints. Collaborating closely with our newsrooms and strategic partners, we spearhead the development of groundbreaking products and technologies.

About the Role:

As Senior Director - AI Operations & Enablement, you will be an operator-builder who pairs executive-grade strategic judgment with hands-on technical fluency in modern AI tooling. You will be the trusted force-multiplier for the most consequential Tech Ops priorities at Dow Jones: reengineering how work gets done across Product & Technology, prototyping AI-enabled workflows directly, and turning fragmented, manual processes into scalable, AI-native operating models. In this high-autonomy role, you will diagnose the as-is, design the to-be, and ship the change - for quick wins and full rebuilds across a 130-year-old global news and information business. You will report to the SVP - Head of Technology Operations.

You Will:

    • Build trusted relationships with leaders across Product, Technology, GM-led business teams and our parent News Corp organization

    • Translate fluently between technical capability and business outcome

    • Drive enterprise-wide AI adoption 

    • Influence more efficient governance processes

  • Scale What Works through Systems Thinking

You Have:

job.title: Senior Manager, Training & Quality Assurance
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

The Dow Jones Customer Service (DJCS) mission is to provide great service for our customers and great experiences for our people.  

Our team has the privilege of delivering impactful experiences by helping our customers access the trusted news and business information published and produced by our marquee brands including, The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, MarketWatch, Dow Jones Factiva and Dow Jones Risk & Compliance. You will find that we are a collaborative group, focused on delivering excellence during every customer interaction. We encourage anyone that wants to join us in our mission to apply.

 

About the Role:

The Senior Manager, Training & Quality Assurance is responsible for new hire training, ongoing learning, knowledge management, and quality assurance across DJCS globally.  You will report to the Vice President of Customer Support Operations and be based in our New Jersey office.

 

You Will


  • Own and modernize curricula across DJCS, defining content, sequence, timing, delivery methods, and readiness standards to shorten time to proficiency and support development beyond initial onboarding. Coordinate Training-led modules and specialist instruction from hiring teams within the agreed plan.
  • Lead the expansion of web-based, self-paced learning for onboarding and ongoing uptraining, combining it with live instruction, systems practice, and shadowing where appropriate.
  • Improve knowledge accuracy, usability, adoption, and maintenance, and prepare the team, content, and working practices for AI-enabled tools.
  • Lead the adoption and validation of automated quality management (AQM) across teams and contact types, establish standards for coaching and performance scoring, and redeploy human QA toward targeted investigation and improvement.
  • Develop staff capabilities and close Consumer/B2B knowledge gaps through cross-training and shared responsibilities, identifying where tools or specialist support are needed.
  • Manage training capacity and delivery, oversee curriculum standards and trainer quality across outsourcing partners, and extend product training and onboarding capability beyond DJCS.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand needs, agree priorities and delivery commitments, and communicate progress and tradeoffs. Measure both program results and stakeholder feedback to ensure the team delivers effective support and a reliable partnership.

 

Who you Are


  • You set a clear direction, challenge established approaches, and turn ideas into practical improvements.
  • You are resourceful and persistent, working through obstacles and balancing change with daily operational demands.
  • You develop people and deliver through others, setting clear expectations, building skills, and getting into the details when needed.
  • You build stakeholder trust through responsiveness, honest communication, and follow-through.
  • You use data, employee and stakeholder feedback, and testing to set priorities, make decisions, and measure results.

You Have


  • 7+ years of relevant experience.
  • Experience managing a training or related performance improvement team in a contact center environment, including developing staff capabilities.
  • Demonstrated success leading changes to onboarding or ongoing learning, with measurable improvements in proficiency, productivity, and learning effectiveness.
  • Experience leading blended learning development and delivery, including self-paced digital content, through internal teams or external specialists.
  • Experience using quality evaluation or interaction analytics to identify performance gaps and measure the results of improvement initiatives.
  • Experience delivering cross-functional initiatives against agreed commitments, supported by examples of effective stakeholder partnerships.
  • Ability to travel up to 20%, both domestically and internationally.
  • Experience implementing or expanding AQM (preferred).
  • Experience managing knowledge resources or implementing AI-enabled learning, knowledge, or employee-support tools (preferred).
  • Experience selecting or managing learning technology, external specialists, or outsourced training and QA programs (preferred).

job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.


Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.



About the Role:

As Senior Product Implementation Manager - Customer Success,  you will be the trusted technical leader responsible for driving the successful delivery, integration, and adoption of our AI-powered pricing solutions. You will own the end-to-end customer delivery lifecycle; from discovery to go-live and continuous optimization; ensuring every engagement delivers measurable business impact.


In this role, you will lead complex technical deployments, act as the bridge between customers and product teams, and mentor junior engineers to ensure consistent excellence in delivery execution. Your blend of technical depth, customer empathy, and delivery discipline will make you a key contributor to our customers’ success and Dow Jones Energy’s continued growth. You will report to the Director - Customer Success. 



You Will:

    • Translate business requirements into robust technical implementation plans and data integration workflows

  • Customer Engagement & Success
    • Act as the technical lead and trusted advisor for enterprise customers throughout their journey
    • Guide customers through onboarding, configuration, and integration, ensuring seamless adoption and measurable ROI
    • Collaborate closely with customer success managers to ensure post-launch value realization and continuous improvement
  • Integration & Automation Expertise

    • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues, ensuring system performance and data integrity
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

    • Contribute to the development of reusable tools, templates, and best practices that elevate delivery efficiency and consistency across projects
  • Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing
    • Support the professional growth of delivery engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and methodology improvements
    • Champion a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous learning within the Customer Success team



You Have:

job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy enables energy and chemical stakeholders around the global to improve operational efficiency and make strategic decisions with deep insights, future outlooks, price discovery and consultation from a celebrated team of subject matter experts. We offer short- and long-term market coverage for more than 200 core building-block chemicals with a full suite of advisory services and top-tier events held around the globe. Our bespoke consulting team has experience from upstream oil, gas, and minerals operations to chemicals, plastics and downstream end-use markets. This rich expertise equips us with a deep understanding of the industry’s most significant challenges, allowing us to collaborate closely and deliver the best solution that fits the needs of our clients. The worldwide chemical and energy industry looks to Dow Jones Energy to guide decisions and help manage risk across the entire value chain.



About the Role:

As a Senior Research Analyst I,  you will cover chemical markets and provide market updates for weekly and monthly reports. You will actively pursue and develop unique analytical approaches that provide values to prospective and existing clients. You will also contribute to long-term projects (i.e. cost studies) related to chemical products. You will report to the Executive Director - Research and Analysis.

job.title: Social Video Journalist
job.description:
Job Description:


MarketWatch is seeking a versatile and creative Video Journalist to produce short-form vertical video that brings personal finance, stock and market stories to life across social platforms, including Instagram, TikTok and others.


Part journalist, part storyteller and part creator — you are comfortable breaking down complex financial topics and producing them in a highly visual format built for scrolling audiences. In this role, you will pitch, shoot, write, edit and appear on camera while working with reporters to turn headlines and data points into short, smart, and engaging stories that help audiences make sense of the economy and their own money.


You Will:

  • Partner with the newsroom to identify compelling stories, trends and data points. Translate these insights into engaging short-form vertical videos that spotlight MarketWatch’s reporters.
  • Pitch, write and produce short-form video stories that explain current events in markets and the broader economy.
  • Appear on camera to deliver explainers, voiceovers and quick-hit market updates.
  • Shoot and edit your own stories from start to finish.
  • Modify and adapt existing long-form content into highly engaging vertical clips.
  • Utilize analytics tools (Instagram metrics, TikTok Insights) to understand what resonates with our audience and iterate on future stories.

You Have:

  • 2+ years of experience creating vertical video for social media platforms.
  • Demonstrated success in producing informative and engaging video journalism in a fast-paced environment, with strong hooks and storytelling skills.
  • Experience writing, producing and editing short-form vertical videos on tight deadlines.
  • Expertise in video and graphics editing using Adobe Premiere and After Effects.
  • Experience in archive producing, including sourcing and utilizing photos, video, graphics, and audio.
  • Deep knowledge of platform-specific trends on YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram, with an eagerness to experiment with new forms of mobile visual storytelling.
  • Strong journalistic fundamentals: writing, story ideation, research, fact-checking, interviewing experts, and sifting through data to produce accurate, compelling videos.
  • A solid understanding of business/finance news, markets, and current affairs.

 

Compensation The base pay range for this role is $TK per year.

About the Role: As a Marketing Data Science Intern, you will collaborate with experienced data scientists and marketing professionals to support data-driven strategies for optimizing marketing effectiveness. You will work on projects that involve building and enhancing predictive models, analyzing customer behavior, and supporting marketing optimization efforts across our product lines. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in advanced analytics, machine learning, and data-driven marketing strategies while contributing to high-impact business outcomes. This role is hybrid, based in our NYC - 1211 Ave of the Americas City office. job.title: Summer 2027 Internship Program – Brand Creative Design Intern
job.description:
Job Description:


Summer 2027 Internship – Brand Intern

Application Deadline: November 13, 2026
We encourage you to submit your application as early as possible, as internship applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

AMER Internship Dates: June 7, 2027 – August 13, 2027
(You must be available to work full-time, in-office during this period.)

About Our Internship Program:
Dow Jones Internship Program is a 10-week summer experience designed to give students real exposure to how . Our interns work on meaningful projects alongside our teams, gaining hands-on skills that make an impact on the business.

We believe the best way to learn is by doing — that’s why you’ll be paired with a mentor, connected with senior leaders, and included in professional development sessions. You’ll also join a diverse global intern community, sharing experiences and building networks that last beyond the program.
Our goal is to provide a supportive, engaging, and fun environment where your work feels valued and your growth comes first. Check out our Dow Jones Internship Program page to learn more and hear directly from past interns about their journeys. At Dow Jones, you’ll have the chance to start your career in an environment where collaboration, trust, and impact come first.

About the Role:
We’re seeking a Brand Design Intern to join our Marketing team. In this hands-on role, you’ll help create new brand identities and support cohesive design experiences across digital, print, and spatial touchpoints. You’ll work with senior designers on projects spanning multiple brands—including The Wall Street Journal, WSJ Events, MarketWatch, Barron’s, IBD, and other Dow Jones companies.

This role is ideal for someone resourceful, proactive, and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment. You’ll gain exposure to high-visibility projects while also rolling up your sleeves on the essential day-to-day tasks that keep brand systems running.

As a Brand Design Intern, you will:
Assist in creating new brand identities from the ground up (logos, color palettes, typography, art direction) and brand guides, moodboards, and toolkits to communicate with stakeholders, partners, and brand ambassadors.
Support senior designers on projects that deliver full brand experiences, including:
Visual concepts and mockups
Digital and media assets (emails, ads, landing pages, digital signage, social graphics campaign collateral, podcast art)
Print and spatial applications (event materials, invitations, onsite design recommendations)
Help build and maintain design systems (typography, composition, hierarchy, color theory, etc.) in Figma, including templates, guidelines, and scalable components.
Collaborate across teams to ensure design consistency across multiple channels and formats.
Conduct competitive research to spot trends, best practices, and opportunities for brand differentiation.
Translate research findings into clear insights that guide creative strategy.

You Have:
Currently pursuing a degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field.
Strong knowledge of digital design principles and fundamentals;
Proficiency in Figma (or practical tools such as Sketch, Adobe Creative Suite).
Strong attention to detail and the ability to produce polished, professional work.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with shifting priorities.
Resourceful, self-driven, and proactive—able to ask the right questions and seek solutions independently.
Open to feedback and eager to learn.
Some knowledge of UI/UX, animation, or print is a plus, but not required.

Program Eligibility:  
Enrollment in a 4-year undergraduate degree program
Graduating in Dec 2027 – July 2029 (U.S.)  
Does not require sponsorship for employment visa status (now or in the future) in the country where applying.

About the Role

Join our Global Workplace Design & Delivery team to help shape and implement our evolving office environments. This role bridges creative design and hands-on operational delivery, focusing on small-scale space planning, workplace restacking, and move management. You will collaborate with design teams, project managers, and business leaders to translate space concepts into smooth, well-executed physical transitions with minimal disruption.

  • Maintain design standard guidelines, FF&E (furniture, fixtures, and equipment) finish libraries, and project documentation repositories.

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s in Interior Design, Architecture, Facilities Management, or a related discipline.
  • Proficiency in digital design and space-planning software paired with strong organizational skills in Excel or Smartsheet.
  • Understanding of commercial office furniture systems, ergonomic guidelines, and schematic space planning principles.
  • Strong visual, written, and interpersonal communication skills to effectively interface between creative design teams and operational stakeholders.

About the Role We are looking for a creative and motivated person to join our team as a Software Engineer Intern. As a member of the Dow Jones Development team, you’ll have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience with our teams and bring our sites and products to new levels of user engagement and technology optimization. You'll use and contribute to our shared technology platforms while staying at the cutting edge of web technology, making impactful changes to heavily trafficked sites where millions will see and appreciate your work. Throughout the experience, you'll collaborate with and learn from highly skilled engineers, while also sharing your knowledge, as we continuously improve products loved by their users. Be part of a culture that fosters collaboration and allows unique perspectives to thrive. You Will: -Collaborate with engineers across other Dow Jones products to take advantage of shared technology -Understand and improve standards of code development for shared applications and services -Learn about new technologies and be able to present pros and cons of adoption in terms of business value, scalability, maintainability, and project delivery performance -Analyze complex technological problems and present solutions -Dig into product requirements to discover goals desired to make informed decisions on technical approaches -Be able to prioritize and manage work, adhering to project timelines in a fast-paced and highly collaborative environment You Have: -Completed at least two years towards your Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field -Familiarity with Javascript and javascript frameworks (React, node.js, next.js, etc.) -Understanding of capabilities with HTML5 and DOM manipulation -CSS knowledge: Grid, Flexbox, Media Queries -Familiarity with version control systems (e.g. Git) and collaborative development workflows -Excellent written and verbal communication -Proactive attitude and willingness to take on new challenges -Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and tools -Exposure to Docker, AWS or other cloud or container based application deployment a plus Program Eligibility:  Enrollment in a 4-year undergraduate degree program Graduating in Dec 2027 – July 2029 (U.S.)   Does not require sponsorship for employment visa status (now or in the future) in the country where applying. Summer 2027 Internship – Subscription Experimentation Intern Application Deadline: November 13, 2026 We encourage you to submit your application as early as possible, as internship applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. AMER Internship Dates: June 7, 2027 – August 13, 2027 (You must be available to work full-time, in-office during this period.) About Our Internship Program: Dow Jones Internship Program is a 10-week summer experience designed to give students real exposure to how . Our interns work on meaningful projects alongside our teams, gaining hands-on skills that make an impact on the business. We believe the best way to learn is by doing — that’s why you’ll be paired with a mentor, connected with senior leaders, and included in professional development sessions. You’ll also join a diverse global intern community, sharing experiences and building networks that last beyond the program. Our goal is to provide a supportive, engaging, and fun environment where your work feels valued and your growth comes first. Check out our Dow Jones Internship Program page to learn more and hear directly from past interns about their journeys. At Dow Jones, you’ll have the chance to start your career in an environment where collaboration, trust, and impact come first. About the Role: As an Experimentation Intern at Dow Jones, you will focus on understanding reader behavior and optimizing the subscription journey through testing. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will gain hands-on experience designing, tracking, and evaluating A/B and multivariate tests across our iconic consumer brands, including The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, and MarketWatch. Role based in New York City, NY. Must work from the NYC office 3x a week (Tuesday through Thursday). This internship is embedded within the Subscription Audience team and provides cross-functional exposure to teams across the organization (Acquisition, Engagement, Subscriber Revenue, Retention, Marketing Operations, Brand Marketing, Product, etc.). You Will: Research industry trends and evaluate competitor tactics to pitch your own test ideas, seeing your hypotheses evolve from an initial concept into a live digital experiment. Manage the end-to-end experiment pipeline by setting up cross-platform automations that keep tests moving smoothly from backlog grooming to real-time status updates. Build out a smart, data-rich experiment repository that maps test results to specific site features and conversion levers to easily calculate win rates and overall CVR impact. Partner with analysts to monitor live A/B and multivariate tests, diving into behavioral data and user funnels to uncover what drives readers to subscribe. Translate complex experiment results and performance dashboards into clear, exciting takeaways for cross-functional partners in Product, Engineering, and the Newsroom. You Have: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a quantitative field (Business Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, or related fields). Coursework or foundational knowledge of experimentation principles (hypothesis testing, A/B testing concepts, or statistical significance). Basic foundational knowledge of SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau). Exposure to or strong interest in learning experimentation and paywall platforms Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets for data manipulation and analysis. Ability to synthesize experimental data into clear, easy-to-understand recommendations for non-technical stakeholders. High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data integrity. Curiosity about digital audience behavior, user experience, and subscription growth strategies. Program Eligibility:  Enrollment in a 4-year undergraduate degree program Graduating in Dec 2027 – July 2029 (U.S.)   Does not require sponsorship for employment visa status (now or in the future) in the country where applying. job.description:
Job Description:

We encourage you to submit your application as early as possible, as internship applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.


AMER Internship Dates: June 7, 2027 – August 13, 2027
(You must be available to work full-time, in-office during this period.)


The Role


We’re looking for a curious, creative and organized intern to support our audio and video team. Working alongside experienced producers, you’ll help develop projects from creative conception through execution, learning how client briefs become compelling content that delivers on creative goals and stays within budget

.


This role is suited to someone interested in producing, storytelling, film, journalism or social content. No prior professional experience is required.

  • Participate in creative brainstorms and help translate client briefs into ideas for audio, video and social content.
  • Research stories, cultural trends and visual references to help shape creative concepts and presentations.

  • Support producers in building budgets, gathering estimates and tracking project expenses.
  • Help coordinate schedules, shoot logistics and production materials.
  • Assist on set and support projects through post-production and delivery.
  • Help track feedback and review content against the client brief.

You Have:


  • An interest in storytelling and how creative ideas become finished productions.
  • Curiosity about brands, audiences and what makes content engaging.
  • An enthusiasm for discovering new talent, formats and perspectives.

job.title: Vice President - Head of Consulting (Dow Jones Energy)
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.


Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.



About the Role:

As Vice President - Head of Consulting, you will lead Dow Jones Energy’s bespoke solutions business across both public and private sector markets — owning its strategy, proposition, commercial performance, and external profile. In this role, you will combine commercial leadership with operational rigor and a strong external presence, scaling a professional services practice that translates the analytical depth of Dow Jones Energy data and insights into high-impact engagements for corporate, government, and multilateral clients. You will report to the Senior Vice President - Head of Research, Consulting & Community.



You Will:
  • Design and execute the growth strategy for the Energy Consulting business, setting clear commercial, brand, and delivery targets
  • Ensure the consulting team meets or exceeds business development and growth targets
  • Drive the evolution and scaling of the consulting practice — its operating model, talent and delivery capabilities
  • Own the business with a relentless focus on customer value, output quality, business margin, expert utilization, and delivery efficiency across every engagement
  • Design, champion, and continuously evolve the Energy Consulting value proposition, articulating differentiated offerings that capitalize on Dow Jones Energy’s expertise across energy, chemicals and resources, as well as the broader Dow Jones capability suite
  • Serve as a senior external face of the business — representing Dow Jones Energy on stage, on air, and in print to shape how clients and the broader market understand global energy and chemical market dynamics
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, Research and Community leadership within Dow Jones Energy to translate our analytical depth into commercially successful consulting engagements
  • Support business development and consulting operations with travel to all regions up to 40% of time 



You Have:
  • 20+ years’ experience in the energy, chemical, or commodity consulting space
  • A track record of leading an advisory business of $20M+ in revenue with full P&L accountability and proven topline and margin growth
  • Experience presenting at industry conferences on panels and to groups of c-suite decision makers
  • Proven experience scaling a professional services business — building delivery models, talent pipelines, and operating discipline that enable durable, profitable growth
  • Experience delivering advisory work for both public sector (government, defense, multilateral) and private sector (corporate, financial) clients
  • Knowledge of and familiarity with key players and competitors in the energy and chemical consulting space
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams
  • History of successful stakeholder management at executive levels

job.title: Manager, TV Audio Infrastructure
job.description:
Who We Are:

WWE® is the global leader in sports entertainment. The company creates and delivers original content 52 weeks a year to a global audience. WWE is committed to family-friendly entertainment on its television programming, Premium Live Events, digital media, and publishing platforms. WWE's TV-PG programming can be seen in more than 1 billion households worldwide in more than 20 languages through world-class distribution partners including Netflix, ESPN, NBCUniversal, USA Network and The CW. WWE is part of TKO Group Holdings (NYSE: TKO). Additional information on WWE can be found at wwe.com and corporate.wwe.com. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Position Summary

The Manager of Broadcast TV Audio Infrastructure assists senior management with responsibilities for the design, operation, maintenance, and strategic development of audio systems while supporting live and recorded television production. This role supports a team of broadcast audio technicians, ensuring reliable, high-quality audio across studios, control rooms, remote productions, and transmission facilities. The manager works closely with production, engineering, IT, and operations teams to support current workflows while planning future technology upgrades.


Key Responsibilities

Audio Infrastructure Management

  • Oversee the operation and maintenance of broadcast audio systems, including intercoms (wired/wireless), audio-over-IP networks, RFOF systems, RF Microphones and IEM monitoring systems.
  • Develop and maintain preventative maintenance schedules and system documentation.
  • Collaborate with external vendors to prioritize, schedule, and expedite repairs, ensuring maximum system reliability and uptime.

 

Technical Leadership

  • Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex audio and broadcast infrastructure issues.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend upgrades to improve efficiency, scalability, and audio quality.
  • Collaborate with IT teams on networked audio systems.

Project Management

  • Plan and execute capital projects, upgrades, technical work books, equipment refreshes, and system integrations.
  • Coordinate installation, testing, commissioning, and acceptance of new systems.
  • Demoing new audio technologies.

Team Leadership

  • Collaborate with upper management to supervise, mentor, and develop broadcast audio engineers and technical staff.
  • Coordinate staffing and technical support coverage for live events and special productions.

 

Operational Support

  • Support live broadcast, entertainment, and special event productions.
  • Ensure compliance with FCC regulations, company standards, and industry best practices.
  • Participate in on-call escalation support for critical broadcast operations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Engineering, Audio Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in broadcast engineering, professional audio, or television infrastructure environments.
  • Extensive knowledge of broadcast audio systems, signal routing, and transmission workflows.
  • Understanding Dante platforms.
  • Strong understanding of television production environments and live broadcast operations.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large-scale network television operations.
  • Familiarity with broadcast intercom systems.
  • Professional certifications in broadcast engineering.
  • Experience with wireless communications, and Audio production technologies.

Key Competencies

  • Broadcast systems infrastructure
  • Audio engineering expertise
  • Project planning and execution
  • Problem-solving under pressure
  • This role combines broadcast audio engineering expertise with operational leadership to ensure reliable, high-quality audio delivery across all television platforms.

Hiring pay rates are based on a number of factors, including location and may vary depending on job-related qualifications, knowledge, skills and experience. job.title: Part – Time TALK SHOW CO-HOST - 93.9 The Eagle — Wake Up Missouri - Columbia, MO
job.description: Part – Time TALK SHOW CO-HOST - 93.9 The Eagle — Wake Up Missouri - Columbia, MO - Zimmer Communications Jobs Jobs | Login Location: Columbia, MO, USA Pay Rate: Pay Type: Employment Type: Part Time Email Me This Job Part - Time TALK SHOW CO-HOST - 93.9 The Eagle - Wake Up Missouri 93.9 The Eagle is looking for a dynamic Co-Host to join our top-rated morning News/Talk show, Wake Up Missouri . This is an opportunity to co-host a fast-paced, three-hour morning show heard across Missouri. ARE YOU THE PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR? Do you have an opinion about almost anything at the drop of a hat? Do you love sharing observations about your life, your experiences and the events everyone is talking about? Are you a storyteller who can turn an everyday experience into entertaining radio? Are you a team player who understands that great radio comes from chemistry, preparation and collaboration? Can you comfortably talk about news, politics, sports, movies, music and pop culture ? Are you willing to tease your fellow hosts-and be teased right back? If so, we want to hear from you. ABOUT WAKE UP MISSOURI Wake Up Missouri focuses on the biggest stories and conversations of the day. There are occasional newsmaker interviews, but the heart of the show is personality, opinions, observations, storytelling and debate . The show moves quickly. When breaking news happens, we change direction and go with it. You need to be prepared, curious, conversational and nimble enough to contribute wherever the show goes. Our target audience is clearly defined, and the show is built to give its personalities the opportunity to connect with listeners and succeed. WHAT YOU'LL GET You'll join a terrific on-air team in a supportive, creative environment. You'll also receive top-notch coaching and ongoing feedback designed to help you develop your personality, sharpen your skills and win in this role. We're looking for someone who doesn't just want to be on the radio. We're looking for someone who has something to say.
